text.body:
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ।। ।। atha brahmavaivarte brahmakhaṇḍam ।। gaṇeśabrahmaśasureśaśeṣāḥ surāśca sarve manavo munīndrāḥ ।। sarasvatīśrīgirijādikāśca yaṃ namanti devyaḥ praṇamāmi taṃ vibhuma।।1।। sthūlāstanūrvidadhataṃ triguṇaṃ virājaṃ viśvāni lomavivareṣu mahāntamādyam।। sṛṣṭyunmukhaḥ svakalayā'pi sasarja sūkṣmaṃ nityaṃ sametya hṛdi yastamajaṃ bhajāmi।।2।। dhyāyante dhyānaniṣṭhāḥ suranaramanavo yogino yogarūḍhāḥ santaḥ svapne'pi santaṃ katikatijanibhiryaṃ na paśyanti taptvā ।। dhyāye svecchāmayaṃ taṃ triguṇaparamaho nirvikāraṃ nirīhaṃ bhaktyā dhyānaikahetornirupamaruciraśyāmarūpaṃ dadhānam ।। 3 ।। vande kṛṣṇaṃ guṇātītaṃ paraṃ brahmācyutaṃ yataḥ ।। āvirbabhūvuḥ prakṛtibrahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।।4।। oṃ namo bhagavate vāsu devāya ।। nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ।। devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ।। 1 ।। amṛtaparamapūrvaṃ bhāratīkāmadhenuṃ śrutigaṇakṛtavatso vyāsadevo dudoha ।। atirucirapurāṇaṃ brahmavaivarttametatpibata pibata mugdhā dugdhamakṣayyamiṣṭam।।2।। bhārate naimiṣāraṇye ṛṣayaḥ śaunakādayaḥ ।। nityāṃ naimittikīṃ kṛtvā kriyāmūṣuḥ kuśāsane ।। 1 ।। etasminnantare sautimāgacchantaṃ yadṛcchayā ।। praṇataṃ suvinītaṃ taṃ vilokya dadurāsanam ।। 2।। taṃ sampūjyātithiṃ bhaktyā śaunako munipuṅgavaḥ।। papraccha kuśalaṃ śāṃtaṃ śāntaḥ paurāṇikaṃ mudā ।। 3 ।। vartmāyāsavinirmuktaṃ vasantaṃ susthirāsane ।। sasmitaṃ sarvatattvajñaṃ purāṇānāṃ purāṇavit ।। 4 ।। paraṃ kṛṣṇakathopetaṃ purāṇaṃ śruti saṃmatam।। maṅgalaṃ maṅgalārhaṃ ca maṅgalyaṃ maṅgalālayam ।। 5 ।। sarvamaṅgalabījaṃ ca sarvadā maṅgalapradam ।। sarvāmaṅgalanighnaṃ ca sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ param ।। 6 ।। haribhaktipradaṃ śaśvatsukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavāt ।। tattvajñānapradaṃ dāraputrapautravivarddhanam ।। 7 ।। papraccha suvinītaṃ ca suprīto munisaṃsadi ।। yathā''kāśe tārakāṇāṃ dvijarājo virājate ।। 8 ।। ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। ।। prasthānaṃ bhavataḥ kutra kuta āyāsi te śivam ।। kimasmākaṃ puṇyadinamadya tvaddarśanena ca ।। 9 ।। vayameva kalau bhītā viśiṣṭajñānavarjitāḥ ।। mumukṣavo bhave magnāstaddhetustvamihāgataḥ ।। 10 ।। bhavānsādhurmahābhāgaḥ purāṇeṣu purāṇavit ।। sarveṣu ca purāṇeṣu niṣṇāto'tikṛpānidhiḥ ।। 11 ।। śrīkṛṣṇe niścalā bhaktiryato bhavati śāśvatī ।। tatkathyatāṃ mahābhāga purāṇaṃ jñānavarddhanam ।। 12 ।। garīyasī yā sākṣācca karmamūlanikṛntanī ।। saṃsārasannibaddhānāṃ nigaḍacchedakartarī ।। 13 ।। bhavadāvāgnidagdhānāṃ pīyūṣa vṛṣṭivarṣiṇī ।। sukhadā''nandadā saute śaśvaccetasi jīvinām ।। 14 ।। yatrādau sarvabījaṃ ca paraṃ brahmanirūpaṇam ।। tasya sṛṣṭyunmukhasyāpi sṛṣṭerutkīrttanaṃ param 15 ।। sākāraṃ vā nirākāraṃ paramātmasvarūpakam ।। kimākārañca tadbrahma taddhyānaṃ kiñca bhāvanam ।। 16 ।। dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ kiṃvā śāntāśca yoginastathā ।। mataṃ pradhānaṃ keṣāṃ vā gūḍhaṃ vede nirūpitam ।। 17 ।। prakṛteśca ya ākāro yatra vatsanirūpitaḥ ।। guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yatra mahadādeśca niścayaḥ ।। 18 ।। golokavarṇanaṃ yatra yatra vaikuṇṭhavarṇanam ।। varṇanaṃ śivalokasya yatrānyat svargavarṇanam ।। 19 ।। aṃśānāṃ ca kalānāṃ ca yatra saute nirūpaṇam ।। ke prākṛtāḥ kā prakṛtiḥ ka ātmā prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 20 ।। nigūḍhaṃ janma yeṣāṃ vā devānāṃ devayoṣitām ।। samutpattiḥ samudrāṇāṃ śailānāṃ saritāmapi ।। 21 ।। ke vāṃ'śāḥ prakṛteścāpi kalāḥ kā vā kalākalāḥ ।। tāsāñca caritaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāstotrādikaṃ śubham ।। 22 ।। durgā sarasvatī lakṣmī sāvitrīṇāñca varṇanam ।। yatraiva rādhikākhyānamatyapūrvaṃ sudhopamam ।। 23 ।। jīvakarmavipākaśca narakāṇāñca varṇanam ।। karmaṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ yatra yatra tebhyo vimokṣaṇam ।। 24 ।। yeṣāñca jīvināṃ yadyatsthānaṃ yatra śubhāśubham।। jīvināṃ karmaṇo yasmādyāsu yāsu ca yoniṣu।। 25 ।। jīvināṃ karmaṇo yasmādyoyo rogo bhavediha ।। mokṣaṇaṃ karmaṇo yasmātteṣāñca tannirūpaya ।। 25 ।। manasā tulasī kālī gaṅgā pṛdhvī vasundharā ।। āsāṃ yatra śubhākhyānamanyāsāmapi yatra vai ।। 27 ।। śāligrāmaśilānāñca dānānāñca nirūpaṇam ।। apūrvaṃ yatra vā saute dharmādharmanirūpaṇam ।। 28 ।। gaṇeśvarasya caritaṃ yatra tajjanma karma ca ।। kavacastotramantrāṇāṃ gūḍhānāṃ yatra varṇanam ।। 29 ।। yadapūrvamupākhyānamaśrutaṃ paramādbhutam ।। kṛtvā manasi tatsarvaṃ sāmprataṃ vaktumarhasi ।। 30 ।। yatra janma bhramo viśve puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। paripūrṇatamasyāpi kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 31 ।। janma kasya gṛhe labdhaṃ puṇye puṇyavato mune ।। sutaṃ prasūtā kā dhanyā mānyā puṇyavatī satī ।। 32 ।। āvirbhūya ca tadgehātkvāgataḥ kena hetunā ।। gatvā kiṃ kṛtavāṃstatra kathaṃ vā punarāgataḥ ।। 33 ।। bhārāvataraṇaṃ kena prārthito goścakāra saḥ ।। vidhāya kiṃvā setuṃ ca golokaṃ gatavānpunaḥ ।। 34 ।। itīdamanyadākhyānaṃ purāṇaṃ śrutidurlabham ।। durvijñeyaṃ munīnāṃ ca manonirmalakāraṇam ।। 35 ।। svajñānādyanmayā pṛṣṭamapṛṣṭaṃ vā śubhāśubham ।। sadyo vairāgyajananaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 36 ।। śiṣyapṛṣṭamapṛṣṭaṃ vā vyākhyānaṃ kurute ca yaḥ ।। sa sadguruḥ satāṃ śreṣṭho yogyāyogye ca yaḥ samaḥ ।। 37 ।। sautiruvāca ।। sarvaṃ kuśalamasmākaṃ tvatpādapadmadarśanāt ।। siddhakṣetrādāgato'haṃ yāmi nārāyaṇāśramam ।। 38 ।। dṛṣṭvā viprasamūhaṃ ca namaskartumihāgataḥ ।। draṣṭuṃ ca naimiṣāraṇyaṃ puṇyadaṃ cāpi bhārate ।। 39 ।। devaṃ vipraṃ guruṃ dṛṣṭvā na namedyastu saṃbhramāt ।। sa kālasūtraṃ vrajati yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 40 ।। harirbrāhmaṇarūpekṣaṇa śaśvad bhramati bhūtale ।। sukṛtī praṇametpuṇyādbrāhmaṇaṃ harirūpiṇam ।। 41 ।। bhagavanyattvayā pṛṣṭaṃ jñātaṃ sarvamabhīpsitam ।। sārabhūtaṃ purāṇeṣu brahmavaivarttamuttamam ।। ।। 42 ।। purāṇopapurāṇānāṃ vedānāṃ bhramabhañjanam ।। haribhaktipradaṃ sarvatattvajñānavivarddhanam ।। 43 ।। kāmināṃ kāmadaṃ cedaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ ca mokṣadam ।। bhaktipradaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ kalpavṛkṣasvarūpakam ।। 44 ।। brahmakhaṇḍaṃ sarvabījaṃ parabrahmanirūpaṇam ।। dhyāyante yoginaḥ santo vaiṣṇavā yatparātparam ।।45।। vaiṣṇavā yoginaḥ santo na ca bhinnāśca śaunaka ।। svājñānaparipākena bhavanti jīvinaḥ kramāt ।। ।।46।। santo bhavanti satsaṅgādyogisaṃgena yoginaḥ ।। vaiṣṇavā bhaktasaṃgena kramātsadyoginaḥ parāḥ ।।47।। yatrodbhavaśca devānāṃ devīnāṃ sarvajīvinām ।। tataḥ prakṛtikhaṇḍe ca devīnāṃ caritaṃ śubham ।। 48 ।। jīvakarmavipākaśca śāligrāmanirūpaṇam ।। tāsāṃ ca kavaca stotramantrapūjānirūpaṇam ।। 49 ।। prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ tatra kalāṃśānāṃ nirūpaṇam ।। kīrtterutkīrtanaṃ tāsāṃ prabhāvaśca nirūpitaḥ ।। 50 ।। sukṛtīnāṃ duṣkṛtīnāṃ yadyatsthānaṃ śubhāśubham ।। varṇanaṃ narakāṇāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।। 51 ।। tato gaṇeśakhaṇḍe ca tajjanma parikīrtitam ।। atīvāpūrvacaritaṃ śrutivedasudurlabham ।। 52 ।। gaṇeśabhṛgusaṃvāde sarvatattvanirūpaṇam ।। nigūḍhakavacastotramantratantra nirūpaṇam ।। 53 ।। śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ ca tataḥ param ।। bhārate puṇyakṣetre ca śrīkṛṣṇajanma karma ca ।। 54 ।। bhuvo bhārāvataraṇaṃ krīḍākautukamaṅgalam ।। satāṃ setuvidhānaṃ ca janmakhaṇḍe nirūpitam ।। 55 ।। idaṃ te kathitaṃ vipra purāṇapravaraṃ param ।। catuḥkhaṇḍaiḥ parimitaṃ sarvadharmanirūpaṇam ।। 56 ।। sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ śrīdaṃ sarvāśāpūrṇakāraṇam ।। brahmavaivartakaṃ nāma sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam ।। 57 ।। sārabhūtaṃ purāṇeṣu kevalaṃ vedasaṃmitam ।। vivṛtaṃ brahmakārtsnyaṃ ca kṛṣṇena yatra śaunaka ।। 58 ।। brahmavaivartakaṃ tena pravadanti purāvidaḥ ।। idaṃ purāṇasūtraṃ ca purā dattaṃ ca brahmaṇe ।। 59 ।। nirāmaye ca goloke kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। mahātīrthe puṣkare ca dattaṃ dharmāya brahmaṇā ।। 60।। dharmeṇa dattaṃ putrāya prītyā nārāyaṇāya ca ।।61।। nārado vyāsadevāya pradadau jāhnavītaṭe ।। vyāsaḥ purāṇasūtraṃ tatsaṃvyasya vipulaṃ mahat ।। 62 ।। mahyaṃ dadau siddhakṣetre puṇyadeśe manoharam ।। mayedaṃ kathitaṃ brahmaṃstatsamagraṃ niśāmaya ।। 63 ।। aṣṭādaśasahasraṃ tu vyāsenedaṃ purāṇakam ।। purāṇakārtsnyaśravaṇe yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnamadhyāyaśravaṇena ca ।। 64 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe'nukramaṇikā nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 ।।
<1.2> śaunaka uvāca ।। kimapūrvaṃ śrutaṃ saute paramādbhutamīpsitam ।। sarvaṃ kathaya saṃvyasya brahmakhaṇḍamanuttamam ।। 1 ।। sautiruvāca ।। vande guroḥ pādapadmaṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ ।। hariṃ devāndvijānnatvā dharmānvakṣye sanātanān ।। 2 ।। yacchrutaṃ vyāsavaktreṇa brahmakhaṇḍamanuttamam ।। ajñānāndhatamodhvaṃsi jñānavartmapradīpakam ।।3।। jyotiḥsamūhaṃ pralaye purā''sītkevalaṃ dvija ।। sūryyakoṭiprabhaṃ nityamasaṃkhyaṃ viśvakāraṇam ।।4 ।। svecchāmayasya ca vibhostajjyotirujjvalaṃ mahat ।। jyotirabhyantare lokatrayameva manoharam ।।5।। teṣāmupari golokaṃ nityamīśvaravad dvija।। trikoṭiyojanāyāmavistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalākṛti ।।6।। tejaḥsvarūpaṃ sumahadratnabhūmimayaṃ param।। adṛśyaṃ yogibhiḥ svapne dṛśyaṃ gamyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ ।।7।। yogena dhṛtamīśena cāntarikṣasthitaṃ varam ।। ādhivyādhijarāmṛtyuśokabhītivivarjitam ।। 8 ।। sadratnaracitāsaṃkhyamandiraiḥ pariśobhitam ।। laye kṛṣṇayutaṃ sṛṣṭau gopagopībhirāvṛtam ।। 9 ।। tadadho dakṣiṇe savye pañcāśatkoṭiyojanān ।। vaikuṇṭhaṃ śivalokaṃ tu tatsamaṃ sumanoharam ।। 10 ।। koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ maṇḍalākṛti ।। laye śūnyaṃ ca sṛṣṭau ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇānvitam ।। 11 ।। caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaiśca jarāmṛtyvādivarjitam ।। savye ca śivalokaṃ ca koṭiyojanavistṛtam ।। 12 ।। laye śūnyaṃ ca sṛṣṭau ca sapārṣadaśivānvitam ।। golokābhyantare jyotiratīva sumanoharam ।। 13 ।। paramāhlādakaṃ śaśvatparamānandakārakam ।। dhyāyante yoginaḥ śaśvadyogena jñānacakṣuṣā ।।14।। tadevānandajanakaṃ nirākāraṃ parātparam ।। tajjyotirantare rūpamatīva sumanoharam ।। 15 ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ raktapaṅkajalocanam।। śāradīyapārvaṇenduśobhitaṃ cāmalānanam ।। 16 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāma manoramam ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sasmitaṃ pītavāsasam ।।11।। sadratnabhūṣaṇaughena bhūṣitaṃ bhaktavatsalam।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ।। 18 ।। śrīvatsavakṣaḥsaṃbhrājatkaustubhena virājitam ।। sadratnasāraracitakirīṭamukuṭojjvalam ।। 19 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। tadeva paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 20 ।। svecchāmayaṃ sarvabījaṃ sarvādhāraṃ parātparam ।। kiśoravayasaṃ śaśvadgopaveṣavidhāyakam ।। 21 ।। koṭipūrṇenduśobhāḍhyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। nirīhaṃ nirvikāraṃ ca paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum ।।22।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ śāntaṃ rāseśvaraṃ varam ।। māṅgalyaṃ maṅgalārhaṃ ca māṅgalyaṃ maṅgalapradam।।23।। paramānandabījaṃ ca satyamakṣaramavyayam ।। । sarvasiddheśvaraṃ sarvasiddhirūpaṃ ca siddhidam।।24।। prakṛteḥ paramīśānaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityavigraham।। ādyaṃ puruṣamavyaktaṃ puruhūtaṃ puruṣṭutam।।25।। satyaṃ svatantramekaṃ ca paramātmasvarūpakam ।। dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ śāntāḥ śāntaṃ tanparamāyaṇam ।। 26 ।। evaṃrūpaṃ paraṃ bibhradbhagavāneka eva saḥ ।। digbhiśca nabhasā sārddhaṃ śūnyaṃ viśvaṃ dadarśa ha ।।27।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe parabrahmanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 2 ।।
<1.3> sautiruvāca ।। dṛṣṭvā śūnyamayaṃ viśvaṃ golokaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram।। nirjantu nirjalaṃ ghoraṃ nirvātaṃ tamasā vṛtam ।। 1 ।। vṛkṣaśailasamudrādivihīnaṃ vikṛtākṛtam ।। nirmuktikaṃ ca nirdhātu niḥsasyaṃ nistṛṇaṃ dvija।।2।। ālocya manasā sarvameka evāsahāyavān ।। svecchayā sraṣṭumārebhe sṛṣṭiṃ svecchāmayaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 3 ।। āvirbabhūvuḥ sargādau puṃso dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ ।। bhavakāraṇarūpāśca mūrtimantastrayo guṇāḥ ।। 4 ।। tato mahānahaṅkāraḥ pañcatanmātra eva ca ।। rūparasagandhasparśaśabdāścaivetisaṃjñakāḥ ।। 5 ।। āvirbabhūva paścātsvayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। śyāmo yuvā pītavāsā vanamālī caturbhujaḥ ।। 6 ।। śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ smeramukhāmbujaḥ ।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ śārṅgī kaustubhabhūṣaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।। śrīvatsavakṣāḥ śrīvāsaḥ śrīvidhiḥ śrīvibhāvanaḥ ।। śāradenduprabhāmṛṣṭasukhendusumano haraḥ ।। 8 ।। kāmadevaprabhāmṛṣṭarūpalāvaṇyasundaraḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇapurataḥ sthitvā tuṣṭāva taṃ puṭāñjaliḥ ।। 9 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varārhaṃ varakāraṇam ।। kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca karma tatkarmakāraṇam ।। 10 ।। tapastatphaladaṃ śaśvattapasvīśaṃ ca tāpasam ।। vande navaghanaśyāmaṃ svātmārāmaṃ manoharam ।।11।। niṣkāmaṃ kāmarūpaṃ ca kāmaghnaṃ kāmakāraṇam।। sarvaṃ sarveśvaraṃ sarvaṃ bījarūpamanuttamam ।। ।। 12 ।। vedarūpaṃ vedabhavaṃ vedoktaphaladaṃ phalam ।। vedajñaṃ tadvidhānaṃ ca sarvavedavidāṃvaram ।। 13 ।। ityuktvā bhaktiyuktaśca sa uvāsa tadājñayā ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye purataḥ paramātmanaḥ ।। 14 ।। nārāyaṇakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhetsusamāhitaḥ ।। trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ pāpaṃ tasya na vidyate ।। 15 ।। putrārthī labhate putraṃ bhāryyārthī labhate priyām ।। bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ dhanaṃ bhraṣṭadhano labhet ।।16।। kārāgāre vipadgrastaḥ stotreṇānena mucyate ।। rogātpramucyate rogī dhruvaṃ śrutvā ca saṃyataḥ ।। 17 ।। sautiruvāca ।। āvirbabhūva tatpaścādātmano vāmapārśvataḥ ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ pañcavaktro digambaraḥ ।। 18 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābha jaṭābhāradharo varaḥ ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyastrinetraścandraśekharaḥ ।। 19 ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharo japamālākaraḥ paraḥ ।। sarvasiddheśvaraḥ siddho yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 20 ।। mṛtyormṛtyurīśvaraśca mṛtyurmṛtyuñjayaḥ śivaḥ ।। jñānānando mahājñānī mahājñānapradaḥ paraḥ ।।21।। pūrṇacandraprabhāmṛṣṭamukhadṛśyo manoharaḥ ।। vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca pravaraḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā।।22।। śrīkṛṣpurataḥ sthitvā tuṣṭāva taṃ puṭāñjaliḥ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro'tigadgadaḥ।।23।। mahādeva uvāca ।। jayasvarūpaṃ jayadaṃ jayeśaṃ jayakāraṇam ।। pravaraṃ jayadānāṃ ca vande tamaparājitam ।। 24 ।। viśvaṃ viśveśvareśaṃ ca viśveśaṃ viśvakāraṇam ।। viśvādhāraṃ ca viśvastaṃ viśvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। 25 ।। viśvarakṣākāraṇaṃ ca viśvaghnaṃ viśvajaṃ param ।। phalabījaṃ phalādhāraṃ phalaṃ ca tatphalapradam ।। 26 ।। tejaḥsvarūpaṃ tejodaṃ sarvatejasvināṃ varam ।। ityevamuktvā taṃ natvā ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। nārāyaṇaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya sa uvāsa tadājñayā ।। 27 ।। iti śambhukṛtaṃ stotraṃ yo janaḥ saṃyataḥ paṭhet ।। sarvasiddhirbhavettasya vijayaṃ ca pade pade ।। 28 ।। santataṃ varddhate mitraṃ dhanamaiśvaryyameva ca ।। śatrusainyaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti duḥkhāni duritāni ca ।। 29 ।। iti brahmavaivarte śambhukṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram ।। sautiruvāca ।। āvirvabhūva tatpaścātkṛṣṇasya nābhipaṅkajāt ।। mahātapasvī vṛddhaśca kamaṇḍalukaro varaḥ ।। 30 ।। śuklavāsāḥ śukladantaḥ śuklakeśaścaturmukhaḥ ।। yogīśaḥ śilpināmīśaḥ sarveṣāṃ janako guruḥ ।। 31 ।। tapasāṃ phaladātā ca pradātā sarvasampadām ।। sraṣṭā vidhātā karttā ca harttā ca sarvakarmaṇām ।।32 ।। dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ jñātā vedaprasūpatiḥ ।। śāntaḥ sarasvatīkāntaḥ suśīlaśca kṛpānidhiḥ।।33> śrīkṛṣṇapurataḥ sthitvā tuṣṭāva taṃ puṭāñjaliḥ ।। pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgo bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। 34 ।। ।। brahmovāca ।। ।। kṛṣṇaṃ vande guṇātītaṃ govindamekamakṣaram ।। avyaktamavyayaṃ vyaktaṃ gopaveṣavidhāyinam ।। 35 ।। kiśoravayasaṃ śāntaṃ gopīkāntaṃ manoharam ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram।।36।। vṛndāvanavanābhyarṇe rāsamaṇḍalasaṃsthitam ।। rāseśvaraṃ rāsavāsaṃ rāsollāsasamutsukam।।37।। ityevamuktvā taṃ natvā ratnasiṃhāsane varam ।। nārāyaṇeśau saṃbhāṣya sa uvāsa tadājñayā ।। 38 ।। iti brahmakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet।। pāpāni tasya naśyanti duḥsvapnaḥ susvapno bhavet ।। 39 ।। bhaktirbhavati govinde śrīputrapautravarddhinī ।। akīrtiḥ kṣayamāpnoti satkīrttirvarddhate ciram ।। 40 ।। iti brahmavaivartte brahmakṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram ।। sautiruvāca ।। āvirbabhūva tatpaścādvakṣasaḥ paramātmanaḥ ।। sasmitaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścicchuklavarṇo jaṭādharaḥ ।। 41 ।। sarvasākṣī ca sarvajñaḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। samaḥ sarvatra sadayo hiṃsākopavivarjitaḥ ।। 42 ।। dharmajñānayuto dharmo dharmiṣṭho dharmado bhavet ।। sa eva dharmiṇāṃ dharmaḥ paramātmā phalodbhavaḥ ।। 43 ।। śrīkṛṣṇapurataḥ sthitvā praṇamya daṇḍavadbhuvi ।। tuṣṭāva paramātmānaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvakāmadam ।। 44 ।। śrīdharma uvāca ।। ।। kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāsudevaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। govindaṃ paramānandamekamakṣaramacyutam ।। 45 ।। gopeśvaraṃ ca gopīśaṃ gopaṃ gorakṣakaṃ vibhum ।। gavāmīśaṃ ca goṣṭhasthaṃ govatsapucchadhāriṇam ।।46।। gogopagopīmadhyasthaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣottamam ।।47।। ityuccāryya samuttiṣṭhanratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśāṃstānsambhāṣya sa uvāsa ha।।48।। caturviśatināmāni dharmavaktrodgatāni ca।। yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya sa sukhī sarvato jayī ।।49।। mṛtyukāle harernāma tasya sādhyaṃ labhed dhuvam ।। sa yātyante hareḥ sthānaṃ haridāsyaṃ bhaveddhruvam ।। 50।। nityaṃ dharmastaṃ ghaṭate nādharme tadratirbhavet ।। caturvarga phalaṃ tasya śaśvatkaragataṃ bhavet।।51।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāpāni palāyante bhayena ca।। bhayāni caiva duḥkhāni vainateyamivoragāḥ।।52।। iti brahmavaivartte dharmakṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram ।। sautiruvāca ।। āvirbabhūva kanyaikā dharmasya vāmapārśvataḥ ।। mūrttirmūrtimatī sākṣāddvitīyā kamalālayā ।।53 ।। āvirbabhūva tatpaścānmukhataḥ paramātmanaḥ ।। ekā devī śuklavarṇā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī ।।54।। koṭipūrṇenduśobhā ḍhyā śaratpaṅkajalocanā ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 55 ।। sasmitā sudatī śyāmā sundarīṇāṃ ca sundarī ।। śreṣṭhā śrutīnāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ viduṣāṃ jananī parā ।। 56 ।। vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kavīnāmiṣṭadevatā ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca śāntarūpā sarasvatī ।। 57 ।। govindapurataḥ sthitvā jagau prathamataḥ sukham ।। tannāmaguṇakīrtiṃ ca vīṇayā sā nanartta ca ।। 58 ।। kṛtāni yāni karmāṇi kalpekalpe yugeyuge ।। tāni sarvāṇi hariṇā tuṣṭāva saṃpuṭāṃjaliḥ ।।59।। sarasvatyuvāca ।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rāsollāsasamutsukam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 60 ।। rāseśvaraṃ rāsakaraṃ varaṃ rāseśvarīśvaram ।। rāsādhiṣṭhātṛdaivaṃ ca vande rāsavinodinam ।।61।। rāsāyāsapariśrāntaṃ rāsarāsavihāriṇam ।। rāsotsukānāṃ gopīnāṃ kāntaṃ śāntaṃ manoharam।।62।। praṇamya ca tamityuktvā prahṛṣṭavadanā satī ।। uvāsa sā sakāmā ca ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। 63 ।। iti vāṇīkṛtaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭheta ।। buddhimāndhanavānso'pi vidyāvānputravānsadā ।।64।। iti brahmavaivarte sarasvatīkṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram ।। sautiruvāca।। āvirbabhūva manasaḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। ekā devī gauravarṇā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā ।। 65 ।। pītavastraparīdhānā sasmitā navayauvanā ।। sarvaiśvaryyādhidevī sā sarvasampatphalapradā ।। svarge ca svargalakṣmīśca rājalakṣmīśca rājasu ।। 66 ।। sā hareḥ purataḥ sthitvā paramātmānamīśvaram ।। tuṣṭāva praṇatā sādhvī bhaktinamrātmakandharā ।। 67 ।। mahālakṣmīruvāca ।। satyasvarūpaṃ satyeśaṃ satyabījaṃ sanātanam ।। satyādhāraṃ ca satyajñaṃ satyamūlaṃ namāmyaham ।। 68 ।। ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā sā covāsa sukhāsane ।। taptakāṃcanavarṇābhā bhāsayantī diśastviṣā ।। 69 ।। āvirbabhūva tatpaścād buddheśca paramātmanaḥ ।। sarvādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 70 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhā sūryyakoṭisamaprabhā ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā śaratpaṅkajalocanā ।। 71 ।। raktavastraparīdhānā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। nidrātṛṣṇā kṣutpipāsā dayā śraddhā kṣamādikāḥ ।। 72 ।। tāsāṃ ca sarvaśaktīnāmīśādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। bhayaṅkarī śatabhujā durgā durgārtināśinī ।। 73 ।। ātmanaḥ śaktirūpā sā jagatāṃ jananī parā ।। triśūlaśaktiśārṅgaṃ ca dhanuḥkhaḍgaśarāṇi ca ।। 74 ।। śaṃkha cakragadāpadmamakṣamālāṃ kamaṇḍalum ।। vajramaṅkuśapāśaṃ ca bhuśuṇḍīdaṇḍatomaram ।।75।। nārāyaṇāstraṃ brahmāstraṃ raudraṃ pāśupataṃ tathā ।। pārjjanyaṃ vāruṇaṃ vāhnaṃ gāndharvaṃ bibhratī satī ।। kṛṣṇasya purataḥ sthitvā tuṣṭāva taṃ mudā'nvitā ।। 76 ।। prakṛtiruvāca।। ahaṃ prakṛtirīśānā sarveśā sarvarūpiṇī ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca mayā ca śaktimajjagat ।। 77 ।। tvayā sṛṣṭā na svatantrā tvameva jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। gatiśca pātā sraṣṭā ca saṃharttā ca punarvidhiḥ ।। 78 ।। sraṣṭuṃ sraṣṭā ca saṃhartuṃ saṃhartā vedhasā vidhiḥ ।। paramānandarūpaṃ tvāṃ vande cānandapūrvakam ।। cakṣurnimeṣakāle ca brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet ।। 79 ।। tasya prabhāvamatulaṃ varṇituṃ kaḥ kṣamo vibho ।। bhrūbhaṅgalīlāmātreṇa viṣṇukoṭiṃ sṛjettu yaḥ ।। 80 ।। carācarāṃśca viśveṣu devānbrahmapurogamān ।। madvidhāḥ kati vā devīḥ sraṣṭuṃ śaktaśca līlayā ।। 81 ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ svīḍyaṃ vande cānandapūrvakam ।। mahānvirāḍ yatkalāṃśo viśvasaṃkhyāśrayo vibho ।। vande cānandapūrvaṃ taṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 82 ।। yaṃ ca stotumaśaktāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। vedā ahaṃ ca vāṇī ca vande taṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 83 ।। vedāśca viduṣāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ stotuṃ śaktāśca na kṣamāḥ ।। nirlakṣyaṃ kaḥ kṣamaḥ stotuṃ taṃ nirīhaṃ namāmyaham ।। 84 ।। ityevamuktvā sā durgā ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। uvāsa natvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭuvustāṃ sureśvarāḥ ।।85।। iti durgākṛtaṃ stotraṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। yaḥ paṭhedarccanākāle sa jayī sarvataḥ sukhī।। 86 ।। durgā tasya gṛhaṃ tyaktvā naiva yāti kadācana ।। bhavābdhau yaśasā bhāti yātyante śrīhareḥ puram ।। 67 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde sṛṣṭinirūpaṇe durgāstotraṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 3 ।।
<1.4> sautiruvāca ।। āvirbabhūva tatpaścātkṛṣṇasya rasanāgrataḥ ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśā devī caikā manoharā ।। 1 ।। śuklavastraparīdhānā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā ।। bibhratī japamālāṃ ca sā sāvitrī prakīrtitā ।। 2 ।। sā tuṣṭāva puraḥ sthitvā paraṃ brahma sanātanam।। puṭāṃjaliparā sādhvī bhaktinamrātmakandharā ।। 3 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। namāmi sarvabījaṃ tvāṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ।। parātparataraṃ śyāmaṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanam ।। 4> ityuktvā sasmitā devī ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। uvāsa śrīhariṃ natvā punareva śrutiprasūḥ ।। 5 ।। āvirbabhūva tatpaścātkṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। mānasācca pumānekastaptakāṃcanasannibhaḥ ।। 6 ।। mano mathnāti sarveṣāṃ pañcabāṇena kāminām ।। tannāma manmathaṃ tena pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 7 ।। tasya puṃso vāmapārśvātkāmasya kāminī varā ।। babhūvātīva lalitā sarveṣāṃ mohakāriṇī ।। 8 ।। ratirbabhūva sarveṣāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sasmitāṃ satīm ।। ratīti tena tannāma pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 9 ।। hariṃ stutvā tayā sārddhaṃ sa uvāsa hareḥ puraḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsane cāsya pañcabāṇo dhanurddharaḥ ।। 10।। māraṇaṃ stambhanaṃ caiva jṛmbhaṇaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tathā ।। unmādanaṃ pañcabāṇanpañcabāṇo bibharti saḥ ।। ।। 11 ।। bāṇāṃścikṣepa sarvāṃśca kāmo bāṇaparīkṣayā ।। sadyaḥ sarve sakāmāśca babhūvurīśvarecchayā ।। 12 ।। ratiṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇaśca retaḥ pāto vabhūva ha ।। tatra tasthau mahāyogī vastreṇācchādya lajjayā ।। 13 ।। vastraṃ dagdhvā samuttasthau jvaladagniḥ sureśvaraḥ ।। koṭitālapramāṇaśca saśikhaśca samujjvalan ।। 14 ।। kṛṣṇastadvarddhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā sasarjāpaḥ svalīlayā ।। niḥśvāsavāyunā sārddhaṃ mukhabinduṃ samudgiran ।। 15 ।। viśvaughaṃ plāvayāmāsa mukhabiṃdujalaṃ dvija ।। tatra kiñcijjalakaṇaṃ vahniṃ śāntaṃ cakāra ha ।। 16 ।। tataḥprabhṛti tenāgnistoyānnirvāṇatāṃ vrajet ।। āvirbhūtaḥ pumānekastatastadadhidevatā ।। 17 ।। uttasthau tajjalādekaḥ pumānsa varuṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। jalādhiṣṭhātṛdevo'sau sarveṣāṃ yādasāmpatiḥ ।। 18 ।। āvirbabhūva kanyaikā tadvahnervāmapārśvataḥ ।। sā svāhā vahnipatnī tāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 19 ।। jaleśasya vāmapārśvātkanyā caikā babhūva sā ।। varuṇānīti vikhyātā varuṇasya priyā satī ।। 20 ।। babhūva pavanaḥ śrīmānvibhorniśvāsavāyutaḥ।। sa ca prāṇāśca sarveṣāṃ niḥśvāsastatphalodbhavaḥ।।21।। tasya vāyorvāmapārśvātkanyā caikā babhūva ha।। vāyoḥ patnī sā ca devī vāyavī parikīrtitā ।।22।। kṛṣṇasya kāmabāṇena retaḥpāto babhūva ha ।। jale tadrecanaṃ cakre lajjayā sura saṃsadi ।। 23 ।। sahasravatsarānte taḍḍimbharūpaṃ babhūva ha ।। tato mahānvirāḍ jajñe viśvaughādhāra eva saḥ ।। 24 ।। yasyaika lomavivare viśvaikasya vyavasthitiḥ ।। sthūlātsthūlataraḥ so'pi mahānnānyastataḥ paraḥ ।। 25 ।। sa eva ṣoḍaśāṃśo'pi kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। mahāviṣṇuḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 26 ।। mahārṇave śayānaḥ sa padmapatraṃ yathā jale ।। babhūvatustau dvau daityau tasya karṇamalodbhavau ।। 27 ।। tau jalācca samutthāya brahmāṇaṃ hantumudyatau ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavāñjaghane tau jaghāna ha ।। 28 ।। babhūva medinī kṛtsnā kārtsnyena medasā tayā ।। tatraiva santi viśvāni sā ca devī vasundharā ।। 29 ।। ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde sṛṣṭinirūpaṇe caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 4 ।। ।।
<1.5> ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। ।। gogopagopyo goloke kiṃ nityāḥ kiṃnu kalpitāḥ ।। mama saṃdehabhedārthaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। ।। sautiruvāca ।। ।। sarvādisṛṣṭau tāḥ klṛptāḥ pralaye pralaye sthitāḥ ।। sarvādisṛṣṭikathanaṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ dvija ।। 2 ।। sarvādisṛṣṭau klṛptau ca nārāyaṇamaheśvarau ।। pralaye pralaye vyaktau sthitau tau prakṛtiśca sā।।3।। sarvādau brahmakalpasya caritaṃ kathitaṃ dvija ।। vārāhapādmakalpau dvau kathayiṣyāmi śroṣyasi ।। 4 ।। brāhmavārāhapādmāśca kalpāśca trividhā mune ।। yathāyugāni catvāri krameṇa kathitāni ca ।। 5 ।। satyaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam ।। triśataiśca ṣaṣṭyadhikairyugairdivyaṃ yugaṃ smṛtam ।। 6 ।। manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ ।। caturdaśeṣu manuṣu gateṣu brahmaṇo dinam ।। 7 ।। triśataiśca ṣaṣṭyadhikairdinairvarṣaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ ।। aṣṭottaraṃ varṣaśataṃ vidherāyurnirūpitam ।। 8 ।। etannimeṣakālastu kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। brahmaṇaścāyuṣā kalpaḥ kālavidbhirnirūpitaḥ ।। 9 ।। kṣudrakalpā bahutarāste saṃvartādayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। saptakalpāṃtajīvī sa mārkaṇḍeyaśca tanmataḥ ।। 10।। brahmaṇaśca dinenaiva sa kalpaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। vidheśca saptadivase munerāyurnirūpitam ।। 11 ।। brāhmavārāhapādmāśca trayaḥ kalpā nirūpitāḥ ।। kalpatraye yathā sṛṣṭiḥ kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 12 ।। brāhme ca medinīṃ sṛṣṭvā sraṣṭā sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ ।। madhukaiṭabhayoścaiva medasā cājñayā prabhoḥ ।।13।। vārāhe tāṃ samuddhṛtya luptāṃ magnāṃ rasātalāt ।। viṣṇorvarāharūpasya dvārā cātiprayatnataḥ ।। 14 ।। pādme viṣṇornābhipadme sraṣṭā sṛṣṭiṃ vinirmame ।। trilokīṃ brahmalokāntāṃ nityalokatrayaṃ vinā ।। 15 ।। etattu kālasaṃkhyānamuktaṃ sṛṣṭinirūpaṇe ।। kiṃcinnirūpaṇaṃ sṛṣṭe kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 16 ।। ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। ।। ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ cakāra bhagavānsātvatāṃpatiḥ ।। etānsṛṣṭvā kiṃ cakāra tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 17 ।। ।। sautiruvāca ।। ।। ataḥ paraṃ tu goloke golokeśo mahānprabhuḥ ।। etānsṛṣṭvā jagāmāsau suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। etaiḥ sametairbhagavānatīva kamanīyakam ।। 18 ।। ramyāṇāṃ kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ madhye'tīva manoharam ।। suvistīrṇaṃ ca susamaṃ susnigdhaṃ maṇḍalīkṛtam ।। 19 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiśca susaṃskṛtam ।। dadhilājasaktudhānyadūrvāparṇapariplutam ।। 20 ।। paṭṭasūtragranthiyuktaṃ navacandanapallavaiḥ ।। saṃyuktarambhāstambhānāṃ samūhaiḥ pariveṣṭitam ।। 21 ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇamaṇḍapānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ।। ratnapradīpajvalitaiḥ puṣpadhūpādivāsitaiḥ।।22।। śṛṃgārārhabhogavastusamūhapariveṣṭitam।। atīva lalitākalpatalpayuktaiḥ suśobhitam ।। 23 ।। tatra gatvā ca taiḥ sārdhaṃ samuvāsa jagatpatiḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā rāsaṃ vismitāste babhūvurmunisattama ।। 24 ।। āvirbabhūva kanyaikā kṛṣṇasya vāmapārśvataḥ ।। dhāvitvā puṣpamānīya dadāvarghyaṃ prabhoḥ pade ।। 25 ।। rāse saṃbhūya goloke sā dadhāva hareḥ puraḥ ।। tena rādhā samākhyātā purāvidbhirdvijottama ।। 26 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। āvirbabhūva prāṇebhyaḥ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ।। 27 ।। devī ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā navayauvanasaṃyutā ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā sasmitā sumanoharā ।। 28 ।। sukomalāṃgī lalitā sundarīṣu ca sundarī ।। bṛhannitambabhārārttā pīnaśroṇipayodharā ।। 29 ।। bandhujīvajitā raktasundaroṣṭhā dharāvarā ।। muktāpaṅktijitā cārudantapaṃktirmanoharā ।। 30 ।। śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduśobhāmṛṣṭaśubhānanā ।। cārusīmantinīcāruśaratpaṅkajalocanā।। 31 ।। khagendracañcuvijitacārunāsā manoharā ।। svarṇagaṇḍūkavijite gaṇḍayugme ca bibhratī ।। 32 ।। dadhatī cārukarṇe ca ratnābharaṇabhūṣite ।। candanāgurukastūrīyuktakuṃkumabindubhiḥ ।। 33 ।। sindūrabindusaṃyuktasukapolā manoharā ।। susaṃskṛtaṃ keśapāśaṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।। 34 ।। sugandhakabarībhāraṃ sundaraṃ dadhatī satī ।। sthalapadmaprabhāmuṣṭaṃ pādayugmaṃ ca bibhratī ।। 35 ।। gamanaṃ kurvatī sā ca haṃsakhañjanagañjanam ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇāṃ vanamālī manoharām।।36।। hāraṃ hīrakanirmāṇaṃ ratnakeyūrakaṅkaṇam ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇaṃ pāśakaṃ sumanoharam ।। 37 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam ।। nānāprakāracitrāḍhyaṃ sundaraṃ paribibhratī ।। 38 ।। sā ca sambhāṣya govindaṃ ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। uvāsa sasmitā bhartuḥ paśyantī mukhapaṅkajam ।। 39 ।। tasyāśca lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyo gopāṅganāgaṇaḥ ।। āvirbabhūva rūpeṇa veśenaiva ca tatsamaḥ ।। 40 ।। lakṣakoṭīparimitaḥ śaśvatsusthirayauvanaḥ ।। saṃkhyāvidbhiśca saṃkhyāto goloke gopikāgaṇaḥ ।। 41 ।। kṛṣṇasya lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyo gopagaṇo mune ।। āvirbabhūva rūpeṇa veṣeṇaiva ca tatsamaḥ ।। ।। 42 ।। triṃśatkoṭiparimitaḥ kamanīyo manoharaḥ ।। saṃkhyāvidbhiśca saṃkhyāto ballavānāṃ gaṇaḥ śrutau ।। 43 ।। kṛṣṇasya lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyaścāvirbabhūva ha ।। nānāvarṇo gogaṇaśca śaśvatsusthirayauvanaḥ ।। 44 ।। balīvardāḥ surabhyaśca vatsā nānāvidhāḥ śubhāḥ ।। atīva lalitāḥ śyāmā bahvyo vai kāmadhenavaḥ ।। 45 ।। teṣāmekaṃ balīvardaṃ koṭisiṃhasamaṃ bale ।। śivāya pradadau kṛṣṇo vāhanāya manoharam ।। 46 ।। kṛṣṇāṃghrinakharandhebhyo haṃsapaṅktirmanoharā ।। āvirbabhūva sahasā strīpuṃvatsasamanvitā ।।। ।। 47 ।। teṣāmekaṃ rājahaṃsaṃ mahābalaparākramam ।। vāhanāya dadau kṛṣṇo brahmaṇe ca tapasvine ।। 48 ।। vāmakarṇasya vivarātkṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। gaṇaḥ śvetaturaṅgāṇāmāvirbhūto manoharaḥ ।। 49 ।। teṣāmekaṃ ca śvetāśvaṃ dharmārthaṃ vāhanāya ca ।। dadau gopāṅganeśaśca saṃprītyā surasaṃsadi ।। 50 ।। dakṣakarṇasya vivarātpuṃsaśca surasaṃsadi ।। āvirbhūtā siṃhapaṅktirmahābalaparākramā ।। 51 ।। teṣāmekaṃ dadau kṛṣṇaḥ prakṛtyai paramādaram ।। amūlyaratnamālyaṃ ca varaṃ yadabhivāñchitam ।। 52 ।। kṛṣṇo yogena yogīndraścakāra rathapañcakam ।। śuddharatnendranirmāṇaṃ manoyāyi manoharam।। 53 ।। lakṣayojanamūrdhve ca prasthe ca śatayojanam ।। lakṣacakraṃ vāyurahaṃ lakṣakrīḍāgṛhānvitam ।। 54 ।। śṛṅgārārhaṃ bhogavastutalpāsaṃkhyasamanvitam ।। ratnapradīpalakṣāṇāṃ vājibhiśca virājitam ।। 55 ।। nānācitravicitrāḍhathaṃ sadratnakalaśojjvalam ।। ratnadarpaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ śobhitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 56 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaiścitrairmuktājālairvibhūṣitam ।। maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahāravirājitam ।। 57 ।। āraktavarṇaratnendrasāranirmāṇakṛtrimaiḥ ।। paṅkajānāmasaṃkhyaiśca sundaraiśca suśobhitam ।। 58 ।। dadau nārāyaṇāyaikaṃ teṣāṃ madhye dvijottamaḥ ।। ekaṃ dattvā rādhikāyai rarakṣāśeṣamātmane ।।।। 59 ।। āvirbabhūva kṛṣṇasya guhyadeśāttataḥ param ।। piṅgalaśca pumānekaḥ piṅgalaiśca gaṇaiḥ saha ।। 60 ।। āvirbhūtā yato guhyāttena te guhyakāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। yaḥ pumān sa kuberaśca dhaneśo guhyakeśvaraḥ ।। 61 ।। babhūva kanyakā caikā kubere vāmapārśvataḥ ।। kuberapatnī sā devī sundarīṇāṃ manoramā ।। 62 ।। bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍabrahmarākṣasāḥ ।। vetālā vikṛtāstasyāvirbhūtā guhyadeśataḥ ।। 63।। śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇo vanamālinaḥ ।। pītavastraparīdhānāḥ sarve śyāmacaturbhujāḥ ।। 64 ।। kirīṭinaḥ kuṇḍalino ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।। āvirbhūtāḥ pārṣadāśca kṛṣṇasya mukhato mune ।। 65 ।। caturbhujānpārṣadāṃśca dadau nārāyaṇāya ca ।। guhyakānguhyakeśāya bhūtādīñchaṅkarāya ca ।।66।। dvibhujāḥ śyāmavarṇāśca japamālākarā varāḥ ।। dhyāyantaścaraṇāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya satataṃ mudā ।।67।। dāsyo niyuktā dasāścaivārghyamādāya yatnataḥ ।। āvirbhūtā vaiṣṇavāśca sarve kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 68 ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgāḥ sāśrunetrāḥ sagadgadā ।। āvirbhūtāḥ pādapadmātpādapadmaikamānasāḥ।।69।। āvirbabhūvuḥ kṛṣṇasya dakṣanetrādbhayaṅkarāḥ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharāstrinetrāścandraśekharāḥ ।। 70 ।। digambarā mahākāyā jvaladagniśikhopamāḥ ।। te bhairavā mahābhāgāḥ śivatulyāśca tejasā ।। 71 ।। rurusaṃhārakālākhyā asitakrodhabhīṣaṇāḥ ।। mahābhairavakhaṭvāṅgāvityaṣṭau bhairavāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 72 ।। āvirbabhūva kṛṣṇasya vāmanetrādbhayaṅkaraḥ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśavyāghracarmāmbaragadādharaḥ ।। 73 ।। digambaro mahākāyastriṇetraścandraśekharaḥ ।। sa īśāno mahābhāgo dikpālānāmadhīśvaraḥ ।। 74 ।। ḍākinyaścaiva yoginyaḥ kṣetrapālāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। āvirbabhūvuḥ kṛṣṇasya nāsikāvivarodarāt ।। 75 ।। surāstrikoṭisaṃkhyātā divyamūrtidharāvarāḥ ।। āvirbarbhūvuḥ sahasā puṃso vai pṛṣṭhadeśataḥ ।। 76 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde sṛṣṭinirūpaṇe brahmakhaṇḍe pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 5 ।
<1.6> sautiruvāca ।। atha kṛṣṇo mahālakṣmīṃ sādaraṃ ca sarasvatīm ।। nārāyaṇāya pradadau ratnendraṃ mālayā saha ।। 1 ।। sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇe prādānmūrtiṃ dharmāya sādaram।। ratiṃ kāmāya rūpāḍhyāṃ kuberāya manoramām ।। 2 ।। anyāśca yā yā anyabhyo yāśca yebhyaḥ samudbhavāḥ ।। tasmai tasmai dadau kṛṣṇastāṃ tāṃ rūpavatīṃ satīm ।। ।। 3 ।। tataḥ śaṃkaramāhūya sarveśo yogināṃ gurum ।। uvāca priyamityevaṃ gṛhṇīyāḥ siṃhavāhinīm ।। 4 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasannīlalohitaḥ ।। uvāca bhītaḥ praṇataḥ prāṇeśaṃ prabhumacyutam ।। 5 ।। śrīmaheśvara uvāca ।। adhunāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prakṛtiṃ prākṛto yathā ।। tvadbhaktyaikavyavahitāṃ dāsyamārgavirodhinīm ।। 6 ।। tattvajñānasamācchannāṃ yogadvārakapāṭikām ।। muktīcchādhvaṃsarūpāṃ ca sakāmāṃ kāmavarddhinīm ।। 7 ।। tapasyācchannarūpāṃ ca mahāmohakaraṇḍikām ।। bhavakārāgṛhe ghore dṛḍhāṃ nigaḍarūpiṇīm ।। ।। 8 ।। śaśvadvibuddhijananīṃ sadbuddhicchedakāriṇīm ।। śaśvadvibhogasārāṃ ca viṣayecchāvivarddhinīm ।। 9।। necchāmi gṛhiṇīṃ nātha varaṃ dehi madīpsitam ।। yasya yadvāñchitaṃ tasmai taddadāti sadīśvaraḥ ।। 10 ।। tvadbhaktiviṣaye dāsye lālasā varddhate'niśam ।। tṛptirna jāyate nāma japane pādasevane ।।11।। tvannāmapañcavaktreṇa guṇaṃ sanmaṅgalālayam ।। svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvadgāyangāyan bhramāmyaham।।12।। ākalpakoṭikoṭiṃ ca tadrūpadhyānatatparam ।। bhogecchāviṣayenaiva yoge tapasi manmanaḥ ।। 13 ।। tvatsevane pūjane ca vandane nāma kīrtane ।। sadollasitameṣāṃ ca viratau viratiṃ labhet ।। 14 ।। smaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ nāma guṇayoḥ śravaṇaṃ japaḥ ।। tvaccārurūpadhyānaṃ tvatpādasevābhivandanam ।। 15 ।। samarpaṇaṃ cātmanaśca nityaṃ naivedyabhojanam ।। varaṃ vareśa dehīdaṃ navadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam ।। 16 ।। sārṣṭisālokyasārūpyasāmīpyaṃ sāmyalīnatām ।। vadanti ṣaḍvidhāṃ muktiṃ muktāmuktivido vibho ।। 17 ।। aṇimālaghimāprāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā ।। īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca sarvakāmāvasāyitā ।। 18 ।। sarvajña dūraśravaṇaṃ parakāyapraveśanam ।। vāksiddhiḥ kalpavṛkṣatvaṃ sraṣṭuṃ saṃhartumīśatā ।। 19 ।। amaratvaṃ ca sarvāgryaṃ siddhayo'ṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। yogāstapāṃsi sarvāṇi dānāni ca vratāni ca ।। ।। 20 ।। yaśaḥkīrtirvacaḥ satyaṃ dharmāṇyanaśanāni ca ।। bhramaṇaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snānamanyasurārcanam ।। 21 ।। surārcā darśanaṃ saptadvīpasaptapradakṣiṇam ।। snānaṃ sarvasamudreṣu sarvasvargapradarśanam ।। 22 ।। brahmatvaṃ caiva rudratvaṃ viṣṇutvaṃ ca paraṃ padam ।। ato'nirvacanīyāni vāñchanīyāni santi vā ।। 23 ।। sarvāṇyetāni sarveśa kathitāni ca yāni ca ।। tava bhaktikalāṃśasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 24 ।। śarvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇastaṃ yogināṃ gurum ।। prahasyovāca vacanaṃ satyaṃ sarvasukhapradam ।। 25 ।। ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। matsevāṃ kuru sarveśa śarvasarvavidāṃvara ।। kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvatpūrṇaṃ śaśvadaharniśam ।। 26 ।। varastapasvināṃ tvaṃ ca siddhānāṃ yogināṃ tathā ।। jñānināṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca sureśvara ।।27।। amaratvaṃ labha bhava bhava mṛtyuṃjayo mahān ।। sarvasiddhiṃ ca vedāṃśca sarvajñatvaṃ ca madvarāt ।।28।। asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ līlayā vatsa paśyasi ।। adyaprabhṛti jñānena tejasā vayasā śiva ।। 29 ।। parā krameṇa yaśasā mahasā matsamo bhava।। prāṇānāmapadhikastvañca na bhaktastvatparo mama ।। 30।। tvatparo nāsti me preyāṃstvaṃ madīyātmanaḥ paraḥ।। ye tvāṃ nindanti pāpiṣṭhā jñānahīnā vicetanāḥ ।। 31 ।। pacyante kālasūtreṇa yāvaccandradivākarau ।। kalpakoṭiśatānte ca grahīṣyasi śivāṃ śiva ।। 32 ।। mamāvyarthaṃ ca vacanaṃ pālanaṃ kartumarhasi ।। tvanmukhānnirgataṃ vākyaṃ na karomyadhuneti ca ।। 33 ।। madvākyaṃ ca svavākyaṃ ca pālanaṃ tatkariṣyasi ।। gṛhītvā prakṛtiṃ śambho divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ।। 34 ।। sukhaṃ mahacca śṛṅgāraṃ kariṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। na kevalaṃ tapasvī tvamīśvaro matsamo mahān ।। 35 ।। kāle gṛhī tapasvī ca yogī svecchāmayo hi yaḥ ।। duḥkhaṃ ca dārasaṃyoge yattvayā kathitaṃ śiva ।। 36 ।। kustrī dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca svāmine na pativratā ।। kule mahati yā jātā kulajā kulapālikā ।। 37 ।। karoti pālanaṃ snehātsatputrasya samaṃ patim ।। patirbandhuḥ patirbharttā daivataṃ kulayoṣitām ।। 38 ।। patito'patito vāpi kṛpaṇaśceśvaro'thavā ।। asatkulaprasūtāyāḥ pitrorduśśīlamiśritāḥ ।। 39 ।। dhruvaṃ tāḥ parabhogyāśca patiṃ nindanti santatam।। āvayoratiriktaṃ ca yā paśyati patiṃ satī ।। 40 ।। goloke svāminā sārddhaṃ koṭikalpaṃ pramodate ।। bhavitā sā śivā śaivī prakṛtivaiṣṇavī śiva ।। 41 ।। madājñayā ca tāṃ sādhvīṃ grahīṣyasi bhavāya ca ।। prakṛtyā yonisaṃyuktaṃ tvalliṅgaṃ tīrthamṛtkṛtam ।।42।। tīrthe sahasraṃ saṃpūjya bhaktyā pañcopacārataḥ ।। sadakṣiṇaṃ saṃyato yaḥ pavitraśca jitendriyaḥ ।। 43 ।। koṭikalpaṃ ca goloke modate ca mayā saha ।। lakṣaṃ tīrthe pūjayedyo vidhivatsādhudakṣiṇam ।। 44 ।। na cyutistasya golokātsa bhavedāvayoḥ samaḥ ।। mṛdbhasmagośakṛtpiṇḍaistīrthe vālukayā'pi vā ।। 45 ।। kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sakṛtpūjya vasetkalpāyutaṃ divi ।। prajāvānbhūmimānvidvānputravāndhanavāṃstathā 46 ।। jñānavānmuktimānsādhuḥ śivaliṅgārcanādbhavet ।। śivaliṅgārcanaṃ sthānaṃ mattīrthaṃ tīrthameva tat ।। bhavettatra mṛtaḥ pāpī śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ।। 47 ।। mahādeva mahādeva mahādevetivādinaḥ ।। paścādyāmi mahātrasto nāmaśravaṇalobhataḥ ।। 48 ।। śiveti śabdamuccāryya prāṇāṃstyajati yo naraḥ ।। koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmukto muktiṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 49 ।। śivakalyāṇavacanaṃ kalyāṇaṃ muktivācakam ।। yatastatprabhavettena sa śivaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। 50 ।। vicchede dhanabandhūnāṃ nimagnaḥ śokasāgare ।। śiveti śabdamuccāryya labhetsarvaśivaṃ naraḥ ।। 51 ।। pāpaghne vartate śiśca vaśca muktiprade tathā ।। pāpaghno mokṣado nṝṇāṃ śivastena prakīrtitaḥ ।। 52 ।। śiveti ca śivaṃ nāma yasya vāci pravarttate ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam ।। 53 ।। ityuktvā śūline kṛṣṇo dattvā kalpataruṃ manum ।। tattvajñānaṃ mṛtyujayamavocatsiṃhavāhinīm ।। 54 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। adhunā tiṣṭha vatse tvaṃ goloke mama sannidhau ।। kāle bhajiṣyasi śivaṃ śivadaṃ ca śivāyanam ।। 55 ।। tejaḥsu sarvadevānāmāvirbhūya varānane ।। saṃhṛtya daityānsarvāṃśca bhavitā sarvapūjitā ।। 56 ।। tataḥ kalpaviśeṣe ca satyaṃ satyayuge sati ।। bhavitā dakṣakanyā tvaṃ suśīlā śambhugehinī ।। 57 ।। tataḥ śarīraṃ saṃtyajya yajñe bhartuśca nindayā ।। menāyāṃ śailabhāryyāyāṃ bhavitā pārvatīti ca ।। 58 ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca vihariṣyasi śambhunā ।। pūrṇaṃ tataḥ sarvakālamamedaṃ tvaṃ labhiṣyasi ।। 59 ।। kāle sarveṣu viśveṣu mahāpūjāsu pūjite।। bhavitā prativarṣe ca śāradī yā sureśvari ।। ।। 60 ।। grāmeṣu nagareṣveva pūjitā grāmadevatā ।। bhavatī bhavitetyevaṃ nāmabhedena cāruṇā ।। 61 ।। madājñayā śivakṛtaistantrairnānāvidhairapi ।। pūjāvidhiṃ vidhāsyāmi kavacaṃ stotrasaṃyutam ।। 62 ।। bhaviṣyanti mahāntaśca tavaiva paricārakāḥ ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ siddhāśca phalabhāginaḥ ।। 63 ।। ye tvāṃ mātarbhajiṣyanti puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। teṣāṃ yaśaśca kīrtiśca dharmaiśvaryyaṃ ca varddhate ।। 64 ।। ityuktvā prakṛtiṃ tasyai mantramekādaśākṣaram ।। dattvā sakāmabījaṃ ca mantrarājamanuttamam ।। 65 ।। cakāra vidhinā dhyānaṃ bhaktaṃ bhaktānukampayā ।। śrīmāyākāmabījāḍhyaṃ dadau mantraṃ daśākṣaram ।। 66 ।। sṛṣṭyaupayaugikīṃ śaktiṃ sarvasiddhiṃ ca kāmadām ।। tadviśiṣṭotkṛṣṭatattvaṃ jñānaṃ tasyai dadau vibhuḥ ।। 67 ।। trayodaśākṣaraṃ mantraṃ dattvā tasmai jagatpatiḥ ।। kavacaṃ stotrasahitaṃ śaṅkarāya tathā dvija ।। 68 ।। dattvā dharmāya taṃ mantraṃ siddhijñānaṃ tadeva ca ।। kāmāya vahnaye caiva kuberāya ca vāyave ।। 69 ।। evaṃ kuberādibhyastu dattvā mantrādikaṃ param।। vidhiṃ provāca sṛṣṭyarthaṃ vidhāturvidhireva saḥ ।। 70 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। madīyaṃ ca tapaḥ kṛtvā divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ।। sṛṣṭiṃ kuru mahābhāga vidhe nānāvidhāṃ parām ।। 71 ।। ityuktvā brahmaṇe kṛṣṇo dadau mālāṃ manoramām ।। jagāma sārddhaṃ gopībhirgopairvṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 72 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe sṛṣṭinirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 6 ।।
<1.7> sautiruvāca ।। tadā brahmā tapaḥ kṛtvā siddhiṃ prāpya yathepsitām ।। sasṛje pṛthivīmādau madhukaiṭabhamedasā ।। 1 ।। sasṛje parvatānaṣṭau pradhānānsumanoharān ।। kṣudrānasaṃkhyānkiṃ brūmaḥ pradhānākhyāṃ niśāmaya ।। 2 ।। sumeruṃ caiva kailāsaṃ malayaṃ ca himālayam।। udayaṃ ca tathā'staṃ ca suvelaṃ gandhamādanam ।। 3 ।। samudrānsasṛje sapta nadānkatividhā nadīḥ ।। vṛkṣāṃśca grāmanagaraṃ samudrākhyā niśāmaya ।। 4 ।। lavaṇekṣusurāsarpirdadhidugdhajalārṇavān ।। lakṣayojanamānena dviguṇāṃśca parātparān ।। 5 ।। saptadvīpāṃśca tadbhūmimaṇḍale kamalākṛte ।। upadvīpāṃstathā saptasīmāśailāṃśca sapta ca ।। 6 ।। nibodha vipra dvīpākhyāṃ purā yā vidhinā kṛtā ।। jambūśākakuśaplakṣakrauñcanyagrodhapauṣkarān ।। 7 ।। meroraṣṭasu śṛṅgeṣu sasṛje'ṣṭau purī prabhuḥ ।। aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ vihārāya manoharāḥ ।। 8 ।। mūle'nantasya nagarīṃ nirmāya jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। ūrdhve svargāṃśca saptaiva teṣāmākhyā niśāmaya।।9।। bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ sumanoharam ।। janolokaṃ tapolokaṃ satyalokaṃ ca śaunaka।। 10।। śṛṅgamūrdhni brahmalokaṃ jarādiparivarjitam ।। tadūrdhve dhruvalokaṃ ca sarvataḥ sumanoharam ।।11।। tadadhaḥ sapta pātālānnirmame jagadīśvaraḥ ।। svargātiriktabhogāḍhyānadhodhaḥ kramato mune ।। 12 ।। atalaṃ vitalaṃ caiva sutalaṃ ca talātalam ।। mahātalaṃ ca pātālaṃ rasātalamadhastataḥ ।। 13 ।। saptadvīpaiḥ saptanākaiḥ saptapātālasaṃjñakaiḥ ।। ebhirlokaiśca brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmādhikṛtameva ca ।। 14 ।। evañcāsaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimameva ca ।। mahāviṣṇośca lomnāṃ ca vivareṣu ca śaunaka ।। 19 ।। prativiśveṣu dikpālā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। surā narādayaḥ sarve santi kṛṣṇasya māyayā ।। 16 ।। brāhmāṇḍagaṇanāṃ kartuṃ na kṣamo jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। na śaṅkaro na dharmaśca na ca viṣṇuśca ke surāḥ।।17।। saṃkhyātumīśvaraḥ śakto na saṃkhyātuṃ tathāpi saḥ ।। viśvākāśadiśāṃ caiva sarvato yadyapi kṣamaḥ ।। 18 ।। kṛtrimāṇi ca viśvāni viśvasthāni ca yāni ca ।। anityāni ca viprendra svapnavannaśvarāṇi ca ।। 19 ।। vaikuṇṭhaḥ śivalokaśca golokaśca tayoḥ paraḥ ।। nityo viśvabahirbhūtaścātmākāśadiśo yathā ।। 20 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe sṛṣṭinirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 7 ।।
<1.8> sautiruvāca ।। brahmā viśvaṃ vinirmāya sāvitryāṃ varayoṣiti ।। cakāra vīryyādhānaṃ ca kāmukyāṃ kāmuko yathā ।। 1 ।। sā divyaṃ śatavarṣaṃ ca dhṛtvā garbhaṃ sudussaham ।। suprasūtā ca suṣuve caturvedānmanoharān ।। 2 ।। vividhāñśāstrasaṃghāṃśca tarkavyākaraṇādikān ।। ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṃkhyakā divyā rāgiṇīḥ sumanoharāḥ ।। 3 ।। ṣaḍrāgānsundarāṃścaiva nānātāla samanvitān ।। satyatretādvāparāṃśca kaliṃ ca kalahapriyam ।। 4 ।। varṣamāsamṛtuṃ caiva tithiṃ daṇḍakṣaṇādikam ।। dinaṃ rātriṃ ca vārāṃśca sandhyāmuṣasameva ca ।। 5 ।। puṣṭiṃ ca devasenāṃ ca medhāṃ ca vijayāṃ jayām ।। ṣaṭkṛttikāśca yogāṃśca karaṇaṃ ca tapo dhanaḥ ।। 6 ।। devasenāṃ mahāṣaṣṭhīṃ kārttikeyapriyāṃ satīm ।। mātṛkāsu pradhānā sā bālānāmiṣṭadevatā ।। 7 ।। brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ ca vārāhaṃ kalpatrayamidaṃ smṛtam ।। nityaṃ naimittikaṃ caiva dviparārddhaṃ ca prākṛtam ।। 8 ।। caturvidhaṃ ca pralayaṃ kālaṃ vai mṛtyukanyakām ।। sarvānvyādhigaṇāṃścaiva sā prasūya stanaṃ dadau ।। 9 ।। atha dhātuḥ pṛṣṭhadeśādadharmaḥ samajāyata।। alakṣmīstadvāmapārśvādbabhūvātyantakāminī ।। 10।। nābhideśādviśvakarmā jāto vai śilpināṃ guruḥ ।। mahāntau vasavo'ṣṭau ca mahābalaparākramāḥ ।। 11 ।। atha dhātuśca manasa āvirbhūtāḥ kumārakāḥ ।। catvāraḥ pañcavarṣīyā jvalanto brahmatejasā ।। 12 ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ।। sanatkumāro bhagavāṃścaturtho jñānināṃ varaḥ ।।13।। āvirbabhūva mukhataḥ kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ ।। divyarūpadharaḥ śrīmānsastrīkaḥ sundaro yuvā ।। 14 ।। kṣattriyāṇāṃ bījarūpo nāmnā svāyambhuvo manuḥ ।। yā strī sā śatarūpā ca rūpāḍhyā kamalā kalā ।।15।। sastrīkaśca manustasthau dhātrājñā paripālakaḥ ।। svayaṃ vidhātā putrāṃśca tānuvāca praharṣitān ।। 16 ।। sṛṣṭiṃ karttuṃ mahābhāgo mahābhāgavatāndvija ।। jagmuste ca nahītyuktvā taptuṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 17 ।। cukopa hetunā tena vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। kopāsaktasya ca vidherjvalato brahmatejasā ।। 18 ।। āvirbhūtā lalāṭācca rudrā ekādaśa prabho ।। kālāgnirudraḥ saṃhartā teṣāmekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 19 ।। sarveṣāmeva viśvānāṃ sa tāmasa iti smṛtaḥ ।। rājasaśca svayaṃ brahmā śivo viṣṇuśca sāttvikau ।। 20 ।। golokanāthaḥ kṛṣṇaśca nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। paramajñānino mūrkhā vadantaṃ tāmasaṃ śivam ।। 21 ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpaṃ ca nirmalaṃ vaiṣṇavāgraṇīm ।। śṛṇu nāmāni rudrāṇāṃ vedoktāni ca yāni ca ।। 22 ।। mahānmahātmā matimānbhīṣaṇaśca bhayaṃkaraḥ ।। ṛtudhvajaścordhvakeśaḥ piṅgalākṣo ruciḥ śuciḥ ।। 23 ।। pulastyo dakṣakarṇācca pulaho vāmakarṇataḥ ।। dakṣanetrāttathā'triśca vāmanetrātkratuḥ svayam ।। 24 ।। araṇirnāsikārandhrādaṅgirāśca mukhādruciḥ ।। bhṛguśca vāmapārśvācca dakṣo dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ ।। 25 ।। chāyāyāḥ kardamo jāto nābheḥ pañcaśikhastathā ।। vakṣasaścaiva voḍhuśca kaṇṭhadeśācca nāradaḥ ।। 26 ।। marīciḥ skandhadeśāccaivāpāntaratamā galāt ।। vasiṣṭho rasanādeśātpracetā adharoṣṭhataḥ ।। 27 ।। haṃsaśca vāmakukṣeśca dakṣakukṣeryatiḥ svayam ।। sṛṣṭiṃ vidhātuṃ sa vidhiścakārājñāṃ sutānprati ।। piturvākyaṃ samākarṇya tamuvāca sa nāradaḥ ।। 28 ।। nārada uvāca ।। pūrvamānaya majjyeṣṭhānsanakādīnpitāmaha ।। kārayitvā dārayuktānasmānvada jagatpate ।। 29 ।। pitrā te tapase yuktāḥ saṃsārāya vayaṃ katham ।। aho hanta prabhorbuddhirviparītāya kalpate ।। 30 ।। kasmai putrāya pīyūṣātparaṃ dattaṃ tapo'dhunā ।। kasmai dadāsi viṣayaṃ viṣamaṃ ca viṣādhikam ।। 31 ।। atīva nimne ghore ca bhavābdhau yaḥ patetpitaḥ ।। niṣkṛtistasya nāstīti koṭikalpe gate'pi ca ।। 32 ।। nistārabījaṃ sarveṣāṃ bījaṃ ca puruṣotamam ।। sarvadaṃ bhaktidaṃ dāsyapradaṃ satyaṃ kṛpāmayam ।। 33 ।। bhaktaikaśaraṇaṃ bhaktavatsalaṃ svacchameva ca ।। bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktanāthaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 34 ।। bhaktārādhyaṃ bhaktasādhyaṃ vihāya parameśvaram ।। mano dadhāti ko mūḍho viṣaye nāśakāraṇe ।। 35 ।। vihāya kṛṣṇasevāṃ ca pīyūṣādadhikāṃ priyām ।। ko mūḍho viṣamaśnāti viṣamaṃ viṣayābhidham ।। 36 ।। svapnavannaśvaraṃ tucchamasatyaṃ mṛtyukāraṇam ।। yathā dīpaśikhāgraṃ ca kīṭānāṃ sumanoharam ।।37।। yathā baḍiśamāṃsaṃ ca matsyāpātasukhapradam।। tathā viṣayiṇāṃ tāta viṣayaṃ mṛtyukāraṇam।।38।। ityuktvā nāradastatra virarāma vidheḥ puraḥ ।। tasthau tātaṃ namaskṛtya jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ।।39।। brahmā kopaparītaśca śaśāpa tanayaṃ dvija ।। uvāca kampitāṅgaśca raktāsyaḥ sphuritādharaḥ ।। 40 ।। brahmovāca ।। bhavitā jñānalopaste macchāpena ca nārada ।। krīḍāmṛgaśca tvaṃ sādhyo yoṣillubddhadhaśca lampaṭaḥ।।41।। sthirayauvanayuktānāṃ rūpāḍhyānāṃ manoharaḥ ।। pañcāśatkāminīnāṃ ca bhartā ca prāṇavallabhaḥ।।42।। śṛṅgāraśāstravettā ca mahāśṛṅgāralolupaḥ।। nānāprakāraśṛṅgāranipuṇānāṃ gurorguruḥ ।।43।। gandharvāṇāṃ ca suvaraḥ susvaraśca sugāyanaḥ ।। vīṇāvādanasandarbhaniṣṇātaḥ sthirayauvanaḥ ।। 44 ।। prājño madhuravāk śāntaḥ suśīlaḥ sundaraḥ sudhīḥ ।। bhaviṣyasi na sandeho nāmataścopabarhaṇaḥ ।। 45 ।। tābhirdivyaṃ lakṣayugaṃ vihṛtya nirjane vane ।। punarmadīyaśāpena dāsī putraśca tatparaḥ ।। 46 ।। vatsa vaiṣṇavasaṃsargādvaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt ।। punaḥ kṛṣṇaprasādena bhaviṣyasi mamātmajaḥ ।। 47 ।। jñānaṃ dāsyāmi te divyaṃ punareva purātanam ।। adhunā bhava naṣṭastvaṃ matsuto nipata dhuvam।।48।। brahmetyuktvā sutaṃ vipra virarāma jagatpatiḥ ।। ruroda nāradastātamavocatsaṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। 49 ।। nārada uvāca ।। krodhaṃ saṃhara saṃhartastāta tāta jagadguro ।। sraṣṭustapasvīśasyāho krodho'yaṃ mayyanākaraḥ ।। 50 ।। śapetparityajedvidvānputramutpathagāminam ।। tapasvinaṃ sutaṃ śaptuṃ kathamarhasi paṃḍita ।। 51 ।। janirbhavatu me brahmanyāsu yāsu ca yoniṣu ।। na jahātu harerbhaktirmā vedaṃ dehi me varam ।।52।। putraścejjagatāṃ dhāturnāsti bhaktirhareḥ pade।। sūkarādatiriktaśca so'dhamo bhārate bhuvi ।। 53 ।। jātismaro harerbhaktiyuktaḥ sūkarayoniṣu ।। janirlabhetsa pravaro golokaṃ yāti karmaṇā ।। 54 ।। govindacaraṇāmbhojabhaktimādhvīkamīpsitam ।। pibatāṃ vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ sparśapūtā vasundharā ।। 55 ।। tīrthāni sparśamicchanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ pitāmaha ।। pāpānāṃ pāpitattvānāṃ kṣālanāyātmanāmapi ।।56।। mantropadeśamātreṇa narā muktāśca bhārate ।। paraiśca koṭipuruṣaiḥ pūrvaiḥ sārdhaṃ hareraho ।। 57 ।। koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmantragrahaṇamātrataḥ ।। muktāḥ śudhyanti yatpūrvaṃ karma nirmūlayanti ca ।।58।। putrāndārāṃśca śiṣyāṃśca sevakānbāndhavāṃstathā ।। yo darśayati sanmārgaṃ sadgatistaṃ labheddhruvam ।।59।। yo darśayatyasanmārgaṃ śiṣyairviśvāsito guruḥ ।। kumbhīpāke sthitistasya yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 60 ।। sa kiṃguruḥ sa kiṃtātaḥ sa kiṃsvāmī sa kiṃsutaḥ।। yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapadāmbhoje bhaktiṃ dātumanīśvaraḥ ।। 61 ।। śapto niraparādhena tvayā'haṃ caturānana ।। mayā śaptuṃ tvamucito ghnantaṃ ghnantyapi paṇḍitāḥ ।। 62 ।। kavacastotrapūjābhiḥ sahitaste manurmanoḥ ।। lupto bhavatu macchāpātprativiśveṣu niścitam ।। 63 ।। apūjyo bhava viśveṣu yāvatkalpatrayaṃ pitaḥ ।। gateṣu triṣu kalpeṣu pūjyapūjyo bhaviṣyasi।।64।। adhunā yajñabhāgaste vratādiṣvapi suvrata ।। pūjanaṃ cāstu māmaikaṃ vandyo bhava surādibhiḥ ।। 65 ।। ityuktvā nāradastatra virarāma pituḥ puraḥ ।। tasthau sabhāyāṃ sa vidhirhṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 66 ।। upabarheṇa gandharvo nāradastena hetunā ।। dāsīputraśca śāpena pitureva ca śaunaka ।। 67 ।। tataḥ punarnāradaśca sa babhūva mahānṛṣiḥ ।। jñānaṃ prāpya pituḥ paścātkathayiṣyāmi cādhunā ।। 68 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe brahmanāradaśāpopalambhanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 8 ।।
<1.9> sautiruvāca ।। atha brahmā svaputrāṃstānādideśa ca sṛṣṭaye ।। sṛṣṭiṃ pracakruste sarve viprendra nāradaṃ vinā ।। 1 ।। marīcermanaso jātaḥ kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ ।। atrernetramalāccandraḥ kṣīrode ca babhūva ha ।। 2 ।। pracetaso'pi manaso gautamaśca babhūva ha ।। pulastyamānasaḥ putro maitrāvaruṇa eva ca ।। 3 ।। manośca śatarūpāyāṃ tisraḥ kanyāḥ prajajñire ।। ākūtirdevahūtiśca prasūtistāḥ pativratāḥ ।। 4 ।। priyavratottānapādau dvau ca putrau manoharau ।। uttānapādatanayo dhruvaḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ।। 5 ।। ākūtiṃ rucaye prādāddakṣāyātha prasūtikām ।। devahūtiṃ kardamāya yatputraḥ kapilaḥ svayam ।। 6 ।। prasūtyāṃ dakṣabījena ṣaṣṭikanyāḥ prajajñire ।। aṣṭau dharmāya sa dadau rudrāyaikādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। 7 ।। śivāyaikāṃ satīṃ prādātkaśyapāya trayodaśa ।। saptaviṃśati kanyāśca dakṣaścandrāya dattavān ।। 8 ।। nāmāni dharmapatnīnāṃ matto vipra niśāmaya ।। śāntiḥ puṣṭirdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ kṣamā śraddhā matiḥ smṛtiḥ ।। 9 ।। śānteḥ putraśca santoṣaḥ puṣṭeḥ putro mahānabhūt ।। dhṛtedhairyyaṃ ca tuṣṭeśca harṣadarpau sutau smṛtau ।। 10 ।। kṣamāputraḥ sahiṣṇuśca śraddhāputraśca dhārmikaḥ ।। materjñānābhidhaḥ putraḥ smṛterjātismaro mahān ।। 11 ।। pūrvapatnyāṃ ca mūrtyāṃ ca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। babhūvurete dharmiṣṭhā dharmaputrāśca śaunaka ।। 12 ।। nāmāni rudrapatnīnāṃ sāvadhānaṃ nibodha me ।। kalā kalāvatī kāṣṭhā kālikā kalahapriyā ।। 13 ।। kandalī bhīṣaṇā rāsnā pramocā bhūṣaṇā śukī ।। etāsāṃ bahavaḥ putrā babhūvuḥ śivapārṣadāḥ ।। 14 ।। sā satī svāminindāyāṃ tanuṃ tatyāja yajñataḥ ।। punarbhūtvā śailaputrī lebhe sā śaṅkaraṃ patim ।। 15 ।। kaśyapasya priyāṇāṃ ca nāmāni śṛṇu dhārmika ।। aditirdevamātā vai daityamātā ditistathā।।16।। sarpamātā tathā kadrūrvinatā pakṣisūstathā ।। surabhiśca gavāṃ mātā mahiṣāṇāṃ ca niścitam ।। 17 ।। sārameyādijantūnāṃ saramā sūścatuṣpadām ।। danuḥ prasūrdānavānāmanyāścetyevamādikāḥ ।। 18 ।। indraśca dvādaśādityā upendrādyāḥ surā mune ।। kathitāścāditeḥ putrā mahābalaparākramāḥ।।19।। indraputro jayantaśca brahmañśacyāmajāyata ।। । ādityasya savarṇāyāṃ kanyāyāṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ।। 20।। śanaiścarayamau putrau kālindī kanyakā tathā ।। upeṃdravīryyātpṛthvyāṃ tu maṅgalaḥ samajāyata।।21।। śaunaka uvāca ।। kathaṃ saute sa copedrānmaṅgalaḥ samajāyata ।। vasundharāyāṃ balavāṃstanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।।22।। । sautiruvāca ।। upendrarūpamālokya kāmārtā ca vasundharā ।। vidhāya sundarīveṣamakṣatā prauḍhayauvanā ।।23।। malaye nirjane ramye cārucandanapallave ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam।।24।। taṃ suśīlaṃ śayānaṃ ca śāntaṃ sasmitamīpsitam ।। sasmitā tasya talpe ca sahasā samupasthitā।।25।। suramyāṃ mālatīmālāṃ dadau tasmai varānanā ।। sugandhi candanaṃ cāru kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ।।26।। upendrastanmano jñātvā kāminīṃ kāmapīḍitām ।। nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ cakāra ca tayā saha ।। 27 ।। tadaṅgasaṅgasaṃsaktā mūrchāṃ prāpa satī tadā ।। mṛteva nidritevāsau bījādhānaṃ kṛte harau ।। 28 ।। tāṃ vilagnāṃ ca suśroṇīṃ sukhasambhogamūrchitām ।। bṛhanmuktanitambāṃ ca sa smitāṃ vipulastanīm ।। 29 ।। kṣaṇaṃ vakṣasi kṛtvā tāṃ tadoṣṭhaṃ ca cucumba ha ।। vihāya tatra rahasi jagāma puruṣottamaḥ ।। 30 ।। urvaśī pathi gacchantī bodhayāmāsa tāṃ mune ।। sā ca papraccha vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa bhūśca tām।। 31 ।। vīryyasaṃvaraṇaṃ kartuṃ sā cāśaktā ca durbalā ।। pravālasyākare trastā vīryyanyāsaṃ cakāra sā ।। 32 ।। tena pravālavarṇaśca kumāraḥ samapadyata ।। tejasā sṛryyasadṛśo nārāyaṇa suto mahān ।। 33 ।। maṅgalasya priyā medhā tasya ghaṇṭeśvaro mahān।। vraṇadātā'titejasvī viṣṇutulyo babhūva ha ।।34।। diterhiraṇyakaśipuhiraṇyākṣau mahābalau ।। kanyā ca siṃhikā vipra saiṃhikeyaśca tatsutaḥ ।।35।। nirṛtiḥ siṃhikā sā ca tena rāhuśca nairṛtaḥ।। sūkareṇa hiraṇyākṣo'pyanapatyo mṛto yuvā ।। 36 ।। hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahrādo vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ।। virocanaśca tatputrastatputraśca baliḥ svayam ।। 37।। baleḥ putro mahāyogī jñānī śaṅkarakiṃkaraḥ ।। ditervaṃśaśca kathitaḥ kadrūvaṃśaṃ nibodha me ।। 38 ।। anantaṃ vāsukiṃ caiva kālīyaṃ ca dhanañjayam ।। karkoṭakaṃ takṣakaṃ ca padmamairāvataṃ tathā ।। 39 ।। mahāpadmaṃ ca śaṃkuṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ tathā ।। dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca durddharṣaṃ durjayaṃ durmukhaṃ balam ।। 40 ।। gokṣaṃ gokārmukaṃ caiva virūpādīṃśca śaunaka ।। na teṣāṃ pravarāścaiva yāvatyaḥ sarpajātayaḥ ।। 41 ।। kanyakā manasā devī kamalāṃśasamudbhavā ।। tapasvinīnāṃ pravarā mahātejasvinī śubhā ।। 42 ।। yatpatiśca jaratkārurnārāyaṇakulodbhavaḥ ।। āstīkastanayo yasyā viṣṇutulyaśca tejasā ।। 43 ।। eteṣāṃ nāmamātreṇa nāsti nāgabhayaṃ nṛṇām ।। kadrūvaṃśo nigadito vinatāyāḥ śṛṇuṣva me ।। 44 ।। vainateyāruṇau putrau viṣṇutulyaparākramau ।। tau babhūvuḥ krameṇaiva yāvatyaḥ pakṣijātayaḥ ।। 45 ।। gāvaśca mahiṣāścaiva surabhipravarā ime ।। sarve vai sārameyāśca babhūvuḥ saramāsutāḥ ।। ।।46 ।। dānavāśca danorvaṃśā anyāssāmānyajātayaḥ ।। uktaḥ kaśyapavaṃśaśca candrākhyānaṃ nibodha me ।। 47 ।। nāmāni candrapatnīnāṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। atyapūrvaṃ ca caritaṃ purāṇeṣu purātanam ।। 48 ।। aśvinī bharaṇī caiva kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā ।। mṛgaśīrṣā tathā''rdrā ca pūjyā sādhvī punarvasuḥ ।। 49 ।। puṣyā''śleṣā maghā pūrvaphalgunyuttaraphalgunī ।। hastā citrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā ।। 50 ।। jyeṣṭhā mūlā tathā pūrvā''ṣāḍhā caivottarā smṛtā ।। śravaṇā ca dhaniṣṭhā ca tathā śatabhiṣak śubhā ।। 51 ।। pūrvā bhādrottarābhādrā revatyantā vidhupriyāḥ ।। tāsāṃ madhye ca subhagā rohiṇī rasikā varā ।। 52 ।। santataṃ rasabhāvena cakāra śaśinaṃ vaśam ।। rohiṇyupagataścandro na yātyanyāṃ ca kāminīm ।। 53 ।। sarvā bhaginyaḥ pitaraṃ kathayāmāsurādṛtāḥ ।। sapatnīkṛtasantāpaṃ prāṇanāśakaraṃ param ।। 54 ।। dakṣaḥ prakupitaścandramaśapanmantrapūrvakam ।। drutaṃ śvaśuraśāpena yakṣmagrasto babhūva saḥ ।। 55 ।। dine dine yakṣmaṇā sa kṣīyamāṇaśca duḥkhitaḥ ।। vapuṣyarddhaṃ kṣīyamāṇe śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 56 ।। dṛṣṭvā candraṃ śaṃkaraśca kleśitaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। karuṇāsāgarastasmai kṛpayā cābhayaṃ dadau ।। 57 ।। nirmuktaṃ yakṣmaṇā kṛtvā svakapole sthalaṃ dadau ।। amaro nirbhayo bhūtvā sa tasthau śivaśekhare ।। 58 ।। taṃ śivaḥ śekhare kṛtvā cābhavaccandraśekharaḥ ।। nāsti deveṣu lokeṣu śivāccharaṇapaṃjaraḥ ।। 59 ।। dakṣakanyāḥ patiṃ muktaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca ruruduḥ punaḥ ।। ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ tātaṃ dakṣaṃ tejasvināṃ varam ।। 60। uccaiśca rurudurgatvā nihatyāṅgaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। tamūcuḥ kātaraṃ dīnā dīnanāthaṃ vidheḥ sutam ।। 61 ।। dakṣakanyā ūcuḥ ।। svāmisaubhāgyalābhāya tvamukto'smābhireva ca ।। saubhāgyamastu nastāta gataḥ svāmī guṇānvitaḥ ।। 62 ।। sthite cakṣuṣi he tāta dṛṣṭaṃ dhvāntamayaṃ jagat ।। vijñātamadhunā strīṇāṃ patireva hi locanam ।। 63 ।। patireva gatiḥ strīṇāṃ patiḥ prāṇāśca sampadaḥ ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ hetuḥ seturbhavārṇave ।। 64 ।। patirnārāyaṇaḥ strīṇāṃ vrataṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। sarvaṃ karma vṛthā tāsāṃ svāmināṃ vimukhāśca yāḥ ।। 65 ।। snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇā ।। sarvadānāni puṇyāni vratāni niyamāśca ye ।। 66 ।। devārcanaṃ cānaśanaṃ sarvāṇi ca tapāṃsi ca ।। svāminaḥ pādasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 67 ।। sarveṣāṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca priyaḥ putraśca yoṣitām ।। sa eva svāminoṃ'śaśca śataputrātparaḥ patiḥ ।। 68 ।। asadvaṃśaprasūtā yā sā dveṣṭi svāminaṃ sadā ।। yasyā manaścalaṃ duṣṭaṃ santataṃ parapūruṣe ।। 69 ।। patitaṃ rogiṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ nirdhanaṃ guṇahīnakam ।। yuvānaṃ caiva vṛddhaṃ vā bhajettaṃ na tyajetsatī ।। 70 ।। saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāpi dveṣṭi yā saṃtyajetpatim ।। pacyate kālasūtre sā yāvaccaṃdradivākarau ।। 71 ।। kīṭaiḥ śunakatulyaiśca bhakṣitā sā divāniśam ।। bhuṅkte mṛtavasāmāṃsaṃ pibenmūtraṃ ca tṛṣṇayā ।। 72 ।। gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ ।। śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni sā bhavedbandhuhā tataḥ ।। 73 ।। tato mānavajanmāni labheccetpūrvakarmaṇaḥ ।। vidhavā dhanahīnā ca rogayuktā bhaved dhruvam ।। 74 ।। dehi naḥ kāntadānaṃ ca kāmapūraṃ vidheḥ suta ।। vidhātrā sadṛśastvaṃ ca punaḥ sraṣṭuṃ kṣamo jagat ।।79 ।। kanyānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaḥ śaṃkarasannidhim ।। jagāma śambhustaṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya nanāma ca ।। 76 ।। dakṣastasyāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā samuvāca kṛpānidhim ।। tatyāja kopaṃ durddhaṣo dṛṣṭvā ca praṇataṃ śivam ।। 77 ।। dakṣa uvāca ।। dehi jāmātaraṃ śambho madīyaṃ prāṇavallabham ।। matsutānāṃ ca prāṇānāṃ parameva priyaṃ patim ।। 78 ।। na ceddadāsi jāmātarmama jāmātaraṃ vidhum ।। dāsyāmi dāruṇaṃ śāpaṃ tubhyaṃ tvaṃ kena mucyase ।। 79 ।। dakṣasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। sudhādhikaṃ ca vacanaṃ brahmañśaraṇapañjaraḥ ।। 80 ।। śiva uvāca ।। karoṣi bhasmasāccenmāṃ dadyā vā śāpameva ca ।। nāhaṃ dātuṃ samarthaśca candraṃ ca śaraṇāgatam ।। 81 ।। śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣastaṃ śaptumudyataḥ ।। śivaḥ sasmāra govindaṃ vipanmokṣaṇakārakam ।। 82 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇo vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk।। samāyayau tayormūlaṃ tau taṃ ca namatuḥ kramāt ।। 83 ।। dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tau sa brahmajyotiḥ sanātanaḥ ।। uvāca śaṅkaraṃ pūrvaṃ paripūrṇatamo dvija ।। 84 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। na cātmanaḥ priyaḥ kaściccharva sarveṣu bandhuṣu ।। ātmānaṃ rakṣa dakṣāya dehi candraṃ sureśvara ।।89।। tapasvināṃ varaḥ śāntastvamevaṃ vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ।। samaḥ sarveṣu jīveṣu hiṃsākrodhavivarjitaḥ ।। 86 ।। dakṣaḥ krodhī ca durddharṣastejasvī brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।। śiṣṭo bibheti durddharṣaṃ na durddharṣaśca kaṃcana ।। 87 ।। nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hasitvā śaṅkaraḥ svayam ।। uvāca nītisāraṃ ca nītibījaṃ parātparam ।। 88 ।। śaṅkara uvāca ।। tapo dāsyāmi tejaśca sarvasiddhiṃ ca sampadam ।। prāṇāṃśca na samartho'haṃ pradātuṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 89 ।। yo dadāti bhayenaiva prapannaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। taṃ ca dharmaḥ parityajya yāti śaptvā sudāruṇam ।। 90 ।। sarvaṃ tyaktuṃ samartho'haṃ na svadharmaṃ jagatprabho ।। yaḥ svadharmavihīnaśca sa ca sarvabahiṣkṛtaḥ ।। 91 ।। yaśca dharmaṃ sadā rakṣeddharmastaṃ parirakṣati ।। dharmaṃ vedeśvara tvaṃ ca kiṃ māṃ brūhi svamāyayā ।। 92 ।। tvaṃ sarvamātā sraṣṭā ca hantā ca pariṇāmataḥ ।। tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhā yasya tasya kasmādbhayaṃ bhavet ।। 93 ।। śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānsarvabhāvavit ।। candraṃ candrādviniṣkṛṣya dakṣāya pradadau hariḥ ।। 94 ।। pratasthāvarddhacandraśca nirvyādhiḥ śivaśekhare ।। nijagrāha paraṃ candraṃ viṣṇudattaṃ prajāpatiḥ ।। 95 ।। yakṣmagrastaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā dakṣastuṣṭāva mādhavam ।। pakṣe pūrṇaṃ kṣataṃ pakṣe taṃ cakāra hariḥ svayam ।। 96 ।। kṛṣṇastebhyo varaṃ dattvā jagāma svālayaṃ dvija ।। dakṣaścandraṃ gṛhītvā ca kanyābhyaḥ pradadau punaḥ ।। 97 ।। candrastāśca pariprāpya vijahāra divāniśam ।। samaṃ dadarśa tāḥ sarvāstatprabhṛtyeva kampitaḥ ।। 98 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiñcitsṛṣṭikramaṃ mune ।। śrutaṃ ca guruvaktreṇa puṣkare munisaṃsadi ।। 99 ।। iti śrībahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe navamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 9 ।।
<1.10> sautiruvāca ।। bhṛgoḥ putraśca cyavanaḥ śukraśca jñānināṃ vara ।। kratorapi kriyā bhāryyā vālakhilyānasūyata ।। 1 ।। trayaḥ putrāścāṅgiraso babhūvurmunisattamāḥ ।। bṛhaspatirutathyaśca śambaraścāpi śaunaka ।। 2 ।। vasiṣṭhasya sutaḥ śaktiḥ śakteḥ putraḥ parāśaraḥ ।। parāśarasutaḥ śrīmānkṛṣṇadvaipāyano hariḥ ।। 3 ।। vyāsaputraḥ śivāṃśaśca śukaśca jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। viśvaśravāḥ pulastyasya yasya putro dhaneśvaraḥ ।। 4 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। aho purāṇa vaduṣāmatyantaṃ durgamaṃ vacaḥ ।। na buddhaṃ vacanaṃ kiṃciddhaneśotpattipūrvakam ।। 5 ।। adhunā kathitaṃ janma dhaneśasyeśvarādidam ।। punarbhiṃnnakramaṃ janma bravīṣi kathameva mām ।। 6 ।। sautiruvāca ।। babhūvurete dikpālāḥ purā ca parameśvarāt ।। punaśca brahmaśāpena sa ca viśvaśravassutaḥ ।। 7 ।। gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dātumutathyaśca dhaneśvaram ।। yayāce koṭisauvarṇaṃ yatnataśca pracetase ।। 8 ।। dhaneśo viraso bhūtvā tasmai taddātumudyataḥ ।। cakāra bhasmasādvipra punarjanma lalābha saḥ ।। 9 ।। tena viśravasaḥ putraḥ kuberaśca dhanādhipaḥ ।। rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca dhārmikaśca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 10 ।। pulahasya suto vātsyaḥ śāṇḍilyaśca ruceḥ sutaḥ ।। sāvarṇirgautamājjajñe munipravara eva saḥ ।। 11 ।। kāśyapaḥ kaśyapājjāto bharadvājo bṛhaspateḥ ।। (svayaṃ vātsyaśca pulahātsāvarṇirgautamāttathā ।। 12 ।। śāṇḍilyaśca ruceḥ putro munistejasvināṃ varaḥ ।।) babhūvuḥ pañcagotrāśca eteṣāṃ pravarā bhave ।। 13 ।। babhūvurbrahmaṇo vaktrādanyā brāhmaṇajātayaḥ।। tāḥ sthitā deśabhedeṣu gotraśūnyāśca śaunaka ।। 14 ।। candrādityamanūnāṃ ca pravarāḥ kṣatriyāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। brahmaṇo bāhudeśāccaivānyāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ ।। 15 ।। ūrudeśācca vaiśyāśca pādataḥ śūdrajātayaḥ ।। tāsāṃ saṅkarajātena babhūvurvarṇasaṅkarāḥ ।। 16 ।। gopanāpitabhillāśca tathā modakakūbarau ।। tāmbūlisvarṇakārau ca vaṇigjātaya eva ca ।। 17 ।। ityevamādyā viprendra sacchūdrāḥ parikīrttitāḥ ।। śūdrāviśostu karaṇo'mbaṣṭho vaiśyadvijanmanoḥ ।। 18 ।। viśvakarmā ca śūdrāyāṃ vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। tato babhūvuḥ putrāśca navaite śilpakāriṇaḥ ।। 19 ।। mālākāraḥ śaṅkhakāraḥ karmakāraḥ kuvindakaḥ ।। kumbhakāraḥ kāṃsyakāraḥ ṣaḍete śilpināṃ varāḥ ।। 20 ।। sūtrakāraścitrakāraḥ svarṇakārastathaiva ca ।। patitāste brahmaśāpādayājyā varṇasaṅkarāḥ ।। ।।21।। śaunaka uvāca ।। kathaṃ devo viśvakarmā vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। śūdrāyāmadhamāyāṃ ca kathaṃ te patitāstrayaḥ ।। 22 ।। kathaṃ teṣu brahmaśāpo hyabhavatkena hetunā ।। he purāṇavidāṃ śreṣṭha tannaḥ śaṃsitumarhasi ।। 23 ।। sautiruvāca ।। ghṛtācī kāmataḥ kāmaṃ veṣaṃ cakre manoharam ।। tāmapaśyadviśvakarmā gacchantīṃ puṣkare pathi ।। 24 ।। āgacchattadvilokācca prasādotphullamānamaḥ ।। tāṃ yayāce sa śṛṅgāraṃ kāmena hṛtacetanaḥ ।। 25 ।। ratnālaṅkārabhūṣāḍhyāṃ sarvāvayavakomalām ।। yathā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ।।26।। bṛhannitamba bhārārtāṃ munimānasamohinīm ।। ativegakaṭākṣeṇa lolāṃ kāmātipīḍitām ।।27।। tacchroṇīṃ kaṭhināṃ dṛṣṭvā vāyunā'pahṛtāṃśukām ।। atīvoccaiḥ stanayugaṃ kaṭhinaṃ vartulaṃ param ।। 28 ।। susmitaṃ cāru vaktraṃ ca śaraccandravinindakam ।। pakvabimbaphalāraktasvoṣṭhādharamanoharam ।। 29 ।। sindūrabindusaṃyuktaṃ kastūrībindusaṃyutam ।। kapolamujjvalaṃ śaśvanmahārhamaṇikuṇḍalam ।। 30 ।। tāmuvāca priyāṃ śāntāṃ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। kāmāgnivarddhanodyogi vacanaṃ śrutisundaram ।। 31 ।। viśvakarmovāca ।। ayi kva yāsi lalite mama prāṇādhike priye ।। mama prāṇāṃścāpahatya tiṣṭha kānte kṣaṇaṃ śubhe ।। 32 ।। tavaivānveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhramāmi jagatītalam ।। svaprāṇāṃstyaktumiṣṭo'haṃ tvāṃ na dṛṣṭvā hutāśane ।।33।। tvaṃ kāmalokaṃ yāsīti śrutvā rambhāmukhoditam ।। āgacchamahamevādya cāsminvartmanyavasthitaḥ ।। 34 ।। aho sarasvatītīre puṣpodyāne manohare ।। sugandhimandaśītena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। 35 ।। yabha kānte mayā sārddhaṃ yūnā kāntena śobhane।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhavet ।।36।। sthirayauvanasaṃyuktā tvameva cirajīvinī।। kāmukī komalāṅgī ca sundarīṣu ca sundarī।।37।। mṛtyuṃjayavareṇaiva mṛtyukanyā jitā mayā ।। kuberabhavanaṃ gatvā dhanaṃ labdhaṃ kuberataḥ।।38।। ratnamālā ca varuṇādvāyoḥ strīratnabhūṣaṇam ।। vahniśuddhaṃ vastrayugaṃ vahneḥ prāptaṃ mahaujasaḥ।।39।। kāmaśāstraṃ kāmadevādyoṣidrañjanakāram।। śṛṅgāraśilpaṃ yatkiñcillabdhaṃ candrācca durlabham ।। 40 ।। ratnamālāṃ vastrayugmaṃ sarvāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।। tubhyaṃ dātuṃ hṛdi kṛtaṃ prāptaṃ tatkṣaṇameva ca ।। 41 ।। gṛhe tāni ca saṃsthāpya cāgato'nveṣaṇe bhave ।। virāme sukhasambhoge tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi sāmpratam ।। 42 ।। kāmukasya vacaḥ śrutvā ghṛtācī sasmitā mune ।। dadau pratyuttaraṃ śīghraṃ nītiyuktaṃ manoharam ।। 43 ।। ghṛtācyuvāca ।। tvayā yaduktaṃ bhadraṃ tatsvīkaromyadhunā param ।। । kintu sāmayikaṃ vākyaṃ bravīṣyāmi smarātura ।। 44 ।। kāmadevālayaṃ yāmi kṛtaveṣā ca tatkṛte ।। yaddine yatkṛte yāmo vayaṃ teṣāṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ।।45।। adyāhaṃ kāmapatnī ca gurupatnī tavādhunā ।। tvayoktamadhunedaṃ ca paṭhitaṃ kāmadevataḥ ।। 46 ।। vidyādātā mantradātā gururlakṣaguṇaiḥ pituḥ ।। mātuḥ sahasraguṇavānnāstyanyastatsamo guruḥ ।।47।। guroḥ śataguṇaiḥ pūjyā gurupatnī śrutau śrutā।। pituḥ śataguṇaṃ pūjyā yathā mātā vicakṣaṇa ।।48।। mātrā samāgame sūnoryāvāndoṣaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ ।। tato lakṣaguṇo doṣo gurupatnīsamāgame ।। 49 ।। mātarityeva śabdena yāṃ ca sambhāṣate naraḥ ।। sa mātṛtulyā satyena dharmaḥ sākṣī satāmapi ।। 50 ।। tayā hi saṃgato yassyātkālasūtraṃ prayāti saḥ ।। tatra ghore vasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 51 ।। mātrā saha samāyoge tato doṣaścaturguṇaḥ ।। sārddhaṃ ca gurupatnyā ca tallakṣaguṇa eva ca।।52।। kumbhīpāke patatyeva yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। prāyaścittaṃ pāpinaśca tasya naiva śrutau śrutam ।।53।। cakrākāraṃ kulālasya tīkṣṇadhāraṃ ca khaṅgavat ।। vasāmūtrapurīṣaiśca paripūrṇaṃ sudustaram ।। 54 ।। śūlavatkṛmisaṃyuktaṃ taptamagnisamaṃ dravat ।। pāpināṃ tadvihāraṃ ca kumbhīpākaprakīrtitam ।। 55 ।। yāvāndoṣo hi puṃsāṃ ca gurupatnīsamāgame ।। tāvāṃśca gurupatnyāṃ vai tatra cetkāmukī yadi ।। 56 ।। adya yāsyāmi kāmasya mandiraṃ tasya kāminī ।। veṣaṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi tvatkṛte'haṃ dināntare ।।57।। ghṛtācīvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā ruroṣa tām ।। śaśāpa śūdrayoniṃ ca vrajeti jagatītale ।।58।। ghṛtācī tadvacaḥ śrutvā taṃ śaśāpa sudāruṇam ।। labha janma bhave tvaṃ ca svargabhraṣṭo bhaveti ca ।। 59 ।। ghṛtācī kārumuktvā ca sā'gacchatkāmamandiram ।। kāmena surataṃ kṛtvā kathayāmāsa tāṃ kathām ।। 60 ।। sā bhārate ca kāmoktyā gopasya madanasya ca ।। patnyāṃ prayāge nagare lebhe janma ca śaunaka ।। 61 ।। jātismarā tatprasūtā babhūva ca tapasvinī ।। varaṃ na vavre dharmiṣṭhā tapasyāyāṃ mano dadhau ।। 62 ।। tapaścakāra tapasā taptakāñcanasannibhā ।। divyaṃ ca śatavarṣaṃ sā gaṅgātīre manorame ।। 63 ।। vīryeṇa surakārośca nava putrānprasūya sā ।। punaḥ svalokaṃ gatvā ca sā ghṛtācī babhūva ha ।। 64 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। kathaṃ vīryyaṃ sā dadhāra surakārostapasvinī ।। putrānnava prasūtā ca kutra vā kati vāsarān।। 65 । sautiruvāca ।। viśvakarmā tu tacchāpaṃ samākarṇya ruṣā'nvitaḥ ।। jagāma brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ śokena hṛtacetanaḥ ।। 66 ।। natvā stutvā ca brahmāṇaṃ kathayāmāsa tāṃ kathām ।। lalābha janma brāhmaṇyāṃ pṛthivyāmājñayā vidheḥ ।। 67 ।। sa eva brāhmaṇo bhūtvā bhuvi kārurbabhūva ha ।। nṛpāṇāṃ ca gṛhasthānāṃ nānāśilpaṃ cakāra ha ।।68।। śilpaṃ ca kārayāmāsa sarvebhyaḥ sarvataḥ sadā । vicitraṃ vividhaṃ śilpamāścaryyaṃ sumanoharam ।। 69 ।। ekadā tu prayāge ca śilpaṃ kṛtvā nṛpasya ca ।। snātuṃ jagāma gaṅgāṃ sa cāpaśyattatra kāminīm ।।70।। ghṛtācīṃ navarūpāṃ ca yuvatiṃ tāṃ tapasvinīm ।। jātismarāṃ tāṃ bubudhe sa ca jātismaro dvija ।। 71 ।। dṛṣṭvā sakāmaḥ sahasā babhūva hṛtacetanaḥ ।। uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ śāntāṃ tāṃ ca tapasvinīm।।72।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। aho'dhunā tvamatraiva ghṛtāci sumanohare ।। mā māṃ smarasi rambhoru viśvakarmā'hameva ca।।73।। śāpamokṣaṃ kariṣyāmi bhaja māṃ tava sundari।। tvatkṛte'tidahatyeva mano me sa ca manmathaḥ।। ।। 74 ।। dvijasya vacanaṃ śrutvā ghṛtācī navarūpiṇī।। uvāca madhuraṃ śāntā nītiyuktaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ ।।75।। gopikovāca।। taddine kāmakāntā'hamadhunā ca tapasvinī ।। kathaṃ tvayā saṃgatā syāṃ gaṃgātīre ca bhārate ।। 76 ।। viśvakarmannidaṃ puṇyaṃ karmakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam ।। atra yatkriyate karma bhogo'nyatra śubhāśubham ।। 77 ।। dharmī mokṣakṛte janma pralabhya tapasaḥ phalāt ।। nibaddhaḥ kurute karma mohito viṣṇumāyayā ।। 78 ।। māyā nārāyaṇīśānā parituṣṭā ca yaṃ bhavet ।। tasmai dadāti śrīkṛṣṇo bhaktiṃ tanmantramīpsitam ।। 79 ।। yo mūḍho viṣayāsakto labdhajanmā ca bhārate ।। vihāya kṛṣṇaṃ sarveśaṃ sa mugdho viṣṇumāyayā ।। 80 ।। sarvaṃ smarāmi devāhamaho jātismarā purā ।। ghṛtācī suraveśyā'hamadhunā gopakanyakā ।। 81 ।। tapaḥ karomi mokṣārthaṃ gaṅgātīre supuṇyade ।। nātra sthalaṃ ca krīḍāyāḥ sthirastvaṃ bhava kāmuka ।। 82 ।। anyatra yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ tadvinaśyati ।। gaṃgātīre kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sadyo lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ।। 83 ।। tattu nārāyaṇakṣetre tapasā ca vinaśyati ।। yadyeva kāmataḥ kṛtvā nivṛttaśca bhavetpunaḥ ।। 84 ।। ghṛtācīvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā'nilākṛtiḥ ।। jagāma tāṃ gṛhītvā ca malayaṃ candanālayam ।। 85 ।। ramyāyāṃ malayadroṇyāṃ puṣpatalpe manorame ।। । puṣpacandanavātena saṃtataṃ surabhīkṛte।।86।। cakāra sukhasambhogaṃ tayā sa vijane vane ।। pūrṇaṃ dvādaśavarṣaṃ ca bubudhe na divāniśam।।87।। babhūva garbhaḥ kāminyāḥ paripūrṇaḥ sudurvahaḥ।। sā suṣāva ca tatraiva putrānnava manoharān।।88।। kṛtaśikṣitaśilpāṃśva jñānayuktāṃśca śaunaka।। pūrṇaprāktanato yugyānbalayuktānvicakṣaṇān ।। 89 ।। mālākārānkarmakārāñchaṅkhakārānkuvindakān ।। kumbhakārānsūtrakārānsvarṇacitrakarāṃstathā ।। 90 ।। tau ca tebhyo varaṃ dattvā tānsaṃsthāpya mahītale ।। mānavīṃ tanumutsṛjya jagmaturnijamandiram ।। 91 ।। svarṇakāraḥ svarṇacauryādbrāhmaṇānāṃ dvijottama ।। babhūva patitaḥ sadyo brahmaśāpena karmaṇā ।। 92 ।। sūtrakāro dvijānāṃ tu śāpena patito bhuvi ।। śīghraṃ ca yajñakāṣṭhāni na dadau tena hetunā।।93।। vyatikrameṇa citrāṇāṃ sadyaścitrakarastathā ।। patito brahmaśāpena brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kopataḥ।।94। kaścidvaṇigviśeṣaśca saṃsargātsvarṇakāriṇaḥ ।। svarṇacauryyādidoṣeṇa patito brahmaśāpataḥ ।।95।। kulaṭāyāṃ ca śūdrāyāṃ citrakārasya vīryyataḥ ।। babhūvāṭṭālikākāraḥ patito jāradoṣataḥ ।। 96 ।। aṭṭālikākārabījātkumbhakārasya yoṣiti ।। babhūva koṭakaḥ sadyaḥ patito gṛhakārakaḥ ।। 97 ।। kumbhakārasya bījena sadyaḥ koṭakayoṣiti ।। babhūva tailakāraśca kuṭilaḥ patito bhuvi।। ।। 98 ।। sadyaḥ kṣatriyabījena rājaputrasya yoṣiti ।। babhūva tīvaraścaiva patito jāradoṣataḥ ।। 99 ।। tīvarasya tu bījena tailakārasya yoṣiti।। babhūva patito dasyurleṭaśca parikīrtitaḥ ।। 100 ।। leṭastīvarakanyāyāṃ janayāmāsa ṣaṭ sutān ।। māllaṃ mantraṃ mātaraṃ ca bhaṇḍaṃ kolaṃ kalandaram ।। 101 ।। brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdravīryyeṇa patito jāradoṣataḥ ।। sadyo babhūva caṇḍālaḥ sarvasmādadhamo'śuciḥ ।। ।। 102 ।। tīvareṇa ca caṇḍālyāṃ carmakāro babhūva ha ।। carmakāryyāṃ ca caṇḍālānmāṃsacchedo babhūva ha ।। 103 ।। māṃsacchedyāṃ tīvareṇa koñcaśca parikīrtitaḥ ।। koñcastriyāṃ tu kaivarttātkarttāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। 104 ।। sadyaścaṇḍālakanyāyāṃ leṭavīryyeṇa śaunaka ।। babhūvatustau dvau putrau duṣṭau haḍḍiḍamau tathā ।।105।। krameṇa haḍḍikanyāyāṃ sadyaścaṇḍālavīryyataḥ ।। babhūvuḥ pañca putrāśca duṣṭā vanacarāśca te ।। 106 ।। leṭāttīvarakanyāyāṃ gaṅgātīre ca śaunaka ।। babhūva sadyo yo bālo gaṅgāputraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 107 ।। gaṅgāputrasya kanyāyāṃ vīryyādvai veṣadhāriṇaḥ ।। babhūva veṣadhārī ca putro yuṅgī prakīrtitaḥ ।। 108 ।। vaiśyāttīvarakanyāyāṃ sadyaḥ śuṇḍī babhūva ha ।। śuṇḍīyoṣiti vaiśyānu pauṇḍrakaśca babhūva ha ।। 109 ।। kṣatrātkaraṇakanyāyāṃ rājaputro babhūva ha ।। rājaputryāṃ tu karaṇādāgarīti prakīrtitaḥ ।। 110 ।। kṣatravīryyeṇa vaiśyāyāṃ kaivarttaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। kalau tīvarasaṃsargāddhīvaraḥ patito bhuvi ।। 111 ।। tīvaryāṃ dhīvarātputro babhūva rajakaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। rajakyāṃ tīvarāccaiva koyālīti babhūva ha ।। 112 ।। nāpitādgopakanyāyāṃ sarvasvī tasya yoṣiti ।। kṣatrādbabhūva vyādhaśca balavānmṛgahiṃsakaḥ ।। 113 ।। tīvarācchuṇḍikanyāyāṃ babhūvuḥ sapta putrakāḥ ।। te kalau haḍḍisaṃsargādbabhūvurdasyavaḥ sadā ।। 114 ।। brāhmaṇyāmṛṣivīryyeṇa ṛtoḥ prathamavāsare ।। kutsitaścodare jātaḥ kūdarastena kīrtitaḥ ।। 115 ।। tadaśaucaṃ vipratulyaṃ patitaścartudoṣataḥ ।। sadyaḥ koṭakasaṃsargādadhamo jagatītale ।। 116 ।। kṣatravīryyeṇa vaiśyāyāmṛtoḥ prathamavāsare ।। jātaḥ putro mahādasyurbalavāṃśca dhanurddharaḥ ।। 117 ।। cakāra vāgatītaṃ ca kṣatriyeṇāpi vāritaḥ ।। tena jātyāḥ sa putraśca vāgatītaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 118 ।। kṣattravīryyeṇa śūdrāyāmṛtudoṣeṇa pāpataḥ ।। balavanto durantāśca babhūvurmlecchajātayaḥ ।। 119 ।। aviddhakarṇāḥ krūrāśca nirbhayā raṇadurjayāḥ ।। śaucācāravihīnāśca durddharṣā dharmavarjitāḥ ।। 120 ।। mlecchātkuvindakanyāyāṃ jolā jātirbabhūva ha।। । jolātkuvindakanyāyāṃ śarāṅkaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। 121 ।। varṇasaṅkaradoṣeṇa bahvyaścāśrutajātaya ।। tāsāṃ nāmāni saṃkhyāśca ko vā vaktuṃ kṣamo dvija ।। 122 ।। vaidyo'śvinīkumāreṇa jāto viprasya yoṣiti ।। vaidyavīryyeṇa śūdrāyāṃ babhūvurbahavo janāḥ ।। 123 ।। te ca grāmyaguṇajñāśca mantrauṣadhiparāyaṇāḥ ।। tebhyaśca jātāḥ śūdrāyāṃ ye vyālagrāhiṇo bhuvi ।। 124 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। kathaṃ brāhmaṇapatnyāṃ tu sūryyaputro'śvinīsutaḥ ।। aho kenāvivekena vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 129 ।। sautiruvāca ।। gacchantīṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ ravinandanaḥ ।। dadarśa kāmukaḥ śāntaḥ puṣpodyāne ca nirjane ।। 126 ।। tayā nivārito yatnādbalena balavānsuraḥ ।। atīva sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 127 ।। drutaṃ tatyāja garbhaṃ sā puṣpodyāne manohare ।। sadyo babhūva putraśca taptakāñcanasannibhaḥ ।। 128 ।। saputrā svāmino gehaṃ jagāma vrīḍitā sadā ।। svāminaṃ kathayāmāsa yanmārge daivasaṅkaṭam ।। 129 ।। vipro roṣeṇa tatyāja taṃ ca putraṃ svakāminīm ।। saridbabhūva yogena sā ca godāvarī smṛtā ।। 130 ।। putraṃ cikitsāśāstraṃ ca pāṭhayāmāsa yatnataḥ ।। nānāśilpaṃ ca maṃtraṃ ca svayaṃ sa ravinandanaḥ ।। 131 ।। vipraśca vetanājyotirgaṇanācca nirantaram ।। vedadharmaparityakto babhūva gaṇako bhuvi ।। 132 ।। lobhī vipraśca śūdrāṇāmagre dānaṃ gṛhītavān ।। grahaṇe mṛtadānānāmagrādāno babhūva saḥ ।। 133 ।। kaścitpumānbrahmayajñe yajñakuṇḍātsamutthitaḥ ।। sa sūto dharmavaktā ca matpūrvapuruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 134 ।। purāṇaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa taṃ ca brahmā kṛpānidhiḥ ।। purāṇavaktā sūtaśca yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavaḥ ।। 139 ।। vaiśyāyāṃ sūtavīryyeṇa pumāneko babhūva ha ।। sa bhaṭṭo vāvadūkaśca sarveṣāṃ stutipāṭhakaḥ ।। 136 ।। evaṃ te kathitaḥ kiṃcitpṛthivyāṃ jātinirṇaya ।। varṇasaṅkaradoṣeṇa bahvyo'nyāḥ santi jātayaḥ।। 1 37।। sabandho yeṣu yeṣāṃ yaḥ sarvajātiṣu sarvataḥ ।। tattvaṃ bravīmi vedoktaṃ brahmaṇā kathitaṃ purā ।। 138 ।। pitā tātastu janako janmadātā prakīrtitaḥ ।। ambā mātā ca jananī janayitrī prasūrapi ।। 139 ।। pitāmahaḥ pitṛpitā tatpitā prapitāpahaḥ ।। ata ūrdhvaṃ jñātayaśca sagotrāḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। 140 ।। mātāmahaḥ pitā mātuḥ pramātāmaha eva ca ।। mātāmahasya janakastatpitā vṛddhapūrvakaḥ ।। 141 ।। pitāmahī piturmātā tacchvaśrūḥ prapitāmahī ।। tacchvaśrūśca parijñeyā sā vṛddhaprapitāmahī ।। 142 ।। mātāmahī mātṛmātā mātṛtulyā ca pūjitā ।। pramātāmahīti jñeyā pramātāmahakāminī ।। 143 ।। vṛddhamātāmahī jñeyā patpituḥ kāminī tathā ।। pitṛbhrātā pitṛ vyaśca mātṛbhrātā ca mātulaḥ ।। 144 ।। pitṛṣvasā piturmātṛṣvasā mātussvasā smṛtā ।। sūnuśca tanayaḥ putro dāyādaścātmajastathā।। ।। 145 ।। dhanabhāgvīryyajaścaiva puṃsi janye ca varttate ।। janyāyāṃ duhitā kanyā cātmajā parikīrtitā ।। 146 ।। putrapatnī vadhū jñeyā jāmātā duhituḥ patiḥ ।। patiḥ priyaśca bhartā ca svāmīkānte ca vartate ।। 147 ।। devaraḥ svāmino bhrātā nanāṃdā svāminaḥ svasā ।। śvaśuraḥ svāminastātaḥ śvaśrūśca svāminaḥ prasūḥ ।। 148 ।। bhāryyā jāyā priyā kāntā strī va patnī prakīrtitā ।। patnībhrātā śyālakaśca svasā patnyāśca śyālikā ।। 149 ।। patnīmātā tathā śvaśrūstatpitā śvaśuraḥ smṛtaḥ ।। sagarbhaḥ sodaro bhrātā sagarbhā bhaginī smṛtā ।। 150 ।। bhaginījo bhāgineyo bhrātṛjo bhrātṛputrakaḥ ।। āvutto bhaginīkānto bhaginīpatireva ca ।। 191 ।। śyālīpatistu bhrātā ca śvaśuraikatvahetunā ।। śvaśurastu pitā jñeyo janmadātuḥ samo mune ।।192।। annadātā bhayatrātā patnītātastathaiva ca ।। vidyādātā janmadātā paṃcaite pitaro nṛṇām ।। 153।। annadātuśca yā patnī bhaginī gurukāminī mātā ca tatsapatnī ca kanyā putrapriyā tathā ।।154।। māturmātā piturmātā śvaśrūpitroḥ svasā tathā।। pitṛvyastrī mātulānī mātaraśca cartudaśa।।155।। pautrastu putraputre ca prapautrastatsute'pi ca ।। tatputrādyāśca ye vaṃśyāḥ kulajāśca prakīrtitāḥ।।156।। kanyāputraśca dauhitrastatputrādyāśca bāṃdhavāḥ।। bhāgineyasutādyāśca puruṣā bāṃdhavāḥ smṛtāḥ।।157।। bhrātṛputrasya putrādyāste punarjñātayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। guruputrastathā bhrātā poṣyaḥ paramabāndhavaḥ।।158।। gurukanyā ca bhaginī poṣyā mātṛsamā mune।। putrasya ca gururbhrātā poṣyaḥ susnigdhabāndhavaḥ ।।159।। putrasya śvaśuro bhrātā bandhurvaivāhikaḥ smṛtaḥ।। kanyāyāḥ śvaśure caiva tatsambandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ।। 160।। guruśca kanyakāyāśca bhrātā susnigdhabāndhavaḥ ।। guruśvaśurabhrātṝṇāṃ gurutulyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 161।। bandhutā yena sārddha ca tanmitraṃ parikīrtitam ।। mitraṃ sukhapradaṃ jñeyaṃ duḥkhado ripurucyate ।। 162 ।। bāndhavo duḥkhado daivānnissambandho'sukhapradaḥ ।। sambandhāstrividhāḥ puṃsāṃ viprendra jagatītale ।। 163 ।। vidyājo yonijaścaiva prītijaśca prakīrtitaḥ ।। mitraṃ tu prītijaṃ jñeyaṃ sa sambadhaḥ sudurlabhaḥ ।। 164 ।। mitramātā mitrabhāryyā mātṛtulyā na saṃśayaḥ।। mitrabhrātā mitrapitā bhrātṛtātasamau nṛṇām ।।165।। caturthaṃ nāmasambandhamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ।। jāraścopapartirbandhurduṣṭā sambhogakarttari ।। 166 ।। upapatnyāṃ navajñā ca preyasī cittahāriṇī ।। svāmitulyaśca jāraśca navajñā gṛhiṇī samā ।। 167 ।। sambandho deśabhede ca sarvadeśe vigarhitaḥ ।। avaidiko ninditastu viśvāmitreṇa nirmitaḥ ।। 168 ।। dustyajaśca mahadbhistu deśabhede vidhīyate ।। akīrtijanakaḥ puṃsāṃ yoṣitāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।। 169 ।। tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vidyamāne yuge yuge ।। 170 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe jātisambandhanirṇayo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 10 ।।
<1.11> śaunaka uvāca ।। dvijaḥ sa bhāryyāṃ saṃtyajya kiñcakāra viśeṣataḥ ।। aśvinorvā mahābhāga kiṃ nāma kasya vaṃśajau ।। 1 ।। sotiruvāca ।। dvijaśca sutapā nāma bhāradvājo mahāmuniḥ ।। tapaścakāra kṛṣṇasya lakṣavarṣaṃ himāliye ।। 2 ।। mahātapasvī tejasvī prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। jyotirdadarśa kṛṣṇasya gagane sahasā kṣaṇam ।। 3 ।। varaṃ sa vavre nirliptamātmānaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। na ca mokṣaṃ yayāce taṃ dāsyaṃ bhaktiṃ ca niścalām ।। 4 ।। babhūvākāśavāṇīti kuru dāraparigraham ।। paścāddāsyaṃ pradāsyāmi bhaktiṃ bhogakṣaye dvija ।।5।। pitṝṇāṃ mānasīṃ kanyāṃ dadau tasmai vidhiḥ svayam ।। tasyāṃ kalyāṇamitraśca babhūva munipuṅgava ।। 6 ।। yasya smaraṇamātreṇa na bhavetkuliśādbhayam ।। na draṣṭavyaṃ bandhumātraṃ nūnaṃ tatsmaraṇāllabhet ।। 7 ।। kalyāṇamitrajananīṃ parityajya mahāmuniḥ ।। śaśāpa sūryyaputraṃ ca yajñabhāgvarjjito bhava ।। 8 ।। sa sodaraśca vā pūjyo bhaveti ca surādhama ।। vyādhigrasto jaḍāṅgaśca bhūyātte'kīrtimāniti।।9।। ityuktvā sutapā gehaṃ pratasthe sūnunā saha ।। aśvibhyāṃ sahitaḥ sūryyaḥ prayayau ca tadantikam ।। 10 ।। putrābhyāṃ vyādhiyuktābhyāṃ sūryyastrijagatāṃ patiḥ ।। munīndraṃ vai sutapasaṃ sa tuṣṭāva ca śaunaka ।। 11 ।। sūryya uvāca।। kṣamasva bhagavanvipra viṣṇurūpa yuge yuge ।। mama putrāparādhaṃ ca bhāradvāja munīśvara ।। 12 ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāḥ surāḥ sarve ca santatam ।। bhuñjate vipradattaṃ tu phalapuṣpajalādikam ।। 13 ।। brāhmaṇāvāhitā devāḥ śaśvadviśveṣu pūjitāḥ ।। na ca viprātparo devo viprarūpī svayaṃ hariḥ ।। 14 ।। brāhmaṇe parituṣṭe ca tuṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। nārāyaṇe ca santuṣṭe santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। 15 ।। nāsti gaṅgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ na ca kṛṣṇātparaḥ suraḥ ।। na śaṅkarādvaiṣṇavaśca na sahiṣṇurdharā parā ।। 16 ।। na ca satyātparo dharmo na sādhvī pārvatīparā ।। na daivādbalavānkaścinna ca putrātparaḥ priyaḥ ।। 17 ।। na ca vyādhisamaḥ śatrurna ca pūjyo guroḥ paraḥ ।। nāsti mātṛsamo bandhurna ca mitraṃ pituḥ param ।। 18 ।। ekādaśīvratānnānyattapo nānaśanātparam ।। paraṃ sarvadhanaṃ ratnaṃ vidyā ratnaṃ paraṃ tataḥ ।। 19 ।। sarvāśramaiḥ paro vipro nāsti viprasamo guruḥ ।। vedavedāṅgatattvajña ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 20 ।। sūryyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājo nanāma tam ।। nīrujau cāpi tatputrau cakāra tapasaḥ phalāt ।। 21 ।। paścācca tava putrau ca yajñabhājau bhaviṣyataḥ ।। ityuktvā taṃ ca sutapāḥ praṇamyāhaskaraṃ muniḥ ।। 22 ।। jagāma gaṅgāṃ saṃtrasto harisevanatatparaḥ।। putrābhyāṃ sahitaḥ sūryyo jagāma nija mandiram ।। 23 ।। babhūvatustau pūjyau ca yajñabhājau dvijāśiṣā ।। etatsūryakṛtaṃ viprastotraṃ yo mānavaḥ paṭhet ।। viprapādaprasādena sarvatra vijayī bhavet ।। 24 ।। brāhmaṇebhyo nama iti prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।। 25 ।। pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni tīrthāni sāgare ।। sāgare yāni tīrthāni viprapādeṣu tāni ca ।। 26 ।। viprapādodakaṃ pītvā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī ।। tāvatpuṣkarapātreṣu pibaṃti pitaro jalam ।। 27 ।। viprapādodakaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ pibet ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।।28।। mahārogī yadi pibedviprapādodakaṃ dvija ।। mucyate sarvarogācca māsamekaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ ।।29 ।। avidyo vā savidyo vā saṃdhyāpūto hi yo dvijaḥ ।। sa eva viṣṇusadṛśo na harau vimukho yadi ।। 30 ।। ghnantaṃ vipraṃ śapantaṃ vā na hanyānna ca taṃ śapet ।। gobhyaḥ śataguṇaṃ pūjyo haribhaktaśca sa smṛtaḥ।।31।। pādodakaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhuṅkte viprasya yo dvija।। nityaṃ naivedyabhojī yo rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 32 ।। ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṅkte yo nityaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcayet।। tasya pādodakaṃ prāpya sthalaṃ tīrthaṃ bhaved dhruvam।। 33 ।। yo bhuṅkte bhojanocchiṣṭaṃ nityaṃ naivedyabhojanam ।। kṛṣṇadevasya pūto'sau jīvanmukto mahītale ।। 34 ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā payo mūtraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam ।। dvijānāṃ kulajātānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ।।35।। brahmā ca brahmaputrāśca sarve viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ।। brāhmaṇastatkule jāto vimukhaśca harau katham ।।36।। pitrormātāmahādīnāṃ saṃsargasya gurośca vā।। doṣeṇa vimukhāḥ kṛṣṇe viprā jīvanmṛtāśca te ।। 37 ।। sa kiṃguruḥ sa kiṃtātaḥ sa kiṃputraḥ sa kiṃsakhā ।। sa kiṃrājā sa kiṃbandhurna dadyādyo harau matim ।। 38 ।। avaiṣṇavāddvijādvipra caṇḍālo vaiṣṇavo varaḥ ।। sagaṇaḥ śvapaco mukto brāhmaṇo narakaṃ vrajet ।। 39 ।। sandhyāhīno'śucirnityaṃ kṛṣṇe vā vimukho dvijaḥ ।। sa eva brāhmaṇābhāso viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 40 ।। guruvaktrādviṣṇumaṃtro yasya karṇe praviśyati ।। taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ jīvanmuktaṃ vadedvidhiḥ ।। ।। 41 ।। puṃsāṃ mātāmahādīnāṃ śataiḥ sārddhaṃ hareḥ padam ।। prayāti vaiṣṇavaḥ puṃsāmātmanaḥ kulakoṭibhiḥ ।।42।। brahmakṣattriyaviṭśūdrāścatasro jātayo yathā ।। svatantrā jātirekā ca viśvasminvaiṣṇavābhidhā ।। 43 ।। dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ śaśvadgovindapadapaṅkajam ।। dhyāyate tāṃśca govindaḥ śaśvatteṣāṃ ca sannidhau ।।44।। sudarśanaṃ saṃniyojya bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ।। tathāpi na hi niścinto'vatiṣṭhedbhaktasannidhau ।। 45 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe viṣṇuvaiṣṇavabrāhmaṇapraśaṃsā nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। ।। 11 ।।
