<1.12> śaunaka uvāca ।। ṛṣivaṃśaprasaṅgena babhūvurvividhāḥ kathāḥ ।। upālambhena prastāvātkautukena śrutā mayā ।।1।। prajā vā sasṛjuḥ ke vā ūrdhvaretāśca kaścana ।। pitrā saha virodhena nāradaḥ kiṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 2 ।। pituḥ śāpena putrasya kiṃ babhūva virodhataḥ ।। piturvā putraśāpena saute tatkathyatāṃ śubham ।। 3 ।। sautiruvāca ।। haṃso yatiścāraṇiśca voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ।। apāntaratamāścaiva sanakādyāśca śaunaka ।। 4 ।। etairvinā'nye bahavo brahmaputrāśca santatam ।। sāṃsārikāḥ prajāvanto gurvājñāparipālakāḥ ।। 5 ।। apūjyaḥ putraśāpena svayaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ ।। tenaiva brahmaṇo mantraṃ nopāsante vipaścitaḥ ।। 6 ।। nārado guruśāpena gandharvaśca babhūva saḥ।। kathayāmi suvistīrṇaṃ tadvṛttāntaṃ niśāmaya ।। 7 ।। gandharvarājaḥ sarveṣāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ varo mahān ।। paramaiśvaryyasaṃyuktaḥ putrahīno hi karmaṇā ।। 8 ।। gurvājñayā puṣkare sa parameṇa samādhinā ।। tapaścakāra śambhośca kṛpaṇo dīnamānasaḥ ।। 9 ।। śivasya kavacaṃ stotraṃ mantraṃ ca dvādaśākṣaram ।। dadau gandharvarājāya vasiṣṭhaśca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 10 ।। jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ mune ।। puṣkare sa nirāhāraḥ putraduḥkhena tāpitaḥ ।। 11 ।। virāme śatavarṣasya dadarśa purataḥ śivam ।। bhāsayaṃtaṃ daśa diśo jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 12 ।। mahattejassvarūpaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। īṣaddhāsaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 13 ।। taporūpaṃ tapobījaṃ tapasyāphaladaṃ phalam ।। śaraṇāgatabhaktāya dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 14 ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vṛṣabhasthaṃ digambaram ।। śuddha sphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam ।। 15 ।। taptasvarṇaprabhājuṣṭajaṭājāladharaṃ varam ।। nīlakaṇḍaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ nāgayajñopavītakam ।। 16 ।। saṃhartāraṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kālaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ param ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍakoṭisaṃkāśamīśvaram ।। 17 ।। tattvajñānapradaṃ śāṃtaṃ muktidaṃ haribhaktidam ।। dṛṣṭvā nanāma sahasā gandharvo daṇḍavadbhuvi ।। 18 ।। vasiṣṭhadattastotreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। varaṃ vṛṇuṣveti śivastamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। sa yayāce hare bhaktiṃ putraṃ paramavaiṣṇavam ।। 19 ।। gandharvasya vacaḥ śrutvā cāha sīccandraśekharaḥ ।। uvāca dīnaṃ dīneśo dīnabandhuḥ sanātanam ।। 20 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। kṛtārthastvaṃ varādekādanyaccarvitacarvaṇam ।। gandharvarāja vṛṇuṣe ko vā tṛpto'timaṅgale ।। 21 ।। yasya bhaktirharau vatsa sudṛḍhā sarvamaṅgalā ।। sa samarthaḥ sarvaviśvaṃ pātuṃ karttuṃ ca līlayā ।। 22 ।। ātmanaḥ kulakoṭiṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ।। puruṣāṇāṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ yāti niścitam ।।23।। trividhāni ca pāpāni koṭijanmārjitāni ca ।। nihatya puṇyabhogaṃ ca haridāsyaṃ labhed dhruvam।।24।। tāvatpatnī sutastāvattāvadaiśvaryyamīpsitam।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ nṛṇāṃ tāvadyāvatkṛṣṇe na mānasam।। 29 ।। kṛṣṇe manasi saṃjāte bhaktikhaḍgo duratyayaḥ ।। narāṇāṃ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ mūlacchedaṃ karotyaho ।। 26 ।। bhavedyeṣāṃ sukṛtināṃ putrāḥ paramavaiṣṇavāḥ ।। kulakoṭiṃ ca teṣāṃ te uddharantyeva līlayā ।। 27 ।। caritārthaḥ pumānekādvaramicchurvarādaho।। kiṃ vareṇa dvitīyena puṃsāṃ tṛptirna maṅgale ।। 28 ।। dhanaṃ saṃcitamasmākaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sudurlabham ।। śrīkṛṣṇe bhaktidāsyaṃ ca na vayaṃ dātumutsukāḥ ।।29।। varayānyaṃ varaṃ vatsa yatte manasi vāṃchitam।। indratvamamaratvaṃ vā brahmatvaṃ labha durlabham।। 30।। sarvasiddhiṃ mahāyogaṃ jñānaṃ mṛtyujayādikam ।। sukhena sarvaṃ dāsyāmi haridāsyaṃ tyaja dhruvam ।। 31 ।। śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। uvāca dīno dīneśaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 32 ।। gandharva uvāca ।। yatpakṣmacālanenaiva brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet ।। tadbrahmatvaṃ svapnatulyaṃ kṛṣṇabhakto na cecchati ।। 33 ।। indratvamamaratvaṃ vā siddhiyogādikaṃ śiva ।। jñānaṃ mṛtyujayādyaṃ vā na hi bhaktasya vāñchitam ।। 34 ।। sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpyasāyujyaṃ śrīharerapi ।। tatra nirvāṇamokṣaṃ ca na hi vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 39 ।। śaśvattatra dṛḍhā bhaktirharidāsyaṃ sudurlabham ।। svapne jāgaraṇe bhaktā vāñchantyevaṃ varaṃ varam ।। 36 ।। taddāsyaṃ vaiṣṇavasutaṃ dehi kalpataro varam ।। tvāṃ prāpya labhate tuṣṭaṃ varaṃ sarvavaro'varaḥ ।। 37।। na dāsyasīdaṃ cecchambho varaṃ duṣkṛtinaṃ ca mām ।। kṛtvā hi svaśiraśchedaṃ pradāsyāmi hutāśane ।। 38 ।। gandharvavacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। bhaktaṃ dīnaṃ ca bhakteśo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ।।39।। śrīśaṃkara uvāca ।। haribhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ putraṃ paramavaiṣṇavam।। cirāyuṣaṃ ca guṇinaṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanam ।। 40 ।। jñāninaṃ sundaravaraṃ gurubhaktaṃ jitendriyam ।। gandharvarājapravaraṃ varemaṃ labha mā śucaḥ ।। 41 ।। ityuktvā śaṃkarastasmājjagāma svālayaṃ mune ।। gandharvarājaḥ santuṣṭa ājagāma svamandiram ।। 42 ।। praphullamānasāḥ sarve mānavāḥ siddhakarmaṇaḥ ।। nāradastasya bhāryyāyāṃ lebhe janma ca bhārate ।। 43 ।। suṣāva putraṃ sā vṛddhā parvate gandhamādane ।। gururvasiṣṭho bhagavānnāma cakre yathocitam ।। 44 ।। bālakasya ca tasyaiva maṅgalaṃ maṅgale dine ।। upa śabdo'dhikārthaśca pūjye ca barhaṇaḥ pumān ।। pūjyānāmadhiko bālastenopabarhaṇābhidhaḥ ।। 49 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe sauti śaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe nāradajanmakathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 12 ।।
<1.13> sautiruvāca ।। putrotsave ca ratnāni dhanāni vividhāni ca ।। gandharvarājaḥ pradadau brāhmaṇebhyo mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 1 ।। upabarhaṇastu kālena harermantraṃ sudurlabham ।। vasiṣṭhena tu samprāpya sa cakre duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।। 2 ।। ekadā gaṇḍakītīre taṃ ca samprāptayauvanam ।। gandharvapatnyo dadṛśurmūrcchāmāpuśca tatkṣaṇam ।। 3 ।। tāśca tīvraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā prāṇānsaṃtyajya yogataḥ ।। pañcāśattā babhūvuśca kanyāścitrarathasya ca ।। 4 ।। upabarhaṇagandharvaṃ tāśca taṃ vavrire patim ।। mudā mālā dadustasmai kāmukyaḥ piturājñayā ।। 5 ।। gṛhītvā tāśca gandharvo yuvā susthirayauvanaḥ।। divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣaṃ ca reme rahasi kāmukaḥ ।।6।। tato'pi suciraṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā tābhiḥ sahāniśam ।। jagāma brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ harigāthāṃ jagau mune ।।7।। dṛṣṭvā sa rambhārambhorunartane kaṭhinaṃ stanam ।। babhūva skhalanaṃ tasya gandharvasya mahātmanaḥ ।।8।। drutaṃ tatyāja saṅgītaṃ mūrcchāṃ prāpa sabhātale ।। uccaiḥ prajahasurdevā brahmā kopācchaśāpa tam ।। 9 ।। vraja tvaṃ śūdrayoniṃ ca gāndharvīṃ tanumutsṛja ।। kāle vaiṣṇavasaṃsargānmatputrastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।। ।। 10 ।। vinā vipattermahimā puṃsāṃ naiva bhavetsuta ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ krameṇa prabhavediti ।। 11 ।। ityevamuktvā sa vidhiragacchatpuṣkarād gṛham ।। upabarhaṇagandharvassa jahau tāṃ tanuṃ tadā ।। 12 ।। mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūramanāhatam ।। viśuddhamājñākhyaṃ ceti bhittvā ṣaṭcakrameva ca ।। 13 ।। iḍāṃ suṣumnāṃ medhāṃ ca piṅgalāṃ prāṇahāriṇīm ।। sarvajñānapradāṃ caiva manassaṃyaminīṃ tathā ।। 14 ।। viśuddhāṃ ca niruddhāṃ ca vāyusaṃcāriṇīṃ tathā ।। tejaśśuṣkakarīṃ caiva balapuṣṭikarīṃ tathā ।। 15 ।। buddhisaṃcāriṇīṃ caiva jñānajṛmbhanakāriṇīm ।। sarvaprāṇaharāṃ caiva punarjīvanakāriṇīm ।। 16 ।। etāḥ ṣoḍaśadhā nāḍīrbhittvā vai haṃsameva ca ।। manasā sahitaṃ brahmarandhramānīya yogataḥ ।। 17 ।। sthitvā muhūrtamātmānamātmanyeva yuyoja ha ।। jātismaraśca yogīndraḥ saṃprāpa brahma śaunaka ।। 18 ।। vīṇāṃ tritantrīṃ duṣprāpyāṃ vāmaskandhe nidhāya ca ।। śuddhasphaṭikamālāṃ ca vidhṛtvā dakṣiṇe kare ।। 19 ।। saṃjalpanparamaṃ brahma vedasāraṃ parātparam ।। paraṃ nistārabījaṃ ca kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam ।। 20 ।। prācyāṃ kṛtvā śiraḥsthānaṃ paścime caraṇadvayam ।। nidhāya darbhaśayane śayānaḥ puruṣo yathā ।। 21 ।। gandharvarājastaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāryyayā saha tatkṣaṇam ।। yogena brahma samprāpa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā smaran ।। 22 ।। patnyaśca bāndhavāḥ sarve vilapya rurudurbhuśam ।। jagmuḥ krameṇa śokārttā mohitā viṣṇumāyayā।।23।। pañcāśadyoṣitāṃ madhye pradhānā mahiṣī ca yā ।। sādhvī mālāvatī nāmnā paramā preyasī varā ।। ।। 24 ।। uccai ruroda sā tīvraṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi ।। ityuvāca ca śokārttā kāntaṃ saṃbodhya caiva hi ।। 25 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। he nātha ramaṇa śreṣṭha vidagdha rasikeśvara ।। darśanaṃ dehi māṃ bandho nimagnāṃ śokasāgare ।। 26 ।। visrambhake suvasane ramye candanakānane ।। puṣpabhadrānadītīre puṣpodyāne manohare ।। 27 ।। candanācalasānnidhye cārucandanakānane ।। puṣpacandanatalpe ca candanānilavāsite।।28।। gandhamādanaśailaikadeśe ramye nadītaṭe ।। puṃskokilanināde ca mālatījālaśālini।।29।। śrīśaile śrīvane divye śrīnivāsaniṣevite ।। śrīyukte śrīpadāmbhoje pūte'cyutakṛte śubhe ।। 30।। purā yā yā kṛtā krīḍā vasante rahasi tvayā ।। mayā ca durhṛdā sārddhaṃ tayā vai dūyate manaḥ ।। 31 ।। sudhātulyena vacasā siktā'haṃ ca purā tvayā ।। dūyate satataṃ tena paramātmā'tidāruṇam ।। 32 ।। sādhunā saha saṃsargo vaikuṇṭhādapi durlabhaḥ ।। aho tato'tivicchedo maraṇādapi duṣkaraḥ ।। 33 ।। tasmātteṣāṃ ca vicchedaḥ sādhuśokakaraḥ paraḥ ।। tato'pi bandhuvicchedaḥ śokaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ ।। 34 ।। tato'patyaviyogo hi maraṇādatiricyate ।। sarvasmātpatibhedo hi tatparaṃ nāsti saṅkaṭam ।। 35 ।। śayane bhojane snāne svapne jāgaraṇe'pi ca ।। svāmivicchedaduḥkhaṃ ca nūtanaṃ ca dine dine ।। 36 ।। sarvaśokaṃ vismaretstrī svāmisaṃyogamātrataḥ ।। bandhumanyaṃ na paśyāmi yaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismaretpatim ।। 37 ।। nāto viśiṣṭaṃ paśyāmi bāndhavaṃ svāminā vinā ।। sādhvīnāṃ kulajātānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 38 ।। he digīśāśca dikpālā he dharma tvaṃ prajāpate ।। girīśa kamalākānta patidānaṃ ca dehi me ।। 39 ।। ityuktvā virahārttā sā kanyā citrarathasya ca ।। mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa tatraiva durgame gahane vane ।। 40 ।। vicetanā tatra tasthau kāntaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। paripūrṇaṃ divānaktaṃ sarvadevaiśca rakṣitā ।। 41 ।। prabhāte cetanāṃ prāpya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ।। ityuvāca punastatra hariṃ saṃbodhya sā satī ।। 42।। mālāvatyuvāca।। he kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha nātha nāhaṃ jagadbahiḥ ।। tvameva jagatāṃ pātā māṃ na pāsi kathaṃ prabho ।। 43 ।। ayaṃ bharttā'sya bhāryyā'haṃ mameti tava māyayā।। tvameva sambhavo bharttā sarveṣāṃ sarvakāraṇaḥ।। 44 ।। gandharvaḥ karmaṇā kāntaḥ kāntā'haṃ cāsya karmaṇā ।। kva gataḥ karmabhogānte kutra saṃsthāpya māṃ priyām ।।45।। ko vā kasya patiḥ putraḥ kā vā kasya priyā prabho ।। saṃyunakti vidhātā ca vinayukti ca karmaṇā। ।।46।। saṃyoge paramānando viyoge prāṇasaṅkaṭam।। śaśvajjagati mūrkhasya nātmārāmasya niścitam।।47।। naśvaro viṣayaḥ satyaṃ bhuvi bhogaśca bāndhavaḥ।। svayaṃ tyaktaḥ sukhāyaiva duḥkhāya tyājitaḥ paraiḥ।।48।। tasmātsantaḥ svayaṃ tyaktvā paramaiśvaryamīpsitam।। dhyāyante satataṃ kṛṣṇa pādapadmaṃ nirāpadam ।। 49 ।। sarvatra jñāninaḥ santaḥ kā strī jñānavatī bhuvi ।। tato mahyaṃ vimūḍhāyai dātumarhati vāñchitam ।। 50 ।। na me vāñchā'maratve ca śakratve mokṣavartmani ।। imaṃ kāntaṃ varaṃ dehi caturvargakaraṃ param ।। 51 ।। yāvatī kāminījātirjagatyāṃ jagadīśvara ।। kasyaicinna hi dattaśca tena dhātredṛśaḥ patiḥ ।। 52 ।। tasmai dattā guṇāḥ sarve rūpāṇi vividhāni ca ।। suśīlāni ca sarvāṇi cāmaratvaṃ vinā hare ।। 53 ।। rūpeṇa ca guṇenaiva tejasā vikrameṇa ca ।। jñānena śāntyā santuṣṭyā haritulyaḥ prabhurmama ।। ।। 54 ।। haribhakto harisamo gāmbhīrye sāgaro yathā ।। dīptimānsūryyatulyaśca śuddho vahnisamastathā ।। 55 ।। candratulyaḥ sudṛśyaśca kandarpasamasundaraḥ ।। buddhyā bṛhaspatisamaḥ kāvye kavisamastathā ।। 56 ।। vāṇī ca sarvaśāstrajñā pratibhāyāṃ bhṛgoriva ।। kuberatulyo dhanavānmahāndātā manoriva ।। 57 ।। dharme dharmasamo dharmī satye satyavratādhikaḥ ।। kumāratulyastapasā svācāre brahmaṇā samaḥ ।। 58 ।। aiśvaryye śakratulyaśca sahiṣṇuḥ pṛthivīsamaḥ ।। evambhūto mṛtaḥ kāntaḥ prāṇā yānti na me katham ।। 59 ।। are surā yajñabhājo ghṛtaṃ bhoktuṃ kṣamā bhuvi ।। kṣaṇenāyajñabhājaśca kariṣyāmi svalīlayā ।। 60 ।। nārāyaṇa jagatkānta nāhameva jagadbahiḥ ।। śīghraṃ jīvaya matkāntamanyathā tvāṃ śapāmyaham ।। 61 ।। prajāpate putraśāpāttvamapūjyo mahītale ।। tavaivānadhikāritvaṃ kariṣyāmyadhunā bhave ।। 62 ।। he śambho jñānalopaṃ te kariṣyāmi śapena ca ।। dharmalopaṃ ca dharmasya kariṣyāmyeva līlayā ।। 63।। yamādhikāraṃ dūre ca kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।। satyaṃ kālaṃ śapiṣyāmi mṛtyukanyāṃ suniṣṭhurām ।। 64 ।। śapāmi sarvānatraiva jarāṃ vyādhiṃ vinā'dhunā ।। vyādhinā jarayā mṛtyurna hyabhūcca patermama ।। 69 ।। ityuktvā kauśikītīre cāgacchacchaptumeva tān ।। mālāvatī mahāsādhvī śavaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 66 ।। tāṃ śaptumudyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā devapurogamaḥ ।। jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ tīraṃ kṣīrapayonidheḥ ।। 67 ।। tatra snātvā ca tuṣṭāva paramātmānamīśvaram ।। viṣṇuṃ brahmā jagatkāntamityuvāca ha bhītavat ।। 68 ।। brahmovāca ।। upabarhaṇapatnī sā kanyā citrarathasya ca ।। kāntahetośca mā devāñchapettvaṃ rakṣa mādhava ।। 69 ।। smaranti sādhavaḥ santo japanti munayo mudā ।। svapne jāgaraṇe caiva sarvakāryyeṣu mādhavam ।। 70 ।। śaraṇāgatadīnārttaparitrāṇaparāyaṇa ।। rakṣa rakṣa hṛṣīkeśa vrajāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ vayam ।। 71 ।। pūjā me putraśāpena vihatā sāmprataṃ prabho ।। adhikārahataṃ māṃ ca kurute mālatī satī ।। 72 ।। sarvādhikāro brahmāṇḍe tvayā dattaḥ purā prabho ।। sampadetādṛśī nātha yāsyatyevādhunā mama ।। 73 ।। mahādeva uvāca ।। tvayā dattaṃ mahājñānaṃ guptaṃ sarveṣu durlabham ।। śatamanvantaratapaḥphalena puṣkare purā ।। 74 ।। aiśvaryaṃ vā dhanaṃ vā'pi vidyā vā vikramo'thavā ।। jñānasya paramārthasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 75 ।। sarvājñātaṃ sarvaguptamatyantaṃ durlabhaṃ param ।। mama tattvajñānaratnaṃ śāpānniryāti yoṣitaḥ ।। 76 ।। aho pativratātejaḥ sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ param ।। tejo'nalena dagdhaṃ māṃ rakṣa rakṣa hare hare ।। 77 ।। dharma uvāca ।। sarvaratnātparaṃ ratnaṃ dharma eva sanātanaḥ ।। yāsyatyevaṃvidho dharmastvayā dattaḥ purā prabho ।। 78 ।। saptamanvantaratapaḥphalena parameśvara ।। prāpto dharmo 'dhunā yāti śāpena yoṣitaḥ prabhau ।। 79 ।। devā ūcuḥ ।। yajñabhājo ghṛtabhujo vayameva tvayā kṛtāḥ ।। yoṣicchāpena tatsarvamadhunā yāti mādhava ।। 80 ।। ityuktvā saṃyatāḥ sarve tasthustatra bhayārditāḥ ।। etasminnantare'kasmādvāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। 81 ।। yūyaṃ gacchata tanmūlaṃ viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। paścādyāsyati śāntyarthamiti vo rakṣaṇāya ca ।। 82 ।। śrutvā tadvacanaṃ devāḥ prahṛṣṭamanasonmukhāḥ ।। jagmurmālāvatīsthānaṃ kauśikītīramīśvarāḥ ।। 83 ।। tāmeva dadṛśurdevā devīṃ mālāvatīṃ satīm ।। ratnasārendrabhūṣābhirujjvalāṃ kamalākalām ।। 84 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ sindūrabindubhūṣitām ।। śaraccandraprabhāṃ śāntāṃ dyotayantīṃ diśastviṣā ।। 89 ।। patisevāmahādharmacirasañcitatejasā ।। prajvalantīṃ supradīptaśikhāṃ vahnerivottamām ।। 86 ।। yogāsanaṃ kurvatī ca śavavakṣaḥsthalasthitām ।। suramyāṃ svāmino vīṇāṃ bibhratīṃ dakṣiṇe kare ।। 87 ।। tarjanyaṅguṣṭhakoṭibhyāṃ śuddhasphaṭikamālikām ।। bhaktyā snehena kāntasya bibhratīṃ yogamudrayā ।। 88 ।। cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ bimboṣṭhīṃ ratnamālinīm ।। yathā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ।। ।।89।। bṛhannitambabhārārttāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām ।। paśyantīṃ śavamīśasya śubhadṛṣṭyā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 90।। evambhūtāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devāste vismayaṃ yayuḥ ।। sthagitāṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ tatra dhārmikā dharmabhīravaḥ ।। 91 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmakhaṇḍe mālāvatīvilāpo nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 13 ।।
<1.14> sautiruvāca ।। tatra sthitvā kṣaṇaṃ devā brahmeśānapurogamāḥ ।। yayurmālāvatīmūlaṃ paraṃ maṅgaladāyakāḥ ।। 1 ।। mālāvatī surāndṛṣṭvā praṇanāma prativratā ।। ruroda kāntaṃ saṃsthāpya devānāṃ sannidhau mune ।। 2 ।। etasminnantare tatra kaścidbrāhmaṇabālakaḥ ।। ājagāma surāṇāṃ ca sabhāmatimanoharaḥ ।। 3 ।। daṇḍī chatrī śuklavāsā bibhrattilakamujjvalam ।। dīrghapustakahastaśca supraśāntaśca susmitaḥ ।। 4 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। surānsaṃbhāṣya tatraiva vismitānviṣṇumāyayā ।।5।। tatrovāsa sabhāmadhye tārāmadhye yathā śaśī ।। uvāca devānsarvāṃśca mālatīṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ।।6।। brāhmaṇa uvāca।। kathamatra surāḥ sarve brahmeśānapurogamāḥ ।। svayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ sraṣṭā vai kena karmaṇā।।7।। sarvabrahmāṇḍasaṃharttā śambhuratra svayaṃ vibhuḥ।। aho trijagatāṃ sākṣī dharmo vai sarvakarmaṇām।।8।। kathaṃ raviḥ kathaṃ candraḥ kathamatra hutāśanaḥ ।। kathaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā kathaṃ vā'tra yamādayaḥ।। ।।9।। he mālāvati te kroḍe ko'tiśuṣkaśśavo'naghe ।। jīvitāyāḥ kathaṃ mūle yoṣitaśca pumāñchavaḥ ।। 1 0 ।। ityuktvā tāṃśca tāṃ vipro virarāma sabhātale ।। mālāvatī taṃ praṇamya samuvāca vicakṣaṇam ।। 11 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। ānandapūrvakaṃ vande viprarūpaṃ janārdanam ।। tuṣṭā devā haristuṣṭo yasya puṣpajalena ca ।।12।। avadhānaṃ kuru vibho śokārtāyā nivedane ।। samā kṛpā satāṃ śaśvadyogyā yogye kṛpāvatām ।। 13 ।। upabarhaṇabhāryyā'haṃ kanyā citrarathasya ca ।। sarve mālāvatīṃ kṛtvā vadante viprapuṅgava ।। 14 ।। divyaṃ lakṣayugaṃ ramye sthāne sthāne manohare ।। kṛtā svacchandataḥ krīḍā cānena svāminā saha ।। 15 ।। priye sneho hi sādhvīnāṃ yāvānviprendra yoṣitām ।। sarva śāstrānusāreṇa jānāsi tvaṃ vicakṣaṇa।। 16 ।। akasmādbrahmaṇaḥ śāpātprāṇāṃstatyāja matpatiḥ।। devānuddiśya vilape yathā jīvati matpatiḥ ।। 17 ।। svakāryyasādhane sarve vyagrāśca jagatītale ।। bhāvābhāvaṃ na jānanti kevalaṃ svārthatatparāḥ ।। ।। 18 ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ santāpaḥ karmaṇāṃ nṛṇām ।। aiśvaryyaṃ paramānando janma mṛtyuśca mokṣaṇam ।। 19 ।। devāśca sarvaja nakā dātāraḥ karmaṇāṃ phalam।। karttāraḥ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ mūlacchedaṃ ca līlayā।। 20।। na hi devātparo bandhurna hi devātparo balī।। dayāvānna hi devācca na ca dātā tataḥ paraḥ ।। 21 ।। sarvāndevānahaṃ yāce patidānaṃ mamepsitam ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phaladāṃśca suradrumān ।। 22 ।। yadi dāsyanti devā me kāntadānaṃ yathepsitam ।। bhadraṃ tadā'nyathā tebhyo dāsyāmi strīvadhaṃ dhruvam ।। 23 ।। śapiṣyāmi ca sarvāṃśca dāruṇaṃ durnivārakam ।। durnivāryyaḥ satīśāpastapasā kena vāryyate ।। 24 ।। ityuktvā mālatī sādhvī śokārtā surasaṃsadi ।। virarāma dvijaśreṣṭhastāmuvāca ca śaunaka ।। 25 ।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। karmaṇāṃ phaladātāro devāḥ satyaṃ ca mālati ।। na sadyaḥ sucireṇaiva dhānyaṃ kṛṣakavannṛṇām ।। 25 ।। gṛhī ca kṛṣakadvārā kṣatre dhānyaṃ vapetsati ।। tadaṅkuro bhavetkāle kāle vṛkṣaḥ phalatyapi ।। ।। 27 ।। kāle supakvaṃ bhavati kāle prāpnoti tadgṛhī ।। evaṃ sarvaṃ samunneyaṃ cireṇa karmaṇaḥ phalam ।। 28 ।। aṣṭhī vapati saṃsāre gṛhastho viṣṇumāyayā ।। kāle tadaṅkuro vṛkṣaḥ kāle prāpnoti tatphalam ।। 29 ।। puṇyavānpuṇyabhūmau ca karoti suciraṃ tapaḥ ।। teṣāṃ ca phaladātāro devāḥ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।। 30 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhe kṣetre śreṣṭhe'nūṣara eva ca ।। yo yajjuhoti bhaktyā ca sa tatprāpnoti niścitam ।।31।। na balaṃ na ca saundaryaṃ naiśvaryaṃ na dhanaṃ sutaḥ ।। naiva strī na ca satkāntaḥ kiṃ bhavettapasā vinā ।।32।। sevate prakṛtiṃ yo hi bhaktyā janmani janmani।। sa labhetsundarīṃ kāntāṃ vinītāṃ ca guṇānvitām ।। 33 ।। śriyaṃ ca niścalāṃ putraṃ pautraṃ bhūmiṃ dhanaṃ prajām ।। prakṛteśca vareṇaiva labhedbhakto'valīlayā ।। 34 ।। śivaṃ śivasvarūpaṃ ca śivadaṃ śivakāraṇam ।। jñānānandaṃ mahātmānaṃ paraṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ param ।।35।। tamīśaṃ sevate yo hi bhaktyā janmani janmani ।। pumānprāpnoti satkāntāṃ kāminī cāpi satpatim ।। ।। 36 ।। vidyāṃ jñānaṃ sukavitāṃ putraṃ pautraṃ parāṃ śriyam ।। balaṃ dhanaṃ vikramaṃ ca labheddharavareṇa saḥ ।। 37 ।। brahmāṇaṃ bhajate yo hi labhetso'pi prajāṃ śriyam ।। vidyāmaiśvaryyamānandaṃ vareṇa brahmaṇo naraḥ ।। 38 ।। yo naro bhajate bhaktyā dīnanāthaṃ dineśvaram ।। vidyāmārogyamānandaṃ dhanaṃ putraṃ labhed dhuvam ।।39।। gaṇeśvaraṃ yo bhajate devadevaṃ sanātanam ।। sarvāgrapūjyaṃ sarveśaṃ bhaktyā janmani janmani ।। ।। 40 ।। vighnanāśo bhavettasya svapne jāgaraṇe'niśam ।। paramānandamaiśvaryyaṃ putraṃ pautraṃ dhanaṃ prajāḥ ।। 41 ।। jñānaṃ vidyāṃ sukavitāṃ labhate tadvareṇa ca ।। bhajate yo hi viṣṇuṃ ca lakṣmīkāntaṃ sureśvaram ।।42।। varārthī cellabhetsarvaṃ nirvāṇamanyathā dhruvam ।। śāntaṃ niṣevya pātāraṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 43 ।। sarvaṃ tapaḥ sarvadharmaṃ yaśaḥ kīrtimanuttamām ।। viṣṇuṃ niṣevya sarveśaṃ yo mūḍho labhate varam ।। 44 ।। viḍambito vidhātrā'sau mohito viṣṇumāyayā ।। māyā nārāyaṇīśānā sarvaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 45 ।। sā kṛpāṃ kurute yaṃ ca viṣṇumantraṃ dadāti tam ।। dharmaṃ yo bhajate dharmī sarvadharmaṃ labhed dhruvam ।।46।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।। yo yaṃ devaṃ bhajedbhaktyā sa cādau labhate ca tam ।। 47 ।। kāle paścāttena sārddhaṃ paraṃ viṣṇoḥ padaṃ labhet ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhajate yo hi nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 48 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sevyaṃ bījaṃ parātparam ।। akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 49 ।। sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ jyotiḥ svecchāmayaṃ vibhum ।। sarvādhāraṃ ca sarveśaṃ paramānandamīśvaram ।। 50 ।। nirliptasākṣirūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। jīvanmuktaḥ sa satyaṃ hi na varaṃ labhate sudhīḥ।।51।। sa sarvaṃ manyate tucchaṃ sālokyādicatuṣṭayam ।। brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā mokṣaṃ yattucchavatsati ।।52।। aiśvaryaṃ loṣṭatulyaṃ ca naśvaraṃ caiva manyate ।। indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca cirajīvitvameva vā ।। 93 ।। jala budbudavad buddhyā cātitucchaṃ na gaṇyate ।। svapne jāgaraṇe vā'pi śaśvatsevāṃ ca vācchati ।।54।। dāsyaṃ vinā na yāceta śrīkṛṣṇasya padaṃ param ।। tatpādābje dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ labdhvā pūrṇo nirantaram ।। 59 ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma niṣevyaṃ susthiraḥ sadā ।। ātmanaḥ kulakoṭiṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ।।56।। śvaśurasya śataṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya cāvalīlayā ।। dāsaṃ dāsīṃ prasūṃ bhāryāṃ putrādapi paraṃ śatam।। ।। 57 ।। uddharetkṛṣṇabhaktaśca golokaṃ yāti niścitam ।। tāvadgarbhe vasetkāmī tāvatī yamayātanā ।। 98 ।। tāvadgṛhī ca bhogārthī yāvatkṛṣṇaṃ na sevate ।। guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe praviśyati ।। 59 ।। yamastallikhanaṃ dūraṃ karoti tatkṣaṇaṃ bhiyā ।। madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā puraiva tanniyojayet ।। 60।। aho vilaṅghya mallokaṃ mārgeṇānena yāsyati।। tasya vai niṣkṛtirnāsti kalpakoṭiśatairapi।।61।। duritāni ca bhītāni koṭijanmakṛtāni ca ।। taṃ vihāya palāyante vainateyaṃ yathoragāḥ ।। 62 ।। purātanaṃ kṛtaṃ karma yadyattasya śubhāśubham ।। chinatti kṛṣṇaścakreṇa tīkṣṇadhāreṇa santatam ।। 63 ।। taṃ vihāya jarā mṛtyuryāti cakrabhiyā sati ।। anyathā śatakhaṇḍaṃ tāṃ kurute ca sudarśanaḥ।।64।। niḥśaṅko yāti golokaṃ vihāya mānavīṃ tanum ।। gatvā divyāṃ tanuṃ dhṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sevate sadā।।65।। yāvatkṛṣṇo hi goloke tāvadbhakto vasetsadā ।। nimeṣaṃ manyate dāso naśvaraṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 66 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde viṣṇumālāvatīsaṃvādo nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 14 ।।
<1.15> brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। kena rogeṇa hi mṛto'dhunā sādhvi tava priyaḥ ।। sarvarogacikitsāṃ ca jānāmi ca cikitsakaḥ ।। 1 ।। mṛtatulyaṃ mṛtaṃ rogātsaptāhābhyantare sati ।। mahājñānena taṃ jīvaṃ jīvayāmyavalīlayā ।।2।। rājamṛtyuṃ yamaṃ kālaṃ vyādhimānīya tvatpuraḥ।। nibadhya dātuṃ śakto'haṃ vyādho baddhvā paśuṃ yathā।।3।। yato na sañcaredvyādhirdeheṣu dehadhāriṇām ।। vyādhīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ yadyatsarvaṃ jānāmi sundari ।। 4 ।। yato na sañcaredvyādhibījaṃ duṣṭamamaṅgalam ।। tadupāyaṃ vijānāmi śāstratattvānusārataḥ।।5 ।। yo vā yogena khedena dehatyāgaṃ karoti ca ।। tasya taṃ jīvanopāyaṃ jānāmi yogadharmataḥ ।। 6 ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā sphītā mālāvatī satī ।। sasmitā snigdhacittā sā tamuvāca praharṣitā ।। 7 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। aho śrutaṃ kimāścaryyaṃ vacanaṃ vālavaktrataḥ ।। vayasā'tiśiśurdṛṣṭo jñānaṃ yogavidāṃ param ।। 8 ।। tvayā kṛtā pratijñā ca kāntaṃ jīvayituṃ mama ।। viparītaṃ na sadvākyaṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ jīvitaḥ patiḥ ।। 9 ।। jīvayiṣyati matkāntaṃ paścādvedavidāṃ varaḥ ।। yadyatpṛcchāmi sandehāttadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 10 ।। sabhāyāṃ jīvite kānte tasya tīvrasya sannidhau ।। tvāṃ hi praṣṭuṃ na śaktā'haṃ vidyamāne madīśvare ।। 11 ।। ete brahmādayo devā vidyamānāśca saṃsadi ।। tvaṃ ca vedavidāṃ śreṣṭho na ca kaścinmadīśvaraḥ ।। 12 ।। nārīṃ rakṣati bharttāṃ cenna ko'pi khaṇḍituṃ kṣamaḥ ।। śāstiṃ karoti yadi sa na ko'pi rakṣitā bhuvi ।। 13 ।। evaṃ deveṣu no śaktiḥ śakre vā brahmarudrayoḥ ।। strī pumbhāvaśca boddhavyaḥ svāmī karttā ca yoṣitām ।। 14 ।। svāmī karttā ca harttā ca śāstā poṣṭā ca rakṣitā ।। abhīṣṭadevaḥ pūjyaśca na guruḥ svāminaḥ paraḥ ।। 15 ।। kanyā satkulajātā yā sā kāntavaśavartinī ।। yā svatantrā ca sā duṣṭā svabhāvātkuṭilā dhruvam ।। 16 ।। duṣṭā parapumāṃsaṃ ca sevate yā narādhamā ।। sā nindati patiṃ śaśvadasadvaṃśaprasūtikā ।। 17 ।। upabarhaṇabhāryyā'haṃ kanyā citrarathasya ca ।। vadhūrgandharvarājasya kāntabhaktā sadā dvija ।।18।। sarvaṃ kālayituṃ śaktastvaṃ ca vedavidāṃ vara ।। kālaṃ yamaṃ mṛtyukanyāṃ madabhyāśaṃ samānaya ।। 19 ।। mālāvatīvacaḥ śrutvā vipro vedavidāṃ varaḥ ।। sabhāmadhye samāhūya tānpratyakṣaṃ cakāra ha ।। 20 ।। dadarśa mṛtyukanyāṃ ca prathamaṃ mālatī satī ।। kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ ghorarūpāṃ raktāmbaradharāṃ varām ।। 21 ।। sasmitāṃ ṣaḍbhujāṃ śāntāṃ dayāyuktāṃ mahāsatīm ।। kālasya svāmino vāme catuṣṣaṣṭisutānvitām ।। 22 ।। kālaṃ nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ ca dadarśa purataḥ satī ।। mahograrūpaṃ vikaṭaṃ grīṣmasūryyasamaprabham ।। 23 ।। ṣaḍvaktraṃ ṣoḍaśabhujaṃ caturviṃśatilocanam ।। ṣaṭpādaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca raktāmbaradharaṃ param ।। 24 ।। devasya devaṃ vikṛtaṃ sarvasaṃhārarūpiṇam ।। kālādhidevaṃ sarveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 25 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyamakṣamālākaraṃ varam ।। japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram।। 26 ।। satī dadarśa purato vyādhisaṃghānsudurjayān ।। vayasā'timahāvṛddhānstanandhānmātṛsannidhau ।। 27 ।। sthūlapādaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ ravinandanam ।। japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 28 ।। dharmādharmavicārajñaṃ paraṃ dharmasvarūpiṇam ।। pāpināmapi śāstāraṃ dadarśa purato yamam ।।29।। tāṃśca dṛṣṭvā ca niḥśaṅkā papraccha prathamaṃ yamam ।। mālāvatī mahāsādhvī prahaṣṭavadanekṣaṇā ।। 30।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। he dharmarāja dharmiṣṭha dharmaśāstraviśārada।। kālavyatikrame kāntaṃ kathaṃ harasi me vibho।। ।।31।। yama uvāca ।। aprāptakālo mriyate na kaścijjagatītale ।। īśvarājñāṃ vinā sādhvi nāmṛtaṃ cālayāmyaham ।। 32।। ahaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā vyādhayaśca sudurjayāḥ ।। niṣekeṇa prāptakālaṃ kālayantīśvarājñayā ।। 33 ।। mṛtyukanyā vicārajñā yaṃ prāpnoti niṣekataḥ ।। tamahaṃ kālayāmyeva pṛcchatāṃ kena hetunā ।। 34 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। tvamapi strī mṛtyukanyā jānāsi svāmivedanam ।। kathaṃ harasi matkāntaṃ jīvitāyāṃ mayi priye ।। 35 ।। mṛtyukanyovāca ।। purā viśvasṛjā sṛṣṭā'pyahamevātra karmaṇi ।। na ca kṣamā parityaktuṃ bahunā tapasā sati ।। 36 ।। satī satīnāṃ madhye ca kācittejasvinī varā ।। māmeva bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamā yadi bhavedbhave ।। 37 ।। sarvāpacchāntireveha tadā bhavati sundari ।। putrāṇāṃ svāminaḥ paścādbhavitā yadbhaviṣyati ।। 38 ।। kālena preritā'haṃ ca matputrā vyādhayaśca vai ।। na matsutānāṃ doṣaśca na ca me śṛṇu niścitam।।39।। pṛccha kālaṃ mahātmānaṃ dharmajñaṃ dharmasaṃsadi ।। tadā yaducitaṃ bhadre tatkariṣyasi niścitam ।। 40 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। he kāla karmaṇāṃ sākṣinkarmarūpa sanātana ।। nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavannamastubhyaṃparāya ca ।। 41 ।। kathaṃ harasi matkāntaṃ jīvitāyāṃ mayi prabho ।। jānāsi sarvaduḥkhaṃ ca sarvajñastvaṃ kṛpānidhe ।। 42 ।। kālapuruṣa uvāca ।। ko vā'haṃ ko yamaḥ kā ca mṛtyukanyā ca vyādhayaḥ ।। vayaṃ bhramāmaḥ satatamīśājñāparipālakāḥ ।। 43 ।। yasya sṛṣṭā ca prakṛtirbrahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। surā munīndrā manavo mānavāḥ sarvajantavaḥ ।। 44 ।। dhyāyante tatpadāmbhojaṃ yoginaśca vicakṣaṇāḥ।। japanti śaśvannāmāni puṇyāni paramātmanaḥ ।। 45 ।। yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryyastapati yadbhayāt ।। sraṣṭā brahmā''jñayā yasya pātā viṣṇuryadājñayā ।। 46 ।। saṃharttā śaṅkaraḥ sarvajagatāṃ yasya śāsanāt ।। dharmaśca karmaṇāṃ sākṣī yasyājñāparipālakaḥ ।। 47 ।। rāśi cakraṃ grahāḥ sarve bhramanti yasya śāsanāt ।। digīśāścaiva dikpālā yasyājñāparipālakāḥ ।। 48 ।। yasyājñayā ca taravaḥ puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ।। bibhratyeva dadatyeva kāle mālāvatīsati ।।49।। yasyājñayā jalādhārā sarvādhārā vasundharā ।। kṣamāvatī pṛthivī kampitā na bhayena ca ।। 50 ।। sahasā mohitā māyā māyayā yasya santatam ।। sarvaprasūryā prakṛtiḥ sā bhītā yadbhayādaho ।। 51 ।। yasyāntaṃ na vidurvedā vastūnāṃ bhāvagā api ।। purāṇāni ca sarvāṇi yasyaiva stutipāṭhakāḥ ।। 52 ।। yasya nāma vidhirviṣṇuḥ sevate sumahānvirāṭ ।। ṣoḍaśāṃśo bhagavataḥ sa eva tejaso vibhoḥ ।। 53 ।। sarveśvaraḥ kālakālo mṛtyormṛtyuḥ parātparaḥ ।। sarvavighnavināśāya taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paricintaya ।। 54 ।। sarvābhīṣṭaṃ ca bharttāraṃ pradāsyati kṛpānidhiḥ ।। ime yatpreritāḥ sarve sa dātā sarva sampadām ।। 55 ।। ityuktvā kālapuruṣo virarāma ca śaunaka ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe punareva tu brāhmaṇaḥ ।। 56 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe mālāvatīkālapuruṣasaṃvāde pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 15 ।।
<1.16> brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। dṛṣṭaḥ kālo yamo mṛtyukanyā vyādhigaṇā aho ।। kaste'dhunā ca sandehastaṃ pṛccha kanyake śubhe ।। 1 ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā hṛṣṭā mālāvatī satī ।। yanmanoni hitaṃ praśnaṃ cakāra jagadīśvaram ।। 2 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। tvayā yatkathito vyādhiḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇahārakaḥ ।। tatkāraṇaṃ ca vividhaṃ sarvaṃ vede nirūpitam ।। 3 ।। yato na sañcaredvyādhirdurnivāro'śubhāvahaḥ ।। tadupāyaṃ ca sākalyaṃ bhavānvaktumihārhati ।। 4 ।। yadyatpṛṣmapṛṣṭaṃ vā jñātamajñātameva vā ।। sarvaṃ kathaya tadbhadraṃ tvaṃ gururdīnavatsalaḥ ।। 5 ।। mālāvatīvacaḥ śrutvā viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। saṃhitāṃ vaktumārebhe sahitārthāṃ ca vaidyakīm।।6।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। vande taṃ sarvatattvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। vedavedāṃgabījasya bījaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram ।।7।। sa īśaścaturo vedānsasṛje maṅgalālayān ।। sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalya bījarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ।।6।। ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyāndṛṣṭvā vedānprajāpatiḥ ।। vicintya teṣāmarthaṃ caivāyurvedaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 9 ।। kṛtvā tu pañcamaṃ vedaṃ bhāskarāya dadau vibhuḥ ।। svatantrasaṃhitāṃ tasmādbhāskaraśca cakāra saḥ ।। 10 ।। bhāskaraśca svaśiṣyebhya āyurvedaṃ svasaṃhitām ।। pradadau pāṭhayāmāsa te cakruḥ saṃhitāstataḥ ।। ।। 11 ।। teṣāṃ nāmāni viduṣāṃ tantrāṇi tatkṛtāni ca ।। vyādhipraṇāśabījāni sādhvi matto niśāmaya ।। 12 ।। dhanvantarirdivo dāsaḥ kāśīrājo'śvinīsutau ।। nakulaḥ sahadevo'rkiścyavano janako budhaḥ ।। 13 ।। jābālo jājaliḥ pailaḥ karatho'gastya eva ca ।। ete vedāṅgavedajñāḥ ṣoḍaśa vyādhināśakāḥ ।। 14 ।। cikitsātattvavijñānaṃ nāma tantraṃ manoharam ।। dhanvantariśca bhaga vāṃścakāra prathamaṃ sati ।। 15 ।। cikitsādarpaṇaṃ nāma divodāsaścakāra saḥ ।। cikitsākaumudīṃ divyāṃ kāśīgajaścakāra saḥ ।। 16 ।। cikitsāsāratantraṃ ca śramaghnaṃ cāśvinīsutau ।। tantraṃ vaidyakasarvasvaṃ nakulaśca cakāra saḥ ।। 17 ।। cakāra sahadevaśca vyādhisindhuvimardanam ।। jñānārṇavaṃ mahātantraṃ yamarājaścakāra ha ।। 18 ।। cyavano jīvadānaṃ ca cakāra bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।। cakāra janako yogī vaidyasandehabhañjanam ।। 19।। sarvasāraṃ candrasuto jābālastantrasārakam ।। vedāṅgasāraṃ tantraṃ ca cakāra jājalirmuniḥ ।। 20 ।। pailo nidānaṃ karathastantraṃ sarvadharaṃ param ।। dvaidhanirṇayatantraṃ ca cakāra kumbhasambhavaḥ ।। 21 ।। cikitsāśāstrabījāni ta ntrāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśa ।।। vyādhipraṇāśabījāni balādhānakarīṣi ।।22।। mathitvā jñānamantreṇaivāyurvedapayonidhim।। tatastasmādudājahrurnavanītāni kovidāḥ ।। 23 ।। etāni kramaśo dṛṣṭvā divyāṃ bhāskarasaṃhitām ।। āyurvedaṃ sarvabījaṃ sarvaṃ jānāsi sundari ।। 24 ।। vyādhestattvaparijñānaṃ vedanāyāśca nigrahaḥ ।। etadvaidyasya vaidyatvaṃ na vaidyaḥ prabhurāyuṣaḥ ।। 25 ।। āyurvedasya vijñātā cikitsāsu yathārthavit ।। dharmiṣṭhaśca dayāluśca tena vaidyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।।26।। janakaḥ sarvarogāṇāṃ durvāro dāruṇo jvaraḥ ।। śivabhaktaśca yogī ca niṣṭhuro vikṛtākṛtiḥ ।। 27 ।। bhīmastripādastriśirāḥ ṣaḍbhujo navalocanaḥ ।। bhasmapraharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ ।।28।। mandāgnistasya janako mandāgnerjanakāstrayaḥ ।। pittaśleṣmasamīrāśca prāṇināṃ duḥkhadāyakāḥ ।। 29 ।। vāyujaḥ pittajaścaiva śleṣmajaśca tathaiva ca ।। jvarabhedāśca trividhāścaturthaśca tridoṣajaḥ ।। 30 ।। pāṇḍuśca kāmalaḥ kuṣṭhaḥ śothaḥ plīhā ca śūlakaḥ ।। jvarātisāragrahaṇīkāsavraṇahalīmakāḥ ।। 31 ।। mūtrakṛcchraśca gulmaśca raktadoṣavikārajaḥ ।। viṣamehaśca kabjaśca godaśca galagaṇḍakaḥ ।। 32 ।। bhramarī sannipātaśca viṣūcī dāruṇī sati ।। eṣāṃ bhedaprabhedena catuḥṣaṣṭī rujaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 33 ।। mṛtyukanyāsutāścaite jarā tasyāśca kanyakā ।। jarā ca bhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ śaśvad bhramati bhūtalam ।।34।। ete copāyavettāraṃ na gacchanti ca saṃyatam।। palāyante ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā vainateyamivoragāḥ ।। 35 ।। cakṣurjalaṃ ca vyāyāmaḥ pādādhastailamardanam ।। karṇayormūrdhni tailaṃ ca jarāvyādhivināśanam ।। 36 ।। vasante bhramaṇaṃ vahnisevāṃ svalpāṃ karoti yaḥ ।। bālāṃ ca sevate kāle jarā taṃ nopagacchati।।37।। khātaśītodakasnāyī sevate candanadravam nopayāti jarā taṃ ca nidāghe'nilasevakam।।38।। prāvṛṣyuṣṇodakasnāyī ghanatoyaṃ na sevate ।। samaye ca samāhārī jarā taṃ nopagacchati ।। 39 ।। śaradraudraṃ na gṛhṇāti bhramaṇaṃ tatra varjayet ।। khātasnāyī samāhārī jarā taṃ nopagacchati ।। 40 ।। khātasnāyī ca hemante kāle vahniṃ ca sevate ।। bhuṅkte navānnamuṣṇaṃ ca jarā taṃ nopagacchati ।। 41 ।। śiśireṃ'śukavahniṃ ca navoṣṇānnaṃ ca sevate ।। yaśca voṣṇodakasnāyī jarā taṃ nopagacchati।।42।। sadyomāṃsaṃ navānnaṃ ca bālāstrīkṣīrabhojanam।। ghṛtaṃ ca sevate yo hi jarā taṃ nopagacchati।।43।। bhuṅkte sadannaṃ kṣutkāle tṛṣṇāyāṃ pīyate jalam ।। nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca tāmbūlaṃ jarā taṃ nopagacchati ।। 44 ।। dadhi haiyaṅgavīnaṃ ca navanītaṃ tathā guḍam ।। nityaṃ bhuṅkte saṃyamī yo jarā taṃ nopagacchati ।।45।। śuṣkamāṃsaṃ striyaṃ vṛddhāṃ bālārkaṃ taruṇaṃ dadhi ।। saṃsevante jarā yāti prahṛṣṭā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ।। 46 ।। rātrau ye dadhi sevante puṃścalīśca rajasvalāḥ ।। tānupaiti jarā hṛṣṭā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha sundari ।। 47 ।। rajasvalā ca kulaṭā cāvīrā jāradūtikā ।। śūdrayājakapatnī yā ṛtuhīnā ca yā sati ।। 48 ।। yo hi tāsāmannabhojī brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। tena pāpena sārddhaṃ sā jarā tamupagacchati ।। 49 ।। pāpānāṃ vyādhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ mitratā santataṃ dhruvam ।। pāpaṃ vyādhijarābījaṃ vighnabījaṃ ca niścitam ।। 50 ।। pāpena jāyate vyādhiḥ pāpena jāyate jarā ।। pāpena jāyate dainyaṃ duḥkhaṃ śoko bhayaṅkaraḥ ।। 51 ।। tasmātpāpaṃ mahāvairaṃ doṣabījamamaṅgalam ।। bhārate satataṃ santo nācaranti bhayāturāḥ ।।52।। svadharmācārayuktaṃ ca dīkṣitaṃ harisevakam ।। gurudevātithīnāṃ ca bhaktaṃ saktaṃ tapaḥsu ca ।।53।। vratopavāsayuktaṃ ca sadā tīrthaniṣevakam ।। rogā dravanti taṃ dṛṣṭvā vainateyamivoragāḥ।।54।। etāñjarā na seveta vyādhisaṃghaśca durjayaḥ ।। sarvaṃ bodhyamasamaye kāle sarvaṃ grasiṣyati ।। 55 ।। jvarasya sarvarogāṇāṃ janakaḥ kathitaḥ sati ।। pittaśleṣmasamīrāśca jvarasya janakāstrayaḥ ।। 56 ।। ete yathā saṃ caranti svayaṃ yānti ca dehiṣu ।। tameva vividhopāyaṃ sādhvi matto niśāmaya ।। 57 ।। kṣudhi jājvalyamānāyāmāhārābhāva eva ca ।। prāṇināṃ jāyate pittaṃ cakre ca maṇipūrake ।। 58 ।। tālabilvaphalaṃ bhuktvā jalapānaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam ।। tadeva tu bhavetpittaṃ sadyaḥ prāṇaharaṃ param ।। 59 ।। taptodakaṃ ca śirasi bhādre tiktaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। daivagrastaśca yo bhuṅkte pittaṃ tasya prajāyate ।। 60 ।। saśarkaraṃ ca dhānyākaṃ piṣṭaṃ śītodakānvitam ।। caṇakaṃ sarvagavyaṃ ca dadhitakravivarjitam ।। 61 ।। bilvatālaphalaṃ pakvaṃ sarvamaikṣavameva ca ।। ārdrakaṃ mudgayūṣaṃ ca tilapiṣṭaṃ saśarkaram ।। 62 ।। pittakṣayakaraṃ sadyo balapuṣṭipradaṃ param ।। pittanāśaṃ ca tadbījamuktamanyannibodha me ।। 63 ।। bhojanānantaraṃ snānaṃ jalapānaṃ vinā tṛṣā ।। tilatailaṃ snigdhatailaṃ snigdhamāmalakīdravam ।।64।। paryyuṣitānnaṃ ca takraṃ ca pakvaṃ rambhāphalaṃ dadhi ।। meghāmbu śarkarātoyaṃ susnigdhajalasevanam ।।65।। nārikelodakaṃ rūkṣasnānaṃ paryuṣite jale ।। taruguṃjāpakvaphalaṃ supakvaṃ karkkaṭīphalam ।।66।। khātasnānaṃ ca varṣāsu mūlakaṃ śleṣmakārakam ।। brahmarandhre ca tajjanma mahadvīryya vināśanam।।67।। vahnisvedaṃ bhraṣṭabhaṅgaṃ pakvatailaviśeṣakam ।। bhramaṇaṃ śuṣkabhakṣaṃ ca śuṣkapakvaharītakī ।।68।। piṇḍārakamapakvaṃ ca rambhā phalamapakvakam ।। vesavāraḥ sindhuvāra anāhāramapānakam ।। 69 ।। saghṛtaṃ rocanācūrṇaṃ saghṛtaṃ śuṣkaśarkaram ।। marīcaṃ pippalaṃ śuṣkamārdrakaṃ jīvakaṃ madhu ।। 70 ।। dravyāṇyetāni gāndharvi sadyaḥ śleṣmaharāṇi ca ।। balapuṣṭikarāṇyeva vāyubījaṃ niśāmaya ।। 71 ।। bhojanānantaraṃ sadyo gamanaṃ dhāvanaṃ tathā ।। chedanaṃ vahnitāpaśca śaśvadbhramaṇamaithunam ।। 72 ।। vṛddhastrīgamanaṃ caiva manaḥsantāpa eva ca ।। atirūkṣamanāhāraṃ yuddhaṃ kalahameva ca ।। 73 ।। kaṭu vākyaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ kevalaṃ vāyukāraṇam ।। ājñākhyacakre tajanma niśāmaya tadauṣadham ।। 74 ।। pakvaṃ rambhāphalaṃ caiva sabījaṃ śarkarodakam ।। nārikelodakaṃ caiva sadyastakraṃ supiṣṭakam ।।75।। māhiṣaṃ dadhi miṣṭaṃ ca kevalaṃ vā saśarkaram ।। sadyaḥ paryyuṣitānnaṃ ca sauvīraṃ śītalodakam ।। 76 ।। pakvatailaviśeṣaṃ ca tilatailaṃ ca kevalam ।। lāṃgalītālakharjūramuṣṇamāmalakīdravam ।। 77 ।। śītaloṣṇodakasnānaṃ susnigdhacandanadravam ।। snigdhapadmapatratalpaṃ susnigdhavyajanāni ca ।। 78 ।। etatte kathitaṃ vatse sadyovāyupraṇāśanam ।। vāyavastrividhāḥ puṃsāṃ kleśasantāpakāmajāḥ ।। 79 ।। vyādhisaṃghaśca kathitastantrāṇi vividhāni ca ।। tāni vyādhipraṇāśāya kṛtāni sadbhireva ca ।। 80 ।। tantrāṇyetāni sarvāṇi vyādhikṣayakarāṇi ca ।। rasāyanādayo yeṣu copāyāśca sudurlabhāḥ ।। 81 ।। na śaktaḥ kathituṃ sādhvi yathārthaṃ vatsareṇa ca ।। teṣāṃ ca sarvatantrāṇāṃ kṛtānāṃ ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ।।82।। kena rogeṇa tvatkānto mṛtaḥ kathaya śobhane ।। tadupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi yena jīvedayaṃ sati ।। 83 ।। sautiruvāca ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā kanyā citrarathasya ca ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe sā gāndharvī praharṣitā ।। 84 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। yogena prāṇāṃstatyāja brahmaṇaḥ śāpahetunā ।। sabhāyāṃ lajjitaḥ kānto mama vipra niśāmaya ।। 85 ।। sarvaṃ śrutamapūrvaṃ ca śubhākhyānaṃ manoharam ।। bhavedbhave kutaḥ keṣāṃ mahallabhyaṃ vipadvinā ।। 86 ।। adhunā matprāṇakāntaṃ dehi dehi vicakṣaṇa ।। natvā vaḥ svāminā sārddhaṃ yāsyāmi svagṛhaṃ prati ।। 87 ।। mālāvatīvacaḥ śrutvā viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। sabhāṃ jagāma devānāṃ śīghraṃ viprastadantikāt ।। 88 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpu0 sautiśau0 brahmakhaṇḍe mālāvatīviṣṇusaṃvāde cikitsāpraṇayane ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 16 ।।
<1.17> sautiruvāca ।। dṛṣṭvā dvijaṃ devasaṃghaḥ pratyutthānaṃ cakāra ca ।। parasparaṃ ca sambhāṣā babhūva tatra saṃsadi ।। 1 ।। mā taṃ bubudhire devāḥ śrīhariṃ viprarūpiṇam ।। paurvāparyyaṃ vismṛtāśca mohitā viṣṇumāyayā ।। 2 ।। surānsambodhya vipraśca vācā madhurayā dvija ।। uvāca satyaṃ paramaṃ prāṇināṃ yacchubhāvaham ।। 3 ।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। upabarhaṇabhāryyeyaṃ kanyā citrarathasya ca ।। yayāce jīvadānaṃ ca svāminaḥ śokakarṣitā ।। 4 ।। adhunā kimanuṣṭhānamasya kāryasya niścitam ।। tanmāṃ brūta surāḥ sarve nityaṃ yatsamayocitam ।। 5 ।। śaptukāmā surānsarvānsādhvī tejasvinī varā ।। ahaṃ kṣemāya yuṣmākamāgato bodhitā satī ।। 6 ।। stutiḥ kṛtā ca yuṣmābhiḥ śvetadvīpe harerapi।। yuṣmākamīśo viṣṇuśca kathamevātra nāgataḥ ।। 7 ।। babhūvākāśavāṇīti paścādyāsyati keśava ।। viparītaṃ kathaṃ bhūtaṃ vāṇīvākyamacañcalam।। ।। 8 ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā svayaṃ brahmā jagadguruḥ ।। uvāca vacanaṃ satyaṃ hitaṃ paramamaṅgalam ।।9।। brahmovāca ।। matputro nāradaḥ śapto gandharvaścopabarhaṇaḥ ।। yogena prāṇāṃstatyāja punaḥ śāpānmamaiva hi ।। 10 ।। kālaṃ lakṣayugaṃ vyāpya sthitirasya mahītale ।। śūdrayoniṃ tataḥ prāpya bhavitā matsutaḥ punaḥ ।। 11 ।। asya kālāvaśeṣasya kiñcidasti dvijottama ।। tattu varṣasahasraṃ caivāyurasyāsti sāmpratam ।। 12 ।। dāsyāmi jīvadānaṃ ca svayaṃ viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ ।। yathainaṃ na spṛśecchāpastatkariṣyāmi niścitam ।। 13 ।। nāgato hariratreti tvayā yatkathitaṃ dvija ।। hariḥ sarvatra sarvātmā vigrahaḥ kuta ātmanaḥ ।। 14 ।। svecchāmayaḥ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। sarvaṃ paśyati sarvajñaḥ sarvatrāsti sanātanaḥ ।। 15 ।। viṣiśca vyāptivacano nuśca sarvatravācakaḥ ।। sarvavyāpī ca sarvātmā tena viṣṇuḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। 16 ।। apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato'pi vā ।। yaḥ smaretpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥ ।।17।। karmārambhe ca madhye vā śeṣe viṣṇuṃ ca yaḥ smaret ।। paripūrṇaṃ tasya karma vaidikaṃ ca bhaveddvija ।। 18 ।। ahaṃ sraṣṭā ca jagatāṃ vidhātā saṃharo haraḥ ।। dharmaśca karmaṇāṃ sākṣī yasyājñāparipālakaḥ ।। 19 ।। kālaḥ saṃharate lokānyamaḥ śāstā ca pāpinām ।। upaiti mṛtyuḥ sarvāṃśca bhiyā yasyājñayā sadā ।। 20 ।। sarveśā yā ca sarvādyā prakṛtiḥ sarvasūḥ purā ।। sā bhītā yasya purato yasyājñāparipālikā ।। 21 ।। maheśvara uvāca ।। putrāṇāṃ brahmaṇasteṣāṃ kasya vaṃśodbhavo bhavān ।। vedānadhītya bhavatā jñātaḥ kaḥ sāra eva ca ।। 22 ।। śiṣyaḥ kasya munīndrasya kastvaṃ nāmnā ca bho dvija ।। bibharttyarkātiriktaṃ ca śiśurūpo'si sāmpratam ।। 23 ।। viḍambayasi devāṃśca viṣṇumasmākamīśvaram ।। hṛdisthaṃ ca na jānāsi paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 24 ।। yasmingate pateddeho dehināṃ paramātmani ।। prayānti sarve tatpaścānnaradevānugā iva ।। 25 ।। jīvastatpratibimbaśca mano jñānaṃ ca cetanā ।। prāṇāścendriyavargāśca buddhirmedhā dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ ।।26।। nidrā dayā ca tandrā ca kṣuttṛṣṇā puṣṭireva ca ।। śraddhā saṃtuṣṭiricchā ca kṣamā lajjādikāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 27 ।। prayāti yatpuraḥ śaktirīśvare gamanonmukhe ।। ete sarve ca śaktiśca yasyājñā paripālakāḥ ।।28।। īśvare ca sthite dehī kṣamaśca sarvakarmasu ।। gate'spṛśyaḥ śavastyājyaḥ kastaṃ dehī na manyate ।। 29 ।। svayaṃ brahmā ca jagatāṃ vidhātā sarvakārakaḥ ।। pādāravindamaniśaṃ dhyāyate draṣṭumakṣamaḥ ।। 30 ।। yugalakṣaṃ tapastaptaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya ca vedhasā ।। tadā babhūva jñānī ca jagatsraṣṭuṃ kṣamastadā ।। 31 ।। asaṃkhyakālaṃ suciraṃ tapastaptaṃ harermayā ।। tṛptiṃ jagāma na manastṛpyate kena maṅgale ।।32।। adhunā pañcavaktreṇa yannāmaguṇakīrtanam ।। gāyanbhramāmi sarvatra nispṛhaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। 33 ।। matto yāti ca mṛtyuśca yannāmaguṇakīrttanāt ।। śaśvajapantaṃ tannāma dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuḥ palāyate ।। 34 ।। sarvabrahmāṇḍasaṃharttā'pyahaṃ mṛtyuṃjayābhidhaḥ ।। suciraṃ tapasā yasya guṇanāmānukīrttanāt ।। 35 ।। kāle tatra vilīno'hamāvirbhūtastataḥ punaḥ ।। na kālo mama saṃharttā na mṛtyuryatprasādataḥ ।।36।। goloke yaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhe śvetadvīpe sa eva ca ।। aṃśāṃśinorna bhedaśca brahmanvahnisphuliṅgavat ।। 37 ।। manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ ।। aṣṭāviṃśatime śakre gate ca brahmaṇo dinam ।। 38 ।। etatsaṃkhyāviśiṣṭasya śatavarṣāyuṣo vidheḥ ।। pāte locanapātaśca yadviṣṇoḥ paramātmanaḥ ।। 39 ।। ahaṃ kalānāmṛṣabhaḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। paraṃ mahimnaḥ ko gacchenna jānāmi ca kiñcana ।। 40 ।। ityuktvā śaṅkarastatra virarāma ca śaunaka ।। dharmaśca vaktumārebhe yaḥ sākṣī sarvakarmaṇām ।। 41 ।। dharma uvāca ।। yatpāṇipādau sarvatra cakṣuśca sarvadarśanam ।। sarvāntarātmā pratyakṣo'pratyakṣaśca durātmanaḥ ।। 42 ।। adhunā'pi sabhāṃ viṣṇurnāyāta iti yadvacaḥ ।। tvayoktaṃ tatkayā buddhyā munīnāṃ ca matibhramaḥ ।। 43 ।। mahannindā bhavedyatra naiva sādhu śṛṇoti tām ।। nindakaḥ śrotṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ kumbhīpākaṃ vrajedyugam ।। 44 ।। śrutvā daivānmahannindāṃ śrīviṣṇoḥ smaraṇād budhaḥ ।। mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti durlabham ।।45।। kāmato'kāmato vā'pi viṣṇunindāṃ karoti yaḥ ।। śṛṇoti yo hasati vā sabhāmadhye narādhamaḥ ।। 46 ।। kumbhīpāke pacati sa yāvaddhi brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। sthalaṃ bhavedapūtaṃ ca surāpātraṃ yathā dvija ।। 47 ।। prāṇī ca narakaṃ yāti śrutaṃ tatraiva ceddhruvam ।। viṣṇunindā ca trividhā brahmaṇā kathitā purā।। 48।। apratyakṣaṃ ca kurute kiṃ vā taṃ ca na manyate।।। devānyasāmyaṃ kurute jñānahīno narādhamaḥ।।49।। tasyātra niṣkṛtirnāsti yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam ।। gurornindāṃ yaḥ karoti piturnindāṃ narādhamaḥ ।। sa yāti kālasūtraṃ ca yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 50 ।। viṣṇurguruśca sarveṣāṃ janako jñānadāyakaḥ ।। poṣṭā pātā bhayatrātā varadātā jagattraye ।। 51 ।। eṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā trayāṇāṃ viprapuṅgava ।। prahasyovāca tāndevānvācā madhurayā punaḥ ।। 52 ।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। kā kṛtā viṣṇunindā'ho he devā dharmaśālinaḥ ।। nāgato hariratreti vyarthā''kāśasarasvatī ।।53।। iti proktaṃ mayā bhadraṃ brūta dharmārthamīśvarāḥ ।। sabhāyāṃ pākṣikāḥ santo ghnanti sma śatapūruṣam ।।54।। yūyaṃ ca bhāvukā brūta viṣṇuḥ sarvatra santatam ।। iti cettatkathaṃ yātāḥ śvetadvīpaṃ varāya ca ।।55।। aṃśāṃśinorna bhedaścedātmanaśceti niścitam।। kalāṃ hitvā niṣevante santaḥ pūrṇatamaṃ katham ।।56।। koṭijanmadurārādhyamasādhyamasatāmapi ।। āśā balavatī puṃsāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sevitumicchati ।।57।। kiṃ kṣudrāḥ kiṃ mahāntaśca vāñchanti paramaṃ padam ।। labdhumicchati candraṃ ca bāhubhyāṃ vāmano yathā।।58।। yo viṣṇurviṣayī viśve śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt।। yūyaṃ brahmeśadharmāśca dikpālāśca digīśvarāḥ।।59।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādyāśca suralokāścarācarāḥ ।। evaṃ katividhāḥ santi prativiśveṣu santatam ।। 60 ।। viśvānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca kaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartumīśvaraḥ ।। sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 61 ।। ūrdhvaṃ ca sarvabrahmāṇḍādvaikuṇṭhaṃ satyamīpsitam ।। tasmādūrdhvaṃ ca golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam ।। 62 ।। caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe lakṣmīkāntaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। sunandanandakumudapārṣadādibhirāvṛtaḥ ।। 63 ।। goloke dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo rādhākāntaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। gopāṅganādibhiryukto dvibhujairvopapārṣadaiḥ ।। 64 ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma sa cātmā sarvadehinām ।। svecchāmayaśca viharedrāse vṛndāvane sadā ।। 69 ।। tajjyotirmaṇḍalākāraṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabham ।। dhyāyante yoginaḥ santaḥ santataṃ ca nirāmayam ।। 66 ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlādhāma manoharam ।। 67 ।। kiśoranayanaṃ śaśvacchāntaṃ sasmitamī śvaram ।। dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ santaḥ sevante satyavigraham।। 68 ।। yūyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavā brūta kasya vaṃśodbhavo bhavān।। śiṣyaḥ kasya munīndrasyetyevaṃ māṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 69 ।। yasya vaṃśodbhavo'haṃ ca yasya śiṣyaśca bālakaḥ ।। tasyedaṃ vacanaṃ jñānaṃ devasaṃghā nibodhata ।। ।। 70 ।। śīghraṃ jīvaya gandharvaṃ deveśvara sureśvara ।। vyakte vicāre mūrkhaḥ ko vāgyuddhe kiṃ prayojanam ।। 71 ।। ityuktvā bālakastatra viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। virarāma sabhāmadhye prajahāsa ca śaunaka ।। 72 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe viṣṇusurasaṃghasaṃvāde viṣṇupraśaṃsāpraṇayane saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 17 ।।
<1.18> sautiruvāca ।। devāḥ sārddhaṃ brāhmaṇena mohitā viṣṇumāyayā ।। prayayurmālatīmūlaṃ brahmeśānapurogamāḥ ।। 1 ।। brahmā kamaṇḍalujalaṃ dadau gātre śavasya ca ।। saṃcāraṃ manasastasya cakāra sundaraṃ vapuḥ ।। 2 ।। jñānadānaṃ dadau tasmai jñānānandaḥ śivaḥ svayam ।। dharmajñānaṃ svayaṃ dharmo jīvadānaṃ ca brāhmaṇaḥ ।। 3 ।। vahnidarśanamātreṇa babhūva jaṭharānalaḥ ।। kāmadarśanamātreṇa sarvakāmaḥ suniścitam ।। 4 ।। tasya vāyoradhiṣṭhānājjagatprāṇasvarūpiṇaḥ ।। niśvāsasya ca sañcāraḥ prāṇānāṃ ca babhūva ha।। ।। 5 ।। sarvvādhiṣṭhānamātreṇa dṛṣṭiśaktirbabhūva ha ।। vākyaṃ vāṇīdarśanena śobhā śrīdarśanena ca ।। 6 ।। śavastathā'pi nottasthau yathā śete jaḍastathā ।। viśiṣṭabodhanaṃ prāpa cādhiṣṭhānaṃ vinā''tmanaḥ ।। 7 ।। brahmaṇo vacanātsādhvī tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। snātvā śīghraṃ sarittoye dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। 8 ।। mālāvatyuvāca ।। vande taṃ paramātmānaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। vinā yena śavāḥ sarve prāṇino jagatītale ।। 9 ।। nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmasu ।। vidyamānaṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ ca sarvaiḥ sarvatra sarvadā ।। 10 ।। yena sṛṣṭā ca prakṛtiḥ sarvādhāro parātparā ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ prasūryā triguṇātmikā ।। 11 ।। jagatsraṣṭā svayaṃ brahmā niyato yasya sevayā ।। pātā viṣṇuśca jagatāṃ saṃharttā śaṅkaraḥ svayam ।। 12 ।। dhyāyante yaṃ surāḥ sarve munayo manavastathā ।। siddhāśca yoginaḥ santaḥ santataṃ prakṛteḥ param।।13।। sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ paraṃ svecchāmayaṃ vibhum ।। varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varārhaṃ varakāraṇam ।।14 ।। tapaḥphalaṃ tapobījaṃ tapasāṃ ca phalapradam ।। svayaṃtapaḥsvarūpaṃ ca sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvataḥ ।। 15 ।। sarvādhāraṃ sarvabījaṃ karma tatkarmaṇāṃ phalam ।। teṣāṃ ca phaladātāraṃ tadbījaṃ kṣayakāraṇam ।। 16 ।। svayaṃtejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। sevādhyānaṃ na ghaṭate bhaktānāṃ vigrahaṃ vinā ।। 17 ।। tattejo maṇḍalākāraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ tatra manoharam ।। 18 ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyamīṣaddhāsyasamanvitam ।। 19 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāma manoharam ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। ।। 20 ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam ।। kiśoravayasaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntamanantakam ।। 21 ।। gopāṅganāparivṛtaṃ kutracinnirjane vane ।। kutracidrāsamadhyasthaṃ rādhayā pariṣevitam ।। 22 ।। kutracidgopaveṣaṃ ca veṣṭitaṃ gopabālakaiḥ ।। śataśṛṅgācalotkṛṣṭe ramye vṛndāvane vane ।। 23 ।। nikaraṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ rakṣantaṃ śiśurūpiṇam ।। goloke virajātīre pārijātavane vane ।। 24 ।। veṇuṃ kvaṇantaṃ madhuraṃ gopīsammohakāraṇam ।। nirāmaye ca vaikuṃṭhe kutracicca caturbhujam ।। 25 ।। lakṣmīkāntaṃ pārṣadaiśca sevitaṃ ca caturbhujaiḥ ।। kutracitsvāṃśarūpeṇa jagatāṃ pālanāya ca।।26।। śvetadvīpe viṣṇurūpaṃ padmayā pariṣevitam ।। kutracitsvāṃśakalayā brahmāṇḍabrahmarūpiṇam।।27।। śivasvarūpaṃ śivadaṃ svāṃśena śivarūpiṇam ।। svātmanaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśena sarvādhāraṃ parātparam।।28।। svayaṃ mahadvirāḍrūpaṃ viśvaughaṃ yasya lomasu ।। līlayā svāṃśakalayā jagatāṃ pālanāya ca।।29।। nānāvatāraṃ bibhrantaṃ bījaṃ teṣāṃ sanātanam।। vasantaṃ kutracitsantaṃ yogināṃ hṛdaye satām ।। 30।। prāṇarūpaṃ prāṇināṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram।। taṃ ca stotumaśaktā'hamabalā nirguṇaṃ vibhum।।31।। nirlakṣyaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca sāraṃ vāṅmanasoḥ param ।। yaṃ stotumakṣamo'nantaḥ sahasravadanena ca ।।32।। pañcavaktraścaturvaktro gajavaktraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ ।। yaṃ stotuṃ na kṣamā māyā mohitā yasya māyayā।।33।। yaṃ stotuṃ na kṣamā śrīśca jaḍībhūtā sarasvatī ।। vedā na śaktā yaṃ stotuṃ ko vā vidvāṃśca vedavit।।34।।।। kiṃ staumi tamanīhaṃ ca śokārttā strī parātparam ।। ityuktvā sā ca gāndharvī virarāma ruroda ca ।। 39 ।। kṛpānidhiṃ praṇanāma bhayārtā ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। kṛṣṇaśca śaktibhiḥ sārddhamadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 35 ।। bharturasyāntare tasyāḥ paramātmā nirākṛtiḥ ।।। utthāya śīghraṃ vīṇāṃ ca dhṛtvā snātvā ca vāsasī ।। 37 ।। praṇanāma devasaṃghaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ purataḥ sthitam ।। nedurdundubhayo devāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca cakrire ।। 38 ।। dṛṣṭvā copari dampatyoḥ pradaduḥ paramāśiṣam ।। gandharvo devapurato nanartta ca jagau kṣaṇam ।। 39 ।। jīvitaṃ purataḥ prāpa devānāṃ ca vareṇa ca ।। jagāma patnyā sārddhaṃ ca pitrā mātrā ca harṣitaḥ ।। 40 ।। upabarhaṇagandharvo gandharvanagaraṃ punaḥ ।। mālāvatī ratnakoṭiṃ dhanāni vividhāni ca ।। 41 ।। pradadau brāhmaṇebhyaśca bhojayāmāsa tānsatī ।। vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam ।। 42 ।। mahotsavaṃ ca vividhaṃ harernāmaikamaṅgalam ।। jagmurdevāśca svasthānaṃ viprarūpī hariḥ svayam ।। 43 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ stavarājaṃ ca śaunaka ।। idaṃ stotraṃ puṇyarūpaṃ pūjākāle tu yaḥ paṭhet ।। 44 ।। haribhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhate vaiṣṇavojanaḥ।। varārthī yaḥ paṭhedbhaktyā cāstikaḥ paramāsthayā।। 45 ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ niścitaṃ labhate phalam ।। vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ।। 46 ।। bhāryyārthī labhate bhāryyāṃ putrārthī labhate sutam ।। dharmārthī labhate dharmaṃ yaśo'rthī labhate yaśaḥ ।। 47 ।। bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ prajābhraṣṭaḥ prajāṃ labhet ।। rogārtto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt ।। 48 ।। bhayānmucyeta bhītastu dhanaṃ naṣṭadhano labhet ।। dasyugrasto mahāraṇye hiṃsrajantusamanvitaḥ ।। dāvāgnidagdho mucyeta nimagnaśca jalārṇave ।। 49 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde gandharvajīvadāne mahāpuruṣastotrapraṇayanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 18 ।।
<1.19> sautiruvāca ।। mālāvatī dhanaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ praharṣitā ।। cakāra vividhaṃ veśaṃ svātmanaḥ svāminaḥ kṛte ।।1।। bhartuścakāra śuśrūṣāṃ pūjāṃ ca samayocitām।। tena sārddhaṃ surasikā reme sā suciraṃ mudā।।2।। mahāpuruṣastotraṃ ca pūjāṃ ca kavacaṃ manum।। vismṛtaṃ bodhayāmāsa svayaṃ rahasi suvratā ।। 3 ।। purā dattaṃ vasiṣṭhena stotrapūjādikaṃ hareḥ ।। gandharvāya ca mālatyai mantramekaṃ ca puṣkare ।।4।। vismṛtaṃ stotrakavacaṃ vasiṣṭhaśca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। gandharvarājaṃ rahasi bodhayāmāsa śūlinaḥ ।। 5 ।। evaṃ cakāra rājyaṃ ca kuberabhavanopame ।। āśrame paramānando gandharvo bāndhavaiḥ saha ।। 6 ।। yathātathā gatābhiśca strībhiranyābhireva ca ।। āgatya tābhiḥ svasvāmī saṃprāptaḥ parayā mudā ।। 7 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ viṣṇormantrapūjāvidhiḥ purā ।। datto viśiṣṭastābhyāṃ ca taṃ bhavānvaktumarhati ।। 8 ।। dvādaśākṣaramantraṃ ca śūlinaḥ kavacādikam ।। dattaṃ gandharvarājāya vasiṣṭhena ca kiṃ purā ।। 9 ।। tadapi brūhi he saute śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। śaṅkarastotrakavacaṃ mantraṃ durgatināśanam।। 10।। sautiruvāca ।। tuṣṭāva yena stotreṇa mālatī parameśvaram ।। tadeva stotraṃ dattaṃ ca mantraṃ ca kavacaṃ śṛṇu ।। 11।। oṃ namo bhagavate rāsamaṇḍaleśāya svāhā ।। imaṃ mantraṃ kalpataruṃ pradadau ṣoḍaśākṣaram ।। 12 ।। purā dattaṃ kumārāya brahmaṇā puṣkare hareḥ ।। purā dattaṃ ca kṛṣṇena goloke śaṅkarāya ca ।।13।। dhyānaṃ ca viṣṇorvedoktaṃ śāśvataṃ sarvadurlabham ।। mūlena sarvaṃ deyaṃ ca naivedyādikamuttamam ।। 14 ।। atīva guptakavacaṃ piturvaktrānmayā śrutam ।। pitre dattaṃ purā vipra gaṅgāyāṃ śūlinā dhruvam।। ।। 15 ।। śūline brahmaṇe dattaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। dharmāya gopīkāntena kṛpayā paramādbhutam ।। 16 ।। brahmovāca ।। rādhākānta mahābhāga kavacaṃ yatprakāśitam ।। brahmāṇḍapāvanaṃ nāma kṛpayā kathaya prabho ।। 17 ।। māṃ maheśaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsala ।। tvatprasādena putrebhyo dāsyāmi bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ।। 18 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu vakṣyāmi brahmeśa dharmedaṃ kavacaṃ param ।। ahaṃ dāsyāmi yuṣmabhyaṃ gopanīyaṃ sudurlamam ।। 19 ।। yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ prāṇatulyaṃ mamaiva hi ।। yattejo mama dehe'sti tattejaḥ kavace'pi ca ।। 20 ।। kuru sṛṣṭimimaṃ dhṛtvā dhātā trijagatāṃ bhava ।। saṃharttā bhava he śambho mama tulyo bhave bhava ।। ।। 21 ।। he dharma tvamimaṃ dhṛtvā bhava sākṣī ca karmaṇām ।। tapasāṃ phaladātāro yūyaṃ bhavata madvarāt ।। 22 ।। brahmāṇḍapāvanasyāsya kavacasya hariḥ svayam ।। ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo'haṃ jagadīśvaraḥ ।। 23 ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। trilakṣavāra paṭhanātsiddhidaṃ kavacaṃ vidhe ।। 24 ।। yo bhavetsiddhakavaco mama tulyo bhavecca saḥ ।। tejasā siddhiyogena jñānena vikrameṇa ca ।। ।। 25 ।। praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu namo rāmeśvarāya ca ।। bhālaṃ pāyānnetrayugmaṃ namo rādheśvarāya ca ।। 25 ।। kṛṣṇaḥ pāyācchrotrayugmaṃ he hare prāṇameva ca ।। jihvikāṃ vahnijāyā tu kṛṣṇāyeti ca sarvataḥ ।। 27 ।। śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti ca kaṇṭhaṃ pātu ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ।। hrīṃ kṛṣṇāya namo vaktraṃ klīṃpūrvaśca bhujadvayam ।। 28 ।। namo gopāṅganeśāya skandhāvaṣṭākṣaro'vatu ।। dantapaṅktimoṣṭhayugmaṃ namo gopīśvarāya ca ।। 29 ।। oṃ namo bhagavate rāsamaṇḍaleśāya svāhā ।। svayaṃ vakṣaḥsthalaṃ pātu mantro'yaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ ।। 30 ।। aiṃ kṛṣṇāya svāheti ca karṇayugmaṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ viṣṇave svāheti ca kapolaṃ savarto'vatu ।। 31 ।। oṃ haraye nama iti pṛṣṭhaṃ pādaṃ sadā 'vatu ।। oṃ govarddhanadhāriṇe svāhā sarvaśarīrakam ।। 32 ।। prācyāṃ māṃ pātu śrīkṛṣṇa āgneyyāṃ pātu mādhavaḥ ।। dakṣiṇe pātu gopīśo nairṛtyāṃ nandanandanaḥ ।। 33 ।। vāruṇyāṃ pātu govindo vāyavyāṃ rādhikeśvaraḥ ।। uttare pātu rāseśa aiśānyāmacyutaḥ svayam ।। 34 ।। satataṃ sarvataḥ pātu paro nārāyaṇaḥ svayam।। iti te kathitaṃ brahmankavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।।35।। mama jīvanatulyaṃ ca yuṣmabhyaṃ dattameva ca ।। aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca ।। kalāṃ nārhanti tānyeva kavacasyaiva dhāraṇāt ।। 36 ।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ ।। snātvā taṃ ca namaskṛtya kavacaṃ dhārayetsudhīḥ ।। 37 ।। kavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। yadi syātsiddhakavaco viṣṇureva bhaveddvija ।। 38 ।। sautiruvāca ।। śivasya kavacaṃ stotraṃ śrūyatāmiti śaunaka ।। vaśiṣṭhena ca yaddattaṃ gandharvāya ca yo manuḥ ।।। 39 ।। oṃ namo bhagavate śivāya svāheti ca manuḥ ।। datto vaśiṣṭhena purā puṣkare kṛpayā vibho ।। 40 ।। ayaṃ mantro rāvaṇāya pradatto brahmaṇā purā ।। svayaṃ śambhuśca bāṇāya tathā durvāsase purā ।।41।। mūlena sarvaṃ deyaṃ ca naivedyādikamuttamam ।। dhyāyennityādikaṃ dhyānaṃ vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam।।42।। oṃ namo mahādevāya ।। bāṇāsura uvāca ।। maheśvara mahābhāga kavacaṃ yatprakāśitam ।। saṃsāra pāvanaṃ nāma kṛpayā kathaya prabho ।। 43 ।। maheśvara uvāca ।। śṛṇu vakṣyāmi he vatsa kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। ahaṃ tumyaṃ pradāsyāmi gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham ।। 44 ।। purā durvāsase dattaṃ trailokyavijayāya ca ।। 45 ।। mamaivedaṃ ca kavacaṃ bhaktyā yo dhārayetsudhīḥ ।। jetuṃ śaknoti trailokyaṃ bhagavannavalīlayā।।46।। saṃsārapāvanasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ।। ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo'haṃ ca maheśvaraḥ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 47 ।। paṃcalakṣajapenaiva siddhidaṃ kavacaṃ bhavet ।। yo bhavetsiddhakavaco mama tulyo bhavedbhuvi ।। tejasā siddhi yogena tapasā vikrameṇa ca ।।48 ।। śambhurme mastakaṃ pātu mukhaṃ pātu maheśvaraḥ ।। dantapaktiṃ nīlakaṇṭho'pyadharoṣṭhaṃ haraḥ svayam ।। 49।। kaṇṭhaṃ pātu candracūḍaḥ skandhau vṛṣabhavāhanaḥ ।। vakṣaḥsthalaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ digambaraḥ ।। 50 ।। sarvāṅgaṃ pātu viśveśaḥ sarvadikṣu ca sarvadā ।। svapne jāgaraṇe caiva sthāṇurme pātu santatam ।। 51 ।। iti te kathitaṃ bāṇa kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ।। 52 ।। yatphalaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ snānena labhate naraḥ ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ kavacasyaiva dhāraṇāt ।। 53 ।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā bhajenmāṃ yaḥ sumandadhīḥ ।। śatalakṣaprajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ ।। 54 ।। sautiruvāca ।। idaṃ ca kavacaṃ proktaṃ stotraṃ ca śṛṇu śaunaka ।। mantrarājaḥ kalpatarurvasiṣṭho dattavānpurā ।। 55 ।। oṃ namaḥ śivāya ।। bāṇāsura uvāca ।। vande surāṇāṃ sāraṃ ca sureśaṃ nīlalohitam ।। yogīśvaraṃ yogabījaṃ yogināṃ ca gurorgurum ।। 56 ।। jñānānandaṃ jñānarūpaṃ jñānabījaṃ sanātanam ।। tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।।57।। taporūpaṃ tapobījaṃ tapodhanadhanaṃ varam ।। varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadamīḍyaṃ siddhagaṇairvaraiḥ।।58।। kāraṇaṃ bhuktimuktīnāṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam ।। āśutoṣaṃ prasannāsyaṃ karuṇāmayasāgaram ।।59।। himacandanakundendukumudāmbhojasannibham।। brahmajyotiḥsvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 60 ।। viṣayāṇāṃ vibhedena bibhrataṃ bahurūpakam ।। jalarūpamagnirūpamākāśarūpamīśvaram।। ।। 61 ।। vāyurūpaṃ candrarūpaṃ sūryyarūpaṃ mahatprabhum ।। ātmanaḥ svapadaṃ dātuṃ samarthamavalīlayā ।।62 ।। bhaktajīvanamīśaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। vedā na śaktā yaṃ stotuṃ kimahaṃ staumi taṃ prabhum ।।63।। aparicchinnamīśānamaho vāṅmanasoḥ param ।। vyāghracarmāmbaradharaṃ vṛṣabhasthaṃ digambaram ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ sasmitaṃ candraśekharam ।। 64 ।। ityuktvā stavarājena nityaṃ bāṇaḥ susaṃyataḥ ।। prāṇamacchaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā durvāsāśca munīśvaraḥ ।। 65 ।। idaṃ dattaṃ vasiṣṭhena gandharvāya purā mune ।। kathitaṃ ca mahāstotraṃ śūlinaḥ paramādbhutam ।। 66 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ paṭhedbhaktyā ca yo naraḥ ।। snānasya sarvatīrthānāṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam ।। 67 ।। aputro labhate putraṃ varṣamekaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ ।। saṃyataśca haviṣyāśī praṇamya śaṅkaraṃ gurum ।। 68 ।। galatkuṣṭhī mahāśūlī varṣamekaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ ।। avaśyaṃ mucyate rogādvyāsavākyamiti śrutam ।। 69 ।। kārāgāre'pi baddho yo naiva prāpnoti nirvṛtim ।। stotraṃ śrutvā māsamekaṃ mucyate bandhanād dhruvam ।। 70 ।। bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ bhaktyā māsaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ ।। māsaṃ śrutvā saṃyataśca labhedbhraṣṭadhano dhanam ।। 71 ।। yakṣmagrasto varṣamekamāstiko yaḥ śṛṇoti cet ।। niścitaṃ mucyate rogācchaṅkarasya prasādataḥ ।। 72 ।। yaḥ śṛṇoti sadā bhaktyā stavarājamimaṃ dvija ।। tasyāsādhyaṃ tribhuvane nāsti kiṃcicca śaunaka ।। 73 ।। kadācidbandhuvicchedo na bhavettasya bhārate ।। acalaṃ paramaiśvaryyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 74 ।। susaṃyato'tibhaktyā ca māsamekaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ ।। abhāryyo labhate bhāryyāṃ suvinītāṃ satīvarām ।।75।। mahāmūrkhaśca durmedhā māsamekaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ ।। buddhiṃ vidyāṃ ca labhate gurūpadeśamātrataḥ।।76।। karmaduḥkhī daridraśca māsaṃ bhaktyā śṛṇoti yaḥ।। dhruvaṃ vittaṃ bhavettasya śaṅkarasya prasādataḥ।।77।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā kṛtvā kīrtiṃ sudurlabhām ।। nānāprakāradharmaṃ ca yātyante śaṅkarālayam ।। 78 ।। pārṣadapravaro bhūtvā sevate tatra śaṅkaram ।। yaḥ śṛṇoti trisandhyaṃ ca nityaṃ stotramanuttamam ।। 79 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunaka saṃvāde viṣṇuśaṅkarastotrakathanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 19 ।।
<1.20> sautiruvāca ।। mudā mālāvatīsārddhaṃ gandharvaścopabarhaṇaḥ ।। reme kālāvaśeṣaṃ ca tābhiśca nirjane vane ।। 1 ।। gandharvarājo mumude putradārādibhiḥ saha ।। nānāvidhaṃ kratuvaraṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ cakāra ha ।। 2 ।। rājatvaṃ bubhuje rājā kuberabhavanopame ।। reme suśīlayā sārddhaṃ sthirayauvanayuktayā ।। 3 ।। gandharvarājaḥ kāle ca gaṅgātīre manohare ।। patnyā sārddhamasūṃstyaktvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yayau mudā ।। 4 ।। śaivaḥ śivaprasādena putrasya viṣṇusevayā ।। babhūva dāso vaikuṇṭhe viṣṇoḥ śyāmacaturbhujaḥ ।। 9 ।। kṛtvā pitrośca satkāraṃ gandharvaścopabarhaṇaḥ ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vipra dhanāni vividhāni ca ।। 6 ।। kāle svayaṃ brahmaśāpātprāṇāṃstyaktvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। sa jajñe vṛṣalīgarbhe brahmabījena śaunaka ।। 7 ।। mālāvatī vahnikuṇḍe puṣkare bhārate bhuvi ।। kṛtvā tu vāñchitaṃ kāmaṃ prāṇāṃstatyāja sā satī ।। 8 ।। sṛṃjayasya tu patnyāṃ ca manuvaṃśodbhavasya ca ।। jajñe nṛpasya sādhvī sā puṇyā jātismarā varā ।। 9 ।। upabarhaṇagandharvaḥ patirme bhaviteti ca ।। itikāmā kāmukī sā sundarī sundarīvarā ।। 10 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। brahmavīryyācchūdrapatnyāṃ gandharvaścopabarhaṇaḥ ।। jātaḥ kena prakāreṇa tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 11 ।। sautiruvāca ।। kānyakubje ca deśe ca drumilo nāma rājakaḥ ।। kalāvatī tasya patnī vandhyā cāpi pativratā ।। 12 ।। svāmidoṣeṇa sā vandhyā kāle ca bharturājñayā ।। upatasthe vane ghore nāradaṃ kāśyapaṃ munim ।। 13 ।। dhyāyamānaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। tasthau suveṣaṃ kṛtvā sā dhyānāntaṃ ca muneḥ puraḥ ।। 14 ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhātulyena tejasā ।। tapantaṃ dūrato'pyevaṃ samīpaṃ gantumakṣamā ।। 15 ।। dhyānānte ca muniśreṣṭhaḥ paraḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। dadarśa purato dūre sundarīṃ sthirayauvanām ।। 16 ।। cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 17 ।। bṛhannitambabhārārttāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām ।। śobhitāṃ pītavastreṇa sasmitāṃ raktalocanām ।। 18 ।। mohitāṃ munirūpeṇa kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām ।। darśayantīṃ stanaśroṇiṃ maithunāsaktacetasā ।। ।। 19 ।। sindūrabindubhūṣāḍhyāṃ sucārukajjalojjvalām ।। padālaktakaśobhāḍhyāṃ rūpeṇaiva yathorvaśīm ।। 20 ।। muniḥ papraccha dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kā tvaṃ kāmini nirjane ।। kasya patnī kathaṃ vā'tra satyaṃ brūhi ca puṃścali ।।21।। muneśca vacanaṃ śrutvā kampitā ca kalāvatī ।। uvāca vinayenaiva kṛtvā ca śrīhariṃ hṛdi ।। 22 ।। kalāvatyuvāca ।। gopikā'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭha drumilasya ca kāminī ।। putrārthinī cāgatā'haṃ tvanmūlaṃ bharturājñayā ।। 23 ।। vīryyādhānaṃ kuru mayi strī nopekṣyā hyupasthitā ।। tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo yathā ।। 24 ।। vṛṣalīvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa munisattamaḥ ।। uvāca nītyaṃ satyaṃ ca kopaprasphuritādharaḥ ।। 25 ।। kāśyapa uvāca ।। yaḥ svalakṣmīṃ ca bhogārhāṃ parāya dātumicchati ।। taṃ sā tyajati mūḍhaṃ ca vedavāda iti dhruvam ।। 26 ।। na tvaṃ drumilabhogārhā punareva bhaviṣyasi ।। viraktena svayaṃ tyaktā na gṛhṇāti ca tvāṃ punaḥ ।। 27 ।। yaḥ śūdrapatnīṃ gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ।। sa caṇḍālo bhavetsatyaṃ na karmārho dvijātiṣu ।। 28 ।। pitṛśrāddhe ca yajñe ca śilāsparśe surārcane ।। adhikāraśca tasyaivamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। ।। 29 ।। kumbhīpākaṃ svayaṃ yāti pātayitvā ca pūruṣān ।। mātāmahānsvātmanaśca daśa pūrvāndaśāparān ।। 30 ।। tattarpaṇaṃ mūtrameva piṇḍaṃ sadyaḥ purīṣakam ।। śālagrāmasya tatsparśe copavāsastrirātrakam ।। 31 ।। tadiṣṭadevo gṛhṇāti na naivedyaṃ na tajjalam ।। saṃnyāsināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tadannaṃ ca purīṣavat ।। 32 ।। kumbhīpāke pacyate sa śakrāntaṃ yāvadeva hi ।। ekaviṃśatipuruṣaiḥ sārddhaṃ satyaṃ ca puṃścali ।। 33 ।। patrocchiṣṭaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte śūdrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇādhamaḥ ।। tattulyo'dharabhojī caivetyāṅgiresabhāṣitam ।। 34 ।। śūdro vā yadi gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇīṃ jñānadurbalaḥ ।। sa pacyate kālasūtre yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 35 ।। aṣṭādaśendrāvacchinnaṃ kālaṃ ca kālasūtrake।। brāhmaṇī pacyate tatra bhakṣitā krimibhirdhruvam ।। 36 ।। tataścaṇḍālayonau ca labdhvā janma ca brāhmaṇī ।। śūdraśca kuṣṭhī bhavati jñātibhiḥ parivarjitaḥ ।। 37 ।। ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho virarāma ca śaunaka ।। vṛṣalī tatpurastasthau śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā ।। 38 ।। etasminnantare tena pathā yāti ca menakā ।। tasyā ūruṃ stanaṃ dṛṣṭvā munervīryyaṃ papāta ha ।। 39 ।। ṛtusnātā ca vṛṣalī pītvā tatra kṣaṇaṃ mudā ।। muniṃ praṇamya prahṛṣṭā prayayau bharturantikam ।। 40 ।। gatvā praṇamya drumilaṃ kāntā kāntaṃ manoharam ।। sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa vṛttāṃttaṃ garbhahetukam ।।41।। kalāvatīvacaḥ śrutvā prahṛṣṭavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। uvāca kāntāṃ madhuraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 42 ।। drumila uvāca ।। viprasya vīryaṃ tvadgarbhe vaiṣṇavasya mahātmanaḥ ।। vaiṣṇavo bhavitā bālastvaṃ ca bhāgyavatī satī ।।43।। yadgarbhe vaiṣṇavo jāto yasya vīryeṇa vā sati ।। tayoryāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam ।।44।। tau ca viṣṇuvimānena sadratnanirmitena ca ।। yātau vaikuṇṭhanagaraṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam ।। 45 ।। kasyacidbrāhmaṇasyaiva gehaṃ gaccha śubhānane ।। paścānmamāntikaṃ bhadre yāsyasīti hareḥ puram ।। 46 ।। ityuktvā goparājaśca snātvā kṛtvā tu tarpaṇam ।। saṃpūjyābhīṣṭadevaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau ।। 47 ।। aśvānāṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ gajānāṃ lakṣameva ca ।। śataṃ mattagajendrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 48 ।। uccaiḥśravaḥ pañcalakṣaṃ rathānāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। śakaṭānāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 49 ।। gavāṃ dvādaśalakṣaṃ ca mahiṣāṇāṃ trilakṣakam ।। trilakṣaṃ rājahaṃsānāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 50 ।। pārāvatānāṃ lakṣaṃ ca śukānāṃ ca śataṃ mune ।। lakṣaṃ ca dāsadāsīnāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 51 ।। grāmāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca nagarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam ।। dhānyataṇḍulaśailaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā।।52।। śatakoṭiṃ suvarṇānāṃ ratnānāṃ ca sahasrakam।। mudrāṇāṃ koṭikalaśaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 53 ।। dadau taijasapātrāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇānāmasaṃkhyakam ।। tāṃ striyaṃ ratnabhūṣāḍhyāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।।54।। rājyaṃ dattvā mahārājo'pyantarbāhye hariṃ smaran ।। jagāma badarīṃ gopo manogāmī mudā'nvitaḥ।55।। tatra māsaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā gaṅgātīre manohare ।। prāṇāṃstatyāja yogena sadyo dṛṣṭo maharṣibhiḥ ।।56।। sa ca viṣṇuvimānena ratnendranirmitena ca।। saṃyukto viṣṇudūtaiśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha।।57।। tatra prāpa harerdāsyaṃ haridāso babhūva saḥ ।। vṛttāntaṃ ca kalāvatyā śrūyatāmiti śaunaka ।। 58 ।। gate kalāvatī nāthe uccaiśca praruroda ha ।। vahnau prāṇāṃstyaktukāmā brāhmaṇenaiva rakṣitā ।। 59 ।। brāhmaṇo mātarityuktvā tāṃ gṛhītvā mudā'nvitaḥ ।। jagāma ratnapūrṇaṃ ca svagehaṃ ca kṣaṇena ca ।। 60 ।। sā vipragehe sādhvī ca suṣāva tanayaṃ varam ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 61 ।। tatrasthā yoṣitaḥ sarvā dadṛśurbālakaṃ śubham ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍajitaṃ taṃ brahmatejasā ।। 62 ।। kāmadevādhikaṃ rūpe candrādhikaśubhānanam ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam ।। 63 ।। hastapādādivalitaṃ sukapolaṃ manoharam ।। padmacakrāṅkitaṃ pādapadmaṃ vā'tulamujjvalam ।। 64 ।। karayugmaṃ vā'tulaṃ ca rudantaṃ ca stanārthinam ।। yoṣito bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayuḥ svāśramaṃ mudā ।। 65 ।। putradārayuto vipraḥ prahṛṣṭaśca nanarta ha ।। sa bālo vavṛdhe tatra śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī ।। 65 ।। pupoṣa brāhmaṇastāṃ ca saputrāṃ ca yathā sutām ।। 67 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde upabarhaṇajanmakathanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 20 ।।
<1.21> sautiruvāca ।। babhūva kāle bālaśca krameṇa pañcahāyanaḥ ।। jātismaro jñānayuktaḥ pūrvamantrasmṛtaḥ sadā ।।1 ।। gīyate satataṃ kṛṣṇayaśonāmaguṇādikam ।। kṣaṇaṃ roditi nṛtyena pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ ।। 2 ।। kṛṣṇasambandhinīṃ gāthāṃ śṛṇoti yatra tatra vai ।। tatsambandhi purāṇaṃ ca tatra tiṣṭhati bālakaḥ ।। 3 ।। dhūlidhūsarasarvāṅgo dhūlinaivedyamīpsitam ।। dhūliṣu pratimāṃ kṛtvā dhūlinā pūjayeddharim ।। 4 ।। putramāhvayate mātā prātarāśāya cenmune ।। hariṃ saṃpūjayāmīti mātaraṃ saṃvadetpunaḥ। 5 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। kiṃ nāma bālakasyāsya janmanyatra babhūva ha ।। vyutpattyā saṃjñayā vā'pi tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 6 ।। sautiruvāca ।। anāvṛṣṭyavaśeṣe ca kāle bālo babhūva ha ।। nāraṃ dadau janmakāle tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ ।।7।। dadāti nāraṃ jñānaṃ ca bālakebhyaśca bālakaḥ ।। jātismaro mahājñānī tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ ।। 8 ।। vīryeṇa nāradasyaiva babhūva bālako mune ।। munīndrasya vareṇaiva tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ ।। 9 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। śiśunāma ca vijñātaṃ vyutpattyā ca yathocitam ।। munīndrasya kathaṃ nāma nāradaśceti maṃgalam ।। 10 ।। sautiruvāca ।। aputrakāya viprāya dharmaputro naro muniḥ ।। dadau putra kaśyapāya tenāyaṃ nāradābhidhaḥ ।। 11 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। adhunā nāmavyutpattiḥ śrutā saute śiśorapi ।। śūdrayonau brahmaputraḥ kathaṃ sa nāradābhidhaḥ ।। 12 ।। sautiruvāca ।। kalpāntare brahmakaṇṭhādbabhūvurbahavo narāḥ ।। narāndadau tatkaṇṭhaṃ ca tena tannāradaṃ smṛtam ।।13।। tato babhūva bālaśca nāradātkaṇṭhadeśataḥ ।। ato brahmā nāma cakre nāradaśceti maṅgalam ।। 14 ।। sāmprataṃ śiśuvṛttāntaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। upālambharahasyena viśiṣṭaṃ kiṃ prayojanam ।। 15 ।। vavṛdhe gopikābālo vipragehe dinedine ।। saputrāṃ pālitāṃ cakre brāhmaṇaḥ svasutāṃ yathā ।।16 ।। etasminnantare viprā āyayurvipramandiram ।। śiśavaḥ pañcavarṣīyā mahātejasvino yathā ।। 17 ।। pracchannaṃ hṛtavantaśca grīṣmamadhyāhnabhāskaram ।। madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā tānnanāma gṛhī dvija ।। 18 ।। phalamūlādikaṃ kāle catvāro munipuṅgavāḥ ।। vipradattaṃ bubhujire taccheśaṃ bubhuje śiśuḥ ।। 19 ।। caturthako munistasmai kṛṣṇamantraṃ dadau mudā ।। teṣāṃ babhūva dāsaḥ sa dvijasya māturājñayā ।। 20।। ekadā śiśumātā ca gacchantī niśi vartmani ।। mamāra sarpadaṣṭā ca tatkṣaṇaṃ smaratī harim ।। 21 ।। sadyo jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇuyānena sā satī ।। viṣṇupārṣadasaṃyuktā sadratnanirmitena ca ।। 22 ।। prātarbālo dvijaiḥ sārdhaṃ prayayau vipramandirāt ।। tattvajñānaṃ dadustasmai brāhmaṇāśca kṛpālavaḥ ।। 23 ।। brahmaputrāḥ śiśuṃ tyaktvā svasthānaṃ prayayuḥ kila ।। mahājñānī śiśustasthau gaṅgātīre manohare ।।24 ।। tatra snātvā vipradattaṃ viṣṇumantraṃ jajāpa saḥ ।। kṣutpipāsārogaśokaharaṃ vedeṣu durlabham ।। 25 ।। mahāraṇye ca ghore ca aśvatthamūlasannidhau ।। kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ tasthau suciraṃ tatra bālakaḥ ।। 26 ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। kaṃ mantraṃ bālakaḥ prāpa kumāreṇa ca dhīmatā ।। dattaṃ paraṃ śrīṃhareśca tadbhavānvaktu marhati ।। 27 ।। sautiruvāca ।। kṛṣṇena datto goloke kṛpayā brahmaṇe purā ।। dvāviṃśatyakṣaro mantro vedeṣu ca sudurlabhaḥ ।। 28 ।। taṃ ca brahmā dadau bhaktyā kumārāya ca dhīmate ।। kumāreṇa sa dattaśca mantraśca śiśave dvija ।। 29 ।। oṃ śrīṃ namo bhagavate rāsa maṇḍaleśvarāya ।। śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti ca mantro'yaṃ kalpapādapaḥ ।। 30 ।। mahāpuruṣastotraṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ kavacaṃ ca yat ।। asyaupayaugikaṃ dhyānaṃ sāmavedoktameva ca ।। 31 ।। tejomaṇḍalarūpe ca sūryyakoṭisamaprabhe ।। yogibhirvāñchitaṃ dhyāne yogaiḥ siddhagaṇaiḥ suraiḥ ।। 32 ।। dhyāyante vaiṣṇavā rūpaṃ tadabhyantarasannidhau ।। atīva kamanīyānirvacanīyaṃ manoharam ।। 33 ।। navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ pakvabimbādhikādharam ।। 34 ।। muktāpaṅktivinindaikadantapaṃktimanoharam ।। sasmitaṃ muralīnyastahastāvalambanena ca ।। 39 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāma manoharam ।। candralakṣaprabhājuṣṭaṃ puṣṭaśrīyuktavigraham ।। 36 ।। tribhaṅgasaṅgi vā yuktaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣi tam ।। 37 ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ।। mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca ratnamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 38 ।। śobhitaṃ jānuparyyantaṃ mālatīvanamālayā ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।।39 ।। maṇinā kaustubhendreṇa vakṣasthalasamujjvalam ।। vīkṣitaṃ gopikābhiśca śaśvadvrīḍitalocanaiḥ ।। 40।। sthirayauvanayuktābhirveṣṭitābhiśca santatam ।। bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitābhiśca rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam ।। ।। 41 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca pūjitaṃ vanditaṃ stutam ।। kiśoraṃ rādhikākāntaṃ śāntarūpaṃ parātparam ।। 42 ।। nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। dhyāyetsarveśvaraṃ taṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 43 ।। idaṃ te kathitaṃ dhyānaṃ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mune ।। mantropayaugikaṃ satyaṃ mantraśca kalpapādapaḥ।।44।। sāmprataṃ bālakastasthau dhyānasthastatra śaunaka ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ।। ।।45।। śaktimānparipuṣṭaśca siddhamantraprabhāvata।। dadarśa bālako dhyāne divyaṃ lokaṃ ca bālakam।।46।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। kiśoravayasaṃ śyāmaṃ gopaveṣaṃ ca sasmitam ।। 47 ।। gopairgopāṅganābhiśca veṣṭitaṃ pītavāsasam ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ candanena vicarcitam।।48।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca stūyamānaṃ parātparam ।। dṛṣṭvā ca suciraṃ śāntaṃ śāntaśca gopikāsutaḥ।।49।। virarāma ca śokārto yadā taddraṣṭumakṣamaḥ ।। rurodāśvatthamūle ca na dṛṣṭvā bālakaṃ śiśuḥ ।। 50 ।। babhūvākāśavāṇīti rudantaṃ bālakaṃ prati ।। satyaṃ prabodhayuktaṃ ca hitameva mitākṣaram ।। 51 ।। sakṛdyaddarśitaṃ rūpaṃ tadeva nādhunā punaḥ ।। api pakvakaṣāyāṇāṃ durdarśaṃ ca kuyoginām ।। 52 ।। etasminvigrahe'tīte saṃprāpte divyavigrahe ।। punardrakṣyasi govindaṃ janmamṛtyuharaṃ harim ।। 53 ।। iti śrutvā bālakaśca virarāma mudā'nvitaḥ ।। kāle tatyāja tīrthe ca tanuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi smaran ।। 54 ।। nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। babhūva śāpamuktaśca nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ।।55।। tanuṃ tvakvā sa jīvaśca vilīno brahmavigrahe ।। babhūva prāktanānnityaḥ kālabhede tirohitaḥ ।।।। 55 ।। āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ svecchayā nityadehinām ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhirbhaktānāṃ nāsti śaunaka ।। 57 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde nāradaśāpavimocanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 21 ।।
<1.22> sautiruvāca ।। kati kalpāntare'tīte sraṣṭuḥ sṛṣṭi vidhau punaḥ ।। marīcimiśraimunibhiḥ sārddhaṃ kaṇṭhādbabhūva saḥ।।1।। vidhernāradanāmnaśca kaṇṭhadeśādbabhūva saḥ ।। nāradaśceti vikhyāto munīndastena hetunā ।। 2 ।। yaḥ putraścetaso dhāturbabhūva munipuṃgavaḥ ।। tena pracetā iti ca nāma cakre pitāmahaḥ ।। 3 ।। babhūva dhāturyaḥ putraḥ sahasā dakṣapārśvataḥ ।। sarvakarmāṇi dakṣaśca tena dakṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 4 ।। vedeṣu kardamaḥ śabdaśchāyāyāṃ varttate sphuṭaḥ ।। babhūva kardamādvālaḥ kardamastena kīrttitaḥ ।। 5 ।। tejobhede marīciśca vedeṣu varttate sphuṭam ।। jātaḥ sadyo'titejasvī marīcistena kīrtitaḥ ।। 6 ।। kratusaṃghaśca bālena kṛto janmāntare'dhunā ।। brahmaputre'pi tannāma kraturityabhidhīyate ।। 7 ।। pradhānāṅgamukhaṃ dhātustato jātaśca bālakaḥ ।। irastejasvivacano'pyaṅgirāstena kīrttitaḥ ।। 8 ।। atitejasvini bhṛgurvarttate nāgni śaunaka ।। jātaḥ sadyo'titejasvī bhṛgustena prakīrttitaḥ ।। 9 ।। bālo'pyaruṇavarṇaśca jātaḥ sadyo'titejasā ।। prajvalannūrdhvatapasā cāruṇistena kīrttitaḥ।। 10 ।। haṃsā ātmavaśā yasya yogena yogino dhuvam ।। bālaḥ paramayogīndrastena haṃsī prakīrttitaḥ ।। 11 ।। vaśībhūtaśca śiṣyaśca jātaḥ sadyo hi bālakaḥ ।। atipriyaśca dhātuśca vaśiṣṭhastena kīrttitaḥ ।। 12 ।। santataṃ yasya yatnaṃ ca tapaḥsu bālakasya ca ।। prakīrttito yatistena saṃyataḥ sarvakarmasu ।। pulastapaḥsu vedeṣu varttate'haḥ sphuṭe'pi ca ।। 13 ।। sphuṭastapaḥsamūhaśca pulahastena bālakaḥ ।। pulastapaḥ samūhaśca yasyāsti pūrvajanmanām ।। tapaḥsaṃghasvarūpaśca pulastyastena bālakaḥ ।। 14 ।। triguṇāyāṃ prakṛtyāṃ trirviṣṇāvaśca pravarttate ।। tayobhaktiḥ samā yasya tena bālo'trirucyate ।। 15 ।। jaṭā vahniśikhārūpāḥ pañca santi ca mastake ।। tapastejobhavā yasya sa ca pañcaśikhaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 16 ।। apāntaratame deśe tapastepe'nyajanmani ।। apāntaratamā nāma śiśostena prakīrtitam ।। 17 ।। svayaṃ tapaḥ samāpnoti vāhayetprāpayetparān ।। voḍhuṃ samarthastapasi voḍhustena prakīrtitaḥ ।।18।। tapasastejasā bālo dīptimānsatataṃ mune ।। tapaḥsu rocate cittaṃ rucistena prakīrtitaḥ ।। 19 ।। kopakāle babhūvurye sraṣṭurekādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। rodanādeva rudrāśca kopitāstena hetunā।। 20।। śaunaka uvāca ।। rudreṣvekatamo bālo maheśa iti me bhramaḥ ।। bhavānpurāṇatattvajñaḥ sandehaṃ chettumarhati।।21।। sautiruvāca ।। viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇaḥ pātā brahmā sraṣṭā rajoguṇaḥ।। tamoguṇāste rudrāśca durnivārā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।। 22 ।। kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā teṣvekaḥ śaṃkarāṃśakaḥ ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpaśca śivaśca śivadaḥ satām ।। 23 ।। anye kṛṣṇasya ca kalāstāvaṃśau viṣṇuśaṃkarau ।। samau sattvasvarūpau dvau paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। 24 ।। uktaṃ rudrodbhave kāle kathaṃ vismarati dvija ।। māyayā mohitāḥ sarve munīnāṃ ca matibhramaḥ ।। 25 ।। sanakaśca sanaṃdaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ।। sanatkumāro bhagavāṃścaturtho brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।। 26 ।। brahmā sraṣṭuṃ pūrvaputrānuvāca te na sehire ।। tena prakopito dhātā rudrāḥ kopodbhavā mune ।। 2 ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca tau dvāvānandavācakau ।। ānanditau ca bālau dvau bhaktipūrṇatamau sadā ।। 28 ।। sanātanaśca śrīkṛṣṇo nityaḥ pūrṇatamaḥ svayam ।। tadbhaktastatsamaḥ satyaṃ tena bālaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 29 ।। sanattu nityavacanaḥ kumāraḥ śiśuvācakaḥ ।। sanatkumāraṃ tenemamuvāca kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 30 ।। brahmaṇo bālakānāṃ ca vyutpattiḥ kathitā mune ।। sāmprataṃ nāradākhyānaṃ śrūyatāṃ ca yathākramam।। 31 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmaputravyutpattikathanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 22 ।।
<1.23> sautiruvāca ।। sraṣṭā sṛṣṭividhānena niyojya sarvabālakān ।। nāradaṃ prerayāmāsa sṛṣṭiṃ karttuṃ ca śaunaka ।। 1 ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ vedasāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। uvāca nāradaṃ brahmā vedavedāṅgapāragam ।। 2 ।। brahmovāca ।। ehi vatsa kulaśreṣṭha nārada prāṇavallabha ।। jñānadīpaśikhājñānatimirakṣayakāraka ।। 3 ।। pūrveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ janakaḥ paramo guruḥ ।। vidyādātā mantradātā dvau samau ca pituḥ parau ।। 4 ।। tavāhaṃ janakaḥ putra vidyādātā ca pālakaḥ ।। mamājñayā ca matprītyā kuru dāraparigraham ।। 5 ।। sa ca śiṣyaḥ so'pi putro yaścājñāṃ pālayedguroḥ ।। na kṣemaṃ tasya mūḍhasya yo guroravacaskaraḥ ।। 6 ।। sa paṇḍitaḥ sa ca jñānī sa kṣemī sa ca puṇyavān ।। gurovarcaskaro yo hi kṣemaṃ tasya pade pade ।। ।। 7 ।। sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca pradhānaḥ puṇyavāngṛhī।। strīputrapautrayuktaṃ ca mandiraṃ tapasaḥ phalam ।। 8 ।। pitaraḥ pūrvakāle ca tithikāle ca devatāḥ ।। sarve gṛhasthamāyānti nipānamiva dhenavaḥ ।। 9 ।। nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kurvanti gṛhiṇaḥ sadā ।। iha etatsukhaṃ puṇyaṃ svargabhogaḥ paratra ca ।। 10 ।। jīvanmukto gṛhasthaśca svadharmaparipālakaḥ ।। yaśasvī puṇyavāṃścaiva kīrtimāndhanavānsukhī।। 11 ।। yaśasvī kīrtimānyo hi mṛto jīvati santatam ।। yaśaḥkīrtivihīno hi jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ ।।12।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā nārado munisattamaḥ ।। uvāca vinayaṃ bhītaḥ śuṣkaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ।।13।। nārada uvāca।। ekadā vāgvirodhena cobhayostātaputrayoḥ ।। hānirbabhūva daivena mahatī vā'yaśaskarī ।। 14 ।। mayā prāptaṃ ca tvacchāpādgāndharvaṃ śaudrameva ca ।। janma karma ca macchāpāttvamapūjyo bhave bhava ।। 15 ।। babhūva śāpo mukto me kāle te bhavitā vidhe ।। doṣāya kalpate śaśvadvirodho na guṇāya ca ।। 16 ।। sa pitā sa gururbandhuḥ sa putraḥ samadhīśvaraḥ ।। yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādapadme dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ ca kārayet ।।17।। asadvartmani cājñānādgacchanti yadi bālakāḥ ।। nivarttayati tāneva sa pitā karuṇānidhiḥ ।। 18 ।। kārayitvā kṛṣṇapāde bhaktityāgaṃ ca yaḥ pitā ।। anyasminviṣaye putraṃ sa kiṃ hantuṃ pravarttayet ।। 19 ।। dāragraho hi duḥkhāya kevalaṃ na sukhāya ca ।। tapaḥsvargabhaktimuktikarmaṇāṃ vyavadhāyakaḥ ।। 20 ।। yoṣitastrividhā brahmangṛhiṇāṃ mūḍhacetasām ।। sādhvī bhogyā ca kulaṭāstāḥ sarvāḥ svārthatatparāḥ।।21।। paralokabhiyā sādhvī tatheha yaśasā''tmanaḥ ।। kāmasnehācca kurute bhartuḥ sevāṃ ca santatam ।। 22 ।। bhogyā bhogārthinī śaśvatkāmasnehena kevalam ।। kurute kāntasevā ca na ca bhogādṛte kṣaṇam ।। 23 ।। vastrālaṃkārasambhogasusnigdhāhāramuttamam ।। yāvatprāpnoti sā bhogyā tāvacca vaśagā priyā ।। 24 ।। kulāṅgārasamā nārī kulaṭā kulanāśinī ।। kapaṭātkurute sevāṃ svāmino na ca bhaktitaḥ ।। 25 ।। sadā puṃyogamāśaṃsurmanasā madanāturā।। āhārādadhikaṃ jāraṃ prārthayantī navaṃ navam ।। 26 ।। jārārthe svapatiṃ tāta hantumicchati puṃścalī ।। tasyāṃ yo viśvasenmūḍho jīvanaṃ tasya niṣphalam ।। 27 ।। kathitā yoṣitaḥ sarvā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ ।। svātmārāmā vijānanti manastāsāṃ na paṇḍitāḥ ।। 28 ।। hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ śaratpadmotsavaṃ mukham ।। sudhāsamaṃ sumadhuraṃ vacanaṃ svārthasiddhaye ।। 29 ।। prakope viṣatulyaṃ ca viśvāse sarvanāśanam ।। durjñeyaṃ tadabhiprāyaṃ nigūḍhaṃ karma kevalam ।। 30 ।। sadā tāsāmavinayaḥ prabalaṃ sāhasaṃ param ।। doṣotkarṣaśchalotkarṣaḥ śaśvanmāyā duratyayā ।। 31 ।। puṃsaścāṣṭaguṇaḥ kāmaḥ śaśvatkāmo jagadguro ।। āhāro dviguṇo nityaṃ naiṣṭhuryyaṃ ca caturguṇam ।।32।। kopaḥ puṃsaḥ ṣaḍguṇaśca vyavasāyaśca niścitam।। yatreme doṣanivahāḥ kā''sthā tatra pitāmaha।।33।। kā krīḍā kiṃ sukhaṃ puṃso viṇmūtramalaveśmani।। tejaḥ pranaṣṭaṃ sambhoge divālāpe yaśaḥkṣayaḥ ।। 34 ।। dhanakṣayo'tiprītau cātyāsaktau ca vapuḥkṣayaḥ।। sāhitye pauruṣaṃ naṣṭaṃ kalahe mānanāśanam ।। sarvanāśaśca viśvāse brahmannārīṣu kiṃ sukham ।। 35 ।। yāvaddhanī ca tejasvī saśrīko yogyatāparaḥ ।। pumānnārīṃ vaśīkartuṃ samarthastāvadeva hi ।। 36 ।। rogiṇaṃ nirddhanaṃ vṛddhaṃ yoṣidvai prekṣate'priyam ।। lokācārabhayāttasmai dadātyāhāramalpakam ।। 37 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ brahmannātmāgamo yathā ।। sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña svātmārāmeśvaro bhavān ।। 38 ।। anugrahaṃ kuru vibho vidāyaṃ dehi sāmpratam ।। kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ prārthayāmi tvayi kalpataroḥ pare ।। 39 ।। ityuktvā nāradastatra dhṛtvā tātapadāmbujam ।। ājñāṃ yayāce pitaraṃ gantu tapasi maṅgale ।। 40 ।। kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ।। kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ natvā brahmāṇaṃ gantumudyataḥ ।। 41 ।। gacchantaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidhātā jagatāṃ mune ।। rurodoccairmuktakaṇṭhaṃ mahāsāṃsāriko yathā ।। 42 ।। kare dhṛtvā samāliṅgya cucumba ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। ciraṃ vakṣasi kṛtvā ca vāsayāmāsa jānuni ।। 43 ।। svātmārāmeśvaro brahmā yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। bheda soḍhuṃ na śakto'bhūdvicchedo duḥsaho nṛṇām ।। 44 ।। kātaraḥ putrabhedena mohito viṣcumāyayā।। śokārtto vaktumārebhe sutaṃ sambodhya śaunaka ।। 45 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe brahmanāradasaṃvāde trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 23 ।।
<1.24> śrībrahmovāca ।। tvaṃ gaccha tapase vatsa kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi ।। ahaṃ yāsyāmi golokaṃ vijñātuṃ kṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। 1 ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ।। sanatkumāro nīrāgaścaturthaḥ putra eva ca ।। 2 ।। yatī haṃsī cāruṇiśca voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ।। putrāstapasvinaḥ sarve kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi ।। 3 ।। vacaskaro marīcirme aṅgirāśca bhṛgustathā ।। ruciratriḥ kardamaśca pracetāśca kraturmanuḥ ।। 4 ।। vasiṣṭho vaśagaḥ śaśvatsarveṣu ca suteṣu ca ।। anye 'vivekino'sādhyāḥ kiṃ me saṃsārakarmaṇi ।। 5 ।। nibodha vatsa vakṣyāmi vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ śubham ।। pāramparyyakramaparaṃ caturvargaphalapradam ।। ।। 6 ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca sarve vāñchanti paṇḍitāḥ ।। vedapraṇihitānetānsabhāsu muniśaṃsitān ।। 7 ।। vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyyayaḥ ।। ādau vipro yajñasūtraṃ paridhāya sukhaṃ sukhī ।। 8 ।। samadhītya tato vedāndadāti gurudakṣiṇām ।। tataḥ prakṛṣṭakulajāṃ suvinītāṃ samudvahet ।। 9 ।। sā sādhvī kulajā yā ca patisevāsu tatparā ।। sadvaro durvinītā ca saṃbhavenna kadācana ।। ākare padmarāgāṇāṃ janma kācamaṇeḥ kutaḥ ।। 10 ।। asadvaṃśaprasūtā yā pitrordoṣeṇa nārada ।। durvinītā ca sā duṣṭā svatantrā sarvakarmasu ।। 11 ।। na vatsa duṣṭāḥ sarvāśca yoṣitaḥ kamalākalāḥ ।। svarveśyāṃśāśca kulaṭā asadvaṃśa samudbhavāḥ ।। 12 ।। nirguṇaṃ svāminaṃ sādhvī sevate ca praśaṃsati ।। na sevate ca kulaṭā priyaṃ nindati sadguṇam ।। 13 ।। sādhuḥ sadvaṃśajāṃ
