kanyāṃ prayatnena parigrahet ।। tasyāṃ putrānsamutpādya vṛddhastu tapase vrajet ।। 14 ।। varaṃ hutavahe vāsaḥ sarpavaktre ca kaṇṭake ।। etebhyo duḥkhado vāsaḥ striyā durmukhayā saha ।। 15 ।। matto'dhītastvayā vedo mahyaṃ ca gurudakṣiṇām ।। putra dehīdameveha kuru dāraparigraham ।। 16 ।। vatsa tvaṃ kulajātāṃ ca pūrvapatnī ca mālatīm ।। vivāhaṃ kuru kalyāṇa kalyāṇe ca dine 'nagha ।। 17 ।। manuvaṃśodbhavasyeha sṛṃjayasya gṛhe satī ।। tvatkṛte janma labdhvā ca kurute bhārate tapaḥ ।। 18 ।। gṛhṇīṣva paramāṃ ratnamālāṃ ca kamalākalām ।। bhārate na bhavedvyarthaṃ janānāṃ tapasaḥ phalam ।। 19 ।। ādau bhavedgṛhī loko vānaprasthastataḥ param ।। tatasta pasvī mokṣāya krama eṣa śrutau śrutaḥ ।। 20 ।। vaiṣṇavānāṃ harerarcā tapasyā ca śrutau śrutā ।। 21 ।। vaiṣṇava tvaṃ gṛhe tiṣṭha kuru kṛṣṇapadārcanam ।। antarbāhye hariryasya tasya kiṃ tapasā suta ।। 22 ।। nāntarbāhye hariryasya tasya kiṃ tapasā'nagha ।। tapasā harirārādhyo nānyaḥ kaścana vidyate ।। 23 ।। yatra tatra kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasevanaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।। vatsa madvacanenaiva gṛhe sthitvā hariṃ bhaja।। 24 ।। gṛhī bhava muniśreṣṭha gṛhiṇāṃ sarvadā sukham ।। kāminyāṃ sukhasambhogaḥ svargabhogasamo mataḥ ।। 29 ।। taddarśanamupasparśaṃ vāñchantyeva mumukṣavaḥ ।। sarvasparśasukhātstrīṇāmupasparśasukhaṃ param।।26।। tataḥ sukhatamaṃ putradarśanaṃ sparśanaṃ mune ।। sarvebhyaḥ preyasī kāntā priyā tena prakīrttitā ।। ।।27।। putraprayojanā kāntā śatakāntāpriyaḥ sutaḥ ।। nāsti putrātparo bandhurnāsti putrātparaḥ priyaḥ ।। 28।। sarvebhyo jayamanvicchetputrādekātparājayam ।। na cātmani priyo'rthaśca tasmādapi sutaḥ priyaḥ ।। 29 ।। ataḥ priyatame putre nyasedātmaparaṃ dhanam ।। ityevamuktvā sa brahmā virarāma ca śaunaka ।। uvāca vacanaṃ tātaṃ nārado jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। 30 ।। nārada uvāca ।। svayaṃ vijñāya sarvārthaṃ svaputraṃ vedadarśane ।। pravarttayatyasanmārge sa dayāluḥ kathaṃ pitā ।।31।। jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāramatinaśvaram ।। jalarekhā yathā mithyā tathā brahmañjagattrayam ।। 32 ।। vihāya haridāsyaṃ ca viṣaye yanmanaścalam ।। durlabhaṃ mānavaṃ janma mā bhūttanniṣphalaṃ kvacit ।। 33 ।। kā vā kasya priyā putro bandhuḥ ko vā bhavārṇave ।। karmormibhiryojanā ca tadapāyo viyojanā ।। 34 ।। sukarma kārayedyo hi tanmitraṃ sa pitā guruḥ ।। durbuddhiṃ janayedyo hi sa ripuḥ syātkathaṃ pitā ।। 35 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tāta vedabījaṃ yathāgamam ।। dhruvaṃ tathā'pi karttavyaṃ tavājñāparipālanam ।। 36 ।। ādau yāsyāmi bhagavannaranārāyaṇāśramam ।। nārāyaṇakathāṃ śrutvā kariṣye dārasaṃgraham ।।37।। ityevamuktvā sa munirvirarāma pituḥ puraḥ ।। puṣpavṛṣṭistadupari tatkṣaṇena babhūva ha ।। 38 ।। kṣaṇaṃ pituḥ puraḥ sthitvā nārado munisattamaḥ ।। uvāca ca punarvedaṃ vacanaṃ maṅgalapradam ।। 39 ।। śrīnārada uvāca ।। dehi me kṛṣṇamantraṃ ca yanmanovāñchitaṃ mama ।। tatsambandhi ca yajjñānaṃ yatra tadguṇavarṇanam।। 40 ।। tataḥ paścātkariṣyāmi tvatprītyā dārasaṃgraham ।। mānase paripūrṇe ca kāryyaṃ kartuṃ pumānsukhī।।41।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahṛṣṭaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ ।। uvāca punarevedaṃ putraṃ jñānavidāṃ varaḥ ।। 42 ।। brahmovāca ।। patyurmantraṃ piturmantraṃ na gṛhṇīyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।। viviktāśramiṇāṃ caiva na mantraḥ sukhadāyakaḥ ।। 43 ।। niṣekāllabhyate mantro gururbharttā ca kāminī।। vidyā sukhaṃ bhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ puruṣaiḥ svecchayā na ca ।। 44 ।। maheśvarastava guruḥ prāktano naḥ purātanaḥ ।। gaccha vatsa śivaṃ śāntaṃ śivadaṃ jñānināṃ gurum ।। 45 ।। tata eva bhavānmantraṃ jñānaṃ labdhvā purātanāt ।। nārāyaṇakathāṃ śrutvā śīghramāgaccha madgṛham ।। 46 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma ca śaunaka ।। praṇamya pitaraṃ bhaktyā śivalokaṃ yayau muniḥ ।। 47 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśau nakasaṃvāde brahmanāradoktasaṃsārasukhāsukhavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 24 ।।
<1.25> sautiruvāca ।। kṣaṇena viprapravaro mudā'nvito jagāma śambhoḥ sadanaṃ manoharam ।। ūrdhvaṃ dhruvādyojanalakṣamīpsitaṃ mahārharatnaughavinirmitaṃ mahat ।। 1 ।। nirāśraye yogabalena śambhunā dhṛtaṃ vicitraṃ vividhālayānvitam ।। dṛṣṭaṃ supuṇyāśayasādhakairvarairmunīndravaryaiḥ paripūritaṃ śubham ।। 2 ।। mayūkhaśūnyaṃ ravicandrayormune hutāśanairveṣṭitameva kevalam ।। prākārarūpairatiriktavarddhitairuccairasaṃkhyāpramitaiḥ śikhojjvalaiḥ ।। 3 ।। puraṃ varaṃ yojanalakṣavistṛtaṃ trikoṭiratnendragṛhānvitaṃ sadā ।। virājitaṃ hīrakasāranirmitaiścitrairvicitrairvividhairmanoharaiḥ ।। 4 ।। māṇikyamuktāmaṇidarpaṇairyutaṃ nasvapnadṛṣṭaṃ dvija viśvakarmaṇaḥ ।। ākalpamekaiḥ śivasevitairjanairniṣevitaṃ santatameva śaunaka ।। 9 ।। siddhairniyuktaṃ śatakoṭilakṣaikaistrikoṭilakṣaiśca yutaṃ svapārṣadaiḥ ।। yuktaṃ trilakṣairvikaṭaiśca bhairavaiḥ kṣetraiścaturlakṣaśataiśca veṣṭitam ।। 6 ।। suradrumairveṣṭitameva santataṃ mandāravṛkṣapravaraiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ ।। virājitaṃ sundarakāmadhenubhiryathā balākāśatakairnabhastalam ।। 7 ।। dṛṣṭvā munirvismayamāpa mānase kiṃ nātra citraṃ surayogināṃ gurau ।। lokaṃ trilokācca vilakṣaṇaṃ paraṃ bhīmṛtyurogārttijarāharaṃ varam ।। 8 ।। dūre sabhāmaṇḍalamadhyagaṃ śivaṃ dadarśa śāntaṃ śivadaṃ manoharam ।। padmatrinetraṃ vidhupañcavaktraṃ gaṅgādharaṃ nirmalacandraśekharam ।। 9 ।। prataptahemābhajaṭādharaṃ vibhuṃ digambaraṃ śubhramanantamakṣaram ।। mandākinīpuṣkarabījamālayā kṛṣṇeti nāmaiva mudā japantam ।। 10 ।। sunīlakaṇṭhaṃ bhujagendramaṇḍitaṃ yogīndrasiddhendra munīndravanditam ।। siddheśvaraṃ siddhavidhānakāraṇaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ kālayamāntakārakam ।। 11 ।। prasannahāsyāsyamanoharaṃ varaṃ viśvāśrayāṇāṃ śivadaṃ varapradam ।। sadā''śutoṣaṃ bhavarogavarjitaṃ bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktajanaikabandhum ।। 12 ।। gatvā samīpaṃ munireṣa śūlinaṃ nanāma mūrdhnā pulakāṅkavigrahaḥ ।। vīṇāṃ tritantrīṃ kvaṇayanpunarjagau kṛṣṇaṃ sa tuṣṭāva kalaṃ sukaṇṭhaḥ ।। 13 ।। dṛṣṭvā munīndrapravaraṃ ca sasmitaṃ vidheḥ sutaṃ vedavidāṃ variṣṭham ।। yogīndrasiddhendramaharṣibhiḥ samaṃ harṣeṇa pīṭhādudapaśyadīśvaraḥ ।। 14 ।। dadau ca tasmai munaye sa saṃbhramādāliṅganaṃ cāśiṣamāsanādikam ।। papraccha bhadrāgamanaprayojanaṃ tapodhanaṃ taṃ tapasā ca śaunaka ।। 15 ।। sadratnasiṃhāsanasundare paraścovāsa śambhurvarapārṣadaiḥ saha ।। novāsa dhātustanayaḥ kṛtāñjalistuṣṭāva bhaktyā praṇataḥ prabhuṃ dvija ।। 16।। gandharvarājena kṛtena nāradaḥ stotreṇa ramyeṇa śubhapradena ca ।। stutvā praṇāmaṃ punareva kṛtvā bhavājñayovāsa bhavasya vāmataḥ ।। 17 ।। cakāra tatraiva nivedanaṃ śive mano'bhilāṣaṃ nijakāmapūrake ।। śrutvā munestadvacanaṃ kṛpānidhirdrutaṃ pratijñāya cakāra comiti ।। 18 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde kailāsaṃ prati nāradāgamanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 25 ।।
<1.26> sautiruvāca ।। haristotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mantraṃ pūjāvidhiṃ param ।। haraṃ yayāce devarṣirdhyānaṃ ca jñānameva ca ।। 1 ।। stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mantraṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ tathā ।। tatprāktanīyajñānaṃ ca dadau tasmai maheśvaraḥ ।। 2 ।। sarvaṃ prāpya muniśreṣṭhaḥ paripūrṇamanorathaḥ ।। uvāca praṇato bhaktyā guruṃ praṇatavatsalam ।। 3 ।। nārada uvāca ।। āhnikaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। svadharmapālanaṃ nityaṃ yato bhavati nityaśaḥ ।। 4 ।। śrīmaheśvara uvāca ।। brāhme muhūrte cotthāya bahmarandhasthapaṅkaje ।। sūkṣme sahasrapatre sve nirmale glānivarjite ।। 5 ।। rātrivāsaṃ parityajya guruṃ tatraiva cintayet ।। vyākhyāmudrākaraṃ prītaṃ sasmitaṃ śiṣyavatsalam ।। 6 ।। prasannavadanaṃ śāntaṃ parituṣṭaṃ nirantaram ।। sākṣādbrahmasvarūpaṃ ca paramaṃ cintayetsadā ।। 7 ।। dhyātvaivaṃ gurumārādhya hṛtpadme nirmale site ।। sahasrapatre vistīrṇe devamiṣṭaṃ vicintayet ।। 8 ।। yasya devasya yaddhyānaṃ yadrūpaṃ tadvicintayet ।। gṛhītvā tadanujñāṃ ca karttavyaṃ samayocitam ।। 9 ।। ādau dhyātvā guruṃ natvā saṃpūjya vidhipūrvakam ।। paścāttadājñāmādāya dhyāyediṣṭaṃ prapūjayet ।। 10।। gurupradarśito devo mantrapūjāvidhirjapaḥ ।। na devena gururdṛṣṭastasmāddevādguruḥ paraḥ ।। ।। 11 ।। gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ ।। guruḥ prakṛtirīśādyā guruścandro'nalo raviḥ ।। 12 ।। gururvāyuśca varuṇo gururmātā pitā suhṛt ।। gurureva paraṃ brahma nāsti pūjyo guroḥ paraḥ ।। 13 ।। abhīṣṭadeve ruṣṭe ca samartho rakṣaṇe guruḥ ।। na samarthā gurau ruṣṭe rakṣaṇe sarvadevatāḥ ।। 14 ।। yasya tuṣṭo guruḥ śaśvajjayastasya pade pade ।। yasya ruṣṭo gurustasya sarvanāśaśca sarvadā ।। 15 ।। na saṃpūjya guruṃ devaṃ yo mūḍhaḥ pūjayed bhramāt।। brahmahatyāśataṃ pāpī labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।16।। sāmavede ca bhagavānityuvāca hariḥ svayam।। tasmādabhīṣṭadevācca guruḥ pūjyatamaḥ paraḥ ।। 17 ।। gurumiṣṭaṃ svayaṃ dhyātvā stutvā vai sādhako mune ।। nirmalaṃ sthalamāsādya viṇmūtraṃ hyutsṛjenmudā ।। 18 ।। jalaṃ jalasamīpaṃ ca sarandhaṃ prāṇisannidhim ।। devālayasamīpaṃ ca vṛkṣamūlaṃ ca vartma ca ।। 19 ।। halotkarṣasthalaṃ caiva sasyakṣetraṃ ca goṣṭhakam ।। nadīkandaragarbhaṃ ca puṣpodyānaṃ ca paṃkilam ।। 20 ।। grāmādyabhyantaraṃ caiva nṛṇāṃ gṛhasamīpakam।। śaṅkuṃ setuṃ śaravaṇaṃ śmaśānaṃ vahnisannidhim ।। 21 ।। krīḍāsthalaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ maṃcakādhaḥsthalaṃ tathā ।। vṛkṣacchāyāyutaṃ sthānamantaḥprāṇyavaparṇakam ।।22।। dūrvāsthānaṃ kuśasthānaṃ valmīkasthānameva ca ।। vṛkṣāropaṇabhūbhiṃ ca kāryārthaṃ ca pariṣkṛtam ।। 23 ।। etatsarvaṃ parityajya sūryyatāpavivarjitam ।। kṛtvā garttaṃ purīṣaṃ ca mūtraṃ ca parivarjayet ।। 24 ।। purīṣamūtrotsargaṃ ca divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ ।। paścimābhimukho rātrau sandhyāyāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।। 25 ।। maunī bhūtvā ca niśvāsaṃ yathā gandho na sañcaret ।। tyaktvā mṛdā samācchādya śaucaṃ kuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।।26।। kṛtvā tu loṣṭaśaucaṃ ca jalaśaucaṃ tataḥ param ।। mṛdyuktaṃ tajjalaṃ caiva tatpramāṇaṃ niśāmaya ।। ।। 27 ।। ekāṃ liṅge mṛdaṃ dadyādvāmahaste catuṣṭayam ।। ubhayorhastayordve tu mūtraśaucaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 28 ।। mūtraśaucaṃ dviguṇitaṃ maidhunānantaraṃ yadi ।। maithunānantaraṃ yadvā mūtraśaucaṃ caturguṇam ।। 29 ।। ekā liṅge gude tisrastathā vāmakare daśa ।। ubhayoḥ sapta dātavyāḥ pādaḥ ṣaṣṭhena śudhyati ।। 30 ।। purīṣaśaucaṃ viprāṇāṃ gṛhiṇāmidameva ca ।। vidhavānāṃ dviguṇitaṃ śaucameva prakīrttitam ।। 31 ।। yatīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca brahmarṣerbrahmacāriṇām ।। caturguṇaṃ ca gṛhiṇāṃ teṣāṃ śaucaṃ prakīrttitam ।। 32 ।। no yāvadupanīyeta dvijaḥ śūdrastathā'ṅganā ।। gandhalepakṣayakaraṃ teṣāṃ śaucaṃ prakīrttitam ।। 33 ।। śaucaṃ kṣatraviśoścaiva dvijānāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ samam ।। dviguṇaṃ vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ munīnāṃ parikīrtitam ।। 34 ।। nyūnādhikaṃ na kartavyaṃ śaucaṃ śuddhimabhīpsatā ।। prāyaścittaṃ prayujyeta vihitātikrame kṛte ।। 35 ।। śaucaṃ tanniyamaṃ mattaḥ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। mṛcchauce ca śucirvipro'pyaśuciśca vyatikrame ।। 36 ।। valmīkamūṣikotkhātāṃ mṛdamantarjalāṃ tathā ।। śaucāvaśiṣṭāṃ gehācca na dadyātkleśasambhavām ।। 37 ।। antaḥprāṇyavaparṇāṃ ca halotkhātāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। kuśamūlotthitāṃ caiva dūrvāmūlotthitāṃ tathā ।। 38 ।। aśvatthamūlānnītāṃ ca tathaiva śayanotthitām ।। catuṣpathācca goṣṭhānāṃ goṣpadānāṃ tathaiva ca।।39।। śasyasthalānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmudyānānāṃ mṛdaṃ tyajet ।। snāto vā'pyathavā'snāto vipraḥ śaucena śudhyati ।। 40 ।। śaucahīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। kṛtvā śaucamidaṃ vipro sukhaṃ prakṣālayetsudhīḥ ।। 41 ।। ādau ṣoḍaśagaṇḍūṣairmukhaśuddhiṃ vidhāya ca ।। dantakāṣṭhena dantaṃ ca tatpaścātparimārjayet ।।42।। punaḥ ṣoḍaśagaṇḍūṣairmukhaśuddhiṃ samācaret ।। dantamārjanakāṣṭhānāṃ niyamaṃ śṛṇu nārada ।।43।। nirūpitaṃ sāmavede hariṇā cāhnikakrame ।। apāmārgaṃ sindhuvāramāmraṃ ca karavīrakam।।44।। khadiraṃ ca śirīṣaṃ ca jātipunnāgaśālakam ।। aśokamarjunaṃ caiva kṣīrivṛkṣaṃ kadambakam ।।45।। jambūkaṃ bakulaṃ tokmaṃ palāśaṃ ca praśastakam ।। badarīṃ pāribhadraṃ ca mandāraṃ śālmaliṃ tathā।।46 ।। vṛkṣaṃ kaṇṭakayuktaṃ ca latādi parivarjayet ।। pippalaṃ ca priyālaṃ ca tinti ḍīkaṃ ca tālakam ।।47।। kharjūraṃ nārikelaṃ ca tālaṃ ca parivarjayet ।। dantaśaucavihīnaśca sarvaśaucavihīnakaḥ ।।48।। śaucahīno'śuci rnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। kṛtvā śaucaṃ śucirvipro dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। 49 ।। prakṣālya pādāvācamya prātaḥsandhyāṃ samācaret।। evaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ saṃdhyāṃ ca kurute kulajo dvijaḥ ।। 50 ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu trisandhyaṃ yaḥ samācaret ।। sandhyātritayahīnassyādanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। 51 ।। yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet ।। nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yastu paścimām ।। 52 ।। sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryyaḥ sarvasmāddvijakarmaṇaḥ ।। pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ parityajya madhyamāṃ paścimāṃ tathā ।।93।। brahmahatyāmātmahatyāṃ pratyahaṃ labhate dvijaḥ ।। ekadaśīvihīno yaḥ sandhyāhīnaśca yo dvijaḥ ।। 54 ।। kalpaṃ vrajetkālasūtraṃ yathā hi vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। prātaḥsandhyāṃ vidhāyaivaṃ gurumiṣṭaṃ suraṃ ravim ।।55 ।। brahmāṇamīśaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca māyāṃ padmāṃ sarasvatīm ।। praṇamya gurumājyaṃ ca darpaṇaṃ madhu kāñcanam।।56।। spṛṣṭvā snānādikaṃ kāle kuryātsādhakasattamaḥ ।। puṣkariṇyāṃ tu vāpyāṃ tu yadā snānaṃ samācaret ।। 57 ।। samuddhṛtya pañcapiṇḍānādau dharmī vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। nadyāṃ nade kandare vā tīrthe vā snānamācaret ।। 58 ।। kuryyātsnātvā tu saṅkalpaṃ tataḥ snānaṃ punarmune ।। śrīkṛṣṇaprītikāmaśca vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām ।। 59 ।। saṅkalpo gṛhiṇāṃ caiva kṛtapātakanāśakaḥ ।। vipraḥ kṛtvā tu saṅkalpaṃ mṛdaṃ gātre pralepayet ।। 60 ।। vedoktamantreṇānena dehaśuddhikṛte naraḥ ।। aśvakrānte rathakrāṃte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare ।। 61 ।। mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ।। uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā ।। 62 ।। āruhya mama gātrāṇi sarvaṃ pāpaṃ pramocaya ।। puṇyaṃ dehi mahābhāge snānānujñāṃ kuruṣva mām ।। 63 ।। ityuktvā ca jale nābhipramāṇe mantrapūrvakam ।। caturhastapramāṇāṃ ca kṛtvā maṇḍalikā śubhām ।। 64 ।। tīrthānyāvāhayettatra hastaṃ dattvā tapodhana ।। yāni yāni ca tīrthāni sarvāṇi kathayāmi te ।। 65 ।। gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati ।। narmade sindhu kāveri jale'sminsannidhiṃ kuru ।। 66 ।। nalinī nandinī sītā mālinī ca mahāpagā।। viṣṇupādābjasambhūtā gaṅgā tripathagāminī ।। 67 ।। padmāvatī bhogavatī svarṇarekhā ca kauśikī ।। dakṣā pṛthvī ca subhagā viśvakāyā śivāmṛtā ।। 68 ।। vidyādharī suprasannā tathā lokaprasādhinī ।। kṣemā ca vaiṣṇavī śāntā śāntidā gomatī satī ।। 69 ।। sāvitrī tulasī durgā mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā rādhā lopāmudrā ditīratiḥ ।। 70।। ahalyā cāditiḥ saṃjñā svadhā svāhā'pyarundhatī ।। śatarūpā devahūtirityādyāḥ saṃsmaretsudhīḥ ।। 71 ।। snātvā snātvā mahāpūtaḥ kuryyāttu tilaka budhaḥ ।। bāhvormūle lalāṭe ca kaṇṭhadeśe ca vakṣasi ।। 72 ।। snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homo devatāpitṛkarma ca ।। tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ yāti lalā ṭe tilakaṃ vinā।। 73 ।। brāhmaṇastilakaṃ kṛtvā kuryyātsandhyāṃ ca tarpaṇam ।। namaskṛtya surānbhaktyā gṛhaṃ gacchenmudā'nvitaḥ ।।74।। prakṣālya pādau yatnena dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। mandiraṃ praviśetprājña ityāha harireva ca ।। 75 ।। vinā pādakṣālanaṃ yaḥ snātvā viśati mandiram ।। tasya snānādikaṃ naṣṭaṃ japahomādipañcakam ।। 76 ।। paridhāya snigdhavastraṃ gṛhaṃ ca praviśedgṛhī ।। ruṣṭā lakṣmīrgṛhā dyāti śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam।। 77 ।। jaṅghordhvataśca yo vipraḥ pādau prakṣālayedyadā ।। tāvadbhavati cāṇḍālo yāvadgaṅgāṃ na paśyati ।। 78 ।। upaviśyāsane brahmañchucirācamya sādhakaḥ ।। pūjāṃ kuryyāttu vedoktā bhaktiyukto hi saṃyataḥ ।। 79 ।। śālagrāme maṇau mantre pratimāyāṃ jale sthale ।। gopṛṣṭhe vā gurau vipre praśastamarcanaṃ hareḥ ।। 80 ।। sarveṣu śastā pūjā ca śālagrāme ca nārada ।। surāṇāmeva sarveṣāṃ yatrādhiṣṭhānameva ca ।।81 ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।। śālagrāmodakenaiva yo'bhiṣekaṃ samācaret ।। 82 ।। śālagrāmajalaṃ bhaktyā nityamaśnāti yo naraḥ ।। jīvanmuktaḥ sa ca bhavedyātyante kṛṣṇamandiram ।। 83 ।। śālagrāmaśilācakraṃ yatra tiṣṭhati nārada ।। sacakro bhagavāṃstatra sarvatīrthāni niścitam ।। 84 ।। tatra yo hi mṛto dehī jñānājñānena daivataḥ ।। ratnanirmitayānena sa yāti śrīhareḥ padam ।। 85 ।। śālagrāmaṃ vinā'nyatra kaḥ sādhuḥ pūjayeddharim ।। kṛtvā tatra hareḥ pūjāṃ paripūrṇaṃ phalaṃ labhet।। ।। 86 ।। pūjādhāraśca kathitaḥ śrūyatāṃ pūjanakramaḥ ।। hareḥ pūjāṃ bahumatāṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam ।। 87 ।। kaściddadāti haraye copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। sundarāṇi pavitrāṇi nityaṃ bhaktyā ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 88 ।। kaściddvādaśa vastūni pañca vastūni kaścana ।। yeṣāmeva yathā śaktirbhaktirmūlaṃ ca pūjane ।।89।। āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam ।। puṣpaṃ candanadhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ naivedyamuttamam ।। 90 ।। gandhaṃ mālyaṃ ca śayyāṃ ca lalitāṃ suvilakṣaṇām ।। jalamannaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ sādhāraṃ deyameva ca ।। 91 ।। gandhānnatalpatāmbūlaṃ vinā dravyāṇi dvādaśa ।। pādyārghyajalanaivedyapuṣpāṇyetāni paṃca ca ।। 92 ।। sarvāṇyetāni mūlena dadyātsādhakasattamaḥ ।। gurūpadiṣṭaṃ mūlaṃ ca praśastaṃ sarvakarmasu ।। 93 ।। ādau kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ param ।। aṅgapratyaṅgayornyāsaṃ mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ param ।।94।। varṇanyāsaṃ vinirvartya cārghyapātraṃ vinirdiśet ।। trikoṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra kūrmaṃ prapūjayet ।। 95।। jalenāpūryya śaṅkhaṃ ca tatra saṃsthāpayeddvijaḥ ।। jalaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivattīrthānyāvāhayettattaḥ ।। 96 ।। pūjopakaraṇaṃ tena jalena kṣālayetpunaḥ ।। tato gṛhītvā puṣpaṃ ca kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ śuciḥ ।। 97 ।। dhyānena gurudattena dhyāyetkṛṣṇamananyadhīḥ ।। dhyātvā pādyādikaṃ sarvaṃ dadyānmūlena sādhakaḥ ।। 98 ।। aṅga pratyaṅgadevaṃ ca tantroktaṃ pūjayeddharim ।। mūlaṃ japtvā yathāśakti devamantraṃ visarjayet ।। 99 ।। dattvopahāraṃ vividhaṃ stutvā ca kavacaṃ paṭhet ।। tataḥ kṛtvā parīhāraṃ mūrdhnā ca praṇamedbhuvi ।। 100।। kṛtvā vai devapūjāṃ ca yajñaṃ kuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।। śrautasmārttāgniyuktaṃ ca baliṃ dadyāttato mune ।। 101 ।। nityaśrāddhaṃ yathāśakti dānaṃ vittānurūpakam ।। kṛtvā kṛtī sa viharetkrama eṣa śrutau śrutaḥ ।। 1 02।। iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vedoktaṃ sūtramuttamam ।। āhnikasya ca viprāṇāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi।।103।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe śivanāradasaṃvāde āhnikanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 26 ।।
<1.27> nārada uvāca ।। bhakṣyaṃ kiṃ vā'pyabhakṣyaṃ ca dvijānāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ prabho ।। yatīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vidhavābrahmacāriṇām ।। 1 ।। kiṃ karttavyamakarttavyamabhogyaṃ bhogyameva vā ।। sarvaṃ kathaya sarvajña sarveśaḥ sarvakāraṇam ।। 2 ।। maheśvara uvāca ।। kaścittapasvī vipraśca nirāhārī ciraṃ muniḥ ।। kaścitsamīraṇāhārī phalāhārī ca kaścana ।।। 3 ।। annāhārī yathā kāle gṛhī ca gṛhiṇīyutaḥ ।। yeṣāmicchā ca yā brahmanrucīnāṃ vividhā gatiḥ ।। 4 ।। haviṣyānnaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ praśastaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā ।। nārāyaṇocchiṣṭamiṣṭamabhakṣyamaniveditam ।। 5 ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam।। viṇmūtraṃ sarvathā proktamannaṃ ca harivāsare ।।6।। brāhmaṇaḥ kāmato'nnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte harivāsare।। trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ so'pi bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ।।7।। na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ ca nārada ।। gṛhibhirbrāhmaṇairannaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare ।।8।। gṛhī śaivaśca śāktaśca brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ ।। prayāti kālasūtraṃ ca bhuktvā ca harivāsare ।। 9 ।। kṛmibhiḥ śālimānaiśca bhakṣitastatra tiṣṭhati ।। viṇmūtrabhojanaṃ kṛtvā yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 10 ।। janmāṣṭamīdine rāmanavamīdivase hareḥ।। śivarātrau ca yo bhuṅkte so'pi dviguṇapātakī ।। 11 ।। upavāsāsamarthaśca phalaṃ mūlaṃ jalaṃ pibet ।। naṣṭe śarīre sa bhavedanyathā cātmaghātakaḥ ।।12।। sakṛdbhuṅkte haviṣyānnaṃ viṣṇornaivedyameva ca।। na bhavetpratyavāyī sa copavāsaphalaṃ labhet ।। 13 ।। ekādaśyāmanāhāraṃ gṛhī vipraśca bhārate ।। sa ca tiṣṭhati vaikuṇṭhe yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 14 ।। gṛhiṇāṃ śaivaśāktānāmidamuktaṃ ca nārada ।। viśeṣato vaiṣṇavānāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। 15 ।। nityaṃ naivedyabhojo yaḥ śrīviṣṇossa hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। nityaṃ śatopavāsānāṃ jīvanmuktaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 16 ।। vāñchanti tasya saṃsparśaṃ tīrthānyakhiladevatāḥ ।। ālāpaṃ darśanaṃ caiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।। 17 ।। dviḥ svinnamannaṃ pṛthukaṃ śuddhaṃ deśaviśeṣake ।। nātyantaśastaṃ viprāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇe na nivedane।। 18 ।। abhakṣyaṃ vai yatīnāṃ ca vidhavābrahmacāriṇām ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca yathā brahmaṃstathaitadvastu na dhruvam ।। 19 ।। tāmbūlaṃ vidhavāstrīṇāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। tapasvināṃ ca viprendra gomāṃsasadṛśaṃ dhruvam ।। 20 ।। sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yadabhakṣyaṃ śṛṇu nārada ।। yaduktaṃ sāmavede ca hariṇā cāhnikakrame ।। 21 ।। tāmrapātre payaḥpānamucchiṣṭe ghṛtabhojanam ।। dugdhaṃ lavaṇasārddhaṃ ca sadyo gomāṃsabhakṣaṇam ।। 22 ।। nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmrapātre sthitaṃ laghu ।। aikṣavaṃ tāmrapātrasthaṃ surātulyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।। 23 ।। utthāya vāmahastena yastoyaṃ pibati dvijaḥ ।। surāpī ca sa vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ ।। 24 ।। anivedyaṃ harerannaṃ bhuktaśeṣaṃ ca nityaśaḥ ।। pītaśeṣajalaṃ caiva gomāṃsasadṛśaṃ mune ।। 25 ।। vāniṅgaṇaphalaṃ caiva gomāṃsaṃ kārttike smṛtam ।। māghe ca mūlakaṃ caiva kalambī śayane tathā ।। 26 ।। śvetavarṇaṃ ca tālaṃ ca masūraṃ matsyameva ca ।। sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tyājyaṃ sarvatra deśake ।। 27 ।। matsyāṃśca kāmato bhuktvā sopavāsastryahaṃ vaset ।। prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śuddhimāpnoti vāḍavaḥ ।। 28 ।। pratipatsu ca kūṣmāṇḍamabhakṣyaṃ hyarthanāśanam ।। dvitīyāyāṃ ca bṛhatībhojanena smareddharim ।। 29 ।। abhakṣyaṃ ca paṭolaṃ ca śatruvṛddhikaraṃ param ।। tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca mūlakaṃ dhananāśanam ।। 30 ।। kalaṅkakāraṇaṃ caiva paṃcamyāṃ bilvabhakṣaṇam ।। tiryyagyoniṃ prāpayettu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai nimbabhakṣaṇam ।। 31 ।। rogavṛddhikaraṃ caiva narāṇāṃ tālabhakṣaṇam।। saptamyāṃ ca tathā tālaṃ śarīrasya ca nāśakam ।। 32 ।। nārikelaphalaṃ bhakṣyamaṣṭamyāṃ buddhināśanam ।। tumbī navamyāṃ gomāṃsaṃ daśamyāṃ ca kalambikā ।। 33 ।। ekādaśyāṃ tathā śimbī dvādaśyāṃ pūtikā tathā ।। trayodaśyāṃ ca vārttākī na bhakṣyā putranāśanam ।।34।। caturdaśyāṃ māṣabhakṣyaṃ mahāpāpakaraṃ param ।। pañcadaśyāṃ tathā māṃsamabhakṣyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ mune ।।35।। gṛhiṇāṃ prokṣitaṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣyamanyadineṣu ca ।। prātaḥ snāne tathā śrāddhe pārvaṇe vratavāsare ।। 36 ।। praśastaṃ sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ pakvatailaṃ ca nārada ।। kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrāṃticaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ।।37।। ravau śrāddhe vratāhe ca duṣṭaṃ strītilatailakam ।। māṃsaṃ ca raktaśākaṃ ca kāṃsyapātre ca bhojanam ।। 38 ।। niṣiddhaṃ śayanaṃ caiva kūrmamāṃsaṃ ca mantritam ।। niṣiddhaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ divā svastrīniṣevaṇam ।। 39 ।। rātrau ca dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ca śayanaṃ sandhyayordine ।। rajasvalāstrīgamanametannarakakāraṇam ।। 40 ।। udakyavīrayorannaṃ puṃścalyannamabhakṣakam ।। śūdrānnaṃ yājakānnaṃ ca śūdraśrāddhānnameva ca ।।41।। abhakṣyānnaṃ ca viprarṣe yadannaṃ vṛṣalīpateḥ ।। brahmanvārdhuṣikānnaṃ ca gaṇakānnamabhakṣakam ।। 42 ।। agradānidvijānnaṃ ca cikitsākārakasya ca ।। hastacitrāharau tailamagrāhyaṃ cāpyabhakṣakam ।। 43 ।। mūle mṛge bhādrapade māṃsaṃ gomāṃsatulyakam ।। amāyāṃ kṛttikāyāṃ ca dvijaiḥ kṣauraṃ vivarjitam ।। 44 ।। kṛtvā tu maithunaṃ kṣauraṃ yo devāṃstarpayetpitṝn ।। rudhiraṃ tadbhavettoyaṃ dātā ca narakaṃ vrajet ।। 45 ।। yatkarttavyamakarttavyaṃ yadbhojyaṃ yadabhojyakam ।। sarvaṃ tubhyaṃ nigaditaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 46 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde nāradaṃ prati śivopadeśe bhakṣyābhakṣyādivivaraṇaṃ nāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।27।।
<1.28> nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ sarvaṃ jagannātha tvatprasādājjagadguro ।। bhavānbrahmasvarūpaṃ ca vada brahmanirūpaṇam ।। 1 ।। prabho kiṃ brahma sākāraṃ kiṃ nirākāramīśvara ।। kiṃ tadviśeṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vā'pyaviśeṣaṇameva ca ।।2।। kiṃ vā dṛśyamadṛśyaṃ vā liptaṃ dehiṣu kiṃ na vā ।। kiṃ vā tallakṣaṇaṃ śāstre vede vā kiṃ nirūpitam ।। 3 ।। brahmātiriktā prakṛtiḥ kiṃ vā brahmasvarūpiṇī ।। prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ vā sārabhūtaṃ śrutau śrutam।।4।। prādhānyaṃ tasya sṛṣṭau ca dvayormadhye varaṃ param ।। vicāryya manasā sarvaṃ sarvajña vada māṃ dhruvam ।।5।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā pañcavaktraḥ prahasya ca ।। bhagavānkartumārebhe parabrahmanirūpaṇam ।। 6 ।। mahādeva uvāca ।। yadyatpṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vatsa nigūḍhaṃ jñānamuttamam ।। sudurlabhaṃ ca vedeṣu purāṇeṣu ca nārada ।। 7 ।। ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śeṣo dharmo mahānvirāṭ।। sarvaṃ nirūpitaṃ brahmannasmābhiḥ śrutibhirmune ।। 8 ।। yadviśeṣaṇayuktaṃ ca dṛśyaṃ pratyakṣameva ca ।। tannirūpitamasmābhirvede vedavidāṃvara।।9।। vaikuṇṭhe ca purā pṛṣṭe dharmeṇa brahmaṇā tadā ।। yaduvāca hariḥ kiñcinnibodha kathayāmi te ।। 10।। sārabhūtaṃ ca tattvānāmajñānāndhakalocanam।। dvaidhabhramatamodhvaṃsa suprakṛṣṭapradīpakam।।11।। paramātmasvarūpaṃ ca paraṃ brahma sanātanam।। sarvadehasthitaṃ sākṣisvarūpaṃ dehikarmaṇām।।12।। prāṇāḥ pañca svayaṃ viṣṇurmano brahmā prajāpatiḥ ।। sarvajñānasvarūpo'haṃ śaktiḥ prakṛtirīśvarī ।। 13 ।। ātmādhīnā vayaṃ sarve sthite tasminvayaṃ sthitāḥ ।। gate gatāśca parame naradevamivānugāḥ ।। 14 ।। jīvastatpratibimbaṃ ca sarvabhogī hi karmaṇām ।। yathā'rkacandrayo rbimbaṃ jalapūrṇaghaṭeṣu ca ।। 15 ।। bimbaṃ ghaṭeṣu bhagneṣu pralīnaṃ candrasūryyayoḥ ।। tathā layaprasaṃge sa jīvo brahmaṇi līyate ।। 16 ।। ekameva paraṃ brahma śeṣe vatsa bhavakṣaye ।। vayaṃ pralīnāstatraiva jagadetaccarācaram ।। 17 ।। tacca jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ ca maṇḍalākārameva ca ।।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍakoṭikoṭisamaprabham।।18।। ākāśamiva vistīrṇaṃ sarvavyāpakamavyayam।। sukhadṛśyaṃ yathā candrabimbaṃ yogibhireva ca ।। 19 ।। vadanti yoginastatra paraṃ brahma sanātanam ।। divāniśaṃ ca dhyāyante satyaṃ tatsarvamaṅgalam ।। 20 ।। nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। svecchāmayaṃ svatantraṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। 21 ।। paramānandarūpaṃ ca paramānandakāraṇam ।। paraṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। tatraiva līnā prakṛtiḥ sarvabījasvarūpiṇī ।। 22 ।। yathā'gnau dāhikā śaktiḥ prabhā sūryye yathā mune।। yathā dugdhe ca dhāvalyaṃ jale śaityaṃ yathaiva ca ।। 23 ।। yathā śabdaśca gagane yathā gandhaḥ kṣitau sadā ।। tathā hi nirguṇaṃ brahma nirguṇā prakṛtistathā ।। 24 ।। sṛṣṭyunmukhena tad brahma cāṃśena puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। sa eva saguṇo vatsa prākṛto viṣayī smṛtaḥ ।। 25 ।। triguṇā sā hi tatraiva parā cchāyāmayī smṛtā।।26।। yathā mṛdā kulālaśca ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ kṣamaḥ sadā।। tathā prakṛtyā tadbrahma sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ kṣamo mune।।27।। svarṇena kuṇḍalaṃ karttuṃ svarṇakāraḥ kṣamo yathā ।। tathā brahma tayā sārddha sṛṣṭiṃ kartumiheśvaraḥ ।। 28 ।। kulālasṛṣṭā na ca mṛnnityā caiva sanātanī ।। na svarṇakārasṛṣṭaṃ tatsvarṇaṃ vā nityameva ca ।। 29 ।। nityaṃ tatparamaṃ brahma nityā ca prakṛtiḥ smṛtā ।। dvayoḥ samaṃ ca prādhānyamiti kecidvadanti hi ।। 30 ।। mṛdaṃ svarṇaṃ samāhartuṃ kulālasvarṇakārakau ।। na samarthau ca mṛtsvarṇaṃ tayorāharaṇe kṣamam ।। 31 ।। tasmāttatprakṛterbrahma parameva ca nārada ।। iti kecidvadantyevaṃ dvayorvai nityatā dhruvam ।। 32 ।। kecidvadanti tadbrahma svayaṃ ca prakṛtiḥ pumān ।। brahmātiriktā prakṛtirvadantīti ca kecana ।। 33 ।। tadbrahma paramaṃ dhāma sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। tadbrahmalakṣaṇaṃ brahmannidaṃ kiṃcicchrutau śrutam ।। 34 ।। brahma cātmā ca sarveṣāṃ nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpi ca ।। sarvavyāpi ca sarvādi lakṣaṇaṃ ca śrutau śrutam।।35।। tadbrahmaśaktiḥ prakṛtiḥ sarvabījasvarūpiṇī ।। yatastacchaktimadbrahma cedaṃ prakṛtilakṣaṇam ।। 36 ।। tejorūpaṃ ca tadbrahma dhyāyante yoginaḥ sadā ।। vaiṣṇavāstanna manyante madbhaktāḥ sūkṣmabuddhayaḥ ।। 37 ।। tattejaḥ kasya nāścaryyaṃ dhyāyante puruṣaṃ vinā ।। kāraṇena vinā kārya kuto vā prabhavedbhuvi ।। 38 ।। dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāstasmāttatra rūpaṃ manoharam ।। svecchāmayasya puṃsaśca sākārasyātmanaḥ sadā ।। 39 ।। tattejomaṇḍalākāre sūryyakoṭisamaprabhe ।। nityaṃ sthalaṃ ca pracchannaṃ golokābhidhameva ca ।। 40।। lakṣakoṭyā yojanānāṃ caturasraṃ manoharam ।। ratnendrasāranirmāṇairgopībhiścāvṛtaṃ sadā ।।41।। sudṛśyaṃ vartulākāraṃ yathā candrasya maṇḍalam ।। nānāratnaiśca khacitaṃ nirādhāraṃ tadicchayā ।। 42 ।। ūrdhvaṃ ca nityavaikuṇṭhātpañcāśatkoṭiyojanam ।। gogopagopīsaṃyuktaṃ kalpavṛkṣasamanvitam ।। 43 ।। kāmadhenubhirākīrṇaṃ rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ।। vṛndāvanavanācchatraṃ virajāveṣṭitaṃ mune ।। 44 ।। śataśṛṅgaṃ śātakumbhaiḥ sudīptaṃ śrīmadīpsitam ।। । lakṣakoṭyā parimitairāśramaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। 45 ।। śatamandirasaṃyuktamāśramaṃ sumanoharam ।। prākāraparikhāyuktaṃ pārijātavanānvitam।। ।। 46 ।। kaustubhendreṇa maṇinā rājitaṃ paramojjvalam ।। hīrasārasusaṃklṛptasopānaiścātisundaraiḥ ।। 47 ।। maṇīndrasāraracitaiḥ kapāṭairdarpaṇānvitaiḥ ।। nānācitravicitrāḍhyairāśramaṃ ca susaṃskṛtam ।। 48 ।। ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyuktaṃ sudīptaṃ ratnadīpakaiḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye mahārghamaṇinirmite ।। 49 ।। nānācitravicitrāḍhye vasantaṃ varamīśvaram ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ śiśum ।। 50 ।। śaranmadhyāhnamārttaṇḍaprabhāmocakalocanam ।। śaratpārvaṇapūrṇenduśubhadīptimadānanam ।। 51 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlāninditamanmatham ।। koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ śrīyuktavigraham ।।52।। sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ supraśastaṃ sumaṅgalam ।। paramottamapītāṃśukayugena samujjvalam ।। 53 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam ।। ājānu mālatīmālāvanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 54 ।। tribhaṅgabhaṅgyā saṃyuktaṃ maṇimāṇikyabhūṣitam ।। mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca sadratnamukuṭojjvalam ।।55।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalasuśobhitam ।। 56 ।। muktāpaṅktisadṛkṣābhadaśanaṃ sumanoharam ।। pakvabimbādharoṣṭhaṃ ca nāsikonnatiśobhanam ।। ।। 57 ।। vīkṣitaṃ gopikābhiśca veṣṭitābhissamantataḥ ।। sthirayauvanayuktābhiḥ sasmitābhiśca sādaram ।। 58 ।। bhūṣitābhiśca sadratnanirmitairbhūṣaṇaiḥ param ।। surendraiśca munīndraiśca munibhirmānavendrakaiḥ ।। 59 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivānantadharmādyairvanditaṃ mudā ।। bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktanāthaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 60 ।। rāseśvaraṃ surasikaṃ rādhāvakṣasthalasthitam ।। evaṃrūpamarūpaṃ taṃ mune dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। ।। 61 ।। satataṃ dhyeyamasmākaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 62 ।। svecchāmayaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। sarvādhāraṃ sarvabījaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvameva ca ।। 63 ।। sarveśvaraṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ pradam ।। sa eva bhagavānādirgoloke dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। 64 ।। gopaveṣaśca gopālaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ ।। paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmān śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikeśvaraḥ ।। 69 ।। sarvāntarātmā sarvatra pratyakṣaḥ sarvagaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāraścātmavācakaḥ ।। sarvātmā ca paraṃ brahma tena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 66 ।। kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāraścādivācakaḥ ।। sarvādipuruṣo vyāpī tena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 67 ।। sa evāṃśena bhagavānvaikuṇṭhe ca caturbhujaḥ ।। caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaistairāvṛtaḥ kamalāpatiḥ ।। 68 ।। sa eva kalayā viṣṇuḥ pātā ca jagatāṃ prabhuḥ ।। śvetadvīpe sindhukanyāpatireva caturbhujaḥ ।। 69 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ parabrahmasvarūpakam ।। asmākaṃ cintanīyaṃ ca sevyaṃ vanditamīpsitam ।। 70 ।। ityuktvā śaṅkarastatra virarāma ca śaunaka ।। gandharvarājastotreṇa tuṣṭuve taṃ ca nāradaḥ ।।71 ।। munistotreṇa santuṣṭo bhagavānādiracyutaḥ ।। jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayastasmai pradadau varamīpsitam ।। 72 ।। munīndrastaṃ saṃpraṇamya prahṛṣṭavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। tadājñayā puṇyarūpaṃ yayau nārāyaṇāśramam ।। 73 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde brahmasvarūpavaikuṇṭhādivarṇanaṃ nāradaprasthānaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 28 ।।
<1.29> sautiruvāca ।। dadarśāśramamāścaryyaṃ devarṣirnāradastathā ।। ṛṣirnārāyaṇasyaiva badarīvanasaṃyutam ।। 1 ।। nānāvṛkṣaphalākīrṇaṃ puṃskokilarutaśrutam ।। śarabhendraiḥ kesarīndrairvyāghraughaiḥ pariveṣṭitam ।। 2 ।। ṛṣīndrasya prabhāveṇa hiṃsābhayavivarjitam ।। mahāraṇyamagamyaṃ ca svargādapi manoharam ।। 3 ।। siddhendrāṇāṃ munīndrāṇāmāśramāṇāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ।। āvṛtaṃ candanāraṇyaiḥ pārijātavanānvitam ।। 4 ।। dadarśa tamṛṣīndraṃ ca sabhāmadhye manoharam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca vasantaṃ yogināṃ gurum ।। 5 ।। japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ।। praṇanāma ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaputraśca śaunaka ।। 6 ।। utthāya sahasā''liṅgya yuyuje paramāśiṣam ।। papraccha kuśalaṃ snehāccakārātithipūjanam ।।7।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa nāradam ।। nivasannāsane ramye vartmaśramavivarjitaḥ ।। 8 ।। uvāca tamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। adhītya vedānsarvāṃśca pituḥ sthāne sudurgamān ।।9।। jñānaṃ samprāpya yogīndrānmantraṃ vai śaṅkarādvibho ।। mano me na hi tṛpnoti durnivāraṃ ca caṃcalam ।। 1 0।। dṛṣṭaṃ mayā tvatpadābjaṃ manasā preritena ca ।। kiṃcijjñānaviśeṣaṃ ca labdhumicchāmi sāmpratam ।। 11 ।। yatra kṛṣṇaguṇākhyānaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham ।। 12 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādyāśca surendraśca surā vibho ।। kaṃ cintayanti munayo manavaśca vicakṣaṇāḥ।।13।। kasmātsṛṣṭiśca bhavati kutra vā saṃpralīyate।। ko vā sarveśvaro viṣṇuḥ sarvakāraṇakārakaḥ।।14।। tasyeśvarasya kiṃ rūpaṃ karma vā kiṃ jagatpate ।। vicāryya manasā sarvaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati।।15।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya bhagavānṛṣiḥ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe puṇyāṃ bhuvanapāvanīm ।। 16 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde nārāyaṇaṃ prati nāradapraśno nāmaikonatriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ।। 29 ।।
<1.30> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। lambodaro harirumāpatirīśaśeṣā brahmādayaḥ suragaṇā manavo munīndrāḥ ।। vāṇīśivātripathagā kamalādikāśca saṃcintayedbhagavataścaraṇāravindam ।। 1 ।। saṃsārasāgaramatīva gabhīraghoraṃ dāvāgnisarpapariveṣṭitaceṣṭitāṅgam ।। saṃlaṃghya gantumabhivāñchati yo hi dāsyaṃ saṃcintayedbhagavataścaraṇāravindam ।। 2 ।। govarddhanoddharaṇakīrttiratīva khinnā bhūrdhāritā ca daśanāgrata eva cārdrā ।। viśvāni lomavivareṣu bibharturādeḥ saṃcintayedbhagavataścaraṇāravindam ।। 3 ।। vedāṅgavedamukhaniḥsṛtakīrttiraṃśairvedāṅgavedajanakasya harervidhātuḥ।। janmāntakādibhayaśokavidīrṇadehaḥ saṃcintayedbhagavataścaraṇāravindam ।।4।। gopāṅganāvadanapaṅkajaṣaṭpadasya rāseśvarasya rasikāramaṇasya puṃsaḥ।। vṛndāvane viharato vrajaveṣaviṣṇoḥ saṃcintayedbhagavataścaraṇāravindam।।5।। cakṣurnimeṣapatito jagatāṃ vidhātā tatkarma vatsa kathituṃ bhuvi kaḥ samarthaḥ।। tvaṃ cāpi nārada mune paramādareṇa saṃcintanaṃ kuru hareścaraṇāravindam ।।6 ।। yūyaṃ vayaṃ tasya kalākalāṃśāḥ kalākalāṃśā manavo munīndrāḥ ।। kalāviśeṣā bhavapāramukhyā mahānvirāḍ yasya kalāviśeṣaḥ ।। 7 ।। sahasraśīrṣā śirasaḥ pradeśe bibhartti siddhārthasamaṃ ca viśvam ।। kūrme ca śeṣo maśako gaje yathā kūrmaśca kṛṣṇasya kalākalāṃśaḥ ।। 8 ।। golokanāthasya vibhoryaśo'malaṃ śrutau purāṇe nahi kiṃcana sphuṭam ।। na pādmamukhyāḥ kathituṃ samarthāḥ sarveśvaraṃ taṃ bhaja pādmamukhyam ।। 9 ।। । viśveṣu sarveṣu ca viśvadhāmnaḥ santyeva śaśvadvidhiviṣṇurudrāḥ ।। teṣāṃ ca saṃkhyāḥ śrutayaśca devāḥ paraṃ na jānanti tamīśvaraṃ bhaja ।। 1 0।। । karoti sṛṣṭiṃ sa vidhervidhātā vidhāya nityāṃ prakṛtiṃ jagatprasūm ।। brahmādayaḥ prākṛtikāśca sarve bhaktipradāṃ śrīprakṛtiṃ bhajanti।।। 1।। brahmasvarūpā prakṛtirna bhinnā yayā ca sṛṣṭiṃ kurute sanātanaḥ ।। śriyaśca sarvāḥ kalayā jagatsu māyā ca sarve ca tayā vimohitāḥ।।12।। nārāyaṇī sā paramā sanātanī śaktiśca puṃsaḥ paramātmanaśca ।। ātmeśvaraścāpi yayā ca śaktimāṃstayā vinā sraṣṭumaśakta eva ।। 13 ।। gatvā vivāhaṃ kuru vatsa sāmprataṃ kartuṃ prayuktaśca piturnideśaḥ।। gurornideśapratipālako bhaveḥ sarvatra pūjyo vijayī ca santatam।।14।। svapatnīṃ pūjayedyo hi vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ।। prakṛtistasya santuṣṭā yathā kṛṣṇo dvijārccane।।15।। sā ca yoṣitsvarūpā ca prativiśveṣu māyayā ।। yoṣitāmapamānena parābhūtā ca sā bhavet ।। 16 ।। divyā strī pūjitā yena patiputravatī satī ।। prakṛtiḥ pūjitā tena sarvamaṅgaladāyinī।।17।। mūlaprakṛtirekā sā pūrṇabrahmasvarūpiṇī ।। sṛṣṭau pañcavidhā sā ca viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ।। 18 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। sarvāsāṃ preyasī kāntā sā rādhā parikīrtitā ।। 19 ।। nārāyaṇapriyā lakṣmīḥ sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī ।। rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sā ca pūjyā sarasvatī ।। 20 ।। sāvitrī vedamātā ca pūjyarūpā vidheḥ priyā ।। śaṅkarasya priyā durgā yasyāḥ putro gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 21 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe brahmakhaṇḍe sautiśaunakasaṃvāde bhagavatstutitatsvarūpavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ।। 30 ।। ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe prathamaṃ brahmakhaṇḍaṃ sampūrṇam ।।
<2.1> śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ।। śrīveṅkaṭeśvarāya namaḥ ।। ।। śrīmahāsarasvatyai namaḥ ।। ।। śrīlakṣmīnarasiṃhābhyāṃ namaḥ ।। ।। atha prakṛtikhaṇḍaprāraṃbhaḥ ।। ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। gaṇeśajananī durgā rādhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।। sāvitrī vai sṛṣṭividhau prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā smṛtā ।। 1 ।। āvirbabhūva sā kena kā vā sā jñānināṃ varā ।। kiṃ vā tallakṣaṇaṃ brūhi sābhavatpañcadhā katham ।। 2 ।। sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ kathamīpsitam ।। avatāraṃ kutra kasyāstanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ।।3।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ vatsa ko vā vaktuṃ kṣamo bhavet।। kiṃcittathāpi vakṣyāmi yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ ।। 4 ।। prakṛṣṭavācakaḥ praśca kṛtiśca sṛṣṭivācakaḥ ।। sṛṣṭau prakṛṣṭā yā devī prakṛtiḥ sā prakīrtitā ।। 5 ।। guṇe prakṛṣṭasattve ca praśabdo vartate śrutau ।। madhyame kṛśca rajasi tiśabdastamasi smṛtaḥ ।। 6 ।। triguṇātmasvarūpā yā sarvaśaktisamanvitā ।। pradhānā sṛṣṭikaraṇe prakṛtistena kathyate ।। 7 ।। prathame varttate praśca kṛtissyātsṛṣṭivācakaḥ ।। sṛṣṭerādyā ca yā devī prakṛtiḥ sā prakīrtitā ।। 8 ।। yogenātmā sṛṣṭividhau dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ ।। pumāṃśca dakṣiṇārddhāṅgo vāmāṅgaḥ prakṛtiḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 9 ।। sā ca brahmasvarūpā syānmāyā nityā sanātanī ।। yathā''tmā ca yathāśaktiryathā'gnau dāhikā smṛtā ।। 10 ।। ataeva hi yogīndraḥ strīpuṃbhedaṃ na manyate ।। sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ brahmañchaśvatpaśyati nārada ।। 11 ।। svecchāmayasyecchayā ca śrīkṛṣṇasya sisṛkṣayā ।। sā''virbabhūva sahasā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 12 ।। tadājñayā pañcavidhā sṛṣṭikarmaṇi bhedataḥ ।। atha bhaktānurodhādvā bhaktānugrahavigrahā ।। 13 ।। gaṇeśamātā durgā yā śivarūpā śivapriyā ।। nārāyaṇī viṣṇumāyā pūrṇabrahmasvarūpiṇī ।। 14 ।। brahmādidevairmunibhirmanubhiḥ pūjitā sadā ।। sarvādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā brahmarūpā sanātanī ।। 19 ।। yaśomaṅgaladharmaśrīsatyapuṇyapradāyinī ।। mokṣaharṣapradātrīyaṃ śokaduḥkhārtināśinī ।। 16 ।। śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇā ।। tejaḥsvarūpā paramā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। 17 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca śaktirīśasya santatam ।। siddheśvarī siddharūpā siddhidā siddhideśvarī ।।18।। buddhirnidrā kṣutpipāsā cchāyā tandrā dayā smṛtiḥ ।। jātiḥ kṣāntiśca śāntiśca kāṃtirbhrāntiśca cetanā ।। 19 ।। tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā lakṣmīrvṛttirmātā tathaiva ca ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 20 ।। uktaḥ śrutau śrutaguṇaścātisvalpo yathāgamam ।। guṇo'styananto'nantāyā aparāṃ ca niśāmaya ।। 21 ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā yā padmā ca paramātmanaḥ ।। sarvasampatsvarūpā yā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā।।22।। kāntā dāntā'tiśāntā ca suśīlā sarvamaṅgalā ।। lobhānmohātkāmaroṣānmadāhaṅkāratastathā ।। 23 ।। tyaktā'nuraktā patyuśca sarvādyā ca pativratā ।। prāṇatulyā bhagavataḥ premapātrī priyaṃvadā ।। 24 ।। sarvasasyātmikā sarvajīvanopāyarūpiṇī ।। mahālakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe patisevāparāyaṇā ।। ।। 25 ।। svarge ca svargalakṣmīśca rājalakṣmīśca rājasu ।। gṛhe ca gṛhalakṣmīśca martyānāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ tathā।। ।। 26 ।। sarveṣu prāṇidravyeṣu śobhārūpā manoharā ।। prītirūpā puṇyavatāṃ prabhārūpā nṛpeṣu ca ।। 27 ।। vāṇijyarūpā vaṇijāṃ pāpināṃ kalahaṅkarī ।। dayāmayī bhaktamātā bhaktānugrahakārikā ।। 28 ।। capale capalā bhaktasampado rakṣaṇāya ca ।। jagajjīvanmṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yayā devyā vinā mune ।। 29 ।। śaktirdvitīyā kathitā vedoktā sarvasammatā ।। sarvapūjyā sarvavandyā cānyāṃ matto niśāmaya ।। ।। 30 ।। vāgbuddhividyājñānādhidevatā paramātmanaḥ ।। sarvavidyāsvarūpā yā sā ca devī sarasvatī ।। 31 ।। subuddhiḥ kavitā medhā pratibhā smṛtidā satām ।। nānāprakārasiddhāntabhedārthakalpanāpradā ।। 32 ।। vyākhyābodhasvarūpā ca sarvasaṃdehabhañjinī ।। vicārakāriṇī granthakāriṇī śaktirūpiṇī ।। 33 ।। sarvasaṅgītasandhānatālakāraṇarūpiṇī ।। viṣayajñānavāgrūpā prativiśvaṃ ca jīvinām ।। ।।34।। yayā vinā ca viśvaugho mūko mṛtasamaḥ sadā ।। vyākhyāmudrākarā śāntā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī ।।39।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā yā suśīlā śrīharipriyā ।। himacandanakundendukumudāmbhojasannibhā।।36।। japantī paramātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ratnamālayā।। tapassvarūpā tapasāṃ phaladātrī tapasvinī।।37।। siddhividyāsvarūpā ca sarvasiddhipradā sadā।।38।। yathāgamaṃ yathākiñcidaparāṃ saṃnibodha me ।। mātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vedāṅgānāṃ ca chandasām।।39।। sandhyāvandanamantrāṇāṃ tantrāṇāṃ ca vicakṣaṇā।। dvijādijātirūpā ca japarūpā tapasvinī।। 40।। brāhmaṇyatejorūpā ca sarvasaṃskārakāriṇī ।। pavitrarūpā sāvitrī gāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ।। 41 ।। tīrthāni yasyāḥ saṃsparśaṃ darśaṃ vāñchanti śuddhaye ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī ।। 42 ।। paramānandarūpā ca paramā ca sanātanī ।। parabrahmasvarūpā ca nirvāṇapadadāyinī ।। 43 ।। brahmatejomayī śaktistadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। yatpādarajasā pūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ ca nārada ।। 44 ।। devī caturthī kathitā pañcamīṃ varṇayāmi te ।। premaprāṇādhidevī yā pañcaprāṇasvarūpiṇī ।। 45 ।। prāṇādhikapriyatamā sarvādyā sundarī varā ।। sarvasaubhāgyayuktā ca māninī gauravānvitā ।। 46 ।। vāmārddhāṅgasvarūpā ca suguṇaistejasā samā ।। parāvarā sarvamātā paramādyā sanātanī ।।47।। paramānandarūpā ca dhanyā mānyā ca pūjitā ।। rāsakrīḍādhidevī ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 48 ।। rāsamaṇḍalasaṃbhūtā rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitā ।। rāseśvarī surasikā rāsāvāsanivāsinī ।। 49 ।। golokavāsinī devī gopīveṣavidhāyikā ।। paramāhlādarūpā ca santoṣāmarṣarūpiṇī ।। 50 ।। nirguṇā ca nirākārā nirliptā''tmasvarūpiṇī ।। nirīhā nirahaṅkārā bhaktānugrahavigrahā ।। 51 ।। vedānusāradhyānena vijñeyā sā vicakṣaṇaiḥ ।। dṛṣṭirdṛṣṭā sahasreṣu surendrairmunipuṅgavaiḥ ।। 52 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitā।। koṭiprabhājuṣṭaśrīyuktā bhaktavigrahā ।। 53 ।। śrīkṛṣṇabhaktadāsyaikadāyinī sarvasampadām ।। avatāre ca vārāhe vṛṣabhānusutā ca yā ।। 54 ।। yatpādapadmasaṃsparśapavitrā ca vasundharā ।। brahmādibhiradṛṣṭā yā sarvadṛṣṭā ca bhārate ।। 55 ।। strīratnasārasaṃbhūtā kṛṣṇavakṣaḥ sthalasthitā ।। tathā ghane navaghane lolā saudāminī mune ।। 56 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi prataptaṃ brahmaṇā purā ।। yatpādapadmanakharadṛṣṭaye cātmaśuddhaye ।। 57 ।। svapne'pi naiva dṛṣṭaḥ syātpratyakṣe'pi ca kā kathā ।। tenaiva tapasā dṛṣṭā bhūri vṛndāvane vane ।। 58 ।। kathitā pañcamī devī sā rādhā parikīrttitā ।। aṃśarūpā kalārūpā kalāṃśāṃśasamudbhavā।। 59 ।। prakṛteḥ prativiśvaṃ ca rūpaṃ syātsarvayoṣitaḥ।। paripūrṇatamāḥ pañcavidhā devyaḥ prakīrttitāḥ ।। 60 ।। yā yāḥ pradhānāṃśarūpā varṇayāmi niśāmaya ।। pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī ।। 61 ।। viṣṇupādābjasaṃbhūtā dravarūpā sanātanī ।। pāpipāpedhmadāhāya jvaladindhanarūpiṇī ।। 62 ।। darśanasparśanasnānapānairnirvāṇadāyinī ।। golokasthānagamanasusopānasvarūpiṇī ।। 63 ।। pavitrarūpā tīrthānāṃ saritāṃ ca parāvarā ।। śambhumaulijaṭāmerumuktāpaṃktisvarūpiṇī ।। 64 ।। tapassampādinī sadyo bhārate ca tapasvinām ।। śaṅkhapadmakṣīranibhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī ।। 65 ।। nirmalā nirahaṅkārā sādhvī nārāyaṇapriyā ।। pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca tulasī viṣṇukāminī ।। 66 ।। viṣṇubhūṣaṇarūpā ca viṣṇupādasthitā satī ।। tapassaṅkalpapūjādisadyassampādinī mune ।। 67 ।। sārabhūtā ca puṣpāṇāṃ pavitrā puṇyadā sadā ।। darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca sadyo nirvāṇadāyinī ।। 68 ।। kalau kaluṣaśuṣkedhmadāhanāyāgnirūpiṇī ।। yatpādapadmasaṃsparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। 69 ।। yatsparśadarśaṃ vāñchanti tīrthānāmātmaśuddhaye ।। yayā vinā ca viśveṣu sarvaṃ karmāsti niṣphalam ।। 70 ।। mokṣadā yā mumukṣūṇāṃ kāmināṃ sarvakāmadā ।। kalpavṛkṣasvarūpā ca bhārate vṛkṣarūpiṇī ।। 71 ।। trāṇāya bhāratānāṃ ca pūjānāṃ paradevatā ।। pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca manasā kaśyapātmajā ।। 72 ।। śaṅkarapriyaśiṣyā ca mahājñānaviśāradā ।। nāgeśvarasyānantasya bhaginī nāgapūjitā ।। 73 ।। nāgeśvarī nāgamātā sundarī nāgavāhinī ।। nāgendragaṇayuktā sā nāgabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 74 ।। nāgendravanditā siddhayoginī nāgavāsinī ।। viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇurūpā viṣṇupūjāparāyaṇā ।। 75 ।। tapaḥsvarūpā tapasāṃ phaladātrī tapasvinī ।। divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣaṃ ca tapastaptaṃ yayā hareḥ ।। 76 ।। tapasvinīṣu pūjyā ca tapasviṣu ca bhārate ।। sarvamantrādhidevī ca jvalantī brahmatejasā ।। 77 ।। brahmasvarūpā paramā brahmabhāvanatatparā ।। jaratkārumuneḥ patnī kṛṣṇaśambhupativratā ।। 78 ।। āstīkasya munermātā pravarasya tapasvinām।। pradhānāṃśasvarūpā yā devasenā ca nārada ।। 79 ।। mātṛkā sā pūjyatamā sā ca ṣaṣṭhī prakīrttitā ।। śiśūnāṃ prativiśvaṃ tu pratipālanakāriṇī।। 80 ।। tapasvinī viṣṇubhaktā kārttikeyasya kāminī ।। ṣaṣṭhāṃśarūpā prakṛtestena ṣaṣṭhī prakīrtitā ।। 81 ।। putrapautrapradātrī ca dhātrī ca jagatāṃ sadā ।। sundarī yuvatī ramyā satataṃ bharturantike ।। 82 ।। sthāne śiśūnāṃ paramā vṛddharūpā ca yoginī ।। pūjā dvādaśamāseṣu yasyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyāstu santatam ।। 83 ।। pūjā ca sūtikāgāre paraṣaṣṭhadine śiśoḥ ।। ekaviṃśatime caiva pūjā kalyāṇahetukī ।। 84 ।। śaśvanniyamitā caiṣā nityā kāmyā'pyataḥ parā ।। mātṛrūpā dayārūpā śaśvadrakṣaṇakāriṇī ।। 85 ।। jale sthale cāntarikṣe śiśūnāṃ svapnagocarā ।। pradhānāṃśasvarūpā yā devī maṅgalacaṇḍikā ।। 86 ।। prakṛtermukhasaṃbhūtā sarvamaṅgaladā sadā ।। sṛṣṭau maṅgalarūpā ca saṃhāre koparūpiṇī ।। 87 ।। tena maṅgalacaṇḍī sā paṇḍitaiḥ parikīrttitā ।। pratimaṅgalavāreṣu prativiśveṣu pūjitā ।। 88 ।। pañcopacārairbhaktyā ca yoṣidbhiḥ paripūjitā ।। putrapautradhanaiśvaryyayaśomaṅgaladāyinī ।।89।। śoka santāpapāpārttiduḥkhadāridryanāśinī।। parituṣṭā sarvavācchāpradātrī sarvayoṣitām ।। 90।। ruṣṭā kṣaṇena saṃhartuṃ śaktā viśvaṃ maheśvarī।। pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca kālī kamalalocanā ।। 91 ।। durgālalāṭasaṃbhūtā raṇe śumbhaniśumbhayoḥ ।। durgārddhāṃśasvarūpā syādguṇaissā tejasā samā ।। 92 ।। koṭisūryyaprabhājuṣṭadivyasundaravigrahā ।। pradhānā sarvaśaktīnāṃ varā balavatī parā ।। 93 ।। sarvasiddhipradā devī paramā siddhiyoginī ।। kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇatulyā tejasā vikramairguṇaiḥ ।। kṛṣṇabhāvanayā śaśvatkṛṣṇavarṇā sanātanī ।। 94 ।। brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ hartuṃ śaktā niḥśvāsamātrataḥ ।। raṇaṃ daityaiḥ samaṃ tasyāḥ krīḍayā lokarakṣayā ।। 95 ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca dātuṃ śaktā supūjitā ।। brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānā munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ ।। 96 ।। pradhānāṃśasvarūpā ca prakṛtiśca vasundharā ।। ādhārabhūtā sarveṣāṃ sarvasasyaprasūtikā ।। 97 ।। ratnākārā ratnagarbhā sarvaratnākarāśrayā ।। prajādibhiḥ prajeśaiśca pūjitā vanditā sadā ।। 98 ।। sarvopajīvyarūpā ca sarvasampadvidhāyinī ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ nirādhāraṃ carācaram ।।99।। prakṛteśca kalā yā yāstā nibodha munīśvara ।। yasya yasya ca yāḥ patnyastāḥ sarvā varṇayāmi te ।। 100 ।। svāhādevī vahnipatnī triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā ।। yayā vinā havirdattaṃ na grahītuṃ surāḥ kṣamāḥ ।। 101 ।। dakṣiṇā yajñapatnī ca dīkṣā sarvatra pūjitā ।। yayā vinā ca viśveṣu sarvaṃ karma ca niṣphalam ।।102।। svadhā pitṝṇāṃ patnī ca munibhirmanubhirnaraiḥ ।। pūjitā paitṛkaṃ dānaṃ niṣphalaṃ ca yayā vinā ।। 103 ।। svastidevī vāyupatnī prati viśveṣu pūjitā ।। ādānaṃ ca pradānaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ ca yayā vinā ।। 104 ।। puṣṭirgaṇapateḥ patnī pūjitā jagatītale ।। yayā vinā parikṣīṇāḥ pumāṃso yoṣito'pi ca ।। 105 ।। anantapatnī tuṣṭiśca pūjitā vanditā sadā ।। yayā vinā na santuṣṭāḥ sarve lokāśca sarvataḥ ।। 106 ।। īśānapatnī sampattiḥ pūjitā ca surairnaraiḥ ।। sarve lokā daridrāśca viśveṣu ca yayā vinā ।। 107।। dhṛtiḥ kapilapatnī ca sarvaiḥ sarvatra pūjitā ।। sarve lokā adhīrāssyurjagatsu ca yayā vinā।। 108 ।। yamapatnī kṣamā sādhvī suśīlā sarvapūjitā।। samunmattāśca rudrāśca sarve lokā yayā vinā ।। 109 ।। krīḍādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kāmapatnī ratiḥ satī ।। kelikautukahīnāśca sarve lokā yayā vinā ।। 110 ।। satyapatnī satī muktiḥ pūjitā jagatāṃ priyā ।। yayā vinā bhavelloko bandhutārahitaḥ sadā ।। 111।। mohapatnī dayā sādhvī pūjitā ca jagatpriyā ।। sarve lokāśca sarvatra niṣṭhurāśca yayā vinā ।। 112 ।। puṇyapatnī pratiṣṭhā sā puṇyarūpā ca pūjitā ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtasamaṃ mune ।। 113 ।। sukarmapatnī kīrtiśca dhanyā mānyā ca pūjitā ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ yaśohīnaṃ mṛtaṃ yathā ।। 114 ।। kriyā udyogapatnī ca pūjitā sarvasaṅgatā ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvamucchinnamiva nārada ।। 115 ।। adharmapatnī mithyā sā sarvadhūrtaiśca pūjitā ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvamucchinnaṃ vidhinirmitam ।। 116 ।। satye adarśanā yā ca tretāyāṃ sūkṣmarūpiṇī ।। arddhāvayavarūpā ca dvāpare saṃhṛtā hriyā ।। 117 ।। kalau mahāpragalbhā ca sarvatra vyāptikāraṇāt ।। kapaṭena saha bhrātrā bhramatyeva gṛhe gṛhe ।। 118 ।। śāntirlajjā ca bhārye dve suśīlasya ca pūjite ।। yasyāṃ vinā jagatsarvamunmattamiva nārada ।। 119 ।। jñānasya tisro bhāryāśca buddhirmedhā smṛtistathā ।। yābhirvinā jagatsarvaṃ mūḍhaṃ mṛtasamaṃ sadā ।। 120।। mūrttiśca dharmapatnī sā kāntirūpā manoharā ।। paramātmā ca viśvaughā nirādhārā yayā vinā ।। 121 ।। sarvatra śobhārūpā ca lakṣmīrmūrtimatī satī ।। śrīrūpā mūrtirūpā ca mānyā dhanyā ca pūjitā।।122।। kālāgnirudrapatnī ca nidrā yā siddhayoginām ।। sarvalokāḥ samācchannā māyāyogena rātriṣu ।। 123 ।। kālasya tisro bhāryyāśca sandhyā rātrirdināni ca ।। yābhirvinā vidhātrā ca saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate ।। 124 ।। kṣutpipāse lobhabhāryye dhanye mānye ca pūjite ।। yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatkṣobhayuktaṃ cintitameva ca ।। ।। 125 ।। prabhā ca dāhikā caiva dve bhārye tejasastathā ।। yābhyāṃ vinā jagatsraṣṭuṃ vidhātā ca na hīśvaraḥ ।। 126 ।। kālakanye mṛtyujare prajvarasya priye priye ।। yasyāṃ jagatsamucchinnaṃ vidhātrā nirmite vidhau ।। 127 ।। nidrākanyā ca tandrā sā prītiranyā sukhapriye।। yābhyāṃ vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ vidhiputra vidhervidhau ।। 128 ।। vairāgyasya ca dve bhārye śraddhā bhaktiśca pūjite ।। yābhyāṃ śaśvajjagatsarvaṃ jīvanmuktamidaṃ mune ।। 129 ।। aditirdevamātā ca surabhiśca gavāṃ prasūḥ ।। ditiśca daityajananī kadrūśca vinatā danuḥ ।। 130 ।। upayuktāḥ sṛṣṭividhāvetāśca prakṛteḥ kalāḥ ।। kalāścānyāḥ santi bahvyastāsu kāścinnibodha me ।। ।। 131 ।। rohiṇī candrapatnī ca saṃjñā sūryasya kāminī ।। śatarūpā manorbhāryā śacīndrasya ca gehinī ।। 132 ।। tārā bṛhaspaterbhāryyā vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī ।। ahalyā gautamastrī syādanasūyā'trikāminī ।। 133 ।। devahūtiḥ kardamasya prasūtirdakṣakāminī ।। pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā menakā sā'mbikāprasūḥ ।। 134 ।। lopāmudrā tathā hūtiḥ kuberasya tu kāminī ।। varuṇānī yamastrī ca balervindhyāvalīti ca ।। 135 ।। kuntī ca damayantī ca yaśodā devakī satī ।। gāndhārī draupadī savyā sāvitrī satyavatpriyā ।। ।। 136 ।। vṛṣabhānupriyā sādhvī rādhāmātā kalāvatī ।। mandodarī ca kausalyā subhadrā kaikayī tathā ।। 137 ।। revatī satyabhāmā ca kālindī lakṣmaṇā tathā ।। mitravindā nāgnajitī tathā jāmbavatī parā ।। 138 ।। lakṣmaṇā rukmiṇī sītā svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā ।। kalā yojanagandhā ca vyāsamātā mahāsatī ।। 139 ।। bāṇaputrī tathoṣā ca citralekhā ca tatsakhī ।। prabhāvatī bhānumatī tathā māyāvatī satī ।। 140।। reṇukā ca bhṛgormātā halimātā ca rohiṇī।। ekānaṃśā ca durgā sā śrīkṛṣṇabhaginī satī ।। 141 ।। bahvyaḥ santi kalāścaivaṃ prakṛtereva bhārate ।। yā yāśca grāmadevyastāḥ sarvāśca prakṛteḥ kalāḥ ।। 142 ।। kalāṃśāṃśasamudbhūtāḥ prativiśveṣu yoṣitaḥ ।। yoṣitāmapamānena prakṛteśca parābhavaḥ ।। 143 ।। brāhmaṇī pūjitā yena patiputravatī satī ।। prakṛtiḥ pūjitā tena vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ।।144।। kumārī cāṣṭavarṣīyā vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ।। pūjitā yena viprasya prakṛtistena pūjitā।।145।। sarvāḥ prakṛtisambhūtā uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ।। sattvāṃśāścottamā jñeyāḥ suśīlāśca pativratāḥ ।।145।।। madhyamā rajasaścāṃśāstāśca bhogyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ ।। sukhasambhogavatyaśca svakārye tatparāḥ sadā ।। 147 ।। adhamāstamasaścāṃśā ajñātakulasambhavāḥ ।। durmukhāḥ kulaṭā dhūrttāḥ svatantrāḥ kalahapriyāḥ।।148।। pṛthivyāṃ kulaṭā yāśca svarge cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।। prakṛtestamasaścāṃśāḥ puṃścalyaḥ parikīrttitāḥ ।। 149 ।। evaṃ nigaditaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛterbhedapañcakam ।। tāḥ sarvāḥ pūjitāḥ pṛthvyāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 150 ।। pūjitā surathenādau durgā durgārtināśinī ।। dvitīyā rāmacandreṇa rāvaṇasya vadhārthinā ।। 151 ।। tatpaścājjagatāṃ mātā triṣu lokeṣu pūjitā ।। jātā''dau dakṣapatnyāṃ ca nihantuṃ daityadānavān ।। 152 ।। tato dehaṃ parityajya yajñe bhartuśca nindayā ।। jajñe himavataḥ patnyāṃ lebhe paśupatiṃ patim ।।153।। gaṇeśaśca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ skando viṣṇukalodbhavaḥ ।। babhūvatustau tanayau paścāttasyāśca nārada ।।154।। lakṣmīrmaṅgalabhūpena prathame paripūjitā ।। triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścāddevatāmunimānavaiḥ ।। 155 ।। sāvitrī prathamaṃ cāpi bhaktyā vai paripūjitā ।। tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunimānavaiḥ ।। 156 ।। ādau sarasvatī devī brahmaṇā paripūjitā ।। tatpaścāttriṣu lokeṣu devatāmunimānavaiḥ ।। 157 ।। prathamaṃ pūjitā rādhā goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। paurṇamāsyāṃ kārttikasya kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। 158 ।। gopikābhiśca gopaiśca bālikābhiśca bālakaiḥ ।। gavāṃ gaṇaiḥ suragaṇaistatpaścānmāyayā hareḥ ।। 199 ।। tadā brahmādibhirdevairmunibhirmanubhistathā। puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā vanditā sadā।। 160।। pṛthivyāṃ prathame devī suyajñena ca pūjitā।। śaṅkareṇopadiṣṭena puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 161 ।। triṣu lokeṣu tatpaścādājñayā paramātmanaḥ ।। puṣpadhūpādibhirbhaktyā pūjitā munibhiḥ suraiḥ ।। ।। 162 ।। kalā yā yāḥ susaṃbhūtāḥ pūjitāstāśca bhārate ।। pūjitā grāmadevyaśca grāme ca nagare mune ।। 163 ।। evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prakṛteścaritaṃ śubham ।। yathāgamaṃ lakṣaṇañca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 164 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛti khaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde prakṛtisvarūpatadbhedavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 ।।
<2.2> nārada uvāca ।। samāsena śrutaṃ sarvaṃ devīnāṃ caritaṃ vibho ।। vibodhanārthaṃ bodhasya vyāsato vaktumarhasi ।।1।। sṛṣṭerādyā sṛṣṭividhau kathamāvirbabhūva ha ।। kathaṃ vā pañcadhā bhūtā vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 2 ।। bhūtā yā yāśca kalayā tayā triguṇayā bhave ।। vyāsena tāsāṃ caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam ।। 3 ।। tāsāṃ janmānukathanaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ param ।। stotraṃ kavacamaiśvaryyaṃ śauryaṃ varṇaya maṅgalam ।। 4 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। nityātmā ca nabho nityaṃ kālo nityo diśo yathā ।। viśveṣāṃ gokulaṃ nityaṃ nityo goloka eva ca ।। 5 ।। tadekadeśo vaikuṇṭho lambabhāgaḥ sa nityakaḥ ।। tathaiva prakṛtirnityā brahmalīnā sanātanī ।। 6 ।। yathā'gnau dāhikā candre padme śobhā prabhā ravau ।। śaśvadyuktā na bhinnā sā tathā prakṛtirātmani ।। 7 ।। vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ।। vinā mṛdā kulālo hi ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ na hīśvaraḥ ।। ।। 8 ।। nahi kṣamastathā brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ tayā vinā ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā tayā syācchaktimānsadā ।। 9 ।। aiśvaryyavacanaḥ śak ca tiḥ parākramavācakaḥ ।। tatsvarūpā tayordātrī yā sā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā ।। 10 ।। samṛddhibuddhisampattiyaśasāṃ vacano bhagaḥ ।। tena śaktirbhagavatī bhagarūpā ca sā sadā ।। 11 ।। tayā yuktaḥ sadā''tmā ca bhagavāṃstena kathyate ।। sa ca svecchāmayaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sākāraśca nirākṛtiḥ ।। 12 ।। tejorūpaṃ nirākāraṃ dhyāyante yoginaḥ sadā ।। vadanti te paraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 13 ।। adṛśyaṃ sarva draṣṭāraṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam ।। sarvadaṃ sarvarūpāntamarūpaṃ sarvapoṣakam।। 14 ।। vaiṣṇavāste na manyante tadbhaktāḥ sūkṣmadarśinaḥ।। vadanti kasya tejaste iti tejasvinaṃ vinā ।।15।। tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ brahma tejasvinaṃ param।। svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam।।16।। atīvasundaraṃ rūpaṃ bibhrataṃ sumanoharam ।। kiśoravayasaṃ śāntaṃ sarvakāntaṃ parātparam ।।17।। navīnanīradābhāsaṃ rāsaikaśyāmasundaram ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmaughaśobhāmocakalocanam ।। 18 ।। muktāsāramahāsvacchadantapaṅktimanoharam ।। mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam ।।19।। sunāsaṃ sasmitaṃ śaśvadbhaktānugrahakārakam ।। jvaladagniviśuddhaikapītāṃśukasuśobhitam ।। 20।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। sarvādhāraṃ ca sarveśaṃ sarvaśaktiyutaṃ vibhum ।। 21 ।। sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ sarvaṃ svatantraṃ sarvamaṅgalam ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ siddhaṃ siddhi daṃ siddhikāraṇam ।। 22 ।। dhyāyante vaiṣṇavāḥ śaśvadevaṃrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param ।। 23 ।। brahmaṇo vayasā yasya nimeṣa upacāryyate ।। sa cātmā paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate ।। 24 ।। kṛṣistadbhaktivacano naśca taddāsyakārakaḥ ।। bhaktidāsyapradātā yaḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। 25 ।। kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāro bījavācakaḥ ।। sarvabījaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityabhidhīyate ।। 25 ।। asaṃkhyabrahmaṇā pāte kāle'tīte'pi nārada ।। yadguṇānāṃ nāsti nāśastatsamāno guṇena ca ।। 27 ।। sa kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasṛṣṭyādau sisṛkṣustveka eva ca ।। sṛṣṭyunmukhastadaṃśena kālena preritaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 28 ।। svecchāmayaḥ svecchayā ca dvidhārūpo babhūva ha ।। strīrūpā vāmabhāgāṃśāddakṣiṇāṃśaḥ pumānsmṛtaḥ ।। 29 ।। tāṃ dadarśa mahākāmī kāmādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ ।। atīva kamanīyāṃ ca cārucampakasannibhām ।। 30 ।। pūrṇendubimbasadṛśanitamvayugalāṃ parām ।। sucārukadalīstambhasadṛśaśroṇisundarīm ।। 31 ।। śrīyuktaśrīphalākārastanayugmamanoramām ।। puṣṭyā yuktāṃ sulalitāṃ madhyakṣīṇāṃ manoharām ।। 32 ।। atīva sundarīṃ śāntāṃ sasmitāṃ vakralocanām ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 33 ।। śaśvaccakṣuścakorābhyāṃ pibantīṃ santataṃ mudā ।। kṛṣṇasya sundaramukhaṃ candrakoṭivinindakam ।। 34 ।। kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā ।। samaṃ sindūrabinduṃ ca bhālamadhye ca bibhratīm ।। 35 ।। suvakrakabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।। ratnendrasārahāraṃ ca dadhatīṃ kāntakāmukīm ।। 36 ।। koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭapuṣṭaśobhāsamanvitām ।। gamane rājahaṃsīṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭyā khañjanagañjanīm ।। 37 ।। atimātraṃ tayā sārddhaṃ rāseśo rāsamaṇḍale ।। rāsollāseṣu rahasi rāsakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha।।38।। nānāprakāraśṛṃgāraṃ śṛṅgāro mūrttimāniva।। cakāra sukhasambhogaṃ yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।।39।। tataḥ sa ca pariśrāntastasyā yonau jagatpitā ।। cakāra vīryyādhānaṃ ca nityānandaḥ śubhakṣaṇe ।। 40 ।। gātrato yoṣitastasyāḥ suratānte ca suvrata ।। nissasāra śramajalaṃ śrāntāyāstejasā hareḥ ।। 41 ।। mahāsuratakhinnāyā niśvāsaśca babhūva ha ।। tadādhāraśramajalaṃ tatsarvaṃ viśvagolakam ।। 425 ।। sa ca niḥśvāsavāyuśca sarvādhāro babhūva ha ।। niśśvāsavāyuḥ sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ ca bhaveṣu ca ।। 43 ।। babhūva mūrttimadvāyorvāmāṅgātprāṇavallabhā ।। tatpatnī sā ca tatputrāḥ prāṇāḥ pañca ca jīvinām ।। 44 ।। prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścaivodāno vyāna eva ca ।। babhūvureva tatputrā adhaḥprāṇāśca pañca ca ।। 49 ।। gharmatoyādhidevaśca babhūva varuṇo mahān ।। tadvāmāṅgācca tatpatnī varuṇānī babhūva sā ।। 46 ।। atha sā kṛṣṇaśaktiśca kṛṣṇādgarbhaṃ dadhāra ha ।। śatamanvantaraṃ yāvajjvalanto(tī?) brahmatejasā ।। 47 ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikapriyā ।। kṛṣṇasya saṅginī śaśvatkṛṣṇavakṣasthalasthitā ।। 48 ।। śatamanvantarātīte kāle paramasundarī ।। suṣāvāṇḍaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ viśvādhārālayaṃ param ।। 49 ।। dṛṣṭvā cāṇḍaṃ hi sā devī hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। utsasarja ca kopena tadaṇḍaṃ golake jale ।। 50 ।। dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaśca tattyāgaṃ hāhākāraṃ cakāra da।।। śaśāpa devīṃ deveśastatkṣaṇaṃ ca yathocitam ।। 51 ।। yato'patyaṃ tvayā tyaktaṃ kopaśīle suniṣṭhure ।। bhava tvamanapatyā'pi cādyaprabhṛti niścitam ।। 52 ।। yā yāstvadaṃśarūpāśca bhaviṣyanti surastriyaḥ ।। anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāstvatsamā nityayauvanāḥ ।। 53 ।। etasminnantare devī jihvāgrātsahasā tataḥ ।। āvirbabhūva kanyaikā śuklavarṇā manoharā ।। 54 ।। pītavastraparīdhānā vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī ।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā sarvaśāstrādhidevatā ।। 59 ।। atha kālāntare sā ca dvidhārūpā babhūva ha ।। vāmārddhāṅgā ca kamalā dakṣiṇārddhā ca rādhikā ।। 56 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva ha ।। dakṣiṇārddhassyāddvibhujo vāmārddhaśca caturbhujaḥ ।। 57 ।। uvāca vāṇīṃ śrīkṛṣṇastvamasya bhava kāminī।। atraiva māninī rādhā naiva bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 58 ।। evaṃ lakṣmīṃ saṃpradau tuṣṭo nārāyaṇāya vai ।। saṃjagāma ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tābhyāṃ sārddhaṃ jagatpatiḥ ।। 59 ।। anapatye ca te dve ca yato rādhāṃśasambhave।। nārāyaṇāṅgādabhavanpārṣadāśca caturbhujāḥ ।। 60 ।। tejasā vayasā rūpaguṇābhyāṃ ca samā hareḥ ।। babhūvuḥ kamalāṅgācca dāsīkoṭyaśca tatsamāḥ ।। 61 ।। atha golokanāthasya lomāvivarato mune ।। āsannasaṃkhyagopāśca vayasā tejasā samāḥ ।। 62 ।। rūpeṇa suguṇenaiva veṣādvā vikrameṇa ca ।। prāṇatulyāḥ priyāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ pārṣadā vibhoḥ ।। 63 ।। rādhāṅgalomakūpebhyo babhūvurgopakanyakāḥ ।। rādhātulyāśca sarvāstā nānyatulyāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ ।। 64 ।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāḥ śaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ ।। anapatyāśca tāḥ sarvāḥ puṃsaḥ śāpena santatam ।। 65 ।। etasminnantare vipra sahasā kṛṣṇadehataḥ ।। āvirbabhūva sā durgā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ।। 66 ।। devī nārāyaṇīśānā sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ।। buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।।67।। devīnāṃ bījarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī।। paripūrṇatamā tejaḥsvarūpā triguṇātmikā ।। 68 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhā sūryyakoṭisamaprabhā ।। īṣaddhāsaprasannāsyā sahasrabhujasaṃyutā ।। 69 ।। nānāśastrāstranikaraṃ bibhratī sā trilocanā ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 70 ।। yasyāścāṃśāṃśakalayā babhūvuḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। sarvaviśvasthitā lokā mohitā māyayā yayā ।। 71 ।। sarvaiśvaryyapradātrī ca kāmināṃ gṛhamedhinām ।। kṛṣṇabhakti pradātrī ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavī ।। 72 ।। mumukṣūṇāṃ mokṣadātrī sukhināṃ sukhadāyinī।। svargeṣu svargalakṣmīḥ sā gṛhalakṣmīrgṛheṣvasau।। ।।।73।। tapasviṣu tapasyā ca śrīrūpā sā nṛpeṣu ca ।। yā cāgnau dāhikārūpā prabhārūpā ca bhāskare ।। 74 ।। śobhāsvarūpā candre ca padmeṣu ca suśobhanā ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā yā śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ।। 79 ।। yayā ca śaktimānātmā yayā vai śaktimajjagat ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ jīvanmṛtamiva sthitam ।। 76 ।। yā ca saṃsāravṛkṣasya bījarūpā sanātanī ।। sthitirūpā buddhirūpā phalarūpā ca nārada ।। 77 ।। kṣutpipāsā dayā śraddhā nidrā tandrā kṣamā dhṛtiḥ ।। śāntirlajjātuṣṭipuṣṭibhrāntikāntyādirūpiṇī ।। 78 ।। sā ca saṃstūya sarveśaṃ tatpuraḥ samupasthitā ।। ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasyai pradadau rādhikeśvaraḥ ।। 79 ।। etasminnantare tatra sastrīkaśca caturmukhaḥ ।। padmanābho nābhipadmānnissasāra pumānmune ।। 80 ।। kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śrīmāṃstapasvī jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। caturmukhastaṃ tuṣṭāva prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। 81 ।। sudatī sundarī śreṣṭhā śatacandrasamaprabhā ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 82 ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye stutā vai sarvakāraṇam ।। uvāsa svāminā sārddha kṛṣṇasya purato mudā ।। 83 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇo dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ ।। vāmārddhāṃgo mahādevo dakṣiṇo gopikāpatiḥ ।। 84 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaḥ śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharo vyāghracarmadharo haraḥ ।। 89 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābha jaṭābhāradharaḥ paraḥ ।। bhasmabhūṣaṇagātraśca sasmitaścandraśekharaḥ ।। 86 ।। digambaro nīlakaṇṭhaḥ sarpa bhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। bibhraddakṣiṇahastena ratnamālāṃ susaṃskṛtām ।। 87 ।। prajapanpañcavaktreṇa brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ।। satyasvarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 88 ।। kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītiharaṃ param ।। 89 ।। saṃstūya mṛtyormṛtyuṃ taṃ jāto mṛtyuñjayābhidhaḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye samuvāsa hareḥ puraḥ ।। 90 ।। iti śrībra0mahāpu0 dvi0 prakṛ0 nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde devadevyutpattirnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 2 ।।
<2.3> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। athāṇḍaṃ tajjale'tiṣṭhadyāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। tataḥ svakāle sahasā dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ ।।1।। tanmadhye śiśurekaśca śatakoṭiraviprabhaḥ।। kṣaṇaṃ rorūyamāṇaśca sa śiśuḥ pīḍitaḥ kṣudhā।।2।। pitṛmātṛparityakto jalamadhye nirāśrayaḥ ।। naikabrahmāṇḍanātho yo dadarśordhvamanāthavat ।। 3 ।। sthūlātsthūlatamaḥ so'pi nāmnā devo mahāvirāṭ ।। paramāṇuryathā sūkṣmātparaḥ sthūlāttathā'pyasau ।। 4 ।। tejasāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśo'yaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। ādhāro'saṃkhyaviśvānāṃ mahāviṣṇussureśvaraḥ ।। 5 ।। pratyekaṃ romakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilāni ca ।। adyāpi teṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ ca kṛṣṇo vaktuṃ na hi kṣamaḥ ।। 6 ।। yathā'sti saṃkhyā rajasāṃ viśvānāṃ na kadācana ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tathā saṃkhyā na vidyate ।। 7 ।। prativiśveṣu santyevaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। pātālādbrahmalokāntaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ parikīrttitam ।। 8 ।। tata ūrdhve ca vaikuṇṭho brahmāṇḍādbahireva saḥ ।। sa ca satyasvarūpaśca śaśvannārāyaṇo yathā ।। 9 ।। tadūrdhve golakaścaiva pañcāśatkoṭiyojanāt ।। nityaḥ satyasvarūpaśca yathā kṛṣṇastathāpyayam ।। 10 ।। saptadvīpamitā pṛthvī saptasāgarasaṃyutā ।। ekonapañcāśadupadvīpā'saṃkhyavanānvitā ।। 11 ।। ūrdhvaṃ sapta suvarlokā brahmalokasamanvitāḥ ।। pātālāni ca saptādhaścaivaṃ brahmāṇḍameva ca ।। 12 ।। ūrdhvaṃ dharāyā bhūrloko bhuvarlokastataḥ paraḥ ।। svarlokastu tataḥ paścānmaharlokastato janaḥ ।। 13 ।। tataḥ parastapolokaḥ satyalokastataḥ paraḥ ।। tataḥ paro brahmalokastaptakāñcananirmitaḥ ।। ।।14 ।। evaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimaṃ tadbāhyābhyantara eva ca ।। tadvināśe vināśaśca sarveṣāmeva nārada ।। 19 ।। jalabududavatsarvaṃ viśvasaṃghamanityakam ।। nityau golokavaikuṇṭhau satyau śaśvadakṛtrimau ।। 16 ।। lomakūpe ca vidhyaṇḍaṃ pratyekaṃ tasya niścitam ।। eṣāṃ saṃkhyāṃ na jānāti kṛṣṇo'nyasyāpi kā kathā ।। 17 ।। pratyekaṃ pratividhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। tisraḥ koṭyaḥ surāṇāṃ ca saṃkhyā sarvatra putraka ।। 18 ।। digīśāścaiva dikpālā nakṣatrāṇi grahādayaḥ ।। bhuvi varṇāśca catvāro'dho nāgāśca carācarāḥ ।। 19 ।। atha kālena sa virāḍūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। ḍimbhāntaraṃ ca śūnyaṃ ca na dvitīyaṃ kathaṃcana ।। 20 ।। cintāmavāpa kṣudyukto ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। jñānaṃ prāpya tadā dadhyau kṛṣṇaṃ paramapūruṣam ।। 21 ।। tato dadarśa tatraiva brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ pītavāsasam ।। 22 ।। sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। jahāsa bālakastuṣṭo dṛṣṭvā janakamīśvaram ।। 23 ।। varaṃ tasmai dadau tuṣṭo vareśaḥ samayocitam।। matsamo jñānayuktaśva kṣutpipāsāvivarjitaḥ ।। 24 ।। brahmāṇḍāsaṃkhyanilayo bhava vatsa layāvadhi ।। niṣkāmo nirbhayaścaiva sarveṣāṃ varado varaḥ ।। rogamṛtyujarāśokapīḍādiparivarjitaḥ ।। 25 ।। ityuktvā taddakṣakarṇe mahāmantraṃ ṣaḍakṣaram ।। triḥ kṛtvā prajajāpādau vedāṅgamavaraṃ param ।। 26 ।। praṇavādicaturthyantaṃ kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam ।। vahnijvālāntamiṣṭaṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param ।। 27 ।। mantraṃ dattvā tadāhāraṃ kalpayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ।। śrūyatāṃ tadbrahmaputra nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 28 ।। prativiśveṣu naivedyaṃ dadyādvai vaiṣṇavo janaḥ ।। ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ viṣayiṇo viṣṇoḥ pañcadaśāsya vai ।। 29 ।। nirguṇasyātmanaścaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। naivedyena ca kṛṣṇasya nahi kiñcitprayojanam ।। 30 ।। yaddadāti va naivedyaṃ yasmai devāya yo janaḥ ।। sa ca khādati tatsarvaṃ lakṣmīdṛṣṭyā punarbhavet ।। 31 ।। taṃ ca mantraṃ varaṃ dattvā tamuvāca punarvibhuḥ ।। anyo varaḥ ka iṣṭaste taṃ me brūhi dadāmi te ।। 32 ।। kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca mahāvirāṭ ।। adanto bālakastatra vacanaṃ samayocitam ।। 33 ।। mahāvirāḍuvāca ।। varaṃ me tvatpadāmbhoje bhaktirbhavatu niścalā ।। santataṃ yāvadāyurme kṣaṇaṃ vā suciraṃ ca vā ।। 34 ।। tvadbhaktiyukto yo loke jīvanmuktaḥ sa santatam ।। tvadbhaktihīno mūrkhaśca jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ ।। 35 ।। kiṃ tajjapena tapasā yajñena yajanena ca ।। vratenaivopavāsena puṇyatīrthaniṣevayā ।। 36 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnasya puṃsaḥ syājjīvanaṃ vṛthā ।। yenātmanā jīvitaśca tameva nahi manyate ।। 37 ।। yāvadātmā śarīre'sti tāvatsyācchaktisaṃyutaḥ ।। paścādyānti gate tasminna svatantrāśca śaktayaḥ ।।38।। sa ca tvaṃ ca mahābhāga sarvātmā prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। svecchāmayaśca sarvādyo brahma jyotiḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 39 ।। ityuktvā bālakastatra virarāma ca nārada ।। uvāca kṛṣṇaḥ pratyuktiṃ madhurāṃ śrutisundarīm ।। 40 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। suciraṃ susthiraṃ tiṣṭha yathā'haṃ tvaṃ tathā bhava ।। asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte pātaste na bhaviṣyati ।। 41 ।। aṃśena pratividhyaṇḍe tvaṃ ca putra virāḍ bhava ।। tvannābhipadme brahmā ca viśvasraṣṭā bhaviṣyati ।। 42 ।। lalāṭe brahmaṇaścaiva rudrāścaikādaśaiva tu ।। śivāṃśena bhaviṣyanti sṛṣṭisaṃcaraṇāya vai ।। 43 ।। kālāgnirudrasteṣveko viśvasaṃhārakārakaḥ ।। pātā viṣṇuśca viṣayī kṣudrāṃśena bhaviṣyati।। ।। 44 ।। madbhaktiyuktaḥ satataṃ bhaviṣyasi vareṇa me ।। dhyānena kamanīyaṃ māṃ nityaṃ drakṣyasi niścitam ।। 45 ।। mātaraṃ kamanīyāṃ ca mama vakṣaḥsthalasthitām ।। yāmi lokaṃ tiṣṭha vatsetyuktvā so'ntaradhīyata ।। 46 ।। gatvā ca nākaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sa uvāca ha ।। sraṣṭāraṃ sraṣṭumīśaṃ ca saṃhartāraṃ ca tatkṣaṇam।।47।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ gaccha vatsa nābhipadmodbhavo bhava।। mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe kṣudrasya ca vidheḥ śṛṇu ।। 48 ।। gaccha vatsa mahādeva brahmabhālodbhavo bhava ।। aṃśena ca mahābhāga svayaṃ ca suciraṃ tapaḥ ।। 49 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma vidheḥ sutaḥ ।। jagāma natvā taṃ brahmā śivaśca śivadāyakaḥ ।। 50 ।। mahāvirāḍ lomakūpe brahmāṇḍe golake jale ।। sa babhūva virāṭkṣudro virāḍaṃśena sāmpratam ।। 51 ।। śyāmo yuvā pītavāsāḥ śayāno jalatalpake।। īṣaddhāsaḥ prasannāsyo viśvarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। 52 ।। tannābhikamale brahmā babhūva kamalodbhavaḥ ।। saṃbhūya padmadaṇḍaṃ ca babhrāma yugalakṣakam ।। 53 ।। nāntaṃ jagāma daṇḍasya padmanābhasya padmajaḥ ।। nābhijasya ca padmasya cintāmāpa pitāmahaḥ ।। 54 ।। svasthānaṃ punarāgatya dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ।। tato dadarśa kṣudraṃ taṃ dhyātvā taddivyacakṣuṣā ।। 55 ।। śayānaṃ jalatalpe ca brahmāṇḍapiṇḍamāvṛte ।। yallomakūpe brahmāṇḍaṃ taṃ ca tatparamīśvaram ।। 56 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ cāpi golokaṃ gopagopīsamanvitam ।। taṃ saṃstūya varaṃ prāpa tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 57 ।। babhūvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ sanakādayaḥ ।। tato rudrāḥ kapālācca śivasyaikādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। 58 ।। babhūva pātā viṣṇuśca vāme kṣudrasya pārśvataḥ ।। caturbhujaśca bhagavāñśvetadvīpanivāsakṛt ।। 59 ।। kṣudrasya nābhipadme ca brahmā viśvaṃ sasarja saḥ ।। svargaṃ martyaṃ ca pātālaṃ trilokaṃ sacarācaram ।। 60 ।। evaṃ sarvaṃ lomakūpe viśvaṃ pratyekameva ca ।। prativiśvaṃ kṣudravirāḍ brahma viṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। 61 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa kṛṣṇasaṅkīrttanaṃ śubham ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 62 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde viśvabrahmāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ।।3।।
<2.4> nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ sarvamapūrvaṃ ca tvatprasādātsudhopamam ।। adhunā prakṛtīnāṃ ca vyāsaṃ varṇaya bho prabho ।। 1 ।। kasyāḥ pūjā kṛtā kena kathaṃ martye prakā śitā ।। kena vā pūjitā kā vā kena kā vā stutā mune ।।2।। kavacaṃ stotrakaṃ dhyānaṃ prabhāvaṃ caritaṃ śubham ।। kābhiḥ kābhyo varo dattastanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 3 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gaṇeśajananī durgā rādhā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।। sāvitrī vai sṛṣṭividhau prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā smṛtā ।। 4 ।। āsītpūjyā prasiddhā ca prabhāvaḥ paramādbhutaḥ ।। sudhopamaṃ ca caritaṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam ।। 5 ।। prakṛtyaṃśāḥ kalā yāśca tāsāṃ ca caritaṃ śubham ।। sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi te brahmansāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। 6 ।। vāṇī vasundharā gaṅgā ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalaca ṇḍikā ।। tulasī mānasī nidrā svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā ।। 7 ।। tejasā matsamāstāśca rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। 8 ।। saṃkṣepamāsāṃ caritaṃ puṇyadaṃ atisundaram ।। jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca tacca vakṣyāmi sundaram ।। 9 ।। durgāyāścaiva rādhāyā vistīrṇaṃ caritaṃ mahat ।। tacca paścātpravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepātkramataḥ śṛṇu ।। 10 ।। ādau sarasvatīpūjā śrīkṛṣṇena vinirmitā ।। yatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। 11 ।। āvirbhūtā yadā devī vaktrataḥ kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ।। iyeṣa kṛṣṇaṃ kāmena kāmukī kāmarūpiṇī ।। 12 ।। sa ca vijñāya tadbhāvaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvamātaram ।। tāmuvāca hitaṃ satyaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 13 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sādhvi madaṃśaṃ ca caturbhujam ।। yuvānaṃ sundaraṃ sarvaguṇayuktaṃ ca matsamam ।। 14 ।। kāmadaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca tāsāṃ taṃ kāmapūrakam ।। koṭikanda rpalāvaṇyaṃ līlānyakkṛtamanmatham ।। 15 ।। kānte kāntaṃ ca māṃ kṛtvā yadi sthātumihecchasi ।। tvatto balavatī rādhā na te bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 16 ।। yo yasmādbalavānvā'pi tato'nyaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ ।। kathaṃ parānsādhayati yadi svayamanīśvaraḥ ।। 17 ।। sarveśassarvaśāstā'haṃ rādhāṃ rādhitumakṣamaḥ ।। tejasā matsamā sā ca rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। 18 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। prāṇato'pi priyaḥ kutra keṣāṃ vā'sti ca kaścana ।। 19 ।। tvaṃ bhadre gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। patiṃ tamīśvaraṃ kṛtvā modasva suciraṃ sukham ।। 20 ।। vivarjitā lobhamohakāmakopena hiṃsayā ।। tejasā tvatsamā lakṣmī rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। 21 ।। tayā sārddhaṃ bhava prītyā sukhaṃ kālaṃ prayāsyati ।। gauravaṃ cāpi tattulyaṃ kariṣyati patirdvayoḥ ।। 22 ।। prativiśveṣu te pūjāṃ mahatīṃ te mudā'nvitāḥ ।। māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambheṣu sundari ।। 23 ।। mānavā manavo devā munīndrāśca mumukṣavaḥ ।। santaśca yoginaḥ siddhā nāgagandharvakiṃnarāḥ ।। 24 ।। madvareṇa kariṣyanti kalpe kalpe yathāvidhi ।। bhaktiyuktāśca dattvā vai copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।।25।। kāṇvaśākhoktavidhinā dhyānena stavanena ca ।। jitendriyāḥ saṃyatāśca pustakeṣu ghaṭe'pi ca ।। 26 ।। kṛtvā suvarṇaguṭikāṃ gandhacandana carccitām ।। kavacaṃ te grahīṣyanti kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bhuje ।। 27 ।। paṭhiṣyanti ca vidvāṃsaḥ pūjākāle ca pūjite ।। ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa tāṃ devīṃ sarvapūjitaḥ ।। 28 ।। tatastatpūjanaṃ cakrurbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। anantaścāpi dharmaśca munīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ ।।29।। sarve devāśca manavo nṛpā vā mānavādayaḥ ।। babhūva pūjitā nityā sarvalokaiḥ sarasvatī ।। 30 ।। nārada uvāca ।। pūjāvidhānaṃ stavanaṃ dhyānaṃ kavacamīpsitam ।। pūjopayuktaṃ naivedyaṃ puṣpaṃ vā candanādikam ।। 31 ।। vada vedavidāṃ śreṣṭha śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। varddhate sāmprataṃ śaśvatkimidaṃ śrutisundaram ।। 32 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kāṇvaśākhoktapaddhatim ।। jaganmātuḥ sarasvatyāḥ pūjāvidhisamanvitām।।33।। māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ vidyārambhadine'pi ca।। pūrve'hni saṃyamaṃ kṛtvā tatra syātsaṃyataḥ śuciḥ ।।34।। snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ।। saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca naivedyādibhireva ca।।35।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām।। saṃpūjya saṃyato'gre ca tato'bhīṣṭaṃ prapūjayet ।। 36 ।। dhyānena vakṣyamāṇena dhyātvā bāhyaghaṭe budhaḥ ।। dhyātvā punaḥ ṣoḍaśopacāraistāṃ pūjayedvratī ।।37।। pūjopayuktaṃ naivedyaṃ yadyadvede nirūpitam ।। vakṣyāmi sāmprataṃ kiñcidyathā'dhītaṃ yathā''gamam ।। 38 ।। navanītaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ lājāṃśca tilalaḍḍukān ।। ikṣumikṣurasaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ pakvaguḍaṃ madhu ।। 39 ।। svastikaṃ śarkarāṃ śukladhānyasyākṣatamakṣatam।। asvinnaśukladhānyasya pṛthukaṃ śuklamodakam ।। 40 ।। ghṛtasaindhavasaṃskārairhaviṣyairvyañjanaistathā ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ piṣṭakaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛ tam ।। 41 ।। piṣṭakaṃ svastikasyāpi pakvarambhāphalasya ca ।। paramānnaṃ ca saghṛtaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam ।। 42 ।। nārikelaṃ tadudakaṃ keśaraṃ mūlamārdrakam ।। pakvarambhāphalaṃ cāru śrīphalaṃ badarīphalam ।। kāladeśodbhavaṃ pakvaphalaṃ śuklaṃ susaṃskṛtam ।। 43 ।। sugandhi śuklapuṣpaṃ ca gandhāḍhyaṃ śuklacandanam ।। navīnaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca sumanoharam ।। mālyaṃ ca śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ muktāhīrādibhūṣaṇam ।।। ।। 44 ।। yaddṛṣṭaṃ ca śrutau dhyānaṃ praśastaṃ śrutisundaram ।। tannibodha mahābhāga bhramabhañjanakāraṇam ।। 45 ।। sarasvatīṃ śuklavarṇāṃ sasmitāṃ sumanoharām ।। koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭapuṣṭaśrīyuktavigrahām ।। 46 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ sasmitāṃ sumanoharām ।। ratnasārendra khacitavarabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 47 ।। supūjitāṃ suragaṇairbrahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ ।। vande bhaktyā vanditā tāṃ munīndramanumānavaiḥ ।। 48।। evaṃ dhyātvā ca mūlena sarvaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। saṃstūya kavacaṃ dhṛtvā praṇameddaṇḍavadbhuvi ।। 49 ।। yeṣāṃ syādiṣṭadevīyaṃ teṣāṃ nityaṃ śubhaṃ mune ।। vidyārambhe ca sarveṣāṃ varṣānte pañcamīdine ।। 50 ।। sarvopayuktamūlaṃ ca vaidikāṣṭākṣaraḥ paraḥ ।। yeṣāṃ yadupadeśo vā teṣāṃ tanmūlameva ca ।। sarasvatī caturthyanto vahnijāyānta eva ca ।। 51 ।। śrīṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāhā ।। lakṣmīmāyādikaṃ caiva mantro'yaṃ kalpapādapaḥ ।। 52 ।। purā nārāyaṇaścemaṃ vālmīkāya kṛpānidhiḥ ।। pradadau jāhnavītīre puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 53 ।। bhṛgurdadau ca śukrāya puṣkare sūryyaparvaṇi ।। candraparvaṇi mārīco dadau vākpataye mudā ।। 54 ।। bhṛgave ca dadau tuṣṭo brahmā badarikāśrame ।। āstīkāya jaratkārurdadau kṣīrodasannidhau ।। vibhāṇḍako dadau merāvṛṣyaśṛṅgāya dhīmate ।। 55 ।। śivaḥ kaṇādamunaye gautamāya dadau mune ।। sūryyaśca yājñavalkyāya tathā kātyāyanāya ca ।। 56 ।। śeṣaḥ pāṇinaye caiva bharadvājāya dhīmate ।। dadau śākaṭāyanāya sutale balisaṃsadi ।। 57 ।। caturlakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।। yadi syātsiddhamantro hi bṛhaspatisamo bhavet ।। 58 ।। kavacaṃ śṛṇu viprendra yaddattaṃ vidhinā purā ।। viśvaśreṣṭhaṃ viśvajayaṃ bhṛgave gandhamādane ।। 59 ।। bhṛguruvāca ।। brahmanbrahmavidāṃ śreṣṭha brahma jñānaviśārada ।। sarvajña sarvajanaka sarvapūjakapūjita ।। 60 ।। sarasvatyāśca kavacaṃ brūhi viśvajayaṃ prabho ।। ayātayāmamantrāṇāṃ samūho yatra saṃyutaḥ ।। 61 ।। brahmovāca ।। śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ sarvakāmadam ।। śrutisāraṃ śrutisukhaṃ śrutyuktaṃ śrutipūjitam ।। 62 ।। uktaṃ kṛṣṇena goloke mahyaṃ vṛndāvane vane ।। rāseśvareṇa vibhunā rāse vai rāsamaṇḍale ।। 63 ।। atīva gopanīyaṃ ca kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ param ।। aśrutādbhutamantrāṇāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitam ।। 64 ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbrahmanbuddhimāṃśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। yaddhṛtvā bhagavāñchukraḥ sarvadaityeṣu pūjitaḥ ।। 65 ।। paṭhanāddhāraṇādvāggmī kavīndro vālmikī muniḥ ।। svāyambhuvo manuścaiva yaddhṛtvā sarvapūjitaḥ ।। 66 ।। kaṇādo gautamaḥ kaṇvaḥ pāṇiniḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ।। granthaṃ cakāra yaddhṛtvā dakṣaḥ kātyāyanaḥ svayam ।। 67 ।। dhṛtvā vedavibhāgaṃ ca purāṇānyakhilāni ca ।। cakāra līlāmātreṇa kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ svayam ।। 68 ।। śātātapaśca saṃvartto vasiṣṭhaśca parāśaraḥ ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādgranthaṃ yājñavalkyaścakāra saḥ ।। 69 ।। ṛṣyaśṛṅgo bharadvājaścāstīko devalastathā ।। jaigīṣavyo'tha jābāli yaddhṛtvā sarva pūjitaḥ ।। 70 ।। kavacasyāsya viprendra ṛṣireṣa prajāpatiḥ ।। svayaṃ bṛhaspatiśchando devo rāseśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।।71।। sarvatattvaparijñāne sarvārthe'pi ca sādhane ।। kavitāsu ca sarvāsu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। 72 ।। oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai svāhā śiro me pātu sarvataḥ ।। śrīṃ vāgdevatāyai svāhā bhālaṃ me sarvadā'vatu ।। 73 ।। oṃ sarasvatyai svāheti śrotraṃ pātu nirantaram ।। oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ bhāratyai svāhā netrayugmaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 74 ।। oṃ hrīṃ vāgvādinyai svāhā nāsāṃ me sarvato'vatu ।। hrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā śrotraṃ sadā'vatu ।। ।। 75 ।। oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ brāhmyai svāheti dantapaṃktīḥ sadā'vatu ।। aimityekākṣaro mantro mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 76 ।। oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ pātu me grīvāṃ skandhaṃ me śrīṃ sadā'vatu ।। śrīṃ vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu ।। 77 ।। oṃ hrīṃ vidyāsvarūpāyai svāhā me pātu nābhikām ।। oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ vāṇyai svāheti mama pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 78 ।। oṃ sarvavarṇātmikāyai pādayugmaṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai sarvāṅgaṃ me sadā'vatu।।79।। oṃ sarvakaṇṭhavāsinyai svāhā prācyāṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ hrīṃ jihvāpravāsinyai svāhā'gni diśi rakṣatu ।। 80 ।। oṃ aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ sarasvatyai budhajananyai svāhā ।। satataṃ mantrarājo'yaṃ dakṣiṇe māṃ sadā'vatu ।। 81 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ tryakṣaro mantro nairṛtyāṃ me sadā'vatu ।। kavijihvāgravāsinyai svāhā māṃ vāruṇe'vatu ।। 82 ।। oṃ sadambikāyai svāhā vāyavye māṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ gadyapadyavāsinyai svāhā māmuttare'vatu ।। 83 ।। oṃ sarvaśāstravāsinyai svāhaiśānyāṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ sarvapūjitāyai svāhā cordhvaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 84 ।। aiṃ hrīṃ pustakavāsinyai svāhā'dho māṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ granthabījarūpāyai svāhā māṃ sarvato'vatu ।। 85 ।। iti te kathitaṃ vipra sarvamantraughavigraham ।। idaṃ viśvajayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ brahmarūpakam ।। 86 ।। purā śrutaṃ dharmavaktrātparvate gandhamādane ।। tava snehānmayā''khyātaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit ।। 87 ।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṅkāra candanaiḥ ।। praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau kavacaṃ dhārayetsudhīḥ ।। 88 ।। pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ tu kavacaṃ bhavet ।। yadi syātsiddhakavaco bṛha spatisamo bhaveta ।। 89 ।। mahāvāgmī kavīndraśca trailokyavijayī bhavet ।। śaknoti sarvaṃ jetuṃ sa kavacasya prabhāvataḥ ।। 90।। idaṃ te kāṇvaśākhoktaṃ kathitaṃ kavacaṃ mune।। stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ vai vandanaṃ tathā।।91।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sarasvatīkavacaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 4 ।।
<2.5> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। vāgdevatāyāḥ stavanaṃ śrūyatāṃ sarvakāmadam ।। mahāmuniryājñavalkyo yena tuṣṭāva tāṃ purā।।1।। guruśāpācca sa munirhatavidyo babhūva ha।। tadā''jagāma duḥkhārto ravisthānaṃ ca puṇyadam ।। 2 ।। saṃprāpya tapasā sūryyaṃ koṇārke dṛṣṭigocare ।। tuṣṭāva sūryyaṃ śokena ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 3 ।। sūryyastaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa vedavedāṅgamīśvaraḥ ।। uvāca stuhi vāgdevīṃ bhaktyā ca smṛtihetave ।। 4 ।। tamityuktvā dīnanātho hyantarddhānaṃ jagāma saḥ ।। muniḥ snātvā ca tuṣṭāva bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।।5।। yājñavalkya uvāca ।। kṛpāṃ kuru jaganmātarmāmevaṃ hatatejasam।। guruśāpātsmṛtibhraṣṭaṃ vidyāhīnaṃ ca duḥkhitam।।6।। jñānaṃ dehi smṛtiṃ dehi vidyāṃ vidyādhidevate ।। pratiṣṭhāṃ kavitāṃ dehi śaktiṃ śiṣyaprabodhikām।।7।। granthanirmitiśaktiṃ ca sacchiṣyaṃ supratiṣṭhitam ।। pratibhāṃ satsabhāyāṃ ca vicārakṣamatāṃ śubhām ।। 8 ।। luptāṃ sarvāṃ daivavaśānnavāṃ kuru punaḥ punaḥ ।। yathā'ṅkuraṃ janayati bhagavānyogamāyayā ।। 9 ।। brahmasvarūpā paramā jyotīrūpā sanātanī ।। sarvavidyādhidevī yā tasyai vāṇye namo namaḥ ।। 10 ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ śaśvajjīvanmṛtaṃ sadā ।। jñānāghidevī yā tasyai sarasvatyai namo namaḥ ।। 11 ।। yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ mūkamunmattavatsadā ।। vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā tasyai vāṇyai namo namaḥ ।। 12 ।। himacandanakundendukumudāmbhoja sannibhā ।। varṇādhidevī yā tasyai cākṣarāyai namo namaḥ ।। 13 ।। visargabindumātrāṇāṃ yadadhiṣṭhānameva ca ।। itthaṃ tvaṃ gīyase sadbhirbhāratyai te namo namaḥ ।।14।। yayā vinā'tra saṃkhyākṛtsaṃkhyāṃ karttuṃ na śaknute ।। kālasaṃkhyāsvarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ।। ।। 15 ।। vyākhyāsvarūpā yā devī vyākhyādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। bhramasiddhāntarūpā yā tasyai devyai namo namaḥ ।। 16 ।। smṛtiśakti jñānaśakti buddhiśaktisvarūpiṇī ।। pratibhākalpanāśaktiryā ca tasyai namo namaḥ ।। 17 ।। sanatkumāro brahmāṇaṃ jñānaṃ papraccha yatra vai ।। babhūva jaḍavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ karttumakṣamaḥ ।। 18।। tadā''jagāma bhagavānātmā śrīkṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ ।। uvāca sattamaṃ stotraṃ vāṇyā iti vidhiṃ tadā ।। 19 ।। sa ca tuṣṭāva tāṃ brahmā cājñayā paramātmanaḥ ।। cakāra tatprasādena tadā siddhāntamuttamam ।। 20 ।। yadā'pyanantaṃ papraccha jñānamekaṃ vasundharā ।। babhūva mūkavatso'pi siddhāntaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ।।21।। tadā tvāṃ ca sa tuṣṭāva saṃtrastaḥ kaśyapājñayā।। tataścakāra siddhāntaṃ nirmalaṃ bhramabhañjanam ।। 22 ।। vyāsaḥ purāṇasūtraṃ ca samapṛcchata vālmikim ।। maunībhūtaḥ sa sasmāra tvāmeva jagadaṃbikām ।।23।। tadā cakāra siddhāntaṃ tvadvareṇa munīśvaraḥ ।। sa prāpa nirmalaṃ jñānaṃ pramādadhvaṃsakāraṇam ।।24।। purāṇasūtraṃ śrutvā sa vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇakalodbhavaḥ।। tvāṃ siṣeve ca dadhyau ca śatavarṣaṃ ca puṣkare ।। tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya sa kavīndro babhūva ha ।।25।। tadā vai vedabhāgaṃ ca purāṇāni cakāra ha ।। yadā mahendre papraccha tattvajñānaṃ śivā śivam ।। 26 ।। kṣaṇaṃ tvāmeva saṃcintya tasyai jñānaṃ dadau vibhuḥ ।। papraccha śabdaśāstraṃ ca mahendraśca bṛhaspatim ।। 27 ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca sa tvāṃ dadhyau ca puṣkare ।। tadā tvatto varaṃ prāpya divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ।। uvāca śabdaśāstraṃ ca tadarthaṃ ca sureśvaram ।। 28 ।। adhyāpitāśca yaiḥ śiṣyā yairadhītaṃ munīśvaraiḥ ।। te ca tvāṃ parisaṃcintya pravarttante sureśvari ।। 29 ।। tvaṃ saṃstutā pūjitā ca munīndramanumānavaiḥ ।। daityendraiśca suraiścāpi brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ ।। 30 ।। jaḍībhūtaḥ sahasrāsyaḥ pañcavaktraścaturmukhaḥ ।। yāṃ stotuṃ kimahaṃ staumi tāmekāsyena mānavaḥ ।।31 ।। ityuktvā yājñavalkyaśca bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। praṇanāma nirāhāro ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 32 ।। tadā jyotistvarūpā sā tenādṛṣṭā'pyuvāca tam ।। sukavīndro bhavetyuktvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha ।। 33
