।। yājñavalkyakṛtaṃ vāṇīstotraṃ yaḥ saṃyataḥ paṭhet ।। sa kavīndro mahāvāgmī bṛhaspatisamo bhavet ।। 34 ।। mahāmūrkhaśca durmedhā varṣamekaṃ ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। sa paṇḍitaśca medhāvī sukaviśca bhaveddhruvam ।।35।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde yājñavalkyoktavāṇīstavanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ।। ।। 5 ।।
<2.6> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sarasvatī sā vaikuṇṭhe svayaṃ nārāyaṇāntike ।। gaṅgāśāpena kalayā kalahādbhārate sarit ।। 1 ।। puṇyadā puṇyajananī puṇyatīrthasvarūpiṇī ।। puṇyavadbhirniṣevyā ca sthitiḥ puṇyavatāṃ mune ।। 2 ।। tapasvināṃ taporūpā tapasyākārarūpiṇī ।। kṛtapāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagnisvarūpiṇī ।। 3 ।। jñāne sarasvatītoye gataṃ yairmānavairbhuvi ।। teṣāṃ sthitiśca vaikuṇṭhe suciraṃ harisaṃsadi ।। 4 ।। bhārate kṛtapāpaśca snātvā tatraiva līlayā ।। mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke vasecciram ।। 9 ।। caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmakṣayāyāṃ dinakṣaye ।। grahaṇe ca vyatīpāte'nyasminpuṇyadine'pi ca ।। 6 ।। anuṣaṅgeṇa yaḥ snāti helayā śraddhayā'pi vā ।। sārūpyaṃ labhate nūnaṃ vaikuṇṭhe sa harerapi ।। 7 ।। sarasvatīmantrakaṃ ca māsamekaṃ tu yo japet ।। mahāmūrkhaḥ kavīndraśca sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ ।।8।। nityaṃ sarasvatītoye yaḥ snātvā muṇḍayennaraḥ ।। na garbhavāsaṃ kurute punareva sa mānavaḥ ।। 9 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kiṃcidbhāratīguṇakīrttanam।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 10 ।। sautiruvāca ।। nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā nārado munisattamaḥ ।। punaḥ papraccha sandehacchedaṃ śaunaka satvaram ।। 11 ।। nārada uvāca ।। kathaṃ sarasvatī devī gaṅgāśāpena bhārate ।। kalayā kalahenaiva samabhūtpuṇyadā sarit ।।12।। śravaṇe śrutisārāṇāṃ varddhate kautukaṃ mama ।। kathāmṛtānāṃ no tṛptiḥ kena śreyasi tṛpyate ।।13।। kathaṃ śaśāpa sā gaṅgā pūjitāṃ tāṃ sarasvatīm ।। śāntā sattvasvarūpā ca puṇyadā sarvadā nṛṇām ।।14।। tejasvinyordvayorvādakāraṇaṃ śrutisundaram ।। sudurlabhaṃ purāṇeṣu tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 19 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm ।। yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpātpramucyate ।। 16 ।। lakṣmīssarasvatī gaṅgā tisro bhāryyā harerapi ।। premṇā samāstāstiṣṭhanti satataṃ harisannidhau ।। 17 ।। cakāra saikadā gaṅgā viṣṇormukhanirīkṣaṇam।। sasmitā ca sakāmā ca sakaṭākṣaṃ punaḥ punaḥ।।18।। vibhurjahāsa tadvaktraṃ nirīkṣya ca mudā kṣaṇam ।। kṣamāṃ cakāra taddṛṣṭvā lakṣmīrnaiva sarasvatī।।19।। bodhayāmāsa tāṃ padmā sattvarūpā ca sasmitā ।। krodhāviṣṭā ca sā vāṇī na ca śāntā babhūva ha ।। 20 ।। uvāca gaṅgāṃ bharttāraṃ raktāsyā raktalocanā ।। kampitā kopavegena śaśvatprasphuritādharā ।।21।। sarasvatyuvāca ।। sarvatra samatābuddhiḥ sadbhartuḥ kāminīḥ prati ।। dharmiṣṭhasya variṣṭhasya viparītā khalasya ca ।। 22 ।। jñātaṃ saubhāgyamadhikaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ te gadādhara ।। kamalāyāṃ ca tattulyaṃ na ca kiṃcinmayi prabho ।।23।। gaṃgāyāḥ padmayā sārddhaṃ prītiścāpi susammatā ।। kṣamāṃ cakāra tenedaṃ viparītaṃ haripriyā ।। 24 ।। kiṃ jīvanena me'traiva durbhagāyāśca sāmpratam ।। niṣphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasyā yā patyuḥ premavañcitā ।।25।। tvāṃ sarveśaṃ sattvarūpaṃ ye vadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। te ca mūrkhā na vedajñā na jānanti matiṃ tava ।।26।। sarasvatīvacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kopasaṃyutām ।। manasā tu samālocya sa jagāma bahiḥ sabhām ।। 27 ।। gate nārāyaṇe gaṃgāmavocannirbhayaṃ ruṣā ।। rāgādhiṣṭhātṛ devī sā vākyaṃ śravaṇaduḥsaham ।। 28 ।। he nirlajje sakāme tvaṃ svāmigarvaṃ karoṣi kim ।। adhikaṃ svāmisaubhāgyaṃ vijñāpayitumicchasi ।। 29 ।। mānahāniṃ kariṣyāmi tavādya harisannidhau ।। kiṃ kariṣyati te kānto mama vai kāntavallabhe ।। 30।। ityevamuktvā gaṃgāyā jighṛkṣuṃ keśamudyatām ।। vārayāmāsa tāṃ padmā madhyadeśasthitā satī ।। 31 ।। śaśāpa vāṇī tāṃ padmāṃ mahākopavatī satī ।। vṛkṣarūpā saridrūpā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 32 ।। viparītaṃ yato dṛṣṭvā kiṃcinno vaktumarhasi ।। santiṣṭhasi sabhāmadhye yathā vṛkṣo yathā sarit ।। 33 ।। śāpaṃ śrutvā ca sā devī na śaśāpa cukopa na ।। tatraiva duḥkhitā tasthau vāṇīṃ dhṛtvā kareṇa ca ।। 34 ।। atyuddhatāṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kopaprasphuritānanā ।। uvāca gaṃgā tāṃ devīṃ padmāṃ padmavilocanā ।। 39 ।। gaṃgovāca ।। tvamutsṛja mahogrāṃ tāṃ padme kiṃ me kariṣyati ।। vāgduṣṭā vāgadhiṣṭhātrī devīyaṃ kalahapriyā ।। 36 ।। yāvatī yogyatā'syāśca yāvatī śaktireva vā ।। tathā karotu vādaṃ ca mayā sārddhaṃ sudurmukhā ।। 37 ।। svabalaṃ yanmama balaṃ vijñāpayitumarhatu ।। jānantu sarve hyubhayoḥ prabhāvaṃ vikramaṃ sati ।। 38 ।। ityevamuktvā sā devī vāṇyai śāpaṃ dadāviti ।। saritsvarūpā bhavatu sā yā tvāmaśapadruṣā ।। 39 ।। adho martyaṃ sā prayātu santi yatraiva pāpinaḥ ।। kalau teṣāṃ ca pāpāṃśaṃ labhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 40 ।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tāṃ śaśāpa sarasvatī ।। tvameva yāsyasi mahīṃ pāpipāpaṃ labhiṣyasi ।। 41 ।। etasminnantare tatra bhagavānājagāma ha ।। caturbhujaścaturbhiśca pārṣadaiśca caturbhujaiḥ ।। 42 ।। sarasvatīṃ kare dhṛtvā vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। bodhayāmāsa sarvajñaḥ sarvajñānaṃ purātanam ।। 43 ।। śrutvā rahasyaṃ tāsāṃ ca śāpasya kalahasya ca ।। uvāca duḥkhitāstāśca vākyaṃ sāmayikaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 44 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। lakṣmi tvaṃ kalayā gaccha dharmadhvajagṛhaṃ śubhe ।। ayonisambhavā bhūmau tasya kanyā bhaviṣyasi ।। 49 ।। tatraiva daivadoṣeṇa vṛkṣatvaṃ ca labhiṣyasi ।। madaṃśasyāsurasyaiva śaṅkhacūḍasya kāminī ।। 46 ।। bhūtvā paścācca matpatnī bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। trailokyapāvanī nāmnā tulasīti ca bhārate ।। 47 ।। kalayā ca saridbhūtvā śīghraṃ gaccha varānane ।। bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpānnāmnā padmāvatī bhava ।। 48 ।। gaṅge yāsyasi cāṃśena paścāttvaṃ viśvapāvanī ।। bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātpāpadāhāya dehinām ।। 49 ।। bhagīrathasya tapasā tena nītā suduṣkarāt ।। nāmnā bhāgīrathī pūtā bhaviṣyasi mahītale ।। 50 ।। madaṃśasya samudrasya jāyā jāye mamājñayā ।। mattkalāṃśasya bhūpasya śantanośca sureśvari ।। 51 ।। gaṅgāśāpena kalayā bhārataṃ gaccha bhārati ।। kalahasya phalaṃ bhuṅkṣva sapatnībhyāṃ sahācyute ।। 52 ।। svayaṃ ca brahmasadanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kāminī bhava ।। gaṅgā yātu śivasthānamatra padmaiva tiṣṭhatu ।। 93 ।। śāntā c krodharahitā madbhaktā matsvarūpiṇī ।। mahāsādhvī mahābhāgā suśīlā dharmacāriṇī ।। 54 ।। yadaṃśakalayā sarvā dharmiṣṭhāśca pativratāḥ ।। śāntarūpā suśīlāśca prativiśveṣu yoṣitaḥ।।। tisro bhāryyāstrayaḥ śyālāstrayo bhṛtyāśca bāndhavāḥ ।। dhruvaṃ vedaviruddhāśca na hyete maṅgalapradāḥ ।। 56 ।। strī puṃvacca gṛhe yeṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ strīvaśaḥ pumān ।। niṣphalaṃ janma vai teṣāmaśubhaṃ ca pade pade ।। 57 ।। mukhaduṣṭā yoniduṣṭā yasya strī kalahapriyā ।। araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ gṛhādvaram ।। 58 ।। janānāṃ ca sthalānāṃ ca purāṇāṃ prāptireva ca ।। satataṃ sulabhā tatra na teṣāṃ tadgṛhe'pi ca ।। 99 ।। varamagnau sthitirhiṃsrajantūnāṃ sannidhau sukham ।। tato'pi duḥkhaṃ puṃsāṃ ca duṣṭastrīsannidhau dhruvam ।। 60 ।। vyādhijvālā viṣajvālā varaṃ puṃsāṃ varānane ।। duṣṭastrīṇāṃ mukhajvālā maraṇādatiricyate ।। ।। 61 ।। puṃsaśca strījitasyeha jīvitaṃ niṣphalaṃ dhruvam ।। yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet ।। 62 ।। sa nindito'tra sarvatra paratra narakaṃ vrajet ।। yaśakīrtivihīno yo jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ ।। 63 ।। bahvīnāṃ ca sapatnīnāṃ naikatra śreyasī sthitiḥ ।। ekabhāryyaḥ sukhī naiva bahubhāryyaḥ kadācana ।। 64 ।। gaccha gaṃge śivasthānaṃ brahmasthānaṃ sarasvati ।। atra tiṣṭhatu maddehe suśīlā kamalālayā ।।65।। susādhyā yasya patnī ca suśīlā ca pativratā।। iha svargasukhaṃ tasya dharmamokṣau paratra ca।।66।। pativratā yasya patnī sa ca muktaḥ śuciḥ sukhī ।। jīvanmṛto'śucirduḥkhī duśśīlāpatireva yaḥ ।। 67 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho virarāma ca nārada ।। atyuccai rurudurdevyaḥ samāliṅgya parasparam ।। 68 ।। tāśca sarvāḥ samālocya krameṇocuḥ sadīśvaram ।। kampitāḥ sāśrunetrāśca śokena ca bhayena ca ।। 69 ।। sarasvatyuvāca ।। prāyaścittaṃ dehi nātha duṣṭāyāṃ janmaśodhakam ।। satsvāminā parityaktāḥ kutra jīvanti kāḥ striyaḥ ।। 70।। dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi dhruvaṃ yogena bhārate ।। atyuccato nipatanaṃ prāptumarhati niścitam ।।71।। gaṃgovāca ।। ahaṃ kenāparādhena tvayā tyaktā jagatpate ।। dehatyāgaṃ kariṣyāmi nirdoṣāyā vadhaṃ labha ।। 72 ।। nirdoṣakāminītyāgaṃ kurute yo jano bhave ।। sa yāti narakaṃ kalpaṃ kiṃ te sarveśvarasya vā ।। 73 ।। lakṣmīruvāca ।। nātha sattvasvarūpastvaṃ kopaḥ kathamaho tava ।। prasādaṃ kuru cāsmabhyaṃ sadīśasya kṣamā varā ।। 74 ।। bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādyāsyāmi kalayā yadi ।। katikālaṃ sthitistatra kadā drakṣyāmi te padam ।।75।। dāsyanti pāpinaḥ pāpaṃ mahyaṃ snānāvagāhanāt ।। kena tasmādvimuktā'hamāgamiṣyāmi te padam।।76।। kalayā tulasīrūpā dharmadhvajasutā satī ।। bhūtvā kadā labhiṣyāmi tvatpādāmbujamacyuta ।। 77 ।। vṛkṣarūpā bhaviṣyāmi tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। māmuddhariṣyasi kadā tanme brūhi kṛpānidhe ।। 78 ।। gaṃgā sarasvatīśāpādyadi yāsyati bhāratam ।। śāpena muktā pāpācca kadā tvāṃ vā labhiṣyati ।। 79 ।। gaṃgāśāpena sā vāṇī yadi yāsyati bhāratam ।। kadā śāpādvinirmucya labhiṣyati padaṃ tava ।। 80 ।। tāṃ vāṇīṃ brahmasadanaṃ gaṃgāṃ vā śivamandiram ।। gantuṃ vadasi he nātha tatkṣamasva ca te vacaḥ ।। 81 ।। ityuktvā kamalā kāntapadaṃ dhṛtvā nanāma ca ।। sukeśairveṣṭayitvā ca ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ।।82।। uvāca padmanābhastāṃ prabhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi।। īṣaddhāsaḥ prasannāsyo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ।। 83 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। tvadvākyamācariṣyāmi svavākyaṃ ca sureśvari ।। samatāṃ ca kariṣyāmi śṛṇu tatkramameva ca ।। 84 ।। bhāratī yātu kalayā saridrūpā ca bhāratam ।। arddhāṃśā brahmasadanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe ।। 85 ।। bhagīrathena nītā sā gaṃgā yāsyati bhāratam ।। pūtaṃ kartuṃ tribhuvanaṃ svayaṃ tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe ।। 86 ।। tatraiva candramauleśca mauliṃ prāpsyati durlabham ।। tataḥ svabhāvataḥ pūtā'pyatipūtā bhaviṣyati ।। 87 ।। kalāṃśāṃśena gaccha tvaṃ bhārate kamalodbhave ।। padmāvatī saridrūpā tulasīvṛkṣarūpiṇī ।। 88 ।। kaleḥ pañcasahasre ca gate varṣe ca mokṣaṇam ।। yuṣmākaṃ saritāṃ bhūyo madgṛhe cāgamiṣyatha ।। ।। 89 ।। sampadāṃ hetubhūtā ca vipattiḥ sarvadehinām ।। vinā vipattirmahimā keṣāṃ padme bhavedbhave ।। 90 ।। manmantropāsakānāṃ ca satāṃ snānāvagāhanāt ।। yuṣmākaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pāpātpāpisparśanahetukāt ।। 91 ।। pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni santyasaṃkhyāni sundari ।। bhaviṣyanti ca pūtāni madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 92 ।। manmantropāsakā bhaktā bhramante bhārate sati ।। pūtaṃ karttuṃ bhārataṃ ca supavitrāṃ vasundharām ।। 93 ।। madbhaktā yatra tiṣṭhanti pādaṃ prakṣālayanti ca ।। tatsthānaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ supavitraṃ bhaveddhruvam ।। 94 ।। strīghno goghnaḥ kṛtaghnaśca brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ ।। jīvanmukto bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 95 ।। ekādaśīvihīnaśca sandhyāhīno'pi nāstikaḥ ।। vṛṣavāho bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 96 ।। asijīvī maṣījīvī dhāvakaḥ śūdrayājakaḥ ।। vṛṣavāho bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 97 ।। viśvāsaghātī mitraghno mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ ।। nyāsahārī bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 98 ।। ṛṇagrasto vārddhuṣiko jārajaḥ puṃścalīpatiḥ ।। pūtaśca puṃścalīputro madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 99 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca devalo grāmayājakaḥ ।। adīkṣito bhavetpūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 100 ।। aśvatthaghātakaścaiva madbhaktānāṃ ca nindakaḥ ।। aniveditabhojī ca pūto madbhaktadarśanāt ।। 101 ।। mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryyāṃ bhrātaraṃ tanayaṃ sutām।। guroḥ kulaṃ ca bhaginīṃ vaṃśahīnaṃ ca bāndhavam ।। 102 ।। śvaśrūṃ ca śvaśuraṃ caiva yo na puṣṇāti nārada ।। sa mahāpātakī pūto madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 103।। devadravyāpahārī ca vipradravyāpahārakaḥ ।। lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vikretā duhitustathā ।। 104 ।। mahāpātakinaścaite śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakāḥ ।। bhaveyurete pūtāśca madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।। 105 ।। lakṣmīruvāca ।। bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi bhaktānugrahakāraka ।। yeṣāṃ sandarśanasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā narādhamāḥ ।। 106 ।। haribhaktivihīnāśca mahāhaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ ।। svapraśaṃsāratā dhūrttāḥ śaṭhā vai sādhu nindakāḥ ।। 107 ।। punanti sarvatīrthāni yeṣāṃ snānāvagāhanāt ।। yeṣāṃ ca pādarajasā pūtā pādodakānmahī ।। 108 ।। yeṣāṃ sandarśanaṃ sparśaṃ devā vāñchanti bhārate ।। sarveṣāṃ paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ ।। 109 ।। na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ ।। te punantyurukālena viṣṇubhaktāḥ kṣaṇādaho।। 110 ।। sautiruvāca ।। mahālakṣmīvacaḥ śrutvā lakṣmīkāntaśca sasmitaḥ।। nigūḍhatattvaṃ kathitumṛṣiśreṣṭhopacakrame ।। 111 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ lakṣmi gūḍhaṃ śrutipurāṇayoḥ ।। puṇyasvarūpaṃ pāpaghnaṃ sukhadaṃ bhuktimuktidam ।। 112 ।। sārabhūtaṃ gopanīyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ khaleṣu ca ।। tvāṃ pavitrāṃ prāṇatulyāṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 113 ।। guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśedvaraḥ ।। vadanti vedavedāṅgāttaṃ pavitraṃ narottamam ।। 114> puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ pūtaṃ tajjanmamātrataḥ ।। svargasthaṃ narakasthaṃ vā muktiṃ prāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt ।। 115 ।। yaiḥ kaiścidyatra vā janma labdhaṃ yeṣu ca jaṃtuṣu ।। jīvanmuktāste ca pūtā yānti kāle hareḥ padam ।। 116 ।। madbhaktiyukto matpūjāniyukto madguṇānvitaḥ ।। madguṇaślāghanīyaśca manniviṣṭaśca santatam ।। 117 ।। madguṇaśrutimātreṇa sānandaḥ pulakānvitaḥ ।। sagadgadaḥ sāśrunetraḥ svātmavismṛtireva ca ।। 118 ।। na vāñchanti sukhaṃ muktiṃ sālokyādi catuṣṭayam ।। brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tadvāñchā mama sevane ।। 119 ।। indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca devatvaṃ ca sudurlabham ।। svargarājyādibhogaṃ ca svapne'pi na hi vācchati ।। 120 ।। brahmāṇḍāni vinaśyanti devā brahmādayastathā ।। kalyāṇabhaktiyuktaśca madbhakto na praṇaśyati ।। 121 ।। bhramanti bhārate bhaktā labdhvā janma sudurlabham ।। te'pi yānti mahīṃ pūtāṃ kṛtvā tīrthaṃ mamālayam ।। 122 ।। ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ kuru padme yathocitam ।। tadājñātāśca tāścakrurharistasthau sukhāsane ।। 123 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sarasvatyupākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 6 ।।
<2.7> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। puṇyakṣetre hyājagāma bhārate sā sarasvatī ।। gaṅgāśāpena kalayā svayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade ।। 1 ।। bhāratī bhārataṃ gatvā brāhmī ca brahmaṇaḥ priyā ।। vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā tena vāṇī ca kīrttitā ।। 2 ।। sarvaṃ viśvaṃ parivyāpya srotasyeva hi dṛśyate ।। hariḥ sarassu tasyeyaṃ tena nāmnā sarasvatī ।। 3 ।। sarasvatī nadī sā ca tīrtharūpā'tipāvanī ।। pāpipāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagnisvarūpiṇī ।। 4 ।। paścādbhagīrathānītā mahīṃ bhāgīrathī śubhā ।। samājagāma kalayā vāṇīśāpena nārada ।। 5 ।। tatraiva samaye tāṃ ca dadhāra śirasā śivaḥ ।। vegaṃ soḍhumaśaktāyā bhuvaḥ prārthanayā vibhuḥ ।। 6 ।। padmā jagāma kalayā sā ca padmāvatī nadī ।। bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātsvayaṃ tasthau hareḥ pade ।। 7 ।। tato'nyayā sā kalayā cālabhajjanma bhārate ।। dharmadhvajasutā lakṣmīrvikhyātā tulasīti ca ।। 8 ।। purā sarasvatīśāpāttatpaścāddhariśāpataḥ ।। babhūva vṛkṣarūpā sā kalayā viśvapāvanī ।। 9 ।। kaleḥ pañcasahasraṃ ca varṣaṃ sthitvā ca bhārate ।। jagmustāśca saridrūpaṃ vihāya śrīhareḥ padam ।। 10 ।। yāni sarvāṇi tīrthāni kāśīṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vinā ।। yāsyanti sārddhaṃ tābhiśca harervaikuṇṭhamājñayā ।। 11 ।। śālagrāmo harermūrttirjagannāthaśca bhāratam।। kalerdaśasahasrānte yayau tyaktvā hareḥ padam ।। 12 ।। vaiṣṇavāśca purāṇāni śaṅkhāśca śrāddhatarpaṇam ।। vedoktāni ca karmāṇi yayustaiḥ sārddhameva ca ।। 13 ।। haripūjā harernāma tatkīrttiguṇakīrttanam ।। vedāṅgāni ca śāstrāṇi yayustaiḥ sārddhameva ca ।। 14 ।। sattvaṃ ca satyaṃ dharmaśca vedāśca grāmyadevatāḥ ।। vrataṃ tapasyā'naśanaṃ yayustaiḥ sārddhameva ca ।। 15।। vāmācāraratāḥ sarve mithyākāpaṭyasaṃyutāḥ।। tulasīvarjitā pūjā bhaviṣyati tataḥ param ।। 16 ।। ekādaśīvihīnāśca sarve dharmavivarjitāḥ ।। hariprasaṅgavimukhā bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param ।। 17 ।। śaṭhāḥ krūrā dāmbhikāśca mahāhaṅkārasaṃyutāḥ ।। caurāśca hiṃsakāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param ।। 18 ।। puṃsāṃ bhedastathā strīṇāṃ vivāho vādanirṇayaḥ ।। svasvāmibhedo vastūnāṃ na bhaviṣyatyataḥ param ।। 19 ।। sarve janāḥ strīvaśāśca puṃścalyaśca gṛhe gṛhe ।। tarjanairbhartsanaiḥ śaśvatsvāminaṃ tāḍayanti ca ।। 20 ।। gṛheśvarī ca gṛhiṇī gṛhī bhṛtyādhiko'dhamaḥ ।। ceṭībhṛtyāsamā vadhvaḥ śvaśrūśca śvaśurastathā ।। 21 ।। karttāro balino gehe yonisambandhibāndhavāḥ ।। vidyāsambandhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sambhāṣā'pi na vidyate।।22।। yathā paricitā lokāstathā puṃsaśca bāndhavāḥ ।। sarvakarmākṣamāḥ puṃso yoṣitāmājñayā vinā ।। 23 ।। brahmakṣattriyaviṭśūdrā jātyā cāravinirṇayaḥ ।। saṃdhyā ca yajñasūtraṃ ca bhāvaluptaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।। 24 ।। mlecchācārā bhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra eva ca ।। mlecchaśāstraṃ paṭhiṣyanti svaśāstrāṇi vihāya te ।। brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ sevakāḥ kalau ।। 25 ।। sūpakārā bhaviṣyanti dhāvakā vṛṣavāhakāḥ ।। satyahīnā janāḥ sarve sasyahīnā ca medinī ।। 26 ।। phalahīnāśca taravo'patyahīnāśca yoṣitaḥ ।। kṣīrahīnāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirvivarjitam ।। 27 ।। dampatī prītihīnau ca gṛhiṇaḥ sukhavarjitāḥ ।। pratāpahīnā bhūpāśca prajāśca karapīḍitāḥ ।। 28 ।। jalahīnā nadā nadyo dīrghikāḥ kandarādayaḥ ।। dharmahīnā puṇyahīnā varṇāścatvāra eva ca ।। 29 ।। lakṣeṣu puṇyavānko'pi na tiṣṭhati tataḥ param ।। kutsitā vikṛtākārā narā nāryyaśca bālakāḥ ।। 30 ।। kuvārttāḥ kutsitapathā bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param ।। kecidgrāmāśca nagarā naraśūnyā bhayānakāḥ ।।31।। kecitsvalpakuṭīreṇa nareṇa ca samanvitāḥ ।। araṇyāni bhaviṣyanti grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca ।। 32 ।। araṇyavāsinaḥ sarve janāśca karapīḍitāḥ ।। sasyāni ca bhaviṣyanti taḍāgeṣu nadīṣu ca ।। 33 ।। kṣetrāṇi sasyahīnāni prakṛṣṭānyarthataḥ param ।। hīnāḥ prakṛṣṭā dhanino baladarpasamanvitāḥ ।।34।। prakṛṣṭavaṃśajā hīnā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge ।। alīkavādino dhūrttāḥ śaṭhā vai satyavādinaḥ ।।35।। pāpinaḥ puṇyavantaścāpyaśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭa eva ca ।। jitendriyā lampaṭāśca puṃścalyaśca pativratāḥ।।36।। tapasvinaḥ pātakino viṣṇubhaktā avaiṣṇavāḥ ।। hiṃsakāśca dayāyuktāścaurāśca naraghātinaḥ।।37।। bhikṣuveṣadharā dhūrttā nindantyupahasanti ca ।। bhūtādisevānipuṇā janānāṃ modakāriṇaḥ ।। 38 ।। pūjitāste bhaviṣyanti vañcakā jñānadurbalāḥ ।। vāmanā vyādhiyuktāśca narā nāryyaśca sarvataḥ ।। 39 ।। alpāyuṣo jarāyuktā yauvaneṣu kalau yuge ।। palitā ṣoḍaśe varṣe mahāvṛddhāstu viṃśatau।। 40।। aṣṭavarṣā ca yuvatī rajoyuktā ca garbhiṇī ।। vatsarānte prasūtā strī ṣoḍaśena jarānvitā ।। 41 ।। etāḥ kāścitsahasreṣu vandhyāścāpi kalau yuge ।। kanyāvikrayiṇaḥ sarve varṇāścatvāra eva ca ।। 42 ।। mātṛjāyāvadhūnāṃ ca jāropārjanatatparāḥ ।। kanyānāṃ bhaginīnāṃ ca jāropārjanajīvinaḥ।।43।। harernāmnāṃ vikrayiṇo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge ।। svayamutsṛjya dānaṃ ca kīrtivarddhanahetave ।।44।। tatpaścānmanasā''locya svayamullaṅghayiṣyati ।। devavṛttiṃ brahmavṛttiṃ vṛttiṃ gurukulasya ca ।।45।। svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā sarvamullaṅghayiṣyati ।। kanyakāgāminaḥ kecitkecicchvaśrvabhigāminaḥ ।। 46 ।। cchaśrva kecidvadhūgāminaśca kecitsarvatragāminaḥ ।। bhaginīgāminaḥ kecitsapatnīmā tṛgāminaḥ ।। 47 ।। bhrātṛjāyāgāminaśca bhaviṣyati kalau yuge ।। agamyāgamanaṃ caiva kariṣyanti gṛhe gahe ।। 48 ।। ātmayoniṃ parityajya vihariṣyanti sarvataḥ ।। patnīnāṃ nirṇayo nāsti bhartṝṇāṃ ca kalau yuge।।49।। prajānāṃ caiva vastūnāṃ grāmāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ।। alīkavādinaḥ sarve sarve cauryārthalampaṭāḥ ।। 50 ।। parasparaṃ hiṃsakāśca sarve ca naraghātinaḥ ।। brahmakṣatraviśāṃ vaṃśā bhaviṣyanti ca pāpinaḥ ।। 51 ।। lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vyāpāraṃ lavaṇasya ca ।। vṛṣavāhā vipravaṃśāḥ śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhinaḥ ।।92।। śūdrānnabhojinaḥ sarve sarve ca vṛṣalīratāḥ ।। pañcaparvaparityaktāḥ kuhūrātriṣu bhojinaḥ ।। 53 ।। yajñasūtravihīnāśca sandhyāśaucavihīnakāḥ ।। 54 ।। puṃścalī vārdhuṣā'vīrā kuṭṭinī ca rajasvalā।। viprāṇāṃ randhanāgāre bhaviṣyanti ca pācikāḥ ।।55।। annānāṃ nirṇayo nāsti yonīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।। āśramāṇāṃ janānāṃ ca sarve mlecchāḥ kalau yuge ।। 56 ।। evaṃ kalau saṃpravṛtte sarve mlecchamayā bhave ।। hastapramāṇe vṛkṣe cāṅguṣṭhamāne ca mānave ।। 57 ।। viprasya viṣṇuyaśasaḥ putraḥ kalkī bhaviṣyati ।। nārāyaṇakalāṃśaśca bhagavānbalināṃ balī ।। 58 ।। dīrgheṇa karavālena dīrghaghoṭakavāhanaḥ ।। mlecchaśūnyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ trirātreṇa kariṣyati ।। 59 ।। nirmlecchāṃ vasudhāṃ kṛtvā cāntarddhānaṃ kariṣyati ।। arājakā ca vasudhā datyugrastā bhaviṣyati ।। 60 ।। sthūlapramāṇaṃ ṣaḍrātraṃ varṣādhārāplutā mahī ।। lokaśūnyā vṛkṣaśūnyā gṛhaśūnyā bhaviṣyati ।। 61 ।। tataśca dvādaśādityāḥ kariṣyantyudayaṃ mune ।। prāpnoti śuṣkatāṃ pṛthvī samā teṣaṃ ca tejasā ।। 62 ।। kalau gate ca durddharṣe saṃpravṛtte kṛte yuge ।। tapassatyasamāyukto dharmaḥ pūrṇo bhaviṣyati ।। 63 ।। tapasvinaśca dharmiṣṭhā vedajñā brāhmaṇā bhuvi ।। pativratāśca dharmiṣṭhā yoṣitaśca gṛhe gṛhe ।। 64 ।। rājānaḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve viprabhaktāḥ svadharmiṇaḥ ।। pratāpavanto dharmiṣṭhāḥ puṇyakarmaratāḥ sadā ।। 65 ।। vaiśyā vāṇijyaniratā viprabhaktāśca dhārmikāḥ ।। śūdrāśca puṇyaśīlāśca dharmiṣṭhā viprasevinaḥ ।। 66 ।। viprakṣattraviśāṃ vaṃśā viṣṇuyajñaparāyaṇāḥ ।। viṣṇumantraratāḥ sarve viṣṇubhaktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 67 ।। śrutismṛtipurāṇajñā dharmajñā ṛtugāminaḥ ।। leśo nāsti hyadharmāṇāṃ dharmapūrṇe kṛte yuge।।68।। dharmastripācca tretāyāṃ dvipācca dvāpare smṛtaḥ।। kalau pravṛtte pādātmā sarvalopastataḥ param ।। 69 ।। vārāḥ sapta yathā vipra tithayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ ।। yathā dvādaśa māsāśca ṛtavaśca ṣaḍeva hi ।। 70 ।। dvau pakṣau cāyane dve ca caturbhiḥ praharairdinam ।। caturbhiḥ prahare rātrirmāsastriṃśaddinaistathā ।। 71 ।। varṣaḥ pañcavidho jñeyaḥ kālasaṃkhyāṃ nibodha me ।। yathā cāyānti yāntyeva tathā yugacatuṣṭayam ।। 72 ।। varṣe pūrṇe narāṇāṃ ca devānāṃ ca divāniśam ।। śatatraye ṣaṣṭyadhike narāṇāṃ ca yuge gate ।। devānāṃ ca yugo jñeyaḥ kālasaṃkhyāvidāṃ mataḥ ।। 73 ।। manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ ।। manvatarasamaṃ jñeyaṃ cendrāyuḥ parikīrtitam ।। 74 ।। aṣṭāviṃśatime cendre gate brāhmaṃ divāniśam ।। aṣṭottare varṣaśate gate pāto vidherbhavet ।। 75 ।। pralayaḥ prākṛto jñeyastatrādṛṣṭā vasundharā ।। jalaplutāni viśvāni brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।।76।। ṛṣayo jīvinaḥ sarve līnāḥ kṛṣṇe parātpare ।। tatraiva prakṛtirlīnā tena prākṛtiko layaḥ ।। 77 ।। laye prākṛtike'tīte pāte ca brahmaṇo mune ।। nimeṣamātraḥ kālaśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 78 ।। evaṃ naśyanti sarvāṇi brahmāṇḍānyakhilāni ca ।। sthitau golokavaikuṇṭhau śrīkṛṣṇaśca sapārṣadaḥ ।। 79 ।। nimeṣamātraḥ pralayo yatra viśvaṃ jalaplutam ।। nimeṣānantare kāle punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ krameṇa ca ।। 80 ।। evaṃ katividhā sṛṣṭirlayaḥ katividho'pi vā ।। katikṛtvo gatāyātaḥ saṃkhyāṃ jānāti kaḥ pumān ।। 81 ।। sṛṣṭīnāṃ ca kalānāṃ ca brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca nārada ।। brahmādīnāṃ ca vidhyaṇḍe saṃkhyāṃ jānāti kaḥ pumān ।।82।। brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca sarveṣāmīśvaraścaika eva saḥ ।। sarveṣāṃ paramātmā ca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 83 ।। brahmādayaśca tasyāṃśāstasyāṃśaśca mahāvirāṭ ।। tasyāṃśaśca virāṭ kṣudrastasyāṃśā prakṛtiḥ smṛtā ।। 84 ।। sa ca kṛṣṇo dvidhābhūto dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ ।। caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। 85 ।। brahmāditṛṇaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtikaṃ bhavet ।। yadyatprākṛtikaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva ca ।। 86 ।। viddhyekaṃ sṛṣṭimūlaṃ tatsatyaṃ nityaṃ sanātanam ।। svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma nirliptaṃ nirguṇaṃ param ।। 87 ।। nirupādhiṃ nirākāraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca navīnaghanasannibham।।88।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ gopaveṣaṃ kiśorakam ।। sarvajñaṃ sarvasevyaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 89 ।। karoti dhātā brahmāṇḍaṃ jñānātmā kama lodbhavaḥ ।। śivo mṛtyuñjayaścaiva saṃharttā sarvatattvavit ।। 90 ।। yasya jñānādyattapasā sarveśastatsamo mahān ।। mahāvibhūtiyuktaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvadā svayam ।। 91 ।। sarvavyāpī sarvapātā sa dātā sarvasampadām ।। viṣṇuḥ sarveśvaraḥ śrīmānyasya jñānājjagatpatiḥ ।। 92 ।। mahāmāyā ca prakṛtiḥ sarvaśaktimatīśvarī ।। yajjñānādyasya tapasā yadbhaktyā yasya sevayā ।। 93 ।। sāvitrī vedamātā ca vedādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। pūjyā dvijānāṃ vedajñā yajñādyasyāśca sevayā ।। 94 ।। sarvavidyādhidevī sā pūjyā ca viduṣāṃ purā ।। yatsevayā yattapasā yasya jñānātsarasvatī ।। 95 ।। yatsevayā yattapasā pradātrī sarvasaṃpadām ।। dhanasasyādhidevī sā mahālakṣmīḥ sanātanī ।। 96 ।। yatsevayā yattapasā sarvaviśveṣu pūjitā ।। sarvagrāmādhidevī sā sarvasampatpradā yinī ।। 97 ।। sarveśvarī sarvavandyā sarveśaṃ prāpa yā patim ।। sarvastutā ca sarvajñā durgā durgatināśinī ।। 98 ।। kṛṣṇavāmāṃśasambhūtā kṛṣṇapremādhidevatā ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā premṇā rādhikā kṛṣṇasevayā ।। 99 ।। sarvādhikaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ mānagauravam ।। kṛṣṇavakṣasthalasthānaṃ patnītvaṃ prāpa sevayā ।। 100 ।। tapaścakāra sā pūrvaṃ śataśṛṅge ca parvate ।। divyaṃ yugasahasraṃ ca nirāhārā'tikarśitā ।। 101 ।। kṛśāṃ niḥśvāsarahitāṃ dṛṣṭvā candrakalopamām ।। kṛṣṇo vakṣaḥsthale kṛtvā ruroda kṛpayā vibhuḥ ।। ।।102।। varaṃ tasyai dadau sāraṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabham ।। mama vakṣaḥsthale tiṣṭha mayi te bhaktirastviti ।। 103 ।। saubhāgyena ca mānena premṇā vai gauraveṇa ca ।। tvaṃ me śreṣṭhā paraṃ premṇā jyeṣṭhā tvaṃ sarvayoṣitām ।। 104 ।। variṣṭhā ca gariṣṭhā ca saṃstutā pūjitā mayā ।। santataṃ tava sādhyo'haṃ bādhyaśca prāṇavallabhe ।। 105 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthaścakre taccetanāṃ tataḥ ।। sapatnīrahitāṃ tāṃ ca cakāra prāṇavallabhām ।। 106 ।। yeṣāṃ yā yāśca devyo vai pūjitāstasya sevayā ।। tapasyā yādṛśī yāsāṃ tāsāṃ tādṛkphalaṃ mune ।। 107 ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca tapastaptvā himālaye ।। durgā ca tatpadaṃ dhyātvā sarvapūjyā babhūva ha ।। 108 ।। sarasvatī tapastaptvā parvate gandhamādane ।। lakṣavarṣaṃ ca divyaṃ ca sarvavandyā babhūva sā ।। 109 ।। lakṣmīryugaśataṃ divyaṃ tapastaptvā ca puṣkare ।। sarvasampatpradātrī sā cābhavattasya sevayā ।। 110 ।। sāvitrī malaye taptvā dvijapūjyā babhūva sā ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasraṃ ca divyaṃ dhyātvā ca tatpadam ।।111।। śatamanvantaraṃ taptaṃ śaṃkareṇa purā vibho ।। śatamanvantaraṃ caiva brahmaṇā tasya bhaktitaḥ ।। 112 ।। śatamanvantaraṃ viṣṇustaptvā pātā babhūva ha ।। śatamanvantaraṃ dharmastaptvā pūjyo babhūva ha ।।113।। manvantaraṃ tapastepe śeṣo bhaktyā ca nārada ।। manvantaraṃ ca sūryyaśca śakraścandrastathā guruḥ ।। 114 ।। divyaṃ śatayugaṃ caiva vāyustaptvā ca bhaktitaḥ ।। sarvaprāṇaḥ sarvapūjyaḥ sarvādhāro babhūva saḥ ।।115।। evaṃ kṛṣṇasya tapasā sarve devāśca pūjitāḥ ।। munayo mānavā bhūpā brāhmaṇāścaiva pūjitāḥ ।। 116 ।। evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ purāṇaṃ ca tathā''gamam ।। guruvaktrādyathā jñātaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 117 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nārada nārāyaṇasaṃvāde yugatanmāhātmyamanvantarakāleśvaraguṇanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 7 ।।
<2.8> nārada uvāca ।। harernimeṣamātreṇa brahmaṇaḥ pāta eva ca ।। tasya pāte prākṛtikaḥ pralayaḥ parikīrttitaḥ ।। 1 ।। pralaye prākṛte coktaṃ tatrādṛṣṭā vasundharā ।। jalaplutāni viśvāni sarve līnā āvirbhūtā tirobhūtā sā calā ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 14 ।। āvirbhūtā sṛṣṭikāle tajjalātparyyupasthitā ।। pralaye ca tirobhūtā jalābhyantaravasthitā ।। 15 ।। prativiśveṣu vasudhā śailakānanasaṃyutā ।। cāpyadhaścoddharaṇakramam ।। maṃgalaṃ maṃgalasyāpi janmavyāsaṃ vada prabho ।। 26 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। vārāhe ca varāhaśca brahmaṇā saṃstutaḥ purā ।। uddadhāra mahīṃ hatvā hiraṇyākṣaṃ rasātalāt ।। 27 29 ।। kṛtvā ratikarīṃ śayyāṃ mūrttiṃ ca sumanoharām ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra rahasi divyavarṣamaharniśam ।। 30 ।। sukhasambhogasaṃsparśānmūrcchāṃ samprāpa sundarī ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo'pi ।। ambuvīcībhūkhananātpāpānmucyeta sa dhruvam ।। anyakūpe kupadajātpāpānmucyeta sa dhruvam ।। 60 ।। parabhūśrāddhajātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। bhūmau vīryyatyāgapāpāddīpādisthāpanāttathā ।। 61 ।। pāpena mucyate prājñaḥ stotrasya paṭhanānmune ।। aśvamedhaśataṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ।। 62 ।। iti śrībrahmavairtte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde pṛthivyupākhyāne pṛthivīstotraṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ।।8।।
<2.9> nārada uvāca।। bhūmidānakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ taddharaṇena yat ।। parabhūmau śrāddharūpaṃ kūpe kupadajaṃ tathā ।। 1 ।। ambuvīcībhūkhananabījatyāgajameva ca ।। dīpādisthāpanātpāpaṃ śrotumicchāmi yatnataḥ ।। 2 ।। anyadvā pṛthivījanyaṃ pāpaṃ yatpraśnataḥ param ।। yadasti tatpratīkāraṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara ।।3।। nārāyaṇa uvāca।। vitastimātraṃ bhūmiṃ ca yo dadāti ca bhārate।। sandhyāpūtāya viprāya sa yāyādviṣṇumandiram ।।4।। bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyā brāhmaṇāya dadāti yaḥ।। bhūmireṇupramāṇe ca varṣe viṣṇupade vaset।।5।। grāmaṃ bhūmiṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca yo dadātyādadāti yaḥ ।। sarvapāpādvinirmuktau cobhau vaikuṇṭhavāsinau ।। 6 ।। bhūmidānaṃ ca tatkāle yaḥ sādhuścānumodate ।। sa prayāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ mitragotrasamanvitaḥ ।। 7 ।। svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harettu yaḥ ।। kālasūtre tiṣṭhati sa yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 8 ।। tatputrapautraprabhṛtirbhūmihīnaḥ śriyā hataḥ ।। sukhahīno daridraḥ syādante yāti ca rauravam ।। 9 ।। gavāṃ mārgaṃ viniṣkṛṣya yaśca sasyaṃ dadāti saḥ ।। divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva kumbhīpāke ca tiṣṭhati ।। 10 ।। goṣṭhaṃ taḍāgaṃ niṣkṛṣya mārgaṃ sasyaṃ dadāti yaḥ ।। sa ca tiṣṭhatyasīpatre yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 11 ।। na pañcapiṇḍamuddhṛtya snāti kūpe parasya yaḥ।। prāpnoti narakaṃ caiva na snānaphalameva ca ।।12।। kāmī bhūmau ca rahasi bījatyāgaṃ karoti yaḥ ।। snigdhareṇupramāṇaṃ ca varṣaṃ tiṣṭhati raurave ।। 13 ।। ambuvīcyambukhananaṃ yaḥ karoti ca mānavaḥ ।। sa yāti kṛmidaṃśaṃ ca sthitistatra caturyugam ।। 14 ।। parakīye luptakūpe kūpaṃ mūḍhaḥ karoti yaḥ ।। puṣkariṇyāṃ ca luptāyāṃ tāṃ dadāti ca yo naraḥ ।। 15 ।। sarvaṃ phalaṃ parasyaiva taptasūrmiṃ vrajettu saḥ ।। tatra tiṣṭhati saṃtapto yāvadidrāścaturdaśa ।। 15 ।। parakīyataḍāge ca paṅkamuddhṛtya cotsṛjet ।। reṇupramāṇavarṣaṃ ca brahmaloke vasennaraḥ ।।17।। piṇḍaṃ pitre bhūtibhartturna pradāya ca mānavaḥ ।। śrāddhaṃ karoti yo mūḍho narakaṃ yāti niścitam ।। 18 ।। bhūmau dīpaṃ yo'rpayati so'ndhaḥ saptasu janmasu ।। bhūmau śaṃkhaṃ ca saṃsthāpya kuṣṭhaṃ janmāntare labhet ।। 19 ।। muktāmāṇikyahīraṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca maṇiṃ tathā ।। yaśca saṃsthāpayedbhūmau daridraḥ saptajanmasu ।। 20 ।। śivaliṅgaṃ śilāmarcyāṃ yaścārpayati bhūtale ।। śatamanvantaraṃ yāvatkṛmibhakṣe sa tiṣṭhati ।।21।। sūktaṃ mantraṃ śilātoyaṃ puṣpaṃ ca tulasīdalam ।। yaścārpayati bhūmau ca sa tiṣṭhennarake yugam ।।22।। japamālāṃ puṣpamālāṃ karpūraṃ rocanāṃ tathā ।। yo mūḍhaścārpayedbhūmau sa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam ।। 23 ।। mune candanakāṣṭhaṃ ca rudrākṣaṃ kuśamūlakam ।। saṃsthāpya bhūmau narake vasenmanvantarāvadhi ।। 24 ।। pustakaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca bhūmau saṃsthāpayettu yaḥ।। na bhavedviprayonau ca tasya janmāntare janiḥ।।29।। brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpamiha vai labhate dhruvam।। granthiyuktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ pūjyaṃ syātsarvavarṇakaiḥ ।। 26 ।। yajñaṃ kṛtvā tu yo bhūmiṃ kṣīreṇa nahi siñcati।। sa yāti taptasūrmiṃ ca saṃtaptaḥ sarvajanmasu ।।27।। bhūkampe grahaṇe yo hi karoti khananaṃ bhuvaḥ ।। janmāntare mahāpāpī so'ṅgahīno bhaveddhruvam ।।28।। bhavanaṃ yatra sarveṣāṃ bhūmistana prakīrttitā।।। vasuratnaṃ yā dadhāti vasudhā ca vasundharā।।29।। harerūrau ca yā jātā sā corvī parikīrttitā ।। dharā dharitrī dharaṇī sarveṣāṃ dharaṇāttu yā ।। 30 ।। ijyā ca yāgabharaṇātkṣoṇī kṣīṇā laye ca yā ।। mahālaye kṣayaṃ yāti kṣitistena prakīrtitā ।। 31 ।। kāśyapī kaśyapasyeyamacalā sthitirūpataḥ ।। viśvambharā taddharaṇāccānantā'nantarūpataḥ ।। 32 ।। pṛthvī pṛdhukakanyātvādvistṛtatvānmahī mune ।। 33 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāṇayasaṃvāde pṛthivyupākhyānaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 9 ।।
<2.10> nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ pṛthivyupākhyānamatīva sumanoharam ।। gaṅgopākhyānamadhunā vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 1 ।। bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādājagāma sureśvarī ।। viṣṇusvarūpā paramā svayaṃ viṣṇupadī satī ।। 2 ।। kathaṃ kutra yuge kena prārthitā preritā purā ।। tatkramaṃ śrotumicchāmi pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham ।। 3 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rājarājeśvaraḥ śrīmansagaraḥ sūryyavaṃśajaḥ ।। tasya bhāryā ca vaidarbhī śaivyā ca dve manohare ।। 4 ।। satyasvarūpaḥ satyeṣṭaḥ satyavāksatyabhāvanaḥ ।। satyadharmavicārajñaḥ paraṃ satyayugodbhavaḥ ।। 5 ।। ekakanyaścaikaputro babhūva sumanoharaḥ ।। asamañja iti khyātaḥ śaibyāyāṃ kulavarddhanaḥ ।। 6 ।। anyā cārādhayāmāsa śaṅkaraṃ putrakāmukī ।। babhūva garbhastasyāśca śivasya tu vareṇa ca ।। 7 ।। gate śatābde pūrṇe ca māṃsapiṇḍaṃ suṣāva sā ।। taddṛṣṭvā ca śivaṃ dhyātvā rurodoccaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।8।। śambhurbrāhmaṇarūpeṇa tatsamīpaṃ jagāma ha ।। cakāra saṃvibhajyaitatpiṇḍaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasradhā ।। 9 ।। sarve babhūvuḥ putrāśca mahābalaparā kramāḥ ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍaprabhājuṣṭakalevarāḥ ।। 10 ।। kapilarṣeḥ kopadṛṣṭyā babhūvurbhasmasācca te ।। rājā ruroda tacchrutvā jagāma maraṇaṃ śucā ।। 11 ।। tapaścakārāsamaṃjo gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt ।। tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ mriyate kālayogataḥ ।। 12 ।। dilīpastasya tanayo gaṅgānayanakāraṇāta ।। tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ yayau lokāntaraṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 13 ।। aśumām̐stasya putraśca gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt ।। tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ mṛtaśca kālayogataḥ ।। 14 ।। bhagīrathastasya putro mahābhāgavataḥ sudhīḥ ।। vaiṣṇavo viṣṇubhaktaśca guṇavāna jarāmaraḥ ।। 15 ।। tapaḥ kṛtvā lakṣavarṣaṃ gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt ।। dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣṭāsyaṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabham ।। 16 ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ kiśoraṃ gopaveṣakam ।। paramātmānamīśaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 17 ।। svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādyaiśca stutaṃ munigaṇairyutam ।। 18 ।। nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 19 ।। vahniśuddhāṃ śukādhānaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। tuṣṭāva dṛṣṭvā nṛpatiḥ praṇamya ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 20 ।। līlayā ca varaṃ prāpya vāñchitaṃ vaṃśatārakam ।। tatrājagāma gaṃgā sā smaraṇātparamātmanaḥ ।। ।। 21 ।। taṃ praṇamya pratasthau ca tatpuraḥ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। uvāca bhagavāṃstatra tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sumanoharam ।। kurvatīṃ stavanaṃ divyaṃ pulakāñcitavigrahām ।। 22 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpādgaccha śīghraṃ sureśvari ।। 23 ।। sagarasya sutānsarvānpūtānkuru mamājñayā ।। tvatsparśavāyunā pūtā yāsyanti mama mandiram ।। 24 ।। bibhrato divyamūrttiṃ te divyasyandanagāminaḥ ।। matpārṣadā bhaviṣyanti sarvakālaṃ nirāmayāḥ ।। 25 ।। karmabhogaṃ samucchidya kṛtaṃ janmani janmani ।। nānāvidhaṃ mahatsvalpaṃ pāpaṃ syādbhārate nṛbhiḥ ।। 26 ।। gaṃgāyāḥ sparśavātena naśyatīti śrutau śrutam ।। sparśanaṃ darśanāddevyāḥ puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ ।। 27 ।। mausalasnānamātreṇa sāmānyadivase nṛṇām।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ naśyatīti śrutau śrutam।।28।। yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca।। nānājanmārjitānyeva kāmato'pi kṛtāni ca ।।29।। tāni sarvāṇi naśyanti mausalasnānato nṛṇām ।। puṇyāhasnānajaṃ puṇyaṃ vedā naiva vadanti ca ।। 30 ।। kecidvadanti te devi phalameva yathāgamam ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivāyāśca sarve naiva vidanti ca ।। 31 ।। sāmānyadivasasnānasaṅkalpaṃ śṛṇu sundari ।। puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ caiva mausalasnānataḥ param ।। 32 ।। tatastriṃśadguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ ravisaṃkramaṇe dine ।। amāyāṃ cāpi tattulyaṃ dviguṇaṃ dakṣiṇāyane ।।33।। tato daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ narāṇāmuttarāyaṇe ।। cāturmāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmanantaṃ puṇyameva ca ।। 34 ।। akṣayāyāṃ ca tattulyaṃ naitadvede nirūpitam ।। asaṃkhyapuṇyaphaladameteṣu snānadānakam ।। 35 ।। sāmānyadivase snānaṃ dhyānācchataguṇaṃ phalam ।। manvantareṣu deveśi yugādiṣu tathaiva ca ।। 36 ।। māghasya sitasaptamyāṃ bhīṣmāṣṭamyāṃ tathaiva ca ।। tathā 'śokāṣṭamītithyāṃ navamyāṃ ca tathā hareḥ ।। 37 ।। tato'pi dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ nandāyāṃ tava durlabham ।। daśapāpaharāyāṃ tu daśamyāṃ sumahatphalam ।। 38 ।। nandāsamaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ mahatpūrvaṃ caturguṇam ।। tataścaturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dvimahatpūrvake sati ।। 39 ।। puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ caiva sāmānyasnānato bhavet ।। candrasūryoparāgeṣu smṛtaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ ।। 40 ।। puṇye'pyarddhodaye kāle tataḥ śataguṇaṃ phalam ।। sarveṣāmeva saṅkalpo vaiṣṇavānāṃ viparyyayaḥ ।।41।। phalasandhānarahitā jīvanmuktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। matprītibhaktikāmāste sarvadā sarvakarmasu ।।42।। guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśetparaḥ ।। jīvanmuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ taṃ vedāḥ sarve vadanti ca ।। 43 ।। puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvaṃ paitṛkaṃ ca paraṃ śatam ।। mātāmahasya ca śataṃ mātaraṃ mātṛmātaram।।44।। bhaginīṃ bhrātaraṃ caiva bhāgineyaṃ ca mātulam ।। śvaśruṃ ca śvaśuraṃ caiva gurupatnīṃ guroḥ sutam ।। 45 ।। guruṃ ca jñānadātāraṃ mitraṃ ca sahacāriṇam ।। bhṛtyaṃ śiṣyaṃ tathā ceṭīṃ prajāḥ svāśramasannidhau ।। 46 ।। uddharedātmanā sārddhaṃ mantragrahaṇamātrataḥ ।। mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। 47 ।। tasya saṃsparśanātpūtaṃ tīrthaṃ ca bhuvi bhārate ।। tasyaiva pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। 48 ।। pādodakasthānamidaṃ tīrthameva bhaveddhruvam ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam ।।49 ।। khādanti no vaiṣṇavāśca sadā naivedyabhojinaḥ ।। viṣṇorniveditānnaṃ ca nityaṃ ye bhuñjate narāḥ ।। 50 ।। pūtāni sarvatīrthāni teṣāṃ ca sparśanādaho ।। viṣṇoḥ pādodakaṃ puṇyaṃ nityaṃ ye bhuñjate narāḥ ।। 51 ।। tatpāpāni palāyante vainateyādivoragāḥ ।। teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa pūtaṃ ca bhuvanatrayam ।। 52 ।। viṣṇoḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ santataṃ tāṃśca rakṣati ।। madguṇaśravaṇādye ca pulakāṅkitavigrahāḥ।। ।। 53 ।। gadgadāḥ sāśrunetrāśca narāste vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ।। putrādapi paraḥ sneho mayi yeṣāṃ nirantaram ।। gṛhādyāśca mayi nyastāste narāḥ vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ।। 54 ।। ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ mattaḥ sarvaṃ carācaram ।। sarveṣāmahameveśa itijñā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ।। 55 ।। asaṃkhyakoṭibrahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। pralaye mayi līyante cetijñā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ।। 56।। tejaḥsvarūpaṃ paramaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। svecchāmayaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 57 ।। sarve prākṛtikā matta āvirbhūtāstirohitāḥ।। iti jānanti ye devi te narā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ।। 58 ।। ityevamuktvā deveśo virarāma tayoḥ puraḥ ।। uvāca taṃ tripathagā bhaktinamrātmakandharā ।।59।। gaṅgovāca ।। yāmi cedbhārataṃ nātha bhāratīśāpataḥ purā ।। tavājñayā ca rājendra tapasā caiva sāmpratam ।। 60 ।। yāni kāni ca pāpāni mahyaṃ dāsyanti pāpinaḥ ।। tāni me kena naśyanti tadupāyaṃ vada prabho ।। 61 ।। katikālaṃ parimitaṃ sthitirme tatra bhārate ।। kadā yāsyāmi sarveśa tvadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ।। 62 ।। mamānyadvācchitaṃ yadyatsarvaṃ jānāsi sarvavit ।। sarvāntarātmantsarvajña tadupāyaṃ vada prabho ।। 63 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। jānāmi vāñchitaṃ gaṅge tava sarvaṃ sureśvari ।। patiste rudrarūpo'yaṃ lavaṇodo bhaviṣyati ।। 64 ।। mamaivāṃśaḥ samudraśca tvaṃ ca lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhuvi ।। 65 ।। yāvattyaḥ santi nadyaśca bhāratyādyāśca bhārate ।। saubhāgyaṃ tava tāsveva lavaṇodasya saurate ।। 66 ।। adyaprabhṛti deveśi kaleḥ pañca sahasrakam ।। varṣaṃ sthitiste bhāratyā bhuvi śāpena bhārate ।। 67 ।। nityaṃ vāridhinā sārddhaṃ kariṣyasi raho ratim ।। tvameva rasikā devī rasikendreṇa saṃyutā ।। 68 ।। tvāṃ toṣayanti stotreṇa bhagīrathakṛtena ca ।। bhāratasthā janāḥ sarve pūjayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ ।।69।। dhyānena kauthumoktena dhyātvā tvāṃ pūjayiṣyati ।। yaḥ stauti praṇamennityaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 70 ।। gaṅgā gaṅgeti yo brūyādyo janānāṃ śatairapi ।। mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ।।71।। sahasrapāpināṃ snānādyatpāpaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।। madbhaktadarśane tāvattadaiva hi vinaśyati ।। 72 ।। pāpināṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ śavasparśena yattava ।। manmantropāsakasnānāttadaghaṃ ca vinaśyati ।। 73 ।। yatra yatra bhavedgaṅge mannāmaguṇakīrttanam ।। tatraiva tvamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyasyaghamocanāt ।। 74 ।। sārddhaṃ saridbhiḥ śreṣṭhābhiḥ sarasvatyādibhiḥ śubhe ।। tattu tīrthaṃ bhavetsadyo yatra madguṇakīrttanam ।। 75 ।। yadreṇusparśamātreṇa pūto bhavati pātakī ।। reṇupramāṇaṃ varṣaṃ ca sa vaikuṇṭhe vased dhruvam ।।76।। jñānena tvayi ye bhaktyā mannāmasmṛtipūrvakam ।। samutsṛjanti prāṇāṃśca te gacchanti hareḥ padam ।। 77 ।। pārṣadapravarāste ca bhaviṣyanti hareściram ।। asaṃkhyakaṃ prākṛtikaṃ layaṃ drakṣyanti te narāḥ ।। 78 ।। mṛtasya bahupuṇyena tacchavaṃ tvayi vinyaset ।। prayāti sa ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāvadasthnāṃ sthitistvayi ।। 79 ।। kāyavyūhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā bhojayitvā svakarmakam ।। tasmai dadāmi sārūpyaṃ taṃ karomi ca pārṣadam ।। 80 ।। ajñānī tvajjalasparśādyadi prāṇānsamutsṛjet ।। tasmai dadāmi sārūpyaṃ taṃ karomi pārṣadam ।। 81 ।। anyatra vā tyajetprāṇāṃstvannāmasmṛtipūrvakam ।। tasmai dadāmi sālokyamasaṃkhyapralayālayam ।। 82 ।। anyatra vā tyajetprāṇānmannāmasmṛtipūrvakam ।। tasmai dadāmi sālokyaṃ yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 83 ।। tīrthe'pyatīrthe maraṇe viśeṣo nāsti kaścana ।। manmantropāsakānāṃ ca nityaṃ naivedyabhojinām ।। 84 ।। pūtaṃ kartuṃ sa śakto hi līlayā bhuvanatrayam ।। ratnendrasārayānena lokaṃ sa prayāti ca ।। 85 ।। madbhaktabāndhavā ye ye te te puṇyadhiyaḥ śubhe ।। te yānti ratnayānena golokaṃ ca sudurlabham ।।86।। yatra tatra mṛtā ye ca jñānājñānena vā sati ।। jīvanmuktāśca te pūtā bhaktasannidhimātrataḥ ।। 87 ।। ityuktvā śrīharistāṃ ca tamuvāca bhagīratham ।। stuhi gaṅgāmimāṃ bhaktyā pūjāṃ kuru ca sāmpratam ।। 88 ।। bhagīrathastāṃ tuṣṭāva pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। dhyānena kauthumoktena stotreṇa ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 89 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇanāmātha paramātmānamīśvaram ।। bhagīrathaśca gaṅgāṃ ca so'ntarddhāya gato hariḥ ।। 90 ।। nārada uvāca ।। stotreṇa kena dhyānena kena pūjākrameṇa ca ।। pūjāṃ cakāra nṛpatirvada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 91 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। pādau prakṣālya cācamya saṃyato bhaktipūrvakam ।। 92 ।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ।। sampūjayennaraśśuddhaḥ so'dhikārī ca pūjane ।। 93 ।। gaṇeśaṃ vighnanāśāya niṣpāpāya divākaram ।। vahniṃ svaśuddhaye viṣṇuṃ muktaye pūjayennaraḥ ।। 94 ।। śivaṃ jñānāya tadināṃ śivāṃ buddhivivṛddhaye ।। sampūjyaitallabhetprājño viparītamato'nyathā ।। 95 ।। dadhyāvanena taddhyānaṃ śṛṇu nārada tattvataḥ ।। dhyānaṃ ca kauthumoktaṃ vai sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।। 96 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ gaṅgāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ।। kṛṣṇavigrahasambhūtāṃ kṛṣṇatulyāṃ parāṃ satīm ।। 97 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। śaratpūrṇenduśatakaprabhājuṣṭakalevarām ।। 98 ।। īṣaddhāsaprasannāsyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ।। nārāyaṇapriyāṃ śāntāṃ satsaubhāgyasamanvitāma ।। 99 ।। bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutām ।। sindūrabindulalitāṃ sārddhaṃ candanabindubhiḥ ।। 100 ।। kastūrīpatrakaṃ gaṇḍe nānācitrasamanvitam ।। pakvabimbasamānaikacārvoṣṭhapuṭamuttamam ।। 101 ।। muktāpaṃktiprabhājuṣṭadantapaṃktimanoharām ।। sucāruvakranayanāṃ sakaṭākṣamanoramām ।। 102 ।। kaṭhinaṃ śrīphalākāraṃ stanayugmaṃ ca bibhratīm ।। bṛhacchroṇīṃ sukaṭhināṃ rambhāstambhapariṣkṛtām ।। 103 ।। sthalapadmaprabhājuṣṭapādapadmayugaṃdharām ।। ratnābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumāktaṃ sayāvakam ।। 104 ।। devendramaulimandāramakarandakaṇāruṇam ।। surasiddhamunīndrādidattārghyaissaṃyutaṃ sadā ।। 105 ।। tapasvimaulinikarabhramaraśreṇisaṃyutam ।। muktipradaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ kāmināṃ svargabhogadam ।। 106 ।। varāṃ vareṇyāṃ varadāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ।। śrīviṣṇoḥ padadātrīṃ ca bhaje viṣṇupadīṃ satīm ।। 107 ।। iti dhyānena cānena dhyātvā tripathagāṃ śubhām ।। dattvā saṃpūjayedbrahmannupahārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। 108 ।। āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ cānulepanam ।। dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ śītalaṃ jalam ।। 109 ।। vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mālyaṃ gaṃdhamācamanīyakam ।। manoharaṃ sutalpaṃ ca deyānyetāni ṣoḍaśa ।। 110।। dattvā bhaktyā saṃpraṇametstutvā tāṃ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। saṃpūjyaivaṃprakāreṇa so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।।111।। stotraṃ vai kauthumoktaṃ ca saṃvādaṃ viṣṇuvedhasoḥ ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi pāpaghnaṃ ca supuṇyadam।।112।। śrībrahmovāca ।। śrotumicchāmi deveśa lakṣmīkānta namaḥ prabho ।। viṣṇo viṣṇupadīstotraṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyakāraṇam ।। 113 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śivasaṃgītasaṃmugdhaśrīkṛṣṇāṅgadravodbhavām ।। rādhāṃgadravasambhūtāṃ tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 114 ।। yā janmasṛṣṭerādau ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। sannidhāne śaṅkarasya tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। ।। 115 ।। gopairgopībhirākīrṇe śubhe rādhāmahotsave ।। kārtikīpūrṇimājātāṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 115 ।। koṭiyojanavistīrṇā dairghye lakṣaguṇā tataḥ ।। samāvṛtā yā golokaṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।117।। ṣaṣṭilakṣairyojanairyā tato dairghye caturguṇā।। samāvṛtā yā vaikuṇṭhaṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।118।। viṃśallakṣairyojanairyā tato dairghye caturguṇā ।। āvṛtā brahmalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 119 ।। triṃśallakṣairyojanairyā dairghye pañcaguṇā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā śivalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 120 ।। ṣaḍyojanasuvistīrṇā dairghye daśaguṇā tataḥ ।। mandākinī yendraloke tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 121 ।। lakṣayojanavirstārṇā dairghye saptaguṇā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā dhruvalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 122 ।। lakṣayojanavistīrṇā dairghye ṣaḍguṇitā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā candra lokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।123।। yojanaiṣṣaṣṭisāhasrairdairghye daśaguṇā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā sṛryyalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham।। ।। 124 ।। lakṣayojanavistīrṇā dairghye ṣaṅguṇitā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā satyalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 125 ।। daśalakṣairyojanairyā dairghye pañcaguṇā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā yā tapolokaṃ tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।126।। sahasrayojanā yā ca dairghye saptaguṇā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā janalokaṃ yā tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 127 ।। sahasrayojanā''yāme dairghye saptaguṇā tataḥ ।। āvṛtā yā ca kailāsaṃ tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham।।128।। pātāle yā bhogavatī vistīrṇā daśayojanā ।। tato daśaguṇā dairghye tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।129।। krośaikamātravistīrṇā tataḥ kṣīṇā na kutracit ।। kṣitau cālakanandā yā tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 130 ।। satye yā kṣīravarṇā ca tretāyāmindusannibhā ।। dvāpare candanābhā ca tāṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।131।। jalaprabhā kalau yā ca nānyatra pṛthivītale ।। svarge ca nityaṃ kṣīrābhā tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 132 ।। yasyāḥ prabhāva atulaḥ purāṇe ca śrutau śrutaḥ ।। yā puṇyadā pāpahartrī tāṃ gaṅgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 133 ।। yattoyakaṇikāsparśaḥ pāpināṃ ca pitāmaha ।। brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ koṭijanmārjitaṃ dahet ।। 134 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahmangaṃgāpadyaikaviṃśatim ।। stotrarūpaṃ ca paramaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyabījakam ।। 135 ।। nityaṃ yo hi paṭhedbhaktyā saṃpūjya ca sureśvarīm ।। aśvamedhaphalaṃ nityaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ।।136।। aputro labhate putraṃ bhāryāhīno labhetpriyām ।। rogānmucyeta rogī ca baddho mucyeta bandhanāt ।। 137 ।। aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya gaṅgāstotramidaṃ śubham ।। ।।138।। śubhaṃ bhavettu duḥsvapnaṃ gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ।।139।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। bhagīratho'nayā stutyā stutvā gaṅgāṃ ca nārada ।। jagāma tāṃ gṛhītvā ca yatra naṣṭaśca sāgarāḥ ।। 140 ।। vaikuṇṭhaṃ te yayustūrṇaṃ gaṅgāyāḥ sparśavāyunā ।। bhagīrathena sā''nītā tena bhāgīrathī smṛtā ।। 141 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaṅgopākhyānamuttamam ।। puṇyadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 142 ।। nārada uvāca ।। śivasaṃgītasaṃmugdhe śrīkṛṣṇe dravatāṃ gate ।। dravatāṃ ca gatāyāṃ ca rādhāyāṃ kiṃ babhūva ha ।। 143 ।। tatrasthāśca janā ye ye te ca kiṃ cakrurudyamam ।। etatsarvaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ prabho vaktumihārhasi।।144।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca rādhāyāḥ sumahotsave ।। kṛṣṇaḥ saṃpūjya tāṃ rādhāmavasadrāsamaṇḍale ।। 145 ।। kṛṣṇena pūjitāṃ tāṃ tu saṃpūjyādṛtamānasāḥ ।। ūcurbrahmādayaḥ sarve ṛṣayaḥ sanakādayaḥ ।। 146 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇa saṃgītaṃ ca sarasvatī ।। jagau sundaratānena vīṇayā ca manoharam ।। 147 ।। tuṣṭo brahmā dadau tasyai mahāratnāḍhyamālikām ।। śiromaṇīndrasāraṃ ca sarvabrahmāṇḍadurlabham ।। 148 ।। kṛṣṇaḥ kaustubharatnaṃ ca sarvaratnātparaṃ varam ।। amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ hārasāraṃ ca rādhikā ।। 149 ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavanvanamālāṃ manoharām ।। amūlyaratnakalitaṃ lakṣmīrmakarakuṇḍalam ।। 150 ।। viṣṇumāyā bhagavatī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। durgā nārāyaṇīśānī viṣṇubhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ।। 151 ।। dharmabuddhiṃ ca dharmastu yaśaśca vipulaṃ bhave ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ vahnirvāyuśca maṇinūpuram ।। 152 ।। etasminnantare śambhurbrahmaṇā prerito muhuḥ ।। jagau śrīkṛṣṇasaṃgītaṃ rāsollāsasamanvitam ।। 153 ।। mūrcchāṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ sarve citraputtalikā yathā ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya dadṛśū rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 154 ।। sthalaṃ sarvaṃ jalākīrṇaṃ hīnarādhāhariṃ tathā ।। atyuccai ruruduḥ sarve gopā gopyaḥ surā dvijāḥ ।। 155 ।। dhyānena dhātā bubudhe sarvametadabhīpsitam ।। gataśca rādhayā sārddhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo dravatāmiti ।। 156 ।। tato brahmādayaḥ sarve tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvaram ।। svamūrttiṃ darśaya vibho vāñchitaṃ varameva naḥ ।। 157 ।। etasminnantare tatra vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। tāmeva śuśruvuḥ sarve suvyaktāṃ madhurāṃ śubhām ।। 158 ।। sarvātmā'hamiyaṃ śaktirbhaktānugrahavigrahā ।। mamāpyasyāśca he devā dehena ca kimāvayoḥ ।। 159 ।। manavo mānavāḥ sarve munayaścaiva vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। manmantrapūtā māṃ draṣṭumāgamiṣyanti matpadam ।। 160 ।। mūrtiṃ draṣṭuṃ ca suvyagrā yūyaṃ yadi sureśvarāḥ ।। karoti śambhustatraiva madīyaṃ vākyapālanam ।। 161 ।। svayaṃ vidhātā tvaṃ brahmannājñāṃ kuru jagadguro ।। kartuṃ śāstraviśeṣaṃ ca vedāṃgaṃ sumanoharam ।। 162 ।। apūrvamantranikaraiḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradaiḥ ।। stotraiśca kavacairdhyānairyutaṃ pūjāvidhikramaiḥ ।। 163 ।। manmantraṃ kavacaṃ stotraṃ kṛtvā yatnena gopaya ।। bhavanti vimukhā yena janānāṃ yatkari ṣyati ।। 164 ।। sahasreṣu śateṣveko manmantropāsako bhavet ।। te te janā mantrapūtāścāgamiṣyanti matpadam ।। ।। 165 ।। anya thā ca bhaviṣyanti sarve golokavāsinaḥ ।। niṣphalaṃ bhavitā sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ caiva vedhasaḥ ।। 166 ।। janāḥ pañcaprakārāśca yuktāḥ sraṣṭurbhave bhave ।। pṛthivīvāsinaḥ kecitkecitsvarganivāsina ।। 167 ।। adhonivāsinaḥ kecidbrahmalokanivāsinaḥ ।। kecidvā vaiṣṇavāḥ kecinmama lokanivāsinaḥ ।। 168 ।। idaṃ kartuṃ mahādevaḥ karotu surasaṃsadi ।। pratijñāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ sadyastato mūrtiṃ ca paśyasi ।। 169 ।। ityevamuktvā gagane virarāma sanātanaḥ ।। taddṛṣṭvā ca jagannāthastamuvāca śivaṃ mudā ।। 170।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā jñāneśo jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। gaṅgātoyaṃ kare dhṛtvā svīcakāra vacastu saḥ ।। 171 ।। saṃyuktaṃ viṣṇumāyādyairmantrādyaiḥ śāstramuttamam ।। vedasāraṃ kariṣyāmi kṛṣṇājñāpālanāya ca ।। 172 ।। gaṃgātoyamupaspṛśya mithyā yadi vadejjanaḥ ।। sa yāti kālasūtraṃ ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 173 ।। ityukte śaṅkare brahmangoloke surasaṃsadi ।। āvirbabhūva śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā saha tatparaḥ ।। 174 ।। te taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca saṃhṛṣṭāḥ saṃstūya puruṣottamam ।। paramānandapūrṇāśca cakruśca punarutsavam ।। 175 ।। kālena śambhurbhagavāñchāstradīpaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sugopyaṃ ca sudurlabham ।। 176 ।। sā caivaṃ dravarūpā yā gaṅgā golokasambhavā ।। rādhākṛṣṇāṅgasambhūtā bhuktimuktiphalapradā ।। 177 ।। sthāne sthāne sthāpitā sā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। kṛṣṇasvarūpā paramā sarvabrahmāṇḍapūjitā ।। 178 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe gaṅgopākhyānaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ।।10।।
<2.11> nārada uvāca।। kaleḥ pañcasahasre sā samatīte sureśvarī ।। kva gatā sā mahābhāgā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।।1।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। bhārataṃ bhāratīśāpātsamāgatyeśvarecchayā ।। jagāma taṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ śāpānte punareva sā ।।2।। bhārataṃ bhāratī tyaktvā cāgamattaddhareḥ padam ।। padmāvatī ca śāpānte gaṃgāyāścaiva nārada ।।3।। gaṅgā sarasvatī lakṣmīścaitāstisraḥ priyā hareḥ।। tulasīsahitā brahmaṃścatasraḥ kīrttitāḥ śrutau।।4।। nārada uvāca ।। hetunā kena devī vai viṣṇupādābjasaṃbhavā ।। dhātuḥ kamaṇḍalusthā ca śaṅkarasya śirogatā ।। 5 ।। babhūva sā muniśreṣṭha gaṃgā nārāyaṇapriyā ।। aho kena prakāreṇa tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 6 ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। purā babhūva goloke sā gaṃgā dravarūpiṇī ।। rādhākṛṣṇāṃgasaṃbhūtā tadaṃśā tatsvarūpiṇī ।। 7 ।। dravādhiṣṭhātṛrūpā yā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ।। navayauvanasampannā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। 8 ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmāsyā sasmitā sumanoharā ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhā śaraccandrasamaprabhā ।। 9 ।। snigdhaprabhā'tisusnigdhā śuddhasattvasvarūpiṇī ।। supīnakaṭhinaśroṇī sunitambayugaṃ varam ।। 10 ।। pīnonnataṃ sukaṭhinaṃ stanayugmaṃ suvartulam ।। sucāru netrayugalaṃ sukaṭākṣaṃ suvakrimam ।। ।। 11 ।। vakrimaṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam ।। sindūrabindulalitaṃ sārddhaṃ candanabindubhiḥ ।। 12 ।। kastūrīpatrikāyuktaṃ gaṇḍayugmaṃ manoharam ।। bandhūkakusumākāramadharoṣṭhaṃ ca suṃdaram ।। 13 ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhadantapaṃktisamujjvalā ।। vāsasī vahniśuddhe ca nīvīyukte ca bibhratī ।। 14 ।। sā sakāmā kṛṣṇapārśve samuttasthe sulajjitā ।। padmapatrasamānābhyāṃ locanābhyāṃ vibho mukham ।। 15 ।। nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ ca pibantī satataṃ mudā ।। praphullavadanā harṣānnavasaṅgamalālasā ।। 15 ।। mūrcchitā prabhurūpeṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahā ।। etasminnantare tatra vidyamānā ca rādhikā ।। 17 ।। gopītriṃśatkoṭiyuktā koṭicandrasamaprabhā ।। kopena raktapadmāsyā raktapaṅkajalocanā ।। 18 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhā mattavāraṇagāminī।। amūlyaratnakhacitanānābharaṇabhūṣitā ।।19।। māṇikyakhacitaṃ hāramamūlyaṃ vahniśaucakam ।। pītābhavastrayugalaṃ nīvīyuktaṃ ca bibhratī ।। 20 ।। sthalapadmaprabhājuṣṭaṃ komalaṃ ca surañjitam ।। kṛṣṇadattārghyasaṃyuktaṃ vinyasyantī padāmbujam ।। 21 ।। ratnendrarājakhacitavimānādavaruhya ca ।। sevyamānā ca sakhibhiḥ śveta cāmaravāyunā ।। 22 ।। kastūrībindutilakaṃ candanendusamanvitam ।। dīptadīpaprabhākāraṃ sindūrāruṇasundaram ।। 23 ।। dadhatī bhālamadhye ca sīmantādhastadujjvalam ।। pārijātaprasūnādimālāyuktaṃ suvakrimam ।। 24 ।। sucārukabarībhāraṃ kampayantī ca kampitā ।। sucārunāsāsaṃyuktamoṣṭhaṃ kampayatī ruṣā ।। 25 ।। gatvā tasthau kṛṣṇapārśve ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। sakhīnāṃ ca samūhaiśca paripūrṇā vibhoḥ sabhā ।। 26 ।। tāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā samuttasthau kṛṣṇaḥ sādaramacyutaḥ ।। saṃbhāṣya madhurālāpaiḥ sasmitaśca sasaṃbhramaḥ ।। 27 ।। praṇemurabhi saṃtrastā gopā namrātmakandharāḥ ।। tuṣṭuvuste ca bhaktyā taṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। 28 ।। utthāya gaṃgā sahasā sambhāṣāṃ ca cakāra sā ।। kuśalaṃ paripapraccha bhītā'tivinayena ca ।। 29 ।। namrabhāvasthitā trastā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā ।। dhyānena śaraṇāpannā śrī kṛṣṇacaraṇambuje ।। 30 ।। taddhṛtpadme sthitaḥ kṛṣṇo bhītāyai cābhayaṃ dadau ।। babhūva sthiracittā sā sarveśvaravareṇa ca ।। 31 ।। ūrdhvaṃ siṃhāsanasthāṃ ca rādhāṃ gaṅgā dadarśa sā ।। susnigdhāṃ sukhadṛśyāṃ ca jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā ।। 32 ।। asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāmādyāṃ cādisṛṣṭiṃ sanātanīm ।। yathā dvādaśavarṣīyāṃ kanyāṃ ca navayauvanām ।। 33 ।। viśvavṛnde nirupamāṃ rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। śānta kāntāmanantāṃ tāmādyantarahitāṃ satīm ।। 34 ।। śubhāṃ subhadrāṃ subhagāṃ svāmisaubhāgyasaṃyutām ।। saundaryasundarīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ sundarīṣvakhilāsu ca ।। 39 ।। kṛṣṇārddhāṅgī kṛṣṇasamāṃ tejasā vayasā tviṣā ।। pūjitāṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ mahālakṣmīśvareṇa ca ।। 36 ।। pracchādyamānāṃ prabhayā sabhāmīśasya suprabhām ।। sakhīdattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ gṛhṇatīmanyadurlabham ।। 37 ।। ajanyāṃ sarvajananīṃ dhanyāṃ mānyāṃ ca māninīm ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevīṃ ca prāṇapriyatamāṃ ramām।।38।। dṛṣṭvā rāseśvarīṃ tṛptiṃ na jagāma sureśvarī ।। nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ ca loca nābhyāṃ papau ca tām।।39।। etasminnantare rādhā jagadīśamuvāca sā।। vācā madhurayā śāntā vinītā sasmitā mune।। 40।। rādhikovāca।। keyaṃ prāṇeśa kalyāṇī sasmitā tvanmukhāmbujam ।। paśyantī satataṃ pārśve sakāmā raktalocanā ।। 41 ।। mūrcchāṃ prāpnoti rūpeṇa pulakāṅkitavigrahā ।। vastreṇa mukhamācchādya nirīkṣantī punaḥ punaḥ ।। 42 ।। tvaṃ cāpi māṃ sannirīkṣya sakāmaḥ sasmitaḥ sadā ।। mayi jīvati goloke bhūtā durvṛttirīdṛśī ।। 43 ।। tvameva caivaṃ durvṛttaṃ vāraṃvāraṃ karoṣi ca ।। kṣamāṃ karomi te premṇā strījātiḥ snigdhamānasā ।। 44 ।। saṃgṛhyemāṃ priyāmiṣṭāṃ golokādgaccha lampaṭa ।। anyathā nahi te bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati sureśvara ।। 45 ।। dṛṣṭastvaṃ virajāyukto mayā candanakānane ।। kṣamā kṛtā mayā pūrvaṃ sakhīnāṃ vacanādaho ।। 46 ।। tvayā macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ purā ।। dehaṃ santyajya virajā nadīrūpā babhūva sā ।। 47 ।। koṭiyojanavistīrṇā tato dairghye caturguṇā ।। adyāpi vidyamānā sā tava satkī rtirūpiṇī ।। 48 ।। gṛhaṃ mayi gatāyāṃ ca punargatvā tadantikam ।। uccairarauṣīrviraje viraje ceti saṃsmaran ।। 49 ।। tadā toyātsamutthāya sā yogātsiddhayoginī ।। sālaṅkārā mūrtimatī dadau tubhyaṃ ca darśanam ।। 50 ।। tatastāṃ ca samāśliṣya vīryyādhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ।। tato babhūvustasyāṃ ca samudrāḥ sapta caiva hi ।। 51 ।। dṛṣṭastvaṃ śobhayā gopyā yuktaścampakakānane ।। sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ।।52।। śobhā dehaṃ parityajya prāviśaccandramaṇḍalam ।। tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca snigdhaṃ tejo babhūva ha ।। 53 ।। saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। ratnāya kiñcitsvarṇāya kiñcinmativarāya ca ।। 54 ।। kiñcitstrīṇāṃ mukhābjebhyaḥ kiñcidrājñe ca kiñcana ।। kiñcitprakṛṣṭavastrebhyo raupyebhyaścāpi kiñcana ।। 55 ।। kiñciccandanapaṅkebhyastoyebhyaścāpi kiñcana ।। kiñcitkisalayebhyaśca puṣpebhyaścāpi kiṃcana ।। 56 ।। kiñcitphalebhyaḥ sasyebhyaḥ supakvebhyaśca kiñcana ।। nṛpadevagṛhebhyaśca saṃskṛtebhyaśca kiṃcana ।। 57 ।। dṛṣṭastvaṃ prabhayā gopyā yukto vṛndāvane vane ।। sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ।। ।। 58 ।। prabhā dehaṃ parityajya prāviśatsūryyamaṇḍalam ।। tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ tejo babhūva ha ।। 59 ।। saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā ca rudatā purā ।। vibhajya cakṣuṣordattaṃ lajjayā tadbhayena ca ।। 60 ।। hutāśanāya kiṃcicca nṛpebhyaścāpi kiñcana ।। kiṃcitpuruṣasaṃghebhyo devebhyaścāpi kiṃcana ।। 61 ।। kiṃciddasyugaṇebhyaśca nāgebhyaścāpi kiṃcana ।। brāhmaṇebhyo munibhyaśca tapasvibhyaśca kiṃcana ।।62।। strībhyaḥ saubhāgyayuktābhyo yaśasvibhyaśca kiṃcana ।। tacca dattvā ca sarvebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ roditumudyataḥ ।।63।। śāntyā gopyā yutastvaṃ ca dṛṣṭo vai rāsamaṇḍale ।। vasante puṣpaśayyāyāṃ mālyavāṃścandanokṣitaḥ ।। 64 ।। ratnapradīpairyuktaśca ratnanirmitamandire ।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyo ratnabhūṣitayā saha ।। 69 ।। tvayā dattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavatyai suvāsitam ।। tayā dattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavāṃstvaṃ purā vibho ।।66।। sadyo macchabdamātreṇa tirodhānaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ।। śāntirdehaṃ parityajya bhiyā līnā tvayi prabho ।।67।। tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca guṇaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha ।। saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā ca rudatā purā ।। 68 ।। viśve viṣayiṇe kiṃcitsattvarūpāya viṣṇave ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpāyai kiṃcillakṣmyai purā vibho ।।69।। tvanmantropāsakebhyaśca vaiṣṇavebhyaśca kiṃcana ।। tapasvibhyaśca dharmāya dharmiṣṭhebhyaśca kiṃcana ।। 70।। mayā pūrvaṃ hi dṛṣṭastvaṃ gopyā ca kṣamayā saha ।। suveṣavānmālyavāṃśca gandhacandanasaṃyutaḥ।। ।। 71 ।। ratnabhūṣitayā cārucandanokṣitayā tayā ।। sukhena mūrchitastalpe puṣpacandanasaṃyute ।। 72 ।। śliṣṭo'bhūnnidrayā sadyaḥ sukhena navasaṅgamāt ।। mayā prabodhitau sā ca bhavāṃśca smaraṇaṃ kuru ।। 73 ।। gṛhītaṃ pītavastraṃ te muralī ca manoharā ।। vanamālā kaustubhaścāpyamūlyaṃ ratnakuṇḍalam ।।74।। paścātpradattaṃ premṇā ca sakhīnāṃ vacanādaho ।। lajjayā kṛṣṇavarṇo'bhūdadyāpi ca bhavānprabho ।।75।। kṣamā dehaṃ parityajya lajjayā pṛthivīṃ gatā ।। tatastasyāḥ śarīraṃ ca guṇaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha ।। 76 ।। saṃvibhajya tvayā dattaṃ premṇā ca rudatā purā ।। kiṃciddattaṃ viṣṇave ca vaiṣṇavebhyaśca kiṃcana ।। 77 ।। dharmiṣṭhebhyaśca dharmāya durbalebhyaśca kiṃcana ।। tapasvibhyo'pi devebhyaḥ paṃḍitebhyaśca kiṃcana ।। 78 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। tvadguṇaṃ bahuvistāraṃ jānāmi ca paraṃ prabho।।79।। ityevamuktvā sā rādhā raktapaṅkajalocanā ।। gaṅgāṃ vaktuṃ samārebhe namrāsyāṃ lajjitāṃ satīm ।। 80 ।। gaṅgā rahasyaṃ yogena jñātvā vai siddhayoginī ।। tirobhūya sabhāmadhyātsvajalaṃ praviveśa sā ।।81।। rādhā yogena vijñāya sarvatrāvasthitāṃ ca tām ।। pānaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe gaṇḍūṣātsiddhayoginī ।। 82 ।। gaṃgā rahasyaṃ yogena jñātvā vai siddhayoginī ।। śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojaṃ paramaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 83 ।। golokaṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmalokādikaṃ tathā ।। dadarśa rādhā sarvatra naiva gaṅgāṃ dadarśa sā ।। 84 ।। sarvato jalaśūnyaṃ ca śuṣkapaṅkajagolakam ।। jalajantusamūhaiśca mṛtadehaiḥ samanvitam ।। 85 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivānantadharmendrendudivākarāḥ ।। manavo mānavāḥ sarve devāḥ siddhāstapasvinaḥ ।। 86 ।। golokaṃ ca samājagmuḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ ।। sarve praṇemurgovindaṃ sarveśaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 87 ।। varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ variṣṭhaṃ varakāraṇam ।। vareśaṃ ca varārhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pravaraṃ prabhum ।। 88 ।। nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirliptaṃ ca nirāśrayam ।। nirguṇaṃ ca nirutsāhaṃ nirvyūhaṃ ca nirañjanam ।। 89 ।। svecchāmayaṃ ca sākāraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। satyasvarūpaṃ satyeśaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ sanātanam ।। ।। 90 ।। paraṃ pareśaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। praṇamya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।। 91 ।। sagadgadā sāśrunetrāḥ pulakāṅkitavigrahāḥ ।। sarve saṃstūya sarveśaṃ bhagavantaṃ paraṃ harim ।।92।। jyotirmayaṃ paraṃ brahma sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। amūlyaratnakhacitacitrasiṃhāsanasthitam ।। 93 ।। sevyamānaṃ ca gopālaiḥ śvetacāmaravāyunā ।। gopālikānṛtyagītaṃ paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। 94 ।। valguveṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ gopaiśca śatakoṭibhiḥ ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 95 ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ pītavāsasam ।। yathā dvādaśavarṣīyaṃ bālaṃ gopālarūpiṇam ।। 96 ।। koṭicandraprabhājuṣṭapuṣṭaśrīyuktavigraham ।। svatejasā parivṛtaṃ susādṛśyaṃ manoharam।। ।। 97 ।। koṭikandarpasaundaryyalīlālāvaṇyavigraham ।। dṛśyamānaṃ ca gopībhiḥ sasmitābhiśca santatam ।। 98 ।। bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitābhiśca mahāratnavinirmitaiḥ ।। pibantībhirlocanābhyāṃ mukhacandraṃ prabhormudā ।। 99 ।। prāṇādhikapriyatamārādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam ।। tayā pradattaṃ tāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ suvāsitam ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ rāse dadṛśuḥ sarvataḥ surāḥ ।। 100 ।। munayo mānavāḥ siddhāstapasā ca tapasvinaḥ ।। prahṛṣṭamānasāḥ sarve jagmuḥ paramavismayam ।। 101 ।। parasparaṃ samālocya te tamūcuścaturmukham ।। nivedituṃ jagannāthaṃ svābhiprāyamabhīpsitam ।। 102 ।। brahmā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sthitaṃ viṣṇostu dakṣiṇe ।। vāmato vāmadevasya cāgamatkṛṣṇamuttamam ।। 103 ।। paramānandayuktaṃ ca paramānandarūpakam ।। sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ dhātā cāpaśyadrāsamaṇḍale ।। 104 ।। sarvaṃ samānaveṣaṃ ca sabhānāsanasaṃsthitam ।। 105 ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। mayūrapucchacūḍaṃ ca kaustubhena virājitam ।। 106 ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ śāntavigraham ।। guṇabhūṣaṇarūpeṇa tejasā vayasā tviṣā ।। 107।। vāsasā yaśasā''kṛtyā mūrtyā sundarayā samam ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaiśvaryyasamanvitam ।। 108 ।। kaḥ sevyassevako veti dṛṣṭvā nirvaktumakṣamaḥ ।। kṣaṇaṃ tejaḥ svarūpaṃ ca rūparāśiyutaṃ kṣaṇam।।109।। ekameva kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhayā sahitaṃ param।। pratyekāsanasaṃsthaṃ ca tayā ca sahitaṃ kṣaṇam ।। 110।। rādhārūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇarūpakalatrakam ।। kiṃ strīrūpaṃ ca puṃrūpaṃ vidhātā dhyātumakṣamaḥ।।111।। hṛtpadmasthaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhātā dhyānena cetasā ।। cakāra stavanaṃ bhaktyā praṇamyātha tvanekadhā ।। 112 ।। tataḥ sa cakṣurunmīlya punaśca tadanujñayā ।। apaśyatkṛṣṇamekaṃ ca rādhāvakṣasthalasthitam ।। 113 ।। svapārṣadaiḥ parivṛtaṃ gopīmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ।। punaḥ praṇemustaṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvuśca punaśca te ।।114।। vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ tānuvāca sureśvaraḥ ।। sarvātmā sarvayajñeśaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ।। 115 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। āgaccha kuśalaṃ brahmannāgaccha kamalāpate ।। ihāgaccha mahādeva śaśvatkuśalamastu vaḥ ।। 116 ।। āgatāḥ stha mahābhāgā gaṅgānayanakāraṇāt ।। gaṃgā maccaraṇatmbhoje bhayena śaraṇaṃ gatā ।। 117 ।। rādhemāṃ pātumicchantī dṛṣṭvā matsannidhānataḥ ।। dāsyāmīmāṃ bahiḥ kṛtvā yūyaṃ kuruta nirbhayām ।। 118 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā sasmitaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ ।। tuṣṭāva sarvārādhyāṃ tāṃ rādhāṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjitām ।। 119 ।।। vaktraiścaturbhiḥ saṃstūya bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāmuvāca caturānanaḥ ।। 120 ।। gaṅgā tvadaṅgasambhūtā prabhorvai rāsamaṇḍale।। dravarūpā ca sā jātā mugdhayā śaṅkarasvarāt।।121।। kṛṣṇāṃśā ca tvadaṃśā ca tvatkanyāsadṛśī priyā।। tanmantragrahaṇaṃ kṛtvā karotu tava pūjanam।।122।। bhaviṣyati patistasyā vaikuṇṭhe ca caturbhujaḥ।। bhūgatāyāḥ kalāyāśca lavaṇodaśca vāridhiḥ।।123।। golokasthā ca yā rādhā sarvatrasthā tathātmikā ।। tadātmikā tvaṃ deveśi sarvadā ca tavātmajā ।। 124 ।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā svīcakāra ca sasmitā ।। bahirbabhūva sā kṛṣṇapādāṅguṣṭhanakhāgrataḥ ।।125।। tatraiva saṃvṛtā śāntā tasthau teṣāṃ ca madhyataḥ ।। uvāsa toyādutthāya tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। 126 ।। tattoyaṃ brahmaṇā kiñcitsthāpitaṃ ca kamaṇḍalau ।। kiṃciddadhāra śirasi candrārddhe candraśekharaḥ ।। 127 ।। gaṅgāyai rādhikāmantraṃ pradadau kamalodbhavaḥ ।। tatstotraṃ kavacaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ dhyānameva ca ।। 128 ।। sarvaṃ tatsāmavedoktaṃ puraścaryyākramaṃ tathā ।। gaṅgā tāmeva saṃpūjya vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau satī ।। 129 ।। lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṃgā tulasī viśvapāvanī ।। etā nārāyaṇasyaiva catasro yoṣito mune।। 130।। atha taṃ sasmitaḥ kṛṣṇo brahmāṇaṃ samuvāca ha।। sarvakālasya vṛttāntaṃ durbodhyamavipaścitām।।131।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। gṛhāṇa gaṃgāṃ he brahman he viṣṇo he maheśvara ।। śṛṇu kālasya vṛttāntaṃ yadatītaṃ niśāmaya ।। 132 ।। yūyaṃ ca ye'nyadevāśca munayo manavastathā ।। siddhāstapasvinaścaiva ye ye'traiva samāgatāḥ ।।133।। te te jīvanti goloke kālacakra vivarjite ।। jalāplutaṃ sarvaviśvamāgataṃ prākṛte laye ।। 134 ।। brahmādyā ye'nyaviśvasthāste līnā adhunā mayi ।। vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca vinā sarvaṃ sajalaṃ paśya padmaja ।। 135 ।। gatvā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru punarbrahmalokādikaṃ param ।। sabrahmāṇḍaṃ viracaya paścādgaṅgā ca yāsyati ।। 136 ।। evamanyeṣu viśveṣu sṛṣṭvā brahmādikaṃ punaḥ ।। karomyahaṃ punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ gaccha śīghraṃ suraiḥ saha ।। 137 ।। maccakṣuṣornimeṣeṇa brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet ।। gatāḥ katividhāste ca bhaviṣyanti ca vedhasaḥ ।। 138 ।। ityuktvā rādhikānātho jagāmāntaḥpuraṃ mune ।। devā gatvā punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ cakrureva prayatnataḥ ।।139।। goloke ca sthitā gaṃgā vaikuṇṭhe śivalokake।। brahmaloke tathā'nyatra yatra tatra purā sthitā ।। 140 ।। tatraiva sā gatā gaṃgā cājñayā paramātmanaḥ ।। nirgatā viṣṇupādābjāttena viṣṇupadī smṛtā ।। 141 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaṃgopākhyānamuttamam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 142 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṃgopākhyāne ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 11 ।।
<2.12> nārada uvāca ।। lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṃgā tulasī lokapāvanī ।। etā nārāyaṇasyaiva catasraśca priyā iti ।। 1 ।। gaṃgā jagāma vaikuṇṭhamidameva śrutaṃ mayā ।। kathaṃ sā tasya patnī ca babhūva brūhi keśava ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gaṃgā jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatpaścācca gato vidhiḥ ।। gatvovāca tayā sārddhaṃ praṇamya jagadīśvaram ।। 3 ।। brahmovāca ।। rādhākṛṣṇāgasaṃbhūtā yā devī dravarūpiṇī ।। tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevīyaṃ rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi ।। 4 ।। navayauvanasampannā suśīlā sundarī varā ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca krodhāhaṅkāravarjitā ।। 5 ।। yadaṅgasambhavā nānyaṃ vṛṇotīyaṃ ca taṃ vinā ।। tatrāpi māninī rādhā mahātejasvinī varā ।। 6 ।। samudyatā pātumimāṃ bhīteyaṃ buddhipūrvakam ।। viveśa caraṇāmbhoje kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 7 ।। sarvaṃ viśuṣkaṃ golokaṃ dṛṣṭvā'hamagamaṃ tadā ।। golākaṃ yatra kṛṣṇaśca sarvavṛttāntalabdhaye ।। 8 ।। sarvāntarātmā sarvaṃ no jñātvā'bhiprāyameva ca ।। bahiścakāra gaṃgāṃ ca pādāṅguṣṭhanakhāgrataḥ ।। 9 ।। dattvā'syai rādhikāmantraṃ pūrayitvā ca golakam ।। saṃpraṇamya ca rādheśaṃ gṛhītvā'trāgamaṃ vibho ।। 10 ।। gāndharveṇa vivāhena gṛhāṇemāṃ sureśvarīm ।। sureśvarastvaṃ rasiko rasikāṃ rasabhāvanaḥ ।। 11 ।। puṃratnaṃ puṃsu deveṣu strīratnaṃ strīṣviyaṃ satī ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhavet ।। 12 ।। upasthitāṃ ca yaḥ kanyāṃ na gṛhṇāti madena ca ।। taṃ vihāya mahālakṣī ruṣṭā yāti na saṃśayaḥ ।। ।। 13 ।। yo bhavetpaṇḍitaḥ so'pi prakṛtiṃ nāvamanyate ।। sarve prākṛtikāḥ puṃsaḥ kāminyaḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ ।। 14 ।। tvameva bhagavā nādyo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। arddhāṃgo dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo'pyardhāṃgena caturbhujaḥ ।। 15 ।। kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasambhūtā paramā rādhikā purā ।। dakṣiṇāṅgātsvayaṃ sā ca vāmāṅgātkamalā yathā ।। 16 ।। tena tvāṃ sā vṛṇotyeva yatastvaddehasambhavā ।। strīpuṃsau vai tathaikāṅgau yathā prakṛtipūruṣau ।। 17 ।। ityevamuktvā dhātā ca tāṃ samarpya jagāma saḥ ।। gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāṃ jagrāha hariḥ svayam ।। 18 ।। śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitām ।। reme ramāpatistatra gaṅgayā sahito mudā ।। 19 ।। gāṃ pṛthvīṃ ca gatā yasmātsvasthānaṃ punarāgatā ।। nirgatā viṣṇupādācca gaṅgā viṣṇupadī smṛtā ।। 20।। mūrcchāṃ samprāpa sā devī navasaṅgamamātrataḥ ।। rasikā sukhasambhogādrasikeśvarasaṃyutā ।।21।। taddṛṣṭvā duḥkhitā vāṇī sāpatnyerṣyāvivarjitā ।। nityamīrṣyati tāṃ vāṇī na ca gaṃgā sarasvatīm ।।22।। gaṅgayā sahitasyaiva tisro bhāryā ramāpateḥ ।। sārddhaṃ tulasyā paścācca catasro hyabhavanmune ।। 23 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṅgopākhyānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 12 ।।
<2.13> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇapriyā sādhvī kathaṃ sā ca babhūva ha।। tulasī kutra sambhūtā kā vā sā pūrvajanmani ।।1।। kasya vā sā kule jātā kasya kanyā tapasvinī ।। kena vā tapasā sā ca saṃprāpa prakṛteḥ param ।। 2 ।। nirvikalpaṃ nirīhaṃ ca sarvasākṣisvarūpakam ।। nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram।। ।।3।। sarvārādhyaṃ ca sarveśaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam ।। sarvādhāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ paripālanam ।।4।। kathametādṛśī devī vṛkṣatvaṃ samavāpa ha।। kathaṃ sā'pyasuragrastā saṃbabhūva tapasvinī ।। 5 ।। sandigdhaṃ me mano lolaṃ prerayenmāṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।। chettumarhasi sandehaṃ sarvasandehabhañjanā। ।। 6 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। manuśca dakṣasāvarṇiḥ puṇyavānvaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ ।। yaśasvī kīrtimāṃścaiva viṣṇoraṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। 7 ।। tatputro dharmasāvarṇirdharmiṣṭho vaiṣṇavaḥ śuciḥ ।। tatputro viṣṇusāvarṇirvaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ ।। 8 ।। tatputro devasāvarṇirviṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ।। tatputro rājasāvarṇirmahāviṣṇuparāyaṇaḥ ।। 9 ।। vṛṣadhvajaśca tatputro vṛṣadhvajaparāyaṇaḥ ।। yasyāśrame svayaṃ śambhurāsīddaivayugatrayam ।। 10 ।। putrādapi paraḥ sneho nṛpe tasmiñchivasya ca ।। na ca nārāyaṇaṃ mene na ca lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm ।। 11 ।। pūjāṃ ca sarvadevānāṃ dūrībhūtāṃ cakāra saḥ ।। bhādre māsi mahālakṣmīpūjāṃ matto'tyajannṛpaḥ ।। 12 ।। māghe sarasvatīpūjāṃ dūrībhūtāṃ cakāra saḥ ।। yajñaṃ ca viṣṇupūjāṃ ca nininde na cakāra saḥ ।। 13 ।। na ko'pi devo bhūpendraṃ śaśāpa śivakāraṇāt ।। bhraṣṭaśrīrbhava bhūpeti cāśapattaṃ divākaraḥ ।। 14 ।। śūlaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ sūryyaṃ dhṛtavācchaṅkaraḥ svayam ।। pitrā sārddha dineśaśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 15 ।। śivastriśūlahastaśca brahmalokaṃ yayau krudhā ।। brahmā sūryyaṃ puraskṛtya vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yayau bhiyā ।। 16 ।। śūlaṃ gṛhītvā tatrāpi dhṛtavāñchaṅkaro ravim ।। brahmakaśyapamārttaṇḍāḥ saṃtrastāḥ śuṣkatālukāḥ ।। 17 ।। nārāyaṇaṃ ca sarveśaṃ te yayuḥ śaraṇaṃ bhiyā ।। mūrdhnā praṇemuste gatvā tuṣṭuvuśca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 18 ।। sarve nivedanaṃ cakrurbhiyaste kāraṇaṃ harau ।। 19 ।। nārāyaṇaśca kṛpayā'bhayaṃ tebhyo dadau mune ।। sthirā bhavata he bhītā bhayaṃ kiṃ vo mayi sthite।। 20।। smaranti ye yatra tatra māṃ vipattau bhayānvitāḥ ।। tāṃstatra gatvā rakṣāmi cakra hastastvarānvitaḥ ।। 21 ।। pātā'haṃ jagatāṃ devaḥ karttā'haṃ satataṃ sadā ।। sṛṣṭvā ca brahmarūpeṇa saṃharttā śivarūpataḥ ।। 22 ।। śivo'haṃ tvamahaṃ cāpi sūryyo'haṃ triguṇātmakaḥ ।। vidhāya nānārūpaṃ ca kuryāṃ sṛṣṭyādikāḥ kriyāḥ ।। 23 ।। yūyaṃ gacchata bhadraṃ vo bhaviṣyati bhayaṃ kutaḥ ।। adyaprabhṛti vo nāsti madvarācchaṅkarādbhayam ।। 24 ।। āśutoṣaḥ sa bhagavāñcharaṇyaśca satāṃ gatiḥ ।। bhaktādhīnaśca bhakteśo bhaktātmā bhaktavatsalaḥ ।।25।। sudarśanaṃ śivaścaiva mama prāṇādhikapriyau ।। brahmāṇḍeṣu na tejasvī he brahmannanayoḥ paraḥ।। 26 ।। śaktaḥ sraṣṭuṃ mahādevaḥ sūryyakoṭiṃ ca līlayā ।। koṭiṃ ca brahmaṇāmevaṃ kimasādhyaṃ ca śūlinaḥ ।। 27 ।। bāhyajñānaṃ tanna kiṃciddhyāyato māṃ divāniśam ।। mannāma madgaṇaṃ bhaktyā pañcavaktreṇa gīyate ।।28।। ahameva cintayāmi tatkalyāṇaṃ divāniśam ।। ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham ।। 29 ।। śivasvarūpo bhagavāñchivādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। śivo bhavati yasmācca śivaṃ tena vidurbudhāḥ ।। 30 ।। etasminnantare tatra cāgamacchaṅkaraḥ svayam ।। śūlahasto vṛṣārūḍho raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ ।। 31 ।। avaruhya vṛṣāttūrṇaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। nanāma bhaktyā taṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ parātparam ।। 32 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitam ।। kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ cakriṇaṃ vanamālinam ।। 33 ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ ca caturbhujam ।। caturbhujaiḥ sevitaṃ ca śvetacāmaravāyunā ।। 34 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasā।। lakṣmīpradattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca nārada ।। 35 ।। vidyādharīnṛtyagītaṃ śṛṇvantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। īśvaraṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 36 ।। taṃ nanāma mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ ca nanāma saḥ ।। nanāma sūryyo bhaktyā ca saṃtrastaścandraśekharam ।। 37 ।। kaśyapaśca mahābhaktyā tuṣṭāva ca nanāma ca ।। śivaḥ saṃstūya sarveśaṃ samuvāsa sukhāsane ।। ।। 38 ।। sukhāsane sukhāsīnaṃ viśrāntaṃ candraśekharam ।। śvetacāmaravātena sevitaṃ viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ ।। 39 ।। akrodhaṃ sattvasaṃsargātprasannaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। stūyamānaṃ pañcavaktraiḥ paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum ।। 40 ।। tamuvāca prasannātmā prasannaṃ surasaṃsadi ।। pīyūṣatulyaṃ madhuraṃ vacanaṃ sumanoharam ।। 41 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। atyantamupahāsyaṃ ca śivapraśnaṃ śive śivam ।। laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ caiva tvāṃ pṛcchāmi tathā 'pi śam।।42।। tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām।। sampatpraśnaṃ tapaḥpraśnamayogyaṃ tvāṃ ca sāmpratam।।43।। jñānādhideve sarvajñe jñānaṃ pṛcchāmi kiṃ vṛthā ।। nirāpadi vipatpraśnamalaṃ mṛtyuñjaye hare ।।44।। tvāmeva vāgdhanaṃ praśnamalaṃ svāśrayamāgame ।। āgato'si kathaṃ vegādityuvāca ramāpatiḥ ।। 45 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। vṛṣadhvajaṃ ca madbhaktaṃ mama prāṇādhikapriyam ।। sūryyaḥ śaśāpa iti me heturāgamakopayoḥ ।। 46 ।। putravātsalyaśokena sūryyaṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ ।। sa brahmāṇaṃ prapannaśca sa sūryyaśca vidhistvayi ।।47।। tvāṃ ye śaraṇamāpannā dhyānena vacasā'pi vā ।। nirāpadaste niśśaṅkā jarā mṛtyuśca tairjitaḥ ।। 48 ।। sākṣādye śaraṇāpannāstatphalaṃ kiṃ vadāmi bhoḥ ।। harismṛtiścābhayadā sarvamaṅgaladā sadā ।। 49 ।। kiṃ me bhaktasya bhavitā tanme brūhi jagatprabho ।। śrīhatasyāsya mūḍhasya sūryyaśāpena hetunā ।। 50 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। kālo'tiyāto daivena yugānāmekaviṃśatiḥ ।। vaikuṇṭhe ghaṭikārddhena śīghraṃ yāhi nṛpālayam।। ।।51।। vṛṣadhvajo mṛtaḥ kālāddurnivāryyātsudāruṇāt ।। haṃsadhvajaśca tatputro mṛtaḥ so'pi śriyā hataḥ ।।52।। tatputrau ca mahābhāgau dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau ।। hataśriyau sūryyaśāpāttau vai paramavaiṣṇavau ।। 53 ।। rājyabhraṣṭau śriyā bhraṣṭau kamalātāpasāvubhau ।। tayośca bhāryyayorlakṣmīḥ kalayā ca janiṣyati ।।54।। sampadyuktau tadā tau ca nṛpaśreṣṭhau bhaviṣyataḥ ।। mṛtaste sevakaḥ śambho gaccha yūyaṃ ca gacchata।।55।। ityuktvā ca salakṣmīkaḥ sabhāto'bhyantaraṃ gataḥ ।। devā jagmuśca saṃhṛṣṭāḥ svāśramaṃ paramaṃ mudā।।56।। śivaśca tapase śīghraṃ paripūrṇatamo yayau।।57।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tulasyupākhyāne trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ।।13।।
<2.14> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। lakṣmīṃ tau ca samārādhya cogreṇa tapasā mune ।। pratyekaṃ varamiṣṭaṃ ca saṃprāpaturabhīpsitam ।। 1 ।। mahālakṣmyā vareṇaiva tau pṛdhvīśau babhūvatuḥ।। dhanavantau putravantau dharmadhvajakuśadhvajau।।2।। kuśadhvajasya patnī ca devī mālāvatī satī ।। sā suṣāva ca kālena kamalāṃśāṃ sutāṃ satīm ।। 3 ।। sā ca bhūtalasambandhājjñānayuktā babhūva ha ।। kṛtvā vedadhvaniṃ spaṣṭamuttasthau sūtikāgṛhe। ।। 4 ।। vedadhvaniṃ sā cakāra jātamātreṇa kanyakā ।। tasmāttāṃ te vedavatīṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 5 ।। jātamātreṇa susnātā jagāma tapase vanam ।। sarvairniṣiddhā yatnena nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ।। 6 ।। ekamanvantaraṃ caiva puṣkare ca tapasvinī ।। atyugrāṃ vai tapasyāṃ tu līlayā ca cakāra sā ।। 7 ।। tathā'pi puṣṭā na kṛśā navayauvanasaṃyutā ।। śuśrāva khe ca sahasā sā vācamaśarīriṇīm ।। ।। 8 ।। janmāntare te bharttā ca bhaviṣyati hariḥ svayam ।। brahmādibhirdurārādhyaṃ patiṃ lapsyasi sundari ।। 9 ।। iti śrutvā tu sā ruṣṭā cakāra ca punastapaḥ ।। atīva nirjanasthāne parvate gandhamādane ।। 10 ।। tatraivaṃ suciraṃ taptvā viśvasya samuvāsa sā ।। dadarśa puratastatra rāvaṇaṃ durnivāraṇam ।। 11 ।। dṛṣṭvā sā'tithibhaktyā ca pādyaṃ tasmai dadau kila ।। susvādu phalamūlaṃ ca jalaṃ cāpi suśītalam ।। 12 ।। tacca bhuktvā sa pāpiṣṭhaścāvātsīttatsamīpataḥ ।। cakāra praśnamiti tāṃ kā tvaṃ kalyāṇi ceti ca ।। 13 ।। tāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā varārohāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām ।। śaratpadmanibhāsyāṃ ca sasmitāṃ sudatīṃ satīm ।। 14 ।। mūrcchāmavāpa kṛpaṇaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ।। tāṃ kareṇa samākṛṣya sambhogaṃ kartumudyataḥ ।। 15 ।। sā satī kopadṛṣṭyā ca stambhitaṃ taṃ cakāra ha ।। sa jaḍo hastapādaiśca kiṃcidvaktuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ ।। 16 ।। tuṣṭāva manasā devīṃ padmāṃśāṃ padmalocanām।। sā tatstavena santuṣṭā prākṛtaṃ taṃ mumoca ha।।17।। śaśāpa ca madarthe tvaṃ vinaśyasi sabāndhavaḥ ।। spṛṣṭā'haṃ ca tvayā kāmādvisṛjāmyavalokaya ।। 18 ।। ityuktvā sā ca yogena dehatyāgaṃ cakāra ha ।। gaṃgāyāṃ tāṃ ca saṃnyasya sva gṛhaṃ rāvaṇo yayau ।। 19 ।। aho kimadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ vā mayā'dhunā ।। iti saṃcintya saṃsmṛtya vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ ।। ।। 20 ।। sā ca kālāntare sādhvī babhūva janakātmajā।। sītādevīti vikhyātā yadarthe rāvaṇo hataḥ ।। 21 ।। mahātapasvinī sā ca tapasā pūrvajanmanaḥ ।। lebhe rāmaṃ ca bharttāraṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ harim ।।22।। saṃprāpya tapasā''rādhya svāminaṃ ca jagatpatim।। sā ramā suciraṃ reme rāmeṇa saha sundarī ।।23।। jātismarā sma smarati tapasaśca kramaṃ purā ।। sukhena tajjahau sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ cāpi sukhaṃ labhet ।। ।। 24 ।। nānāprakāravibhavaṃ cakāra suciraṃ satī ।। samprāpya sukumāraṃ tamatīva navayauvanam ।। 25 ।। guṇinaṃ rasikaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaveṣamanuttamam ।। strīṇāṃ manojñaṃ ruciraṃ tathā lebhe yathepsitam ।। 26 ।। piturvacaḥpālanārthaṃ satyasandho raghūttamaḥ।। jagāma kānanaṃ paścātkālena ca balīyasā ।। 27 ।। tasthau samudranikaṭe sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca ।। dadarśa tatra vahniṃ ca viprarūpadharaṃ hariḥ ।। 28 ।। taṃ rāmaṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa ca duḥkhī babhūva ha ।। uvāca kiṃcitsatyeṣṭaṃ satyaṃ satyaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 29 ।। vahniruvāca।। bhagavañchrūyatāṃ vākyaṃ kālena yadupasthitam ।। sītāharaṇakālo'yaṃ tavaiva samupasthitaḥ ।। 30 ।। daivaṃ ca durnivāryyaṃ vai na ca daivātparaṃ balam ।। matprasū mayi saṃnyasya cchāyāṃ rakṣāntike'dhunā ।।31।। dāsyāmi sītāṃ tubhyaṃ ca parīkṣāsamaye punaḥ ।। devaiḥ prasthāpito'haṃ ca na ca vipro hutāśanaḥ ।। 32 ।। rāmastadvacanaṃ śrutvā na prakāśya ca lakṣmaṇam ।। svacchandaṃ svīcakārāsau hṛdayena vidūyatā ।।33।। vahniryogena sītāvanmāyāsītāṃ cakāra ha ।। tattulyaguṇarūpāṃ tāṃ dadau rāmāya nārada ।। 34 ।। sītāṃ gṛhītvā sa yayau gopyaṃ vaktuṃ niṣedhya ca ।। lakṣmaṇo naiva bubudhe gopyamanyasya kā kathā ।। 39 ।। etasminnantare rāmo dadarśa kanakaṃ mṛgam ।। sītā taṃ prerayāmāsa tadarthe yatnapūrvakam ।। 36 ।। saṃnyasya lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo jānakyā rakṣaṇe vane ।। svayaṃ jagāma hantuṃ taṃ vivyadhe sāyakena ca ।। 37 ।। lakṣmaṇeti ca śabdaṃ vai kṛtvā māyāmṛgastadā ।। prāṇāṃstatyāja sahasā puro dṛṣṭvā hariṃ smaran ।। 38 ।। mṛgarūpaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।। ratnanirmitayānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa jagāma ha ।। 39 ।। vaikuṇṭhasya mahādvāraṃ kiṅkaro dvārapālayoḥ ।। jaya vijayayoścaiva balavāṃśca jayābhidhaḥ ।। 40 ।। śāpena sanakādīnāṃ samprāpto rākṣasīṃ tanum ।। punarjagāma taddvāramādau sa dvārapālayoḥ ।।41।। atha śabdaṃ ca sā śrutvā lakṣmaṇeti ca viklavam ।। sītā taṃ prerayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmasannidhau ।।42।। gate ca lakṣmaṇe rāmaṃ rāvaṇo durnivāraṇaḥ ।। sītāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau laṅkāmeva svalīlayā ।। 43 ।। viṣasāda ca rāmaśca vane dṛṣṭvā ca lakṣmaṇam ।। tūrṇaṃ ca svāśramaṃ gatvā sītāṃ naiva dadarśa saḥ ।। 44 ।। mūrcchāṃ samprāpya suciraṃ vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ punaḥ ।। punarbabhrāma gahane tadanveṣaṇapūrvakam ।। 45 ।। kāle saṃprāpya tadvārtāṃ gṛdhadvārā nadītaṭe ।। sahāyaṃ vānaraṃ kṛtvā cābadhnātsāgaraṃ hariḥ ।। ।। 46 ।। laṅkāṃ gatvā raghuśreṣṭhaścāvadhītsāyakena ca ।। sabāndhavaṃ rāvaṇaṃ ca sītāṃ samprāpa duḥkhitām ।। 47 ।। tāṃ ca vahniparīkṣāṃ va kārayāmāsa satvaram ।। hutāśanastatra kāle vāstavīṃ jānakīṃ dadau ।। 48 ।। chāyā covāca vahniṃ ca rāmaṃ ca vinayānvitā ।। kariṣyāmīti kimahaṃ tadupāyaṃ vadasva me ।। 49 ।। vahniruvāca ।। tvaṃ gaccha tapase devi puṣkaraṃ ca supuṇyadam ।। kṛtvā tapasyāṃ tatraiva svargalakṣmīrbhaviṣyasi ।। 50 ।। sā ca tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratepe puṣkare tapaḥ ।। divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣa ca svarge lakṣmīrbabhūva ha।।51।। sā ca kālena tapasā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā ।। kāminī pāṇḍavānāṃ ca draupadī drupadātmajā ।। 52 ।। kṛte yuge vedavatī kuśadhvajasutā śubhā ।। tretāyāṃ rāmapatnī ca sīteti janakātmajā ।। 53 ।। tacchāyā draupadī devī dvāpare drupadātmajā ।। trihāyaṇīti sā proktā vidyamānā yugatraye ।।54।। nārada uvāca ।। priyāḥ pañca kathaṃ tasyā babhūvurmunipuṅgava ।। iti vai cittasandehaṃ dūrīkuru mahāprabho।।55।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। laṅkāyāṃ vastutaḥ sītā rāmaṃ saṃprāpa nārada ।। rūpayauvanasampannā chāyā sā bahuvihvalā ।।56।। rāmāgnyorājñayā taptvā yayāce śaṅkaraṃ varam।। kāmāturā pativyagrā prārthayantī punaḥ punaḥ।।57।। patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi trilocana।। patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi pañcavāraṃ pativratā ।।58।। śivastatprārthanāṃ śrutvā sasmito rasikeśvaraḥ ।। priye tava priyāḥ pañca bhavantīti varaṃ dadau ।। 59 ।। tenāsītpāṇḍavānāṃ ca pañcānāṃ kāminī priyā ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ prastutaṃ vastutaḥ śṛṇu।। 60।। atha saṃprāpya laṅkāyāṃ sītāṃ rāmo manoharām।। vibhīṣaṇāya tāṃ laṅkāṃ dattvā'yodhyāṃ yayau punaḥ।।61।। ekādaśasahasrābdaṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ ca bhārate ।। jagāma sarvairlokaiśca sārddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhameva ca ।।62।। kamalāṃśā vedavatī kamalāyāṃ viveśa sā ।। kathitaṃ puṇyamākhyānaṃ puṇyadaṃ pāpanāśanam ।। 63 ।। satataṃ mūrtimantaśca vedāścatvāra eva ca ।। santi yasyāśca jihvāgre sā ca vedavatī smṛtā ।। 64 ।। kuśadhvajasutākhyānamuktaṃ saṃkṣepatastava ।। dharmadhvajasutākhyānaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 65 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tulasyupākhyāne vedavatīprastāve caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 14 ।।
<2.15> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dharmadhvajasya patnī ca mādhavīti ca viśrutā।। nṛpeṇa sārddhaṃ sā rāgādreme vai gandhamādane ।। 1 ।। śayyāṃ ratikarīṃkṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitā ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgī puṣpacandanavāyunā ।। 2 ।। strīratnamaticārvaṃgī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। kāmukī rasikaśreṣṭhā rasikeśena saṃgatā ।। 3 ।। suratādviratirnāsīttayoḥ suratavijñayoḥ ।। gataṃ varṣaśataṃ daivaṃ nājānītāṃ divāniśam।।4।। tato rajasvalāṃ prāpya suratādvirarāma saḥ ।। kāmukī sundarī kiṃcinna ca tṛptiṃ jagāma sā ।।5।। dadhāra garbhaṃ sā sadyo devābdaśatakaṃ satī ।। śrīgarbhā śrīyutā sā ca saṃbabhūva dinedine ।। 6 ।। śubhakṣaṇe śubhadine śubhayogena saṃyute ।। śubhalagne śubhāṃśe ca śubhasvāmigṛhānvite ।। 7 ।। kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca sitavāre ca padmaje ।। suṣāva sā ca padmāṃśāṃ padminīṃ sumanoharām ।। 8 ।। pādapadmayuge caiva padmarāgavirājitām ।। rājarājeśvarīṃ lakṣmīṃ sarvāvayavasundarīm ।। 9 ।। rājalakṣmīlakṣmayuktāṃ rājalakṣmyadhidevatām ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ।। 10 ।। pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca paśyantīṃ sasmitāṃ gṛham ।। hastapādatalāraktāṃ nimnanābhiṃ manoramām ।। 11 ।। tadadhastrivalīyuktāṃ vṛttavalgunitambinīm।। śīte sukhoṣṇasarvāṃgīṃ grīṣme ca sukhaśītalām ।। 12 ।। śyāmāṃ sukeśīṃ rucirāṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalām ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ sundarīṣvekasundarīm ।। 13 ।। narā nāryyaśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tulanāṃ dātumakṣamāḥ ।। tena nāmnā ca tulasīṃ tāṃ vadanti purāvidaḥ ।। 14 ।। sā ca bhūmiṣṭhamātreṇa yogyā strīprakṛtiryathā ।। sarvairniṣiddhā tapase jagāma badarīvanam ।। 15 ।। tatra daivābdalakṣaṃ ca cakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ।। mama nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī bhaviteti viniścitā ।।
