16 ।। grīṣme pañcatapāḥ śīte toyasthā sā ca sundarī ।। prakāśasthā vṛṣṭidhārāṃ sahantī ca divāniśam ।। ।। 17 ।। viṃśatsahasravarṣaṃ ca phalatoyāśanā ca sā ।। triṃśacchatasahasrābdaṃ patrāhārā tapasvinī ।। 18 ।। catvāriṃśatsahasrābdaṃ vāyvāhārā kṛśodarī।। tato daśasahasrābdaṃ nirāhārā babhūva sā।।19।। nirlakṣyāṃ caikapādasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kamalodbhavaḥ।। samāyayau varaṃ dātuṃ paraṃ badarikāśramam ।। 20 ।। caturmukhaṃ ca sā dṛṣṭvā prāṇaṃsīddhaṃsavāhanam ।। tāmuvāca jagatkartā vidhātā jagatāmapi ।। 21 ।। brahmovāca ।। varaṃ vṛṇuṣva tulasi yatte manasi vāñchitam ।। haribhaktiṃ ca muktiṃ vā'pyajarāmaratāmapi ।। 22 ।। tulasyuvāca ।। śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi yanme manasi vāñchitam ।। sarvajñasyāpi purataḥ kā lajjā mama sāmpratam ।। 23 ।। ahaṃ ca tulasī gopī goloke'haṃ sthitā purā ।। kṛṣṇapriyā kiṅkarī ca tadaṃśā tatsakhī priyā ।। 24 ।। govindena sahāsaktāmatṛptāṃ māṃ ca mūrcchitām ।। rāseśvarī samāgatya cāpaśyadrāsamaṇḍale।।25।। govindaṃ bhartsayāmāsa māṃ śaśāpa ruṣā'nvitā।। yāhi tvaṃ mānavīṃ yonimityevaṃ ca pitāmaha।।26।। māmuvāca sa govindo madaṃśaṃ tvaṃ caturbhujam ।। labhiṣyasi tapastaptvā bhārate brahmaṇo varāt ।। 27 ।। ityevamuktvā deveśo'pyantardhānamavāpa saḥ ।। devyā bhiyā tanuṃ tyaktvā labdhaṃ janma mayā bhuvi ।। 28 ।। ahaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ śāntaṃ sundavigraham ।। sāmprataṃ labdhumicchāmi varamevaṃ ca dehi me ।। 29 ।। brahmovāca ।। sudāmā nāma gopaśca śrīkṛṣṇāṅgasamudbhavaḥ ।। tadaṃśaścātitejasvī cālabhajjanma bhārate ।। 30 ।। sāmprataṃ rādhikāśāpāddanuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। śaṅkhacūḍa iti khyātastrailākye na ca tatparaḥ ।। 31 ।। goloke tvāṃ purā dṛṣṭvā kāmonmathitamānasaḥ ।। vilaṃghituṃ na śaknoti rādhikāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।। 32 ।। sa ca jātismarastaptvā tvāṃ lalābha vareṇa ca ।। jātismarā tu tvamapi sarvaṃ jānāsi sundari ।। 33 ।। adhunā tasya patnī ca bhava bhāvini śobhane ।। paścānnārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ śāntameva labhiṣyasi ।। 34 ।। śāpānnārāyaṇasyaiva kalayā daivayogataḥ ।। prāpnoṣi vṛkṣarūpaṃ taṃ tvaṃ pūtā viśvapāvanī ।। 35 ।। pradhānā sarvapuṣpāṇāṃ viṣṇuprāṇādhikā bhavet ।। tvayā vinā ca sarveṣāṃ pūjā ca viphalā bhavet ।।36।। vṛndāvane vṛkṣarūpā nāmnā vṛndāvanīti ca ।। tvatpatrairgopikā gopāḥ pūjayiṣyanti mādhavam।।37।। vṛkṣādhidevīrūpeṇa sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇena santatam।। vihariṣyasi gopena svacchandaṃ madvareṇa ca।।38।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sasmitā hṛṣṭamānasā।। praṇanāma ca dhātāraṃ taṃ ca kiṃciduvāca ha।।39।। tulatyuvāca।। yathā me dvibhuje kṛṣṇe vāñchā ca śyāmasundare।। satyaṃ bravīmi he tāta na tathā ca caturbhuje।। 40।। atṛptā'haṃ ca govinde daivācchṛṅgārabhaṃgataḥ ।। govindasyaiva vacanātprārthayāmi caturbhujam।।41।। tatprasādena govindaṃ punareva sudurlabham ।। dhruvameva labhiṣyāmi rādhā bhītiṃ pramocaya ।। 42 ।। brahmovāca ।। gṛhāṇa rādhikāmantraṃ dade vai ṣoḍaśākṣaram ।। tasyāśca prāṇatulyā tvaṃ madvareṇa bhaviṣyasi।।43।। śṛṃgāraṃ yuvayorgopyamājñāsyati ca rādhikā ।। rādhāsamā tvaṃ subhagā govindasya bhaviṣyasi ।। 44 ।। ityevamuktvā dattvā ca devyai tatṣoḍaśākṣaram ।। mantraṃ tasyai jagaddhātā stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ param ।। 45 ।। sarvaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca puraścaryāvidhikramam ।। paraṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā so'ntarddhānamavāpa ha ।। 46 ।। sā ca brahmopadeśena puṇye badarikāśrame ।। jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ yadiṣṭaṃ pūrvajanmanaḥ ।। 47 ।। divyaṃ dvādaśavarṣaṃ ca pūjāṃ caiva cakāra sā ।। babhūva siddhā sā devī tatpratyādeśamāpa ca ।। 48 ।। siddhe tapasi mantre ca varaṃ prāpya yathepsitam ।। bubhuje ca mahābhāgaṃ yadviśveṣu sudurlabham ।। 49 ।। prasannamānasā devī tatyāja tapasaḥ klamam ।। siddhe phale narāṇāṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca sukhamuttamam ।। 50 ।। bhuktvā pītvā ca santuṣṭā śayanaṃ ca cakāra sā ।। talpe manorame tatra puṣpacandanacarcite ।। 51 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tulasyupākhyāne tulasīvarapradānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ।।15।।
<2.16> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। tulasī parituṣṭā sā cāsvāpsīddhṛṣṭamānasā ।। navayauvanasampannā praśaṃsantī varāṃganā ।। 1 ।। cikṣepa pañcabāṇaśca pañca bāṇāṃśca tāṃ prati ।। puṣpāyudhena sā dagdhā puṣpacandanacarcitā ।। 2 ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṃgī kampitā raktalocanā ।। kṣaṇaṃ sā śuṣkatāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ha ।।3।। kṣaṇamudvignatāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ tandrāṃ sukhāvahām ।। kṣaṇaṃ sā dahanaṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ prāpa pramattatām।।4।। kṣaṇaṃ sā cetanāṃ prāpa kṣaṇaṃ prāpa viṣaṇṇatām ।। uttiṣṭhantī kṣaṇaṃ talpādgacchantī nikaṭaṃ kṣaṇam ।। 5।। bhramantī kṣaṇamudvegādvivasantī kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ ।। kṣaṇameva samudvegādasvāpsītpunareva sā ।। 6 ।। puṣpacandanatalpaṃ ca tadbabhūvātikaṇṭakam ।। viṣamāhārakaṃ svādu divyarūpaṃ phalaṃ jalam ।।7।। nilayaśca nirākāraḥ sūkṣmavastraṃ hutāśanaḥ।। sindūrapatrakaṃ caiva vraṇatulyaṃ ca duḥkhadam।।8।। kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa tandrāyāṃ suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ satī।। sundaraṃ ca yuvānaṃ ca sasmitaṃ rasikeśvaram।।9।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam।। āgacchantaṃ mālyavantaṃ paśyantaṃ tanmukhāmbujam ।। 10 ।। kathayantaṃ ratikathāṃ cumbantamadharaṃ muhuḥ ।। śayānaṃ puṣpatalpe ca samāśliṣyantamaṅgakam ।। 11 ।। punareva tu gacchantamāgacchantaṃ vasantakam ।। kānta kva yāsi prāṇeśa tiṣṭhetyevamuvāca sā ।। 12 ।। punaḥ svacetanāṃ prāpya vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ ।। evaṃ tapovane sā ca tasthau tatraiva nārada ।। 13 ।। śaṅkhacūḍo mahāyogī jaigīṣavyānmanoramam ।। kṛṣṇasya mantraṃ samprāpya prāpya siddhiṃ tu puṣkare ।। 14 ।। paṭhansadā tu kavacaṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। brahmeśācca varaṃ prāpya yattanmanasi vāñchitam ।।15।। ājñayā brahmaṇaḥ so'pi badarīṃ vai samāyayau ।। āgacchantaṃ śaṅkhacūḍamapaśyattulasī mune।।16।। navayauvanasampannaṃ kāmadevasamaprabham।।17।। śvetacampakavarṇābhaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam ।। 18 ।। mahāratnagaṇāklṛptavimānasthaṃ manoharam ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmāḍhyagaṇḍasthalavirājitam ।। 19 ।। pārijātaprasūnāḍhyamālyavantaṃ ca susmitam ।। kastūrīkuṅkumayutaṃ sugandhitilakojjvalam।। 20।। sā dṛṣṭvā sannidhāne taṃ mukhamācchādya vāsasā ।। sasmitā taṃ nirīkṣantī sakaṭākṣaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।।21।। babhūva sā namramukhī navasaṅgamalajjitā।। kāmukī kāmabāṇena pīḍitā pulakānvitā ।। 22 ।। pibantī tanmukhāmbhojaṃ locanābhyāṃ ca santatam ।। dadarśa śaṅkhacūḍaśca kanyāmekāṃ tapovane ।। 23 ।। puṣpacandanatalpasthāṃ vasantīṃ vāsasā vṛtām ।। paśyantīṃ tanmukhaṃ śaśvatsasmitāṃ sumanoharām ।।24।। supīnakaṭhinaśroṇīṃ pīnonnatapayodharām।। muktāpaṃktiprabhājuṣṭadantapaṃktiṃ subibhratīm ।।25।। pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca sunāsāṃ sundarīṃ varām ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ śaraccandrasamaprabhām ।। 26 ।। svatejasā parivṛtāṃ sukhadṛśyāṃ manoramām ।। kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā ।। 27 ।। sindūrabindunā śaśvatsīmantādhaḥsthalojjvalām ।। nimnanābhigabhīrāṃ ca tadadhastrivalīyutām ।। 28 ।। karapadmatalāraktāṃ nakhacandrairvibhūṣitām ।। sthalapadmaprabhājuṣṭaṃ pādapadmaṃ ca bibhratīm ।। 29 ।। āraktavarṇaṃ lalitamalaktakasamaprabham ।। sthalapadmaiśca jalajaiḥ padmarāgavirājitām ।। 30।। śaradinduvinindyaikanakhendvoghavirājitām।। amūlyaratna saṃmiśrayāvakena svalaṃkṛtām।।31।। maṇīndramukhyakhacitakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitām ।।32।। dadhatīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam।। amūlya ratnasaṃklṛptamakarākṛtirūpiṇā।।33।। citrakuṇḍalayugmaśrīsuṣumāpariśobhitām ।। ratnendramuktāhāraśrīstanamadhyasthalojjvalām ।।34।। ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūraśaṃkhabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। ratnāṃgulīyakairdivyairaṃgulyāvalibhiryutām ।। 39 ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ lalitāṃ ramyāṃ suśīlāṃ sudatīṃ satīm ।। uvāsa tatsamīpe ca madhuraṃ tāmuvāca saḥ।।36।। śaṃkhacūḍa uvāca ।। kā tvaṃ kasya ca kanyā'si dhanye mānye suyoṣitām।। kā tvaṃ kāmini kalyāṇi sarvakalyāṇadāyini।।37।। svargabhogādisaritivihāre hārarūpiṇi।। saṃsāradārasāre ca māyādhāre manohare।। ।। 38 ।। jagadvilakṣaṇe kṣāme munīnāṃ mohakāriṇi ।। maunaṃ tyaktvā kiṃkaraṃ māṃ sambhāṣāṃ kuru sundari ।। 39 ।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sakāmā vāmalocanā ।। sasmitā namravadanā sakāmaṃ tamuvāca sā।। 40।। tulasyuvāca ।। dharmadhvajasutā'haṃ ca tapāmyasyāṃ tapovane ।। tapasvinīha tiṣṭhāmi kastvaṃ gaccha yathāsukham।।41।। kāminīṃ kulajātāṃ ca rahasyekākinīṃ satīm।। na pṛcchati kule jāta evameva śrutau śrutam ।।42।। lampaṭo'satkule jāto dharmaśāstrārthavarjitaḥ ।। yenāśrutaḥ śruterarthaḥ sa kāmīcchati kāminīm।।43।। āpāta madhurāmante cāntakāṃ puruṣasya tām ।। viṣakumbhākārarūpāmamṛtāsyāṃ ca santatam ।। 44 ।। hṛdaye kṣuradhārābhāṃ śaśvanmadhurabhāṣiṇīm ।। svakāryyapariniṣpattitatparāṃ satataṃ sadā।।45।। kāryyārthe svāmivaśagāmanyathaivāvaśāṃ sadā ।। svāntarmalinarūpāṃ ca prasannavadanekṣaṇām।।46।। śrutau purāṇe yāsāṃ ca caritramanirūpitam ।। tāsu ko viśvasetprājño hyaprājña iva sarvadā ।। 47 ।। tāsāṃ ko vā ripurmitraṃ prārthayantīṃ navaṃ navam ।। dṛṣṭvā suveśaṃ puruṣamicchantīṃ hṛdaye sadā।।48।। bāhye svātmasatītvaṃ ca jñāpayantīṃ prayatnataḥ ।। śaśvatkāmāṃ ca rāmāṃ ca kāmādhārāṃ manoharām।।49।। bāhye chalācchādayantīṃ svāntarmaithunalālasām।। kāntaṃ grasantīṃ rahasi bāhye'tīva sulajjitām।। 50।। māninīṃ maithunābhāve kopinīṃ kalahāṃkurām ।। saṃbhītāṃ bhūrisambhogātsvalpamaithunaduḥkhitām ।। 51 ।। sumṛṣṭānnaṃ śītatoyamākāṃkṣantīṃ ca mānase ।। sundaraṃ rasikaṃ kāntaṃ yuvānaṃ guṇinaṃ sadā ।। 52 ।। sutātparamatisnehaṃ kurvantīṃ ratikartari ।। prāṇādhikaṃ priyatamaṃ sambhoga kuśalaṃ priyam ।। 53 ।। paśyantīṃ riputulyaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ vā maithunākṣamam ।। kalahaṃ kurvatī śaśvattena sārddhaṃ sukopanām ।। 54 ।। carcayā bhakṣayantīṃ taṃ kīnāśa iva gorajaḥ ।। dussāhasasvarūpāṃ ca sarvadoṣāśrayāṃ sadā ।।55।। śaśvatkapaṭarūpāṃ ca sarvadoṣāśrayāṃ sadā ।। brahma viṣṇuśivādīnāṃ dustyājyāṃ moharūpiṇīm ।। 56 ।। tapomārgārgalāṃ śaśvanmuktidvārakapāṭikām ।।57।। harerbhaktivyavahitāṃ sarvamāyā karaṇḍikām ।। saṃsārakārāgāre ca śaśvannigaḍarūpiṇīm ।। 58 ।। indrajālasvarūpāṃ ca mithyāvādisvarūpiṇīm ।। bibhratīṃ bāhya saundaryaṃ madhyāṅgamatikutsitam ।।59 ।। nānāviṇmūtrapūyānāmādhāraṃ malasaṃyutam ।। durgandhi doṣasaṃyuktaṃ raktāktaṃ cāpyasaṃskṛtam ।। ।।। 60।। māyārūpaṃ māyināṃ ca vidhinā nirmitaṃ purā ।। viṣarūpāṃ mumukṣūṇāmadṛśyāṃcaiva sarvadā।।61।। ityuktvā tulasī taṃ ca virarāma ca nārada ।। sasmitaḥ śaṃkhacūḍaśca pravaktumupacakrame ।।62।। śaṃkhacūḍa uvāca ।। tvayā yatkathitaṃ devi na ca sarvamalīkakam ।। kiṃcitsatyamalīkaṃ ca kiṃcinmatto niśāmaya।।63।। nirmitaṃ dvividhaṃ dhātrā strīrūpaṃ sarvamohanam ।। kṛtyārūpaṃ vāstavaṃ ca praśasyaṃ cāpraśaṃsitam।। ।।64।। lakṣmī sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikādikam।। sṛṣṭisūtrasvarūpaṃ cāpyādyaṃ sraṣṭvā tu nirmitam ।। 65 ।। etāsāmaṃśarūpaṃ yatstrīrūpaṃ vāstavaṃ smṛtam ।। tatpraśaṃsyaṃ yaśorūpaṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam ।। 66 ।। śatarūpā devahūtissvadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā ।। chāyāvatī rohiṇī ca varuṇānī śacī tathā ।। 67 ।। kuberavāyupatnī sā'pyaditiśca ditistathā ।। lopāmudrā'nasūyā ca kaiṭabhī tulasī tathā ।।68।। ahalyā'rundhatī menā tārā mandodarī parā ।। damayantī vedavatī gaṃgā ca yamunā tathā ।। 69 ।। puṣṭistuṣṭiḥ smṛtirmedhā kālikā ca vasundharā ।। ṣaṣṭhī maṃgalacaṇḍī ca mūrtirvai dharmakāminī ।। 70 ।। svastiḥ śraddhā ca kāntiśca tuṣṭiḥ śāntistathā parā ।। nidrā tandrā kṣutpipāsā sandhyā rātrirdināni ca ।। 71 ।। sampattivṛttikīrtyaśca kriyāśobhāprabhāṃśakam ।। yatstrīrūpaṃ ca sambhūtamuttamaṃ tadyuge yuge ।। 72 ।। kṛtyāsvarūpaṃ tadyattu svarveśyādikameva ca ।। tadapraśaṃsyaṃ viśveṣu puṃścalīrūpameva ca ।। 73 ।। sattvapradhānaṃ yadrūpaṃ tacca śuddhaṃ svabhāvataḥ ।। taduttamaṃ ca viśveṣu sādhvīrūpaṃ praśaṃsitam ।।74।। tadvāstavaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ।। rajorūpaṃ tamorūpaṃ kṛtyāsu dvividhaṃ smṛtam ।।75।। sthānābhāvātkṣaṇābhāvānmadhyavṛtterabhāvataḥ ।। dehakleśena rogeṇa satsaṃsargeṇa sundari।।76।। bahugoṣṭhā vṛtenaiva ripurājabhayena ca ।। rajorūpasya sādhvītvamatainaivopajāyate ।। 77 ।। idaṃ madhyamarūpaṃ ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। tamorūpaṃ durnivāryyamadhamaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ।।78।। na pṛcchati kule jātaḥ paṇḍitaśca parastriyam।। nirjane durjane vā'pi rahasye vacasāṃ striyam ।।79।। āgacchāmi tvatsamīpamājñayā brahmaṇo'dhunā ।। gāndharveṇa vivāhena tvāṃ grahīṣyāmi śobhane ।। 80 ।। ahameva śaṅkhacūḍo devavidrāvakārakaḥ ।। danuvaṃśodbhavo viśve sudāmā'haṃ hareḥ pure ।। 81 ।। ahamaṣṭasu gopeṣu gogopīpārṣadeṣu ca ।। adhunā dānavendro'haṃ rādhikāyāśca śāpataḥ ।। 82 ।। jātismaro'haṃ jānāmi kṛṣṇamantraprabhāvataḥ ।। jātismarā tvaṃ tulasī saṃsaktā hariṇā purā ।। 83 ।। tvameva rādhikākopājjātā'si bhārate bhuvi ।। tvāṃ sambhoktumicchako'haṃ nālaṃ rādhābhayāttataḥ ।। 84 ।। ityevamuktvā sa pumānvirarāma mahāmune ।। sasmitā tulasī hṛṣṭā pravaktumupacakrame ।। 85 ।। tulasyuvāca ।। evaṃvidho budho viśve budheṣu ca praśaṃsitaḥ ।। kāntamevaṃvidhaṃ kāntā śaśvadicchati kāmataḥ ।। 86 ।। tvayā'hamadhunā satyaṃ vicāreṇa parājitā ।। sa ninditaścāpyaśuciryaḥ pumāṃśca striyā jitaḥ ।। 87 ।। nindanti pitaro devā bāndhavāḥ strījitaṃ janam ।। strījitaṃ manasā vācā pitā bhrātā ca nindati ।।88।। śudhyedvipro daśāhena jātake mṛtake tathā ।। bhūmipo dvādaśāhena vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhataḥ ।। 89 ।। śūdro māsena vedeṣu mātṛvadvarṇasaṅkaraḥ।। aśuciḥ strījitaḥ śudhyeccitādahanakālataḥ ।। 90 ।। na gṛhṇantīcchayā tasya pitaraḥ piṇḍatarpaṇam ।। na gṛhṇantīcchayā devāsta sya puṣpajalādikam ।। 91 ।। kiṃ tasya jñānatapasā japahomaprapūjanaiḥ ।। kiṃ vidyayā vā yaśasā strībhiryasya mano hṛtam ।। 92 ।। vidyāprabhāvajñānārthaṃ mayā tvaṃ ca parīkṣitaḥ ।। kṛtvā parīkṣāṃ kāntasya vṛṇoti kāminī varam ।। 93 ।। varāya guṇahīnāya vṛddhāyājñānine tathā ।। daridrāya ca mūrkhāya rogiṇe kutsitāya ca ।। 94 ।। atyantakopayuktāya cātyantadurmukhāya ca ।। paṃgulāyāṅgahīnāya cāndhāya badhirāya ca ।। 95 ।। jaḍāya caiva mūkāya klībatulyāya pāpine ।। brahmahatyāṃ labhetso'pi yaḥ svakanyāṃ dadāti ca।। ।। 96 ।। śāntāya guṇine caiva yūne ca viduṣe'pi ca ।। vaiṣṇavāya sutāṃ dattvā daśavājiphalaṃ labhet ।। 97 ।। yaḥ kanyāpālanaṃ kṛtvā karoti vikrayaṃ yadi ।। vipadā dhanalobhena kumbhīpākaṃ sa gacchati ।। 98 ।। kanyāmūtrapurīṣaṃ ca tatra bhakṣati pātakī ।। kṛmibhirdaśitaḥ kākairyāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।।99।। tadante vyādhayonau ca labhate janma niścitam ।। vikrīṇāti māṃsabhāraṃ vahatyeva divāniśam ।। 100 ।। ityevamuktvā tulasī virarāma tapovane ।। etasminnantare brahmā tayorantikamāyayau ।। 101 ।। mūrdhnā nanāma tulasī śaṅkhacūḍaśca nārada ।। uvāsa tatra deveśaścovāca ca tayorhitam।।102।। kiṃ karoṣi śaṅkhacūḍa saṃvādamanayā saha ।। gāndharveṇa vivāhena tvamasyā grahaṇaṃ kuru ।। 103 ।। tvaṃ ca puruṣaratnaṃ ca strīratnaṃ strīṣviyaṃ satī ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamo guṇavānbhavet।।104।। nirvirodhasukhaṃ rājanko vā tyajati durlabham ।। yo'virodhasukhatyāgī sa paśurnātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 105 ।। kimupekṣasi tvaṃ kāntamīdṛśaṃ guṇinaṃ satī ।। devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca dānavānāṃ vimardanam ।। 106 ।। yathā lakṣmīśca lakṣmīśe yathā kṛṣṇe ca rādhikā।। yathā mayi ca sāvitrī bhavānī ca bhave yathā ।। 107 ।। yathā dharā varāhe ca yathā menā himālaye ।। yathā'trāvanasūyā ca damayantī nale yathā ।। 108 ।। rohiṇī ca yathā candre yathā kāme ratiḥ satī ।। yathā ditiḥ kaśyape ca vaśiṣṭhe'rundhatī yathā ।। ।। 109 ।। yathā'halyā gautame ca devahūtiśca kardame ।। yathā bṛhaspatau tārā śatarūpā manau yathā ।। 110 ।। yathā ca dakṣiṇā yajñe yathā svāhā hutāśane ।। yathā śacī mahendre ca yathā puṣṭirgaṇeśvare ।। 111 ।। devasenā yathā skande dharme mūttiryathā satī ।। saubhāgyā supriyā tvaṃ ca śaṅkhacūḍe tathā bhava ।। 112 ।। anena sārddhaṃ suciraṃ sundareṇa ca sundari ।। sthāne sthāne vihāraṃ ca yathecchaṃ kuru santatam ।। 113 ।। paścātprāpsyasi govindaṃ goloke punareva ca ।। caturbhujaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe śaṃkhacūḍe mṛte sati ।। 114 ।। ityevamāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā svālayaṃ prayayau vidhiḥ ।। gāndharveṇa vivāhena jagṛhe tāṃ ca dānavaḥ ।।115।। svarge dundubhivādyaṃ ca puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। sa reme ramayā sārddhaṃ vāsagehe manohare ।। 116 ।। mūrcchāṃ samprāpa tulasī navasaṅgamasaṅgatā ।। nimagnā nirjane sādhvī sambhogasukha sāgare ।। 117 ।। catuḥṣaṣṭikalāmānaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭividhaṃ sukham ।। kāmaśāstraṃ yanniruktaṃ rasikānāṃ yathepsitam ।। 118 ।। aṅgapratyaṃga saṃśleṣapūrvakaṃ strīmanoharam ।। tatsarvaṃ sukhaśṛṃgāraṃ cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ ।।119।। atīva ramyedeśe ca sarvajantuvivarjite ।। puṣpacandanatalpe ca puṣpacandanavāyunā ।। 120 ।। puṣpodyāne nadītīre puṣpacandanacarcite ।। gṛhītvā rasikāṃ rāmāṃ puṣpacandanacarcitām ।। ।। 121 ।। bhūṣitāṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ sarvairatīva sumanoharām ।। suraterviratirnāsti tayoḥ suratavijñayoḥ ।। 122 ।। jahāra mānasaṃ bharturlīlayā tulasī satī ।। cetanāṃ rasikāyāśca jahāra rasabhāvavit ।। 123 ।। vakṣasaścandanaṃ bāhvostilakaṃ vijahāra sā ।। sa ca jagrāha tasyāśca sindūrabindupatrakam ।। 124 ।। sa tadvakṣasi tasyāśca nakharekhāṃ dadau mudā।। sā dadau tadvāmapārśve karabhūṣaṇalakṣaṇam ।। 125 ।। rājā tadoṣṭhapuṭake dadau daśanadaṃśanam ।। tadgaṇḍayugale sā ca pradadau taccaturguṇam ।। 123 ।। suraterviratau tau ca samutthāya parasparam ।। suveśaṃ cakratustatra yattanmanasi vāñchitam ।। 127 ।। kuṅkumāktacandanena sā tasmai tilakaṃ dadau ।। sarvāṅge sundare ramye cakāra cānulepanam ।। 128 ।। suvāsitaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ vahniśuddhe ca vāsasī ।। pārijātasya kusumaṃ mālyaṃ caiva suśobhanam ।। 129 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇamaṃgulīyakamuttamam ।। sundaraṃ ca maṇivaraṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। 130 ।। dāsī tavāhamityevaṃ samuccārya punaḥ punaḥ ।। nanāma parayā bhaktyā svāminaṃ guṇaśālinam ।। 131 ।। sasmitā tanmukhāṃbhojaṃ locanābhyāṃ papau punaḥ ।। nimeṣarahitābhyāṃ ca sakaṭākṣaṃ ca sundaram ।। 132 ।। sa ca tāṃ ca samākṛṣya cakāra vakṣasi priyām ।। sasmitaṃ vāsasā''cchannaṃ dadarśa mukhapaṅkajam ।। 133 ।। cucumba kaṭhine gaṇḍe bimboṣṭhe punareva ca ।। dadau tasyai vastrayugmaṃ varuṇādāhṛtaṃ ca yat ।। tadāhṛtāṃ ratnamālāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutām ।। 134 ।। dadau mañjīrayugmaṃ ca svāhāyāśca hṛtaṃ ca yat ।। keyūrayugmaṃ chāyāyā rohiṇyāścaiva kuṇḍalam ।। 135 ।। aṃgulīyakaratnāni ratyāśca varabhūṣaṇam ।। śaṅkhaṃ suruciraṃ citraṃ yaddattaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 136 ।। vicitrapīṭhakaśreṇīṃ śayyāṃ cāpi sudurlabhām ।। bhūṣaṇāni ca dattvā ca parīhāraṃ cakāra ha ।। 137 ।। nirmāya kabarībhāraṃ tasyāśca mālyasaṃyutam ।। sucitraṃ patrakaṃ gaṇḍe jayalekhasamaṃ tathā ।। 138 ।। candralekhātribhiryuktaṃ candanena sugandhinā ।। paritaḥ paritaścitraiḥ sārddhaṃ kuṃkumabindubhiḥ ।। 139 ।। jvalatpradīpākāraṃ ca sindūratilakaṃ dadau ।। tatpādapadmayugale sthalapadmavinindite ।। 140 ।। citrālaktakarāgaṃ ca nakhareṣu dadau mudā ।। svavakṣasi muhurnyastaṃ sarāgaṃ caraṇāmbujam ।। 141 ।। he devi tava dāso'hamityuccāryya punaḥ punaḥ ।। ratnanirmāṇayānena tāṃ ca kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 142 ।। tapovanaṃ parityajya rājāsthānāntaraṃ yayau।। malaye devanilaye śaile śaile vane vane ।। 143 ।। sthāne sthāne'tiramye ca puṣpodyāne'tinirjane ।। kandare kandare sindhutīre ca sundare vane ।। 144 ।। puṣpabhadrānadītīre nīravātamanohare ।। puline puline divye nadyāṃ nadyāṃ nade nade ।। 145 ।। madhau madhukarāṇāṃ ca madhuradhvaninādite ।। vinisyande supavane nandane gandhamādane ।। 146 ।। devodyāne devavane citre candanakānane ।। campakānāṃ ketakīnāṃ mādhavīnāṃ ca mādhave ।।147।। kundānāṃ mālatīnāṃ ca kumudāmbhojakānane ।। kalpavṛkṣe kalpavṛkṣe pārijātavane vane ।।148।। nirjane kāñcanīsthāne dhanye kāñcanaparvate ।। kāñcīvane kiñcanake kañcake kāñcanākare ।। 149 ।। puṣpacandanatalpe ca puṃskokilarutaśrute ।। puṣpacandanasaṃyuktaḥ puṣpacandanavāyunā ।। 150 ।। kāmukyā kāmukaḥ kāmātsa reme rāmayā saha ।। na tṛpto dānavendraśca tṛptiṃ naiva jagāma sā ।। 151 ।। haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva vavṛdhe madanastayoḥ ।। tayā saha samāgatya svāśramaṃ dānavastataḥ ।। 152 ।। ramyaṃ krīḍālayaṃ kṛtvā vijahāra punastataḥ ।। evaṃ saṃbubhuje rājyaṃ śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān ।। 153 ।। ekamanvantaraṃ pūrṇaṃ rājarājeśvaro balī ।। devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca dānavānāṃ ca santatam ।। 154 ।। gandharvāṇāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca śāstidaḥ ।। hatādhikārā devāśca caranti bhikṣukā yathā ।। 155 ।। pūjāhomādikaṃ teṣāṃ jahāra viṣayaṃ balāt ।। āśrayaṃ cādhikāraṃ ca śastrāstrabhūṣaṇādikam ।। 196 ।। nirudyamāḥ surāḥ sarve citraputtalikā yathā ।। te ca sarve viṣaṇṇāśca prajagmurbrahmaṇaḥ sabhām।। ।। 157 ।। vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsū ruruduśca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ।। tadā brahmā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma śaṅkarālayam ।। 158 ।। sarvaṃ saṃkathayāmāsa vidhātā candraśekharam ।। brahmā śivaśca taiḥ sārddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca jagāma ha ।। 159 ।। sudurlabhaṃ paraṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param ।। samprāpa ca varaṃ dvāramāśramāṇāṃ hareraho ।। 160 ।। dadarśa dvārapālāṃśca ratnasiṃhāsanasthitān ।। śobhitānpītavastraiśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān।। ।। 161 ।। vanamālānvitānsarvānśyāmasundaravigrahān ।। śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharāṃścaiva caturbhujān ।। 162 ।। sasmitānpadmavaktrāṃśca padmanetrānmanoharān ।। brahmā tānkathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ gamanārthakam ।। 163 ।। te'nujñāṃ ca dadustasmai praviveśa tadājñayā ।। evaṃ ca ṣoḍaśa dvārānnirīkṣya kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 164 ।। devaḥ sārddhaṃ tānatītya praviveśa hareḥ sabhām ।। devarṣibhiḥ parivṛtāṃ pārṣadaiśca caturbhujaiḥ ।। 165 ।। nārāyaṇasvarūpaiśca sarvaiḥ kaustubhabhūṣitaiḥ ।। pūrṇendumaṇḍalākārāṃ caturasrāṃ manoharām ।। 166 ।। maṇīndrasāranirmāṇāṃ hīrāsārasuśobhitām ।। amūlyaratnakhacitāṃ racitāṃ svecchayā hareḥ ।। 167 ।। māṇikyamālājālāḍhyāṃ muktāpaṃktivibhūṣitām ।। maṇḍitāṃ maṇḍalākārai ratnadarpaṇakoṭibhiḥ।।168।। vicitraiścitrarekhābhirnānācitravicitritām।। padmarāgendraracitai racitāṃ padmakṛtrimaiḥ ।। ।।169।। sopānaśatakairyuktāṃ syamantakavinirmitaiḥ।। paṭṭasūtragranthiyutaiścārucandanapallavaiḥ।। 170।। indranīlamaṇistambhairveṣṭitāṃ sumanoramām।। sadratnapūrṇakumbhānāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitām ।। 171 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitām ।। kastūrīkuṅkumāktaiśca sugandhicandanadravaiḥ ।। 172 ।। susaṃskṛtāṃ tu sarvatra vāsitā gandhavāyunā ।। vidyādharīsamūhānāṃ saṅgītaiśca manoharam ।। 173 ।। sahasrayojanāyāmāṃ paripūrṇāṃ ca kiṃkaraiḥ ।। dadarśa śrīhariṃ brahmā śaṅkaraiśca suraiḥ saha ।। 174 ।। vasantaṃ tanmadhyadeśe yathendraṃ tārakāvṛtam ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇacitrasiṃhāsanasthitam ।। 179 ।। kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇaṃ ca caturbhujam ।। ।। 175 ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ sumanoharam ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇasarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ।। 177 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bibhrataṃ kelipaṅkajam ।। purato nṛtyagītaṃ ca paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। 178 ।। śāntaṃ sarasvatīkāntaṃ lakṣmīdhṛtapadāmbujam ।। bhaktapradattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ suvāsitam ।। 179 ।। gaṅgayā parayā bhaktyā sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। sarvaiśca stūyamānaṃ ca bhaktinamrātmakandharaiḥ ।। 180 ।। evaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum ।। brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve praṇamya tuṣṭuvustadā ।। 181 ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgāḥ sāśrunetrāḥ sagadgadāḥ ।। bhaktyā paramayā bhaktā bhītā namrātmakandharāḥ ।। 182 ।। puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā vidhātā jagatāmapi ।। vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa vinayena hareḥ puraḥ ।। 183 ।। haristadvacanaṃ śrutvā sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvavit ।। prahasyovāca brahmāṇaṃ rahasyaṃ ca manoharam ।। 184 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। śaṅkhacūḍasya vṛttāntaṃ sarvaṃ jānāmi padmaja ।। madbhaktasya ca gopasya mahātejasvinaḥ purā ।। 185 ।। surāḥ śṛṇuta tatsarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। golokasyaiva caritaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇyakāraṇam ।। 186 ।। sudāmā nāma gopaśca pārṣadapravaro mama ।। sa prāpa dānavīṃ yoniṃ rādhāśāpātsudāruṇāt ।। 187 ।। tatraikadā'hamagamaṃ svālayādrāsamaṇḍalam ।। vihāya māninīṃ rādhāṃ mama prāṇādhikāṃ parām ।। 188 ।। sā māṃ virajayā sārddhaṃ vijñāya kiṃkarīmukhāt ।। paścātkrudhā sā''jagāma māṃ dadarśa ca tatra ca ।। 189।। virajāṃ ca nadīrūpāṃ māṃ jñātvā ca tirohitam ।। punarjagāma sā ruṣṭā svālayaṃ sakhibhiḥ saha ।। 190 ।। māṃ dṛṣṭvā mandire devī sudāma sahitaṃ purā ।। bhṛśaṃ māṃ bhartsayāmāsa maunībhūtaṃ ca susthiram ।। 191 ।। tac tvā ca sumahāṃśca sudāmā tāṃ cukopa ha।। sa ca tāṃ bhartsayāmāsa kopena mama sannidhau।।192।। tacchrutvā sā kopayuktā raktapaṅkajalocanā ।। bahiṣkartuṃ cakārājñāṃ saṃtrastā mama saṃsadi।।193।। sakhīlakṣaṃ samuttasthau durvāraṃ tejasojjvalam ।। bahiścakāra taṃ tūrṇaṃ jalpantaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 194 ।। sā ca tadvacanaṃ śrutvā samāruṣṭā śaśāpa tam ।। yāhi re dānavīṃ yonimityevaṃ dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ ।।195।। taṃ gacchantaṃ śapantaṃ ca rudantaṃ māṃ praṇamya ca ।। vārayāmāsa sā tuṣṭā rudantī kṛpayā punaḥ ।। 196 ।। he vatsa tiṣṭha mā gaccha kva yāsīti punaḥ punaḥ ।। samuccāryya ca tatpaścājjagāma sā ca vismitā ।। 197 ।। gopyaśca ruruduḥ sarvā gopāśceti suduḥkhitāḥ ।। te sarve rādhikā cāpi tatpaścādbodhitā mayā ।। 198 ।। āyāsyati kṣaṇārdhena kṛtvā śāpasya pālanam ।। sudāmaṃstvamihāgacchetyuvāca sā nivāritā ।। 199 ।। golokasya kṣaṇārddhena caikamanvantaraṃ bhavet ।। pṛthivyāṃ jagatāṃ dhātarityevaṃ vacanaṃ dhruvam ।। 200 ।। sa eva śaṃkhacūḍaśca punastatraiva yāsyati ।। mahābaliṣṭho yogīśaḥ sarvamāyāviśāradaḥ ।।201।। mama śūlaṃ gṛhītvā ca śīghraṃ gacchata bhāratam ।। śivaḥ karotu saṃhāraṃ mama śūlena rakṣasaḥ ।। 202 ।। mamaiva kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। bibharti dānavaḥ śaśvatsaṃpāravijayī tataḥ ।।203 ।। tatra brahmansthite kaṇṭhe na ko'pi hiṃsituṃ kṣamaḥ ।। tadyāñcāṃ ca kariṣyāmi viprarūpo'hameva ca ।।204।। satītvabhaṅgastatpatnyā yatra kāle bhaviṣyati ।। tatraiva kāle tanmṛtyuriti datto varastvayā ।। 205 ।। tatpatnyāścodare vīryyamarpayiṣyāmi niścitam ।। tatkṣaṇenaiva tanmṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 206 ।। paścātsā dehamutsṛjya bhaviṣyati priyā mama ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho dadau śūlaṃ harāya ca ।।207।। śūlaṃ dattvā yayau śīghraṃ harirabhyantaraṃ mudā ।। bhārataṃ ca yayurdevā brahmarudrapurogamāḥ ।। 208 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe tulasyupākhyāne ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 16 ।।
<2.17> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। brahmā śivaṃ saṃniyojya saṃhāre dānavasya ca ।। jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ yathāsthānaṃ mahāmune ।। 1 ।। candrabhāgānadītīre vaṭamūle manohare ।। tatra tasthau mahādevo devanistārahetave ।। 2 ।। dūtaṃ kṛtvā puṣpadantaṃ gandharveśvaramīpsitam ।। śīghraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa śaṃkhacūḍāntikaṃ mudā ।। 3 ।। sa ceśvarājñayā śīghraṃ yayau tannagaraṃ varam ।। mahendranagarotkṛṣṭaṃ kuberabhavanādhikam ।। 4 ।। pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ dairghye taddviguṇaṃ mune ।। sphāṭikākāramaṇibhissamantātpariveṣṭitam ।। saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca durgamābhiḥ samanvitam ।। 5 ।। jvaladagninibhairnityaṃ śobhitaṃ ratnakoṭibhiḥ ।। yuktaṃ ca vīthiśatakairmaṇivedisamanvitaiḥ ।। 6 ।। parito vaṇijāṃ saṃghairnānāvastuvirājitaiḥ ।। sindūrākāramaṇibhirnirmitaiśca vicitritaiḥ ।। 7 ।। bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣitairdivyairāśramaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ ।। gatvā dadarśa tanmadhye śaṅkhacūḍālayaṃ varam ।। 8 ।। atīva valayākāraṃ yathā pūrṇendumaṇḍalam ।। jvaladagniśikhābhiśca parikhābhiścatasṛbhiḥ।।9।। sudurgamaṃ ca śatrūṇāmanyeṣāṃ sugamaṃ sukham ।। atyuccairgaganasparśyamaṇiprācīraveṣṭitam।। 10।। rājitaṃ dvādaśadvārairdvārapālasamanvitaiḥ ।। ratnakṛtrimapadmāḍhyai ratnadarpaṇabhūṣitaiḥ ।।11 ।। maṇīndrasārakhacitaiḥ śobhitaṃ lakṣamandiraiḥ।। śobhitaṃ ratnasopānai ratnastambhavirājitaiḥ ।।12।। ratnacitrakapāṭādyaiḥ sadratnakalaśānvitaiḥ।। ratnendracitrarājībhiḥ sudīptābhirvirājitaiḥ।।13।। parito rakṣitaṃ śaśvaddānavaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ।। divyāstradhāribhiḥ śūrairmahābalaparākramaiḥ।।14।। sundaraiśca suveṣaiśca nānālaṅkārabhūṣitaiḥ ।। tāndṛṣṭvā puṣpadanto'pi varadvāraṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। 15 ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ puruṣaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca sasmitam ।। tiṣṭhantaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ ca tāmravarṇaṃ bhayaṅkaram ।। 16 ।। kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ jagāma tadanujñayā ।। atikramya navadvāraṃ jagāmābhyantaraṃ puram ।। 17 ।। na kaiścidvārito dūto dūtarūpeṇa tasya ca ।। gatvā so'bhyantaraṃ dvāraṃ dvārapālamuvāca ha ।। 18 ।। raṇasya sarvavṛttāntaṃ vijñāpayitumīśvaram ।। sa ca taṃ kathayitvā ca dūtaṃ gantumuvāca ha ।। 19 ।। sa gatvā śaṃkhacūḍaṃ taṃ dadarśa sumanoharam ।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitam ।। 20 ।। maṇīndrakhacitaṃ citraṃ ratnadaṇḍasamanvitam ।। ratnakṛtrimapuṣpaiśca praśastaṃ śobhitaṃ sadā ।। 21 ।। bhṛtyena hastavidhṛtaṃ svarṇacchatraṃ manoharam ।। sevitaṃ pārṣadagaṇairvyajanaiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 22 ।। suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। mālyānulepanaṃ sūkṣmavastraṃ ca dadhataṃ mune ।। 23 ।। dānavendraiḥ parivṛtaṃ suveṣaṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ ।। śatakoṭibhiranyaiśca bhramadbhiśśastradhāribhiḥ ।। 24 ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṣpadantaḥ savismayaḥ ।। uvāca raṇavṛttāntaṃ yaduktaṃ śaṅkareṇa ca ।। 25 ।। puṣpadanta uvāca ।। rājendra śivadūto'haṃ puṣpadantābhidhaḥ prabho ।। yaduktaṃ śaṅkareṇaiva tadbravīmi niśāmaya ।। 26 ।। rājyaṃ dehi ca devānāmadhikāraṃ ca sāmpratam ।। devāśca śaraṇāpannā deveśe śrīharau pare ।। 27 ।। dattvā triśūlaṃ hariṇā tubhyaṃ prasthāpitaḥ śivaḥ ।। candrabhāgānadītīre vaṭamūle trilocanaḥ ।।28।। viṣayaṃ dehi teṣāṃ ca yuddhaṃ vā kuru niścitam ।। gatvā vakṣyāmi kiṃ śambhuṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 29 ।। dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śaṅkhacūḍaḥ prahasya ca ।। prabhāte hyāgamiṣyāmi tvaṃ ca gacchetyuvāca ha ।। 30 ।। sa gatvovāca tūrṇaṃ taṃ vaṭamūlasthamīśvaram ।। śaṅkhacūḍasya vacanaṃ tadīyaṃ yatparicchadam ।।31।। etasminnantare skanda ājagāma śivāntikam ।। vīrabhadraśca nandī ca mahākālaḥ subhadrakaḥ ।। 32 ।। viśālākṣaśca bāṇaśca piṅgalākṣo vikampanaḥ ।। virūpo vikṛtiścaiva maṇibhadraśca bāṣkalaḥ।।33।। kapilākṣo dīrghadaṃṣṭro vikaṭastāmralocanaḥ ।। kālaṅkaṭo balībhadraḥ kālajihvaḥ kuṭīcaraḥ ।।34।। balonmatto raṇaślāghī durjayo durgamastathā ।। aṣṭau ca bhairavā raudrā rudrāścaikādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। 39 ।। vasavo vāsavādyāśca ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। hutāśanaśca candraśca viśvakarmā'śvinau ca tau ।।36।। kuberaśca yamaścaiva jayanto nalakūbaraḥ ।। vāyuśca varuṇaścaiva budho vai maṃgalastathā ।। ।। 37 ।। dharmaśca śanirīśānaḥ kāmadevaśca vīryyavān ।। ugradaṃṣṭrā cogracaṇḍā koṭṭarī kaiṭabhī tathā ।। 38 ।। svayaṃ śatabhujā devī bhadrakālī bhayaṃkarī ।। ratnendrarājakhacitavimānopari saṃsthitā ।। 39 ।। raktavastraparīdhānā raktamālyānulepanā ।। nṛtyantī ca hasantī ca gāyantī susvaraṃ mudā ।। 40।। abhayaṃ dadatī bhaktamabhayā sā bhayaṃ ripum ।। bibhratī vikaṭāṃ jihvāṃ sulolāṃ yojanāyatām ।। ।। 41 ।। kharparaṃ vartulākāraṃ gambhīraṃ yojanāyatam ।। triśūlaṃ gaganasparśiṃ śaktiṃ vai yojanāyatām ।। 42 ।। śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śarāṃścāpaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।। mudgaraṃ muśalaṃ vajraṃ khaḍgaṃ phalakamujjvalam ।। 43 ।। vaiṣṇavāstraṃ vāruṇāstramāgneyaṃ nāgapāśakam ।। nārāyaṇāstraṃ brahmāstraṃ gāndharvaṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā ।। 44 ।। pārjanyaṃ vai pāśupataṃ jṛmbhaṇāstraṃ ca pārvatam ।। māheśvarāstraṃ vāyavyaṃ daṇḍaṃ sammohanaṃ tathā ।। nānāvidhānyāyudhāni divyāstraśatakaṃ param ।।45।। āgatya tatra tasthau sā yoginīnāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ।। sārddhaṃ vai ḍākinīnāṃ ca vikaṭānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 46 ।। bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍabrahmarākṣasāḥ ।। vetālāścaiva yakṣāśca rākṣasāścaiva kinnarāḥ ।। 47 ।। tābhiścaiva saha skando natvā vai candraśekharam ।। pituḥ pārśve sabhāyāṃ ca samuvāsa bhavājñayā ।। 48 ।। atha dūte gate tatra śaṃkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān।। uvāca tulasīṃ vārttāṃ gatvā'bhyantarameva ca ।।49।। raṇavārttāṃ ca sā śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā ।। uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvī hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 50।। tulasyuvāca ।। he prāṇanātha he bandho tiṣṭha me vakṣasi kṣaṇam ।। he prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdeva rakṣa me jīvanaṃ kṣaṇam ।।91।। bhuṃkṣva janmasu bhogyaṃ tadyadvai manasi vāṃchitam ।। paśyāmi tvāṃ kṣaṇaṃ kiñcillocanābhyāṃ pipāsitā ।। 52 ।। āndolayanti prāṇā me mano dagdhaṃ ca santatam ।। dussvapnaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ cādyaiva carame niśi ।। 53 ।। tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā bhuktvā pītvā nṛpeśvaraḥ ।। uvāca vacanaṃ prājño hitaṃ satyaṃ yathocitam ।।54।। śaṅkhacūḍa uvāca ।। kālena yojitaṃ sarvaṃ karma bhoganibandhane ।। śubhaṃ harṣaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokamamaṃgalam ।।55।। kāle bhavanti vṛkṣāśca śākhāvantaśca kālataḥ ।। krameṇa puṣpavantaśca phalavantaśca kālataḥ ।।56।। teṣāṃ phalāni pakvāni prabhavantyeva kālataḥ ।। te sarve phalinaḥ kāle kāle kālaṃ prayānti ca।।57।। bhavanti kāle bhūtāni kāle kālaṃ prayānti ca।। kāle bhavanti viśvāni kāle naśyanti sundari।।58।। sraṣṭā ca kāle sṛjati pātā pāti ca kālataḥ।। saṃharttā saṃharetkāle saṃcaranti krameṇa te ।।59।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ।। sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃharttā sa kṛtsnāṃśena sarvadā।।60।। kāle sa eva prakṛtiṃ nirmāya svecchayā prabhuḥ।। nirmāya prākṛtānsarvānviśvasthāṃśca carācarān।।61।। ābrahmastaṃbaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtrimameva ca।। pravadanti ca kālena naśyatyapi hi naśvaram।।62।। bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ triguṇātparam ।। sarveśaṃ sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvātmānantamīśvarama।।63।। jalaṃ jalena sṛjati jalaṃ pāti jalena yaḥ ।। harejjalaṃ jalenaiva taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja santatam ।।64।। yasyājñayā vāti vātaḥ śīghragāmī ca santatam।। yasyājñayā ca tapanastapatyeva yathākṣaṇam ।। 65 ।। yathākṣaṇaṃ varṣatīndro mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu ।। yathākṣaṇaṃ dahatyagniścandro bhramati bhītavat।।66।। mṛtyormūlaṃ kālamūlaṃ yamasya ca yamaṃ param।। sraṣṭāraṃ sraṣṭurapi ca pātuḥ pālakameva ca ।।67।। saṃharttāraṃ ca saṃhartustaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja।। ko bandhuścaiva keṣāṃ vā sarvabandhuṃ bhaja priye ।। 68 ।। ahaṃ ko vā tvaṃ ca kā vā vidhinā yojitaḥ purā ।। tvayā sārddhaṃ karmaṇā ca punastena viyojitaḥ ।।69।। ajñānī kātaraḥ śoke vipattau ca na paṇḍitaḥ ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhramatyeva cakranemikrameṇa ca ।। ।। 70 ।। nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ sarveśaṃ kāntaṃ prāpsyasi niścitam ।। tapaḥ kṛtaṃ yadarthe ca purā badarikāśrame ।। 71।। mayā tvaṃ tapasā labdhā brahmaṇaśca vareṇa hi ।। harerarthe tava tapo hariṃ prāpsyasi kāmini ।। 72 ।। vṛndāvane ca govindaṃ goloke tvaṃ labhiṣyasi ।। ahaṃ yāsyāmi tallokaṃ tanuṃ tyaktvā ca dānavīm ।। 73 ।। tatra drakṣyasi māṃ tvaṃ ca tvāṃ ca drakṣyāmi santatam ।। āgamaṃ rādhikāśāpādbhārataṃ ca sudurlabham ।। 74 ।। punaryāsyāmi tatraiva kaḥ śoko me śṛṇu priye ।। tvaṃ hi dehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca । ।।75।। tatkālaṃ prāpsyasi hariṃ mā kānte kātarā bhava ।। ityuktvā ca dinānte ca tayā sārddhaṃ manohare ।।76।। suṣvāpa śobhane talpe puṣpacandanacarcite ।। nānāprakāravibhave cacāra ratnamandire ।। 77 ।। ratnapradīpasaṃyukte strīratnaṃ prāpya sundarīm ।। nināya rajanīṃ rājā krīḍākautukamaṃgalaiḥ ।।78।। kṛtvā vakṣasi kāntāṃ tāṃ rudantīmatiduḥkhitām ।। kṛśodarīṃ nirāhārāṃ nimagnāṃ śokasāgare।79।। punastāṃ bodhayāmāsa divyajñānena bodhavit ।। purā kṛṣṇena yaddattaṃ bhāṇḍīre tattvamuttamam ।। 80 ।। sa ca tasyai dadau tacca sarvaśokaharaṃ param ।। jñānaṃ saṃprāpya sā devī prasannavadanekṣaṇā ।। 81 ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra harṣeṇa sarvaṃ matvā'tinaśvaram ।। tau dampatī ca krīḍārttau nimagnau sukhasāgare ।। 82 ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgau mūrcchitau nirjane mune ।। aṃgapratyaṃgasaṃyuktau suprītau suratotsukau ।। 83 ।। ekāṃgau ca tathā tau dvau cārddhanārīśvarau yathā ।। prāṇeśvaraṃ ca tulasī mene prāṇādhikaṃ param ।। 84 ।। prāṇādhikāṃ ca tāṃ mene rājā prāṇādhikeśvarīm ।। tau sthitau sukhasuptau ca tantritau sundarau samau ।। 85 ।। suveṣau sukhasambhogādaceṣṭau sumanoharau ।। kṣaṇaṃ sacetanau tau ca kathayantau rasāśrayām ।। kathāṃ manoharāṃ divyāṃ hasantau ca kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ ।। 86 ।। bhuktavantau ca tāmbūlaṃ pradataṃ ca parasparam ।। 87 ।। parasparaṃ sevitau ca suprītyā śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। kṣaṇaṃ śayānau sānandau vasantau ca kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ ।। 88 ।। kṣaṇaṃ keliniyuktau ca rasabhāvasamanvitau ।। suratādviratirnāsti tau tadviṣayapaṇḍitau ।। 89 ।। satataṃ jayayuktau dvau kṣaṇaṃ naiva parājitau ।। ।। 90 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tulasīśaṃkhacūḍasambhogo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 17 ।।
<2.18> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā dhyātvā rājā kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। brāhme muhūrtte cotthāya puṣpatalpānmanoharāt ।।1।। rātrivāsaḥ parityajya snātvā maṅgalavāriṇā ।। dhaute ca vāsasī dhṛtvā kṛtvā tilakamujjvalam ।।2।। cakārāhnikamāvaśyamabhīṣṭaguruvandanam ।। dadhyājyaṃ madhu lājāṃśca so'paśyadvastu maṅgalam ।। 3 ।। ratnaśreṣṭhaṃ maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ vastraśreṣṭhaṃ ca kāñcanam ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dadau bhaktyā yathānityaṃ ca nārada ।। 4 ।। amūlyaratnaṃ yatkiñcinmuktāmāṇikyahīrakam ।। dadau viprāya gurave yātrāmaṅgalahetave ।। 5 ।। gajaratnaṃ cāśvaratnaṃ dhenuratnaṃ manoharam ।। dadau sarvaṃ daridrāya viprārthaṃ maṅgalāya ca ।। 6 ।। kośāgārasahasraṃ ca nagarāṇāṃ trilakṣakam ।। grāmāṇāṃ śatakoṭiṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 7 ।। putraṃ kṛtvā ca rājendraṃ sucandraṃ dānaveṣu ca ।। putre samarpya bhāryāṃ ca rājyaṃ vai sarvasampadam ।। 8 ।। prajānucarasaṃghaṃ ca kośaughaṃ vāhanādikam ।। svayaṃ sannāhayuktaśca dhanuṣpāṇirbabhūva ha ।। 9 ।। bhṛtyadvārā krameṇaiva sa cakre sainyasaṃcayam ।। aśvānāṃ ca trilakṣeṇa pañcalakṣeṇa hastinām ।। ।। 10 ।। rathānāmayutenaiva dhānuṣkāṇāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ।। trikoṭibhiścarmiṇāṃ ca śūlināṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 11 ।। kṛtā senā'parimitā dānavendreṇa nārada ।। yasyāṃ senāpatiścaiva yuddhaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। 12 ।। mahārathaḥ sa vijñeyo rathināṃ pravaro raṇe ।। trilakṣākṣauhiṇī senāpatiṃ kṛtvā narādhipaḥ।।13।। triṃśadakṣauhiṇīvādyabhāṇḍaughaṃ ca cakāra saḥ ।। bahirbabhūva śibirānmanasā śrīhariṃ smaran।।14।। ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ vimānaṃ hyāruroha saḥ ।। guruvargānpuraskṛtya prayayau śaṅkarāntikam ।। 15 ।। puṣpabhadrānadītīre yatrākṣayavaṭaḥ śubhaḥ ।। siddhāśramaṃ ca siddhānāṃ siddhikṣetraṃ ca nāmataḥ ।।16।। kapilasya tapasthānaṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhārate ।। paścimodadhipūrve ca malayasya ca paścime।।17।। śrīśailottarabhāge ca gandhamādanadakṣiṇe ।। pañcayojanavistīrṇā dairghye śataguṇā tathā ।। śāśvatī jalapūrṇā ca puṣpabhadrānadī śubhā ।। 18 ।। lavaṇodapriyā bhāryyā śaśvatsaubhāgyasaṃyutā ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā bhārate ca supuṇyadā ।।19।। śarāvatīmiśritā ca nirgatā sā himālayāt।। gomantaṃ vāmataḥ kṛtvā praviṣṭā paścimodadhau ।। 20।। tatra gatvā śaṃkhacūḍo luloke candraśekharam ।। vaṭamūle samāsīnaṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabham ।। 21 ।। kṛtvā yogāsane sthitvā mudrāyuktaṃ ca sasmitam ।। śuddhasphaṭika saṅkāśaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 22 ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ jaṭājālaṃ ca bibhratam ।। 23 ।। trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca nāgayajñopavītinam ।। mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālamṛtyuṃ viśvamṛtyukaraṃ param ।। 24 ।। bhaktamṛtyuharaṃ śāntaṃ gaurīkāntaṃ manoramam ।। tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 25 ।। āśutoṣaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। viśvanāthaṃ viśvarūpaṃ viśvabījaṃ ca viśvajam ।। 26 ।। viśvambharaṃ viśvavaraṃ viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam ।। kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca narakārṇavatāraṇam ।। 27 ।। jñānapradaṃ jñānabījaṃ jñānānandaṃ sanātanam ।। avaruhya vimānācca sa dṛṣṭvā dānaveśvaraḥ ।। 28 ।। sarvaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhaktiyuktaḥ śirasā praṇanāma saḥ ।। vāmato bhadrakālīṃ ca skandaṃ tatpurataḥ sthitam ।। 29 ।। āśiṣaṃ ca dadau tasmai kālī skandaśca śaṅkaraḥ ।। uttasthurdānavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve nandīśvarādayaḥ ।। 30।। parasparaṃ ca sambhāṣāṃ te cakustatra sāmpratam।। rājā kṛtvā ca sambhāṣāmuvāsa śivasannidhau ।।31।। prasannātmā mahādevo bhagavāṃstamuvāca ha ।। 32 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। vidhātā jagatāṃ brahmā pitā dharmasya dharmavit ।। marīcistasya putraśca vaiṣṇavaścāpi dhārmikaḥ ।। 33 ।। kaśyapaścāpi tatputro dharmiṣṭhaśca prajāpatiḥ ।। dakṣaḥ prītyā dadau tasmai bhaktyā kanyāstrayodaśa ।। 34 ।। tāsvekā ca danuḥ sādhvī tatsaubhāgyena varddhitā ।। catvāriṃśaddanoḥ putrā dānavāstejasojjvalāḥ ।। 35 ।। teṣveko vipracittiśca mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। tatputro dhārmiko dambho viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ ।। 36 ।। jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ puṣkare lakṣavatsaram ।। śukācāryyaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 37 ।। tadā tvāṃ tanayaṃ prāpa paraṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇam ।। purā tvaṃ pārṣado gopo gopeṣvaṣṭasu dhārmikaḥ ।। 38 ।। adhunā rādhikāśāpādbhārate dānaveśvaraḥ ।। ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ bhramaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 39 ।। sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaikyaṃ harerapi ।। dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sevanaṃ vinā।। 40।। brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tucchaṃ mene ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। indratvaṃ vā kuberatvaṃ na mene gaṇanāsu ca ।। 41 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktasya te kiṃ vā devānāṃ viṣaye bhrame ।। dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāṃ matprītiṃ kuru bhūmipa ।। 42 ।। sukhaṃ svarājye tvaṃ tiṣṭha devāssantu svake pade ।। alaṃ bhrātṛvirodhena sarve kaśyapavaṃśajāḥ ।। 43 ।। yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ।। jñātidrohasya pāpasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 44 ।। svasampadāṃ ca hāniṃ ca yadi rājendra manyase ।। sarvāvasthāsu samatā keṣāṃ yāti ca sarvadā।।45।। brahmaṇaśca tirobhāvo laye prākṛtike sati ।। āvirbhāvaḥ punastasya prabhavedīśvarecchayā।। ।। 46 ।। jñānaṃ buddhiśca tapasā smṛtirlokasya niścitam ।। karoti sṛṣṭiṃ jñānena sraṣṭā so'pi krameṇa ca ।।47।। paripūrṇatamo dharmaḥ satye satyāśrayaḥ sadā ।। so'pi tribhāgastretāyāṃ dvibhāgo dvāpare smṛtaḥ ।। 48 ।। ekabhāgaḥ kaleḥ pūrve taddhrāsaśca krameṇa ca ।। kalāmātraṃ kaleḥ śeṣe kuhvāṃ candrakalā yathā ।। 49 ।। yādṛktejo ravergrīṣme na tādṛkśiśire punaḥ ।। dine ca yādṛṅ madhyāhne sāyaṃprātarna tatsamam ।। 50 ।। udayaṃ yāti kālena bālyatāṃ ca krameṇa ca ।। prakāṇḍatāṃ ca tatpaścātkāle'staṃ punareva saḥ ।। 51 ।। dine pracchannatāṃ yāti kāle vai durdine ghane ।। rāhugraste kampitaśca punareva prasannatām ।। 52 ।। paripūrṇatamaścandraḥ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca yādṛśaḥ।। । tādṛśo na bhavennityaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine ।।53।। punaḥ sa puṣṭatāṃ yāti parakuhvā dinedine ।। sampadyuktaḥ śuklapakṣe kṛṣṇe mlānaśca yakṣmaṇā ।। 54 ।। rāhugraste dine mlāno durdine nibiḍe ghane ।। kāle candro bhavecchuddho bhraṣṭaśrīḥ kālabhedake ।। 55 ।। bhaviṣyati baliścendro bhraṣṭaśrīḥ sutale'dhunā ।। kālena pṛthvī sasyāḍhyā sarvādhārā vasundharā ।। 56 ।। kāle jale nimagnā sā tirobhūtā vipadgatā ।। kāle naśyanti viśvāni prabhavantyeva kālataḥ ।। 97 ।। carācarāśca kālena naśyanti prabhavanti ca ।। īśvarasyaiva samatā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 58 ।। ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayo yasmādasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam ।। adṛśyaṃ cāpi paśyāmi vāraṃ vāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। ।। 59 ।। sa ca prakṛtirūpaśca sa eva puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। sa cātmā sarvajīvaśca nānārūpadharaḥ paraḥ ।। 60 ।। karoti satataṃ yo hi tannāmaguṇakīrttanam ।। kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ sa jayati janma rogaṃ jarāṃ bhayam ।। 61 ।। sraṣṭā kṛto vidhistena pātā viṣṇuḥ kṛto bhave ।। ahaṃ kṛtaśca saṃharttā vayaṃ viṣayiṇo yataḥ ।।62।। kālāgnirudraṃ saṃhāre niyujya viṣaye nṛpa ।। ahaṃ karomi satataṃ tannāmaguṇakīrttanam ।। ।। 63 ।। tena mṛtyuñjayo'haṃ ca jñānenānena nirbhayaḥ ।। mṛtyurmatto bhayādyāti vainateyādivoragaḥ ।। 64 ।। ityuktvā sa ca sarveśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ।। virarāmātha śarvaśca sabhāmadhye ca nārada ।। 69 ।। rājā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praśaśaṃsa punaḥ punaḥ ।। uvāca suṃdaraṃ devaṃ paraṃ vinayapūrvakam ।। 66 ।। śaṃkhacūḍa uvāca ।। tvayā yatkathitaṃ nātha sarvaṃ satyaṃ ca nānṛtam ।। tathā'pi kiñcidyatsatyaṃ śrūyatāṃ mannivedanam ।। 67 ।। jñātidrohe mahatpāpaṃ tvayoktamadhunā trayam ।। gṛhītvā tasya sarvasvaṃ kutaḥ prasthāpito baliḥ ।। 68 ।। mayā samuddhṛtaṃ sarvamaiśvaryyaṃ vikrameṇa ca ।। sutalācca samuddhartuṃ nālaṃ so'pi gadādharaḥ ।।69 ।। sabhrātṛko hiraṇyākṣaḥ kathaṃ devaiśca hiṃsitaḥ ।। śumbhādayaścāsurā vai kathaṃ devairnipātitāḥ ।। 70 ।। purā samudramathane pīyūṣaṃ bhakṣitaṃ suraiḥ ।। kleśabhājo vayaṃ tatra taiḥ sarvaphalabhājanaiḥ।। ।। 71 ।। krīḍābhāṇḍamidaṃ viśvaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। yadā dadāti yasmai sa tasyaiśvaryaṃ bhavettadā ।। 72 ।। devadānavayorvādaḥ śaśvannaimittikaḥ sadā ।। parājayo jayasteṣāṃ kāle'smākaṃ krameṇa ca ।। 73 ।। tatrāvayorvirodhe ca gamanaṃ niṣphalaṃ tava ।। sama sambandhinorbandhvorīśvarasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 74 ।। jāyate mahatī lajjā sparddhā'smābhiḥ sahādhunā ।। tato'dhikā ca samare kīrtti hāniḥ parājaye ।। 75 ।। śaṃkhacūḍavacaḥ śrutvā prahasyāha trilocanaḥ ।। yathocitaṃ sumadhuramatyugraṃ dānaveśvaram ।। 76 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। yuṣmābhiḥ saha yuddhaṃ me brahmavaṃśasamudbhavaiḥ ।। kā lajjā mahatī rājannakīrtirvā parājaye ।। 77 ।। yuddhamādau harereva madhunā kaiṭabhena ca ।। hiraṇyakaśipoścaiva saha tenātmanā nṛpa ।। 78 ।। hiraṇyākṣasya yuddhaṃ ca punastena gadābhṛtā ।। tripuraiḥ saha yuddhaṃ ca mayā cāpi purā kṛtam ।। 79 ।। sarveśvaryyāḥ sarvamātuḥ prakṛtyāśca babhūva ha ।। saha śumbhādibhiḥ pūrvaṃ samaraṃ paramādbhutam ।। 80 ।। pārṣadapravarastvaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। ye ye hatāśca te daityā nahi ke'pi tvayā samāḥ।। 81 ।। kā lajjā mahatī rājanmama yuddhe tvayā saha ।। surāṇāṃ śaraṇasyaiva preṣitasya hareraho ।। 82 ।। dehi rājyaṃ ca devānāṃ vāgvyaye kiṃ prayojanam ।। yuddhaṃ mā kuru matsārddhamiti me niścitaṃ vacaḥ ।। 83 ।। ityuktvā śaṃkarastatra virarāma ca nārada ।। uttasthau śaṃkhacūḍaśca svāmānyaiḥ saha satvaraḥ ।। 84 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe tulatyupākhyāne śiva śaṃkhacūḍasaṃvāde'ṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 18 ।।
<2.19> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śivaṃ praṇamya śirasā dānavendraḥ pratāpavān ।। samāruroha yānaṃ ca svāmātyaiḥ saha satvaraḥ ।। 1 ।। babhūvuste ca saṃkṣubdhāḥ skandaśaktyā'rditāstadā ।। nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। 2 ।। skandasyopari tatraiva samare ca bhayaṅkare ।। skandasya samaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadadbhutamulbaṇam ।। 3 ।। dānavānāṃ kṣayakaraṃ yathā prākṛtikaṃ layam ।। rājā vimānamāruhya śaravarṣaṃ cakāra ha ।। 4 ।। nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭiśca ghanavṛṣṭiryathā tathā ।। mahānghorāndhakāraśca vahnyutthānaṃ babhūva ha ।। 5 ।। devāḥ pradudruvuścānye sarve nandīśvarādayaḥ ।। ekākī kārttikeyastu tasthau samaramūrddhani ।। 6 ।। parvatānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śilānāṃ śākhināṃ tathā ।। śaśvaccakāra vṛṣṭiṃ ca durvāhyāṃ ca bhayaṅkarīm ।। 7 ।। nṛpasya śaravṛṣṭyā ca pracchannaḥ śivanandanaḥ । nīradena ca sāndreṇa saṃcchanno bhāskaro yathā ।।8।। dhanusskandasya ciccheda durvahaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram ।। babhañja ca rathaṃ divyaṃ ciccheda rathaghoṭakān ।। 9 ।। mayūraṃ jarjjarībhūtaṃ divyāstreṇa cakāra saḥ ।। śaktiṃ cikṣepa sūryyābhāṃ tasya vakṣovibhedinīm ।। 10 ।। kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāṃ ca saṃprāpya cetanāmupalabhya saḥ ।। gṛhītvā'nyaddhanurdivyaṃ yaddattaṃ viṣṇunā purā ।। 11 ।। ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ yānamāruhya cāgnibhūḥ ।। śastramastraṃ gṛhītvā ca cakāra raṇamulbaṇam ।। 12 ।। sarpāṃśca parvatāṃścaiva vṛkṣāṃśca prastarāṃstathā ।। sarvāṃściccheda kopena divyāstreṇa śivātmajaḥ ।। 13 ।। āgneyaṃ vāruṇāstreṇa vārayāmāsa vai guhaḥ ।। rathaṃ dhanuśca ciccheda śaṃkhacūḍasya līlayā ।। 14 ।। savāhaṃ sārathiṃ caiva kirīṭaṃ mukuṭojjvalam ।। cikṣepa śaktimulkābhāṃ dānavendrasya vakṣasi ।। 15 ।। mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya rājopalabhya vai cetanāṃ punaḥ ।। āruhya vai yānamanyaṃ dhanurjagrāha satvaraḥ ।। 16 ।। cakāra śarajālaṃ ca māyayā māyināṃ varaḥ ।। guhaṃ cācchādya samare śarajālena nārada ।। 17 ।। jagrāha śaktimavyarthāṃ śatasūryyasamaprabhām ।। pralayāgniśikhārūpāṃ viṣṇorvai tejasā vṛtām ।। 18 ।। cikṣepa tāṃ ca kopena mahāvegena kārttike ।। papāta śaktistadgātre vahnirāśirivojjvalā ।। 19 ।। mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa śaktyā ca kārttikeyo mahābalaḥ ।। kālī gṛhītvā taṃ kroḍe nināya śivasannidhau ।। 20 ।। śivastaṃ darśanādeva jīvayāmāsa līlayā ।। dadau balamanantaṃ ca sa cottasthau pratāpavān ।। 21 ।। śivaḥ svasainyaṃ devāṃśca prerayāmāsa satvaraḥ।। dānavendraiḥ sasainyaiśca yuddhārambho babhūva ha ।। 22 ।। svayaṃ mahendro yuyudhe sārddhaṃ ca vṛṣaparvaṇā ।। bhāskaro yuyudhe vipracittinā saha satvaraḥ ।। 23 ।। dambhena saha candraśca cakāra samaraṃ param ।। kāleśvareṇa kālaśca gokarṇena hutāśanaḥ ।। 24 ।। kuberaḥ kālakeyena viśvakarmā mayena ca ।। bhayaṅkareṇa mṛtyuśca saṃhāreṇa yamastathā ।। 29 ।। kalaviṅkena varuṇaścañcalena samīraṇaḥ ।। budhaśca dhṛtapuṣṭena raktākṣeṇa śanaiścaraḥ ।। 26 ।। jayanto ratnasāreṇa vasavo varcasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ।। aśvinau vai dīptimatā dhūmreṇa nalakūbaraḥ ।। 27 ।। dhanurddhareṇa dharmaśca maṇḍūkākṣeṇa maṅgalaḥ ।। śobhākareṇaiveśānaḥ piṭhareṇa ca manmathaḥ ।।28।। ulkāmukhena dhūmreṇa khaṅgenāpi dhvajena ca ।। kāṃcīmukhena piṇḍena dhūmreṇa saha nandinā ।। 29 ।। viśvena ca palāśena cādityā yuyudhuḥ param ।। ekādaśa mahārudrāścaikādaśa bhayaṅkaraiḥ ।। 30 ।। mahāmārī ca yuyudhe cogradaṇḍādibhiḥ saha ।। nandīśvarādayaḥ sarve dānavānāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha ।। 31 ।। yuyudhuśca mahadyuddhe pralaye ca bhayaṅkare ।। vaṭamūle ca śambhuśca tasthau kālyā sutena ca ।। 32 ।। sarve ca yuyudhuḥ sainyasamūhāḥ satataṃ mune ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye koṭibhirdānavaiḥ saha ।। 33 ।। uvāsa śaṃkhacūḍaśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। śaṅkarasya ca yodhāśca yuddhe sarve parājitāḥ ।। 34 ।। devāśca dudruvuḥ sarve bhītāśca kṣatavikṣatāḥ ।। cakāra kopaṃ skandaśca devebhyaścābhayaṃ dadau ।। 39 ।। balaṃ ca svagaṇānāṃ vai varddhayāmāsa tejasā।। svayamekaśca yuyudhe dānavānāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha ।। 36 ।। akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ samare sa jaghāna ha ।। kharparaṃ pātayāmāsa kālī kamalalocanā ।। 37 ।। papau raktaṃ dānavānāṃ kruddhā sā śatakharparam ।। daśalakṣaṃ gajendrāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca vājinām ।। 38 ।। samādāyaikahastena mukhe cikṣepa līlayā ।। kabandhānāṃ sahasraṃ ca nanartta samare mune ।। 39 ।। skandasya śarajālena dānavāḥ kṣatavikṣatāḥ ।। bhītāśca dudruvuḥ sarve mahābalaparākramāḥ ।। 40 ।। vṛṣaparvā vipracittirdambhaścāpi vikaṅkanaḥ ।। skandena sārddhaṃ yuyudhuste ca sarve krameṇa ca।।41।। kālī jagāma samaramarakṣatkārttikaṃ śivaḥ ।। vīrāstāmanujagmuśca te ca nandīśvarādayaḥ ।। 42 ।। sarve devāśca gandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ ।। rājyabhāṇḍāśca bahuśaḥ śatakoṭirbalāhakāḥ ।। 43 ।। sā ca gatvā ca saṃgrāmaṃ siṃhanādaṃ cakāra ha ।। devyā vai siṃhanādena prāpurmūrcchāṃ ca dānavāḥ ।। 44 ।। aṭṭāṭṭahāsamaśivaṃ cakāra ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। hṛṣṭā papau ca mādhvīkaṃ nanartta raṇamūrddhani ।। 45 ।। ugradaṃṣṭrā cogracaṇḍā kauṭṭarī ca papau madhu ।। yoginīnāṃ ḍākinīnāṃ gaṇāḥ suragaṇādayaḥ ।। 46 ।। dṛṣṭvā kālīṃ śaṅkhacūḍaḥ śīghramājiṃ samāyayau ।। dānavāśca bhayaṃ prāpū rājā tebhyo'bhayaṃ dadau ।। 47 ।। kālī cikṣepa cāgneyaṃ pralayāgniśikhopamam ।। rājā nirvāpayāmāsa vāruṇena sa līlayā ।। 48 ।। cikṣepa vāruṇaṃ sā ca tattīvraṃ mahadadbhutam ।। gāndharveṇa ca ciccheda dānavendraśca līlayā ।। 49 ।। māheśvaraṃ pracikṣepa kālī vahniśikhopamam ।। rājā jaghāna tacchīghraṃ vaiṣṇavena ca līlayā ।। 50 ।। nārāyaṇāstraṃ sā devī cikṣipe mantrapūrvakam ।। rājā nanāma taṃ dṛṣṭvā cāvaruhya rathādaho ।।51।। ūrdhvaṃ jagāma tacchastraṃ pralayāgniśikhopamam ।। papāta śaṅkhacūḍaśca bhaktyā vai daṇḍavadbhuvi ।। brahmāstraṃ sā ca cikṣepa yatnato mantrapūrvakam ।। 52 ।। brahmāstreṇa mahārāja nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra ha ।। cikṣepātīva divyāstraṃ sā devī mantrapūrvakam ।। 53 ।। rājā divyāstrajālena nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra ha ।। devī cikṣepa śaktiṃ ca yatnato yojanāyatām ।। 54 ।। rājā tīkṣṇāstrajālena śatakhaṇḍaṃ cakāra ha ।। jagrāha mantrapūrvaṃ ca devī pāśupataṃ ruṣā ।। 55 ।। nikṣeptuṃ sā niṣiddhā ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। mṛtyuḥ pāśupate nāsti nṛpasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।। 56 ।। yāvadastyeva kaṇṭhe'sya kavacaṃ hi hareriti ।। yāvatsatītvamastīha satyāśca nṛpayoṣitaḥ ।। 57 ।। tāvadasya jarā mṛtyurnāstīti brahmaṇo varaḥ ।। ityākarṇya mahākālī na taccikṣepa sā satī।।58।। śatalakṣaṃ dānavānāmagrahīllīlayā krudhā।। attuṃ jagāma vegena śaṃkhacūḍaṃ bhayaṃkarī।।।।।। divyāstreṇa sutīkṣṇena vārayāmāsa dānavaḥ ।। khaṅgaṃ cikṣepa sā devī grīṣmasūryopamaṃ param ।। 60।। divyāstrairdānavendro'yaṃ śatakhaṇḍaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। punarattuṃ mahādevī vegena ca jagāma tam ।। 61 ।। sarvasiddheśvaraḥ śrīmānvavṛdhe dānaveśvaraḥ ।। nivārayāmāsa ca tāṃ sarvasiddheśvaro varaḥ ।। vegena muṣṭinā kālī kopayuktā bhayaṃkarī ।।62।। babhañjātha rathaṃ tasya cāhanatsārathiṃ satī ।। sā ca śūlaṃ ca cikṣepa pralayāgniśikhopamam ।। 63 ।। vāmahastena jagrāha śaṃkhacūḍaśca līlayā ।। muṣṭyā jaghāna taṃ devī mahākopena vegataḥ ।। 64 ।। babhrāma vyathayā daityaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ha ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau pratāpavān ।। 69 ।। na cakre bāhuyuddhaṃ sa devyā saha nanāma tām ।। devyāścāstraṃ ca ciccheda cāgrahītsvena tejasā ।। 66 ।। nāstraṃ cikṣepa tāṃ bhaktyā mātṛbuddhyā ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 67 ।। gṛhītvā dānavaṃ devī bhrāmayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। ūrdhvaṃ ca prerayāmāsa mahāvegena kopataḥ ।। 68 ।। ūrdhvātpapāta vegena śaṃkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān ।। nipatya ca samuttasthau sa natvā bhadrakālikām ।।69।। ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ vimānāgryaṃ manoharam ।। āruroha rathaṃ hṛṣṭo na viśrānto mahāraṇe ।। । ।। 70 ।। kṣatajaṃ dānavānāṃ ca māṃsaṃ ca vipulaṃ kṣudhā ।। pītvā bhuktvā bhadrakālī yayau sā śaṃkarāntikam ।। 71 ।। uvāca raṇavṛttāntaṃ paurvāparyyaṃ yathākramam ।। śrutvā jahāsa śambhuśca dānavānāṃ vināśanam ।।72।। lakṣaṃ ca dānavendrāṇāmavaśiṣṭaṃ raṇe'dhunā ।। udvṛttaṃ bhūbhṛtā sārddhaṃ tadanyaṃ bhuktamīśvara ।।73।। saṃgrāme dānavendraṃ ca hantuṃ pāśupatena vai ।। avadhyastava rājeti vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। ।। 74 ।। rājendraśca mahājñānī mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। na ca cikṣepa mayyastraṃ ciccheda mama sāyakam ।। 75 ।। iti śrī brahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tulasyupākhyāne kālīśaṃkhacūḍayuddha ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 19 ।।
<2.20> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śivastattvaṃ samākarṇya tattvajñānaviśāradaḥ ।। yayau svayaṃ ca samaraṃ svagaṇaiḥ saha nārada ।। 1 ।। śaṃkhacūḍaḥ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānādavaruhya ca ।। nanāma parayā bhaktyā daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi ।। 2 ।। taṃ praṇamya ca vegena vimānaṃ hyāruroha saḥ ।। tūrṇaṃ cakāra sannāhaṃ dhanurjagrāha durvaham ।। 3 ।। śivadānavayoryuddhaṃ pūrṇamabdaṃ babhūva ha ।। na vai babhūvaturbrahmaṃstayorjayaparājayau ।। 4 ।। nyastaśastraśca bhagavānnyastaśastraśca dānavaḥ ।। rathasthaḥ śaṃkhacūḍaśca vṛṣastho vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ।। 5 ।। dānavānāṃ ca śatakamudvṛttaṃ ca babhūva ha ।। raṇe ye mṛtāḥ śaṃbhorjīvayāmāsa tānvibhuḥ ।। 6 ।। tato viṣṇurmahāmāyo vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk ।। āgatya ca raṇasthānamavocaddānaveśvaram।।7।। vṛddhabrāhmaṇa uvāca ।। dehi bhikṣāṃ ca rājendra mahyaṃ viprāya sāmpratam ।। tvaṃ sarvasampadāṃ dātā yanme manasi vāñchitam ।। 8 ।। nirāhārāya vṛddhāya tṛṣitāyāturāya ca ।। paścāttvāṃ kathayiṣyāmi puraḥ satyaṃ ca kurviti ।।9।। omityuvāca rājendraḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। kavacārthī janaścāhamityuvāca sa māyayā ।। 10 ।। tacchrutvā dānavaśreṣṭho dadau kavacamuttamam ।। gṛhītvā kavacaṃ divyaṃ jagāma harireva ca ।। 11 ।। śaṅkhacūḍasya rūpeṇa jagāma tulasīṃ prati ।। gatvā tasyāṃ māyayā ca vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 12 ।। atha śambhurhareḥ śūlaṃ dānavārthaṃ samagrahīt ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍaśatakaprabhamujjvalam ।। 13 ।। nārāyaṇādhiṣṭhitāgraṃ brahmādhiṣṭhitamadhyamam ।। śivādhiṣṭhitamūlaṃ ca kālādhiṣṭhitadhārakam ।।14।। kiraṇāvalisaṃyuktaṃ pralayāgniśikhopamam ।। durnivāryaṃ ca durdharṣamavyarthaṃ vairighātakam ।। ।। 15 ।। tejasā cakratulyaṃ ca sarvaśastravighātakam ।। śivakeśavayoranyad durvahaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram ।। 16 ।। dhanussahasraṃ dairghyeṇa vistṛtyā śatahastakam ।। sajīvaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca nityarūpamanirmitam ।। 17 ।। saṃhartuṃ sarvavidhyaṇḍamekadā daivalīlayā ।। cikṣepa ghūrṇanaṃ kṛtvā śaṃkhacūḍe ca nārada ।। 18 ।। rājā cāpaṃ parityajya śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbujam ।। dhyānaṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ dhiyā ।। ।।19।। śūlaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā nyapataddānavopari ।। cakāra bhasmasāttaṃ ca sarathaṃ caiva līlayā ।। 20 ।। rājā dhṛtvā divyarūpaṃ bālakaṃ gopaveṣakam ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।।21।। nānāratnasubhūṣāḍhyagopakoṭibhirāvṛtam ।। golokādāgataṃ yānamāruhya tatpuraṃ yayau।।22।। gatvā nanāma śirasā rādhāmādhavayormune ।। bhaktyā taccaraṇāmbhojaṃ rāse vṛndāvane mune।। sudāmānaṃ tau ca dṛṣṭvā prasanna vadanekṣaṇau ।। 23 ।। tadā ca cakratuḥ kroḍe snehena parisaṃplutau ।। atha śūlaśca vegena prayayau śūlinaḥ karam ।। 24 ।। śaṅkarastena śūlena dānavasyāsthijālakam ।। 25 ।। premṇā ca prerayāmāsa lavaṇode ca sāgare ।। asthibhiḥ śaṃkhacūḍasya śaṃkhajātirbabhūva ha ।। ।। 26 ।। nānāprakārarūpā ca śreṣṭhā pūtā surārcane ।। praśastaṃ śaṃkhatoyaṃ ca devānāṃ prītidaṃ param ।। 27 ।। tīrthatoyasvarūpaṃ ca pavitraṃ śaṃkaraṃ vinā ।। śaṃkhaśabdo bhavedyatra tatra lakṣmīśca susthirā ।। 28 ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yaḥ snātaḥ śaṃkhavāriṇā ।। śaṃkhaṃ hareradhiṣṭhānaṃ yatra śaṃkhastato hariḥ ।। 29 ।। tatraiva satataṃ lakṣmīrdūrībhūtamamaṅgalam ।। strīṇāṃ ca śaṃkhadhvanibhiḥ śūdrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।। bhītā ruṣṭā yāti lakṣmīḥ sthalamanyaṃ sthalāttataḥ ।। 30।। śivaśca dānavaṃ hatvā śivalokaṃ jagāma saḥ।। prahṛṣṭo vṛṣamāruhya svagaṇaiśca samāvṛtaḥ ।। 31 ।। surāḥ svaviṣayaṃ prāpuḥ paramānandasaṃyutāḥ ।। nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ ।। ।। 32 ।। babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca śivasyopari santatam ।। praśaśaṃsuḥ surāstaṃ ca munīndrapravarādayaḥ ।। 33 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpu rāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tulasyupākhyāne śaṃkhacūḍavadhe śaṃkhaprastāvo nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 20 ।।
<2.21> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānvīryyādhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। tulasyā kena rūpeṇa tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।।1।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavāndevānāṃ sādhanena ca ।। śaṃkhacūḍasya rūpeṇa reme tadrāmayā saha ।।2।। śaṃkhacūḍasya kavacaṃ gṛhītvā māyayā hariḥ ।। punarvidhāya tadrūpaṃ jagāma tulasīgṛham ।। 3 ।। dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa tulasīdvārasannidhau ।। jayaśabdaravadvārā bodhayāmāsa sundarīm ।। 4 ।। tacchrutvā sā ca sādhvī ca paramānandasaṃyutā ।। rājamārgagavākṣeṇa dadarśa paramādarāt ।। 5 ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā kārayāmāsa maṅgalam ।6। bandibhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca vācikebhyo dhanaṃ dadau ।। 6 ।। avaruhya rathāddevo devyāśca bhavanaṃ yayau ।। amūlyaratnasaṃklṛptaṃ sundaraṃ sumanoharam ।। 7 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca purataḥ kāntaṃ śāntaṃ kāntā mudā'nvitā ।। tatpādaṃ kṣālayāmāsa nanāma ca ruroda ca ।। 8।। ratnasiṃhā sane ramye vāsayāmāsa kāmukī ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau tasmai karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 9 ।। adya me saphalaṃ janma hyadya me saphalāḥ kriyāḥ ।। raṇāgataṃ ca prāṇeśaṃ paśyantyāśca punargṛhe।। 10।। sasmitā sakaṭākṣaṃ ca sakāmā pulakāñcitā ।। papraccha raṇavṛttāntaṃ kāntaṃ madhurayā girā ।। 11 ।। tulasyuvāca ।। asaṃkhyaviśvasaṃhartrā sārddhamājau tava prabho ।। kathaṃ babhūva vijayastanme brūhi kṛpānidhe ।।12।। tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya kamalāpatiḥ ।। śaṃkhacūḍasya rūpeṇa tāmuvācānṛtaṃ vacaḥ ।। 13 ।। śrīhariruvāca ।। āvayoḥ samaraṃ kānte pūrṇamabdaṃ babhūva ha ।। nāśo babhūva sarveṣāṃ dānavānāṃ ca kāmini ।। 14 ।। prītiṃ ca kārayāmāsa brahmā ca svayamāvayoḥ ।। devānāmadhikāraśca pradatto brahmaṇā purā ।। 15 ।। mayā''gataṃ svabhavanaṃ śivalokaṃ śivo gataḥ ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthaḥ śayanaṃ ca cakāra ha ।।16।। reme ramāpatistatra rāmayā saha nārada ।। sā sādhvī sukhasambhogādākarṣaṇavyatikramāt ।। sarvaṃ vitarkayāmāsa kastvamevetyuvāca ha ।। 17 ।। tulasyuvāca ।। ko vā tvaṃ vada māyeśo bhuktā'haṃ māyayā tvayā।।18।। dūrīkṛtaṃ matsatītvamathavā tvāṃ śapāmahe ।। tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā hariḥ śāpabhayena ca ।। 19 ।। dadhāra līlayā brahmansvāṃ mūrtiṃ sumanoharām ।। dadarśa purato devī devadevaṃ sanātanam ।। navīnanīrada śyāmaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam ।। 20 ।। koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā ।। 21 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā kāminī kāmānmūrchāṃ saṃprāpa līlayā ।। punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya punaḥ sā tamuvāca ha ।। 22 ।। he nātha te dayā nāsti pāṣāṇa sadṛśasya ca।। chalena dharmabhaṅgena mama svāmī tvayā hataḥ ।। 23 ।। pāṣāṇasadṛśastvaṃ ca dayāhīno yataḥ prabho ।। tasmātpāṣāṇarūpa stvaṃ bhuvi deva bhavādhunā ।। 24 ।। ye vadanti dayāsindhuṃ tvāṃ te bhrāntā na saṃśayaḥ ।। bhakto vinā'parādhena parārthe ca kathaṃ hataḥ ।।25।। durvṛttastvaṃ ca sarvajño na jānāsi paravyathām ।। atastvamekajanuṣi svameva vismariṣyasi ।। 26 ।। ityuktvā ca mahāsādhvī nipatya caraṇe hareḥ ।। bhṛśaṃ ruroda śokārttā vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ ।। 27 ।। tasyāśca karuṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā karuṇāmayasāgaraḥ ।। nārāyaṇastāṃ bodhayitumuvāca kamalāpatiḥ ।। 28 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। tapastvayā kṛtaṃ sādhvi madarthe bhārate ciram ।। tvadarthe śaṅkhacūḍaśca cakāra suciraṃ tapaḥ ।। 29 ।। kṛtvā tvāṃ kāminīṃ kāmī vijahāra ca tatphalāt ।। adhunā dātumucitaṃ tavaiva tapasaḥ phalam ।। 30 ।। idaṃ śarīraṃ tyaktvā ca divyaṃ dehaṃ vidhāya ca ।। rāse me ramayā sārddhaṃ tvaṃ ramāsadṛśī bhava।।31।। iyaṃ tanurnadīrūpā gaṇḍakīti ca viśrutā ।। pūtā supuṇyadā nṛṇāṃ puṇyā bhavatu bhārate ।। 32 ।। tava keśasamūhāśca puṇyavṛkṣā bhavantviti ।। tulasīkeśasambhūtā tulasīti ca viśrutā ।। 33 ।। trilokeṣu ca puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇāṃ devapūjane ।। pradhānarūpā tulasī bhaviṣyati varānane ।।34।। svarge martye ca pātāle vaikuṇṭhe mama sannidhau।। bhavantu tulasīvṛkṣā varāḥ puṣpeṣu sundari ।। 35 ।। goloke virajātīre rāse vṛndāvane bhuvi ।। bhāṇḍīre campakavane ramye candanakānane ।। 36 ।। mādhavīketakīkundamallikāmālatīvane ।। bhavantu taravastatra puṣpasthāneṣu puṇyadā ।। 37 ।। tulasītarumūle ca puṇyadeśe supuṇyade ।। adhiṣṭhānaṃ tu tīrthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca bhaviṣyati ।। 38 ।। tatraiva sarvadevānāṃ samadhiṣṭhānameva ca ।। tulasīpatrapatanaṃ prāyo yatra varānane।। 39 ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।। tulasīpatratoyena yo'bhiṣekaṃ samācaret ।। 40।। sudhāghaṭasahasreṇa sā tuṣṭirna bhaveddhareḥ ।। yā ca tuṣṭirbhavennṝṇāṃ tulasīpatradānataḥ ।। 41 ।। gavāmayutadānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। tulasīpatradānena tatphalaṃ labhate sati ।। 42 ।। tulasīpatratoyaṃ ca mṛtyukāle ca yo labhet ।। sa mucyate sarvapāpādviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ।। 43 ।। nityaṃ yastulasī toyaṃ bhuṅkte bhaktyā ca yo naraḥ ।। sa eva jīvanmuktaśca gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet।।44।। nityaṃ yastulasīṃ dattvā pūjayenmāṃ ca mānavaḥ।। lakṣāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 45 ।। tulasīṃ svakare dhṛtvā dehe dhṛtvā ca mānavaḥ ।। prāṇāṃstyajati tīrtheṣu viṣṇu lokaṃ sa gacchati ।। 46 ।। tulasīkāṣṭhanirmāṇamālāṃ gṛhṇāti yo naraḥ ।। pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam ।। 47 ।। tulasīṃ svakare dhṛtvā svīkāraṃ yo na rakṣati ।। sa yāti kālasūtraṃ ca yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 48 ।। karoti mithyāśapathaṃ tulasyā yo hi mānavaḥ ।। sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 49 ।। tulasītoyakaṇikāṃ mṛtyukāle ca yo labhet ।। ratnayānaṃ samāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa prayāti ca।। 50। pūrṇimāyāmamāyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ ravisaṃkrame ।। tailābhyaṃge cāsnāte ca madhyāhne niśi sandhyayoḥ ।। 51 ।। āśauce'śucikāle vā rātrivāsānvite narāḥ ।। tulasīṃ ye ca chindanti te chindanti hareḥ śiraḥ ।। 52 ।। trirātraṃ tulasīpatraṃ śuddhaṃ paryuṣitaṃ sati ।। śrāddhe vrate vā dāne vā pratiṣṭhāyāṃ surārcane ।। 53 ।। bhūgataṃ toyapatitaṃ yaddattaṃ viṣṇave sati ।। śuddhaṃ tu tula sīpatraṃ kṣālanādanyakarmaṇi ।।54।। vṛkṣādhiṣṭhātrī devī yā goloke ca nirāmaye ।। kṛṣṇena sārddhaṃ rahasi nityaṃ krīḍāṃ kariṣyati।55।। nadyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā bhārate ca supuṇyadā ।। lavaṇodasya patnī ca madaṃśasya bhaviṣyati ।।56।। tvaṃ ca svayaṃ mahāsādhvī vaikuṇṭhe mama sannidhau ।। ramāsamā ca rāse ca bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 57 ।। ahaṃ ca śailarūpī ca gaṇḍakītīrasannidhau ।। adhiṣṭhānaṃ kari ṣyāmi bhārate tava śāpataḥ ।। 58 ।। vajrakīṭāśca kṛmayo vajradaṃṣṭrāśca tatra vai ।। tacchilākuhare cakraṃ kariṣyanti madīyakama।।59।। ekadvāre catuścakraṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidham ।। 60।। ekadvāre catuścakraṃ navīnanīradopamam।। lakṣmījanārdanaṃ jñeyaṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā ।। 61 ।। dvāradvaye catuścakraṃ goṣpadena samanvitam ।। raghunāthābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā ।। ।। 62 ।। atikṣudraṃ dvicakraṃ ca navīnajaladaprabham ।। dadhivāmanābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca sukhapradam ।। 63 ।। atikṣudraṃ dvicakraṃ ca vanamā lāvibhūṣitam ।। vijñeyaṃ śrīdharaṃ devaṃ śrīpradaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā ।। 64 ।। sthūlaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā ।। dvicakaṃ sphuṭamatyantaṃ jñeyaṃ dāmodarābhidham ।। 65 ।। madhyamaṃ vartulākāraṃ dvicakraṃ bāṇavikṣatam ।। raṇarāmābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ śaratūṇasamanvitam ।। 66 ।। madhyamaṃ saptacakraṃ ca chatratūṇasamanvitam ।। rājarājeśvaraṃ jñeyaṃ rājasampatpradaṃ nṛṇām ।। 67 ।। dvisaptacakraṃ sthūlaṃ ca navīnajaladaprabham ।। anantākhyaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam ।। 68 ।। cakrākāraṃ dvicakraṃ ca saśrīkaṃ jaladaprabham ।। sagoṣpadaṃ madhyamaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ madhusūda nam।।69।। sudarśanaṃ caikacakraṃ guptacakraṃ gadādharam ।। dvicakraṃ hayavaktrābhaṃ hayagrīvaṃ prakīrttitam।। 70।। atīva vistṛtāsyaṃ ca dvicakraṃ vikaṭaṃ sati ।। narasiṃhābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ sadyo vairāgyadaṃ nṛṇām ।। 71 ।। dvicakraṃ vistṛtāsyaṃ ca vanamālāsamanvitam ।। lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ vijñeyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sukhadaṃ sadā ।। 72 ।। dvāradeśe dvicakraṃ ca saśrīkaṃ ca samaṃ sphuṭam ।। vāsudevaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ।। 73 ।। pradyumnaṃ sūkṣmacakraṃ ca navīnanīradaprabham ।। suṣire cchidrabahulaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca sukhapradam ।। 74 ।। dve cakre caikalagne ca pṛṣṭhe yatra tu puṣkalam ।। saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ sukhadaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā ।। 75 ।। aniruddhaṃ tu pītābhaṃ vartulaṃ cātiśobhanam ।। sukhapradaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ pravadanti manī ṣiṇaḥ ।। 76 ।। śālagrāmaśilā yatra tatra sannihito hariḥ ।। tatraiva lakṣmīrvasati sarvatīrthasamanvitā।।77।। yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ।। tāni sarvāṇi naśyaṃti śālagrāmaśilārccanāt ।। 78 ।। chatrākāraṃ bhavedrājyaṃ vartule ca mahāśriyaḥ ।। duḥkhaṃ ca śakaṭākāre śūlāgre maraṇaṃ dhuvam ।। 79 ।। vikṛtāsye ca dāridryaṃ piṅgale hānireva ca ।। lagnacakre bhavedvyādhirvidīrṇe maraṇaṃ dhuvam ।। 80 ।। vrataṃ dānaṃ pratiṣṭhā ca śrāddhaṃ ca devapūjanam ।। śālagrāmaśilāyāścaivādhiṣṭhānātpraśastakam ।। 81 ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।। śālagrāmaśilātoyairyo'bhiṣekaṃ samācaret ।। 82 ।। sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ prādakṣiṇye bhuvo yathā ।। sarvayajñeṣu tīrtheṣu vrateṣvanaśaneṣu ca ।। 83 ।। tasya sparśaṃ ca vāñchanti tīrthāni nikhilāni ca ।। jīvanmukto mahāpūto bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।84।। pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ tapasāṃ karaṇe sati ।। tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nṛnaṃ śālagrāmaśilārcanāt ।। 85 ।। śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca yo naraḥ ।। surepsitaṃ prasādaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāharam ।।86।। tasya sparśaṃ ca vāñchanti tīrthāni nikhi lāni ca ।। jīvanmukto mahāpūto'pyante yāti hareḥ padam ।। 87 ।। tatraiva hariṇā sārddhamasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam ।। paśyatyeva hi dāsye ca nirmukto dāsyakarmaṇi ।। 88 ।। yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ।। taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā bhiyā yānti vainateyamivo ragāḥ ।। 89 ।। tatpādapadmarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। puṃsāṃ lakṣaṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ nistārastasya janmanaḥ ।। 90 ।। śālagrāmaśilā toyaṃ mṛtyukāla ca yo labhet ।। sarvapāpādvinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ।। 91 ।। nirvāṇamuktiṃ labhate karmabhogādvimucyate ।। viṣṇupāde pralīnaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।92।। śālagrāmaśilāṃ dhṛtvā mithyāvādaṃ vadettu yaḥ।। sa yāti kūrmadaṃṣṭraṃ ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 93 ।। śālagrāmaśilāṃ spṛṣṭvā svīkāraṃ yo na pālayet ।। sa prayātyasipatraṃ ca lakṣamanvantarādhikam ।। 94 ।। tulasīpatra vicchedaṃ śālagrāme karoti yaḥ ।। tasya janmāntare kāle strīvicchedo bhaviṣyati ।। 95 ।। tulasīpatravicchedaṃ śaṃkhe yo hi karoti ca ।। bhāryyāhīno bhavetso'pi rogī ca saptajanmasu ।। 96 ।। śālagrāmaṃ ca tulasīṃ śaṃkhamekatra eva ca ।। yo rakṣati mahājñānī sa bhave cchrīharipriyaḥ ।। 97 ।। sakṛdeva hi yo yasyāṃ vīryyādhānaṃ karoti yaḥ ।। tadvicchede tasya duḥkhaṃ bhavedeva parasparam ।। 98 ।। tvaṃ priyā śaṃkhacūḍasya caikamanvantarāvadhi ।। śaṃkhena sārddha tvadbhedaḥ kevalaṃ duḥkhadastava ।।99।। ityuktvā śrīharistāṃ ca virarāma ca sādaram ।। sa ca dehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ dadhāra ha ।। 100 ।। yathā śrīśca tathā sā cāpyuvāsa harivakṣasi ।। prajagāma tayā sārddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ kamalā patiḥ ।। 101 ।। lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṅgā tulasī cāpi nārada ।। hareḥ priyāścatasraśca vabhūvurīśvarasya ca ।। 102 ।। sadyastaddehajātā ca babhūva gaṇḍakī nadī ।। hareraṃśena śailaśca tattīre puṇyado nṛṇām ।। 103 ।। kurvanti tatra kīṭāśca śilāṃ bahuvidhāṃ mune ।। jale patanti yā yāśca jaladābhāśca niścitam ।। 104 ।। sthalasthāḥ piṅgalā jñeyāścopatāpāddhareriti ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 105 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde tulasyupākhyānaṃ ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ।। 21 ।।
<2.22> nārada uvāca ।। tulasī ca jagatpūjyā pūtā nārāyaṇapriyā ।। tasyāḥ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ kiṃ na śrutaṃ mayā।। ।। 1 ।। kena pūjyā stutā kena purā prathamato mune ।। tava pūjyā sā babhūva kena vā vada māmaho ।। 2 ।। sūta uvāca ।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya garuḍadhvajaḥ ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe puṇyarūpāṃ purātanīm ।।3।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। hariḥ saṃprāpya tulasīṃ reme ca ramayā saha ।। ramāsamāṃ tāṃ saubhāgyāṃ cakāra gauraveṇa ca ।। 4 ।। sehe lakṣmīśca gaṃgā ca tasyāśca navasaṃgamam ।। saubhāgyaṃ gauravaṃ kopānna sehe ca sarasvatī ।।5।। sā tāṃ jaghāna kalahe māninī harisannidhau ।। vrīḍayā svāpamānācca sā'ntarddhānaṃ cakāra ha।।6।। sarvasiddheśvarī devī jñāninī siddhayoginī ।। babhūvādarśanaṃ kopātsarvatra ca hareraho।।7।। harirna dṛṣṭvā tulasīṃ bodhayitvā sarasvatīm।। tadanujñāṃ gṛhītvā ca jagāma tulasīvanam।।8।। tatra gatvā ca snātvā ca tulasyā tulasīṃ satīm।। pūjayāmāsa dhyātvā tāṃ stotraṃ bhaktyā cakāra ha।।9।। lakṣmīmāyākāmavāṇībījapūrvaṃ daśākṣaram।। vṛndāvanīti ṅentaṃ ca vahnijāyāntameva ca।। 10।। śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ vṛndāvanyai svāhā ।। anena kalpataruṇā mantrarājena nārada ।। pūjayecca vidhānena sarvasiddhiṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 11 ।। ghṛtadīpena dhūpena sinduracandanena ca ।। naivedyena ca puṣpeṇa copahāreṇa nārada।।12।। haristotreṇa tuṣṭā sā cāvirbhūya mahīruhāt।। prapannā caraṇāmbhoje jagāma śaraṇaṃ śubham।।13।। varaṃ tasyai dadau viṣṇurjagatpūjyā bhaveti ca ।। ahaṃ tvāṃ ca dhariṣyāmi svamūrdhni vakṣasīti ca ।। 14 ।। sarve tvāṃ dhārayiṣyanti svayaṃ mūrdhni surādayaḥ ।। ityuktvā tāṃ gṛhītvā ca prayayau svālayaṃ vibhuḥ।।15।। nārada uvāca ।। kiṃ dhyānaṃ stavanaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ vā pūjāvidhikramam ।। tulasyāśca mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi।।16।। nārāyaṇa uvāca।। antarhitāyāṃ tasyāṃ ca gatvā ca tulasīvanam।। hariḥ saṃpūjya tuṣṭāva tulasīṃ virahāturaḥ ।। 17 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। vṛndārūpāśca vṛkṣāśca yadaikatra bhavanti ca ।। vidurbudhāstena vṛndāṃ matpriyāṃ tāṃ bhajā myaham।।18।। purā babhūva yā devī hyādau vṛndāvane vane ।। tena vṛndāvanī khyātā tāṃ saubhāgyāṃ bhajāmyaham।।19।। asaṃkhyeṣu ca viśveṣu pūjitā yā nirantaram ।। tena viśvapūjitākhyāṃ jagatpūjyāṃ bhajāmyaham ।। 20।। asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni pavitrāṇi yayā sadā ।। tāṃ viśvapāvanīṃ devīṃ viraheṇa smarāmyaham ।।21।। devā na tuṣṭāḥ puṣpāṇāṃ samūhena yayā vinā ।। tāṃ puṣpasārāṃ śuddhāṃ ca draṣṭumicchāmi śokataḥ।।22।। viśve yatprāptimātreṇa bhaktyā''nando bhaveddhruvam।। nandinī tena vikhyātā sā prītā bhavitā hi me।।23।। yasyā devyā stulā nāsti viśveṣu nikhileṣu ca ।। tulasī tena vikhyātā tāṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ priye ।। 24 ।। kṛṣṇajīvanarūpā yā śaśvatpriyatamā satī ।। tena kṛṣṇajīvanīti mama rakṣatu jīvanam ।। 25 ।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā tatra tasthau ramāpatiḥ ।। dadarśa tulasīṃ sākṣātpāda padme natāṃ satīm ।। 26 ।। rudatīmabhimānena māninīṃ mānapūjitām ।। priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā priyaḥ śīghraṃ vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 27 ।। bhāratyājñāṃ gṛhītvā ca svālayaṃ ca yayau hariḥ ।। bhāratyā saha tatprītiṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram ।। 28 ।। varaṃ viṣṇurdadau tasyai viśvapūjyā bhaveti ca ।। śirodhāryyā ca sarveṣāṃ vandyā mānyā mameti ca ।। 29 ।। viṣṇorvareṇa sā devī parituṣṭā babhūva ha ।। sarasvatī tāmāśliṣya vāsayāmāsa sannidhau ।। 30 ।। lakṣmīrgaṅgā sasmitā tāṃ samāśliṣya ca nārada ।। gṛhaṃ praveśayāmāsa vinayena satīṃ tadā।।31।। vṛndāṃ vṛndāvanīṃ viśvapāvanīṃviśvapūjitām ।। puṣpasārāṃ nandinīṃ ca tulasīṃ kṛṣṇajīvanīm।।32।। etannāmāṣṭakaṃ caita tstotraṃ nāmārthasaṃyutam ।। yaḥ paṭhettāṃ ca saṃpūjya so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 33 ।। kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca tulasyā janma maṅgalam ।। tatra tasyāśca pūjā ca vihitā hariṇā purā ।। 34 ।। tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayettāṃ ca bhaktyā ca viśvapāvanīm ।। sarvapāpādvinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ।। 35 ।। kārttike tulasīpatraṃ viṣṇave yo dadāti ca ।। gavāmayutadānasya phalamāpnoti niścitam ।।36।। aputro labhate putraṃ priyāhīno labhetpriyām ।। bandhuhīno labhedbandhuṃ stotrasmaraṇamātrataḥ ।। 37 ।। rogī pramucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt ।। bhayānmucyeta bhītastu pāpānmucyeta pātakī ।। 38 ।। ipyevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ dhyānapūjāvidhiṃ śṛṇu।। tvameva veda jānāsi kāṇvaśākhoktameva ca ।। 39 ।। yadvakṣye pūjayettāṃ ca bhaktyā cāvāhanaṃ vinā ।। upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdhyānaṃ pātakanāśanam ।। 40 ।। tulasīṃ puṣpasārāṃ ca satīṃ pūjyāṃ manoharām ।। kṛtsnapāpedhmadāhāya jvaladagniśikhopamām ।।41।। puṣpeṣu tulanāpyasyā nāsīddevīṣu vā mune ।। pavitrarūpā sarvāsu tulasī sā ca kīrttitā ।। 42 ।। śirodhāryyā ca sarveṣāmīpsitāṃ viśvapāvanīm ।। jīvanmuktāṃ muktidāṃ ca bhaja tāṃ haribhaktidām।।43।। iti dhyātvā ca saṃpūjya stutvā ca praṇamedbudhaḥ ।। uktaṃ tulasyupākhyānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥśrotumi cchasi ।। 44 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tulasyupākhyānaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ।।22।।
<2.23> nārada uvāca ।। tulasyupākhyānamidaṃ śrutamīśa sudhopamam ।। yattu sāvitryupākhyānaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। purā yena samudbhūtā sā śrutā ca śrutiprasūḥ ।। kena vā pūjitā devī prathame kaiśca vā pare ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। brahmaṇā vedajananī pūjitā prathame mune ।। dvitīye ca devagaṇaistatpaścādviduṣāṃ gaṇaiḥ ।। 3 ।। tathā cāśvapatiḥ pūrvaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhārate ।। tatpaścātpūjayāmāsurvarṇāścatvāra eva ca ।। 4 ।। nārada uvāca ।। ko vā so'śvapatirbrahmankena vā tena pūjitā ।। sarvapūjyā ca sāvitrī tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 5 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। madradeśe mahārājo babhūvāśvapatirmune ।। vairiṇāṃ balaharttā ca mitrāṇāṃ duḥkhanāśanaḥ ।। 6 ।। āsīttasya mahārājñī mahiṣī dharmacāriṇī ।। mālatīti ca sā khyātā yathā lakṣmīrgadābhṛtaḥ ।। 7 ।। sā ca rājñī mahāsādhvī vasiṣṭhasyopadeśataḥ ।। cakārārādhanaṃ bhaktyā sāvitryāścaiva nārada ।। 8 ।। pratyādeśaṃ na sā prāpa mahiṣī na dadarśa tām ।। gṛhaṃ jagāma sā duḥkhāddhṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 9 ।। rājā tāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā bodhayitvā nayena vai ।। sāvitryāstapase bhaktyā jagāma puṣkaraṃ tadā ।। 10 ।। tapaścacāra tatraiva saṃyataḥ śatavatsaram ।। na dadarśa ca sāvitrīṃ pratyādeśo babhūva ha ।। 11 ।। śuśrāvākāśavāṇīṃ ca nṛpendraścāśarīriṇīm ।। gāyatrīdaśalakṣaṃ ca japaṃ kurviti nārada ।। 12 ।। etasminnantare tatra prajagāma parāśaraḥ ।। praṇanāma nṛpastaṃ ca munirnṛpamuvāca ha ।। 13 ।। parāśara uvāca ।। sakṛjjapaśca gāyatryāḥ pāpaṃ dinakṛtaṃ haret ।। daśadhā prajapānnṝṇāṃ divārātryaghameva ca ।। 14 ।। śatadhā ca japāccaivaṃ pāpaṃ māsārjitaṃ param ।। sahasradhā japāccaiva kalmaṣaṃ vatsarārjitam ।। 15 ।। lakṣaṃ janmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ daśalakṣaṃ trijanmanaḥ ।। sarvajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śatalakṣo vinaśyati ।। 15 ।। karoti muktiṃ viprāṇāṃ japo daśaguṇastataḥ ।। karaṃ sarpaphaṇākāraṃ kṛtvā tu ūrdhvamudritam ।। 17 ।। ānamramūrddhamacalaṃ prajapetprāṅmukho dvijaḥ ।। anāmikāmadhyadeśādatho vāmakrameṇa ca ।। 18 ।। tarjanīmūlaparyyantaṃ japasyaiṣa kramaḥ kare ।। śvetapaṅkaja bījānāṃ sphāṭikānāṃ ca saṃskṛtām ।। 19 ।। kṛtvā vā mālikāṃ rājañjapettīrthe surālaye ।। saṃsthāpya mālāmaśvatthapatrasaptasu saṃyataḥ ।। 20 ।। kṛtvā gorocanāktāṃ ca gāyatryā snāpayetsudhīḥ ।। gāyatrīśatakaṃ tasyāṃ japecca vidhipūrvakam ।। 21 ।। athavā pañcagavyena snātā mālā ca saṃskṛtā ।। atha gaṅgodakenaiva snātā vā'tisusaṃskṛtā ।।22।। evaṃ krameṇa rājarṣe daśalakṣaṃ japaṃ kuru ।। sākṣād drakṣyasi sāvitrīṃ trijanmamapātakakṣayāt ।। 23 ।। nityaṃ nityaṃ trisandhyaṃ ca kariṣyasi dine dine ।। madhyāhne cāpi sāyāhne prātareva śuciḥ sadā ।। 24 ।। sandhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet ।। 25 ।। nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yaśca paścimām ।। sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryyaḥ sarvasmād dvijakarmaṇaḥ ।।26।। yāvajjīvanaparyyantaṃ yastrisandhyāṃ karoti ca ।। sa ca sūryyasamo viprastejasā tapasā sadā ।।27।। tatpādapadmarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। jīvanmuktaḥ sa tejasvī sandhyā pūto hi yo dvijaḥ ।। 28 ।। tīrthāni ca pavitrāṇi tasya sparśanamātrataḥ ।। tataḥ pāpāni yāntyeva vainateyādivoragāḥ ।। 29 ।। na gṛhṇanti surāḥ pūjāṃ pitaraḥ piṇḍatarpaṇam ।। svecchayā ca dvijāteśca trisandhyarahitasya ca ।। 30 ।। viṣṇumantravihīnaśca trisandhyarahito dvijaḥ ।। ekādaśīvihīnaśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 31 ।। hareranaivedyabhojī dhāvako vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। śūdrānnabhojī vipraśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 32 ।। śavadāhī ca śūdrāṇāṃ yo vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 33 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ ca pratigrāhī śūdrayājī ca yo dvijaḥ ।। asijīvī maṣījīvī viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।।34।। yo vipro'vīrānnabhojī ṛtusnātānnabhojakaḥ ।। bhagajīvī vārdhuṣiko viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 35 ।। yaḥ kanyāvikrayī vipro yo harernāmavikrayī ।। yo vidyāvikrayī bhūpa viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 36 ।। sūryyodaye ca dvirbhojī matsyabhojī ca yo dvijaḥ ।। śilāpūjādirahito viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 37 ।। ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭhaḥ sarva pūjāvidhikramam ।। tamuvāca ca sāvitryā dhyānādikamabhīpsitam ।। 38 ।। dattvā sarvaṃ nṛpendrāya prayayau svālayaṃ muniḥ ।। rājā saṃpūjya sāvitrīṃ dadarśa varamāpa ca।।39।। nārada uvāca।। kiṃ vā dhyānaṃ ca sāvitryāḥ kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānakam।। stotraṃ mantraṃ ca kiṃ dattvā prayayau sa parāśaraḥ ।। 40।। nṛpaḥ kena vidhānena saṃpūjya śrutimātaram।। varaṃ ca kiṃ vā saṃprāpa vada so'śvapatirnṛpaḥ।।41।। nārāyaṇa uvāca।। jyeṣṭhe kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ śuddhe kāle ca saṃyataḥ।। vratameva caturdaśyāṃ vratī bhaktyā samācaret।।42।। vrataṃ caturdaśābdaṃ ca dvisaptaphalasaṃyutam।। dattvā dvisaptanaivedyaṃ puṣpadhūpādikaṃ tathā ।।43।। vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca bhojyaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam।। saṃsthāpya maṅgalaghaṭaṃ phalaśākhāsamanvitama।।44।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām।। saṃpūjya pūjayediṣṭaṃ ghaṭe āvāhite mune।।45।। śṛṇu dhyānaṃ ca sāvitryāścoktaṃ mādhyandine ca yat।। stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca mantraṃ ca sarvakāmadam ।। 46 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ jvalantīṃ brahmatejasā ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍasahasrasamasuprabhām ।। 47 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ।।48।। sukhadāṃ muktidāṃ śāntāṃ kāntāṃ ca jagatāṃ vidheḥ।। sarvasampatsvarūpāṃ ca pradātrīṃ sarvasampadām ।। 49 ।। vedādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca vedaśāstrasvarūpiṇīm ।। vede bījasvarūpāṃ ca bhaje tvāṃ vedamātaram ।। 50 ।। dhyātvā dhyānena cānena dattvā puṣpaṃ svamūrddhani ।। punardhyātvā ghaṭe bhaktyā devīmāvāhayedvratī ।। 51 ।। dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ vedoktamantrapūrvakam ।। sampūjya stutvā praṇamedevaṃ devīṃ vidhānataḥ ।। 52 ।। āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ cānulepanam ।। dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ śītalaṃ jalam।।53।। vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mālyaṃ gandhamācamanīyakam।। manoharaṃ sutalpaṃ ca deyānyetāni ṣoḍaśa।।54।। dārusāravikāraṃ ca hemādinirmitaṃ ca vā ।। devādhāraṃ puṇyadaṃ ca mayā nityaṃ niveditam ।। 55 ।। tīrthodakaṃ ca pādyaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ prītidaṃ mahat ।। pūjāṅgabhūtaṃ śuddhaṃ ca mayā bhaktyā niveditam।। 56 ।। pavitrarūpamarghyaṃ ca dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitam ।। puṇyadaṃ śaṃkhatoyāktaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam ।। 57।। sugandhi dhātrītailaṃ ca dehasaundaryyakāraṇam ।। mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā snānīyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 58 ।। malayācalasambhūtaṃ dehaśobhāvivarddhanam ।। sugandhiyuktaṃ sukhadaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam ।। 59 ।। gandhadravyodbhavaḥ puṇyaḥ prītido divyagandhadaḥ ।। mayā nivedito bhaktyā dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 60 ।। jagatāṃ darśanīyaṃ ca darśanaṃ dīptikāraṇam ।। andhakāradhvaṃsabījaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ niveditam ।। 61 ।। tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva prītidaṃ kṣudvināśanam ।। puṇyadaṃ svādurūpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 62 ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ caiva mayā bhaktyā niveditam ।। 63 ।। suśītalaṃ vāsitaṃ ca pipāsānāśakāraṇam ।। jagatāṃ jīvarūpaṃ ca jīvanaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।।64।। dehaśobhāsvarūpaṃ ca sabhāśobhāvivarddhanam ।। kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।।65।। kāñcanādibhirābaddhaṃ śrīyuktaṃ śrīkaraṃ sadā।। sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva bhūṣaṇaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 66 ।। nānāpuṣpalatākīrṇaṃ bahubhāsā samanvitam ।। prītidaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva mālyaṃ vai pratigṛhyatām ।। 67 ।। sarvamaṅgalarūpaśca sarva maṅgalado varaḥ ।। puṇyapradaśca gandhāḍhyo gandhaśca pratigṛhyatām ।।68।। śuddhaṃ śuddhipradaṃ caiva śuddhānāṃ prītidaṃ mahat ।। ramyamācamanīyaṃ ca mayā dattaṃ pragṛhyatām ।। 69 ।। ratnasārādinirmāṇaṃ puṣpacandanasaṃyutam ।। sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva sutalpaṃ pratigṛhyatāma ।। 70 ।। nānāvṛkṣasamudbhūtaṃ nānārūpasamanvitam ।। phalasvarūpaṃ phaladaṃ phalaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām ।। 71 ।। sindūraṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ bhālaśobhāvivarddhanam ।। bhūṣaṇaṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca sindūraṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 72 ।। viśuddhagraṃthisaṃyuktaṃ puṇyasūtravinirmitam ।। pavitraṃ vedamantreṇa yajñasūtraṃ ca gṛhyatām ।। 73 ।। dravyāṇyetāni mūlena dattvā stotraṃ paṭhetsudhīḥ ।। tataḥ praṇamya viprāya vratī dadyācca dakṣiṇām ।। 74 ।। sāvitrīti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ।। lakṣmīmāyākāmapūrvaṃ mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ viduḥ ।। 79 ।। śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ sāvitryai svāhā ।। madhyandinoktaṃ stotraṃ ca sarvavāñchāphalapradam ।। viprajīvanarūpaṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te ।।76।। kṛṣṇena dattā sāvitrī goloke brahmaṇe purā ।।। na yāti sā tena sārddhaṃ brahmalokaṃ tu nārada ।। 77 ।। brahmā kṛṣṇājñayā bhaktyā paryaṣṭaudvedamātaram ।। tadā sā parituṣṭā ca brahmāṇaṃ cakame satī ।। 78 ।। brahmovāca ।। nārāyaṇasvarūpe ca nārāyaṇi sanātani ।। nārāyaṇātsamudbhūte prasannā bhava sundari ।। 79 ।।।। tejassvarūpe parame paramānandarūpiṇi ।। dvijātīnāṃ jātirūpe prasannā bhava sundari।। 80।। nitye nityapriye devi nityānandasvarūpiṇi।। sarvamaṃgalarūpeṇa prasannā bhava sundari ।।81।। sarvasvarūpe viprāṇāṃ mantrasāre parātpare ।। sukhade mokṣade devi prasannā bhava sundari।।82।। viprapāpendhadāhāya jvaladagniśikhopame ।। brahmatejaḥprade devi prasannā bhava sundari ।। 83 ।। kāyena manasā vācā yatpāpaṃ kurute dvijaḥ ।। tatte smaraṇamātreṇa bhasmībhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati।।84।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tatra tasthau ca saṃsadi ।। sāvitrī brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ brahmalokaṃ jagāma sā ।।89 ।। anena stavarājena saṃstūyāśvapatirnṛpaḥ ।। dadarśa tāṃ ca sāvitrīṃ varaṃ prāpa manogatam ।।86।। stavarājamidaṃ puṇyaṃ trisandhyāyāṃ ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ yatphalaṃ tallabhed dhruvam ।। 87 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne sāvitrīstotrakathanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatitamodhyāyaḥ ।। 23 ।।
<2.24> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। stutvā so'śvapatistena saṃpūjya vidhipūrvakam ।। dadarśa tatra tāṃ devīṃ sahasrārkasamaprabhām ।। 1 ।। uvāca sā taṃ rājānaṃ prasannā sasmitā satī ।। yathā mātā svaputraṃ ca dyotayantī diśastviṣā ।।2।। sāvitryuvāca ।। jānāmi te mahārāja yatte manasi varttate ।। vāñchitaṃ tava patnyāśca sarvaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam ।।3 ।। sādhvī kanyābhilāṣaṃ ca karoti tava kāminī ।। tvaṃ prārthayasi putraṃ ca bhaviṣyati ca te kramāt ।। 4 ।। ityuktvā sā mahādevī brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha ।। rājā jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatkanyā''dau babhūva ha ।। 5 ।। rājño dhanācca sāvitryā babhūva kamalā kalā ।। sāvitrīti ca tannāma cakārāśvapatirnṛpaḥ ।। 6 ।। kālena sā varddhamānā babhūva ca dine dine ।। rūpayauvanasampannā śukle candrakalā yathā ।। 7 ।। sā varaṃ varayāmāsa dyumatsenātmajaṃ tadā।। sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca nānāguṇasamanvitam ।। ।।8।। rājā tasmai dadau tāṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। sa ca sārdhaṃ kautukena tāṃ gṛhītvā gṛhaṃ yayau।।9।। sa ca saṃvatsare'tīte satyavānsatyavikramaḥ ।। jagāma phalakāṣṭhārthaṃ praharṣaṃ piturājñayā ।। 10।। jagāma tatra sāvitrī tatpaścāddaivayogataḥ ।। nipatya vṛkṣāddaivena prāṇāṃstatyāja satyavān ।। 11 ।। yamastajjīvapuruṣaṃ baddhvāṅguṣṭhasamaṃ mune ।।
