gṛhītvā gamanaṃ cakre tatpaścātprayayau satī ।। 12 ।। paścāttāṃ sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā yamaḥ saṃyaminīpatiḥ ।। uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvīṃ sādhūnāṃ pravaro mahān ।। 13 ।। yama uvāca ।। aho kva yāsi sāvitri gṛhītvā mānuṣīṃ tanum ।। yadi yāsyasi kāntena sārdhaṃ dehaṃ tadā tyaja ।। 14 ।। gantuṃ marttyo na śaknoti gṛhītvā pāñcabhautikam।। dehaṃ ca yamalokaṃ ca naśvaraṃ naśvaraḥ sadāḥ ।। 15 ।। pūrṇaśca bharttuste kālaḥ hyabhavadbhārate sati ।। sa karmaphalabhogārthaṃ satyavānyāti madgṛham ।। 16 ।। karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇaiva pralīyate ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ karmaṇaiva prapadyate ।। 17 ।। karmaṇendro bhavejjīvo brahmaputraḥ svakarmaṇā ।। svakarmaṇā harerdāso janmādirahito bhavet ।। 16 ।। svakarmaṇā sarvasiddhimamaratvaṃ labhed dhruvam ।। labhetsvakarmaṇā viṣṇoḥ sālokyādicatuṣṭayam ।। 19 ।। karmaṇā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca muktatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।। suratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca rājendratvaṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 20 ।। karmaṇā ca munīndratvaṃ tapasvitvaṃ ca karmaṇā ।। karmaṇā kṣatriyatvaṃ ca vaiśyatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।। 21 ।। karmaṇā caiva śūdratvamantyajatvaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 22 ।। svakarmaṇā ca mlecchatvaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। svakarmaṇā jaṅgamatvaṃ sthāvaratvaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 23 ।। svakarmaṇā ca śailatvaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।। svakarmaṇā paśutvaṃ ca pakṣitvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।। 24 ।। svakarmaṇā kṣudrajantuḥ kṛmitvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।। svakarmaṇā ca sarpatvaṃ gandharvatvaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 25 ।। svakarmaṇā rākṣasatvaṃ kinnaratvaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। svakarmaṇā ca yakṣatvaṃ kūṣmāṇḍatvaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 26 ।। svakarmaṇā ca pretatvaṃ vetālatvaṃ svakarmaṇā।। bhūtatvaṃ ca piśācatvaṃ ḍākinītvaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 27 ।। daityatvaṃ dānavatvaṃ cāpyasuratvaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā puṇyavāñjīvo mahāpāpī svakarmaṇā ।। 28 ।। karmaṇā sundaro'rogī mahārogī ca karmaṇā ।। karmaṇā cāndhaḥ kāṇaśca kutsitaśca svakarmaṇā ।। 29 ।। karmaṇā narakaṃ yānti jīvāḥ svargaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā śakralokaṃ ca sūryyalokaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 30 ।। karmaṇā candralokaṃ ca vahnilokaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā vāyulokaṃ ca karmaṇā varuṇālayam ।। 31 ।। tathā kuberalokaṃ ca naro yāti svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā dhruvalokaṃ ca śivalokaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 32 ।। yāti nakṣatralokaṃ ca satyalokaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। janolokaṃ tapolokaṃ maharlokaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। 33 ।। svakarmaṇā ca pātālaṃ brahmalokaṃ svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā bhārataṃ puṇyaṃ sarvepsitavarapradam ।। 34 ।। karmaṇā yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ ca nirāmayam ।। karmaṇā cirajīvī ca kṣaṇāyuśca svakarmaṇā ।। 35 ।। karmaṇā koṭikalpāyuḥ kṣīṇāyuśca svakarmaṇā ।। jīvasaṃcāramātrāyurgarbhe mṛtyuḥ svakarmaṇā ।। 36 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayā tattvaṃ ca sundari ।। karmaṇā te mṛto bharttā gaccha vatse yathāsukham ।। 37 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde karmavipāke karmaṇaḥ sarvahetutvapradarśanaṃ nāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 24 ।।
<2.25> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। yamasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī ca pativratā ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā tamuvāca manasvinī ।। 1 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। kiṃ karma vā śubhaṃ dharmmarāja kiṃ vā'śubhaṃ nṛṇām ।। karma nirmūlayantyeva kena vā sādhavo janāḥ ।।2।। karmaṇāṃ bījarūpaḥ kaḥ ko vā karmmaphalapradaḥ।। kiṃ karmma tadbhavetkena ko vā taddhetureva ca।।3।। ko vā karmaphalaṃ bhuṅkte ko vā nirlipta eva ca ।। ko vā dehī kaśca dehaḥ ko vā vai karmakārakaḥ।।4।। kiṃ vijñānaṃ mano buddhiḥ ke vā prāṇāḥ śarīriṇām ।। kānīndriyāṇi kiṃ teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ devatāśca kāḥ।।5।। bhoktā bhojayitā ko vā ko bhogaḥ kā ca niṣkṛtiḥ ।। ko jīvaḥ paramātmā kastanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।।6।। yama uvāca ।। vedena vihitaṃ karma tanmaye maṅgalaṃ param।। avaidikaṃ tu yatkarma tadevāśubhameva ca।।7।। ahaitukī viṣṇusevā saṅkalparahitā satām।। karmmanirmmūlanātmā vai sā caiva haribhaktidā।।8।। haribhakto naro yaśca sa ca muktaḥ śrutau śrutam ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokabhītivivarjitaḥ ।।9।। muktiśca dvividhā sādhvi śrutyuktā sarvasammatā ।। nirvāṇapadadātrī ca haribhaktipradā nṛṇām ।। 10 ।। haribhaktisvarūpāṃ ca muktiṃ vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। anye nirvāṇarūpāṃ ca muktimicchanti sādhavaḥ ।। ।। 11 ।। karmmaṇo bījarūpaśca santataṃ tatphalapradaḥ ।। rūrmarūpaśca bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 12 ।। so'pi taddheturūpaśca karmma tena bhavetsati ।। jīvaḥ karmaphalaṃ bhuṅkte ātmā nirlipta eva ca ।। 13 ।। ātmanaḥ pratibimbaṃ ca dehī jīvaḥ sa eva ca ।। pāñcabhautikarūpaśca deho naśvara eva ca।।14।। pṛthivī vāyurākāśo jalaṃ tejastathaiva ca।। etāni sūtrarūpāṇi sṛṣṭiḥ sṛṣṭividhau hareḥ ।। ।। 15 ।। karttā bhoktā ca dehī ca svātmā bhojayitā sadā ।। bhogo vibhavabhedaśca niṣkṛtirmuktireva ca ।। 16 ।। sadasadbhedabījaṃ ca jñānaṃ nānāvidhaṃ bhavet ।। viṣayāṇāṃ vibhāgānāṃ bhedabījaṃ ca kīrttitam ।।17।। buddhirvivecanārūpā jñānasaṃdīpinī śrutau ।। vāyubhedāśca vai prāṇā balarūpāśca dehinām ।। 16 ।। indriyāṇāṃ vai pravaramīśvarāṇāṃ samūhakam ।। prerakaṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva durnivāryaṃ ca dehinām ।। 19 ।। anirūpyamadṛśyaṃ ca jñānabhedaṃ manaḥ smṛtam ।। locanaṃ śravaṇaṃ prāṇaṃ tvagjihvādikamindriyam ।। 20 ।। aṅgināmaṅga rūpaṃ ca prerakaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। ripurūpaṃ mitrarūpaṃ sukhadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sadā ।। 21 ।। sūryyo vāyuśca pṛthivī vāṇyādyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। prāṇadehādibhṛdyo hi sa jīvaḥ parikīrttitaḥ।।22।। paramātmā paraṃ brahma nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam।।23।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mayā pṛṣṭaṃ yathāgamam ।। jñānināṃ jñānarūpaṃ ca gaccha vatse yathāsukham ।। 24 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। tyaktvā kva yāmi kāntaṃ vā tvāṃ vā jñānārṇavaṃ budham ।। praśnaṃ yadyatkaromi tvāṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 25 ।। kāṃ kāṃ yoniṃ yāti jīvaḥ karmaṇā kena vā yama ।। kena vā karmaṇā svargaṃ kena vā narakaṃ pitaḥ ।। 26 ।। kena vā karmaṇā muktiḥ kena bhaktirbhaveddhareḥ ।। kena vā karmaṇā rogī cārogī kena karmaṇā।।27।। kena vā dīrghajīvī ca kenālpāyuśca karmmaṇā ।। kena vā karmmaṇā duḥkhī kena vā karmmaṇā sukhī ।। 28 ।। aṅgahīnaśca kāṇaśca badhiraḥ kena karmmaṇā ।। andho vā kṛpaṇo vā'pi pramattaḥ kena karmmaṇā ।। 29 ।। kṣipto'tilubdhakaścaiva kena vā naraghātakaḥ ।। kena siddhimavāpnoti sālokyādicatuṣṭayam ।। 30।। kena vā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca tapasvitvaṃ ca kena vā ।। svargabhogādikaṃ kena vaikuṇṭhaṃ kena karmmaṇā।।31।। golokaṃ kena vā brahmansarvotkṛṣṭaṃ nirāmayam।। narakaṃ vā katividhaṃ kiṃ saṃkhyaṃ nāma kiṃ tathā ।।32।। ko vā kaṃ narakaṃ yāti kiyantaṃ teṣu tiṣṭhati ।। pāpināṃ karmmaṇā kena ko vā vyādhiḥ prajāyate ।।33।। yadyadasti mayā pṛṣṭaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 34 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde karmmavipāke yamoktyanantaraṃ sāvitrīpraśno nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 25 ।।
<2.26> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sāvitrīvacanaṃ śrutvā jagāma vismayaṃ yamaḥ । prahasya vaktumārebhe karmapākaṃ ca jīvinām ।। 1 ।। yama uvāca ।। kanyā dvādaśavarṣīyā vatse tvaṃ vayasā'dhunā ।। jñānaṃ te pūrvaviduṣāṃ yogināṃ jñānināṃ param ।। 2 ।। sāvitrīvaradānena tvaṃ sāvitrīkalā sati ।। prāptā purā bhūbhṛtā ca tapasā tatsamā śubhe ।। 3 ।। yathā śrīḥ śrīpateḥ kroḍe bhavānī ca bhavorasi ।। yathā rādhā ca śrīkṛṣṇe sāvitrī brahmavakṣasi ।। 4 ।। dharmorasi yathā mūrttiḥ śatarūpā manau yathā ।। kardame devahūtiśca vasiṣṭhe'rundhatī yathā ।। 5 ।। aditiḥ kaśyape cāpi yathā'halyā ca gautame ।। yathā śacī mahendre ca yathā candre ca rohiṇī ।। 6 ।। yathā ratiḥ kāmadeve yathā svāhā hutāśane ।। yathā svadhā ca pitṛṣu yathā saṃjñā divākare ।। 7 ।। varuṇānī ca varuṇe yajñe ca dakṣiṇā yathā ।। yathā dharā varāhe ca devasenā ca kārtike ।। 8 ।। saubhāgyā supriyā tvaṃ ca bhava satyavati priye ।। iti tubhyaṃ varaṃ dattamaparaṃ ca yadīpsitam ।। vṛṇu devi mahābhāge sarvaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam ।। 9 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। satyavadaurasenaiva putrāṇāṃ śatakaṃ mama ।। bhaviṣyati mahābhāga varametanmadīpsitam ।। 10 ।। matpituḥ putraśatakaṃ śvaśurasya ca cakṣuṣī ।। rājyalābho bhavatveva varamevaṃ madīpsitam ।। 11 ।। ante satyavatā sārddhaṃ yāsyāmi harimandiram ।। samatīte lakṣavarṣe dehīmaṃ me jagatprabho ।। 12 ।। jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ ca me ।। viśvavistārabījaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 13 ।। yama uvāca ।। bhaviṣyati mahāsādhvi sarvaṃ mānasikaṃ tava ।। jīvakarmmavipākaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 14 ।। śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca karmmaṇāṃ janma bhārate ।। puṇyakṣetre'tra sarvatra nānyatra bhuñjate janāḥ ।। 15 ।। surā daityā dānavāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ ।। narāśca karmmajanakā na sarve samajīvinaḥ ।। 16 ।। viśiṣṭajīvinaḥ karmma bhuñjate sarvayoniṣu ।। viśeṣato mānavāśca bhramanti sarvayoniṣu ।। ।। 17 ।। śubhāśubhaṃ bhuñjate ca karma pūrvārjitaṃ param ।। śubhena karmaṇā yānti te svargādikameva ca ।। 18 ।। karmmaṇā cāśubhenaiva bhramanti narakeṣu ca ।। karmmanirmūlane muktiḥ sā coktā dvividhā matā ।। 19।। nirvāṇarūpā sevā ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। kukarmaṇā jīvaścārogī śubhakarmaṇā ।। 20 ।। dīrghajīvī ca kṣīṇāyuḥ sukhī duḥkhī ca niścitam ।। andhādayaścāṅgahīnāḥ kutsitena ca karmaṇā ।। 21 ।। siddhyādikamavāpnoti sarvotkṛṣṭena karmmaṇā ।। sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari ।। 22 ।। sudurlabhaṃ subhogyaṃ ca purāṇeṣu śrutiṣvapi ।। 23 ।। durlabhā mānavī jātiḥ sarvajātiṣu bhārate ।। sarvābhyo brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ praśastaḥ sarvakarmmasu।।24।। viṣṇubhakto dvijaścaiva garīyānbhārate tataḥ ।। niṣkāmaśca sakāmaśca vaiṣṇavo dvividhaḥ sati ।।25।। sakāmaśca pradhānaśca niṣkāmo bhakta eva ca ।। karmabhogī sakāmaśca niṣkāmo nirupadravaḥ ।। 26 ।। sa yāti dehaṃ tyaktā ca padaṃ viṣṇornirāmayam ।। punarāgamanaṃ nāsti teṣāṃ niṣkāmiṇāṃ sati ।। 27 ।। ye sevante ca dvibhujaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ।। golokaṃ yānti te bhaktā divyarūpavidhāriṇaḥ ।। 28 ।। ye ca nārāyaṇaṃ bhaktāḥ sevante ca caturbhujam ।। vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti te sarve divyarūpavidhāriṇaḥ ।।29 ।। sakāmino vaiṣṇavāśca gatvā vaikuṇṭhameva ca ।। bhārataṃ punarāyānti teṣāṃ janma dvijātiṣu ।। 30 ।। kālena te ca niṣkāmā bhaviṣyanti krameṇa ca ।। bhaktiṃ ca nirmalāṃ buddhiṃ tebhyo dāsyati niścitam ।। 31 ।। brāhmaṇādvaiṣṇavādanye sakāmāḥ sarvajanmasu ।। na teṣāṃ nirmalā buddhirviṣṇubhaktivivarjitāḥ ।। 32 ।। tīrthāśritā dvijā ye ca tapasyāniratāḥ sati ।। te yānti brahmalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhāratam ।।33।। svadharmaniratā viprāḥ sūryyabhaktāśca bhārate ।। vrajanti sūryalokaṃ te punarāyānti bhāratam ।। 34 ।। svadharmaniratā viprāḥ śaivāḥ śāktāśca gāṇapāḥ ।। te yānti śivalokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhāratam ।। 35 ।। ye viprā anyadeveṣṭāḥ svadharmaniratāḥ sati ।। te gatvā śakralokaṃ ca punarāyānti bhāratam ।। 36 ।। haribhaktāśca niṣkāmāḥ svadharmmarahitā dvijāḥ ।। te'pi yānti harerlokaṃ kramādbhaktibalādaho ।।37 ।। svadharmmarahitā viprā devānyasevinaḥ sadā ।। bhraṣṭācārāśca bālāśca te yāṃti narakaṃ dhruvam ।। 38 ।। svadharmmaniratāścaivaṃ varṇāścatvāra eva ca ।। bhavantyeva śubhasyaiva karmaṇaḥ phalabhāginaḥ ।। 39 ।। svadharmmarahitāste ca narakaṃ yānti hi dhruvam।। bhārate ca bhavantyeva karmmaṇaḥ phalabhāginaḥ।। 40।। svadharmaniratā viprāḥ svadharmaniratāya ca।। kanyāṃ dadati viprāya candralokaṃ vrajanti te ।।41।। vasaṃti tatra te sādhvi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa।। sālaṅkṛtāyā dānena dviguṇaṃ phalamucyate ।।42।। sakāmā yāṃti tallokaṃ na niṣkāmāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। te prayāṃti viṣṇulokaṃ phalasandhānavarjitāḥ ।। 43 ।। gavyaṃ ca rajataṃ bhāryāṃ vastraṃ sasyaṃ phalaṃ jalam ।। ye dadatyeva viprebhyastallokaṃ hi vrajanti ca ।।44।। vasaṃti te ca tallokaṃ yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati ।। kālaṃ ca suciraṃ vāsaṃ kurvaṃti tatra te janāḥ ।। 45 ।। ye dadati suvarṇaṃ ca gāṃ ca tāmrādikaṃ sati ।। te yāṃti sūryalokaṃ ca śucaye brāhmaṇāya ca ।। 46 ।। vasanti tatra te loke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati ।। vipule ca ciraṃ vāsaṃ kurvaṃti ca nirāmayāḥ ।।47 ।। dadāti bhūmiṃ viprebhyo dhānyāni vipulāni ca ।। sa yāti viṣṇulokaṃ ca śvetadvīpaṃ manoharam।।48।। tatraiva nivasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ।। vipulaṃ vipule vāsaṃ karoti puṇyavānsati ।। 49 ।। gṛhaṃ dadaṃti viprāya ye janā bhaktipūrvakam ।। te yāṃti suralokaṃ ca ciraṃ tatra bhavaṃti te ।। 50।। gṛhareṇupramāṇābdaṃ dānaṃ puṇyadine yadi ।। vipulaṃ vipule vāsaṃ kurvaṃti mānavāḥ sati।।51।। yasmai yasmai ca devāya yo dadāti gṛhaṃ naraḥ।। sa yāti tasya lokaṃ ca reṇumānābdameva ca ।। 52 ।। saudhe caturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pūrtte śataguṇaṃ phalam ।। prakṛṣṭe'ṣṭaguṇaṃ tasmādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 53 ।। yo dadāti taḍāgaṃ ca sarvabhūtāya bhārate ।। sa yāti janalokaṃ ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati।। 54 ।। vāpyāṃ phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ prāpnoti mānavastataḥ ।। tathā setupradānena taḍāgasya phalaṃ labhet ।। 55 ।। dhanuścatuḥsahasreṇa dairghyamānena niścitam ।। nyūnā vā tāvatī prasthe sā vāpī parikīrttitā ।। 56 ।। daśavāpīsamā kanyā yadi pātre pradīyate ।। phalaṃ dadāti dviguṇaṃ yadi sālaṃkṛtā bhavet।। 57 ।। tatphalaṃ ca taḍāge ca paṅkoddhāreṇa tatphalam ।। vāpyāśca paṃkoddhāreṇa vāpītulyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 58 ।। aśvatthavṛkṣamāropya pratiṣṭhāṃ ca karoti yaḥ ।। sa yāti tapaso lokaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ param ।। 59 ।। puṣpodyānaṃ yo dadāti sāvitri sarvabhūtaye ।। sa vaseddhruvaloke ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam।। 60।। yo dadāti vimānaṃ ca viṣṇave bhārate sati ।। viṣṇuloke vasetso'pi yāvanmanvantaraṃ param।।61।। citrayukte ca vipule phalaṃ tasya caturguṇam।। rathārdhaṃ śibikādāne phalameva labheddhruvam ।। 62 ।। yo dadāti bhaktiyukto haraye dolamandiram ।। viṣṇuloke vasetso'pi yāvanmanvataraṃ param ।। 63 ।। rājamārgaṃ saudhayuktaṃ yaḥ karoti pativrate ।। varṣāṇāmayutaṃ so'pi śakraloke mahīyate।। 64 ।। brāhmaṇebhyo'pi devebhyo dāne samaphalaṃ labhet ।। yacca dattaṃ hi tadbhokturna dattaṃ nopatiṣṭhate ।। 65 ।। bhuktvā svargādikaṃ saukhyaṃ punarāyānti bhārate ।। labhedviprakuleṣveva krameṇaivottamādiṣu ।। 66 ।। bhārate puṇyavānvipro bhuktvā svargādikaṃ param ।। punaḥ so'pi bhavedvipro na punaḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ।।67।। kṣatriyo vā'pi vaiśyo vā kalpakoṭiśatena ca ।। tapasā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca na prāpnoti śrutau śrutam ।।68।। svadharmarahitā viprā nānāyoniṃ vrajanti ca ।। bhuktvā ca karmabhāgaṃ ca viprayoniṃ labhetpunaḥ।।69।। nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi ।। avaśyavameva bhoktavyaṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi ।। 70 ।। avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham।। devatīrthe sahāyena kāyavyūhena śudhyati।।71।। etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi।।72।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇa dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe sāvitryupākhyāne karmavipāke karmānurūpasthānagamanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ।।26।।
<2.27> sāvitryuvāca ।। prayāṃti svargamanyaṃ ca yena yenaiva karmmaṇā।। mānavāḥ puṇyavantaśca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। yama uvāca ।। annadānaṃ ca viprāya yaḥ karoti ca bhārate ।। annapramāṇavarṣa ca śakraloke mahīyate ।।2।। annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।। nātra pātraparīkṣā syānna kālaniyamaḥ kvacit ।। 3 ।। devebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo vā dadāti cāsanaṃ yadi ।। mahīyate vahniloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam ।। 4 ।। yo dadāti ca viprāya divyāṃ dhenuṃ payasvinīm ।। tallomamānavarṇaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe ca mahīyate ।।5।। caturguṇaṃ puṇyadine tīrthe śataguṇaṃ phalam ।। dānaṃ nārāyaṇakṣetre phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ।। 6 ।। gāṃ yo dadāti viprāya bhārate bhaktipūrvakam ।। varṣāṇāmayutaṃ caiva candraloke mahīyate ।।7।। yaścobhayamukhīdānaṃ karoti brāhmaṇāya ca ।। tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe ca mahīyate।।8।। yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya śāligrāmaṃ savastrakam ।। mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau ।।9।। yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya chatraṃ ca sumanoharam ।। varṣāṇāmayutaṃ so'pi modate varuṇālaye ।। 10 ।। viprāya pādukāyugmaṃ yo dadāti ca bhārate ।। mahīyate vāyuloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati।।11।। yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya śayyāṃ divyāṃ manoharām।। mahīyate candraloke yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 12 ।। yo dadāti pradīpaṃ ca devāya brāhmaṇāya ca ।। yāvanmanvantaraṃ so'pi brahmaloke mahīyate ।। 13 ।। samprāpya mānavīṃ yoniṃ cakṣuṣmāṃśca bhaveddhruvam ।। na yāti yamalokaṃ ca tena puṇyena sundari ।। 14 ।। karoti gajadānaṃ ca yo hi viprāya bhārate।। yāvadindrādidevasya loke cārdhāsane vaset ।। 15 ।। bhārate yo'śvadānaṃ ca karoti brāhmaṇāya ca ।। modate vāruṇe loke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 16 ।। prakṛṣṭāṃ śibikāṃ yo hi dadāti brāhmaṇāya ca ।। mahīyate viṣṇuloke yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati ।। 17 ।। yo dadāti ca viprāya vyajanaṃ śvetacāmaram ।। mahīyate vāyuloke varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam ।। 18 ।। dhānyācalaṃ yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya ca bhārate ।। sa ca dhānyapramāṇābdaṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।। 19 ।। tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya cirajīvī bhavetsukhī ।। dātā grahītā tau dvau ca dhruvaṃ vaikuṇṭhagāminau ।। 20 ।। satataṃ śrīharernāma bhārate yo japennaraḥ ।। sa eva cirajīvī ca tato mṛtyuḥ palāyate ।।21 ।। yo naro bhārate varṣe dolanaṃ kārayeddhareḥ ।। pūrṇimārajanīśeṣe jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। 22 ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante viṣṇumandiram।। niścitaṃ nivasettatra śatamanvantarāvadhi ।। 23 ।। phalamuttaraphālgunyāṃ tato'pi dviguṇaṃ bhavet ।। kalpāntajīvī sa bhavedityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 24 ।। tiladānaṃ brāhmaṇāya yaḥ karoti ca bhārate ।। tilapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca modate viṣṇumandire ।। 25 ।। tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya cirajīvī bhavetsukhī।। tāmrapātrasthadānena dviguṇaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet।।26।। sālaṃkṛtāṃ ca bhogyāṃ ca savastrāṃ sundarīṃ priyām।। yo dadāti brāhmaṇā ya bhārate ca pativratām ।। 27 ।। mahīyate candraloke yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। tatra svarveśyayā sārddhaṃ modate ca divāniśam ।। 28 ।। tato gandharvaloke ca varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati ।। divāniśaṃ kautukena corvaśyā saha modate ।। 29 ।। tato janmasahasraṃ ca prāpnoti sundarīṃ priyām ।। satīṃ saubhāgyayuktāṃ ca komalāṃ priyavādinīm ।। 30 ।। dadāti saphalaṃ vṛkṣaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca yo naraḥ ।। phalapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca śakraloke mahīyate ।। 31 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya labhate sutamuttamam ।। saphalānāṃ ca vṛkṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca praśaṃsitam ।। 32 ।। kevalaṃ phaladānaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya dadāti yaḥ ।। suciraṃ svargavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā yāti ca bhāratam।। 33 ।। nānādravyasamāyuktaṃ nānāsasyasamanvitam ।। dadāti yaśca viprāya bhārate vipulaṃ gṛham ।। 34 ।। kuberaloke vasati sa ca manvantarāvadhi ।। tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya mahāṃśca dhanavānbhavet ।। 35 ।। yo janaḥ sasyasaṃyuktāṃ bhūmiṃ ca rucirāṃ sati ।। dadāti bhaktyā viprāya puṇyakṣetre ca vā sati।। ।। 36 ।। mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe manvantaraśataṃ dhruvam ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya mahāṃśca bhūmivānbhavet ।। 37 ।। taṃ na tyajati bhūmiśca janmanāṃ śatakaṃ param ।। śrīmāṃśca dhanavāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajeśvaraḥ ।। 38 ।। saprajaṃ ca prakṛṣṭaṃ ca grāmaṃ dadyāddvijātaye ।। lakṣamanvantaraṃ caiva vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate ।।39।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya grāmalakṣaṃ labheddhruvam ।। na jahāti ca taṃ pṛthvī janmanāṃ lakṣameva ca ।। 40।। saprajaṃ suprakṛṣṭaṃ ca pañcasasyasamanvitam ।। nānāpuṣkariṇīvṛkṣaphalabhogasamanvitam ।।41।। nagaraṃ yaśca viprāya dadāti bhārate bhuvi ।। mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe daśalakṣendrakālakam।।42।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rājendro bhārate bhavet।। nagarāṇāṃ ca niyutaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ।। ।। 43 ।। dharā taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāṃ niyutaṃ dhruvam ।। paramaiśvarya saṃyukto bhavedeva mahītale ।।44।। nagarāṇāṃ ca śatakaṃ deśaṃ yo hi dvijātaye ।। suprakṛṣṭaprajāyuktaṃ dadāti bhaktipūrvakam ।। 49 ।। vāpītaḍāgasaṃyuktaṃ nānāvṛkṣasamanvitam ।। mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe koṭimanvantarāvadhi ।। 46 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya jambūdvīpapatirbhavet ।। paramaiśvaryyasaṃyukto yathā śakrastathā bhuvi ।। 47 ।। mahī taṃ na jahātyeva janmanāṃ koṭimeva ca ।। kalpāntajīvī sa bhavedrājarājeśvaro mahān ।।48।। svādhikāraṃ samagraṃ ca yo dadāti dvijātaye।। caturguṇa phalaṃ cāto bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ ।।49।। jambūdvīpaṃ yo dadāti brāhmaṇāya pativrate ।। phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ cāto bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ ।। 50।। saptadvīpamahīdātuḥ sarvatīrthānusevinaḥ।। sarveṣāṃ tapasāṃ karttuḥ sarvopavāsakāriṇaḥ।।51।। sarvadānapradātuśca sarvasiddheśvarasya ca ।। astyeva punarāvṛttirna bhaktasya hareraho।।52।। asaṃkhyabrahmaṇā pātaṃ paśyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sati ।। nivasanti hi goloke vaikuṇṭhe vā hareḥ pade।।53।। viṣṇumantropāsakaśca vihāya mānavīṃ tanum।। bibhartti divyarūpaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāpaham।।54।। labdhvā viṣṇośca sārūpyaṃ viṣṇusevāṃ karoti ca।। sa ca paśyati goloke hyasaṃkhyaṃ prākṛtaṃ layam।।55।। naśyanti devāḥ siddhāśca viśvāni nikhilāni ca।। kṛṣṇabhaktā na naśyanti janmamṛtyujarāharāḥ।।56।। kārttike tulasīdānaṃ karoti haraye ca yaḥ ।। yugaṃ patrapramāṇaṃ ca modate harimandire ।। 57 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। sukhī ca cirajīvī ca sa bhavedbhārate bhuvi।।58।। ghṛtapradīpaṃ haraye kārttike yo dadāti ca ।। palapramāṇaṃ varṣaṃ ca modate harimandire ।। 59 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। mahādhanāḍhyaḥ sa bhaveccakṣuṣmāṃścaiva dīptimān ।। 60 ।। māghe yaḥ snāti gaṅgāyāmaruṇodayakālataḥ ।। yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate harimandire ।। 61 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraḥ sa bhavedbhārate bhuvi ।। 62 ।। māghe yaḥ snāti gaṃgāyāṃ prayāge cāruṇodaye ।। vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi lakṣamanvantarāvadhi ।। 63 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya viṣṇumantraṃ labheddhruvam ।। tyaktvā ca mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ punaryāti hareḥ padam ।। 64 ।। nāsti tatpunarāvṛttirvaikuṇṭhācca mahītale ।। karoti haridāsyaṃ ca labdhvā sārūpyameva ca ।। 65 ।। nityasnāyī ca gaṅgāyāṃ sa pūtaḥ sūryyavadbhuvi ।। pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam ।। 66 ।। tasyaiva pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। modate sa ca vaikuṇṭhe yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 67 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya tapasvipravaro bhavet ।। svadharmanirataḥ śuddho vidvāṃśca sujitendriyaḥ ।। 68 ।। mīnakarkaṭayormadhye gāḍhaṃ tapati bhāskare ।। bhārate yo dadātyeva jalameva suvāsitam ।। 69 ।। modate sa ca vaikuṇṭhe yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya sukhī niṣkapaṭo bhavet ।। 70 ।। vaiśākhe haraye bhaktyā yo dadāti ca candanam ।। yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi modate viṣṇumandire ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rūpavāṃśca sukhī bhavet ।।71।। vaiśākhe saktudānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti dvijātaye ।। saktureṇupramāṇābdaṃ modate viṣṇumandire ।। 72।। karoti bhārate yo hi kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratam ।। śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।73 ।। vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। 74 ।। ihaiva bhārate varṣe śivarātriṃ karoti yaḥ ।। modate śivaloke ca saptamanvantarāvadhi ।। 79 ।। śivāya śivarātrau ca bilvapatraṃ dadāti yaḥ ।। patrapramāṇaṃ ca yugaṃ modate śivamandire ।। 76।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya śivabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। vidyāvānputravāñchrīmānprajāvānbhūmivānbhavet ।। 77 ।। caitramāse'thavā māghe śaṅkaraṃ yo'rcayedvratī ।। karoti narttanaṃ bhaktyā vetrapāṇirdivāniśam ।। 78 ।। māsaṃ vāpyarddhamāsaṃ vā daśa saptadināni vā ।। dinamānaṃ yugaṃ so'pi śivaloke mahīyate ।। 79 ।। śrīrāmanavamīṃ yo hi karoti bhārate naraḥ।। saptamanvantaraṃ yāvanmodate viṣṇumandire ।। 80 ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rāmabhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro mahāṃśca dhārmiko bhavet ।। 81 ।। śāradīyāṃ mahāpūjāṃ prakṛteryaḥ karoti ca ।। mahiṣaiśchāgalairmeṣairikṣukūṣmāṇḍakaistathā ।। 82 ।। naivedyairupahāraiśca dhūpadīpādibhistathā ।। nṛtyagītādibhirvādyairnānākautukamaṅgalaiḥ ।। ।। 83 ।। śivaloke vasetso'pi saptamanvantarāvadhi ।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya buddhiṃ ca nirmalāṃ labhet ।। 84 ।। acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti putrapautrādivarddhinīm ।। mahāprabhāvayuktaśca gajavājisamanvitaḥ ।। 85 ।। rājarājeśvaraḥ so'pi bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। bhādraśuklāṣṭamīṃ prāpya mahālakṣmīṃ ca yo'rcayet ।।86 ।। nityaṃ bhaktyā pakṣamekaṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। dattvā tasyai prakṛṣṭāni copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।। 87 ।। vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvaccandradivākarau।। punaḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya rājarājeśvaro bhavet ।। 88 ।। kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca kṛtvā tu rāsamaṇḍalam ।। gopānāṃ śatakaṃ kṛtvā gopīnāṃ śatakaṃ tathā ।। 89 ।। śilāyāṃ pratimāyāṃ vā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhayā saha ।। bhārate pūjayeddattvā copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।। 90 ।। goloke ca vasetso'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। bhārataṃ punarāgatya haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। 91 ।। krameṇa sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ labdhvā mantraṃ harerapi ।। dehaṃ tyaktvā ca golokaṃ punareva prayāti saḥ ।। 92 ।। tatra kṛṣṇasya sārūpyaṃ saṃprāpya pārṣado bhavet ।। punastatpatanaṃ nāsti jarāmṛtyuharo mahān ।। 93 ।। śuklāṃ vā'pyathavā kṛṣṇāṃ karotyekādaśīṃ ca yaḥ ।। vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 94 ।। bhārataṃ punarāgatya haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। punaryāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ na tasya patanaṃ bhavet ।। 95 ।। bhādre śukle ca dvādaśyāṃ yaḥ śakraṃ pūjayennaraḥ ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śakraloke mahīyate ।। 96 ।। ravivāre'rkasaṃkrāntyāṃ saptamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ ।। sampūjyārkaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ yaḥ karoti ca bhārate ।। 97 ।। mahīyate so'rkaloke yāvaccandradivākarau ।। bhārataṃ punarāgatya cārogī śrīyuto bhavet ।। 98 ।। jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitrīṃ yo hi pūjayet ।। mahīyate brahmaloke saptamanvantarāvadhi ।। 99 ।। punarmahīṃ samāgatya śrīmānatulavikramaḥ ।। cirajīvī bhavetso'pi jñānavānsampadā yutaḥ ।। 100 ।। māghasya śuklapañcamyāṃ pūjayedyaḥ sarasvatīm ।। saṃyato bhaktito dattvā copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa।।101।। mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāvadbrahmadivāniśam ।। saṃprāpya ca punarjanma sa bhavetkavipaṇḍitaḥ ।। 102 ।। gāṃ suvarṇādikaṃ yo hi brāhmaṇāya dadāti ca ।। nityaṃ jīvanaparyantaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca bhārate ।। 103 ।। gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ dviguṇaṃ viṣṇumandire ।। modate hariṇā sārddhaṃ krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ ।। 104 ।। tataḥ punarihāgatya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। tataḥ punarihāgatya rājarājeśvaro bhavet ।। gomāṃśca putravānvidvāñjñānavānsarvataḥ sukhī ।। 105 ।। bhojayedyo hi miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca bhārate ।। vipralomapramāṇābdaṃ modate viṣṇumandire ।। 106 ।। tataḥ punarihāgatya sa sukhī dhanavānbhavet ।। vidvānsucirajīvī ca śrīmānatulavikramaḥ ।। 107 ।। yo vakti vā dadātyeva harernāmāni bhārate ।। yuganāmapramāṇaṃ ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।। 108 ।। tataḥ punarihāgatya viṣṇubhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। yadi nārāyaṇakṣetre phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ labhet ।। 109 ।। nāmnāṃ koṭiṃ hareryo hi kṣetre nārāyaṇe japet ।। sarvapāpavinirmukto jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam ।। 110 ।। labhate na punarjanma vaikuṇṭhe sa mahīyate ।। labhedviṣṇośca sārūpyaṃ na tasya patanaṃ bhavet ।। 111 ।। yaḥ śivaṃ pūjayennityaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ ca pārthivam ।। yāvajjīvanaparyyantaṃ sa yāti śivamandiram ।। 112 ।। mṛdāṃ reṇupramāṇābdaṃ śivaloke mahīyate ।। tataḥ punarihāgatya rājendro bhārate bhavet ।। ।। 113 ।। śilāṃ ca yo'rcayennityaṃ śilātoyaṃ ca bhakṣati ।। mahīyate sa vaikuṇṭhe yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam ।। 114 ।। tato labdhvā punarjanma haribhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ।। mahīyate viṣṇuloke na tasya patanaṃ bhavet ।। 115 ।। tapāṃsi caiva sarvāṇi vratāni nikhilāni ca।। kṛtvā tiṣṭhati vaikuṇḍe yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।।116।। tato labdhvā punarjanma rājendro bhārate bhavet ।। tato mukto bhavetpaścātpunarjanma na vidyate ।। 117 ।। yaḥ snāti sarvartīrtheṣu bhuvi kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ।। sa ca nirvāṇatāṃ yāti na tajjanma bhavedbhuvi ।।118।। puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca yo'śvamedhaṃ karoti ca ।। aśvalomapramāṇābdaṃ śakrasyārddhāsane vaset ।। 119 ।। caturguṇaṃ rājasūye phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।। naramedhe'śvamedhārddhaṃ gomedhe ca tadeva ca।। 120।। putreṣṭau ca tadardhaṃ ca suputraṃ ca labheddhruvam।। labhate lāṅgaleṣṭau ca gomedhasadṛśaṃ phalam।।121।। tatsamānaṃ ca vipreṣṭau vṛddhiyāge ca tatphalam ।। padmayajñe tadarddhaṃ ca phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।।122।। viśoke ca viśokaṃ ca padmārddhaṃ svargamaśnute ।। vijaye vijayī rājā svarge padmasamaṃ bhavet।।123।। prājāpatye prajālābho bhūvṛddhirbhūbhṛtāṃ bhavet ।। iha rājaśriyaṃ labdhvā padmārddhaṃ svargamaśnute ।। ṛddhiyāge mahaiśvaryaṃ svargaṃ padmasamaṃ bhavet ।।124।। viṣṇuyajñaḥ pradhānaṃ ca sarvayajñeṣu sundari ।। brahmaṇā ca kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ mahāsambhārasaṃyutaḥ ।। 125 ।। babhūva kalaho yatra dakṣaśaṅkarayoḥ sati ।। śepuśca nandinaṃ viprā nandī viprāṃśca kopataḥ ।। 126 ।। । yato hetordakṣayajñaṃ babhañja candraśekharaḥ ।। cakāra viṣṇuyajñaṃ ca purā dakṣaprajāpatiḥ ।।127।। dharmaśca kaśyapaścaiva śeṣaścāpi ca kardamaḥ ।।। svāyambhuvo manuścaiva tatputraśca priyavrataḥ ।। 128 ।। śivaḥ sanatkumāraśca kapilaśca dhruvastathā ।। rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ samṛddhyā ca kraturbhavet ।। 129 ।। rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam ।। viṣṇuyajñātparo yajño nāsti vede phalapradaḥ ।। 130 ।। bahukalpāntajīvī ca jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam ।। jñānena tejasā caiva viṣṇutulyo bhavediha ।।131।। devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śivaḥ ।। śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedā āśramāṇāṃ ca brāhmaṇāḥ ।।132।। tīrthānāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā pavitrāṇāṃ ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। ekādaśī vratānāṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā ।। 133।। nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathā candraḥ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā ।। yathā strīṇāṃ ca prakṛtirādhārāṇāṃ vasundharā।। ।। 134 ।। śīghragānāṃ cendriyāṇāṃ cañcalānāṃ yathā manaḥ ।। prajāpatīnāṃ brahmā ca prajeśānāṃ prajāpatiḥ ।। 139 ।। vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā ।। śrīmatāṃ ca yathā śrīśca viduṣāṃ ca sarasvatī ।। 136 ।। pativratānāṃ durgā ca saubhāgyānāṃ ca rādhikā ।। viṣṇuyajñastathā vatse yajñeṣu ca mahāniti ।।137।। aśvamedhaśatenaiva śakratvaṃ labhate dhruvam ।। sahasreṇa viṣṇupadaṃ saṃprāpa pṛthureva ca ।। ।। 138 ।। snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇam ।। sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ phalameva ca ।। 139 ।। pāṭhaścaturṇāṃ vedānāṃ prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā ।। phalaṃ bījamidaṃ sarvaṃ muktidaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam ।। 140 ।। purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu cetihāseṣu sarvataḥ ।। nirūpitaṃ sārabhūtaṃ kṛṣṇapādāmbujārcanam ।। 141 ।। tadvarṇanaṃ ca taddhyānaṃ tannāmaguṇakīrttanam ।। tatstotraṃ smaraṇaṃ caiva vandanaṃ japa eva ca ।। 142 ।। tatpādodakanaivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ nityameva ca ।। sarvasammatamityevaṃ sarvepsitamidaṃ sati ।। 143 ।। bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। gṛhāṇa svāminaṃ vatse sukhaṃ gaccha svamandiram ।। 144 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ nṛṇām ।। sarvepsitaṃ sarvamataṃ paraṃ tattvapradaṃ nṛṇām ।। 145 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nārada nārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitrīyamasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne śubhakarmavipākaprakathanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 27 ।।
<2.28> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca।। harerutkīrttanaṃ śrutvā sāvitrī yamavaktrataḥ ।। sāśrunetrā sapulakā yamaṃ punaruvāca sā ।। 1 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। harerutkīrttanaṃ dharma svakuloddhārakāraṇam ।। śrotṝṇāṃ caiva vaktṝṇāṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam ।। 2 ।। dānānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca siddhīnāṃ tapasāṃ param ।। yogānāṃ caiva vedānāṃ sevanaṃ kīrttanaṃ hareḥ ।। 3 ।। muktatvamamaratvaṃ vā sarvasiddhitvameva vā ।। śrīkṛṣṇasevanasyaiva kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।4।। bhajāmi kena vidhinā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। mūḍhāṃ māmabalāṃ tāta vada vedavidāṃvara ।। 5 ।। śubhakarmmavipākaṃ ca śrutaṃ nṛṇāṃ manoharam ।। karmmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।।6।। ityuktvā sā satī brahmanbhaktinamrātmakandharā ।। tuṣṭāva dharmmarājaṃ ca vedoktena stavena ca ।। 7 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। tapasā dharmamārādhya puṣkare bhāskaraḥ purā ।। dharmāṃśaṃ yaṃ sutaṃ prāpa dharmarājaṃ namāmyaham ।। 8 ।। samatā sarvabhūteṣu yasya sarvasya sākṣiṇaḥ ।। ato yannāma śamanamiti taṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 9 ।। yenāntaśca kṛto viśve sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ param ।। karmānurūpakālena taṃ kṛtāntaṃ namāmyaham ।। 10 ।। bibharti daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyāya pāpināṃ śuddhihetave। ।। namāmi taṃ daṇḍadharaṃ yaḥ śāstā sarvakarmaṇām ।। 11 ।। viśve yaḥ kalayatyeva sarvāyuścāpi santatam ।। atīva durnivāryyañca taṃ kālaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 12 ।। tapasvī vaiṣṇavo dharmmī saṃyamī vijitendriyaḥ ।। jīvināṃ karmmaphaladaṃ taṃ yamaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 13 ।। svātmārāmañca sarvajño mitraṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ bhavet ।। pāpināṃ kleśado yaśca puṇyaṃ mitraṃ namāmyaham ।। 14 ।। yajjanma brahmaṇo vaṃśe jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā।। yo dhyāyati paraṃ brahma brahmavaṃśaṃ namāmyaham ।। 15 ।। ityuktvā sā ca sāvitrī praṇanāma yamaṃ mune ।। yamastāṃ viṣṣubhajanaṃ karmmapākamuvāca ha ।। 16 ।। idaṃ yamāṣṭakaṃ nityaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet ।। yamāttasya bhayaṃ nāsti sarvapāpātpramucyate ।। 17 ।। mahāpāpī yadi paṭhennityaṃ bhaktyā ca nārada ।। yamaḥ karoti taṃ śuddhaṃ kāyavyūhena niścitam।।18।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitrīkṛtayamastotraṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।28।।
<2.29> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। yamastasyai viṣṇumantraṃ dattvā ca vidhipūrvakam ।। karmmāśubhavipākaṃ ca tāmuvāca raveḥ sutaḥ ।। 1 ।। yama uvāca ।। śubhakarmavipākaṃ ca śrutaṃ nānāvidhaṃ sati ।। karmāśubhavipākaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 2 ।। nānāprakāraṃ svargaṃ ca yāti jīvaḥ sukarmaṇā ।। kukarmaṇā ca narakaṃ yāti nānāvidhaṃ naraḥ ।। 3 ।। narakāṇāṃ ca kuṇḍāni santi nānāvidhāni ca ।। nānāpurāṇabhedena nāmabhedāni tāni ca ।।4।। vistṛtāni gabhīrāṇi kleśadāni ca jīvinām ।। bhayaṅkarāṇi ghorāṇi he vatse kutsitāni ca ।। 5 ।। ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni saṃyamanyāṃ ca santi ca ।। nibodha teṣāṃ nāmāni prasiddhāni śrutau sati ।।6।। vahnikuṇḍaṃ taptakuṇḍaṃ kṣamakuṇḍaṃ bhayānakam ।। viṭkuṇḍaṃ mūtrakuṇḍaṃ ca śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ ca duḥsaham ।। 7 ।। garakuṇḍaṃ dūṣikākuṇḍaṃ vasākuṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca ।। śukrakuṇḍamasṛkkuṇḍamaśrukuṇḍaṃ ca kutsitam ।। 8 ।। kuṇḍaṃ gātramalānāṃ ca karṇaviṭkuṇḍameva ca ।। majjākuṇḍaṃ māṃsakuṇḍaṃ nakhakuṇḍaṃ ca dustaram ।। 9 ।। lomnāṃ kuṇḍaṃ keśakuṇḍamasthikuṇḍaṃ ca duḥkhadam ।। tāmrakuṇḍaṃ lauhakuṇḍaṃ prataptaṃ kleśadaṃ mahat ।। 10।। tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍaṃ ca viṣakuṇḍaṃ ca vighnadam ।। dharmmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ cāpi prakīrttitam ।। 11 ।। prataptatailakuṇḍaṃ ca dantakuṇḍaṃ ca durvaham ।। kṛmikuṇḍaṃ pūyakuṇḍaṃ sarpakuṇḍaṃ durantakam ।। 12 ।। maśakuṇḍaṃ daṃśakuṇḍaṃ bhīmaṃ garalakuṇḍakam ।। kuṇḍaṃ ca vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ vṛścikānāṃ ca suvrate ।। 13 ।। śarakuṇḍaṃ śūlakuṇḍa khaḍgakuṇḍaṃ ca bhīṣaṇam।। golakuṇḍaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ kākakuṇḍaṃ śucāspadam ।। 14 ।। sañcālakuṇḍaṃ vājakuṇḍaṃ bandhakuṇḍaṃ sudustaram ।। taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍaṃ ca tīkṣṇa pāṣāṇakuṇḍakam ।। 15 ।। lālākuṇḍamasikuṇḍaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ sudāruṇam ।। cakrakuṇḍaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ kūrmmakuṇḍaṃ maholbaṇam ।। 16 ।। jvālakuṇḍaṃ bhasmakuṇḍaṃ pūtikuṇḍaṃ ca sundari ।। taptasūryamasīpatraṃ kṣuradhāraṃ sucīmukham ।। 17 ।। godhāmukhaṃ nakramukhaṃ gajadaṃśaṃ ca gomukham ।। kumbhīpākaṃ kālasūtramavaṭodamaruntudam।। 18 ।। pāṃśubhojaṃ pāśaveṣṭaṃ śūlaprotaṃ prakampanam ।। ulkāmukhamandhakūpaṃ vedhanaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam ।। ।। 19 ।। jālabandhaṃ dehacūrṇaṃ dalanaṃ śoṣaṇaṅkaram ।। sarpajvālāmukhaṃ jihmadhūmāndhaṃ nāgaveṣṭanam ।। 20।। kuṇḍānyetāni sāvitri pāpināṃ kleśadāni ca ।। niyuktaiḥ kiṅkaragaṇai rakṣitāni ca santatam ।। 21 ।। daṇḍahastaiḥ śūlahastaiḥ pāśahastairbhayaṅkaraiḥ ।। śaktihastairgadāhastairmadamattaiśca dāruṇaiḥ ।। 22 ।। tamoyuktairdayāhīnairdurnivāryyaṃ ca sarvataḥ ।। tejasvibhiśca niḥśaṅkaistāmrapiṅgalalocanaiḥ ।।23 ।। yogayuktaiḥ siddhayogairnānārūpadharairvaraiḥ ।। āsannamṛtyubhirdṛṣṭaiḥ pāpibhiḥ sarvajīvibhiḥ ।। 24 ।। svakarmanirataiḥ śaivaiḥ śāktaiḥ sauraiśca gāṇapaiḥ ।। adṛṣṭaiḥ puṇyakṛdbhiśca siddhayogibhireva ca ।। 25 ।। svadharmmaniratairvā'pi viratairvā svatantrakaiḥ ।। balavadbhiśca niḥśaṅkaiḥ svapnadṛṣṭaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ ।। 26 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sādhvi kuṇḍasaṃkhyānirūpaṇam ।। yeṣāṃ nivāso yatkuṃḍe nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 27 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe sāvitryupākhyāne yamasāvitrīsaṃvāde narakakuṇḍasaṃkhyānaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ।। 29 ।।
<2.30> yama uvāca ।। harisevārataḥ śuddho yogī siddho vrato sati ।। tapasvī brahmacārī ca na yāti narakaṃ yatiḥ ।। 1 ।। kaṭuvācā bāndhavāṃśca khalatvena ca yo naraḥ ।। dagdhānkaroti balavānvahnikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 2 ।। gātralomapramāṇābdaṃ tatra sthitvā hutāśane ।। paśuyonimavāpnoti raudre dagdhastrijanmani ।। 3 ।। brāhmaṇaṃ tṛṣitaṃ kṣubdhaṃ prataptaṃ gṛhamāgatam ।। na bhojayati yo mūḍhastaptakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 4 ।। tatra lomapramāṇābdaṃ sthitvā tatra ca duḥkhitaḥ ।। taptasthale vahnikuṇḍe pakṣī ca saptajanmasu ।। 5 ।। ravivārārkasaṃkrāntyāmamāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ।। vastrāṇāṃ kṣārasaṃyogaṃ karoti yo hi mānavaḥ ।। 6 ।। sa yāti kṣārakuṇḍaṃ ca sūtramānābdameva ca ।। sa vrajedrājakīṃ yoniṃ saptajanmasu bhārate ।। 7 ।। svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harettu yaḥ ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkuṇḍaṃ ca prayāti saḥ ।। 8 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viḍbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmiśca punarbhuvi ।।9।। parakīyataḍāge ca taḍāgaṃ yaḥ karoti ca ।। utsṛjeddaivadoṣeṇa mūtrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 10 ।। tadreṇumānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। bhārate godhikā caiva sa bhavetsaptajanmasu ।। 11 ।। ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti śleṣmakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। 12 ।। pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva sa preto bhārate bhavet ।। śleṣmamūtragaraṃ caiva pūyaṃ bhuṅkte tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 13 ।। pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva guruṃ bhāryyāṃ sutaṃ sutām ।। yo na puṣṇātyanāthaṃ ca garakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 14 ।। pūrṇamabdasahasraṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। tato vrajedbhūtayoniṃ śatavarṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 15 ।। dṛṣṭvātithiṃ vakracakṣuḥ karoti yo hi mānavaḥ ।। pitṛdevāstasya jalaṃ na gṛhṇanti ca pāpinaḥ ।। 16 ।। yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ।। ihaiva labhate cānte dūṣikākuṇḍamāvrajet।। 17 ।। pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। tato naro bhavedbhūmau daridraḥ saptajanmasu ।। 18 ।। dattvā dravyaṃ ca viprāya cānyasmai dīyate yadi।। sa tiṣṭhati vasākuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram।।19।। tato bhavetsa caṇḍālastrijanmani tataḥ śuciḥ ।। kṛkalāso bhavetso'pi bhārate saptajanmasu ।। tato bhavenmānavaśca daridro'lpāyureva ca ।। 20।। pumāṃsaṃ kāminī vā'pi kāminīṃ vā pumānatha ।। yaḥ śukraṃ pāyayatyeva śukrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 21 ।। pūrṇamabdaśataṃ caiva tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। yonikṛmiḥ śatābdaṃ ca bhavedbhuvi tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 22 ।। santāḍya ca guruṃ vipraṃ raktapātaṃ ca kārayet ।। sa ca tiṣṭhatyasṛkkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram।।23।। tato bhavedvyādhajanma saptajanmasu bhārate ।। tataḥ śuddhimavāpnoti mānavaśca krameṇa ca ।। 24 ।। aśru sravantaṃ gāyantaṃ bhaktaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca gadgadam ।। śrīkṛṣṇaguṇasaṃgīte hasatyeva hi yo naraḥ ।। 25 ।। sa vasedaśrukuṇḍe ca tadbhojī śatavatsaram ।। tato bhavetsa caṇḍālastrijanmani tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 26 ।। karoti khalatāṃ śaśvadaśuddhahṛdayo naraḥ ।। kuṇḍaṃ gātramalānāṃ ca sa ca yāti daśābdakam ।। 27 ।। tataḥ sa gārdabhīṃ yonimavāpnoti trijanmani ।। trijanmani ca śārgālīṃ tataḥ śuddho bhaveddhruvam ।। 28 ।। badhiraṃ yo hasatyeva nindatyeva hi mānavaḥ ।। sa vasetkarṇaviṭkuṇḍe tadbhojī śatavatsaram ।। 29 ।। tato bhavetsa badhiro daridraḥ saptajanmasu ।। saptajanmasvaṅgahīnastataḥ śuddhiṃ labheddhruvam ।। ।। 30 ।। lobhātsvapālanārthāya jīvinaṃ hanti yo naraḥ ।। majjākuṇḍe vasetso'pi tadbhojī lakṣavarṣakam ।। 31 ।। tato bhavetsa śaśako mīnaśca saptajanmasu ।। eṇādayaśca karmmabhyastataḥ śuddhiṃ labheddhruvam ।।32।। svakanyāpālanaṃ kṛtvā vikrīṇāti hi yo naraḥ ।। arthalobhānmahāmūḍho māṃsakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 33 ।। kanyālomapramāṇābdaṃ tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। taṃ ca kuṇḍe prahāraṃ ca karoti yamakiṅkaraḥ ।। 34 ।। māṃsabhāraṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā raktadhārāṃ lihetkṣudhā ।। tato hi bhārate pāpī kanyāviṭsu kṛmirbhavet ।। 35 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi vyādhaśca saptajanmasu ।। trijanmani varāhaśca kukkurassaptajanmasu ।। 36 ।। saptajanmasu maṇḍūko jalaukāḥ saptajanmasu ।। saptajanmasu kākaśca tataḥ śuddhiṃ labheddhruvam ।। 37 ।। vratānāmupavāsānāṃ śrāddhādīnāṃ ca saṃyame ।। na karoti kṣaurakarma so'śuciḥ sarvakarmasu ।। 38 ।। sa ca tiṣṭhati kuṇḍeṣu nakhādīnāṃ ca sundari ।। tadeva dinamānābdaṃ tadbhojī daṇḍatāḍitaḥ ।। 39 ।। sakeśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ yo vā'rcayati bhārate ।। sa tiṣṭhati keśakuṇḍe mṛdreṇumānavarṣakam ।। 40 ।। tadante yāvanīṃ yoniṃ prayāti harakopataḥ ।। śatābdācchuddhimāpnoti svakulaṃ labhate dhruvam ।। 41 ।। pitṝṇāṃ yo viṣṇupade piṇḍaṃ naiva dadāti ca ।। sa tiṣṭhatyasthikuṇḍe ca svalomābdaṃ maholbaṇe ।। 42 ।। tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya khañjaḥ saptasu janmasu ।। bhavenmahādaridraśca tataḥ śuddho hi daṇḍataḥ ।। 43 ।। yaḥ sevate mahāmūḍho gurviṇīṃ ca svakāminīm ।। prataptatāmrakuṇḍe ca śatavarṣaṃ sa tiṣṭhati।। ।। 44 ।। avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte ṛtusnātānnameva ca ।। lauhakuṇḍe śatābdaṃ ca sa ca tiṣṭhati taptake ।। 49 ।। sa vrajedrājakīṃ yoniṃ karmakārīṃ ca saptasu ।। mahāvraṇī daridraśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। ।। 46 ।। yo hi gharmāktahastena devadravyamupaspṛśet ।। śatavarṣapramāṇaṃ ca gharmakuṇḍe sa tiṣṭhati ।। 47 ।। yaḥ śūdreṇābhyanujñāto bhuṅkte śūdrānnameva ca ।। sa ca taptasurākuṇḍe śatābdaṃ tiṣṭhati dvijaḥ ।। 48।। tato bhavecchradrayājī brāhmaṇaḥ saptajanmasu ।। śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaved dhruvam ।। ।। 49 ।। vāgduṣṭā kaṭuvācā yā tāḍayetsvāminaṃ sadā ।। tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍe sā tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। 50 ।। tāḍitā yamadūtena daṇḍena ca caturyugam ।। tata uccaiḥśravāḥ saptajanmasveva tataḥ śuciḥ ।।51।। viṣeṇa jīvinaṃ hanti nirdayo yo hi pāmaraḥ ।। viṣakuṃḍe ca tadbhojī sahasrābdaṃ ca tiṣṭhati।। ।।52।। tato bhavennṛghātī ca vraṇī syātsaptajanmasu ।। saptajanmasu kuṣṭhī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddhruvam ।।53।। daṇḍena tāḍayedyo hi vṛṣaṃ ca vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। bhṛtyadvārā svatantro vā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 54 ।। prataptatailakuṇḍe ca sa tiṣṭhati caturyugam ।। gavāṃ lomapramāṇābdaṃ vṛṣo bhavati tatparam ।। 55 ।। dantena hanti jīvaṃ yo lauhena baḍiśena vā ।। dantakuṇḍe vasetso'pi varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sati ।। 56 ।। tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya codaravyādhisaṃyutaḥ।। kliṣṭena janmanaikena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ।।57।। yo bhuṃkte ca vṛthā māṃsaṃ matsyabhojī ca brāhmaṇaḥ ।। hareranaivedyabhojī kṛmikuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 58 ।। svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। tato bhavenmlecchajātistrijanmani tato dvijaḥ ।।59।। brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrayājī yaḥ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojakaḥ ।। śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca pūyakuṇḍaṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 60।। yāvallomapramāṇābdaṃ yajamānasya suvrate ।। tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। 61 ।। tato bhāratamāgatya sa śūdraḥ saptajanmasu ।। mahāśūlī daridraśca tataḥ śuddhaḥ punardvijaḥ ।। 62 ।। laghuṃ kūraṃ mahāntaṃ vā sarpaṃ hanti ca yo naraḥ ।। svātmalomapramāṇābdaṃ sarpakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 63 ।। sarpeṇa bhakṣitaḥ so'pi yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। vasecca sarpaviṭjīvī tataḥ sarpo bhaveddhruvam ।। 64 ।। tato bhavenmānavaścāpyalpāyurdadrusaṃyutaḥ ।। mahākleśena tanmṛtyuḥ sarpeṇa bhakṣaṇaṃ dhruvam ।। 65 ।। vidhiṃ prakalpya jīvāṃśca kṣudrajantūṃśca hanti yaḥ ।। sadaṃśamaśake kuṇḍe janmamānadinābdakam ।। 66 ।। divāniśaṃ bhakṣitastairanāhāraśca śabdakṛt ।। baddhahastapadādiśca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ।। 67 ।। tato bhavetkṣudrajanturjātirvai yāvatī smṛtā ।। tato bhavenmānavaśca so'ṅgahīnastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 68 ।। yo mūḍho madhu gṛhṇāti hatvā ca madhumakṣikāḥ ।। sa eva garale kuṃḍe jīvamānadinābdakam ।। 69 ।। bhakṣito garalairdagdho yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। tato hi makṣikājātistataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 70 ।। daṇḍaṃ karotyadaṃḍye ca vipre daṇḍaṃ karoti ca ।। sa kuṇḍaṃ vajradaṃṣṭrāṇāṃ kīṭānāṃ vai prayāti ca ।। 71 ।। tallomamānavarṣaṃ ca tatra tiṣṭhatyaharniśam ।। śabdakṛdbhakṣitastaiśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 72 ।। arthalobhena yo bhūpaḥ prajādaṇḍaṃ karoti ca ।। vṛścikānāṃ ca kuṇḍeṣu tallomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam ।। 73 ।। tato vṛścikajātiśca saptajanmasu jāyate ।। tato naraścāṅgahīno vyādhiyukto bhaveddhruvam ।। 74 ।। brāhmaṇaḥ śastradhārī yo hyanyeṣāṃ dhāvako bhavet ।। sandhyāhīnaśca mūḍhaśca haribhaktivihīnakaḥ ।। 75 ।। sa tiṣṭhati svalomābdaṃ kuṇḍādiṣu śarādiṣu ।। viddhaḥ śarādibhiḥ śaśvattataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 76 ।। kārāgāre sāndhakāre nibadhnāti prajāśca yaḥ ।। pramattaḥ svalpadoṣeṇa golakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। ।। 77 ।। tatkuṇḍaṃ taptatoyāktaṃ sāndhakāraṃ bhayaṅkaram ।। tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca kīṭaiśca saṃyuktaṃ golakuṇḍakam ।। 178।। kīṭairviddho vasettatra prajālomābdameva ca ।। tato bhavennīcabhṛtyastataḥ śuddho naro bhuvi ।। 79 ।। sarovarādutthitāṃśca nakrādīnhanti yaḥ sati ।। nakrakaṇṭakamānābdaṃ nakrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ 1।। 80 ।। tato nakrādijātiśca bhavennadyādiṣu dhruvam ।। tataḥ sadyo viśuddho hi daṇḍenaiva naraḥ punaḥ ।। 81 ।। vakṣaḥ śroṇīstanāsyaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ ।। kāmena kāmuko yo hi puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।।82।। sa vasetkākakuṇḍaṃ ca kākaiśca kṣuṇṇalocanaḥ ।। tataḥ svalomamānābdaṃ tataścāndhastrijanmani।।83।। saptajanmadaridraśca mahākrūraśca pātakī ।। bhārate svarṇakāraśca sa ca svarṇavaṇiktataḥ ।। 84 ।। yo bhārate tāmracauro lauhacauraśca sundari ।। sa svalomapramāṇābdaṃ vajrakuṇḍaṃ prayāti vai ।। 89 ।। tatraiva vajraviḍbhojī vajraiśca kṣuṇṇalocanaḥ ।। tāḍito yamadūtena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 86 ।। bhārate devacauraśca devadravyādihārakaḥ ।। suduṣkare vajrakuṇḍe svalomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam ।। 87 ।। dehadagdho hi tadvajrairanāhāraśca śabdakṛt ।। tāḍito yamadūtena tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। ।। 88 ।। raupyagavyāṃ śukānāṃ ca yaścauraḥ suraviprayoḥ ।। taptapāṣāṇakuṇḍe ca svalomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam ।। 89 ।। trijanmani bakaḥ so'pi śvetahaṃsastrijanmani ।। janmaikaṃ śaṅkhacillaśca tato'nye śvetapakṣiṇaḥ ।। 90 ।। tato raktavikārī ca śūlī vai mānavo bhavet ।। saptajanmasu cālpāyustataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 91 ।। raityakāṃsyādipātraṃ ca yo haretsuraviprayoḥ ।। tīkṣṇapāṣāṇakuṇḍe ca svalomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam ।। 92 ।। sa bhavedaśvajātiśca bhārate saptajanmasu ।। tato' dhikāṅgayuktaśca pādarogī tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 93 ।। puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte puṃścalījīvyajīvanaḥ ।। svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca lālākuṇḍe vaseddhruvam ।। 94 ।। tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। tataścakṣuśśūlarogī tataḥ śuddhaḥ krameṇa saḥ ।। 95 ।। । mlecchasevī maṣījīvī yo vipro bhārate bhuvi ।। sa ca taptamaṣīkuṇḍe svalomābdaṃ vaseddhruvam ।। 96 ।। tāḍito yamadūtena tadbhojī tatra tiṣṭhati ।। tatastrijanmani bhavetkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ paśuḥ sati ।। 97 ।। trijanmani bhavecchāgaḥ kṛṣṇasarpastrijanmani ।। tataśca tālavṛkṣaśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 98 ।। dhānyādi sasyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ yo haretsuraviprayoḥ ।। āsanaṃ ca tathā talpaṃ cūrṇakuṇḍaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 99 ।। śatābdaṃ tatra nivasedyamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। tato bhavenmeṣajātiḥ kukkuṭaśca trijanmani ।। 100 ।। tato bhavenmānavaśca kāsavyādhiyuto bhuvi ।। vaṃśahīno daridraścāpyalpāyuśca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 101 ।। cakraṃ karoti viprāṇāṃ hṛtvā dravyaṃ ca yo naraḥ ।। sa vaseccakrakuṇḍe ca śatābdaṃ daṃḍatāḍitaḥ ।। 102 ।। tato bhavenmānavaśca tailakārastrijanmani ।। vyādhiyukto bhavedrogī vaṃśahīnastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 103 ।। bāndhaveṣu ca vipreṣu kurute vakratāṃ naraḥ।। prayāti vajrakuṇḍaṃ ca vasettatra yugaṃ sati ।। 104 ।। tato bhavetsa vakrāṃgo hīnāṅgaḥ saptajanmasu ।। daridro vaṃśahīnaśca bhāryyāhīnastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 105 ।। śayane kūrmamāṃsaṃ ca brāhmaṇo yo hi bhakṣati ।। kūrmmakuṇḍe vasetso'pi śatābdaṃ kūrmmabhakṣitaḥ।।106।। tato bhavetkūrmmajanma trijanmani ca sūkaraḥ।। trijanmani biḍālaśca mayūraśca trijanmani ।। 107 ।। ghṛtatailādikaṃ caiva yo haretsuraviprayoḥ ।। jvālakuṇḍaṃ sa vai yāti bhasmakuṇḍaṃ ca pātakī ।। 108।। tatra sthitvā śatābdaṃ ca sa bhavettailapāyikaḥ ।। saptajanmasu matsyaḥ syānmūṣakaśca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 109 ।। sugandhitailaṃ dhātrīṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ tathaiva vā ।। bhārate puṇyavarṣe ca yo haretsuraviprayoḥ ।। 110 ।। vaseddurgandhakuṃḍe ca durgandhaṃ ca labhetsadā ।। svalomamānavarṣaṃ ca tato durgandhiko bhavet ।। 111 ।। durgaṃdhikaḥ saptajanau mṛganābhistrijanmani ।। saptajanma sugaṃdhiśca tato vai mānavo bhavet ।। 112 ।। balenaiva khalatvena hiṃsārūpeṇa vā sati ।। balī ca yo haredbhūmiṃ bhārate parapaitṛkīm ।। 113 ।। sa vasettaptaśūle ca bhavettato divāniśam ।। taptataile yathā jīvo dagdho bhramati santatam ।। 114 ।। bhasmasānna bhavatyeva bhogadeho na naśyati ।। saptamanvantaraṃ pāpī santaptastatra tiṣṭhati ।। 115 ।। śabdaṃ karotyanāhāro yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṭkṛmirbhārate tataḥ ।। 116 ।। tato bhavedbhūmihīno daridraśca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। tataḥ svayoniṃ saṃprāpya śubhakarmā bhavetpunaḥ ।। 117 ।। chinatti jīvinaḥ khaṅgairdayāhīnaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।। naraghātī hanti naramarthalobhena bhārate ।। 118 ।। asipatre ca sa vasedyāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। teṣu cedbrāhmaṇānhanti śatamanvantaraṃ tadā ।।119 ।। chinnāṅgaśca bhavetpāpī khaṅgadhāreṇa santatam ।। anāhāraḥ śabdakṛcca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। 120 ।। caṇḍālaḥ śatajanmāni bhārate sūkaro bhavet ।। kukkuraḥ śatajanmāni sṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 121 ।। vyāghraśca saptajanmāni vṛkaścaiva trijanmani ।। janmasaptasu gaṃḍo syānmahiṣaśca trijanmani ।। 122 ।। grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vā'pi dāhanaṃ yaḥ karoti ca ।। kṣuradhāre vasetso'pi cchinnāṅgastriyugaṃ sati ।। ।। 123 ।। tataḥ preto bhavetsadyo vahnivaktro bhramenmahīm ।। saptajanmāmedhyabhojī khadyotaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 124 ।। tato bhavenmahāśūlī mānavaḥ saptajanmasu ।। saptajanma galatkuṣṭhī tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 125 ।। parakarṇopajāpena paranindāṃ karoti yaḥ ।। paradoṣe mahātoṣī devabrāhmaṇanindakaḥ ।।126।। sūcīmukhe sa ca vasetsūcīviddho yugatrayam ।। tato bhavedvṛścikaśca sarpaḥ syātsaptajanmasu ।। 127 ।। vajrakīṭaḥ saptajanau bhasmakīṭastataḥ param ।। tato bhavenmānavaśca mahāvyādhistataḥ śuciḥ ।। 128 ।। gṛhiṇāṃ ca gṛhaṃ bhittvā vastuteyaṃ karoti yaḥ ।। gāśca cchāgāṃśca meṣāṃśca yāti godhāmukhaṃ ca saḥ ।। 129 ।। tato bhavetsaptajanau gojātirvyādhisaṃyutaḥ ।। trijanmameṣajātiśca cchāgajātistrijanmani ।। 130 ।। tato bhavenmānavaśca nityarogī daridrakaḥ ।। bhāryyāhīno bandhuhīnaḥ santāpī ca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 131 ।। sāmānyadravyacauraśca yāti nakramukhaṃ yugam ।। tato bhavenmānavaśca mahārogī tataḥ śuciḥ ।। ।। 132 ।। hanti gāśca gajāṃścaiva turagāṃśca narāṃstathā ।। sa yāti gajadaṃśaṃ ca mahāpāpī yugatrayam ।। 133 ।। tāḍito yamadūtena gajadantena santatam ।। sa bhavedgajajātiśca turagaśca trijanmani ।। gojātimlecchajātiśca tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 134 ।। jalaṃ pibantīṃ tṛṣitāṃ gāṃ vārayati yo naraḥ ।। tacchuśrūśāvihīnaśca gomukhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ ।। 135 ।। narakaṃ gomukhākāraṃ kṛmitaptodakānvitam ।। tatra tiṣṭhati santapto yāvanmanvantarāvadhi ।। 136 ।। tato naro'pi gohīno mahārogī daridrakaḥ ।। sapta janmanyantyajātiḥ tataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 137 ।। gohatyāṃ brahmahatyāṃ ca yaḥ karotyatideśikīm ।। yo hi gacchedagamyāṃ ca sandhyāhīno'pyadīkṣitaḥ ।। 138 ।। pratigrāhī ca tīrtheṣu grāmayājī ca devalaḥ ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca pramatto vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। 139 ।। gohatyāṃ brahmahatyāṃ ca strīhatyāṃ ca karoti yaḥ ।। mitrahatyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāṃ mahāpāpī ca bhārate ।। 140 ।। kumbhīpāke sa ca vasedyāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। tāḍito yamadūtena cūrṇyamānaśca santatam ।। 141 ।। kṣaṇaṃ patati vahnau ca kṣaṇaṃ patati kaṇṭake ।। kṣaṇaṃ ca taptataileṣu taptatoyeṣu ca kṣaṇam ।। 142 ।। kṣaṇaṃ ca taptapāṣāṇe taptalohe kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।। gṛdhrakoṭisrahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ ।। 143 ।। kākaśca saptajanmāni sarpassyātsaptajanmasu ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tato vai viṭkṛmirbhavet ।। 144 ।। tato bhavetsa vṛṣaṇo galatkuṣṭhī daridrakaḥ ।। yakṣmagrasto vaṃśahīno bhāryyāhīnastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 145 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। brahmahatyā ca gohatyā kiṃvidhā vā''tideśikī ।। kā vā nṛṇāmagamyā vā ko vā sandhyāvihīnakaḥ ।। 146 ।। adīkṣitaḥ pumānko vā ko vā tīrthe pratigrahī ।। dvijaḥ ko vā grāmayājī ko vā vipraśca devalaḥ ।। 147 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraḥ kaḥ pramatto vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 148 ।। yama uvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇe ca tadarccāyāṃ mṛnmayyāṃ prakṛtau tathā ।। śive ca śivaliṅge vā sūryye sūryyamaṇau tathā ।। 149 ।। gaṇeśe vā tadarccāyāmevaṃ sarvatra sundari ।। karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ।। 150।। svagurau sveṣṭadeve vā janmadātari mātari।। karoti bhedabuddhiṃ yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ।।151।। vaiṣṇaveṣvanyabhakteṣu brāhmaṇeṣvitareṣu ca ।। karoti samatāṃ yo hi brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 152 ।। yo mūḍho viṣṇunaivedye cānyanaivedyake tathā ।। hareḥ pādodakeṣvanyadevapādodake tathā ।। karoti samatāṃ yo hi brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 153 ।। sarveśvareśvare kṛṣṇe sarvakāraṇakāraṇe ।। sarvādye sarvadevānāṃ sevye sarvāntarātmani ।। 154 ।। māyayā'nekarūpe vā'pyeka eva hi nirguṇe ।। karotyanyena samatāṃ brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 155 ।। pitṛdevārcanāṃ paurvāparāṃ vedavinirmitām ।। yaḥ karoti niṣedhaṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 156 ।। ye nindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ tanmantropāsakaṃ tathā ।। pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te ।। 157 ।। śivaṃ śivasvarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikaṃ priyam ।। pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca jñānānandaṃ sanātanam ।। 158।। pradhānaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devānāṃ savyamīśvaram।। ye nārcayanti nindanti brahmahatyāṃ labhaṃti te ।। 159 ।। ye viṣṇumāyāṃ nindanti viṣṇubhaktipradāṃ satīm ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca prakṛtiṃ sarvamātaram ।। 160 ।। sarvadevīsvarūpāṃ ca sarvādyāṃ sarvavanditām ।। sarvakāraṇarūpāṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te ।। 161 ।। kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ rāmanavamīṃ puṇyadāṃ parām ।। śivarātriṃ tathā caikādaśīṃ vāraṃ ravestathā ।। 162 ।। pañcaparvāṇi puṇyāni ye na kurvanti mānavāḥ ।। labhante brahmahatyāṃ te cāṇḍālādhikapāpinaḥ ।। 163 ।। ambuvīcyāṃbukhanane jale śaucādikaṃ ca ye ।। kurvanti bhārate vatse brahmahatyāṃ labhanti te ।। 164 ।। guruṃ ca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sādhvīṃ bhāryyāṃ sutaṃ sutām ।। anāthānyo na puṣṇāti brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 165 ।। vivāho yasya na bhavenna paśyati sutaṃ ca yaḥ ।। haribhaktivihīno yo brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 166 ।। hareranaivedyabhojī nityaṃ viṣṇuṃ na pūjayet ।। puṇyaṃ pārthivaliṃgaṃ vā brahmahatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 167 ।। āhāraṃ kurvatīṃ gāṃ ca pibantīṃ yo nivārayet ।। yāti goviprayormmadhye gohatyāṃ ca labhettu saḥ ।। 168 ।। daṇḍairgāstāḍayenmūḍho yo vipro vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। dine dine gavāṃ hatyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 169 ।। dadāti gobhya ucchiṣṭaṃ yojayedvṛṣavāhakam ।। bhojayedvṛṣavāhānnaṃ sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam।। ।। 170।। vṛṣalīpatiṃ yājayedyo bhuṃkte'nnaṃ tasya yo naraḥ ।। gohatyāśatakaṃ so'pi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 171 ।। pādaṃ dadāti vahnau ca gāśca pādena tāḍayet ।। gṛhaṃ viśedadhautāṃghriḥ snātvā govadhamāpnuyāt ।। 172 ।। yo bhuṃkte snigdhapādena śete snigdhāṃghrireva ca ।। sūryyodaye ca dvirbhojī sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।। 173 ।। avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte yonijīvī ca vai dvijaḥ ।। yastrisandhyāvihīnaśca sa gohatyāṃ labhed dhruvam ।।174।। pitṝṃśca parvakāle ca tithikāle ca devatām ।। na sevate'tithiṃ yo hi gohatyāṃ sa labheddhruvam ।। 175 ।। svabhartari ca kṛṣṇe ca bhedabuddhiṃ karoti yā ।। kaṭūktyā tāḍayetkāntaṃ sā gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।।176।। gomārgakhananaṃ kṛtvā vapate sasyameva ca ।। taḍāge vā tadūrdhvaṃ vā sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।। 177 ।। prāyaścittaṃ govadhasya yaḥ karoti vyatikramam ।। arthalobhādathājñānātsa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।। 178 ।। rājake daivake yatnādgosvāmī gāṃ na pātayet ।। duḥkhaṃ dadāti yo mūḍho gohatyāṃ sa labheddhruvam ।।179।। prāṇinaṃ laṃghayedyo hi devārcāyāṃ rataṃ jalam ।। naivedyaṃ puṣpamannaṃ ca sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।। ।। 180।। śaśvannāstīti vādī yo mithyāvādī pratārakaḥ ।। devadveṣī gurudveṣī sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।। 181 ।। devatāpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā guruṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ sati ।। sambhramānna namedyo hi sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।।182।। na dadātyāśiṣaṃ kopātpraṇatāya ca yo dvijaḥ ।। vidyārthine ca vidyāṃ vai sa gohatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।।183।। gohatyā brahmahatyā ca kathitā cātideśikī ।। yathā śrutaṃ sūryyavaktrātkiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 184 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। vāstave cātideśe ca sambandhe pāpapuṇyayoḥ ।। nyūnādhike ca ko bhedastanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 185 ।। yama uvāca ।। kutrāpi vāstavaḥ śreṣṭho nyūno'tideśikassadā ।। kutrātideśikaḥ śreṣṭho vāstavo nyūna eva ca ।। 186 ।। kutra vā samatā sādhvi tayorvedapramāṇataḥ ।। karoti tatra nāsthāṃ yo guruhatyāṃ labhettu saḥ ।। 187 ।। purā paricite vipre vidyāmantrapradātari ।। gurau pitṛtvamāropādvastutaśśreṣṭha ucyate।।188।। pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇastathā।। vidyā mantrapradātā ca guruḥ pūjyaḥ śrutermataḥ ।। 189 ।। guruto gurupatnī ca gaurave ca garīyasī ।। yatheṣṭaṃ devapatnī ca pūjyā cābhīṣṭadevatā।। ।। 190 ।। vipraḥ śivasamo yaśca viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ ।। rājā''tideśikācchreṣṭho vāstavo guṇalakṣataḥ ।। 191 ।। sarvaṃ gaṅgāsamaṃ toyaṃ sarve vyāsasamā dvijāḥ ।। grahaṇe sṛryyaśaśinoścātraiva samatā tayoḥ ।। 192 ।। ātideśikahatyāyā vāstavaśca caturguṇaḥ ।। sammataḥ sarvavedānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 193 ।। ātideśikahatyāyā bhedaśca kathitaḥ sati ।। yā yā'gamyā nṛṇāmeva nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 194 ।। svastrī gamyā ca sarveṣāmiti vede nirūpitā ।। agamyā ca tadanyā yā ceti vedavedo viduḥ ।। 195 ।। sāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sundari ।। atyagamyāśca yā yā vai nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 196 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ viprapatnī ca viprāṇāṃ śūdrakāminī ।। atyagamyā'tinindyā ca loke vede pativrate ।। 197 ।। śūdraścedbrāhmaṇīṃ gacchedbrahmahatyāśataṃ labhet ।। tatsamaṃ brāhmaṇī cāpi kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 198 ।। yadi śūdrāṃ vrajedvipro vṛṣalīpatireva saḥ ।। sa bhraṣṭo viprajāteśca caṇḍālātso 'dhamaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 199 ।। viṣṭhāsamaśca tatpiṃḍo mūtratulyaṃ ca tarpaṇam ।। tatpitṝṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca pūjane tatsamaṃ sati ।। 200 ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ sandhyārcātapasā'rjitam ।। dvijasya vṛṣalībhogānnaśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 201 ।। brāhmaṇaśca surāpītī viḍbhojī vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। harivāsarabhojī ca kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 202 ।। gurupatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ sapatnīmātaraṃ prasūm ।। sutāṃ putravadhūṃ śvaśrūṃ sagarbhāṃ bhaginīṃ sati ।। 203 ।। sodarabhrātṛjāyāṃ ca mātulānīṃ pitṛprasūm ।। mātuḥ prasūṃ tattvasāraṃ bhaginīṃ bhrātṛkanyakām ।। ।। 204 ।। śiṣyāṃ ca śiṣyapatnīṃ ca bhagineyasya kāminīm ।। bhrātuḥ putrapriyāṃ caivāpyagamyāmāha padmajaḥ ।। 205 ।। etāsvekāmanekāṃ vā yo vrajenmānavo'dhamaḥ ।। svamātṛgāmī vedeṣu brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet ।। 206 ।। akarmmārho'pi so'spṛśyo loke vede'ti ninditaḥ ।। sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca mahāpāpī sudustaram।।207।। karotyaśuddhāṃ sandhyāṃ ca sandhyāṃ vā na karoti yaḥ।। trisandhyāṃ varjayedyo vā sandhyāhīnaśca sa dvijaḥ ।।208।। vaiṣṇavaṃ ca tathā śaivaṃ śāktaṃ sauraṃ ca gāṇapam ।। yo'haṅkārānna gṛhṇāti mantraṃ so'dīkṣitaḥ smṛtaḥ ।।209।। pravāhamavadhiṃ kṛtvā yāvaddhastacatuṣṭayam ।। tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī gaṅgāgarbhāntare vare ।। 210 ।। tatra nārāyaṇakṣetre kurukṣetre hareḥ pade।। vārāṇasyāṃ badaryyāṃ ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame ।। 211 ।। puṣkare bhāskarakṣetre prabhāse rāsamaṇḍale ।। haridvāre ca kedāre some badarapāvane ।। 212 ।। sarasvatīnadītīre puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। godāvaryāṃ ca kauśikyāṃ triveṇyāṃ ca himālaye ।। 213 ।। eṣvanyatra ca yo dānaṃ pratigṛhṇāti kāmataḥ ।। sa ca tīrthapratigrāhī kumbhīpākaṃ prayāti ca ।। 214 ।। śūdrātiriktayājī yo grāmayājī ca kīrttitaḥ ।। tathā devopajīvī yo devalaḥ parikīrttitaḥ ।। 215 ।। śūdrapākopajīvī yaḥ sūpakāra iti smṛtaḥ ।। sandhyāpūjāvihīnaśca pramattaḥ patitaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 216 ।। uktaṃ pūrvaprakaraṇe lakṣaṇaṃ vṛṣalīpateḥ ।। ete mahāpātakinaḥ kumbhīpākaṃ prayānti te ।। 217 ।। kuṃḍānyanyāni te yānti nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 218 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne yamasāvitrīsaṃvāde karmavipāke pāpinarakanirūpaṇaṃ śivaprāśastyaṃ brahmahatyādipadārthaparibhāṣānirūpaṇaṃ nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 30 ।।
<2.31> yama uvāca ।। harisevāṃ vinā sādhvi na labhetkarmakhaṇḍanam ।। śubhakarmma svargabījaṃ narakaṃ ca kukarmmataḥ ।। 1 ।। puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte veśyānnaṃ ca pativrate ।। tāṃ vrajettu dvijo yo hi kālasūtraṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 2 ।। śatavarṣaṃ kālasūtre sthitvā śūdro bhaveddhruvam ।। tatra janmani rogī ca tataḥ śuddho bhaveddvijaḥ ।। ।। 3 ।। pativratā caikapatnī dvitīye kulaṭā smṛtā ।। tṛtīye dharṣiṇī jñeyā caturthe puṃścalī smṛtā ।। 4 ।। veśyā ca pañcame ṣaṣṭhe yugmī ca parikīrtitā ।। ata ūrdhvaṃ mahāveśyā sā'spṛśyā sarvajātiṣu ।। 5 ।। yo dvijaḥ kulaṭāṃ gaccheddharṣiṇīṃ puṃścalīmapi ।। veśya yugmīṃ mahāveśyāmavaṭodaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 6 ।। śatābdaṃ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī caturguṇam ।। ṣaḍguṇaṃ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī guṇāṣṭakam ।। 7 ।। yugmīgāmī daśaguṇaṃ vasettatra na saṃśayaḥ ।। mahāveśyākāmukaśca tataḥ śataguṇaṃ vaset ।। 8 ।। tadā hi sarvagāmī cetyevamāha pitāmahaḥ ।। tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṅkte yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।।9।। tittiriḥ kulaṭāgāmī dhṛṣṭāgāmī ca vāyasaḥ।। kokilaḥ puṃścalīgāmī veśyāgāmī vṛkastathā ।। 10 ।। yugmīgāmī sūkaraśca saptajanmasu bhārate ।। mahāveśyākāmukaśca śmaśāne śālmalistaruḥ ।। 11 ।। yo bhuṃkte jñānahīnaśca grahaṇe candrasūyyaryoḥ ।। aruntudaṃ sa yātyeva candramānābdameva ca ।। 12 ।। tato bhavenmānavassyādudaravyādhisaṃyutaḥ ।। gulmayuktaśca kāṇaśca dantahīnastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 13 ।। vākpradattāṃ hi kanyāṃ ca yaścānyasmai dadāti ca ।। sa vasetpāṃśubhoge ca tadbhojī ca śatābdakam ।।14।। dattāpahārī yaḥ sādhvi pāśaveṣṭaṃ śatābdakam ।। nivaseccharaśayyāyāṃ yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ।।15।। na pūjayedyo hi bhaktyā śivaliṅgaṃ ca pārthivam ।। sa yāti śūlinaḥ kopācchūlaprotaṃ sudāruṇam ।। 16 ।। sthitvā śatābdaṃ tatraiva śvāpadaḥ saptajanmasu ।। tato bhaveddevalaśca saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।। 17 ।। karoti daṇḍaṃ yo vipre yadbhayātkampate dvijaḥ ।। prakampane vasetso'pi vipralomābdameva ca ।।18।। prakopavadanā kopātsvāminaṃ yā ca paśyati ।। kaṭūktiṃ taṃ ca vadati yāti colkāmukhaṃ ca sā ।। 19 ।। ulkāṃ dadāti vaktre ca satataṃ yamakiṅkaraḥ ।। daṇḍena tāḍayenmūrdhni tallomābdapramāṇakam ।। 20 ।। tato bhavenmānavī ca vidhavā saptajanmasu ।। bhuktvā duḥkhaṃ ca vaidhavyaṃ vyādhiṃ bhuktvā tataḥ śuciḥ ।।21।। yā brāhmaṇī śūdrabhogyā sā'ndhakūpaṃ prayāti ca।। taptaśaucodake dhvānte tadāhārā divāniśam ।। 22 ।। nivasedatisantaptā yamadūtena tāḍitā ।। śaucodake nimagnā ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 23 ।। kākī janmasahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkarī ।। kukkuṭī śatajanmāni śṛgālī saptajanmasu ।।24।। pārāvatī saptajanau vānarī saptajanmasu ।। tato bhavetsā caṇḍālī sarvabhogyā ca bhārate।।25।। tato bhavecca rajakī yakṣmagrastā ca puṃścalī।। tataḥ kuṣṭhayutā tailakārī śuddhā bhavettataḥ ।। 26 ।। veśyā vasedvedhane ca yugmī vai daṇḍatāḍane ।। jālabandhe mahāveśyā kulaṭā dehacūrṇake ।। 27 ।। svairiṇī dalane caiva dhṛṣṭā vai śoṣaṇe tathā ।। nivasedyātanāyuktā yamadūtena tāḍitā ।। 28 ।। viṇmūtrabhakṣaṇaṃ tatra yāvanmanvantaraṃ sati।। tato bhavedviṭkṛmiśca varṣalakṣaṃ tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 29 ।। brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchetkṣattriyāmapi kṣatriyaḥ ।। vaiśyo vaiśyāṃ ca śūdrāṃ ca śūdro vā'pi vrajedyadi ।। 30 ।। svavarṇaparadārī ca kaṣaṃ yāti tayā saha ।। bhuktvā kaṣāyataptodaṃ nivaseddvādaśābdakam ।। 31 ।। tato vipro bhavecchuddhaścaivaṃ ca kṣatriyādayaḥ ।। yoṣitaścāpi śudhyantītyevamāha pitāmahaḥ ।। 32 ।। kṣatriyo brāhmaṇīṃ gacchedvaiśyo vā'pi pativrate ।। mātṛgāmī bhavetso'pi śūrpaṃ ca narakaṃ vrajet ।। 33 ।। śūrpākāraiśca kṛmibhirbrāhmaṇyā saha bhakṣitaḥ ।। prataptamūtrabhojī ca yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। 34 ।। tatraiva yātanāṃ bhuṃkte yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। saptajanmasu vārāhaśchāgalaśca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 39 ।। kare dhṛtvā ca tulasīṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet ।। mithyā vā śapathaṃ kuryyātsa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet ।। 36 ।। gaṅgātoyaṃ kare dhṛtvā pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet ।। śilāṃ ca devapratimāṃ sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet ।। 37 ।। dattvā ca dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ pratijñāṃ yo na pālayet ।। sthitvā devagṛhe vā'pi sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet ।। 38 ।। spṛṣṭvā ca brāhmaṇaṃ gāṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇusamaṃ sati ।। na pālayetpratijñāṃ ca sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet ।। 39 ।। mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca yo hi viśvāsaghātakaḥ ।। mithyāsākṣyapradaścaiva sa ca jvālāmukhaṃ vrajet ।। 40 ।। ete tatra vasantyeva yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। yathā'ṅgārapradagdhāśca yamadūtaiśca tāḍitāḥ ।। 41 ।। caṇḍālastulasīsparśī saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।। mleccho gaṃgājalasparśī pañcajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।। 42।। śilāsparśī viṭkṛmiśca saptajanmasu sundari ।। arccāsparśī vraṇakṛmissaptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।। 43 ।। dakṣahastapradhātā ca sarpassyātsaptajanmasu ।। tato bhaveddhastahīno mānavaśca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 44 ।। mithyāvādī devagṛhe devalaḥ saptajanmasu ।। viprādisparśakārī ca so'gradānī bhaveddhruvam ।। 45 ।। tato bhavanti mūkāste badhirāśca trijanmasu ।। bhāryyāhīnā vaṃśahīnā buddhihīnāstataḥ śuciḥ ।। 46 ।। mitradrohī ca na kulaḥ kṛtaghnaścāpi gaṇḍakaḥ ।। viśvāsaghātī vyāghraśca saptajanmasu bhārate ।। 47 ।। mithyāsākṣyapradaścaiva bhallūkaḥ saptajanmasu ।। pūrvānsapta parānsapta puruṣānhanti cātmanaḥ ।। '48 ।। nityakriyāvihīnaśca jaḍatvena yuto dvijaḥ ।। yasyānāsthā vedavākye mandaṃ hasati saṃtamam।। ।। 49 ।। vratopavāsahīnaśca sadvākyapariniṃdakaḥ ।। jihme jihmo vasetso'pi śatābdaṃ ca himodake ।। 50 ।। jalajaṃturbhavetso'pi śatajanmakrameṇa ca ।। tato nānāprakārā ca matsyajātistataḥ śuciḥ ।। 51 ।। yo vā dhanasyāpahāraṃ devābrahmaṇayoścaret ।। pātayitvā svapuruṣāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān ।। 52 ।। svayaṃ yāti ca dhūmāṃdhaṃ dhūmadhvāṃtasamanvitam ।। dhūmakliṣṭo dhūmabhojī vasettatra caturyugam ।। ।। 53 ।। tato mūṣakajātiśca śatajanmāni bhārate ।। tato nānāvidhāḥ pakṣijātayaḥ kṛmijātayaḥ ।। 54 ।। tato nānāvidhā vṛkṣajātayaśca tato naraḥ ।। bhāryāhīno vaṃśahīnaḥ śabaro vyādhisaṃyutaḥ।। 55 ।। tato bhavetsvarṇakāraḥ suvarṇasya vaṇiktathā ।। tato yavanasevī ca brāhmaṇo gaṇakastataḥ ।। 56 ।। vipro daivajñopajīvī vaidyajīvī cikitsakaḥ ।। vyāpārī lohalākṣāde rasādervikrayī ca yaḥ ।। ।। 57 ।। sa yāti nāgaveṣṭaṃ ca nāgairveṣṭita eva ca ।। vasetsvalomamānābdaṃ tatra vai nāgadaṃśitaḥ ।। 58 ।। tato bhavetsa gaṇako vaidyo vai saptajanmasu ।। gopaśca karmmakāraśca śaṅkhakārastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 59 ।। prasiddhāni ca kuṇḍāni kathitāni pativrate ।। anyāni cāprasiddhāni tatra kṣudrāṇi santi vai ।। 60 ।। santi pātakinasteṣu svakarmaphalabhoginaḥ ।। bhramaṃti tāvatsaṃsāre kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।61।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne karmavipāke pāpināṃ kuṇḍanirṇayo nāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 31 ।।
<2.32> sāvitryuvāca ।। dharmarāja mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga ।। nānāpurāṇetihāsapāñcarātrapradarśakaḥ ।।1।। sarveṣu sārabhūtaṃ yatsarveṣṭaṃ sarvasammatam ।। karmacchede bījarūpaṃ praśaṃsyaṃ sukhadaṃ nṛṇām ।। 2 ।। yaśaḥpradaṃ dharmadaṃ ca sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalam ।। yena yāmīṃ na te yāṃti yātanāṃ bhavaduḥkhadām ।। 3 ।। kuṇḍāni ca na paśyanti tatra naiva pataṃti ca ।। na bhavedyena janmādi tatkarma vada suvrata ।। 4 ।। kimākārāṇi kuṇḍāni kāni teṣāṃ matāni ca ।। kena rūpeṇa tatraiva sadā tiṣṭhaṃti pāpinaḥ ।। 5 ।। svadehe bhasmasādbhūte yāṃti lokāntaraṃ narāḥ ।। kena dehena vā bhogaṃ bhuñjate vā śubhāśubham ।। 6 ।। suciraṃ kleśabhogena kathaṃ deho na naśyati ।। deho vā kiṃvidho brahmaṃstanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।।7।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sāvitrīvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmarājo hariṃ smaran ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe guruṃ natvā ca nārada।। 8 ।। yama uvāca ।। vatse caturṣu vedeṣu dharmo vai saṃhitāsu ca ।। purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu pāñcarātrādikeṣu ca ।। 9 ।। anyeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu vedāṃgeṣu ca suvrate ।। sarveṣṭaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇasevanam ।। 10 ।। janmamṛtyujarārogaśokasantāpatāraṇam ।। sarvamaṅgalarūpaṃ ca paramānandakāraṇam ।। 11 ।। kāraṇaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ narakārṇavatāraṇam ।। bhaktivṛkṣāṃkurakaraṃ karmavṛkṣanikṛntanam ।।12 ।। golokamārgasopānamavināśipadapradam।। sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyādipradaṃ śubhe।।13।। kuṇḍāni yamadūtaṃ ca yamaṃ ca yamakiṅkarān ।। svapne'pi nahi paśyanti sati śrīkṛṣṇakiṅkarāḥ ।। 14 ।। harivrataṃ ye kurvaṃti gṛhiṇaḥ karmabhoginaḥ ।। ye snāṃti haritīrthe ca nāśnanti harivāsare ।। 15 ।। praṇamaṃti hariṃ nityaṃ haryyarcāṃ pūjayanti ca ।। na yānti te ca ghorāṃ ca mama saṃyamanīṃ purīm ।। 16 ।। trisandhyapūtā viprāśca śuddhācārasamanvitāḥ ।। svadharmaniratāḥ śāntā na yānti yamamandiram ।। 17 ।। te svargabhogino'nye ca śuddhā devānyakiṃkarāḥ ।। yāntyāyānti ca martyaṃ ca svargaṃ ca nahi nirvṛtāḥ ।। nivṛttiṃ na hi lipsanti kṛṣṇasevāṃ vinā narāḥ ।। 18 ।। svadharmmaniratāścāpi svadharmaviratāstathā ।। gacchanto martyalokaṃ ca durddharṣā yamakiṅkarāḥ ।। 19 ।। bhītāḥ kṛṣṇopāsakācca vainateyādivoragāḥ ।। svadūtaṃ pāśahastaṃ ca gacchantaṃ taṃ vadāmyaham ।। 20 ।। yāsyasīti ca sarvatra haribhaktāśramaṃ vinā ।। kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ nāmāni ca nikṛntanam ।। 21 ।। karoti nakharāñjalyā citraguptaśca bhītavat ।। madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā teṣāṃ ca kurute punaḥ ।। 22 ।। vilaṃghya brahmalokaṃ ca goloke gacchatāṃ satām ।। duritāni ca naśyanti teṣāṃ saṃsparśamātrataḥ ।। 23 ।। yathā suprajvaladvahnau kāṣṭhāni ca tṛṇāni ca ।। prāpnoti mohaḥ saṃmohaṃ tāṃśca dṛṣṭvā'tibhītavat ।। 24 ।। kāmaśca kāminaṃ yāti lobha krodhau tataḥ sati ।। mṛtyuḥ palāyate rogo jarā śoko bhayaṃ tathā ।। 25 ।। kālaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ karmma harṣo bhogastathaiva ca ।। ye ye na yānti yāmīṃ ca kathitāste mayā sati ।। 26 ।। śṛṇu dehasya vivṛtiṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam ।। pṛthivī vāyurākāśaṃ tejastoyamiti sphuṭam ।। 27 ।। dehināṃ dehabījaṃ ca sraṣṭuḥ sṛṣṭividhau param ।। pṛthvyādipañcabhūtaiśca yo deho nirmito bhavet ।। 28 ।। sa kṛtrimo naśvaraśca bhasmasācca bhavediha ।। vṛddhāṅguṣṭhapramāṇena yo jīvaḥ puruṣākṛtiḥ ।। 29 ।। bibharti sūkṣmadehaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ bhogahetave ।। sa deho na bhavedbhasma jvaladagnau mamālaye ।। 30 ।। jalena naṣṭo deho vā prahāre suciraṃ kṛte ।। na śastre ca na cāstre ca sutīkṣṇe kaṇṭake tathā ।। 31 ।। taptadrave taptalauhe taptapāṣāṇa eva ca ।। prataptapratimāśleṣe'pyatyūrdhvane'pi ca ।। ।। 32 ।। na ca dagdho na bhagnaśca bhuṃkte saṃtāpameva ca ।। kathitaṃ devi vṛttāntaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca yathāgamam ।। kuṇḍānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ।। ।। 33 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 32 ।।
<2.33> yama uvāca ।। pūrṇendumaṇḍalākāraṃ sarvakuṇḍaṃ ca vartulam ।। atīva nimnaṃ pāṣāṇabhedaiśca khacitaṃ sati ।। 1 ।। na naśvaraṃ cāpralayaṃ nirmitaṃ ceśvarecchayā ।। kleśadaṃ vai pātakināṃ nānārūpaṃ tadālayam ।। 2 ।। jvaladaṅgārarūpaṃ ca śatahastaśikhānvitam ।। paritaḥ krośamānaṃ ca vahnikuṇḍaṃ prakīrttitam ।। 3 ।। mahacchabdaṃ prakurvadbhiḥ pāpibhiḥ paripūritam ।। rakṣitaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiścāpi santatam ।। 4 ।। prataptodakapūrṇaṃ ca hiṃsrajantusamanvitam ।। mahāghorāndhakāraṃ ca pāpisaṃghena saṃkulam ।। 9 ।। prakurvatā kākuśabdaṃ prahārairvarṇitena ca।। krośārddhamānaṃ maddūtastāḍitena ca rakṣitam ।। 6 ।। tattakṣārodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ nakraiśca pariveṣṭitam ।। saṅkulaṃ pāpibhiścaiva krośamānaṃ bhayānakam ।। 7 ।। trāhīti śabdaṃ kurvadbhirmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। pracaladbhiranāhāraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaiḥ ।। 8 ।। viṇmūtraireva pūrṇaṃ ca krośamānaṃ ca kutsitam ।। atidurgandhisaṃyuktaṃ vyāptaṃ pāpibhireva ca ।। 9 ।। tāḍitairmama dūtaiścāpyanāhārairupadravaiḥ ।। rakṣeti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistatkīṭaireva bhakṣitam।। ।। 10 ।। taptamūtradravaiḥ pūrṇaṃ mūtrakīṭaiśca saṃkulam ।। yuktaṃ mahāpāpibhiśca tatkīṭairdaṃśitaṃ sadā ।। 11 ।। gavyūtimānaṃ dhvāntāktaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam।। maddūtaistāḍitairghoraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaiḥ ।।12।। ślaiṣmapūrṇaṃ krośamitaṃ veṣṭitaṃ ceṣṭitaiḥ sadā ।। tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca tatkīṭairbhakṣitaiḥ sadā ।। 13 ।। krośārddhaṃ garapūrṇaṃ ca garabhojibhiranvitam ।। garakīṭairbhakṣitaiśca pāpibhiḥ pūrṇameva ca।। 14।। tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca śabdakṛdbhiśca kampitaiḥ ।। sarpākārairvajradaṃṣṭraiḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ।।15।। netrayormalapūrṇaṃ ca krośārddhaṃ kīṭasaṃyutam ।। pāpibhiḥ saṃkulaṃ śaśvaddravadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ ।। 16 ।। vasārasena pūrṇaṃ ca krośaturyyaṃ sudussaham ।। tadbhojibhiḥ pātakibhirvyāptaṃ dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।।17।। śukrapūrṇaṃ krośaturyyaṃ śukrakīṭaiśca bhakṣitaiḥ ।। krandadbhiḥ pāpibhiḥ śaśvatsaṃkulaṃ vyākulairbhiyā।। ।। 18 ।। durgandhiraktapūrṇaṃ ca vāpīmānaṃ gabhīrakam ।। tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca saṃkulaṃ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ ।। 19 ।। pūrṇaṃ netrāśrubhirnṛṇāṃ vāpyarddhaṃ pāpibhiryutam ।। tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca tadbhakṣyaiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ ।। 20 ।। nṛṇāṃ gātramalaiḥ pūrṇaṃ tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca vyagraiśca kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ।।21।। karṇaviṭparipūrṇaṃ ca tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। vāpīturyyapramāṇaṃ ca rudadbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitai।।22।। majjāpūrṇaṃ narāṇāṃ ca mahādurgandhisaṃyutam ।। mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ vāpīturyyapramāṇakam ।। 23 ।। paripūrṇaṃ snigdhamāṃsairmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ।। pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ caiva vāpīmānaṃ bhayānakam ।। 24 ।। kanyāvikrayibhiścaiva tadbhakṣyaiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ ।। trāhīti śabdaṃ kurvadbhistrāsitaiśca bhayānakam ।। 25 ।। vāpīturyyapramāṇaṃ ca nakhādikacatuṣṭayam ।। pāpibhiḥ saṃkulaṃ śaśvanmama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 26 ।। prataptatāmrakuṃḍaṃ ca tāmraparyyunmukhānvitam ।। tāmrāṇāṃ pratimālakṣaiḥ prataptairāvṛtaṃ sadā ।। 27 ।। pratyekaṃ pratimāśliṣṭai rudadbhiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। gavyūtimānaṃ vistīrṇaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 28 ।। prataptalohadhāraṃ ca jvaladaṅgārasaṃyutam ।। lohānāṃ pratimālakṣaiḥ prataptairāvṛtaṃ sadā ।। 29 ।। pratyekaṃ sarvasaṃśliṣṭaiḥ śaśvadvicalitairbhiyā ।। rakṣa rakṣeti śabdaṃ ca kurvadbhirdūtatāḍitaiḥ ।। 30 ।। mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam ।। bhayānakaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ lauhakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 31 ।। dharmakuṇḍaṃ taptasurākuṇḍaṃ vāpyarddhameva ca ।। tadbhojibhiḥ pāpibhiśca vyāptaṃ maddūtatāḍitaiḥ ।।32।। adhaḥ śālmalivṛkṣasya tīkṣṇakaṇṭakakuṇḍakam ।। lakṣapauruṣamānaṃ ca krośamānaṃ ca duḥkhadam ।। 33 ।। dhanurmāne kaṇṭakaiśca sutīkṣṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitam ।। 34 ।। pratyekaṃ kaṃṭakairviddhaṃ mahāpātakibhiryutam ।। vṛkṣāgrānnipatadbhiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 35 ।। jalaṃ dehīti śabdaṃ ca kurvadbhiḥ śuṣkatālukaiḥ ।। mahābhayā'tivyagraiśca daṇḍasaṃbhinnamastakaiḥ ।। pracaladbhiryathā taptataile jīvibhireva ca ।।36।। viṣaughaistakṣakādīnāṃ pūrṇaṃ ca krośamānakam।। tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 37 ।। prataptatailapūrṇaṃ ca kīṭādiparivarjitam ।। tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ snigdhagātraiśca veṣṭitaiḥ ।। 38 ।। kākuśabdaṃ prakurvadbhiścaladbhirdūtatāḍitaiḥ ।। mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam ।। 39 ।। śastrakuṇḍaṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ krośamānaṃ bhayānakam ।। śūlākāraiḥ sutīkṣṇāgrairlauhaśastraiśca veṣṭitam ।। 40 ।। śastratalpasvarūpaṃ ca krośaturyyapramāṇakam ।। pātakibhirveṣṭitaṃ ca kuntaviddhaiśca veṣṭitam ।। 41 ।। tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālakaiḥ ।। kīṭaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānaiśca sarpayānairbhayaṅkaraiḥ ।।42।। tīkṣṇadantaiśca vikṛtairvyāptaṃ dhvāntayutaṃ sati ।। mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ bhītairvā kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ ।। rudadbhiḥ krośamānaṃ ca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 43 ।। atidurgandhisaṃyuktaṃ krośārddhaṃ pūyasaṃyutam ।। tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 44 ।। dvigavyūti pramāṇaṃ ca himatoyaprapūritam ।। tālavṛkṣapramāṇaiśca sarpakoṭibhirāvṛtam ।। 49' ।। sarpaveṣṭitagātraiśca pāpibhiḥ sarpabhakṣitaiḥ ।। saṃkulaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 46 ।। kuṇḍatrayaṃ maśādīnāṃ pūrṇaṃ ca maśakādibhiḥ ।। sarvaṃ kośārddhamānaṃ ca mahāpātakibhiryutam ।। 47 ।। hastapādādibhirbaddhaiḥ kṣatraiḥ kṣatajalauhitaiḥ ।। hāheti śabdaṃ kurvadbhiḥ pracaladbhiśca santatam।।48।। vajravṛścikayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ tābhyāṃ ca paripūritam ।। vāpyarddhaṃ pāpibhiryuktaṃ vajravṛścikadaṃśitaiḥ ।। 49 ।। kuṇḍatrayaṃ śarādīnāṃ taireva paripūritam ।। tairviddhaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ vāpyarddhaṃ raktalohitaiḥ ।। 50।। taptapaṅkodakaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sadhvāntaṃ golakuṇḍakam ।। kīṭaiḥ saṃpīḍyamānaiśca bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। 51 ।। vāpyarddhaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca jalasthairnakrakoṭibhiḥ ।। dāruṇairvikṛtākārairbhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। 52 ।। viṇmūtraśleṣmabhakṣyaiśca saṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ ।। kākaiśca vikṛtākārairdhanurlakṣaṃ ca pāpibhiḥ ।। 53 ।। sañcālavājayoḥ kuṇḍaṃ tābhyāṃ ca paripūritam ।। bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam ।। 54 ।। dhanuḥśataṃ vajrayuktaṃ pāpibhiḥ saṅkulaṃ sadā ।। śabdakṛdbhirvajradagdhairantardhvāntamayaṃ sadā।। ।। 55 ।। vāpīdviguṇayānaṃ ca taptaprastaranirmitam ।। jvaladaṅgārasadṛśaṃ caladbhiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। 56 ।। kṣuradhāropamaistīkṣṇaiḥ pāṣāṇe rnirmitaṃ param ।। mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ kṣataṃ kṣatajalohitaiḥ ।। 57 ।। durgandhilālāpūrṇaṃ ca tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। krośamānaṃ gabhīraṃ ca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।।58।। taptatoye'ñjanākāraiḥ paripūrṇaṃ dhanuśśatam ।। caladbhiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ mama dūtena tāḍitaiḥ।।59।। pūrṇaṃ cūrṇadravaiḥ krośamānaṃ pāpibhiranvitam ।। tadbhojibhiḥ pradagdhaiśca mama dūtaiśca tāḍitaiḥ ।। 60 ।। kuṇḍaṃ kulālacakrābhaṃ ghūrṇyamānaṃ ca santatam ।। sutīkṣṇaṣoḍaśāraṃ ca ghūrṇitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। 61 ।। atīva vakraṃ nimnaṃ ca dvigavyūtipramāṇakam ।। kandarākāranirmāṇaṃ taptodakasamanvitam ।।62।। mahāpātakibhiryuktaṃ bhakṣitairjalajantubhiḥ ।। pracaladbhiḥ śabdakṛdbhirdhvāntayuktaṃ bhayānakam ।। 63 ।। koṭibhirvikṛtākāraiḥ kacchapaiśca sudāruṇaiḥ ।। jalasthaiḥ saṃyutaṃ taiśca bhakṣitaiḥ pāpibhiryutam।।64।। jvālākalāpaistejobhinirmitaṃ krośamānakam ।। śabdakṛdbhiḥ pāpibhiśca caladbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ sadā ।। 65 ।। krośamānaṃ gabhīraṃ ca taptabhasmabhiranvitam ।। śaśvaccaladbhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ pāpibhirbhasmabhakṣitaiḥ ।। 66 ।। taptapāṣāṇaloṣṭānāṃ samūhaiḥ paripūritam ।। prāṇibhirdagdhagātraiśca yuktaṃ vai śuṣkatālukaiḥ ।। 67 ।। krośamānaṃ dhvāntamayaṃ gabhīramatidāruṇaiḥ ।। tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca dagdhakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 68 ।। apyūrmiyuktatoyaṃ ca prataptakṣārasaṃyutam ।। nānāprakāra vikṛtaṃ jalajantusamanvitam ।। 69 ।। dvigavyūtipramāṇaṃ ca gabhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyutam ।। tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ daṃśitairjalajantubhiḥ।। 70।। caladbhiḥ krandamānaiśca na paśyadbhiḥ parasparam ।। uttaptasūrmikuṇḍaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ ca bhayānakam ।। 71 ।। asipatravanasyaivāpyuccaistāla taroradhaḥ ।। krośārddhamānakuṇḍaṃ ca patatpatrasamanvitam ।। 72 ।। pāpināṃ raktapūrṇaṃ ca vṛkṣāgrātpatatāṃ param ।। paritrāhīti śabdaṃ ca kurvatāmasatāmapi ।। 73 ।। gabhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyuktaṃ raktakīṭasamanvitam ।। tadasīpatrakuṇḍaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ ca bhayānakam ।। 74 ।। dhanuśśatapramāṇaṃ ca kṣurākārāstrasaṃkulam।। pāpināṃ raktapūrṇaṃ ca kṣuradhāraṃ bhayānakam।।75।। sūcīvāśyāstrasaṃyuktaṃ pāpiraktaughapūritam।। pañcāśaddhanurāyāmaṃ kleśadaṃ sūcīkāmukham ।। 76 ।। godhāhvajantubhedasya mukhākṛti bhayānakam ।। kūparūpaṃ gabhīraṃ ca dhanurviṃśatimānakam ।। 77 ।। mahāpātakinā caiva mahākleśakaraṃ param ।। tatkīṭabhakṣitānāṃ ca namrāsyānāṃ ca santatam ।। 78 ।। kuṇḍaṃ naramukhākāraṃ dhanuṣṣoḍaśamānakam ।। gabhīraṃ kūparūpaṃ ca pāpiṣṭhaiḥ saṃkulaṃ sadā ।। 79 ।। gajendrāṇāṃ samūhena vyāptaṃ kuṇḍākṛti sthalam।। gajadantahatānāṃ ca pāpināṃ raktapūritam ।। 80 ।। tatkīṭabhakṣitānāṃ ca dīnaśabdakṛtāṃ sadā ।। dhanuśśatapramāṇaṃ ca kīrttitaṃ gajadaṃśanam ।। 81 ।। dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ vai gomukhākṛti ।। pāpināṃ duḥkhadaṃ caiva gomukhaṃ parikīrttitam ।। 82 ।। bhramitaṃ kālacakreṇa santataṃ ca bhayānakam ।। kumbhākāraṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ dvigavyūtipramāṇakam ।। 83 ।। lakṣamānavamānaṃ ca gabhīramativistṛtam ।। kutracittaptatailaṃ ca kuṇḍābhyantaramantike ।।84।। kutracittaptalauhādikuṇḍaṃ tāmrādikaṃ tathā ।। kutracittaptapāṣāṇakuṇḍābhyantaramantike ।। 85 ।। pāpināṃ ca pradhānaiśca mahāpātakibhiryutam ।। parasparaṃ na paśyadbhiḥ śabdakṛdbhiśca santatam ।। 86 ।। tāḍitairmama dūtaiśca daṇḍaiśca musalaistathā ।। 87 ।। ghūrṇamānaṃ patadbhiśca mūrcchitaiśca muhurmuhuḥ ।। pātitairmama dūtaiścāpyatyūrdhvātpatitaiḥ kṣaṇam ।। 88 ।। yāvantaḥ pāpinaḥ santi sarvakuṇḍeṣu sundari ।। caturguṇāḥ santi tatra kumbhīpāke ca dustare ।। 89 ।। suciraṃ patitāścaiva bhogadehavivarjitāḥ ।। sarvakuṇḍapradhānaṃ ca kumbhīpākaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 90 ।। kālanirmitasūtreṇa nibaddhā yatra pāpinaḥ ।। utthāpitāśca maddūtaiḥ kṣaṇameva nimajjitāḥ ।। 91 ।। niśvāsabandhāḥ suciraṃ kuṇḍānāmantare tathā ।। atīvakleśayuktāśca bhogadehā anaśvarāḥ ।। 92 ।। daṇḍena musalenaiva mama dūtaiśca tāḍitāḥ ।। prataptatoyayuktaṃ ca kālasūtraṃ prakīrtitam ।। 93 ।। avaṭaḥ kūpabhedaśca yatrodaṃ ca tadākṛti ।। prataptatoyapūrṇaṃ ca dhanurviṃśatpramāṇakam ।। 94 ।। vyāptaṃ mahāpāpibhiśca dagdhagātraiśca santatam ।। maddūtaistāḍitaiḥ śaśvadavaṭodaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 95 ।। yattoyasparśamātreṇa sarva vyādhiśca pāpinām ।। bhavedakasmātpatatāṃ yatra kuṇḍe dhanuśśate ।। 96 ।। sarve ruddhāḥ pāpinaśca vyathante yatra santatam ।। hāheti śabdaṃ kurvantastadevāruntudaṃ viduḥ ।।।97।। taptapāṃsubhirākīrṇaṃ jvaladbhistu sudagdhakaiḥ ।। tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ pāṃsubhojaṃ dhanuśśatam ।।98।। patatāṃ pāpināṃ yatra bhavedeva prakampanam ।। pātamātreṇa pāpī vai bhavetpāśena veṣṭitaḥ ।। 99 ।। krośamāne ca kuṇḍe vai vidustatpāśaveṣṭanam ।। dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca śūlaprotaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 100 ।। pātamātreṇa pāpī ca śūlena grathito bhavet ।। patatāṃ pāpināṃ yatra bhavedeva prakampanam ।। 101 ।। atīva himatoye ca krośārddhaṃ ca prakampanam ।। dadatyeva hi maddūtā yatrolkāḥ pāpināṃ mukhe ।। 102 ।। dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca tadulkābhiśca saṃkulam ।। lakṣamānavamānaṃ ca gabhīraṃ ca dhanuśśatam ।। 103 ।। nānāprakārakrimibhiḥ saṃyuktaṃ ca bhayānakaiḥ ।। atyandhakārakhyāptaṃ yatkūpākāraṃ ca varttulam ।। 104 ।। tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiryuktaṃ na paśyadbhiḥ parasparam।। taptatoyapradagdhaiśca caladbhiḥ kīṭabhakṣitaiḥ ।। dhvāntena cakṣuṣā cāndhairandhakūpaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 105 ।। nānāprakāraśastraughairyatra viddhāśca pāpinaḥ ।। dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca vedhanaṃ tatprakīrtitam ।। 106 ।। daṇḍena tāḍitā yatra mama dūtaiśca pāpinaḥ ।। dhanuḥṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca tatkuṇḍaṃ daṇḍatāḍanam ।। 107 ।। nibaddhāśca mahājālairyathā mīnāśca pāpinaḥ ।। dhanustriṃśatpramāṇaṃ ca jālabaddhaprakīrtitam ।। 108 ।। patatāṃ pāpināṃ kuṇḍe dehāścūrṇībhavanti ca ।। lauhavedinibaddhāntaḥ koṭimānavamānakam ।।109।। gabhīraṃ dhvāntayuktaṃ ca dhanurviṃśatimānakam ।। mūrcchitānāṃ jaḍānāṃ taddehacūrṇaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 110 ।। dalitāḥ pāpino yatra maddūtairmusalaiḥ sadā ।। dhanuṣṣoḍaśamānaṃ ca tatkuṇḍaṃ dalanaṃ smṛta m ।। 111 ।। pātamātre yatra pāpī śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। vālukāsu ca taptāsu dhanustriṃśatpramāṇakam ।। 112 ।। śatamānavamānaṃ ca gabhīraṃ dhvāntasaṃyutam।। jalāhārairvirahitaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam।।113।। nānācarmakaṣāyodaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ dhanuḥśatam।। durgandhiyuktaṃ tadbhakṣyaiḥ pāpibhiḥ saṃkulaṃ mahat ।।114।। śūrpākāramukhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dhanurdvādaśamānakam।। taptalauhīvālukābhiḥ pūrṇaṃ pātakibhiryutam।।115।। antarā 'gniśikhānāṃ ca jvālāvyāttamukhaṃ sadā ।। dhanurviṃśatimānaṃ ca yasya kuṇḍasya sundari ।। 116 ।। jvālābhirdagdhagātraiśca pāpibhirvyāptameva yat ।। tanmahatkleśadaṃ śaśvatkuṇḍaṃ jvālāmukhaṃ smṛtam ।। 117 ।। pātamātrādyatra pāpī mūrchito vyathito bhavet।। tapteṣṭakābhyantaritaṃ vāpyarddhaṃ jihmakuṇḍakam ।। 118 ।। dhūmāndhakārayuktaṃ ca dhūmāndhaiḥ pāpibhiryutam ।। dhanuḥśataṃ śvāsabaddhairdhūmāndhaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 119 ।। pātamātrādyatra pāpī nāgaissaṃveṣṭito bhavet ।। dhanuḥśataṃ nāgapūrṇaṃ nāgaveṣṭanakuṇḍakam ।। 120 ।। ṣaḍaśītiśca kuṇḍāni mayoktāni niśāmaya ।। lakṣaṇaṃ cāpi teṣāṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 121 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne yamalokasthanarakakuṇḍalakṣaṇaprakathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 33 ।।
<2.34> sāvitryuvāca ।। haribhaktiṃ dehi mahyaṃ sārabhūtāṃ sudurlabhām ।। tvattaḥ sarvaṃ śrutaṃ deva nāvaśiṣṭo'dhunā mama ।। 1 ।। kiṃcitkathaya me dharmaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaguṇakīrttagam ।। puṃsāṃ lakṣoddhārabījaṃ narakārṇavatārakam ।। 2 ।। kāraṇaṃ muktikāryāṇāṃ sarvāśubhanivāraṇam ।। dāraṇaṃ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ kṛta pāpaughahārakam ।। 3 ।। muktayaḥ katidhā santi kiṃ vā tāsāṃ ca lakṣaṇam ।। haribhaktermūrtibhedaṃ niṣekasyāpi lakṣaṇam ।। 4 ।। tattvajñānavihīnā ca strījātirvidhinirmitā ।। kiṃ tajjñānaṃ sārabhūtaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 5 ।। sarvadānaṃ hyanaśanaṃ tīrthasnānaṃ vrataṃ tapaḥ
