।। ajñāne jñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 6 ।। pituḥ śataguṇā mātā gauraveṇātiricyate ।। mātuḥ śataguṇaiḥ pūjyo jñānadātā guruḥ prabho ।। 7 ।। yama uvāca ।। pūrvaṃ sarvo varo datto yaste manasi vāñchitaḥ ।। adhunā haribhaktiste vatse bhavatu madvarāt ।। 8 ।। śrotumicchasi kalyāṇi śrīkṛṣṇaguṇakīrttanam ।। vaktṝṇāṃ praśnakartṝṇāṃ śrotṝṇāṃ kulatārakam ।। 9 ।। śeṣo vaktrasahasreṇa nahi yadvaktu mīśvaraḥ ।। mṛtyuñjayo na kṣamaśca vaktuṃ pañcamukhena ca ।। 10 ।। dhātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi ।। brahmā caturmukhenaiva nālaṃ viṣṇuśca sarvavit ।। 11 ।। kārtikeyaḥ ṣaṇmukhena nāpi vaktumalaṃ dhruvam ।। na gaṇeśaḥ samarthaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 12 ।। sārabhūtāśca śāstrāṇāṃ vedāścatvāra eva ca ।। kalāmātraṃ yadgaṇānāṃ na vidanti budhāśca ye ।। 13 ।। sarasvatī ca yatnena nālaṃ yadguṇavarṇane ।। sanatkumāro dharmaśca sanakaśca sanātanaḥ ।।14।। sanandaḥ kapilaḥ sūryyo ye cānye brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।। vicakṣaṇā na yadvaktuṃ ke vā'nye jaḍabuddhayaḥ।।19।। na yadvaktuṃ kṣamāḥ siddhā munīndrā yoginastathā ।। ke vā'nye ca vayaṃ ke vā bhagavadguṇavarṇane।।16।। dhyāyanti yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। atisādhyaṃ svabhaktānāṃ tadanyeṣāṃ sudurlabham ।। 17 ।। kaścitkiṃcidvijānāti tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ mahat ।। atiriktaṃ vijānāti brahmā brahmasutādayaḥ ।। 18 ।। tato'tiriktaṃ jānāti gaṇeśo jñānināṃ guruḥ ।। sarvātiriktaṃ jānāti sarvajñaḥ śambhureva ca ।।19।। tasmai dattaṃ purā jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā।। atīva nirjane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale।। 20।। tatraiva kathitaṃ kiṃcidyadguṇotkīrttanaṃ punaḥ ।। dharmāya kathayāyāsa śivaloke śivaḥ svayam ।। 21 ।। dharmastatkathayāmāsa puṣkare bhāskarāya ca ।। pitā mama yamārādhya gāṃ prāpa tapasā sati ।। 22 ।। pūrvaṃ svaviṣayaṃ cāhaṃ na gṛhṇāmi prayatnataḥ ।। vairāgyayuktastapase gantumicchāmi suvrate ।। 23 ।। tadā māṃ kathayāmāsa pitā tadguṇakīrttanam ।। yathāgamaṃ tadvadāmi nibodhātīva durgamam ।। 24 ।। tadguṇaṃ sa na jānāti tadanyasya ca kā kathā ।। yathā''kāśaṃ na jānāti svāntameva varānane ।। 25 ।। sarvāntarātmā bhagavānsarvakāraṇakāraṇam।। sarveśvaraśca sarvādyaḥ sarvavitsarvarūpadhṛk ।। 26 ।। nityarūpī nityadehī nityānando nirākṛtiḥ ।। niraṃkuśaśca niśśṛṅgo nirguṇaśca nirāśrayaḥ ।। 27 ।। nirliptaḥ sarvasākṣī ca sarvādhāraḥ parātparaḥ ।। prakṛtistadvikārā ca prākṛtāstadvikārajāḥ ।। 28 ।। svayaṃ pumāṃśca prakṛtiḥ svayaṃ ca prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। rūpaṃ vidhatte'rūpaśca bhaktānugrahahetave ।। 29 ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca sundaraṃ sumanoharam ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ gopaveṣakam ।। 30 ।। kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyalīlādhāma manoharam ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmoṣakalocanam ।। 31 ।। śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduśobhāsaṃśobhitānanam ।। amūlyaratnakhacitaratnābharaṇabhūṣitam ।। 32 ।। sasmitaṃ śobhitaṃ śaśvadamūlyā''pītavāsasā ।। paraṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 33 ।। sukhadṛśyaṃ ca śāntaṃ ca rādhākāntamanantakam ।। gopībhirvīkṣyamāṇaṃ ca sasmitābhiḥ samantataḥ ।। 34 ।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam।। vaṃśīṃ kvaṇantaṃ dvibhujaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 35 ।। kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa sundaraṃ vakṣasojjvalam ।। kuṅkumāgarukastūrīcandanārcitavigraham ।। 36 ।। cārucampakamālābjamālatīmālyamaṇḍitam ।। cārucampakaśobhāḍhyacūḍāvaktrimarājitam ।। 37 ।। dhyāyanti caivambhūtaṃ vai bhaktā bhaktipariplutāḥ।। yadbhayājjagatāṃ dhātā vidhatte sṛṣṭimeva ca ।। 38 ।। karoti lekhanaṃ karmānurūpaṃ sarvadehinām ।। tapasāṃ phaladātā ca karmaṇāṃ ca yadājñayā ।। 39 ।। viṣṇuḥ pātā ca sarveṣāṃ yadbhayātpāti santatam ।। kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā sarvaviśveṣu yadbhayāt ।। 40 ।। śivo mṛtyuñjayaścaiva jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।। yajjñānadānātsiddheśo yogīśaḥ sarvavitsvayam ।।41 ।। paramānanda yuktaśca bhaktivairāgyasaṃyutaḥ ।। yatprasādādvāti vātaḥ pravaraḥ śīghragāminām ।। 42 ।। tapanaśca pratapati yadbhayātsantataṃ sati ।। yadājñayā varṣatīndro mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu ।। 43 ।। yadājñayā dahedvahnirjalameva suśītalam ।। diśo rakṣanti dikpālā mahābhītā yadājñayā ।। 44 ।। bhramanti rāśicakrāṇi grahā vai yadbhayena ca ।। bhayātphalanti vṛkṣāśca puṣpantyapi ca yadbhayāt ।। 45 ।। bhayātphalāni pakvāni niṣphalāstaravo bhayāt ।। yadājñayā sthalasthāśca na jīvanti jaleṣu ca ।। 46 ।। tathā sthale jalasthāśca na jīvanti yadājñayā ।। ahaṃ niyamakarttā ca dharmādharmaṃ ca yadbhayāt ।। 47 ।। kālaśca kalayetsarvaṃ bhramatyeva yadājñayā ।। akāle haretkālo mṛtyurvai yadbhayena ca ।। 48 ।। jvaladagnau patantaṃ ca gabhīre ca jalārṇave ।। vṛkṣāgrāttīkṣṇakhaḍge ca sarpādīnāṃ mukheṣu ca।।49।। nānāśastrāstraviddhaṃ ca raṇeṣu viṣameṣu ca ।। puṣpacandanatalpe ca bandhuvargaiśca rakṣitam ।। 50 ।। śayānaṃ tantramantraiśca kāle kālo haredbhayāt ।। dhatte vāyustoyarāśiṃ toyaṃ kūrmaṃ yadājñayā ।। 51 ।। kūrmo'nantaṃ sa ca kṣoṇīṃ samudrānsaptaparvatān ।। sarvāṃścaiva kṣamārūpo nānārūpaṃ bibhartti saḥ ।। 52 ।। yataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni līyante'nte ca tatra vai ।। indrāyuścaiva divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ ।।53।। । aṣṭāviṃśacchakrapāte brahmaṇassyādaharniśam ।। ṣaṣṭyādhike pañcaśate sahasre pañcaviṃśatau ।। 54 ।। yuge narāṇāṃ śakrāyurevaṃ saṃkhyāvido viduḥ ।। evaṃ triṃśaddinairmāso dvābhyāṃ tābhyāmṛtuḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 55 ।। ṛtubhiḥ ṣaḍbhirevābdaṃ śatābdaṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। brahmaṇaśca nipāte vai cakṣurunmīlanaṃ hareḥ ।। 56 ।। cakṣurnimīlane tasya layaṃ prākṛtikaṃ viduḥ ।। pralaye prākṛtāḥ sarve devādyāśca carācarāḥ ।। 57 ।। līnā dhātari dhātā ca śrīkṛṣṇe nābhipaṅkaje ।। viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca vaikuṇṭhe yaścaturbhujaḥ ।। 58 ।। vilīnā vāmapārśve ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। rudrādyā bhairavādyāśca yāvantaśca śivānugāḥ ।। 59 ।। śivādhāre śive līnā jñānānande sanātane ।। jñānādhidevaḥ kṛṣṇasya mahādevasya cātmanaḥ ।। 60 ।। tasya jñāne vilīnaśca babhūvātha kṣaṇaṃ hareḥ ।। durgāyāṃ viṣṇumāyāyāṃ vilīnāḥ sarva śaktayaḥ ।। 61 ।। sā ca kṛṣṇasya buddhau ca buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। nārāyaṇāṃśaḥ skandaśca līno vakṣasi tasya ca ।। 62 ।। śrīkṛṣṇāṃśaśca tadbāhau devādhīśo gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। padmāṃśabhūtā padmāyāṃ sā rādhāyāṃ ca suvrate ।।63।। gopyaścāpi ca tasyāṃ ca sarvā vai devayoṣitaḥ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī sā tasya prāṇeṣu sā sthitā ।।64।। sāvitrī ca sarasvatyāṃ vedaśāstrāṇi yāni ca ।। sthitā vāṇī ca jihvāyāṃ tasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ।। 65 ।। golokasthasya gopāśca vilīnāstasya lomasu ।। tatprāṇeṣu ca sarveṣāṃ prāṇā vātā hutāśanaḥ ।। 66 ।। jaṭharāgnau vilīnaśca jalaṃ tadrasanāgrataḥ।। vaiṣṇavāścaraṇāmbhoje paramānandasaṃyutāḥ ।। 67 ।। sārātsāratarā bhaktirasapīyūṣapāyinaḥ ।। virāṭ kṣudraśca mahati līnaḥ kṛṣṇe mahānvirāṭ ।। 68 ।। yasyaiva lomakūpeṣu viśvāni nikhilāni ca ।। yasya cakṣu nimeṣeṇa mahāṃśca pralayo bhavet ।।69।। cakṣurunmīlane sṛṣṭiryasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ।। yāvannimeṣe sṛṣṭissyāttāvadunmīlane vyayaḥ ।। 70।। brahmaṇaśca śatābdena sṛṣṭistatra layaḥ punaḥ।। brahmasṛṣṭilayānāṃ ca saṃkhyā nāstyeva suvrate ।।71।। yathā bhūrajasāṃ caiva saṃkhyānaṃ ca niśāmaya ।। cakṣurnimeṣe pralayo yasya sarvāntarātmanaḥ ।। 72 ।। unmīlane punaḥ sṛṣṭirbhavedeveśvarecchayā ।। tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ vaktuṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। 73 ।। yathā śrutaṃ tātavaktrāttathoktaṃ ca yathāgamam ।। muktayaśca caturvedairniruktāśca caturvidhāḥ ।। 74 ।। tatpradhānā harerbhaktirmukterapi garīyasī।। sālokyadā harerekā cānyā sārūpyadā parā ।।75।। sāmīpyadā ca nirvāṇadātrī caivamiti smṛtiḥ।। bhaktāstā nahi vāñchanti vinā tatsevanādikam ।। 73 ।। siddhatvamamaratvaṃ ca brahmatvaṃ cāvahelayā ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhibhayaśokādikhaṇḍanam।।77।। dhāraṇaṃ divyarūpasya vidurnirvāṇamokṣadam ।। muktiśca sevārahitā bhaktiḥ sevāvivarddhinī।।78।। bhaktimuktyorayaṃ bhedo niṣeke lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu ।। vidurbudhā niṣekaṃ ca bhogaṃ ca kṛtakarmaṇām ।। 79 ।। tatkhaṇḍanaṃ ca śubhadaṃ paraṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevanam ।। tattvajñānamidaṃ sādhvi sāraṃ vai lokavedayoḥ ।। 80 ।। vighnaghnaṃ śubhadaṃ coktaṃ gaccha vatse yathāsukham ।। ityuktvā sūryyaputraśca jīvayitvā ca tatpatim ।। 81।। tasyai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā gamanaṃ kartumudyataḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā yamaṃ ca gacchantaṃ sāvitrī taṃ praṇamya ca ।। 82 ।। ruroda caraṇe dhṛtvā sadvicchedo'tiduḥkhadaḥ ।। sāvitrīrodanaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamasso'yaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 83 ।। tāmityuvāca santuṣṭastvarodīccāpi nārada ।। 84 ।। yama uvāca ।। lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। ante yāsyasi goloke śrīkṛṣṇabhavanaṃ śubhe ।। 85 ।। gatvā ca svagṛhaṃ bhadre sāvitryāśca vrataṃ kuru ।। ddvisaptavarṣaparyyantaṃ nārīṇāṃ mokṣakāraṇam ।। 86 ।। jyeṣṭhe śuklacaturdaśyāṃ sāvitryāśca vrataṃ śubham।। śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade mahālakṣmyā vrataṃ śubham ।। 87 ।। dvyaṣṭavarṣavrataṃ cedaṃ pratyabdaṃ pakṣameva ca ।। karoti parayā bhaktyā sā yāti ca hareḥ padam ।। 88 ।। pratimaṅgalavāre ca devīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām ।। pratimāsaṃ śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṅgaladāyikām ।।89।। tathā cāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ manasā sarvasiddhidām ।। rādhāṃ rāse ca kārtikyāṃ kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ priyām ।। 90 ।। upoṣya śuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca pratimāse varapradām ।। viṣṇumāyāṃ bhagavatīṃ durgāṃ durgārtināśinīm ।। 91 ।। prakṛtiṃ jagadambāṃ ca patiputravatīṃ satīm ।। pativratāsu śuddhāsu yantreṣu pratimāsu ca ।। 92 ।। yā nārī pūjayedbhaktyā dhanasantānahetave ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śrīhareḥ padam ।। 93 ।। ityuktvā tāṃ dharmarājo jagāma nijamandiram।। gṛhītvā svāminaṃ sā ca sāvitrī ca nijālayam।।94।। sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ ca yathākramam।। anyāṃśca kathayāmāsa bāndhavāṃścaiva nārada ।। 99 ।। sāvitrījanakaḥ putrānsa prāpadvai krameṇa ca ।। śvaśuraścakṣuṣī rājyaṃ sā ca putrānvareṇa ca ।। 96 ।। lakṣavarṣaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। jagāma svāminā sārddhaṃ golokaṃ sā pativratā ।। 97 ।। savituścādhidevī yā mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। sāvitrī cāpi vedānāṃ sāvitrī tena kīrttitā ।। 98 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa sāvitryākhyānamuttamam ।। jīvakarmavipākaṃ ca kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 99 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne sāvitryā yamopadeśasamāptirnāma catustriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 34 ।। iti sāvitryupākhyānam ।।
<2.35> nārada uvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇasyātmanaścaiva nirguṇasya nirākṛteḥ ।। sāvitrīyamasaṃvāde śrutaṃ suvimalaṃ yaśaḥ ।।1।। tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ satyaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi lakṣmyupākhyānamīśvara।।2।। kenādau pūjitā sā'pi kimbhūtā kena vā purā ।। tadguṇotkīrttanaṃ satyaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara।।। ।। 3 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sṛṣṭerādau purā brahmankṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। devī vāmāṃśasaṃbhūtā cāsītsā rāsamaṇḍale ।। 4 ।। atīva sundarī śyāmā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalā ।। yathā dvādaśavarṣīyā ramyā susthirayauvanā ।। 5 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhā sukhadṛśyā manoharā ।। śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduprabhāsaṃśobhitānanā ।। 6 ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāśobhitalocanā ।। sā ca devī dvidhābhūtā sahasaiveśvarecchayā ।। 7 ।। samā rūpeṇa varṇena tejasā vayasā tviṣā ।। yaśasā vāsasā mūrtyā bhūṣūṇena guṇena ca ।। 8 ।। smitena vīkṣaṇenaiva vacasā gamanena ca ।। madhureṇa svareṇaiva nayenānunayena ca ।। 9 ।। tadvāmāṃśā mahālakṣmīrdakṣiṇāṃśā ca rādhikā ।। rādhā''dau varayāmāsa dvibhujaṃ ca parātparam ।। 10 ।। mahālakṣmīśca tatpaścāccakame kamanīyakam ।। kṛṣṇastadgauraveṇaiva dvidhārūpo babhūva ha ।। 11 ।। dakṣiṇāṃśo vai dvibhujo vāmāṃśaśca caturbhujaḥ ।। caturbhujāya dvibhujo mahālakṣmīṃ dadau purā ।। 12 ।। lakṣyate dṛśyate viśvaṃ snigdhadṛṣṭyā yayā'niśam।। devīṣu yā ca mahatī mahālakṣmīśca sā smṛtā ।।13।। dvibhujo rādhikākānto lakṣmīkāntaścaturbhujaḥ।। goloke dvibhujastasthau gopairgopībhirāvṛtaḥ।।14।। caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau padmayā saha ।। sarvāṃśena samau tau dvau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇau parau।।15।। mahālakṣmīśca yogena nānārūpā babhūva sā।। vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīḥ paripūrṇatamā parā।।16।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā ca sarvasaubhāgyasaṃyutā।। premṇā sā vai pradhānā ca sarvāsu ramaṇīṣu ca।।17।। svarge ca svargalakṣmīśca śakrasampatsvarūpiṇī।। pātāleṣu ca martyeṣu rājalakṣmīśca rājasu।।18।। gṛhalakṣmīrgṛheṣveva gṛhiṇī ca kalāṃśayā।। sampatsvarūpā gṛhiṇāṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṃgalā।।19।। gavāṃ prasūḥ sā surabhirdakṣiṇā yajñakāminī।। kṣīrodasindhu kanyā sā śrīrūpā padminīṣu ca।। 20।। śobhārūpā ca candre sā sūryyamaṇḍalamaṇḍitā।। vibhūṣaṇeṣu ratneṣu phaleṣu jalajeṣu ca ।।21।। nṛpeṣu nṛpapatnīṣu divyastrīṣu gṛheṣu ca ।। sarvasasyeṣu vastreṣu sthāne sā saṃskṛte tathā ।। 22 ।। pratimāsu ca devānāṃ maṅgaleṣu ghaṭeṣu ca ।। māṇikyeṣu ca muktāsu mālyeṣu ca manoharā ।।23।। maṇīṃdreṣu ca hāreṣu kṣīraṃ vai candaneṣu ca ।। vṛkṣaśākhāsu ramyāsu navamegheṣu vastuṣu ।। 24 ।। vaikuṇṭhe pūjitā sā''dau devī nārāyaṇena ca ।। dvitīye brahmaṇā bhaktyā tṛtīye śaṅkareṇa ca ।। 25 ।। viṣṇunā pūjitā sā ca kṣīrode bhārate mune ।। svāyambhuvena manunā mānavendraiśca sarvataḥ ।। 26 ।। ṛṣīndraiśca munīndraiśca sadbhiśca gṛhibhirbhavet ।। gandharvādyaiśca nāgādyaiḥ pātāleṣu ca pūjitā ।। 27 ।। śuklāṣṭamyāṃ bhādrapade pūjā vai brahmaṇā kṛtā ।। bhaktyā ca pakṣaparyantaṃ triṣu lokeṣu nārada ।। 28 ।। caitre pauṣe ca bhādre ca puṇye maṅgalavāsare ।। viṣṇunā nirmitā pūjā triṣu lokeṣu bhaktitaḥ ।। 29 ।। varṣānte pauṣasaṃkrāṃtyāṃ medhyāmāvāhya cāṅgaṇe ।। manustāṃ pūjayāmāsa sā bhūtā bhuvanatraye ।। 30 ।। rājñā saṃpūjitā sā vai maṅgalenaiva maṅgalā।। kedāreṇaiva nīlena nalena subalena ca ।। 31 ।। dhruveṇauttānapādena śakreṇa balinā tathā ।। kaśyapena ca dakṣeṇa manunā ca vivasvatā ।। 32 ।। priyavratena candreṇa kubereṇaiva vāyunā ।। yamena vahninā caiva varuṇenaiva pūjitā ।। 33 ।। evaṃ sarvatra sarvaiśca vanditā pūjitā sadā ।। sarvaiśvaryyādhidevī sā sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī ।। 34 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde lakṣmyupākhyāne lakṣmīsvarūpapūjādivarṇanaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 35 ।।
<2.36> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇapriyā sā ca varā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ।। vaikuṇṭhādhiṣṭhātṛdevī mahālakṣmīḥ sanātanī ।। 1 ।। kathaṃ babhūva sā devī pṛthivyāṃ sindhukanyakā ।। kiṃ taddhyānaṃ ca kavacaṃ sarvaṃ pūjāvidhikramam ।। 2 ।। purā kena stutā''dau sā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 3 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। purā durvāsasaḥ śāpādbhraṣṭaśrīkaḥ purandaraḥ।। babhūva devasaṃghaśca martyalokaśca nārada ।।4।। lakṣmīḥ svargādikaṃ tyaktvā ruṣṭā paramaduḥkhitā।। gatvā līnā ca vaikuṇṭhe mahālakṣmyāṃ ca nārada।।5।। tadā śokādyayurdevā duḥkhitā brahmaṇaḥ sabhām ।। brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya yayurvaikuṇṭhameva ca।।6।। vaikuṇṭhe śaraṇā pannā devā nārāyaṇe pare ।। atīva dainyayuktāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ ।। 7 ।। tadā lakṣmīśca kalayā purā nārāyaṇājñayā ।। babhūva sindhukanyā sā śakrasampatsvarūpiṇī ।। 8 ।। tadā mathitvā kṣīrodaṃ devā daityagaṇaiḥ saha ।। saṃprāpuśca varaṃ lakṣmyā dadṛśustāṃ ca tatra hi ।। 9।। surādibhyo varaṃ dattvā vanamālāṃ ca viṣṇave ।। dadau prasannavadanā tuṣṭā kṣīrodaśāyine ।। 10 ।। devāścāpyasurākrāntaṃ rājyaṃ prāpuśca tadvarāt ।। tāṃ saṃpūjya ca saṃstūya sarvatra ca nirāpadaḥ ।।1 1 ।। nārada uvāca ।। kathaṃ śaśāpa durvāsā muniśreṣṭhaḥ purandaram।। kena doṣeṇa vā brahmanbrahmiṣṭhaṃ brahmavitpurā।। 12।। mamanthe kena rūpeṇa jaladhistaiḥ surādibhiḥ।। kena stotreṇa sā devī śakre sākṣādbabhūva ha।।1 3।। ko vā tayośca saṃvādo hyabhavattadvada prabho ।। 14 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। madhupānapramattaśca trailokyādhipatiḥ purā ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra rahasi rambhayā saha kāmukaḥ ।। 15 ।। kṛtvā krīḍāṃ tayā sārddhaṃ kāmukyā hṛtacetanaḥ ।। tasthau tatra mahāraṇye kāmonmathita cetanaḥ ।। 16 ।। kailāsaśikharaṃ yāntaṃ vaikuṇṭhādṛṣipuṅgavam ।। durvāsasaṃ dadarśendro jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 17 ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍasahasraprabhamīśvaram ।। prataptakāñcanābhāsaṃ jaṭābhāramahojjvalam ।। 18 ।। śuklayajñopavītaṃ ca cīraṃ daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍalum ।। mahojjvalaṃ ca tilakaṃ bibhrataṃ candrasannibham ।। 19 ।। samanvitaṃ śiṣyavargairvedavedāṅgapāragaiḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā nanāma śirasā sambhramāttaṃ purandaraḥ ।। 20 ।। śiṣyavargaṃ sa bhaktyā vai tuṣṭāva ca mudānvitaḥ ।। muninā ca saśiṣyeṇa tasmai dattāśśubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 21 ।। viṣṇudattaṃ pārijātapuṣpaṃ ca sumanoharam ।। mṛtyurogajarāśokaharaṃ mokṣakaraṃ dadau ।। 22 ।। śakraḥ puṣpaṃ gṛhītvā ca pramatto rājasampadā ।। bhrameṇa sthāpayāmāsa tatra vai hastimastake ।। 23 ।। hastī tatsparśamātreṇa rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। tejasā vayasā kāntyā viṣṇutulyo babhūva saḥ ।। 24 ।। tyaktvā śakraṃ gajendraścāpyagacchadghorakānanam ।। na śaśāka mahendrastaṃ rakṣituṃ tejasā mune ।। 25 ।। tatpuṣpaṃ tyaktavantaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ munīśvaraḥ ।। taṃ śaśāpa mahātejāḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ।। 26 ।। durvāsā uvāca ।। are śriyā pramattastvaṃ kathaṃ māmavamanyase ।। maddattapuṣpaṃ garveṇa tyaktavānhastimastake ।। 27 ।। viṣṇorniveditaṃ puṣpaṃ naivedyaṃ vā phalaṃ jalam ।। prāptimātreṇa bhoktavyaṃ tyāgena brahmahā janaḥ।।28।। bhraṣṭaśrīrbhraṣṭabuddhiśca bhraṣṭajñāno bhavennaraḥ।। yastyajedviṣṇunevedyaṃ bhāgyenopasthitaṃ śubham।।29।। prāptimātreṇa yo bhuṅkte bhaktyā viṣṇuniveditam।। puṃsāṃ śataṃ samuddhṛtya jīvanmuktaḥ svayaṃ bhavet।। 30।। viṣṇunaivedyabhojī yo nityaṃ tu praṇameddharim।। pūjayetstauti vā bhaktyā sa viṣṇusadṛśo bhavet ।। 31 ।। tatsparśavāyunā sadyastīrthaughaśca viśudhyati ।। tatpādarajasā mūḍha sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।।32।। puṃścalyannamavīrānnaṃ śūdraśrāddhānnameva ca ।। yaddhareranivedyaṃ ca vṛthāmāṃsamabhakṣakam ।।33।। śivaliṅgapradattānnaṃ yadannaṃ śūdrayājinām ।। cikitsakadvijānāṃ ca devalānnaṃ tathaiva ca ।। 34 ।। kanyāvikrayiṇāmannaṃ yadannaṃ yonijīvinām ।। anuṣṇānnaṃ paryuṣitaṃ sarvabhakṣyāvaśeṣi tam ।। 35 ।। śūdrāpatidvijānnaṃ ca vṛṣavāhadvijānnakam ।। adīkṣitadvijānnaṃ ca yadannaṃ śavadāhinām ।। 36 ।। agamyagāmināṃ caiva dvijānāmannameva ca।। mitradruhāṃ kṛtaghnānāmannaṃ viśvāsaghātinām ।। 37।। mithyāsākṣyapradānāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। etatsarvaṃ vi śudhyeta viṣpunaivedyabhakṣaṇāt।।38।। śvapaco viṣṇusevī ca vaṃśānāṃ koṭimuddharet ।। harerabhakto vipraśca svaṃ ca rakṣitumakṣamaḥ ।। 39 ।। ajñānādyadi gṛhṇāti viṣṇornirmālyameva ca ।। saptajanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 40।। jñātvā bhaktyā ca gṛhṇāti viṣṇornaivedyameva ca ।। koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 41 ।। yasmātsaṃsthāpitaṃ puṣpaṃ garvādvai hastimastake ।। tasmādyuṣmānparityajya yātu lakṣmīrhareḥ padam ।। 42 ।। nārāyaṇasya bhakto'haṃ na bibhemīśvaraṃ vidhim ।। kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ jarāṃ caiva kānanyāngaṇayāmi ca ।। 43 ।। kiṃ kariṣyati te tātaḥ kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ ।। bṛhaspatirguruścaiva niśśaṅkasya ca me hareḥ ।। 44 ।। idaṃ puṣpaṃ yasya mūrdhni tasya vai pūjanaṃ puraḥ।। mūrdhni cchinne śivaśiśośchittvedaṃ yojayiṣyati।।42।। iti śrutvā mahendraśca dhṛtvā taccaraṇadvayam।। uccai ruroda śokārttastamuvāca bhayākulaḥ ।। 46 ।। indra uvāca ।। dattaḥ samucitaḥ śāpo mahyaṃ mattāya he prabho ।। hṛtā tvayā cetsampattiḥ kiyajjñānaṃ ca dehi me ।। 47 ।। aiśvaryyaṃ vipadāṃ bījaṃ pracchannajñānakāraṇam ।। muktimārgārgalaṃ dārḍhyāddharibhaktivyapāyakam ।। 48 ।। janmamṛtyujarārogaśokaduḥkhāṃkuraṃ param ।। sampattitimirāndhaśca muktimārgaṃ na paśyati ।। 49 ।। sampanmattaḥ samūḍhaśca surāmattaḥ sacetanaḥ ।। bāndhavairveṣṭitaḥ so'pi bandhudveṣakaro mune ।। 50 ।। sampanmade pramattaśca viṣayāndhaśca vihvalaḥ ।। mahākāmī sāhasikaḥ sattvamārge na paśyati ।।51।। dvividho viṣayāndhaśca rājasastāmasaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। aśāstrajñastāmasaśca śāstrajño rājasaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 52 ।। śāstre ca dvividhaṃ mārgaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ munipuṅgava ।। pravṛttibījamekaṃ ca nivṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ param ।। 53 ।। caranti jīvinaścādau pravṛttau duḥkhavartmani ।। svacchande cāprasanne ca nirnirodhe ca santatam ।। 54 ।। āpātamadhure lobhātkleśe ca sukhamāninaḥ ।। pariṇāmotpattibīje janmamṛtyujarākare ।। 55 ।। anekajanmaparyyantaṃ kṛtvā ca bhramaṇaṃ mudā ।। svakarmavihitāyāṃ ca nānāyonyāṃ krameṇa ca ।।56।। tataḥ kṛṣṇānugrahācca satsaṅgaṃ labhate janaḥ ।। sahasreṣu śateṣveko bhavābdheḥ pārakāraṇam ।। 57 ।। sādhuḥ sattvapradīpena muktimārgaṃ pradarśayet ।। tadā karoti yatnaṃ ca jīvī bandhanakhaṇḍane ।। 58 ।। anekajanmayogena tapasā'naśanena ca ।। tadā labhenmuktimārgaṃ nirvighnaṃ sukhadaṃ param ।। 59 ।। idaṃ śrutaṃ gurorvaktrātprasaṅgāvasareṇa ca ।। nahi pṛṣṭamato'nyacca bhavaduḥkhaughaveṣṭitāḥ ।। 60 ।। adhunā vidhinā datto vipattau jñānasāgaraḥ।। sampadrūpā vipadiyaṃ mama nistārakāriṇī।।61।। jñānasindho dīnabandho mahyaṃ dīnāya sāmpratam ।। dehi kiñcijjñānasāraṃ bhavapāraṃ dayānidhe ।। 62 ।। indrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya jñānināṃ guruḥ ।। jñānaṃ kathitumārebhe hyatituṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 63 ।। durvāsā uvāca ।। aho mahendra māṅgalyamātmānaṃ draṣṭumicchasi ।। āpātato duḥkhabījaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 64 ।। svagarbhayātanānāśapīḍākhaṇḍanakāraṇam ।। duṣpārāsāradurvārasaṃsārārṇavatārakam ।। 65 ।। karmavṛkṣāṅkuracchedakāraṇaṃ sarvatārakam ।। santoṣasantatikaraṃ pravaraṃ sarvavartmanām ।। 66 ।। dānena tapasā vā'pi vratenānaśanādinā ।। karmaṇā svargabhogādi sukhaṃ bhavati jīvinām ।। 67 ।। kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva mūlaṃ saṃchidya yatnataḥ ।। adhunedaṃ mokṣabījaṃ saṃkalpābhāva eva ca ।। 68 ।। yatkarma sāttvikaṃ kuryyādasaṃkalpitameva ca ।। sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ kṛtvā pare brahmaṇi līyate ।। 69 ।। sāṃsārikāṇāmetattu nirvāṇaṃ mocakaṃ viduḥ ।। necchanti vaiṣṇavāstattu sevāvirahakātarāḥ ।। 70 ।। sevāṃ kurvanti te nityaṃ vidhāyottamadehakam ।। goloke vā'pi vaikuṇṭhe tasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ।। 71 ।। harisevādirūpāṃ ca muktimicchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। jīvanmuktāśca te śakra svakuloddhārakāriṇaḥ ।। 72 ।। smaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ viṣṇorarcanaṃ pādasevanam ।। vandanaṃ stavanaṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā naivedyabhakṣaṇam ।। 73 ।। caraṇodakapānaṃ ca tanmaṃtrajapanaṃ param ।। idaṃ nistārabījaṃ ca sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ bhavet ।। 74 ।। idaṃ mṛtyuñjayajñānaṃ dattaṃ mṛtyuñjayena me ।। tacchiṣyo'haṃ ca niśśaṅkastatprasādācca sarvataḥ ।। 75 ।। sa janmadātā sa guruḥ sa ca bandhuḥ satāṃ paraḥ ।। yo dadāti harerbhaktiṃ trailokye ca sudurlabham ।। 76 ।। darśayedanyamārgaṃ ca vinā śrīkṛṣṇasevanam ।। sa ca taṃ nāśayatyeva dhruvaṃ tadvadhabhāgbhavet ।। 77 ।। santataṃ jagatāṃ kṛṣṇanāma maṅgalakāraṇam ।। maṅgalaṃ varddhate nityaṃ na bhavedāyuṣo vyayaḥ ।। 78 ।। tebhyo'pyapaiti kālaśca mṛtyussyādroga eva ca ।। santāpaścaiva śokaśca vainateyādivoragāḥ ।। 79 ।। kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca brāhmaṇaḥ śvapaco'pi vā ।। brahmalokaṃ samullaṃghya yāti golokamuttamam ।। 80 ।। brahmaṇā pūjitaḥ so'pi madhuparkādinā ca yaḥ ।। stutaḥ suraiśca siddhaśca paramānandabhāvanaḥ ।। 81 ।। jñānasāraṃ tapaḥsāraṃ brahmasāraṃ paraṃ śivam ।। śivenoktaṃ yogasāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇapadasevanam ।। 82 ।। brahmādistambaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva kevalam ।। bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 83 ।। atīva sukhadaṃ sāraṃ bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ param ।। siddhiyogapradaṃ caiva dātāraṃ sarvasampadām।। 84 ।। yogināmapi siddhānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca tapasvinām ।। sarveṣāṃ karmabhogo'sti na nārāyaṇasevinām ।। 85 ।। bhasmasācca bhavetpāpaṃ yadupasparśamātrataḥ ।। jvaladagnau pātitaṃ ca yathā śuṣkendhanaṃ tathā ।। 86 ।। tato rogā hi vepante pāpāni ca bhayāni ca ।। dūrataśca palāyante yamadūtāstato bhayāt ।। 87 ।। tāvannibaddhaḥ saṃsāre kārāgāre vidherjanaḥ ।। na yāvatkṛṣṇa mantraṃ ca prāpnoti guruvaktrataḥ ।। 88 ।। kṛtakarmaughabhogākhyanigaḍacchedakāraṇam ।। māyājālocchedakaraṃ māyāpāśanikṛntanam ।।89।। golokamārgasopānaṃ nistāre bījakāraṇam ।। bhaktyaṃkurasvarūpaṃ ca nityaṃ vṛddhamanaśvaram ।। 90 ।। sāraṃ ca sarvatapasāṃ yovānāṃ sādhanaṃ tathā ।। siddhīnāṃ vedapāṭhānāṃ vratādīnāṃ ca niścitam ।। 91 ।। dānānāṃ tīrthaśaucānāṃ yajñādīnāṃ purandara ।। pūjānāmupavāsānāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 92 ।। puṃsāṃ lakṣaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ।। pūrvaṃ paraṃ ca tatsaṃkhyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum ।। 93 ।। sahodaraṃ kalatraṃ ca vaktuṃ śiṣyaṃ ca kiṅkaram ।। samuddharecca śvaśuraṃ śvaśrūṃ kanyāṃ ca tatsutam ।। 94 ।। svātmānaṃ ca satīrthyaṃ ca gurupatnīṃ guroḥ sutam ।। uddharedbalavānbhakto mantragrahaṇamātrataḥ ।। 95 ।। mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। tatsparśapūtastīrthaughaḥ sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। 96 ।। anekajanmaparyyantaṃ dīkṣāhīno bhavennaraḥ ।। tadanyadevamantraṃ ca labhate puṇyaleśataḥ ।। 97 ।। saptajanmasu devānāṃ kṛtvā sevāṃ svakarmataḥ ।। labhate ca ravermantraṃ sākṣiṇaḥ sarvakarmaṇām ।। 98 ।। janmatrayaṃ bhāskaraṃ ca sevitvā mānavaḥ śuciḥ ।। labhedgaṇeśamantraṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param ।। 99 ।। janmatrayaṃ taṃ niṣevya nirvighnaśca bhavennaraḥ ।। vighneśasya prasādena divyajñānaṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 100 ।। tadā jñānapradīpena samālocya mahāmatiḥ ।। ajñānāndhatamaśchittvā mahāmāyāṃ bhajennaraḥ ।। 101 ।। prakṛtiṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ ca durgāṃ durgatināśinīm ।। siddhidāṃ siddhirūpāṃ ca paramāṃ siddhiyoginīm ।। 102 ।। vāṇīrūpāṃ ca padmāṃ ca bhadrāṃ kṛṣṇapriyātmikām ।। nānārūpāṃ tāṃ niṣevya janmanāṃ śatakaṃ naraḥ ।। 103 ।। tatprasādādbhavejjñānī jñānānandaṃ tadā bhajet ।। kṛṣṇaṃ jñānādhidevaṃ ca mahādevaṃ sanātanam ।। 104 ।। śivaṃ śivasvarūpaṃ ca śivadaṃ śivakāraṇam ।। paramānandarūpaṃ ca paramānandadāyinam ।। 105 ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। amaratvapradaṃ caiva dīrghamāyuṣyadaṃ param ।। 106 ।। indratvaṃ ca manutvaṃ ca dātuṃ śaktaṃ ca līlayā ।। rājendratvapradaṃ caiva jñānadaṃ haribhaktidam ।। 107 ।। janmatrayaṃ tamārādhya cāśutoṣaprasādataḥ ।। sarvadasya prasādena śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 108 ।। varadasya vareṇaiva haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। tadā tadbhaktasaṃsargātkṛṣṇamantraṃ labheddhruvam ।। 109 ।। nirmmalajñānadīpena pradīptena ca tattvavit ।। brahmādistambaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva paśyati ।। 110 ।। dayānidheḥ prasādena nirmalajñānamālabhet ।। varadasya vareṇaiva haribhaktiṃ labheddhruvam ।। 111 ।। tadā nirvṛtimāpnoti sārātsārāṃ parātparām ।। yatra dehe labhenmantraṃ taddehāvadhi bhārate ।। 112 ।। tatpāñcabhautikaṃ tyaktvā bibhṛyāddivyarūpakam ।। karoti dāsyaṃ goloke vaikuṇṭhe vā hareḥ pade ।। 113 ।। paramānandasaṃyukto mohādiṣu vivarjitaḥ ।। na vidyate punarjanma punarāgamanaṃ hare ।। 114 ।। punaśca na pibetkṣīraṃ dhṛtvā mātṛstanaṃ param ।। viṣṇumantropāsakānāṃ gaṅgādestīrthasevinām ।। 115 ।। svadharmiṇāṃ ca bhikṣūṇāṃ punarjanma na vidyate ।। tīrthe parityajetpāpaṃ kriyāṃ kṛtvā hariṃ bhajet ।। 116 ।। ayaṃ nirūpito dhātrā svadharmastīrthasevinām ।। tannāmamantraṃ prajapettatsevādiṣu tatparaḥ ।। 117 ।। vratopavāsarata ityukto vai viṣṇusevinām ।। sadanne vā kadanne vā loṣṭe vā kāñcane tathā ।। 118 ।। samā buddhiryasya śaśvatsa saṃnyāsīti kīrtitaḥ ।। daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ raktavastramātraṃ ca dhārayet ।। 119 ।। nityaṃ pravāsī naikatra syātsaṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ ।। śuddhācāradvijānnaṃ ca bhuṅkte lobhādivarjitaḥ ।। 120 ।। kintu kiṃcinna yāceta sa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ ।। na vyāpārī nāśramī ca sarvakarmavivarjitaḥ ।। 121 ।। dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ śaśvatsa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ ।। śaśvanmaunī brahmacārī saṃbhāṣā parivarjitaḥ ।। 122 ।। sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ paśyetsa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ ।। sarvatra samabuddhiśca hiṃsāmāyāvivarjitaḥ ।। 123 ।। krodhāhaṅkārarahitaḥ sa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ ।। ayācitopasthitaṃ ca miṣṭāmiṣṭaṃ ca bhuktavān ।। 124 ।। na yācate bhakṣaṇārthī sa saṃnyāsīti kīrttitaḥ ।। na ca paśyenmukhaṃ strīṇāṃ na tiṣṭhettatsamīpata।।125।। dāravīmapi yoṣāṃ ca na spṛśedyaḥ sa bhikṣukaḥ ।। ayaṃ saṃnyāsināṃ dharma ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 126।। viparyyaye vināśaśca janmayāmyaṃ bhayaṃ bhavet ।। janmaduḥkhaṃ yāmyaduḥkhaṃ jīvināmatidāruṇam ।।127।। surasūkarayonau vā garbhe duḥkhaṃ samaṃ sura ।। yonau vā kṣudrajantūnāṃ paśvādīnāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 128 ।। garbhe smaranti sarve te karmma janma śatodbhavam।। vismarennirgato jīvo garbhādvai viṣṇumāyayā।। svadehaṃ pāti yatnena suro vā kīṭa eva vā।।129।। yonerabhyantare śukre patite puruṣasya ca।। śukraṃ śoṇitayuktaṃ ca sahasā tatkṣaṇaṃ bhavet।। 130।। raktādhike mātṛsamaścetare piturākṛtiḥ।। yugmāhe ca bhavetputraḥ kanyakā tadviparyyaye ।।131।। ravibhaumagurūṇāṃ ca vāre cettadbhavetsutaḥ ।। ayugmāhe taditare vāre vai kanyakā bhavet ।। 132।। prathamaprahare janma yasya so'lpāyureva ca ।। dvitīye madhyamaścaiva tṛtīye tatparo bhavet ।। 133 ।। caturthe cirajīvī syātkṣaṇānāmanurūpakaḥ ।। duḥkhī vā'tha sukhī vā'pi pūrvakarmānurūpataḥ ।। 134 ।। yādṛśe ca kṣaṇe janma prasavastādṛśe bhavet ।। prasūtikṣaṇacarcā ca kurvantyevaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ ।। 135 ।। kalalaṃ tvekarātreṇa pravṛddhaḥ syāddine dine ।। saptame badarākāro māse gaṇḍusamo bhavet ।। 136 ।। māsatraye māṃsapiṇḍo hastapādādivarjitaḥ ।। sarvāvayavasampanno dehī māse ca pañcame ।। 137 ।। bhavettu jīvasaṃcāraḥ ṣaṇmāse sarvatattvavit ।। duḥkhī svalpasthalasthāyī śakunta iva pañjare ।। 138 ।। mātṛjagdhānnapānaṃ ca bhuṅkte'medhyasthale sthitaḥ ।। hāheti śabdaṃ kṛtvā ca cintayedīśvaraṃ param ।। 139 ।। evaṃ ca caturo māsānbhuktvā paramayātanām ।। prerito vāyunā kāle garbhādvai nirgato bhavet ।। 140 ।। digdeśakālāvyutpanno vismṛto viṣṇumāyayā ।। śaśvadviṇmūtrasaṃyuktaḥ śiśuḥ syācchaiśavāvadhi ।। 141 ।। parāyatto'pyakṣamaśca maśakādini vāraṇe ।। kīṭādibhukto duḥkhī ca rauti tatra punaḥ punaḥ ।। 142 ।। stanāndho'pyasamarthaśca yāñcāṃ kartumabhīpsitām ।। na vāṇī nissarettasya paugaṇḍāvadhi susphuṭā।।143।। paugaṇḍe yātanāṃ bhuktvā prāpnute yauvanaṃ punaḥ ।। na smarenmāyayā dehī garbhāderyātanāṃ punaḥ।। ।। 144 ।। āhāramaithunārttaśca nānāmohādiveṣṭitaḥ ।। putraṃ kalatramanugaṃ yatnena paripālayet ।। 145।। evaṃ yāvatsamarthaśca tāvadeva hi pūjitaḥ ।। asamarthaṃ ca manyante bāṃdhavā gojaraṃ yathā ।। 146 ।। yadā'tīva jarāyukto jaḍo'tibadhiro bhavet।। kāsaśvāsādiyuktaśca parāyatto'timūḍhavat ।। 147 ।। tadantare'nutāpaṃ ca kurute santataṃ punaḥ ।। na sevitaṃ harestīrthaṃ satsaṃgaścāpi kāmataḥ ।। 148 ।। punaśca mānavīṃ yoniṃ labhāmi bhārate yadi ।। tadā tīrthaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaje vai kṛṣṇamityaho ।। 149 ।। ityevamādi manasi kurvantaṃ taṃ jaḍaṃ sura ।। gṛhṇāti yamadūtaśca kāle prāpte'tidāruṇaḥ ।। 150 ।। sa paśyedyamadūtaṃ ca pāśahastaṃ ca daṇḍinam ।। atīva koparaktākṣaṃ vikṛtākāramulbaṇam ।। 151 ।। durnivāryyamupāyaiśca baliṣṭhaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram ।। durdṛśyaṃ sarvasiddhijñaṃ sarvādṛṣṭaṃ puraḥ sthitam।। 152 ।। dṛṣṭamātrānmahābhīto viṇmūtraṃ ca samutsṛjet ।। tadā prāṇāṃstyajetsadyo dehaṃ vai pāñcabhautikam ।।153।। aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ gṛhītvā yamakiṅkaraḥ।। vinyasya bhogadehe ca svasthānaṃ prāpayed drutam ।। 154 ।। jīvo gatvā yamaṃ paśyetsarvadharmajñameva ca ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthe ca sasmitaṃ susthiraṃ param ।।155।। dharmādharmavicārajñaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvatomukham ।। viśveṣvekādhikāraṃ ca vidhātrā nirmitaṃ purā ।।156।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadagaṇairdūtaiścāpi trikoṭibhiḥ ।।157।। japantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanāma śuddhasphāṭikamālayā।। dhyāyamānaṃ tatpadābjaṃ pulakāṅkitavigraham ।। 158 ।। sagadgadaṃ sāśrunetraṃ sarvatra samadarśinam।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śaśvatsusthirayauvanam ।।159।। svatejasā prajvalantaṃ sukhadṛśyaṃ vicakṣaṇam ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrābhaṃ citraguptapuraḥsthitam ।। 160 ।। puṇyātmanāṃ śāntarūpaṃ pāpināṃ ca bhayaṅkaram ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇameddehī mahābhītaśca tiṣṭhati ।। 161 ।। citraguptavicāreṇa yeṣāṃ yaducitaṃ phalam ।। śubhāśubhaṃ ca kurute tadeva ravinandanaḥ ।। 162 ।। evaṃ teṣāṃ gatāyāte nivṛttirnāsti jīvinām ।। nivṛttiheturūpaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇapadasevanam ।। ।। 163 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ varaṃ prārthaya vāñchitam ।। sarvaṃ dāsyāmi te vatsa na me'sādhyaṃ ca kiṃcana ।। 164 ।। mahendra uvāca ।। indratvaṃ ca gataṃ bhadraṃ kimaiśvaryye prayojanam ।। kalpavṛkṣa muniśreṣṭha dehi me paramaṃ padam ।। 165 ।। mahendrasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṅgavaḥ ।। tamuvāca vacaḥ satyaṃ vedoktaṃ sārameva ca ।।166।। durvāsā uvāca ।। paraṃ padaṃ viṣayiṇāṃ mahendrātisudurlabham ।। muktiryuṣmadvidhānāṃ ca na laye prākṛte'pi ca ।। 167 ।। āvirbhāvaḥ sṛṣṭividhau tirobhāvo laye'pi ca ।। yathā jāgaraṇaṃ suptirbhavatyeva krameṇa ca ।। 168 ।। yathā bhramati kālaśca tathā viṣayiṇo dhuvam ।। cakranemikrameṇaiva nityameveśvarecchayā ।।169।। palamekaṃ bhavedeva yathā vipalaṣaṣṭibhiḥ ।। ṣaṣṭibhiśca palairdaṇḍo muhūrtto dviguṇāttataḥ।। 170।। triṃśadbhiśca muhūrttaiśca bhavedeva divāniśam।। daśapañca divārātriḥ pakṣamekaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ।। 171 ।। pakṣābhyāṃ śuklakṛṣṇābhyāṃ māsa eva vidhīyate ।। ṛturdvābhyāṃ ca māsābhyāṃ saṃkhyāvidbhi prakīrttitaḥ ।। 172 ।। ṛtutrayeṇāyanaṃ ca tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ca vatsaraḥ ।। triṃśatsahasrādhikaiśca tricatvāriṃśalakṣakaiḥ ।। 173 ।। vatsarairnaramānaiśca yugānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam ।। ṣaṣṭyā'dhike pañcaśate sahasre pañcaviṃśatau ।।174।। yuge narāṇāṃ śakrāyurmanorāyuḥ prakīrttitam ।। diglakṣendranipāte'ṣṭasahasrādhika eva ca।।175।। nipāto brahmaṇastatra bhavetprākṛtiko layaḥ ।। laye prākṛtike vatsa kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 176 ।। cakṣurnimeṣaḥ sṛṣṭiśca punarunmīlane tathā ।। brahmasṛṣṭilayānāṃ ca saṃkhyā nāsti śrutau śrutam ।।177।। yathā pṛthivyā reṇūnāmityūce candraśekharaḥ ।। eteṣāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ nāsti kathitāni ca yāni tu ।। 178।। sṛṣṭisūtrasvarūpaṃ hi cānyadvṛṇu varaṃ sura ।। munīndrasya vacaḥ śrutvā devendro vismito mune ।। 179 ।। ātmanaḥ pūrvamaiśvaryyaṃ varayāmāsa tatra vai ।। tatprāpsyasyacireṇaivetyuktvā sa prayayau gṛham ।। 180 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durvāsomunisurendrasaṃvāde indraṃ prati durvāsaḥśāpādikathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 36 ।।
<2.37> nārada uvāca ।। harerguṇaṃ samākarṇya jñānaṃ prāpya purandaraḥ ।। kiṃ cakāra gṛhaṃ gatvā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।।1।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya guṇaṃ śrutvā vītarāgo babhūva sa ।। vairāgyaṃ varddhayāmāsa tadā brahmandine dine ।। 2 ।। munisthānādgṛhaṃ gatvā sa dadarśāmarāvatīm ।। daityairasurasaṃghaiśca samākīrṇāṃ bhayākulām ।।3।। viṣaṇṇabāndhavāṃ caiva bandhuhīnāṃ ca kutracit ।। pitṛmātṛkalatrādivihīnāmaticañcalām ।। 4 ।। śatrugrastāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tāmagamadvākpatiṃ prati ।। śakro mandākinītīre dadarśa gurumīśvaram ।। 5 ।। dhyāyamānaṃ paraṃ brahma gaṅgātoye sthitaṃ param ।। sūryyābhisaṃmukhaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ vai viśvato mukham ।। 6 ।। sāśrunetraṃ pulakitaṃ paramānandasaṃyutam ।। variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ ceṣṭasevinam ।। 7 ।। śreṣṭhaṃ ca vandhuvargāṇāmatiśreṣṭhaṃ ca māninām ।। jyeṣṭhaṃ ca bandhuvargāṇāṃ neṣṭaṃ ca suravairiṇām ।। 8 ।। dṛṣṭvā guruṃ japantaṃ ca tatra tasthau sureśvaraḥ ।। praharānte guruṃ dṛṣṭvā cotthitaṃ praṇanāma saḥ ।। 9 ।। praṇamya caraṇāmbhoje rurodoccairmuhurmurhuḥ ।। vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaśāpādikaṃ tathā ।। 10।। punarvaro mayā labdho jñānināmapi durlabhām ।। vairigrastāṃ svīyapurīṃ krameṇaiva sureśvaraḥ ।। 11 ।। śiṣyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā satāṃ buddhimatāṃ varaḥ ।। bṛhaspatiruvācedaṃ koparaktāntalocanaḥ ।। 12 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। śrutaṃ sarvaṃ suraśreṣṭha mā rodīrvacanaṃ śṛṇu ।। na kātaro hi nītijño vipattau syātkadācana ।। 13 ।। sampattirvā vipattirvā naśvarā svapnarūpiṇī ।। pūrvasvakarmāyattā ca svayaṃ karttā tayorapi ।। ।। 14 ।। sarveṣāṃ ca bhramatyeva śaśvajjanmani janmani ।। cakranemikrameṇaiva tatra kā paridevanā ।। 15 ।। bhuṅkte hi svakṛtaṃ karma sarvatrāpi ca bhārate ।। śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkiṃcitsvakarmaphalabhukpumān ।। 16 ।। nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi ।। avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ।। 17 ।। ityevamuktaṃ vede ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। sāmni kauthumaśākhāyāṃ saṃbodhya svakulodbhavam ।। ।।18।। janma bhogāvaśeṣe ca sarveṣāṃ kṛtakarmaṇām ।। anurūpaṃ ca teṣāṃ vai bhārate'nyatra caiva hi ।।19।। karmaṇā brahmaśāpaṃ ca karmaṇā ca śubhāśiṣam ।। karmaṇā ca mahālakṣmīṃ labheddainyaṃ ca karmaṇā ।। 20 ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ karma jīvināmanugacchati ।। nahi tyajedvinā bhogāttaṃ chāyeva purandara ।। 21 ।। kālabhede deśabhede pātrabhede ca karmaṇām ।। nyūnatā'dhikatā vā'pi bhavedeva hi karmaṇām ।। ।। 22 ।। vastudāne ca vastūnāṃ samaṃ puṇyaṃ same dine ।। dinabhede koṭiguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā'dhikaṃ tataḥ ।। 23 ।। samadeśe ca vastūnāṃ dāne puṇyaṃ samaṃ vṛṣan ।। deśabhede koṭiguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā'dhikaṃ tataḥ ।। 24 ।। same pātre samaṃ puṇyaṃ vastūnāṃ kartureva ca ।। pātrabhede śataguṇamasaṃkhyaṃ vā tato'dhikam ।। 25 ।। yathā phalanti sasyāni nyūnānyapyadhikāni ca ।। karṣakāṇāṃ kṣetrabhede pātrabhede phalaṃ tathā ।। 26 ।। sāmānyadivase vipre dānaṃ samaphalaṃ bhavet ।। amāyāṃ ravisaṃkrāntyāṃ phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet ।। cāturmāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmanantaphalameva ca ।। 27 ।। grahaṇe śaśinaḥ koṭiguṇaṃ ca phalameva ca ।। sūryyasya grahaṇe cāpi tato daśaguṇaṃ phalam ।। 28 ।। akṣayāyāmakṣayaṃ cāpyasaṃkhyaphalamucyate ।। evamanyatra puṇyāhe phalādhikyaṃ bhavediha ।। 29 ।। yathā dāne tathā snāne jape vai puṇyakarmasu ।। evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ narāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam ।। 30 ।। sāmānyadeśe dānaṃ ca vipre samaphalaṃ bhavet ।। tīrthe devagṛhe caiva phalaṃ śataguṇaṃ smṛtam ।। 31 ।। gaṅgāyāṃ vai koṭiguṇaṃ kṣetre nārāyaṇe'vyayam ।। kurukṣetre badaryyāṃ ca kāśyāṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tathā ।। 32 ।। yathā ca vai koṭiguṇaṃ tathā vai viṣṇumandire ।। kedāre vai lakṣaguṇaṃ haridvāre tathā phalam ।। 33 ।। puṣkare bhāskarakṣetre daśalakṣaguṇaṃ phalam ।। evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ phalādhikyaṃ krameṇa ca ।।34।। sāmānyabrāhmaṇe dānaṃ samameva phalaṃ labhet ।। lakṣaṃ trisandhyaṃ pūte ca paṇḍite ca jitendriye ।।35।। viṣṇumantropāsake ca budhe koṭiguṇaṃ phalam।। evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ phalādhikyaṃ guṇādhikaṃ ।।36।। yathā daṇḍena sūtreṇa śarāveṇa jalena ca ।। kumbhaṃ nirmāti cakreṇa kumbhakāro mṛdā bhuvi।।37।। tathaiva karmasūtreṇa phalaṃ dhātā dadāti ca ।। yasyājñayā sṛṣṭividhau taṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ।। 38 ।। sa vidhātā vidhātuśca pātuḥ pātā jagattraye ।। sraṣṭuḥ sraṣṭā ca saṃharttuḥ saṃharttā kālakālakaḥ ।। 39 ।। mahāvipattau saṃsāre yaḥ smarenmadhusūdanam ।। vipattau tasya sampattirbhavedityāha śaṅkaraḥ ।। 40 ।। ityevamuktvā jīvaśca samāliṅgya sureśvaram ।। dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ ceṣṭaṃ bodhayāmāsa nārada ।। 41 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde bṛhaspatimahendrasaṃvāde mahālakṣmyupākhyāne karmaphalanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।37।।
<2.38> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। hariṃ dhyātvā harirbrahmañjagāma brahmaṇaḥ sabhām।। bṛhaspatiṃ puraskṛtya sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha ।। 1 ।। śīghraṃ gatvā brahmalokaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca kamalodbhavam ।। praṇemurdevatāḥ sarvā guruṇā saha nārada ।।2।। vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa surācāryo vidhiṃ vibhum ।। prahasyovāca tacchrutvā mahendraṃ kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 3 ।। brahmovāca ।। vatsa madvaṃśajāto'si prapautro me vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। bṛhaspateśca śiṣyastvaṃ surāṇāmadhipaḥ svayam ।।4।। mātāmahaste dakṣaśca viṣṇubhaktaḥ pratāpavān ।। kulatrayaṃ yacchuddhaṃ ca kathaṃ so'haṃkṛto bhavet ।। 5 ।। mātā pativratā yasya pitā śuddho jitendriyaḥ ।। mātāmaho mātulaśca kathaṃ so'haṃkṛto bhavet ।। 6 ।। janaḥ paitṛkadoṣeṇa doṣānmātāmahasya ca ।। gurordāṣānnītidoṣairharidveṣī bhaveddhruvam ।। 7 ।। sarvāntarātmā bhagavānsarvadeheṣvavasthitaḥ।। yasya dehātsa prayāti sa śavastatkṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।। 8 ।। mano'hamindriyeśaśca jñānarūpo hi śaṅkaraḥ ।। asravaḥ prakṛtirviṣṇurbuddhirbhagavatī satī ।। 9 ।। nidrādayaḥ śaktayaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ।। ātmanaḥ pratibimbaṃ ca jīvo bhogī śarīrabhṛt ।। 10 ।। ātmanīśe gate dehātsarve yānti sasaṃbhramāt ।। yathā vartmani gacchantaṃ naradevamivānugāḥ ।। 11 ।। ahaṃ śivaśca śeṣaśca viṣṇurdharmo mahānvirāṭ ।। vayaṃ yadaṃśā bhaktāśca tatpuṣpaṃ nyakkṛtaṃ tvayā ।। 12 ।। śivena pūjitaṃ pādapadmaṃ puṣpeṇa yena ca ।। tacca durvāsasā dattaṃ daivenānyakṛtaṃ sura ।। 13 ।। tatpuṣpaṃ mastake yasya kṛṣṇapādābjataścyutam ।। sarveṣāṃ vai surāṇāṃ ca tatpūjā purato bhavet ।।14।। daivena vañcitastvaṃ ca daivaṃ ca balavattaram ।। bhāgyahīnaṃ janaṃ mūḍhaṃ ko vā rakṣitumīśvaraḥ ।। 15 ।। kṛṣṇaṃ na manyate yo hi śrīnāthaṃ sarvavanditam ।। prayāti ruṣṭā taddāsī mahālakṣmīrvihāya tam ।। 16 ।। śatayajñena yā labdhā dīkṣitena tvayā purā ।। sā śrīrgatā 'dhunā kopātkṛṣṇanirmālyavarjanāt ।। 17 ।। adhunā gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ mayā ca guruṇā saha ।। niṣevya tatra śrīnāthaṃ śriyaṃ prāpsyasi tadvarāt ।। 18 ।। ityevamuktvā sa brahmā sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha ।। śīghraṃ jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ yatra śrīśastayā saha ।। 19 ।। tatra gatvā paraṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। dṛṣṭvā tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca prajvalantaṃ svatejasā ।। 20 ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍaśatakoṭisamaprabham ।। śāntaṃ cānādimadhyāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntamanantakam ।। 21 ।। caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaiśca sarasvatyā stutaṃ natam ।। bhaktyā caturbhirvedaiśca gaṅgayā pariṣevitam ।। 22 ।। taṃ praṇemuḥ surāḥ sarve mūrdhnā brahmapurogamāḥ ।। bhaktinamrāḥ sāśrunetrāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam ।। 23 ।। vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa svayaṃ brahmā kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। rurudurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ svādhikāracyutāśca tāḥ।।24।। sa cāpaśyatsuragaṇaṃ vipadgrastaṃ bhayākulam ।। vastrabhūṣaṇaśūnyaṃ ca vāhanādivivarjitam ।।25 ।। śobhāśūnyaṃ hataśrīkaṃ parivārairanāvṛtam ।। uvāca kātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vipannabhayabhañjanaḥ।।26।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। mā bhairbrahmanhe surāśca bhayaṃ kiṃ vo mayi sthite ।। dāsyāmi lakṣmīmacalāṃ paramaiśvaryavarddhinīm।।27।। kiñca madvacanaṃ kiñcicchrūyatāṃ samayocitam ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 28 ।। janāścāsaṃkhyaviśvasthā madadhīnāśca santatam।। yathā tathā'haṃ madbhaktaiḥ parādhīnaḥ svatantrakaḥ ।। 29 ।। yo yo ruṣṭo hi madbhakte matpare hi niraṅkuśaḥ ।। tadgṛhe'haṃ na tiṣṭhāmi padmayā saha niścitam ।। 30 ।। durvāsāḥ śaṅkarāṃśaśca vaiṣṇavo matparāyaṇaḥ ।। tacchāpādāgato'haṃ ca saśrīko vo gṛhādapi ।। 31 ।। yatra śaṅkhadhvanirnāsti tulasī ca śilārcanam ।। na bhojanaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ na padmā tatra tiṣṭhati ।। 32 ।। madbhaktānāṃ ca me nindā yatra yatra bhavetsurāḥ ।। mahāruṣṭā mahālakṣmīstato yāti parābhavāt ।। 33 ।। madbhaktihīno yo mūḍho yo bhuṅkte harivāsare ।। mama janmadine cāpi yāti śrīstadgṛhādapi ।। 34 ।। mannāmavikrayī yaśca vikrīṇāti svakanyakām ।। yatrātithirna bhuṅkte ca matpriyā yāti tadgṛhāt ।। 35 ।। pāpināṃ yo gṛhaṃ yāti śūdraśrāddhānnabhojinām ।। mahāruṣṭā tato yāti mandirātkamalālayā ।। 36 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca bhāgyahīnaśca vāḍavaḥ ।। yāti ruṣṭā tadgṛhācca devī kamalavāsinī ।। 37 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāro yo brāhmaṇo vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। tattoyapānabhītā ca kamalā yāti tadgrahāt ।। 38 ।। vipro yavanasevī ca devalaḥ śūdrayājakaḥ ।। tattoyapānabhītā ca vaiṣṇavī yāti tadgrahāt ।। 39 ।। viśvāsaghātī mitraghno naraghātī kṛtaghnakaḥ ।। agamyāṃ yāti yo vipro madbhāryyā yāti tadgṛhāt ।। 40 ।। aśuddhahṛdayaḥ kūro hiṃsako nindako dvijaḥ ।। brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdrajātaśca yāti devī ca tadgrahāt ।। 41 ।। yo vipraḥ puṃścalīputro mahāpāpī ca tatpatiḥ ।। avīrānnaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte tasmādyāti jagatprasūḥ ।। 42 ।। tṛṇaṃ chinatti nakharaistairvā yo hi likhenmahīm ।। jihmo vā malavāsāśca sā prayāti ca tadgrahāt ।। 43 ।। sūryyodaye ca dvirbhojī divāśāyī ca vāḍavaḥ ।। divāmaithunakārī ca tasmādyāti haripriyā ।। ।। 44 ।। ācārahīno yo vipro yaśca śūdrapratigrahī ।। adīkṣito hi yo mūḍhastasmāllolā prayāti ca ।। 49 ।। snigdhapādaśca nagno vā yaḥ śete jñānadurbalaḥ ।। śaśvaddharmātivācālo yāti vai tadgṛhātsatī ।। 46 ।। śirasnātaśca tailena yo'nyadaṅgamupaspṛśet ।। svāṅge ca vādayedvādyaṃ ramā yāti ca tadgṛhāt ।। 47 ।। vratopavāsahīno yaḥ sandhyāhīno'śucirdvijaḥ ।। viṣṇubhaktivihīno yastasmādyāti haripriyā ।। 48 ।। brāhmaṇaṃ nindayedyo hi tānvai dveṣṭi ca santatam ।। hiṃsākārī dayāhīno yāti sarvaprasūstataḥ ।। 49 ।। yatra tatra harerarcā harerutkīrttanaṃ śubham ।। tatra tiṣṭhati sā devī kamalā sarvamaṅgalā ।। 50 ।। yatra praśaṃsā kṛṣṇasya tadbhaktasya pitāmaha ।। sā ca kṛṣṇapriyā devī tatra tiṣṭhati santatam।।51।। yatra śaṅkhadhvaniḥ śaṅkhaḥ śilā ca tulasīdalam।। tatsevā vandanaṃ dhyānaṃ tatra sā tiṣṭhati svayam ।।52।। śivaliṅgārcanaṃ yatra tasya cotkīrttanaṃ śubham।। durgārcanaṃ tadguṇāśca tatra padmanivāsinī ।।93।। viprāṇāṃ sevanaṃ yatra teṣāṃ vai bhojanaṃ śubham ।। arcanaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tatra padmamukhī satī ।। 54 ।। ityuktvā ca surānsarvānramāmāha ramāpatiḥ ।। kṣīrodasāgare janma labhasva kalayā rame ।। 55 ।। ityuktvā tāṃ jagannātho brahmāṇaṃ punarāha ca ।। mathitvā sāgaraṃ lakṣmīṃ devebhyo dehi padmaja ।। 56 ।। ityuktvā kamalākānto devaścāntaradhānmune ।। devāścireṇa kālena yayuḥ kṣīrodasāgaram ।। 97 ।। manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā kūrmaṃ kṛtvā ca bhājanam ।। rajjuṃ kṛtvā vāsukiṃ ca mamanthuścaiva sāgaram ।। 58 ।। dhanvantariṃ ca pīyūṣamuccaiḥśravasamīpsitam ।। nānāratnaṃ hastiratnaṃ prāpurlakṣmyāśca darśanam ।।59।। vanamālāṃ dadau sā ca kṣīrodaśāyine mune ।। sarveśvarāya ramyāya viṣṇave vaiṣṇavī satī ।। 60।। devaiḥ stutā pūjitā ca brahmaṇā śaṅkareṇa ca ।। dadau dṛṣṭiṃ suragṛhe brahmaśāpavimocikām ।। 61 ।। prāpurdevāḥ svaviṣayaṃ daityairgrastaṃ bhayaṅkaraiḥ।। mahālakṣmīprasādena varadānena nārada ।। 62 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmyupākhyānamuttamam ।। sukhadaṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 63 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde lakṣmyupākhyāne samudramathanaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 38 ।।
<2.39> nārada uvāca ।। harerutkīrttanaṃ bhadraṃ śrutaṃ tajjñānamuttamam ।। īpsitaṃ lakṣmyupākhyānaṃ dhyānaṃ stotrādikaṃ vada ।। 1 ।। hariṇā pūjitā pūrvaṃ tato brahmādibhistathā।। śakreṇa bhraṣṭarājyena sārddhaṃ suragaṇena ca।। dhyānena pūjitā kena vidhinā kena vā purā।। kena stutā vā stotreṇa tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 3 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। snātvā tīrthe purā śakro dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। kṣīrode saṃsthāpya ghaṭaṃ devaṣaṭkamapūjayat ।। 4 ।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ।। etānbhaktyā samabhyarcya puṣpagandhādibhistathā ।। 5 ।। tatrāvāhya mahālakṣmīṃ paramaiśvaryyarūpiṇīm ।। pūjāṃ cakāra deveśo brahmaṇā ca purodhasā ।। 6 ।। puraḥ sthiteṣu muniṣu brāhmaṇeṣu gurau tathā ।। devādiṣu ca deveśe jñānānande śive mune ।। 7 ।। pārijātasya puṣpaṃ ca gṛhītvā candanokṣitam ।। dhyātvā devīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ pūjayāmāsa nārada ।।8।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ yaduktaṃ brahmaṇe purā ।। dhyānena hariṇā tena tannibodha vadāmi te।।9।। sahasradalapadmasya karṇikāvāsinīṃ parām ।। śaratpārvaṇakoṭīnduprabhājuṣṭakarāṃ varām ।। 10 ।। svatejasā prajvalantīṃ sukhadṛśyāṃ manoharām ।। prataptakāñcananibhāṃ śobhāṃ mūrtimatīṃ satīm ।। 11 ।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ śobhitāṃ pītavāsasā ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ramyāṃ susthirayauvanām ।। 12 ।। sarvasampatpradātrīṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ bhaje śubhām ।। dhyānenānena tāṃ dhyātvā copahāraissusaṃyutaḥ ।। 13 ।। sampūjya brahmavākyena copahārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।। dadau bhaktyā vidhānena pratyekaṃ mantrapūrvakam ।।14।। praśaṃsyāni prahṛṣṭāni durlabhāni varāṇi ca।। amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। āsanaṃ ca vicitraṃ ca mahālakṣmi pragṛhyatām ।। 19 ।। śuddhaṃ gaṅgodakamidaṃ sarvavanditamīpsitam ।। pāpedhmavahnirūpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ kamalālaye ।। 16 ।। puṣpacandanadūrvādisaṃyutaṃ jāhnavījalam ।। śaṅkhagarbhasthitaṃ śuddhaṃ gṛhyatāṃ padmavāsini ।। 17 ।। sugandhiyuktatailaṃ ca sugandhāmalakījalam ।। dehasaundaryyabījaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ śrīharipriye ।। 18 ।। vṛkṣaniryāsarūpaṃ ca gandhadravyādisaṃyutam ।। kṛṣṇakānte pavitro vai dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 19 ।। malayācalasaṃbhūtaṃ vṛkṣasāraṃ manoharam ।। sugandhiyuktaṃ sukhadaṃ candanaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 20 ।। jagaccakṣussvarūpaṃ ca dhvāntapradhvaṃsakāraṇam ।। pradīpaṃ śuddharūpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari ।। 21 ।। nānopahārarūpaṃ ca nānārasasamanvitam ।। nānāsvādukaraṃ caiva naivedyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 22 ।। annaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca prāṇarakṣaṇakāraṇam ।। tuṣṭidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ cānnaṃ madhuraṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 23 ।। śālyakṣatasupakvaṃ ca śarkarāgavyasaṃyutam ।। susvādu ramyaṃ padme ca paramānnaṃ pragṛhyatām ।। 24 ।। śarkarāgavyapakvaṃ ca susvādu sumanoharam ।। mayā niveditaṃ lakṣmi svastikaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 25 ।। nānāvidhāni ramyāṇi pakvāni ca phalāni tu ।। svādurasyāni kamale gṛhyantāṃ phaladāni ca ।। 26 ।। surabhistanasambhūtaṃ susvādu sumanoharam ।। martyāmṛtaṃ ca gavyaṃ vai gṛhyatāmacyutapriye ।। 27 ।। susvādurasasaṃyuktamikṣuvṛkṣarasodbhavam ।। agnipakvamapakvaṃ vā guḍaṃ vai devi gṛhyatām ।। 28 ।। yavagodhūmasasyānāṃ cūrṇareṇusamudbhavam ।। supakvaguḍagavyāktaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 29 ।। sasyacūrṇodbhavaṃ pakvaṃ svastikādisamanvitam ।। mayā niveditaṃ devi piṣṭakaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 30 ।। pārthivaṃ vṛkṣabhedaṃ ca vividhairdravyakārakam ।। susvādu rasasaṃyuktamaikṣavaṃ pratigṛhyatām।।31।। śītavāyupradaṃ caiva dāhe ca sukhadaṃ param ।। kamale gṛhyatāṃ cedaṃ vyajanaṃ śvetacāmaram।।32।। tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। jihvājāḍyacchedakaraṃ tāmbūlaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 33 ।। suvāsitaṃ śītalaṃ ca pipāsānāśakāraṇam ।। jagajjīvanarūpaṃ ca jīvanaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 34 ।। dehasaundaryyabījaṃ ca sadā śobhāvivarddhanam ।। kārpāsajaṃ ca kṛmijaṃ vasanaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 35 ।। ratnasvarṇavikāraṃ ca dehasaukhyavivarddhanam ।। śobhādhānaṃ śrīkaraṃ ca bhūṣaṇaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। ।। 36 ।। nānākusumasandarbhaṃ bahuśobhāpradaṃ param ।। suralokapriyaṃ śuddhaṃ mālyaṃ devi pragṛhyatām ।। 37 ।। śuddhidaṃ śuddhirūpaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। gandhavastūdbhavaṃ ramyaṃ gandhaṃ devi pragṛhyatām ।।38।। puṇyatīrthodakaṃ caiva viśuddhaṃ śuddhidaṃ sadā।। gṛhāṇa kṛṣṇakānte tvaṃ ramyamācamanīyakam ।। 39 ।। ratnasāraissaṃgrathitaṃ puṣpacandanasaṃyutam ।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sutalpaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 40 ।। yadyaddravyamapūrvaṃ ca pṛthivyāmasti durlabham ।। devabhūṣāḍhyabhogyaṃ ca taddravyaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 41 ।। dravyāṇyetāni dattvā vai mūlena devapuṃgava ।। mūlaṃ jajāpa bhaktyā ca daśalakṣaṃ vidhānataḥ ।।42।। japena daśalakṣeṇa mantrasiddhirbabhūva ha ।। mantraśca brahmaṇā dattaḥ kalpavṛkṣaśca sarvadā ।। 43 ।। lakṣmīrmāyā kāmavāṇī tataḥ kamalavāsinī ।। svāhānto vaidiko mantrarājo'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥ ।। 44 ।। śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ kamalavāsinyai svāhā ।। kubero'nena mantreṇa sarvaiśvaryamavāptavān ।। rājarājeśvaro dakṣaḥ sāvarṇirmanureva ca ।। 49 ।। maṃgalo'nena mantreṇa saptadvīpavatīpatiḥ।। priyavratottānapādau kedāro nṛpa eva ca।।46।। ete ca siddhā rājendrā mantreṇānena nārada।। siddhe mantre mahālakṣmīrdadau śakrāya darśanam ।। 47 ।। ratnendravyūhakhacitavimānasthā varapradā ।। saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ chādayantī tviṣā ca sā ।। 48 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakārikā ।। 49 ।। bibhratī ratnamālāṃ ca koṭi candrasamaprabhā ।। dṛṣṭvā jagatprasūṃ śāntāṃ tāṃ tuṣṭāva purandaraḥ ।। 50 ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। brahmaṇā ca pradattena stotrarājena saṃyataḥ ।। sarvābhīṣṭapradenaiva vaidikenaiva tatra ca ।। 51 ।। indra uvāca ।। oṃ namaḥ kamalavāsinyai nārāyaṇyai namo namaḥ ।। kṛṣṇapriyāyai sārāyai padmāyai ca namo namaḥ ।। 52 ।। padmapatrekṣaṇāyai ca padmāsyāyai namo namaḥ ।। padmāsanāyai padminyai vaiṣṇavyai ca namo namaḥ ।। 53 ।। sarvasampatsvarūpāyai sarvadātryai namo namaḥ ।। sukhadāyai mokṣadāyai siddhidāyai namo namaḥ ।। 54 ।। haribhaktipradātryai ca harṣadātryai namo namaḥ ।। kṛṣṇavakṣasthitāyai ca kṛṣṇeśāyai namo namaḥ ।। 55 ।। kṛṣṇaśobhāsvarū pāyai ratnāḍhyāyai namo namaḥ ।। sampattyadhiṣṭhātṛdevyai mahādevyai namo namaḥ ।। 56 ।। sasyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca sasyalakṣmyai namo namaḥ ।। namo buddhisvarūpāyai buddhidāyai namo namaḥ ।। 57 ।। vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrlakṣmīḥ kṣīrodasāgare ।। svargalakṣmīrindragehe rājalakṣmīrnṛpālaye ।। 58 ।। gṛhalakṣmīśca gṛhiṇāṃ gehe ca gṛhadevatā ।। surabhissā gavāṃ mātā dakṣiṇā yajñakāminī ।। 59 ।। aditirdevamātā tvaṃ kamalā kamalālaye ।। svāhā tvaṃ ca havirdāne kavyadāne svadhā smṛtā ।। 60 ।। tvaṃ hi viṣṇusvarūpā ca sarvādhārā vasundharā ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā tvaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā।।61।। krodhahiṃsāvarjitā ca varadā ca śubhānanā।। paramārthapradā tvaṃ ca haridāsyapradā parā।।62।। yayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ bhasmībhūtamasārakam ।। jīvanmṛtaṃ ca viśvaṃ ca śavatulyaṃ yayā vinā ।। 63 ।। sarveṣāṃ ca parā tvaṃ hi sarvabāndhavarūpiṇī।। yayā vinā na saṃbhāṣyo bāndhavairbāndhavaḥ sadā।।64।। tvayā hīno bandhuhīnastvayā yuktaḥ sabāndhavaḥ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ tvaṃ ca kāraṇarūpiṇī।।65।। stanandhayānāṃ tvaṃ mātā śiśūnāṃ śaiśave yathā।। tathā tvaṃ sarvadā mātā sarveṣāṃ sarvaviśvataḥ ।।66।। tyaktastano mātṛhīnaḥ sa cejjīvati daivataḥ ।। tvayā hīno janaḥ ko'pi na jīvatyeva niścitam ।। 67 ।। suprasannasvarūpā tvaṃ me prasannā bhavāmbike ।। vairigrahastadviṣayaṃ dehi mahyaṃ sanātani ।। 68 ।। vayaṃ yāvattvayā hīnā bandhuhīnāśca bhikṣukāḥ ।। sarvasaṃpadvihīnāśca tāvadeva haripriye ।।69।। rājyaṃ dehi śriyaṃ dehi balaṃ dehi sureśvari ।। kīrtiṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi putrānmahyaṃ ca dehi vai ।। 70।। kāmaṃ dehi matiṃ dehi bhogāndehi haripriye ।। jñānaṃ dehi ca dharmaṃ ca sarvasaubhāgyamīpsitam ।।71।। sarvādhikāramevaṃ vai prabhāvaṃ ca pratāpakam ।। jayaṃ parākramaṃ yuddhe paramaiśvaryyameva ca।।72।। ityuktvā tu mahendraśca sarvaiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha ।। nanāma sāśrunetro'yaṃ mūrdhnā caiva punaḥ punaḥ ।।73।। brahmā ca śaṃkaraścaiva śeṣo dharmaśca keśavaḥ।। sarve cakruḥ parīhāraṃ surārthe ca punaḥ punaḥ।।74।। devebhyaśca varaṃ dattvā puṣpamālāṃ manoharām।। keśavāya dadau lakṣmīḥ santuṣṭā surasaṃsadi ।। 75 ।। yayurdevāśca santuṣṭāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ ca nārada ।। devī yayau hareḥ kroḍaṃ hṛṣṭā kṣīrodaśāyinaḥ ।।76।। yayatustau svasvagṛhaṃ brahmeśānau ca nārada ।। dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tau ca devebhyaḥ prītipūrvakam ।।77।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। kuberatulyaḥ sa bhavedrājarājeśvaro mahān ।। 78 ।। siddhastotraṃ yadi paṭhetso'pi kalpatarurnaraḥ ।। pañcalakṣa japenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।। 79 ।। siddhiḥstotraṃ yadi paṭhenmāsamekaṃ ca saṃyataḥ ।। mahāsukhī ca rājendro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 80 ।। nārada uvāca ।। puṣpaṃ durvāsasā dattamasti vai yasya mastake ।। tasya sarvā puraḥpūjetyuktaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā prabho ।। 81।। tadeva sthāpitaṃ puṣpaṃ gajendrasyaiva mastake ।। yato janma gaṇeśasya sa ca matto vanaṃ gataḥ ।। 82 ।। mūrdhni cchinne gaṇapateḥ śanerdṛṣṭyā purā mune ।। tatskandhe yojayāmāsa hastimastaṃ hariḥ svayam ।।83।। adhunoktaṃ devaṣaṭkaṃ saṃpūjya ca purandaraḥ ।। pūjayāmāsa lakṣmīṃ ca kṣīrode ca suraiḥ saha ।। 84 ।। aho purāṇavaktṝṇāṃ durbodhaṃ vacanaṃ nṛṇām ।। suvyaktamasya siddhāntaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 85 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। yadā śaśāpa śakraṃ ca durvāsā munipuṃgavaḥ ।। tadā nāstyeva tajjanma pūjākāle babhūva saḥ ।।86।। suciraṃ duḥkhitā devā babhramurbrahmaśāpataḥ।। paścātprāpuśca tāṃ lakṣmīṃ vareṇa ca harermune।।87।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde lakṣmīpūjāvidhānaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।39।। śrīlakṣmyupākhyānaṃ samāptam ।।
<2.40> nārada uvāca।। nārāyaṇa mahābhāga samaścaiva tvayā prabho।। rūpeṇa ca guṇaiścaiva yaśasā tejasā tviṣā।।1।। tvameva jñānināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ siddhānāṃ yogināṃ tathā।। tapasvināṃ munīnāṃ ca paro vedavidāṃ tathā।। mahālakṣmyā upākhyānaṃ vijñātaṃ mahadadbhutam ।।2।। anyatkiñcidupākhyānaṃ nigūḍhaṃ vada sāmpratam।। atīva gopanīyaṃ yadupayuktaṃ ca sarvataḥ।। aprakāśyaṃ purāṇeṣu vedoktaṃ dharmasaṃyutam।।3।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca।। nānāprakāramākhyānamaprakāśyaṃ purāṇataḥ ।। śrutau katividhaṃ gūḍhamāste brahmansudurlabham।। 4 ।। teṣu yatsārabhūtaṃ ca śrotuṃ kiṃvā tvamicchasi ।। tanme brūhi mahābhāga paścādvakṣyāmi tatpunaḥ ।।5।। nārada uvāca ।। svāhā devahavirdāne praśastā sarvakarmasu।। pitṛdāne svadhā śastā dakṣiṇā sarvato varā ।।6।। etāsāṃ caritaṃ janma phalaṃ prādhānyameva ca ।। śrotumicchāmi te vaktrādvada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 7 ।। sautiruvāca ।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṃgavaḥ ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe purāṇoktāṃ purātanīm ।। 8 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sṛṣṭeḥ prathamato devāścāhārārthaṃ yayuḥ purā ।। brahmaloke brahmasabhāmagamyāṃ sumanoharām ।। 9 ।। gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurmune tvāhārahetukam ।। brahmā śrutvā pratijñāya siṣeve śrīhareḥ padam ।। 10 ।। yajñarūpo hi bhagavānkalayā ca babhūva saḥ ।। yajñe yadyaddhavirdānaṃ dattaṃ tebhyaśca vedhasā ।। 11 ।। havirdadati viprāśca bhaktyā ca kṣatriyādayaḥ ।। surā naiva prāpnuvanti taddānaṃ munipuṃgava ।। 12 ।। devā viṣaṇṇāste sarve tatsabhāṃ ca punaryayuḥ ।। gatvā nivedanaṃ cakrurāhārābhāvahetukam ।। 13 ।। brahmā śrutvā tu manasā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। prakṛtiṃ pūjayāmāsa dhyāyanneva tadājñayā।। ।। 14 ।। prakṛtiḥ kalayā caiva sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ।। babhūva dāhikā śaktiragneḥ svāhāsvarūpiṇī ।। 15 ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārttaṇḍa prabhānyakkārakāriṇī ।। atīva sundarī rāmā ramaṇīyā manoharā ।। 16 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugrahakāriṇī ।। uvāceti vidheragre padmayone varaṃ vṛṇu ।। 17 ।। vidhistadvacanaṃ śrutvā sambhramātsamuvāca tām ।। 18 ।। brahmovāca ।। tvamagnerdāhikā śaktirbhava patnī ca sundarī ।। dagdhuṃ na śaktassvahutaṃ hutāśaśca tvayā vinā ।। 19 ।। tvannāmoccāryya mantrānte yaddāsyati havirnaraḥ ।। surebhyastatprāpnuvanti surāḥ sānandapūrvakam ।। 20।। agneḥ sampatsvarūpā ca śrīrūpā ca gṛheśvarī ।। devānāṃ pūjitā śaśvannarādīnāṃ bhavāmbike।। ।। 21 ।। brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā sā viṣaṇṇā babhūva ha ।। tamuvāca svayaṃ devī svābhiprāyaṃ svayambhuvam ।। 22 ।। svāhovāca ।। ahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajiṣyāmi tapasā sucireṇa ca ।। brahmaṃstadanyadyatkiṃcitsvapnavadbhrama eva ca ।।23 ।। vidhātā jagatāṃ tvaṃ ca śambhurmṛtyuñjayaḥ prabhuḥ ।। bibharti śeṣo viśvaṃ ca dharmmaḥ sākṣī ca dehinām ।। 24 ।। sarvādyapūjyo devānāṃ gaṇeṣu ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। prakṛtiḥ sarvasūḥ sarve pūjitā yatprasādataḥ ।।25।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva pūjitā yaṃ niṣevya ca ।। tatpādapadmaṃ brahmaikyabhāvādvai cintayāmyaham ।।26।। padmāsyā pādmamityuktvā padmalābhānusārataḥ ।। jagāma tapase pādme padmādīśasya padmajā ।। 27 ।। tapastepe lakṣavarṣamekapādena pādmajā ।। tadā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 28 ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sundarī ।। mūrchāṃ samprāpa kāmena kāmeśasya ca kāmukī ।। 29 ।। vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ sarvajñastāmuvāca saḥ ।। svakroḍe ca samutthāpya kṣīṇāṃgīṃ tapasā ciram ।। 30 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। vārāhe ca tvamaṃśena mama patnī bhaviṣyasi ।। nāmnā nāgnajitī kanyā kānte nagnajitasya ca ।। 31 ।। adhunā'gnerdāhikā tvaṃ bhava patnī ca bhāvini ।। mantrāṅgarūpā pūtā ca matprasādādbhaviṣyasi ।। 32 ।। vahnistvāṃ bhaktibhāvena sampūjya ca gṛheśvarīm।। ramiṣyate tvayā sārddhaṃ rāmayā ramaṇīyayā ।। 33 ।। ityuktvā'ntardadhe devo devīmāśvāsya nārada ।। tatrājagāma santrasto vahnirbrahmanideśataḥ ।। 34 ।। dhyānaiśca sāmavedoktairdhyātvā tāṃ jagadambikām ।। sampūjya parituṣṭāva pāṇiṃ jagrāha mantrataḥ ।। 35 ।। tadā divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sa reme rāmayā saha ।। atīva nirjane ramye sambhogasukhade sadā ।।36।। babhūva garbhaṃ tasyāśca hutāśasyaiva tejasā ।। taddadhāra ca sā devī divyaṃ dvādaśavatsaram ।। 37 ।। tataḥ suṣāva putrāṃśca ramaṇīyānmanoharān ।। dakṣiṇāgnirgārhapatyāhavanīyānkrameṇa ca ।। ।। 38 ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyādayaḥ ।। svāhāntaṃ mantramuccāryya havirdadati nityaśaḥ ।। 39 ।। svāhāyuktaṃ ca mantraṃ ca yo gṛhṇāti praśastakam ।। sarvasiddhirbhavettasya brahmangrahaṇamātrataḥ ।। 40 ।। viṣahīno yathā sarpo vedahīno yathā dvijaḥ ।। patisevāvihīnā strī vidyāhīno yathā naraḥ ।। 41 ।। phalaśākhāvihīnaśca yathā vṛkṣo hi ninditaḥ ।। svāhāhīnastathā mantro na drutaṃ phaladāyakaḥ ।। 42 ।। parituṣṭā dvijāḥ sarve devāḥ saṃprāpurāhutim ।। svāhāntenaiva mantreṇa saphalaṃ sarvakarma ca ।। 43 ।। ityevaṃ varṇitaṃ sarvaṃ svāhopākhyānamuttamam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ ki bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 44 ।। nārada uvāca ।। svāhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ stotraṃ munīśvara ।। saṃpūjya vahnistuṣṭāva yena tāṃ vada me prabho ।। 45 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ stotraṃ pūjāvidhānakam ।। vadāmi śrūyatāṃ brahmansāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। 46 ।। sarvayajñārambhakāle śālagrāme ghaṭe'thavā ।। svāhāṃ saṃpūjya yatnena yajñaṃ kuryyātphalāptaye ।। 47 ।। svāhāṃ mantrāṅgabhūtāṃ ca mantrasiddhisvarūpiṇīm ।। siddhāṃ ca siddhidāṃ nṛṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāṃ bhaje ।। 48।। iti dhyātvā ca mūlena dattvā pādyādikaṃ naraḥ ।। sarvasiddhiṃ labhetstutvā mūlaṃ stotraṃ mune śṛṇu ।। 49 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ vahnijāyāyai devyai svāhetyanena ca ।। yaḥ pūjayecca tāṃ devīṃ sarveṣṭaṃ labhate dhruvam ।। 50 ।। vahniruvāca ।। svāhā ''dyā prakṛteraṃśā mantratantrāṅgarūpiṇī।। mantrāṇāṃ phaladātrī ca dhātrī ca jagatāṃ satī ।।51।। siddhisvarūpā siddhā ca siddhidā sarvadā nṛṇām ।। hutāśadāhikāśaktistatprāṇādhikarūpiṇī ।। 52 ।। saṃsārasārarūpā ca ghorasaṃsāratāriṇī ।। devajīvanarūpā ca devapoṣaṇakāriṇī ।। 53 ।। ṣoḍaśaitāni nāmāni yaḥ paṭhedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ ।। sarvasiddhirbhavettasya ceha loke paratra ca ।। 54 ।। nāṅgahīno bhavettasya sarvakarmasu śobhanam ।। aputro labhate putramabhāryyo labhate priyām ।। 55 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nārada nārāyaṇasaṃvāde svāhopākhyāne svāhājanmādikathanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 40 ।। iti svāhopākhyānaṃ samāptam।।
<2.41> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi svadhopākhyānamuttamam ।। pitṝṇāṃ vai tṛptikaraṃ śrāddhānāṃ phalavarddhanam ।। 1 ।। sṛṣṭerādau pitṛgaṇānsasarja jagatāṃ vidhiḥ ।। caturo vai mūrttimatastrīṃśca tejassvarūpiṇaḥ ।। 2 ।। sapta dṛṣṭvā pitṛgaṇānsiddhirūpānmanoharān ।। āhāraṃ sasṛje teṣāṃ śrāddhatarpaṇapūrvakam।। 3 ।। snānaṃ tarpaṇaparyyantaṃ śrāddhāntaṃ devapūjanam ।। āhnikaṃ ca trisandhyāntaṃ viprāṇāṃ ca śrutau śrutam ।। 4 ।। nityaṃ na kuryyādyo viprastrisandhyaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam ।। baliṃ vedadhvaniṃ so'pi viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 5 ।। harisevāvihīnaśca śrīhareranivedyabhuk ।। bhasmāntaṃ sūtakaṃ tasya na karmārhaḥ sa nārada ।। 6 ।। brahmā śrāddhādikaṃ sṛṣṭvā jagāma pitṛhetave ।। na prāpnuvanti pitaro dadati brāhmaṇādayaḥ ।। 7 ।। sarve prajagmuḥ kṣudhitā viṣaṇṇā brahmaṇaḥ sabhām ।। sarve nivedanaṃ cakrustameva jagatāṃ vidhim ।। ।। 8 ।। brahmā ca mānasīṃ kanyāṃ sasṛje tāṃ manoharām ।। rūpayauvanasampannāṃ śaraccandrasamaprabhām ।। 9 ।। vidyāvatīṃ guṇavatīmapi rūpavatīṃ satīm ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 10 ।। viśuddhāṃ prakṛteraṃśāṃ sasmitāṃ varadāṃ śubhām ।। svadhābhidhānāṃ sudatīṃ lakṣmīṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutām ।। 11 ।। śatapadmapadanyastapādapadmaṃ ca bibhratīm ।। patnīṃ pitṝṇāṃ padmāsyāṃ padmajāṃ padmalocanām ।। ।। 12 ।। pitṛbhyastāṃ dadau kanyāṃ tuṣṭebhyastuṣṭirūpiṇīm ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ copadeśaṃ cakre vai gopanīyakam ।। 13 ।। svadhāntaṃ mantramuccāryya pitṛbhyo dehi ceti ca ।। krameṇa tena viprāśca pitre dānaṃ daduḥ purā ।। 14 ।। svāhā śastā devadāne pitṛdāne svadhā varā ।। sarvatra dakṣiṇā śastā hato yajñastvadakṣiṇaḥ ।। 15 ।। pitaro devatā viprā munayo mānavāstathā ।। pūjāṃ cakruḥ svadhāṃ śāntāṃ tuṣṭāva paramādaram ।। 16 ।। devādayaśca santuṣṭāḥ paripūrṇamanorathāḥ ।। viprādayaśca pitaraḥ svadhādevīvareṇa ca ।। 17 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ svadhopākhyānamuttamam ।। sarveṣāṃ vai tuṣṭikaraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 18 ।। nārada uvāca ।। svadhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ stotraṃ mahāmune ।। śrotumicchāmi yatnena vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 19 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। taddhyānaṃ stavanaṃ brahmanvedoktaṃ sarvasammatam ।। sarvaṃ jānāsi vakṣye vai jñātumicchasi vṛddhaye ।। 20 ।। śaratkṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ maghāyāṃ śrāddhavāsare ।। svadhāṃ saṃpūjya yatnena tataḥ śrāddhaṃ samācaret ।। 21 ।। svadhāṃ nābhyarcya yo vipraḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryyādahaṃmatiḥ ।। na bhavetphalabhāk satyaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇayostathā ।। 22 ।। brahmaṇo mānasīṃ kanyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ।। pūjyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ śrāddhānāṃ phaladāṃ bhaje ।। 23 ।। iti dhyātvā ghaṭe ramye śālagrāme'thavā śubhe ।। dadyātpādyādikaṃ tasyai mūleneti śrutau śrutam ।। 24 ।। āṃ śrīṃ klīṃ svadhādevyai svāheti ca mahāmanum ।। samuccāryya ca saṃpūjya stutvā tāṃ praṇameddvijaḥ ।। 25 ।। stotraṃ śṛṇu muniśreṣṭha brahmaputra viśārada ।। sarvavāñchāpradaṃ nṝṇāṃ brahmaṇā yatkṛtaṃ purā।।26।। brahmovāca ।। svadhoccāraṇamātreṇa tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ।। mucyate sarvapāpebhyo vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 27 ।। svadhā svadhā svadhetyevaṃ yadi vāratrayaṃ smaret ।। śrāddhasya phalamāpnoti kālatarpaṇayostathā ।। 28 ।। śrāddhakāle svadhāstotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। labhecchrāddhaśatānāṃ ca puṇyameva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 29 ।। svadhā svadhā svadhetyevaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। priyāṃ vinītāṃ sa labhetsādhvīṃ putraṃ guṇānvitam ।। 30।। pitṝṇāṃ prāṇatulyā tvaṃ dvijajīvanarūpiṇī ।। śrāddhādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca śrāddhādīnāṃ phalapradā ।। 31 ।। bahirmanmanaso gaccha pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭihetave ।। saṃprītaye dvijātīnāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ vṛddhihetave ।। ।। 32 ।। nityā nityasvarūpā'si guṇarūpā'si suvrate ।। āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sṛṣṭau ca pralaye tava।। 33 ।। oṃ svasti ca namaḥ svāhā svadhā tvaṃ dakṣiṇā tathā ।। nirūpitāścaturvede ṣaṭ praśastāśca karmiṇām ।। 34 ।। purā''sīstvaṃ svadhā gopī goloke rādhikā sakhī ।। dhṛtā svorasi kṛṣṇena yatastena svadhā smṛtā ।। 35 ।। dhvastā tvaṃ rādhikāśāpādgolokādviśvamāgatā ।। kṛṣṇāśliṣṭā tayā dṛṣṭā purā vṛndāvane vane ।। 36 ।। kṛṣṇāliṃganapuṇyena bhūtā me mānasī sutā ।। atṛptasurate tena caturṇāṃ svāmināṃ priyā ।। ।। 37 ।। svāhā sā sundarī gopī purā''sīdrādhikāsakhī ।। ratau svayaṃ kṛṣṇamāha tena svāhā prakīrttitā ।। 38 ।। kṛṣṇena sārddhaṃ suciraṃ vasante rāsamaṇḍale ।। prayattā surate śliṣṭā dṛṣṭā sā rādhayā purā ।।39।। tasyāḥ śāpena sā dhvastā golokādviśvamāgatā ।। kṛṣṇāliṅganapuṇyena samabhūdvahnikāminī ।। 40 ।। pavitrarūpā paramā devādyairvanditā nṛbhiḥ ।। yannāmoccāraṇenaiva naro mucyeta pātakāt ।। 41 ।। yā suśīlābhidhā gopī purā''sīdrādhikāsakhī ।। uvāsa dakṣiṇe kroḍe kṛṣṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।। 42 ।। pradhvastā sā ca tacchāpādgolokādviśvamāgatā ।। kṛṣṇāliṅganapuṇyena sā babhūva ca dakṣiṇā ।। 43 ।। sā preyasī ratau dakṣā praśastā sarvakarmasu ।। uvāsa dakṣiṇe bharturdakṣiṇā tena kīrttitā ।। 44 ।। gopyā babhūvustisro vai svadhā svāhā ca dakṣiṇā ।। karmiṇāṃ karmapūrṇārthaṃ purā caiveśvarecchayā ।। 49 ।। ityevamuktvā sa brahmā brahmaloke ca saṃsadi ।। tasthau ca sahasā sadyaḥ svadhā sā''virbabhūva ha ।। 46 ।। tadā pitṛbhyaḥ pradadau tāmeva kamalānanām ।। tāṃ saṃprāpya yayuste ca pitaraśca praharṣitāḥ ।। 47 ।। svadhāstotramidaṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu vedapāṭhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 48 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde svadhopākhyāne svadhotpattitatpūjādikathanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 41 ।। iti svadhopākhyānaṃ samāptam।।
<2.42> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। uktaṃ svāhāsvadhākhyānaṃ praśastaṃ madhuraṃ param ।। vakṣyāmi dakṣiṇākhyānaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।।1।। gopī suśīlā goloke purā''sītpreyasī hareḥ ।। rādhāpradhānā sadhrīcī dhanyā mānyā manoharā ।। atīva sundarī rāmā subhagā sudatī satī ।।2।। vidyāvatī guṇavatī satī rūpavatī tathā ।। kalāvatī komalāṃgī kāntā kamalalocanā ।। 3 ।। suśroṇī sustanī śyāmā nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalā ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitā ।। 4 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhā bimboṣṭhī mṛgalocanā ।। kāmaśāstrasuniṣṇātā kāminī kalahaṃsagā ।। 5 ।। bhāvānuraktā bhāvajñā kṛṣṇasya priyabhāminī ।। rasajñā rasikā rāse rāseśasya rasotsukā ।। 6 ।। uvāsa dakṣiṇe kroḍe rādhāyāḥ purataḥ purā ।। saṃbabhūvānamramukho bhayena madhusūdanaḥ ।। 7।। dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ ca purato gopīnāṃ pravarāṃ varām।। māninīṃ raktavadanāṃ raktapaṅkajalocanām ।। 8 ।। kopena kampitāṅgī ca kopanāṃ kopadarśanām ।। kopena niṣṭhuraṃ vaktumudyatāṃ sphuritādharām ।।9।। āgacchantīṃ ca vegena vijñāya tadanantaram।। virodhabhīto bhagavānantarddhānaṃ jagāma saḥ ।। 10 ।। palāyantaṃ ca taṃ śāntaṃ sattvādhāraṃ suvigraham ।। vilokya kampitā gopī suśīlā'ntardadhau bhiyā ।। 11 ।। vilokya saṅkaṭaṃ tatra gopīnāṃ lakṣakoṭayaḥ ।। baddhāñjalipuṭā bhītā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।।12।। rakṣa rakṣetyuktavatyo he devīti punaḥ punaḥ ।। yayurbhayena śaraṇaṃ tasyāścaraṇapaṅkaje ।। ।। 13 ।। trilakṣakoṭayo gopāḥ sudāmādaya eva ca ।। yayurbhayena śaraṇaṃ tatpādābje ca nārada ।। 14 ।। palāyantaṃ ca kāntaṃ vai vijñāya parameśvarī ।। palāyantīṃ sahacarīṃ suśīlāṃ ca śaśāpa sā ।। 15 ।। adyaprabhṛti golokaṃ sā cedāyāti gopikā ।। sadyo gamanamātreṇa bhasmasācca bhaviṣyati ।। 16 ।। ityevamuktvā tatraiva devadevīśvarī ruṣā ।। rāseśvarī rāsamadhye rāseśaṃ cājuhāva ha।। ।। 17 ।। nālokya purataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhā virahakātarā ।। yugakoṭisamaṃ mene kṣaṇabhedena suvratā ।। 18 ।। he kṛṣṇa he prāṇanāthāgaccha prāṇādhikapriya ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdeveha prāṇā yānti tvayā vinā ।। 19 ।। strīgarvaḥ patisaubhāgyādvarddhate ca dine dine ।। sustrī cedvibhavo yasmātte bhajeddharmataḥ sadā ।। 20 ।। patirbandhuḥ kulastrīṇāmadhidevaḥ sadā gatiḥ ।। paraṃ sampatsvarūpaśca sukharūpaśca mūrttimān।। ।। 21 ।। dharmadaḥ sukhadaḥ śaśvatprītidaḥ śāntidaḥ sadā ।। sammānado mānadaśca mānyo vai mānakhaṇḍanaḥ ।। 22 ।। sārātsāratamaḥ svāmī bandhūnāṃ bandhuvarddhanaḥ ।। na ca bharttuḥ samo bandhuḥ sarvabandhuṣu dṛśyate ।।23।। bharaṇādeva bhartā'yaṃ pālanātpatirucyate ।। śarīreśācca sa svāmī kāmadaḥ kānta eva ca ।। 24 ।। bandhuśca sukhabandhācca prītidānātpriyaḥ paraḥ ।। aiśvaryyadānādīśaśca prāṇeśātprāṇanāyakaḥ।।25।। ratidānācca ramaṇaḥ priyo nāsti priyātparaḥ ।। putrastu svāminaḥ śukrājjāyate tena sa priyaḥ।।26।। śataputrātparaḥsvāmī kulajānāṃ priyaḥ sadā।। asatkulaprasūtā yā kāntaṃ vijñātumakṣamā ।।27।। snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣaṇam ।। prādakṣiṇyaṃ pṛthivyāśca sarvāṇi ca tapāṃsi vai।।28।। sarvāṇyeva vratādīni mahādānāni yāni ca।। upoṣaṇāni puṇyāni yānyanyāni ca viśvataḥ।।29।। gurusevāviprasevādevasevādikaṃ ca yat। svāminaḥ pādasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm।। 30।। guruvipreṣṭadeveṣu sarvebhyaśca patirguruḥ।। vidyādātā yathā puṃsāṃ kulajānāṃ tathā priyaḥ।।31।। gopītrilakṣakoṭīnāṃ gopānāṃ ca tathaiva ca।। brahmāṇḍānāmasaṃkhyānāṃ tatrasthānāṃ tathaiva ca ।।32।। ramādigopakāntānāmīśvarī tatprasādataḥ।। ahaṃ na jāne taṃ kāntaṃ strīsvabhāvo duratyayaḥ ।। 33 ।। ityuktvā rādhikā kṛṣṇaṃ tatra dadhyau subhaktitaḥ ।। ārātsaṃprāpa taṃ tena vijahāra ca tatra vai ।। 34 ।। atha sā dakṣiṇādevī dhvastā golokato mune ।। suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā viveśa kamalātanau।।35।। atha devādayaḥ sarve yajñaṃ kṛtvā suduṣkaram ।। na labhante phalaṃ teṣāṃ viṣaṇṇāḥ prayayurvidhim ।।36।। vidhirnivedanaṃ śrutvā devādīnāṃ jagatpatiḥ ।। dadhyau sucintito bhaktyā tatpratyādeśamāpa saḥ ।। 37 ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānmahālakṣmīśca dehataḥ ।। martyalakṣmīṃ viniṣkṛṣya brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।। 38 ।। brahmā dadau tāṃ yajñāya pūrṇārthaṃ karmaṇāṃ satām ।। yajñaḥ saṃpūjya vidhivattāṃ tuṣṭāva ramāṃ mudā ।। 39 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ candrakoṭisamaprabhām ।। atīva kamanīyāṃ ca sundarīṃ sumanoharām ।। 40 ।। kamalāsyāṃ komalāṅgīṃ kamalāyatalocanām ।। kamalāsanasaṃpūjyāṃ kamalāṅgaḥsamudravām ।। 41 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ bimboṣṭhīṃ sudatīṃ satīm ।। bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।। 42 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। suveṣāḍhyāṃ ca susnātāṃ munimānasamohinīm ।। 43 ।। kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhaṃ candanaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ।। sindūrabindunā'tyantaṃ mastakādhasthalojjvalām।।44।। supraśastanitambāḍhyāṃ bṛhacchroṇipayodharām ।। kāmadevādhārarūpāṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām।।45।। tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ramaṇīyāṃ ca yajño mūrcchāmavāpa ha ।। patnīṃ tāmeva jagrāha vidhibodhitamārgataḥ ।। 46 ।। divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ caiva tāṃ gṛhītvā'tha nirjane ।। yajño reme mudā yukto rāmayā ramayā saha ।। 47 ।। garbhaṃ dadhāra sā devī divyaṃ dvādaśavatsaram ।। tataḥ suṣāva putraṃ ca phalaṃ vai sarvakarmaṇām ।।48।। karmaṇāṃ phaladātā ca dakṣiṇā karmaṇāṃ satām ।। paripūrṇe karmaṇi ca tatputraḥ phaladāyakaḥ।।49।। yajño dakṣiṇayā sārddhaṃ putreṇa ca phalena ca ।। karmaṇāṃ phaladātā cetyevaṃ vedavido viduḥ ।। 50 ।। yajñaśca dakṣiṇāṃ prāpya putraṃ ca phaladāyakam ।। phalaṃ dadau ca sarvebhyaḥ karmaṭhebhyo yadā mune ।। 51 ।। tadā devādayastuṣṭāḥ paripūrṇamanorathāḥ ।। svasthānaṃ prayayuḥ sarve dharmavaktrādidaṃ śrutam ।। 52 ।। kṛtvā karma ca kartā tu tūrṇaṃ dadyācca dakṣiṇām ।। tatkṣaṇaṃ phalamāpnoti vedairuktamidaṃ mune ।। 53 ।। kartā karmaṇi pūrṇe'pi tatkṣaṇādyadi dakṣiṇām ।। na dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaśca daivenājñānato'thavā ।। 54 ।। muhūrtte samatīte ca dviguṇā sā bhaveddhruvam ।। 55 ।। ekarātre vyatīte tu bhavedrasaguṇā ca sā ।। trirātre vai daśaguṇā saptāhe dviguṇā tataḥ ।। 56 ।। māse lakṣaguṇā proktā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca varddhate ।। saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sā trikoṭiguṇā bhavet ।। 57 ।। karmma tadyajamānānāṃ sarvaṃ vai niṣphalaṃ bhavet ।। sa ca brahmasvāpahārī na karmārho'śucirnaraḥ ।। 58 ।। daridro vyādhiyuktaśca tena pāpena pātakī ।। tadgṛhādyāti lakṣmīśca śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam ।। 59 ।। pitaro naiva gṛhṇanti taddattaṃ śrāddhatarpaṇam ।। evaṃ surāśca tatpūjāṃ taddattāṃ pāvakāhutim ।। 60 ।। dātā dadāti no dānaṃ grahītā tanna yācate ।। ubhau tau narakaṃ yātaśchinnarajjuryathā ghaṭaḥ ।। 61 ।। nārpayedyajamānaścedyācitāraṃ ca dakṣiṇām ।। bhavedbrahmasvāpahārī kumbhīpākaṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 62 ।। varṣalakṣaṃ vasettatra yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। tato bhavetsa caṇḍālo vyādhiyukto daridrakaḥ ।। 63 ।। pātayetpuruṣānsapta pūrvānvai pūrvajanmanaḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 64 ।। nārada uvāca ।। yatkarma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ ko bhuṅkte tatphalaṃ mune ।। pūjāvidhiṃ dakṣiṇāyāḥ purā yajñakṛtaṃ vada ।। 65 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। karmaṇo'dakṣiṇasyaiva kuta eva phalaṃ mune ।। sadakṣiṇe karmaṇi ca phalameva pravarttate ।। 66 ।। yā yā karmaṇi sāmagrī balirbhuṅkte ca tāṃ mune ।। balaye tatpradattaṃ ca vāmanena purā mune ।। 67 ।। aśrotriyaṃ śrāddhavastu cāśrāddhaṃ dānameva ca ।। vṛṣalīpativiprāṇāṃ pūjādravyādikaṃ ca yat ।।68।। ṛtvijā na kṛtaṃ yajñamaśuceḥ pūjanaṃ ca yat ।। gurāvabhaktasya karma balirbhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ ।। 69 ।। dakṣiṇāyāśca yaddhyānaṃ stotraṃ pūjāvidhikramam ।। tatsarvaṃ kāṇvaśākhoktaṃ pravakṣyāmi niśāmaya ।। 70 ।। purā saṃprāpya tāṃ yajñaḥ karmadakṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇām।। mumoha tasyā rūpeṇa tuṣṭuve kāmakātaraḥ ।। 71 ।। yajña uvāca ।। purā golokagopī tvaṃ gopīnāṃ pravarā parā ।। rādhāsamā tatsakhī ca śrīkṛṣṇapreyasī priye ।। 72 ।। kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu rāse rādhāmahotsave ।। āvirbhūtā dakṣiṇāṃśātkṛṣṇasyāto hi dakṣiṇā ।। 73 ।। purā tvaṃ ca suśīlākhyā śīlena suśubhena ca ।। kṛṣṇadakṣāṃśavāsācca rādhāśāpācca dakṣiṇā ।। 74 ।। golokāttvaṃ paridhvastā mama bhāgyādupasthitā ।। kṛpāṃ kuru tvamevādya svāminaṃ kuru māṃ priye ।। 75 ।। kartṝṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ devī tvameva phaladā sadā ।। tvayā vinā ca sarveṣāṃ sarva karma ca niṣphalam ।। 76 ।। phalaśākhāvihīnaśca yathā vṛkṣo mahītale ।। tvayā vinā tathā karma kartṝṇāṃ ca na śobhate ।। 77 ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca dikpālādaya eva ca ।। karmaṇaśca phalaṃ dātuṃ na śaktāśca tvayā vinā ।। 78 ।। karmarūpī svayaṃ brahmā phalarūpī maheśvaraḥ ।। yajñarūpī viṣṇurahaṃ tvameṣāṃ sārarūpiṇī ।। 79 ।। phaladātā paraṃ brahma nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। svayaṃ kṛṣṇaśca bhagavānna ca śaktastvayā vinā ।। 80 ।। tvameva śaktiḥ kānte me śaśvajjanmani janmani ।। sarvakarmaṇi śakto'haṃ tvayā saha varānane ।। 81 ।। ityuktvā tatpurastasthau yajñādhiṣṭhātṛdevakaḥ ।। tuṣṭā babhūva sā devī bheje taṃ kamalākalā ।। 82 ।। idaṃ ca dakṣiṇāstotraṃ yajñakāle ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। phalaṃ ca sarvayajñānāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 83 ।। rājasūye vājapeye gomedhe naramedhake ।। aśvamedhe lāṃgale ca viṣṇuyajñe yaśaskare ।। 84 ।। dhanade bhūmide phalgau putreṣṭau gajamedhake ।। lohayajñe svarṇayajñe paṭalavyādhikhaṇḍane ।। 85 ।। śivayaje rudrayajñe śakrayajñe ca bandhake ।। iṣṭau varuṇayāge ca kanduke vairimardane ।। 86 ।। śuciyāge dharmayāge recane pāpamocane ।। bandhane karmayāge ca maṇiyāge subhadrake ।। 87 ।। eteṣāṃ ca samārambhe idaṃ stotraṃ ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। nirvighnena ca tatkarma sāṅgaṃ bhavati niścitam ।। 88 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ ca kathitaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhānakam ।। śālagrāme ghaṭe vā'pi dakṣiṇāṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ ।। 89 ।। lakṣmīdakṣāṃśasambhūtāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kamalākalām ।। sarvakarmasu dakṣāṃ ca phaladāṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। 90 ।। viṣṇoḥśaktisvarūpāṃ ca suśīlāṃ śubhadāṃ bhaje ।। dhyātvā'nenaiva varadāṃ sudhīrmūlena pūjayet ।। 91 ।। dattvā pādyādikaṃ devyai vedoktena ca nārada।। oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ hrīṃ dakṣiṇāyai svāheti ca vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। 92 ।। pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ sarvapūjitām ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dakṣiṇākhyānamuttamam ।। 93 ।। sukhadaṃ prītidaṃ caiva phaladaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। idaṃ ca dakṣiṇākhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। 94 ।। aṃgahīnaṃ ca tatkarma na bhavedbhārate bhuvi ।। aputro labhate putraṃ niścitaṃ ca guṇānvitam ।। 95 ।। bhāryyāhīno labhedbhāryyāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ parām ।। varārohāṃ putravatīṃ vinītāṃ priyavādinīm ।। 96 ।। pativratāṃ suvratāṃ ca śuddhāṃ ca kulajāṃ varām ।। vidyāhīno labhedvidyāṃ dhanahīno dhanaṃ labhet ।। 97 ।। bhūmihīno labhedbhūmiṃ prajāhīno labhetprajāḥ ।। saṅkaṭe bandhuvicchede vipattau bandhane tathā ।। 98 ।। māsamekamidaṃ śrutvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ।। 99 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde dakṣiṇopākhyāne dakṣiṇotpattitatpūjādividhānaṃ nāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 42 ।।
<2.43> nārada uvāca ।। anekāsāṃ ca devīnāṃ śrutamākhyānamuttamam ।। anyāsāṃ caritaṃ brahmanvada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ vipra vedeṣvasti pṛthakpṛthak ।। pūrvoktānāṃ ca devīnāṃ tvaṃ kāsāṃ śrotumicchasi ।। 2 ।। nārada uvāca ।। ṣaṣṭhī maṅgalacaṇḍī ca manasā prakṛteḥ kalā ।। utpattimāsāṃ caritaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।।3।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ṣaṣṭhāṃśā prakṛteryā ca sā ca ṣaṣṭhī prakīrtitā।। bālakādhiṣṭhātṛdevī viṣṇumāyā ca bāladā ।। 4 ।। mātṛkāsu ca vikhyātā devasenābhidhā ca sā ।। prāṇādhikapriyā sādhvī skandabhāryyā ca suvratā ।। 5 ।। āyuḥpradā ca bālānāṃ pātrī rakṣaṇakāriṇī ।। satataṃ śiśupārśvasthā yogādvai siddhiyoginī ।। 6 ।। tasyāḥ pūjāvidhau brahmannitihāsavidhiṃ śṛṇu ।। yacchrutaṃ dharmamukhataḥ sukhadaṃ putradaṃ param ।।7 ।। rājā priyavrataścāsītsvāyambhuva manoḥ sutaḥ ।। yogīndro nodvahedbhāryyāṃ tapasyāsu rataḥ sadā ।। 8 ।। brahmājñayā ca yatnena kṛtadāro babhūva saḥ ।। suciraṃ kṛtadāraśca na lebhe tanayaṃ mune ।।9 ।। putreṣṭiyajñaṃ taṃ cāpi kārayāmāsa kaśyapaḥ ।। mālinyai tasya kāntāyai muniryajñacaruṃ dadau ।। 10 ।। bhuktvā caruṃ ca tasyāśca sadyo garbho babhūva ha ।। dadhāra taṃ ca sā devī daivaṃ dvādaśavatsaram ।। 11 ।। tataḥ suṣāva sā brahmankumāraṃ kanakaprabham।। sarvāvayavasampannaṃ mṛtamuttāralocanam ।। 12 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruruduḥ sarvā nāryyo vai bāndhavastriyaḥ ।। mūrcchāmavāpa tanmātā putraśokena suvratā ।। 13 ।। śmaśānaṃ ca yayau rājā gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune ।। ruroda tatra kāntāre putraṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 14 ।। notsṛjya bālakaṃ rājā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ ।। jñānayogaṃ visasmāra putraśokātsudāruṇāt ।। 15 ।। etasminnantare tatra vimānaṃ ca dadarśa ha ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ maṇirājavirājitam ।। 16 ।। tejasā jvalitaṃ śaśvacchobhitaṃ kṣaumavāsasā ।। nānācitravicitrāḍhathaṃ puṣpamālā virājitam ।। 17 ।। dadarśa tatra devīṃ ca kamanīyāṃ manoharām।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ramyasusthirayauvanām ।। 18 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। kṛpāmayīṃ yogasiddhāṃ bhaktānugrahakāriṇīm ।। 19 ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ purato rājā tuṣṭāva paramādarāt ।। cakāra pūjanaṃ tasyā vihāya bhuvi bālakam ।। 20 ।। papraccha rājā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā grīṣmasūryyasamaprabhām ।। tejasā jvalitāṃ śāntāṃ kāntāṃ skandasya nārada ।। 21 ।। priyavrata uvāca ।। kā tvaṃ suśobhane kānte kasya kāntā'si suvrate ।। kasya kanyā varārohe dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ।। 22 ।। nṛpendrasya vacaḥ śrutvā jaganmaṅgaladāyinī ।। uvāca devasenā sā devarakṣaṇakāriṇī ।। 23 ।। devānāṃ daityabhītānāṃ purā senā babhūva sā ।। jayaṃ dadau ca tebhyaśca devasenā ca tena sā।।24।। devasenovāca। brahmaṇo mānasī kanyā devasenā'hamīśvarī ।। sṛṣṭvā māṃ manaso dhātā dadau skandāya bhūmipa ।। 25 ।। mātṛkāsu ca vikhyātā skandasenā ca suvratā ।। viśve ṣaṣṭhīti vikhyātā ṣaṣṭhāṃśā prakṛteryataḥ ।। 26 ।। putradā'hamaputrāya priyadātrī priyāya ca ।। dhanadā ca daridrebhyaḥ kartṛbhyaḥ śubhakarmadā ।। 27 ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ harṣaṃ maṃgalameva ca ।। sampattiśca vipattiśca sarvaṃ bhavati karmaṇā ।। 28 ।। karmaṇā bahuputrī ca vaṃśahīnaśca karmaṇā ।। karmaṇā rūpavāṃścaiva rogī śaśvatsvakarmaṇā ।। 29 ।। karmaṇā mṛtaputraśca karmaṇā cirajīvinaḥ ।। karmaṇā guṇavantaśca karmaṇā cāṃgahīnakāḥ ।। 30 ।। tasmātkarma paraṃ rājansarvebhyaśca śrutau śrutam ।। karmarūpī ca bhagavāṃstaddvārā phalado hariḥ ।। ।। 31 ।। ityevamuktvā sā devī gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune ।। mahājñānena sahasā jīvayāmāsa līlayā ।। 32 ।। rājā dadarśa taṃ bālaṃ sasmitaṃ kanakaprabham ।। devasenā ca paśyantaṃ nṛpamambarameva ca।।33।। gṛhītvā bālakaṃ devī gaganaṃ gantumudyatā ।। punastuṣṭāva tāṃ rājā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। 34 ।। nṛpastotreṇa sā devī parituṣṭā babhūva ha ।। uvāca taṃ nṛpaṃ brahmanvedoktaṃ karma nirmitam ।। 35 ।। devasenovāca ।। triṣu lokeṣu rājā tvaṃ svāyambhuvamanoḥ sutaḥ ।। mama pūjāṃ ca sarvatra kārayitvā svayaṃ kuru ।। 36 ।। tadā dāsyāmi putraṃ te kulapadmaṃ manoharam ।। suvrataṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ guṇavantaṃ supaṇḍitam ।। 37 ।। jātismaraṃ ca yogīndraṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam ।। śatakratukaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṣattriyāṇāṃ ca vanditam ।।38।। mattamātaṅgalakṣāṇāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ balaṃ śubham ।। dhanvinaṃ guṇinaṃ śuddhaṃ viduṣāṃ priyameva ca ।। ।। 39 ।। yoginaṃ jñāninaṃ caiva siddharūpaṃ tapasvinam ।। yaśasvinaṃ ca lokeṣu dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 40 ।। ityevamuktvā sā devī tasmai tadbālakaṃ dadau ।। rājā ca taṃ svīcakāra tatpūjārthaṃ ca suvrataḥ ।। 41 ।। jagāma devī svargaṃ ca dattvā tasmai śubhaṃ varam ।। ājagāma mahārājaḥ svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। āgatya kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ putrahetukam ।।42।। tuṣṭā babhūvuḥ santuṣṭā narā nāryaśca nārada ।।। maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa sarvatra sutahetukam ।। devīṃ ca pūjayāmāsa brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau ।। 43 ।। rājā ca pratimāseṣu śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ mahotsavam ।। ṣaṣṭhyā devyāśca yatnena kārayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।। 44 ।। bālānāṃ sūtikāgāre ṣaṣṭhāhe yatnapūrvakam ।। tatpūjāṃ kārayāmāsa caikaviṃśativāsare ।। 45 ।। bālānāṃ śubhakārye ca śubhānnaprāśane tathā ।। sarvatra varddhayāmāsa svayameva cakāra ha ।। 46 ।। dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ matto niśāmaya ।। yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktreṇa kauthumoktaṃ ca suvrata ।। 47 ।। śālagrāme ghaṭe vā'tha vaṭamūle'thavā mune।। bhittyāṃ puttalikāṃ kṛtvā pūjayedvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। 48 ।। ṣaṣṭhāṃśāṃ prakṛteḥ śuddhāṃ supratiṣṭhāṃ ca suvratām ।। suputradāṃ ca śubhadāṃ dayārūpāṃ jagatprasūm ।। 49 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। pavitrarūpāṃ paramāṃ devasenāṃ parāṃ bhaje ।। 50 ।। iti dhyātvā svaśirasi puṣpaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। punardhyātvā ca mūlena pūjayetsuvrataḥ satīm ।। 51 ।। pādyārghyācamanīyaiśca gandhadhūpapradīpakaiḥ ।। naivedyairvividhaiścāpi phalena ca śubhena ca ।।92।। mūlamoṃ hrīṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevye svāheti vidhipūrvakam ।। aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ yathāśakti japennaraḥ ।। ।। 53 ।। tatra stutvā ca namate bhaktiyuktaḥ samāhitaḥ ।। stotraṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ dhanaputraphalapradam ।। 54 ।। aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahāmantraṃ lakṣadhā yo japenmune ।। sa putraṃ labhate nūnamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 59 ।। stotraṃ śṛṇu muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ ca śubhāvaham ।। vāñchāpradaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gūḍhaṃ vede ca nārada ।। 56 ।। priyavrata uvāca ।। namo devyai mahādevyai siddhyai śāntyai namo namaḥ ।। sukhādāyai mokṣadāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ ।। 57 ।। varadāyai putradāyai dhanadāyai namo namaḥ ।। sukhadāyai mokṣadāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ ।। 58 ।। śakteḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśarūpāyai siddhāyai ca namo namaḥ ।। māyāyai siddhayoginyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ ।। 59 ।। pārāyai pāradāyai ca ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ ।। sārāyai sāradāyai ca pārāyai sarvakarmaṇām ।। 60 ।। bālādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca ṣaṣṭhī devyai namo namaḥ ।। kalyāṇadāyai kalyāṇyai phaladāyai ca karmaṇām ।। 61 ।। pratyakṣāyai ca bhaktānāṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevyai
