namo namaḥ ।। pūjyāyai skandakāntāyai sarveṣāṃ sarvakarmasu।62।। devarakṣaṇakāriṇyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpāyai vanditāyai nṛṇāṃ sadā।।63।। hiṃsākrodhairvarjitāyai ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ।। dhanaṃ dehi priyāṃ dehi putraṃ dehi sureśvari ।। 64 ।। dharmaṃ dehi yaśo dehi ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ ।। bhūmiṃ dehi prajāṃ dehi dehi vidyāṃ supūjite ।। 69 ।। kalyāṇaṃ ca jayaṃ dehi ṣaṣṭhīdevyai namo namaḥ ।। iti devīṃ ca saṃstūya lebhe putraṃ priyavrataḥ ।। 66 ।। yaśasvinaṃ ca rājendraṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ ।। ṣaṣṭhīstotramidaṃ brahmanyaḥ śṛṇoti ca vatsaram ।। 67 ।। aputro labhate putraṃ varaṃ sucirajīvinam ।। varṣamekaṃ ca yā bhaktyā saṃyattedaṃ śṛṇoti ca ।। 68 ।। sarvapāpādvinirmuktā mahāvandhyā prasūyate ।। vīraputraṃ ca guṇinaṃ vidyāvantaṃ yaśasvinam ।। 69 ।। sucirāyuṣmantameva ṣaṣṭhīmātṛprasādataḥ ।। kākavandhyā ca yā nārī mṛtāpatyā ca yā bhavet ।। 70 ।। varṣaṃ śrutvā labhetputraṃ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ ।। rogayukte ca bāle ca pitā mātā śṛṇoti ca ।। 71 ।। māsaṃ ca mucyate bālaḥ ṣaṣṭhīdevīprasādataḥ ।। iti śrībrahma0ma0dvi0pra0nāradanārāyaṇasaṃ0ṣaṣṭhyupākhyāne ṣaṣṭhīdevyutpattitatpūjāstotrādikathanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ।।43।।
<2.44> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। kathitaṃ ṣaṣṭhyupākhyānaṃ brahmaputra yathāgamam।। devī maṅgalacaṇḍī ca tadākhyānaṃ niśāmaya ।। 1 ।। tasyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ dharmavaktrācca yacchrutam ।। śrutisammatameveṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ viduṣāmapi ।। 2 ।। caṇḍāyāṃ varttate caṇḍī jāgratī śatrumaṇḍale ।। maṅgaleṣu ca yā dakṣā maṅgalā saiva caṇḍikā ।। 3 ।। durgāyāṃ vidyate caṇḍī maṅgalo'pi mahīsute ।। maṅgalā'bhīṣṭadevī yā sā syānmaṅgalacaṇḍikā ।। 4 ।। maṃgalo manuvaṃśaśca saptadvīpāvanīpatiḥ ।। tasya pūjyā'bhīṣṭadevī tena maṃgalacaṇḍikā ।। 5 ।। mūrttibhedena sā durgā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। kṛpārūpā'tipratyakṣā yoṣitāmiṣṭadevatā ।।6।। prathame pūjitā sā ca śaṅkareṇa purā parā ।। tripurasya vadhe ghoraṃ viṣṇunā preritena ca ।। 7 ।। brahmanbrahmopadeśena durgaprasthe ca saṅkaṭe ।। ākāśātpatite yāne ruṣā daityena pātite ।। 8 ।। brahmaviṣṇūpadiṣṭaśca durgāṃ tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraḥ ।। sā ca maṃgalacaṇḍīyamabhavadrūpabhedataḥ ।। 9 ।। uvāca purataḥ śambhorbhayaṃ nāstīti te prabho ।। bhagavānvṛṣarūpaśca sarveśaśca babhūva ha ।। 10 ।। yuddhaśaktisvarūpā'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi tadājñayā ।। mayā''tmanā ca hariṇā sahāyena vṛṣadhvaja ।। 11 ।। jahi daityaṃ ca deveśa surāṇāṃ padaghātakam ।। ityuktvā'ntarhitā devī śambhoḥ śaktirbabhūva sā ।। 12 ।। viṣṇudattena śastreṇa jaghāna tamumāpatiḥ ।। munīndra patite daitye sarve devā maharṣayaḥ ।। 13 ।। tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ devā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।। sadyaḥ śirasi śambhośca puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। 14 ।। brahmā viṣṇuśca santuṣṭo dadau tasmai śubhāśiṣam ।। brahmaviṣṇūpadiṣṭaśca susnātaḥ śaṅkaraḥ śuciḥ ।। 15 ।। pūjayāmāsa tāṃ śaktiṃ devīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām ।। pādyārghyācamanīyaiśca balibhirvividhairapi ।। 16 ।। puṣpacandananaivedyairbhaktyā nānāvidhairmune ।। chāgairmeṣaiśca mahiṣairgaṇḍairmāyāvibhirvaraiḥ ।। 17 ।। vastrālaṅkāramālyaiśca pāyasaiḥ piṣṭakairapi ।। madhubhiśca sudhābhiśca pakvairnānāvidhaiḥ phalaiḥ ।। 18 ।। saṅgītairnarttanairvādyairutsavaiḥ kṛṣṇakīrttanaiḥ ।। dhyātvā mādhyandinoktena dhyānena vidhipūrvakam ।। 19 ।। dadau dravyāṇi mūlena mantreṇaiva ca nārada ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ sarvapūjye devi maṅgalacaṇḍike ।। aiṃ krūṃ phaṭsvāhetyevaṃ cāpyekaviṃśākṣaro manuḥ।। ।। 20 ।। pūjyaḥ kalpataruścaiva bhaktānāṃ sarvakāmadaḥ ।। daśalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।। 21 ।। mantrasiddhirbhavedyasya sa viṣṇuḥ sarvakāmadaḥ ।। dhyānaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ brahmanvedoktaṃ sarvasammatam ।। 22 ।। devīṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ ramyāṃ susthirayauvanām ।। sarvarūpaguṇāḍhyāṃ ca komalāṃgīṃ manoharām ।। 23 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ candrakoṭisamaprabhām ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। ।। 24 ।। bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mallikāmālyabhūṣitam।। bimboṣṭhīṃ sudatīṃ śuddhāṃ śaratpadmanibhānanām ।। 25 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ sunīlotpalalocanām ।। jagaddhātrīṃ ca dātrīṃ ca sarvebhyaḥ sarvasampadām ।। 26 ।। saṃsārasāgare ghore potarūpāṃ varāṃ bhaje ।। 27 ।। devyāśca dhyānamityevaṃ stavanaṃ śrūyatāṃ mune ।। prayataḥ saṅkaṭagrasto yena tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraḥ ।। 28 ।। śaṅkara uvāca ।। rakṣa rakṣa jaganmātardevi maṃgalacaṇḍike ।। saṃhartri vipadāṃ rāśerharṣamaṃgalakārike ।। 29 ।। harṣamaṃgaladakṣe ca harṣamaṃgalacaṇḍike ।। śubhe maṃgaladakṣe ca śubhamaṃgala caṇḍike ।। 30 ।। maṃgale maṅgalārhe ca sarvamaṃgalamaṃgale ।। satāṃ maṃgalade devi sarveṣāṃ maṃgalālaye ।। 31 ।। pūjyā maṃgalavāre ca maṃgalābhīṣṭadaivate ।। pūjye maṃgalabhūpasya manuvaṃśasya santatam ।। 32 ।। maṃgalādhiṣṭhātṛdevi maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgale ।। saṃsāre maṃgalādhāre mokṣamaṃgaladāyini ।। 33 ।। sāre ca maṃgalādhāre pāre tvaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। pratimaṃgalavāraṃ ca pūjye tvaṃ maṃgalaprade ।। 34 ।। stotreṇānena śambhuśca stutvā magalacaṇḍikām ।। pratimaṃgalavāre ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā gataḥ śivaḥ ।। 35 ।। devyāśca maṃgalastotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। tanmaṃgalaṃ bhavecchaśvanna bhavettadamaṃgalam ।। 36 ।। prathame pūjitā devī śambhunā sarvamaṃgalā ।। dvitīye pūjitā devī maṃgalena graheṇa ca ।। 37 ।। tṛtīye pūjitā bhadrā maṃgalena nṛpeṇa ca ।। caturthe maṃgale vāre sundarībhiśca pūjitā ।। pañcame maṅgalākāṃkṣairnarairmaṃgalacaṇḍikā।।38।। pūjitā prativiśveṣu viśveśaiḥ pūjitā sadā ।। tataḥ sarvatra saṃpūjya sā babhūva sureśvarī ।। 39 ।। devādibhiśca munibhirmanubhirmānavairmune ।। devyāśca maṅgalastotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। 40 ।। tanmaṃgalaṃ bhavecchaśvanna bhavettadamaṃgalam ।। varddhante tatputrapautrā maṃgalaṃ ca dine dine ।। 41 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde maṅgalopākhyāne tatstotrādikathanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ।।44।।
<2.45> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। uktaṃ dvayorupākhyānaṃ brahmaputra yathāgamam।। śrūyatāṃ manasākhyānaṃ yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ।।1।। kanyā bhagavatī sā ca kaśyapasya ca mānasī।। teneyaṃ manasādevī manasā yā ca dīvyati ।। 2 ।। manasā dhyāyate yā vā paramātmānamīśvaram ।। tena sā manasādevī yogenaitena dīvyati ।।3।। ātmārāmā ca sā devī vaiṣṇavī siddhayoginī ।। triyugaṃ ca tapastaptvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 4 ।। jaratkāruśarīraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yāṃ kṣaṇamīśvaraḥ ।। gopīpatirnāma cakre jaratkāruriti prabhuḥ ।। 5 ।। vāñchitaṃ ca dadau tasyai kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। pūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa cakāra ca punaḥ svayam ।। 6 ।। svarge ca nāgaloke ca pṛthivyāṃ bahmalokataḥ ।। bhṛśaṃ japatsu gaurī sā sundarī ca manoharā ।। 7 ।। jagadgaurīti vikhyātā tena sā pūjitā satī ।। śivaśiṣyā ca sā devī tena śaivīti kīrttitā ।।8।। viṣṇubhaktā'tīva ramyā vaiṣṇavī tena nārada ।। nāgānāṃ prāṇarakṣitrī janamejayayajñake।।9।। nāgeśvarīti vikhyātā sā nāgabhaginī tathā ।। viṣaṃ saṃharttumīśā sā tena sā viṣahāriṇī ।। 1 0।। siddhaṃ yogaṃ harātprāpa tenāsau siddhayoginī।। mahājñānaṃ ca gopyaṃ ca mṛtasañjīvinīṃ parām ।।1 1।। mahājñānayutāṃ tāṃ ca pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। āstīkasya munīndrasya mātā sā vai tapasvinaḥ ।। 12 ।। āstīkamātā vikhyātā jaratkāruriti sma sā ।। priyā munerjaratkārormunīndrasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 13 ।। yogino viśvapūjyasya jaratkāroḥ priyā tataḥ ।। 14 ।। oṃ namo manasāyai ।। jaratkārurjagadgaurī manasā siddhayoginī ।। vaiṣṇavī nāgabhaginī śaivī nāgeśvarī tathā ।। 15 ।। jaratkārupriyā''stīkamātā viṣaharīti ca ।। mahājñānayutā caiva sā devī viśvapūjitā ।। 16 ।। dvādaśaitāni nāmāni pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। tasya nāgabhayaṃ nasti tasya vaṃśodbhavasya ca ।। 17 ।। nāgabhīde ca śayane nāgagraste ca mandire ।। nāgakṣate nāgadurge nāgaveṣṭitavigrahe ।। 18 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ paṭhitvā tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। nityaṃ paṭhedyastaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgavargaḥ palāyate ।। 19 ।। daśalakṣajapenaiva stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।। stotraṃ siddhaṃ bhavedyasya sa viṣaṃ bhoktumīśvaraḥ ।। 20।। nāgaughaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa bhavennāgavāhanaḥ ।। nāgāsano nāgatalpo mahā siddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 21 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde manasopākhyāne manasāstotrādika thanaṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 45 ।।
<2.46> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। pūjāvidhānaṃ stotraṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munipuṃgava ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ devīpūjāvidhānakam ।। 1 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ nāgayajñopavītinīm ।।2।। mahājñānayutāṃ caiva pravarāṃ jñānināṃ satām ।। siddhādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca siddhāṃ siddhipradāṃ bhaje ।। 3 ।। iti dhyātvā ca tāṃ devīṃ mūlenaiva prapūjayet ।। naivedyairvividhairdīpaiḥ puṣpairdhūpānulepanaiḥ ।। 4 ।। mūlamantraśca vedokto bhaktānāṃ vāñchitapradaḥ।। mūlakalpatarurnāma susiddho dvādaśākṣaraḥ ।।5।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ krīṃ aiṃ manasādevyai svāheti kīrtitaḥ ।। pañcalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।। 6 ।। mantrasiddhirbhavedyasya sa siddho jagatītale ।। sudhāsamaṃ viṣaṃ tasya dhanvantarisamo bhavet ।। 7 ।। brahmannāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ guḍāśākhāsu yatnataḥ ।। āvāhya devīṃ māsāntaṃ pūjayedyo hi bhaktitaḥ ।। 8 ।। pañcamyāṃ mānasākhyāyāṃ devyai dadyācca yo balim ।। dhanavānputravāṃścaiva kīrtimānsa bhaveddhruvam ।। 9 ।। pūjāvidhānaṃ kathitaṃ tadākhyānaṃ niśāmaya ।। kathayāmi mahābhāga yacchrutaṃ dharmavaktrataḥ ।। 10 ।। purā nāgabhayākrāntā babhūvurmānavā bhuvi ।। yānyānkhādanti nāgāśca na te jīvanti nārada ।। 11 ।। mantrāṃśca sasṛje bhītaḥ kaśyapo brahmaṇā'rthitaḥ ।। vedabījānusāreṇa copadeśena vedhasaḥ ।।1 2।। mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ tāṃ mānasāṃ sasṛje tataḥ ।। tapasā manasā tena mānasā sā babhūva ha ।। 13 ।। kumārī sā ca saṃbhūya cāgamacchaṅkarālayam ।। bhaktyā sampūjya kailāse tuṣṭuve candraśekharam ।। 14 ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca taṃ siṣeve muneḥ sutā ।। āśutoṣo maheśaśca tāṃ ca tuṣṭo babhūva ha ।। 15 ।। mahājñānaṃ dadau tasyai pāṭhayāmāsa sāma ca ।। kṛṣṇamantraṃ kalpataruṃ dadāvaṣṭākṣaraṃ mune ।। 16 ।। lakṣmīmāyākāmabīja ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ tathā ।। oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya ।। trailokyamaṅgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ pūjanakramam ।। 17 ।। stavanaṃ sarvapūjyaṃ ca dhyānaṃ bhuvanapāvanam ।। puraścaryyākramaṃ cāpi vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam ।। 18 ।। prāpya mṛtyuñjayājjñānaṃ paraṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ satī ।। jagāma tapase sādhvī puṣkaraṃ śaṅkarājñayā ।।19।। triyugaṃ ca tapastaptvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। siddhā babhūva sā devī dadarśa purataḥ prabhum ।। 20 ।। dṛṣṭvā kṛśāṅgīṃ bālāṃ ca kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। pūjāṃ ca kārayāmāsa cakāra ca hariḥ svayam ।। 21 ।। varaṃ ca pradadau tasyai pūjitā tvaṃ bhave bhava ।। varaṃ dattvā ca kalyāṇyai sadyaścāntardadhe vibhuḥ ।। 22 ।। prathame pūjitā sā ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। dvitīye śaṅkareṇaiva kaśyapena sureṇa ca ।। 23 ।। manunā muninā caiva hyahinā mānavādinā ।। babhūva pūjitā sā ca triṣu lokeṣu suśrutā ।। 24 ।। jaratkārumunīndrāya kaśyapastāṃ dadau purā ।। ayācito muniśreṣṭho jagrāha brāhmaṇājñayā ।। 25 ।। kṛtvodvāhaṃ mahāyogī viśrāntastapasā ciram ।। suṣvāpa devyā jaghane vaṭamūle ca puṣkare ।। 26 ।। nidrāṃ jagāma sa muniḥ smṛtvā nidreśamīśvaram ।। jagāmāstaṃ dinakaraḥ sāyaṃkāla upasthitaḥ ।। 27 ।। saṃcintya manasā tatra manasā ca pativratā ।। dharmmalopabhayenaiva cakārālocanaṃ satī ।। 28 ।। akṛtvā paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ nityāṃ caiva dvijanmanām।। brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ labhiṣyati patirmama ।। 29 ।। nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yaśca paścimām ।। sa sarvadā'śucirnityaṃ brahmahatyādikaṃ labhet ।। 30 ।। vedoktamiti saṃcintya bodhayāmāsa taṃ munim ।। sa ca buddhvā muniśreṣṭhastāṃ cukopa bhṛśaṃ muniḥ ।। 31 ।। jaratkāruruvāca ।। kathaṃ me suvrate sādhvi nidrābhaṅgaḥ kṛtastvayā ।। vyarthaṃ vratādikaṃ tasyā yā bharttuścāpakāriṇī ।।32।। tapaścānaśanaṃ caiva vrataṃ dānādikaṃ ca yat ।। bharturapriyakāriṇyāḥ sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam ।। 33 ।। yayā patiḥ pūjitaśca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pūjitastayā ।। pativratāvratārthaṃ ca patirūpī hariḥ svayam ।। 34 ।। sarvadānaṃ sarvayajñaḥ sarvatīrthaniṣevaṇam।। sarvaṃ tapo vrataṃ sarvamupavāsādikaṃ ca yat ।। 35 ।। sarvadharmaśca satyaṃ ca sarvadevaprapūjanam ।। tatsarvaṃ svāmisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 36 ।। supuṇye bhārate varṣe patisevā karoti yā ।। vaikuṇṭhaṃ svāminā sārddhaṃ sā yāti brahmaṇaḥ padam ।। 37 ।। vipriyaṃ kurute bharturvipriyaṃ vadati priyam ।। asatkulaprajātā yā tatphalaṃ śrūyatāṃ sati ।।38।। kumbhīpākaṃ vrajetsā ca yāvaccandradivākarau ।। tato bhavati cāṇḍālī patiputravivarjitā ।। 39 ।। ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho babhūva sphuritādharaḥ ।। cakampe manasā sādhvī bhayenovā ca taṃ patim ।। 40 ।। manasovāca ।। sandhyālopabhayenaiva nidrābhaṅgaḥ kṛtastava ।। kuru śāntiṃ mahābhāga duṣṭāyā mama suvrata ।। 41 ।। śṛṅgārāhāranidrāṇāṃ yaśca bhaṅgaṃ karoti ca ।। sa vrajetkālasūtraṃ ca svāminaśca viśeṣataḥ ।। 42 ।। ityuktvā manasā devī svāminaścaraṇāmbuje ।। papāta bhaktyā bhītā ca ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 43 ।। kupitaṃ ca muniṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīsūryyaṃ śaptumudyatam ।। tatrājagāma bhagavānsandhyayā saha nārada ।। 44 ।। tatrāgatya muniśreṣṭhamavocadbhāskaraḥ svayam ।। vinayena vinītaśca tayā saha yathocitam ।। 45 ।। śrīsūryya uvāca ।। sūryyāstasamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmalopabhayena ca ।। tvāṃ bodhayāmāsa vipra nāhamastaṃ gatastadā ।। 46 ।। kṣamasva bhagavanbrahmanmāṃ śaptuṃ nocitaṃ mune ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ ca hṛdayaṃ navanītasamaṃ sadā ।।47।। teṣāṃ kṣaṇārddhaṃ krodhaśca tato bhasma bhavejjagat ।। punaḥ sraṣṭuṃ dvijaḥ śakto na tejasvī dvijātparaḥ ।। 48 ।। brahmaṇo vaṃśasambhūtaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhāvayennityaṃ brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam ।। 49 ।। sūryyasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dvijastuṣṭo babhūva ha ।। sūryyo jagāma svasthānaṃ gṛhītvā brāhmaṇāśiṣam ।। 50।। tatyāja manasāṃ vipraḥ pratijñāpālanāya ca ।। rudantīṃ śokayuktāṃ ca hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 51 ।। sā sasmāra guruṃ śambhumiṣṭadevaṃ hariṃ vidhim ।। kaśyapaṃ janmadātāraṃ vipattau bhayakarśitā ।। 52 ।। tatrājagāma bhagavāngopīśaḥ śambhureva ca ।। vidhiśca kaśyapaścaiva manasā paricintayan ।। 53 ।। sa ca dṛṣṭvā'bhīṣṭadevaṃ niguṇe prakṛteḥ param ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ ।। 94 ।। namaścakāra śambhuṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ kaśyapaṃ tathā ।। kathamāgamanaṃ tvatretyevaṃ praśnaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 55 ।। brahmā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sahasā samayocitam।। tamuvāca namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśapadāmbujam ।। 56 ।। yadi tyaktā dharmapatnī dharmiṣṭhā manasā satī ।। kuruṣvāsyāṃ sutotpattiṃ dharmasaṃsthāpanāya vai ।। 57 ।। yatirvā brahmacārī vā bhikṣurvanacaro'pi vā ।। jāyāyā ca sutotpattiṃ kṛtvā paścādbhavenmuniḥ ।।58।। akṛtvā tu sutotpattiṃ virāgī yastyajetpriyām ।। sravettapastatpuṇyaṃ ca cālinyāṃ ca yathā jalam ।।59।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā jaratkārurmunīśvaraḥ ।। cakre tannābhisaṃsparśaṃ yogādvai mantrapūrvakam ।। 60 ।। tasyai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā yayurdevā mudā'nvitāḥ ।। mudā'nvitā ca manasā jaratkārurmudā'nvitaḥ ।। 61 ।। muneḥ karasparśamātrātsadyo garbho babhūva ha।। manasā yā muniśreṣṭha muniśreṣṭha uvāca tām ।।62।। jaratkāruruvāca ।। garbheṇānena manase tava putro bhaviṣyati।। jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro dharmiṣṭho vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ।।63।। tejasvī ca tapasvī ca yaśasvī ca guṇānvitaḥ ।। varo vedavidāṃ caiva yogināṃ jñānināṃ tathā।।64।। sa ca putro viṣṇubhakto dhārmikaḥ kulamuddharet ।। nṛtyanti pitaraḥ sarve janmamātreṇa vai mudā ।। 65 ।। pativratā suśīlā yā sapriyā priyavādinī ।। dharmiṣṭhā putramātā ca kulajā kulapālikā ।। 66 ।। haribhaktiprado bandhustadiṣṭaṃ yatsukhapradam ।। yo bandhacchitsa ca pitā harervartmapradarśakaḥ ।। 67 ।। sā garbhadhāriṇī yā ca garbhavāsavimocinī ।। viṣṇumantrapradātā ca sa gururviṣṇubhaktidaḥ ।। 68 ।। guruśca jñānadātā ca tajjñānaṃ kṛṣṇabhāvanam ।। ābrahmastambaparyyantaṃ yato viśvaṃ carācaram ।। 69 ।। āvirbhūtaṃ tirobhūtaṃ kiṃ vā jñānaṃ tadanyataḥ ।। vedajaṃ yogajaṃ yadyattatsāraṃ harisevanam ।। 70 ।। tattvānāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca hareranyadviḍambanam ।। dattaṃ jñānaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ sa svāmī jñānado hi yaḥ ।। 71 ।। jñānātpramucyate bandhātsa ripuryo hi bandhadaḥ ।। viṣṇubhaktiyutaṃ jñānaṃ yo dadāti sa vai guruḥ ।। 72 ।। sa ripuḥ śiṣyaghātī ca yato bandhānna mocayet ।। jananīgarbhajātkleśādyamatāḍanajāttathā ।। 73 ।। na mocayedyaḥ sa kathaṃ gurustāto hi bāndhavaḥ ।। paramānandarūpaṃ ca kṛṣṇamārgamanaśvaram ।। 74 ।। na darśayedyaḥ sa kathaṃ kīdṛśo bāndhavo nṛṇām ।। bhaja sādhvi paraṃ brahmācyutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca nirguṇam ।। nirmūlaṃ ca purākarma bhavedyatsevayā dhruvam ।। 75 ।। mayā chalena tvaṃ tyaktā doṣaṃ me kṣamyatāṃ priye ।। kṣamāyutānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ sattvātkrodho na vidyate।। 76 ।। puṣkare tapase yāmi gaccha devi yathāsukham ।। śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje dhyānavicchedakātaraḥ ।।77।। dhanādiṣu striyāṃ prītiḥ pravṛttipathagāminām ।। śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje niḥspṛhāṇāṃ manorathāḥ ।। 78 ।। jaratkāruvacaḥ śrutvā manasā śokakātarā ।। sā sāśrunetrā vinayāduvāca prāṇavallabham ।। 79 ।। manasovāca ।। doṣeṇāhaṃ tvayā tyaktā nidrābhaṅgena te prabho ।। yatra smarāmi tvāṃ bandho tatra māmāgamiṣyasi।। 80।। bandhubhedaḥ kleśatamaḥ putrabhedastataḥ paraḥ ।। prāṇeśabhedaḥ prāṇānāṃ vicchedātsarvataḥ paraḥ ।।81।। patiḥ pativratānāṃ ca śataputrādhikaḥ priyaḥ ।। sarvasmācca priyaḥ strīṇāṃ priyastenocyate budhaiḥ।।82।। putre yathaikaputrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā harau ।। netre yathaikanetrāṇāṃ tṛṣitānāṃ yathā jale ।।83।। kṣudhitānāṃ yathā'nne ca kāmukānāṃ yathā striyām।। yathā parasve caurāṇāṃ yathā jāre kuyoṣitām।। ।। 84 ।। viduṣāṃ ca yathā śāstre vaṇijye vaṇijāṃ yathā ।। tathā śaśvanmanaḥ kānte sādhvīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ prabho ।। 85 ।। ityuktvā manasā devī papāta svāminaḥ pade ।। kṣaṇaṃ cakāra kroḍe tāṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।।86 ।। netrodakena manasāṃ snāpayāmāsa tāṃ muniḥ ।। sā'śruṇā ca muneḥ kroḍaṃ siṣeve bhedakātarā ।।87।। tadā jñānena tau dvau ca viśokau ca babhūvatuḥ ।। smāraṃ smāraṃ padāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 88 ।। jagāma tapase vipraḥ sa kāntāṃ suprabodhya ca ।। jagāma manasā śambhoḥ kailāsaṃ mandiraṃ guroḥ ।। 89 ।। pārvatī bodhayāmāsa manasāṃ śokakarśitām ।। śivaścātīva bodhena śivena ca śivālaye।। 90 ।। supraśaste dine sādhvī suṣuve maṅgale kṣaṇe।। nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ putraṃ ca jñānināṃ yogināṃ gurum ।। 91 ।। garbhasthito mahājñānaṃ śrutvā śaṅkaravaktrataḥ ।। sa babhūva mahāyogī yogināṃ jñānināṃ guruḥ ।। 92 ।। jātakaṃ kārayāmāsa vācayāmāsa maṃgalam ।। vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa śivāya ca śivaḥ śiśoḥ ।। 93 ।। ratnatrikoṭilakṣaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau śivaḥ ।। pārvatī ca gavāṃ lakṣaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca ।। 94 ।। śambhuśca caturo vedānvedāṃgānitarāṃstathā ।। bālakaṃ pāṭhayāmāsa jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ param ।। 95 ।। bhaktirasti svakānte cābhīṣṭe deve harau gurau।। yasyāstena ca tatputro babhūvāstīka eva ca ।। 96 ।। jagāma tapase viṣṇoḥ puṣkaraṃ śaṅkarājñayā ।। saṃprāpya ca mahāmantraṃ tapaśca paramātmanaḥ ।। 97 ।। divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ ca tapastaptvā tapodhanaḥ ।। ājagāma mahāyogī namaskartuṃ śivaṃ prabhum ।। 98 ।। śaṃkaraṃ ca namaskṛtya puraḥ kṛtvā ca bālakam ।। sā cājagāma manasā kaśyapasyāśramaṃ pituḥ ।।99।। tāṃ saputrāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā mudaṃ prāpa prajāpatiḥ ।। śatalakṣaṃ ca ratnānāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mune ।। 100 ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa tvasaṃkhyāñchreyase śiśoḥ ।। aditiśca ditiścānyā mudaṃ prāpuḥ paraṃ tathā ।। 101 ।। sā saputrā ca suciraṃ tasthau tātālaye tadā ।। tadīyaṃ punarākhyānaṃ vakṣye tvaṃ tanniśāmaya ।। 102 ।। athābhimanyutanaye brahmaśāpaḥ parīkṣite ।। babhūva sahasā brahmandaivadoṣeṇa karmaṇā ।। 103 ।। saptāhe samatīte tu takṣakastvāṃ ca daṃkṣyati ।। śaśāpa śṛṅgī kauśikyā jalaṃ saṃspṛśya ceti saḥ ।। 104 ।। rājā śrutvā tatpravṛttiṃ gaṃgādvāraṃ jagāma saḥ ।। tatra tasthau ca saptāhaṃ śuśruve dharmasaṃhitām ।। 105 ।। saptāhe samatīte tu gacchantaṃ takṣakaṃ pathi ।। dhanvantarirmocayitumapaśyadgantuko nṛpam ।। 106 ।। tayorbabhūva saṃvādaḥ suprītiśca parasparam ।। dhanvantarermaṇiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ takṣakaḥ svecchayā dadau ।। 107 ।। sa yayau taṃ gṛhītvā tu tuṣṭasaṃhṛṣṭa mānasaḥ ।। apaśyattakṣakastūrṇaṃ nṛpaṃ mañcakasaṃsthitam ।।1 08 ।। rājā jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ smāraṃ smāraṃ hari gurum ।। saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsa piturvai janamejayaḥ।।1 09।। rājā cakāra yajñaṃ ca sarpasatrābhidhaṃ mune ।। prāṇāṃstatyāja sarpāṇāṃ samūho brahmatejasā ।। 110।। sa takṣakaśca bhītaśca mahendraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। sendraṃ ca takṣakaṃ hantuṃ vipravargaḥ samudyataḥ ।। 111 ।। atha devāśca munayaścāyayurmanasāntikam ।। tāṃ tuṣṭāva mahendraśca samakṣaṃ bhayakātaraḥ ।।1 12।। tatra āstīka āgatya māturyajñamathājñayā ।। mahendratakṣakaprāṇānyayāce bhūmipaṃ varam।। ।। 113 ।। dadau varaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpayā brāhmaṇājñayā ।। yajñaṃ samāpya viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadau mudā ।। 114 ।। viprāśca munayo devā gatvā ca manasāntikam ।। manasāṃ pūjayāmāsustuṣṭuvuśca pṛthakpṛthak ।।1 15।। śakraḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro bhaktiyuktaḥ sadā śuciḥ ।। manasāṃ pūjayāmāsa tuṣṭāva paramādarāt ।। 1 16।। upacāraḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbaliṃ dattvā priyaṃ tadā ।। pradadau parituṣṭaśca brahmaviṣṇusurājñayā।। ।।1 17।। saṃpūjya manasādevīṃ prayayuḥ svālayaṃ ca te ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 118 ।। nārada uvāca ।। kena stotreṇa tuṣṭāva mahendro manasāṃ satīm ।। pūjāvidhikramaṃ tasyāḥ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।। 119 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। susnātaḥ śucirācānto dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। ratnasiṃhāsane devīṃ vāsayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। 120 ।। svargagaṅgājalenaiva ratnakumbha sthitena ca ।। snāpayāmāsa manasāṃ mahendro vedamantrataḥ ।। 121 ।। vāsasī vāsayāmāsa vahniśuddhe manorame ।। sarvāṃge candanaṃ liptvā pādyārghyaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ।। 122 ।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ।। saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa tāṃ satīm ।। ।। 123 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ manasādevyai svāhetyevaṃ ca mantrataḥ ।। daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa dadau sarvānyathocitam ।। 124 ।। upacārānṣoḍaśakānbhaktito durlabhānhariḥ ।। pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā ca brahmaṇā prerito mudā ।। 125 ।। vādyaṃ nānāprakāraṃ ca vādayāmāsa tatra vai ।। babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca nabhaso manasopari ।। 126 ।। devo viprājñayā tatra brahmaviṣṇuśivājñayā ।। tuṣṭāva sāśrunetraśca pulakāñcita vigrahaḥ ।। 327 ।। mahendra uvāca ।। devi tvāṃ stotumicchāmi sādhvīnāṃ pravarāṃ varām ।। parātparāṃ ca paramāṃ nahi stotuṃ kṣamo 'dhunā ।। 128 ।। stotrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vede svabhāvākhyānataḥ param ।। na kṣamaḥ prakṛtiṃ vaktuṃ guṇānāṃ tava suvrate ।। 129 ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā tvaṃ kopahiṃsāvivarjitā।। na ca śapto munistena tyaktayā ca tvayā yataḥ ।। tvaṃ mayā pūjitā sādhvi jananī ca yathā'ditiḥ ।। ।। 130 ।। dayārūpā ca bhaginī kṣamārūpā yathā prasūḥ ।। tvayā me rakṣitāḥ prāṇāḥ putradārāḥ sureśvari ।। 131 ।। ahaṃ karomi tvāṃ pūjyāṃ mama prītiśca varddhate ।। nityaṃ yadyāpi pūjyā tvaṃ bhave'tra jagadambike ।। 132 ।। tathā'pi tava pūjāṃ vai varddhayāmi punaḥ punaḥ ।। ye tvāmāṣāḍhasaṃkrāntyāṃ pūjayiṣyanti bhaktitaḥ ।।133।। pañcamyāṃ manasākhyāyāṃ māsānte vā dine dine ।। putrapautrādayasteṣāṃ varddhante ca dhanāni ca ।। 134 ।। yaśasvinaḥ kīrttimanto vidyāvanto guṇānvitāḥ ।। ye tvāṃ na pūjayiṣyanti nindantyajñānato janāḥ ।। ।। 135 ।। lakṣmīhīnā bhaviṣyanti teṣāṃ nāgabhayaṃ sadā ।। tvaṃ svargalakṣmīḥ svarge ca vaikuṇṭhe kamalā kalā ।। 136।। nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavāñjaratkārurmunīśvaraḥ ।। tapasā tejasā tvāṃ ca manasā sasṛje pitā ।।137।। asmākaṃ rakṣaṇāyaiva tena tvaṃ manasābhidhā ।। manasā devituṃ śaktā cātmanā siddhayoginī ।। 138 ।। tena tvaṃ manasādevī pūjitā vanditā bhave ।। yāṃ bhaktyā manasā devāḥ pūjayantyaniśaṃ bhṛśam ।। 139 ।। tena tvāṃ manasādevīṃ pravadanti purāvidaḥ ।। sattvarūpā ca devī tvaṃ śaśvatsattvaniṣevayā ।। 140 ।। yo hi yadbhāvayennityaṃ śataṃ prāpnoti tatsamam ।। indraśca manasāṃ stutvā gṛhītvā bhaginīṃ ca tām ।। 141 ।। nirjagāma svabhavanaṃ bhūṣāvāsaparicchadām ।। putreṇa sārddhaṃ sā devī ciraṃ tasthau piturgṛhe ।।142।। bhrātṛbhiḥ pūjitā śaśvanmānyā vandyā ca sarvataḥ ।। golokātsurabhī brahmaṃstatrāgatya supūjitām ।। 143 ।। tāṃ snāpayitvā kṣīreṇa pūjayāmāsa sādaram ।। jñānasya kathayāmāsa svarūpaṃ sarvadurlabham ।। tadā devaiḥ pūjitā sā svargalokaṃ punaryayau ।।144।। idaṃ stotraṃ puṇyabījaṃ tāṃ saṃpūjya ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। tasya nāgabhayaṃ nāsti tasya vaṃśe bhavecca yaḥ ।। 145 ।। viṣaṃ bhavetsudhātulyaṃ siddhastotraṃ yadā paṭhet ।। pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhastotro bhavennaraḥ ।।146।। sarpaśāyī bhavetso'pi niścitaṃ sarpavāhanaḥ ।। 147 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde manasopākhyāne tadutpattipūjāstotrādikathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 46 ।।
<2.47> nārada uvāca ।। kā vā sā surabhī devī golokā dāgatā ca yā ।। tajjanmacaritaṃ brahmañchrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gavāmadhiṣṭhātṛdevī gavāmādyā gavāṃ prasūḥ ।। gavāṃ pradhānā surabhī goloke ca samudbhavā ।। 2 ।। sarvādisṛṣṭeḥ kathanaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। babhūva tena tajjanma purā vṛndāvane vane ।। 3 ।। ekadā rādhikānātho rādhayā saha kautukāt ।। gopāṃganāparivṛtaḥ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau ।। 4 ।। sahasā tatra rahasi vijahāra ca kautukāt ।। babhūva kṣīrapānecchā tadā svecchāparasya ca।। 5 ।। sasṛje surabhīṃ devīṃ līlayā vāmapārśvataḥ ।। vatsayuktāṃ dugdhavatīṃ vatsānāṃ ca manoramām ।। 6 ।। dṛṣṭvā savatsāṃ surabhīṃ ratnabhāṇḍe dudoha saḥ ।। kṣīraṃ sudhātiriktaṃ ca janmamṛtyuharaṃ param।। 7।। taduṣṇaṃ ca payaḥ svādu papau gopīpatiḥ svayam ।। saro babhūva payasā bhāṇḍavisraṃsanena ca ।।8।। dīrghe ca vistṛte caiva paritaḥ śatayojanam ।। golokeṣu prasiddhaṃ tadramyaṃ kṣīrasarovaram ।। 9 ।। gopikānāṃ ca rādhāyāḥ krīḍāvāpī babhūva sā ।। ratnena racitā tūrṇaṃ bhūtā vāpīśvarecchayā ।। 10 ।। babhūva kāmadhenūnāṃ sahasā lakṣakoṭayaḥ ।। tāvatyo hi savatsāśca surabhīlomakūpataḥ ।। 11 ।। tāsāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca saṃbabhūvurasaṃkhyakāḥ ।। kathitā ca gavāṃ sṛṣṭistayā saṃpūritaṃ jagat ।। 12 ।। pūjāṃ cakāra bhagavānsurabhyāśca purā mune ।। tato babhūva tatpūjā triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā ।। 13 ।। dīpānvitā paradine śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā bhave ।। babhūva surabhīpūjā dharmavaktrāditi śrutam ।। 14 ।। dhyānaṃ stotraṃ mūlamantraṃ yadyatpūjāvidhikramam ।। vedoktaṃ ca mahābhāga nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 15 ।। oṃ surabhyai nama iti mantro'yaṃ tu ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ।। siddho lakṣajapenaiva bhaktānāṃ kalpapādapaḥ ।।16।। sthitaṃ dhyānaṃ yajurvede pūjanaṃ sarvasammatam ।। ṛddhidāṃ vṛddhidāṃ caiva muktido sarvakāmadām ।। 17 ।। lakṣmīsvarūpāṃ paramāṃ rādhāsahacarīṃ parām ।। gavāmadhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ gavāmādyāṃ gavāṃ prasūm ।।18।। pavitrarūpāṃ pūjyāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ sarvakāmadām ।। yayā pūtaṃ sarvaviśvaṃ tāṃ devīṃ surabhīṃ bhaje ।। 19 ।। ghaṭe vā dhenuśirasi baddhastaṃbhe gavāṃ ca vā ।। śālagrāme jale'gnau vā surabhī pūjayeddvijaḥ ।। 20 ।। dīpānvitā paradine pūrvāhṇe bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ।। yaḥ pūjayecca surabhīṃ sa ca pūjyo bhavedbhuvi ।। 21 ।। ekadā triṣu lokeṣu vārāhe viṣṇumāyayā ।। kṣīraṃ jahāra sahasā cintitāśca surādayaḥ ।। 22 ।। te gatvā brahmaṇo lokaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tuṣṭuvustadā ।। tadājñayā ca surabhīṃ tuṣṭuve pākaśāsanaḥ ।। 23 ।। mahendra uvāca ।। namo devyai mahādevyai surabhyai ca namo namaḥ ।। gavāṃ bījasvarūpāyai namaste jagadambike ।। 24 ।। namo rādhāpriyāyai ca padmāṃśāyai namo namaḥ ।। namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca gavāṃ mātre namo namaḥ ।। kalpavṛkṣasvarūpāyai pradātryai sarvasaṃpadām ।। 25 ।। śrīdāyai dhanadāyai ca buddhidāyai namo namaḥ ।। śubhadāyai prasannāyai gopradāyai namo namaḥ ।। 26 ।। yaśodāyai saukhyadāyai dharmajñāyai namo namaḥ ।। stotraśravaṇamātreṇa tuṣṭā hṛṣṭā jagatprasūḥ ।। 27 ।। āvirbabhūva tatraiva brahmaloke sanātanī ।। mahendrāya varaṃ dattvā vāñchitaṃ sarvadurlabham ।। 28 ।। jagāma sā ca golokaṃ yayurdevādayo gṛham ।। babhūva viśvaṃ sahasā dugdhapūrṇaṃ ca nārada ।। 29 ।। dugdhād ghṛtaṃ tato yajñastataḥ prītiḥ surasya ca ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet ।। 30 ।। sa gomāndhanavāṃścaiva kīrttimānpuṇyavānbhavet ।। susnātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।। 31 ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante kṛṣṇamandiram ।। suciraṃ nivasettatra kurute kṛṣṇasevanam ।। 32 ।। na punarbhavanaṃ tasya brahmaputra bhave bhavet ।। 33 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde surabhyupākhyāne tadutpatti tatpūjādikathanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 47 ।।
<2.48> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇa mahābhāga nārāyaṇaparāyaṇa ।। nārāyaṇāṃśa bhagavanbrūhi nārāyaṇīṃ kathām ।। 1 ।। śrutaṃ surabhyupākhyānamatīva sumanoharam ।। gopyaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu purāvidbhiḥ praśaṃsitam ।। 2 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi rādhikākhyānamuttamam ।। tadutpattiṃ ca taddhyānaṃ stotraṃ kavacamuttamam ।। 3 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। purā kailāsaśikhare bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। siddheśaṃ siddhidaṃ sarvasvarūpaṃ śaṃkaraṃ param ।। 4 ।। praphullavadanaṃ prītaṃ sasmitaṃ munibhiḥ stutam ।। kumārāya prarocantaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 5 ।। rāsotsavarasākhyānaṃ rāsamaṇḍalavarṇanam ।। tadākhyānāvasāne ca prastāvāvasare satī ।। 6 ।। papraccha pārvatī sphītā sasmitā prāṇavallabham ।। stavanaṃ kurvatī bhītā prāṇeśena prasāditā । ।। 7 ।। provāca taṃ mahādevaṃ mahādevī sureśvarī ।। apūrvaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sudurlabham ।। 8 ।। śrīpārvatyuvāca ।। āgamaṃ nikhilaṃ nātha śrutaṃ sarvamanuttamam ।। pāñcarātrādikaṃ nītiśāstrayogaṃ ca yoginām ।। 9 ।। siddhānāṃ siddhiśāstraṃ ca nānātantraṃ manoharam ।। bhaktānāṃ bhaktiśāstraṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 10 ।। devīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ caritaṃ tvanmukhāmbujāt ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi rādhikākhyānamuttamam ।।1 1।। śrutau śrutaṃ praśastaṃ ca rādhāyāśca samāsataḥ ।। tvanmukhātkāṇvaśākhāyā vyāsenoktāṃ vadādhunā ।। 12 ।। āgamākhyānakāle ca bhavatā svīkṛtaṃ purā ।। nahīśvaravyāhṛtiśca mithyā bhavitumarhati ।। 13 ।। tadutpatiṃ ca taddhyānaṃ nāmno māhātmyamuttamam ।। pūjāvidhānaṃ caritaṃ stotraṃ kavacamuttamam ।।14।। ārādhanavidhānaṃ ca pūjāpaddhatimīpsitām।। sāmprataṃ brūhi bhagavanmāṃ bhaktāṃ bhaktavatsala ।। 15 ।। kathaṃ na kathitaṃ pūrvamāgamākhyānakālataḥ ।। pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā namravaktro babhūva saḥ ।। 16 ।। pañcavaktraśca bhagavāñchuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। svasatyabhaṅgabhītaśca maunībhūya vicintayan ।। 17 ।। sasmāra kṛṣṇaṃ dhyānenābhīṣṭadevaṃ kṛpānidhim ।। tadanujñāṃ ca saṃprāpya svārddhāṅgāṃ tāmuvāca saḥ ।। 18 ।। niṣiddho'haṃ bhagavatā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। āgamārambhasamaye rādhākhyānaprasaṃgataḥ ।। 19 ।। madarddhāṃgasvarūpā tvaṃ na madbhinnā svarūpataḥ ।। ato'nujñāṃ dadau kṛṣṇo mahyaṃ vaktuṃ maheśvari ।। 20 ।। madiṣṭadevakāntāyā rādhāyāścaritaṃ sati ।। atīva gopanīyaṃ ca sukhadaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktidam ।। 21 ।। jānāmi tadahaṃ durge sarvaṃ pūrvāparaṃ varam ।। yajjānāmi rahasyaṃ ca na tadbrahmā phaṇīśvaraḥ ।। 22 ।। na tatsanatkumāraśca na ca dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। na devendro munīṃdrāśca siddhendrāḥ siddhapuṅgavāḥ ।। 23 ।। matto balavatī tvaṃ ca prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyatā ।। atastvāṃ gopanīyaṃ ca kathayāmi sureśvari ।। 24 ।। śṛṇu durge pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam ।। caritaṃ rādhikāyāśca durlabhaṃ ca supuṇyadam ।। 25 ।। purā vṛndāvane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। śataśṛṃgaikadeśe ca mālatīmallikāvane ।। 26 ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye tasthau tatra jagatpatiḥ ।। svecchāmayaśca bhagavānbabhūva ramaṇotsukaḥ ।। 27 ।। riraṃsostasya jagatāṃ patyustanmallikāvane ।। icchayā ca bhavetsarvaṃ tasya svecchāmayasya ca ।। 28 ।। etasminnantare durge dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ ।। dakṣiṇāṃgaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇo vāmārddhāṃgā ca rādhikā ।। 29 ।। babhūva ramaṇī ramyā rāseśā ramaṇotsukā ।। amūlyaratnābharaṇā ratnasiṃhāsanasthitā ।। 30 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā koṭipūrṇaśaśiprabhā ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhā rājitā ca svatejasā।।31।। sasmitā sudatī śuddhā śaratpadmanibhānanā ।। bibhratī kabarīṃ ramyāṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitām।।32।। ratnamālāṃ ca dadhatī grīṣmasūryyasamaprabhām ।। muktāhāreṇa śubhreṇa gaṃgādhārānibhena ca ।। 33 ।। saṃyuktaṃ vartulottuṃgaṃ sumeru girisannibham ।। kaṭhinaṃ sundaraṃ dṛśyaṃ kastūrīpatracihnitam ।। 34 ।। māṃgalyaṃ maṃgalārhaṃ ca stanayugmaṃ ca bibhratī ।। nitambaśroṇibhārārttā navayauvanasundarī ।। 35 ।। kāmāturaḥ sasmitāṃ tāṃ dadarśa rasikeśvaraḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā kāntāṃ jagatkānto babhūva ramaṇotsukaḥ ।।36।। dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ sukāntaṃ ca sā dadhāra hareḥ puraḥ ।। tena rādhā samākhyātā purāvidbhirmaheśvari ।। 37 ।। rādhā bhajati taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sa ca tāṃ ca parasparam ।। ubhayoḥ sarvasāmyaṃ ca sadā santo vadanti ca ।। 38 ।। bhavanaṃ dhāvanaṃ rāse smaratyāliṃganaṃ japan ।। tena jalpati saṃketaṃ tatra rādhāṃ sa īśvaraḥ ।। 39 ।। rāśabdoccāraṇādbhakto rāti muktiṃ sudurlabhām ।। dhāśabdoccāraṇāddurge dhāvatyeva hareḥ padam ।। ।। 40 ।। kṛṣṇavāmāṃśasambhūtā rādhā rāseśvarī purā ।। tasyāścāṃśāṃśakalayā babhūvurdevayoṣitaḥ ।। 41 ।। rā ityādānavacano dhā ca nirvāṇavācakaḥ ।। tato'vāpnoti muktiṃ ca tena rādhā prakīrtitā ।। 42 ।। babhūva gopīsaṃghaśca rādhāyā lomakūpataḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇalomakūpebhyo babhūvuḥ sarvaballavāḥ ।। 43 ।। rādhāvāmāṃśabhāgena mahālakṣmīrbabhūva sā ।। tasyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sā gṛhalakṣmīrbabhūva sā ।। 44 ।। caturbhujasya sā patnī devī vaikuṇṭhavāsinī।। tadaṃśā rājalakṣmīśca rājasampatpradāyinī ।। 45 ।। tadaṃśā martyalakṣmīśca gṛhiṇāṃ ca gṛhe gṛhe ।। dīpādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca sā caiva gṛhadevatā ।। 46 ।। svayaṃ rādhā kṛṣṇapatnī kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthalasthitā ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca tasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ।। 47 ।। ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva pārvati ।। bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ triguṇātparam ।। 48 ।। paraṃ pradhānaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। sarvādyaṃ sarvapūjyaṃ va nirīhaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 49 ।। svecchāmayaṃ nityarūpaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। tadbhinnānāṃ ca devānāṃ prākṛtaṃ rūpameva ca ।। 50 ।। tasya prāṇādhikā rādhā bahusaubhāgyasaṃyutā ।। mahāviṣṇoḥ prasūḥ sā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 51 ।। māninīṃ rādhikāṃ santaḥ sevante nityaśassadā ।। sulabhaṃ yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabham ।। 52 ।। svapne rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ nahi paśyanti ballavāḥ ।। svayaṃ devī hareḥ kroḍe chāyārūpeṇa kāminī ।। 53 ।। sa ca dvādaśagopānāṃ rāyāṇapravaraḥ priye ।। śrīkṛṣṇāṃśaśca bhagavānviṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ ।। 54 ।। sudāmaśāpātsā devī golokādāgatā mahīm ।। vṛṣabhānugṛhe jātā tanmātā ca kalāvatī ।।55।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargata haragaurīsaṃvāde rādhopākhyāne rādhotpattitatpūjādikathanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 48 ।।
<2.49> pārvatyuvāca ।। kathaṃ sudāmaśāpañca sā devī lalābha ha ।। kathaṃ śaśāpa bhṛtyo hi svābhīṣṭāṃ devakāminīm ।। 1 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। śṛṇu devī pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam ।। gopyaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu śubhadaṃ bhaktimuktidam ।। 2 ।। ekadā rādhikeśaśca goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। śataśṛṃgākhyagiryekadeśe vṛndāvane vane ।।3।। gṛhītvā virajāṃ gopīṃ subhāgyāṃ rādhikāsamām ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 4 ।। ratnapradīpasaṃyukte ratnanirmāṇamaṇḍale ।। amūlyaratnakhacitamañcake puṣpatalpake ।। 5 ।। kastūrīkuṃkumārakte sucandanasudhūpite ।। sugandhimālatīmālāsamūhaparimaṇḍite ।। 6 ।। suratādviratirnāsti dampatī ratipaṇḍitau ।। tau dvau parasparāktau sukhasambhogatantritau ।। 7 ।। manvantarāṇāṃ lakṣaśca kālaḥ parimito gataḥ ।। golokasya svalpakāle janmādirahitasya ca ।। 8 ।। dūtyaścatasro jñātvā'tha jagadustāṃ tu rādhikam ।। śrutvā paramaruṣṭā sā tatyāja harimīśvarī ।।9।। prabodhitā ca sakhibhiḥ koparaktāsyalocanā ।। vihāya ratnālaṅkāraṃ vahniśuddhāṃśuke śubhe ।। 10 ।। krīḍāpadmaṃ ca sadratnāmūlyadarpaṇamujjvalam ।। nirmārjayāmāsa satī sindūraṃ citrapatrakam ।। 11 ।। prakṣālya toyāñjalibhirmukharāgamalaktakam ।। visrastakabarībhārā muktakeśī prakampitā ।। 12 ।। śuklavastraparīdhānā rūkṣā veṣādivarjitā ।। yayau yānāntikaṃ tūrṇaṃ priyālībhirnivāritā।।13।। ājuhāva sakhīsaṃghaṃ roṣavisphuritādharā ।। śaśvatkampānvitāṃgī sā gopībhiḥ parivāritā ।।14।। tābhirbhaktyā yutābhiśca kātarābhiśca saṃstutā ।। āruroha rathaṃ divyamamūlyaṃ ratnanirmitam ।। daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ dairghye tacchatayojanam ।।15।। sahasracakrayuktaṃ ca nānācitrasamanvitam ।। nānāvicitravasanaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ kṣaumairvirājitam ।। 16 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇadarpaṇaiḥ pariśobhitam ।। maṇīndrajālamālābhaiḥ puṣpamālāsahasrakaiḥ ।। 17 ।। sadratna kalaśairyuktaṃ ramyairmandirakoṭibhiḥ ।। trilakṣakoṭibhiḥ sārddha gopībhiśca priyālibhiḥ ।। 18 ।। yayau rathena tenaiva sumanomālinā priye ।। śrutvā kolāhalaṃ gopaḥ sudāmā kṛṣṇapārṣadaḥ ।। 19 ।। kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā sāvadhānaṃ gopaiḥ sārddhaṃ palāyitaḥ ।। bhayena kṛṣṇaḥ santrasto vihāya virajāṃ satīm ।। 20 ।। svapremamagnaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi tirodhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। sā satī samayaṃ jñātvā vicāryya svahṛdi krudhā ।। 21 ।। rādhāprakopabhītā ca prāṇāṃstatyāja tatkṣaṇam ।। virajāligaṇāstatra bhayavihvalakātarāḥ ।। 22 ।। prayayuḥ śaraṇaṃ sādhvīṃ virajāṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ bhiyā ।। goloke sā saridrūpā jātā vai śailakanyake ।। 23 ।। koṭiyojanavistīrṇā dīrghe śataguṇā tathā ।। golokaṃ veṣṭayāmāsa parikheva manoharā ।। 24 ।। babhūvuḥ kṣudranadyaśca tadā'nyā gopya eva ca ।। sarvā nadyastadaṃśāśca prativiśveṣu sundari ।। 25 ।। ime sapta samudrāśca virajānandanā bhuvi ।। athāgatya mahābhāgā rādhā rāseśvarī parā ।। 26 ।। na dṛṣṭvā virajāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca punaryayau ।। jagāma kṛṣṇastāṃ rādhāṃ gopālairaṣṭabhiḥ saha ।। 27 ।। gopībhirdvāri yuktābhirvārito'pi punaḥ punaḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca sā devī bhartsayāmāsa taṃ tadā ।। 28 ।। sudāmā bhartsayāmāsa tāṃ tathā kṛṣṇasannidhau ।। kruddhā śaśāpa sā devī sudāmānaṃ sureśvarī ।। 29 ।। gaccha tvamāsurīṃ yoniṃ gaccha dūramato drutam ।। śaśāpa tāṃ sudāmā ca tvamito gaccha bhāratam ।। 30 ।। bhava gopī gopakanyāmukhyābhiḥ svābhireva ca ।। tatra te kṛṣṇavicchedo bhaviṣyati śataṃ samāḥ ।। ।।31।। tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhagavāṃśca kariṣyati ।। iti śaptvā sudāmā'sau praṇamya jananīṃ harim ।। sāśrunetro mohayuktastato gantuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 32 ।। rādhā jagāma tatpaścātsāśrunetrā'tivihvalā ।। vatsa kva yāsītyuccāryya putravicchedakātarā ।। 33 ।। kṛṣṇastāṃ bodhayāmāsa vidyayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। śīghraṃ saṃprāpsyasi sutaṃ mā rudastvaṃ varānane ।। 34 ।। sa cāsuraḥ śaṅkhacūḍo babhūva tulasīpatiḥ ।। macchūlabhinnakāyena golokaṃ vai jagāma saḥ ।। 35 ।। rādhā jagāma vārāhe gokulaṃ bhārataṃ satī ।। vṛṣabhānośca vaiśyasya sā ca kanyā babhūva ha ।। 36 ।। ayonisambhavā devī vāyugarbhā kalāvatī ।। suṣuve māyayā vāyuṃ sā tatrāvirbabhūva ha ।। 37 ।। atīte dvādaśābde tu dṛṣṭvā tāṃ navayauvanām ।। sārdhaṃ rāyāṇavaiśyena tatsambandhaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 38 ।। chāyāṃ saṃsthāpya tadgehe sā'ntarddhānamavāpa ha ।। babhūva tasya vaiśyasya vivāhaśchāyayā saha ।। 39 ।। gate caturdaśābde tu kaṃsabhīteśchalena ca ।। jagāma gokulaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śiśurūpī jagatpatiḥ ।। 40 ।। kṛṣṇamātā yaśodā yā rāyāṇastatsahodaraḥ ।। goloke gopakṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sambandhātkṛṣṇamātulaḥ।।41।। kṛṣṇena saha rādhāyāḥ puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vidhinā jagatāṃ vidhiḥ।।42।। svapne rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ nahi paśyanti ballavāḥ।। svayaṃ rādhā hareḥ kroḍe chāyā rāyāṇamandire।।43।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe purā vidhiḥ।। rādhikācaraṇāmbhojadarśanārthī ca puṣkare ।।44।। bhārāvataraṇe bhūmerbhārate nandagokule ।। dadarśa tatpadāmbhojaṃ tapasastatphalena ca।45।। kiñcitkālaṃ sa vai kṛṣṇaḥ puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। reme golokanāthaśca rādhayā saha bhārate।। 46 ।। tataḥ sudāmaśāpena vicchedaśca babhūva ha ।। tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhūmeḥ kṛṣṇaścakāra saḥ ।। 47 ।। śatābde samatīte tu tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ ।। dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ sā rādhā sa ca tāṃ ca parasparam ।। 48 ।। tato jagāma golokaṃ rādhayā saha tattvavit ।। kalāvatī yaśodā ca paryagādrādhayā saha ।। 49 ।। vṛṣabhānuśca nandaśca yayau golokamuttamam ।। sarve gopāśca gopyaśca yayustā yāḥ samāgatāḥ ।। 50 ।। chāyā gopāśca gopyaśca prāpurmuktiṃ ca sannidhau ।। remire tāśca tatraiva sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇena pārvati ।। 51 ।। ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣakoṭyaśca gopyo gopāśca tatsamāḥ ।। golokaṃ prayayurmuktāḥ sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇena rādhayā ।। 52 ।। droṇaḥ prajāpatirnando yaśodā tatpriyā dharā ।। saṃprāpa pūrvatapasā paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 53 ।। vasudevaḥ kaśyapaśca devakī cāditiḥ satī ।। devamātā devapitā pratikalpe svabhāvataḥ ।। 54 ।। pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā rādhāmātā kalāvatī ।। vasudāmāpi golokād vṛṣabhānuḥ samāyayau ।। 55 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ durge rādhikākhyānamuttamam ।। sampatkaraṃ pāpaharaṃ putrapautravivardhanam ।। 56 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhārūpo dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ ।। caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। 57 ।। caturbhujasya patnī ca mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।। gaṃgā ca tulasī caiva devyo nārāyaṇapriyāḥ ।।58।। śrīkṛṣṇapatnī sā rādhā tadarddhāṅgasamudbhavā ।। tejasā vayasā sādhvī rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। 59 ।। ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ vadedbudhaḥ ।। vyatikrame brahmahatyāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 60 ।। kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। cakāra pūjāṃ rādhāyāstatsambandhimahotsavam ।। 61 ।। sadratnaghuṭikāyāśca kṛtvā tatkavacaṃ hariḥ ।। dadhāra kaṇṭhe bāhau ca dakṣiṇe saha gopakaiḥ ।। 62 ।। kṛtvā dhyānaṃ ca bhaktyā ca stotrametaccakāra saḥ ।। rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ cakhāda madhusūdanaḥ ।। 63 ।। rādhā pūjyā ca kṛṣṇasya tatpūjyo bhagavānprabhuḥ ।। parasparābhīṣṭadeve bhedakṛnnarakaṃ vrajet ।। 64 ।। dvitīye pūjitā sā ca dharmeṇa brahmaṇā mayā ।। anantavāsukibhyāṃ ca raviṇā śaśinā purā ।। 65 ।। mahendreṇa ca rudraiśca manunā mānavena ca ।। surendraiśca munīndraiśca sarvaviśvaiśca pūjitā ।। 66 ।। tṛtīye pūjitā sā ca saptadvīpeśvareṇa ca ।। bhārate ca suyajñena putrairmitrairmudā'nvitaiḥ ।। 67 ।। brāhmaṇenābhiśaptena devadoṣeṇa bhūbhṛtā ।। vyādhigrastena hastena duḥkhinā ca vidūyatā ।। 68 ।। saṃprāpa rājyaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīḥ sa ca rādhāvareṇa ca ।। stotreṇa brahmadattena stutvā ca parameśvarīm ।। 69 ।। abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ tasyāḥ kaṇṭhe bāhau dadhāra saḥ ।। dhyātvā cakāra pūjāṃ ca puṣkare śatavatsarān ।। 70 ।। ante jagāma golokaṃ ratnayānena bhūmipaḥ ।। iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 71 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargata haragaurīsaṃvāde rādhopākhyāne rādhāyāḥ sudāmaśāpādikathanaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 49 ।।
<2.50> pārvatyuvāca ।। ko vā suyajño nṛpatiḥ kutra vaṃśe babhūva saḥ ।। kathaṃ viprābhiśaptaśca kathaṃ saṃprāpa rādhikām ।। 1 ।। sarvātmanaśca kṛṣṇasya patnīṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjitām ।। kathaṃ viṇmūtradhārī ca siṣeve parameśvarīm ।। 2 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe purā vidhiḥ ।। yatpādāmbhojareṇūnāṃ labdhaye puṣkare vibhuḥ ।। 3 ।। kathaṃ dadarśa tāṃ devo mahālakṣmīṃ purā satīm ।। durdarśāmapi yuṣmākaṃ dṛśyā sā'bhūtkathaṃ nṛṇām ।। 4 ।। kathaṃ trijagatāṃ dhātā tasmai tatkavacaṃ dadau ।। dhyānaṃ pūjāvidhiṃ stotraṃ tasyā vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 5 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। svāyambhuvo manurdevi manūnāmādireva ca ।। brahmātmajastapasvī ca śatarūpāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।।6।। uttānapādastatputrastatputro dhruva eva ca ।। dhruvasya kīrtirvikhyātastrailokye śailakanyake ।।7।। utkalastasya putraśca nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। sahasraṃ rājasūyānāṃ puṣkare sa cakāra ha ।। 8 ।। sarvāṇi ratnapātrāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। amūlyaratnarāśīnāṃ sahasraṃ tejasā vṛtam ।। 9 ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rājā yajñānte sa mahotsave ।। dṛṣṭvā tacchobhanaṃ yajñaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ priye ।। 10 ।। suyajñaṃ nāma nṛpatiṃ cakāra surasaṃsadi ।। sa ca rājā suyajñaśca manuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। 11 ।। annadātā ratnadātā dātā vai sarvasampadām ।। daśalakṣaṃ gavāṃ caiva ratnaśṛṅgaparicchadam ।। 12 ।। nityaṃ dadau sa viprebhyo mudāyuktaḥ sadakṣiṇam ।। gavāṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇāṃ dadau nityaṃ mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 13 ।। supakvāni ca māṃsāni brāhmaṇebhyaśca pārvati ।। ṣaṭkoṭīrbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ ।। 14 ।। coṣyaiścarvyairlehyapeyairatitṛptaṃ dine dine ।। vipralakṣaṃ sūpakāraṃ bhojayāmāsa tatparam ।। 15 ।। pūrṇamannaṃ ca sūpāktaṃ sagavyaṃ māṃsavarjitam ।। viprā bhojanakāle ca manuvaṃśasamudbhavam ।। 16 ।। na tuṣṭuvuḥ suyajñaṃ ca tuṣṭuvustatpitṝṃśca te ।। dine suyajñayajñānte ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣakoṭayaḥ ।। 17 ।। cakruḥ subhojanaṃ viprāścātitṛptāśca sundari ।। gṛhītāni ca ratnāni svagṛhaṃ voḍhumakṣamāḥ ।। 18 ।। vṛṣalebhyo daduḥ kiñcitkiñcitpathi ca tatyajuḥ ।। viprāṇāṃ bhojanānte ca viprānyebhyo dadau nṛpaḥ ।। 19 ।। tathāpyurvaritaṃ tatra cānnarāśisahasrakam ।। kṛtvā yajñaṃ mahābāhuḥ samuvāsa svasaṃsadi ।। ।। 20 ।। ratnendrasārasaṃklṛptacchatrakoṭisamanvite ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye paṭṭavastraiḥ susaṃskṛte ।। 21 ।। candanādisusaṃsṛṣṭe ramye candanapallavaiḥ ।। śākhāyuktaiḥ pūrṇakumbhai rambhāvṛkṣaiśca śobhite ।। 22 ।। candanāgurukastūrīvanasindūrasaṃskṛte ।। vasuvāsavacandrendrarudrāditya samanvite ।। 23 ।। munināradamanvādibrahmaviṣṇuśivānvite ।। etasminnantare tatra vipra ekaḥ samāyayau ।। 24 ।। rūkṣo malinavāsāśca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca mālyacandanacarcitam ।। 25 ।। rājānamāśiṣaṃ cakre sasmitaḥ sampuṭāñjaliḥ ।। praṇanāma nṛpastaṃ ca nottasthau kiṃcideva hi ।।26।। sabhāsadaśca nottasthurjahasuḥ svalpameva ca ।। munibhyo'pi ca devebhyo namaskṛtya dvijottamaḥ ।। 27 ।। śaśāpa nṛpatiṃ krodhāttatrātiṣṭhanniraṃkuśaḥ ।। gaccha dūramato rājyādbhraṣṭaśrīrbhava pāmara ।। 28 ।। bhavāciraṃ galatkuṣṭhī buddhihīno'pyupadrutaḥ ।। ityuktvā kampitaḥ krodhātsabhāsthāñchaptumudyataḥ ।। 29 ।। ye yatra jahasuḥ sarve samuttasthuḥ sabhāsadaḥ ।। sarve cakruḥ praṇāmaṃ te krodhaṃ tatyāja vāḍavaḥ ।। 30 ।। praṇamyāgatya rājā taṃ ruroda bhayakātaraḥ ।। nissasāra sabhāmadhyāddhṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 31 ।। brāhmaṇo gūḍharūpī ca prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। tatpaścānmunayaḥ sarve prayayurbhayakātarāḥ ।। 32 ।। he vipra tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti samuccāryya punaḥ punaḥ ।। pulahaśca pulastyaśca pracetā bhṛguraṃgirāḥ ।। 33 ।। marīciḥ kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭhaḥ kratureva ca ।। śukro bṛhaspati ścaiva durvāsā lomaśastathā ।। 34 ।। gautamaśca kaṇādaśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanaḥ kaṭhaḥ ।। pāṇinirjājaliścaiva ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।। 35 ।। taittiriścāpyāpiśalirmārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca voḍhuḥ pailaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 36 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānnaranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। parāśaro jaratkāruḥ saṃvarttaḥ karabhastathā ।। 37 ।। bharadvājaśca vālmīkiraurvaśca cyavanastathā ।। agastyo 'trirutathyaśca saṅkartā''stīka āsuriḥ ।। 38।। śilālirlāṅgaliścaiva śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ।। gargo vatsaḥ pañcaśikho jamadagniśca devalaḥ ।। 39 ।। jaigīṣavyo vāmadevo vālakhilyādayastathā ।। śaktirdakṣaḥ kardamaśca praskannaḥ kapilastathā ।। 40 ।। viśvāmitraśca kautsaścāpyṛcīko'pyaghamarṣaṇaḥ ।। ete cānye ca munayaḥ pitaro'gnirharipriyā ।।41।। dikpālā devatāḥ sarvā vipraṃ paścātsamāyayuḥ।। brāhmaṇaṃ bodhayāmāsurvāsayāmāsurīśvari ।। 42 ।। samūcustaṃ krameṇaiva nītiṃ nītiviśāradāḥ ।। 43 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde rādhopākhyāne suyajñopākhyānaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।50।।
<2.51> śrīpārvatyuvāca ।। kimūcurbrāhmaṇaṃ brahmanbrāhmaṇā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।। nītijñā nītivacanaṃ tanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। santoṣya taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca stavena vinayena ca ।। krameṇa vaktumārebhe munisaṃgho varānane ।। 2 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca ।। tvatpaścādāgatā lakṣmīḥ kīrttiḥ sattvaṃ yaśastathā ।। suśīlaṃ ca mahaiśvaryaṃ pitaro'gniḥ surāstathā ।। 3 ।। āgatā nṛpagehebhyaḥ kṛtvā bhraṣṭaśriyaṃ nṛpam ।। bhava tuṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭha cāśutoṣaśca vāḍavaḥ ।।4।। brāhmaṇānāṃ tu hṛdayaṃ komalaṃ navanītavat ।। śuddhaṃ sunirmalaṃ caiva mārjitaṃ tapasā mune ।। 5 ।। kṣamasvāgaccha viprendra śuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam ।। āśiṣaṃ kuru tasmai tvaṃ pavitrapadareṇunā ।।6।। bhṛguruvāca ।। atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivarttate ।। pitarastasya devāśca vahniścaiva tathaiva ca ।। 7 ।। nirāśāḥ pratigacchanti cātitherapratigrahāt।। kṣamasvāgaccha viprendra śuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam ।। 8 ।। strīghnairgoghnaiḥ kṛtaghnaiśca brahmaghnairgurutalpagaiḥ ।। tulyadoṣo bhavatyetairyasyātithiranarcitaḥ ।। 9 ।। pulastya uvāca ।। paśyanti ye vakradṛṣṭyā cātithiṃ gṛhamāgatam ।। dattvā svapāpaṃ tasmai tatpuṇyamādāya gacchati ।। 10 ।। kṣamasva nṛpadoṣaṃ ca gaccha vatsa yathāsukham ।। rājā svakarmadoṣeṇa nottasthau tatkṣamāṃ kuru ।। 11 ।। pulaha uvāca ।। rājaśriyā vidyayā vā brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate ।। viprastrisandhyāhīno yaḥ śrīhīnaḥ kṣatriyo bhavet ।। 12 ।। ekādaśīvihīnaśca viṣṇunaivedyavañcitaḥ ।। kṣamasvāgaccha viprendra śuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam ।। 13 ।। kraturuvāca।। brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā'pi vaiśyo vā śūdra eva ca।। dīkṣāhīno bhavetso'pi brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate।।14।। dhanahīnaḥ putrahīno bhāryyāhīno bhaveddhruvam ।। kṣamasvāgaccha bhagavañchuddhaṃ kuru nṛpālayam ।। 15 ।। aṅgirā uvāca ।। jñānavānbrāhmaṇo bhūtvā brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate।। vṛṣavāho bhavetso'pi bhārate saptajanmasu।।16।। marīciruvāca।। puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca devaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ gurum।। viṣṇubhaktivihīnaśca sa bhavedyo'vamanyate ।। 17 ।। kaśyapa uvāca ।। vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yo'satyamavamanyate ।। viṣṇumantravihīnaśca tatpūjāvirato bhavet ।।18।। pracetā uvāca ।। atithiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā nābhyutthānaṃ karoti yaḥ ।। pitṛbhaktivihīnassyātsa bhavedbhārate bhuvi।।19।। prāpnoti kauñjarīṃ yoniṃ sa mūḍhaḥ saptajanmasu ।। śīghraṃ gaccha dvijaśreṣṭha rājñe dehyāśiṣaśśubhāḥ ।। 20।। durvāsā uvāca ।। guruṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā'pi devatāpratimāmapi ।। dṛṣṭvā śīghraṃ na praṇametsa bhavetsūkaro bhuvi ।।21।। mithyāsākṣī ca bhavati tathā viśvāsaghātakaḥ ।। kṣamasva sarvamasmākamātithyagrahaṇaṃ kuru ।। 22 ।। rājovāca ।। chalena kathito dharmo yuṣmābhirmunipuṅgavaiḥ ।। sarvaṃ kṛtvā ca vispaṣṭaṃ māṃ mūḍhaṃ bodhayantvaho ।। 23 ।। strīghnagoghnakṛtaghnānāṃ gurustrīgāmināṃ tathā ।। brahmaghnānāṃ ca ko doṣo brūta māṃ yogināṃ varāḥ ।। 24 ।। vasiṣṭha uvāca ।। kāmato govadhe rājanvarṣaṃ tīrthaṃ bhramennaraḥ ।। yavayāvakabhojī ca kareṇa ca jalaṃ pibet ।। 25 ।। tadā dhenuśataṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadakṣiṇam ।। dattvā muñcati pāpācca bhojayitvā śataṃ dvijān ।। 26 ।। prāyaścitte tu vai cīrṇe sarvapāpānna mucyate ।। pāpāvaśeṣādbhavati duḥkhī cāṇḍāla eva ca ।। 27 ।। ātideśikahatyāyāṃ tadardhaṃ phalamaśnute ।। prāyaścittānukalpena sarvapāpānna mucyate।।।। 28 ।। śukra uvāca ।। gohatyādviguṇaṃ pāpaṃ strīhatyāyāṃ bhaveddhruvam ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kālasūtre vaseddhruvam ।। 29 ।। tato bhavenmahāpāpī sūkaraḥ saptajanmasu ।। tato bhavati sarpaśca saptajanmanyataḥ śuciḥ ।। 30 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। strīhatyādviguṇaṃ pāpaṃ brahmahatyākṛto bhavet ।। lakṣavarṣaṃ mahāghore kumbhīpāke vaseddhruvam।। 33 ।। tato bhavenmahāpāpī viṣṭhākīṭaḥ śatābdakam।। tato bhavati sarpaśca saptajanmanyataḥ śuciḥ ।। 32 ।। gautama uvāca ।। doṣaḥ kṛtaghne rājendra brahmahatyācaturguṇaḥ ।। niṣkṛtirnāsti vedoktā kṛtaghnānāṃ ca niścitam ।। 33 ।। rājovāca ।। lakṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। kṛtaghnaḥ katidhā proktaḥ keṣu ko doṣa eva ca।।34।। ṛṣyaśṛṅga uvāca ।। kṛtaghnāḥ ṣoḍaśavidhāḥ sāmavede nirūpitāḥ ।। sarvaḥ pratyekadoṣeṇa pratyekaṃ phalamaśnute ।। 35 ।। kṛte satye ca puṇye ca svadharme tapasi sthite ।। pratijñāyāṃ ca dāne ca svagoṣṭhīparipālane ।। 36 ।। gurukṛtye devakṛtye kāmyakṛtye dvijārcane ।। nityakṛtye ca viśvāse paradharmapradānayoḥ ।। 37 ।। etānyo hanti pāpiṣṭhaḥ sa kṛtaghna iti smṛtaḥ ।। eteṣāṃ santi lokāśca tajjanma bhinnayoniṣu ।। 38 ।। yānyāṃśca narakāṃste ca yānti rājendra pāpinaḥ ।। te te ca narakāḥ santi yamaloke suniścitam ।।39।। suyajña uvāca।। ke kiṃ kṛtvā kṛtaghnāśca kāṃskāngacchanti rauravān ।। pratyekaṃ śrotumicchāmi vaktumarhasi me prabho।।।। 40 ।। kātyāyana uvāca ।। kṛtvā śapatharūpaṃ ca satyaṃ hanti na pālayet ।। sa kṛtaghnaḥ kālasūtre vasedeva caturyugam ।। 41 ।। saptajanmasu kākaśca saptajanmasu pecakaḥ ।। tataḥ śūdro mahāvyādhiḥ saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।। 42 ।। śrīsanandana uvāca ।। puṇyaṃ kṛtvā vadatyeva kīrtivarddhanahetunā ।। sa kṛtaghnastaptasūrmyāṃ vasatyeva yugatrayam ।। 43 ।। pañcajanmasu maṇḍūkastriṣu janmasu karkaṭaḥ ।। tadā mūko mahāvyādhirdaridraśca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 44 ।। sanātana uvāca ।। svadharmaṃ hanti yo vipraḥ sandhyātrayavivarjitaḥ ।। atarpayaṃśca yaḥ snāti viṣṇunaivedyavarjitaḥ ।। 45 ।। viṣṇupūjāvihīnaśca viṣṇumantravihīnakaḥ ।। ekādaśīvihīnaḥ śrīkṛṣṇajanmadine tadā ।।।। 46 ।। śivarātrau ca yo bhuṅkte śrīrāmanavamīdine ।। pitṛkṛtyādihīno yaḥ sa kṛtaghra iti smṛtaḥ ।। 47 ।। kumbhīpāke vasatyeva yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। tataścāṇḍālatāṃ yāti saptajanmasu niścitam ।। 48 ।। śatajanmani gṛdhraśca śatajanmani sūkaraḥ ।। tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaśca śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārakaḥ ।। 49 ।। tato bhavejjanma sapta brāhmaṇo vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca bhavetsaptasu janmasu ।।।। 50 ।। dvijo bhūtvā saptajanau bhārate vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। bhuktvā svabhogaleśaṃ ca bhramitvā yāti rauravam ।। 51 ।। punaḥ punaḥ pāpayoniṃ narakaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। tato bhavedgardabhaśca mārjāraḥ pañcajanmasu ।। 52 ।। pañcajanmasu maṇḍūko bhavecchuddhastataḥ kramāt।।53।। suyajña uvāca ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakaraṇe śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhane ।। śūdrānnabhojane vā'pi śūdrastrīgamane'pi ca।।54।। brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ko doṣo vṛṣāṇāṃ vāhane tathā ।। etānsarvānsamālocya brūhi māṃ niścayaṃ mune ।। 55 ।। parāśara uvāca ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca yo vipro jñānadurbalaḥ ।। asipatre vasatyeva yugānāmekasaptatiḥ ।। 56 ।। tato bhavedgardabhaśca mūṣikaḥ saptajanmasu।। tailakīṭassaptajanmasvataḥ śuddho bhavennaraḥ ।। 57 ।। jaratkāruruvāca ।। bhṛtyadvārā svayaṃ vā'pi yo vipro vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। sa kṛtaghna iti khyātaḥ prasiddho bhārate nṛpa ।। 58 ।। brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tannityaṃ vṛṣatāḍane ।। vṛṣapṛṣṭhe bhāradānātpāpaṃ taddviguṇaṃ bhaveta ।। 59 ।। sūryyātape vāhayedyaḥ kṣudhitaṃ tṛṣṭitaṃ vṛṣam ।। brahmahatyāśataṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 60 ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ viprāṇāṃ vṛṣavāhinām ।। nādhikāro bhavetteṣāṃ pitṛdevārcane nṛpa ।।61 ।। lālākuṇḍe vasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ।। viṣṭhābhakṣyaṃ mūtrajalaṃ tatra tasya bhaveddhruvam ।। 62 ।। trisandhyaṃ tāḍayettaṃ ca śūlena yamakiṅkaraḥ ।। ulkāṃ dadāti mukhataḥ sūcyā kṛntati santatam ।।63।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet ।। tataḥ kākaḥ pañcajanmasvathaivaṃ baka eva ca ।। 64 ।। pañcajanmasu gṛdhraśca śṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu ।। tato daridraḥ śūdraśca mahāvyādhistataḥ śuciḥ ।। 69 ।। bhāradvāja uvāca ।। śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī yaḥ sa kṛtaghna iti smṛtaḥ ।। vayaḥpramāṇāṃ rājendra brahmahatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।। 66 ।। tattulyayonibhramaṇāttattulyanarakācchuciḥ ।। yo doṣo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhane ।। 67 ।। tāvadeva bhaveddoṣaḥ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojane ।। 68 ।। vibhāṇḍaka uvāca ।। pitṛśrāddhe ca śūdrāṇāṃ bhuṅkte yo brāhmaṇo'dhamaḥ।। surāpītī brahmaghātī pitṛdevārcanādbahiḥ ।। 69 ।। mārkaṇḍeya uvāca ।। yo doṣo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śūdrastrīgamane nṛpa ।। ahaṃ vakṣyāmi vedoktaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। 70।। kṛtaghnānāṃ pradhānaśca yo vipro vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। kṛmidaṃṣṭre vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa।।71।। kṛmibhakṣyo bhavedvipro vihvalo yamakiṅkaraiḥ ।। pratimāṃ tāṃ taptalauhīmāśleṣayati nityaśaḥ ।। 72 ।। tataśca puṃścalīyonau kṛmirbhavati niścitam ।। evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca tataḥ śūdrastataḥ śuciḥ।।73।। suyajña uvāca।। anyeṣāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ vada karmaphalaṃ mune।। ślāghyo me brāhmaśāpaśca kasya sampadvinā''padam ।। 74 ।। dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama ।। āgatāstu yato muktā madgehe munayaḥ surāḥ ।। 75 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvi0 pra0 nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde nṛpamunisaṃvāde rādhopākhyāne karmavipāko nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 51 ।।
<2.52> śrīpārvatyuvāca ।। anyeṣāṃ ca kṛtaghnānāṃ yadyatkarmaphalaṃ prabho ।। teṣāṃ kimūcurmunayo vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ ।। 1 ।। śrīmaheśvara uvāca ।। praśnaṃ kurvati rājendre sarveṣu muniṣu priye ।। tatra pravaktumārebhe ṛṣirnārāyaṇo mahān ।। 2 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ harettu yaḥ ।। sa kṛtaghna iti jñeyaḥ phalaṃ ca śṛṇu bhūmipa ।। 3 ।। yāvanto reṇavaḥ siktā viprāṇāṃ netrabindubhiḥ ।। tāvadvarṣasahasraṃ ca śūlapote sa tiṣṭhati ।। 4 ।। taptāṅgāraṃ ca tadbhakṣyaṃ pānaṃ vai taptamūtrakam ।। taptāṅgāre ca śayanaṃ tāḍito yamakiṅkaraiḥ ।। 5 ।। tadante ca mahāpāpī viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi devamānena bhārate ।। 6 ।। tato bhavedbhūmihīnaḥ prajāhīnaśca mānavaḥ ।। daridraḥ kṛpaṇo rogī śūdro nindyastataḥ śuciḥ ।।7।। nārada uvāca ।। hanti yaḥ parakīrtti ca svakīrttiṃ vā narādhamaḥ।। sa kṛtaghna iti khyātastatphalaṃ ca niśāmaya ।। 8 ।। andhakūpe vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa।। kīṭairnakulagṛdhraiśca bhakṣitaḥ satataṃ nṛpa ।। 9 ।। taptakṣārodakaṃ pāpī nityaṃ pibati vai tataḥ ।। saptajanmasvataḥ sarpaḥ kākaḥ pañcasvataḥ śuciḥ ।। 10 ।। devala uvāca ।। brahmasvaṃ vā gurusvaṃ vā devasvaṃ vā'pi yo haret ।। sa kṛtaghna iti jñeyo mahāpāpī ca bhārate ।।11।। avaṭode vasetso'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। tato bhavetsurāpī sa tataḥ śūdrastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 12 ।। jaigīṣavya uvāca ।। pitṛmātṛgurūṃścāpi bhaktihīno na pālayet ।। vācā'pi tāḍayettāṃśca sa kṛtaghra iti smṛtaḥ ।। vācā ca tāḍayennityaṃ svāminaṃ kulaṭā ca yā ।। 13 ।। sā kṛtaghnīti vikhyātā bhārate pāpinī varā ।। vahnikuṇḍaṃ mahāghoraṃ tau prayātassuniścitam ।। 14 ।। tatra vahnau vasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ।। tato bhavejjalaukāśca saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।। 15 ।। vālmīkiruvāca ।। yathā taruṣu vṛkṣatvaṃ sarvatra na jahāti ca ।। tathā kṛtaghnatā rājansarvapāpeṣu varttate ।। 16 ।। mithyāsākṣyaṃ yo dadāti kāmātkrodhāttathā bhayāt ।। sabhāyāṃ pākṣikaṃ vakti sa kṛtaghna iti smṛtaḥ ।। 17 ।। puṇyamātraṃ cāpi rājanyo hanti sa kṛtaghnakaḥ ।। sarvatrāpi ca sarveṣāṃ puṇyahānau kṛtaghnatā ।। 18 ।। mithyāsākṣyaṃ pākṣikaṃ vā bhārate vakti yo nṛpa ।। yāvadindrasahasraṃ ca sarpakuṇḍe vaseddhruvam ।। 19 ।। santataṃ veṣṭitaḥ sarpairbhīto vai bhakṣitastathā ।। bhuṅkte ca sarvaviṇmūtraṃ yamadūtena tāḍitaḥ ।। 20 ।। kṛkalāso bhavettatra bhārate saptajanmasu ।। saptajanmasu maṇḍūkaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saptabhiḥ saha ।। 21 ।। tato bhavedvai vṛkṣaśca mahāraṇye tu śālmaliḥ ।। tato bhavennaro mūkastataḥ śūdrastataḥ śuciḥ ।। 22 ।। āstīka uvāca ।। gurvaṅganānāṃ gamane mātṛgāmī bhavennaraḥ ।। narāṇāṃ mātṛgamane prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate ।। 23 ।। bhārate ca nṛpaśreṣṭa yo doṣo mātṛgāminām ।। brāhmaṇīgamane caiva śūdrāṇāṃ tāvadeva hi ।। 24 ।। brāhmaṇyāstāvadeva syāddoṣaḥ śūdreṇa maithune ।। kanyānāṃ putrapatnīnāṃ śvaśrūṇāṃ gamane tathā ।। 25 ।। sagarbhabhrātṛpatnīnā bhaginīnāṃ tathaiva ca ।। doṣaṃ vakṣyāmi rājendra yadāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 26 ।। yaḥ karoti mahāpāpī caitābhiḥ saha maithunam ।। jīvanmṛto bhavetso'pi caṇḍālo'spṛśya eva ca ।। 27 ।। nādhikāro bhavettasya sūryyamaṇḍaladarśane ।। śālagrāmaṃ tajjalaṃ ca tulasyāśca dalaṃ jalam ।। 28 ।। sarvatīrthajalaṃ caiva viprapādodakaṃ tathā ।। spraṣṭuṃ ca naiva śaknoti viṭtulyaḥ pātakī naraḥ ।। 29 ।। daivaṃ guruṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca namaskartuṃ na cārhati ।। viṣṭhādhikaṃ tadannaṃ ca jalaṃ mūtrādhikaṃ tathā ।। 30 ।। devatāḥ pitaro viprā naiva gṛhṇanti bhārate ।। bhavettadaṅgavātena tīrthamaṅgāravāhanam ।। 31 ।। saptarātraṃ hyupavaseddaivasparśāttathā dvijaḥ ।। bhārakrāntā ca pṛthivī tadbhāraṃ voḍhumakṣamā ।। 32 ।। tatpāpātpatito deśaḥ kanyāvikrayiṇo yathā ।। tatsparśācca tadālāpācchayanāśrayabhojanāt ।। 33 ।। nṛṇāṃ ca tatsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। kumbhīpāke vasetso'pi yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam ।। 34 ।। divāniśaṃ bhramettatra cakrāvarttaṃ nirantaram ।। dagdho vā'gniśikhābhiśca yamadūtaiśca tāḍitaḥ ।। 35 ।। evaṃ nityaṃ mahāpāpī bhuṅkte nirayayātanām ।। viṣṭhāhāraśca sarvatra kumbhīpāke'tha pātitaḥ ।। 36 ।। gate prākṛtike ghore mahati pralaye tathā ।। punaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ samārambhe tadvidho vā bhavetpunaḥ ।। 37 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet ।। tato bhavati caṇḍālo bhāryyāhīno napuṃsakaḥ ।।38।। saptajanmasu śuddhaśca galatkuṣṭhī napuṃsakaḥ ।। tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaścāpyandhaḥ kuṣṭhī napuṃsakaḥ।।39।। labdhvaivaṃ sapta janmāni mahāpāpī bhavecchuciḥ ।। 40 ।। munaya ūcuḥ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamasmābhirvo yathāgamam ।। ebhistulyo bhaveddoṣo'pyatithīnāṃ parābhave।।41।। praṇāmaṃ kuru viprendraṃ gṛhaṃ prāpaya niścitam ।। saṃpūjya brāhmaṇaṃ yatnādgṛhītvā brāhmaṇāśiṣam ।।42।। vanaṃ gaccha mahārāja tapasyāṃ kuru satvaram।। brahmaśāpairvinirmuktaḥ punarevāgamiṣyasi।।43।। ityuktvā munayaḥ sarve yayustūrṇaṃ svamandiram।। surāścāpi ca rājāno bandhuvargāśca pārvati ।। 44 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde rādhopākhyāne suyajñopākhyāne karmavipāko nāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 52 ।।
<2.53> śrīpārvatyuvāca ।। gateṣu munisaṃgheṣu śrutvā karmaphalaṃ nṛṇām ।। kiṃ cakāra nṛpaśreṣṭho brahmaśāpena vihvalaḥ ।। 1 ।। atithirbrāhmaṇo vā'pi kiṃ cakāra tadā prabho ।। jagāma nṛpagehaṃ vā na vā tadvaktumarhasi ।। 2 ।। maheśvara uvāca ।। gateṣu munisaṃgheṣu nindāgrasto narādhipaḥ ।। preritaśca vasiṣṭhena dharmiṣṭhena purodhasā ।।।। 3 ।। papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau pādayorbrāhmaṇasya ca ।। tyaktvā manyuṃ dvijaśreṣṭho dadau tasmai śubhāśiṣam ।। 4 ।। sasmitaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktamanyuṃ kṛpāmayam ।। uvāca nṛpatiśreṣṭhaḥ sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 5 ।। rājovāca ।। kutra vaṃśe bhavāñjātaḥ kiṃ nāma bhavataḥ prabho ।। kiṃnāmā vā'pi tadbrūhi kva vāsaḥ kathamāgataḥ ।।6।। viprarūpī svayaṃ viṣṇurgūḍhaḥ kapaṭamānuṣaḥ ।। sākṣātsa mūrtimānagniḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। 7 ।। ko vā guruste bhagavanniṣṭadevaśca bhārate ।। tava veṣaḥ kathamayaṃ jñānapūrṇasya sāmpratam ।।8।। gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ nikhilamaiśvaryyaṃ kośameva ca ।। svabhṛtyaṃ kuru me putraṃ māṃ ca dāsīṃ striyaṃ mune ।। 9 ।। saptasāgarasaṃyuktāṃ saptadvīpāṃ vasundharām ।। aṣṭādaśopadvīpāḍhyāṃ saśailavanaśobhitām ।। 10 ।। mayā bhṛtyena śādhi tvaṃ rājendro bhava bhārate ।। ratnendrasārakhacite tiṣṭha siṃhāsane vare ।।।। 11 ।। nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṅgavaḥ ।। uvāca paramaṃ tattvamajñātaṃ sarvadurlabham ।। 12 ।। atithiruvāca ।। marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putrastatputraḥ kaśyapaḥ svayam ।। kaśyapasya sutāḥ sarve prāptā devatvamīpsitam।।13।। teṣu tvaṣṭā mahājñānī cakāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ।।14।। siṣeve brāhmaṇārthaṃ ca devadevaṃ hariṃ param।। nārāyaṇādvaraṃ prāpa vipraṃ tejasvinaṃ sutam ।। 15।। tato babhūva tejasvī viśvarūpastapodhanaḥ।। purodhasaṃ cakārendro vākpatau taṃ krudhā gate।।16।। mātāmahebhyo daityebhyo dattavantaṃ ghṛtāhutim ।। ciccheda taṃ śunāsīro brāhmaṇaṃ māturājñayā।।17।। viśvarūpasya tanayo virūpo matpitā nṛpa ।। ahaṃ ca sutapā nāma virāgī kaśyapo dvijaḥ ।। । 18।। mahādevo mama gururvidyājñānamanupradaḥ ।। abhīṣṭadevaḥ sarvātmā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 19 ।। taccintayāmi pādābjaṃ na me vāñchā 'sti sampadi ।। sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaṃ rādhikāpateḥ ।। 20।। tena dattaṃ na gṛhṇāmi vinā tatsevanaṃ śubham ।। brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā manye'haṃ jalabimbavat ।। 21 ।। bhaktivyavahitaṃ mithyābhramameva tu naśvaram ।। indratvaṃ vā manutvaṃ vā sauratvaṃ vā narādhipa।।22।। na manye jalarekheti nṛpatvaṃ kena gaṇyate ।। śrutvā suyajñayajñe te munīnāṃ gamanaṃ nṛpa ।। 23 ।। lālasāṃ viṣṇubhaktiṃ te saṃprāpayitumāgataḥ ।। kevalānugṛhītastvaṃ nahi śapto mayā'dhunā।।24।। samuddhṛtaśca patito ghore nimne bhavārṇave ।। nahyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ ।। 29 ।। te punantyurukālena kṛṣṇabhaktāśca darśanāt ।। rājannirgamyatāṃ gehāddehi rājyaṃ sutāya ca ।। 26 ।। putre nyasya priyāṃ sādhvīṃ gaccha vatsa vanaṃ drutam ।। brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva bhūmipa ।। 27 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhaja rādheśaṃ paramātmā namīśvaram ।। dhyānasādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādibhiḥ ।। 28 ।। āvirbhūtaistirobhūtaiḥ prākṛtaiḥ prakṛteḥ param ।। brahmā sraṣṭā hariḥ pātā haraḥ saṃhārakārakaḥ ।। 29 ।। dikpālāśca digīśāśca bhramantyevāsya māyayā ।। yadājñayā vāti vāyuḥ sūryyo dinapatiḥ sadā।। ।। 30 ।। niśāpatiḥ śaśī śaśvatsasyasusnigdhatākaraḥ ।। kālena mṛtyuḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvaviśveṣu vai bhavet ।। 31 ।। kāle varṣati śakraśca dahatyagniśca kālataḥ।। bhītavadviśvaśāstā ca prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ।।32।। kālaḥ saṃharate kāle kāle sṛjati pāti ca।। svadeśe vai samudraśca svadeśe vai vasundharā।।33।। svadeśe parvatāścaiva svāḥ pātālāḥ svadeśataḥ।। svarlokāḥ sapta rājendra saptadvīpā vasundharā।।34।। śailasāgarasaṃyuktāḥ pātālāḥ sapta caiva hi ।। brahmāṇḍamebhirlokaiśca ḍimbākāraṃ jalaplutam ।।35।। santyeva pratividhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। surā narāśca nāgāśca gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ ।।36।। āpātālādbrahmalokaparyyantaṃ ḍimbarūpakam ।। idameva tu vidhyaṇḍamuttamaṃ kṛtrimaṃ nṛpa ।। 37 ।। nābhipadme virāḍviṣṇoḥ kṣudrasya jalaśāyinaḥ ।। sthitaṃ yathā padmabījaṃ karṇikāyāṃ ca paṅkaje ।।38।। evaṃ so'pi śayānassyājjalatalpe suviplute ।। dhyāyatyeva mahāyogī prākṛtaḥ prakṛteḥ param ।। 39 ।। kālabhītaśca kāleśaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ।। । mahāviṣṇorlomakūpasādhāraḥ so'sti vistṛte ।। kūpeṣu lomnāṃ pratyekamevaṃ viśvāni santi vai ।। 40 ।। mahāviṣṇorgātralomnāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca bhūmipa ।। saṃkhyāṃ karttuṃ na śaknoti kṛṣṇo'pyanyasya kā kathā ।।41।। mahāviṣṇuḥ prākṛtikaḥ so'pi ḍimbodbhavaḥ sadā।। bhavetkṛṣṇecchayā ḍimbaḥ prakṛtergarbhasambhavaḥ ।। 42 ।। sarvādhāro mahānviṣṇuḥ kālabhītaḥ sa śaṅkitaḥ ।। kāleśaṃ dhyāyati svairaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ।। 43 ।। evaṃ ca sarvaviśvasthā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। mahānvirāṭ kṣudravirāṭ sarve prākṛtikāḥ sadā ।।44।। । sā sarvabījarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। kāle līnā ca kāleśe kṛṣṇe taṃ dhyāyati sma sā ।।45।। evaṃ sarve kālabhītāḥ prakṛtiḥ prākṛtāstathā ।। āvirbhūtāstirobhūtāḥ kālena paramātmani ।।46।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mahājñānaṃ sudurlabham ।। śivena guruṇā dattaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।47।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde rādhopākhyāne suyajñaṃ pratyatithyupadeśo nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।53।।
<2.54> rājovāca ।। kutrādhāro mahāviṣṇoḥ sarvādhārasya tasya ca ।। kālabhītasya kati ca kālamāyā munīśvara ।। 1 ।। kṣudrasya katicitkālaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prakṛtestathā ।। manorindrasya candrasya sūryyasyāyustathaiva ca ।। 2 ।। anyeṣāṃ vai janānāṃ ca prākṛtānāṃ paraṃ vayaḥ ।। vedoktaṃ suvicāryyaṃ ca vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 3 ।। viśvānāmūrdhvabhāge ca kassyādvā loka eva saḥ ।। kathayasva mahābhāga sandehacchedanaṃ kuru ।। 4 ।। muniruvāca ।। goloko nṛpa viśvānāṃ vistṛtaśca nabhassamaḥ ।। tathā nityaṃ ḍimbarūpaśśrīkṛṣṇecchāsamudbhavaḥ ।। 9 ।। jalena paripūrṇaśca kṛṣṇasya mukhabindunā ।। sṛṣṭyunmukhasyādisarge pariśrāntasya khelataḥ ।।6।। prakṛtyā saha yuktasya kalayā nijayā nṛpa ।। tatrādhāro mahāviṣṇorviśvādhārasya vistṛtaḥ ।।7।। prakṛtirgarbhasaṃryuktaḍimbodbhūtasya bhūmipa ।। suvistṛte jalādhāre śayānaśca mahāvirāṭ ।। 8 ।। rādheśvarasya kṛṣṇasya ṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। dūrvādalaśyāmarūpaḥ sasmitaśca caturbhujaḥ ।। 9 ।। vanamālādharaḥ śrīmāñchobhitaḥ pītavāsasā ।। ūrdhvaṃ nabhasi tadviṣṇornityavaikuṇṭha eva ca ।। 10।। ātmā''kāśasamo nityo vistṛtaścandrabimbavat ।। īśvarecchāsamudbhūto nirlakṣyaśca nirāśrayaḥ ।। 11 ।। ākāśavatsuvistāro ratnaughaiśca vinirmitaḥ ।। tatra nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānvanamālī caturbhujaḥ ।। 12 ।। lakṣmīsarasvatīgaṅgātulasīpatirīśvaraḥ ।। sunandanandakumudapārṣadādibhirāvṛtaḥ।।13।। sarveśaḥ sarvasiddheśo bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhābhūto dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ ।।14।। caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। ūrdhvaṃ vaikuṇṭhalokācca pañcāśatkoṭiyojanāta ।। 15 ।। goloko varttulākāro variṣṭhassarvalokataḥ ।। amūlyaratnakhacitairmandiraiśca vibhūṣitaḥ ।। 16 ।। ratnendrasārakhacitaiḥ stambhasopānacitritaiḥ ।। maṇīndradarpaṇāsaktaiḥ kapāṭaiḥ kalaśojjvalaiḥ ।। 17 ।। nānācitravicitraiśca śibiraiśca virājitaḥ ।। koṭiyojanavistīrṇo dairghye śataguṇastathā ।। virajāsaridākīrṇaiśśataśṛṃgaissuveṣṭitaḥ ।। 18 ।। saridardhapramāṇena dairghyeṇa ca tatena ca ।। śailārddhaparimāṇena yukto vṛndāvanena ca ।। ।। 19 ।। tadarddhamānavilasadrāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ ।। saricchailavanādīnāṃ madhye goloka eva ca ।। 20 ।। yathā paṃkajamadhye ca karṇikā sumanoharā ।। tatra gogopagopībhirgopīśo rāsamaṇḍale ।। 21 ।। rāseśvaryyā rādhikayā saṃyuktaḥ santataṃ nṛpa ।। dvibhujo muralīhastaḥ śiśurgopālarūpadhṛk ।।22।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhāno ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgo ratnamālāvirājitaḥ ।।23।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaśca ratnacchatreṇa śobhitaḥ ।। tathā sa priyagopālaiḥ sevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 24 ।। bhūṣitābhiśca gopībhirmālācandanacarcitaḥ।। sasmitaḥ sakaṭākṣābhiḥ suveṣābhiśca vīkṣitaḥ।।25।। kathito lokavistāro yathāśakti yathāgamam।। yathāśrutaṃ śambhuvaktrātkālamānaṃ niśāmaya ।। 26 ।। pātraṃ ṣaṭpalasaṃbhūtaṃ gabhīraṃ caturaṅgulam ।। 27 ।। svarṇamāṣakṛtacchidraṃ daṇḍaiśca caturaṃgulaiḥ ।। yāvajjalaplutaṃ pātraṃ tatkālaṃ daṇḍameva ca ।। 28 ।। daṇḍadvayaṃ muhūrtaṃ ca yāmastasya catuṣṭayam ।। vāsaraścāṣṭabhiryāmaiḥ pakṣastairdaśapañcabhiḥ ।। 29 ।। māso dvābhyāṃ ca pakṣābhyāṃ varṣaṃ dvādaśamāsakaiḥ ।। māsena vai narāṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tadaharniśam ।। 30 ।। kṛṣṇapakṣe dinaṃ proktaṃ śukle rātriḥ prakīrttitā ।। vatsareṇa narāṇāṃ ca devānāṃ ca divāniśam ।। 31 ।। ayanaṃ hyuttaramaho rātrirvai dakṣiṇāyanam ।। yugakarmānurūpaṃ ca narādīnāṃ vayo nṛpa ।। 32 ।। prakṛteḥ prākṛtānāṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ niśāmaya ।। kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam ।। 33 ।। divyairdvādaśasāhasraiḥ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। catvāri trīṇi ca dvayekaṃ sahasrāṇi kṛtādikam ।।34।। teṣāṃ ca sandhyāsandhyāṃśau dve sahasre prakīrtite ।। tricatvāriṃśakairlakṣaissaviṃśatisahasrakaiḥ ।। 35 ।। caturyugaṃ parimitaṃ naramānakrameṇa ca ।। lakṣaiśca saptadaśabhissāṣṭaviṃśasahasrakaiḥ ।। 36 ।। kṛtaṃ yugaṃ nṛmānena saṃkhyāvidbhiḥ prakīrttitam ।। sahasraiṣṣaṇṇavatibhirlakṣairdvādaśabhissaha ।। 37 ।। tretāyugaṃ parimitaṃ kālavidbhiḥ prakīrttitam ।। aṣṭalakṣaissaha mitaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭisahasrakam।।38।। parimāṇaṃ dvāparasya saṃkhyāvidbhiritīritam।। sadvātriṃśatsahasraiśca caturlakṣaiśca vatsaraiḥ।। nṛmānādvai kaliyugaṃ viduḥ kālavido bughāḥ।।39।। tatra sapta ca vārā vai tithayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ।। divārātryaśca pakṣau dvau māso varṣaṃ ca nirmitam।। 40।। tathā bhramati taccakramevamevaṃ caturyugam।। tathā yugāni rājendra tathā manvantarāṇi ca।।41।।। manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ।। evaṃ kramādbhramantyeva manavaśca caturdaśa।।42।। pañcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ ṣaṣṭyantaśatapañcakam ।। naramānayugaṃ caiva paraṃ manvantaraṃ smṛtam।।43।। ākhyānaṃ ca manūnāṃ ca dharmiṣṭhānāṃ narādhipa।। yacchrutaṃ śivavaktreṇa tattvaṃ matto niśāmaya।।44।। ādyo manurbrahmaputraḥ śatarūpā pativratā ।। dharmiṣṭhānāṃ variṣṭhaśca gariṣṭho manuṣu prabhuḥ।।45।। svāyambhuvaḥ śambhuśiṣyo viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ।। jīvanmukto mahājñānī bhavataḥ prapitāmahaḥ।।46।। rājasūyasahasraṃ ca cakre vai narmadātaṭe।। trilakṣamaśvamedhaṃ ca trilakṣaṃ naramedhakam।।47।। gomedhaṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ vidhivanmahadadbhutam ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ trikoṭīśca bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ ।। 48 ।। pañcalakṣagavāṃ māṃsaiḥ supakvairghṛtasaṃskṛtaiḥ ।। carvyaiṃścoṣyairlehyapeyairmiṣṭadravyaiḥ sudurlabhaiḥ।।49।। amūlyaratnalakṣaṃ ca daśakoṭisuvarṇakam ।। svarṇaśṛṅgayutaṃ divyaṃ gavāṃ lakṣaṃ supūjitam ।। ।। 50।। vahniśuddhāni vastrāṇi munīndrāṇāṃ ca lakṣakam ।। bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ gajendrāṇāṃ ca lakṣakam।। trilakṣamaśvaratnaṃ ca śātakuṃbhavibhūṣitam।।91।। sahasraṃ ratharatnaṃ ca śibikālakṣameva ca।। trikoṭisvarṇapātrāṇi sānnaṃ sajalamīpsitam।। trikoṭisvarṇabhūṣāśca karpūrādisuvāsitam।।52।। tāmbūlaṃ suvicitraṃ ca trikoṭisvarṇatalpakam।। ratnendrakhacitairmañcaiḥ racitairviśvakarmaṇā ।।53।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaiścitrai rājitaṃ mālyajālakaiḥ।। nityaṃ dadau brāhmaṇebhyo viṣṇuprītyā śivājñayā।।54।। saṃprāpya śaṃkarājjñānaṃ kṛṣṇamaṃtraṃ sudurlabham।। saṃprāpya kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ ca golokaṃ vai jagāma saḥ।।55।। dṛṣṭvā muktaṃ svaputraṃ ca prahaṣṭo'bhūtprajāpatiḥ।। tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraṃ tuṣṭaḥ sasṛje'nyaṃ manuṃ vidhiḥ।।56।। yataḥ svayambhuputro'yamataḥ svāyambhuvo manuḥ।। svārociṣo manuścaiva dvitīyo vahninandanaḥ।।57।। rājā vadānyo dharmiṣṭhaḥ svāyambhuvasamo mahān ।। priyavratasutāvanyau dvau manū dharmiṇāṃ varau ।। 58 ।। tau tṛtīyau caturthau ca vaiṣṇavau tāpasottamau ।। tau ca śaṅkaraśiṣyau ca kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇau ।। 59 ।। dharmiṣṭhānāṃ variṣṭhaśca raivataḥ pañcamo manuḥ ।। ṣaṣṭhaśca cākṣuṣo jñeyo viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।। 60 ।। śrāddhadevaḥ sūryasuto vaiṣṇavaḥ saptamo manuḥ ।। sāvarṇiḥ sūryatanayo vaiṣṇavo manuraṣṭamaḥ ।। 61 ।। navamo dakṣasāvarṇirviṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ।। daśamo brahmasāvarṇirbrahmajñānaviśāradaḥ ।। 62 ।। tataśca dharmasāvarṇirmanurekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। dharmiṣṭhaśca variṣṭhaśca vaiṣṇavavratatatparaḥ ।। ।। 63 ।। jñānī ca rudrasāvarṇirmanuśca dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। dharmātmā devasāvarṇirmanurevaṃ trayodaśaḥ ।। 64 ।। caturdaśo mahājñānī candrasāvarṇireva ca ।। yāvadāyurmanūnāṃ syādindrāṇāṃ tāvadeva hi ।। 65 ।। caturdaśendrāvacchinnaṃ brahmaṇo dinamucyate ।। tāvatī brahmaṇo rātriḥ sā ca brāhmī niśā nṛpa ।। 66 ।। kālarātriśca sā jñeyā vedeṣu parikīrttitā ।। brahmaṇo vāsare rājankṣudrakalpaḥ prakīrttitaḥ।। ।। 67 ।। saptakalpe ciraṃjīvī mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ ।। brahmalokādadhaḥ sarve lokā dagdhāśca tatra vai ।। 68 ।। utthitenaiva sahasā saṅkarṣaṇamukhāgninā ।। candrārkabrahmaputrāśca brahmalokaṃ gatā dhruvam ।।69।। brahmarātrivyatīte tu punaśca sasṛje vidhiḥ ।। tasyāṃ brahmaniśāyāṃ ca kṣudraḥ pralaya ucyate ।। 70 ।। devāśca manavaścaiva tatra dagdhā narādayaḥ ।। evaṃ triṃśaddivārātrairbrahmaṇo māsa eva ca ।। 71 ।। varṣaṃ dvādaśamāsaiśca brahmasambandhi caiva hi ।। evaṃ pañcadaśābde tu gate ca brahmaṇo nṛpa ।। dainaṃdinastu pralayo vedeṣu parikīrttitaḥ ।। ।। 72 ।। moharātriśca sā proktā vedavidbhiḥ purātanaiḥ ।। tatra sarve praṇaṣṭāssyuścandrārkādidigīśvarāḥ ।। 73 ।। ādityā vasavo rudrā manavo mānavādayaḥ ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva gandharvā rākṣasādayaḥ ।। 74 ।। mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca pecakaścirajīvinaḥ ।। indradyumnaśca nṛpatiścākūpāraśca kacchapaḥ ।।79।। nāḍījaṃgho bakaścaiva sarve naṣṭāśca tatra vai ।। brahmalokādadhaḥ sarve lokā nāgālayāstathā ।। ।। 76 ।। brahmalokaṃ yayuḥ sarve brahmaputrādayastathā ।। gate dainaṃdine brahmā lokāṃśca sasṛje punaḥ ।।77।। evaṃ śatābdaparyyantaṃ paramāyuḥ prajāpateḥ ।। brahmaṇaśca nipāte syānmahākalpo bhavennṛpa ।। 78 ।। prakīrtitā mahārātriḥ saiva ceha purātanaiḥ ।। brahmaṇaśca nipāte ca brahmāṇḍaugho jalaplutaḥ ।। 79 ।। devamātā ca sāvitrī vedā dharmmādayastathā ।। sarve praṇaṣṭā mṛtyuśca prakṛtiṃ ca śivaṃ vinā ।। 80 ।। nārāyaṇe pralīnāśca viśvasthā vaiṣṇavāstathā ।। kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā sarvarudragaṇaiḥ saha ।।81।। mṛtyuñjaye mahādeve pralīnaḥ sa tamo guṇaḥ ।। brahmaṇaśca nipātena nimeṣaḥ prakṛterbhavet ।। 82 ।। nārāyaṇasya śambhośca mahāviṣṇośca niścitam ।। nimeṣānte punaḥ sṛṣṭirbhavetkṛṣṇecchayā nṛpa ।। 83 ।। kṛṣṇo nimeṣarahito nirguṇaḥ prakṛte paraḥ ।। saguṇānāṃ nimeṣaśca kālasaṃkhyāvayomitaḥ ।। ।। 84 ।। nirguṇasya ca nityasya cādyantarahitasya ca ।। nimeṣāṇāṃ sahasreṇa prakṛterdaṇḍa ucyate ।। 89 ।। ṣaṣṭidaṇḍātmikāstasyā vāsaraśca prakīrttitaḥ ।। triṃśadrātriṃ dinairmāso varṣaṃ dvādaśamāsakaiḥ ।। 86 ।। evaṃ gate śatābde ca śrīkṛṣṇe prakṛterlayaḥ ।। prakṛtyāṃ ca pralīnāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇe prākṛto layaḥ ।। 87 ।। sarvānsaṃhṛtya sā caikā mahāviṣṇoḥ prasūśca yā ।। kṛṣṇavakṣasi līnā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।।88 ।। santo vadanti tāṃ durgāṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca parāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ satīm ।। 89 ।। buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca śrīkṛṣṇasyaiva nirguṇām ।। yanmāyāmohitāścaiva brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ।। 90।। vaiṣṇavāstāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ parāṃ rādhāṃ vadanti te ।। arddhāṅgāṃ ca mahālakṣmīḥ priyā nārāyaṇasya ca ।। 91 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca premṇā prāṇādhikāṃ varām ।। sthirapremamayīṃ śaktīṃ nirguṇāṃ nirguṇasya ca ।।92।। nārāyaṇaśca śambhuśca saṃhṛtya svagaṇānbahūn ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpī śrīkṛṣṇe līnaśca nirguṇe।। ।।93।। gopā gopyaśca gāvaśca savatsāśca narādhipa ।। sarve līnāḥ prakṛtyāṃ ca prakṛtiḥ parameśvare।।। mahāviṣṇau vilīnāśca te sarve kṣudraviṣṇavaḥ ।। mahāviṣṇuḥ prakṛtyāṃ ca sā caivaṃ paramātmani।।95।। prakṛtiryoganidrā ca śrīkṛṣṇanayanadvaye ।। adhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāraivaṃ māyayā ceśvarecchayā।।96।। prakṛtervāsaro yāvanmitaḥ kālaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। tāvadvṛndāvane nidrā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ।।97।। amūlya ratnatalpe ca vahniśuddhāṃśukārcite ।। gandhacandanamālyaughavāyvādisurabhīkṛte ।। 98 ।। punaḥ prajāgare tasya sarvasṛṣṭirbhavetpunaḥ ।। evaṃ sarve prākṛtāśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vinā ।। 99 ।। tadvandanaṃ tatsmaraṇaṃ tasya dhyānaṃ tadarcanam ।। kīrttanaṃ tadguṇānāṃ ca mahāpātakanāśanam ।। 100 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yadyanmṛtyuñjayācchrutam ।। yathāgamaṃ mahārāja kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 101 ।। suyajña uvāca।। kālāgnirudro viśvānāṃ saṃharttā ca tamoguṇaḥ ।। brahmaṇo'nte vilīnaśca sattvaṃ mṛtyuñjaye śive ।।102।। śivo līno nirguṇe ca śrīkṛṣṇe prākṛte laye ।। kathaṃ tava gurornāma mṛtyuñjaya iti śrutam ।।103।। kathaṃ prasūrmahāviṣṇormūlaprakṛtirīśvarī।। asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni santi vai yasya lomasu ।। 104 ।। sutapā uvāca ।। brahmaṇo'nte mṛtyukanyā praṇaṣṭā jalabimbavat ।। saṃhartrī sarvalokānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ narādhipa ।। 105 ।। katidhā mṛtyukanyānāṃ brahmaṇāṃ koṭiśo laye ।। kālena līnaḥ śambhuśca sattvarūpe ca nirguṇe । 106 ।। mṛtyukanyā jitā śaśvacchivena guruṇā mama ।। na mṛtyunā jitaḥ śambhuḥ kalpe kalpe śrutau śrutam ।। 107 ।। śambhurnārāyaṇasyaiva prakṛteśca narādhipa ।। nityānāṃ līnatā nitye tanmāyā na tu vāstavī ।। 108 ।। svayaṃ pumānnirguṇaśca kālena saguṇaḥ svayam ।। svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śambhurmāyayā prakṛtiḥ svayam ।। 109 ।। tadaṃśastatsamaḥ śaśvadyathā vahneḥ sphuliṅgavat ।। ye ye ca brahmaṇā sṛṣṭā rudrādityādayastathā ।। 110 ।। kalpe kalpe jitāste te naśvarā mṛtyukanyayā ।। na śivo brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaḥ satyo nityaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 111 ।। katidhā brahmaṇāṃ pāto yannimeṣaṇa bhūmipa ।। athādisarge śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛtyāṃ ca jagadguruḥ ।। 112 ।। cakāra vīryādhānaṃ ca puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। tadvāmāṃśasamudbhūtā rāse rāseśvarī parā ।। 113 ।। garbhaṃ dadhāra sā rādhā yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ।। tataḥ suṣāva sā ḍimbhaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 114 ।। cukopa ḍimbhaṃ sā dṛṣṭvā hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। taḍḍimbhaṃ prerayāmāsa tadadho viśva golake ।। 115 ।। tyaktvā'patya mahādevī ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। kṛṣṇastāṃ bodhayāmāsa mahāyogena yogavit ।। 116 ।। babhūva tasmāḍimbhācca sarvādhāro mahāvirāṭ ।। 117 ।। suyajña uvāca ।। adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama ।। śāpo me vararūpaścāpyabhavadbhaktikāraṇam ।। 118 ।। sudurlabhā harerbhaktiḥ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalā ।। na tasyāśca samaṃ vipra vedoktaṃ bhaktipañcakam ।।119।। yathā bhaktirmama bhavecchrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ।। sudurlabhā ca sarveṣāṃ tatkuruṣva mahāmune ।। 120 ।। nahyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ ।। te punantyurukālena kṛṣṇabhaktāśca darśanāt ।। 121 ।। sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca dvijāterjātiruttamā ।। svadharmaniratāścaiva teṣu śreṣṭhaśca bhārate ।। 122 ।। kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।। nityaṃ naivedyebhojī ca tataḥ śreṣṭho mahāñchuciḥ ।।123।। tvāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ mahājñānārṇavaṃ param ।। saṃprāpya śivaśiṣyaṃ ca kaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ mune ।। 124 ।। adhunā'haṃ galatkuṣṭhī tava śāpānmahāmune ।। kathaṃ tapasyāmaśucirnādhikārī karomi ca ।। 125 ।। sutapā uvāca ।। haribhaktipradātrī sā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ।। sā ca yānanugṛhṇāti tebhyo bhaktiṃ dadāti ca ।। 126 ।। yāṃśca māyā mohayati tebhyastāṃ na dadāti ca ।। karoti vañcanāṃ teṣāṃ naśvareṇa dhanena ca ।। 127 ।। kṛṣṇapremamayīṃ śaktiṃ prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām ।। bhaja rādhāṃ nirguṇāṃ tāṃ pradātrīṃ sarvasampadām ।। 128 ।। śīghraṃ yāsyāsi golokaṃ tadanugrahasevayā ।। sā sevitā śrīkṛṣṇena sarvārādhyena pūjitā ।। 129 ।। dhyānasādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ bhaktāḥ saṃsevya nirguṇam ।। sucireṇa ca golokaṃ prayānti bahujanmataḥ ।। 130 ।। kṛpāmayīṃ ca saṃsevya bhaktā yāntyacireṇa vai ।। sā prasūśca mahāviṣṇoḥ sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī ।। 131 ।। sahasravarṣaparyyantaṃ viprapādodakaṃ piba ।। kāmadevasvarūpaśca rogahīno bhaviṣyasi ।।132।। viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī ।। tāvatpuṣkarapatreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam ।। 133 ।। pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni tīrthāni sāgare ।। sāgare yāni tīrthāni viprapādeṣu tāni ca ।। 134 ।। viprapādodakaṃ caiva pāpavyādhivināśanam ।। sarvatīrthodakasamaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham ।। 135 ।। vipro mānavarūpī ca devadevo janārdanaḥ ।। vipreṇa dattaṃ dravyaṃ ca bhuñjate sarvadevatāḥ ।। 136 ।। ityevamuktvā vipraśca gṛhītvā tasya pūjanam ।। jagāma gṛhamityuktvā tvāyāsye vatsarāntare ।। 137 ।। bhaktyā ca bubhuje rājā viprapādodakaṃ śive ।। viprāṃśca pūjayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa vatsaram ।। 138 ।। saṃvatsare vyatīte tu nirmukto vyādhito nṛpaḥ ।। ājagāma muniśreṣṭhaḥ sutapāḥ kaśyapāgraṇīḥ ।। 139 ।। rādhāpūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ manum ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ dadau tasmai nṛpāya saḥ ।। 140 ।। rājannirgamyatāṃ śīghramityuktvā tapase muniḥ ।। jagāma svālayāddurgaṃ nirjagāma tvarannṛpaḥ ।। 141 ।। rurudurbāndhavāḥ sarve trirātraṃ śokamūrcchitāḥ ।। bhāryyāśca tatyajuḥ prāṇānputro rājā babhūva ha ।। 142 ।। suyajñaḥ puṣkaraṃ gatvā cakre vai duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।। divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ rājā jajāpa paramaṃ manum ।। 143 ।। tadā dadarśa gagane rathasthāṃ parameśvarīm ।। sa taddarśanamātreṇa niṣpāpaśca babhūva ha ।।144।। tatyāja mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ divyāṃ mūrttiṃ dadhāra ha ।। sā devī tena yānena ratnendrairnirmitena ca।।145।। nṛpaṃ nītvā ca golokaṃ tatra caiṣā yayau tadā ।। rājā dadarśa golokaṃ nadyā virajayā vṛtam।।146।। veṣṭitaṃ parvatenaiva śataśṛṅgeṇa cāruṇā।। śrīvṛndāvanasaṃyuktaṃ rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ।।147।। gogopagopīnikaraiḥ śobhitaṃ parisevataiḥ।। ratnendrasārakhacitairmandiraiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।।148।। nānācitravicitraiśca rājitaṃ pariśobhitam।। saptatriṃśadbhirākrīḍaiḥ kalpavṛkṣasamanvitaiḥ ।। 149।। pārijātadrumākīrṇairveṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ ।। ākāśavatsuvistīrṇaṃ vartulaṃ candrabimbavat ।। 150 ।। atyūrdhvamapi vaikuṇṭhātpañcāśatkoṭiyojanam ।। śūnye sthitaṃ nirādhāraṃ dhuvameveśvarecchayā ।।151।। ātmākāśasamaṃ nityamasmākaṃ ca sudurlabham ।। ahaṃ nārāyaṇo'nanto brahmā viṣṇurmahānvirāṭ ।। 152 ।। dharmakṣudravirāṭsaṃgho gaṅgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।। tvaṃ viṣṇumāyā sāvitrī tulasī ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 153 ।। sanatkumāraḥ skandaśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। kapilo dakṣiṇā yajño brahmaputrāśca yoginaḥ ।। 154 ।। pavano varuṇaścandraḥ sūryyo rudro hutāśanaḥ ।। kṛṣṇamantropāsakaśca bhāratasthāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 155 ।। ebhirdṛṣṭaśca goloko nānyairdṛṣṭaḥ kadācana।। nirāmaye ca tatraiva ratnasiṃhāsane sthitam।।156।। ratnamālākirīṭaiśca bhūṣitaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ।। sunirmalaiḥ pītavastraiḥ vahniśuddhairvirājitam ।। 157 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ kiśoraṃ goparūpiṇam ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaśvetapaṅkajalocanam ।।158।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyamīṣaddhāsyaṃ manoharam ।।
dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham।।159।। svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param।। dhyānasādhyaṃ durārādhyamasmākaṃ ca sudurlabham।। 160।। priyairdvādaśagopālaiḥ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ।। vīkṣitaṃ gopikāvṛndaiḥ sasmitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ।।161।। pīḍitaiḥ kāmabāṇaiśca śaśvatsusthirayauvanaiḥ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānai ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ।।162।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca parātparam ।। dadarśa rājā tatraiva rādhayā darśitaṃ tadā ।। 163 ।। stutaṃ caturbhivedaiśca mūrtimadbhirmanoharaiḥ ।। rāgiṇīnāṃ ca rāgāṇāmatīva sumanoharam ।। 164 ।। śrutavantaṃ ca saṅgītaṃ yantravaktrotthitaṃ śive ।। nityayā ca sanātanyā prakṛtyā ca saha tvayā ।। 165 ।। śaśvatpūjitapādābjamakhaṇḍatulasīdalaiḥ ।। kastūrīkuṃkumāktaiśca gandhacandanacarcitaiḥ ।। 166 ।। dūrvābhirakṣatābhiśca pārijātaprasūnakaiḥ ।। nirmalairvirajātoyairdattārghyairatiśobhitam ।। 167 ।। suprasannaṃ svatantraṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। sarveṣāṃ cāntarātmānaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvajīvanam ।। 168 ।। sarvādhāraṃ paraṃ pūjyaṃ brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam ।। sarvasampatsvarūpaṃ ca dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 159 ।। sarvamaṅgalarūpaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam ।। sarvamaṃgaladaṃ sarvamaṃgalanāṃ ca maṃgalam।।
