170 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpatistrasto hyavaruhya rathāttvaran ।। sāśrunetraḥ pulakito mūrdhnā sa praṇanāma ca ।। 171 ।। paramātmā dadau tasmai svadāsyaṃ ca śubhāśiṣam ।। svabhaktiṃ niścalāṃ satyāmasmākaṃ ca sudurlabhām ।। 172 ।। rādhā'varuhya svarathātkṛṣṇavakṣasyuvāsa sā ।। gopībhiḥ supriyābhiśca sevitā śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। ।। 173 ।। sambhāṣitā śrīkṛṣṇena sasmitena ca pūjitā ।। samutthitena sahasā bhaktyā vai sambhrameṇa ca ।। 174 ।। ādau rādhāṃ samuccāryya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ ca mādhavam ।। pravadanti ca vedeṣu vedavidbhiḥ purātanaiḥ ।।175।। viparyyayaṃ ye vadanti ye nindanti jagatprasūm ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ premamayīṃ śaktiṃ ca rādhikām ।। 176 ।। te pacyante kālasūtre yāvaccandradivākaram ।। bhavanti strīputrahīnā rogiṇaḥ śatajanmasu ।।।177। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ durge rādhikākhyānamuttamam ।। sā tvaṃ satī bhagavatī vaiṣṇavī ca sanātanī।।178।। nārāyaṇī viṣṇumāyā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। māyayā māṃ pṛcchasi tvaṃ sarvajñā sarvarūpiṇī।।179। strījātiṣvadhidevī ca parā jātismarā varā ।। kathitaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 180 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃ vādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde rādhākhyāne suyajñākhyāne sutapaḥsuyajñasaṃvāde suyajñasya golokaprāptirnāma catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ।।54।। iti suyajñopākhyānaṃ samāptam ।।
<2.55> śrīpārvatyuvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya sthite mantre cānyeṣāmīśvarasya vaḥ ।। kathaṃ jagrāha rādhāyā mantraṃ vai vaiṣṇavo nṛpaḥ ।। 1 ।। kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca kiṃ dhyānaṃ kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ ca kim ।। kaṃ mantraṃ ca dadau rājñe tāṃ pūjāpaddhatiṃ vada ।। ।। 2 ।। śrīmaheśvara uvāca ।। he vipra kaṃ bhajāmīti praśnaṃ kurvati rājani ।। śīghraṃ prāpnomi golokaṃ kasyārādhanato mune ।। 3 ।। ityuktavantaṃ rājendramuvāca brāhmaṇottamaḥ ।। tatsevayā ca tallokaṃ prāpsyase bahujanmataḥ ।। 4 ।। tatprāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ bhaja rādhāṃ parātparām ।। kṛpāmayīprasādena śīghraṃ prāpnoti tatpadam ।। 5 ।। ityuktvā rādhikāmantraṃ dadau tasmai ṣaḍakṣaram ।। oṃ rādheti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ।। 6 ।। prāṇāyāmaṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ mantranyāsaṃ tathaiva ca ।। karāṃganyāsamevaṃ ca dhyānaṃ sarvasudurlabham ।। 7 ।। stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ taṃ ca śikṣayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। rājā tena krameṇaiva jajāpa paramaṃ manum ।। 8 ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ।। kṛṣṇastāṃ pūjayāmāsa purā dhyānena yena ca ।। 9 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ koṭicandrasamaprabhām ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ।। suśroṇīṃ sunitambāṃ ca pakvabimbādharāṃ varām।। 10।। muktāpaṃktipratinidhidantapaṃktimanoharām।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakārikām ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnamālāvibhūṣitām ।। 11 ।। ratnakeyūravalayāṃ ratnamañjīrarañjitām ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena vicitreṇa virājitām ।। sūryyaprabhāpratikṛtigaṇḍasthalavirājitām ।। 12 ।। amūlyaratnakhacitagraiveyakavibhūṣitām ।। sadratnasārakhacitakirīṭamukuṭojjvalām ।। ratnāṃgulīyasaṃyuktāṃ ratnapāśakaśobhitām ।। 13।। bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyaśobhitām।। rūpādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca mattavāraṇagāminīm ।। 14 ।। gopībhiḥ supriyābhiśca sevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā ।। 15 ।। sindūrabindunā cārusīmantādhaḥsthalojjvalām ।। nityaṃ supūjitāṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। 16 ।। kṛṣṇasaubhāgyasaṃyuktāṃ kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ varām।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevīṃ ca nirguṇāṃ ca parātparām।।17।। mahāviṣṇuvidhātrīṃ ca pradātrīṃ sarvasampadām ।। kṛṣṇabhaktipradāṃ śāntāṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ।। 18 ।। vaiṣṇavīṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ ca kṛṣṇapremamayīṃ śubhām ।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitām ।। rāse rāseśvarayutāṃ rādhāṃ rāseśvarīṃ bhaje ।। 19 ।। dhyātvā puṣpaṃ mūrdhni dattvā punardhyāyejjagatprabhum ।। dadyātpuṣpaṃ punardhyātvā copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।। 20 ।। āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ gandhānulepanam ।। dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ supuṣpaṃ ca snānīyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam ।। 21 ।। nānāprakāranaivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ vāsitaṃ jalam ।। madhuparkaṃ ratnatalpamupacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।। 22 ।। pratyekaṃ vedamantreṇa dattaṃ bhaktyā ca bhūbhṛtā ।। mantrāṃśca śrūyatāṃ durge vedoktānsarvasammatān ।। 23 ।। ratnasāravikāraṃ ca nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। varaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ rādhe pūjāsu gṛhyatām ।।24 ।। amūlyaratnakhacitamamūlyaṃ sūkṣmameva ca ।। vahniśuddhaṃ nirmalaṃ ca vasanaṃ devi gṛhya tām।।25।। sadratnasārapāsthaṃ sarvatīrthodakaṃ śubham ।। pādaprakṣālanārthaṃ ca rādhe pādyaṃ ca gṛhyatām ।।26।। dakṣiṇāvarttaśaṅkhasthaṃ sadūrvāpuṣpacandanam ।। pūtaṃ yuktaṃ tīrthatoyai rādhe'rghyaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। ।। 27 ।। pārthivadravyasaṃbhūtamatīva surabhīkṛtam ।। maṅgalārhaṃ pavitraṃ ca rādhe gandhaṃ gṛhāṇa me ।। 28 ।। śrīkhaṇḍacūrṇaṃ susnigdhaṃ kastūrīkuṃkumānvitam ।। sugandhayuktaṃ deveśi gṛhyatāmanulepanam ।। 29 ।। vṛkṣa niryāsasaṃyuktaṃ pārthivadravyasaṃyutam ।। agnikhaṇḍaśikhājātaṃ dhūpaṃ devi gṛhāṇa me ।। 30 ।। andhakāre bhayaharamamūlyamaṇiśobhitam ।। ratnapradīpaṃ śobhāḍhayaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvari ।।31।। pārijātaprasūnaṃ ca gandhacandanacarcitam ।। atīva śobhanaṃ ramyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari ।।32।। sugandhāmalakīcūrṇaṃ susnigdhaṃ sumanoharam ।। viṣṇutailasamāyuktaṃ snānīyaṃ devi gṛhyatām।।33।। amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ keyūravalayādikam।। śaśvatsu śobhanaṃ rādhe gṛhyatāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ mama।।34।। kāladeśodbhavaṃ pakvaphalaṃ vai laḍḍukādikam।। paramānnaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ devi gṛhyatām।।35।। tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। sarvabhogādhikaṃ svādu tāmbūlaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 36 ।। aśanaṃ ratnapātrasthaṃ susvādu sumanoharam ।। mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari।।37। ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitam ।। puṣpacandanacarcāḍhyaṃ paryyaṃkaṃ devi gṛhyatām 38 ।। evaṃ saṃpūjya devīṃ tāṃ dadyātpuṣpāñjalitrayam ।। yatnena pūjayeddevīṃ nāyikāśca vrate vratī ।। 39 ।। prāgādikramayogena dakṣiṇāvartataḥ priye ।। bhaktyā pañcopacāreṇa supriyāḥ paricārikāḥ ।। 40 ।। mālāvatīṃ pūrvakoṇe vahnikoṇe ca mādhavīm ।। dakṣiṇe ratnamālāṃ ca suśīlāṃ nairṛte satīm ।। 41 ।। paścime vai śaśikalāṃ pārijātāṃ ca mārute ।। padmāvatīmuttare cāthaiśānyāṃ sundarīṃ tathā ।। 42 ।। yūthikāmālatīpadmamālā dadyād vrate vratī ।। parihāraṃ ca kurute sāmavedoktameva ca ।। 43 ।। tvaṃ devī jagatāṃ mātā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā śubhā ।। 44 ।। kṛṣṇapremamayī śaktiḥ kṛṣṇe saubhāgyarūpiṇī ।। kṛṣṇabhaktiprade rādhe namaste maṅgalaprade ।। 45 ।। adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama ।। pūjitā'si mayā sā ca yā śrīkṛṣṇena pūjitā ।। 46 ।। kṛṣṇavakṣasi yā rādhā sarvasaubhāgyasaṃyutā ।। rāse rāseśvarīrūpā vṛndā vṛndāvane vane ।। 47 ।। kṛṣṇapriyā ca goloke tulasīkānane tu yā ।। campāvatī kṛṣṇasaṃge krīḍā campakakānane ।। 48 ।। candrāvalī candravane śataśṛṃge satīti ca।। virajā darpahantrī ca virajātaṭakānane।।49।। padmāvatī padmavane kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇasarovare।। bhadrā kuñjakuṭīre ca kāmyā vai kamyake vane।। 50।। vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrvāṇī nārāyaṇorasi।। kṣīrode sindhukanyā ca martye lakṣmīrharipriyā।।51।। sarvasvarge svargalakṣmīrdevaduḥkhavināśinī।। sanātanī viṣṇumāyā durgā śaṅkaravakṣasi।।52।। sāvitrī vedamātā ca kalayā brahmavakṣasi ।। kalayā dharmapatnī tvaṃ naranārāyaṇaprabhoḥ ।। 53 ।। kalayā tulasī tvaṃ ca gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī ।। lomakūpodbhavā gopyaḥ kalāṃśā rohiṇī ratiḥ ।। 54 ।। kalā kalāṃśarūpā ca śatarūpā śacī ditiḥ ।। aditirdevamātā ca tvatkalāṃśā haripriyā ।।95।। devyaśca munipatnyaśca tvatkalākalayā śubhe ।। kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ dehi me kṛṣṇapūjite ।। 56 ।। evaṃ kṛtvā parīhāraṃ stutvā ca kavacaṃ paṭhet ।। purā kṛtaṃ stotrametadbhaktidāsyapradaṃ śubham ।।57।। evaṃ nityaṃ pūjayedyo viṣṇutulyaḥ sa bhārate ।। jīvanmuktaśca pūtaśca golokaṃ yāti niścitam ।। 58 ।। kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ ca rādhāṃ yaḥ pūjayecchive ।। evaṃ krameṇa pratyabdaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 59 ।। paramaiśvaryyayuktaḥ syādiha loke sa puṇyavān ।। sarvapāpādvinirmukto yātyante viṣṇumandiram ।। 60 ।। ādāvevaṃ krameṇaiva rāse vṛndāvane vane ।। stutā sā pūjitā rādhā śrīkṛṣṇena purā satī ।।61।। saṃpūjitā dvitīye ca dhātrā tvevaṃ krameṇa ca ।। tvadvareṇa ca saṃprāpya vidhātā vedamātaram ।। 62 ।। nārāyaṇo mahālakṣmīṃ prāpa saṃpūjya bhāratīm ।। gaṃgāṃ ca tulasīṃ caiva parāṃ bhuvanapāvanīm ।। ।।63। viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca prāpa sindhusutāṃ tathā ।। mṛtāyāṃ dakṣakanyāyāṃ mayā kṛṣṇājñayā purā ।। 64 ।। tvameva durgā samprāptā pūjitā puṣkare ca sā ।। aditiṃ kaśyapaḥ prāpa candraḥ saṃprāpa rohiṇīm ।। 65 ।। kāmo ratiṃ ca saṃprāpa dharmo mūrtiṃ pativratām। devāśca munayaścaiva yāṃ saṃpūjya prativratām ।। 66 ।। saṃprāpuryadvareṇaiva dharmakāmārthamokṣakam ।। evaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca kathitaṃ ca stavaṃ śṛṇu ।। 67 ।। śrīmaheśvara uvāca ।। ekadā māninī rādhā babhūvāgocarā prabhoḥ ।। saṃsaktasya tulasyāṃ ca gopyāṃ ca tulasīvane।।68।। sā saṃhṛtya svamūrttīśca kalāḥ sarvāśca līlayā ।। sarve babhūvurdevāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। 69 ।। bhraṣṭaiśvaryyāśca niśśrīkā bhāryyāhīnā hyupadrutāḥ ।। te ca sarve samālocya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।। 70 ।। teṣāṃ stotreṇa santuṣṭaḥ snātvā saṃpūjya tāṃ śuciḥ ।। tuṣṭāva paramātmā sa sarveṣāṃ rādhikāṃ satīm ।। 71 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। evameva priyo'haṃ te pramodaścaiva te mayi ।। suvyaktamadya kāpaṭyavacanaṃ te varānane ।।72।। he kṛṣṇa tvaṃ mama prāṇā jīvātmeti ca santatam ।। yadbrūhi nityaṃ premṇā tvaṃ sāmprataṃ tadgataṃ drutam ।। ।। 73 ।। tasmātsarvamalīkaṃ te vacanaṃ jagadambike ।। kṣuradhāraṃ ca hṛdayaṃ strījātīnāṃ ca sarvataḥ ।। 74 ।। asmākaṃ vacanaṃ satyaṃ yadbravīmi ca tacchrutam ।। pañcaprāṇādhidevī tvaṃ rādhā prāṇādhiketi me ।। 75 ।। śakto na rakṣituṃ tvāṃ ca yānti prāṇāstvayā vinā ।। vinā'dhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca ko vā kutra ca jīvati ।।93।।। mahāviṣṇośca mātā tvaṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। saguṇā tvaṃ ca kalayā nirguṇā svayameva tu ।।77।। jyotīrūpā nirākārā bhaktānugrahavigrahā ।। bhaktānāṃ rucivaicitryānnānāmūrttīśca bibhratī ।। 78 ।। mahālakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe bhāratī ca satāṃ prasūḥ ।। puṇyakṣetre bhārate ca satī tvaṃ pārvatī tathā ।। 79 ।। tulasī puṇyarūpā ca gaṃgā bhuvanapāvanī ।। brahmaloke ca sāvitrī kalayā tvaṃ vasundharā ।। 80।। goloke rādhikā tvaṃ ca sarvagopālakeśvarī ।। tvayā vinā'haṃ nirjīvo hyaśaktaḥ sarva karmmasu ।। 81 ।। śivaḥ śaktastvayā śaktyā śavākārastvayā vinā ।। vedakartā svayaṃ brahmā vedamātrā tvayā saha ।। 82 ।। nārāyaṇastvayā lakṣmyā jagatpātā jagatpatiḥ ।। phalaṃ dadāti yajñaśca tvayā dakṣiṇayā saha ।।83।। bibhartti sṛṣṭiṃ śeṣaśca tvāṃ kṛtvā mastake bhuvam ।। bibhartti gaṅgārūpāṃ tvāṃ mūrdhni gaṃgādharaḥ śivaḥ ।।84।। śaktimacca jagatsarvaṃ śavarūpaṃ tvayā vinā ।। vaktā sarvastvayā vāṇyā sūto mūkastvayā vinā ।।89।। yathā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ karttuṃ kulālaḥ śaktimānsadā ।। sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ tathā'haṃ ca prakṛtyā ca tvayā saha ।।86।। tvayā vinā jaḍaścāhaṃ sarvatra ca na śaktimān ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā tvaṃ tvamāgaccha mamāntikam ।। 87 ।। vahnau tvaṃ dāhikāśaktirnāgniśśaktastvayā vinā ।। śobhāsvarūpā candre tvaṃ tvāṃ vinā na sa sundaraḥ ।। 88 ।। prabhārūpā hi sūryye tvaṃ tvāṃ vinā na sa bhānumān ।। na kāmaḥ kāminībandhustvayā ratyā vinā priye ।।89।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā tāṃ saṃprāpa jagatprabhuḥ ।। devā babhūvuḥ saśrīkāḥ sabhāryyāḥ śaktisaṃyutāḥ ।। 90 ।। sastrīkaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ samabhūcchailakanyake ।। gopīpūrṇaśca goloko hyabhavattatprasādataḥ ।। 91 ।। rājā jagāma golokamiti stutvā haripriyām ।। śrīkṛṣṇena kṛtaṃ stotraṃ rādhāyā yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। 92 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ ca taddāsyaṃ saṃ prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ।। strīvicchede yaḥ śṛṇoti māsamekamidaṃ śuciḥ ।। 93 ।। acirāllabhate bhāryyāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ satīm ।। bhāryāhīno bhāgyahīno varṣamekaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ।। 94 ।। acirāllabhate bhāryyāṃ suśīlāṃ sundarīṃ satīm ।। purā mayā ca tvaṃ prāptā stotreṇānena pārvati ।। 95 ।। mṛtāyāṃ dakṣakanyāyāmājñayā paramātmanaḥ ।। stotreṇānena saṃprāptā sāvitrī brahmaṇā purā ।। 96 ।। purā durvāsasaḥ śāpānniśśrīke devatāgaṇe ।। stotreṇānena devaistaiḥ saṃprāptā śrīḥ sudurlabhā ।। 97 ।। śṛṇoti varṣamekaṃ ca putrārthī labhate sutam ।। mahāvyādhī rogamukto bhavetstotraprasādataḥ ।। 98 ।। kārttikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu tāṃ saṃpūjya paṭhettu yaḥ ।। acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 99 ।। nārī śṛṇoti cetstotraṃ svāmisaubhāgyasaṃyutā ।। bhaktyā śṛṇoti yaḥ stotraṃ bandhanānmucyate dhruvam।। ।। 100 ।। nityaṃ paṭhati yo bhaktyā rādhāṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ ।। sa prayāti ca golokaṃ nirmukto bhavabandhanāt ।। 101 ।। iti śrī brahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvādāntargataharagaurīsaṃvāde śrīrādhikopākhyāne rādhāpūjāstotrādikathanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 55 ।।
<2.56> śrīpārvatyuvāca ।। pūjāvidhānaṃ stotraṃ ca śrutamatyadbhutaṃ mayā ।। adhunā kavacaṃ brūhi śroṣyāmi tvatprasādataḥ ।। 1 ।। śrīmaheśvara uvāca ।। śṛṇu vakṣyāmi he durge kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। purā mahyaṃ nigaditaṃ goloke paramātmanaḥ ।। 2 ।। atiguhyaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ sarvamantraughavigraham ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbrahmā saṃprāpto vedamātaram ।। 3 ।। yaddhṛtvā'haṃ tava svāmī sarvamātā sureśvarī ।। nārāyaṇaśca yaddhṛtvā mahālakṣmīmavāpa saḥ ।। 4 ।। yaddhṛtvā paramātmā ca nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। babhūva śaktimānkṛṣṇaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ purā vibhuḥ।।5।। viṣṇuḥ pātā ca yaddhṛtvā saṃprāptassindhukanyakām ।। śeṣo bibharti brahmāṇḍaṃ mūrdhni sarṣapavadyataḥ ।।6।। pratyekaṃ lomakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍāni mahānvirāṭ।। bibharti dhāraṇādyasya sarvādhāro babhūva saḥ ।।7।। yaddhāraṇācca paṭhanāddharmmaḥ sākṣī ca sarvataḥ।। yaddhāraṇātkuberaśca dhanādhyakṣaśca bhārate ।। 8 ।। indraḥ surāṇāmīśaśca paṭhanāddhāraṇādvibhuḥ ।। nṛpāṇāṃ manurīśaśca paṭhanāddhāraṇātprabhuḥ ।। ।।। 9 ।। śrīmāṃścandraśca yaddhṛtvā rājasūyaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। svayaṃ sūryastrilokeśaḥ paṭhanāddhāraṇāddhariḥ ।। 10।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādagnirjagatpūtaṃ karoti ca।। yaddhṛtvā vāti vāto'yaṃ punāti bhuvanatrayam।। 11 ।। yaddhṛtvā ca svatantro hi mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu।। triḥsaptakṛtvo niḥkṣatrāṃ cakāra ca vasundharām ।। 12 ।। jāmadagnyaśca rāmaśca paṭhanāddhāraṇātprabhū ।। papau samudraṃ yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātkumbhasambhavaḥ ।। 13 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānyaddhṛtvā jñānināṃ guruḥ ।। jīvanmuktau ca siddhau ca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।।14।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātsiddho vasiṣṭho brahmaputrakaḥ।। siddheśaḥ kapilo yasmādyasmāddakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।।15।। yasmādbhṛguśca māṃ dveṣṭi kūrmmaḥ śeṣaṃ bibhartti ca ।। sarvādhāro yato vāyurvaruṇaḥ pavano yataḥ ।। 16 ।। īśāno dikpatiścaiva yamaḥ śāstā yataḥ śive ।। kālaḥ kālāgnirudraśca saṃharttā jagatāṃ yataḥ ।।17।। yaddhṛtvā gautamaḥ siddhaḥ kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ ।। vasudevasutāṃ prāpa caikāṃśena tu tatkalām ।।18।। purā svajāyāvicchede durvāsā munipuṅgavaḥ।। saṃprāpa rāmaḥ sītāṃ ca rāvaṇena hṛtāṃ purā ।।19।। purā nalaśca saṃprāpa damayantīṃ yataḥ satīm ।। śaṅkhacūḍo mahāvīro daityānāmīśvaro yataḥ ।। 20 ।। vṛṣo vahati māṃ durge yato hi garuḍo harim ।। evaṃ saṃprāpa saṃsiddhiṃ siddhāśca munayaḥ purā ।।21 ।। yaddhṛtvā ca mahālakṣmīḥ pradātrī sarvasampadām ।। sarasvatī satāṃ śreṣṭhā yataḥ krīḍāvatī ratiḥ ।।22।। sāvitrī vedamātā ca yataḥ siddhimavāpnuyāt।। sindhukanyā martyalakṣmīryato viṣṇumavāpa sā ।। 23 ।। yaddhṛtvā tulasī pūtā gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī ।। yaddhṛtvā sarvasasyāḍhyā sarvādhārā vasundharā ।। 24 ।। yaddhṛtvā manasādevī siddhā vai viśvapūjitā ।। yaddhṛtvā devamātā ca viṣṇuṃ putramavāpa sā ।। 25 ।। pativratā ca yaddhṛtvā lopāmudrā'pyarundhatī ।। lebhe ca kapilaṃ putraṃ devahūtī yataḥ satī ।। 26 ।। priyavratottānapādau sutau prāpa ca tatprasūḥ ।। tvanmātā cāpi saṃprāpa tvāṃ devīṃ girijāṃ yataḥ ।। 27 ।। evaṃ sarve siddhagaṇāḥ sarvaiśvaryyamavāpnuyuḥ ।। śrījaganmaṅgalasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ।। 28 ।। ṛṣicchando'sya gāyatrī devī rāseśvarī svayam ।। śrīkṛṣṇabhakti saṃprāptau viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। 29 ।। śiṣyāya kṛṣṇabhaktāya brāhmaṇāya prakāśayet ।। śaṭhāya paraśiṣyāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।। 30 ।। rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ na deyaṃ kavacaṃ priye ।। kaṇṭhe dhṛtamidaṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। 31 ।। mayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca goloke brahmaṇā viṣṇunā purā ।। oṃ rādheti caturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ।। 32 ।। kṛṣṇenopāsito mantraḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ śiro'vatu ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rādhikāṃ ṅentaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ।। 33 ।। kapālaṃ netrayugmaṃ ca śrotra yugmaṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ eṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rādhikāyai vahnijāyāntameva ca ।। 34 ।। mastakaṃ keśasaṃghāṃśca mantrarājaḥ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ rāṃ rādhācaturthyantaṃ vahnijāyāntameva ca ।। 35 ।। sarvasiddhipradaḥ pātu kapolaṃ nāsikāṃ mukham ।। klīṃ śrīkṛṣṇapriyā ṅentaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ pātu namo'ntakam ।। 36 ।। oṃ rāṃ rāseśvarīṃ ṅentaṃ skaṃdhaṃ pātu namo'ntakam ।। oṃ rāṃ rāsavilāsinyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।।37।। vṛndāvanavilāsinyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu ।। tulasīvanavāsinyai svāhā pātu nitambakam ।। 38 ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā ṅentaṃ svāhāntaṃ praṇavādikam ।। pādayugmaṃ ca sarvāṅgaṃ santataṃ pātu sarvataḥ ।। 39 ।। prācyāṃ rakṣatu sā rādhā vahnau kṛṣṇapriyā'vatu ।। dakṣe rāseśvarī pātu gopīśā nairṛte'vatu ।। 40 ।। paścime nirguṇā pātu vāyavye kṛṣṇapūjitā ।। uttare santataṃ pātu mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 41 ।। sarveśvarī sadaiśānyāṃ pātu māṃ sarvapūjitā ।। jale sthale cāntarikṣe svapne jāgaraṇe tathā ।। 42 ।। mahāviṣṇośca jananī sarvataḥ pātu santatam ।। kavacaṃ kathitaṃ durge śrījaganmaṅgalaṃ param ।। 43 ।। yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ param ।। tava snehānmayā'' khyātaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit।।44।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ।। kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau dhṛtvā viṣṇusamo bhavet ।।45।। śatalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ ca kavacaṃ bhavet ।। yadi syātsiddhakavaco na dagdho vahninā bhavet ।। 46 ।। etasmātkavacāddurge rājā duryyodhanaḥ purā ।। viśārado jalastambhaṃ vahnistambhaṃ ca niścitam ।। 47 ।। mayā sanatkumārāya purā dattaṃ ca puṣkare।। sūryyaparvaṇi merau ca sa sāndīpanaye dadau।।48।। ballāya tena dattaṃ ca dadau duryyodhanāya saḥ।। kavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ।।49।। nityaṃ paṭhati bhaktyedaṃ tanmantropāsakaśca yaḥ।। viṣṇutulyo bhavennityaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet।। 50।। snānena sarvatīrthānāṃ sarvadānena yatphalam।। sarvavratopavāsena pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇaiḥ।।51।। sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣāyāṃ nityaṃ vai satyarakṣaṇe ।। nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasevāyāṃ kṛṣṇanaivedyabhakṣaṇe ।। ।। 52 ।। pāṭhe caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ yatphalaṃ ca labhennaraḥ ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ paṭhanātkavacasya ca ।। 53 ।। rājadvāre śmaśāne ca siṃhavyāghrānvite vane ।। dāvāgnau saṃkaṭe caiva dasyucaurānvite bhaye ।। 54 ।। kārāgāre vipadgraste ghore ca dṛḍhabandhane ।। vyādhiyukto bhavenmukto dhāraṇātkavacasya ca ।। 55 ।। ityetatkathitaṃ durge tavaivedaṃ maheśvari।। tvameva sarvarūpā māṃ māyā pṛcchasi māyayā ।।56।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityuktvā rādhikākhyānaṃ smāraṃsmāraṃ ca mādhavam ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro babhūva saḥ ।। 97 ।। na kṛṣṇasadṛśo devo na gaṅgāsadṛśī sarit ।। na puṣkarātparaṃ tīrthaṃ na varṇo brāhmaṇātparaḥ ।। 58 ।। paramāṇoḥ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ paro mahān ।। nabhaḥ paraṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ yathā nāstyeva nārada ।। 59 ।। yathā na vaiṣṇavājjñānī yogīndraḥ śaṅkarātparaḥ ।। kāmakrodhalobhamohā jitāstenaiva nārada ।। 60 ।। svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvatkṛṣṇadhyānarataḥ śivaḥ ।। yathā kṛṣṇastathā śambhurna bhedo mādhaveśayoḥ ।। 61 ।। yathā śambhurvaiṣṇaveṣu yathā deveṣu mādhavaḥ ।। tathedaṃ kavacaṃ vatsa kavaceṣu praśastakam ।। 62 ।। śiśabdo maṅgalārthaśca vakāro dātṛvācakaḥ ।। maṅgalānāṃ pradātā yaḥ sa śivaḥ parikīrttitaḥ ।। 63 ।। narāṇāṃ santataṃ viśve śaṃ kalyāṇaṃ karoti yaḥ ।। kalyāṇaṃ mokṣa ityuktaṃ sa evaṃ śaṅkaraḥ smṛtaḥ।।64।। brahmādīnāṃ surāṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ vedavādinām।। teṣāṃ ca mahatāṃ devo mahādevaḥ prakīrtitaḥ।।65।। mahatī pūjitā viśve mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī। ।। tasyā devaḥ pūjitaśca mahādevaḥ sa ca smṛtaḥ ।। 66 ।। viśvasthānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mahatāmīśvaraḥ svayam ।। maheśvaraṃ ca tenemaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 67 ।। he brahmaputra dhanyo'si yadguruśca maheśvaraḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇa bhaktidātā yo bhavānpṛcchati māṃ ca kim ।। 68 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde rādhikopākhyāne tanmantrādikathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāya।।56।। iti rādhopākhyānam ।।
<2.57> nārada uvāca ।। sarvākhyānaṃ śrutaṃ brahmannatīva paramādbhutam।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi durgopākhyānamuttamam।।1।। durgā nārāyaṇīśānā viṣṇumāyā śivā satī ।। nityā satyā bhagavatī śarvāṇī sarvamaṅgalā।।2।। ambikā vaiṣṇavī gaurī pārvatī ca sanātanī।। nāmāni kauthumoktāni sarveṣāṃ śubhadāni ca।।3।। arthaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ varam।। brūhi vedavidāṃ śreṣṭha vedoktaṃ sarvasammatam ।।4।। kena vā pūjitā sā''dau dvitīye kena vā purā ।। tṛtīye vā caturthe vā kena sarvatra pūjitā ।। 5 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। arthaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca viṣṇurvede cakāra saḥ ।। jñātvā punaḥ pṛcchasi tvaṃ kathayāmi yathāgamam ।। 6 ।। durgo daitye mahāvighne bhavabandhe ca karmmaṇi ।। śoke duḥkhe ca narake yamadaṇḍe ca janmani ।। 7 ।। mahābhaye'tiroge cāpyāśabdo hantṛvācakaḥ ।। etānhantyeva yā devī sā durgā parikīrttitā ।।8।। yaśasā tejasā rūpairnārāyaṇasamā guṇaiḥ ।। śaktirnārāyaṇasyeyaṃ tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā ।। 9 ।। īśānaḥ sarvasiddhyarthe cāśabdo dātṛvācakaḥ ।। sarvasiddhipradātrī yā sā'pīśānā prakīrttitā ।। 10।। sṛṣṭā māyā purā sṛṣṭau viṣṇunā paramātmanā ।। mohitaṃ māyayā viśvaṃ viṣṇumāyā prakīrttitā ।।11।। śive kalyāṇarūpā ca śivadā ca śivapriyā ।। priye dātari cāśabdaḥ śivā tena prakīrtitā ।।12।। sadbuddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī vidyamānā yuge yuge।। pativratā suśīlā ca sā satī parikīrtitā।।13।। yathā nityo hi bhagavānnityā bhagavatī tathā।। svamāyayā tirobhūtā tatreśe prākṛte laye।।14।। ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva kṛtrimam।। durgā satyasvarūpā sā prakṛtirbhagavānyathā।।15।। siddhaiśvaryādikaṃ sarvaṃ yasyāmasti yuge yuge ।। siddhādike bhago jñeyastena sā bhagavatī smṛtā ।।16।। sarvānmokṣaṃ prāpayati janmamṛtyujarādikam ।। carācarāṃśca viśvasthāñcharvāṇī tena kīrtitā ।। 17 ।। maṅgalaṃ mokṣavacanaṃ cāśabdo dātṛvācakaḥ ।। sarvānmokṣānyā dadāti saiva syātsarvamaṅgalā ।। 18 ।। harṣe sampadi kalyāṇe maṃgalaṃ parikīrtitam ।। tāndadāti ca sarvebhyastena sā sarvamaṃgalā ।।19।। ambeti mātṛvacano vandane pūjane sadā ।। pūjitā vanditā mātā jagatāṃ tena sā'mbikā ।। 20 ।। viṣṇubhaktā viṣṇurūpā viṣṇoḥ śaktisvarūpiṇī ।। sṛṣṭau ca viṣṇunā sṛṣṭā vaiṣṇavī tena kīrtitā ।। 21 ।। gauraḥ pīte ca nirlipte pare brahmaṇi nirmale ।। tasyātmanaḥ śaktiriyaṃ gaurī tena prakīrtitā ।। 22 ।। guruḥ śambhuśca sarveṣāṃ tasya śaktiḥ yā satī ।। guruḥ kṛṣṇaśca tanmāyā gaurī tena prakīrttitā ।। ।। 23 ।। tithibhede parvabhede kalpabhede'nyabhedake ।। khyātau teṣu ca vikhyātā pārvatī tena kīrtitā ।। 24 ।। mahotsavaviśeṣe ca parvanniti sukīrtitā ।। tasyādhidevī yā sā ca pārvatī parikīrttitā।।25।। parvatasya sutā devī sā''virbhūtā ca parvate।। parvatādhiṣṭhātṛdevī pārvatī tena kīrttitā ।। 26 ।। sarvakāle sanā prokto vistṛte ca tanīti ca ।। sarvatrasarvakāle ca vidyamānā sanātanī ।।27।। arthaḥ ṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca kīrttitaśca mahāmune।। yathāgamaṃ tvaṃ vedoktopākhyānaṃ ca niśāmaya ।।28।। prathame pūjitā sā ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā।। vṛndāvane ca sṛṣṭyādau goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 29 ।। madhukaiṭabhabhītena brahmaṇā sā dvitīyataḥ ।। tripurapreritenaiva tṛtīye tripurāriṇā।। ।। 30 ।। bhraṣṭaśriyā mahendreṇa śāpāddurvāsasaḥ purā ।। caturthe pūjitā devī bhaktyā bhagavatī satī ।। 31 ।। tadā munīndraiḥ siddhendrairdevaiśca munipuṅgavaiḥ ।। pūjitā sarvaviśveṣu samabhūtsarvataḥ sadā ।। 32 ।। tejassu sarvadevānāṃ sā''virbhūtā purā mune ।। sarve devā dadustasyai śastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।। 33 ।। durgādayaśca daityāśca nihatā durgayā tayā ।। dattaṃ svarājyaṃ devebhyo varaṃ ca yadabhīpsitam ।। ।। 34 ।। kalpāntare pūjitā sā surathena mahātmanā ।। rājñā ca medhaśiṣyeṇa mṛnmayyāṃ ca sarittaṭe ।। 35 ।। meṣādibhiśca mahiṣaiḥ kṛṣṇasāraiśca maṇḍakaiḥ ।। chāgairikṣusukūṣmāṇḍaiḥ pakṣibhirbalibhirmune ।। 36 ।। vedoktāṃścaiva dattvaivamupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ।। dhyātvā ca kavacaṃ dhṛtvā saṃpūjya ca vidhānataḥ ।। 37 ।। rājā kṛtvā parīhāraṃ varaṃ prāpa yathepsitam ।। muktiṃ saṃprāpa vaiśyaśca saṃpūjya ca sarittaṭe ।।38।। tuṣṭāva rājā vaiśyaśca sāśrunetraḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। sasarja mṛnmayīṃ tāṃ vai gabhīre nirmale jale ।।39।। mṛnmayīṃ tāmadṛṣṭvā ca jaladhautāṃ narādhipaḥ ।। ruroda ca tadā vaiśyastataḥ sthānāntaraṃ yayau ।। 40 ।। tyaktvā dehaṃ ca vaiśyastu puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।। 41 ।। kṛtvā jagāma golokaṃ durgādevīvareṇa saḥ ।। rājā yayau svarājyaṃ ca pūjyo niṣkaṇṭakaṃ balī ।। 42 ।। bhogaṃ ca bubhuje bhūpaḥ ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam ।। bhāryāṃ svarājyaṃ saṃnyasya putre vai kālayogataḥ ।।43।। manurbabhūva sāvarṇistaptvā vai puṣkare tapaḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa samāsena yathāgamam।।44।। durgākhyānaṃ muniśreṣṭha kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi।।91। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛ0 nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne durgādināmavyutpattyādikathanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ।।57।।
<2.58> nārada uvāca।। kasya vaṃśodbhavo rājā suratho dharmiṇāṃ varaḥ।। kathaṃ saṃprāpa vai jñānaṃ medhaso jñānināṃ varāt।।1।। kasya vaṃśodbhavo brahmanmedhaso munisattama।। babhūva kutra saṃvādo nṛpasya muninā saha।।2।। sakhyaṃ babhūva kutrāsya vā prabho nṛpavaiśyayoḥ।। vyāsena śrotumicchāmi vada vedavidāṃ vara ।।3।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। atriśca brahmaṇaḥ putrastasya putro niśākaraḥ ।। sa ca kṛtvā rājasūyaṃ dvijarājo babhūva ha ।। 4 ।। gurupatnyāṃ ca tārāyāṃ tasyābhūcca budhaḥ sutaḥ ।। budhaputrastu caitraśca tatputraḥ surathaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 5 ।। nārada uvāca ।। gurupatnyāṃ ca tārāyāṃ samabhūttatsutaḥ katham।। aho vyatikramaṃ brūhi vedasya ca mahāmune ।। 6 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sampanmatto mahākāmī vyacarajjāhnavītaṭe ।। tārāṃ suraguroḥ patnīṃ dharmiṣṭhāṃ ca pativratām ।। 7 ।। susnātāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām ।। suśroṇīṃ sunitambāḍhyāṃ madhyakṣīṇāṃ manoharām ।। 8 ।। sudatīṃ komalāṃgīṃ ca navayauvanasaṃyutām ।। sūkṣmavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 9 ।। kastūrībindunā sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā ।। sindūrabindunā cāruphālamadhyasthalojjvalām ।। 10 ।। vāyunā'dhovastrahīnāṃ sakāmāṃ raktalocanām ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ pakvabimbādharāṃ varām ।। 11 ।। sasmitāṃ namnavaktrāṃ ca lajjayā candradarśanām ।। gacchantīṃ svagṛhaṃ harṣānmattavāraṇagāminīm ।। 12 ।। tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manmathākrāntaścandro lajjāṃ jahau mune ।। pulakāṃkitasarvāṅgaḥ sakāmastāmuvāca saḥ ।। 13 ।। candra uvāca ।। yoṣicchreṣṭhe kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha variṣṭhe rasikāsu ca ।। suvidagdhe vidagdhānāṃ mano harasi santatam ।। 14 ।। niṣevya prakṛtiṃ janmasahasre kāmasāgare ।। tapaḥphalena tvāṃ prāpa bṛhacchroṇīṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 15 ।। aho tapasvinā sārddhamavidagdhena vedhasā ।। yojitā tvaṃ rasavatī śaśvatkāmāturā varā ।। 16 ।। kiṃ vā sukhaṃ ca vijñātamavijñeṣu samāgame ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṅgamaḥ sukhasāgaraḥ ।। 17 ।। kāmena kāminī tvaṃ ca dagdhā'si vyarthamīśvari ।। karmaṇā vā''tmadoṣādvā ko jānāti manaḥ striyāḥ ।। 18 ।। dine dine vṛthā yāti durlabhaṃ navayauvanam ।। navīnayauvanasthāyā vṛddhena svāminā tava ।। 19 ।। śaśvattapasyāyuktaśca kṛṣṇamātmānamīpsitam ।। svapne jāgaraṇe vā'pi dhyāyannāste bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 20 ।। sarvakāmarasajñā tvaṃ niṣkāmaṃ kāmamīpsitam ।। dhyāyantī kāmukī śaśvadyūnāṃ śṛṃgāramātmani ।। 21 ।। anyaśca tvanmanaḥkāmo bhinnaṃ tvadbharturīpsitam ।। yayośca bhinnau viṣayau kā prītiḥ saṃgame tayoḥ ।। 22 ।। vāsantīpuṣpatalpe ca gandhacandana carcite ।। modasva māṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ vasante mādhavīvane ।। 23 ।। sugandhyutphullakusume nirjane candane vane ।। bhavatī yuvatī bhāgyavatī tatraiva modatām ।। 24 ।। candane campakavane śītacampakavāyunā ।। ramye campakatalpe ca krīḍāṃ kuru mayā saha ।। 25।। ityuktvā madano nmatto madanādhikasundaraḥ ।। papāta caraṇe devyā mando mandākinītaṭe ।। 25 ।। niruddhamārgā candreṇa śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā ।। abhītovāca kopena raktapaṃkajalocanā ।। 24 ।। tārovāca ।। dhik tvāṃ candra tṛṇaṃ manye parastrīlampaṭaṃ śaṭham ।। atrerabhāgyāttvaṃ putro vyarthaṃ te janma jīvanam ।। 28 ।। are kṛtvā rājasūyamātmānaṃ manyase balī ।। babhūva puṇyaṃ te vyarthaṃ viprastrīṣu ca yanmanaḥ ।। 29 ।। yasya cittaṃ parastrīṣu so'śuciḥ sarvakarmasu ।। na karmaphalabhākpāpī nindyo viśveṣu sarvataḥ ।।30 ।। satītvaṃ me nāśayasi yakṣmagrasto bhaviṣyasi ।। atyucchrito nipatanaṃ prāpnotīti śrutau śrutam ।। 31 ।। duṣṭānāṃ darpahā kṛṣṇo darpaṃ te nihaniṣyati ।। tyaja māṃ mātaraṃ vatsa satyaṃ te śaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 32 ।। ityuktvā tārakā sādhvī ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। cakāra sākṣiṇaṃ dharmaṃ sūryyaṃ vāyuṃ hutāśanam ।। 33 ।। brahmāṇaṃ paramātmānamākāśaṃ pavanaṃ dharām ।। dinaṃ rātriṃ ca sandhyāṃ ca sarvaṃ suragaṇaṃ mune ।। 34 ।। tārakāvacanaṃ śrutvā na bhītaḥ sa cukopa ha।। kare dhṛtvā rathe tūrṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sundarīm ।।35।। rathaṃ ca cālayāmāsa manoyāyī manoharam।। manoharāṃ gṛhītvā tāṃ sa ca reme manoharam ।। 36 ।। vispandake suravane candane puṣpabhadrake ।। puṣkare ca nadītīre puṣpite puṣpakānane ।।37।। sugandhi puṣpatalpe ca puṣpacandanavāyunā ।। nirjane malayadroṇyāṃ snigdhacandanacarcite ।। 38 ।। śaile śaile nade nadyāṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kurvatostayoḥ ।। gataṃ varṣaśataṃ harṣānmuhūrttamiva nārada ।। 39 ।। babhūva śaraṇāpanno bhīto daityeṣu candramāḥ ।। tejasvini tathā śukre teṣāṃ ca balināṃ gurau ।। 40 ।। abhayaṃ ca dadau tasmai kṛpayā bhṛgunandanaḥ ।। guruṃ jahāsa devānāṃ suvipakṣaṃ bṛhaspatim ।। 41 ।। sabhāyāṃ jahasurhṛṣṭā balino ditinandanāḥ ।। abhayaṃ ca dadustasmai bhītāya ca kalaṅkine ।। 42 ।। satīsatītvadhvaṃsena pāpiṣṭhacandramaṇḍale ।। babhūva śaśarūpaṃ ca kalaṃkaṃ nirmale malam ।। 43 ।। uvāca taṃ mahābhītaṃ śukro vedavidāṃ varaḥ ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ vedayuktaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 44 ।। śukra uvāca ।। tvamaho brahmaṇaḥ pautro'pyatrerbhagavataḥ sutaḥ ।। durnītaṃ karma te putra nīcavannayaśaskaram ।। 45 ।। rājasūyasya suphale nirmale kīrttimaṇḍale ।। sudhārāśau surābindurūpamaṃkamupārjitam ।। 46 ।। tyaja devagurau patnīṃ prasūmiva mahāsatīm ।। dharmiṣṭhasya variṣṭhasya brāhmaṇānāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ।। 47 ।। śambhoḥ surāṇāmīśasya guruputrasya vedhasaḥ ।। pautrasyāṃgirase nityaṃ jvalato brahmatejasā ।।48।। śatrorapi guṇā vācyā doṣā vācyā gurorapi ।। iti sadvaṃśajātānāṃ svabhāvaṃ ca satāmapi ।।49।। sa śatrurme suraguruḥ paro viśve niśākara ।। tathā'pi sahajākhyānaṃ varṇitaṃ dharmasaṃsadi ।। yatra lokāśca dharmiṣṭhāstatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। ।। 50 ।। yato dharmastataḥ kṛṣṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ ।। gaurekaṃ pañca ca vyāghrī siṃhī sapta prasūyate ।। 51 ।। hiṃsakāḥ pralayaṃ yānti dharmo rakṣati dhārmikam ।। devāśca guravo viprāḥ śaktā yadyapi rakṣitum ।।52।। tathā'pi nahi rakṣanti dharmaghnaṃ pāpinaṃ janam।। kulaṭā viprapatnīnāṃ gamane suraviprayoḥ ।। 53 ।। brahmahatyāṣoḍaśāṃśa pātakaṃ ca bhaveddhruvam ।। tāsāmupasthitānāṃ ca gamane taccaturthakam ।। 54 ।। viprapatnīsatīnāṃ ca gamanaṃ vai balena cet ।। brahmahatyāśataṃ pāpaṃ bhavedeva śrutau śrutam ।। 55 ।। dharmmaṃ cara mahābhāga brāhmaṇīṃ tyaja sāmpratam ।। kṛtvā'nutāpaṃ pāpācca nivṛttistu mahāphalā ।। 56 ।। upāyena ca te pāpaṃ dūrībhūtaṃ bhavennanu ।। śaraṇāgata bhītasya mayi devasya dharmataḥ ।। 57 ।। śastrahīnaṃ ca bhītaṃ ca dīnaṃ ca śaraṇārthinam ।। yo na rakṣatyadharmiṣṭhaḥ kumbhīpāke vaseddhruvam।। । ।। 58 ।। rājasūyaśatānāṃ ca rakṣitā labhate phalam ।। paramaiśvaryyayuktaśca dharmeṇa sa bhavediha ।। 59 ।। ityuktvā vai daityaguruḥ svarge mandākinītaṭe ।। snātvā taṃ snāpayāmāsa viṣṇupūjāṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 60 ।। viṣṇupādābjajātena tannaivedyaṃ śubhapradam ।। gaṃgodakena puṇyena bhojayāmāsa candrakam ।।61।। kroḍe kṛtvā tu taṃ bhītaṃ sajjitaṃ pāpakarmaṇā ।। kuśahastastamityūce smāraṃsmāraṃ hariṃ mune ।। ।। 62 ।। śukra uvāca ।। yadyasti me tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ pūjāphalaṃ hare ।। satyaṃ vrataphalaṃ caiva satyaṃ satyavacaḥ phalam ।। 63 ।। tīrthasnānaphalaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ dānaphalaṃ yadi ।। upavāsaphalaṃ satyaṃ pāpānmukto bhavānbhavet ।। 64 ।। vipraṃ trisandhyāhīnaṃ yā viṣṇupūjāvihī nakam ।। tannāpnotu mahāghoraṃ candrapāpaṃ sudāruṇam ।। 65 ।। svabhāryyāvañcanaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ prayāti parastriyam ।। sa yātu narakaṃ ghoraṃ rudrapāpena pātakī ।।66।। vācā vā tāḍayetkāntaṃ duśśīlā durmukhā ca yā ।। sā yugaṃ candrapāpena yātu lālāmukhaṃ dhruvam ।।67।। anaivedyaṃ vṛthānnaṃ ca yaśca bhuṅkte harerdvijaḥ ।। sa yātu kālasūtraṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam ।। 68 ।। ambuvācyaṃ bhūkhananaṃ yaḥ karoti narā dhamaḥ ।। candrapāpādyugaśataṃ kālasūtraṃ sa gacchatu ।। 69 ।। svakāntaṃ vañcayitvā ca yā yāti parapūruṣam ।। sā yātu vahnikuṇḍaṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam ।। 70 ।। kīrttiṃ karoti rajasā parakīrttiṃ vilupya ca ।। sa yugaṃ candrapāpena kumbhīpākaṃ ca gacchatu ।। 71 ।। pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhāryyāṃ yo na puṣṇāti pātakī ।। svaguruṃ candrapāpena yātu caṇḍālatāṃ dhruvam ।। 72 ।। kulaṭānnamavīrānnamṛtusnātānnameva ca ।। yo'śnāti candrapāpaṃ ca yātu taṃ pāpinaṃ dhruvam ।।73।। sa yātu tena pāpena kumbhīpākaṃ caturyugam ।। tasmāduttīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī ।। 74 ।। divase yo grāmyadharmaṃ mahāpāpī karoti ca ।। yo gacchetkāmataḥ kāmī gurviṇīṃ vā rajasvalām ।। 75 ।। taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca mahāghoraṃ ca pāpinam ।। sa yātu tena pāpena kālasūtraṃ caturyugam ।।76।। mukhaṃ śroṇīṃ stanaṃ cāpi yaḥ paśyati parastriyāḥ ।। kāmataḥ kāmadagdhaśca yātu taṃ candrakalmaṣam ।।77।। sa yātu lālābhakṣaṃ ca candrapāpāccaturyugam ।। tasmāduttīryya bhavatu cāṇḍālo'ndho napuṃsakaḥ ।। 78 ।। kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrānticaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca ।। māṃsaṃ masūraṃ lakucaṃ yaśca bhukṅte raverdine ।। 71 ।। kurute grāmyadharmaṃ ca yātu taṃ candrakilbiṣam ।। caturyugaṃ kālasūtraṃ tena pāpena gacchatu ।। 80 ।। tasmāduttīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī ।। saptajanmasu sadrogī daridraḥ kubja eva ca ।।81।। ekādaśyāṃ ca yo bhuṅkte kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīdine।। śivarātrau mahāpāpī yātu taṃ candrapātakam ।। 82 ।। sa yātu kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। tena pāpena cāpnotu cāṇḍālīṃ yonimeva ca ।। 83 ।। tāmrasthaṃ dugdhamādhvīkamucchiṣṭe ghṛtameva ca ।। nārikelodakaṃ kāṃsye dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ tathā ।। 84 ।। pītaśeṣa jalaṃ caiva bhuktaśeṣaṃ tathaudanam ।। asakṛccaudanaṃ bhuṅkte sūryye nāstaṃ gate dvijaḥ ।। 85 ।। taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca durnivāraṃ ca dāruṇam ।। sa yātu tena pāpena cāndhakūpaṃ caturyugam ।। 86 ।। svakanyāvikrayī vipro devalo vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca teṣāṃ vai sūpakārakaḥ ।। 87 ।। aśvatthatarughātī ca viṣṇuvaiṣṇavanindakaḥ ।। taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca dāruṇaṃ pāpinaṃ bhṛśam ।। ।। 88 ।। sa yātu tasmātpāpācca taptasūrmīṃ ca pātakī ।। śaśvaddagdho bhavatu sa yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 89 ।। tasmādutīryya cāṇḍālīṃ yonimāpnoti pātakī ।। saptajanmasu cāṇḍālo vṛṣabhaḥ pañcajanmasu ।। 90 ।। gardabho janmaśatakaṃ sūkarassaptajanmasu ।। tīrthadhvāṃkṣassaptasu vai viṭkṛmiḥ pañcajanmasu ।। jalaukā janmaśatakaṃ śucirbhavatu tatparam ।। 91 ।। vṛthā māṃsaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte svārthaṃ pākānnameva ca ।। tadadattaṃ mahāpāpī prāpnuyāccandrapātakam ।। 92 ।। sa yātu candrapāpena cāsipatraṃ caturyugam ।। tato bhavatu sarpaśca paśussyātsaptajanmasu ।। 93 ।। vipro vārdhuṣiko yo hi yonijīvī cikitsakaḥ ।। harernāmnāṃ ca vikretā yaśca vā svāṅgavikrayī ।।94।। svadharmakathakaścaiva yaśca svātmapraśaṃsakaḥ ।। maṣījīvī dhāvakaśca kulaṭāpoṣya eva ca ।।95।। taṃ yātu candrapāpaṃ ca candro bhavatu vijvaraḥ ।। sa yātu tena pāpena śūlaprotaṃ sudāruṇam ।।96।। tatra viddho bhavatu sa yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। tato daridro rogī ca dīkṣāhīno naraḥ paśuḥ ।। 97 ।। lākṣāmāṃsarasānāṃ ca tilānāṃ lavaṇasya ca ।। aśvānāṃ caiva lauhānāṃ vikretā naraghātakaḥ ।। 98 ।। vipraḥ kulālaḥ cauraśca yātu taṃ candrapātakam ।। sa yātu tena pāpena kṣuradhāraṃ suduḥsaham ।। 99 ।। tatra cchinno bhavatu sa yāvadindrasahasrakam ।। tasmāduttīryya sa bhavetsṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 100 ।। saptajanmasu mārjāro mahiṣo janmapañcakam ।। saptajanmasu bhallūkaḥ kukkurassaptajanmasu ।। 101 ।। matsyatve janmaśatakaṃ karkaṭī janmapañcakam ।। godhikā janmaśatakaṃ gardabhaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 102 ।। saptajanmasu maṇḍūkastataḥ syānmānavo'dhamaḥ ।। carmmakāraśca rajakastailakāraśca varddhakiḥ ।।1 03।। nāvikaḥ śavajīvī ca vyādhaśca svarṇakārakaḥ ।। kumbhakāro lohakārastataḥ kṣatrastato dvijaḥ ।। 104 ।। iti candraṃ śuciṃ kṛtvā samuvāca tu tārakām ।। tyaktvā candraṃ mahāsādhvi gaccha kāntamiti dvijaḥ ।। 109 ।। prāyaścittaṃ vinā pūtā tvamevaṃ śuddhamānasā ।। akāmā yā baliṣṭhena na strī jāreṇa duṣyati ।। 106 ।। ityevamuktvā śukraśca candraṃ vā tārakāṃ satīm ।। sasmitāṃ sasmitaṃ caiva cakāra ca śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 107 ।। iti śrī... bra... vai... mahāpu... dvitī... prakṛtikha... nāradanārāyaṇasaṃ... durgopākhyāne tārācandrayordoṣanivāraṇaṃ nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 58 ।।
<2.59> nārada uvāca ।। bṛhaspatiḥ kiṃ cakāra tārakāharaṇāntare।। kathaṃ saṃprāpa tāṃ sādhvīṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dṛṣṭvā vilambaṃ tārāyāḥ snāntyāścāpi guruḥ svayam ।। prasthāpayāmāsa śiṣyamanveṣārthaṃ ca jāhnavīm।।2।। śiṣyo gatvā ca tadvattaṃ jñātvā vai lokavaktrataḥ।। rudannuvāca svaguruṃ tārakāharaṇaṃ mune।।3।। śrutvā suragururvārtāṃ śaśinā ca priyāṃ hṛtām ।। muhūrttaṃ prāpa mūrcchāṃ ca tataḥ saṃprāpya cetanām ।। 4 ।। rurodoccaiḥ saśiṣyaśca hadayena vidūyatā ।। śokena lajjayā''viṣṭo vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ।।5।। uvāca śiṣyānsambodhya nītiṃ ca śrutisammatām ।। sāśrunetraḥ sāśrunetrāñchokārtaḥ śokakarśitān ।।6।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। he vatsāḥ kena śapto'haṃ na jāne kāraṇaṃ param ।। duḥkhaṃ dharmmaviruddho yaḥ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ।।7।। yasya nāsti satī bhāryyā gṛheṣu priyavādinī ।। araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।। 6 ।। bhāvānuraktā vanitā hṛtā yasya ca śatruṇā ।। araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।। 9 ।। suśīlā sundarī bhāryyā gatā yasya gṛhādaho ।। araṇyaṃ tena ganta vyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।। 10।। daivenāpahṛtā yasya patisādhyā pativratā ।। araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ yathā gṛham ।। 11 ।। yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti gṛhiṇī vā suśāsitā ।। araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।। 12 ।। priyāhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ yasya pūrṇaṃ draviṇabandhubhiḥ ।। araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।। 13 ।। bhāryāśūnyā vanasamāḥ sabhāryāśca gṛhā gṛhāḥ ।। gṛhiṇī ca gṛhaṃ proktaṃ na gṛhaṃ gṛhamucyate ।।14।। aśuciḥ strīvihīnaśca daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ।। yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet।।15।। dāhikāśaktihīnaśca yathā mando hutāśanaḥ ।। prabhāhīno yathā sūryyaḥ śobhāhīno yathā śaśī ।। 16 ।। śaktihīno yathā jīvo yathā cātmā tanuṃ vinā ।। vinā''dhāraṃ yathā''dheyo yatheśaḥ prakṛtiṃ vinā ।। 17 ।। na ca śakto yathā yajñaḥ phalado dakṣiṇāṃ vinā।। karmaṇāṃ ca phalaṃ dātuṃ sāmagrī mūlameva ca ।। 18 ।। vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāro yathā śaktaḥ svakarmaṇi ।। yathā śaktaḥ kulālaśca mṛttikāṃ ca vinā dvijāḥ ।। 19 ।। tathā gṛhī na śaktaśca satataṃ sarvakarmaṇi ।। gṛhādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca svaśaktigṛhiṇīṃ vinā ।। 20 ।। bhāryyāmūlāḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhāryyāmūlā gṛhāstathā ।। bhāryyāmūlaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ gṛhe sadā ।। 21 ।। bhāryyāmūlaḥ sadā harṣo bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca maṅgalam ।। bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca saṃsāro bhāryyāmūlaṃ ca saurabham ।। 22 ।। yathā rathaśca rathināṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca tathā gṛham ।। sārathistu yathā teṣāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca tathā priyā ।। 23 ।। sarvaratnapradhānā ca strīratnaṃ duṣkulādapi ।। gṛhītā sā gṛhasthenevetyāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 24 ।। yathā jalaṃ vinā padmaṃ padmaṃ śobhāṃ vinā yathā ।। tathaiva puṃsāṃ svagṛhaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhiṇīṃ vinā ।। 25 ।। ityevamuktvā sa guruḥ praviveśa gṛhaṃ muhuḥ ।। gṛhādbahirnissasāra bhūyo bhūyaḥ śucā'nvitaḥ ।। 26 ।। muhurmuhuśca mūrcchāṃ ca cetanāṃ samavāpa saḥ ।। bhūyobhūyo rurodoccaiḥ smāraṃsmāraṃ priyāguṇān ।। 27 ।। athāntare mahājñānī jñānibhiśca prabodhitaḥ ।। sacchiṣyairmunibhiścānyaiḥ purandaragṛhaṃ yayau ।। 28 ।। sa guruḥ pūjitastena cātithyena marutvatā ।। tamuvāca svavṛttāntaṃ hṛdi śalyamivāpriyam ।। 29 ।। bṛhaspativacaḥ śrutvā raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ ।। tamuvāca mahendraśca kopaprasphuritādharaḥ ।। 30 ।। mahendra uvāca ।। dūtānāṃ vai sahasraṃ ca cārakarmaṇi gacchatu ।। atīva nipuṇaṃ dakṣaṃ tattvaprāptinimittakam ।। 31 ।। yatrāsti pātakī candro manmātrā tārayā saha ।। gacchāmi tatra sannaddhaḥ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha ।। 32 ।। tyaja cintāṃ mahābhāga sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। bhadrabījaṃ durgamidaṃ kasya sampadvipadvinā ।। 33 ।। ityuktvā ca śunāsīro dūtānāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। tūrṇaṃ prasthāpa yāmāsa tatkarmanipuṇaṃ mune ।। 34 ।। te dūtā vai varṣaśataṃ yayurnirjanameva ca ।। sudurlaṃghyaṃ ca viśveṣu bhramitvā śakramāyayuḥ ।। 35 ।। candraṃ ca śukrabhavane taṃ prapannaṃ ca vijvaram ।। dṛṣṭvā satārakaṃ bhītaṃ kathayāmāsurīśvaram ।। 36 ।। iti śrutvā śunāsīro natavaktro bṛhaspatim ।। uvāca śokasantapto hadayena vidūyatā ।। 37 ।। mahendra uvāca ।। śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। bhayaṃ tyaja mahābhāga sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 38 ।। tvayā nahi jitaḥ śukro na mayā ditinandanaḥ ।। etadālocya candraśca jagāma śaraṇaṃ kavim ।।39।। gaccha śīghraṃ brahmalokamasmābhiḥ sārddhameva ca ।। brahmaṇā saha yāsyāmaḥ kailāse śaṅkaraṃ vayam ।। 40 ।। ityuktvā tu mahendraśca santapto guruṇā saha ।। jagāma brahmalokaṃ ca sukhadṛśyaṃ nirāmayam ।। 41 ।। tatra dṛṣṭvā ca brahmāṇaṃ nanāma guruṇā saha ।। provāca sarvavṛttāntaṃ devānāmīśvaraṃ param ।। 42 ।। mahendravacanaṃ śrutvā hasitvā kamalodbhavaḥ ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāramuvāca vinayānvitaḥ ।। 43 ।। brahmovāca ।। yo dadāti parasmai ca duḥkhameva ca sarvataḥ ।। tasmai dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca śāstā kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 44 ।। ahaṃ sraṣṭā ca sṛṣṭeśca pātā viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ।। yathā rudraśca saṃharttā dadāti ca śivaṃ śivaḥ ।। 45 ।। nirantaraṃ sarvasākṣī dharmo vai sarvakāraṇam ।। sarve devā viṣayiṇaḥ kṛṣṇājñāparipālakāḥ ।। 46 ।। bṛhaspatirutathyaśca saṃvartaśca jitendriyaḥ ।। trayaścāṃgirasaḥ putrā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ ।। 47 ।। saṃvartāya kaniṣṭhāya na ca kiñciddadau guruḥ ।। sa babhūva tapasvī ca kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyati ceśvaram ।। 48 ।। madhyamasyotathyakasya satīṃ bhāryāṃ ca gurviṇīm ।। jahāra kāmatastāṃ ca bhrātṛjāyāmakāmukīm ।। 49 ।। yo haredbhrātṛjāyāṃ ca kāmī kāmādakāmukīm ।। brahmahatyāsahasraṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 50 ।। sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram ।। bhrātṛjāyāpahārī ca mātṛgāmī bhavennaraḥ ।। 51 ।। tasmāduttīryya pāpī ca viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ।। varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi tatra sthitvā ca pātakī ।। 52 ।। tato bhavenmahāpāpī varṣakoṭisahasrakam ।। puṃścalīyonigarte ca kṛmiścaiva purandara ।। ।। 53 ।। gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni kukkuraḥ ।। bhrātṛjāyāpaharaṇācchatajanmāni sūkaraḥ ।। 54 ।। dadāti yo na dāyaṃ ca baliṣṭho durbalāya ca ।। sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca yāvaccandradivākaram ।। 95 ।। nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi ।। avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ।। 56 ।। jagadguroḥ śivasyāpi guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ ।। jñātaṃ karotu vṛttāntamīśvaraṃ balināṃ varama ।। 57 ।। sarve samūhā devānāṃ sannaddhāśca savāhanāḥ ।। madhyasthā munayaścaiva santu vai narmadātaṭe ।। 58 ।। paścādahaṃ ca yāsyāmi puṇyaṃ tannarmmadātaṭam ।। gurustadguruputro'pi śīghraṃ yātu śivālayam ।।59।। mahendra uvāca ।। kathaṃ vā vedakarttuśca siddhānāṃ yogināṃ guroḥ ।। mṛtyuñjayasya śambhośca guruputro bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 60 ।। aṅgirāstava putraśca tatputraśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। tvatto jñānī mahādevaḥ kathaṃ śiṣyo guroḥ pituḥ ।। 61 ।। brahmovāca ।। katheyamatiguptā ca purāṇeṣu purandara ।। imāṃ purāpravṛttiṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya।।62।। mṛtavatsā karmmadoṣādbhāryyā cāṅgirasaḥ purā ।। vrataṃ cakāra sā caiva kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 63 ।। vrataṃ puṃsavanaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ cakāra sā ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānkārayāmāsa tāṃ vratam ।। 64 ।। tadā''gatya ca golokātparamātmā kṛpāmayaḥ ।। svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 65 ।। suvratāṃ ca salakṣmīkāṃ tāmuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। praṇatāṃ sāśrunetrāṃ ca vinītāṃ ca tayā stutaḥ ।। 66 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। gṛhāṇedaṃ vrataphalaṃ mama tejassamanvitam ।। bhuṃkṣva madvarataḥ putri bhaviṣyati madaṃśataḥ ।। 67 ।। patirguruśca devānāṃ mahatāṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। putraste bhavitā sādhvi madvareṇa bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 68 ।। madvareṇa bhavedyo hi sa ca madvaraputrakaḥ ।। tvadgarbhe mama putro'yaṃ cirajīvī bhaviṣyati ।। 69 ।। varajo vīryyajaścaiva kṣetrajaḥ pālakastathā।। vidyāmantrasutau caiva gṛhītaḥ saptamaḥ sutaḥ ।। 70 ।। ityuktvā rādhikānāthaḥ svalokaṃ ca jagāma saḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇavaraputro'yaṃ jñānīśvaraguruḥ svayam ।। mṛtyuñjayaṃ mahājñānaṃ śivāya pradadau purā ।। 71 ।। divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ ca tapaścakre himālaye ।। svayogaṃ jñānamakhilaṃ tejassvāmasamaṃ param ।। svaśaktiṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ ca svāṃśaṃ vai vāhanaṃ vṛṣam ।। 72।। svaśūlaṃ ca svakavacaṃ svamantraṃ dvādaśākṣaram ।। kṛpāmayaḥ stutastena śrīkṛṣṇaśca parātparaḥ ।। śivaloke śivā sā ca viṣṇumāyā śivapriyā ।।73।। śaktirnārāyaṇasyeyaṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī ।। tejastu sarvadevānāṃ sā''virbhūtā sanātanī ।। 74 ।। jaghāna daityanikaraṃ devebhyaḥ pradadau padam ।। kalpānte dakṣakanyā ca sā mūlaprakṛtiḥ satī ।। 75 ।। pitṛyajñe tanuṃ tyaktvā yogādvai siddhayoginī ।। babhūva śailakanyā sā sādhvī vai bhartṛnindayā ।।76।। kālena kṛṣṇatapasā śaṅkaraṃ prāpa sundarī।। śrīkṛṣṇo hi guruḥ śambhoḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ।77।। kṛṣṇasya varaputro'yaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ ।। ato hetoḥ suragururguruputraḥ śivasya ca ।। 78 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamatiguhyaṃ purātanam।। iti pradhānasambandhaḥ śrutaśca kathito mayā ।। 79 ।। pāraṃparikamanyaṃ ca kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। durvāsā garuḍaścaiva śaṅkarāṃśaḥ pratāpavān ।। 80 ।। śiṣyau cāṃgirasastau dvau guruputro'thavā tataḥ ।। prāṇādhikāyāṃ satyāṃ ca mṛtāyāṃ dakṣaśāpataḥ ।। 81 ।। svajñānaṃ svaṃ ca bhagavānvisasmāra svamohataḥ ।। smaraṇaṃ kārayāmāsa kṛṣṇena prerito'ṅgirāḥ ।। 82 ।। ato hetorguruścaivaṃ matsutassyācchivasya saḥ ।। śīghraṃ gacchatu kailāsaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 83 ।। tvaṃ gaccha tatra sannaddhaḥ sadevo narmadātaṭam ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma ca nārada ।। 84 ।। gururyayau ca kailāsaṃ mahendro narmadātaṭam ।। 85 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛti khaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne bṛhaspateḥ kailāsagamanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 59 ।।
<2.60> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇa mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāraga ।। nipītaṃ ca mahākhyānaṃ tvanmukhenduvinisṛtam ।। 1 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi kimuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। śivaṃ ca gatvā kailāsaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 2 ।। jagatkartā vidhātā ca kiṃ vā taṃ pratyuvāca saḥ ।। etatsarvaṃ samālocya vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 3 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śīghraṃ gatvā ca kailāsaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīḥ śaṃkaraṃ guruḥ ।। praṇamya tasthau purato lajjāvanatakandharaḥ ।। ।। 4 ।। dṛṣṭvā gurusutaṃ śambhurudatiṣṭhatkuśāsanāt ।। āliṅganaṃ dadau tasmai śīghraṃ māṃgalikāśiṣaḥ ।। 5 ।। svāsane vāsayitvā vai papraccha kuśalaṃ vacaḥ ।। uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ bhītaṃ taṃ lajjitaṃ śivaḥ ।। 6 ।। śrīśaṅkara uvāca ।। kathamevaṃvidhastvaṃ ca duḥkhī malina vigrahaḥ ।। sāśrunetro lajjitaśca bhrātastatkāraṇaṃ vada ।। 7 ।। kiṃ vā tapasyā hīnā te sandhyā hīnā'thavā mune ।। kiṃ vā śrīkṛṣṇasevā sā vihīnā daivadoṣataḥ ।। 8 ।। kiṃ vā gurau bhaktihīno'bhīṣṭadeve'thavā gurau ।। kiṃ vā na rakṣituṃ śaktaḥ prapannaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 9 ।। kiṃ vā'tithiste vimukhaḥ kiṃ vā poṣyā bubhukṣitāḥ ।। kiṃ vā svatantrā strī vā te kiṃ vā putro'vacaskaraḥ ।। 1 0।। suśāsito na śiṣyo vā kiṃ bhṛtyāścottarapradāḥ ।। kiṃ vā te vimukhā lakṣmīḥ kiṃ vā ruṣṭo gurustava ।। 11 ।। gariṣṭhaśca variṣṭhaśca śaśvatsantuṣṭa mānasa ।। gurustava vasiṣṭhaśca preṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ satāmaho ।।12।। kiṃ vā ruṣṭo'bhīṣṭadevaḥ kiṃ vā ruṣṭāśca vāḍavāḥ ।। kiṃ vā ruṣṭā vaiṣṇavāśca kiṃ vā te prabalo ripuḥ ।। 13 ।। kiṃ vā te bandhuvicchedo vigraho balinā saha ।। kiṃ vā padaṃ paragrastaṃ kiṃ vā bandhudhanaṃ ca vā ।।14।। kena te vā kṛtā nindā khalairvā pāpibhirmune ।। kena vā tvaṃ parityakto bāndhavena priyeṇa vā।।15।। bandhustyaktastvayā kiṃ vā vairāgyeṇa krudhā'thavā ।। kiṃ vā tīrthe nahi snātaṃ na dattaṃ puṇyavāsare।।16।। gurunindā bandhunindā khalavaktrācchrutā'thavā ।। gurunindā hi sādhūnāṃ maraṇādatiricyate ।। 17 ।। asadvaṃśaprajātānāṃ khalānāṃ nindanaṃ tathā ।। dauśśīlyamevamasatāṃ śaśvannārakiṇāmiha ।। 18 ।। parapraśaṃsakāḥ santaḥ puṇyavanto hi bhārate ।। śaśvanmaṅgalayuktāśca rājante manasā sadā ।। 19 ।। putre yaśasi toye ca samṛddhe ca parākrame ।। aiśvarye vā pratāpe ca prajābhūmidhaneṣu ca ।। 20 ।। vacaneṣu ca buddhau ca svabhāve ca caritrataḥ ।। ācāre vyavahāre ca jāyate hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām।।21।। yādṛgyeṣāṃ ca hadaye tādṛkteṣāṃ ca maṃgalam ।। yādṛgyeṣāṃ pūrvapuṇyaṃ tādṛkteṣāṃ ca mānasam ।। 22 ।। ityuktvā ca mahādevo virarāma svasaṃsadi ।। tamuvāca mahāvaktā svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 23 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। akathyameva vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmi kimīśvara ।। lokāḥ karmavaśānnityaṃ nānājanmasu yatkṛtam ।। 24 ।। svakarmaṇāṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkte janturjanmani janmani ।। nahi naṣṭaṃ ca tatkarma vinā bhogācca bhārate ।। 25 ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śoko narāṇāṃ bhārate prabho ।। kecidvadanti hi bhavetsvakṛtena ca karmaṇā ।। 25 ।। kecidvadanti daivena svabhāveneti kecana ।। trividhā gatayo hyasya vedavedāṅgapāraga ।। 27 ।। svayaṃ ca karmajanakaḥ karma vai daivakāraṇam ।। svabhāvo jāyate nṝṇāṃ svātmanaḥ pūrvakarmaṇaḥ ।। 28 ।। svakarmaṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jantūnāṃ pratijanmani ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ svātmanaśca prajāyate ।। 29 ।। svakarmaphalabhoktā ca jīvo hi saguṇaḥ sadā ।। ātmabhojayitā sākṣī nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 30 ।। sa evātmā sarvasevyaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca phalapradaḥ ।। sa vai sṛjati daivaṃ ca svabhāvaṃ karma caiva hi ।। 33 ।। karmaṇā ca nṛṇāṃ lajjā praśaṃsā ca praphullatā ।। lajjābījaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ tathā'pi kathayāmi te ।। 32 ।। ityuktvā sarvavṛttāntamavocattaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।। śrutvā babhūva namrāsyo gaurīśo lajjayā tadā ।।33।। japamālā karādbhraṣṭā kopāviṣṭasya śūlinaḥ ।। babhūva sadyaḥkampaśca raktapaṃkajalocane।।34।। saṃhartturīśo rudrasya viṣṇoḥ pātuḥ sakhā śivaḥ ।। sraṣṭuḥ stutyaśca mānyaśca svātmanaḥ paramātmanaḥ ।। 35 ।। nirguṇasya ca kṛṣṇasya prakṛtīśasya nārada ।। kopātpravaktumārebhe śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। 36 ।। śiva uvāca ।। śivamastu ca sādhūnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāmiha ।। avaiṣṇavānāmasatāmaśivaṃ ca pade pade ।। 37 ।। dadāti vaiṣṇavebhyaśca yo duḥkhaṃ susthito janaḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇastasya saṃharttā vighnastasya pade pade ।। 38 ।। avaiṣṇavānāṃ hṛdayaṃ nahi śuddhaṃ sadāmalam ।। śrīkṛṣṇamantrasmaraṇaṃ manonairmalyakāraṇam ।। 39 ।। bhidyate hadayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ ।। viṣṇumantropāsanayā kṣīyate karma tannṛṇām ।। 40 ।। aho śrīkṛṣṇadāsānāṃ kaḥ svabhāvaḥ sunirmalaḥ ।। hṛtabhāryyaṃ mūrcchitaśca na śaśāpa ripuṃ guruḥ ।। 41 ।। gururyasya variṣṭhaśca krodhahīnaśca dhārmikaḥ ।। śataputraghnamapyenaṃ na śaśāpa ripuṃ muniḥ ।। 42 ।। niśśvāsādvai suragurorbhrāturmama bṛhaspateḥ ।। bhasmībhūto nimeṣeṇa śatacandro bhaveddhruvam ।। ।। 43 ।। tathā'pi taṃ no śaśāpa dharmmabhaṅgabhayena ca ।। tapasyā hīyate śaptuḥ kopāviṣṭasya nityaśaḥ ।। 44 ।। aho hyatrerasatputraḥ parastrīlubdhakaḥ śaṭhaḥ ।। tapasvino vaiṣṇavasya brahmaputrasya dhīmataḥ ।। 45 ।। dharmiṣṭhā brahmaṇaḥ putrā vaiṣṇavā brāhmaṇāstathā ।। keciddevā dvijā daityāḥ pautrāśca trividhā matāḥ ।। 46 ।। ye sāttvikā brāhmaṇāste devā rājasikāstathā ।। daityāstāmasikā raudrā baliṣṭhāścoddhatāḥ sadā ।। 47 ।। svadharmaniratā viprā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।। śaivāḥ śāktāśca te devā daityāḥ pūjāvivarjitāḥ ।। 48 ।। mumukṣavo viṣṇubhaktā brāhmaṇā dāsyalipsavaḥ ।। aiśvaryyalipsavo devāścāsurāstāmasāstathā ।। 49 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ svadharmaśca kṛṣṇasyārccanamīpsitam ।। niṣkāmānāṃ nirguṇasya parasya prakṛterapi ।। 50 ।। ye brāhmaṇā vaiṣṇavāśca svatantrāḥ paramaṃ padam ।। yāntyanyopāsakāścānyaiḥ sārddhaṃ ca prākṛte laye ।। 51 ।। varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sādhavo vaiṣṇavā yadi ।। viṣṇumantravihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco varaḥ ।। 52 ।। paripakvā vipakvā vā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaśca te ।। satataṃ pāti tāṃścaiva viṣṇucakraṃ sudarśanam ।। 53 ।। yathā vahnau śuṣkatṛṇaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavetsadā।। tathā pāpaṃ vaiṣṇaveṣu kāṣṭhānīva hutāśane ।। 54 ।। guruvaktrādviṣṇumantro yasya karṇe pravekṣyati ।। taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 55 ।। puṃsāṃ śataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ।। svasodarāṃśca jananīmuddharantyeva vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 56 ।। gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena piṇḍadāḥ piṇḍabhojinam ।। samuddharanti puṃsāṃ ca vaiṣṇavāśca śataṃ śatam ।।97।। mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। yamastasmānmahābhīto vainateyādivoragaḥ ।। 58 ।। punantyeva hi tīrthāni gaṅgādīni ca bhārate ।। kṛṣṇamantropāsakāśca sparśamātreṇa vākpate ।। 59 ।। pāpāni pāpināṃ tīrthe yāvanti prabhavanti ca ।। naśyanti tāni sarvāṇi vaiṣṇavasparśamātrataḥ ।। 60 ।। kṛṣṇamantropāsakānāṃ rajasā pādapadmayoḥ ।। sadyo muktāḥ pātakebhyaḥ kṛtsnā pūtā vasundharā ।। 61 ।। vāyuśca pavano vahniḥ sūryyaḥ sarvaṃ punāti ca ।। ete pūtā vaiṣṇavānāṃ sparśamātreṇa līlayā ।। 62 ।। ahaṃ brahmā ca śeṣaśca dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmmaṇām ।। ete hṛṣṭāśca vāñchanti vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamam ।। 63 ।। phalaṃ karmānurūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ bhārate bhavet ।। na bhavettadvaiṣṇave ca siddhadhānye yathāṃ'kuram ।। 64 ।। hanti teṣāṃ karma pūrvaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। kṛpayā svapadaṃ tebhyo dadātyeva kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 65 ।। tejasvināṃ ca pravaraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhṛgunandanam ।। sa candro durbalo bhītaḥ śukraṃ ca śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 66 ।। sudarśano baliṣṭhaṃ ca śukraṃ jetuṃ na śaktimān ।। tathā'pi coddhariṣyāmi tārāṃ mantreṇa madguroḥ ।। 67 ।। bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ।। suprasanne bhagavati patnīṃ prāpsyasi līlayā ।। 68 ।। mantraṃ tasya pradāsyāmi bhrātaḥ kalpataruṃ param ।। koṭijanmāghanighnaṃ ca sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam ।।69।। brahmādistaṃbaparyyantaṃ naśvaraṃ jalabimbavat ।। śaraṇaṃ yāhi govindaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। tāvadbhavecchā bhogecchā strīsukhecchā nṛṇāmiha ।। 70 ।। yāvadgurumukhāmbhojānna prāpnoti manuṃ hareḥ ।। saṃprāpya durlabhaṃ mantraṃ vitṛṣṇo hi bhavennaraḥ ।। 71 ।। indratvamamaratvaṃ ca nahi vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। nahi vāñchanti mokṣaṃ ca dāsyaṃ bhaktiṃ vinā hareḥ ।। 72 ।। bhakti nirmathanaṃ bhakto mokṣaṃ no vāñchati prabhoḥ ।। jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayatvaṃ ca sarvasiddhiṃ tadīpsitam ।। 73 ।। vāksiddhiṃ caiva dhātṛtvaṃ bhaktānāṃ nahi vāñchitam ।। bhaktiṃ vihāya kṛṣṇasya viṣayaṃ yo hi vāñchati ।।।74।।। viṣamatti sudhāṃ tyaktvā vañcito viṣṇumāyayā ।। ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca dharmo'nantaśca kaśyapaḥ ।।75।। kapilaśca kumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। svāyambhuvo manuścaiva prahlādaśca parāśaraḥ ।। ।। 76 ।। bhṛguḥ śukraśca durvāsā vasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ ।। baliśca vālakhilyāśca varuṇaśca hutāśanaḥ ।। 77 ।। vāyuḥ sūryaśca garuḍo dakṣo gaṇapatiḥ svayam ।। ete parā bhaktavarāḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।।78।। ye ca tasya kalāḥ śreṣṭhāste tadbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।। ityuktvā śaṅkarastasmai dadau kalpataruṃ manum ।।79।। lakṣmīmāyākāmabījaṃ ṅentaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ mune ।। paraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mune ।। ।। 80 ।। tatpuraścaraṇaṃ dhyānaṃ śuddhe mandākinītaṭe ।। guruḥ saṃprāpya taṃ mantraṃ śaṅkarācca jagadguroḥ ।। 81 ।। viṣaṇṇo hi bhavābdhau ca babhūva tamuvāca ha ।। 82 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। ājñāṃ kuru jagannātha yāmi taptuṃ harestapaḥ ।। tārā tiṣṭhatu tatraiva na tayā me prayojanam ।।83।। paśyāmi viṣatulyaṃ ca sarvaṃ naśvaramīśvara ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmi satyaṃ nityaṃ ca nirguṇam।।84।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। paragrastāṃ striyaṃ tyaktvā na praśaṃsyaṃ tapo mune ।। sambhāvitasya duścarccā maraṇādatiricyate ।। 85 ।। puro gaccha mahābhāga tametaṃ narmadātaṭam ।। yatra brahmādayo devāstatrāhaṃ yāmi satvaram ।।86।। śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā yayau suraguruḥ svayam ।। āyayau ca mahābhāgaḥ śaṅkaro narmadātaṭam ।। 87 ।। sagaṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇam ।। praṇemurdevatāḥ sarvā manavo munayastathā ।। 88 ।। nanāma śambhuḥ śirasā viṣṇuṃ ca kamalodbhavam ।। dadau viṣṇurmaheśāya premṇā''liṅganamāsanam ।। 89 ।। etasminnantare tatra cāgamacca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। praṇanāma mahādevaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca kamalodbhavam ।। 90 ।। sūryyaṃ dharmamanantaṃ ca naraṃ māṃ ca munīśvarān ।। svaguruṃ pitaraṃ bhaktyā cāvasattatra saṃsadi ।। 91 ।। sañcintya manasā yuktimūce tatra ca saṃsadi ।। svayaṃ viṣṇuśca bhagavānbrahmāṇaṃ candraśekharam ।।92।। viṣṇuruvāca।। yuvāṃ ca munayaścaiva samudrapulinaṃ drutam।। śukraṃ kañcicca madhyasthaṃ prasthāpayitumarhatha ।।93।। vigraheṇaiva viṣamaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। madāśiṣā suragurustārāṃ prāpsyati niścitam ।। 94 ।। suraiḥ stutaśca santuṣṭaḥ śukrācāryyo bhaviṣyati ।। suraiḥ śukro hi na jitaḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa rakṣitaḥ ।। 95 ।। yuvābhyāṃ prārthyamāno'haṃ yuvayoḥ stavanena ca ।। śvetadvīpādāgato'smi parituṣṭaḥ stavena ca ।। 96 ।। śukrāśramamasīparṇaṃ sarvā gacchantu devatāḥ ।। ripurbaliṣṭhaḥ stotreṇa vaśībhūta iti śrutiḥ ।। 97 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthastatraivāntara dhīyata ।। stuto brahmādibhidevaiḥ praṇataiḥ paripūjitaḥ ।।98।। gate ca jagatāṃ nāthe śvetadvīpaṃ ca nārada ।। cintitāśca surāḥ sarve viṣaṇṇamanasastathā ।। 99 ।। munīndevāṃśca saṃbodhya brahmā vai tatra saṃsadi ।। uvāca nītisāraṃ tatsammataṃ śaṅkarasya saḥ ।। 100 ।। brahmovāca ।। mama śambhośca dharmasya viṣṇorvā sarvasākṣiṇaḥ ।। asmākaṃ ca samaḥ sneho daitye deve ca putrakāḥ ।। 101 ।। daityānāṃ ca guruṃ śukraṃ prapannaśca niśākaraḥ ।। na jitaśca suraiḥ śukraḥ pūjito ditinandanaiḥ ।। 102 ।। tārāhetorahaṃ yāmi śukrasya bhavanaṃ surāḥ ।। sarve samudrapulinaṃ yāntu viṣṇornideśataḥ ।।103।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā cāgamacchukrasannidhim ।। prayayurdevatā viprāḥ samudrapulinaṃ mune।। ।। 104 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte ma0dvi0pra0nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇopadiṣṭatāroddharaṇopāyajñānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 60 ।।
<2.61> nārada uvāca ।। tataḥ paraṃ kiṃ rahasyaṃ babhūvāsuradevayoḥ ।। śrotumicchāmi bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। brahmā jagāma nilayaṃ śukrasya ca mahātmanaḥ ।। nānādaityagaṇākīrṇaṃ ratnamaṇḍapabhūṣitam ।। 2 ।। pañcāśatkoṭibhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ parītaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ ।। saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca veṣṭitaṃ durgameva ca ।। 3।। rakṣitaṃ rakṣakagaṇairdaityaiśca śatakoṭibhiḥ ।। padmarāgairviracitaiḥ prāvāraiḥ pariśobhitam ।। 4 ।। dadarśa jagatāṃ dhātā sabhāyāṃ bhṛgunandanam ।। stutaṃ munigaṇairdaityai ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam ।। 5 ।। japantaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram ।। koṭisūryyaprabhaṃ śaśvajjvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 6 ।। dṛṣṭvā pautraṃ prabhāyuktaṃ vidhātā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। ātmānaṃ kṛtinaṃ mene putraṃ pautraṃ ca nārada ।। 7 ।। dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaṃ śukro dhātāraṃ jagatāṃ prabhum ।। utthāya sahasā bhītaḥ praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 8 ।। ādāya pūjayāmāsa copacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā sambhrameṇa yathāgamam ।। 9 ।। vidyā mantrapradātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। svakarmaṇāṃ ca phaladaṃ sarveṣāṃ viśvato varam ।।10।। śukrasya stavanenaiva santuṣṭo jagatāṃ patiḥ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇamavasattatra saṃsadi ।। 11 ।। śukreṇa śirasā dattaratnasiṃhāsane vare।। tejasā jvalite ramye nirmite viśvakarmaṇā।। ।। 12 ।। śukraḥ praṇamya brahmāṇaṃ kumāraṃ śakunaṃ kratum ।। vasiṣṭhaṃ ca marīciṃ ca sanandaṃ ca sanātanam ।। 13 ।। kapilaṃ vai pañcaśikhaṃ voḍhumaṃgirasaṃ mune ।। dharmaṃ māṃ ca naraṃ bhaktyā praṇanāma kṛtāñjaliḥ ।।14।। pratyekaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaraṃ ca yathocitam ।। siṃhāsaneṣu ratneṣu vāsayāmāsa dhārmikaḥ ।। 15 ।। prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sarve praṇemurditinandanāḥ ।। ṛṣisaṃghāśca dhātāraṃ tuṣṭuvuśca yathāgamam ।। 16 ।। sarvānsaṃstūya sa kaviravocatsampuṭāñjaliḥ ।। sāśrunetraḥ sapulakaḥ praṇato vinayānvitaḥ ।। 17 ।। śukra uvāca ।। adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ।। svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavānsākṣāddṛṣṭaḥ svamandire ।। 18 ।। sākṣāddṛṣṭāśca tatputrā bhagavantaḥ sanātanāḥ ।। tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇo'tha māmevaṃ paramātmā parātparaḥ ।। 19 ।। kṛtārthaṃ kartumīśā māṃ yuṣmākaṃ svāgataṃ śiśum ।। svātmārāmeṣu kuśalapraśnamevaṃ viḍambanam ।। 20 ।। pavitraṃ kartumīśā māṃ heturāgamane'tra vaḥ ।। aparaṃ brūtha kiṃ vā'pi śāsta naḥ karavāmi kim ।। 21 ।। brahmovāca ।। udvignaściravicchedāttvāṃ pautraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ ।। vicchedaḥ putrapautrāṇāṃ maraṇādatiricyate ।। 22 ।। kuśalaṃ te muniśreṣṭha putrayoścāpi yoṣitaḥ ।। kuśalaṃ te svadharmāṇāṃ kāmyānāṃ tapasāmapi ।। 23 ।। dine dine'paricchannaṃ śrīkṛṣṇārcanamīpsitam ।। sva guroḥ sevanaṃ nityamavicchinnaṃ bhavettava ।। 24 ।। gurviṣṭayoḥ pūjanaṃ ca sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam ।। pāpādhirogaśokaghnaṃ puṇyaharṣapradaṃ śubham।। ।। 29 ।। abhīṣṭadevaḥ santuṣṭo gurau tuṣṭe nṛṇāmiha ।। iṣṭadeve ca santuṣṭe santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। 26 ।। gururvipraḥ suro ruṣṭo yeṣāṃ pātakināmiha ।। teṣāṃ ca kuśalaṃ nāsti vighnastasya pade pade ।। 27 ।। tuṣṭaśca satataṃ vatsa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। sarvāntarātmā bhagavāṃstava bhaktyā ca nirguṇaḥ ।। 28 ।। tava tuṣṭo gururahaṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi ।। mayi tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo harau tuṣṭe tu devatāḥ ।।29।। sāmprataṃ śṛṇu me dhīmannatrāgamanakāraṇam ।। preṣitasya surāṇāṃ ca viśvasaṃhartureva ca ।। 30 ।। śivasya guruputrasya sādhvīṃ tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ।। apahṛtya niśānāthastavaiva śaraṇāgataḥ ।। 31 ।। śambhurdharmaśca sūryyaśca śakro'nantaśca putraka ।। ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālāśca digīśvarāḥ ।। 32 ।। yuddhāyāyānti sannaddhāstisraḥ koṭyaśca devatāḥ ।। nāgāḥ kimpuruṣāścaiva yakṣarākṣasaguhyakāḥ ।। 33 ।। bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍā brahmarākṣasāḥ ।। kirātāścaiva gandharvāḥ samudrapuline'dhunā ।। 34 ।। tārakāmayasaṃgrāme madhyastho 'haṃ sutaiḥ saha ।। dehi tārāṃ raṇaṃ kiṃ vā tyaja candraṃ ca kāminam ।।35।। śukra uvāca ।। āgacchantu surāḥ sarve sannaddhā raṇadurmadāḥ।। yotsye vinā maheśaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ca guruṃ param ।।36।। daityā ūcuḥ ।। ubhayeṣāṃ guruḥ śambhurmānyo vandyaśca sarvadā ।। dharmaśca sākṣī sarveṣāṃ tvameva ca pitāmahaḥ ।।37।। anyāṃśca tṛṇatulyāṃśca nahi manyāmahe vayam ।। āgacchantu ca yotsyāmo vraja brūhi jagadguro।। ।। 38 ।। kṛpayā guruputrasya yadyāyāti maheśvaraḥ ।। āgneyāstraṃ prayokṣyāmaḥ paścādyotsyāmahe prabho ।। 39 ।। brahmovāca ।। kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā viśvasya balināṃ varaḥ ।। he vatsāstena sārddhaṃ ca ko vā yuddhaṃ kariṣyati ।। 40 ।। bhadrakālī jaganmātā khaḍgakharpara dhāriṇī ।। tayā durddharṣayā sārddhaṃ ko vā yuddhaṃ kariṣyati ।। 41 ।। sā sahasrabhujā devī muṇḍamālāvibhūṣaṇā ।। yojanāyatavaktrā ca daśayojanavistṛtā ।। 42 ।। saptatālapramāṇāśca yasyā dantā bhayānakāḥ ।। krośapramāṇajihvā ca māhālolā bhayaṅkarī ।। ।। 43 ।। atīva raudrā sannaddhā bhīmāḥ śaṃkarakiṃkarāḥ ।। atibhīmā bhairavāśca nandī ca raṇakarkaśaḥ ।। 44 ।। śivasya pārṣadāḥ sarvaṃ mahābalaparākramāḥ ।। vīrabhadrādayaḥ śūrāḥ koṭisūryyasamaprabhāḥ ।। 45 ।। sahasramūrdhnaḥ śeṣasya phaṇāmaṇḍalabhūṣaṇam ।। viśvaṃ sarṣapatulyaṃ ca ko vā yoddhā ca tatsamaḥ।।46।। kālāgnirudraḥ saṃharttā yasya śambhośca kiṃkaraḥ।। śūlinastripuraghnasya jvalato brahmatejasā।।47।। yasya pāśupatāstreṇa durnivāryeṇa putrakāḥ ।। bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavedviśvaṃ daityānāṃ caiva kā kathā ।।48। yasya śūlena bhinnaśca śaṅkhacūḍaḥ pratāpavān ।। sudāmā pārṣadavaraḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ।।49।। trikoṭisūryyasadṛśastejasvī paramādbhutaḥ ।। rādhākavacakaṇṭhaśca sarvadaityajaneśvaraḥ ।। 50।। madhukaiṭabhayorhantā hiraṇyakaśipośca yaḥ ।। sa ca viṣṇuḥ samāyāti śvetadvīpātsvayaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 51 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma ca saṃsadi ।। prahasyovāca daiteyo dānavānāmadhīśvaraḥ ।। 52 ।। prahrāda uvāca ।। namastubhyaṃ jagaddhātaḥ sarveṣāṃ prāktaneśvara ।। sarvapūjyaḥ sarvanāthaḥ kiṃ vakṣyāmi tavāgrataḥ ।। 53 ।। hiraṇyakaśiporhantā madhukaiṭabhayośca yaḥ ।। sā kalā yasya kṛṣṇasya paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। ।। 54 ।। sarvāntarātmanastasya cakraṃ nāma sudarśanam ।। asmākaṃ lokamasmāṃśca taddrāgdhakṣyati dussaham ।। 55 ।। tato na balavāñchambhurna ca pāśupataṃ vidhe ।। na ca kālī na śeṣaśca na ca rudrādayaḥ surāḥ ।। 56 ।। yasya lomasu viśvāni nikhilāni jagatpate ।। sarvādhārasya ca vibhoḥ sthūlātsthūlatarasya ca ।। 97 ।। ṣoḍaśāṃśo bhagavataḥ sa caiva hi mahānvirāṭ ।। ananto nahi tatsthūlo na kālī bṛhatī tataḥ ।। 58 ।। āgacchantu surāḥ sarve yuddhaṃ kurvantu sāmpratam ।। na bibhemi śarebhyaśca na ca pāśupatāddharāt ।। 59 ।। namastasmai bhagavate śivāya śivarūpiṇe ।। namo'nantāya sādhubhyo vaiṣṇavebhyaḥ prajāpate ।। 60 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādena nirbhayo'haṃ nirāmayaḥ ।। na me svātmabalaṃ brahmaṃstadbalaṃ yatprabhorbalam ।। 61 ।। svapāpena mṛtastāto purā vai viṣṇunindayā ।। nirbandhācchaṅkhacūḍaśca darpācca madhukaiṭabhau ।। 62 ।। tripuraḥ kiṅkaro'smākaṃ vīratvena na gaṇyate ।। tathā'pi preritastena sa rathastho maheśvaraḥ ।। 63 ।। ityuktvā dānavaśreṣṭho virarāma ca saṃsadi ।। uvāca jagatāṃ dhātā punareva ca nārada ।। 64 ।। brahmovāca ।। vināśakāraṇaṃ yuddhamubhayordaityadevayoḥ।। suprītyā caraṇaṃ vatsa sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam ।। 65 ।। tārāṃ bhikṣāṃ dehi mahyaṃ bhikṣukāya ca vedhase ।। vimukhe bhikṣuke rājangṛhasthaḥ sarvapāpabhāk ।। 66 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca ।। svakīrtiṃ rakṣa rājendra siṃhastvaṃ suradaityayoḥ ।। yasya bhikṣurjagaddhātā tasya kīrteśca kā kathā ।। 67 ।। sanātana uvāca ।। na jitastvaṃ surendraiśca brahmeśānapurogamaiḥ ।। rakṣitaḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa vaiṣṇavaḥ puṇyavāñchuciḥ ।। 68 ।। sanandana uvāca ।। yasyeṣṭadevaḥ sarvātmā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। guruśca vaiṣṇavaḥ śukraḥ sa ca kena jito mahān ।। 69 ।। sanaka uvāca ।। puṇyavānna jitaḥ kena jitaḥ pāpī svapātakaiḥ ।। puṇyadīpo na nirvāti pāṣaṇḍenaiva vāyunā ।। 70 ।। ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।। dehi tārāṃ mahābhāga candra prāṇādhikaṃ guroḥ ।। svakīrtiṃ rakṣa suciraṃ prārthayāmaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 71 ।। prahrāda uvāca ।। sthite madīśvare sākṣānnahi bhṛtyo virājate ।। karttāraṃ brūhi mannāthaṃ guruṃ śukraṃ satāṃ varam ।। 72 ।। śiṣyāṇāmādhipatye ca sādhūnāṃ gururīśvaraḥ ।। gurau samarpitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvaiśvaryyaṃ munīśvaraṃ ।। 73 ।। vayaṃ bhṛtyāśca poṣyāśca svaguroḥ paricārakāḥ ।। te ca śiṣyāḥ kuśalino gurvājñāṃ pālayanti ye ।। 74 ।। prahrādasya vacaḥ śrutvā cakāra prārthanāṃ kavim ।। dadau śukraśca tārāṃ tāṃ candraṃ ca malinaṃ mune ।। 75 ।। dattvā tārāṃ vidhuṃ śukraḥ praṇanāma vidheḥ pade ।। namaskṛtya munibhyaśca praṇataḥ svapuraṃ yayau ।। 76 ।। prahlādaḥ sagaṇo bhaktyā namaskṛtya vidheḥ pade ।। pratyekaṃ vai munigaṇānpraṇataḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau ।। 77 ।। brahmā dadarśa tārāṃ ca praṇatāṃ svapade satīm ।। lajjayā namravaktrāṃ ca rudatīṃ gurviṇīṃ mune ।। 78 ।। candraṃ ca praṇataṃ dhātā kroḍe saṃsthāpya māyayā ।। uvāca malināṃ tārāṃ kātarāṃ ca kṛpāmayaḥ ।।79।। tāre tyaja bhayaṃ mattaḥ bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite ।। saubhāgyayuktā svapatau bhaviṣyasi vareṇa me ।। 80।। durbalā balinā grastā niṣkāmā na cyutā bhavet ।। prāyaścittena śuddhā sā na strī jāreṇa duṣyati ।। 81 ।। sakāmā kāmato jāraṃ bhajate svasukhena ca ।। prāyaścittānna śuddhā sā svāminā parivarjitā ।। 82 ।। kumbhīpāke pacyate sā yāvaccandradivākaram ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ sparśanaṃ sarvapāpadam ।। 83 ।। pāpī yasyāśca tasyāśca sādhubhiḥ parivarjitam ।। kasya garbhaṃ vada śubhe gaccha vatse gurorgṛham ।। 84 ।। tyaja lajjāṃ mahābhāge sarvaṃ ca prāktanādbhavet।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca satī tadā ।।85।। candrasya garbhaṃ he tāta bibharmyadya svakarmaṇā ।। sarve me sākṣiṇaḥ santi durbalāyāḥ prajāpate ।। 86 ।। yadā jagrāha candro māṃ dayāhīnaśca durmatiḥ।। ityuktvā tārakā devī suṣāva kanakaprabham ।। 87 ।। kumāraṃ sundaraṃ tatra jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। gṛhītvā tanayaṃ candro natvā brahmāṇamīśvaram ।। 88 ।। jagāma sa svabhavanaṃ brahmā sindhutaṭaṃ yayau ।। sādhvīṃ tārāṃ ca gurave devebhyo'pyabhayaṃ dadau ।।89।। āśiṣaṃ śambhudharmābhyāṃ dattvā lokaṃ yayau vidhiḥ ।। devā yayuḥ svabhavanaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 90 ।। bhāvānuraktavanitāṃ prāpya saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। tārakāgarbhasaṃbhūtaḥ sa eva ca budhaḥ svayam ।। 91 ।। tejasvī sadgraho brahmaścandrasya tanayo mahān ।। sa eva nandanavane citrāṃ saṃprāpya nirjane ।। 92 ।। ghṛtācyā garbhasaṃbhūtāṃ kuberasya ca retasā ।। dṛṣṭvā ca nirjane ramyāṃ kanyāṃ kamalalocanām ।। 93 ।। atīva yauvanasthāṃ ca bālāṃ ṣoḍaśavārṣikīm ।। gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāṃ jagrāha vidhoḥ sutaḥ ।। 94 ।। tasyāmathāyaṃ rahasi vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। babhūva rājā citrāyāṃ caitro vai maṇḍaleśvaraḥ ।।95।। saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ śāsti vai dhārmiko balī ।। śataṃ nadyo ghṛtānāṃ ca dadhnāṃ nadyaḥ śatāni ca ।। 96 ।। śatāni nadyo dugdhānāṃ madhunadyaśca ṣoḍaśa ।। daśa nadyaśca tailānāṃ śarkarālakṣarāśayaḥ ।। 97 ।। miṣṭānnānāṃ svastikānāṃ lakṣarāśiśca nityaśaḥ ।। pañcakoṭigavāṃ māṃsaṃ sāpūpaṃ svannameva ca ।। 98 । eteṣāṃ ca nadīrāśīrbhuñjate brāhmaṇā mune ।। gavāṃ lakṣaṃ ca ratnānāṃ maṇīnāṃ lakṣameva ca ।। 99 ।। śatalakṣaṃ suvarṇānāṃ lakṣaṃ vai sūkṣmavāsasām ।। ratnānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ pātramatīva sumanoharam ।। 100 ।। dadau dvijātaye rājā nityaṃ vai jīvitāvadhi ।। tasya caitrasya putraśca rājā'dhiratha eva ca ।। 101 ।। tasya putraśca surathaścakravarttī bṛhacchravāḥ ।। mahājñānaṃ ca saṃprāpya medhaso munisattamāt ।। 102 ।। bheje purā viṣṇumāyāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। śaratkāle mahāpūjāṃ cakāra sa sarittaṭe।।103।। vaiśyena sārdhaṃ sa mahāñjñānināṃ munisattama।। rājā kaliṅgadeśasya virādhaśca viśāṃ varaḥ ।। 104 ।। tasya putro mahāyogī drumiṇo jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। drumiṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ prājñaḥ puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।। 105 ।। kṛtvā samādhiṃ saṃprāpa jñānināṃ vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ।। putrairdārairnirastaśca dhanalobhāddurātmabhiḥ ।।106।। sa ca koṭisuvarṇaṃ ca nityaṃ dattvā jalaṃ papau ।। muktiṃ saṃprāpa saṃsevya viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm।।107।। rājā lebhe manutvaṃ ca rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ mune ।। uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ dhātā trijagatāṃ patiḥ ।। 108 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne gurostārāprāptibudhotpattyādivarṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 61 ।।
<2.62> nārada uvāca ।। kathaṃ rājā mahājñānaṃ saṃprāpa munisattamāt ।। vaiśyo muktiṃ medhasaśca tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dhruvasya pautro balavānnandirutkalanandanaḥ ।। svāyambhuvamanorvaṃśyaḥ satyavādī jitendriyaḥ ।। 2 ।। akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ gṛhītvā sainyameva ca ।। kolāṃ ca veṣṭayāmāsa surathasya mahāmateḥ ।।3।। yuddhaṃ babhūva niyataṃ pūrṇamabdaṃ ca nārada ।। ciraṃjīvī vaiṣṇavaśca jigāya surathaṃ nṛpaḥ ।।4।। ekākī suratho bhīto nandinā ca bahiṣkṛtaḥ ।। niśāyāṃ hayamāruhya jagāma gahanaṃ vanam ।। 5 ।। dadarśa tatra vaiśyaṃ ca puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe ।। tayorbabhūva saṃprītiḥ kṛtabāndhavayormune ।। 6 ।। vaiśyena sārddhaṃ nṛpatiragacchanmedhasāśramam ।। puṣkaraṃ duṣkaraṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ vai bhārate satām ।। ।। 7 ।। dadarśa tatra nṛpatirmuniṃ taṃ tīvratejasam ।। śiṣyebhyaśca pravocantaṃ brahmatattvaṃ sudurlabham ।।8।। rājā nanāma vaiśyaśca śirasā munipuṅgavam ।। munistau pūjayāmāsa dadau tābhyāṃ śubhāśiṣam ।। 9 ।। praśnaṃ cakāra kuśalaṃ jātināma pṛthakpṛthak ।। dadau pratyuttaraṃ rājā krameṇa munipuṅgavam ।। 10 ।। suratha uvāca ।। rājā'haṃ suratho brahmaṃścaitravaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। bahirbhūtaḥ svarājyācca nandinā balinā'dhunā ।। ।। 11 ।। kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi kathaṃ rājyaṃ bhavenmama ।। tanmāṃ brūhi mahābhāga tvāmeva śaraṇāgatam ।। 12 ।। ayaṃ vaiśyaḥ samādhiśca svagṛhācca bahiṣkṛtaḥ ।। putraiḥ kalatrairdaivena dhanalobhena dhārmikaḥ ।। 13 ।। brāhmaṇāya dadau nityaṃ ratnakoṭiṃ dine dine ।। niṣiddhyamānaḥ putraiśca kalatrairbāndhavairayam ।। 14 ।। kopānnirākṛtastaiśca punaranveṣitaḥ śucā ।। ayaṃ gṛhaṃ ca na yayau virakto jñānavāñchuciḥ।। 15 ।। putrāśca pitṛśokena gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yayurvanam ।। dattvā dānāni viprebhyo viraktāḥ sarvakarmasu ।। 16 ।। sudurlabhaṃ harerdāsyaṃ vaiśyasyāsya ca vāñchitam ।। kathaṃ prāpnoti niṣkāmastanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 17 ।। śrīmedhā uvāca ।। karoti māyayā cchannaṃ viṣṇumāyā duratyayā ।। nirguṇasya ca kṛṣṇasya triguṇā viśvamājñayā ।। 18 ।। kṛpāṃ karoti yeṣāṃ sā dharmiṇāṃ ca kṛpāmayī ।। tebhyo dadāti kṛpayā kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ।। 19 ।। yeṣāṃ māyāvināṃ māyā na karoti kṛpāṃ nṛpa ।। māyayā tānnibadhnāti mohajālena durgatān ।। 20 ।। naśvare'nityasaṃsāre bhrāmayedbarbarā sadā ।। kurvantī nityabuddhiṃ ca vihāya parameśvaram ।। 21 ।। devamanyaṃ niṣevante tanmantraṃ ca japaṃti ca ।। mithyā kiñcinnimittaṃ ca kṛtvā manasi lobhataḥ ।। 22 ।। saptajanmasu saṃsevya devatāśca hareḥ kalāḥ ।। tadā prakṛtyā kṛpayā sevante prakṛtiṃ tadā ।। 23 ।। saptajanmasu saṃsevya viṣṇumāyāṃ kṛpāmayīm ।। śive bhaktiṃ labhante te jñānānande sanātane ।। 24 ।। jñānādhiṣṭhātṛdevaṃ ca haressaṃsevya śaṅkaram ।। acirādviṣṇubhaktiṃ ca prāpnuvanti maheśvarāt ।। 25 ।। sevante saguṇaṃ sattvaṃ viṣṇuṃ viṣayiṇaṃ tadā ।। sattvajñānācca paśyanti jñānaṃ vai nirmalaṃ narāḥ ।। ।। 26 ।। niṣevya saguṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ sāttvikā vaiṣṇavā narāḥ ।। labhante nirguṇe bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe prakṛteḥ pare ।। 27 ।। gṛhṇanti santastadbhaktā mantraṃ tasya nirāmayam ।। niṣevya nirguṇaṃ devaṃ te bhavanti ca nirguṇāḥ ।। 28 ।। asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pātaṃ te ca paśyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। dāsyaṃ kurvanti satataṃ goloke ca nirāmaye ।। 29 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktātkṛṣṇamantraṃ yo gṛhṇāti narottamaḥ ।। puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca svapitṝṇāṃ samuddharet ।। 30 ।। mātāmahānāṃ sāhasramuddharenmātaraṃ tathā ।। dāsādikaṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ sa prayāti ca ।। 31 ।। bhavārṇave mahāghore karṇadhārasvarūpiṇī ।। dīnānpārayate nityaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktyā ca naukayā ।। 32 ।। svakarmabandhanaṃ chettuṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavī ।। tīkṣṇaśastrasvarūpā sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 33 ।। vivecikā cāvaraṇī śakteḥ śaktirdvidhā nṛpa ।। pūrvaṃ dadāti bhaktāya cetarāya parātparā ।। 34 ।। satyasvarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastasmātsarvaṃ ca naśvaram ।। buddhirviveciketyevaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ sanātanī ।। 35 ।। nityarūpā mameyaṃ śrīriti cāvaraṇī ca dhīḥ ।। avaiṣṇavānāmasatāṃ karmmabhogabhujāmaho ।। 36 ।। ahaṃ pracetasaḥ putraḥ pautraśca brahmaṇo nṛpa ।। bhajāmi kṛṣṇamātmānaṃ jñānaṃ saṃprāpya śaṅkarāt ।। 37 ।। gaccha rājannadītīraṃ bhaja durgāṃ sanātanīm ।। buddhimāvaraṇīṃ tubhyaṃ devo dāsyati kāmine ।। 38 ।। niṣkāmāya ca vaiśyāya vaiṣṇavāya ca vaiṣṇavī ।। buddhiṃ vivecikāṃ śuddhāṃ dāsyatyeva kṛpāmayī।। 39।। ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho dadau tābhyāṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। pūjāvidhānaṃ durgāyāḥ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ manum ।। ।। 40 ।। vaiśyo muktiṃ ca saṃprāpa tāṃ niṣevya kṛpāmayīm ।। rājā rājyaṃ manutvaṃ ca paramaiśvaryyamīpsitam ।। 41 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ durgopākhyānamuttamam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 42 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛti khaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne surathamedhassaṃvāde surathavaiśyayorabhilaṣitasiddhirnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 62 ।।
<2.63> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇa mahābhāga vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। rājā kena prakāreṇa siṣeve prakṛtiṃ parām ।। 1 ।। samādhirnāma vaiśyo vā niṣkāmaṃ nirguṇaṃ vibhum ।। bheje kena prakāreṇa prakṛterupadeśataḥ ।। 2 ।। kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānaṃ ca dhyānaṃ vā manureva ca ।। kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ kiṃ vā dadau rājñe mahāmuniḥ ।। 3 ।। vaiśyāya prakṛtistasmai kiṃ vā jñānaṃ dadau param ।। sākṣādbabhūva sahasā kena vā prakṛtistayoḥ ।। 4 ।। jñānaṃ saṃprāpya vaiśyaśca kiṃ padaṃ prāpa durlabham ।। gatirbabhūva rājñaśca kā vā tāṃ ca śṛṇomyaham ।। 5 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rājā vaiśyaśca saṃprāpya mantraṃ vai medhaso muneḥ ।। stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ devyā dhyānaṃ caiva puraskriyām ।। jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ rājā vaiśyaśca puṣkare ।। 6 ।। snātvā trikālaṃ varṣaṃ ca tataḥ śuddho babhūva saḥ ।। sākṣādbabhūva tatraiva mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 7 ।। rājñe dadau rājyavaraṃ manutvaṃ vāñchitaṃ sukham ।। jñānaṃ nigūḍhaṃ vaiśyāya dadau cātisudurlabham ।। 8 ।। yaddattaṃ śūline pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। nirāhāramatikliṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā vaiśyaṃ kṛpāmayī ।।9 ।। ruroda kṛtvā kroḍe tamaceṣṭaṃ śvāsavarjitam ।। cetanāṃ kuru bho vatsetyuccāryya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 10।। cetanāṃ ca dadau tasmai svayaṃ caitanyarūpiṇī ।। saṃprāpya cetanāṃ vaiśyo ruroda prakṛteḥ puraḥ ।। 11 ।। tamuvāca prasannā'sau kṛpayā'tikṛpāmayī ।। 12 ।। śrīprakṛtiruvāca ।। varaṃ vṛṇuṣva he vatsa yatte manasi varttate ।। brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā tato vā'tisudurlabham ।। 13 ।। indratvaṃ vā manutvaṃ vā sarvasiddhatvameva ca ।। tucchaṃ tubhyaṃ na dāsyāmi naśvaraṃ bālavañcanam ।। 14।। vaiśya uvāca ।। brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā mātarme nahi vāñchitam ।। tato'tidurlabhaṃ kiṃ vā na jāne tadabhīpsitam ।। 15 ।। tvayyeva śaraṇāpanno dehi yadvāñchitaṃ tava ।। anaśvaraṃ sarvasāraṃ varaṃ me dātumarhasi ।। 16 ।। prakṛtiruvāca ।। adeyaṃ nāsti me tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi mama vāñchitam ।। yato yāsyasi golokaṃ padameva sudurlabham ।। 17 ।। sarvasāraṃ ca yajjñānaṃ surarṣīṇāṃ sudurlabham ।। tadgṛhyatāṃ mahābhāga gaccha vatsa hareḥ padam ।। 18 ।। smaraṇaṃ vandanaṃ dhyānamarcanaṃ guṇakīrttanam ।। śravaṇaṃ bhāvanaṃ sevā kṛṣṇe sarvanivedanam ।।19।। etadevaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ navadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiyamatāḍanakhaṇḍanam ।। 20।। āyurharati lokānāṃ ravireva hi santatam ।। navadhā bhaktihīnānāmasatāṃ pāpināmapi ।। 21 ।। bhaktāstadgatacittāśca vaiṣṇavāścirajīvinaḥ ।। jīvanmuktāśca niṣpāpā janmādiparivarjitāḥ ।। 22 ।। śivaḥ śeṣaśca dharmaśca brahmā viṣṇurmahānvirāṭ ।। sanatkumāraḥ kapilaḥ sanakaśca sanandanaḥ ।। 23 ।। voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho dakṣo nāradaśca sanātanaḥ ।। bhṛgurmarīcirdurvāsāḥ kaśyapaḥ pulaho'ṅgirāḥ ।। 24 ।। medhāvī lomaśaḥ śukro vasiṣṭhaḥ kratureva ca ।। bṛhaspatiḥ kardamaśca śaktiratriḥ parāśaraḥ ।। 25 ।। mārkaṇḍeyo baliścaiva prahlādaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। yamaḥ sūryyaśca varuṇo vāyuścandro hutāśanaḥ ।। 26 ।। akūpāra ulūkaśca nāḍījaṃghaśca vāyujaḥ ।। naranārāyaṇau kūrmma indradyumno vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 27 ।। navadhā bhaktiyuktāśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। ete mahānto dharmiṣṭhā bhaktānāṃ pravarāstathā ।। 28 ।। ye tadbhaktāste tadaṃśā jīvanmuktāśca santatam ।। pāpāpahārāstīrthānāṃ pṛthivyāśca viśāṃ pate ।। 29 ।। ūrdhvaṃ ca sapta svargāśca saptadvīpā vasundharā ।। adhassapta ca pātālā etadbrahmāṇḍameva ca ।। 30 ।। evaṃvidhānāṃ viśvānāṃ saṃkhyā nāstyeva putraka ।। evaṃ ca prativiśveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ।।31।। devā devarṣayaścaiva manavo mānavādayaḥ ।। sarvāśramāśca sarvatra santi baddhāśca māyayā ।। 32 ।। mahāviṣṇorlomakūpe santi viśvāni yasya ca ।। sa ṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ kṛṣṇasya cātmanaśca mahāvirāṭ ।। ।। 33 ।। bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma nityaṃ nirguṇamacyutam ।। prakṛteḥ paramīśānaṃ kṛṣṇamātmānamīpsitam ।। 34 ।। nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirvikāraṃ nirañjanam ।। niṣkāmaṃ nirvirodhaṃ ca nityānandaṃ sanātanam ।। 39 ।। svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। tejassvarūpaṃ paramaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 36 ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ śivādīnāṃ ca yoginām ।। sarveśvaraṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmadam ।। 37 ।। sarvādhāraṃ ca sarvajñaṃ sarvānandakaraṃ param ।। sarvadharmapradaṃ sarvaṃ sarvajñaṃ prāṇarūpiṇam ।। 38 ।। sarvadharmasvarūpaṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ pararūpaṃ ca bhaktidam ।। 39 ।। dāsyadaṃ dharmadaṃ caiva sarvasiddhipradaṃ satām ।। sarvaṃ tadatiriktaṃ ca naśvaraṃ kṛtrimaṃ sadā ।। 40 ।। parātparataraṃ śuddhaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ śivam ।। yathāsukhaṃ gaccha vatsa bhagavantamadhokṣajam ।। 41 ।। kṛṣṇeti dvyakṣaraṃ mantraṃ gṛhītvā kṛṣṇadāsyadam ।। puṣkaraṃ duṣkaraṃ gatvā daśalakṣamimaṃ japa ।। 42 ।। daśalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavettava ।। ityuktvā sā bhagavatī tatraivāntaradhīyata ।।43।। vaiśyo natvā ca tāṃ bhaktyā cāgamatpuṣkaraṃ mune ।। puṣkare duṣkaraṃ taptvā sa lebhe kṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। bhagavatyāḥ prasādena kṛṣṇadāso babhūva saḥ ।। 44 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃ vāde durgopākhyāne surathasamādhimedhassaṃvāde prakṛtivaiśyasaṃvādakathanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 63 ।।
<2.64> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rājā yena krameṇaiva bheje tāṃ prakṛtiṃ parām ।। tacchrūyatāṃ mahābhāga vedoktaṃ kramameva ca ।। 1 ।। snātvā''camya mahārājaḥ kṛtvā nyāsatrayaṃ tadā ।। svakarāṅgāṅgamantrāṇāṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 2 ।। prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca śaṅkhaśodhanam ।। dhyātvā devīṃ ca mṛnmayyāṃ cakārāvāhanaṃ tadā ।। 3 ।। punardhyātvā ca bhaktyā ca pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। devyāśca dakṣiṇe bhāge saṃsthāpya kamalālayām ।।4 ।। saṃpūjya bhaktibhāvena bhaktyā paramadhārmikaḥ ।। devaṣaṭkaṃ samāvāhya devyāśca purato ghaṭe।। 5 ।। bhaktyā ca pūjayāmāsa vidhipūrvaṃ ca nārada ।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ।। 6 ।। devaṣaṭkaṃ ca saṃpūjya namaskṛtya vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। tadā dhyāyenmahādevīṃ dhyānenānena bhaktitaḥ ।। 7 ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ paraṃ kalpataruṃ mune ।। dhyāyennityaṃ mahādevīṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm।। ।। 8 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ pūjyāṃ vandyāṃ sanātanīm ।। nārāyaṇīṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ viṣṇubhaktidām ।। 9 ।। sarvasvarūpāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvādhārāṃ parātparām ।। sarvavidyāsarvamantrasarvaśaktisvarūpiṇīm।। 10।। saguṇāṃ nirguṇāṃ sattvāṃ varāṃ svecchāmayīṃ satīm ।। mahāviṣṇośca jananīṃ kṛṣṇasyārddhāṅgasambhavām।।11।। kṛṣṇapriyāṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiṃ kṛṣṇabuddhyadhidevatām ।। kṛṣṇastutāṃ kṛṣṇapūjyāṃ kṛṣṇavandyāṃ kṛpāmayīm ।। 12 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ koṭisūryyasamaprabhām ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakārikām ।। 13 ।। durgāṃ śatabhujāṃ devīṃ mahaddurgatināśinīm ।। trilocanapriyāṃ sādhvīṃ triguṇāṃ ca trilocanām ।। 14 ।। trilocanaprāṇarūpāṃ śuddhārddhacandraśekharām ।। bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam ।। 15 ।। vartulaṃ vāmavaktraṃ ca śambhormānasamohinīm ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitām ।। 16 ।। nāsādakṣiṇabhāgena bibhratīṃ gajamauktikam ।। amūlyaratnaṃ bahulaṃ bibhratīṃ śravaṇopari ।। 17 ।। muktāpaṃktivinindyaikadantapaṃktisuśobhitām ।। pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca suprasannāṃ sumaṃgalām ।। 18 ।। citrapatrāvalīramyakapolayugalojjvalām ।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitām ।। 19 ।। ratnakaṅkaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ ratnapāśaṃkaśobhitām ।। ratnāṃgulīyanikaraiḥ karāṃgulicayojjvalām ।। ।। 20 ।। pādāṅgulinakhāsaktālaktarekhāsuśobhanām ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ gandhacandanacarcitām ।। 21 ।। bibhratīṃ stanayugmaṃ ca kastūrībinduśobhitam ।। sarvarūpaguṇavatīṃ gajendramandagāminīm ।। 22 ।। atīva kāntāṃ śāntāṃ ca nitāntāṃ yogasiddhiṣu ।। vidhātuśca vidhātrīṃ ca sarvadhātrīṃ ca śaṃkarīm ।। 23 ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāmatīva sumanoharām ।। kastūrībindubhiḥ sārddhamadhaścandanabindunā ।। 24 ।। sindūrabindunā śaśvadbhālamadhyasthalojjvalām ।। śaranmadhyāhnakamalaprabhāmocanalocanām ।। 25 ।। cārukajjalarekhābhyāṃ sarvataśca samujjvalām ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlāninditavigrahām ।। 26 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃ ca sadratnamukuṭojjvalām ।। sṛṣṭau sraṣṭuḥ śilparūpāṃ dayāṃ pātuśca pālane ।। 27 ।। saṃhārakāle saṃharttuḥ parāṃ saṃhārarūpiṇīm ।। niśumbhaśumbhamathinīṃ mahiṣāsuramardinīm ।। 28 ।। purā tripurayuddhe ca saṃstutā tripurāriṇā ।। madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe viṣṇuśaktisvarūpiṇīm ।। 29 ।। sarvadaityanihantrīṃ ca raktabījavināśinīm ।। nṛsiṃhaśaktirūpāṃ ca hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe ।। 30।। varāhaśaktiṃ vārāhe hiraṇyākṣavadhe tathā।। parabrahmasvarūpāṃ ca sarvaśaktiṃ sadā bhaje ।। 31 ।। iti dhyātvā svaśirasi puṣpaṃ dattvā vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। punardhyātvā caiva bhaktyā kuryyādāvāhanaṃ tataḥ ।। 32 ।। prakṛteḥ pratimāṃ dhṛtvā mantramevaṃ paṭhennaraḥ ।। jīvanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryyānmanunā'nena yatnataḥ ।। 33 ।। ehyehi bhagavatyamba śivalokātsanātani ।। gṛhāṇa mama pūjāṃ ca śāradīyāṃ sureśvari ।। 34 ।। ihāgaccha jagatpūjye tiṣṭha tiṣṭha maheśvari ।। he mātarasyāmarcāyāṃ sanniruddhā bhavāmbike ।। 35 ।। ihāgacchantu tvatprāṇāścādhiprāṇaiḥ sahācyute ।। ihāgacchantu tvaritaṃ tavaiva sarva śaktayaḥ ।। 36 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ ca durgāyai vahnijāyāntameva ca ।। samuccāryyorasi prāṇāḥ santiṣṭhantu sadāśive ।। 37 ।। sarvendriyādhidevāste ihāgacchantu caṇḍike।। te śaktayo'trāgacchantu ihāgacchantu īśvarāḥ ।। 38 ।। sa ihāgacchetyāvāhya parihāraṃ karoti ca ।। mantreṇānena viprendra tacchṛṇuṣva
