samāhitaḥ ।। 39 ।। svāgataṃ bhagavatyamba śivalokācchivapriye ।। prasādaṃ kuru māṃ bhadre bhadrakāli namo'stu te ।। 40 ।। dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama ।। āgatā'si yato durge māheśvari madālayam ।। 41 ।। adya me saphalaṃ janma sārthakaṃ jīvanaṃ mama ।। pūjayāmi yato durgāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 42 ।। bhārate bhavatīṃ pūjyāṃ durgāṃ yaḥ pūjayed budhaḥ ।। so'nte yāti ca golokaṃ paramaiśvaryyavāniha ।।43।। kṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavīpūjāṃ viṣṇulokaṃ vrajetsudhīḥ ।। māheśvarīṃ ca saṃpūjya śivalokaṃ ca gacchati ।। 44 ।। sāttvikī rājasī caiva tridhā pūjā ca tāmasī ।। bhagavatyāśca vedoktā cottamā madhyamā 'dhamā ।। 45 ।। sāttvikī vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca śāktādīnāṃ ca rājasī ।। adīkṣitānāmasatāmanyeṣāṃ tāmasī smṛtā ।। 46 ।। jīvahatyā vihīnā yā varā pūjā tu vaiṣṇavī ।। vaiṣṇavā yānti golokaṃ vaiṣṇavībalidānataḥ ।। 47 ।। māheśvarī rājasī ca balidānasamanvitā ।। śāktādayo rājasāśca kailāsaṃ yānti te tathā ।। 48 ।। kirātāstridivaṃ yānti tāmasyā pūjayā tayā ।। tvameva jagatāṃ mātaścaturvargaphalapradā ।। 49 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharā tvaṃ ca parātparā ।। 50 ।। sukhadā mokṣadā bhadrā kṛṣṇabhaktipradā sadā ।। nārāyaṇi mahāmāye durge durgatināśini ।। 51 ।। durgeti smṛtimātreṇa yāti durgaṃ nṛṇāmiha ।। iti kṛtvā parīhāraṃ devyā vāme ca sādhakaḥ ।। 52 ।। tripadyā upariṣṭāttu śaṃkhaṃ saṃsthāpayettu saḥ ।। tatra dattvā jalaṃ pūrṇaṃ dūrvāṃ puṣpaṃ ca candanam ।। 53 ।। dhṛtvā dakṣiṇahastena mantramevaṃ paṭhennaraḥ ।। puṇyastvaṃ śaṃkha puṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam ।। prabhūtaḥ śaṃkhacūḍāttvaṃ purā kalpe pavitrakaḥ ।। 54 ।। tato'rghyapātraṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinā'nena paṇḍitaḥ ।। dattvā saṃpūjayeddevīmupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।।55।। trikoṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā sajalena kuśena ca ।। kūrmaṃ śeṣaṃ dharitrīṃ ca pūjayettatra dhārmikaḥ ।। 56 ।। tripadīṃ sthāpayettatra tripadyāṃ śaṃkhameva ca ।। śaṃkhe tribhāgatoyaṃ ca dattvā saṃpūjayettataḥ ।। 57 ।। gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati ।। narmmade sindhukāveri candrabhāge ca kauśiki ।।98।। svarṇarekhe kanakhale pāribhadre ca gaṇḍaki ।। śvetagaṅge rudrarekhe pampe campe ca gomati ।। ।।59।। padmāvati triparṇāśe vipāśe viraje prabhe ।। śatahrade celagaṃge jale'sminsannidhiṃ kuru ।। 60।। vahniṃ sūryyaṃ ca candraṃ ca viṣṇuṃ ca varuṇaṃ śivam ।। pūjayettatra toye ca tulasyā candanena ca ।। naivedyāni ca sarvāṇi prokṣayettajjalena ca।।61।। pratyekaṃ vai tato dadyādupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyaṃ snānīyamanulepanam ।। 62 ।। madhuparkaṃ gandhamarghyaṃ puṣpaṃ naivedyamīpsitam ।। punarācamanīyaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam ।। 63 ।। dhūpaṃ pradīpaṃ talpaṃ cetyupacārāstu ṣoḍaśa ।। 64 ।। amūlyaratnasaṃklṛptaṃ nānācitra virājitam ।। varaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhyatāṃ śaṅkarapriye ।। 65 ।। anantasūtraprabhavamīśvarecchāvinirmitam ।। jvaladagniviśuddhaṃ ca vasanaṃ gṛhyatāṃ śive ।। 66 ।। amūlyaratnapātrasthaṃ nirmalaṃ jāhnavījalam ।। pādaprakṣālanārthāya durge devi pragṛhyatām ।। ।। 67 ।। sugandhāmalakīsnigdhadravametatsudurlabham ।। supakvaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari ।। 68 ।। kastūrīkuṃkumāktaṃ ca sugandhi drutacandanam ।। suvāsitaṃ jaganmātargṛhyatāmanulepanam ।। 69 ।। mādhvīkaṃ ratnapātrasthaṃ supavitraṃ sumaṅgalam ।। madhuparkaṃ mahādevi gṛhyatāṃ prītipūrvakam ।। 70 ।। sugandhamūlacūrṇaṃ ca sugandhadravyasaṃyutam ।। supavitraṃ maṅgalārhaṃ devi gandhaṃ gṛhāṇa me ।। 71 ।। pavitraṃ śaṃkhapātrasthaṃ dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitam ।। svargamandākinītoyamarghyaṃ caṇḍi gṛhāṇa me ।। 72 ।। sugandhi puṣpaśreṣṭhaṃ ca pārijātatarūdbhavam ।। nānāpuṣpādimālyāni gṛhyantāṃ jagadambike ।।73।। divyaṃ siddhānnamāmānnaṃ piṣṭakaṃ pāyasādikam ।। miṣṭānnaṃ laḍḍukaphalaṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ śive ।। 74 ।। suvāsitaṃ śītatoyaṃ karpūrādisusaṃskṛtam।। mayā niveditaṃ bhaktyā gṛhyatāṃ śailakanyake ।। 75 ।। guvākaparṇacūrṇaṃ ca karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। sarvabhogakaraṃ ramyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 76 ।। amūlyaratnasāraiśca khacitaṃ ceśvarecchayā ।। sarvāṅgaśobhanakaraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ devi gṛhyatām ।। 77 ।। taruniryyāsacūrṇaṃ ca gandhavastusamanvitam ।। hutāśamaśikhāśuddhaṃ dhūpaṃ devi ca gṛhyatām ।। 78 ।। divyaratnaviśeṣaṃ ca sāndradhvāntanivārakam ।। supavitraṃ pradīpaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvari ।। 79 ।। ratnasāragaṇākīrṇaṃ divyaṃ paryyaṅkamuttamam ।। sūkṣmavastraiśca saṃsyūtaṃ devi talpaṃ pragṛhyatām ।। 80 ।। evaṃ saṃpūjya tāṃ durgāṃ dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ mune ।। tato'ṣṭanāyakā devīryatnataḥ paripūjayet ।। 81 ।। ugracaṇḍāṃ pracaṇḍāṃ ca caṇḍogrāṃ caṇḍanāyikām ।। aticaṇḍāṃ ca caṇḍāṃ ca caṇḍāṃ caṇḍavatīṃ tathā ।।82।। padme cāṣṭadale caitāḥ prāgādikramatastathā।। pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya bhairavānmadhyadeśataḥ।।83।। ādau mahābhairavaṃ ca tathā saṃhārabhairavam ।। asitāṃgabhairavaṃ ca rurubhairavameva ca ।। 84 ।। kālabhairavamapyevaṃ krodhabhairavameva ca ।। tāmracūḍaṃ candracūḍamante vai bhairavadvayam ।। 85 ।। etānsaṃpūjya madhye vai nava śaktīṃśca pūjayet ।। tatra padme cāṣṭadale madhye vai bhaktipūrvakam ।। 86 ।। brahmāṇīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ caiva raudrīṃ māheśvarīṃ tathā ।। nārasiṃhī ca vārāhīmindrāṇīṃ kārttikīṃ tathā ।। 87 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca pradhānāṃ sarvamaṅgalām ।। nava śaktīśca saṃpūjya ghaṭe devāṃśca pūjayet ।। 88 ।। śaṅkaraṃ kārttikeyaṃ ca sūryyaṃ somaṃ hutāśanam ।। vāyuṃ ca varuṇaṃ caiva devyāśceṭīṃ baṭuṃ tathā ।। 89 ।। catuṣṣaṣṭiṃ yoginīnāṃ saṃpūjya vidhipūrvakam ।। yathāśakti baliṃ dattvā karoti stavanaṃ budhaḥ ।। 90 ।। kavacaṃ ca gale baddhvā paṭhitvā bhaktipūrvakam ।। tataḥ kṛtvā parīhāraṃ namaskuryyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।। 91 ।। balidānavidhānaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munisattama ।। māyārtiṃ mahiṣaṃ chāgaṃ dadyānmeṣādikaṃ śubham ।। 92 ।। sahasravarṣaṃ suprītā durgā māyātidānataḥ ।। mahiṣācchatavarṣaṃ ca daśavarṣaṃ ca chāgalāt ।। 93 ।। varṣaṃ meṣeṇa kūṣmāṇḍaiḥ pakṣibhirhariṇaistathā ।। daśavarṣaṃ kṛṣṇasāraiḥ sahasrābdaṃ ca gaṇḍakaiḥ ।।94।। kṛtrimaiḥ piṣṭakalitaiḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ paśubhistathā ।। māsaṃ supakvādiphalairakṣatairiti nārada ।। 95 ।। yuvakaṃ vyādhihīnaṃ ca saśṛṃgaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam ।। viśuddhamavikārāṃgaṃ suvarṇaṃ puṣṭameva ca ।। 96 ।। śiśunā balinā dāturhanti putraṃ ca caṇḍikā ।। vṛddhena vai gurujanaṃ kṛśenāpīṣṭabāndhavān ।। 97 ।। dhanaṃ caivādhikāṃgena hīnāṃgena prajāstathā ।। kāminīṃ śṛṃgabhaṃgena kāṇena bhrātaraṃ tathā ।। 98 ।। ghuṭikena bhavenmṛtyurvighnaṃ syāccitramastakaiḥ ।। hanti mitraṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhairbhraṣṭaśrīḥ pucchahīnataḥ ।। 99 ।। māyātīnāṃ svarūpaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munisattama ।। vakṣyāmyatharvavedoktaṃ phalahānirvyatikrame ।। 100 ।। pitṛmātṛvihīnaṃ ca yuvakaṃ vyādhivarjitam ।। vivāhitaṃ dīkṣitaṃ ca paradāravihīnakam ।। 101 ।। ajārajaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca sacchūdraparipoṣitam ।। tadbandhubhyo dhanaṃ dattvā krītamūlyātirekataḥ ।। 102 ।। snāpayitvā ca taṃ karttā pūjayedvastracandanaiḥ ।। mālyairdhūpaiśca sindūrairdadhigorocanādibhiḥ ।। 103 ।। taṃ ca varṣaṃ bhrāmayitvā bhṛtyadvāreṇa yatnataḥ ।। varṣānte ca samutsṛjya durgāyai taṃ nivedayet ।। 104 ।। aṣṭamīnavamīsandhau dadyānmāyātimeva ca ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ balidānaṃ prasaṅgataḥ ।। 105 ।। baliṃ stutvā ca dattvā ca dhṛtvā ca kavacaṃ budhaḥ ।। praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ।। 106 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne pūjāvidhibalipaśulakṣaṇaviśeṣo nāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।64।।
<2.65> nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga sudhārasaparaṃ varam ।। stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ pūjāphalaṃ kālaṃ vada prabho ।।1।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ārdrāyāṃ bodhayeddevīṃ mūlenaiva praveśayet ।। uttareṇārccayitvā tāṃ śravaṇāyāṃ visarjayet ।।2।। ārdrāyuktanavamyāṃ tu kṛtvā devyāśca bodhanam ।। pūjāyāḥ śatavārṣikyāḥ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।। 3 ।। mūlāyāṃ tu praveśe ca naramedhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 4 ।। kṛtvā visarjanaṃ devyāḥ śravaṇāyāṃ ca mānavaḥ।। lakṣmīṃ ca putrapautrāṃśca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ।।5।। bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pūjāyāṃ labhate naraḥ ।। nakṣatrayogābhāve tu pārvatyāścaiva nārada ।।6।। navamyāṃ bodhanaṃ kṛtvā pakṣaṃ saṃpūjya mānavaḥ।। aśvamedhaphalāvāptyai daśamyāṃ ca visarjayet ।।7।। saptamyāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।। aṣṭamyāṃ pūjanaṃ śastaṃ balidānavivarjitam ।।8।। aṣṭamyāṃ balidānena vipattirjāyate nṛṇām ।। dadyādvicakṣaṇo bhaktyā navamyāṃ vidhivadbalim।।9।। balidānena viprendra durgāprītirbhavennṛṇām।। hiṃsājanyaṃ na pāpaṃ ca labhate yajñakarmaṇi।। 10।। utsargakarttā dātā ca cchettā poṣṭā ca rakṣakaḥ ।। agre paścānnibaddhā ca saptaite'vadhakāriṇaḥ ।। 11 ।। yo yaṃ hanti sa taṃ hanti neti vedoktameva ca ।। kurvanti vaiṣṇavīṃ pūjāṃ vaiṣṇavāstena hetunā ।। 12 ।। evaṃ saṃpūjya surathaḥ pūrṇaṃ varṣaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ।। kavacaṃ ca gale baddhvā tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm ।। 13 ।। stotreṇa parituṣṭā sā tasya sākṣādbabhūva ha ।। sa dadarśa puro devīṃ grīṣmasūryyasamaprabhām ।। 14 ।। tejasvarūpāṃ paramāṃ saguṇāṃ nirguṇāṃ varām ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ kamanīyāṃ ca tejomaṇḍalamadhyataḥ ।। 15 ।। svecchāmayīṃ kṛpārūpāṃ bhaktānugrahakāriṇīm ।। punastuṣṭāva rājendro bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। 16 ।। stavena parituṣṭā sā sasmitā bhaktipūrvakam ।। uvāca satyaṃ rājendraṃ kṛpayā jagadambikā ।। 17 ।। prakṛtiruvāca ।। sākṣātsaṃprāpya māṃ rājanvṛṇoṣi vibhavaṃ varam ।। dadāmi tubhyaṃ vibhavaṃ sāmprataṃ vāñchitaṃ tava।।18।। nirjitya sarvāñchatrūṃśca labdhvā rājyamakaṇṭakam ।। bhaviṣyasi mahārāja sāvarṇirmanuraṣṭamaḥ।।19।। dāsyāmi tubhyaṃ jñānaṃ ca pariṇāme narādhipa ।। bhaktiṃ dāsyaṃ ca parame śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ।। 20 ।। vṛṇoti vibhavaṃ yo hi sākṣānmāṃ prāpya mandadhīḥ ।। māyayā vañcitaḥ so'pi viṣamattyamṛtaṃ tyajet ।। 21 ।। brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva ca ।। nityaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇaṃ nirguṇameva ca ।। 22 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmahamādyā parātparā ।। saguṇā nirguṇā cāpi varā svecchāmayī sadā ।।23।। nityā 'nityā sarvarūpā sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। bījarūpā ca sarveṣāṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 24 ।। puṇye vṛndāvane ramye goloke rāsamaṇḍale।। rādhā prāṇādhikā'haṃ ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 25 ।। ahaṃ durgā viṣṇumāyā buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। ahaṃ lakṣmīśca vaikuṇṭhe svayaṃ devī sarasvatī ।। 25 ।। sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ brahmāṇī brahmalokataḥ ।। ahaṃ gaṅgā ca tulasī sarvādhārā vasundharā ।। 27 ।। nānāvidhā'haṃ kalayā māyayā sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। sā'haṃ kṛṣṇena saṃsṛṣṭā nṛpa bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā ।।28।। bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā sṛṣṭo yena puṃsā mahānvirāṭ।। lomnāṃ kūpeṣu viśvāni yasya santi hi nityaśaḥ ।। 29 ।। asaṃkhyāni ca tānyeva kṛtrimāṇi ca māyayā ।। anitye nityabuddhiṃ ca sarve kurvanti santatam ।। 30 ।। saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpā vasundharā ।। tadadhaḥ sapta pātālāḥ svarlokāścaiva sapta ca ।। 31 ।। evaṃ viśvaṃ bahuvidhaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ।। pratyekaṃ sarvavidhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।।32।। sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇa iti jñānaṃ parātparam ।। vedānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā ।।33।। devānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ sāraḥ kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ।। tadbhaktihīno yo mūḍhaḥ sa ca jīvanmṛto dhuvam ।। 34 ।। pavitrāṇi ca tīrthāni tadbhaktasparśavāyunā ।। tanmantropāsakaścaiva jīvanmukta iti smṛtaḥ ।। 39 ।। mantragrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet ।। vinā japena tapasā vinā tīrthena pūjayā ।। 36 ।। mātāmahānāṃ śatakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। puṃsāmevaṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ ca sa gacchati ।। 37 ।। idaṃ jñānaṃ sārabhūtaṃ kathitaṃ te narādhipa ।। manvantarānte bhogānte bhaktiṃ dāsyāmi te harau ।। 38 ।। nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karmma kalpakoṭiśatairapi ।। avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karmma śubhāśubham ।। ।। 39 ।। ahaṃ yamanugṛhṇāmi tasmai dāsyāmi nirmalām ।। niścalāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ।। 40 ।। karomi vañcanāṃ yaṃ yaṃ tebhyo dāsyāmi sampadam ।। prātaḥ svapnasvarūpāṃ ca mithyeti bhramarūpiṇīm ।। 41 ।। iti te kathitaṃ jñānaṃ gaccha vatsa yathāsukham।। ityuktvā ca mahādevī tatraivāntaradhīyata।।42।। rājā saṃprāpya rājyaṃ ca natvā tāṃ prayayau gṛham ।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa durgopākhyānamuttamam ।। 43 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne prakṛtisurathasaṃvāde jñānakathanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 65 ।।
<2.66> nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ sarvaṃ nāvaśiṣṭaṃ kiñcideva hi niścitam ।। prakṛteḥ kavacaṃ stotraṃ brūhi me munisattama ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। purā stutā sā goloke kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। saṃpūjya madhumāse ca saṃprīte rāsamaṇḍale ।। madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe dvitīye viṣṇunā purā ।। 2 ।। tatraiva kāle sā durgā brahmaṇā prāṇasaṅkaṭe ।। caturthe saṃstutā devī bhaktyā ca tripurāriṇā ।। 3 ।। purā tripurayuddhe ca mahāghoratare mune ।। pañcame saṃstutā devī vṛtrāsuravadhe tathā ।। 4 ।। śakreṇa sarvadevaiśca ghore ca prāṇasaṅkaṭe ।। tadā munīndrairmanubhirmānavaiḥ surathādibhiḥ ।। 5 ।। saṃstutā pūjitā sā ca kalpe kalpe parātparā ।। stotraṃ ca śrūyatāṃ brahmansarvavighnavināśakam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ bhavasantārakāraṇam ।। 6 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। tvameva sarvajananī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। tvamevādyā sṛṣṭividhau svecchayā triguṇātmikā ।। 7 ।। kāryyārthe saguṇā tvaṃ ca vastuto nirguṇā svayam ।। parabrahmasvarūpā tvaṃ satyā nityā sanātanī ।। 8 ।। tejassvarūpā paramā bhaktānugravigrahā ।। sarvasvarūpā sarveśā sarvādhārā parātparā ।। ।। 9 ।। sarvabījasvarūpā ca sarvapūjyā nirāśrayā ।। sarvajñā sarvatobhadrā sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalaḥ ।। 10 ।। sarvabuddhisvarūpā ca sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ।। sarvajñānapradā devī sarvajñā sarvabhāvinī ।। 11 ।। tvaṃ svāhā devadāne ca pitṛdāne svadhā svayam ।। dakṣiṇā sarvadāne ca sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ।। 12 ।। nidrā tvaṃ ca dayā tvaṃ ca tṛṣṇā tvaṃ cātmanaḥ priyā ।। kṣutkṣāntiḥ śāntirīśā ca śāntiḥ sṛṣṭiśca śāśvatī ।। 13 ।। śraddhā puṣṭiśca tandrā ca lajjā śobhā dayā tathā ।। satāṃ sampatsvarūpā śrīrvipattirasatāmiha ।। 14 ।। prītirūpā puṇyavatāṃ pāpināṃ kalahāṅkurā ।। śaśvatkarmamayī śaktiḥ sarvadā sarvajīvinām ।। 15 ।। devebhyaḥ svapado dātrī dhāturdhātrī kṛpāmayī ।। hitāya sarvadevānāṃ sarvāsuravināśinī ।।16।। yoginidrā yogarūpā yogadātrī ca yoginām ।। siddhisvarūpā siddhānāṃ siddhidā siddhayoginī।।17।। brahmāṇī māheśvarī ca viṣṇumāyā ca vaiṣṇavī ।। bhadradā bhadrakālī ca sarvalokabhayaṃkarī ।।18।। grāme grāme grāmadevī gṛhadevī gṛhe gṛhe ।। satāṃ kīrttiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca nindā tvamasatāṃ sadā ।। 19 ।। mahāyuddhe mahāmārī duṣṭasaṃhārarūpiṇī ।। rakṣāsvarūpā śiṣṭānāṃ māteva hitakāriṇī ।। 20 ।। vandyā pūjyā stutā tvaṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ ca sarvadā ।। brahmaṇyarūpā viprāṇāṃ tapasyā ca tapasvinām ।। 21 ।। vidyā vidyāvatāṃ tvaṃ ca buddhirbuddhimatāṃ satām ।। medhā smṛtisvarūpā ca pratibhā pratibhāvatām ।। 22 ।। rājñāṃ pratāparūpā ca viśāṃ vāṇijyarūpiṇī ।। sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭisvarūpā tvaṃ rakṣārūpā ca pālane ।।23।। tathā'nte tvaṃ mahāmārī viśve viśvaiśca pūjite।। kālarātrirmahārātrirmoharātriśca mohinī।।24।। duratyayā me māyā tvaṃ yayā saṃmohitaṃ jagat।। yayā mugdho hi vidvāṃśca mokṣamārgaṃ na paśyati।।25।। ityātmanā kṛtaṃ stotraṃ durgāyā durganāśanam ।। pūjākāle paṭhedyo hi siddhirbhavati vāñchitā ।।26।। vandhyā ca kākavandhyā ca mṛtavatsā ca durbhagā।। śrutvā stotraṃ varṣamekaṃ suputraṃ labhate dhuvam।।27।। kārāgāre mahāghore yo baddho dṛḍhabandhane।। śrutvā stotraṃ māsamekaṃ bandhanānmucyate dhuvam ।।28।। yakṣmagrasto galatkuṣṭhī mahāśūlī mahājvarī ।। śrutvā stotraṃ varṣamekaṃ sadyo rogātpramucyate ।। ।। 29 ।। putrabhede prajābhede patnībhede ca durgataḥ ।। śrutvā stotraṃ māsamekaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 30 ।। rājadvāre śmaśāne ca mahāraṇye raṇasthale ।। hiṃsrajantusamīpe ca śrutvā stotraṃ pramucyate ।।31।। gṛhadāhe ca dāvāgnau dasyusainyasamanvite ।। stotraśravaṇamātreṇa labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।32।। mahādaridro mūrkhaśca varṣaṃ stotraṃ paṭhettu yaḥ ।। vidyāvāndhanavāṃścaiva sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ ।।33।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe dvitīye prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne durgāstotraṃ nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।66।।
<2.67> nārada uvāca।। bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvajñānaviśārada ।। brahmāṇḍamohanaṃ nāma prakṛteḥ kavacaṃ vada ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu vakṣyāmi he vatsa kavacaṃ ca sudurlabham ।। śrīkṛṣṇenaiva kathitaṃ kṛpayā brahmaṇe purā ।। 2 ।। brahmaṇā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dharmārthaṃ jāhnavītaṭe ।। dharmeṇa dattaṃ mahyaṃ ca kṛpayā puṣkare prabhuḥ ।। 3 ।। tripurāriśca yaddhṛtvā jaghāna tripuraṃ purā ।। mumoca dhātā yaddhṛtvā madhukaiṭabhayorbhayam ।। jaghāna raktabījaṃ taṃ yatkṛtvā bhadrakālikā ।। 4 ।। yaddhṛtvā tu mahendraśca saṃprāpa kamalālayām ।। yaddhṛtvā ca mahākālaścirajīvī ca dhārmikaḥ ।। ।। 5 ।। yaddhṛtvā ca mahājñānī nandī sānandapūrvakam ।। yaddhṛtvā ca mahāyoddhā rāmaḥ śatrubhayaṅkaraḥ ।। 6 ।। yaddhṛtvā śivatulyaśca durvāsā jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। oṃ durgeti caturthyantaṃ svāhānto me śiro'vatu ।। 7 ।। mantraḥ ṣaḍakṣaro'yaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ kalpapādapaḥ ।। vicāro nāsti vedeṣu grahaṇe ca manormune ।।8।। mantragrahaṇamātreṇa viṣṇutulyo bhavennaraḥ ।। mama vaktraṃ sadā pātu coṃ durgāyai namo'ntataḥ।। ।। 9 ।। oṃ durge rakṣayati ca kaṇṭhaṃ pātu sadā mama ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīmiti mantro'yaṃ skandhaṃ pātu nirantaram ।। 10 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīmiti pṛṣṭhaṃ ca pātu me sarvataḥ sadā ।। hrīṃ me vakṣaḥsthalaṃ pātu hastaṃ śrīmiti santatam ।। 11 ।। oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ pātu sarvāṅgaṃ svapne jāgaraṇe tathā ।। prācaṃ māṃ prakṛtiḥ pātu pātu vahnau ca caṇḍikā ।। 12 ।। dakṣiṇe bhadrakālī ca nairṛtyāṃ ca maheśvarī ।। vāruṇyāṃ pātu vārāhī vāyavyāṃ sarvamaṅgalā।।13।। uttare vaiṣṇavī pātu tathaiśānyāṃ śivapriyā ।। jale sthale cāntarikṣe pātu māṃ jagadambikā।।14।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa kavacaṃ ca sudurlabham ।। yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ pravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit ।। 15 ।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ ।। kavacaṃ dhārayedyastu so'pi viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ ।। 16 ।। bhramaṇe sarvatīrthānāṃ pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇe ।। yatphalaṃ labhate lokastadetaddhāraṇānmune ।। 17 ।। pañcalakṣajapenaiva siddhametadbhaveddhruvam ।। loke ca siddhakavacaṃ nāstraṃ vidhyati saṃkaṭe ।। 18 ।। na tasya mṛtyurbhavati jale vahnau viśeddhruvam ।। jīvanmukto bhavetso'pi sarvasiddheśvaraḥ svayam ।। 19 ।। yadi syātsiddhakavaco viṣṇutulyo bhaveddhruvam ।। kathitaṃ prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ sudhākhaṇḍātparaṃ mune ।। 20 ।। yā caiva mūlaprakṛtiryasyāḥ putro gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। kṛtvā kṛṣṇavrataṃ sā ca lebhe gaṇapatiṃ sutam ।। 21 ।। svāṃśena kṛṣṇo bhagavānbabhūva ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। śrutvā ca prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ suśrāvyaṃ ca sudhopamam ।। 22 ।। bhojayitvā ca dadhyannaṃ tasmai dadyācca kāñcanam ।। savatsāṃ surabhiṃ ramyāṃ dadyādvai bhaktipūrvakam ।। 23 ।। vāso'laṃkāraratnaiśca toṣayedvācakaṃ mune ।। puṣpālaṃkāravasanairupahāragaṇaistathā ।। 24 ।। pustakaṃ pūjayedevaṃ bhaktiśraddhāsamanvitaḥ ।। evaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ śṛṇoti tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati ।। 25 ।। varddhate putrapautrādiryaśasvī tatprasādataḥ ।। lakṣmīrvasati tadgehe hyante golokamāpnuyāt ।। labhetkṛṣṇasya dāsyaṃ sa bhaktiṃ kṛṣṇe suniścalām ।। 26 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe prakṛtikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgopākhyāne brahmāṇḍamohanakavacaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 67 ।। ।। ।। śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ।। ।। ।। ।। ।। ।। samāptaścāyaṃ śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇa prakṛtikhaṇḍo dvitīyaḥ ।।
<3.1> śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ।। śrīmadveṅkaṭeśāya namaḥ ।। śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ।। atha brahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīyaṃ gaṇapatikhaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate ।। nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ।। devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ।। 1 ।। nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ prakṛti khaṇḍaṃ tadamṛtārṇavamuttamam ।। sarvotkṛṣṭamabhīṣṭaṃ ca mūḍhānāṃ jñānavardanam ।। 2 ।। adhunā śrīgaṇeśasya khaṇḍaṃ śrotumihāgataḥ ।। tajjanma caritaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। 3 ।। kathaṃ jajñe suraśreṣṭhaḥ pārvatyā udare śubhe ।। devī kena prakāreṇa cālabhattādṛśaṃ sutam।। ।। 4 ।। sa cāṃśaḥ kasya devasya kathaṃ janma lalābha saḥ ।। ayonisambhavaḥ kiṃ vā kiṃ vā'sau yonisambhavaḥ ।। 5 ।। kiṃ vā tadbrahmatejo vā kiṃ tasya ca parākramaḥ ।। kā tapasyā ca ki jñānaṃ kiṃ vā tannirmmalaṃ yaśaḥ ।। 6 ।। kathaṃ tasya puraḥpūjā viśveṣu nikhileṣu ca ।। sthite nārāyaṇe śambhau jagadīśe ca dhātari ।। 7 ।। purāṇeṣu nigūḍhaṃ ca tajjanma parikīrttitam ।। kathaṃ vā gajavaktro'yamekadanto mahodaraḥ ।।8।। etatsarvaṃ samācakṣva śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। suvistīrṇaṃ mahābhāga tadatīva manoharam ।।9।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam ।। pāpasantāpaharaṇaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam ।। 10 ।। sarvamaṅgaladaṃ sāraṃ sarvaśrutimanoharam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣabījaṃ ca pāpamūlanikṛntanam ।। 11 ।। daityārditānāṃ devānāṃ tejorāśisamudbhavā ।। devī saṃhṛtya daityaughāndakṣakanyā babhūva ha ।। 12 ।। sā ca nāmnā satī devī svāmino nindayā purā ।। dehaṃ saṃtyajya yogena jātā śailapriyodare ।। 13 ।। śaṅkarāya dadau tāṃ ca pārvatīṃ parvato mudā ।। tāṃ gṛhītvā mahādevo jagāma vijanaṃ vanam ।।14।। śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā puṣpacandanacarcitām ।। sa reme narmadātīre puṣpodyāne tayā saha ।।15।। sahasravarṣaparyyantaṃ daivamānena nārada ।। tayorbabhūva śṛṃgāro viparītādiko mahān ।। ।। 16 ।। durgāṃgasparśamātreṇa madanānmūrcchitaḥ śivaḥ ।। mūrcchitā sā śivasparśādbubudhe na divāniśam ।। 17 ।। haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇe puṃskokilarutākule ।। nānāpuṣpavikāsāḍhye bhramaradhvaniguñjite ।। 18 ।। sugandhikusumāśleṣivāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। atīva sukhade tatra sarvajantuvivarjite ।। 19 ।। dṛṣṭvā tayostacchṛṅgāraṃ cintāṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ parām ।। brahmāṇaṃ ca puraskṛtya yayurnārāyaṇāntikam ।। ।। 20 ।। taṃ natvā kathayāmāsa brahmā vṛttāntamīpsitam ।। saṃtasthurdevatāḥ sarvāścitraputtalikā yathā ।। 21 ।। brahmovāca ।। sahasravarṣaparyyantaṃ devamānena śaṅkaraḥ ।। ratau rataśca niśceṣṭo na yogī virarāma ha ।। 22 ।। maithunasya virāme ca dampatyorjagadīśvara ।। kimbhūtaṃ bhavitā'patyaṃ tathyaṃ kathitumarhasi ।। 23 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। cintā nāsti jagaddhātaḥ sarva bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati।। mayi ye śaraṇāpannāsteṣāṃ dukhaṃ kuto vidhe ।। 24 ।। yenopāyena tadvīryaṃ bhūmau patati niścitam ।। tatkuruṣva prayatnena sārddhaṃ devagaṇena ca ।।25।। yadā ca śambhorvīryyaṃ tatpārvatyā udare patet ।। tato'patyaṃ ca bhavitā surāsuravimardakam ।।26।। tataḥ śakrādayaḥ sarve surā nārāyaṇājñayā ।। prayayurnarmmadātīraṃ yayau brahmā nijālayam ।। 27 ।। tatraiva parvatadroṇībahirdeśe surāḥ parāḥ ।। viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve babhūvurbhayakātarāḥ ।। 28 ।। śakro rājā kuberaṃ ca kubero varuṇaṃ tathā ।। samīraṇaṃ ca varuṇo yamaṃ caiva samīraṇaḥ ।। 29 ।। hutāśanaṃ yamaścaiva bhāskaraṃ ca hutāśanaḥ ।। candraṃ tathā bhāskaraśca tvīśānaṃ candra eva ca ।। 30 ।। evaṃ devāḥ prerayanti devāṃśca ratibhañjane ।। haraśṛṃgāra bhaṃgaṃ ca kurvityuktvā parasparam ।। 31 ।। dvāri sthito vakraśirāḥ śakraḥ prāha maheśvaram ।। 32 ।। indra uvāca ।। kiṃ karoṣi mahādeva yogīśvara namo'stu te ।। jagadīśa jagadbīja bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjana ।। 33 ।। harirjagāmetyuktvā tamājagāma ca bhāskaraḥ ।। uvāca bhīto dvārastho bhayārtto vakracakṣuṣā ।।34।। śrīsūryya uvāca ।। kiṃ karoṣi mahādeva jagatāṃ paripālaka ।। suraśreṣṭha mahābhāga pārvatīśa namo'stu te ।। 35 ।। ityevamuktvā śrīsūryyaḥ sa jagāma bhayāttataḥ ।। ājagāma tathā candra avocadvakrakandharaḥ ।। 36 ।। candra uvāca ।। kiṃ karoṣi trilokeśa trilocana namo'stu te ।। ātmārāma svayaṃpūrṇa puṇyaśravaṇakīrttana ।। 37 ।। ityevamuktvā bhītaśca virarāma niśāpatiḥ ।। samīraṇo'pi dvārasthassaṃvīkṣyovāca sādaram 4। 38 ।। pavana uvāca ।। kiṃ karoṣi jagannātha jagadbandho namo 'stu te ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ bījarūpa sanātana ।।39।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā yogajñānaviśāradaḥ ।। tyaktukāmo na tatyāja śṛṅgāraṃ pārvatī bhayāt ।। 40 ।। dṛṣṭvā surānbhayārttaśca punaḥ stotuṃ samudyatān।। vijahau sukhasambhogaṃ kaṇṭhalagnāṃ ca pārvatīm ।। 41 ।। uttiṣṭhato maheśasya trāsalajjāyutasya ca ।। bhūmau papāta tadvīryyaṃ tataḥ skando babhūva ha ।। 42 ।। paścāttāṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathāmatimanoharām ।। skandajanmaprasaṅge ca sāmprataṃ vāñchitaṃ śṛṇu ।। 43 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 ।।
<3.2> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। tyaktvā ratiṃ mahādevo dadarśa purataḥ surān ।। palāyadhvamiti prāha kṛpayā pārvatībhayāt।। ।। 1 ।। devāḥ palāyitā bhītāḥ pārvatīśāpahetunā ।। sarvabrahmāṇḍasaṃharttā cakampe pārvatībhayāt ।। 2 ।। talpādutthāya sā durgā na ca dṛṣṭvā purassurān ।। samutthitaṃ kopavahniṃ stambhayāmāsa dehataḥ ।। 3 ।। adyaprabhṛti te devā vyarthavīryyā bhavantviti ।। śaśāpa devī tāndevānatiruṣṭā babhūva ha ।। 4 ।। tataḥ śivaḥ śivāṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhasaṃraktalocanām ।। rudantīṃ namravadanāṃ likhantīṃ dharaṇītalam ।। 5 ।। śivastāṃ duḥkhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā krodhasaṃraktalocanām ।। haste gṛhītvā deveśo vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 6 ।। atīva bhītaḥ saṃtrasta uvāca madhuraṃ vacaḥ ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। kathaṃ ruṣṭā giriśreṣṭhakanye dhanye manohare।।7।। mama saubhāgyarūpe ca prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevate ।। kiṃ te 'bhīṣṭaṃ kariṣyāmi vada māṃ jagadambike ।।8।। brahmāṇḍasaṃghe nikhile kimasādhyamihāvayoḥ ।। aho niraparādhaṃ māṃ prasannā bhava sundari।। ।। 9 ।। daivādajñātadoṣasya śāntiṃ me karttumarhasi ।। tvayā yuktaḥ śivo'haṃ ca sarvaṣāṃ śivadāyakaḥ ।। 10 ।। tvayā vinā hīśvaraśca śavatulyo'śivaḥ sadā ।। prakṛtistvaṃ ca buddhistvaṃ śaktistvaṃ ca kṣamā dayā ।। 11 ।। tuṣṭistvaṃ ca tathā puṣṭiḥ śāntistvaṃ kṣāntireva ca ।। kṣuttvaṃ chāyā tathā nidrā tandrā śraddhā sureśvari ।। 12।। sarvādhārasvarūpā tvaṃ sarvabījasvarūpiṇī ।। smitapūrvaṃ vada vacaḥ sāmprataṃ sarasaṃ śive ।। 13 ।। tvatkopaviṣasaṃdagdhaṃ drutaṃ jīvaya māṃ mṛtam ।। 14 ।। śaṃkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṣamāyuktā ca pārvatī ।। uvāca madhuraṃ devī hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 15 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। kiṃ tvā'haṃ kathayiṣyāmi sarvajñaṃ sarvarūpiṇam ।। ātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ sarvadeheṣvavasthitam ।। 16 ।। kāminī mānasaṃ kāmamaprajñaṃ svāminaṃ vadet ।। sarveṣāṃ hṛdayajñaṃ ca hṛdīṣṭaṃ kathayāmi kim ।। 17 ।। sugopyaṃ sarvanārīṇāṃ lajjājananakāraṇam ।। akathyamapi sarvāsāṃ maheśa kathayāmi te।। 18 ।। sukheṣu madhye strīṇāṃ ca vibhaveṣu sureśvara ।। satpuṃsā saha sambhogo nirjaneṣu paraṃ sukham ।। 19 ।। tadbhaṃgena ca yadduḥkhaṃ tatsamaṃ nāsti ca striyāḥ ।। kāntānāṃ kāntavicchedaśokaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ ।। 20 ।। kṛṣṇapakṣe yathā candraḥ kṣīyamāṇo dine dine ।। tathā kāntaṃ vinā kāntā kṣīṇā kānta kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।। 21 ।। cintājvaraśca sarveṣāmupatāpaśca vāsasām ।। sādhvīnāṃ kāntavicchedasturagānāṃ ca maithunam ।। 22 ।। ratibhaṃgo duḥkhamekaṃ dvitīyaṃ vīryyapātanam ।। duḥkhātireki duḥkhaṃ ca tṛtīyamanapatyatā ।। 23 ।। trailokyakāntaṃ kāntaṃ tvāṃ labdhvā'pi na ca me sutaḥ ।। yā strī putravihīnā ca jīvanaṃ tannirarthakam ।। 24 ।। janmāntarasukhaṃ puṇyaṃ tapodānasamudbhavam ।। sadvaṃśajātaputraśca paratreha sukhapradaḥ ।। 25 ।। suputraḥ svāminoṃ'śaśca svāmitulyasukhapradaḥ ।। kuputraśca kulāṅgāro manastāpāya kevalam ।। 26 ।। svāmī svāṃśena sustrīṇāṃ garbhe janma labheddhruvam ।। sādhvīstrī mātṛtulyā ca satataṃ hitakāriṇī ।। 27 ।। asādhvī vairitulyā ca śaśvatsantāpadāyinī ।। mukhaduṣṭā yoniduṣṭā cāsādhvīti tridhā smṛtā ।। 28 ।। kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada yogīśvareśvara ।। upāyasindho tapasāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca phalaprada ।। 29 ।। ityuktvā pārvatī devī namravaktrā babhūva ha ।। prahasya śaṃkaro devo bodhayāmāsa pārvatīm ।। 30 ।। satputrabījaṃ sukhadaṃ tāpanāśanakāraṇam ।। mitaṃ snigdhaṃ suruciraṃ pravaktumupacakrame ।। 31 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nārada nārāyaṇasaṃvāde dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 2 ।।
<3.3> śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। śṛṇu pārvati vakṣyāmi tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। upāyataḥ kāryyasiddhirbhavatyeva jagattraye ।। 1 ।। sarvavāṃchitasiddhestu bījarūpaṃ sumaṅgalam ।। manasaḥ prītijanakamupāyaṃ kathayāmi te ।।2।। harerārādhanaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kuru varānane ।। vrataṃ ca puṇyakaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ kariṣyasi।।3।। mahākaṭhorabījaṃ ca vāñchākalpataruṃ param ।। sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ sāraṃ putradaṃ sarvasaukhyadam ।।4।। nadīnāṃ ca yathā gaṃgā devānāṃ ca hariryathā ।। vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathāhaṃ ca devīnāṃ tvaṃ yathā priye ।।5।। varṇānāṃ ca yathā viprastīrthānāṃ puṣkaraṃ yathā ।। puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaṃ ca patrāṇāṃ tulasī yathā ।। 6 ।। yathā puṇyapradānāṃ ca tithirekādaśī smṛtā।। ravivāraśca vārāṇāṃ yathā puṇyapradaḥ śive ।। māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣaścāpyṛtūnāṃ mādhavo yathā ।। 7 ।। saṃvatsaro vatsarāṇāṃ yugānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ yathā ।। vidyāpradaśca pūjyānāṃ gurūṇāṃ jananī yathā ।। sādhvī patnī yathāptānāṃ viśvastānāṃ mano yathā ।। 8 ।। yathā dhanānāṃ ratnaṃ ca priyāṇāṃ ca yathā patiḥ ।। yathā putraśca bandhūnāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ kalpapādapaḥ ।।9।। phalānāṃ vai cūtaphalaṃ varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ tathā।। vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca śatarūpā ca yoṣitām ।। 10 ।। yathā kāśī purīṇāṃ ca sūryyastejasvināṃ yathā ।। yathenduḥ sukhadānāṃ ca sundarāṇāṃ ca manmathaḥ ।। 11 ।। śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedāḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā ।। hanūmānvānarāṇāṃ ca kṣetrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇānanam ।। 12 ।। yaśodānāṃ yathā vidyā kavitā ca manoharā ।। ākāśo vyāpakānāṃ ca hyaṃgānāṃ locanaṃ yathā ।। 13 ।। vibhavānāṃ harikathā sukhānāṃ haricintanam ।। sparśānāṃ putrasaṃsparśo hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca yathā khalaḥ ।।14।। pāpānāṃ ca yathā mithyā pāpināṃ puṃścalī yathā ।। puṇyānāṃ ca yathā satyaṃ tapasāṃ harisevanam ।। 15 ।। yathā ghṛtaṃ ca gavyānāṃ yathā brahmā tapasvinām।। amṛtaṃ bhakṣyavastūnāṃ sasyānāṃ dhānyakaṃ yathā ।। 16 ।। puṇyadānāṃ yathā toyaṃ śuddhānāṃ ca hutāśanaḥ ।। suvarṇaṃ taijasānāṃ ca miṣṭānāṃ priyabhāṣaṇam ।। 17 ।। garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva hastināmindravāhanam ।। yogināṃ ca kumāraśca devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ ।। 18 ।। gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho jīvo buddhimatāṃ yathā ।। sukavīnāṃ yathā śukraḥ kāvyānāṃ ca purāṇakam ।। 19 ।। srotasvatāṃ samudraśca yathā pṛthvī kṣamāvatām ।। lābhānāṃ ca yathā muktirharibhaktiśca sampadām ।। 20 ।। pavitrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavāśca varṇānāṃ praṇavo yathā ।। viṣṇumantraśca mantrāṇāṃ bījānāṃ prakṛtiryathā ।। 21 ।। viduṣāṃ ca yathā vāṇī gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā ।। yathā kubero yakṣāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ vāsukiryathā ।। 22 ।। yathā pitā te śailānāṃ gavāṃ ca surabhiryathā ।। vedānāṃ sāmavedaśca tṛṇānāṃ ca yathā kuśaḥ ।। 23 ।। sukhadānāṃ yathā lakṣmīrmano vai śīghragāminām ।। akṣarāṇāmakāraśca yathā tāto hitaiṣiṇām ।। 24 ।। śālagrāmaśca mūrtīnāṃ parśūnāṃ viṣṇupañjaraḥ ।। catuṣpadānāṃ pañcāsyo mānavo jīvināṃ yathā ।। 25 ।। yathā svāntaṃ cendriyāṇāṃ mandāgniśca rujāṃ yathā ।। balināṃ ca yathā śaktirahaṃ śaktimatāṃ tathā ।। 26 ।। mahānvirāṭ ca sthūlānāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ paramāṇukaḥ ।। yathendra āditeyānāṃ daityānāṃ ca baliryathā ।। 27 ।। yathā dadhīcirdātṝṇāṃ prahrādaścaiva sādhuṣu ।। brahmāstraṃ ca yathā'strāṇāṃ cakrāṇāṃ ca sudarśanam ।। 28।। nṛṇāṃ rājā rāmacandro dhanvināṃ lakṣmaṇo yathā ।। sarvādhāraḥ sarvasevyaḥ sarvabījaṃ ca sarvadaḥ।। sarvasāro yathā kṛṣṇo vratānāṃ puṇyakaṃ yathā।।29।। vrataṃ kuru mahābhāge triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। sarvaśreṣṭhaśca putraste vratādeva bhaviṣyati ।। 30 ।। vratārādhyaśca vai kṛṣṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ vāñchitapradaḥ ।। jano yatsevanānmuktaḥ pitṛbhiḥ koṭibhiḥ saha।। ।। 31 ।। harimantraṃ gṛhītvā ca harisevāṃ karoti yaḥ ।। bhārate janma saphalaṃ svātmanaḥ sa karoti ca ।। 32 ।। uddhṛtya koṭipuruṣānvaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti niścitam ।। śrīkṛṣṇapārṣado bhūtvā sukhaṃ tatraiva modate ।। 33 ।। sahodarānsvabhṛtyāṃśca svabandhūnsahacāriṇaḥ ।। svastriyaśca samuddhṛtya bhakto yāti hareḥ padam ।। 34 ।। ' tasmādgṛhāṇa girije harermmantraṃ sudurlabham ।। japa mantraṃ vrate tatra pitṝṇāṃ muktikāraṇam।। ।। 35 ।। ityuktvā śaṃkaro devo gatvā girijayā saha ।। śīghraṃ ca jāhnavītīraṃ harermmantraṃ manoharam ।। 36 ।। tasyai dadau ca saṃprītyā kavacaṃ stotrasaṃyutam ।। pūjāvidhānaniyamaṃ kathayāmāsa tāṃ mune ।। 37 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 3 ।।
<3.4> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śrutvā vratavidhānaṃ ca durgā saṃhṛṣṭamānasā ।। sarvaṃ vratavidhānaṃ ca saṃpraṣṭumupacakrame ।। 1 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। sarvaṃ vratavidhānaṃ māṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho parātpara ।। 2 ।। kāni vratopayuktāni dravyāṇi ca phalāni ca ।। saniyamaṃ sabhakṣyaṃ ca vidhānaṃ tatphalaṃ prabho।।3।। dehi mahyaṃ vinītāyai niyuktaṃ satpurohitam।। puṣpopahārānviprāṃśca dravyāharaṇakiṃkarān ।। 4 ।। anyāni copayuktāni mayā'jñātāni yāni ca ।। sanniyojaya tatsarvaṃ strīṇāṃ svāmī ca sarvadaḥ ।। 5 ।। pitā kaumārakāle ca sadā pālanakārakaḥ ।। bharttā madhye sutaḥ śeṣe tridhā'vasthā suyoṣitām ।।6 ।। tāto'śokaḥ prāṇatulyāṃ dattvā sattvāmine sutām ।। svāmī nirvṛtimāpnoti saṃnyasya svasute priyām ।। 7 ।। bandhutrayayutā yā strī sā ca bhāgyavatī parā ।। kiñcidvihīnā madhyā ca sarvahīnā'dhamā bhuvi।।।। eteṣāṃ ca samīpasthā praśaṃsyā sā jagattraye।। ninditā'nyeṣu saṃnyastā sarvametacchrutau śrutam।।9।। sarvātmā bhagavāṃstvaṃ ca sarvasākṣī ca sarvavit।। dehi mahyaṃ putravaraṃ svātmanirvṛtihetukam।। 10।। svātmabodhānumānena mahātmani niveditam।। sarvāntarābhiprāyajñaṃ bodhajñaṃ bodhayāmi kim।।11।। ityuktvā pārvatī prītyā papāta svāminaḥ pade ।। kṛpāsindhuśca bhagavānpravaktumupacakrame।।12।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi vidhānaṃ niyamaṃ phalam ।। phalāni caiva dravyāṇi vratayogyāni yāni ca ।। 13 ।। viprāṇāṃ śatakaṃ śuddhaṃ phalapuṣpopahārakam ।। kiṃkarāṇāṃ ca śatakaṃ dravyāharaṇakārakam।।14।। dāsīnāṃ śatakaṃ lakṣaṃ niyuktaṃ ca purohitam ।। sarvavratavidhānajñaṃ vedavedāntapāragam ।। 15 ।। pravaraṃ haribhaktānāṃ sarvajñaṃ jñānināṃ varam।। sanatkumāraṃ mattulyaṃ gṛhāṇa vratahetave।।16।। devi śuddhe ca kāle ca paraṃ niyamapūrvakam।। māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ vratārambhaḥ śubhaḥ priye।।17।। gātraṃ sunirmalaṃ kṛtvā śirassaṃskārapūrvakam ।। upoṣya pūrvadivase vastraṃ saṃśodhya yatnataḥ ।। 18 ।। aruṇodayavelāyāṃ talpādutthāya suvratī ।। mukhaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā snātvā vai nirmale jale।।19।। ācamya yatnapūto hi harismaraṇapūrvakam ।। dattvā'rghyaṃ haraye bhaktyā gṛhamāgatya satvaram।। 20।। dhaute ca vāsasī dhṛtvā hyupaviśyāsane śucau।। ācamya tilakaṃ dhṛtvā samāpya svāhnikaṃ punaḥ ।।21।। ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivatsvastivācanapūrvakam ।। purohitasya varaṇaṃ puraḥ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ ।।22।। saṅkalpaṃ vedavihitaṃ vratametatsamācaret ।। vrate dravyāṇi nityāni copacārāstu ṣoḍaśa।।23।। deyāni nityaṃ deveśi kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।। āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam ।।24।। snānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।। sugandhi puṣpadhūpaṃ ca dīpanaivedyacandanam ।। 25 ।। yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। dravyāṇyetāni pūjāyāścāṅgarūpāṇi sundari ।।26।। devi kiñcidvihīnena cāṅgahāniḥ prajāyate ।। aṃgahīnaṃ ca yatkarmma cāṅgahīno yathā naraḥ ।। aṃgahīne ca kāryye ca phalahāniḥ prajāyate ।। 27 ।। aṣṭottaraśataṃ puṣpaṃ pārijātasya viṣṇave ।। deyaṃ pratidinaṃ durge svātmano rūpahetave ।। 28 ।। śvetacampakapuṣpāṇāṃ lakṣamakṣatamīpsitam ।। pradeyaṃ haraye bhaktyā varṇasaundaryyahetave ।। 29 ।। sahasrapatrapadmānāmakṣataṃ lakṣakaṃ tathā ।। bhaktyā deyaṃ ca haraye mukhasaundaryyahetave ।। 30 ।। amūlyaratnaracitaṃ darpaṇānāṃ sahasrakam ।। deyaṃ nārāyaṇāyaiva netrayordīptihetave ।। 31 ।। nīlotpalānāṃ lakṣaṃ ca deyaṃ kṛṣṇāya bhaktitaḥ ।। vratāṅgabhūtaṃ deveśi cakṣuṣo rūpahetave ।। ।। 32 ।। himālayodbhavaṃ lakṣaṃ ruciraṃ śvetacāmaram ।। pradeyaṃ keśavāyaiva keśasaundaryyahetave ।। 33 ।। amūlyaratnaracitaṃ puṭakānāṃ sahasrakam ।। pradeyaṃ gopikeśāya nāsāsaundaryahetave ।। 34 ।। bandhūkapuṣpalakṣaṃ ca deyaṃ rādheśvarāya ca ।। saumyauṣṭhādharayoścaiva varṇasaundaryahetave ।। 35 ।। muktāphalānāṃ lakṣaṃ ca dantasaundaryahetave ।। deyaṃ golokanāthāya śailaje bhaktipūrvakam ।। 35 ।। ratnagaṇḍūṣalakṣaṃ ca gaṇḍasaundaryyahetave ।। maheśvarāya dātavyaṃ vrate śailendrakanyake ।। 37 ।। ratnapāśakalakṣaṃ ca deyaṃ brahmeśvarāya ca ।। oṣṭhādhaḥ sthalarūpāya vratī prāṇeśi bhaktitaḥ ।। 38 ।। karṇabhūṣaṇalakṣaṃ ca ratnasāravinirmmitam ।। deyaṃ sarveśvarāyaiva karṇasaundaryyahetave ।।39।। mādhvīkakalaśānāṃ ca lakṣaṃ ratnavinirmmitam ।। deyaṃ viśveśvarāyaiva svarasaundaryyahetave ।। 40।। sudhāpūrṇaṃ ca kumbhānāṃ sahasraṃ ratnanirmmitam ।। deyaṃ kṛṣṇāya deveśi vākyasaundaryyahetave ।। 41 ।। ratnapradīpalakṣaṃ ca gopaveṣavidhāyine ।। deyaṃ kiśoraveṣāya dṛṣṭisaundaryya hetave ।। 42 ।। dhattūrakusumākāraṃ ratnapātrasahasrakam ।। deyaṃ gorakṣakāyaiva balasaundaryyahetave ।। 43 ।। sadratnasāraracitaṃ padmanālasahasrakam ।। deyaṃ caṇḍakapālāya bāhusaundaryyahetave ।। 44 ।। lakṣaṃ ca raktapadmānāṃ karasaundaryahetave।। deyaṃ gopāṃganeśāya nārāyaṇi harivrate ।। 45 ।। aṃgulīyakalakṣaṃ ca ratnasāravinirmmitam ।। aṃgulīnāṃ ca rūpārthaṃ deyaṃ deveśvarāya ca ।। 46 ।। maṇīndrasāralakṣaṃ ca śvetavarṇaṃ manoharam ।। deyaṃ munīndranāthāya nakhasaundaryyahetave ।। 47 ।। sadratnasārahārāṇāṃ lakṣaṃ cātimanoharam ।। deyaṃ madanamohāya vakṣaḥsaundaryyahetave ।। 48 ।। supakvaśrīphalānāṃ ca lakṣaṃ ca sumanoharam ।। deyaṃ siddhendranāthāya stanasaundaryyahetave ।। 49 ।। sadratnavartulākārapatralaśaṃ manoharam ।। deyaṃ padmālayeśāya dehasaundaryyahetave ।। 50 ।। sadratnasāraracitaṃ nābhīnāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। pradeyaṃ padmanābhāya nābhisaundaryyahetave ।। 51 ।। sadratnasāraracitaṃ rathacakrasahasrakam ।। nitambasaundaryyārthaṃ ca deyaṃ vai cakrapāṇaye ।। 52 ।। suvarṇarambhāstambhānāṃ lakṣaṃ ca sumanoharam ।। pradeyaṃ śrīnivāsāya śroṇisaundaryyahetave ।। 53 ।। śatapatrasthalābjānāṃ lakṣamamlānamakṣatam ।। pradeyaṃ padmanetrāya pādasaundaryyahetave ।। 54 ।। suvarṇaracitānāṃ ca khañjanānāṃ sahasrakam ।। gatisaundaryyahetvarthaṃ deyaṃ lakṣmīśvarāya ca ।। 55 ।। rājahaṃsasahasraṃ ca gajendrāṇāṃ sahasrakam ।। suvarṇaracitaṃ deyaṃ haraye gatihetave ।। ।। 56 ।। suvarṇacchatralakṣaṃ ca deyaṃ nārāyaṇāya ca ।। vicitraṃ ratnasāreṇa mūrddhasaundaryyahetave ।। 57 ।। mālatīnāṃ ca kusumamakṣataṃ lakṣamīśvari ।। deyaṃ vṛndāvaneśāya hāsyasaundaryyahetave ।। 98 ।। amūlyaratnalakṣaṃ ca deyaṃ nārāyaṇāya vai ।। suvrate vratapūrṇārthaṃ śīlasaundaryyahetave ।। 59 ।। svacchasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ maṇīndraśreṣṭhalakṣakam ।। deyaṃ munīndranāthāya manassaundaryyahetave ।। 60 ।। pravālasārasaṃkāśaṃ maṇisārasahasrakam ।। deyaṃ kṛṣṇāya bhaktyā ca priyārāgavivṛddhaye ।। 61 ।। māṇikyasāralakṣaṃ ca deyaṃ kṛṣṇāya yatnataḥ ।। janmanaḥ koṭiparyyantaṃ svāmisaubhāgyahetave ।। 62 ।। kūṣmāṇḍaṃ nārikelaṃ ca jambīraṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā ।। phalānyetāni deyāni haraye putrahetave ।। 63 ।। ratnendrasāralakṣaṃ ca deyaṃ kṛṣṇāya yatnataḥ ।। asaṃkhyajanmaparyyantaṃ svāmino dhanavṛddhaye ।। 64 ।। vādyaṃ nānāprakāraṃ ca kāṃsyatālādikaṃ param ।। vrate sampattivṛddhyartha śrīhariṃ śrāvayedvratī ।।65।। pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ sarpiḥ śarkarāktaṃ manoharam ।। pradeyaṃ haraye bhaktyā svāmino bhogavṛddhaye ।। 66 ।। sugandhipuṣpamālānāṃ lakṣamakṣatamīpsitam ।। pradeyaṃ haraye bhaktyā haribhaktivivṛddhaye ।। 67 ।। naivedyāni ca deyāni svādūni madhurāṇi ca ।। śrīkṛṣṇaprītiprāptyarthaṃ durge nānāvidhāni ca ।। 68 ।। nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi tulasīsaṃyutāni ca ।। śrīkṛṣṇaprītaye bhaktyā vrate deyāni suvrate ।। 69 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca pratyahaṃ bhojayedvratī ।। svātmanaḥ sasyavṛddhyarthaṃ vrate janmani janmani ।। 70 ।। puṣpāñjaliśataṃ deyaṃ nityaṃ pūrṇaṃ ca pūjane ।। praṇāmaśatakaṃ devi kartavyaṃ bhaktivṛddhaye ।। 71 ।। ṣaṇmāsāṃśca haviṣyānnaṃ māsānpañca phalādikam ।। haviḥ pakṣaṃ jalaṃ pakṣaṃ vrate bhakṣecca suvrate ।। 72 ।। ratnapradīpaśatakaṃ vahniṃ dadyāddivāniśam ।। rātrau kuśāsanaṃ kṛtvā nityaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ vrate ।। 73 ।। smaraṇaṃ kīrttataṃ keliḥ prekṣaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇam ।। saṃkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca kriyānirvṛttirityapi ।। 74 ।। svapnamaithunakaṃ tyājyaṃ vratinā vrataśuddhaye ।। sampūrṇe ca vrate devi pratiṣṭhā tadanantaram ।। 75 ।। triśataṃ vai ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ rallakaṃ vastrasaṃyutam ।। sabhojyaṃ sopavītaṃ ca sopahāraṃ dadātvayam ।। 76 ।। triśataṃ vai ṣaṣṭyadhikasahasraṃ viprabhojanam ।। triśataṃ vai ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ sahasraṃ tilahomakam ।। 77 ।। triśataṃ vai ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ sahasraṃ svarṇameva ca ।। deyā vratasamāptau ca dakṣiṇā vidhibodhitā ।। 78 ।। anyāṃ samāptidivase kathayiṣyāmi dakṣiṇām ।। etadvrataphalaṃ devi dṛḍhā bhaktirharau bhavet ।। 79 ।। haritulyo bhavetputro vikhyāto bhuvanatraye ।। saundaryaṃ svāmisaubhāgyamaiśvaryyaṃ vipulaṃ dhanam ।। 80 ।। sarvavāñchitasiddhīnāṃ bījaṃ janmani janmani ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi vrataṃ kuru maheśvari ।। 81 ।। putraste bhavitā sādhvītyuktvā sa virarāma ha ।। 82 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde puṇyaka vratavidhānaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 4 ।।
<3.5> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śrutvā vratavidhāne ca durgā saṃhṛṣṭamānasā ।। punaḥ papraccha kāntaṃ sā divyāṃ vratakathāṃ śubhām ।। 1 ।। śrīpārvatyuvāca ।। kimadbhutaṃ vrataṃ nātha vidhānaphalamasya ca ।। adhikāṃ tatkathāṃ brūhi vrataṃ kena prakāśitam ।। 2 ।। atha puṇyakavratakathā ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। śatarūpā manoḥ patnī putraduḥkhena duḥkhitā ।। brahmaṇaḥ sthānamāgatya sā brahmāṇamuvāca ha ।। 3 ।। śatarūpovāca ।। brahmankena prakāreṇa vandhyāyāśca suto bhavet ।। tanme brūhi jagaddhātaḥ sṛṣṭikāraṇakāraṇa ।। 4 ।। tajjanma niṣphalaṃ brahmannaiśvaryyaṃ dhanameva ca ।। kiṃcinna śobhate gehe vinā putreṇa putriṇām ।।9।। tapodānodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ janmāṃtarasukhāvaham ।। sukhado mokṣaḥ prītidātā putraśca putriṇām ।। 6 ।। putrī putramukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāśvamedhaśatodbhavam ।। phalaṃ punnāmanarakatrāṇahetuṃ labheddhruvam ।। 7 ।। putrotpatterupāyaṃ vai vada māṃ tāpasaṃyutām ।। tadā bhadraṃ na cedbhartrā saha yāsyāmi kānanam ।। 8 ।। gṛhāṇa rājyamaiśvaryya dhanaṃ pṛthvīṃ prajāvahām ।। kimetenāvayostāta vinā putrairaputriṇoḥ ।। 9 ।। aputriṇo mukhaṃ draṣṭuṃ vidvānnotsahate 'śivam ।। mukhaṃ darśayituṃ lajjāṃ samavāpnotyaputrakaḥ ।। 10 ।। athavā garalaṃ bhuktvā pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ।। aputrapautramaśivaṃ gṛhaṃ syātstrīvihīnakam ।। 11 ।। ityevamuktvā sā sākṣādbrahmaṇo'gre ruroda ha ।। kṛpānidhiśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā pravaktumupacakrame ।।12।। brahmovāca ।। śṛṇu vatse pravakṣyāmi putropāyaṃ sukhāvaham ।। sarvaiśvaryyādibījaṃ ca sarvavāñchāpradaṃ śubham ।।13।। māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ vratametatsupuṇyakam ।। kartavyaṃ śuklakāle ca kṛṣṇamārādhya sarvadam ।। 14 ।। saṃvatsaraṃ ca kartavyaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam ।। dravyāṇi vedairuktāni vrate deyāni suvrate ।। 15 ।। vrataṃ ca kāṇvaśākhoktaṃ sarvavāñchitasiddhidam ।। kṛtvā putraṃ labha śubhe viṣṇutulyaparākramam ।। ।। 16 ।। brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā sā kṛtvā vratamuttamam ।। priyavratottānapādau lebhe putrau manoharau ।। 17 ।। vrataṃ kṛtvā devahūtirlebhe siddheśvaraṃ sutam ।। nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ kapilaṃ puṇyakaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham ।। 18 ।। arundhatīdaṃ kṛtvā tu lebhe śaktisutaṃ śubhā ।। śaktikāntā vrataṃ kṛtvā sutaṃ lebhe parāśaram ।। 19 ।। aditiśca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vāmanakaṃ sutam।। śacī jayantaṃ putraṃ ca lebhe kṛtvedamīśvarī ।। 20।। uttānapādapatnīdaṃ kṛtvā lebhe dhruvaṃ sutam ।। kuberajāyā kṛtvedaṃ lebhe ca nalakūbaram ।। 21 ।। sūryyapatnī manuṃ lebhe kṛtvedaṃ vratamuttamam ।। atripatnī sutaṃ candraṃ lebhe kṛtvedamuttamam ।। 22 ।। lebhe cāṃgirasaḥ patnī kṛtvedaṃ vratamuttamam ।। bṛhaspatiṃ suraguruṃ putramasya prabhāvataḥ ।। 23 ।। bhṛgorbhāryyā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe daityaguruṃ sutam ।। śukraṃ nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ ca sarvatejasvināṃ varam ।।24।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi vratānāṃ vratamuttamam ।। tvamevaṃ kuru kalyāṇi himālayasute śubhe।।29।। sādhyaṃ rājendrapatnīnāṃ devīnāṃ ca sukhāvaham ।। vratametanmahāsādhvi sādhvīnāṃ prāṇataḥ priyam ।। 26 ।। vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa svayaṃ gopāṅganeśvaraḥ ।। īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tava putro bhaviṣyati ।। ।। 27 ।। ityuktvā śaṃkarastatra virarāma ca nārada ।। vrataṃ cakāra sā devī pradṛṣṭā śaṅkarājñayā ।। 28 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ gaṇeśajanikāraṇam ।। 29 ।। iti śrībahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde puṇyakavratakathanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 5 ।।
<3.6> śaunaka uvāca ।। nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। kiṃ papraccha punaḥ sādho tanme brūhi tapodhana ।। 1 ।। sūta uvāca ।। nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। vratārambhavidhānaṃ ca saṃpraṣṭumupacakrame ।। ।। 2 ।। nārada uvāca ।। kṛtaṃ kena prakāreṇa vratametacchubhāvaham।। tanme brūhi muniśreṣṭha pārvatyā bharturājñayā ।।3।। lalābha janma bhūteśaḥ kṛte suvratayā vrate ।। brahmankena prakāreṇa tannaḥ śaṃsitumarhasi ।। 4 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca।। kathayitvā kathāṃ divyāṃ vidhānaṃ ca vratasya ca ।। svayaṃ vidhātā tapasāṃ jagāma tapase śivaḥ ।। 5 ।। harerārādhanavyagro mūrttibhedadharo hariḥ ।। haribhāvanaśīlaśca haridhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ।। ।। 6 ।। paramānandapūrṇaśca jñānānandaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। divāniśaṃ na jānāti harimantraṃ bahiḥ smaran ।। 7 ।। prahṛṣṭamanasā devī pārvatī bharturājñayā ।। kiṅkarānprerayāmāsa viprāṃśca vratahetave ।। 8 ।। ānīya sarvadravyāṇi vrate yogyāni yāni ca।। vrataṃ kartuṃ samārebhe śubhadā sā śubhe kṣaṇe ।। 9 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānājagāma vidheḥ sutaḥ ।। mūrttimāṃstejasā rāśiḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। 10।। brahmā''jagāma hṛṣṭaśca brahmalokātsabhāryyakaḥ ।। atitrasto hi bhagavānājagāma maheśvaraḥ ।। 11 ।। viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyī ca salakṣmīkaścaturbhujaḥ ।। bhagavāñjagatāṃ pātā śāstā bharttā sapārṣadaḥ ।। 12 ।। vanamālādhara śyāmo bhūṣito ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। tathā sambhṛtasambhāro ratnayānena nārada ।। 13 ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca kapilaśca sanātanaḥ ।। āsuriśca kraturhaṃso voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho'ruṇiḥ ।। 14 ।। yatiśca sumatiścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca sahānugaḥ ।। pulahaśca pulastyaścāpyatriśca bhṛguraṃgirāḥ ।। 15 ।। agastyaśca pracetāśca durvāsāścyavanastathā ।। marīciḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇvo jaratkāruśca gautamaḥ ।। 16 ।। bṛhaspatirutathyaśca saṃvartaḥ saubharistathā ।। jābālirjamadagniśca jaigīṣavyaśca devalaḥ ।। ।। 17 ।। gokāmukho vakrarathaḥ pāribhadraḥ parāśaraḥ ।। viśvāmitro vāmadeva ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।। 18 ।। mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍuśca puṣkaro lomaśastathā ।। kautso vatsaśca dakṣaśca bālāgniraghamarṣaṇaḥ ।। 19 ।। kātyāyanaḥ kaṇādaśca pāṇiniḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ।। śaṃkurāpiśaliścaiva śākalyaḥ śaṅkha eva ca ।। 20 ।। ete cānye ca bahavaḥ saśiṣyā munayo mune ।। āvāṃ ca dharmmaputrau ca naranārāyaṇau samau ।। 21 ।। dikpālāśca tathā devā yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ ।। ājagmuḥ parvatāḥ sarve sagaṇāḥ pārvatīvrate ।। 22 ।। himālayaḥ śailarājaḥ sāpatyaśca sabhāryakaḥ ।। sagaṇaḥ sānugaścaiva ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 23 ।। tathā sambhṛtasambhāro nānādravyasamanvitaḥ ।। maṇi māṇikyaratnāni vrate yogyāni yāni ca ।। 24 ।। nānāprakāravastūni jagatyāṃ durlabhāni ca ।। lakṣaṃ ca gajaratnānāmaśvaratnaṃ trilakṣakam ।। 25 ।। daśalakṣaṃ gavāṃ ratnaṃ śatalakṣaṃ suvarṇakam ।। rucakānāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ sparśānāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। 26 ।। muktānāṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ kaustubhānāṃ sahasrakam ।। susvādunānādravyāṇāṃ lakṣabhārāṇi kautukī ।। anantaratnaprabhava ājagāma sutāvrate ।।27।। brāhmaṇā manavaḥ siddhā nāgā vidyādharāstathā ।। saṃnyāsino bhikṣukāśca bandinaḥ pārvatīvrate ।। 28 ।। vidyādharī nartakī ca narttakā'psarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।। nānāvidhā vādyabhāṇḍā ājagmuḥ śivamandiram ।। 29 ।। kailāsarājamārgaṃ ca candanena susaṃskṛtam ।। āmrapallavasūtrāḍhyaṃ kadalīstambhaśobhitam ।। 30 ।। dūrvādhānyaphalaiḥ parṇalājapuṣpairvibhūṣitam ।। nirmitaṃ padmarāgeṇa dadṛśuste gaṇā mudā ।। 31 ।। uccaiḥ siṃhāsaneṣvete pūjitāḥ śaṅkareṇa ca ।। kailāsavāsinaḥ sarve paramānandasaṃyutāḥ ।। 32 ।। dānādhyakṣaḥ śunāsīraḥ kuberaḥ kośarakṣakaḥ ।। ādeṣṭā ca svayaṃ sūryyaḥ pariveṣṭā jalādhipaḥ ।। 33 ।। dadhnāṃ nadyaḥ sahasrāṇi dugdhānāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। sahasrāṇi ghṛtānāṃ ca guḍānāṃ ca śatāni ca ।। 34 ।। mādhvīkānāṃ sahasrāṇi tailānāṃ ca śatāni ca ।। lakṣāṇi caiva takrāṇāṃ babhūvuḥ pārvatīvrate ।।35।। pīyūṣāṇāṃ ca kumbhāni śatalakṣāṇi nārada ।। miṣṭānnānāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ babhūvurlakṣarāśayaḥ ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ ghṛtāktānāṃ ca nārada ।। 36 ।। svastikānāṃ ca pūrṇānāṃ babhūvurlakṣarāśayaḥ ।। guḍasaṃskṛtalājānāṃ babhūvuḥ koṭirāśayaḥ।।37।। śālīnāṃ pṛthukānāṃ ca rāśīnāṃ daśakoṭayaḥ।। varataṇḍularāśīnāṃ mune saṃkhyā na vidyate ।। 38 ।। svarṇaraupyapravālānāṃ maṇīnāṃ ca mahāmune ।। babhūvuḥ parvatāstatra kailāse pārvatī vrate ।। 39 ।। pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva śālyannaṃ sumanoharam ।। cakāra lakṣmīḥ pākaṃ ca vyañjanaṃ ghṛtasaṃskṛtam ।। 40 ।। bubhuje devarṣigaṇaiḥ śivo nārāyaṇena ca ।। babhūvurlakṣaviprāśca pariveṣaṇakārakāḥ ।। 41 ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau tebhyaḥ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthebhyo vipralakṣāḥ sudakṣakāḥ ।। 42 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ kṣīrodaśāyinam ।। sevyamānaṃ pārṣadaiśca sasmitaiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 43 ।। ṛṣibhiḥ stūyamānaṃ ca siddhairdevagaṇaistathā ।। vidyādharīṇāṃ nṛtyāni paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। 44 ।। gandharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śrutavantaṃ manoharam ।। papraccha śaṅkaro brahmanbrahmeśaṃ prītipūrvakam ।। 45 ।। brahmaṇā prerito yuktaṃ vrataṃ karttavyamīpsitam ।। devarṣigaṇapūrṇāyāṃ sabhāyāṃ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। 46 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। madīyaṃ vacanaṃ nātha śrīnivāsa śṛṇu prabho ।। tapassvarūpa tapasāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca phalaprada ।। 47 ।। vratānāṃ japayajñānāṃ pūjānāṃ sarvapūjita ।। sarveṣāṃ bījarūpeṇa vāñchākalpataro hare ।। 48।। supuṇyaṃ ca vrataṃ karttuṃ brahmannicchati pārvatī ।। putrārthinī sā śokārttā hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 49 ।। ratibhaṃge kṛte devairvyarthavīryyaśucārditā ।। prabodhitā mayā sādhvī vividhairvacanāmṛtaiḥ ।। 50 ।। satputraṃ svāmisaubhāgyaṃ suvratā yācate vrate ।। tābhyāṃ vinā na santuṣṭā svaprāṇāṃstyaktumicchati ।। 51 ।। purā tyaktvā svadehaṃ ca pitṛyajñe ca māninī ।। mannindayā himavati punarjanma lalābha sā ।। 52 ।। sarvaṃ jānāsi vṛttāntaṃ sarvajñaṃ tvāṃ vadāmi kim ।। dīnāṃ tāṃ vada tattvajña pariṇāmaśubhapradām ।। 53 ।। durnivāryyaśca sarveśa strīsvabhāvaśca cāpalaḥ।। dustyajyaṃ yogibhiḥ siddhairasmābhiśca tapasvibhiḥ ।। 54 ।। jitendriyairjitakrodhaiḥ strīrūpaṃ mohakāraṇam ।। sarvamāyākaraṇḍaṃ ca kāmavarddhanakāraṇam ।। 55 ।। brahmāstraṃ kāmadevasya durbhedyaṃ jayakāraṇam ।। sunirmitaṃ ca vidhinā sarvādyaṃ vidhipūrvakam ।। 56 ।। mokṣadvārakapāṭaṃ ca haribhaktinirodhanam ।। saṃsārabandhanastambharajjurūpamakṛntanam ।। 57 ।। vairāgyanāśabījaṃ ca śaśvadrāgavivarddhanam ।। pattanaṃ sāhasānāṃ ca doṣāṇāmālayaṃ sadā ।। 58 ।। apratyayānāṃ kṣetraṃ ca svayaṃ kapaṭamūrtimat ।। ahaṅkārāśrayaṃ śaśvadviṣakumbhaṃ sudhāmukham ।। 59 ।। sarvairasādhyamānaṃ ca durārādhyaṃ ca sarvadā ।। svakāryyasādhyācārāḍhyaṃ kalahāṃkurakāraṇam ।। 60 ।। sarvaṃ niveditaṃ brahmankarttavyaṃ vaktumarhasi ।। kāryyaṃ sarvaṃ parāmarśe pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 61 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityevamuktvā bhagavānnirīkṣya brahmaṇo mukham ।। virarāma sabhāmadhye stutvā ca kamalāpatim ।। 62 ।। śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya jagadīśvaraḥ ।। hitaṃ ca nītivacanaṃ pravaktumupacakrame ।। 63 ।। śrīviṣṇuruvāca ।। supuṇyakavrataṃ sāraṃ satīsantānahetave ।। svāmisaubhāgyabījaṃ ca patnī te kartumicchati ।। 64 ।। sarvāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ।। sukhadaṃ sukhasāraṃ ca mokṣadaṃ pārvatīśvara ।। 69 ।। ātmā sākṣisvarūpaśca jyotīrūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। nirāśrayaśca nirlipto nirupādhirnirāmayaḥ ।। 66 ।। bhaktaprāṇaśca bhakteśo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ।। durārādhyo hi yo'nyeṣāṃ bhaktānāmatisādhakaḥ ।। 67 ।। bhaktyadhīno hi bhagavānsarvasiddho hi niṣphalaḥ ।। te yasya ca kalāḥ puṃso brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 68 ।। mahānvirāḍyadaṃśaśca nirliptaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। avyayo nigrahaścogro bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 69 ।। ugragraho grahāṇāṃ ca grahanigrahakārakaḥ। trikoṭijanmamadhye ca na sādhyo bhavatā vinā ।। 70 ।। labdhavā hi bhārate janma haribhaktiṃ labhennaraḥ ।। sevanaṃ kṣudradevānāṃ kṛtvā saptasu janmasu ।। 71 ।। sūryyamantramavāpnoti kevalaṃ sa tadāśiṣā ।। sūryyamantraṃ samārādhya triṣu janmasu bhārate ।। 72 ।। prāpnoti śaivaṃ mantraṃ ca sarvadaṃ mānavo mudā ।। saṃsevya parayā bhaktyā tvāmevaṃ saptajanmasu ।। 73 ।। prāpnoti māyāmantraṃ ca tvatpadābjaprasādataḥ ।। śataṃ janmasu cārādhya māyāṃ nārāyaṇīṃ parām ।। 74 ।। nārāyaṇakalāṃ sevyāṃ samavāpnoti mānavaḥ ।। kalāṃ niṣevya varṣe'tra puṇyakṣetre sudurlabhe ।। 75 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktimavāpnoti bhaktasaṃsargahaitukīm ।। saṃprāpya bhaktiṃ niṣpakvāṃ bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ ca bhārate ।। 76 ।। prāpnoti paripakvāṃ ca bhaktiṃ bhaktaniṣevayā ।। tadā bhaktaprasādena devānāmāśiṣā śiva ।। śrīkṛṣṇamantraṃ prāpnoti nirvāṇaphaladaṃ param ।। 77 ।। kṛṣṇavrataṃ kṛṣṇamantraṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ।। kṛṣṇatulyo bhavedbhaktaściraṃ kṛṣṇaniṣevayā ।। 78 ।। mahati pralaye pātaḥ sarveṣāṃ vai suniścitam ।। na pātaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ sādhūnāmavināśinām ।। 79 ।। avināśini goloke modante kṛṣṇakiṃkarāḥ ।। hasanti te suniścintā devānbrahmādikāñchiva ।। 80 ।। tvaṃ saṃharttā ca sarveṣāṃ na bhaktānāṃ maheśvara ।। māyā mohayate sarvānbhaktānna kṛpayā mama ।। 81 ।। māyā nārāyaṇī mātā sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktidā ।। na kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ prāpnoti vinā māyāniṣevaṇam ।। 82 ।। sā ca nārāyaṇī māyā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। kṛṣṇapriyā kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇatulyā'vināśinī ।। 83 ।। sā ca tejassvarūpā ca svecchāvigrahadhāriṇī ।। āvirbhūtā ca devānāṃ tejasā'suranigrahe ।। 84 ।। nihatya daityasaṃghāṃśca dakṣapatnyāṃ ca bhārate ।। lalābha dakṣastapasā janma cānekajanmanaḥ ।। ।। 85 ।। tyaktvā dehaṃ pituryajñe sā satī tava nindayā ।। jagāma devī golokaṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiḥ sanātanī ।। 86 ।। gṛhītvā vigrahaṃ tasyā guṇarūpāśraya param ।। bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ bhārate tvaṃ viṣaṇṇo'bhūḥ purā hara ।। 87 ।। prabodhito mayā tvaṃ ca śrīśaileṣu sarittaṭe ।। lalābha janma sā śailakāntāyāmacireṇa ca ।। 88 ।। karotu puṇyakaṃ sādhvī suvratā suvrataṃ śivā ।। rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ puṇyaṃ śaṃkara puṇyake ।। 89 ।। rājasūyasahasrāṇāṃ vrate yatra dhanavyayaḥ ।। na sādhyaṃ sarvasādhvīnāṃ vratametattrilocana ।। 90 ।। svayaṃ bhūteśanāthastvaṃ puṇyakasya prabhāvataḥ ।। pārvatīgarbhajātaśca varaḥ putro bhaviṣyati ।। 91 ।। svayaṃ devagaṇānāṃ sa yasmādīśaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। gaṇeśa iti vikhyāto bhaviṣyati jagattraye।।92।। yasya smaraṇamātreṇa vighnanāśo bhaveddhruvam।। jagatāṃ hetunā'nena vighnanighnābhidho vibhuḥ ।।93।। nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi yasmāddeyāni puṇyake।। bhuktvā lambodaratvaṃ ca tena lambodaraḥ smṛtaḥ।।94।। śanidṛṣṭyā śiraśchedādgajavaktreṇa yojitaḥ ।। gajānanaḥ śiśustena sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhidaḥ ।।99।। dantabhaṅgaḥ paraśunā parśurāmasya vai yataḥ ।। hetunā tena vikhyātaścaikadantābhidhaḥ śiśuḥ ।। 96 ।। pūjyaśca sarvadevānāmasmākaṃ jagatāṃ vibhuḥ ।। sarvāgre pūjanaṃ tasya bhavitā madvareṇa vai ।। 97 ।। pūjāsu sarvadevānāmagre saṃpūjya taṃ janaḥ ।। pūjāphalamavāpnoti nirvighnena vṛthā'nyathā ।। 98 ।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca viṣṇuṃ śambhuṃ hutāśanam ।। durgāmetānsanniṣevya pūjayeddevatāntaram ।। 99 ।। gaṇeśapūjane vighnaṃ nirmūlaṃ jagatāṃ bhavet ।। nirvyādhiḥ sūryyapūjāyāṃ śuciḥ śrīviṣṇupūjane ।। 100 ।। mokṣaśca pāpanāśaśca yaśaścaiśvaryamuttamam ।। tattvajñānaṃ sutṛptīnāṃ bījaṃ śaṃkarapūjanāt ।। 101 ।। svabuddhiśuddhijananaṃ kīrttitaṃ vahnipūjanam ।। vidhisaṃskṛtavahnestu pūjāto jñānato mṛtiḥ ।। 102।। dātā bhoktā ca bhavati śaṃkarāgniniṣevaṇāt ।। haribhaktipradaṃ caiva paraṃ durgārccanaṃ śivam ।। 103 ।। viparītaṃ trijagatāmeteṣāṃ pūjanaṃ vinā ।। evaṃ kramo mahādeva kalpe kalpe'sti niścitam ।। 104 ।। ete śaśvadvidyamānā nityāḥ sṛṣṭiparāyaṇāḥ ।। āvirbhāvatirobhāvau caiteṣāmīśvarecchayā ।। ।। 105 ।। ityuktvā śrīharistatra virarāma sabhātale ।। prahṛṣṭā devatā viprāḥ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ ।। 106 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇeśakhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde vratājñāgrahaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 6 ।।
<3.7> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। harerājñāṃ samādāya haraḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। uvāca pārvatīṃ prītyā harisaṃlāpamaṅgalam ।। 1 ।। śivājñāṃ ca samādāya śivā saṃhṛṣṭamānasā ।। vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa maṃgalaṃ magalavrate ।। 2 ।। susnātā sudatī śuddhā bibhratī dhautavāsasī ।। saṃsthāpya ratnakalaśaṃ śukladhānyopari sthiram ।। 3 ।। āmrapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalākṣatasuśobhitam ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena virājitam ।। 4 ।। ratnāsanasthā ratnāḍhyā ratnodbhavasutā satī ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃśca saṃpūjya munipuṃgavān ।। 5 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca saṃpūjya supurohitam ।। candanāgurukastūrīratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 6 ।। saṃsthāpya purato bhaktyā dikpālānratnabhūṣitān ।। devānnarāṃśca nāgāṃśca samarcya vidhibodhitam ।। 7 ।। samarcya parayā bhaktyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena virājitān ।। 8 ।। vahniśuddhaissuvastraiśca sadratnairbhūṣaṇaistathā ।। pūjādravyaiśca vividhaiḥ pūjitānpuṇyake mune ।। samārebhe vrataṃ devī svastivācanapūrvakam ।। 9 ।। āvāhyābhīṣṭadevaṃ taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ maṃgale ghaṭe ।। bhaktyā dadau krameṇaiva copacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ।। 10 ।। yāni vrate vidheyāni deyāni vividhāni ca ।। pradadau tāni sarvāṇi pratyekaṃ phaladāni ca ।। 11 ।। vratoktamupahāraṃ ca durlabhaṃ bhuvanatraye ।। tacca sarvaṃ dadau bhaktyā suvrate suvratā satī ।। 12 ।। dattvā dravyāṇi sarvāṇi vedamantreṇa sā satī ।। homaṃ ca kārayāmāsa trilakṣaṃ tilasarpiṣā ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa pūjayitvā'tithīṃstathā ।। 13 ।। bhojayāmāsa sā devī suvrate suvratā satī ।। pratyahaṃ savidhānaṃ ca cakre sā pūrṇavatsaram ।। 14 ।। samāptidivase viprastamuvāca purohitaḥ ।। suvrate suvrate mahyaṃ dehi tvaṃ patidakṣiṇām ।। 15 ।। iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vilapya surasaṃsadi ।। mūrcchāṃ prāpa mahāmāyā māyāmohitacetasā ।।16।। tāṃ ca te mūrcchitāṃ dṛṣṭvā prahasya munipuṃgavāḥ ।। śaṅkaraṃ preṣayāmāsa brahmā viṣṇuśca nārada ।। 17 ।। saṃprārthitaḥ sabhāsadbhiḥ śivāṃ bodhayituṃ tadā ।। śivaḥ samudyamaṃ cakre pravaktuṃ vadatāṃ varaḥ ।।18।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। uttiṣṭha bhadre bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। sāmprataṃ cetanaṃ kṛtvā madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇu ।। 19 ।। śivaḥ śivāṃ tāmityuktvā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukām ।। vakṣasi sthāpayāmāsa kārayāmāsa cetanām ।। 20 ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ mitaṃ sarvaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। yaśaskaraṃ ca phaladaṃ pravaktumupacakrame ।। ।। 21 ।। śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yadvedena nirūpitam ।। sarvasammatamiṣṭaṃ ca dharmārthaṃ dharmmasaṃsadi ।। 22 ।। sarveṣāṃ karmmaṇāṃ devi sārabhūtā ca dakṣiṇā ।। yaśodā phaladā nityaṃ dharmiṣṭhe dharmakarmaṇi ।। 23 ।। daivaṃ vā paitṛkaṃ vā'pi nityaṃ naimittikaṃ priye ।। yatkarmma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ।। dātā ca karmmaṇā tena kālasūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 24 ।। athānte dainyamāpnoti śatruṇā paripīḍitaḥ ।। dakṣiṇā vipramuddiśya tatkālaṃ tu na dīyate ।। 29 ।। tanmuhūrte vyatīte tu dakṣiṇā dviguṇā bhavet ।। caturguṇā dinātīte pakṣe śataguṇā bhavet ।। 26 ।। māse pañcaśataghnā syātṣaṇmāse taccaturguṇā ।। saṃvatsare vyatīte tu karmma tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet ।। 27 ।। dātā ca narakaṃ yāti yāvadvarṣasahasrakam ।। putrapautradhanaiśvaryyaṃ kṣayamāpnoti pātakāt ।। dharmo naṣṭo bhavettasya dharmmahīne ca karmmaṇi ।। 28 ।। śrīviṣṇuruvāca ।। rakṣa svadharmaṃ dharmiṣṭhe dharmajñe dharmakarmaṇi ।। sarveṣāṃ ca bhavedrakṣā svadharmaparipālane ।। 29 ।। brahmovāca ।। yaśca kena nimittena na dharmaṃ parirakṣati ।। dharme naṣṭe ca dharmajñe tasya kartā vinaśyati ।। 30 ।। dharma uvāca ।। māṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ sādhvi pradāya patidakṣiṇām ।। mayi sthite mahāsādhvi sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 31 ।। devā ūcuḥ ।। dharmaṃ rakṣa mahāsādhvi kuru pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ sati ।। vayaṃ tava vrate pūrṇe kurmastvāṃ pūrṇamānasām ।।32।। munaya ūcuḥ ।। kṛtvā sādhvi pūrṇahomaṃ dehi viprāya dakṣiṇām ।। sthiteṣvasmāsu dharmajñe kimabhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।।33।। sanatkumāra uvāca ।। śive śivaṃ dehi mahyaṃ na cedvrataphalaṃ tyaja ।। suciraṃ saṃcitasyāpi svātmanastapasaḥ phalam ।। 34 ।। karmaṇyadakṣiṇe sādhvi yāgasyāhaṃ tu tatphalam ।। prāpsyāmi yajamānasya saṃpūrṇaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam ।। 35 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। kiṃ karmmaṇā me deveśāḥ kiṃ me dakṣiṇayā mune ।। kiṃ putreṇa ca dharmeṇa yatra bharttā ca dakṣiṇā ।। 36 ।। vṛkṣārcane phalaṃ kiṃ vai yadi bhūmirna cārcyate ।। gate ca kāraṇe kāryyaṃ kutaḥ sasyaṃ kutaḥ phalam ।। 37 ।। prāṇāstyaktāḥ svecchayā ceddehaissyātkiṃ prayojanam ।। dṛṣṭiśaktivihīnena cakṣuṣā kiṃ prayojanam ।।38।। śataputrasamaḥ svāmī sādhvīnāṃ ca sureśvarāḥ ।। yadi bharttā vrate deyaḥ kiṃ vratena sutena vā ।। 39 ।। bharturvaṃśaśca tanayaḥ kevalaṃ bhartṛmūlakaḥ ।। yatra mūlaṃ bhavedbhraṣṭaṃ tadvāṇijyaṃ ca niṣphalam ।। 40 ।। śrīviṣṇuruvāca ।। putrādapi paraḥ svāmī dharmaśca svāminaḥ paraḥ ।। naṣṭe dharme ca dharmiṣṭhe svāminā kiṃ sutena vā ।। 41 ।। brahmovāca ।। svāminaśca paro dharmo dharmātsatyaṃ ca suvrate।। satyaṃ saṃkalpitaṃ karma na tu bhraṣṭaṃ kuru vratam।।42।। pārvatyuvāca।। nirūpitaśca vedeṣu svaśabdo dhanavācakaḥ।। tadyasyāstīti sa svāmī vedajña śṛṇu madvacaḥ।।43।। tasya dātā sadā svāmī na ca svasvāmitāṃ labhet।। aho'vyavasthā bhavatāṃ vedajñānāmabodhataḥ ।।44।। dharmma uvāca ।। patnī vinā'nyaṃ svaṃ sādhvi svāminaṃ dātumakṣamā ।। dampatī dhruvamekāṅgau dvayordāne dvakau samau ।। 45 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। pitā dadāti jāmātre sa ca gṛhṇāti tatsutām ।। na śrutaṃ viparītaṃ ca śrutau śrutiparāyaṇāḥ ।। 46 ।। devā ūcuḥ ।। buddhisvarūpā tvaṃ durge buddhimanto vayaṃ tvayā ।। vedajñe vedavādeṣu ke vā tvāṃ jetumīśvarāḥ ।।47।। nirūpitā puṇyake tu vrate svāmī ca dakṣiṇā ।। śrutau śruto yaḥ sa dharmo viparīto hyadharmakaḥ ।।48।। pārvatyuvāca ।। kevalaṃ vedamāśritya kaḥ karoti vinirṇayam ।। balavām̐llaukiko vedāllokācāraṃ ca kastyajet ।। 49 ।। vede prakṛtipuṃsośca garīyānpuruṣo dhruvam ।। nibodhata surāḥ prājñā bālāhaṃ kathayāmi kim ।। 50 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। na pumāṃsaṃ vinā sṛṣṭirna sādhvi prakṛtiṃ vinā ।। śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvayoḥ sraṣṭā samau prakṛtipūruṣau ।। 51 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। sarvasraṣṭā ca yaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ soṃ'śena saguṇaḥ pumān ।। pumāngarīyānprakṛtestathaiva na tataśca sā ।। 52 ।। etasminnantare devā munayastatra saṃsadi ।। ratnendrasāraracitamākāśe dadṛśū ratham ।। 53 ।। pārṣadaissaṃparivṛtaṃ yutaṃ śyāmaiścaturbhujaiḥ ।। vanamālāparivṛtai ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ ।। avaruhya mudā yānādājagāma sabhātalam ।। 54 ।। tuṣṭuvustaṃ surendrāste devaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsinam ।। śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharamīśaṃ caturbhujam ।। 95 ।। lakṣmīsarasvatīkāntaṃ śāntaṃ taṃ sumanoharam ।। sukhadṛśyamabhaktānāmadṛśyaṃ koṭijanmabhiḥ ।। 56 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ koṭicandrasamaprabham ।। amūlyaratnaracitacārubhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। ।। 57 ।। sevyaṃ brahmādidevaiśca sevakaiḥ satataṃ stutam ।। tadbhāsā saṃparicchannairveṣṭitaṃ ca surarṣibhiḥ ।। 58 ।। vāsayāmāsa taṃ te ca ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। taṃ praṇemuśca śirasā brahmaśaktiśivādayaḥ ।। 59 ।। sampuṭāñjalayaḥ sarve pulakāṅgāśrulocanāḥ ।। 60 ।। sasmitastāṃśca papraccha sarvaṃ madhurayā girā ।। prabodhitaḥ subodhajñaḥ pravaktumupacakrame ।। 61 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। saha buddhyā buddhimanto na vaktumucitaṃ surāḥ।। sarve śaktyā yayā viśve śaktimanto hi jīvinaḥ।।62।। brahmāditṛṇaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtikaṃ jagat।। satyaṃ satyaṃ vinā māṃ ca mayā śaktiḥ prakāśitā ।। 63 ।। āvirbhūtā ca sā mattaḥ sṛṣṭau devī madicchayā ।। tirohitā ca sā śeṣe sṛṣṭisaṃharaṇe mayi ।। 64 ।। prakṛtiḥ sṛṣṭikartrī ca sarveṣāṃ jananī parā ।। mama tulyā ca manmāyā tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā ।। ।। 65 ।। suciraṃ tapasā taptaṃ śaṃbhunā dhyāyatā ca mām ।। tena tasmai mayā dattā tapasāṃ phalarūpiṇī ।। 66 ।। vrataṃ ca lokaśikṣārthamasyā na svārthameva ca ।। svayaṃ vratānāṃ tapasāṃ phaladātrī jagattraye ।। 67 ।। māyayā mohitāḥ sarve kimasyā vāstavaṃ vratam ।। sādhyamasya vrataphalaṃ kalpe kalpe punaḥ punaḥ ।। 68 ।। sureśvarā madaṃśāśca brahmaśaktimaheśvarāḥ ।। kalāḥ kalāṃśarūpāśca jīvinaśca surādayaḥ ।। 69 ।। mṛdā vinā ghaṭaṃ karttuṃ kulālaśca yathā'kṣamaḥ ।। vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalaṃ karttumakṣamaḥ ।। 70 ।। vinā śaktyā tathā'haṃ ca svasṛṣṭiṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ।। śaktipradhānā sṛṣṭiśca sarvadarśanasammatā ।। 71 ।। ahamātmā hi nirlipto'dṛśyaḥ sākṣī ca dehinām ।। dehāḥ prākṛtikāḥ sarve naśvarāḥ pāñcabhautikāḥ ।। 72 ।। ahaṃ nityaḥ śarīrī ca bhānuvigrahavigrahaḥ ।। sarvādhārā sā prakṛtiḥ sarvātmā'haṃ jagatsu ca ।।73।। ahamātmā mano brahmā jñānarūpo maheśvaraḥ ।। pañca prāṇāḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurbuddhiḥ prakṛtirīśvarī ।। ।। 74 ।। medhā nidrādayaścaitāḥ sarvāśca prakṛteḥ kalāḥ ।। sā ca śailendrakanyaiṣā tviti vede nirūpitam ।। 79 ।। ahaṃ golokanāthaśca vaikuṇṭheśaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। gopīgopaiḥ parivṛtastatraiva dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। caturbhujo'tra deveśo lakṣmīśaḥ pārṣadairvṛtaḥ ।। 76 ।। ūrdhva paraśca vaikuṇṭhātpañcāśatkoṭiyojane ।। mamāśrayaśca goloke yatrāhaṃ gopikāpatiḥ ।। 77 ।। vratārādhyassa dvibhujaḥ sa ca tatphaladāyakaḥ।। yadrūpaṃ cintayedyo hi tacca tatphaladāyakaḥ।।78।। vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru śive śivaṃ dattvā ca dakṣiṇām।। punaḥ samucitaṃ mūlyaṃ dattvā nāthaṃ grahīṣyasi।।79।। viṣṇudehā yathā gāvo viṣṇudehastathā śivaḥ ।। dvijāya dattvā gomūlyaṃ gṛhāṇa svāminaṃ śubhe।। 80।। yajñapatnīṃ yathā dātuṃ kṣamaḥ svāmī sadaiva tu ।। tathā sā svāminaṃ dātumīśvarīti śrutermatam।।81।। ityuktvā sa sabhāmadhye tatraivāntaradhīyata ।। hṛṣṭāste sā ca saṃhṛṣṭā dakṣiṇāṃ dātumudyatā ।। 82 ।। kṛtvā śivā pūrṇahomaṃ sā śivaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।। svastītyuktvā ca jagrāha kumāro devasaṃsadi ।।83।। uvāca durgā saṃtrastā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā ।। kṛtvāñjalipuṭā vipraṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।।84।। pārvatyuvāca ।। gomūlyaṃ matpatisamamiti vede nirūpitam।। gavāṃ lakṣaṃ prayacchāmi dehi matsvāminaṃ dvija।।85।। tadā dāsyāmi viprebhyo dānāni vividhāni ca।। ātmahīno hi dehaśca karmma kiṃ kartumīśvaraḥ।।86।। sanatkumāra uvāca ।। gavāṃ lakṣeṇa me devi valgunā kiṃ prayojanam ।। dattasyāmūlya ratnasya gavāṃ pratyarpaṇena ca।।87।। svasya svasya svayaṃ dātā lokaḥ sarvo jagattraye।। kartturevepsitaṃ karma bhavetkiṃ vā parecchayā ।। 88 ।। digambaraṃ puraḥ kṛtvā bhramiṣyāmi jagattrayam।। bālakānāṃ bālikānāṃ samūhasmitakāraṇam।।89।। ityuktvā brahmaṇaḥ putro gṛhītvā śaṅkaraṃ mune।। sannidhau vāsayāmāsa tejasvī devasaṃsadi।। 90।। dṛṣṭvā śivaṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ kumāreṇa ca pārvatī।। samudyatā tanuṃ tyaktuṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā।। ।। 91 ।। vicintya manasā sādhvītyevameva duratyayam ।। na dṛṣṭo'bhīṣṭadevaśca na ca prāptaṃ phalaṃ vrate ।। 92 ।। etasminnantare devāḥ pārvatīsahitāstadā ।। sadyo dadṛśurākāśe tejasāṃ nikaraṃ param ।। 93 ।। koṭisūryyaprabhordhvaṃ ca prajvalantaṃ diśo daśa ।। kailāsaśailapurataḥ sarvadevādibhiryutam ।। 94 ।। sarvāśrayaṃ gaṇācchannaṃ vistīrṇaṃ maṇḍalākṛtim ।। tacca dṛṣṭvā bhagavatastuṣṭuvuste krameṇa ca ।। ।। 95 ।। viṣṇuruvāca ।। brahmāṇḍāni ca sarvāṇi yallomavivareṣu ca ।। so'yaṃ te ṣoḍaśāṃśaśca ke vayaṃ yo mahāvirāṭ ।। 96 ।। brahmovāca ।। vedopayuktaṃ dṛśyaṃ yatpratyakṣaṃ draṣṭumīśvara ।। stotuṃ tadvarṇitumahaṃ śaktaḥ kiṃ staumi tatparaḥ ।।97।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। jñānādhiṣṭhātṛdevo'haṃ staumi jñānaparaṃ ca kim ।। sarvānirvacanīyaṃ taṃ tvāṃ ca svecchāmayaṃ vibhum ।। 98 ।। dharma uvāca ।। adṛśyamavatāreṣu yaddṛśyaṃ sarvajantubhiḥ ।। kiṃ staumi tejorūpaṃ tadbhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 99 ।। devā ucuḥ ।। ke vayaṃ tvatkalāṃśāśca kiṃ vā tvāṃ stotumīśvarāḥ ।। stotuṃ na śaktā vedā yaṃ na ca śaktā sarasvatī ।। 100 ।। munaya ucuḥ ।। vedānpaṭhitvā vidvāṃso vayaṃ kiṃ vedakāraṇam ।। stotumīśā na vāṇī ca tvāṃ vāṅmanasayoḥ param ।। 101 ।। sarasvatyuvāca ।। vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ māṃ vadante vedavādinaḥ ।। kiñcinna śaktā tvāṃ stotumaho vāṅmanasoḥ param ।। 102 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। vedaprasūrahaṃ nātha sṛṣṭvā tvatkalayā purā ।। kiṃ staumi strīsvabhāvena sarvakāraṇakāraṇam।।103।। lakṣmīruvāca ।। tvadaṃśaviṣṇukāntāhaṃ jagatpoṣaṇakāriṇī।। kiṃ staumi tvatkalāsṛṣṭā jagatāṃ bījakāraṇam ।। 104 ।। himālaya uvāca ।। hasanti santo māṃ nātha karmaṇā sthāvaraṃ param।। stotuṃ samudyataṃ kṣudraḥ kiṃ staumi stotumakṣamaḥ ।। 105 ।। krameṇa sarve taṃ stutvā devā viraramurmune ।। devyaśca munayaḥ sarve pārvatī stotumudyatā ।। 106 ।। dhautavastrā jaṭābhāraṃ bibhratī suvratā vrate ।। preritā paramātmānaṃ vratārādhyaṃ śivena ca ।।107।। jvaladagniśikhārūpā tejomūrtimatī satī ।। tapasāṃ phaladā mātā jagatāṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। 108 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। kṛṣṇa jānāsi māṃ bhadraṃ nāhaṃ tvāṃ jñātumīśvarī ।। ke vā jānanti vedajñā vedā vā vedakārakāḥ ।।109।। tvadaṃśāstvāṃ na jānanti kathaṃ jñāsyanti te kalāḥ।। tvaṃ cāpi tattvaṃ jānāsi kimanye jñātumīśvarāḥ ।। 110 ।। sūkṣmātsūkṣmatamo'vyaktaḥ sthūlātsthūlatamo mahān ।। viśvastvaṃ viśvarūpaśca viśvabījaṃ sanātanaḥ ।। 111 ।। kāryyaṃ tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। tejassvarūpo bhagavānnirākāro nirāśrayaḥ ।। 112 ।। nirlipto nirguṇaḥ sākṣī svātmārāmaḥ parātparaḥ ।। prakṛtīśo virāḍbījaṃ virāḍrūpastvameva ca ।। saguṇastvaṃ prākṛtikaḥ kalayā sṛṣṭihetave ।। 113 ।। prakṛtistvaṃ pumāṃstvaṃ ca vedā'nyo na kvacidbhavet ।। jīvastvaṃ sākṣiṇo bhogī svātmanaḥ pratibimbakam ।। 114 ।। karma tvaṃ karmabījaṃ tvaṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāyakaḥ ।। dhyāyanti yoginastejastvadīyamaśarīri yat ।। keciccaturbhujaṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam ।। 115 ।। vaiṣṇavāścaiva sākāraṃ kamanīyaṃ manoharam ।। śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ param ।।116।। dvibhujaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ।। śāntaṃ gopāṅganākāntaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 117 ।। evaṃ tejasvinaṃ bhaktāḥ sevante santataṃ mudā ।। dhyāyanti yogino yattatkutastejasvinaṃ vinā ।। 118 ।। tattejo bibhratāṃ deva devānāṃ tejasā purā ।। āvirbhūtā surāṇāṃ ca vadhāya brahmaṇā stutā ।। 119 ।। nityā tejastvarūpā'haṃ dhṛtvā vai vigrahaṃ vibho ।। strīrūpaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca vidhāya samupasthitā ।। 120 ।। māyayā tava māyā'haṃ mohayitvā'surānpurā ।। nihatya sarvāñchailendramagamaṃ taṃ himālayam ।। 121 ।। tato'haṃ saṃstutā devaistārakākṣeṇa pīḍitaiḥ ।। abhavaṃ dakṣajāyāyāṃ śivastrī bhavajanmani ।।122।। tyaktvā dehaṃ dakṣayajñe śivā'haṃ śivanindayā ।। abhavaṃ śailajāyāyāṃ śailādhīśasya karmaṇā ।। 123 ।। anekatapasā prāptaḥ śivaścātrāpi janmani ।। pāṇiṃ jagrāha me yogī prārthito brahmaṇā vibhuḥ ।। 124 ।। śṛṅgārajaṃ ca tattejo nālabhaṃ devamāyayā ।। staumi tvāmeva teneśa putraduḥkhena duḥkhitā ।। 125 ।। vrate bhavadvidhaṃ putraṃ labdhumicchāmi sāmpratam ।। devena vihitā vede sāṃge svasvāmidakṣiṇā ।। 126 ।। śrutvā sarvaṃ kṛpāsindho kṛpāṃ me kartumarhasi ।। ityuktvā pārvatī tatra virarāma ca nārada ।। 127 ।। bhārate pārvatīstotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti susaṃyataḥ ।। satputraṃ labhate nūnaṃ viṣṇutulyaparākramam ।। 128 ।। saṃvatsaraṃ haviṣyāśī harimabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ ।। supuṇyakavrataphalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 129 ।। viṣṇustotramidaṃ brahmansarvasampattivaddharnam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ svāmisaubhāgyavarddhanam ।। 130।। sarvasaundaryyabījaṃ ca yaśorāśivivarddhanam ।। haribhaktipradaṃ tattvajñānabuddhisukhapradam ।। 131 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde puṇyakavrate patidāne pārvatīkṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotrakathanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 7 ।।
<3.8> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। pārvatyāḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ ।। svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvādṛśyaṃ sudurlabham ।। 1 ।। stutvā devī vrataparā kṛṣṇasaṃlagnamānasā ।। dadarśa tejasāṃ madhye svarūpaṃ sarvamohanam ।। 2 ।। sadratnasāraracite hīrakeṇa pariṣkṛte ।। yukte māṇikyamālābhī ratnapūrṇe manorame ।। 3 ।। pītāṃśukaṃ vahniśuddhaṃ varaṃ vaṃśakaraṃ param ।। vanamālāgalaṃ śyāmaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 4 ।। kiśoravayasaṃ citraveṣaṃ vai candanāṃkitam ।। cārusmitāsyamīḍyaṃ tacchāradenduvinindakam ।। 9 ।। mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaṃ kekipicchāvacūḍakam ।। gopāṃganāparivṛtaṃ rādhāvakṣasthalojjvalam ।। 6 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlādhāma manoharam ।। atīva hṛṣṭaṃ sarveṣṭaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 7 ।। dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ rūpavatī putraṃ tadanurūpakam ।। manasā varayāmāsa varaṃ saṃprāpya tatkṣaṇam ।। 8 ।। varaṃ dattvā vareśastu yadyanmanasi vāñchitam ।। dattvā'bhīṣṭaṃ surebhyaśca tattejo'ntaradhīyata ।। 9 ।। kumāraṃ bodhayitvā tu devadevyai digambaram ।। dadurnirupamaṃ tatra prahṛṣṭāyai kṛpānvitāḥ ।। 10 ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dadau durgā ratnāni vividhāni ca ।। suvarṇāni ca bhikṣubhyo bandibhyo viśvananditā ।। 11 ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa devānvai parvatāṃstathā ।। śaṃkaraṃ pūjayāmāsa copahārairanuttamaiḥ ।। 12 ।। dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ।। saṃgītaṃ gāpayāmāsa harisambandhi sundaram।। 13।। vrataṃ samāpya sā durgā dattvā dānāni sasmitā ।। sarvāṃśca bhojayitvā tu bubhuje svāminā saha ।। 14 ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। kramātpradāya sarvebhyo bubhuje tena kautukāt ।। 15 ।। payaḥphenanibhāṃ śayyāṃ ramyāṃ sadratnamañcake ।। puṣpacandanasaṃyuktāṃ kastūrīkuṃkumānvitām ।। rahasi svāminā sārddhaṃ suṣvāpa parameśvarī ।। ।। 16 ।। kailāsasyaikadeśe ca ramye candanakānane ।। sugandhikusumāḍhyena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। 17 ।। bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokilarutāśraye ।। vyahārṣītsā surasikā tatra tena sahāmbikā ।। 18 ।। retaḥpatanakāle ca sa viṣṇurviṣṇumāyayā ।। vidhāya viprarūpaṃ tadājagāma ratergṛham ।।19।। jaṭāvantaṃ vinā tailaṃ kucailaṃ bhikṣukaṃ mune ।। atīvaśukladaśanaṃ tṛṣṇayā paripīḍitam।। ।। 20 ।। atīva kṛśagātraṃ ca bibhrattilakamujjvalam ।। bahukākusvaraṃ dīnaṃ dainyātkutsitamūrtimat ।। 21 ।। ājuhāva mahādevamativṛddho'nnayācakaḥ ।। daṇḍāvalambanaṃ kṛtvā ratidvāre'tidurbalaḥ ।। 22 ।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। kiṃ karoṣi mahādeva rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। saptarātrivrate'tīte pāraṇākāṃkṣiṇaṃ kṣudhā।।23।। kiṃ karoṣi mahādeva he tāta karuṇānidhe ।। paśya vṛddhaṃ jarāgrastaṃ tṛṣayā paripīḍitam।। ।। 24 ।। mātaruttiṣṭha me'nnaṃ tvaṃ prayacchādya śivaṃ jalam ।। anantaratnodbhavaje rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 25 ।। mātarmātarjaganmātarehi nāhaṃ sthito bahiḥ ।। sīdāmi tṛṣayā kasmātsthitāyāmātmamātari ।। 26 ।। iti kākusvaraṃ śrutvā śivasyottiṣṭhato mune ।। papāta vīryyaṃ śayyāyāṃ na yonau prakṛtestadā ।। 27 ।। uttasthau pārvatī trastā sūkṣmavastraṃ pidhāya ca ।। ājagāma bahirdvāraṃ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ ।। 28 ।। dadarśa brāhmaṇaṃ dīnaṃ jarayā paripīḍitam ।। vṛddhaṃ lulitagātraṃ ca bibhrataṃ daṇḍamānatam ।। 29 ।। tapasvinamaśāntaṃ ca śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukam ।। kurvantaṃ parayā bhaktyā praṇāmaṃ stavanaṃ tayoḥ ।। 30 ।। śrutvā tadvacanaṃ tatra nīlakaṇṭhaḥ sudhopamam ।। uvāca parayā prītyā prasannastaṃ prahasya ca ।। 31 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। gṛhaṃ te kutra viprarṣe vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। kinnāma bhavataḥ kṣipraṃ jñātumicchāmi sāmpratam ।। 32 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। āgato'si kuto vipra mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ ।। adya me saphalaṃ janma brāhmaṇo madgṛhe'tithiḥ ।। 33 ।। atithiḥ pūjito yena trijagattena pūjitam ।। tatraivādhiṣṭhitā devā brāhmaṇā guravo dvija ।। 34 ।। tīrthānyatithipādeṣu śaśvattiṣṭhanti niścitam ।। tatpādadhautatoyena miśritāni labhedgṛhī ।। 35।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ।। atithiḥ pūjito yena svātmaśaktyā yathocitam ।। 36 ।। mahādānāni sarvāṇi kṛtāni tena bhūtale ।। atithiḥ pūjito yena bhārate bhaktipūrvakam ।। 37 ।। nānāprakārapuṇyāni vedoktāni ca yāni vai ।। anye cātithisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 38 ।। apūjito'tithiryasya bhavanādvinivarttate ।। pitṛdevāgnayaḥ paścādguravo yāntyapūjitāḥ ।। 39 ।। yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ।। tāni sarvāṇi labhate nābhyarcyātithimīpsitam।। 40।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। jānāsi vedānvedajñe vedoktaṃ kuru pūjanam ।। kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ pīḍito mātarvacanaṃ ca śrutau śrutam ।। 41 ।। vyādhiyukto nirāhāro yadā vā'naśanavratī ।। manorathenopahāraṃ bhoktumicchati mānavaḥ।।42।। pārvatyuvāca ।। bhoktumicchasi kiṃ vipra trailokye ca sudurlabham।। dāsyāmi bhoktuṃ tvāmadya majjanma saphalaṃ kuru ।।43।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। vrate suvratayā sarvamupahāraṃ samāhṛtam ।। nānāvidhaṃ miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ bhoktuṃ śrutvā samāgataḥ।।44।। suvrate tava putro'hamagre māṃ pūjayiṣyasi ।। dattvā miṣṭāni vastūni trailokye durlabhāni ca ।। 45 ।। tātāḥ pañcavidhāḥ proktā mātaro vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। putraḥ pañcavidhaḥ sādhvi kathito vedavādibhiḥ।।46।। vidyādātā'nnadātā ca bhayatrātā ca janmadaḥ ।। kanyādātā ca vedoktā narāṇāṃ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 47 ।। gurupatnī garbhadhātrī stanadātrī pituḥ svasā ।। svasā mātuḥ sapatnī ca putrabhāryyā'nnadāyikā ।। 48 ।। bhṛtyaḥ śiṣyaśca poṣyaśca vīryyajaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ।। dharmaputrāśca catvāro vīryyajo dhanabhāgiti ।। 49 ।। kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ pīḍito mātarvṛddho'haṃ śaraṇāgataḥ ।। sāmprataṃ tava vandhyāyā anāthaḥ putra eva ca ।। 50 ।। piṣṭakaṃ paramānnaṃ ca supakvāni phalāni ca ।। nānāvidhāni piṣṭāni kāladeśodbhavāni ca ।। 51 ।। pakvānnaṃ svastikaṃ kṣīramikṣumikṣuvikārajam ।। ghṛtaṃ dadhi ca śālyannaṃ ghṛtapakvaṃ ca vyañjanam ।। 52 ।। laḍḍukāni tilānāṃ ca miṣṭānnaiḥ saguḍāni ca ।। mamājñātāni vastūni sudhayā tulyakāni ca ।। 53 ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। calaṃ sunirmalaṃ svādu dravyāṇyetāni vāsitam ।।54।। dravyāṇi yāni bhuktvā me cāru lambodaraṃ bhavet ।। anantaratnodbhavaje tāni mahyaṃ pradāsyasi ।। 55 ।। svāmī te trijagatkarttā pradātā sarvasampadām ।। mahālakṣmī svarūpā tvaṃ sarvaiśvaryyapradāyinī ।। 56 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyamamūlyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ cāru pradāsyasi sudurlabham ।। 57 ।। sudurlabhaṃ harermantraṃ harau bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ sati ।। haripriyā hareḥ śaktistvameva sarvadā sthitā ।। 58 ।। jñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ nāma dātṛśaktiṃ sukhapradām ।। sarvasiddhiṃ ca kiṃ mātaradeyaṃ svasutāya ca ।। 59 ।। manaḥ sunirmalaṃ kṛtvā dharme tapasi santatam ।। śreṣṭhe savaṃ kariṣyāmi na kāme janma hetuke ।। 60 ।। svakāmātkurute karma karmaṇo bhoga eva ca ।। bhogau śubhāśubhau jñeyau tau hetū sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।।61।। duḥkhaṃ na kasmādbhavati sukhaṃ vā jagadambike ।। sarvaṃ svakarmaṇo bhogastena tadvirato budhaḥ ।। 62 ।। karma nirmūlayantyeva santo hi satataṃ mudā ।। haribhāvanabuddhyā tattapasā bhaktasaṅgataḥ ।। 63 ।। indriyadravyasaṃyogasukhaṃ vidhvaṃsanāvadhi ।। harisaṃlāparūpaṃ ca sukhaṃ tatsarvakālikam ।।64।। harismaraṇaśīlānāṃ nāyuryāti satāṃ satī ।। na teṣāmīśvaraḥ kālo na ca mṛtyuñjayo dhruvam ।। 65 ।। ciraṃ jīvanti te bhaktā bhārate cirajīvinaḥ ।। sarvasiddhiṃ ca vijñāya svacchandaṃ sarvagāminaḥ ।। 66 ।। jātismarā harerbhaktā jānate koṭijanmanaḥ ।। kathayanti kathāṃ janma labhante svecchayā mudā ।। 67 ।। paraṃ punanti te pūtāstīrthāni svīyalīlayā ।। puṇyakṣetre'tra sevāyai parārthaṃ ca bhramanti te ।। 68 ।। vaiṣṇavānāṃ padasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। kālaṃ godohamātraṃ tu tīrthe yatra vasanti te ।। 69 ।। gurorāsyādviṣṇumantraḥ śrutau yasya praviśyati ।। taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthapūtaṃ pravadanti purāvidaḥ ।। 70 ।। puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvamuddharanti śataṃ param ।। līlayā bhārate bhaktyā sodarānmātaraṃ tathā ।। 71 ।। mātāmahānāṃ puruṣāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān ।। mātuḥ prasūmuddharanti dāruṇādyamatāḍanāt ।। ।। 72 ।। bhaktadarśanamāśleṣaṃ mānavāḥ prāpnuvanti ye ।। te yātāḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitāḥ ।। 73 ।। na liptāḥ pātakairbhaktāḥ santataṃ harimānasāḥ ।। yathā'gnayaḥ sarvabhakṣyā yathā dravyeṣu vāyavaḥ ।।74।। trikoṭijanmanāmante prāpnoti janma mānavam ।। prāpnoti bhaktasaṃgaṃ sa mānuṣe koṭijanmataḥ ।। 75 ।। bhaktasaṅgādbhavedbhakteraṅkuro jīvitaḥ satī ।। abhaktadarśanādeva sa ca prāpnoti śuṣkatām ।। ।। 76 ।। punaḥ praphullatāṃ yāti vaiṣṇavālāpamātrataḥ ।। aṃkuraścāvināśī ca varddhate pratijanmani ।। 77> tattarovarddhamānasya haridāsyaṃ phalaṃ sati ।। pariṇāme bhaktipāke pārṣadaśca bhaveddhareḥ ।। 78 ।। mahati pralaye nāśo na bhavettasya niścitam ।। sarvasṛṣṭeśca saṃhāre brahmalokasya vedhasaḥ ।। 79 ।। tasmānnārāyaṇe bhaktiṃ dehi māmambike sadā ।। na bhavedviṣṇubhaktiśca viṣṇumāye tvayā vinā ।। 80।। tadvantaṃ lokaśikṣārthaṃ svatapastava pūjanam ।। sarveṣāṃ phaladātrī tvaṃ nityarūpā sanātanī ।। 81 ।। gaṇeśarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kalpe kalpe tavātmajaḥ ।। tvatkroḍamāgataḥ kṣipramityuktvā'ntaradhīyata ।। 82 ।। kṛtvā'ntardhānamīśaśca bālarūpaṃ vidhāya saḥ ।। jagāma pārvatī talpaṃ mandirābhyantarasthitam ।। 83 ।। talpasthe śivavīryye ca miśritaḥ sa babhūva ha ।। dadarśa gehaśikharaṃ prasūte bālake yathā ।।84।। śuddhacampakavarṇābhaḥ koṭicandrasamaprabhaḥ ।। sukhadṛśyaḥ sarvajanaiścakṣūraśmivivarddhakaḥ ।। 85 ।। atīva sundaratanuḥ kāmadevavimohanaḥ ।। sukhaṃ nirupamaṃ bibhracchāradenduvinindakam ।। 86 ।। sundare locane bibhraccārupadmavinindake ।। oṣṭhādharapuṭaṃ bibhratpakvabimbavinindakam ।। 87 ।। kapālaṃ ca kapolaṃ ca paramaṃ sumanoharam ।। nāsāgraṃ ruciraṃ bibhradvīndracañcuvinindakam ।। 88 ।। trailokye vai nirupamaṃ sarvāṃgaṃ bibhraduttamam ।। śayānaḥ śayane ramye prerayanhastapādakam ।। 89 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇeśakhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇeśotpattivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 8 ।।
<3.9> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। harau tirohite śarvāṇī durgā śaṃkarastadā ।। brāhmaṇānveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā babhrāma parito mune ।। 1 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। aye viprendrātivṛddha kva gato'si kṣudhā''turaḥ ।। he tāta darśanaṃ dehi prāṇānvai rakṣa me vibho ।। 2 ।। śiva śīghraṃ samuttiṣṭha brāhmaṇānveṣaṇaṃ kuru ।। kṣaṇamunmanasoreṣa gataḥ pratyakṣamāvayoḥ ।। 3 ।। agṛhītvā gṛhātpūjāṃ gṛhiṇo'tithirīśvara ।। yadi yāti kṣudhā''rttaśca tasya kiṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।। 4 ।। pitarastanna gṛhṇanti piṇḍadānaṃ ca tarpaṇam ।। tasyāhutiṃ na gṛhṇāti vahniḥ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ surāḥ ।। 5 ।। havyaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ dravyamaśuceśca surāsamam ।। amedhyasadṛśaḥ piṇḍaḥ sparśanaṃ puṇyanāśanam ।। 6 ।। etasminnantare tatra vāg babhūvāśarīriṇī ।। kaivalyayuktā sā durgā tāṃ śuśrāva śucā''turā ।। 7 ।। śāntā bhava jaganmātassvasutaṃ paśya mandire ।। kṛṣṇaṃ golokanāthaṃ taṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ param ।।8।। supuṇyakavratataroḥ phalarūpaṃ sanātanam ।। yattejo yoginaḥ śaśvaddhyāyanti santataṃ mudā ।। 9 ।। dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavā devā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। yasya pūjyasya sarvāgre kalpe kalpe ca pūjanam ।। 10 ।। yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvavighno vinaśyati ।। puṇyarāśisvarūpaṃ ca svasutaṃ paśya mandire ।। 11 ।। kalpe kalpe dhyāyasi yaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। paśya tvaṃ muktidaṃ putraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।।12।। tava vāñchāpūrṇabījaṃ tapaḥkalpataroḥ phalam।। sundaraṃ svasutaṃ paśya koṭikandarpanindakam ।।13।। nāyaṃ vipraḥ kṣudhā''rttaśca viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। kiṃ vā vilāpaṃ kuruṣe kva vā vṛddhaḥ kva cātithiḥ ।। sarasvatī tvevamuktvā virarāma ca nārada ।। 14 ।। trastā śrutvā''kāśavāṇīṃ jagāma svālayaṃ satī ।। dadarśa bālaṃ paryyaṅke śayānaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā।।15।। paśyantaṃ gehaśikharaṃ śatacandrasamaprabham ।। svaprabhāpaṭalenaiva dyotayantaṃ mahītalam ।। 16 ।। kurvantaṃ bhramaṇaṃ talpe paśyantaṃ svecchayā mudā ।। umeti śabdaṃ kurvantaṃ rudantaṃ taṃ stanārthinam ।। 17 ।। dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutaṃ rūpaṃ trastā śaṃkarasannidhim ।। gatvā sovāca giriśaṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalā ।। 18 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। gṛhamāgaccha sarveśa tapasāṃ phaladāyakam ।। kalpe kalpe dhyāyasi yaṃ taṃ paśyāgatya mandiram ।। 19 ।। śīghraṃ putramukhaṃ paśya puṇyabījaṃ mahotsavam ।। punnāmanarakatrāṇakāraṇaṃ bhavatāraṇam ।। 20 ।। snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇam ।। putrasaṃdarśanasyāsya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 21 ।। sarvadānena yatpuṇyaṃ kṣmāpradakṣiṇataśca yat ।। putradarśanapuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 22 ।। sarvaistapobhiryatpuṇyaṃ devānaśanairvrataiḥ ।। satputrodbhavapuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 23 ।। yadviprabhojanaiḥ puṇyaṃ yadeva surasevanaiḥ ।। satputraprāptipuṇyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 24 ।। pārvatyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śivaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। ājagāma svabhavanaṃ kṣipraṃ vai kāntayā saha ।। dadarśa talpe svasutaṃ taptakāñcanasannibham ।। 25 ।। hadayasthaṃ ca yadrūpaṃ tadevātimanoharam ।। durgātalpātsamādāya kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ sutam।। cucumbānandajaladhau nimagnā setyuvāca tam ।। 26 ।। saṃprāpyāmūlyaratnaṃ tvāṃ pūrṇameva sanātanam ।। yathā mano daridrasya sahasā prāpya saddhanam ।। 27 ।। kānte suciramāyāte proṣite yoṣito yathā ।। mānasaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ca babhūva ca tathā mama ।। 28 ।। suciraṃ gatamāyātamekaputrā kathā sutam ।। dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭā yathā vatsa tathā'hamapi sāmpratam ।। 29 ।। sadratnaṃ suciraṃ bhraṣṭaṃ prāpya hṛṣṭo yathā janaḥ ।। anāvṛṣṭau suvṛṣṭiṃ ca saṃprāpyāhaṃ tathā sutam ।। 30 ।। yathā suciramandhānāṃ sthitānāṃ ca nirāśraye ।। cakṣussunirmmalaṃ prāpya manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathaiva me ।। 31 ।।
