dustare sāgare ghore patitasya ca saṃkaṭe ।। anaukasya prāpya naukāṃ manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama ।। 32 ।। tṛṣṇayā śuṣkakaṇṭhānāṃ sucirācca suśītalam।। suvāsitaṃ jalaṃ prāpya manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama।।33।। dāvāgnipatitānāṃ ca sthitānāṃ ca nirāśraye ।। niragnimāśrayaṃ prāpya manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama ।। 34 ।। ciraṃ bubhukṣitānāṃ ca vratopoṣaṇakāriṇām ।।35।। sadannaṃ purato dṛṣṭvā manaḥ pūrṇaṃ tathā mama ।। ityuktvā pārvatī tatra kroḍe kṛtvā svabālakam ।।36।। prītyā stanaṃ dadau tasmai paramānandamānasā ।। kroḍe cakāra bhagavānbālakaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। 37 ।। cucumba gaṇḍe vedoktaṃ yuyuje cāśiṣaṃ mudā ।। 38 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇa tṛtīye gaṇapati khaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde bālagaṇeśadarśanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 9 ।।
<3.10> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। tau dampatī bahirgatvā putramaṅgalahetave।। vividhāni ca ratnāni dvijebhyo dadaturmudā ।। 1 ।। bandibhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca dānāni vividhāni ca ।। nānāvidhāni vādyāni vādayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ ।। 2 ।। himālayaśca ratnānāṃ dadau lakṣaṃ dvijātaye ।। sahasraṃ ca gajendrāṇāmaśvānāṃ ca trilakṣakam ।। 3 ।। daśalakṣaṃ gavāṃ caiva pañcalakṣaṃ suvarṇakam ।। muktāmāṇikyaratnāni maṇiśreṣṭhāni yāni ca ।। 4 ।। anyānyapi ca dānāni vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।। sarvāṇyamūlyaratnāni kṣīrodotpattikāni ca ।। 5 ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dadau viṣṇuḥ kaustubhaṃ kautukānvitaḥ ।। brahmā viśiṣṭadānāni viprāṇāṃ vāñchitāni ca ।। sudurlabhāni sṛṣṭau ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 6 ।। dharmaḥ sūryyaśca śakraśca devāśca munayastathā ।। gandharvāḥ parvatā devyo dadurdānaṃ krameṇa ca ।। 7 ।। māṇikyānāṃ sahasrāṇi ratnānāṃ ca śatāni ca ।। śatāni kaustubhānāṃ ca hīrakāṇāṃ śatāni ca ।। 8 ।। haridvarṇamaṇīndrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi mudā'nvitāḥ ।। gavāṃ ratnāni lakṣāṇi gajaratnasahasrakam ।। amūlyānyanyaratnāni śvetavarṇāni kautukāt।। 10।। śatalakṣaṃ suvarṇānāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukāni ca ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dadau brahmā tatra kṣīrodadhirmudā ।। 11 ।। hāraṃ cāmūlyaratnānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। atīva nirmalaṃ sāraṃ sūryyabhānuvinindakam ।।12।। pariṣkṛtaṃ ca māṇikyairhīrakaiśca virājitam ।। ramyaṃ kaustubhamadhyasthaṃ dadau devī sarasvatī।। ।। 13 ।। trailokyasāraṃ hāraṃ ca sadratnagaṇanirmitam ।। bhūṣaṇāni ca sarvāṇi sā sāvitrī dadau mudā ।। 14 ।। lakṣaṃ suvarṇaloṣṭānāṃ dhanāni vividhāni ca ।। śatānyamūlyaratnānāṃ kuberaśca dadau mudā ।। 15 ।। dānāni dattvā viprebhyaste sarve dadṛśuḥ śiśum ।। paramānandasaṃyuktāḥ śivaputrotsave mune ।। 16 ।। bhāraṃ voḍhumaśaktāśca brāhmaṇā bandinastathā ।। sthāyaṃsthāyaṃ ca gacchanto dhanāni pathi kātarāḥ ।। 17 ।। kathayanti kathāḥ sarve viśrāntāḥ pūrvadāyinām ।। buddhāḥ śṛṇvanti muditā yuvāno bhikṣukā mune ।। 18 ।। viṣṇuḥ pramuditastatra vādayāmāsa dundubhim ।। saṃgītaṃ pāyayāmāsa kārayāmāsa nartanam ।। vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa purāṇāni ca nārada ।। 19 ।। munīndrānānayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa tānmudā ।। āśiṣaṃ dāpayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam।। sārddhaṃ devaścai devībhirdadau tasmai śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। ।। 20 ।। viṣṇuruvāca ।। śivena tulyaṃ jñānaṃ te paramāyuśca bālaka ।। parākrame mayā tulyaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhava ।। 21 ।। brahmovāca ।। yaśasā te jagatpūrṇaṃ sarvapūjyo bhavāciram ।। sarveṣāṃ purataḥ pūjā bhavatvatisudurlabhā ।। 22 ।। dharmma uvāca ।। mayā tulyaḥ sudharmiṣṭho bhavānbhavatu durlabhaḥ ।। sarvajñaśca dayāyukto haribhakto hareḥ samaḥ।।23।। mahādeva uvāca ।। dātā bhava mayā tulyo haribhaktaśca buddhimān।। vidyāvānpuṇyavāñchānto dāntaśca prāṇavallabha ।। 24 ।। lakṣmīruvāca ।। mama sthitiśca gehe te dehe bhavatu śāśvatī ।। pativratā mayā tulyā śāntā kāntā manoharā ।। 25 ।। sarasvatyuvāca ।। mayā tulyā sukavitā dhāraṇāśaktireva ca ।। smṛtirvivecanāśaktirbhavatvatitarāṃ suta ।। 26 ।। sāvitryuvāca ।। vatsāhaṃ vedajananī vedajñānī bhavāciram ।। manmantrajapaśīlaśca pravaro vedavādinām ।। ।। 27 ।। himālaya uvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇe'timatiḥ śaśvadbhaktirbhavatu śāśvatī ।। śrīkṛṣṇatulyo guṇavānbhava kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 28 ।। menakovāca ।। samudratulyo gāmbhīryye kāmatulyaśca rūpavān ।। śrīyuktaḥ śrīpatisamo dharmme dharmasamo bhava ।। 29 ।। vasundharovāca ।। kṣamāśīlo mayā tulyaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvaratnavān ।। nirvighno vighnanighnaśca bhava vatsa śubhāśrayaḥ ।। 30 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। tātatulyamahāyogī siddhaḥ siddhipradaḥ śubhaḥ ।। mṛtyuñjayaśca bhagavānbhavatvativiśāradaḥ।।31।। ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve yuyujurāśiṣaḥ।। brāhmaṇā bandinaścaiva yuyujuḥ sarvamaṅgalam ।।32।। sarvaṃ te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। gaṇeśajanmakathanaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam ।।33।। imaṃ sumaṃgalādhyakṣaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti sukhaṃ yataḥ ।। sarvamaṃgalasaṃyuktaḥ sa bhavenmaṃgalālayaḥ ।। 34 ।। aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam।। kṛpaṇo labhate sattvaṃ śaśvatsampatpradāyi ca ।। 35 ।। bhāryyārthī labhate bhāryyāṃ prajārthī labhate prajām ।। ārogyaṃ labhate rogī saubhāgye durbhagā labhet ।। 36 ।। bhraṣṭaputraṃ naṣṭadhanaṃ proṣitaṃ ca priyaṃ labhet ।। śokāviṣṭaḥ sadā''nandaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 37 ।। yatpuṇyaṃ labhate martyo gaṇeśākhyānakaśrutau ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnamadhyāyaśravaṇānmune ।। 38 ।। ayaṃ ca maṅgalādhyāyo yasya gehaṃ ca tiṣṭhati ।। sadā maṅgalasaṃyuktaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 39 ।। yātrākāle ca puṇyāhe yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। sarvābhīṣṭaṃ sa labhate śrīgaṇeśaprasādataḥ ।। 40 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇeśakhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇeśodbhavamaṃgalaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 10 ।।
<3.11> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। haristamāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। devaiśca munibhiḥ sārddhamavasattatra saṃsadi ।। 1 ।। dakṣiṇe śaṃkarastasya vāme brahmā prajāpatiḥ ।। purato jagatāṃ sākṣī dharmo dharmavatāṃ varaḥ ।। 2 ।। tathā dharmasamīpe ca sūryyaḥ śakraḥ kalānidhiḥ ।। devāśca munayo brahmannūṣuḥ śailāḥ sukhāsane ।। 3 ।। nanartta narttakaśreṇī jagurgandharva kinnarāḥ ।। śrutisāraṃ śrutisukhaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ śrutayo harim ।। 4 ।। etasminnantare tatra draṣṭuṃ śaṅkaranandanam ।। ājagāma mahāyogī sūryaputraḥ śanaiścaraḥ ।। 5 ।। atyantanamravadana īṣanmudritalocanaḥ ।। antarbahiḥ smarankṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaikagatamānasaḥ ।। 6 ।। tapaḥphalāśī tejasvī jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ।। atīva sundaraḥ śyāmaḥ pītāmbaradharo varaḥ ।। 7 ।। praṇamya viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ śivaṃ dharmaṃ raviṃ surān ।। munīndrānbālakaṃ draṣṭuṃ jagāma tadanujñayā ।।8।। pradhānadvāramāsādya śivatulyaparākramam ।। dvāḥsthaṃ vai śūlahastaṃ ca viśālākṣamuvāca ha ।। 9 ।। śanaiścara uvāca ।। śivājñayā śiśuṃ draṣṭuṃ yāmi śaṃkarakiṃkara ।। viṣṇupramukhadevānāṃ munīnāmanurodhataḥ ।। 10 ।। ājñāṃ dehi ca māṃ gantuṃ pārvatīsannidhiṃ budha ।। punaryāmi śiśuṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣayāsaktamānasaḥ ।। 11 ।। viśālākṣa uvāca ।। ājñāvaho na devānāṃ nāhaṃ śaṃkarakiṃkaraḥ ।। mārgaṃ dātuṃ na śakto'haṃ vinā manmāturājñayā ।। 12 ।। ityuktvā'bhyantarabhyetya preritaḥ sa śivājñayā ।। dadau mārgaṃ graheśāya viśālākṣo mudā tataḥ ।। 13 ।। śanirabhyantaraṃ gatvā cānamannamrakandharaḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃ ca pārvatīṃ sasmitāṃ mudā ।। 14 ।। sakhībhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। sakhīdattaṃ ca tāmbūlamupabhujya suvāsitam ।।15।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। paśyantīṃ narttakīnṛtyaṃ putraṃ dhṛtvā ca vakṣasi ।। 16 ।। nataṃ sūryyasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā durgā saṃbhāṣya satvaram ।। śubhāśiṣaṃ dadau tasmai pṛṣṭvā tanmaṃgalaṃ śubham ।। 37 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। kathamānamravaktrastvaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmpratam ।। kiṃ na paśyasi māṃ sādho bālakaṃ vā graheśvara ।। 18 ।। śaniruvāca।। sarve svakarmaṇā sādhvi bhuñjate tapasaḥ phalam।। śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma koṭikalpairna lupyate ।। 19 ।। karmaṇā jāyate janturbrahmendrāryyamamandire ।। karmaṇā narageheṣu paśvādiṣu ca karmaṇā ।। 20 ।। karmaṇā narakaṃ yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti karmaṇā ।। svakarmaṇā ca rājendro bhṛtyaścāpi svakarmaṇā ।। 21 ।। karmaṇā sundaraḥ śaśvadvyādhiyuktaḥ svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā viṣayī mātarnnirliptaśca svakarmaṇā ।। 22 ।। karmaṇā dhanavām̐lloko dainyayuktaḥ svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā satkuṭumbī ca karmaṇā bandhukaṇṭakaḥ ।। 23 ।। subhāryaśca suputraśca sukhī śaśvatsvakarmaṇā ।। aputrakaśca kustrīko nistrīkaśca svakarmaṇā ।। 24 ।। itihāsaṃ cātigopyaṃ śṛṇu śaṅkaravallabhe ।। akathyaṃ jananīpārśve lajjājanakakāraṇam ।। 25 ।। ābālyātkṛṣṇabhakto'haṃ kṛṣṇadhyānaikamānasaḥ ।। tapasyāsu rataśśaśvadviṣaye'pi rataḥ sadā ।। 26 ।। pitā dadau vivāhe tu kanyāṃ citrarathasya ca ।। atitejasvinī śaśvattapasyāsu ratā satī ।। 27 ।। ekadā sā tvṛtusnātā suveṣaṃ svaṃ vidhāya ca ।। ratnālaṅkārasaṃyuktā munimānasamohinī ।। 28 ।। hareḥ pādaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ paśyantī madamohitā ।। matsamīpaṃ samāgatya sasmitā lolalocanā ।।29।। śaśāpa māmapaśyantamṛtunāśācca kopataḥ ।। bāhyajñānavihīnaṃ ca dhyānasaṃlagnamānasam ।। 30 ।। na dṛṣṭā'haṃ tvayā yena na kṛtaṃ hyṛturakṣaṇam tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca yadvastu mūḍha sarvaṃ vinaśyati ।। 31 ।। ahaṃ ca virato dhyānāttoṣayaṃstāṃ tadā satīm ।। śāpaṃ moktuṃ na śaktā sā paścāttāpamavāpa ha ।। 32 ।। tena mātarna paśyāmi kiñcidvastu svacakṣuṣā ।। tataḥ prakṛtinamrāsyaḥ prāṇihiṃsābhayādaham ।। 33 ।। śanaiścaravacaḥ śrutvā cāhasatpārvatī mune ।। uccaiḥ prajahasuḥ sarvā narttakīkinnarīgaṇāḥ ।। 34 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde śanipārvatīsaṃvāde śaneradhodṛṣṭau kāraṇakathanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 11 ।।
<3.12> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। durgā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sasmāra harimīśvaram ।। īśvarecchāvaśībhūtaṃ jagadevetyuvāca ha।।1।। sā ca devī daivavaśā śaniṃ provāca kautukāt।। paśya māṃ macchiśumiti niṣekaḥ kena vāryyate।।2।। pārvatyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śanirmene hṛdā svayam ।। paśyāmi kiṃ na paśyāmi pārvatīsutamityaho ।। yadi bālo mayā dṛṣṭastasya vighno bhaveddhruvam।।3।। anyathā supraśastaṃ ca purataḥ svātmarakṣaṇam ।। ityevamuktvā dharmiṣṭho dharmaṃ kṛtvā tu sākṣiṇam।। bālaṃ draṣṭuṃ manaścakre na tu tanmātaraṃ śaniḥ।।4।। viṣaṇṇamānasaḥ pūrvaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ।। savyalocanakoṇena dadarśa ca śiśormukham ।।5।। śaneśca dṛṣṭimātreṇa cicchide mastakaṃ mune ।। cakṣurnimīlayāmāsa tasthau namrānanaḥ śaniḥ।।6।। tasthau ca pārvatīkroḍe tatsarvāṅgaṃ salohitam।। viveśa mastakaṃ kṛṣṇe gatvā golokamīpsitam।।7।। mūrcchā saṃprāpa sā devī vilapya ca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ।। matteva ca pṛthivyāṃ tu kṛtvā vakṣasi bālakam ।। 8 ।। vismitāste surāḥ sarve citraputtalikā yathā ।। devyaśca śailā gandharvāḥ sarve kailāsavāsinaḥ ।। 9 ।। tānsarvānmūrcchitāndṛṣṭvaivāruhya garuḍaṃ hariḥ ।। jagāma puṣpabhadrāṃ sa cottarasyāṃ diśi sthitām ।। 10 ।। puṣpabhadrānadītīre hyapaśyatkānane sthitam ।। gajendraṃ nidritaṃ tatra śayānaṃ hastinīyutam ।। 11 ।। tathodakchirasaṃ ramyaṃ mūrcchitaṃ surataśramāt ।। paritaḥ śāvakātkṛtvā paramānandamānasam ।। 12 ।। śīghraṃ sudarśanenaiva cicchide tacchiro mudā ।। sthāpayāmāsa garuḍe rudhirāktaṃ manoharam ।। 13 ।। gajacchinnāṅgavikṣepātprabodhaṃ prāpya hastinī ।। śāvakānbodhayāmāsa cāśubhaṃ vadatī tadā ।। ruroda śāvakaiḥ sārddhaṃ sā vilapya śucāturā ।। 14 ।। tuṣṭāva kamalākāntaṃ śāntaṃ sasmitamīśvaram ।। śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ param ।। garuḍasthaṃ jagatkāntaṃ bhrāmayantaṃ sudarśanam ।। 15 ।। niṣekaṃ khaṇḍituṃ śaktaṃ niṣekajanakaṃ vibhum ।। niṣekabhogadātāraṃ bhoganistārakāraṇam ।। 16 ।। prabhustatstavanāttuṣṭastasyai vipra varaṃ dadau ।। muṇḍātuṇḍaṃ pṛthakkṛtya yuyuje'nyagajasya ca ।। 17 ।। jīvayāmāsa taṃ tatra brahmajñānena sarvavit ।। sarvāṃge yojayāmāsa gajasya caraṇāmbujam ।। 18 ।। tvaṃ jīvākalpaparyyantaṃ parivāraiḥ samaṃ gaja ।। ityuktvā ca manoyāyī kailāsaṃ hyājagāma saḥ ।। 19 ।। āhṛtya pārvatīhastādbālaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। ruciraṃ tacchirassamyagyojayāmāsa bālake ।। 20 ।। brahmasvarūpo bhagavānbrahmajñānena līlayā ।। jīvayāmāsa taṃ śīghraṃ huṃkāroccāraṇena ca ।। 21 ।। pārvatīṃ bodhayitvā tu kṛtvā kroḍe ca taṃ śiśum ।। bodhayāmāsa tāṃ kṛṣṇa ādhyātmikavibodhanaiḥ ।। 22 ।। viṣṇuruvāca ।। brahmādikīṭaparyyantaṃ phalaṃ bhuṅkte svakarmaṇaḥ ।। jagadbuddhisvarūpā'si tvaṃ na jānāsi kiṃ śiva ।। 23 ।। kalpakoṭiśataṃ bhogī jīvināṃ tatsvakarmaṇā ।। upasthito bhavennityaṃ pratiyonau śubhāśubhaiḥ ।। 24 ।। indraḥ svakarmaṇā kīṭayonau janma labhetsati ।। kīṭaścāpi bhavedindraḥ pūrvakarmaphalena vai।।25।। siṃho'pi makṣikāṃ hantumakṣamaḥ prāktanaṃ vinā ।। maśako hastinaṃ hantuṃ kṣamaḥ svaprāktanena ca ।।26।। sukhaṃ duḥkha bhayaṃ śokamānandaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam ।। sukarmaṇaḥ sukhaṃ harṣamitare pāpakarmaṇaḥ ।। 27 ।। ihaiva karmaṇo bhogaḥ paratra ca śubhāśubhaiḥ ।। karmopārjanayogyaṃ ca puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam ।। 28 ।। karmaṇaḥ phaladātā ca vidhātā ca vidherapi ।। mṛtyormṛtyuḥ kālakālo niṣekasya niṣekakṛt ।। 29 ।। saṃharturapi saṃharttā pātuḥ pātā parātparaḥ ।। golokanāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ।। 30।। vayaṃ yasya kalāḥ puṃso brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। mahāvirāḍyadaṃśaśca yallomavivare jagat ।। 31 ।। kalāṃśāḥ ke'pi taddharme kalāśāṃśāśca kecana ।। carācaraṃ jagatsarvaṃ tatra tasthau vināyakaḥ ।। 32 ।। śrīviṣṇorvacanaṃ śrutvā parituṣṭā ca pārvatī ।। stanaṃ dadau ca śiśave taṃ praṇamya gadādharam ।। 33 ।। tuṣṭāva pārvatī tuṣṭā preritā śaṃkareṇa ca ।। kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhaktyā viṣṇuṃ taṃ kamalāpatim ।।34।। āśiṣaṃ yuyuje viṣṇuḥ śiśuṃ ca śiśumātaram ।। dadau gale bālakasya kaustubhaṃ ca svabhūṣaṇam ।।35।। brahmā dadau svamukuṭaṃ dharmo vai ratnabhūṣaṇam।। krameṇa devyo ratnāni daduḥ sarve yathocitam।।36।। tuṣṭāva taṃ mahādevaścātyantaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। devāśca munayaḥ śailā gandharvāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ।।37।। dṛṣṭvā śivāḥ śivā caiva bālakaṃ mṛtajīvitam ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tatra koṭiratnāni nārada ।।36।। aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ।। bandibhyaḥ pradadau tatra bālake mṛtajīvite ।।39।। himālayaśca saṃtuṣṭo hṛṣṭā devāśca tatra vai ।। dadurdānāni viprebhyo bandibhyaḥ sarvayoṣita।। 40।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam ।। vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa purāṇāni ramāpatiḥ ।। 41 ।। śaniṃ saṃlajjitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārvatī kopaśālinī ।। śaśāpa ca sabhāmadhye'pyaṅgahīno bhaveti ca ।। 42 ।। dṛṣṭvā śaptaṃ śaniṃ sūryyaḥ kaśyapaśca yamastathā ।। te'tiruṣṭāḥ samuttasthurgāmukāḥ śaṅkarālayāt ।। 43 ।। raktākṣāste raktamukhāḥ kopaprasphuritādharāḥ ।। tāṃ dharmasākṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇuṃ saṃśaptumudyatāḥ ।। 44 ।। brahmā tānbodhayāmāsa viṣṇunā preritaḥ suraiḥ ।। raktāsyāṃ pārvatīṃ caiva kopaprasphuritādharām ।। 45 ।। brahmāṇamūcuste tatra krameṇa samayocitam ।। bhīravo devatāḥ sarve munayaḥ parvatāstathā ।। 46।। kaśyapa uvāca ।। durdṛṣṭo'yaṃ prāktanena patnīśāpena sarvadā ।। bālaṃ dadarśa yatnena tasya vai māturājñayā ।। 47 ।। śrīsūryya uvāca ।। taṃ dharmaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sūnorvai māturājñayā ।। yatputro'tiprayatnena hyapaśyatpārvatīsutam ।। 48 ।। yathā niraparādhena matputraṃ sā śaśāpa ha ।। tatputrasyāṃgabhaṃgaśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 49 ।। yama uvāca ।। pradāya svayamājñāṃ ca śaśāpeyaṃ svayaṃ katham ।। vayaṃ śapāmaḥ ko'dharmo jighāṃsośca vihiṃsane ।। 50 ।। brahmovāca ।। śaśāpa pārvatī ruṣṭā strīsvabhāvācca cāpalāt ।। sarveṣāṃ vacanenaiva kṣantumarhantu sādhavaḥ ।। 51 ।। durge dattvā tvamājñāṃ ca putradarśanahetave ।। kathaṃ śapasi nirdoṣamatithiṃ tvadgṛhāgatam ।। 52 ।। ityuktvā śanimādāya bodhayitvā ca pārvatīm ।। tāṃ taṃ samarpaṇaṃ cakre śāpa mocanahetave ।। 53 ।। babhūva pārvatī tuṣṭā brahmaṇo vacanānmune।। śāntā babhūbuste tatra dineśayamakaśyapāḥ।।54।। uvāca pārvatī tatra santuṣṭā taṃ śanaiścaram ।। prasāditā śivenaiva brahmaṇā parisevitā ।। 55 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। graharājo bhava śane madvareṇa haripriyaḥ ।। cirajīvī ca yogīndro haribhaktasya kā vipat ।। 56 ।। adyaprabhṛti nirvighnā harau bhaktirdṛḍhā'stu te ।। śāpo'moghastato me'dya kiñcitkhañjo bhaviṣyasi ।। 57 ।। ityuktvā pārvatī tuṣṭā bālaṃ dhṛtvā ca vakṣasi ।। uvāsa yoṣitāṃ madhye tasmai dattvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 58 ।। śanirjagāma devānāṃ samīpaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। praṇamya bhaktyā tāṃ brahmannambikāṃ jagadambikām ।। 59 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde śanikṛtagaṇeśadarśana tajjātagaṇeśaśiraḥpatana viṣṇukṛtagaṇeśaśiroyojana śaniśāpādikathanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 12 ।।
<3.13> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। atha viṣṇuḥ śubhe kāle devaiśca munibhiḥ saha ।। pūjayāmāsa taṃ bālamupahārairanuttamaiḥ ।। 1 ।। sarvāgre tava pūjā ca mayā dattā surottama ।। sarvapūjyaśca yogīndro bhava vatsetyuvāca tam ।। 2 ।। vanamālāṃ dadau tasmai brahmajñānaṃ ca muktidam ।। sarvasiddhiṃ pradāyaiva cakārātmasamaṃ hariḥ ।। 3 ।। dadau dravyāṇi cārūṇi copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। nāmabhiḥ stavanaṃ cakre munibhiśca samaṃ suraiḥ ।। 4 ।। vighneśaśca gaṇeśaśca herambaśca gajānanaḥ ।। lambodaraścaikadantaḥ śūrpakarṇo vināyakaḥ ।। 5 ।। etānyaṣṭau ca nāmāni sarvasiddhipradāni ca ।। āśiṣaṃ dāpayāmāsa cānayāmāsa tānmunīn ।। 6 ।। siddhāsanaṃ dadau dharmastasmai brahmā kamaṇḍalum ।। śaṅkaro yogapaṭṭaṃ ca tattvajñānaṃ sudurlabham ।। 7 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ śakraḥ sūryyaśca maṇikuṇḍale ।। māṇikyamālāṃ candraśca kuberaśca kirīṭakam ।। 8 ।। vahniśuddhaṃ ca vasanaṃ dadau tasmai hutāśanaḥ ।। ratnacchatraṃ ca varuṇo vāyū ratnāṃgulīyakam ।। 9 ।। kṣīrododbhavasadratnaracitaṃ valayaṃ varam ।। mañjīraṃ cāpi keyūraṃ dadau padmālayā mune ।। 10 ।। kaṇṭhabhūṣāṃ ca sāvitrī bhāratī hāramujjvalam ।। krameṇa sarvadevāśca devyaśca yautakaṃ daduḥ ।। 11 ।। munayaḥ parvatāścaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca ।। vasundharā dadau tasmai vāhanāya ca mūṣakam।।12।। krameṇa devā devyaśca munayaḥ parvatādayaḥ।। gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā manavo mānavāstathā ।।13।। nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi svādūni madhurāṇi ca ।। pūjāṃ cakruśca te sarve kramādvai bhaktipūrvakam ।। 14 ।। pārvatī jagatāṃ mātā smerānanasaroruhā ।। ratnasiṃhāsane putraṃ vāsayāmāsa nārada ।। 19 ।। sarvatīrthodakai ratnakalaśāvarjitaiḥ stutaiḥ ।। snāpayāmāsa vedoktamantreṇa munibhistadā ।। agniśuddhe ca vasane dadau tasmai satī mudā ।। 16 ।। godāvaryudakaiḥ pādyamarghyaṃ gaṃgodakena ca ।। dūrvābhirakṣatāpuṣpaiścandanena samanvitam ।। 17 ।। puṣkarodakamānīya punarācamanīyakam ।। madhuparkaṃ ratnapātrairāsavaṃ śarkarānvitam ।। 18 ।। snānīyaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ ca svarvaidyābhyāṃ vinirmitam ।। amūlyaratnaracitaṃ cārubhūṣākadambakam ।। 19 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāmanyeṣāṃ śatakāni ca ।। mālatīcampakādīnāṃ puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca ।। pūjārhāṇi ca patrāṇi tulasīsahitāni ca ।। 20 ।। candanāgurukastūrī kuṃkumāni ca sādaram ।। ratnapradīpanikaraṃ dhūpaṃ ca parito dadau ।। 21 ।। naivedyaṃ tatpriyaṃ caiva tilalaḍḍukaparvatān ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ ca parvatān ।। 22 ।। pakvānnānāṃ parvatāśca susvādusumanoharān ।। parvatānsvastikānāṃ ca susvāduśarkarānvitān ।। 23 ।। guḍāktānāṃ ca lājānāṃ pṛthukānāṃ ca parvatān ।। śālyannānāṃ piṣṭakānāṃ parvatānvyañjanaiḥ saha ।। payobhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca lakṣāṇi pradadau mudā ।। 24 ।। lakṣāṇi dadhipūrṇānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca pūjane ।। madhubhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca trilakṣāṇi ca sundarī ।। 25 ।। sarpissuvarṇakumbhānāṃ paṃcalakṣāṇi sādaram ।। dāḍimānāṃ śrīphalānāmasaṃkhyāni phalāni ca ।। 26 ।। kharjūrāṇāṃ kapitthānāṃ jambūnāṃ vividhāni ca ।।। āmrāṇāṃ panasānāṃ ca kadalīnāṃ ca nārada ।। phalāni nārikelānāmasaṃkhyāni dadau mudā ।। 27।। anyāni paripakvāni kāladeśodbhavāni ca ।। dadau tāni mahābhāga svādūni madhurāṇi ca ।। 28 ।। svacchaṃ sunirmalaṃ caiva karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। gaṅgājalaṃ ca pānārthaṃ punarācamanīyakam ।। 29 ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। suvarṇapātraśatakaṃ bhakṣyapūrṇaṃ ca nārada ।। 30 ।। śailarājapriyā mātyāḥ pupūjuḥ śailajātmajam ।।31।। oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ gaṇeśvarāya brahmarūpāya cārave ।। sarvasiddhipradeśāya viśveśāya namo namaḥ ।।32।। ityanenaiva mantreṇa dattvā dravyāṇi bhaktitaḥ।। sarve pramuditāstatra brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ।।33।। dvātriṃśadakṣaro mālāmantro'yaṃ sarvakāmada।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phaladaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ ।।34।। pañcalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhistu mantriṇaḥ।। mantrasiddhirbhavedyasya sa ca viṣṇuśca bhārate।।35।। vighnāni ca palāyante tannāmasmaraṇena ca ।। mahāvāggmī mahāsiddhiḥ sarvasiddhisamanvitaḥ ।। 36 ।। vākpatirgurutāṃ yāti tasya sākṣātsuniścitam ।। mahākavīndro guṇavānviduṣāṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।। 37 ।। saṃpūjyānena mantreṇa devā ānandasaṃplutāḥ ।। nānāvidhāni vādyāni vādayāmāsurutsave ।।38।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsuḥ kārayāmāsurutsavam ।। dadurdānāni tebhyaśca bandibhyaśca viśeṣataḥ ।।39।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। atha viṣṇuḥ sabhāmadhye taṃ sampūjya gaṇeśvaram ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā sarvavighnavināśakam ।। 40 ।। īśa tvāṃ stotumicchāmi brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ।। naiva varṇayituṃ śakto'styanurūpamanīhakam ।। 41 ।। pravaraṃ sarvadevānāṃ siddhānāṃ yogināṃ gurum ।। sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveśaṃ jñānarāśisvarūpiṇam ।। 42 ।। avyaktamakṣaraṃ nityaṃ satyamātmasvarūpiṇam ।। vāyutulyaṃ ca nirliptaṃ cākṣataṃ sarvasākṣiṇam ।। 43 ।। saṃsārārṇavapāre ca māyāpote sudurlabhe ।। karṇadhārasvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 44 ।। varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varadānāmapīśvaram ।। siddhaṃ siddhisvarūpaṃ ca siddhidaṃ siddhisādhanama ।। 49 ।। dhyānātiriktaṃ dhyeyaṃ ca dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca dhārmikam ।। dharmasvarūpaṃ dharmajñaṃ dharmādharmaphalapradam ।।46।। bījaṃ saṃsāravṛkṣāṇāmaṃkuraṃ ca tadāśrayam ।। strīpuṃnapuṃsakānāṃ ca rūpametadatīndriyam ।। 47 ।। sarvādyamagrapūjyaṃ ca sarvapūjyaṃ guṇārṇavam ।। svecchayā saguṇaṃ brahma nirguṇaṃ svecchayā punaḥ ।।48।। svayaṃ prakṛtirūpaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। tvāṃ stotumakṣamo'nantaḥ sahasravadanairapi ।। 49 ।। na kṣamaḥ pañcavaktraśca na kṣamaścaturānanaḥ ।। sarasvatī na śaktā ca na śakto'haṃ tava stutau ।। na śaktāśca caturvedāḥ ke vā te vedavādinaḥ ।। 50।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā munīśasurasaṃsadi ।। sureśaśca suraiḥ sārddhaṃ virarāma ramāpatiḥ ।।51।। idaṃ viṣṇukṛtaṃ stotraṃ gaṇeśasya ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। sāyaṃ prātaśca madhyāhne bhaktiyuktaḥ samāhitaḥ ।। 52 ।। tadvighnanāśaṃ kurute vighneśaḥ satataṃ mune ।। varddhate sarvakalyāṇaṃ kalyāṇajanakaḥ sadā ।। 53 ।। yātrākāle paṭhitvā yo yāti tadbhaktipūrvakam ।। tasya sarvābhīṣṭasiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 54 ।। tena dṛṣṭaṃ ca dussvapnaṃ susvapnamupajāyate ।। kadā'pi na bhavettasya grahapīḍā ca dāruṇā ।। 55 ।। bhavedvināśaḥ śatrūṇāṃ bandhūnāṃ cāpi varddhanam ।। śaśvadvighnavināśaśca śaśvatsamyagvivarddhanam ।। 56 ।। sthirā bhavedgṛhe lakṣmīḥ putrapautravivarddhanam ।। sarvaiśvaryyamiha prāpya hyante viṣṇupadaṃ labhet ।। 57 ।। phalaṃ cāpi ca tīrthānāṃ yajñānāṃ yadbhaveddhruvam ।। mahatāṃ sarvadānānāṃ tadgaṇeśaprasādata ।।58।। nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ stotraṃ gaṇeśasya pūjanaṃ ca manoharam ।। kavacaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāmprataṃ bhavatāraṇam ।।59।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। pūjāyāṃ sunivṛttāyāṃ sabhāmadhye śanaiścaraḥ ।। uvāca viṣṇuṃ sarveṣāṃ tārakaṃ jagatāṃ gurum ।। 60 ।। śanaiścara uvāca ।। sarvaduḥkhavināśāya pāpapraśamanāya ca ।। kavacaṃ vighnanighnasya vada vedavidāṃvara ।। 61 ।। babhūva no vivādaśca śaktyā vai māyayā saha ।। tadvighnapraśamārthaṃ ca kavacaṃ dhārayāmyaham ।। 62 ।। śrīviṣṇuruvāca ।। vināyakasya kavacaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। sugopyaṃ ca purāṇeṣu durlabhaṃ cāgameṣu ca ।। 63 ।। uktaṃ kauthumaśākhāyāṃ sāmavede manoharam ।। kavacaṃ vighnanāthasya sarvavighnaharaṃ param ।। 64 ।। rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ prāṇā deyāśca sūryyaja ।। evambhūtaṃ ca kavacaṃ na deyaṃ prāṇasaṅkaṭe ।। 65 ।। āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ svecchayā yasya māyayā ।। nityo'yamekadantaśca kavacaṃ cāsya vatsaka ।।66।। pūjā'sya nityā stotraṃ ca kalpe kalpe'sti santatam।। asya vai janmanaḥ pūrvaṃ munayaśca siṣevire।।67।। yathā madavatāreṣu janmavigrahadhāraṇam ।। tathā gaṇeśvarasyāpi janma śailasutodare ।। 68 ।। yaddhṛtvā munayaḥ sarve jīvanmuktāśca bhārate ।। niśśaṅkāśca surāḥ sarve śatrupakṣavimardakāḥ ।। 69 ।। kavacaṃ bibhratāṃ mṛtyurna bhiyā yāti sannidhim ।। nāyurvyayo nāśubhaṃ ca brahmāṇḍe na parājayaḥ ।। 70 ।। daśa lakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ tu kavacaṃ bhavet ।। yo bhavetsiddhakavaco mṛtyuṃ jetuṃ sa ca kṣamaḥ ।। 71 ।। susiddhakavaco vāgmī ciraṃjīvī mahītale ।। sarvatra vijayī pūjyo bhavedgrahaṇamātrataḥ ।। 72 ।। mālāmantramimaṃ puṇyaṃ kavacaṃ maṅgalaṃ śubham ।। bibhratāṃ sarvapāpāni praṇaśyanti suniścitam ।। 73 ।। bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍā brahmarākṣasāḥ ।। ḍākinīyoginīyakṣavetālā bhairavādayaḥ ।। 74 ।। bālagrahā grahāścaiva kṣetrapālādayastathā ।। varmaṇaḥ śabdamātreṇa palāyante ca bhīravaḥ ।।75।। ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva śokāścaiva bhayāvahāḥ ।। na yānti sannidhiṃ teṣāṃ garuḍasya yathoragāḥ ।। 76 ।। ṛjave gurubhaktāya svaśiṣyāya prakāśayet ।। khalāya paraśiṣyāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।। 77 ।। saṃsāramohakasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ।। ṛṣiśchandaśca bṛhatī devo lambodaraḥ svayam।। dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। 78 ।। sarveṣāṃ kavacānāṃ ca sārabhūtamidaṃ mune ।। oṃ gaṃ huṃ śrīgaṇeśāya svāhā me pātu mastakam ।। dvātriṃśadakṣaro mantro lalāṭaṃ me sadā'vatu ।। 79 ।। oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ śrīṃ gamiti vai satataṃ pātu locanam ।। tāluke pātu vighneśaḥ satataṃ dharaṇītale ।। 80 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīmiti paraṃ santataṃ pātu nāsikām ।। oṃ gauṃ gaṃ śūrpakarṇāya svāhā pātvadharaṃ mama ।। dantāṃśca tālukāṃ jihvāṃ pātu me ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ ।। 81 ।। oṃ laṃ śrīṃ lambodarāyeti svāhā gaṇḍaṃ sadā 'vatu ।। oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ vighnanāśāya svāhā karṇaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 82 ।। oṃ śrīṃ gaṃ gajānanāyeti svāhā skandhaṃ sadā'vatu।। oṃ hrīṃ vināyakāyeti svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 83 ।। oṃ klīṃ hrīmiti kaṅkālaṃ pātu vakṣaḥsthalaṃ param ।। karau pādau sadā pātu sarvāṃgaṃ vighnanāśakṛt ।। 84 ।। prācyāṃ lambodaraḥ pātu cāgneyyāṃ vighnanāyakaḥ ।। dakṣiṇe pātu viśveśo nairṛtyāṃ tu gajānanaḥ ।। 85 ।। paścime pārvatīputro vāyavyāṃ śaṃkarātmajaḥ ।। kṛṣṇasyāṃśaścottare ca paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। 86 ।। aiśānyāmekadantaśca herambaḥ pātu cordhvataḥ ।। adho gaṇādhipaḥ pātu sarvapūjyaśca sarvataḥ ।। svapne jāgaraṇe caiva pātu māṃ yogināṃ guruḥ ।। 87 ।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ।। saṃsāramohanaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।।88।। śrīkṛṣṇena purā dattaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। vṛndāvane vinītāya mahyaṃ dinakarātmaja ।। 89 ।। mayā dattaṃ ca tubhyaṃ ca yasmai kasmai na dāsyasi ।। paraṃ varaṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarvasaṃkaṭatāraṇam ।। 90 ।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivatkavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ।। kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so'pi viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ ।। 91 ।। aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca ।। grahendra kavacasyāsya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 92 ।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā yo bhajecchaṃkarātmajam ।। śatalakṣaprajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ ।। 93 ।। iti saṃsāramohanaṃ nāma kavacam ।। dattvedaṃ sūryyaputrāya virarāma sureśvaraḥ ।। paramānandasaṃyuktā devāstasthuḥ samīpataḥ ।। 94 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇeśapūjāstavakavacakathanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।13।।
<3.14> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। devāstasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ ca sarve saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।। gandharvā munayaḥ śailāḥ paśyantaḥ sumahotsavam।। ।। 1 ।। etasminnantare durgā smerānanasaroruhā ।। uvāca viṣṇuṃ praṇatā deveśaṃ tatra saṃsadi ।।2।। pārvatyuvāca ।। tvaṃ pātā sarvajagatāṃ nātha nāhaṃ jagadbahiḥ ।। kathaṃ matsvāmino vīryyamamoghaṃ rakṣitaṃ prabho ।। 3 ।। ratibhaṅge kṛte devairbrahmaṇā preritaistvayā ।। bhūmau nipatitaṃ vīryaṃ kena devena vai hṛtam ।। 4 ।। sarve devāstvatpuratastadanviṣyantu sādaram ।। arājakaṃ kathamidaṃ tiṣṭhati tvayi rājani ।। 5 ।। pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya jagadīśvaraḥ ।। uvāca devavarge ca munivarge ca tiṣṭhati ।। 6 ।। śrīviṣṇuruvāca ।। devāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutam ।। śivasyāmoghavīryyaṃ yattatpurā kena nirhṛtam ।। 7 ।। sabhāmānayata kṣipraṃ na ceddaṇḍamihārhatha ।। sa ko rājā na śāstā yaḥ prajābādhyaśca pākṣikaḥ ।। 8 ।। viṣṇostadvacanaṃ śrutvā samālocya parasparam ।। ūcuḥ sarve śivāvākyaistrāsitāḥ purato hareḥ ।। 9 ।। brahmovāca ।। tadvīryaṃ nirhṛtaṃ yena puṇyabhūmau ca bhārate ।। sa vañcito bhavatvatra puṇyāhe puṇyakarmaṇi ।। 10 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। madvīryyaṃ nirhṛtaṃ yena puṇyabhūmau ca bhārate ।। sa vañcito bhavatvatra sevane pūjane tava ।। 11 ।। yama uvāca ।। sa vañcito bhavatvatra śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇe ।। ekādaśīvrate caiva tadvīryyaṃ yena nirhṛtam ।।12।। indra uvāca ।। tadvīryaṃ nirhṛtaṃ yena pāpināṃ pāpamocane ।। bhavatvatra yaśo luptaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ karma santatam ।। 13 ।। varuṇa uvāca ।। bhavatvatra kalau janma varṣe syādbhārate hare ।। śūdrayājakapatnyāśca garbhe tadyena nirhṛtam ।। 14 ।। kubera uvāca ।। nyāsahārī sa bhavatu viśvāsaghnaśca mitrahā ।। satyaghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca tadvīryaṃ yena nirhṛtam।।15।। īśāna uvāca ।। paradravyāpahārī ca sa bhavatvatra bhārate ।। naraghātī gurudrohī tadvīryaṃ yena nirhṛtam।।16।। rudrā ūcuḥ।। te mithyāvādinaḥ santu bhārate pāradārikāḥ ।। gurunindāratāḥ śaśvattadvīryyaṃ yaiśca nirhṛtam ।। 17 ।। kāmadeva uvāca ।। kṛtvā pratijñāṃ yo mūḍho na sampālayate bhramāt ।। bhājanaṃ tasya pāpasya sa bhavedyena taddhṛtam ।। 18 ।। svarvaidyāvūcatuḥ ।। mātuḥ piturguroścaiva strīputrāṇāṃ ca poṣaṇe ।। bhavetāṃ vañcitau tau ca yābhyāṃ vīryyaṃ ca taddhṛtam ।। 19 ।। sarve devā ūcuḥ ।। mithyāsākṣyapradātāro bhavantvatra ca bhārate ।। aputriṇo daridrāśca yaiśca vīryyaṃ hi taddhṛtam ।। 20 ।। devapatnya ūcuḥ ।। tā nindaṃtu svabharttāro gacchantu parapūruṣam ।। santu buddhivihīnāśca yābhirvīryyaṃ hi taddhṛtam ।। 21 ।। devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā devīnāṃ ca harissvayam ।। karmaṇāṃ sākṣiṇaṃ dharmaṃ sūryyaṃ candraṃ hutāśanam ।। 22 ।। pavanaṃ pṛthivīṃ toyaṃ sandhye rātriṃ divaṃ mune ।। uvāca jagatāṃ karttā pātā śāstā jagattraye ।। 23 ।। śrīviṣṇuruvāca ।। devairna nirhṛtaṃ vīryyaṃ tadetatkena nirhṛtam ।। tadamoghaṃ bhagavato maheśasya jagadguroḥ ।। 24 ।। yūyaṃ ca sākṣiṇo viśve satataṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। yuṣmābhirnirhṛta kiṃ vā kimbhūtaṃ vaktumarhatha ।। 25 ।। īśvarasya vacaḥ śrutvā sabhāyāṃ kampitāśca te ।। parasparaṃ samālocya krameṇocuḥ puro hareḥ ।। 26 ।। śrīdharma uvāca ।। rateruttiṣṭhato vīryyaṃ papāta vasudhātale ।। mayā jñātamamoghaṃ tacchaṅkarasya prakopataḥ ।। 27 ।। kṣitiruvāca ।। vīryyaṃ voḍhumaśaktā'haṃ tadvahnau nyakṣipaṃ purā ।। atīva durvahaṃ brahmannabalāṃ kṣantumarhasi ।। 28 ।। agniruvāca ।। vīryyaṃ voḍhumaśaktā'haṃ nyakṣipaṃ śarakānane ।। durbalasya jagannātha kiṃ yaśaḥ kiṃ ca pauruṣam ।। 29 ।। vāyuruvāca ।। śareṣu patitaṃ vīryyaṃ sadyo bālo babhūva ha ।। atīva sundaro viṣṇo svarṇarekhānadītaṭe ।। 30 ।। śrīsūryya uvāca ।। rudantaṃ bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā'gamamastācalaṃ prati ।। preritaḥ kālacakreṇa niśi saṃsthātumakṣamaḥ ।। 31 ।। candra uvāca ।। rudantaṃ bālakaṃ prāpya gṛhītvā kṛttikāgaṇaḥ ।। jagāma svālayaṃ viṣṇo gacchanbadarikāśramāt ।। ।। 32 ।। jalamuvāca ।। amuṃ rudantamānīya stanaṃ dattvā stanārthine ।। varddhayāmāsurīśasya taṃ tāḥ sūryyādhikaprabham ।। 33 ।। sandhye ūcatuḥ ।। adhunā kṛttikānāṃ ca ṣaṇṇāṃ tatpoṣyaputrakaḥ ।। tannāma cakrustāḥ premṇā kārttikeya iti svayam ।। 34 ।। rātriruvāca ।। na cakrurbālakaṃ tāśca locanānāmagocaram ।। prāṇebhyo'pi premapātraṃ yaḥ poṣṭā tasya putrakaḥ ।। 35 ।। dinamuvāca ।। yāni yāni ca vastūni trailokye durlabhāni ca ।। praśaṃsitāni svādūni bhojayāmāsureva tam ।। 36 ।। teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā santuṣṭo madhusūdanaḥ ।। te sarve harimityūcuḥ sabhāyāṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।। 37 ।। putrasya vārttāṃ samprāpya pārvatī hṛṣṭamānasā ।। koṭiratnāni viprebhyo dadau bahudhanāni ca ।। dadau sarvāṇi viprebhyo vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca।।38।। lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī menā sāvitrī sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। viṣṇuśca sarvadevāśca brāhmaṇebhyo dadurdhanam ।। 39 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇeśakhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde kārttikeyajanmakathanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 14 ।।
<3.15> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। putrasya vārttāṃ samprāpya pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ ।। prerito viṣṇunā devairmunibhiḥ parvatairmune ।। 1 ।। dūtānprasthāpayāmāsa mahābalaparākramān ।। vīrabhadraṃ viśālākṣaṃ śaṅkukarṇaṃ kabandhakam ।। 2 ।। nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ vajradantaṃ bhagandaram ।। godhāmukhaṃ dadhimukhaṃ jvaladagniśikhopamam ।। 3 ।। lakṣaṃ ca kṣetrapālānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca trilakṣakam ।। vetālānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ yakṣāṇāṃ pañcalakṣakam ।। 4 ।। kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ trilakṣaṃ brahmarākṣasān ।। ḍākinīnāṃ caturlakṣaṃ yoginīnāṃ trilakṣakam ।। 5 ।। rudrāṃśca bhairavāṃścaiva śivatulyaparākramān ।। anyāṃśca vikṛtākārānasaṃkhyānapi nārada ।। 6 ।। te sarve śivadūtāśca nānāśastrāstrapāṇayaḥ ।। kṛttikānāṃ ca bhavanaṃ veṣṭayāmāsurujjvalam ।।7।। dṛṣṭvā tānkṛttikāḥ sarvā bhayavihvalamānasāḥ।। kārttikeyaṃ ca jagṛhurjvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 8 ।। kṛttikā ūcuḥ ।। vatsa sainyānyasaṃkhyāni veṣṭayāmāsurāyalam ।। na jānīmo vayaṃ kasya karālāni ca bālaka ।। 9 ।। kārttikeya uvāca ।। bhayaṃ tyajata kalyāṇyo bhayaṃ kiṃ vo mayi sthite ।। durnivāryyaḥ karmapāko mātaraḥ kena vāryyate ।। 10।। etasminnantare tatra senānīrnandikeśvaraḥ ।। purataḥ kārttikeyasya tiṣṭhaṃstāsāmuvāca ha ।। 11 ।। nandikeśvara uvāca।। bhrātaḥ pravṛttiṃ śṛṇu me mātuścāpi śubhāvahām ।। preṣitasya surendrasya saṃhartuḥ śaṃkarasya ca ।। 12 ।। kailāse sarvadevāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। sabhāyāṃ te vasantaśca gaṇeśotsavamaṅgalam ।। 13 ।। śailendrakanyā taṃ viṣṇuṃ jagatāṃ paripālakam ।। saṃbodhya kathayāmāsa tavānveṣaṇakāraṇam ।। 14 ।। papraccha devānviṣṇustānkrameṇāvāptihetave ।। pratyuttaraṃ daduste tu pratyekaṃ ca yathocitam।। 15 ।। tvamatra kṛttikāsthāne kathayāmāsurīśvaram ।। sarve dharmādayo devā dharmādharmasya sākṣiṇaḥ ।। yā babhūva rahaḥkrīḍā pārvatīśivayoḥ purā ।। 16 ।। dṛṣṭasya ca suraiḥ śambhovīryyaṃ bhūmau papāta ha ।। bhūmistadakṣipadvahnau vahniśca śarakānane ।। tato labdhaḥ kṛttikābhiramūbhirgaccha sāmpratam ।।17।। tavābhiṣekaṃ viṣṇuśca kariṣyati suraiḥ saha ।। śastraṃ labdhvā'khilaṃ deva tārakaṃ saṃhaniṣyati।। putrastvaṃ viśvasaṃharttustvāṃ goptuṃ na kṣamā imāḥ ।।18।। nāgniṃ goptuṃ yathā śaktaḥ śuṣkavṛkṣaḥ svakoṭare ।। dīptimāṃstvaṃ ca viśveṣu tāsāṃ geheṣu śobhase ।। yathā patanmahākūpe dvijarājo na rājate ।। 19 ।। karoṣi jagadālokaṃ nācchanno'syāṅgatejasā ।। yathā sūryyaḥ karācchanno na bhavetpūruṣasya ca ।। 20 ।। viṣṇustvaṃ ca jagadvyāpī nāsāṃ vyāpyo'si śāmbhava ।। yathā na keṣāṃ vyāpyaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ vyāpakaṃ nabhaḥ ।। 21 ।। yogīndro nānuliptastvaṃ bhogī ca paripoṣaṇe ।। naiva lipto yathā''tmā ca karmma bhogeṣu jīvinām ।। 22 ।। viśvādhārastvamīśaśca nāmṛte sambhavetsthitiḥ ।। sāgarasya yathā nadyāṃ saritāmāśrayasya ca ।। 23 ।। nahi sarveśvarāvāsaḥ sambhavetkṛttikālaye ।। garuḍasya yathā vāsaḥ kṣudre ca caṭakodare ।। 24 ।। tvāṃ ca devā na jānanti bhaktānugraha vigraham ।। guṇānāṃ tejasāṃ rāśiṃ yathā jñānamayoginaḥ ।।25।। tvāmanirvacanīyaṃ ca kathaṃ jānanti kṛttikāḥ ।। yathā parāṃ harerbhaktimabhaktā mūḍhacetasaḥ ।। 26 ।। bhrātarye yaṃ na jānanti te taṃ kurvantyanādaram ।। nādriyante yathā bhekāstvekāvāsaṃ ca paṅkajam ।। 27 ।। kārttikeya uvāca।। bhrātaḥ sarvaṃ vijānāmi jñānaṃ traikālikaṃ ca yat।। jñānī tvaṃ kā praśaṃsā te yato mṛtyuñjayāśritaḥ।।28।। karmaṇā janma yeṣāṃ vā yāsu yāsu ca yoniṣu ।। tāsu te nirvṛtiṃ bhrātarnāpnuvanti ca santatam।।29।। ye yatra santi santo vā mūḍhā vā karmabhogataḥ।। te'pi taṃ bahumanyante mohitā viṣṇumāyayā।। 30।। sāmprataṃ jagatāṃ mātā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī।। sarvādyā viṣṇumāyā ca sarvadā viṣṇumaṅgalā ।। 31 ।। śailendrapatnī garbhe sā cālabhajjanma bhārate ।। dāruṇaṃ ca tapastaptvā samprāpacchaṅkaraṃ patim ।। 32 ।। brahmāditṛṇaparyyantaṃ sarvaṃ mithyaiva kṛtrimam ।। sarve kṛṣṇodbhavāḥ kāle vilīnāstatra kevalam ।। 33 ।। kalpe kalpe jaganmātā mātā me pratijanmani ।। yajjanmamāyayā baddho nityaḥ sṛṣṭividhāvaham ।। 34 ।। prakṛterudbhavāssatyaṃ jagatyāṃ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। kāścidaṃśāḥ kalāḥ kāścitkalāṃśāṃśena kāścana ।। 36 ।। kṛttikā jñānavatyaśca yoginyaḥ prakṛteḥ kalāḥ ।। stanaiśca saṃvarddhito'hamupahāreṇa santatam ।। ।। 36 ।। tāsāmahaṃ poṣyaputro madambāḥ poṣaṇādimāḥ ।। tasyāśca prakṛteḥ putro gatastvatsvāmivīryyataḥ ।। 37 ।। na garbhajo'haṃ śailendrakanyāyā nandikeśvara ।। sā ca me dharmato mātā tathemāḥ sarvasammatāḥ ।। 38 ।। stanadātrī garbhadhātrī bhakṣyadātrī gurupriyā ।। abhīṣṭadevapatnī ca pituḥ patnī ca kanyakāḥ।।39।। sagarbhakanyā bhaginī putrapatnī priyāprasūḥ ।। māturmātā piturmātā sodarasya priyā tathā ।। 40।। mātuḥ pituśca bhaginī mātulānī tathaiva ca ।। janānāṃ vedavihitā mātaraḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ ।।41।। imāśca sarvasiddhijñāḥ paramaiśvaryyasaṃyutāḥ ।। na kṣudrā brahmaṇaḥ kanyāstriṣu lokeṣu pūjitāḥ ।। 42 ।। viṣṇunā preritastvaṃ ca śambhoḥ putrasamo mahān ।। gaccha yāmi tvayā sārddhaṃ drakṣyāmi surasaṃcayam ।।43।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇeśakhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde nandikārttikeyasaṃvādo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 15 ।।
<3.16> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityevamuktvā taṃ śīghraṃ bodhayitvā ca kṛttikāḥ ।। uvāca kiṃcidyuktaṃ ca vacanaṃ śaṅkarātmajaḥ ।। 1 ।। kārtikeya uvāca ।। yāsyāmi śaṃkarasthānaṃ drakṣyāmi surasañcayam ।। mātaraṃ bandhuvargāṃścāpyājñāṃ me datta mātaraḥ ।। 2 ।। daivādhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ janma karma śubhāvaham ।। saṃyogaśca viyogaśca na ca daivātparaṃ balam ।। 3 ।। kṛṣṇāyattaṃ ca taddaivaṃ sa ca daivātparastataḥ ।। bhajanti satataṃ santaḥ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 4 ।। daivaṃ varddhayituṃ śaktaḥ kṣayaṃ karttuṃ svalīlayā ।। na daivabaddhastadbhaktaścāvināśīti nirṇayaḥ ।।5।। tasmādbhajata govindaṃ mohaṃ tyajata duḥkhadam।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ janmamṛtyubhayāpaham ।। 6 ।। paramānandajananaṃ mohajālanikṛntanam ।। śaśvadbhajanti yatsarve brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। 7 ।। ko'haṃ bhavābdhau yuṣmākaṃ kā vā yūyaṃ mamātmikāḥ ।। tatkarmasrotasāṃ sarvaṃ puñjībhūtaṃ ca phenavat ।। 8 ।। saṃśleṣaṃ vā viyogaṃ vā sarvamīśvaracintayā ।। brahmāṇḍamīśvarādhīnaṃ na svatantraṃ vidurbudhāḥ ।। 9 ।। jalabudbudavatsarvamanityaṃ ca jagattrayam ।। māyāmanitye kurvanti māyayā mūḍhacetasaḥ ।। 10 ।। santastatra na lipyante vāyuvatkṛṣṇacetasaḥ ।। tasmānmohaṃ parityajya cājñaptiṃ datta mātaraḥ ।। 11 ।। ityevamuktvā tā natvā sārddhaṃ śaṅkarapārṣadaiḥ ।। yātrāṃ cakāra bhagavānmanasā śrīhariṃ smaran ।। 12 ।। etasminnantare tatra dadarśa rathamuttamam ।। viśvakarmakṛtaṃ ramyaṃ hīrakeṇa virājitam ।। 13 ।। sadratnasāraracitaṃ māṇikyena virājitam ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiśca śobhitam ।। 14 ।। maṇīndradarpaṇaḥ śvetacāmarairatidīpitam ।। krīḍārhamandirai ramyaiścitritaiścitritaṃ varam ।। 15 ।। śatacakraṃ suvistīrṇaṃ manoyāyi manoharam ।। prasthāpitaṃ ca pārvatyā veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadairvaraiḥ ।। 16 ।। samāruhantaṃ yānaṃ tā hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। sahasā cetanāṃ prāpya muktakeśyaḥ śucā''turāḥ ।। 17 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca svapuraḥ skandaṃ staṃbhitāścātiśokataḥ ।। unmattā iva tatraiva vaktumārebhire bhiyā ।। 18 ।। kṛttikā ūcuḥ ।। kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca yāsyāmo vayaṃ vatsa tvadāśrayāḥ ।। vihāyāsmānkva yāsi tvaṃ nāyaṃ dharmmastavādhunā ।। 19 ।। snehena varddhito'smābhiḥ putro'smākaṃ svadharmataḥ ।। nāyaṃ dharmo mātṛvargānanuraktaḥ sutastyajet ।। 20 ।। ityuktvā kṛttikāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ sutam ।। punarmūrcchāmavāpustāḥ sutavicchedadāruṇam ।। 21 ।। kumāro bodhayitvā tā adhyātmavacanena vai ।। tābhiśca pārṣadaiḥ sārddhamāruroha rathaṃ mune ।। 22 ।। pūrṇakumbhaṃ dvijaṃ veśyāṃ śukladhānyāni darpaṇam।। dadhyājyaṃ madhu lājāṃśca puṣpaṃ dūrvākṣatānsitān ।। 23 ।। vṛṣaṃ gajendraṃ turagaṃ jvaladagniṃ suvarṇakam ।। pūrṇaṃ ca paripakvāni phalāni vividhāni ca ।। 24 ।। patiputravatīṃ nārīṃ pradīpaṃ maṇimuttamam ।। muktāṃ prasūnamālāṃ ca sadyomāṃsaṃ ca candanam ।। 25 ।। dadarśaitāni vastūni maṅgalāni puro mune ।। śṛgālaṃ nakulaṃ kumbhaṃ śavaṃ vāme śubhāvaham ।। 26 ।। rājahaṃsaṃ mayūraṃ ca khañjanaṃ ca śukaṃ pikam ।। pārāvataṃ śaṅkhacillaṃ cakravākaṃ ca maṅgalam ।। 27 ।। kṛṣṇasāraṃ ca surabhiṃ camarīṃ śvetacāmaram।। dhenuṃ ca vatsasaṃyuktāṃ patākāṃ dakṣiṇe śubhām।। ।। 28 ।। nānāprakāravādyaṃ cāpyaśrauṣīnmaṃgaladhvanim ।। manoharaṃ ca saṃgītaṃ ghaṇṭāśaṃkhadhvaniṃ tathā ।। 29 ।। dṛṣṭvā śrutvā maṅgalaṃ sa hyagamattātamandiram ।। kṣaṇenānandayuktaśca manoyāyirathena ca ।। 30 ।। kumāraḥ prāpya kailāsaṃ nyagrodhākṣayamūlake ।। kṣaṇaṃ tasthau kṛttikābhiḥ pārṣadapravaraiḥ saha ।। 31 ।। pārvatī maṃgalaṃ kṛtvā rājamārgaṃ manoharam ।। padmarāgairindranīlaiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ paritaḥ puram ।। 32 ।। rambhāstambhasamūhaiśca paṭṭasūtrāṃśukaistathā ।। śrīkhaṇḍapallavairyuktaṃ pūrṇakumbhaiḥ suśobhitam ।। 33 ।। pūrṇakumbhajalairvyāptaṃ siktaṃ candanavāribhiḥ ।। asaṃkhyaratnadīpaiśca maṇirājairvirājitam ।। 34 ।। naṭanarttakaveśyānāmutsavaiḥ saṃkulaṃ sadā ।। bandibhirvipravargaiśca dūrvāpuṣpakarairyutam।।35।। patiputravatībhiśca sādhvībhiśca samanvitam।। lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ durgāṃ sāvitrīṃ tulasīṃ ratim।।36।। arundhatīmahalyāṃ ca ditiṃ tārāṃ manoramām ।। aditiṃ śatarūpāṃ ca śacīṃ sandhyāṃ ca rohiṇīm ।। 37 ।। anasūyāṃ tathā svāhāṃ saṃjñāṃ varuṇakāminīm।। ākūtiṃ ca prasūtiṃ ca devahūtiṃ ca menakām ।। 38 ।। tāmekapāṭalāmekaparṇāṃ mainākakāminīm ।। vasundharāṃ ca manasāṃ puraskṛtya samāyayau।। ।। 39 ।। rambhā tilottamā menā ghṛtācī mohinī śubhā ।। urvaśī ratnamālā ca suśīlā lalitā kalā ।। 40 ।। kadambamālā surasā vanamālā ca sundarī ।। etāścānyāśca bahavo viprendrāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।। 41 ।। saṃgītanarttanaparāḥ sasmitā veṣasaṃyutāḥ ।। karatālakarāḥ sarvā jagmurānandapūrvakam ।। 42 ।। devāśca munayaḥ śailā gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā ।। sarve yayuḥ pramuditāḥ kumārasyānumajjane ।। 43 ।। nānāprakāravādyaiśca rudrairvā pārṣadaiḥ saha ।। bhairavaiḥ kṣetrapālaiśca yayau sārddhaṃ maheśvaraḥ ।। 44 ।। atha śaktidharo hṛṣṭo dṛṣṭvā ''rātpārvatīṃ tadā ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ śirasā praṇanāma ha।।45।। taṃ padmāpramukhaṃ devīgaṇaṃ ca munikāminīm ।। śivaṃ ca parayā bhaktyā sarvānsaṃbhāṣya yatnataḥ ।। 46 ।। kārttikeyaṃ śivā dṛṣṭvā kroḍe kṛtvā cucumba ca ।। śaṅkaraśca surāḥ śailā devyo vai śailayoṣitaḥ ।।47।। pārvatīpramukhā devyastathā devaśca śaṅkaraḥ ।। śailāśca munayaḥ sarve dadustasmai śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 48 ।। kumāraḥ sa gaṇaiḥ sārddhamāgatya ca śivālayam ।। dadarśa taṃ sabhāmadhye viṣṇuṃ kṣīrodaśāyinam।।49।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। dharmabrahmendracandrārkavahnivāyvādibhiryutam ।। 50 ।। īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। stutaṃ munīndrairdevendraiḥ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।।51।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatāṃ nāthaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। pulakānvitasarvāṃgaḥ śirasā praṇanāma ha ।। 52 ।। vidhiṃ dharmaṃ ca devāṃśca munīndrāṃśca mudā'nvitān ।। praṇanāma pṛthaktatra prāpa tebhyaśśubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 53 ।। pṛthaksaṃbhāṣya sarvāṃścāpyuvāsa kanakāsane ।। dadau dhanāni viprebhyaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ ।। 54 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde kārttikeyāgamanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 16 ।।
<3.17> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। atha viṣṇurjagatkānto hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtvā śubhakṣaṇam ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa ṣaṇmukham ।।1।। nānāvidhāni vādyāni kāṃsyatālādikāni ca ।। nānāvidhāni yantrāṇi vādayāmāsa kautukāt ।। 2 ।। vedamantrābhiṣiktaiśca sarvartīrthodapūrṇakaiḥ ।। sadratnakumbhaśatakaiḥ snāpayāmāsa taṃ mudā ।। 3 ।। sadratnasārakhacitaṃ kirīṭaṃ maṅgalāṅgade ।। amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ bhūṣaṇāni bahūni ca ।। 4 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśuke divye kṣīrodārṇavasambhavam ।। kaustubhaṃ vanamālāṃ ca tasmai cakraṃ dadau mudā ।। 5 ।। brahmā dadau yajñasūtraṃ vedā vai vedamātaram ।। sandhyāmantraṃ kṛṣṇamantraṃ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ hareḥ ।। 6 ।। kamaṇḍaluṃ ca brahmāstraṃ vidyāṃ vai vairimardinīm ।। dharmo dharmamatiṃ divyāṃ sarvajīve dayāṃ dadau ।। 7 ।। paraṃ mṛtyuñjayaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaśāstrāvabodhanam ।। śaśvatsukhapradaṃ tattvajñānaṃ ca sumanoharam ।। 8 ।। yogatattvaṃ siddhitattvaṃ brahmajñānaṃ sudurlabham ।। śūlaṃ pinākaṃ paraśuṃ śaktiṃ pāśupataṃ dhanuḥ ।। saṃhārāstravinikṣepaṃ tatsaṃhāre dadau śivaḥ ।। 9 ।। śvetacchatraṃ ratnamālāṃ dadau tasmai jaleśvaraḥ ।। gajendraṃ ca hayendraṃ ca sudhākumbhaṃ sudhānidhiḥ ।। 10 ।। manoyāyirathaṃ sūryyaḥ sannāhaṃ ca manoramam ।। yamadaṇḍaṃ yamaścaiva mahāśaktiṃ hutāśanaḥ ।। nānāśastrāṇyupāyāni sarve devā dadurmudā ।। 11 ।। kāmaśāstraṃ kāmadevo dadau tasmai mudā'nvitaḥ ।। kṣīrodo'mūlyaratnāni viśiṣṭe ratnanūpure ।। 12 ।। pārvatī sasmitā hṛṣṭā paramānandamānasā ।। mahāvidyāṃ suśīlāṃ ca vidyāṃ medhāṃ dayāṃ smṛtim ।। 13 ।। buddhiṃ sunirmalāṃ śāntiṃ tuṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ kṣamāṃ dhṛtim ।। sadṛḍhāṃ ca harau bhaktiṃ haridāsyaṃ dadau mudā ।। 14।। prajāpatirdevasenāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। suvinītāṃ suśīlāṃ ca sundarīṃ sumanoharām ।। 15 ।। dadau tasmai vedamantrairvivāhavidhinā svayam ।। yāṃ vadanti mahāṣaṣṭhīṃ paṇḍitāḥ śiśupālikām ।। 16 ।। abhiṣicya kumāraṃ ca sarve devā yayurgṛham ।। munayaścaiva gandharvāḥ praṇamya jagadīśvarān ।। 17।। nārāyaṇaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ dharmaṃ tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraḥ ।। praṇanāma hariṃ tāta dharmamāliṃgya nārada।।18।। prītyā yayau ca śailendraḥ sagaṇaḥ śaṃkarārcitaḥ।। ye ye tatrāgatā sarve yayurānandapūrvakam ।। 19 ।। paramānandasaṃyukto devyā saha maheśvaraḥ ।। kālāntare ca tānsarvānpunarānīya śaṃkaraḥ ।। puṣṭiṃ dadau vivāhena gaṇeśāya mahātmane।। 20।। sutābhyāṃ sagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ pārvatī hṛṣṭamānasā ।। siṣeve svāminaḥ pādapadmaṃ sā sarvakāmadam ।। 21 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kumārasyābhiṣecanam ।। vivāhaḥ pūjanaṃ tasya gaṇeśasya vivāhakam ।। 22 ।। pārvatīputralābhaśca devānāṃ ca samāgamaḥ ।। kā te manasi vāñchā'sti kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 23 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde kumāragaṇeśavivāha kumārābhiṣekakathanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 17 ।।
<3.18> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇa mahābhāga vedavedāṃgapāraga ।। pṛcchāmi tvāmahaṃ kiṃcidatisandehavānyataḥ ।। 1 ।। sutasya tridaśeśasya śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ ।। vighnanighnasya yadvighnamīśvarasya kathaṃ prabho ।।2।। paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānparamātmā parātparaḥ ।। golokanāthaḥ svāṃśena pārvatītanayaḥ svayam।।3।। aho bhagavatastasya mastakacchedanaṃ vibho ।। grahadṛṣṭyā graheśasya kathaṃ me vaktumarhasi ।। 4 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sāvadhānaṃ śṛṇu brahmannitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। vighneśasya babhūvedaṃ vighnaṃ yena ca nārada ।। 5।। ekadā śaṃkaraḥ sūryyaṃ jaghāna paramaṣṭadhā ।। sumālimālihantāraṃ śūlena bahuvatsalaḥ ।। 6 ।। śrīsūryyo'moghaśūlenāśanitulyena tejasā ।। jahau sa cetanāṃ sadyo rathācca nipapāta ha ।। 7 ।। dadarśa kaśyapaḥ putraṃ mṛtamuttānalocanam ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ śokādvilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ।।8।। hāhākāraṃ surāścakrurvilepurbhayakātarāḥ ।। andhībhūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ babhūva tamasā vṛtam ।। 9 ।। niṣprabhaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāśapatkaśyapaḥ śivam ।। tapasvī brahmaṇaḥ pautraḥ prajvanbrahmatejasā ।। 10 ।। matputrasya yathā vakṣaśchinnaṃ śūlena te'dya vai ।। tvatputrasya śiraśchinnaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 11 ।। śivaśca galitakrodhaḥ kṣaṇenaivāśutoṣakaḥ ।। brahmajñānena tatpūrṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt ।। 12 ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāmaṃśaśca triguṇātmakaḥ ।। sūryyaśca cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau pituḥ puraḥ ।। 13 ।। nanāma pitaraṃ bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। vijñāya śambhoḥ śāpaṃ ca kaśyapaṃ sa cukopa ha ।। 14 ।। viṣayānnaiva jagrāha kopenaivamuvāca ha ।। viṣayāṃśca parityajya bhaje śrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram ।।15।। sarvaṃ tucchamanityaṃ ca naśvaraṃ ceśvaraṃ vinā ।। vihāya maṅgalaṃ satyaṃ vidvānnecchedamaṃgalam ।। 16 ।। devaiśca prerito brahmā samāgatya sasambhramaḥ ।। bodhayitvā raviṃ tatra yuyoja viṣayeṣvajaḥ ।। 17 ।। tasmai dattvā''śiṣaśśambhurbrahmā ca svālayaṃ mudā ।। jagāma kaśyapaścaiva svarāśiṃ ravireva ca ।। 18 ।। atha mālī sumālī ca vyādhigrastau babhūvatuḥ ।। śvitrau galitasarvāṃgau śaktihīnau hataprabhau।। 19 ।। tāvuvāca svayaṃ brahmā yuvāṃ ca bhajatāṃ ravim ।। sūryyakopena malinau yuvāmevaṃ hataprabhau ।। 20 ।। sūryyasya kavacaṃ stotraṃ sarvapūjāvidhiṃ vidhiḥ ।। jagāma kathayitvā tau brahmalokaṃ sanātanaḥ ।।21।। tatastau puṣkaraṃ gatvā siṣevāte raviṃ mune।। snātvā trikālaṃ bhaktyā ca japantau mantramuttamam ।। 22 ।। tataḥ sūryyādvaraṃ prāpya nijarūpau babhūvatuḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhayaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 23 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde vighneśavighnakathanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 18 ।।
<3.19> nārada uvāca ।। kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ nātha brahmaṇā lokasākṣiṇā ।। dānavābhyāṃ purā dattaṃ sūryasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 1 ।। kiṃ vā pūjāvidhānaṃ vā kiṃ mantraṃ vyādhināśanam ।। sarvaṃ cāsya mahābhāga tanme tvaṃ vaktumarhasi ।।2।। sūta uvāca ।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānkaruṇānidhiḥ।। stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mantramūce tatpūjanakramam ।।3।। nārāyaṇa uvāca।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi sūryyapūjāvidheḥ kramam।। stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ sarvaṃ pāpavyādhivimocakam ।। 4 ।। sumālimālinau daityau vyādhigrastau babhūvatuḥ ।। vidhiṃ sasmaratuḥ stotuṃ śivamantrapradāyakam ।। 9 ।। brahmā gatvā ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ papraccha kamalāpatim ।। śivaṃ tatraiva saṃpaśyanvasantaṃ harisannidhau ।। 6 ।। brahmovāca ।। sumālimālinau daityau vyādhigrastau babhūvatuḥ ।। ka upāyo vada hare tayorvyādhivināśane ।। 7 ।। viṣṇuruvāca ।। kṛtvā sūryyasya sevāṃ ca puṣkare pūrṇavatsaram ।। vyādhihanturmadaṃśasya tau ca muktau bhaviṣyataḥ ।। 8 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। sūryastotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mantraṃ kalpataruṃ param ।। dehi tābhyāṃ jagatkānta vyādhihanturmahātmanaḥ ।। 9 ।। ārātsampatpradātārau sarvadātā hariḥ svayam ।। vyādhihantā dinakaro yasya yo viṣayo vidhe ।। 10 ।। tayostu mantraṃ saṃprāpya yayau daityagṛhaṃ vidhiḥ ।। tadā praṇamya taṃ dṛṣṭvā tasmai dadaturāsanam ।। 11 ।। tāvuvāca svayaṃ brahmā rogagrastau dayānidhiḥ ।। stabdhāvāhārarahitau pūyadurgandhasaṃyutau ।। 12 ।। brahmovāca ।। gṛhītvā kavacaṃ stotraṃ mantraṃ pūjāvidhikramam ।। gatvā hi puṣkaraṃ vatsau bhajathaḥ praṇatau ravim ।। 13 ।। tāvūcatuḥ ।। bhajāvaḥ kena vidhinā kena mantreṇa vā vidhe ।। kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ kiṃ vā tadāvābhyāṃ vadādhunā ।। 14 ।। brahmovāca ।। kṛtvā trikālaṃ snānaṃ ca mantreṇānena bhāskaram ।। saṃsevya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā nīrujau ca bhaviṣyatha ।। 15 ।। oṃ hrīṃ namo bhagavate sūryyāya paramātmane svāhā ।। ityanena ca mantreṇa sāvadhānaṃ divākaram ।। saṃpūjya bhaktyā dattvā vai copahārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ।। evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvaddhruvaṃ muktau bhaviṣyathaḥ ।। 16 ।। apūrvaṃ kavacaṃ tasya yuvābhyāṃ pradadāmyaham ।। yaddattaṃ guruṇā pūrvamindrāya prītipūrvakam ।। 17 ।। tatsahasrabhagāṅgāya śāpena gautamasya ca ।। ahalyāharaṇenaiva pāpamuktāya saṅkaṭe ।। 18 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। indra śṛṇu pravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। yaddhṛtvā munayaḥ pūtā jīvanmuktāśca bhārate ।। 19 ।। kavacaṃ bibhrato vyādhirna bhiyā yāti sannidhim ।। yathā dṛṣṭvā vainateyaṃ palāyante bhujaṅgamāḥ ।। 20 ।। śuddhāya gurubhaktāya svaśiṣyāya prakāśayet ।। khalāya paraśiṣyāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।। 21 ।। jagadvilakṣaṇasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ।। ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo dinakaraḥ svayam ।। vyādhipraṇāśe saundaryye viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। 22 ।। sadyorogaharaṃ sāraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।। oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīsūryyāya svāhā me pātu mastakam ।।23 ।। aṣṭādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kapālaṃ me sadā'vatu।। oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ sūryyāya svāhā me pātu nāsikām ।। 24 ।। cakṣurme pātu sūryaśca tārakāṃ ca vikartanaḥ ।। bhāskaro me'dharaṃ pātu dantāndinakaraḥ sadā ।। 25 ।। pracaṇḍaḥ pātu gaṇḍaṃ me mārtaṇḍaḥ karṇameva ca ।। mihiraśca sadā skandhe jaṃghe pūṣā sadā'vatu ।।26।। vakṣaḥ pātu raviḥ śaśvannābhiṃ sūryyaḥ svayaṃ sadā।। kaṃkālaṃ me sadā pātu sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ।।27।। karau pātu sadā bradhnaḥ pātu pādau prabhākaraḥ।। vibhākaro me sarvāṃgaṃ pātu santatamīśvaraḥ।।28।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa kavacaṃ sumanoharam।। jagadvilakṣaṇaṃ nāma trijagatsu sudurlabham ।।29।। purā dattaṃ ca manave pulastyena tu puṣkare ।। mayā dattaṃ ca tubhyaṃ tadyasmai kasmai na dehi bhoḥ ।। 30 ।। vyādhito mucyase tvaṃ ca kavacasya prasādataḥ ।। bhavānarogī śrīmāṃśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 31 ।। lakṣavarṣahaviṣyeṇa yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ kavacasyāsya dhāraṇāt ।। 32 ।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā yo mūḍho bhāskaraṃ yajet ।। daśalakṣaprajapto'pi mantrasiddhirna jāyate ।। 33 ।। brahmovāca ।। dhṛtvedaṃ kavacaṃ vatsau kṛtvā ca stavanaṃ raveḥ ।। yuvāṃ vyādhivinirmuktau niścitaṃ tu bhaviṣyathaḥ ।। 34 ।। stavanaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ sūryyasya vyādhimocanam ।। sarvapāpaharaṃ sāraṃ dhanārogyakaraṃ param ।। 35 ।। brahmovāca ।। taṃ brahma paramaṃ dhāma jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। tvāmahaṃ stotumicchāmi bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 36 ।। trailokyalocanaṃ lokanāthaṃ pāpavimocanam ।। tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ duḥkhadaṃ pāpināṃ sadā ।। 37 ।। karmānurūpaphaladaṃ karmabījaṃ dayānidhim ।। karmarūpaṃ kriyārūpamarūpaṃ karmabījakam ।। 38 ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāmaṃśaṃ ca triguṇātmakam ।। vyādhidaṃ vyādhihantāraṃ śokamohabhayāpaham ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ bhaktidaṃ sarvakāmadam।। 39 ।। sarveśvaraṃ sarvarūpaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। pratyakṣaṃ sarvalokānāmapratyakṣaṃ manoharam ।। 40 ।। śaśvadrasaharaṃ paścādrasadaṃ sarvasiddhidam ।। siddhi svarūpaṃ siddheśaṃ siddhānāṃ paramaṃ gurum ।। 41 ।। stavarājamidaṃ proktaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ param ।। trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ vyādhibhyassa pramucyate ।। 42 ।। āndhyaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca dāridryaṃ rogaḥ śoko bhayaṃ kaliḥ ।। tasya naśyati viśveśa śrīsūryyakṛpayā dhruvam ।। 43 ।। mahākuṣṭhī ca galitaścakṣurhīno mahāvraṇī ।। yakṣmagrasto mahāśūlī nānāvyādhiyuto'si vā ।। 44 ।। māsaṃ kṛtvā haviṣyānnaṃ śrutvā'to mucyate dhruvam ।। snānaṃ ca sarvatīrthānāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। ।।45।। puṣkaraṃ gacchataṃ śīghraṃ bhāskaraṃ bhajataṃ sutau ।। ityevamuktvā sa vidhirjagāma svālayaṃ mudā ।।46।। tau niṣevya dineśaṃ taṃ nīrujau saṃbabhūvatuḥ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi।।47।। sarvavighnaharaṃ sāraṃ vighneśaṃ vighnanāśanam।। stotreṇānena taṃ stutvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 48 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde vighnakāraṇakathanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 19 ।।
<3.20> nārada uvāca ।। hareraṃśasamutpanno haritulyo bhavāndhiyā ।। tejasā vikrameṇaiva matpraśnaṃ śrotumarhasi ।।1।। vighnanighnasya yadvighnaṃ śrutaṃ tatparamādbhutam ।। tadvighnakāraṇaṃ caiva viśvakāraṇavaktrataḥ ।। 2 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi paraṃ sandehabhañjanam ।। trailokyanāthatanaye gajāsyāyojanārthakam ।। 3 ।। sthiteṣvanyeṣu bahuṣu jantuṣvabjabhuvaḥ pate ।। suprāṇināṃ surūpeṣu nānārūpeṣu rūpiṇām ।। 4 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gajāsyayojanāyāśca kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu nārada ।। gopyaṃ sarvapurāṇeṣu vedeṣu ca sudurlabham।।5।। tāraṇaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvasampadām ।। hāraṇaṃ vipadāṃ caiva rahasyaṃ pāpamocanam ।। 6 ।। mahālakṣmyāśca caritaṃ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva caturvargaphalapradam।।7।। śṛṇu tāta pravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। rahasyaṃ pādmakalpasya purā tātamukhācchrutam ।। 8 ।। ekadaiva mahendraśca puṣpabhadrāṃ nadīṃ yayau ।। mahāsampanmadonmattaḥ kāmī rājaśriyā'nvitaḥ ।। 9।। tattīre'tirahaḥsthāne puṣpodyāne manohare ।। atīva durgame'raṇye sarvajantuvivarjite ।। 10 ।। bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokilarutaśrave ।। sugandhipuṣpa saṃśliṣṭavāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। 11 ।। dadarśa rambhāṃ tatraiva candralokātsamāgatām ।। surataśramaviśrāntikāmukīṃ kāmakāmukīm ।। ।। 12 ।। icchantīmīpsitāṃ krīḍāṃ gacchantīṃ madanāśramam ।। ekākinīmunmanaskāṃ manmathodgatamānasām ।। 13 ।। suśroṇīṃ sudatīṃ śyāmāṃ bimbādharasaroruhām।। bṛhannitambabhārārttāṃ mattavāraṇagāminīm।।14।। sasmitāsyaśaraccandrāṃ sukaṭākṣaṃ ca bibhratīm।। bibhratīṃ kabarīṃ ramyāṃ mālatīmālyaśobhitām ।। 15 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukadharāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। kastūrībindunā sārddhaṃ sindūraṃ bibhratīṃ mudā ।। ।। 16 ।। nīlotpaladalaśyāmakajjalojjalalocanām ।। maṇikuṇḍalayugmāḍhyagaṇḍasthalavirājitām ।। 17 ।। atyunnataṃ sukaṭhinaṃ patrarājivirājitam ।। sukhadaṃ rasikānāṃ ca stanayugmaṃ ca bibhratīm ।। 18 ।। sarvaśobhāṃ suveṣāḍhyāṃ subhagāṃ suratotsukām ।। prāṇādhikāṃ ca devānāṃ svacchāṃ svacchandagāminīm ।। 19 ।। varāmapsarasāṃ ramyāmatīva sthirayauvanām ।। guṇarūpavatīṃ śāntāṃ munimānasamohinīm ।। 20।। dṛṣṭvā tāmativeṣāḍhyāṃ tatkaṭākṣeṇa pīḍitaḥ ।। indro'tīndriyacāpalyātpravaktupacakrame ।। 21 ।। indra uvāca ।। kva gacchasi varārohe kva gatā'si manohare ।। mayā dṛṣṭā hi sucirātkalyāṇi subhage'dhunā ।। 22 ।। tavānveṣaṇakarttā'haṃ śrutvā vācikamagrataḥ ।। tvadāsaktamanāścāsmi nānyāṃ vai gaṇayāmi ca ।। 23 ।। suvāsitajalārthī yaḥ kimicchetpaṅkilaṃ jalam ।। paṅkaṃ neccheccandanārthī paṅkajārthī na cotpalam ।। 24 ।। sudhārthī na surāmiccheddugdhārthī nāvilaṃ jalam ।। sugandhipuṣpaśāyī yo hyastratalpaṃ na cecchati ।।25 ।। svargī ca narakaṃ necchetsubhogī duṣṭabhojanam ।। paṇḍitaiḥ saha saṃvāsī necchetstrīsannidhiṃ naraḥ ।। vihāya ratnābharaṇaṃ ko'pīcchellohabhūṣaṇam ।। 26 ।। tvāṃ nāśliṣya mahāvijñāṃ kāṃ mūḍho gantumicchati।। vihāya gaṅgāṃ ko vijño nadīmanyāṃ ca vāṃchati ।। 27 ।। indriyaiścendriyaratiṃ varddhayantīṃ pade pade ।। varaṃ prārthayitāraśca prāṇinaśca sukhārthinaḥ ।।28।।। ityevamuktvā bhagavānavaruhya gajeśvarāt ।। kāmayuktaśca puratastasthau tasyāśca nārada ।। 29 ।। śrutvā tadvacanaṃ rambhā mahāśṛṅgāralolupā ।। jahāsānamravadanā pulakāñcitavigrahā ।। 30 ।। smerānanā kaṭākṣeṇa stanorvordarśanena ca ।। narmoktigarbhavākyena cāharattasya cetanām ।। 31 ।। mitaṃ sāraṃ sumadhuraṃ susnigdhaṃ komalaṃ priyam ।। puruṣāyattabījaṃ ca pravaktumupacakrame ।। 32 ।। rambhovāca ।। yāsyāmi vāñchitaṃ yatra praśnena tava kiṃ phalam ।। nāhaṃ santoṣajananī dhūrttānāṃ duṣṭamitratā ।। 33 ।। yathā madhukaro lobhātsarvapuṣpāsavaṃ labhet ।। svādu yatrātiriktaṃ sa tatra tiṣṭhati santatam ।। 34 ।। tathaiva kāmukī loke bhramedbhramaravatsadā ।। cāñcalyātsa hi kāsveva vāyuvadrasamāharet ।। 35 ।। supumānaṅgavatstrīṇāṃ yathā śākhāśca śākhiṣu ।। kāmukī kākavallolaḥ phalaṃ bhuktvā prayāti ca ।। 36 ।। svakāryyamuddharedyāvattāvadvā sa prayojanam ।। sthitiḥ kāryyānurodhena yathā kāṣṭhe hutāśanaḥ ।। 37 ।। yāvattaḍāge toyāni tāvadyādāṃsi teṣu ca ।। śoṣārambhe ca toyānāṃ yānti sthānāntaraṃ punaḥ ।। 38 ।। tvaṃ devānāmīśvaro'si kāminīnāṃ ca vāñchitaḥ ।। pumāṃsaṃ rasikaṃ śaśvadvāñchanti rasikāḥ sukhāt ।। 39 ।। yuvānaṃ rasikaṃ śāntaṃ suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ priyam ।। guṇinaṃ dhaninaṃ svacchaṃ kāntamicchati kāminī ।। 40 ।। duśśīlaṃ rogiṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ ratiśaktiviyojitam ।। adātāramavijñaṃ ca naiva vāñchanti yoṣitaḥ ।। 41 ।। kā mūḍhā na ca vāñchanti tvāmevaṃ guṇasāgaram ।। tavājñākāriṇīṃ dāsīṃ gṛhāṇātra yathāsukham ।। 42 ।। ityuktvā sasmitā sā ca taṃ papau vakracakṣuṣā ।। kāmāgnidagdhā vigalallajjā tasthau samīpataḥ ।। 43 ।। jñātvā bhāvaṃ smarārttāyāḥ smaraśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। gṛhītvā tāṃ puṣpatalpe vijahāra tayā saha ।। 44 ।। cucumba rahasi prauḍhāṃ nagnāṃ ca subhagāṃ varām ।। pakvabimbādharauṣṭhīṃ ca sudatyā cuṃbitastayā ।। 45 ।। nānāprakāraśṛṅgārādviparītādikānmune ।। sukhī babhūva tasyāṃ vai śṛṃgāro mūrtimāniva ।। 46 ।। tau kāmāhitacittau no bubudhāte divāniśam ।। anyonyagatacittau ca kāmārtau jñānavarjitau ।। 47 ।। sa ca kṛtvā sthale krīḍāṃ tayā saha sureśvaraḥ।। yayau jalavihārārthaṃ puṣpabhadrānadī jalam ।। 48 ।। sa cakāra jalakrīḍāṃ tayā saha mudā kṣaṇam ।। jalātsthale sthalāttoye vijahāra punaḥ punaḥ ।।49।। etasminnantare tena vartmanā munipuṃgavaḥ ।। saśiṣyo yāti durvāsā vaikuṇṭhācchaṅkarālayam ।। 50 ।। taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā munīndraṃ ca devendraḥ stabdhamānasaḥ ।। nanāmāgatya sahasā dadau tasmai sa cāśiṣaḥ ।। 51 ।। pārijātaprasūnaṃ yaddattaṃ nārāyaṇena vai ।। tacca dattaṃ mahendrāya munīndreṇa mahātmanā ।।52।। dattvā puṣpaṃ mahābhāgastamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ।। māhātmyaṃ tasya yatkiṃcidapūrvaṃ munisattamaḥ ।।53।। durvāsā uvāca ।। sarvavighnaharaṃ puṣpaṃ nārāyaṇaniveditama ।। mūrdhnīdaṃ yasya devendra jayastasyaiva sarvataḥ ।। 94 ।। puraḥpūjā ca sarveṣāṃ devānāmagraṇīrbhavet। tacchāyeva mahālakṣmīrna jahāti kadā'pi tam ।।55।। jñānena tejasā buddhyā vikrameṇa balena ca ।। sarvadevādhikaḥ śrīmānharitulyaparākramaḥ ।। 55 ।। bhaktyā mūrdhni na gṛhṇāti yo'haṃkāreṇa pāmaraḥ ।। naivedyaṃ ca harereva sa bhraṣṭaśrīḥ svajātibhiḥ ।। ityuktvā śaṃkarāṃśaśca hyagamacchaṃkarālayam ।।57।। tatsa rambhāṃtike tiṣṭhaṃścikṣepa gajamastake ।। tena bhraṣṭaśriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā jagāma surālayam।।58।। puṃścalī yogyamicchantī nāparaṃ cañcalā'dhamā ।। devarājaṃ parityajya gajarājo mahābalī ।। 59 ।। praviveśa mahāraṇyaṃ taṃ nikṣipya svatejasā ।। tatraiva kariṇīṃ prāpya mattaḥ saṃbubhuje balāt ।। 60 ।। sā'to babhūva vaśagā yoṣijjātiḥ sukhārthinī ।। tayorbabhūvāpatyānāṃ nivahastatra kānane ।। 61 ।। haristanmastakaṃ chittvā yojayāmāsa bālake ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। gajāsyayojanāyāśca kāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam ।। 62 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇapatergajāsyayojanāhetukathanaṃ nāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।20।।
<3.21> nārada uvāca ।। te devā brahmaśāpena niḥśrīkā kena vā prabho ।। babhūvustadrahasyaṃ ca gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham ।। 1 ।। kathaṃ vā prāpurete tāṃ kamalāṃ jagatāṃ prasūm ।। kiṃ cakāra mahendraśca tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gajendreṇa parābhūto rambhayā ca sumandadhīḥ ।। bhraṣṭaśrīrdainyayuktaśca sa jagāmāmarāvatīm ।। ।। 3 ।। tāṃ dadarśa nirānando nirānandāṃ purīṃ mune ।। dainyagrastāṃ bandhuhīnāṃ vairivargaiḥ samākulām ।। 4 ।। iti śrutvā dūtamukhājjagāma gurumandiram ।। tena devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma brahmaṇaḥ sabhām ।। 5 ।। gatvā nanāma taṃ śakraḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ tathā guruḥ ।। tuṣṭāva vedavākyaiśca stotreṇāpi ca saṃyataḥ ।। 6 ।। pravṛttiṃ kathayāmāsa vākpatistaṃ prajāpatim ।। śrutvā brahmā namravaktraḥ pravaktumupacakrame ।। 7 ।। brahmovāca ।। matprapautro'si devendra śaśvadrājañchriyā jvalan ।। lakṣmīsamaśacībharttā parastrīlolupaḥ sadā ।। 8 ।। gautamasyābhiśāpena bhagāṃgaḥ surasaṃsadi ।। punarlajjāvihīnastvaṃ parastrīratilolupaḥ ।। 9 ।। yaḥ parastrīṣu niratastasya śrī vā kuto yaśaḥ ।। sa ca nindyaḥ pāpayuktaḥ śaśvatsarvasabhāsu ca ।। 10 ।। naivedyaṃ śrīharereva dattaṃ durvāsasā ca te ।। gajamūrdhni tvayā nyastaṃ rambhayā''hṛtacetasā ।। 11 ।। kva sā rambhā sarvabhogyā kvādhunā tvaṃ śriyā hataḥ ।। sarvasaukhyapradātrī tvāṃ gatā tyaktvā kṣaṇena sā ।। 12 ।। veśyā saśrīkamicchantī niḥśrīkaṃ na ca cañcalā ।। navaṃ navaṃ prārthayantī parinindya purātanam ।। 13 ।। yadgataṃ tadgataṃ vatsa niṣpannaṃ na nivarttate ।। bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ bhaktyā padmāyāḥ prāptihetave ।।14।। ityuktvā taṃ jagatsraṣṭuḥ stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ dadau ।। nārāyaṇasya mantraṃ ca nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।।15।। sa taiḥ sārddhaṃ ca guruṇā hyajapanmantramīpsitam ।। gṛhītvā kavacaṃ tena paryaṣṭautpuṣkare harim ।।16।। varṣamekaṃ nirāhāro bhārate puṇyade śubhe ।। siṣeve kamalākāntaṃ kamalāprāptihetave ।। 17 ।। āgatya taṃ haristasmai vāñchitaṃ ca varaṃ dadau ।। lakṣmīstotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mantramaiśvaryyavarddhanam ।। 18 ।। dattvā jagāma vaikuṇṭhamindraḥ kṣīrodameva ca ।। gṛhītvā kavacaṃ stutvā prāpa padmālayāṃ mune ।। 19 ।। sureśvaro'riṃ jitvā vai hyalabhaccāmarāvatīm ।। pratyekaṃ ca surāḥ sarve svālayaṃ prāpurīpsitam ।। 20 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde śakralakṣmīprāptirnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 21 ।।
<3.22> nārada uvāca ।। āvirbhūya haristasmai kiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ dadau ।। mahālakṣmyāśca lakṣmīśastanme brūhi tapodhana ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca।। puṣkare ca tapastaptvā virarāma sureśvaraḥ ।। āvirbabhūva tatraiva kliṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariḥ svayam ।।2।। tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśo varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ।। sa ca vavre varaṃ lakṣmīmīśastasmai dadau mudā ।। 3 ।। varaṃ dattvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ pravaktumupacakrame ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ ca sāraṃ ca pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 4 ।। śrīmadhusūdana uvāca ।। gṛhāṇa kavacaṃ śakra sarvaduḥkhavināśanam ।। paramaiśvaryyajanakaṃ sarvaśatruvimardanam ।। 5 ।। brahmaṇe ca purā dattaṃ viṣṭape ca jalaplute ।। yaddhṛtvā jagatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvaiśvaryyayuto vidhiḥ ।।6।। babhūvurmanavaḥ sarve sarvaiśvaryayutā yataḥ ।। sarvaiśvaryyapradasyāsya kavacasya ṛṣirvidhiḥ ।। 7 ।। paṅktiśchandaśca sā devī svayaṃ padmālayā varā ।। siddhyaiśvaryyasukheṣveva viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। yaddhṛtvā kavacaṃ lokaḥ sarvatra vijayī bhavet ।। 8 ।। mastakaṃ pātu me padmā kaṇṭhaṃ pātu haripriyā ।। nāsikāṃ pātu me lakṣmīḥ kamalā pātu locane ।। 9 ।। keśānkeśavakāntā ca kapālaṃ kamalālayā ।। jagatprasūrgaṇḍayugmaṃ skandhaṃ sampatpradā sadā ।। ।। 10 ।। oṃ śrīṃ kamalavāsinyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ padmālayāyai svāhā vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu ।। pātu śrīrmama kaṅkālaṃ bāhuyugmaṃ ca te namaḥ ।। 11 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ lakṣmyai namaḥ pādau pātu me saṃtataṃ ciram ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ namaḥ padmāyai svāhā pātu nitambakam ।। 12 ।। oṃ śrīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā sarvāṅgaṃ pātu me sadā ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā māṃ pātu sarvataḥ ।।13।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvasampatkaraṃ param ।। sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।।14।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivatkavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ।। kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau sa sarvavijayī bhavet ।। 15 ।। mahālakṣmīrgṛhaṃ tasya na jahāti kadācana ।। tasya cchāyeva satataṃ sā ca janmani janmani ।। 16 ।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā bhajellakṣmīṃ sa mandadhīḥ ।। śatalakṣaprajāpe'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ ।। 17 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dattvā tasmai ca kavacaṃ mantraṃ vai ṣoḍaśākṣaram ।। santuṣṭaśca jagannātho jagatāṃ hitakāraṇam ।।18।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ namo mahālakṣmyai svāhā।। dadau tasmai ca kṛpayā cendrāya ca mahāmune ।। 19 ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham ।। siddhairmunīndrairduṣprāpyaṃ dhruvaṃ siddhipradaṃ śubham।। 20 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ śatacandrasamaprabhām ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।।21।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakārikām ।। sahasradalapadmasthāṃ svasthāṃ ca sumanoharām ।। 22 ।। śāntāṃ ca śrīhareḥ kāntāṃ tāṃ bhajejjagatāṃ prasūm ।।23।। dhyānenānena devendro dhyātvā lakṣmīṃ manoharām ।। bhaktyā saṃpūjya tasyai ca copacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ।।24।। stutvā'nena stavenaiva vakṣyamāṇena vāsava ।। natvā varaṃ gṛhītvā ca labhiṣyasi ca nirvṛtim ।। 25 ।। stavanaṃ śṛṇu devendra mahālakṣmyāḥ sukhapradam।। kathayāmi sugopyaṃ ca triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।।26।। nārāyaṇa uvāca।। devi tvāṃ stotumicchāmi na kṣamāḥ stotumīśvarāḥ ।। buddheragocarāṃ sūkṣmāṃ tejorūpāṃ sanātanīm ।। anivāryyaguṇāḍhyāṃ ca ko vā nirvaktumīśvaraḥ ।। 27 ।। svecchāmayīṃ nirākārāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahām ।। staumi vāṅmanasāpārāṃ kiṃ vā'haṃ jagadambike।।28।। parāṃ caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ pārabījaṃ bhavārṇave ।। sarvasasyādhidevīṃ ca sarvāsāmapi sampadām ।।29।। yogināṃ caiva yogānāṃ jñānānāṃ jñānināṃ tathā ।। vedānāṃ vai vedavidāṃ jananīṃ varṇayāmi kim।। 30।। yayā vinā jagatsarvamabījaṃ niṣphalaṃ dhruvam ।। yayā stanaṃdhayānāṃ ca vinā mātrā sukhaṃ bhavet ।। 31 ।। prasīda jagatāṃ mātā rakṣāsmānatikātarān ।। vayaṃ tvaccaraṇāmbhoje prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ।। 32 ।। namaḥ śaktisvarūpāyai jaganmātre namo namaḥ ।। jñānadāyai buddhidāyai sarvadāyai namo namaḥ ।।33।। haribhaktipradāyinyai muktidāyai namo namaḥ।। sarvajñāyai sarvadāyai mahālakṣmyai namo namaḥ ।। 34 ।। kuputrāḥ kutracitsanti na kutrāpi kumātaraḥ।। kutra mātā putradoṣaṃ taṃ vihāya ca gacchati।।35।। stanandhayebhya iva me he mātardehi darśanam ।। kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho tvamasmānbhaktavatsale ।।36।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa padmāyāśca śubhāvaham ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ śubhadaṃ sampadaḥpradam ।।37।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। mahālakṣmīrgṛhaṃ tasya na jahāti kadācana ।। 38 ।। ityuktvā śrīharistaṃ ca tatraivāntaradhīyata ।। devo jagāma kṣīrodaṃ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ tadājñayā ।। 39 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde lakṣmīstavakavacapūjā kathanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 22 ।।
<3.23> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। indraśca guruṇā sārddhaṃ suraissaṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। jagāma śīghraṃ padmāyai tīraṃ kṣīrapayonidheḥ ।। kavacaṃ ca gale baddhvā sadratnaguṭikānvitam ।। manasā stavanaṃ divyaṃ smāraṃ smaraṃ punaḥpunaḥ।1।। te sarve bhaktiyuktāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ kamalālayām ।। sāśrunetrāśca dīnāśca bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।। 2।। sā teṣāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā sadyaḥ sākṣādbabhūva ha ।। sahasradalapadmasthā śatacandrasamaprabhā ।। 3 ।। jagadvyāptaṃ suprabhayā jaganmātraṃ yayā mune ।। tānuvāca jagaddhātrī hitaṃ sāraṃ yathocitam ।। 4 ।। śrī mahālakṣmīruvāca।। vatsā necchāmi vo gehāngantuṃ naivaṃ kṣamā'dhunā ।। bhraṣṭāndṛṣṭvā brahmaśāpādbibhemi brahmaśāpataḥ ।।5।। prāṇā me brāhmaṇāḥ sarve śaśvatputrādhikaṃ priyāḥ ।। vipradattaṃ ca yatkiñcidupajīvyaṃ sadaiva ca ।। 6 ।। viprā bruvantu māṃ tuṣṭā yāsyāmi bhavadājñayā ।। na me pūjāṃ dhruvaṃ kartuṃ kṣamāste ca tapasvinaḥ ।।7 । gurubhirbrāhmaṇairdevairbhikṣubhirvaiṣṇavaistathā ।। yadyabhāgyaṃ bhaveddaivātte śaptāḥ santi taissadā ।। 8।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānbibheti brahmaśāpataḥ ।। sarvabījaṃ ca bhagavānsarveśaśca sanātanaḥ ।। 9 ।। etasminnantare brahmanbrāhmaṇā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ।। ājagmuḥ sasmitāḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā।। 10।। aṃgirāśca pracetāśca kratuśca bhṛgureva ca ।। pulahaśca pulastyaśca marīciścātrireva ca ।। 11।। sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānsākṣānnārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।। 12 ।। kapilaścāsuriścaiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ।। durvāsāḥ kaśyapo'gastyo gautamaḥ kaṇva eva ca।। 13 ।। aurvaḥ kātyāyanaścaiva kaṇādaḥ pāṇinistathā ।। mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca vasiṣṭho bhagavānsvayam ।। 14 ।। brāhmaṇā vividhairdravyaiḥ pūjayāmāsurīśvarīm ।। devāścāraṇyanaivedyairupahāreṇa bhaktitaḥ ।। 15 ।। stutvā munīndrāstāṃ bhaktyā cakrurārādhanaṃ mudā ।। āgaccha devabhavanaṃ martyaṃ ca jagadambike ।। 16 ।। teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca jagatprasūḥ ।। parituṣṭā gāmukī ca nirbhayā brāhmaṇājñayā ।। 17 ।। śrīmahālakṣmīruvāca ।। gṛhānyāsyāmi devānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ cājñayā dvijāḥ ।। yeṣāṃ gehaṃ na gacchāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ bhārateṣu ca ।। 18 ।। sthirā puṇyavatāṃ gehe sunītipathavedinām।। gṛhasthānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vā putravatpālayāmi tān ।। 19 ।। yaṃ yaṃ ruṣṭo gururdevo mātā tātaśca bāndhavāḥ ।। atithiḥ pitṛlokaśca yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 20 ।। mithyāvādī ca yaḥ śaśvadanadhyāyī ca yaḥ sadā ।। sattvahīnaśca duśśīlo na gehaṃ tasya yāmyaham।।21।। satyahīnaḥ sthāpyahārī mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ ।। viśvāsaghnaḥ kṛtaghno yo yāmi tasya na mandiram ।।22।। cintāgrasto bhayagrastaḥ śatrugrasto'tipātakī ।। ṛṇagrasto'tikṛpaṇo na gehaṃ yāmi pāpinām ।।23।। dīkṣāhīnaśca śokārtto mandadhīḥ strījitaḥ sadā ।। na yāmyapi kadā gehaṃ puṃścalyāḥ patiputrayoḥ ।। 24 ।। yo durvākkalahāviṣṭaḥ kaliḥ śaśvadyadālaye ।। strī pradhānā gṛhe yasya yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 25 ।। yatra nāsti hareḥ pūjā tadīyaguṇakīrttanam ।। notsukastatpraśaṃsāyāṃ yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 26 ।। kanyānnavedavikretā naraghātī ca hiṃsakaḥ ।। narakāgārasadṛśaṃ yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 27 ।। mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryāṃ gurupatnīṃ guruṃ sutam ।। anāthāṃ bhaginīṃ kanyāmananyāśrayabāndhavān ।। 28 ।। kārpaṇyādyo na puṣṇāti sañcayaṃ kurute sadā ।। tadgehānnarakāgārānyāmi tānna munīśvarāḥ ।। 29 ।। daśanaṃ vasanaṃ yasya samalaṃ rūkṣamastakam ।। vikṛtau grāsahāsau ca yāmi tasya na mandiram।। 30। mūtraṃ purīṣamutsṛjya yastatpaśyati mandadhīḥ ।। yaḥ śete snigdhapādena yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 31 ।। adhautapādaśāyī yo nagnaḥ śete'tinidritaḥ ।। sandhyāśāyī divāśāyī yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 32 ।। mūrdhni tailaṃ puro dattvā yo'nyadaṅgamupaspṛśet ।। dadāti paścādgātre vā yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 33 ।। dattvā tailaṃ mūrdhni gātre viṇmūtraṃ yaḥ samutsṛjet ।। praṇamedāharetpuṣpaṃ yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 34 ।। tṛṇaṃ chinatti nakharairnakharairvilikhenmahīm ।। gātre pāde malaṃ yasya yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 35 ।। svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā brahmavṛttiṃ surasya ca ।। yo harejjñānaśīlaśca yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 36 ।। yatkarma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ kurute mūḍhadhīḥ śaṭhaḥ ।। sa pāpī puṇyahīnaśca yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 37 ।। mantravidyopajīvī ca grāmayājī cikitsakaḥ ।। sūpakṛddevalaścaiva yāmi tasya na mandiram ।। 38 ।। vivāhaṃ dharmakāryaṃ vā yo nihanti ca kopataḥ ।। divāmaithunakārī yo yāmi tasya na mandiram ।।39।। ityuktvā sā mahālakṣmīrantarddhānaṃ jagāma ha ।। dadau dṛṣṭiṃ ca devānāṃ gṛhe martye ca nārada ।। 40।। tāṃ praṇamya surāḥ sarve munayaśca mudā'nvitāḥ ।। prajagmuḥ svālayaṃ śīghraṃ śatrutyaktaṃ suhṛdyutam ।।41।। nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge babhūvuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ।। prāpurdevāḥ svarājyaṃ ca niścalāṃ kamalāṃ mune ।। 42 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa lakṣmīcaritamuttamam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 43 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇapatergajāsyatvakāraṇa lakṣmībrāhmaṇavirodhādi lakṣmīcaritrakathanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 23 ।।
<3.24> nārada uvāca ।। nārāyaṇa mahābhāga hareraṃśasamudbhava ।। sarvaṃ śrutaṃ tvatprasādādgaṇeśacaritaṃ śubham ।।1।। dantadvayayutaṃ vaktraṃ gajarājasya bālake ।। viṣṇunā yojitaṃ brahmannekadantaḥ kathaṃ śiśuḥ ।।2।। kuto gato'sya danto'nyastadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। sarveśvarastvaṃ sarvajñaḥ kṛpāvānbhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 3 ।। sūta uvāca ।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā smerānana saroruhaḥ ।। ekadantasya caritaṃ pravaktumupacakrame ।। 4 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। ekadantasya caritaṃ sarvamaṃgalamaṃgalam ।। 5 ।। ekadā kārttavīryyaśca jagāma mṛgayāṃ mune ।। mṛgānnihatya bahulānpariśrānto babhūva saḥ ।। 6 ।। niśāmukhe dine'tīte tatra tasthau vane nṛpaḥ ।। jamadagnyāśramābhyāśe copoṣyānīkasaṃyutaḥ ।।7।। prātaḥ sarovare rājā snātaḥ śuciralaṃkṛtaḥ ।। tadā''treyeṇa dattaṃ ca hyajapadbhaktito manum ।। 8 ।। munirdadarśa rājānaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukam।। prītyā''dareṇa mṛdulaṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ muniḥ ।। 9 ।। nanāma sambhamādrājā muniṃ sūryyasamaprabham ।। sa ca tasmai dadau prītyā praṇatāya śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 10 ।। vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa rājā cānaśanādikam ।। saṃbhrameṇaiva muninā trasto rājā nimantritaḥ ।। 11 ।। vijñāpya taṃ muniśreṣṭhaḥ prayayau svālayaṃ mudā ।। etadvṛttaṃ kāmadhenuṃ kathayāmāsa bhītavat ।।12।। uvāca sā muniṃ bhītaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ te mama sthitau ।। jagadbhojayituṃ śaktastvaṃ mayā ko nṛpo mune ।। 13 ।। rājabhojanayogyārhaṃ yadyaddravyaṃ prayācase ।। sarvaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyāmi triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। 14 ।। sauvarṇāni ca raupyāṇi pātrāṇi vividhāni ca ।। bhojanārhāṇyasaṃkhyāni pākapātrāṇi yāni ca ।। 15 ।। pātrāṇi svādupūrṇāni pradadau munaye ca sā ।। nānāvidhāni svādūni paripakvaphalāni ca ।। 16 ।। panasāmraśrīphalāni nārikelādikāni ca ।। rāśībhūtānyasaṃkhyāni svādulaḍḍukarāśayaḥ ।। 17 ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ।। pakvānnānāṃ parvatāṃśca paramānnasya kandarān ।। 18 ।। dugdhānāṃ ca ghṛtānāṃ ca nadīrdadhnāṃ dadau mudā ।। śarkarāṇāṃ tathā rāśiṃ modakānāṃ ca parvatān ।। 19 ।। pṛthukānāṃ suśālīnāṃ parvatānpradadau mudā ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau pūrṇaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 20 ।। nṛpayogyaṃ kautukācca sundaraṃ vastrabhūṣaṇam ।। muniḥ sambhṛtasambhāro dattvā dravyaṃ manoharam ।। 21 ।। bhojayāmāsa rājānaṃ sasainyamapi līlayā ।। yadyastu durlabhaṃ vastu paripūrṇaṃ nṛpeśvara ।। jagāma vismayaṃ rājā dṛṣṭvā pātrāṇyuvāca ha ।। 22 ।। rājovāca ।। dravyāṇyetāni saciva durlabhānyaśrutāni ca ।। mamāsādhyāni sahasā kvāgatānyavalokaya ।। 23 ।। nṛpājñayā ca sacivaḥ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā munergṛhe ।। rājānaṃ kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ mahadbhutam ।। 24 ।। saciva uvāca ।। dṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ mahārāja nibodha munimandiram ।। vahnikuṇḍaṃ yajñakāṣṭhakuśapuṣpaphalānvitam ।।25।। kṛṣṇacarmasruvasrugbhiḥ śiṣyasaṃghaiśca saṃkulam ।। taijasādhārasasyādisarvasampadvivarjitam ।। 26 ।। vṛkṣacarmaparīdhānā dṛṣṭāḥ sarve jaṭādharāḥ ।। gṛhaikadeśe dṛṣṭā sā kapilaikā manoharā ।। 27 ।। cārvaṃgī rudravarṇābhā raktapaṅkajalocanā ।। jvalantī tejasā tatra pūrṇacandrasamaprabhā ।। 28 ।। sarvasampadguṇādhārā sākṣādiva haripriyā ।। ityevaṃ bodhito rājā durbuddhiḥ sacivājñayā ।। 29 ।। muniṃ yayāce tāṃ dhenuṃ nibaddhaḥ kālapāśataḥ ।। kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ ca kā buddhiḥ kaḥ kālaḥ sarvato balī।। 30।। puṇyavānbuddhimāndaivādrājendro 'yācata dvijam ।। puṇyātprajāyate karma puṇyarūpaṃ ca bhārate ।। 31 ।। pāpātprajāyate karma pāparūpaṃ bhayāvaham ।। puṇyātkṛtvā svargabhogaṃ janma puṇyasthale nṛṇām ।। 32 ।। pāpādbhuktvā ca narakaṃ kutsitaṃ janma jīvinām ।। jīvināṃ niṣkṛtirnāsti sthite karmaṇi nārada ।। 33 ।। tena kurvanti santaśca santataṃ karmaṇaḥ kṣayam ।। sā vidyā tattapo jñānaṃ sa guruḥ sa ca bāndhavaḥ ।। 34 ।। sā mātā sa pitā putrastatkṣayaṃ kārayettu yaḥ ।। jīvināṃ dāruṇo rogaḥ karmabhogaḥ śubhāśubhaḥ ।। 39 ।। bhaktavaidyastaṃ nihanti kṛṣṇabhaktirasāyanāt ।। māyā dadāti tāṃ bhaktiṃ pratijanmani sevitā ।। 36 ।। parituṣṭā jagaddhātrī bhaktebhyo buddhidāyinī ।। parā parama bhaktāya māyā yasmai dadāti ca ।।37।। māyāṃ tasmai mohayituṃ na vivekaṃ kadācana ।। māyāvimohite rājā munimānīya yatnataḥ ।। ।। 38 ।। uvāca vinayādbhaktyā kṛtāñjalipuṭo mudā ।। 39 ।। rājovāca ।। dehi bhikṣāṃ kalpataro kāmadhenuṃ ca kāmadām ।। mahyaṃ bhaktāya bhakteśa bhaktānugrahakāraka ।। 40।। yuṣmadvidhānāṃ dātṝṇāmadeyaṃ nāsti bhārate ।। dadhīcirdevatābhyaśca dadau svāsthi purā śrutam ।। ।। 41 ।। bhrūbhaṃgalīlāmātreṇa taporāśe tapodhana ।। samūhaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ sraṣṭuṃ śakto'si bhārate ।। 42 ।। muniruvāca ।। aho vyatikramaṃ rājanbravīṣi śaṭha vañcaka ।। dānaṃ dāsyāmi vipro'haṃ kṣatriyāya kathaṃ nṛpa ।। 43 ।। kṛṣṇena dattā goloke brahmaṇe paramātmanā ।। kāmadhenuriyaṃ yajñe na deyā prāṇataḥ priyā ।। 44 ।। brahmaṇā bhṛgave dattā priyaputrāya bhūmipa ।। mahyaṃ dattā ca bhṛguṇā kapilā paitṛkī mama ।।45।। golokajā kāmadhenurdurlabhā bhuvanatraye।। līlāmātrātkathamahaṃ kapilāṃ sraṣṭumīśvaraḥ ।। 46 ।। nāhaṃ re hāliko mūḍhastutyā notthāpito budhaḥ ।। kṣaṇena bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamo'hamatithiṃ vinā ।। 47 ।। gṛhaṃ gaccha gṛhaṃ gaccha me kopaṃ naiva varddhaya ।। putra dārādikaṃ paśya daivabādhita pāmara ।।48।। munestadvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa sa narādhipaḥ ।। natvā muniṃ sainyamadhyaṃ prayayau vidhibādhitaḥ ।। ।। 49 ।। gatvā sainyasakāśaṃ sa kopaprasphuritādharaḥ ।। kiṅkarānpreṣayāmāsa dhenumānayituṃ balāt ।। 50 ।। kapilāsannidhiṃ gatvā ruroda munipuṃgavaḥ ।। kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ śokena hatacetanaḥ ।। 51 ।। rudantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā surabhistamuvāca ha ।। sākṣāllakṣmīsvarūpā sā bhaktānugrahakārikā ।।52।। surabhiruvāca ।। indro vā hāliko vā'pi vastu svaṃ dātumīśvaraḥ ।। śāstā pālayitā dātā svavastūnāṃ ca santatam ।।53।। svecchayā cennṛpendrāya māṃ dadāsi tapodhana ।। tena sārddhaṃ gamiṣyāmi svecchayā ca tavājñayā ।।94।। athavā na dadāsi tvaṃ na gamiṣyāmi te gṛhāt ।। matto dattena sainyena dūrīkuru nṛpaṃ dviṣam ।। 55 ।। kathaṃ rodiṣi sarvajña māyāmohitacetanaḥ ।। saṃyogaśca viyogaśca kālasādhyo na cātmanaḥ ।। 56 ।। tvaṃ vā ko me tavāhaṃ kā sambandhaḥ kālayojitaḥ ।। yāvadeva hi sambandho mamatvaṃ tāvadeva hi ।।57।। mano jānāti yaddravyamātmīyaṃ ceti kevalam ।। duḥkhaṃ ca tasya vicchedādyāvatsvatvaṃ ca tatra vai ।।। ।।। 58 ।। ityuktvā kāmadhenuśca suṣāva vividhāni ca ।। śastrāṇyastrāṇi sainyāni sūryatulyaprabhāṇi ca ।।59।। nirgatāḥ kapilāvaktrāttrikoṭyaḥ khaḍgadhāriṇām ।। vinissṛtā nāsikāyāḥ śūlinaḥ pañca koṭayaḥ ।। 60 ।। vinissṛtā locanābhyāṃ śatakoṭidhanurddharā।। kapālānnissṛtā vīrāstrikoṭyo daṇḍadhāriṇām।। 61 ।। vakṣassthalānnissṛtāśca trikoṭyaśśaktidhāriṇām ।। śatakoṭyo gadāhastāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśādvinirgatāḥ।।62।। vinissṛtāḥ pādatalādvādyabhāṇḍāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। jaṃghādeśānnissṛtāśca trikoṭyo rājaputrakāḥ ।। 63 ।। vinirgatā guhyadeśāttrikoṭimlecchajātayaḥ।। dattvā sainyāni kapilā munaye cābhayaṃ dadau। yuddhaṃ kurvantu sainyāni tvaṃ na yāhītyuvāca ha।।64।। muniḥ sambhūtasambhārairharṣayukto babhūva ha।। nṛpeṇa prerito bhṛtyo nṛpaṃ sarvamuvāca ha।।65।। kapilāsainyavṛttāntamātmavargaparājayam।। tacchrutvā nṛpaśārdūlastrastaḥ kātaramānasaḥ ।। dūtāntsaṃpreṣya sainyāni cājahāra svadeśataḥ।।66।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde ekadantatvapraśnaprasaṅge jadamagnikārttavīryayuddhāraṃbhavarṇanaṃnāma caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 24 ।।
<3.25> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। hariṃ smarankārtavīryyo hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। dūtaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa kupito munisannidhim ।। 1 ।। yuddhaṃ dehi muniśreṣṭha kiṃ vā dhenuṃ ca vāñchitām ।। mahyaṃ bhṛtyāyātithaye suvicāryya yathocitam ।।2।। dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṃgavaḥ ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ sarvaṃ dūtamuvāca ha ।। 3 ।। muniruvāca ।। dṛṣṭo nṛpo nirāhāraḥ samānīto mayā gṛham ।। vividhaṃ ca yathāśaktyā bhojitaśca yathocitam ।।4 ।। kapilāṃ yācate rājā mama prāṇādhikāṃ priyām।। tāṃ dātumakṣamo dūta yuddhaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam ।। 5 ।। munestadvacanaṃ śrutvā dūtaḥ sarvamuvāca ha ।। nṛpendraṃ ca sabhāmadhye sannāhaissaṃyutaṃ bhiyā ।।6।। muniśca kapilāmāha sāmprataṃ kiṅkaromyaham ।। karṇadhāraṃ vinā naukā tathā sainyaṃ vinā mayā।।7।। kapilā ca dadau tasmai śastrāṇi vividhāni ca।। yuddhaśāstropadeśaṃ ca sandhānaṃ caupayogikam।।8।। jayaṃ bhavatu te vipra yuddhe jeṣyasi niścitam ।। tava mṛtyurna bhavitā satyamastraṃ vinā mune ।।9 ।। nṛpeṇa sārddhaṃ te yuddhamayuktaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca ।। dattātreyasya śiṣyeṇa vyarthaṃ vai śaktidhāriṇā ।। ityuktvā kapilā brahmanvirarāma manasvinī ।। 10 ।। munirmanasvī sainyaṃ ca sajjīkṛtya tato mune ।। gṛhītvā sarvasainyaṃ ca sa jagāma raṇājiram।।11।। rājā jagāma yuddhāya nanāma munipuṃgavam ।। ubhayoḥ sainyayoryuddhaṃ babhūva bahuduṣkaram ।। 12 ।। rājasainyaṃ jitaṃ sarvaṃ kapilāsenayā balāt ।। vicitraṃ ca rathaṃ rājño babhañje līlayā raṇe ।। 13 ।। dhanuściccheda sajyaṃ tatsā senā kāpilī mudā।। nṛpendraḥ kāpileyāni jetuṃ sainyāni cākṣamaḥ ।। 14 ।। sainyāni taṃ śastravṛṣṭyā nyastaśastraṃ cakāra ha ।। śaravṛṣṭyā śastravṛṣṭyā rājā mūrcchāmavāpa ha ।। 19 ।। kiñcicchiṣṭaṃ balaṃ rājñaḥ kiṃcideva palāyitam ।। munīndro mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpendramatithiṃ mune ।। 16 ।। kṛpānidhiśca kṛpayā tatsainyaṃ sañjahāra ca ।। gatvā sainyaṃ vilīnaṃ ca kapilāyāṃ ca kṛtrimam ।। 17 ।। nṛpāya muninā śīghraṃ dattāścaraṇareṇavaḥ ।। āśīrvādaṃ pradattaṃ ca jayo'stviti kṛpālunā ।। kamaṇḍalujalaṃ prokṣya jīvayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam ।। 18 ।। sa rājā cetanāṃ prāpya samutthāya raṇājirāt ।। mūrdhnā nanāma bhaktyā ca muniśreṣṭhaṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 19 ।। muniḥ śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā rājānaṃ tvāliliṅga saḥ ।। punastaṃ snāpayitvā ca bhojayāmāsa yatnataḥ ।। 20 ।। navanītaṃ hi hṛdayaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu santatam ।। anyeṣāṃ kṣuradhārābhamasādhyaṃ dāruṇaṃ sadā ।। uvāca taṃ muniśreṣṭho gṛhaṃ gaccha dharādhipa।। ।। 21 ।। rājovāca ।। raṇaṃ dehi mahābāho dhenuṃ kiṃ vā mayepsitām ।। 22 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde jamadagnikārtavīryārjunayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 25 ।।
<3.26> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। hariṃ smaranmuniśreṣṭho vākyaṃ śrutvā ca bhūbhṛtaḥ ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ pravaktusupacakrame ।। 1 ।। muniruvāca ।। gṛhaṃ gaccha mahābhāga rakṣa dharmaṃ sanātanam ।। sarvasampatsthirā śaśvatsthite dharme suniścitam।।2।। tvāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nirāhāraṃ samānīya gṛhaṃ nṛpa।। tava pūjāmakaravaṃ yathāśakti vidhānataḥ।।। sāmprataṃ mūrchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā pādareṇuṃ śubhāśiṣam ।। adadāṃ cetayāñcakre vaktumevocitaṃ na ca ।। 4 ।। nṛpastadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇamya munipuṃgavam ।। rathamanyaṃ tvāruroha yuddhaṃ dehītyuvāca ha ।।5।। muniḥ kṛtvā ca sannāhaṃ taṃ yoddhumupacakrame ।। rājā taṃ yuyudhe tatra kopenāhatacetanaḥ ।। 6 ।। kapilādattaśastreṇa nyastaśastraṃ cakāra tam ।। kapilādattayā śaktyā punarmūrcchāmavāpa ca ।। 7 ।। punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya rājā rājīvalocanaḥ ।। muninā yuyudhe tatra kopena punareva ca ।। 8 ।। āgneyaṃ yojayāmāsa samare nṛpapuṃgavaḥ ।। munirnirvāpayāmāsa vāruṇena ca līlayā ।। 9 ।। nṛpendro vāruṇāstraṃ ca cikṣepa samare munau ।। vāyavyāstreṇa sa muniḥ śamayāmāsa līlayā ।। 10 ।। vāyavyāstraṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaścikṣepa samare tadā ।। gāndharveṇa muniśreṣṭhaḥ śamayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।। 11 ।। nāgāstraṃ ca nṛpaśreṣṭhaścikṣepa raṇamūrddhani ।। gāruḍena muniśreṣṭho
