nijaghāna kṣaṇānmudā ।। 12 ।। māheśvaraṃ mahāstraṃ ca śatasūryyasamaprabham ।। cikṣepa nṛpatiśreṣṭho dyotayantaṃ diśo daśa ।।13।। vaiṣṇavāstreṇa divyena trilokavyāpakena ca ।। munirnirvāpayāmāsa bahuyatnena nārada ।।14।। munirnārāyaṇāstraṃ ca cikṣipe mantrapūrvakam ।। śastraṃ dṛṣṭvā mahārājo nanāma śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 15 ।। ūrdhvaṃ ca bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā kṣaṇaṃ dīptvā diśo daśa ।। pralayāgnisamaṃ tatra svayamantaradhīyata ।।16।। jṛmbhaṇāstraṃ ca sa muniścikṣepa raṇamūrddhani ।। nidrāṃ prāpattena rājā suṣvāpa ca mṛto yathā।।17।। dṛṣṭvā nṛpaṃ nidritaṃ taṃ cārddhacandreṇa tatkṣaṇam ।। ciccheda sārathiṃ yānaṃ dhanurbāṇaṃ munistadā ।। 18।। mukuṭaṃ ca kṣurapreṇa cchatraṃ sannāhameva ca ।। astraṃ tṛṇaṃ vājigaṇaṃ vividhe na ca bhūbhṛtaḥ ।। 19 ।। munistatsacivānsarvānnāgāstreṇaiva līlayā ।। nibadhya sthāpayāmāsa prahasya samarasthale ।। 20।। munistaṃ bodhayāmāsa sumantreṇaiva līlayā ।। nibaddhasarvāmātyānāṃ darśayāmāsa bhūmipam ।। 21 ।। darśayitvā nṛpaṃ tāṃśca mocayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam।। nṛpendramāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ gacchetyuvāca ha ।।22।। rājā kopātsamutthāya śūlamudyamya yatnataḥ ।। cikṣepa taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ muniḥ śaktyā jaghāna tam ।।23।। etasminnantare brahmā samāgatya raṇasthalam ।। sa prītiṃ janayāmāsa sunītyā ca parasparam ।।24।। munirnanāma brahmāṇaṃ santuṣṭaśca raṇasthale ।। rājā natvā vidhiṃ carṣiṃ svapuraṃ prayayau tadā ।।25।। muniryayau svāśramaṃ ca sva lokaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ kiṃcidaparaṃ kathayāmi te ।।26।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇa saṃvāde jamadagnikārtavīryayuddhopaśamavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 26 ।।
<3.27> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। hariṃ smṛtvā gṛhaṃ gatvā rājā vismitamānasaḥ ।। ājagāma mahāraṇye jamadagnyāśramaṃ punaḥ ।। 1 ।। rathānāṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ rathināṃ daśalakṣakam ।। aśvendrāṇāṃ gajendrāṇāṃ padā tīnāmasaṃkhyakam ।।2।। rājendrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca mahābalaparākramam ।। mahāsamṛddhiyuktaśca trailokyaṃ jetumīśvaraḥ ।।3।। sarvato veṣṭayāmāsa jamadagnyāśramaṃ mudā ।। rathastho varmayuktaśca kārttavīryyārjunaḥ svayam ।। 4 ।। sainyaśabdairvādyaśabdairmahākolāhalairmune ।। jamadagnyāśramasthāśca mūrcchāmāpurbhayena ca ।। 5 ।। kuṭīṃ praviśya balavāngṛhītvā kapilāṃ śubhām ।। puraṃ gantuṃ manaścakre durbuddhirasadāśrayaḥ ।। 6 ।। samuttasthau muniśreṣṭho gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। ekākī muktagātraśca dhenuṃ natvā hariṃ smaran ।।7।। āśramasthāñjanānsarvānsamāśvāsya ca yatnataḥ ।। ājagāma raṇasthānaṃ niśśaṅko nṛpateḥ puraḥ ।।8।। nirmame śarajālaṃ ca sa munirmantrapūrvakam ।। ācchādayatsvāśramaṃ tairmānavaṃ varmaṇā yathā ।। 9 ।। aparaṃ śarajālaṃ ca nirmame munipuṅgavaḥ ।। taireva vārayāmāsa sarvasainyaṃ yathākramam ।। 10 ।। muninā śarajālena sarvasainyaṃ samāvṛtam ।। tāni sarvāṇi guptāni yathā patrāṇi pañjare ।। 11 ।। rājā dṛṣṭvā muniśreṣṭhamavaruhya rathātpuraḥ ।। sārddhaṃ nṛpendrairbhaktyā ca praṇanāma kṛtājjaliḥ।।12।। natvā''ruroha yānaṃ sa muneḥ prāpya śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। āruhya ca nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ svayānaṃ hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। ।।13।। nṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaścikṣepa munipuṅgave।। astraṃ śastraṃ gadāṃ śaktiṃ jaghāna krīḍayā muniḥ ।। muniścikṣepa divyāstraṃ cicchide līlayā nṛpaḥ ।। 14 ।। śūlaṃ cikṣepa nṛpatistañjaghāna tadā muniḥ ।। aparaṃ śarajālaṃ ca nirmame munipuṅgavaḥ ।। 15 ।। śastraughairdurnivāryyaiśca khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cakāra ca saḥ ।। nibaddhāśśarajālena na ca śaktāḥ palāyitum ।। 16 ।। jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa muninā te ca sarve vijṛmbhitāḥ ।। hastyaśvarathapādātasahitaṃ sarvasainyakam ।।17।। rājānaṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā na jaghāna munīśvaraḥ ।। gṛhītvā kapilāṃ hṛṣṭo rudantīṃ śokamūrcchitām ।। bodhayitvā puraḥ kṛtvā svāśramaṃ gantumudyataḥ ।। 18 ।। etasminnantare rājā cetanāṃ prāpya nārada ।। nivārayāmāsa muniṃ gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। 19 ।। jagāma kapilā trastā svasthānaṃ ca raṇājirāt ।। muniśca tasthau niśśaṅko gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। 20 ।। brahmāstraṃ ca nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ sa cikṣepa munau tadā ।। brahmāstreṇa munīndrasya sadyo nirvāṇatāṃ gatam ।।21 ।। divyāstreṇa muniśreṣṭho nṛpasya saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। rathaṃ ca sārathiṃ caiva cicchide varma durvaham ।। 22 ।। atha rājā mahākruddho dadarśa svasamīpataḥ ।। dattena dattāṃ śaktiṃ tāmekapūruṣaghātinīm ।।23।। jagrāha natvā dattaṃ taṃ sa natvā śaktimulbaṇām ।। cūrṇayāmāsa tatraiva śatasūryyasamaprabhām।। ।। 24 ।। yattejaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tejo nārāyaṇasya ca ।। śambhośca brahmaṇaścaiva māyāyāścaiva nārada ।। 25 ।। tatraivāvāhayāmāsa sa yogī mantrapūrvakam ।। tejasā dyotayāmāsa gaganaṃ ca diśo daśa ।।26।। dṛṣṭvā kṣipantīṃ tāṃ devā hāhākāreṇa cukruśuḥ।। ākāśasthāśca samaraṃ paśyanto duḥkhitā hṛdā ।। 27 ।। cikṣepa tāṃ cūrṇayitvā kārtavīryyārjunaḥ svayam ।। sadyaḥ papāta sā śaktirjvalantī munivakṣasi ।। 28 ।। vidāryyoro muneḥ śaktirjagāma harisannidhim ।। dattāya hariṇā dattā śastrāstranidhaye tadā ।। 29 ।। mūrcchāṃ samprāpya sa muniḥ prāṇāṃstatyāja tatkṣaṇam ।। tejo'mbare bhramitvā ca brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha ।। 30।। yuddhe muniṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda kapilā muhuḥ।। he tāta tātetyuccāryya golokaṃ sā jagāma ha ।। 31 ।। sarvaṃ sā kathayāmāsa goloke kṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ taṃ gopairgopībhirāvṛtam ।। 32 ।। kṛṣṇena brahmaṇe dattā brahmaṇā bhṛgave purā ।। sā prītyā puṣkare brahmanbhṛguṇā jamadagnaye ।। 33 ।। natvā ca kāmadhenūnāṃ samūhaṃ sā jagāma ha ।। tadaśrubindunā marttye ratnasaṃdho babhūva ha ।।34।। atha rājā taṃ nihatya bodhayitvā svasainyakam ।। prāyaścittaṃ vinirvartya jagāma svapuraṃ mudā ।। 35 ।। prāṇanāthaṃ mṛtaṃ śrutvā jagāma reṇukā satī।। muniṃ vakṣasi saṃsthāpya kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchā mavāpa sā ।। 36 ।। tataḥ sā cetanāṃ prāpya na ruroda pativratā ।। ehi vatsa bhṛgo rāma rāma rāmetyuvāca ha ।। 37 ।। ājagāma bhṛgustūrṇaṃ kṣaṇādvai puṣkarādaho ।। nanāma mātaraṃ bhaktyā manoyāyī ca yogavit ।। 38 ।। dṛṣṭvā rāmo mṛtaṃ tātaṃ śokārtāṃ jananīṃ satīm ।। ākarṇya raṇavṛttāntaṃ prayāntīṃ kapilāṃ śucā ।। 39 ।। vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ tatra he tāta jananīti ca ।। citāṃ cakāra yogī ndraścandanairājyasaṃyutām ।। 40 ।। reṇukā rāmamādāya tūrṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। cucumba gaṇḍe śirasi rurodoccairbhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ।। 41 ।। rāma rāma mahābāho kva yāmi tvāṃ vihāya ca ।। vatsa vatseti kṛtvaivaṃ vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ।। 42 ।। matprāṇādhika he vatsa madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇu ।। pitroḥ śeṣakriyāṃ kṛtvā yāyā yuddhaṃ na putraka ।। 43 ।। gṛhe tiṣṭha sukhaṃ vatsa tapasyāṃ kuru śāśvatīm ।। samaraṃ naiva sukhadaṃ dāruṇaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ saha ।। 44।। māturvacanamaśrutvā pratijñāṃ tāṃ cakāra ha ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi dhruvaṃ mahīm ।। ।। 49 ।। kārtavīryaṃ haniṣyāmi līlayā kṣatriyādhamam ।। pitṝṃśca tarpayiṣyāmi kṣatriyakṣatajaistathā ।। 46 ।। ityudīryya puro māturvilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ bodhayāmāsa mātaram ।। 47 ।। rāma uvāca ।। pituḥ śāsanahantāraṃ piturvadhavidhāyakam ।। yo na hanti mahāmūḍho rauravaṃ sa vrajed dhruvam ।।48।। agnido garadaścaiva śastrapāṇirdhanāpahaḥ ।। kṣetradārāpahārī ca pitṛbandhuvihiṃsakaḥ ।। 49 ।। satataṃ mandakārī ca nindakaḥ kaṭujalpakaḥ।। ekādaśaite pāpiṣṭhā vadhārhā vedasammatāḥ ।। 50 ।। dvijānāṃ draviṇādānaṃ sthānānnirvāsanaṃ sati ।। vapanaṃ tāḍanaṃ caiva vadhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ।। 51 ।। etasminnantare tatra cājagāma bhṛguḥ svayam ।। atitrasto manasvī ca hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 52 ।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ reṇukārāmau vinatau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ।। sa tāvuvāca vedoktaṃ paralokahitāya ca ।। 93 ।। bhṛguruvāca ।। madvaṃśajāto jñānī tvaṃ kathaṃ vilapase suta ।। jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāre ca carācaram ।। 54 ।। satyasāraṃ satyabījaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cintaya putraka ।। yad gataṃ tadgataṃ vatsa gataṃ naivāgamiṣyati ।। 55 ।। yadbhavettadbhavatyeva bhavitā yadbhaviṣyati ।। pūrvārjitaṃ svīyakarma phalaṃ kena nivāryyate ।। 56 ।। bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca yatkṛṣṇena nirūpitam ।। nirūpitaṃ yattatkarma kena vatsa nivāryate ।। 57 ।। māyābījaṃ māyināṃ ca śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam ।। saṃketapūrvakaṃ nāma prātaḥ svapnasamaṃ suta ।। 58 ।। kṣudhā nidrā dayā śāntiḥ kṣamā kāntyādayastathā ।। yānti prāṇā mano jñānaṃ prayāte paramātmani ।। 59 ।। buddhiśca śaktayaḥ sarvā rājendramiva kiṃkarāḥ ।। sarve tamanugacchanti taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja yatnataḥ ।। 60 ।। ke vā keṣāṃ ca pitaraḥ ke vā keṣāṃ sutāḥ suta ।। karmabhiḥ preritāḥ sarve bhavābdhau dustare param ।। 61 ।। jñānino mā rudantyeva mā rodīḥ putra sāmpratam ।। rodanāśruprapatanānmṛtānāṃ narakaṃ dhuvam ।। 62 ।। saṃketākhyoccāraṇena yadrudanti ca bāndhavāḥ ।। śatavarṣaṃ ruditvā taṃ prāpnuvanti na niścitam ।। pārthivāṃśaṃ ca pṛthivī gṛhṇātyasthitvacādikam ।। 63 ।। toyāṃśaṃ ca tathā toyaṃ śūnyāṃśaṃ gaganaṃ tathā ।। vāyvaṃśaṃ ca tathā vāyustejastejoṃśakaṃ tathā ।। 64 ।। sarve vilīnāḥ sarveṣu ko vā''yāsyati rodanāt ।। nāmaśrutiyaśaḥkarma kathāmātrāvaśeṣitaḥ ।। 65 ।। vedoktaṃ caiva yatkarma kuru tatpāralaukikam ।। sa ca bandhuḥ sa putraśca paralokahitāya yaḥ ।। 66 ।। bhṛgostadvacanaṃ śrutvā śokaṃ tatyāja tatkṣaṇam ।। reṇukā ca mahāsādhvī taṃ vastumupacakrame ।। 67 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde jamadagnisaṃhāraparaśurāmapratijñādivarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 27 ।।
<3.28> reṇukovāca ।। brahmannanugamiṣyāmi prāṇanāthasya sāmpratam । ṛtoścaturthadivase mṛto'yaṃ cādya mānadaḥ ।। 1 ।। karttavyā kā vyavasthā'tra vada vedavidāṃ vara।। tvamāgato me sahasā puṇyena katijanmanām ।।2।। bhṛguruvāca ।। aho puṇyavato bharturanugaccha mahāsati ।। caturthadivasaṃ śuddhaṃ svāminaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। 3 ।। śuddhā bharttuścaturthe'hni na śuddhā daivapitryayoḥ ।। daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pañcame'hni viśuddhyati ।। 4 ।। vyālagrāhī yathā vyālaṃ bilāduddharate balāt ।। tadvatsvāminamādāya sādhvī svargaṃ prayāti ca ।।5।। modate svāminā tatra yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। ata ūrdhvaṃ karmabhogaṃ bhuṅkṣva sādhvi śubhāśubham ।। 6 ।। sa putro bhaktidātā yaḥ sā ca strī yā'nugacchati ।। sa bandhurdānadātā yaḥ sa śiṣyo gurumarcayet ।। 7 ।। so'bhīṣṭadevo yo rakṣetsa rājā pālayetprajāḥ ।। sa ca svāmī priyāṃ dharme matiṃ dātumiheśvaraḥ ।। 8 ।। sa gururdharmadātā yo haribhaktipradāyakaḥ ।। ete praśaṃsyā vedeṣu purāṇeṣu ca niścitam ।। 9 ।। reṇukovāca ।। gantuṃ svasvāminā sārddhaṃ kā śaktā bhārate mune ।। kā vā'pyaśaktā nārīṣu tanme brūhi tapodhana ।। 10 ।। bhṛguruvāca ।। bālāpatyāśca garbhiṇyo hyadṛṣṭaṛtavastathā ।। rajasvalā ca kulaṭā galitavyādhisaṃyutā ।। 11 ।। patisevāvihīnā yā hyabhaktā kaṭubhāṣiṇī ।। etā gacchanti ceddaivānna kāntaṃ prāpnuvanti tāḥ ।। 12 ।। saṃskṛtāgniṃ puro dattvā citāsu śayitaṃ patim ।। kāntāstamanugacchanti kāntāścetprāpnuvanti tāḥ ।। 13 ।। anugacchanti yāḥ kāntaṃ tameva prāpnuvanti tāḥ ।। sārddhaṃ kṛtvā puṇyabhogaṃ divi janmani janmani ।। 14 ।। iyaṃ te kathitā sādhvi vyavasthā gṛhiṇāṃ dhruvam ।। tīrthe jñānamṛtānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ gatiṃ śṛṇu।। ।। 15 ।। yā sādhvī vaiṣṇavaṃ kāntaṃ yatra yatrānugacchati ।। prayāti svāminā sārddhaṃ vaikuṇṭhe harisannidhim ।। 16 ।। viśeṣo nāsti bhaktānāṃ tīrthe vā'nyatra nārada ।। maraṇena phalaṃ tulyaṃ muktānāṃ kṛṣṇabhāvinām ।। 17 ।। tayoḥ pāto nāsti tasmānmahati pralayaṃ sati ।। nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ bhajeta pumānstrī kamalālayām ।। 18 ।। tīrthe jñānamṛtaścāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti niścitam ।। sabhāryo modate tatra yāvadvai brahmaṇāṃ śatam ।। 19 ।। ityuktvā reṇukāṃ tatra jāmadagnyamuvāca ha ।। vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaṃ sa bhṛguḥ samayocitam ।। 20 ।। ehi vatsa mahābhāga tyaja śokamamaṅgalam ।। uttānaṃ kuru tātaṃ ca dakṣiṇāśirasaṃ bhṛgo ।। 21 ।। vastrayajñopavītaṃ ca nūtanaṃ paridhāpaya ।। anaśrunayano bhūtvā santiṣṭhandakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ।। 22 ।। araṇīsaṃbhavāgniṃ ca gṛhāṇa prītipūrvakam ।। pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni sarveṣāṃ smaraṇaṃ kuru ।। 23 ।। gayādīni ca tīrthāni ye ca puṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ ।। kurukṣetraṃ ca gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ ca saridvarām ।।24।। kauśikīṃ candrabhāgāṃ ca sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm ।। gaṇḍakīmatha kāśīṃ ca panasāṃ sarayūṃ tathā ।। 25 ।। puṣpabhadrāṃ ca bhadrāṃ ca narmadāṃ ca sarasvatīm ।। godāvarīṃ ca kāverīṃ svarṇarekhāṃ ca puṣkaram ।। 26 ।। raivataṃ ca varāhaṃ ca śrīśailaṃ gandhamādanam ।। himālayaṃ ca kailāsaṃ sumeruṃ ratnaparvatam ।। 27 ।। vārāṇasīṃ prayāgaṃ ca puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। haridvāraṃ ca badarīṃ smāraṃsmāre punaḥ punaḥ ।। 28 ।। candanāgarukastūrīsugandhikusumaṃ tathā ।। pradāya vāsasā''cchādya sthāpayainaṃ citopari ।। 29 ।। karṇākṣināsikāsye tvaṃ śalākāṃ ca hiraṇmayīm ।। kṛtvā nirmanthanaṃ tāta viprebhyo dehi sādaram ।। 30।। satilaṃ tāmrapātraṃ ca dhenuṃ ca rajataṃ tathā ।। sadakṣiṇaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dattvā'gniṃ dehyakātaraḥ ।। 31 ।। oṃ kṛtvā duṣkṛtaṃ karmma jānatā vā'pyajānatā ।। mṛtyukālavaśaṃ prāpya naraṃ pañcatvamāgatam ।। 32 ।। dharmādharmasamāyuktaṃ lobhamohasamāvṛtam ।। daha sarvāṇi gātrāṇi divyām̐llokānsa gacchatu ।। ।। 33 ।। imaṃ mantraṃ paṭhitvā tu tātaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ।। mantreṇānena dehyagniṃ janakāya hariṃ smaran ।। 34 ।। oṃ asmatkule tvaṃ jāto'si tvadīyo jāyatāṃ punaḥ ।। asau svargāya lokāya svāheti vada sāmpratam ।।35।। agniṃ dehi śiraḥsthāne he bhṛgo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ।। taccakāra bhṛguḥ sarvaṃ sagotrairājñayā bhṛgoḥ ।। 36 ।। atha putraṃ reṇukā sā kṛtvā tatra svavakṣasi ।। uvāca kiṃcidvacanaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 37 ।। avirodho bhavābdhau ca sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। virodho nāśabījaṃ ca sarvopadravakāraṇam ।। 38 ।। akartavyo virodho vai dāruṇaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ saha ।। pratijñā caiva karttavyā madīye vacane śrute ।।39 ।। ālocya brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ bhṛguṇā divyamantriṇā ।। yathocitaṃ ca kartavyaṃ sadbhirālocanaṃ śubham ।। 40।। ityuktvā taṃ parityajya kāntaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi।। sā suṣvāpa citāyāṃ ca paśyantī taṃ harismṛtiḥ ।।41।। vahniṃ dadau citāyāṃ ca sa rāmo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ।। bhrātṛbhiḥ pitṛśiṣyaiśca sārddhaṃ sa vilalāpa ca ।। 42 ।। rāma rāmeti rāmeti vākyamuccāryya sā satī ।। purastājjāmadagnyasya bhasmībhūtā babhūva sā।।43।। bharturnāma samākarṇya tatrājagmurhareścarāḥ।। rathasthāḥ śyāmavarṇāśca sarve cārucaturbhujāḥ ।। 44 ।। śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇo vanamālinaḥ ।। kirīṭinaḥ kuṇḍalinaḥ pītakauśeyavāsasaḥ ।।45।। rathe kṛtvā reṇukāṃ tāṃ gatvā te brahmaṇaḥ padam ।। jamadagniṃ samādāya prajagmurharisannidhim ।।46।। tau dampatī ca vaikuṇṭhe tasthaturharisannidhau ।। kṛtvā dāsyaṃ hareḥ śaśvatsarvamaṅgalamaṅgalam ।। 47 ।। atha rāmo brāhmaṇaiśca bhṛguṇā saha nārada ।। pitroḥ śeṣakriyāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau ।। 48 ।। gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi divyaśayyāṃ manoramām ।। suvarṇādhārasahitāṃ jalamannaṃ ca candanam ।। 49 ।। ratnadīpaṃ raupyaśailaṃ suvarṇāsanamuttamam ।। suvarṇādhārasahitaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam ।। 50।। chatraṃ ca pāduke caiva phalaṃ mālyaṃ manoharam ।। phalaṃ mūlādikaṃ caiva miṣṭānnaṃ ca manoharam ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dattvā brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ ।। 51 ।। dadarśa brahmalokaṃ sa śātakumbhavinirmitam ।। svarṇaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ svarṇastambhairvibhūṣitam ।। 52 ।। dadarśa tatra brahmāṇaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 53 ।। siddhaistapaścāndrāyaṇairṛṣīndraiḥ pariveṣṭitam ।। vidyādharīṇāṃ nṛtyaṃ ca paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।।54।। saṃgītamupaśṛṇvantaṃ gīyamānaṃ ca gāyakaiḥ ।। candanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumena virājitam ।।55।। tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। dhātāraṃ sarvajagatāṃ kartāraṃ ceśvaraṃ param ।। 56 ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma japantaṃ kṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। guhyayogaṃ pravocantaṃ pṛcchantaṃ śiṣyamaṇḍalam ।। 57 ।। dṛṣṭvā tamavyayaṃ bhaktyā praṇanāma bhṛguḥ puraḥ ।। uccaiśca rodanaṃ kṛtvā svavṛttāntamuvāca ha।। ।। 58 ।। bhṛguruvāca ।। brahmaṃstvadvaṃśajāto'haṃ jamadagnisuto vidhe ।। pitāmahastvamasmākaṃ sarvajñaṃ kathayāmi kim ।। 59 ।। mṛgayāmāgataṃ bhūpaṃ pitā me copavāsinam ।। pāraṇāṃ kārayāmāsa kapilādattavastunā ।। 60 ।। sa rājā kapilālobhātkārtavīryyārjunaḥ svayam ।। ghātayāmāsa mattātamityuktvoccai ruroda saḥ ।।61।। nirudhya bāṣpaṃ sa punaruvāca karuṇānidhiḥ ।। mātā me'nugatā sādhvī māṃ vihāya jagadguro ।। 62 ।। adhunā'hamanāthaśca tvaṃ me mātā pitā guruḥ ।। kartā pālayitā dātā pāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।।63।। āgato'haṃ tava sabhāṃ pramāturmāturājñayā ।। upāyena jagannātha madvairihananaṃ kuru ।।64।। sa rājā sa ca dharmiṣṭhaḥ sa dayāluryaśaskaraḥ ।। sa pūjyaḥ sa sthiraśrīśca yo dīnaṃ paripālayet ।। 65 ।। dhanidīnau samaṃ dṛṣṭvā yaḥ prajāṃ na ca pālayet ।। taddehādyāti ruṣṭā śrīḥ sa bhavedbhraṣṭarājyakaḥ ।। 66 ।। śrutvā viprabaṭorvākyaṃ karuṇāsāgaro vidhiḥ ।। dattvā śubhāśiṣaṃ tasmai vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 67 ।। śrutvā bhṛgoḥ pratijñāṃ ca vismitaścaturānanaḥ ।। atīva duṣkarāṃ ghorāṃ bahujīvavighātinīm ।। 68 ।। karmaṇā tadbhavetsarvamiti kṛtvā tu mānase ।। uvāca jāmadagnyaṃ taṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।।69।। brahmovāca ।। pratijñā duṣkarā vatsa vahujīvavighātinī।। sṛṣṭireṣā bhagavataḥ sambhavedīśvarecchayā ।। 70 ।। sṛṣṭiḥ sṛṣṭā mayā putra kleśenaiveśvarājñayā ।। sṛṣṭiluptau pratijñā te dāruṇā'karuṇā parā ।। 71 ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kartumicchasi medinīm ।। ekakṣattriyadoṣeṇa tajjātiṃ hantumicchasi ।। 72 ।। brahmakṣattriyaviṭchūdrairnityā sṛṣṭiścaturvidhaiḥ ।। āvirbhūtā tirobhūtā harereva punaḥ punaḥ ।। 73 ।। anyathā tvatpratijñā ca bhavitā prāktanena te ।। bahvāyāsena te kāryyasiddhirbhavitumarhati ।। 74 ।। śivalokaṃ gaccha vatsa śaṅkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। pṛthivyāṃ bahavo bhūpāḥ santi śaṅkarakiṅkarāḥ ।। ।। 75 ।। vinā'jñayā maheśasya ko vā tānhantumīśvaraḥ ।। bibhrataḥ kavacaṃ divyaṃ śaktervai śaṅkarasya ca ।। 76 ।। upāyaṃ kuru yatnena jayabījaṃ śubhāvaham ।। upāyataḥ samārabdhāḥ sarve siddhyantyupakramāḥ ।। 77 ।। śrīkṛṣṇamantrakavacagrahaṇaṃ kuru śaṅkarāt ।। durlabhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ śaivaṃ śāktaṃ vijeṣyati ।। 78 ।। guruste jagatāṃ nāthaḥ śivo janmani janmani ।। mantro matto na yuktaste yo yuktaḥ sa bhavedvidhiḥ ।। 79 ।। karmaṇā labhyate mantraḥ karmaṇā labhyate guruḥ ।। svayamevopatiṣṭhante ye yeṣāṃ teṣu te dhuvam ।। 80 ।। trailokya vijayaṃ nāma gṛhītvā kavacaṃ varam ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyasi mahīṃ bhṛgo ।। 81 ।। divyaṃ pāśupataṃ tubhyaṃ dātā dāsyati śaṃkaraḥ ।। tena dattena mantreṇa kṣatrasaṃghaṃ vijeṣyasi ।। 82 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde bhṛgorbrahmalokagamane brahmoktopāyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 28 ।।
<3.29> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā praṇamya ca jagadgurum।। sphītastasmādvaraṃ prāpya śivalokaṃ jagāma saḥ ।। 1 ।। lakṣayojanamūrdhvaṃ ca brahmalokādvilakṣaṇam ।। anirvācyasuśobhāḍhyaṃ vāyvādhāraṃ manoharam ।। 2 ।। vaikuṇṭhaṃ dakṣiṇe yasya gaurīlokaśca vāmataḥ ।। yadadho dhuvalokaśca sarvalokātparaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 3 ।। teṣāmūrdhvaṃ ca golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanaḥ ।। ata ūrdhvaṃ na lokaśca sarvopari ca sa smṛtaḥ ।। 4 ।। manoyāyī sa yogīndraḥ śivalokaṃ dadarśa ha ।। upamānopameyābhyāṃ rahitaṃ mahadadbhutam ।।5।। yogīndrāṇāṃ vareṇyaiśca siddhavidyāviśāradaiḥ।। koṭikalpatapaḥpūtaiḥ puṇyavadbhirniṣevitam।।6।। veṣṭitaṃ kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ samūhairvāñchitapradaiḥ ।। samūhaiḥ kāmadhenūnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ virājitam ।। 7 ।। pārijātatarūṇāṃ ca vanarājivirājitam ।। puṣpodyānāyutairyuktaṃ sadā cātisuśobhitam ।। 8 ।। maṇīndrasāraracitaiḥ śobhitairmaṇivedibhiḥ ।। rājamārgaśatairdivyaiḥ sarvataḥ paribhūṣitam ।।9।। maṇīndrāsāranirmāṇaśatakoṭigṛhairyutam ।। nānācitravicitrāḍhyairmaṇīndrakalaśojjvalaiḥ ।। 10 ।। tanmadhyadeśe ramye ca dadarśa śaṅkarālayam ।। maṇīndrasāraracitaprākāraṃ sumanoharam ।। 11 ।। atyūrdhvamambarasparśi kṣīranīranibhaṃ param ।। ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ śatamandiraiḥ ।। 12 ।। amūlyaratnaracitai ratnasopānabhūṣitaiḥ ।। ratnastambhakapāṭaiśca hīrakeṇa pariṣkṛtaiḥ ।। 13 ।। māṇikyajālamālābhiḥ sadratnakalaśojjvalaiḥ ।। nānāvicitracitreṇa citritaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। 14 ।। ālayasya purastatra siṃhadvāraṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। ratnendrasārakhacitakapāṭaiśca virājitaiḥ ।। 15 ।। śobhitaṃ vedikābhiśca bāhyābhyantarataḥ sadā ।। racitābhiḥ padmarāgairmahāmarakatairgṛham ।। 16 ।। nānāprakāracitreṇa citritaṃ sumanoharam ।। karālarūpāvadrākṣīd dvārapālau bhayaṃkarau ।। ।। 17 ।। mahākarāladantāsyau viraktau raktalocanau ।। dagdhaśailapratīkāśau mahābalaparākramau ।। 18 ।। vibhūtibhūṣitāṃgau ca vyāghracarmāmbarau varau ।। piṅgalākṣau viśālākṣau jaṭilau ca trilocanau ।।19।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharau jvalantau brahmatejasā ।। tau dṛṣṭvā manasā bhītastrastaḥ kiñciduvāca ha ।। 20 ।। vinayena vinītaśca durvinītau mahābalau ।। ātmanaḥ sarvavṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa tatpuraḥ ।। ।। 21 ।। viprasya vacanaṃ śrutvā kṛpāyuktau babhūvatuḥ ।। gṛhītvā''jñāṃ caradvārā śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 22 ।। praveṣṭumājñāṃ dadaturīśvarānucarau varau ।। bhṛgustadājñāmādāya praviveśa hariṃ smaran ।। 23 ।। pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśa dvāro dadarśa sumanoharāḥ ।। dvārapālairniyuktāśca nānācitravicitritāḥ ।। 24 ।। dṛṣṭvā tā mahadāścaryyādapaśyacchūlinaḥ sabhām ।। nānāsiddhagaṇākīrṇāṃ maharṣigaṇasevitām ।। 25 ।। pārijātasugandhāḍhyavāyunā surabhīkṛtām ।। dadarśa tatra deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ candraśekharam ।। 26 ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ param।। vibhūtibhūṣitāṃgaṃ taṃ nāgayajñopavītinam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।।27।। mahāśivaṃ śivakaraṃ śivabījaṃ śivāśrayam।। ātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabham ।। 28 ।। īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। śaśvajjyotissvarūpaṃ ca lokānugrahavigraham।।29।। dhṛtavantaṃ jaṭājālaṃ dakṣakanyāsamanvitam ।। tapasāṃ phaladātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 30।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ pañca vaktraṃ trilocanam ।। guhyaṃ brahma pravocantaṃ śiṣyebhyastattvamudrayā ।। 31 ।। stūyamānaṃ ca yogīndraiḥ siddhendraiḥ parisevitam ।। pārṣadapravaraiśśaśvatsevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ।।32।। dhyāyamānaṃ paraṃ brahma paripūrṇatamaṃ param।। svecchāmayaṃ guṇātītaṃ jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param।।33।। jyotīrūpaṃ ca sarvādyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। dhyāyantaṃ paramānandaṃ pulakāñcitavigraham ।। susvaraṃ sāśrunetraṃ tamudgāyantaṃ guṇārṇavam ।। 34 ।। bhūtendrairvai rudragaṇaiḥ kṣetrapālaiśca veṣṭitam ।। mūrdhnā nanāma paraśurāmo dṛṣṭvā tamādarāt ।। 35 ।। tadvāme kārttikeyaṃ ca dakṣiṇe ca gaṇeśvaram ।। nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ vīrabhadraṃ ca tatpuraḥ ।। aṃke dadarśa kāntāṃ tāṃ gaurīṃ śailendrakanyakām ।। 36 ।। nanāma sarvānmūrdhnā ca bhaktyā ca parayā mudā ।। dṛṣṭvā haraṃ paraṃ toṣātstotuṃ samupacakrame ।।37।। sagadgadapadaṃ dīnassāśrunetro'tikātaraḥ ।। kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śāntaḥ śokārtaḥ śokanāśanam ।। 38 ।। paraśurāma uvāca ।। īśa tvāṃ stotumicchāmi sarvathā stotumakṣamaḥ ।। akṣarākṣayabījaṃ ca kiṃ vā staumi nirīhakam ।।39।। na yojanāṃ karttumīśo deveśaṃ staumi mūḍhadhīḥ ।। vedā na śaktā yaṃ stotuṃ kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ ।। ।। 40।। vāgbuddhimanasāṃ dūraṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam ।। jñānamātreṇa sādhyaṃ ca siddhaṃ siddhairniṣevitam।। 41।। yamākāśamivādyantamadhyahīnaṃ tathā'vyayam ।। viśvatantramatantraṃ ca svatantraṃ tantrabījakam ।। 42 ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyamatisādhyaṃ kṛpānidhim ।। trāhi māṃ karuṇāsindho dīnabandho'tidīnakam ।। 43 ।। adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ।। svapne'pyadṛṣṭaṃ bhaktaiścādhunā paśyāmi cakṣuṣā ।। 44 ।। śakrādayaḥ suragaṇāḥ kalayā yasya sambhavāḥ ।। carācarāḥ kalāṃśena taṃ namāmi maheśvaram ।। 45 ।। strīrūpaṃ klībarūpaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ ca bibharti yaḥ ।। sarvādhāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ taṃ namāmi maheśvaram ।। 46 ।। yaṃ bhāskarasvarūpaṃ ca śaśirūpaṃ hutāśanam ।। jalarūpaṃ vāyurūpaṃ taṃ namāmi maheśvaram ।। 47 ।। anantaviśvasṛṣṭīnāṃ saṃhartāraṃ bhayaṃkaram ।। kṣaṇena līlāmātreṇa taṃ namāmi maheśvaram ।।48।। yaḥ kālaḥ kālakālaśca kalirbījaṃ ca kālajaḥ।। ajaḥ prajaśca yaḥ sarvastaṃ namāmi maheśvaram।।49।। ityevamuktvā sa bhṛguḥ papāta caraṇāmbuje ।। āśiṣaṃ ca dadau tasmai suprasanno babhūva saḥ ।। 50 ।। jāmadagnyakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktisaṃyutaḥ ।। sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati ।। 51 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde paraśurāmasya kailāsagamananāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 29 ।।
<3.30> śaṃkara uvāca ।। kastvaṃ vaṭo kasya putraḥ kva vāsaḥ stavanaṃ katham ।। kiṃ vā te'haṃ kariṣyāmi vāñchitaṃ vada sāmpratam ।। 1 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। śokākulaṃ tvāṃ paśyāmi vimanaskaṃ suvismitam ।। vayasā'tiśiśuṃ śāntaṃ guṇena guṇināṃ varam।।2।। bhṛguruvāca ।। jamadagnisuto'haṃ ca bhṛguvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ।। reṇukā'mbā me paraśurāmo'haṃ nāmataḥ prabho ।।3।। krīṇīhi māṃ dayāsindho vidyāpaṇyena kiṃkaram ।। tvāmīśaḥ śaraṇāpannaṃ rakṣa māṃ dīnavatsala ।। 4 ।। mṛgayāmāgataṃ bhūpaṃ pitā me copavāsinam।। cakārātithyamānīya kapilādattavastunā ।। 5 ।। rājā taṃ kapilālobhādghātayāmāsa mandadhīḥ ।। kapilā taṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā golokaṃ ca jagāma sā ।।6।। mātā'nugamanaṃ cakre hyanātho'haṃ ca sāmpratam ।। tvaṃ me pitā śivā mātā rakṣa māṃ putravatprabho ।। 7 ।। mayā kṛtā pratijñā ca śokenaivātiduṣkarā ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi mahīmiti ।। 8 ।। kārtavīryyaṃ haniṣyāmi samare tātaghātakam ।। ityetatparipūrṇaṃ me bhagavānkartumarhati ।। 9 ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā durgāmukhaṃ haraḥ ।। babhūvānamravaktraśca sā ca śuṣkauṣṭhatālukā ।। 10 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। tapasvinvipraputrastvaṃ nirbhūpāṃ kartumicchasi ।। trissaptakṛtvaḥ kopena sāhasaste mahānbaṭo ।। 11 ।। hantumicchasi niḥśastraḥ sahasrārjunamīśvaram ।। bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā yasya rāvaṇasya parājayaḥ ।। 12 ।। tasmai pradattaṃ dattena śrīhareḥ kavacaṃ baṭo ।। śaktiravyartharūpā ca yayā te hiṃsitaḥ pitā ।। 13 ।। harermmantraṃ saṃstavanaṃ yaḥ paṭhecca divāniśam ।। ko vā śaknoti taṃ hantuṃ na paśyāmīha bhūtale ।। 14 ।। aye vipra gṛhaṃ gaccha kiṃ kariṣyati śaṃkaraḥ ।। anye bhūpāśca madbhṛtyāḥ kā bhīsteṣāṃ mayi sthite।।15।। kālyuvāca।। aye vipra baṭo jālma nirbhūpānkartumicchasi।। yathā hi vāmanaścandraṃ kareṇāhartumicchati।।16।। kṛtayajñānmahāpuṇyānmahābalaparākramān ।। digambarasahāyena madbhṛtyānhantumicchasi ।। 17 ।। sa tayorvacanaṃ śrutvā rurodoccaiśca śokataḥ ।। sahasā puratasteṣāṃ prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 18 ।। viprasya rodanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkaraḥ karuṇānidhiḥ ।। paśyandurgāṃ ca kālīṃ ca jñātvā''śayamatho vibhuḥ ।। 19 ।। tayoranumatiṃ prāpya sarveśo bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। jamadagnisutaṃ sadyaḥ pravaktumupacakrame ।। 20 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। adyaprabhṛti he vatsa tvaṃ me putrasamo mahān ।। dāsyāmi mantraṃ guhyaṃ te triṣu lokeṣu durllabham ।। 21 ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ ca kavacaṃ dāsyāmi paramādbhutam ।। līlayā matprasādena kārttavīryaṃ haniṣyasi ।। 22 ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyasi mahīṃ dvija ।। jagatte yaśasā pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 23 ।। ityuktvā śaṃkarastasmai dadau mantraṃ sudurlabham ।। trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 24 ।। stavaṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca puraścaraṇapūrvakam ।। mantrasiddheranuṣṭhānaṃ yathāvanniyamakramam ।। 25 ।। siddhisthānaṃ kālasaṃkhyaṃ kathayāmāsa nārada ।। vedavedāṅgādikaṃ ca pāṭhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।। 26 ।। nāgapāśaṃ pāśupataṃ brahmāstraṃ ca sudurlabham ।। nārāyaṇāstramāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā ।। 27 ।। gāndharvaṃ gāruḍaṃ caiva jṛmbhaṇāstraṃ tathaiva ca ।। gadāṃ śaktiṃ ca paraśuṃ śūlamavyarthamuttamam ।। 28 ।। nānāprakāraśastrāstramantraṃ ca vidhipūrvakam ।। śastrāstrāṇāṃ ca saṃhāraṃ tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau ।। 29 ।। ātmarakṣaṇasandhānaṃ saṃgrāmavijayakramam ।। māyāyuddhaṃ ca vividhaṃ huṃkāraṃ mantrapūrvakam ।। 30 ।। rakṣaṇaṃ ca svasainyānāṃ parasainyavimardanam ।। nānāprakāramatulamupāyaṃ raṇasaṃkaṭe ।। saṃhāre mohinīṃ vidyāṃ dadau mṛtyuharāṃ haraḥ ।। 31 ।। sthitvā ciraṃ gurorvāṃse sarvavidyāṃ vibodhya saḥ ।। tīrthe kṛtvā mantrasiddhiṃ tāṃśca natvā jagāma saḥ ।।32।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde paraśurāmasya śivadattāstraśastrādiprāptivarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।30।।
<3.31> nārada uvāca।। bhagavañchrotumicchāmi kiṃ mantraṃ bhagavānharaḥ ।। kṛpayā'dātparaśurāmāya stotraṃ ca varma ca ।। 1।। ko vā'sya mantrasyārādhyaḥ kiṃ phalaṃ kavacasya ca ।। stavanasya phalaṃ kiṃ vā tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। mantrārādhyo hi bhagavānparipūrṇatamaḥ svayam ।। golokanāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo gopagopīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 3 ।। trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। stavarājaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhūtiyogasamudbhavam ।। 4 ।। mantraṃ kalpataruṃ nāma sarvakāmaphalapradam ।। dadau paraśurāmāya ratnaparvatasannidhau ।।5 ।। svayaṃprabhānadītīre pārijātavanāntare ।। āśrame lokadevasya mādhavasya ca sannidhau ।। 6 ।। mahādeva uvāca ।। vatsāgaccha mahābhāga bhṛguvaṃśasamudbhava ।। putrādhiko'si premṇā me kavacagrahaṇaṃ kuru ।। 7 ।। śṛṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi brahmāṇḍe paramādbhutam ।। trailokyavijayaṃ nāma śrīkṛṣṇasya jayāvaham ।। 8 ।। śrīkṛṣṇena purā dattaṃ goloke rādhikāśrame ।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhye ca mahyaṃ vṛndāvane vane ।। 9 ।। atiguhyataraṃ tattvaṃ sarvamantraughavigraham ।। puṇyātpuṇyataraṃ caiva paraṃ snehādvadāmi te ।। 10 ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanāddevī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। śumbhaṃ niśumbhaṃ mahiṣaṃ raktabījaṃ jaghāna ha ।। 11 ।। yaddhṛtvā'haṃ ca jagatāṃ saṃharttā sarvatattvavit।। avadhyaṃ tripuraṃ pūrvaṃ durantamapi līlayā ।। 12 ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbrahmā sasṛje sṛṣṭimuttamām ।। yaddhṛtvā bhagavāñcheṣo vidhatte viśvameva ca ।। 13 ।। yaddhṛtvā kūrmarājaśca śeṣaṃ dhatte hi līlayā ।। yaddhṛtvā bhagavānvāyurviśvādhāro vibhuḥ svayam ।। 14 ।। yaddhṛtvā varuṇaḥ siddhaḥ kuberaśca dhaneśvaraḥ ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādindro devānāmadhipaḥ svayam ।। ।। 15 ।। yaddhṛtvā bhāti bhuvane tejorāśiḥ svayaṃ raviḥ ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanāccandro mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। 16 ।। agastyaḥ sāgarānsapta yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātpapau ।। cakāra tejasā jīrṇaṃ daityaṃ vātāpisaṃjñakam ।। 17 ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanāddevī sarvādhārā vasundharā ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanātpūtā gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī ।। 18 ।। yaddhṛtvā jagatāṃ sākṣī dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ।। sarvavidyādhidevī sā yacca dhṛtvā sarasvatī ।।19।। yaddhṛtvā jagatāṃ lakṣmīrannadātrī parātparā ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādvedānsāvitrī sā suṣāva ca ।। 20।। vedāśca dharmmavaktāro yaddhṛtvā paṭhanād bhṛgo ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanācchuddhastejasvī havyavāhanaḥ ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānyaddhṛtvā jñānināṃ varaḥ।।21।। dātavyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktāya sādhave ca mahātmane ।। śaṭhāya paraśiṣyāya dattvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।। 22।। trailokyavijayasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ।। ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo rāseśvaraḥ svayam ।।23।। trailokyavijayaprāptau viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। parātparaṃ ca kavacaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham।।24।। praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ sadā ।। pāyātkapālaṃ kṛṣṇāya svāhā pañcākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ ।।25।। kṛṣṇeti pātu netre ca kṛṣṇa svāheti tārakam ।। haraye nama ityevaṃ bhrūlatāṃ pātu me sadā ।। 26 ।। oṃ goviṃdāya svāheti nāsikāṃ pātu santatam ।। gopālāya namo gaṇḍau pātu me sarvataḥ sadā ।। 27 ।। oṃ namo gopāṅganeśāya karṇau pātu sadā mama ।। oṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ śaśvatpātu me'dharayugmakam ।। 28 ।। oṃ govindāya svāheti dantaughaṃ me sadā'vatu ।। pātu kṛṣṇāya dantādho dantordhvaṃ klīṃ sadā'vatu ।। 29 ।। oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti jihvikāṃ pātu me sadā।। rāseśvarāya svāheti tālukaṃ pātu me sadā।। 30।। rādhikeśāya svāheti kaṇṭhaṃ pātu sadā mama ।। namo gopāṅganeśāya vakṣaḥ pātu sadā mama।।31।। oṃ gopeśāya svāheti skandhaṃ pātu sadā mama।। namaḥ kiśoraveṣāya svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu।।32।। udaraṃ pātu me nityaṃ mukundāya namaḥ sadā।। oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya svāheti karau pātu sadā mama ।।33।। oṃ viṣṇave namo bāhuyugmaṃ pātu sadā mama।। oṃ hrīṃ bhagavate svāhā nakharaṃ pātu me sadā।।34।। oṃ namo nārāyaṇāyeti nakharandhraṃ sadā'vatu।। oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ padmanābhāya nābhiṃ pātu sadā mama ।। 35 ।। oṃ sarveśāya svāheti kaṅkālaṃ pātu me sadā ।। oṃ gopīramaṇāya svāhā nitambaṃ pātu me sadā ।। 36 ।। oṃ gopīramaṇanāthāya pādau pātu sadā mama ।। oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ rasikeśāya svāhā sarvaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 37 ।। oṃ keśavāya svāheti mama keśānsadā'vatu ।। namaḥ kṛṣṇāya svāheti brahmarandhraṃ sadā'vatu ।। 38।। oṃ mādhavāya svāheti me lomāni sadā'vatu।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ rasikeśāya svāhā sarvaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 39 ।। paripūrṇatamaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prācyāṃ māṃ sarvadā'vatu ।। svayaṃ golokanātho māmāgneyyāṃ diśi rakṣatu ।। 40 ।। pūrṇabrahmasvarūpaśca dakṣiṇe māṃ sadā'vatu ।। nairṛtyāṃ pātu māṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paścime pātu māṃ hariḥ ।। 41 ।। govindaḥ pātu māṃ śaśvadvāyavyāṃ diśi nityaśaḥ ।। uttare māṃ sadā pātu rasikānāṃ śiromaṇiḥ ।। 42 ।। aiśānyāṃ māṃ sadā pātu vṛndāvanavihārakṛt ।। vṛndāvanīprāṇanāthaḥ pātu māmūrdhvadeśataḥ ।। 43 ।। sadaiva mādhavaḥ pātu balihārī mahābalaḥ ।। jale sthale cāntarikṣe nṛsiṃhaḥ pātu māṃ sadā ।। 44 ।। svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvatpātu māṃ mādhavaḥ sadā ।। sarvāntarātmā nirliptaḥ pātu māṃ sarvato vibhuḥ ॥ 45 ॥ iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ॥ trailokyavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ॥ 46 ॥| mayā śrutaṃ kṛṣṇavaktrātpravaktavyaṃ na kasyacit ॥ gurumabhyarcya vidhivatkavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ॥ 47 ॥ kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so'pi viṣṇurna saṃśayaḥ ॥ sa ca bhakto vasedyatra lakṣmīrvāṇī vasettataḥ ॥ 48 ॥ yadi syātsiddhakavaco jīvanmukto bhavettu saḥ ॥ niścitaṃ koṭivarṣāṇāṃ pūjāyāḥ phalamāpnuyāt ॥ 49 ॥ rājasūyasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca॥ aśvamedhāyutānyeva naramedhāyutāni ca ॥50॥ mahādānāni yānyeva prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā ॥ trailokyavijayasyāsya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ॥ 51 ॥ vratopavāsaniyamaṃ svādhyāyādhyayanaṃ tapaḥ ॥ snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu nāsyārhanti kalāmapi ॥ 52 ।॥ siddhatvamamaratvaṃ ca dāsatvaṃ śrīharerapi ॥ yadi syātsiddhakavacaḥ sarvaṃ prāpnoti niścitam।। sa bhavetsiddhakavaco daśalakṣaṃ japettu yaḥ।। yo bhavetsiddhakavacaḥ sarvajñaḥ sa bhaveddhruvam।।54।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā bhajetkṛṣṇaṃ sumandadhīḥ।। koṭikalpaṃ prajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ।।55।। gṛhītvā kavacaṃ vatsa mahīṃ niḥkṣatriyāṃ kuru।। trissaptakṛtvo niśśaṃkaḥ sadānando hi līlayā ॥ 56 ॥। rājyaṃ deyaṃ śiro deyaṃ prāṇā deyāśca putraka ॥| evaṃbhūtaṃ ca kavacaṃ na deyaṃ prāṇasaṃkaṭe ॥ 57 ॥ iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde paraśurāmāya śrīkṛṣṇakavacapradānaṃ nāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ।।31।।
<3.32> bhṛguruvāca।। samprāptaṃ kavacaṃ nāṣa śaśvatsarvāṅgarakṣaṇam।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ śatrusaṃhārakāraṇam॥1॥ adhunā bhagavanmantraṃ stotraṃ pūjāvidhiṃ prabho ॥ dehi mahyamanāthāya śaraṇāgatapālaka ॥2॥ mahādeva uvāca ॥ oṃ śrīṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya paripūrṇatamāya svāhā॥ mantreṣu mantrarājo'yaṃ mahānsaptadaśākṣaraḥ ॥3॥ siddho'yaṃ pañcalakṣeṇa japena munipuṃgavaḥ॥ taddaśāṃśaṃ ca havanaṃ taddaśāṃśābhiṣecanam ॥ tarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśaṃ ca taddaśāṃśaṃ ca mārjanam ॥ suvarṇānāṃ ca śatakaṃ puraścaraṇadakṣiṇā ॥ 4 ॥ mantrasiddhasya puṃsaśca viśvaṃ karatale mune ॥ śaktaḥ pātuṃ samudrāṃśca viśvaṃ saṃhartumīśvaraḥ ॥ 9 ॥ pāñcabhautikadehena vaikuṇṭhaṃ gantumīśvaraḥ ॥ tasya saṃsparśamātreṇa padapaṅkajareṇunā ॥ pūtāni sarvatīrthāni sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ॥ 6 ॥| dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ śṛṇu manmukhato mune ।। sarveśvarasya kṛṣṇasya bhaktimuktipradāyi ca ।। 7 ।। navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ nīlendīvaralocanam ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyamīṣaddhāsyaṃ manoharam ।। 8 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlādhāmamanoharam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ taṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 9 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ varam ।। vīkṣyamāṇaṃ ca gopībhiḥ sasmitābhiśca santatam ।। 10 ।। praphullamālatīmālāvanamālā vibhūṣitam ।। dadhataṃ kundapuṣpāḍhyāṃ cūḍāṃ candrakacarccitām ।। 11 ।। prabhāṃ kṣipantīṃ nabhasaścandratārānvitasya ca ।। ratnabhūṣitasarvāṃgaṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam।।12।। siddhendraiśca munīndraiśca devendraiḥ parisevitam।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśaiśca śrutibhiśca stutaṃ bhaje।।13।। dhyānenānena taṃ dhyātvā copacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ।। dattvā bhaktyā ca saṃpūjya sarvajñatvaṃ labhetpumān ।।14।। arghyaṃ pādyaṃ cāsanaṃ ca vasanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ tathā।। gāmarghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca yajñasūtramanuttamam ।।15।। dhūpadīpau ca naivedyaṃ punarācamanīyakam ।। nānāprakārapuṣpāṇi tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam।। ।।16।। manoharaṃ divyatalpaṃ kastūryagarucandanaiḥ।। bhaktyā bhagavate deyaṃ mālyaṃ puṣpāñjalitrayam ।। 17 ।। tataḥ ṣaḍaṃgaṃ sampūjya paścātsa mpūjayedgaṇam।। śrīdāmānaṃ sudāmānaṃ vasudāmānameva ca।।18।। haribhānuṃ candrabhānuṃ sūryyabhānuṃ subhānukam।। pārṣadapravarānsapta pūjayedbhaktibhā vataḥ।।19।। gopīśvarīṃ rādhikāṃ ca mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm।। kṛṣṇaśaktiṃ kṛṣṇapūjyāṃ pūjayedbhaktipūrvakam ।। 20 ।। gopagopīgaṇaṃ śāntaṃ māṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca pārvatīm ।। lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ pṛthvīṃ sarvadevaṃ sapārṣadam।।21।। devaṣaṭkaṃ samabhyarcya punaḥ pañcopacārataḥ।। paścādevaṃ krameṇaiva śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ ।।22।। gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ।। devaṣaṭkaṃ samabhyarcya ceṣṭadevaṃ ca pūjayet ।। 23 ।। gaṇeśaṃ vighnanāśāya vyādhināśāya bhāskaram ।। ātmanaḥ śuddhaye vahniṃ śrīviṣṇuṃ muktihetave ।। 24 ।। jñānāya śaṅkaraṃ durgāṃ paramaiśva ryyahetave ।। sampūjane phalamidaṃ viparītamapūjane ।।25।। tataḥ kṛtvā parīhāramiṣṭadevaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ।। stotraṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ paṭhedbhaktyā ca tacchṛṇu।।26।। mahādeva uvāca ।। paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paraṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam।। nirliptaṃ paramātmānaṃ namāmyakhilakāraṇam।।27।। sthūlātsthūlatamaṃ devaṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatamaṃ param ।। sarvadṛśyamadṛśyaṃ ca svecchācāraṃ namāmyaham ।। 28 ।। sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ prabhum ।। sarvādhāraṃ ca sarvaṃ ca svecchārūpaṃ namāmyaham ।।29।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ nirupamaṃ vibhum ।। karālarūpamatyantaṃ bibhrataṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 30 ।। karmmaṇaḥ karmarūpaṃ taṃ sākṣiṇaṃ sarvakarmaṇaḥ ।। phalaṃ ca phaladātāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 31 ।। sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā kalayā mūrtibhedataḥ ।। nānāmūrtiḥ kalāṃśena yaḥ pumāṃstaṃ namāmyaham ।। 32 ।। svayaṃ prakṛtirūpaśca māyayā ca svayaṃ pumān ।। tayoḥ paraṃ svayaṃ śaśvattannamāmi parātparam ।। 33 ।। strīpunnapuṃsakaṃ rūpaṃ yo bibharti svamāyayā ।। svayaṃ māyā svayaṃ māyī yo devastaṃ namāmyaham ।। 34 ।। tārakaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। dhārakaṃ sarvaviśvānāṃ sarvabījaṃ namāmyaham ।। 35 ।। tejasvināṃ raviryo hi sarvajātiṣu vāḍavaḥ ।। nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca yaścandrastaṃ namāmi jagatprabhum ।। 36 ।। rudrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jñānināṃ yo hi śaṅkaraḥ ।। nāgānāṃ yo hi śeṣaśca taṃ namāmi jagatpatim ।। 37 ।। prajāpatīnāṃ yo brahmā siddhānāṃ kapilaḥ svayam ।। sanatkumāro muniṣu taṃ namāmi jagadgurum।।38।। devānāṃ yo hi viṣṇuśca devīnāṃ prakṛtiḥ svayam।। svāyambhuvo manūnāṃ yo mānaveṣu ca vaiṣṇavaḥ।। nārīṇāṃ śatarūpā ca bahurūpaṃ namāmyaham ।।39।। ṛtūnāṃ yo vasantaśca māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣakaḥ ।। ekādaśī tithīnāṃ ca namāmyakhilarūpiṇam ।। 40।। sāgaraḥ saritāṃ yaśca parvatānāṃ himālayaḥ ।। vasundharā sahiṣṇūnāṃ taṃ sarvaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।41।। patrāṇāṃ tulasīpatraṃ dārurūpeṣu candanam ।। vṛkṣāṇāṃ kalpavṛkṣo yastaṃ namāmi jagatpatim ।। 42 ।। puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaśca sasyānāṃ dhānyameva ca ।। amṛtaṃ bhakṣyavastūnāṃ nānārūpaṃ namāmyaham।।43।। airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām ।। kāmadhenuśca dhenūnāṃ sarvarūpaṃ namāmyaham।।44।। taijasānāṃ suvarṇaṃ ca dhānyānāṃ yava eva ca ।। yaḥ kesarī paśūnāṃ ca vararūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 49 ।। yakṣāṇāṃ ca kubero yo grahāṇāṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। dikpālānāṃ mahendraśca taṃ namāmi paraṃ varam ।। 46 ।। vedasaṃghaśca śāstrāṇāṃ paṇḍitānāṃ sarasvatī ।। akṣarāṇāmakāro yastaṃ pradhānaṃ namāmyaham ।। 47 ।। mantrāṇāṃ viṣṇumantraśca tīrthānāṃ jāhnavī svayam ।। indriyāṇāṃ mano yo hi sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ namāmyaham ।। ।। 48 ।। sudarśanaṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ vyādhināṃ vaiṣṇavo jvaraḥ ।। tejasāṃ brahmatejaśca vareṇyaṃ taṃ namāmyaham ।। 49 ।। balaṃ yo vai balavatāṃ mano vai śīghragāminām ।। kālaḥ kalayatāṃ yo hi taṃ namāmi vilakṣaṇam ।। 50।। jñānadātā gurūṇāṃ ca mātṛrūpaśca bandhuṣu । mitreṣu janmadātā yastaṃ sāraṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।51।। śilpināṃ viśvakarmā yaḥ kāmadevaśca rūpiṇām ।। pativratā ca patnīnāṃ namasyaṃ taṃ namāmyaham ।। 52 ।। priyeṣu putrarūpo yo nṛparūpo nareṣu ca ।। śālagrāmaśca yantrāṇāṃ taṃ viśiṣṭaṃ namāmyaham ।। 53 ।। dharmmaḥ kalyāṇabījānāṃ vedānāṃ sāmavedakaḥ ।। dharmmāṇāṃ satyarūpo yo viśiṣṭaṃ taṃ namāmyaham ।। 54 ।। jale śaityasvarūpo yo gandharūpaśca bhūmiṣu ।। śabdarūpaśca gagane taṃ praṇamya namāmyaham ।। 55 ।। kratūnāṃ rājasūyo yo gāyatrī chandasāṃ ca yaḥ ।। gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathastaṃ gariṣṭhaṃ namāmyaham ।।56।। kṣīrasvarūpo gavyānāṃ pavitrāṇāṃ ca pāvakaḥ।। puṇyadānāṃ ca yaḥ stotraṃ taṃ namāmi śubhapradam ।।57।। tṛṇānāṃ kuśarūpo yo vyādhirūpaśca vairiṇām ।। guṇānāṃ śāntarūpo yaścitrarūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 58 ।। tejorūpo jñānarūpaḥ sarvarūpaśca yo mahān।। sarvānirvacanīyaṃ ca taṃ namāmi svayaṃ vibhum।।59।। sarvādhāreṣu yo vāyuryathā''tmā nityarūpiṇām ।। ākāśo vyāpakānāṃ yo vyāpakaṃ taṃ namāmyaham ।। 60 ।। vedānirvacanīyaṃ yanna stotuṃ paṇḍitaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। yadanirvacanīyaṃ ca ko vā tatstotumīśvaraḥ ।। 61 ।। vedā na śaktā yaṃ stotuṃ jaḍībhūtā sarasvatī ।। taṃ ca vāṅmanasāpāraṃ ko vidvānstotumīśvaraḥ ।।62।। śuddhatejassvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śyāmarūpaṃ namāmyaham ।।63।। dvibhujaṃ muralīvaktraṃ kiśoraṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। śaśvadgopāṅganābhiśca vīkṣyamāṇaṃ namāmyaham।।64।। rādhayā dattatāmbūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ manoharam।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca tamīśaṃ praṇamāmyaham।।65।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ।। pārṣadapravarairgopakumāraistaṃ namāmyaham।।66।। vṛndāvanāntare ramye rāsollāsasamutsukam।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ namāmi rasikeśvaram ।। 67 ।। śataśṛṅge mahāśaile goloke ratnaparvate ।। virajāpuline ramye praṇamāmi vihāriṇam।।68।। paripūrṇatamaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ।। satyaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ ca nityaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ namāmyaham ।। 69 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya stotramidaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sa dātā bhārate bhavet ।। 70 ।। haridāsyaṃ harau bhaktiṃ labhetstotraprasādataḥ ।। iha loke jagatpūjyo viṣṇutulyo bhaveddhruvam ।। 71 ।। sarvasiddheśvaraḥ śānto'pyante yāti hareḥ padam ।। tejasā yaśasā bhāti yathā sūryyo mahītale।।72।। jīvanmuktaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ sa bhavennātra saṃśayaḥ ।। arogī guṇavānvidvānputravāndhanavānsadā ।। 73 ।। ṣaḍabhijño daśabalo manoyāyī bhaveddhruvam ।। sarvajñaḥ sarvadaścaiva sa dātā sarvasampadām ।। kalpavṛkṣasamaḥ śaśvadbhavetkṛṣṇaprasādataḥ ।। 74 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ vatsa tvaṃ gaccha puṣkaram ।। tatra kṛtvā mantrasiddhiṃ paścātprāpsyasi vāñchitam ।। 75 ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kuru pṛthvīṃ yathāsukham ।। mamāśiṣā muniśreṣṭha śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādataḥ ।। 76 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde stavapradānaṃ nāma dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।32।।
<3.33> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śivaṃ praṇamya sa bhṛgurdurgāṃ kālīṃ mudā'nvitaḥ ।। gatvā puṣkaratīrtha ca mantrasiddhiṃ cakāra ha।1।। sa babhūva nirāhāro māsaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ ।। dhyāyankṛṣṇapadāmbhojaṃ vāyurodhaṃ cakāra saḥ ।।2।। dadarśa cakṣurunmīlya gaganaṃ tejasā vṛtam ।। diśo daśa dyotayantaṃ samācchannadivākaram ।।3।। tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ ratnayānaṃ dadarśa ha ।। dadarśa tatra puruṣamatyantaṃ sundaraṃ varam।।4।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। praṇamya daṇḍavanmūrdhnā varaṃ vavre tamīśvaram ।।5।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi mahīmiti ।। pādāravinde sudṛḍhāṃ tāṃ bhaktimanapāyinīm।।6।। dāsyaṃ sudurllabhaṃ śaśvavatpādābje ca dehi me ।। kṛṣṇastasmai varaṃ dattvā tatraivāntaradhīyata।।7।। bhṛguḥ praṇamya bhavanaṃ tajjagāma parātparam।। paspanda dakṣiṇāṅgaṃ ca paraṃ maṅgalasūcakam।।8।। vāñchā pratītijananaṃ susvapnaṃ ca dadarśa ha ।। manaḥ prasannaṃ sphītaṃ ca tadbabhūva divāniśam ।। bhāṣya svajanaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhe tasthau mudā'nvitaḥ ।। ।। 9 ।। svaśiṣyānpitṛśiṣyāṃśca bhrātṛvargāṃśca bāndhavān ।। ānīyānīya vividhānmantrāṃśca sa cakāra ha ।। 10।। paurvāparyyaṃ svavṛttāntaṃ tānevoktvā śubhakṣaṇe ।। taireva sārddhaṃ balavānbabhūva gamanonmukhaḥ ।। 11 ।। dadarśa maṅgalaṃ rāmaḥ śuśrāva jayasūcakam ।। bubudhe manasā sarvaṃ svajayaṃ vairisaṃkṣayam।।12।। yātrākāle ca purataḥ śuśrāva sahasā muniḥ ।। hariśabdaṃ siṃhaśabdaṃ ghaṇṭādundubhivādanam।।13।। ākāśavāṇīsaṃgītaṃ jayaste bhaviteti ca ।। naveṅgitaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ meghaśabdaṃ jayāvaham ।।14।। cakāra yātrāṃ bhagavāñchrutvaivaṃ vividhaṃ śubham ।। dadarśa purato viprabandidaivajñabhikṣukān ।।15।। jvalatpradīpaṃ dadhatīṃ patiputravatīṃ satīm।। puro dadarśa smerāsyāṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। ।। 16 ।। śivaṃ śivāṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ cāṣaṃ ca nakulaṃ tathā ।। gacchandadarśa rāmaśca yātrāmaṃgalasūcakam ।। 17 ।। kṛṣṇasāraṃ gajaṃ siṃhaṃ turagaṃ gaṇḍakaṃ dvipam ।। camarīṃ rājahaṃsaṃ ca cakravākaṃ śukaṃ pikam ।। 18 ।। mayūraṃ khañjanaṃ caiva śaṃkhacillaṃ cakorakam ।। pārāvataṃ balākaṃ ca kāraṇḍaṃ cātakaṃ caṭam ।। 19 ।। saudāmanīṃ śakracāpaṃ sūryyaṃ sūryāprabhāṃ śubhām ।। sadyomāṃsaṃ sajīvaṃ ca matsyaṃ śaṅkhaṃ suvarṇakam ।। 20 ।। māṇikyaṃ rajataṃ muktāṃ maṇīndraṃ ca pravālakam ।। dadhi lājāñchukladhānyaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ ca kuṅkumam ।। 21 ।। parṇaṃ patākāṃ chatraṃ ca darpaṇaṃ śvetacāmaram ।। dhenuṃ vatsaprayuktāṃ ca rathasthaṃ bhūmipaṃ tathā ।। 22 ।। dugdhamājyaṃ tathā pūgamamṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā ।। śālagrāmaṃ pakvaphalaṃ svastikaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ।।23।। mārjjāraṃ ca vṛṣendraṃ ca meṣaṃ parvatamūṣikam ।। meghācchannasya ca raverudayaṃ candramaṇḍalam'।। ।। 24 ।। kastūrīṃ vyajanaṃ toyaṃ haridrāṃ tīrthamṛttikām ।। siddhārthaṃ sarṣapaṃ dūrvāṃ vipravālaṃ ca bālikām ।। 25 ।। mṛgaṃ veśyāṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ ca karpūraṃ pītavāsasam ।। go mūtraṃ gopurīṣaṃ ca godhūliṃ gopadāṅkitam ।। 26 ।। goṣṭhaṃ gavāṃ vartma ramyāṃ gośālāṃ gogatiṃ śubhām ।। bhūṣaṇaṃ devamūrtiṃ ca jvaladagniṃ mahotsavam ।।27।। tāmraṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ vandyaṃ sindūraṃ mālyacandanam ।। gandhaṃ ca hīrakaṃ ratnaṃ dadarśa dakṣiṇe śubham ।।28।। sugandhivāyorāghrāṇaṃ prāpa viprāśiṣaṃ śubhām ।। 29 ।। ityevaṃ maṅgalaṃ jñātvā prayayau sa mudā'nvitaḥ ।। astaṃ gate dinakare narmmadātīrasannidhau।। 30।। tatrākṣayavaṭaṃ divyaṃ dadarśa sumanoharam ।। atyūrdhvaṃ vistṛtamatipuṇyāśramapadaṃ param।।3 1।। paulastyatapasaḥ sthānaṃ sugandhimarudanvitam।। kārtavīryyārjunābhyāśe tatra tasthau gaṇaiḥ saha।।32।। suṣvāpa puṣpaśayyāyāṃ kiṅkaraiḥ parisevitaḥ।। nidrāṃ yayau pariśrāntaḥ paramānandasaṃgataḥ।।33।। niśātīte ca sa bhṛguścāru svapnaṃ dadarśa ha ।। na cintitaṃ yanmanasā vāyupittakaphaṃ vinā ।। 34 ।। gajāśvaśailaprāsādagovṛkṣaphaliteṣu ca ।। āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ rudantaṃ kṛmibhakṣitam ।। 35 ।। āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ naukāyāṃ candanokṣitam ।। dhṛtavantaṃ puṣpamālāṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā ।। 36 ।। viṇmūtrokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ vasāpūyasamanvitam ।। vīṇāṃ varāṃ vādayantamātmānaṃ ca dadarśa ha ।। 37 ।। vistīrṇapadmapattraiśca svaṃ dadarśa sarittaṭe ।। dadhyājyamadhusaṃyuktaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca pāyasam ।। 38 ।। bhuktavantaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ labhantaṃ brāhmaṇāśiṣam।। phalapuṣpapradīpaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha।।39। paripakvaphalaṃ kṣīramuṣṇānnaṃ śarkarānvitam ।। svastikaṃ bhuktavantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 40 ।। jalaukasā vṛścikena mīnena bhujagena ca ।। bhakṣitaṃ bhītamātmānaṃ palāyantaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। ।। 41 ।। tato dadarśa cātmānaṃ maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryyayoḥ ।। patiputravatīṃ nārīṃ paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ dvijaḥ ।। 42 ।। suveṣayā kanyakā sa smitena dvijena ca ।। dadarśa śliṣṭamātmānaṃ tuṣṭena parituṣṭayā ।। 43 ।। phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ devatāpratimāṃ nṛpam ।। gajasthaṃ ca rathasthaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha ।। 44 ।। pītavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitām ।। viśantīṃ brāhmaṇo gehaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha ।। 45 ।। śaṃkhaṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ śvetamālāṃ muktāṃ ca candanam ।। suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha ।। 46 ।। gajaṃ vṛṣaṃ ca sarpaṃ ca śvetaṃ ca śvetacāmaram ।। nīlotpalaṃ darpaṇaṃ ca bhārgavo vai dadarśa ha ।। 47 ।। rathasthaṃ navaratnāḍhyaṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ svaṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।। 48 ।। padmaśreṇīṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ dadhi lājānghṛtaṃ madhu ।। parṇacchatraṃ chatriṇaṃ ca bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।। 49 ।। bakapaṃktiṃ haṃsapaṃktiṃ kanyāpaṃktiṃ vratānvitām ।। pūjayanto ghaṭaṃ śubhraṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।। 50 ।। maṇḍapasthaṃ dvijagaṇaṃ pūjayantaṃ haraṃ harim ।। jayo'stvityuktavantaṃ taṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।। 51 ।। sudhāvṛṣṭiṃ parṇavṛṣṭiṃ phalavṛṣṭiṃ ca śāśvatīm ।। puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiṃ ca bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।। 52 ।। sadyomāṃsaṃ jīvamatsyaṃ mayūraṃ śvetakhañjanam ।। sarovaraṃ ca tīrthāni bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।। 53 ।। pārāvataṃ śukaṃ cāṣaṃ śaṃkhaṃ cillaṃ ca cātakam ।। vyāghraṃ siṃhaṃ ca surabhīṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।54।। gorocanāṃ haridrāṃ ca śukladhānyācalaṃ varam ।। jvaladagniṃ tathā dūrvāṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।55।। devālayasamūhaṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ ca pūjitam ।। arcitāṃ mṛnmayīṃ śaivāṃ bhṛguḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।। 56 ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ।। bhṛgurdadarśa svapne ca bubhuje ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 57 ।। divyavastraparīdhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।। agamyāgamanaṃ svapne cakāra bhṛgunandanaḥ ।।58।। dadarśa narttakīṃ veśyāṃ rudhiraṃ ca surāṃ papau ।। rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgaḥ svapne ca bhṛgunandanaḥ ।। 59 ।। pakṣiṇāṃ pītavarṇānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca nārada ।। māṃsāni bubhuje rāmo hṛṣṭaḥ svapne'ruṇodaye ।। 60 ।। akasmānnigaḍairbaddhaṃ kṣataṃ śastreṇa svaṃ punaḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā ca bubudhe prātaḥ samuttasthau hariṃ smaran।। 61 ।। atīva hṛṣṭaḥ svapnena prātaḥkṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। manasā bubudhe sarvaṃ vijeṣyāmi ripuṃ dhruvam ।। 62 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivatte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapati khaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 33 ।।
<3.34> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sa prātarāhnikaṃ kṛtvā samālocya ca taiḥ saha ।। dūtaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa kārttavīryyāśramaṃ bhṛguḥ ।।1।। sa dūtaḥśīghramāgatya vasantaṃ rājasaṃsadi ।। veṣṭitaṃ sacivaiḥ sārddhamuvāca nṛpatīśvaram ।। 2 ।। rāmadūta uvāca ।। narmmadātīrasānnidhye nyagrodhākṣayamūlake ।। sa bhṛgurbhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ tatra tvaṃ gantumarhasi ।। 3 ।। yuddhaṃ kuru mahārāja jātibhirjñātibhiḥ saha ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyati mahīmiti ।। 4 ।। ityuktvā rāmadūtaścāpyagacchadrāmasannidhim ।। rājā vidhāya sannāhaṃ samaraṃ gantumudyataḥ ।। 5 ।। gacchantaṃ samaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prāṇeśaṃ sā manoramā ।। tameva vārayāmāsa vāsayāmāsa sannidhau ।। 6 ।। rājā manoramāṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। tāmuvāca sabhāmadhye vākyaṃ mānasikaṃ mune ।। 7 ।। kārttavīryyārjuna uvāca।। māmevāhvayate kānte jamadagnisuto mahān ।। sa tiṣṭhannarmmadātīre raṇāya bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ।। 8 ।। samprāpya śaṅkarācchastraṃ mantraṃ ca kavacaṃ hareḥ ।' trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kartumicchati medinīm ।। 9 ।। āndolayanti me prāṇā manaḥ saṃkṣubhitaṃ muhuḥ ।। śaśvatsphurati vāmāṅgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ svapnaṃ śṛṇu priye ।। 10 ।। tailābhyaṅgitamātmānamapaśyaṃ gardabhopari ।। auḍhapuṣpasya mālyaṃ ca bibhrataṃ raktacandanam ।। 11 ।। raktavastraparīdhānaṃ lohālaṅkārabhūṣitam ।। krīḍantaṃ ca hasantaṃ ca nirvāṇāṅgārarāśinā ।। 12 ।। bhasmācchannāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ japāpuṣpānvitāṃ sati ।। rahitaṃ candrasūryyābhyāṃ rastasandhyānvitaṃ nabhaḥ ।। 13 ।। muktakeśāṃ ca nṛtyantīṃ vidhavāṃ chinnanāsikām ।। raktavastraparīdhānāmapaśyaṃ cāṭṭahāsinīm ।। 14 ।। saśarāmagnirahitāṃ citāṃ bhasmasamanvitām ।। bhasmavṛṣṭimasṛgvṛṣṭimagnivṛṣṭimapīśvari ।। 19 ।। pakva tālaphalākīrṇāṃ pṛthivīmasthisaṃyutām।। apaśyaṃ karparaughaṃ ca chinnakeśanakhānvitam ।।16।। parvataṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca rāśībhūtaṃ kapardakam।। cūrṇānāṃ caiva tailānāmadṛśaṃ kandaraṃ niśi ।।17।। adṛśaṃ puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣamaśokakaravīrayoḥ ।। tālavṛkṣaṃ ca phalitaṃ tatra caiva patatphalam ।। 18 ।।। svakarātpūrṇakalaśaḥ papāta ca babhañja ca ।। ityapaśyaṃ ca gaganātsampataccandramaṇḍalam ।।19।। apaśyamambarātsūryyamaṇḍalaṃ samampatadbhuvi ।। ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ grahaṇaṃ candrasūryyayoḥ ।। 20 ।। vikṛtākārapuruṣaṃ vikaṭāsyaṃ digambaram ।। āgacchantaṃ cāgratastamapaśyaṃ ca bhayānakam ।। 21 ।। bālā dvādaśāvarṣīyā vastrabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। saṃruṣṭā yāti madgehādityapaśyamahaṃ niśi ।। 22 ।। ājñāṃ tvaṃ dehi rājendra tvadgehādyāmi kānanam ।। vadasi tvaṃ māmiti ca niśyapaśyamahaṃ śucā ।। 23 ।। ruṣṭo vipro māṃ śapate saṃnyāsī ca tathā guruḥ ।। bhittau puttalikāścitrā nṛtyantīśca dadarśa ha ।। 24 ।। cañcalānāṃ ca gṛdhrāṇāṃ kākānāṃ nikaraiḥ sadā ।। pīḍitaṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca svamapaśyamahaṃ niśi ।। 25 ।। pīḍitaṃ tailayantreṇa bhrāmitaṃ tailakāriṇā ।। digambarānpāśahastānapaśyamahamīśvari ।। 26 ।। nṛtyanti gāyakāḥ sarve gānaṃ gāyanti me gṛhe ।। vivāhaṃ paramānandamityapaśyamahaṃ niśi ।। 27 ।। ramaṇaṃ kurvato lokānkeśākeśi ca kurvataḥ ।। adṛśaṃ samaraṃ rātrau kākānāṃ ca śunāmapi ।। 28 ।। moṭakāni ca piṇḍāni śmaśānaṃ śavasaṃyutam ।। raktavastraṃ śuklavastramapaśyaṃ niśi kāmini ।। 29 ।। kṛṣṇāmbarā kṛṣṇavarṇā nagnā vai muktakeśinī।। vidhavā''śliṣyati ca māmapaśyaṃ niśi śobhane ।। ।। 30 ।। nāpito muṇḍate muṇḍaṃ śmaśruśreṇīṃ ca me priye ।। vakṣaḥsthalaṃ ca nakharamityapaśyamahaṃ niśi ।। 31 ।। pādukā carmarajjūnāmapaśyaṃ rāśimulbaṇam ।। cakraṃ bhramantaṃ bhūmau ca kulālasyeti sundari ।। 32 ।। vātyayā ghūrṇamānaṃ ca śuṣkavṛkṣaṃ tamutthitam ।। pūrṇamānaṃ kabandhaṃ vai cāpaśyaṃ niśi suvrate ।। 33 ।। grathitāṃ muṇḍamālāṃ ca cūrṇamānāṃ ca vātyayā ।। atīva ghoradaśanāmapyapaśyamahaṃ vare ।। 34 ।। bhūtapretā muktakeśā vamantaśva hutāśanam ।। māṃ bhīṣayanti satatamityapaśyamahaṃ niśi ।। 35 ।। dagdhajīvaṃ dagdhavṛkṣaṃ vyādhigrastaṃ naraṃ param ।। aṅgahīnaṃ ca vṛṣalamapyapaśyamahaṃ niśi ।। 36 ।। gehaparvatavṛkṣāṇāṃ sahasā patanaṃ param ।। muhurmuhurvajrapātamapyapaśyamahaṃ niśi ।। 37 ।। kukkurāṇāṃ śṛgālānāṃ rodanaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। gṛhe gṛhe ca niyatamapaśyaṃ sarvato niśi ।। 38 ।। adhaśśirastūrddhvapādaṃ muktakeśaṃ digambaram ।। bhūmau bhramantaṃ gacchantaṃ cāpyapaśyamahaṃ naram ।। 39 ।। vikṛtākāraśabdaṃ ca grāmādau deva rodanam ।। prātaḥ śrutvaivāvabuddhaḥ ka upāyo vadādhunā ।। 40 ।। nṛpatervacanaṃ śrutvā hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। sagadgadaṃ ca rudatī tamuvāca nṛpeśvaram ।। 41 ।। manoramovāca ।। he nātha ramaṇaśreṣṭha śreṣṭha sarvamahībhṛtām ।। prāṇātireka prāṇeśa śṛṇu vākyaṃ śubhāvaham ।।42।। nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavāñjāmadagnyo mahābalī ।। sṛṣṭisaṃharturīśasya śiṣyo'yaṃ jagataḥ prabhoḥ ।। 43 ।। triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi mahīmiti ।। pratijñā yasya rāmasya tena sārddhaṃ raṇaṃ tyaja ।। 44 ।। pāpinaṃ rāvaṇaṃ jitvā śūraṃ tvamapi manyase ।। sa tvayā na jito nātha svapāpena parājitaḥ ।। 45 ।। yo na rakṣati dharmmaṃ ca tasya ko rakṣitā bhuvi ।। sa naśyati svayaṃ mūḍho jīvannapi mṛto hi saḥ ।। 46 ।। śubhāśubhasya satataṃ sākṣī dharmmasya karmaṇaḥ ।। ātmārāmaḥ sthitaḥ svānto mūḍhastvaṃ nahi paśyasi ।।47।। putradārādikaṃ yadyatsarvaiśvaryyaṃ sudharmiṇām ।। jalabudbudavatsarvamanityaṃ naśvaraṃ nṛpa ।।48।। saṃsāraṃ svapnasadṛśaṃ matvā santo'tra bhārate।। dhyāyanti satataṃ dharmmaṃ tapaḥ kurvanti bhaktitaḥ ।। 49 ।। dattena dattaṃ yajjñānaṃ tatsarvaṃ vismṛtaṃ tvayā ।। asti cedviprahiṃsāyāṃ kubuddhe tvanmanaḥ katham ।। 50 ।। sukhārthe mṛgayāṃ gatvā tatropoṣya dvijāśrame ।। bhuktvā miṣṭamapūrvaṃ ca hato vipro nirarthakam ।। 51 ।। guru viprasurāṇāṃ ca yaḥ karoti parābhavam ।। abhīṣṭadevastaṃ ruṣṭo vipattistasya sannidhau ।। 52 ।। smaraṇaṃ kuru rājendra dattātreyapadāmbujam ।। gurau bhaktiśca sarveṣāṃ sarvavighnavināśinī ।। 53 ।। gurudevaṃ samabhyarcya taṃ bhṛguṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। vipre deve prasanne ca kṣattriyāṇāṃ nahi kṣatiḥ ।। 54 ।। viprasya kiṃkaro bhūpo vaiśyo bhūpasya bhūmipa ।। sarveṣāṃ kiṅkarāḥ śūdrā brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ ।। 59 ।। ayaśaḥ śaraṇaṃ śaśvatkṣatriyasya ca kṣatriye ।। mahadyaśastaccharaṇaṃ gurudevadvijeṣu ca ।। 96 ।। brāhmaṇaṃ bhaja rājendra garīyāṃsaṃ surādapi ।। brāhmaṇe parituṣṭe ca santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ।।57।। ityevamuktvā rājendraṃ kroḍe kṛtvā mahāsatī।। muhurmuhurmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpa ruroda ca ।।58।। kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha mahārāja punarevamuvāca sā ।। snānaṃ kuru mahārāja bhojayiṣyāmi vāñchitam ।। 59 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkarpūraiḥ kuṃkumairyutam ।। anulepaṃ kariṣyāmi sarvāṃge tava sundara ।। 60।। kṣaṇaṃ siṃhāsane tiṣṭha kṣaṇaṃ vakṣasi me prabho।। sabhāyāṃ puṣparacite talpe paśyāmi śobhanam ।। 61 ।। śataputrādhikaḥ premṇā satīnāṃ vai patirnṛpa ।। nirūpito bhagavatā vedeṣu hariṇā svayam ।। 62 ।। manorastavacaḥ śrutvā rājā paramapaṇḍitaḥ ।। bodhayāmāsa tāṃ rājñīṃ dadau pratyuttaraṃ punaḥ ।। 63 ।। kārttavīryyārjuna uvāca ।। śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi śrutaṃ sarvaṃ tvayeritam ।। śokārtānāṃ ca vacanaṃ na praśaṃsyaṃ sabhāsu ca ।। 64 ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ kalahaḥ prītireva ca ।। karma bhogārhakālena sarvaṃ bhavati sundari ।। 65 ।। kālo dadāti rājatvaṃ kālo mṛtyuṃ punarbhavam ।। kālaḥ sṛjati saṃsāraṃ kālaḥ saṃharate punaḥ ।। 66 ।। karoti pālanaṃ kālaḥ kālarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। kālasya kālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vidhāturvidhireva ca ।। 67 ।। saṃhartturvā'pi saṃharttā pātuḥ pātā ca karmakṛt ।। sa karmaṇāṃ karmarūpī dadāti tapasāṃ phalam ।। kaḥ kena hanyate jantuḥ karmaṇā vai vinā sati।। ' ।। 68 ।। sraṣṭā sṛjati sṛṣṭiṃ ca saṃharttā saṃharetpunaḥ ।। pātā pāti ca bhūtāni yasyājñāṃ paripālayet ।। 69 ।। yasyājñayā vāti vātaḥ santataṃ bhayavihvalaḥ ।। śaśvatsañcarate mṛtyuḥ sūryyastapati santatam ।। 70 ।। varṣatīndro dahatyagniḥ kālo bhramati bhītavat ।। tiṣṭhanti sthāvarāḥ sarve caranti satataṃ carāḥ ।। 71 ।। vṛkṣāśca puṣpitāḥ kāle phalitaḥ pallavānvitāḥ ।। śuṣyanti kālataḥ kāle varddhante ca tadājñayā ।।72।। āvirbhūtā tirobhūtā sṛṣṭireva tadājñayā ।। tasyājñayā bhavetsarvaṃ na kiñcitsvecchayā nṛṇām ।। ।। 73 ।। nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavāñjāmadagnyo mahābalaḥ ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyati mahīmiti।। 74 ।। pratijñā viphalā tasya na bhavettu kadācana ।। niścitaṃ tasya vadhyo'hamiti jānāmi suvrate ।। 75 ।। jñātvā sarvaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ yāmi tatkatham ।। pratiṣṭhitānāṃ cākīrttirmaraṇādatiricyate ।। 76 ।। ityevamuktvā rājendraḥ samaraṃ gantumudyataḥ ।। vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ।। 77 ।। śatakoṭirnṛpāṇāṃ ca gajendrāṇāṃ trilakṣakam ।। akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ mahābalaparākramam ।। 78 ।। aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca padātīnāṃ tathaiva ca ।। asaṃkhyakaṃ rathānāṃ ca gṛhītvā gantumudyataḥ ।। 79 ।। babhūva stimitā sādhvī dṛṣṭvā taṃ gamanonmukham । dhṛtavantaṃ ca sannāhamakṣayaṃ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। 80 ।। krīḍāgāre kṣaṇaṃ tasthau kṛtvā kāntaṃ svavakṣasi ।। paśyantī tanmukhāmbhojaṃ cucumba ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 81 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde kārtavīryārjuna saṃnāho nāma catustriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 34 ।।
<3.35> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। manoramā prāṇanāthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। bhaviṣyaṃ manasā cakre yadyatsvāmimukhācchutam ।। 1 ।। putrāṃśca purataḥ hṛtvā bāndhavāṃśca svakiṃkarān ।। sasmāra sā haripadaṃ mene satyaṃ bhavenmune।।2।। yogena bhittvā ṣaṭcakraṃ vāyuṃ saṃsthāpya mūrddhani ।। brahmarandhrasthakamale sahasradalasaṃyute ।। 3 ।। svāntamākṛṣya viṣayājjalabudbudasannibhāt ।। saṃsthāpya baddhvā jñānena lolaṃ brahmaṇi niṣkale ।। 4 ।। dvividhaṃ karma saṃnyasya nirmūlamapunarbhavam ।। tatra prāṇāṃśca tatyāja na ca prāṇādhikaṃ priyam ।। 5 ।। sa rājā tāṃ mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpa ruroda ca ।। sannāhaṃ saṃparityajya kṛtvā vakṣasyuvāca tām ।।6।। rājovāca ।। manorame samuttiṣṭha na yāsyāmi raṇājiram ।। sacetanā māṃ paśyeti vilapantaṃ muhumurhuḥ ।। 7 ।। manorame samuttiṣṭha mayā sārddhaṃ gṛhaṃ vraja ।। na kariṣyāmi samaraṃ bhṛguṇā saha bhāmini ।। 8 ।। manorame samuttiṣṭha śrīśailaṃ vraja sundari ।। tatra krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā sārddhaṃ yathā purā ।। 9 ।। manorame samuttiṣṭha vraja godāvarīṃ priye ।। jalakrīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ yathā purā ।। 10 ।। manorame samuttiṣṭha nandanaṃ vraja sundari ।। puṣpabhadrānadītīre vihariṣyāmi nirjane ।। 11 ।। manorame samuttiṣṭha malayaṃ vraja sundari ।। tvayā sārddhaṃ ramiṣye'haṃ tatra candanakānane ।। 12 ।। śītena gandhayuktena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokila rutaśrite ।। 13 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumālepanaṃ kuru ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ paśya māṃ sasmite sati ।। 14 ।। sudhātulyaṃ sumadhuraṃ vacanaṃ racaya priye ।। kuṭilabhrūvikāraṃ ca kathaṃ na kuruṣe'dhunā ।। 15 ।। nṛpasya rodanaṃ śrutvā vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। sthirībhava mahārāja kuruṣe rodanaṃ katham ।। 16 ।। tvaṃ mahājñānināṃ śreṣṭho dattātreyaprasādataḥ ।। jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ paśya śobhanam ।। 17 ।। kamalāṃśā ca sā sādhvī jagāma kamalālayam ।। tvameva gaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ raṇaṃ kṛtvā raṇājire ।। 18 ।। ityeva vacanaṃ śrutvā jahau śokaṃ narādhipaḥ ।। tataścandanakāṣṭhena citāṃ divyāṃ cakāra ha ।। 19 ।। saṃskārāgniṃ kārayitvā putradvārā dadāha tām ।। nānāvidhāni ratnāni brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 20 ।। nānāvidhāni dānāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ।। manoramāyāḥ puṇyena brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।।21।। bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ śaśvaddīyatāṃ dīyatāmiti ।। śabdo babhūva sarvatra kārttavīryyāśrame mune ।।22।। koṣeṣu svādhikāreṣu sthitaṃ yadyaddhanaṃ tadā ।। manoramāyāḥ puṇyena brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 23 ।। rājā jagāma samaraṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। sārdhaṃ sainyasamūhaiśca vādyabhāṇḍairasaṃkhyakaiḥ ।।24।। dadarśa maṅgalaṃ rājā puro vartmani vartmani ।। yayau tathāpi samaraṃ nājagāma gṛhaṃ punaḥ।।25।। muktakeśīṃ chinnanāsāṃ rudatīṃ ca digambarām ।। kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānāmaparāṃ vidhavāmapi ।। 26 ।। mukhaduṣṭāṃ yoniduṣṭāṃ vyādhiyuktāṃ ca kuṭṭinīm ।। patiputravihīnāṃ ca ḍākinīṃ puṃścalī tathā ।। 27 ।। kumbhakāraṃ tailakāraṃ vyādhaṃ sarpopajīvinam ।। kucailamatirūkṣāṃgaṃ nagnaṃ kāṣāyavāsinam ।। 28 ।। vasāvikrayiṇaṃ caiva kanyāvikrayiṇaṃ tathā ।। citādagdhaṃ śavaṃ bhasma nirvāṇāṅgārameva ca।।29।। sarpakṣataṃ naraṃ sarpaṃ godhāṃ ca śaśakaṃ viṣam।। śrāddhapākaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ ca moṭakaṃ ca tilāṃstathā ।। 30।। devalaṃ vṛṣavāhaṃ ca śūdraśrāddhānnabhojinam ।। śūdrānnapācakaṃ śūdrayājakaṃ grāmayājakamā।31।। kuśaputtalikāṃ caiva śavadāhanakāriṇam ।। śūnyakumbhaṃ bhagnakumbhaṃ tailaṃ lavaṇamasthi ca।।32।। kārpāsaṃ kacchapaṃ cūrṇaṃ kukkuraṃ śabdakāriṇam ।। dakṣiṇe ca sṛgālaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bhairavaṃ ravam ।।33।। kapardakaṃ ca kṣauraṃ ca cchinnakeśaṃ nakhaṃ malam ।। kalahaṃ ca vilāpaṃ ca tathā tatkāriṇaṃ janam ।। 34 ।। amaṅgalaṃ rudantaṃ ca rudantaṃ śokakāriṇam ।। 35 ।। mithyāsākṣya pradātāraṃ cauraṃ ca naraghātinam।। puṃścalīpatiputrau ca puṃścalyodanabhojinam ।। 36 ।। devatāguruviprāṇāṃ vastuvittāpahāriṇam ।। dattāpahāriṇaṃ dasyuṃ hiṃsakaṃ sūcakaṃ khalam ।। 37 ।। pitṛmātṛviraktaṃ ca dvijāśvatthavighātinam ।। satyaghnaṃ ca kṛtaghnaṃ ca sthāpyasyāpyapahāriṇam ।। 38 ।। vipramitradrohamevaṃ kṣataṃ viśvāsaghātakam ।। gurudevadvijānāṃ ca nindakaṃ svāṃgaghātakam ।। 39 ।। jīvānāṃ ghātakaṃ caiva svāṃgahīnaṃ ca nirdayam।। vratopavāsahīnaṃ ca dīkṣāhīnaṃ napuṃsakam ।। 40।। galitavyādhigātraṃ ca kāṇaṃ badhirameva ca ।। pulkasaṃ chinnaliṅgaṃ ca surāmattaṃ surāṃ tathā ।।41।। kṣiptaṃ vamantaṃ rudhiraṃ mahiṣaṃ gardabhaṃ tathā ।। mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ rūkṣiṇaṃ nṛkapālakam ।।42।। caṇḍavātaṃ raktavṛṣṭiṃ vādyaṃ vai vṛkṣapātanam ।। vṛkaṃ ca sūkaraṃ gṛdhraṃ śyenaṃ kaṅkaṃ ca bhallukam।।43।। pāśaṃ ca śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca vāyasaṃ gandhakaṃ tathā।।44।। pratigrāhibrāhmaṇaṃ ca tantramantropajīvinam।। vaidyaṃ ca raktapuṣpaṃ cāpyauṣadhaṃ tuṣameva ca।।45।। kuvārttāṃ mṛtavārtāṃ ca vipraśāpaṃ ca dāruṇam।। durgandhivātaṃ duśśabdaṃ rājā'paśyatsa vartmani ।। 46 ।। manaśca kutsitaṃ prāṇāḥ kṣubhitāśca nirantaram।। vāmāṃgaspandanaṃ dehajāḍyaṃ rājño babhūva ha ।। 47 ।। tathā'pi rājā niśśaṅko dadarśa yāhīti vāñchitam ।। teṣāṃ sahyaṃ tadbabhūvurdulaṃghyā brāhmaṇāśiṣaḥ ।। 50 ।। bhṛguṃ praṇamya rājendro rājendraiḥ saha tatkṣaṇāt ।। āruroha rathaṃ tūrṇaṃ nānāyudhasamanvitam ।। 51 ।। nānāprakāravādyaṃ ca dundubhiṃ murajādikam ।। vādayāmāsa sahasā brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam ।। 52 ।। uvāca rāmo rājendraṃ rājendrāṇāṃ ca saṃsadi ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ vākyaṃ vedavidāṃ varaḥ ।। 93 ।। paraśurāma uvāca jagate yaśasā pūrṇamayaśo vārddhake katham ।। ।। 61 ।। dātā variṣṭho dharmmiṣṭho yaśasvī puṇyavānsudhīḥ ।। kārttavīryārjunasamo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।। 62 ।। purātanā vadantīti bandino dharaṇītale ।। yo vikhyātaḥ purāṇeṣu tasya duṣkīrttirīdṛśī ।। 63 ।। durvākyaṃ duḥsahaṃ rājaṃstīkṣṇāstrādapi jīvinām ।। saṃkaṭe'pi satāṃ vaktrāddviruktirna vinirgatā ।। 64 ।। na dadāmi dviruktiṃ te prakṛtaṃ daśākṣarī mahāvidyā dattā durvāsasā purā ।। sucandrāyaiva kavacaṃ bhadrakālyāḥ sudurlabham ।। 39 ।। kavacaṃ bhadrakālyāśca devānāṃ ca sudurlabham ।। kavacaṃ tadgale yasya sarvaśatruvimardakam ।। 40 ।। atīva pūjyaṃ śastaṃ ca trailokyajayakāraṇam।। tasminsthite ca kavace kastvaṃ jetumalaṃ bhuvi ।। 41 ।। bhṛgo gacchatu bhikṣārthaṃ karotu prārthanāṃ nṛpam ।। sūryyavaṃśodbhavo rājā dātā paramadhārmikaḥ ।। 42 ।। prāṇāṃśca kavacaṃ mantraṃ sarvaṃ dāsyati niścitam ।। 43 ।। bhṛguḥ saṃnyāsiveṣeṇa gatvā rājāntikaṃ mune ।। bhikṣāṃ cakāra mantraṃ ca kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 44 ।। rājā dadau ca tanmantraṃ kavacaṃ paramādarāt ।। tataḥ śaṅkaraśūlena taṃ jaghāna nṛpaṃ bhṛguḥ ।। 45 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde bhṛgukārtavīryayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 36> <3.37> ।। nārada uvāca।। kavacaṃ śrotumicchāmi tāṃ ca vidyāṃ daśākṣarīm ।। nātha tvatto hi sarvajña bhadrakālyāśca sāmpratam ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi mahāvidyāṃ daśākṣarīm ।। gopanīyaṃ ca kavacaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। 2 ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ kālikāyai svāheti ca daśākṣarīm ।। durvāsā hi dadau rājñe puṣkare sūryyaparvaṇi ।।3।। daśalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhiḥ kṛtā purā ।। pañcalakṣajapenaiva paṭhankavacamuttamam ।।4।। babhūva siddhakavaco'pyayodhyāmājagāma saḥ ।। kṛtsnāṃ hi pṛthivīṃ jigye kavacasya prabhāvataḥ ।। 5 ।। nārada uvāca ।। śrutā daśākṣarī vidyā triṣu lokeṣu durlabhā ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi kavacaṃ brūhi me prabho ।। 6 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu vakṣyāmi viprendra kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। nārāyaṇena yaddattaṃ kṛpayā śūline purā ।। 7 ।। tripurasya vadhe ghore śivasya vijayāya ca ।। tadeva śūlinā dattaṃ purā durvāsase mune ।।8।। durvāsasā ca yaddattaṃ sucandrāya mahātmane ।। atiguhyataraṃ tattvaṃ sarvamantraughavigraham ।। ।।9।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ kālikāyai svāhā me pātu mastakam ।। klīṃ kapālaṃ sadā pātu hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīmiti locane ।। 10 ।। oṃ hrīṃ trilocane svāhā nāsikāṃ me sadā'vatu ।। klīṃ kālike rakṣa rakṣa svāhā dantānsadā'vatu ।। 11 ।। klīṃ bhadrakālike svāhā pātu me'dharayugmakam ।। oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kālikāyai svāhā kaṇṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।। 12 ।। oṃ hrīṃ kālikāyai svāhā karṇayugmaṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ krīṃ krīṃ klīṃ kālyai svāhā skandhaṃ pātu sadā mama ।। 13 ।। oṃ krīṃ bhadrakālyai svāhā mama vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ klīṃ kālikāyai svāhā mama nābhiṃ sadā'vatu ।। 14 ।। oṃ hrīṃ kālikāyai svāhā mama pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।। raktabījavināśinyai svāhā hasto sadā'vatu ।। 15 ।। oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ muṇḍamālinyai svāhā pādau sadāvatu।। oṃ hrīṃ cāmuṇḍāyai svāhā sarvāṅgaṃ me sadā'vatu।।16।। prācyāṃ pātu mahākālī cāgneyyāṃ raktadantikā ।। dakṣiṇe pātu cāmuṇḍā nairṛtyāṃ pātu kālikā ।। 17 ।। śyāmā ca vāruṇe pātu vāyavyāṃ pātu caṇḍikā ।। uttare vikaṭāsyā cāpyaiśānyāṃ sāṭṭahāsinī ।। 18 ।। pātūrdhvaṃ lolajihvā sā māyā''dyā pātvadhaḥ sadā ।। jale sthale cāntarikṣe pātu viśvaprasūḥ sadā ।। 19 ।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ।। sarveṣāṃ kavacānāṃ ca sārabhūtaṃ parātparam ।। 20।। saptadvīpeśvaro rājā sucandro'sya prabhāvataḥ ।। kavacasya prabhāvena māndhātā pṛthivīpatiḥ ।। 21 ।। pracetā lomaśaścaiva yataḥ siddho babhūva ha ।। yato hi yogināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ saubhariḥ pippalāyanaḥ ।। 22 ।। yadi syātsiddhakavacaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet ।। mahādānāni sarvāṇi tapāṃsyevaṃ vratāni va ।। niścitaṃ kavacasyāsya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 23 ।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā bhajetkālīṃ jagatprasūm ।। śatalakṣaṃ prajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ ।। 24 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde bhadrakālīkavacanirūpaṇaṃ nāma saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 37 ।।
<3.38> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। sucandre patite brahmanrājendrāṇāṃ śiromaṇau ।। agamatpuṣkarākṣastu senātryakṣauhiṇīyutaḥ ।। 1 ।। sūryyavaṃśodbhavo rājā sucandratanayo mahān ।। mahālakṣmīsevakaśca lakṣmīvānsūryyasannibhaḥ ।। 2 ।। mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ gale yasya manoharam ।। paramaiśvaryyasaṃyuktastrailokyavijayī tataḥ ।।3।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhrātaraḥ sarve raiṇukeyasya dhīmataḥ ।। āyayuḥ samaraṃ karttuṃ nānāśastrāstrapāṇayaḥ ।।।4।। rājendraḥ śarajālena cchedayāmāsa tāṃstathā ।। cicchiduḥ śarajālaṃ ca te vīrāścaiva līlayā ।। 5 ।। cicchiduḥ syandanaṃ rājñaste vīrāḥ pañcabāṇataḥ ।। sārathiṃ pañcabāṇena rathāśvaṃ daśabāṇataḥ ।। 6 ।। taddhanuḥ saptabāṇena tūrṇaṃ vai pañcabāṇataḥ ।। cicchidustadbhrātṛvargānviprāḥ śaṅkaraśūlataḥ ।।7।। te ca tryakṣauhiṇīṃ senānnijaghnuścāpi līlayā ।। hantuṃ nṛpendraṃ te vīrāḥ śivaśūlaṃ nicikṣipuḥ ।। gale babhūva tacchūlaṃ rājñaḥ puṣkaramālikā ।। 8 ।। śaktiṃ ca parighaṃ caiva bhuśuṇḍīṃ mudgaraṃ tathā ।। gadāṃ ca cikṣipurviprāḥ kopena jvaladagnayaḥ ।। 9 ।। tāni śastrāṇi cūrṇāni kṣmābhṛto dehayogataḥ ।। vismitā bhrātaraḥ sarve bhṛgoreva mahāmune ।। 10।। rathaṃ dhanuśca śastrāṇi cāstrāṇi vividhāni ca ।। senāṃ prasthāpayāmāsa kārttavīryyārjunaḥ svayam।।11।। rājā syandanamāruhya puṣkarākṣo mahābalaḥ ।। cakāra śarajālaṃ ca mahāghorataraṃ mune ।। 12 ।। cicchiduḥ śarajālaṃ te vīrāḥ śastrāstrapāṇayaḥ ।। rājā prasvāpanenaiva nidritāṃstāṃścakāra ha ।। 13 ।। bhrātṝṃśca nidritāndṛṣṭvā jāmadagnyo mahābalaḥ ।। kṣatavikṣatasarvāṃgānbodhayāmāsa tattvataḥ ।।14।। bodhayitvā tānnivāryya jagāma raṇamūrddhani ।। cikṣepa parśuṃ kopena śīghraṃ rājajighāṃsayā।।15।। chittvā rājñaḥ kirīṭaṃ ca parśurbhūmau papāta ha।। jagrāha paraśuṃ śīghraṃ jāmadagnyo mahābalaḥ।।16।। tadā śaṅkaraśūlaṃ ca cikṣipe mantrapūrvakam ।। nṛpasya kuṇḍalaṃ chittvā jagāma śivasannidhim।।17।। rājā nihantuṃ taṃ rāmaṃ śarajālaṃ cakāra ha ।। ciccheda śarajālaṃ ca reṇukeyaśca līlayā ।।18।। krameṇa rājā nānāstraṃ cikṣipe mantrapūrvakam।। tacciccheda krameṇaiva bhṛguḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ।।19।। bhṛguścikṣepa nānāstraṃ mahāsandhānapūrvakam ।। tacciccheda mahārājaḥ sandhānenaiva līlayā ।। 20 ।। rāmaścikṣepa sandhāya brahmāstraṃ mantrapūrvakam ।। rājā nirvāpaṇaṃ cakre sandhānenaiva līlayā ।।21।। sarvāṇyastrāṇi śastrāṇi rāmaḥ pāśupataṃ vinā ।। cikṣepa kopavibhrāṃto bhūpaściccheda tāni ca ।। 22 ।। rāmaḥ stutvā śivaṃ natvā''dade pāśupataṃ mune ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānavocad viprarūpadhṛk ।। 23 ।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। kiṃ karoṣi bhṛgo vatsa tvamevaṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। naraṃ hantuṃ pāśupataṃ kopātkiṃ kṣipasi bhramāt ।। 24 ।। viśvaṃ pāśupatenaiva bhavedbhasma ca satvaram ।। sarvaghnaṃ syācchastramidaṃ vinā śrīkṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। 25 ।। aho pāśupataṃ jetuṃ nālameva sudarśanam ।। hareḥ sudarśanaṃ caiva sarvāstraparimardakam ।।26।। khaṭvāṃginaḥ pāśupātaṃ harereva sudarśanam ।। ete pradhāne sarveṣāmastrāṇāṃ ca jagattraye ।। 27 ।। tyaja pāśupataṃ brahmanmadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇu ।। yathā jeṣyasi rājānaṃ puṣkarākṣaṃ mahābalam ।। 28 ।। kārttavīryyamajetāraṃ yathā jeṣyasi sāmpratam ।। śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānena tatsarvaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 29 ।। mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। bhaktyā ca puṣkarākṣeṇa dhṛtaṃ kaṇṭhe vidhānataḥ ।। 30 ।। paraṃ durgatināśinyāḥ kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। dhṛtaṃ ca dakṣiṇe bāhau puṣkarākṣasutena ca ।। 31 ।। kavacasya prabhāveṇa viśvaṃ jetuṃ kṣamau ca tau ।। ko jetā ca tribhuvane dehe ca kavace sthite ।। 32 ।। ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhikṣārthaṃ sannidhāne tayormune ।। kariṣyāmi ca tadbhikṣāṃ pratijñā saphalā'stu te ।। 33 ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ saṃtrastamānasaḥ ।। uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 34 ।। paraśurāma uvāca ।। na jānāmi mahāprājña kastvaṃ brāhmaṇarūpadhṛk ।। śīghraṃ ca brūhi māṃ mūḍhaṃ tadā gaccha nṛpāntikam ।। 35 ।। jāmadagnyavacaḥ śrutvā prahasya brāhmaṇaḥ svayam ।। uktvā cāhaṃ viṣṇuriti yayau bhikṣitumīśvaraḥ ।। 36 ।। gatvā tayoḥ sannidhānaṃ yayāce kavace ca tau ।। dadatustau ca kavace viṣṇave viṣṇumāyayā ।। gṛhītvā kavace viṣṇurvaikuṇṭhaṃ nirjagāma saḥ ।। 37 ।। nārada uvāca ।। mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ kena dattaṃ mahāmune ।। puṣkarākṣāya bhūpāya śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। 38 ।। kavacaṃ cāpi durgāyāḥ puṣkarākṣasutāya ca ।। durllabhaṃ kena vā dattaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhasi ।। 39 ।। kavacaṃ cāpi kimbhūtaṃ tayorvā tasya kiṃ phalam ।। mantrau tu kiṃprakārau ca tanme brūhi jagadguro।। ।।। 40 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dattaṃ sanatkumāreṇa puṣkarākṣāya dhīmate ।। mahālakṣmyāśca kavacaṃ mantraścāpi daśākṣaraḥ ।। 41 ।। stavanaṃ cāpi gopyaṃ vai proktaṃ taccaritaṃ ca yat ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ pūjāṃ caiva manoharām ।। 42 ।। durgāyāścāpi kavacaṃ dattaṃ durvāsasā purā।। stavanaṃ cāpi gopyaṃ ca mantraścāpi daśākṣaraḥ।।43।। paścācchroṣyasi tatsarvaṃ devyāśca paramādbhutam।। mahāyuddhasamārambhe dattaṃ prārthanayā ca yat ।।44।। mahālakṣmyāśca mantraṃ ca śṛṇu taṃ kathayāmi te ।। oṃ śrīṃ kamalavāsinyai svāheti paramādbhutam ।। 45।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ śṛṇu pūjāvidhiṃ mune ।। dattaṃ tasmai kumāreṇa puṣkarākṣāya dhīmate ।। 46 ।। sahasradalapadmasthāṃ padmanābhapriyāṃ satīm ।। padmālayāṃ padmavaktrāṃ padmapatrābhalocanām ।। 47।। padmapuṣpapriyāṃ padmapuṣpatalpādhiśāyinīm ।। padminīpadmahastāṃ ca padmamālāvibhūṣitām ।। 48 ।। padmabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyāṃ padmaśobhāvivarddhanīm ।। padmāṭavīṃ prapaśyantīṃ sasmitāṃ tāṃ bhaje mudā ।। 49 ।। candanāṣṭadale padme padmapuṣpeṇa pūjayet ।। gaṇaṃ sampūjya dattvā caivopacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। 50 ।। tataḥ stutvā ca praṇametsādhako bhaktipūrvakam ।। kavacaṃ śrūyatāṃ brahmansarvasāraṃ vadāmi te ।। 51 ।। śṛṇu viprendra padmāyāḥ kavacaṃ paramaṃ śubham ।। padmanābhena yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipadmake ।। 52 ।। samprāpya kavacaṃ brahmā tatpadme sasṛje jagat ।। padmālayāprasādena salakṣmīko babhūva saḥ ।। 53 ।। padmālayāvaraṃ prāpya pādmaśca jagatāṃ prabhuḥ ।। pādyena padmakalpe ca kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।।54।। dattaṃ sanatkumārāya priyaputrāya dhīmate ।। kumāreṇa ca yaddattaṃ puṣkarāya ca nārada ।। 55 ।। yaddhṛtvā pāṭhanād brahmā savasiddheśvaro mahān ।। paramaiśvaryyasaṃyuktaḥ sarvasampatsamanvitaḥ ।। 56 ।। yaddatvā ca dhanādhyakṣaḥ kuberaśca dhanādhipaḥ ।। svāyambhuvo manuḥ śrīmānpaṭhanāddhāraṇādyataḥ ।। 57 ।। priyavratottānapādau lakṣmīvantau yato mune ।। pṛthuḥ pṛthvīpatiḥ sadyo hyabhavadvāraṇādyataḥ ।। 58 ।। kavacasya prasādena svayaṃ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।। dharmmaśca karmmaṇāṃ sākṣī pātā yasya prasādataḥ ।। 59 ।। yaddhṛtvā dakṣiṇe bāhau viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodaśāyitaḥ ।। bhaktyā vidhatte kaṇṭhe ca śeṣo nārāyaṇāṃśakaḥ ।। 60 ।। yaddhṛtvā vāmanaṃ lebhe kaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ ।। sarvadevādhipaḥ śrīmānmahendro dhāraṇādyataḥ ।। 61 ।। rājā marutto bhagavānabhavaddhāraṇādyataḥ ।। trailokyādhipatiḥ śrīmānnahuṣo yasya dhāraṇāt ।। 62 ।। viśvaṃ vijigye khaṭvāṅgaḥ paṭhanāddhāraṇādyataḥ ।। mucukundo yataḥ śrīmānmāndhātṛtanayo mahān।। 63 ।। sarvasampatpadasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ।। ṛṣiśchandaśca bṛhatī devī padmālayā svayam ।। 64 ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। puṇyabījaṃ ca mahatāṃ kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।।65।। oṃ hrīṃ kamalavāsinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam।। śrīṃ me pātu kapālaṃ ca locane śrīṃ śriyai namaḥ।66।।। oṃ śrīṃ śriyai svāheti ca karṇayugmaṃ sadā'vatu।। oṃ śrīṃ klīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā me pātu nāsikāma।67।। oṃ śrīṃ padmālayāyai ca svāhā dantānsadā'vatu ।। oṃ śrīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca dantarandhraṃ sadā'vatu।।68।। oṃ śrīṃ nārāyaṇeśāyai mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadā'vatu।। oṃ śrīṃ keśavakāntāyai mama skandhaṃ sadā'vatu।। ।।69।। oṃ śrīṃ padmanivāsinyai svāhā nābhiṃ sadā'vatu।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saṃsāramātre mama vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu।। 70।। oṃ śrīṃ moṃ kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śriyai svāhā ca mama hastau sadā'vatu ।। 71 ।। oṃ śrīnivāsakāntāyai mama padau sadā'vatu ।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ śriyai svāhā sarvāṅgaṃ me sadā'vatu ।। 72 ।। prācyāṃ pātu mahālakṣmīrāgneyyāṃ kamalālayā ।। padmā māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṃ śrīrharipriyā ।। 73 ।। padmālayā paścime māṃ vāyavyāṃ pātu sā svayam ।। uttare kamalā pātu caiśānyāṃ sindhukanyakā ।। 74 ।। nārāyaṇī ca pātūrdhvamadho viṣṇupriyā'vatu ।। santataṃ sarvataḥ pātu viṣṇuprāṇādhikā mama ।। ।। 79 ।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ।। sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 76 ।। suvarṇaparvataṃ dattvā merutulyaṃ dvijātaye ।। yatphalaṃ labhate dharmī kavacena tato'dhikam ।। 77 ।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivatkavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ।। kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau sa śrīmānpratijanmani ।। 78 ।। asti lakṣmīrgṛhe tasya niścalā śatapūruṣam ।। devendraiścāsurendraiśca so'vadhyo niścitaṃ bhavet ।। 79 ।। sa sarvapuṇyavāndhīmānsarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yasyedaṃ kavacaṃ gale ।। 80 ।। yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ lobhamohabhayairapi ।। gurubhaktāya śiṣyāya śaraṇyāya prakāśayet ।। 81 ।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā japellakṣmīṃ jagatprabhum ।। koṭisaṃkhyaṃ prajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ ।। 82 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde śrīlakṣmīkavacavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 38 ।।
<3.39> nārada uvāca ।। kavacaṃ kathitaṃ brahmanpadmāyāśca manoharam ।। paraṃ durgatināśinyāḥ kavacaṃ kathaya prabho ।।1।। padmākṣaprāṇatulyaṃ ca jīvanaṃ balakāraṇam ।। kavacānāṃ ca yatsāraṃ durgāsevanakāraṇam ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi durgāyāḥ kavavaṃ śubham ।। śrīkṛṣṇenaiva yaddattaṃ goloke brahmaṇe purā ।। 3।। brahmā tripurasaṃgrāme śaṃkarāya dadau purā ।। jaghāna tripuraṃ rudro yaddhṛtvā bhaktipūrvakam ।। 4 ।। haro dadau gautamāya padmākṣāya ca gautamaḥ ।। yato babhūva padmākṣaḥ saptadvīpeśvaro jayī ।। 5 ।। yaddhṛtvā paṭhanādbrahmā jñānavāñchaktimānbhuvi ।। śivo babhūva sarvajño yogināṃ ca gururyataḥ ।। śivatulyo gautamaśca babhūva munisattamaḥ ।। 6 ।। brahmāṇḍavijayasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ।। ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devī durgatināśinī ।। 7 ।। brahmāṇḍavijaye caiva viniyogaḥ prakīrttitaḥ ।। puṇyatīrthaṃ ca mahatāṃ kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 8 ।। oṃ hrīṃ durgatināśinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam ।। oṃ hrīṃ me pātu kapālaṃ cāpyoṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ pātu locane।।9।। pātu me karṇayugmaṃ cāpyoṃ durgāyai namaḥ sadā।। oṃ hrīṃ śrīmiti nāsāṃ me sadā pātu ca sarvataḥ।। 10।। hrīṃ śrīṃ krūmiti dantāṃśca pātu klīmoṣṭhayugmakam।। klīṃ klīṃ klīṃ pātu kaṇṭhaṃ ca durge rakṣatu gaṇḍake।।11।। skandhaṃ mahākāli durge svāhā pātu nirantaram ।। vakṣo vipadvināśinyai svāhā me pātu sarvataḥ।।12।। durge durge rakṣa pārśvau svāhā nābhiṃ sadā'vatu।। durge durge dehi rakṣāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ me pātu sarvataḥ।।13।। oṃ hrīṃ durgāyai svāhā ca hastau pādau sadā'vatu ।। oṃ hrīṃ durgāyai svāhā ca sarvāṃgaṃ me sadā'vatu ।। 14 ।। prācyāṃ pātu mahāmāyā cāgneyyāṃ pātu kālikā ।। dakṣiṇe dakṣakanyā ca nairṛtyāṃ śivasundarī ।। 15 ।। paścime pārvatī pātu vārāhī vāruṇe sadā ।। kuberamātā kauberyyāmaiśānyāmīśvarī sadā ।। 16 ।। ūrdhvaṃ nārāyaṇī pātu tvambikā'dhaḥ sadā'vatu ।। jñānaṃ jñānapradā pātu svapne nidrā sadā'vatu ।। 17।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa sarvamantraughavigraham ।। brahmāṇḍavijayaṃ nāma kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 18 ।। susnātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam ।। sarvavratopavāse ca tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। 19 ।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ ।। kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau kavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ।। 20।। sa ca trailokyavijayī sarvaśatrupramardakaḥ।। idaṃ kavacamajñātvā bhajeddurgatināśinīm।।21।। śatalakṣaṃ prajapto'pi na mantraḥ siddhidāyakaḥ।। ।। 22 ।। kavacaṃ kāṇvaśākhoktamuktaṃ nārada siddhidam ।। yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham ।।23।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde durgatināśinīkavacaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 39 ।।
<3.40> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। taṃ gṛhītvā tadā viṣṇau vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gate sati।। saputraṃ ca sahasrākṣaṃ jaghāna bhṛgunandanaḥ।।1।। kṛtvā yuddhaṃ tu saptāhaṃ brahmāstreṇa prayatnataḥ ।। rājā kavacahīno'pi saputraśca papāta ha।। patite tu sahasrākṣe kārtavīryyārjunaḥ svayam।। ājagāma mahāvīro dvilakṣākṣauhiṇīyutaḥ।। ।।3।। suvarṇarathamāruhya ratnasāraparicchadam ।। nānāstraṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā tasthau samaramūrddhani।।4।। samare taṃ paraśurāmo rājendraṃ ca dadarśa ha ।। ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyai rājendrāṇāṃ ca koṭibhiḥ ।।5।। ratnātapatrabhūṣāḍhyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। 6 ।। rājā dṛṣṭvā munīndraṃ tamavaruhma rathādaho ।। praṇamya rathamāruhya tasthau nṛpagaṇaiḥ saha ।। 7 ।। dadau śubhāśiṣaṃ tasmai rāmaśca samayocitam ।। provāca ca gatārthaṃ taṃ svargaṃ gaccheti sānugaḥ।।8।। ubhayoḥ senayoryuddhamabhavattatra nārada ।। palāyitā rāmaśiṣyā bhrātaraśca mahābalāḥ ।। kṣatavikṣatasarvāṅgāḥ kārttavīryyaprapīḍitāḥ ।। 9 ।। nṛpasya śarajālena rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ।। na dadarśa svasainyaṃ ca rājasainyaṃ tathaiva ca ।। 10 ।। cikṣepa rāmaścāgneyaṃ babhūvāgnimayaṃ raṇe ।। nirvāpayāmāsa rājā vāruṇenaiva līlayā ।। 11 ।। cikṣepa rāmo gāndharvaṃ śailasarpasamanvitam ।। vāyavyena mahārājaḥ prerayāmāsa līlayā ।। 12 ।। cikṣepa rāmo nāgāstraṃ durnivāryyaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।। gāruḍena mahārājaḥ prerayāmāsa līlayā ।। 13 ।। māheśvaraṃ ca bhagavāṃścikṣepa bhṛgunandanaḥ ।। nirvāpayāmāsa rājā vaiṣṇavāstreṇa līlayā ।। 14 ।। brahmāstraṃ cikṣipe rāmo nṛpanāśāya nārada ।। brahmāstreṇa ca śāntaṃ tatprāṇanirvāpaṇaṃ raṇe ।। 15 ।। dattadattaṃ ca yacchūlamavyarthaṃ mantrapūrvakam ।। jagrāha rājā paraśurāmanāśāya saṃyuge ।। 16 ।। śūlaṃ dadarśa rāmaśca śatasūryyasamaprabham ।। pralayāgriśikhodriktaṃ durnivāryaṃ surairapi ।। 17 ।। papāta śūlaṃ samare rāmasyopari nārada ।। mūrcchāmavāpa sa bhṛguḥ papāta ca hariṃ smaran ।। 18 ।। patite tu tadā rāme sarve devā bhayākulāḥ ।। ājagmuḥ samaraṃ tatra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 19 ।। śaṅkaraśca mahājñānī mahājñānena līlayā ।। brāhmaṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa tūrṇaṃ nārāyaṇājñayā ।। 20 ।। bhṛguśca cetanāṃ prāpya dadarśa purataḥ surān ।। praṇanāma paraṃ bhaktyā lajjānamrātmakandharaḥ ।। 21 ।। rājā dṛṣṭvā sureśāṃśca bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। praṇamya śirasā mūrdhnā tuṣṭāva ca sureśvarān ।। 22 ।। tatrājagāma bhagavāndattātreyo raṇasthalam ।। śiṣyarakṣānimittena kṛpālurbhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 23 ।। bhṛguḥ pāśupatāstraṃ ca so'grahītkopasaṃyutaḥ ।। dattadattena dṛṣṭena babhūva stambhito bhṛguḥ ।।24।। dadarśa stambhito rāmo rājānaṃ raṇamūrddhani ।। nānāpārṣadayuktena kṛṣṇenā''rakṣitaṃ raṇe ।।25।। sudarśanaṃ prajvalantaṃ bhramaṇaṃ kurvatā sadā ।। sasmitena stutenaiva brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ ।। ।। 26 ।। gopālaśatayuktena gopaveṣavidhāriṇā ।। navīnajaladābhena vaṃśīhastena gāyatā ।। 27 ।। etasminnantare tatra vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। dattena dattaṃ kavacaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 28 ।। rājño'sti dakṣiṇe bāhau sadratnaguṭikānvitam ।। gṛhītakavace śambhau bhikṣayā yogināṃ gurau ।। 29 ।। tadā hantuṃ nṛpaṃ śakto bhṛguśceti ca nārada ।। śrutvā'śarīriṇīṃ vāṇīṃ śaṅkaro dvijarūpadhṛk।। 30 ।। bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā tu kavacamānīya ca nṛpasya ca ।। śambhunā bhṛgave dattaṃ kṛṣṇasya kavacaṃ ca yat ।। 31 ।। etasminnantare devā jagmuḥ svasthānamuttamam ।। pratyuvācāpi paraśurāmo vai samare nṛpam ।।32।। paraśurāma uvāca ।। rājendrottiṣṭha samaraṃ kuru sāhasapūrvakam ।। kālabhede jayo nṛṇāṃ kālabhede parājayaḥ।।33।। adhītaṃ vidhivaddattaṃ kṛtsnā pṛthvī suśāsitā ।। samyakkṛtaśca saṃgrāmastvayā'haṃ mūrcchito 'dhunā।। 34 ।। jitāḥ sarve ca rājendrā līlayā rāvaṇo jitaḥ ।। jito'haṃ dattaśūlena śambhunā jīvitaḥ punaḥ ।। 35 ।। rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā paramadhārmikaḥ ।। mūrdhnā praṇamya taṃ bhaktyā yathārthoktimuvāca ha ।। 36 ।। rājovāca ।। kimadhītaṃ tathā dattaṃ kā vā pṛthvī suśāsitā ।। gatāḥ katividhā bhūpā mādṛśā dharaṇītale ।। 37 ।। buddhistejo vikramaśca vividhā raṇamantraṇā ।। śrīraiśvaryaṃ tathā jñānaṃ dānaśaktiśca laukikam ।। 38 ।। ācāro vinayo vidyā pratiṣṭhā paramaṃ tapaḥ ।। sarvaṃ manoramāsaṃge gatameva mama prabho ।। 39 ।। sā ca strī prāṇatulyā me sādhvī padmāṃśasambhavā ।। yajñeṣu patnī māteva snehe krīḍati saṃginī ।। 40।। ābālyātsaṃginī śaśvacchayane bhojane raṇe ।।
