tāṃ vinā prāṇahīno'haṃ viṣahīno yathoragaḥ ।। 41 ।। tvayā na dṛṣṭaṃ yuddhaṃ me pureyaṃ śocanā sthitā ।। dvitīyā śocanā vipra hato'haṃ brāhmaṇena ca ।। 42 ।। kāle siṃhaḥ sṛgālaṃ ca sṛgālaḥ siṃhameva ca ।। kāle vyāghraṃ hanti mṛgo gajendraṃ hariṇastathā ।। 43 ।। mahiṣaṃ makṣikā kāle garuḍaṃ ca tathoragaḥ ।। kiṅkaraḥ stauti rājendraṃ kāle rājā ca kiṃkaram।। 44 ।। indraṃ ca mānavaḥ kāle kāle brahmā mariṣyati ।। tirobhūtvā sā prakṛtiḥ kāle śrīkṛṣṇavigrahe ।। 49 ।। mariṣyanti surāḥ sarve trilokasthāścarācarāḥ ।। sarve kāle layaṃ yānti kālo hi duratikramaḥ।।46।। kālasya kālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sraṣṭuḥ sraṣṭā yathecchayā।। saṃhartā caiva saṃhartuḥ pātuḥ pātā parātparaḥ।।47।। mahāsthūlātsthūlatamaḥ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatamaḥ kṛśaḥ ।। paramāṇuparaḥ kālaḥ kālassyātkālabhedakaḥ ।। 48 ।। yasya lomāni viśvāni sa pumāṃśca mahāvirāṭ ।। tejasā ṣoḍaśāṃśaśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।।49।। tataḥ kṣudravirāḍ jātaḥ sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ param ।। yaḥ sraṣṭā ca svayaṃ brahmā yannābhikamalodbhavaḥ ।। 50 ।। nābheḥ kamaladaṇḍasya yo'ntaṃ na prāpa yatnataḥ ।। bhramaṇāllakṣavarṣaṃ ca tataḥ svasthānasaṃsthitaḥ ।। 51 ।। tapaścakre tatastatra lakṣavarṣaṃ ca vāyubhuk ।। tato dadarśa golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca sapārṣadam ।। ।। 52 ।। gopagopīparivṛtaṃ dvibhujaṃ muralīdharam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca rādhāvakṣasthalasthitam ।। 53 ।। dṛṣṭvā'nujñāṃ gṛhītvā ca praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। īśvarecchāṃ ca vijñāya sraṣṭuṃ sṛṣṭiṃ mano dadhe ।। 54 ।। yaḥ śivaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃharttā sa ca sraṣṭurlalāṭajaḥ ।। viṣṇuḥ pātā kṣudravirāṭ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt ।। 55 ।। sṛṣṭikāraṇabhūtāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। santi viśveṣu sarveṣu śrīkṛṣṇasya kalodbhavāḥ ।।56।। te'pi devāḥ prākṛtikāḥ prākṛtaśca mahāvirāṭ ।। sarvaprasūtiḥ prakṛtiḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।।57।। na śaktaḥ parameśo'pi tāṃ śaktiṃ prakṛtiṃ vinā ।। sṛṣṭiṃ vidhātuṃ māyeśo na sṛṣṭirmāyayā vinā ।। 58 ।। sā ca kṛṣṇe tirobhūya sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārake ।। sā''virbhūtā sṛṣṭikāle sā ca nityā maheśvarī ।।59।। kulālaśca kaṭaṃ kartuṃ yathā'śakto mṛdaṃ vinā।। svarṇaṃ vinā svarṇakāraḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ।। 60 ।। sā ca śaktiḥ sṛṣṭikāle pañcadhā ceśvarecchayā ।। rādhā padmā ca sāvitrī durgā devī sarasvatī ।। 61 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। prāṇādhikapriyatamā sā rādhā parikīrttitā ।। 62 ।। aiśvaryyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī sarvamaṅgalakāriṇī ।। paramānandarūpā ca sā lakṣmīḥ parikīrttitā ।।63।। vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā parameśasya durlabhā ।। yā mātā vedaśāstrāṇāṃ sā sāvitrī prakīrtitā।।64।। buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇī ।। sarvajñānātmikā sarvā sā durgā durganāśinī ।। 65 ।। vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā śāstrajñānapradā sadā ।। kṛṣṇakaṇṭhodbhavā sā syādyā ca devī sarasvatī।।66।। pañcadhā''dau svayaṃ devī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। tataḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇaiva bahudhā kalayā ca sā ।। 67 ।। yoṣitaḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pumāṃsaḥ puruṣasya ca ।। māyayā sṛṣṭi kāle ca tadvinā na bhavedbhavaḥ।।68।। sṛṣṭiśca prativiśveṣu brahmanbrahmodbhavā sadā ।। pātā viṣṇuśca saṃharttā śivaḥ śaśvacchivapradaḥ ।।69।। dattadattaṃ jñānamidaṃ rāma mahyaṃ ca puṣkare ।। dīkṣākāle ca māghyāṃ ca munipravarasannidhau ।। 70 ।। ityuktvā kārttavīryyaśca rāmaṃ natvā ca sasmitaḥ ।। āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। 71 ।। rāmastato rājasainyaṃ brahmāstreṇa jaghāna ha ।। nṛpaṃ pāśupatenaiva līlayā śrīhariṃ smaran ।। 72 ।। evaṃ trissaptakṛtvaśca krameṇa ca vasundharām ।। rāmaścakāra nirbhūpāṃ līlayā ca śivaṃ smaran ।। 73 ।। garbhasthaṃ māturaṅkasthaṃ śiśuṃ vṛddhaṃ ca madhyamam ।। jaghāna kṣatriyaṃ rāmaḥ pratijñāpālanāya vai ।। 74 ।। kārttavīryyaśca golokaṃ tvagamatkṛṣṇasannidhim ।। jagāma toṣātparaśurāmaśca śrīhariṃ smaran।। 75 ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ mahīṃ dṛṣṭvā maheśvaraḥ ।। ramaṇaṃ tena paraśurāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca kātaram ।। 76 ।। devāśca munayo devyaḥ siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ ।। sarve cakruḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ rāmamūrdhni ca nārada ।। 77 ।। svarge dundubhayo nedurharṣaśabdo babhūva ha।। yaśasā caiva paraśurāmasyāpūritaṃ jagat ।।78।। brahmā bhṛguśca śukraśca vālmīkiścyavanastathā।। jamadagnirbrahmalokādājagāma praharṣitaḥ।।79।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāḥ sānandāśca samanvitāḥ ।। dūrvāpuṣpakarāḥ sarve kurvanto maṃgalāśiṣaḥ।। ।। 80 ।। praṇanāma ca tānrāmo daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi ।। kroḍe cakāra brahmā''dau kramāttāteti saṃvadan ।। 81 ।। tamuvācātha paraśurāmaṃ brahmā jagadguruḥ ।। vedasāraṃ nītiyutaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 82 ।। brahmovāca ।। śṛṇu rāma pravakṣyāmi sarvasampatkaraṃ param ।। kāṇvaśākhoktavacanaṃ satyaṃ vai sarvasammatam ।।83।। pūjyānāmeva sarveṣāmiṣṭaḥ pūjyatamaḥ paraḥ ।। janako janmadānācca pālanācca pitā smṛtaḥ ।। 84 ।। garīyāñjanmadātuśca so'nnadātā pitā mune ।। vinā'nnaṃ naśvaro deho nityaṃ ca piturudbhavaḥ ।। 89 ।। tayoḥ śataguṇaṃ mātā pūjyā mānyā ca vanditā।। garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ saiva proktā garīyasī।।86।। tebhyaḥ śataguṇaṃ pūjyo'bhīṣṭadevaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ।। jñānavidyāmantradātā'bhīṣṭadevātparo guruḥ ।। 87 ।। guruvadguruputraśca gurupatnī tato'dhikā ।। deve ruṣṭe gurū rakṣedgurau ruṣṭe na kaścana ।। 88 ।। gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ ।। gurureva paraṃ brahma brāhmaṇebhyaḥ priyaḥ paraḥ ।। 89 ।। gururjñānaṃ dadātyeva jñānaṃ ca haribhaktidam ।। haribhaktipradātā yaḥ ko vā bandhustataḥ param ।। 90 ।। ajñānatimirācchanno jñānadīpaṃ yato labhet ।। labdhvā ca nirmalaṃ paśyetko vā bandhustataḥ paraḥ ।। 91 ।। gurudattaṃ sumantraṃ ca japtvā jñānaṃ tato labhet ।। sarvajñatvācca siddhiṃ ca ko vā bandhustato'dhikaḥ ।। 92 ।। sukhaṃ jayati sarvatra vidyayā gurudattayā ।। yayā pūjyo'pi jagati ko vā bandhustato'dhikaḥ ।। 93 ।। vidyāndho vā dhanāndho vā yo mūḍho na yajedgurum ।। brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 94 ।। daridraṃ patitaṃ kṣudraṃ narabudyā bhajedgurum ।। tīrthasnāto'pi na śucirnādhikārī ca karmasu ।। 95 ।। abhīṣṭadevaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo guruste śaṅkaraḥ svayam ।। śaraṇaṃ gaccha he putra devapūjyatamaṃ gurum ।। 96 ।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpā tvayā pṛthvī kṛtā yataḥ ।। prāptā tvayā harerbhaktistaṃ śivaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 97 ।। śivāṃ ca śivarūpaṃ ca śivadaṃ śivakāraṇam ।। śivārādhyaṃ śivaṃ śāntaṃ guruṃ tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 98 ।। golokanātho bhagavānaṃśena śivarūpadhṛk ।। ya iṣṭadevaḥ sa gurustameva śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 99 ।। ātmā kṛṣṇaḥ śivo jñānaṃ mano'haṃ sarvajīviṣu ।। prāṇā viṣṇossā prakṛtissarvaśaktiyutā suta ।। 100।। jñānadaṃ jñānarūpaṃ ca jñānabījaṃ sanātanam ।। mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālakālaṃ taṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 101 ।। brahmajyotissvarūpaṃ taṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। śaraṇaṃ vraja sarvajñaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 102 ।। prakṛtirlakṣavarṣaṃ ca tapastaptvā yamīśvaram ।। kāntaṃ priyapatiṃ lebhe taṃ guruṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 103 ।। ityuktvā munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma kamalodbhavaḥ ।। rāmaśca gantuṃ kailāsaṃ manaścakre ca nārada ।। 104 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte tṛtīye gaṇeśakhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde bhṛgoḥ kailāsagamanopadeśo nāma catvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 40 ।।
<2.41> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। hareśca kavacaṃ dhṛtvā kṛtvā niḥ kṣatriyāṃ mahīm ।। rāmo jagāma kailāsaṃ namaskartuṃ śivaṃ gurum।।।। gurupatnīṃ śivāmambāṃ draṣṭuṃ gurusutau ca tau ।। guṇairnārāyaṇasamau kārttikeyagaṇeśvarau ।। 2 ।। manoyāyī mahātmā sa bhṛgussaṃprāpya tatkṣaṇam ।। dadarśa parvataṃ ramyamatīva sumanoharam ।। 3 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśairmaṇibhiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। suvarṇabhūmisadṛśai rājamārgairvirājitam ।। 4 ।। sindūrāruṇavarṇaiśca veṣṭitaṃ maṇivedibhiḥ ।। saṃyuktaṃ muktānikaraiḥ pūritaṃ maṇimaṇḍapaiḥ ।। 5 ।। yakṣāṇāmālayairdivyaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ ।। kapāṭastambhasopānaiḥ śobhitairmaṇinirmitaiḥ।। ।।6।। suvarṇakalaśairdivyai rājataiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ।। ratnakāñcanapūrṇaiśca yakṣendragaṇaveṣṭitaiḥ।।7।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyairdīpitaiḥ sundarīgaṇaiḥ।। bālikābhirbālakaiśca citraputtalikākaraiḥ ।।8।। krīḍadbhiḥ sasmitaiḥ śaśvatsvacchandaṃ ca virājitaiḥ ।। pārijātadrumagaṇaiḥ svarṇadītīranīrajaiḥ ।। 9 ।। ākīrṇaṃ puṣpajālaiśca puṣpitaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ।। kalpavṛkṣāśritaiḥ siddhaiḥ kāmadhenupuraskṛtaiḥ ।। 10 ।। siddhavidyāsu nipuṇaiḥ puṇyavadbhirniṣevitam ।। trilakṣayojanācchāyairvaṭavṛkṣairathākṣayaiḥ ।। 11 ।। śatayojanavistīrṇaiḥ śataskandhasamanvitaiḥ ।। asaṃkhyaśākhāni karairasaṃkhyaphalasaṃyutaiḥ ।। 12 ।। nānāpakṣigaṇākīrṇaiḥ sumanoharaśabditaiḥ ।। kampitaiḥ śītavātena maṇḍitaṃ ca sugandhinā ।। 13 ।। puṣpodyānasahasreṇa sarasāṃ ca śatena ca ।। siddhendrālayalakṣaiśca maṇiratnavikārajaiḥ ।। 14 ।। rāmaśca dṛṣṭvā nagaramatisaṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। dadarśa purato ramyaṃ śrīyuktaṃ śaṃkarālayam ।।15।। suvarṇamūlyaśatakairmaṇibhiḥ svarṇavarṇakaiḥ ।। khacitaṃ ratnasāraiśca racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। ।। 16 ।। tripañcayojanocchrāyaṃ caturyojanavistṛtam ।। caturasraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ prākāraṃ sumanoharam ।। 17 ।। dvāraṃ ratnakapāṭena nānā citrānvitena ca ।। maṇīndravedibhiryuktaṃ maṇistambhavirājitaiḥ ।। 18 ।। taddakṣiṇe vṛṣendraṃ ca vāme siṃhaṃ ca nārada ।। nandīśvaraṃ mahākālaṃ piṅgalākṣaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।।19।। viśālākṣaṃ ca bāṇaṃ ca virūpākṣaṃ mahābalam ।। vikaṭākṣaṃ bhāskarākṣaṃ raktākṣaṃ vikaṭodaram ।। 20 ।। saṃhārabhairavaṃ kālabhairavaṃ ca bhayaṅkaram ।। rurubhairavamīśābhaṃ mahābhairavameva ca ।। 21 ।। kṛṣṇāṅgabhairavaṃ caiva krodhabhairavamulbaṇam ।। kapālabhairavaṃ caiva rudrabhairavameva ca ।। 22 ।। siddheṃdrādīnrudragaṇānvidyādharasuguhyakān ।। bhūtānpretānpiśācāṃśca kūṣmāṇḍānbrahmarākṣasān।।23।। vetālāndānavāṃścaiva yogīndrāṃśca jaṭādharān ।। yakṣānkimpuruṣāṃścaiva kinnarāṃśca dadarśa ha ।।24।। tāndṛṣṭvā nandikeśājñāṃ gṛhītvā bhṛgunandanaḥ ।। tānsambhāṣyābhyantaraṃ ca jagāmānandasaṃplutaḥ ।। 25 ।। ratnendrasārakhacitaṃ dadarśa śatamandiram ।। amūlyaratnakalaśairjvaladbhiśca virājitam ।। 26 ।। amūlyaratnaracitairmuktānirmmaladarpaṇaiḥ ।। hīrasāravikāraiśca kapāṭaiśca virājitam ।। ।। 27 ।। gorocanābhirmaṇibhiryutaṃ stambhasahasrakaiḥ ।। maṇisāravikāraiśca sopānaiḥ pariśobhitam ।। 28 ।। dadarśābhyantaraṃ dvāraṃ nānācitraiśca citritam ।। māṇikyamuktāgrathitairmālājālairvirājitam ।। 29 ।। dadarśa kārttikeyaṃ ca vāme dakṣe gaṇeśvaram ।। vīrabhadraṃ mahākāyaṃ śivatulyaparākramam ।। 30 ।। pradhānapārṣadagaṇānkṣetrapālāṃśca nārada ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthāṃśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān।। ।। 31 ।। tānsambhāṣya bhṛguḥ śīghraṃ mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। parśuhastassa paraśurāmo gantuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 32 ।। gacchantaṃ taṃ gaṇeśaśca kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhetyuvāca ha ।। nidrito nidrayā yukto mahādevo'dhuneti ca ।। 33 ।। īśvarājñāṃ gṛhītvā'hamatrāgatya kṣaṇāntare ।। tvayā sārddhaṃ gamiṣyāmi bhrātastiṣṭhātra sāmpratam।।34।। gaṇeśavākyaṃ paraśurāmaśśrutvā mahābalaḥ ।। bṛhaspatisamo vaktā pravaktumupacakrame।। ।।35।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde kailāsavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 41 ।।
<3.42> paraśurāma uvāca ।। yāsyāmyantaḥpuraṃ bhrātaḥ praṇāmaṃ kartumīśvaram ।। praṇamya mātaraṃ bhaktyā yāsyāmi tvaritaṃ gṛham।।1।। trissaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kṛtvā pṛthvīṃ ca līlayā ।। kārttavīryyaḥ sucandraśca hato yasya prasādataḥ ।। 2 ।। nānāvidyā yato labdhā nānāśastraṃ sudurlabham ।। taṃ guruṃ jagatāṃ nāthaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi sāmpratam।।3।। saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ caiva bhaktānugrahavigraham।। satyaṃ satyasvarūpaṃ ca brahma jyotiḥ sanātanam ।।4।। svecchāmayaṃ dayāsindhuṃ dīnabandhuṃ munīśvaram।। ātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ parātparam ।।5।। parāparāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ puruhūtaṃ puraskṛtam ।। purāṇaṃ paramātmānamīśānaṃ tvādimavyayam।।6।। sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam ।। sarvamagaladaṃ śāntaṃ sarvaiśvaryyapradaṃ varam ।। 7 ।। āśutoṣaṃ prasannāsyaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalam ।। bhaktābhayapradaṃ bhaktavatsalaṃ samadarśanam ।।8।। itthaṃ paraśurāmo'sthāduktvā gaṇapateḥ puraḥ ।। vācā madhurayā tatra samuvāca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 9 ।। kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha śṛṇu bhrātaridaṃ vacaḥ ।। rahaḥsthalasthito naiva draṣṭavyaḥ strīyutaḥ pumān ।। 10 ।। strīsaṃyuktaṃ ca puruṣaṃ yaḥ paśyati narādhamaḥ ।। karoti rasabhaṅgaṃ vā kālasūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam ।।11।।। tatra tiṣṭhati pāpīyānyāvaccandradivākaram ।। viśeṣataśca pitaraṃ guruṃ bhūtapatiṃ dvija ।। 12 ।। rahaḥ suratasaṃsaktaṃ nahi paśyedvicakṣaṇaḥ ।।। kāmataḥ kopato vā'pi yaḥ paśyetsuratonmukham ।। 13 ।। strīvicchedo bhavettasya dhruvaṃ saptasu janmasu ।। śroṇīvakṣasthalaṃ vaktraṃ yaḥ paśyati parastriyaḥ ।। kāmato'pi vimūḍhaśca so'ndho bhavati niścitam ।। 14 ।। gaṇeśasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya bhṛgunandanaḥ ।। tamuvāca mahākopānniṣṭhuraṃ vacanaṃ mune ।। 15 ।। paraśurāma uvāca ।। aho śrutaṃ kiṃ vacanamapūrvaṃ nītisaṃyutam ।। idamevamaho naivaṃ śrutamīśvaravaktrataḥ ।। 16 ।। śrutaṃ śrutau vākyamidaṃ kāmināṃ ca vikāriṇām ।। nirvikārasya ca śiśorna doṣaḥ kaścideva hi ।। yāsyāmyantaḥpuraṃ bhrātastava kiṃ tiṣṭha bālaka ।। 17 ।। yathādṛṣṭi kariṣyāmi matkāryyaṃ samayocitam ।। tavaiva tāto mātā cetyevaṃ naiva nirūpitam ।।18।। jagatāṃ pitarau tau ca pārvatīparameśvarau ।। pārvatī strī pumāñchambhuriti kairna nirūpitaḥ ।। 19 ।। sarvarūpaḥ śaṅkaraśca sarvārūpā ca pārvatī ।। guṇātītasya kā krīḍā tadbhaṃgo vā kuto vibho ।। 20 ।। krīḍā lajjā bhītibhaṃgo grāmyasyaiva na ceśituḥ ।। standhayaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā pitrorllajjā kuto bhavet ।। 21 ।। lajjāyāśca kuto lajjā lajjeśasya ca sā kutaḥ ।। lajjā lajjāṃ kimāpnoti tāpaṃ kiṃ vā hutāśanaḥ ।। 22 ।। śītaṃ śaityamaho bhrātarnidāgho dāhameva ca ।। bhītirbhītimavāpnoti mṛtyormṛtyurbibheti kim ।। 23 ।। kuto jvaro jvaraṃ hanti vyādhiṃ vyādhiśca jīryati ।। saṃharttā nāpi saṃharttuḥ kālaḥ kālādbibheti kim।। ।। 24 ।। sraṣṭāraṃ sṛjate sraṣṭā pātā kiṃ pāti te mate ।। kṣutkṣudhaṃ samavāpnoti tṛṣṇā tṛṣṇāṃ prayāti kim ।। 25 ।। nidrā nidrāṃ ca śobhāṃ śrīḥ śāntiḥ śāṃtiṃ ca te mate ।। puṣṭiḥ puṣṭiṃ kimāpnoti tuṣṭistuṣṭiṃ kṣamā kṣamām।। ātmanaḥ paramātmā'sti śaktiḥ śaktyā bibheti kim ।। 26 ।। kāmakrodhau lobhamohau svātmanaite na bādhitāḥ ।। dayā na baddhā dayayā necchā baddhecchayā prabho ।। 27 ।। jñānabuddhyoḥ ko vikāro jarāṃ no bādhate jarā ।। cintā na cintayā grastā cakṣuścakṣurna paśyati ।। 28 ।। harṣo mudaṃ kiṃ prāpnoti śokaṃ śoko na bādhate ।। kā vipattirvipatteśca sampattiḥ sampadaḥ kutaḥ ।। 29 ।। medhāyā dhāraṇā śaktiḥ smṛtervā smaraṇaṃ kutaḥ ।। na dagdhaḥ svapratāpena vivasvāniti sammataḥ ।। 30 ।। viparītamato bhrātastvayaivācarito'dhunā ।। na śruto'yaṃ gurumukhānna dṛṣṭo na śrutau śrutaḥ ।। 31 ।। ityuktvā cāpi paraśurāmaśśaśvatprahasya saḥ ।। śīghraṃ gantuṃ manaścakraṃ tadguhābhyantaraṃ mudā ।। 32 ।। tacca rāmavacaḥ śrutvā jitakrodho gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpaśca prahasya tamuvāca ha ।। 33 ।। gaṇapatiruvāca ।। ajñānatimirācchanno jñānaṃ prāpnoti tadvidaḥ ।। piturbhrāturmukhājjñānaṃ durlabhaṃ bhāgyavām̐llabhet ।। 34 ।। śrutaṃ jñānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca jñānināmapi durlabham ।। kiñcinme tvaṃ manda buddheḥ śṛṇu bhrātarnivedanam ।। 35 ।। yo nirguṇaḥ sa nirliptaḥ śaktibhirna hi saṃyutaḥ ।। sisṛkṣurāśritaśśaktyā nirguṇaḥ saguṇo bhavet ।। 36 ।। yāvanti ca śarīrāṇi bhogārhāṇi mahāmune ।। prākṛtāni ca sarvāṇi vinā śrīkṛṣṇavigraham ।। 37 ।। dhyāyanti yoginastaṃ ca śuddhajyotissvarūpiṇam ।। hastapādādirahitaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 38 ।। vaiṣṇavāste namasyanti bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। kuto babhūva tajjyotiraho tejasvino vinā ।। 39 ।। jyotirabhyantare nityaṃ śarīraṃ śyāmasundaram ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sasmitaṃ pītavāsasam।। 40।। atīvāmūlyasadratnabhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitam।। jyotirabhyantare mūrtiṃ paśyanti kṛpayā vibhoḥ।।41।। tadā dāsye niyuktāste bhavantyeveśvarecchayā ।। yogastapo vā dāsyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 42 ।। yadā sṛṣṭyunmukhaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sasṛje prakṛtiṃ mudā । tadyonau hyarpitaṃ vīryaṃ vīryyāḍḍimbho babhūva ha ।। 43 ।। divyena lakṣavarṣeṇa garbhāḍḍimbho vinirgataḥ ।। tadā babhūva niśśvāsastato vāyurbabhūva ha ।। 44 ।। niśśvāsena samaṃ bhrātarmukhabindurvinirgataḥ ।। tato babhūva sahasā jalarāśirhareḥ puraḥ ।। 45 ।। tajjale ca sthito ḍimbho divyavarṣāṇi lakṣakam ।। tato babhūva sahasā viśvādhāro mahāvirāṭ ।। 46 ।। yāvanti gātralomāni tasya santi mahātmanaḥ ।। brahmāṇḍāni ca tāvanti vidyamānāni niścitam ।। 47 ।। tatraiva pratividhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। devāśca munayaścaiva vidyamānāścarācarāḥ।।48।। mahāvirāḍāśrayaśca sarvasya ca janasya ca।। niśśvāsavāyurbhagavānbabhūva śrīharermune।।49।। mahāviṣṇuśca kalayā tataḥ kṣudravirāḍabhūt ।। tannābhikamale brahmā śaṃkarastallāṭajaḥ।। 50।। viṣṇustadaṃśaḥ pātā yaḥ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt ।। evaṃ te pratividhyaṇḍe brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 51 ।। svayaṃ ca svāṃśakalayā nānāmūrttidharo hariḥ ।। tadā'bhavacca saguṇaḥ sarvaśaktiyutastadā ।। 52 ।। kathaṃ lajjādirahitaḥ sa ca svacchāmayo mahān ।। sarvadā sarvabhogārhaḥ sarvaśaktisamanvitaḥ ।। 53 ।। lajjā nāstyeva lajjāyā mato'yaṃ sarvasammataḥ ।। yā ca lajjāvatī devī tasya lajjā kuto gatā ।। 54 ।। sarvaśaktimatī durgā prakṛtyā sā ca śailajā ।। tasyā lajjādayaḥ santi sarvadā sarvasammatāḥ ।। 55 ।। pañcadhā prakṛtiryā ca śrīkṛṣṇasya babhūva ha ।। rādhā padmā ca sāvitrī durgā devī sarasvatī ।। 56 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ।। prāṇādhikā priyā sā ca rādhā''ste tasya vakṣasi ।। 57 ।। vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā ।। lakṣmīrnārāyaṇasyaiva sarvasampatsvarūpiṇī ।। 58 ।। sarasvatī dvidhā bhūtvā kṛṣṇasya mukha nirgatā ।। sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ kāntā svayaṃ nārāyaṇasya ca ।। 59 ।। buddhyadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā jñānasūḥ śaktisaṃyutā ।। sā durgā śūlinaḥ kāntā tasyā lajjā kuto gatā ।। 60।। prakṛtiḥ pañcadhā bhrātargoloke ca babhūva ha।। imāḥ pradhānāḥ kalayā babhūvurnaikadhā yataḥ।।61।। viprendra nityaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmāṇḍātparamucyate ।। avināśi sthalaṃ śaśvallaye prākṛtike dhruvam ।। 62 ।। tatra nārāyaṇo devaḥ kṛṣṇārddhāṃśaścaturbhujaḥ ।। vanamālī pītavāsāḥ śaktyā vai padmayā saha ।। 63 ।। svayaṃ kṛṣṇaśca goloke dvibhujaḥ śyāmasundaraḥ।। sasmito muralīhasto rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitaḥ ।। 64 ।। śaśvadgogopagopībhiḥ saṃyukto goparūpadhṛk ।। paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānnirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 65 ।। svecchāmayaḥ svatantrastu paramānandarūpadhṛk ।। surāḥ kalodbhavā yasya ṣoḍaśāṃśo mahāvirāṭ ।। 66 ।। yato bhavanti viśvāni sthūlasūkṣmādikāni ca ।। punastatra pralīyanta evameva muhurmuhuḥ ।। 67 ।। goloka ūrdhvavaikuṇṭhātpañcāśatkoṭiyojanaḥ ।। nāsti lokastadūrdhvaṃ ca nāsti kṛṣṇātparaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 68 ।। idaṃ śrutaṃ śambhuvaktrānmayā te kathitaṃ dvija ।। kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhādhunā bhrātarīśvaraḥ suratonmukhaḥ ।। 69 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇeśaparaśurāmasaṃvādo nāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 42 ।।
<3.43> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā sa tadā rāgataḥ sudhīḥ ।। parśuhastassa vai rāmo nirbhayo gantumudyataḥ ।। 1 ।। gaṇeśvarastadā dṛṣṭvā śīghramutthāya yatnataḥ ।। vārayāmāsa sa prītyā cakāra vinayaṃ punaḥ ।। 2 ।। rāmastaṃ prerayāmāsa huṃ kṛtvā tu punaḥ punaḥ ।। babhūva ca tatastatra vāgyuddhaṃ hastakarṣaṇaiḥ ।। 3 ।। parśunikṣepaṇaṃ kartuṃ manaścakre bhṛgustadā ।। hāhā kṛtvā kārtikeyo bodhayāmāsa saṃsadi ।। 4 ।। avyarthamastraṃ he bhrātarguruputre kathaṃ kṣipeḥ ।। guruvadguruputraṃ ca mā bhavānhantumarhati ।। 9 ।। parśuṃ kṣipantaṃ kupitaṃ raktapadmadalekṣaṇam ।। gaṇeśo rodhayāmāsa nivarttasvetyuvāca tam ।। 6 ।। punargaṇeśaṃ rāmaśca prerayāmāsa kopataḥ ।। papāta purato vegānmānahīno gajānanaḥ ।। 7 ।। gajānanaḥ samutthāya dharmaṃ kṛtvā tu sakṣiṇam ।। punastaṃ bodhayāmāsa jitakrodhaḥ śivātmajaḥ ।। 8 ।। nivartasva nivarttasvetyuccāryya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। praveśane te kā śaktirīśvarājñāṃ vinā prabho ।। 9 ।। mama bhrātā tvamatithirvidyāsambandhato dhruvam ।। īśvarapriyaśiṣyaśca soḍhaṃ vai tena hetunā ।। 10 ।। na hyahaṃ kārttavīryyaśca bhūpāste kṣudrajantavaḥ ।। ato vipra na jānāsi māṃ ca viśveśvarātmajam ।। 11 ।। kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha nivarttasva samare brāhmaṇātithe ।। kṣaṇāntare tvayā sārddhaṃ yāsyāmīśvarasannidhim ।। 12 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। herambavacanaṃ śrutvā prajahāsa punaḥ punaḥ।। parśuṃ kṣeptuṃ manaścakre praṇamya hariśaṅkarau ।।13।। parśuṃ kṣipantaṃ kopena taṃ ca rāmaṃ gajānanaḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā mumūrṣuṃ deveśo dharmaṃ kṛtvā tu sākṣiṇam ।। 14 ।। yogena varddhayāmāsa śuṇḍāṃ tāṃ koṭiyojanām ।। yogīndrastatra santiṣṭhanbhrāmayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 15 ।। śatadhā veṣṭayitvā tu bhrāmayitvā tu tatra vai ।। ūrddhvamuttolya vegena kṣudrāhiṃ garuḍo yathā ।। 16 ।। saptadvīpāṃśca śailāṃśca meruṃ cākhilasāgarān ।। kṣaṇena darśayāmāsa rāmaṃ yogaparāhatam ।। 17 ।। hastapādādyanāthaṃ taṃ jaḍaṃ sarvāṃgakampitam ।। punastaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa darpitaṃ darpanāśanaḥ ।। 18 ।। bhūrlokaṃ ca bhuvarlokaṃ svarlokaṃ ca sureśvaraḥ ।। janolokaṃ tapolokaṃ dhruvalokaṃ ca tatparam ।। 19 ।। gaurīlokaṃ śambhulokaṃ darśayāmāsa nārada ।। darśayitvā tu vidhyaṇḍaṃ sa papau sapta sāgarān ।। 20 ।। punarudgiraṇaṃ cakre sanakramakarodakam ।। tatra taṃ pātayāmāsa gambhīre sāgarodake ।। 21 ।। mumūrṣuṃ taṃ santarantaṃ punarjagrāha līlayā ।। punastatra bhrāmayitvā brahmāṇḍādūrddhvamapyamum ।। 22 ।। vaikuṇṭhaṃ darśayāmāsa salakṣmīkaṃ caturbhujam ।। kṣaṇaṃ tatra bhrāmayitvā yogīndro yogamāyayā ।। 23 ।। punaḥ karaṃ ca yogena varddhayāmāsa līlayā ।। golokaṃ darśayāmāsa virajāṃ ca nadīśvarīm ।। 24 ।। vṛndāvanaṃ śṛṅgaśataṃ śailendraṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। gopīgopādibhiḥ sārddhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śyāmasundaram ।। 25 ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 26 ।। tejasā koṭisūryyābhaṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam ।। evaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ darśayitvā praṇamayya punaḥ punaḥ ।। 27 ।। kṣaṇena lambamānaṃ ca bhrāmayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ceṣṭadevaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।। bhrūṇahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ bhṛgordūraṃ cakāra ha ।। 28 ।। na bhavedyātanā naṣṭā vinā bhogena pāpajā ।। svalpāṃ ca bubhuje rāmo gatā'nyā kṛṣṇadarśanāt ।। 29 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya bhuvi vegātpapāta ha ।। babhūva dūrībhūtaṃ ca gaṇeśastambhanaṃ bhṛgoḥ ।। 30 ।। sasmāra kavacaṃ stotraṃ gurudattaṃ sudurlabham ।। abhīṣṭadevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ guruṃ śambhuṃ jagadgurum ।। 31 ।। cikṣepa parśumavyarthaṃ śivatulyaṃ ca tejasā ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhāśataguṇaṃ mune ।। 32 ।। pituravyarthamastraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā gaṇapatiḥ svayam ।। jagrāha vāmadantena nāstraṃ vyarthaṃ cakāra ha ।। 33 ।। nipātya parśurvegena cchittvā dantaṃ samūlakam ।। jagāma rāmahastaṃ ca mahādevabalena ca ।। 34 ।। hāheti śabdamākāśe devāścakrurmahābhiyā ।। vīrabhadraḥ kārttikeyaḥ kṣetrapālāśca pārṣadāḥ ।। ।। 35 ।। papāta bhūmau dantaśca saraktaḥ śabdayaṃstadā ।। papāta gairikāyukto yathā sphaṭikaparvataḥ ।।36।। śabdena mahatā vipra cakampe pṛthivī bhiyā ।। kailāsasthā janāḥ sarve mūrcchāmāpuḥ kṣaṇaṃ bhiyā ।। 37 ।। nidrā babhañja tatkāle nidreśasya jagatprabhoḥ ।। ājagāma bahiḥ śambhuḥ pārvatyā saha sambhramāt ।।38।। puro dadarśa herambaṃ lohitāsyaṃ kṣatena tam ।। bhagnadantaṃ jitakrodhaṃ sasmitaṃ lajjitaṃ mune ।। 39 ।। papraccha pārvatī śīghraṃ skandaṃ kimiti putraka ।। sa ca tāṃ kathayāmāsa vārtāṃ paurvāparīṃ bhiyā ।। 40 ।। cukopa durgā kṛpayā ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। uvāca śambhoḥ purataḥ putraṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 41 ।। sambodhya śambhuṃ śokena bhiyā vinayapūrvakam ।। uvāca praṇatā sādhvī praṇatārtiharaṃ patim ।। 42 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇeśadantabhaṅgakāraṇavarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 43 ।।
<3.44> pārvatyuvāca ।। sarve jānanti jagati durgāṃ śaṅkarakiṃkarīm ।। apekṣā rahitā dāsī tasyā vai jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।। 1 ।। īśvarasya samāḥ sarvāstṛṇaparvatajātayaḥ ।। dāsīputrasya śiṣyasya doṣaḥ kasyeti ca prabho ।। 2 ।। vicāraṃ kartumucitaṃ tvaṃ ca dharmavidāṃ varaḥ ।। vīrabhadraḥ kārttikeyaḥ pārṣadāḥ santi sākṣiṇaḥ ।।3।। sākṣye mithyāṃ ko vadedvā dvāveṣāṃ bhrātarau samau ।। sākṣye same śatrumitre satāṃ dharmanirūpaṇe ।। 4 ।। sākṣī sabhāyāṃ yatsākṣyaṃ jānannapyanyathā vadet ।। kāmataḥ krodhato vā'pi lobhena ca bhayena ca ।। 5 ।। sa yāti kumbhīpākaṃ ca nipātya śatapūruṣam ।। taiśca sārddhaṃ vasettatra yāvaccandradivākaram ।। 6 ।। ahaṃ vibodhituṃ śaktā yannirṇetrī dvayorapi ।। tathā'pi tava sākṣāttu mamājñā ninditā śrutau ।। 7 ।। kiṃkarāṇāṃ prabhā tatra nṛpe vasati saṃsadi ।। udite bhāskare pṛthvyāṃ khadyoto hi yathā prabho ।। 8 ।। suciraṃ tapasā prāptaṃ tvadīyaṃ caraṇāmbujam ।। parityāgabhayenaiva santataṃ bhītayā mayā ।। 9 ।। yatkiṃcitkopaśokābhyāmuktaṃ mohena tatparam।। tatkṣamasva jagannātha putrasnehācca dāruṇāt ।। 10 ।। tvayā yadi parityaktā tadā putreṇa tena kim ।। sādhvyāḥ sadvaṃśajāyāśca śataputrādhikaḥ patiḥ ।। 11 ।। asadvaṃśaprasūtā yā duśśīlā jñānavarjitā ।। svāminaṃ manyate nāsau pitrordoṣeṇa kutsitā ।। 12 ।। kutsitaṃ patitaṃ mūḍhaṃ daridraṃ rogiṇaṃ jaḍam ।। kulajā viṣṇutulyaṃ ca kāntaṃ paśyati santatam ।। 13 ।। hutāśano vā sūryyo vā sarvatejasvināṃ varaḥ ।। pativratātejasaśca kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm।।14।। mahādānāni puṇyāni vratānyanaśanāni ca ।। tapāṃsi patisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm।।15।। putrovā'pi pitā vā'pi bāndhavo'tha sahodaraḥ ।। yoṣitāṃ kulajātānāṃ na kaścitsvāminaḥ samaḥ ।। 16 ।। ityuktvā svāminaṃ durgā dadarśa purato bhṛgum ।। śambhoḥ padābjaṃ sevantaṃ nirbhayaṃ tamuvāca ha।।17।। pārvatyuvāca ।। aho rāma mahābhāga brahmavaṃśyo'si paṇḍitaḥ ।। putro'si jamadagneśca śiṣyo vai yogināṃ guroḥ ।।18।। mātā te reṇukā sādhvī padmāṃśā satkulodbhavā ।। mātāmaho vaiṣṇavaśca mātulaśca tato'dhikaḥ ।। । ।। 19 ।। tvaṃ ca reṇukabhūpasya manuvaṃśodbhavasya ca ।। dauhitro mātulaḥ sādhuḥ śūro viṣṇupadāśrayaḥ ।। 20 ।। kasya doṣeṇa durddharṣastvaṃ na jāne'pyaśuddhadhīḥ ।। yeṣāṃ doṣairjano duṣṭastamṛte śuddhamānasaḥ ।। 21 ।। amoghaṃ prāpya parśuṃ ca guruṃ ca karuṇānidhim ।। parīkṣāṃ kṣattriye kṛtvā babhūvāsya sute punaḥ ।। 22 ।। gurave dakṣiṇādānamucitaṃ ca śrutau śrutam ।। bhagno dantastatsutasya cchindhi mastakamapyaho ।।23।। gaṇeśvaraṃ raṇe jitvā sthitaścedāvayoḥ puraḥ ।। sa tvaṃ labdhvā''śiṣo loke pūjito'bhūrjagattraye।।24।। parśunā'moghavīryyeṇa śaṅkarasya vareṇa ca ।। hantuṃ śaktaḥ sṛgālaśca siṃhaṃ śārdūlamākhubhuk।।25।। tvadvidhaṃ lakṣakoṭiṃ ca hantuṃ śakto gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro nahi hanti ca makṣikām ।। 26 ।। tejasā kṛṣṇatulyo'yaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। deśaścānye kṛṣṇakalāḥ pūjā'sya puratastataḥ ।। 27 ।। vrataprabhāvataḥ prāptaḥ śaṅkarasya vareṇa ca ।। śokenātikaṭhoreṇa nahi sampadvinā''padam ।। 28 ।। ityuktvā pārvatī roṣāttaṃ rāmaṃ hantumudyatā ।। rāmaḥ sasmāra taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya manasā gurum ।।29।। etasminnantare durgā dadarśa purato dvijam ।। atīva vāmanaṃ bālaṃ sūryyakoṭisamaprabham।। 30 ।। śukladantaṃ śuklavāsaṃ śuklayajñopavītinam ।। daṇḍinaṃ chatriṇaṃ caiva suprabhaṃ tilakojjvalam।। ।। 31 ।। dadhataṃ tulasīmālāṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। ratnakeyūravalayaṃ ratnamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 32 ।। ratnanūpurapādaṃ ca sadratnamukuṭojjvalam ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmāḍhyagaṇḍasthalavirājitam ।। 33 ।। sthiramudrāṃ darśayantaṃ bhaktavāmakareṇa ca ।। dakṣiṇe'bhayamudrāṃ ca bhakteśaṃ bhaktavatsalam ।। 34 ।। bālikābālakagaṇairnāgaraiḥ sasmitairyutam ।। kailāsavāsibhiḥ sarvairāvṛddhairīkṣitaṃ mudā ।। 39 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā sambhramācchambhuḥ sabhṛtyaḥ sahaputrakaḥ ।। mūrdhnā bhaktyā prāṇamacca durgāyai daṇḍavadbhuvi ।। 36 ।। āśiṣaṃ pradadau bālaḥ sarvebhyo vāñchitapradām ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā bālakāḥ sarve mahāścaryyaṃ yayurbhiyā ।। 37 ।। dattvā tasmai śivo bhaktyā tūpacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśa ।। pūjāṃ cakāra śrutyuktāṃ paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। 38 ।। tuṣṭāva kāṇvaśākhoktastotreṇa natakandharaḥ ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṃgo bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। ।। 39 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca prāvocacchaṅkaraḥ svayam ।। atīva tejasā'tyantaṃ pracchannākṛtimeva ca ।। 40 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। ātmārāmeṣu kuśalapraśno'tīva viḍambanam ।। te śaśvatkuśalādhārāḥ kuśalāḥ kuśalapradāḥ ।। 41 ।। ayane saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ।। prāptastvamatithibrahmankṛṣṇasevāphalodayāt ।। 42 ।। paripūrṇatamaḥ kṛṣṇo lokanistārahetave ।। puṇyakṣetre hi kalayā bhārate ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 43 ।। atithiḥ pūjito yena pūjitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। atithiryasya santuṣṭastasya tuṣṭo hariḥ svayam ।।44।। snānena sarvatīrtheṣu sarvadānena yatphalam ।। sarvavratopavāsena sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣayā ।। 45' ।। sarvaistapobhirvividhairnityairnaimittikādibhiḥ ।। tadevātithisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 46 ।। atithiryasya bhagnāśo yāti ruṣṭaśca mandirāt ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam ।। 47 ।। strīgoghnaśca kṛtaghnaśca brahmaghno gurutalpagaḥ ।। pitṛmātṛgurūṇāṃ ca nindako naraghātakaḥ ।। 48 ।। sandhyāhīnaḥ svaghātī ca satyaghno harinindakaḥ ।। brahmasvasthāpyahārī ca mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ ।। 49 ।। mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca vṛṣavāhaśca sūpakṛt ।। śavadāhī grāmayājī brāhmaṇo vṛṣalīpatiḥ ।। 50 ।। śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca śūdraśrāddheṣu bhojakaḥ ।। kanyāvikrayakārī ca śrīharernāmavikrayī ।। 51 ।। lākṣāmāṃsatilānāṃ ca lavaṇasya tilasya ca ।। vikretā brāhmaṇaścaiva turagāṇāṃ gavāṃ tathā ।। 52 ।। ekādaśīkṛṣṇasevāhīno vipraśca bhārate।। ete mahāpātakinastriṣu lokeṣu ninditāḥ।।53।। kālasūtre ca narake patanti brahmaṇāṃ śatam ।। etebhyo'pyadhikaḥ so'pi yaścātithiparāṅmukhaḥ ।। 54 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śaṅkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā santuṣṭaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।। meghagambhīrayā vācā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ ।। 95 ।। viṣṇuruvāca ।। śvetadvīpādāgato'haṃ jñātvā kolāhalaṃ ca vaḥ ।। asya rāmasya rakṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktasya sāmpratam ।। 56 ।। naiteṣāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ।। rakṣāmi tāṃścakrahasto gurumanyaṃ vinā śiva ।। 57 ।। nāhaṃ pātā gurau ruṣṭe balavadguruhelanam ।। tatparaḥ pātakī nāsti sevāhīno gurośca yaḥ ।। 58 ।। mānyaḥ pūjyaśca sarvebhyaḥ sarveṣāṃ janako bhavet ।। aho yasya prasādena sarvānpaśyati mānavaḥ ।। 59 ।। janako janmadānācca pālanācca pitā nṛṇām ।। tato vistārakaraṇātkalayā sa prajāpatiḥ ।। 60 ।। pituḥ śataguṇaṃ mātā poṣaṇādgarbhadhāraṇāt ।। vandyā pūjyā ca mānyā ca prasūssyādvai vasundharā ।। 61 ।। mātuḥ śataguṇaṃ vandyaḥ pūjyo mānyo'nnadāyakaḥ ।। yadvinā naśvaro deho viṣṇuśca kalayā'nnadaḥ ।। 62 ।। annadātuḥ śataguṇo'bhīṣṭadevaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ ।। gurustasmācchataguṇo vidyāmantrapradāyakaḥ ।। 63 ।। ajñānatimirācchannaṃ jñānadīpena cakṣuṣā ।। yaḥ sarvārthaṃ darśayati tatparo naiva bāndhavaḥ ।।64।। gurudattena mantreṇa tapaseṣṭasukhaṃ labhet।। sarvajñatvaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ tatparo naiva bāndhavaḥ।।65।। sarvaṃ jayati sarvatra vidyayā gurudattayā ।। tasmātpūjyo hi jagati ko vā bandhustato'dhikaḥ ।। 66 ।। vidyāndho vā dhanāndho vā yo mūḍho na bhajedgurum ।। brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ sa lipto nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 67 ।। daridraṃ patitaṃ kṣudraṃ narabuddhyā''caredgurum ।। tīrthasnāto'pi na śucirnādhikārī ca karmasu ।। 68 ।। pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhāryyāṃ gurupatnīṃ guruṃ param ।। yo na puṣṇāti kāpaṭyātsa mahāpātakī śiva ।। 69 ।। gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ ।। gurureva paraṃ brahma gururbhāskararūpakaḥ ।। 70 ।। guruścandrastathendraśca vāyuśca varuṇo'nalaḥ ।। sarvarūpo hi bhagavānparamātmā svayaṃ guruḥ ।। 71 ।। nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nahi kṛṣṇātparaḥ suraḥ ।। nāsti gaṅgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ na puṣpaṃ tulasīdalāt ।। 72 ।। nāsti kṣamāvatī bhūmeḥ putrānnāstyaparaḥ priyaḥ ।। na ca daivātparā śaktirnaikādaśyāḥ paraṃ vratam ।। 73 ।। śālagrāmātparo yantro na kṣetraṃ bhāratātparam ।। paraṃ puṇyasthalānāṃ ca puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yathā ।। 74 ।। mokṣadānāṃ yathā kāśī vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śivaḥ ।। na pārvatyāḥ parā sādhvī na gaṇeśātparo vaśī ।।75।। na ca vidyāsamo bandhurnāsti kaścidguroḥ paraḥ ।। vidyādātuḥ putradārau tatsamau nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 76 ।। gurustriyāṃ ca putre cāpyabhavadrāmahelanam ।। paraṃ sammārjanaṃ kartumāgato'haṃ tavālayam ।। 77 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityevamuktvā śambhuṃ ca durgāṃ sambodhya nārada ।। uvāca bhagavāṃstatra satyasāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ ।। 78 ।। śrīviṣṇuruvāca ।। śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śubham ।। nītiyuktaṃ vedasāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 79 ।। yathā te gajavaktraśca kārttikeyaśca pārvati ।। । tathā paraśurāmaśca bhārgavo nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 80 ।। nāstyeṣu snehabhedaśca tava vā śaṃkarasya ca ।। vicāryya sarvaṃ sarvajñe kuru mātaryathocitam ।। 81 ।। putreṇa sārddhaṃ putrasya vivādo daivadoṣataḥ ।। daivaṃ hantuṃ ko hi śakto daivaṃ ca balavattaram ।। 82 ।। putrābhidhānaṃ vedeṣu paśya vatse varānane ।। ekadanta iti khyātaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam ।। 83 ।। putranāmāṣṭakaṃ stotraṃ sāmavedoktamīśvari ।। śṛṇuṣvāvahitaṃ mātaḥ sarvavighnaharaṃ param ।। 84 ।। viṣṇuruvāca ।। gaṇeśamekadantaṃ ca herambaṃ vighnanāyakam ।। lambodaraṃ śūrpakarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ guhāgrajam ।। 85 ।। aṣṭākhyārthaṃ ca putrasya śṛṇu mātarharapriye ।। stotrāṇāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca sarvavighnaharaṃ param ।। 86 ।। jñānārthavācako gaśca ṇaśca nirvāṇavācakaḥ ।। tayorīśaṃ paraṃ brahma gaṇeśaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 87 ।। ekaśabdaḥ pradhānārtho dantaśca balavācakaḥ ।। balaṃ pradhānaṃ sarvasmādekadantaṃ namāmyaham ।। 88 ।। dīnārthavācako heśca rambaḥ pālakavācakaḥ ।। pālakaṃ dīnalokānāṃ herambaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 89 ।। vipattivācako vighno nāyakaḥ khaṇḍanārthakaḥ ।। vipatkhaṇḍanakāraṃ taṃ praṇame vighnanāyakam ।। ।। 90 ।। viṣṇudattaiśca naivedyairyasya lambaṃ purodaram ।। pitrā dattaiśca vividhairvande lambodaraṃ ca tam ।। 91 ।। śūrpākārau ca yatkarṇau vighnavāraṇakārakau ।। sampaddau jñānarūpau ca śūrpakarṇaṃ namāmyaham ।।92।। viṣṇuprasādaṃ muninā dattaṃ yanmūrdhni puṣpakam ।। tadgajendramukhaṃ kāntaṃ gajavaktraṃ namāmyaham ।।93 ।। guhasyāgre ca jāto'yamāvirbhūto harālaye ।। vande guhāgrajaṃ devaṃ sarvadevāgrapūjitam।। ।। 94 ।। etannāmāṣṭakaṃ durge nānāśaktiyutaṃ param ।। etannāmāṣṭakaṃ stotraṃ nānārthasahitaṃ śubham ।। 95 ।। trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ sa sukhī sarvato jayī ।। tato vighnāḥ palāyante vainateyādyathoragāḥ ।। 96 ।। gaṇeśvaraprasādena mahājñānī bhaveddhruvam ।। putrārthī labhate putraṃ bhāryyārthī kuśalāṃ striyam ।।97।। mahājaḍaḥ kavīndraśca vidyāvāṃśca bhaveddhruvam ।। putrastvaṃ paśya vede ca tathā kopaṃ ca no kuru।। ।। 98 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde gaṇeśastotrakathanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 44 ।।
<3.45> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। pārvatīṃ bodhayitvā tu viṣṇū rāmamuvāca ha ।। hitaṃ sāraṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 1 ।। viṣṇuruvāca ।। rāma tvamadhunā satyamaparādhī śrutermmate ।। kopātkṛtvā dantabhaṅgaṃ gaṇeśasya sthito'śive ।। 2 ।। stotreṇaiva mayoktena stutvā gaṇapatiṃ param ।। kāṇvaśākhoktavidhinā stuhi durgāṃ jagatprasūm ।। 3 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya parā śaktirbuddhirūpā jagatprabhoḥ ।। asyāṃ ca tava ruṣṭāyāṃ hatā buddhirbhaviṣyati ।। 4 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpeyamanayā śaktimajjagat।। anayā śaktimānkṛṣṇo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 5 ।। sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ na śaktaśca brahmā śaktyā'nayā vinā ।। vayamasyāṃ prasūtāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 6 ।। surasaṃghe'suragraste kāle ghoratare dvija ।। tejastu sarvadevānāmāvirbhūtā purā satī ।। 7 ।। kṛṣṇājñayā'surānhatvā dattvā tebhyaḥ padaṃ tataḥ ।। dakṣapatnyāṃ janiṃ lebhe dakṣasya tapasā purā ।। 8 ।। bhāryyā bhūtvā śaṃkarasya punaḥ patyuśca nindayā ।। dehaṃ tyaktvā śailapatnyāṃ janiṃ lebhe purā satī ।। 9 ।। śaṃkarastapasā labdho yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। labdho gaṇapatiḥ putraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṛṣṇasevayā ।। 10 ।। yaṃ dhyāyasyeva nityaṃ kiṃ taṃ na jānāsi bālaka ।। sa eva bhagavānkṛṣṇaścāṃśena girijāsutaḥ ।। 11 ।। kṛtāñjalirnato bhūtvā stuhi durgāṃ śivapriyām ।। śivāṃ śivapradāṃ śaivāṃ śivabījāṃ śiveśvarīm ।। 12 ।। śivāyāḥ stotrarājena purā śūlikṛtena vai ।। tripurasya vadhe ghore brahmaṇā preritena ca ।। 13 ।। ityuktvā śrīpadaṃ śīghraṃ jagāma śrīniketanam ।। gate harau hariṃ smṛtvā rāmastāṃ stotumudyataḥ ।। 14 ।। stotreṇa viṣṇudattena sarvavighnahareṇa ca ।। dharmmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ kāraṇena ca nārada ।। 15 ।। kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā snātvā gaṅgodake śubhe ।। guruṃ praṇamya bhakteśaṃ dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।।16।। ācamya natvā mūrdhnā tāṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṃgaścānandāśrusamanvitaḥ ।।17।। paraśurāma uvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya ca goloke paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। āvirbhūtā vigrahataḥ purā sṛṣṭyunmukhasya ca ।। 18 ।। sūryyakoṭiprabhāyuktā vastrālaṅkārabhūṣitā ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā sasmitā sumanoharā ।। 19 ।। navayauvanasampannā sindūrāruṇyaśobhitā ।। lalitaṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam ।। 20 ।। aho'nirvacanīyā tvaṃ cārumūrttiṃ ca bibhratī ।। mokṣapradā mumukṣūṇāṃ mahāviṣṇorvidhiḥ svayam ।। 21 ।। mumoha kṣaṇamātreṇa dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ sarvamohinīm ।। bālaissaṃbhūya sahasā sasmitā dhāvitā purā ।। 22 ।। sadbhiḥ khyātā tena rādhā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। kṛṣṇastāṃ sahasā bhīto vīryyādhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 23 ।। tato ḍimbhaṃ mahajjajñe tato jāto mahāvirāṭ ।। yasyaiva lomakūpeṣu brahmāṇḍānyakhilāni ca ।। 24 ।। rādhāratikrameṇaiva tanniśvāso babhūva ha ।। sa niśśvāso mahāvāyuḥ sa virāḍ viśvadhārakaḥ ।। 25 ।। bhayagharmmajalenaiva pupluve viśvagolakam ।। sa virāḍ viśvanilayo jalarāśirbabhūva ha ।। 26 ।। tatastvaṃ pañcadhābhūya pañca mūrtīśca bibhratī।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛmūrtiryā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ vadanti purāvidaḥ ।। 27 ।। vedādhiṣṭhātṛmūrtiryā vedaśāstraprasūrapi ।। tāṃ sāvitrīṃ śuddharūpāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 28 ।। aiśvaryyādhiṣṭhātṛmūrtiḥ śāntistvaṃ śāntarūpiṇī ।। lakṣmīṃ vadanti santastāṃ śuddhāṃ sattvasvarūpiṇīm ।। 29।। rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā śuklamūrtissatāṃ prasūḥ ।। sarasvatīṃ tāṃ śāstrajñāṃ śāstrajñāḥ pravadantyaho ।। 30 ।। buddhirvidyā sarvaśakteryā mūrtiradhidevatā ।। sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyā sarvamaṅgalarūpiṇī ।। 31 ।। sarvamaṅgalabījasya śivasya nilaye'dhunā ।।32।। śive śivāsvarūpā tvaṃ lakṣmīrnārāyaṇāntike ।। sarasvatī ca sāvitrī vedasūrbrahmaṇaḥ priyā ।।33।। rādhā rāseśvarasyaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। paramānandarūpasya paramānandarūpiṇī।।34।। tvatkalāṃśāṃśakalayā devānāmapi yoṣitaḥ ।। 35 ।। tvaṃ vidyā yoṣitaḥ sarvāssarveṣāṃ bījarūpiṇī ।। chāyā sūryyasya candrasya rohiṇī sarva mohinī।।36।। śacī śakrasya kāmasya kāminī ratirīśvarī।। varuṇānī jaleśasya vāyoḥ strī prāṇavallabhā।।37।। vahneḥ priyā hi svāhā ca kuberasya ca sundarī।। yamasya tu suśīlā ca nairṛtasya ca kaiṭabhī ।।38।। aiśānī syācchaśikalā śatarūpā manoḥ priyā।। devahūtiḥ kardamasya vasiṣṭhasyāpyarundhatī ।। 39 ।। lopāmudrā'pyagastyasya devamātā'ditistathā ।। ahalyā gautamasyāpi sarvādhārā vasundharā ।। 40 ।। gaṅgā ca tulasī cāpi pṛthivyāṃ yā saridvarā ।। etāḥ sarvāśca yā hyanyā sarvāstvatkalayā'mbike ।। 41 ।। gṛhalakṣmī gṛhe nṝṇāṃ rājalakṣmīśca rājasu ।। tapasvināṃ tapasyā tvaṃ gāyatrī brāhmaṇasya ca ।। 42 ।। satāṃ sattvasvarūpā tvamasatāṃ kalahāṅkurā ।। jyotīrūpā nirguṇasya śaktistvaṃ saguṇasya ca ।। 43 ।। sūryye prabhāsvarūpā tvaṃ dāhikā ca hutāśane ।। jale śaityasvarūpā ca śobhārūpā niśākare ।। 44 ।। tvaṃ bhūmau gandharūpā cāpyākāśe śabdarūpiṇī ।। kṣutpipāsādayastvaṃ ca jīvināṃ sarvaśaktayaḥ ।। 45 ।। sarvabījasvarūpā tvaṃ saṃsāre sārarūpiṇī ।। smṛtirmedhā ca buddhirvā jñānaśaktirvipaścitām ।। 46 ।। kṛṣṇena vidyā yā dattā sarvajñāna prasūḥ śubhā ।। śūline kṛpayā sā tvaṃ yayā mṛtyuñjayaḥ śivaḥ ।।47।। sṛṣṭipālanasaṃhāraśaktayastrividhāśca yāḥ ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ sā tvameva namo'stu te ।। 48 ।। madhukaiṭabhabhītyā ca trasto dhātā prakampitaḥ ।। stutvā muktaśca yāṃ devīṃ tāṃ mūrdhnā praṇamāmyaham ।। 49 ।। madhukaiṭabhayoryuddhe trātā'sau viṣṇurīśvarīm ।। babhūva śaktimānstutvā tvāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 50 ।। tripurasya mahāyuddhe sarathe patite śive ।। yāṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ surāḥ sarve tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 51 ।। viṣṇunā vṛṣarūpeṇa svayaṃ śambhuḥ samutthitaḥ ।। jaghāna tripuraṃ stutvā tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 52 ।। yadājñayā vāti vātaḥ sūryastapati santatam ।। varṣatīndro dahatyagnistāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 53 ।। yadājñayā hi kālaśca śaśvadbhramati vegataḥ ।। mṛtyuścarati jantūnāṃ tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham।। ।। 54 ।। sraṣṭā sṛjati sṛṣṭiṃ ca pātā pāti yadājñayā ।। saṃharttā saṃharetkāle tāṃ durgāṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 55 ।। jyotissvarūpo bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇo nirguṇaḥ svayam ।। yayā vinā na śaktaśca sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ namāmi tām ।। 56 ।। rakṣa rakṣa jaganmātaraparādhaṃ kṣamasva me ।। śiśūnāmaparādhena kuto mātā hi kupyati ।। 57 ।। uktvā paraśurāmaśceti natvā tāṃ ruroda ha ।। tuṣṭā durgā saṃbhrameṇa cābhayaṃ ca varaṃ dadau ।। 58 ।। amaro bhava he putra vatsa susthiratāṃ vraja ।। sarvaprasādātsarvatra jayo'stu tava santatam ।। 59 ।। sarvāntarātmā bhagavāṃstuṣṭassyātsantataṃ hariḥ ।। bhaktirbhavatu te kṛṣṇe śivade ca śive gurau ।। 60 ।। iṣṭadeve gurau yasya bhaktirbhavati śāśvatī ।। taṃ hantuṃ nahi śaktā vā ruṣṭā vā sarvadevatāḥ ।। 61 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya ca bhaktastvaṃ śiṣyo vai śaṃkarasya ca ।। gurupatnīṃ stauṣi yasmātkastvāṃ hantumiheśvaraḥ ।। 62 ।। aho na kṛṣṇabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ।। anyadeveṣu ye bhaktā na bhaktā vā niraṅkuśāḥ ।। 63 ।। candramā balavāṃstuṣṭo yeṣāṃ bhāgyavatāṃ bhṛgo ।। teṣāṃ tārāgaṇā ruṣṭāḥ kiṃ kurvaṃti ca durbalāḥ।।64।। yasmai tuṣṭaḥ pālayati naradevo mahānsukhī ।। tasya kiṃ vā kariṣyanti ruṣṭā bhṛtyāśca durbalāḥ।।65।। ityuktvā pārvatī tuṣṭā dattvā rāmāya cāśiṣam ।। jagāmāntaḥpuraṃ tūrṇaṃ harṣaśabdo babhūva ha ।।66।। stotraṃ vai kāṇvaśākhoktaṃ pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। yātrākāle tathā prātarvācchitārthaṃ labheddhruvam ।।67।। putrārthī labhate putraṃ kanyārthī kanyakāṃ labhet ।। vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ prajārthī cāpnuyātprajāḥ ।। bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ naṣṭavitto dhanaṃ labhet ।।68।। yasya ruṣṭo gururdevo rājā vā bāndhavo'thavā ।। tasmai tuṣṭaśca varadaḥ stotrarājaprasādataḥ ।। 69 ।। dasyugrastaḥ phaṇigrastaśśatrugrasto bhayānakaḥ ।। vyādhigrasto bhavenmuktaḥ stotrasmaraṇamātrataḥ ।। ।। 70 ।। rājadvāre śmaśāne ca kārāgāre ca bandhane ।। jalarāśau nimagnaśca muktastatsmṛtimātrataḥ ।।71।। svāmibhede putrabhede mitrabhede ca dāruṇe ।। stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa vāñchitārthaṃ labheddhruvam ।। 72 ।। kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ varṣaṃ ca stotrarājaṃ śṛṇoti yā ।। bhaktyā durgāṃ ca sampūjya mahāvandhyā prasūyate ।। 73 ।। labhate sā divyaputraṃ jñāninaṃ cirajīvinam ।। asaubhāgyā ca saubhāgyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaśravaṇāllabhet ।।74।। navamāsaṃ kākavandhyā mṛtavatsā ca bhaktitaḥ ।। stotrarājaṃ yā śṛṇoti sā putraṃ labhate dhruvam ।।72।। kanyāmātā putrahīnā pañcamāsaṃ śṛṇoti yā ।। ghaṭe sampūjya durgāṃ ca sā putraṃ labhate dhruvam ।। 76 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde paraśurāmakṛtadurgāstotraṃ nāma pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 45 ।।
<3.46> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। stutvā tāṃ parśurāmo'sau harṣasaṃphullamānasaḥ ।। stotreṇa hariṇoktena sa tuṣṭāva gaṇādhipam ।। 1 ।। pūjāṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca naivedyairvividhairapi ।। dhūpairdīpaiśca gandhaiśca puṣpaiśca tulasīṃ vinā ।। 2 ।। sampūjya bhrātaraṃ bhaktyā sa rāmaḥ śaṃkarājñayā ।। gurupatnīṃ guruṃ natvā gamanaṃ kartumudyataḥ ।। 3 ।। nārada uvāca ।। pūjāṃ bhagavataścakre rāmo gaṇapateryadā ।। naivadyairvividhaiḥ puṣpaistulasīṃ ca vinā katham ।। 4 ।। tulasī sarvapuṣpāṇāṃ mānyā dhanyā manoharā ।। kathaṃ pūjāṃ sārabhūtāṃ na gṛhṇāti gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 5 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। brahmakalpasya vṛttāntaṃ nigūḍhaṃ ca manoharam ।।6।। ekadā tulasī devī prodbhinnanavayauvanā ।। tīrthaṃ bhramantī tapasā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ।। 7 ।। dadarśa gaṅgātīre sā gaṇeśaṃ yauvanānvitam ।। atīva sundaraṃ śuddhaṃ sasmitaṃ pītavāsasam ।। 8 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। dhyāyantaṃ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham ।। 9 ।। jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum ।। surūpahāryyaṃ niṣkāmaṃ sakāmā tamuvāca ha ।। 10 ।। tulasyuvāca ।। aho dhyāyasi kiṃ deva śāntarūpa gajānana ।। kathaṃ lambodaro deho gajavaktraṃ kathaṃ tava ।। 11 ।। ekadantaḥ kathaṃ vaktre vadāmutra ca kāraṇam ।। tyaja dhyānaṃ mahābhāga sāyaṃkāla upasthitaḥ ।। 12 ।। ityuktvā tulasī devī prajahāsa punaḥ punaḥ ।। paraṃ cetasi dagdhā sā kāmabāṇaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ ।। 13 ।। gaṇeśasya pradhānāṃge dattvā kiñcijjalaṃ mune ।। jaghāna tarjanyagreṇa niṣpandaṃ kṛṣṇamānasam ।। 14 ।। babhūva dhyānabhagnaṃ ca tasya nārada cetanam ।। duḥkhaṃ ca dhyānabhedena tadvicchedo hi śokadaḥ ।। 15 ।। dhyānaṃ tyaktvā hariṃ smṛtvā cāpaśyatkāminīṃ puraḥ ।। navayauvanasampannāṃ sasmitāṃ kāmapīḍitām ।। ।। 16 ।। lambodaraśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vinayapūrvakam ।। uvāca sasmitaḥ śāntaḥ śāntāṃ kāmāturāṃ vaśī ।। 17 ।। gaṇeśvara uvāca ।। kā tvaṃ vatse kasya kanyā mātarmā brūhi kiṃ śubhe ।। pāpado'śubhadaḥ śaśvaddhyānabhaṃgastapasvinām ।। 18 ।। kṛṣṇaḥ karotu kalyāṇaṃ hantu vighnaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। taddhyānabhaṃgajāddoṣānnāśubhaṃ syāttu te śubhe ।। 19 ।। gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca smarāturā ।। sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca devaṃ madhurayā girā ।। 20 ।। tulasyuvāca ।। dharmātmajasya kanyā'hamaprauḍhā ca tapasvinī ।। tapasyā me svāmino'rthe tvaṃ svāmī bhava me prabho ।। 21 ।। tulasīvacanaṃ śrutvā gaṇeśaḥ śrīhariṃ smaran ।। tāmuvāca mahāprājñaḥ prājñīṃ madhurayā girā ।। 22 ।। gaṇeśa uvāca ।। he mātarnāsti me vācchā ghore dāraparigrahe ।। dāragraho hi duḥkhāya na sukhāya kadācana ।। 23 ।। haribhaktervyavāyaśca tapasyānāśakārakaḥ ।। mokṣadvārakapāṭaśca bhavabandhanapāśakaḥ ।। 24 ।। garbhavāsakaraḥ śaśvattattvajñānanikṛntakaḥ ।। saṃśayānāṃ samārambho yastyājyo vṛṣalairapi ।। 25 ।। geho'yaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarvamāyākaraṇḍakam ।। sāhasānāṃ samūhaśca doṣāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।। 26 ।। nivartasva mahābhāge paśyānyaṃ kāmukaṃ patim ।। kāmukenaiva kāmukyāḥ saṃgamo guṇavānbhaveta ।। 27 ।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā kopātsā taṃ śaśāpa ha ।। dārāste bhavitā'sādhvī gaṇeśvara na saṃśayaḥ ।। 28 ।। ityākarṇya suraśreṣṭhastāṃ śaśāpa śivātmajaḥ ।। devi tvamasuragrastā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 29 ।। tatpaścānmahatāṃ śāpādvṛkṣastvaṃ bhaviteti ca ।। mahātapasvītyuktvā tāṃ virarāma ca nārada ।। 30 ।। śāpaṃ śrutvā tu tulasī sā ruroda punaḥ punaḥ ।। tuṣṭāva ca suraśreṣṭhaṃ sa prasanna uvāca tām ।। 31 ।। gaṇeśvara uvāca ।। puṣpāṇāṃ sārabhūtā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi manorame ।। kalāṃśena mahābhāge svayaṃ nārāyaṇapriyā ।। 32 ।। priyā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya viśeṣataḥ ।। pūjā vimuktidā nṝṇāṃ mayā bhogyā na nityaśaḥ ।। 33'।। ityuktvā tāṃ suraśreṣṭho jagāma tapase punaḥ ।। harerārādhanavyagro badarīsannidhiṃ yayau ।। 34 ।। jagāma tulasī devī hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। nirāhārā tapaścakre puṣkare lakṣavarṣakam ।। 35 ।। paścānmunīndraśāpena gaṇeśasya ca nārada ।। sā priyā śaṃkhacūḍasya babhūva suciraṃ mune ।। 36 ।। tataḥ śaṅkaraśūlena sa mamārāsureśvaraḥ ।। sā kalāṃśena vṛkṣatvaṃ yayau nārāyaṇapriyā ।। 37 ।। kathitaścetihāsaste śruto dharmamukhātpurā ।। mokṣapradaśca sāraśca purāṇena prakīrtitaḥ ।। 38 ।। tataḥ paraśurāmo'sau jagāma tapase vanam ।। praṇamya śaṅkaraṃ durgāṃ saṃpūjya ca gaṇeśvaram ।। 39 ।। pūjito vanditaḥ sarvaiḥ surendramunipuṅgavaiḥ ।। pārvatīśivasānnidhye sukhaṃ tasthau gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 40 ।। idaṃ gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। sa rājasūyayajñasya phalamāpnoti niścitam ।। 41 ।। aputro labhate putraṃ śrīgaṇeśaprasādataḥ ।। dhīraṃ vīraṃ ca dhaninaṃ guṇinaṃ cirajīvinam ।। 42 ।। yaśasvinaṃ putriṇaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ sukavīśvaram ।। jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasampadām ।। 43 ।। suśīlaṃ ca sadācāraṃ praśaṃsyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ labhet ।। ahiṃsakaṃ dayāluṃ ca tattvajñānaviśāradam ।। 44 ।। bhaktyā gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya vastrālaṅkāracandanaiḥ ।। śrutvā gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ mahāvandhyā prasūyate ।। 49 ।। mṛtavatsā kākavandhyā brahmanputraṃ labheddhruvam ।। adūṣyadūṣaṇaparā śuddhā caiva labhetsutam ।। 46 ।। saṃpūrṇaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ śrutvā yallabhate phalam ।। tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ śrutvedaṃ khaṇḍamuttamam।।47।। vāñchāṃ kṛtvā tu manasi śṛṇoti paramāsthitaḥ।। tasmai dadāti sarveṣṭaṃ suraśreṣṭho gaṇeśvaraḥ ।।48।। śrutvā gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ vighnanāśāya yatnataḥ ।। svarṇayajñopavītaṃ ca śvetacchatraṃ ca mālyakam ।। 49 ।। pradīyate vācakāya svastikaṃ tilalaḍḍukān ।। paripakvaphalānyeva deśakālodbhavāni ca ।। 50।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīye gaṇapatikhaṇḍe nāradanārāyaṇasaṃvāde paraśurāmāgamanaitatkhaṇḍaśravaṇaphalavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 46 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe tṛtīyaṃ gaṇapatikhaṇḍaṃ samāptam ।।
<4.1> ।। śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ ।। ।। śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ ।। ।। śrīgopījanavallabhāya namaḥ ।। ।। atha brahmavaivartīyaśrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaprāraṃbhaḥ ।। nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ।। devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ।। 1 ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। śrutaṃ prathamato brahmanbrahmakhaṇḍaṃ manoharam ।। brahmaṇo vadanāṃbhojātparamādbhutameva ca ।।1।। tatastadvacanāttūrṇaṃ samāgatya tavāṃtikam ।। śrutaṃ prakṛtikhaṇḍaṃ ca sudhākhaṃḍātparaṃ varam ।। 2 ।। tato gaṇapateḥ khaṃḍamakhaṃḍabhavakhaṃḍanam ।। na me tṛptaṃ mano lolaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ śrotumicchati ।। 3 ।। śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍaṃ ca janmādeḥ khaṃḍanaṃ nṛṇām ।। pradīpaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ karmaghnaṃ haribhaktidam ।। 4 ।। sadyo vairāgyajananaṃ bhavaroganikṛṃtanam ।। kāraṇaṃ muktibījānāṃ bhavābdhestāraṇaṃ param ।। 5 ।। karmopabhogarogāṇāṃ khaṃḍane ca rasāyanam ।। śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbhojaprāptisopāna kāraṇam ।। 6 ।। jīvanaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jagatāṃ pāvanaṃ param ।। vada vistārya māṃ bhaktaṃ śiṣyaṃ ca śaraṇāgatam ।। 7 ।। kena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa ājagāma mahītalam ।। sarvāṃśaireka eveśaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ।।8।। yuge kutra kuto hetoḥ kutra vā''virbabhūva ha ।। vasudevo'sya janakaḥ ko vā kā vā ca devakī ।। 9 ।। vada kasya kule janma māyayā suviḍaṃbanam ।। kiṃ cakāra samāgatya kena rūpeṇa vā hariḥ ।। ।। 10 ।। jagāma gokulaṃ kaṃsabhayena sūtikāgṛhāt ।। kathaṃ kaṃsātkīṭatulyādbhayeśasya bhayaṃ mune ।। 11 ।। harirvā gopaveṣeṇa gokule kiṃ cakāra ha ।। kuto gopāṅganāsārdhaṃ vijahāra jagatpatiḥ ।।12।। kā vā gopāṃganā ke vā gopālā bālarūpiṇaḥ ।। kā vā yaśodā ko naṃdaḥ kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ cakāra ha ।।13।। kathaṃ rādhā puṇyavatī devī gokulavāsinī ।। vraje vā vrajakanyā sā babhūva preyaso hareḥ।।14।। kathaṃ gopyo durārādhyaṃ saṃprāpurīśvaraṃ param ।। kathaṃ tāśca parityajya jagāma mathurāṃ punaḥ ।। 19 ।। bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ vidhāya jagāma saḥ ।। kathayasva mahābhāga puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana ।। 16 ।। sudurlabhāṃ harikathāṃ taraṇiṃ bhavasāgare ।। niṣekabhoganigaḍakleśacchedana kartanīm ।। 17 ।। pāpeṃdhanānāṃ dahane jvaladagniśikhāmiva ।। puṃsāṃ śrutavatāṃ koṭijanmakilbiṣanāśinīm ।। 18 ।। muktiṃ karṇasudhāramyāṃ śokasāgaranāśinīm ।। mahyaṃ bhaktāya śiṣyāya jñānaṃ dehi kṛpānidhe ।। 19 ।। tapojapamahādānātpṛthivyāṃ tīrthadarśanāt ।। śrutipāṭhādanaśanādvratāddevārcanādapi ।। 20 ।। dīkṣāyāḥ sarvayajñeṣu yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। ṣoḍaśīṃ jñānadānasya kalāṃ nārhati tatphalam ।। 21 ।। pitrā'haṃ preṣito jñānādānāya tava sannidhim ।। sudhāsamudraṃ saṃprāpya ko vā'nyatpātumicchati ।। 22 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। mayā jñāto'si dhanyastvaṃ puṇyarāśiḥ sumūrtimān ।। karoṣi bhramaṇaṃ lokānpāvituṃ kulapāvana ।। 23 ।। janānāṃ hṛdayaṃ sadyaḥ suvyaktaṃ vacanena vai ।। śiṣye kalatre kanyāyāṃ dauhitre bāṃdhave'pi ca ।। 24 ।। putre pautre ca vacasi pratāpe cāpadi striyām ।। vṛddhau vairiṇi vidyāyāṃ jñāyate hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām ।। 25 ।। jīvanmukto'si pūtastvaṃ śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ ।। punāsi pādarajasā sarvādhārāṃ vasundharām ।। 26 ।। punāsi lokāntsarvāṃśca svīyavigrahadarśanāt ।। sumaṃgalāṃ harikathāṃ tena tvaṃ śrotumicchasi ।। 27 ।। yatra kṛṣṇakathāḥ saṃti tatraiva sarvadevatāḥ ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva tīrthāni nikhilāni ca ।। 28 ।। kathāḥ śrutvā kathāṃte te yāṃti santo nirāpadam ।। bhavaṃti tāni tīrthāni yeṣu kṛṣṇakathāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 29 ।। sadyaḥ kṛṣṇakathāvaktā svasya puṃsāṃ śataṃ śatam।। samuddhṛtya śrutavatāṃ punāti nikhilaṃ kulam ।। 30 ।। praṣṭā tu praśnamātreṇa punāti kulamātmanaḥ ।। śrotā śravaṇamātreṇa svakulaṃ sva svabāṃdhavān ।। 31 ।। śatajanmatapastapto janmedaṃ bhārate labhet ।। karoti saphalaṃ janma śrutvā harikathāmṛtam ।। 32 ।। arcanaṃ vaṃdanaṃ mantrajapaḥ sevanameva ca ।। smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ śaśvadguṇaśravaṇamīpsitam ।। 33 ।। nivedanaṃ tasya dāsyaṃ navadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam ।। karoti janma suphalaṃ kṛtvaitāni ca nārada ।। 34 ।। na ca vighno bhavettasya paramāyurna naśyati ।। na yāti tatpuraḥ kālo vainateyamivoragaḥ ।। 35 ।। na jahāti samīpaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ tasya hariḥ svayam ।। upatiṣṭhati tūrṇaṃ tamaṇimādikasiddhayaḥ ।। 36 ।। sudarśanaṃ bhramatyeva tasya pārśve divāniśam ।। kṛṣṇājñayā ca rakṣārthaṃ ko vā kiṃ kartumīśvaraḥ ।। 37 ।। na yāṃti tatsamīpaṃ ca svapne'pi yamakiṃkarāḥ ।। jvaladagniṃ yathā dṛṣṭvā śalabhā na vrajaṃti tam ।। 36 ।। vyādhayo vipadaḥ śokā viprāśca na prayāṃti tam ।। na yāti tatsamīpaṃ ca mṛtyurmṛtyubhayānmune ।। 39 ।। ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। sa ca sarvatra niḥśaṃkaḥ sukhī kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ ।। 40 ।। tava kṛṣṇakathāyāṃ ca ratirātyaṃtikī sadā ।। janakasya svabhāvo hi janye tiṣṭhati niścitam ।। 41 ।। vipreṃdra kā praśaṃseyaṃ janma te brahmamānase ।। yatra yatra kule janma tanmatistādṛśī bhavet ।। 42 ।। pitā vidhātā jagatāṃ kṛṣṇapādābjasevayā ।। nityaṃ karoti yaḥ śaśvannavadhā bhaktilakṣaṇam ।। 43 ।। ratiḥ kṛṣṇakathāyāṃ ca yasyāśrupulakodgamaḥ ।। mano nimagnaṃ tatraiva sa bhaktaḥ kathito budhaiḥ ।।44।। putradārādikaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti śrīhareriti ।। ātmanā manasā vācā sa bhaktaḥ kathito budhaiḥ ।। 45 ।। nirjane tīrthasaṃparke niḥsaṃgā ye mudā'nvitāḥ ।। dhyāyaṃte caraṇāṃbhojaṃ śrīhareste ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।46।। dayā'sti sarvajīveṣu sarvaṃ kṛṣṇama yaṃ jagat ।। yo jānāti mahājñānī sa bhakto vaiṣṇavo mataḥ ।।47।। śaśvadye nāma gāyaṃti guṇaṃ maṃtraṃ japaṃti ca ।। kurvaṃti śravaṇaṃ gāthā vadaṃti te'tivaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 46 ।। labdhānīṣṭāni vastūni pradātuṃ haraye mudā ।। tūrṇaṃ yasya mano hṛṣṭaṃ sa bhakto jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। 49 ।। yanmano haripādābje svapne jñāne divāniśam।। pūrvakarmopabhogaṃ ca bahirbhuṅkte sa vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 50 ।। guruvaktrādviṣṇumaṃtro yasya karṇe viśatyalam ।। taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 51 ।। pūrvāntsapta parāntsapta sapta mātāmahādikān ।। sodarānuddharedbhaktaḥ svaprasūṃ ca prasūprasūm ।।52।। kalatraṃ kanyakāṃ baṃdhuṃ śiṣyaṃ dauhitramātmanaḥ ।। kiṃkarānkiṃkarīścaivamuddharedvaiṣṇavaḥ sadā ।। 53 ।। sadā vāṃchati tīrthāni vaiṣṇavasparśadarśane ।। pāpidattāni pāpāni teṣāṃ naśyaṃti saṃgataḥ ।। 54 ।। godohanakṣaṇaṃ yāvadyatra tiṣṭhaṃti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। tatra sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃti tāvanmahītale ।।55।। dhruvaṃ tatra mṛtaḥ pāpī mukto yāti hareḥ padam ।। tathaiva jñānagaṃgāyāmaṃte kṛṣṇasmṛtau yathā।।56।। tulasīkānane goṣṭhe śrīkṛṣṇamaṃdire pare।। vṛṃdāraṇye haridvāre tīrtheṣvanyeṣu vā yathā ।।57।। pāpāni pāpināṃ yāṃti tīrthasnānāvagāhanāt ।। teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyaṃti vaiṣṇavasparśavāyunā ।।58।। na hi sthātuṃ śaknuvaṃti pāpānyeva kṛtāni ca ।। jvaladagnau yathā kṣipraṃ śuṣkāṇi hi tṛṇāni ca ।।59।। bhaktaṃ vartmani gacchaṃtaṃ ye ye paśyaṃti mānavāḥ।। saptajanmārjitāghāni teṣāṃ naśyaṃti niścitam ।। 60।। ye niṃdaṃti hṛṣīkeśaṃ tadbhaktaṃ puṇyarūpiṇam ।। śatajanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati niścitam।। 61 ।। te pacyaṃte mahāghore kuṃbhīpāke bhayānake ।। bhakṣitāḥ kīṭasaṃghena yāvaccaṃdradivākarau ।। 62 ।। tasya darśanamātreṇa puṇyaṃ naśyati niścitam ।। gaṃgāṃ snātvā raviṃ natvā tadā vidvānviśudhyati ।। 63 ।। vaiṣṇavasparśamātreṇa mukto bhavati pātakī ।। tasya pāpāni haṃtyeva svāṃtaḥstho madhusūdanaḥ।। ।। 64 ।। ityevaṃ kathito vipra viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayorguṇaḥ ।। adhunā śrīharerjanma nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 65 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayorguṇapraśaṃsāprastāvavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 ।।
<4.2> ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। yena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇa ājagāma mahītalam।। yaṃ yaṃ vidhāya bhūmau sa jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 1।। bhārāvataraṇopāyaṃ duṣṭānāṃ ca vadhodyamam ।। sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi suvicārya vidhānataḥ ।। 2 ।। adhunā gopaveṣaṃ ca gokulāgamanaṃ hareḥ ।। rādhā gopālikā yena nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 3 ।। śaṃkhacūḍavadhaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ śrutam ।। adhunā tatsuvistārya nibodha kathayāmi te ।। ।। 4 ।। śrīdāmnaḥ kalahaścaiva babhūva rādhayā saha ।। śrīdāmā śaṃkhacūḍaśca śāpāttasyā babhūva ha ।। 5 ।। rādhāṃ śaśāpa śrīdāmā yāhi yoniṃ ca mānavīm ।। vraje vrajāṃganā bhūtvā vicarasva mahītale ।। 6 ।। bhītā śrīdāmaśāpātsā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ samuvāca ha ।। gopīrūpā bhaviṣyāmi śrīdāmā māṃ śaśāpa ha ।। 7 ।। kamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada māṃ bhayabhaṃjana ।। tvayā vinā kathamahaṃ dhariṣyāmi svajīvanam ।। 8 ।। kṣaṇamekaṃ yugaśataṃ kālanātha tvayā vinā ।। cakṣurnimeṣavirahādbhavedaṃdhaṃ mano mama ।। 9।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhaṃ kṣudhāpūrṇānanaṃ tava ।। nātha cakṣuñcakorābhyāṃ pibāmyahamaharniśam।। 10 ।। tvamātmā me manaḥ prāṇā dehamātraṃ vahāmyaham ।। dṛṣṭiśaktiśca cakṣustvaṃ jīvanaṃ paramaṃ dhanam ।।11।। svapne jñāne tvayi manaḥ smarāmi tvatpadāṃbujam ।। tava dāsyaṃ vinā nātha na jīvāmi kṣaṇaṃ vibho ।। 12 ।। kṛṣṇastadvacanaṃ śrutvā bodhayāmāsa suṃdarīm ।। vakṣasi preyasīṃ kṛtvā cakāra nirbhayāṃ ca tām ।।13।। mahītalaṃ gamiṣyāmi vārāhe ca varānane ।। mayā sārdhaṃ bhūgamanaṃ janma te'pi nirūpitam ।।14।। vrajaṃ gatvā vraje devi vihariṣyāmi kānane ।। mama prāṇādhikā tvaṃ ca bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite ।।15।। tāmityuktvā haristatra virarāma jagatpatiḥ ।। ato hetorjagannātho jagāma naṃdagokulam।। 15 ।। kiṃ vā tasya bhayaṃ kaṃsādbhayāṃtakārakasya ca ।। māyā bhayacchalenaiva jagāma rādhikāṃtikam ।। 17 ।। vijahāra tayā sārdhaṃ gopaveṣaṃ vidhāya saḥ ।। saha gopāṃganābhiśca pratijñāpālanāya ca ।।18।। brahmaṇā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samāgatya mahītalam ।। bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 19 ।। nārada uvāca ।। śrīdāmnaḥ kalahaścaiva kathaṃ vā rādhayā saha ।। saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃvyasya kathayādhunā ।। 20 ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā rādhayā sārdhaṃ goloke śrīhariḥ svayam ।। vijahāra mahāraṇye nirjane rāsamaṃḍale ।। ।। 21 ।। rādhikāsukhasaṃbhogād bubudhe na svakaṃ param।। kṛtvā vihāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇastāmapṛṣṭvā vihāya ca।।22।। gopikāṃ virajāmanyāṃ śṛṅgārārthaṃ jagāma ha ।। vṛṃdāraṇye ca virajā subhagā rādhikāsamā ।।23।। tasyā vayasyāḥ suṃdaryo gopīnāṃ śatakoṭayaḥ ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā gopī dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ।।24।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthā sā dadarśa harimantike।। dadarśa śrīharistāṃ ca śaraccaṃdranibhānanām ।।25।। manoharāṃ sasmitāṃ ca paśyaṃtīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। sadā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ prodbhinnanavayauvanām ।।26।। ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ bhūṣitāṃ śuklavāsasā ।। pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgīṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām ।।27।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śrīharistūrṇaṃ vijahāra tayā saha ।। puṣpatalpe mahāraṇye nirjane ratnamaṃḍape ।।28।। mūrcchāmavāpa virajā kṛṣṇaśṛṃgārakautukāt ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi prāṇeśaṃ koṭikaṃdarpasannibham ।। 29 ।। tayā saktaṃ śrīhariṃ ca ratnamaṃḍapasaṃsthitam ।। dṛṣṭvā ca rādhikālyaśca cakrustāṃ ca nivedanam ।। 30 ।। tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā suṣvāpa ca cukopa ha ।। bhṛśaṃ ruroda sā devī raktapaṃkajalocanā ।। 31 ।। tā uvāca mahādevī māṃ taṃ darśayituṃ kṣamāḥ ।। yadi satyaṃ brūta yūyaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ pragacchata ।। 32 ।। kariṣyāmi phalaṃ gopyāḥ kṛṣṇasya ca yathocitam ।। ko rakṣitā'dya tasyāśca mayi śāstiṃ prakurvati ।। 33 ।। śīghramānayatālyaśca tayā sārddhaṃ hariṃ priyam ।। aṃtarvaktraṃ sasmitaṃ ca viṣakuṃbhaṃ sudhāmukham ।। 34 ।। madāśrayaṃ samāgaṃtuṃ yūyaṃ dāsaṃ na dāsyatha ।। tameva maṃḍapaṃ ramyaṃ yāta saṃrakṣateśvaram ।। 35 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā kāścidgopyo bhayānvitāḥ ।। tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃpuṭāṃjalyo bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ।। tāmūcuḥ purataḥ sthitvā sarvā eva priyāṃ satīm ।। 36 ।। ।। ālya ūcuḥ ।। vayaṃ taṃ darśayiṣyāmo virajāsahitaṃ vibhum ।। 37 ।। tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā rathamāruhya suṃdarī ।। jagāma sārdhaṃ gopībhistriṣaṣṭiśatakoṭibhiḥ ।। 38 ।। ratneṃdrasāraracitaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham ।। maṇīṃdrasāraracitaṃ kalaśānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 39 ।। rājitaṃ citrarājībhirvaijayaṃtīvirājitam ।। lakṣacakrasamāyuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam ।। 40 ।। maṇisāravikāraiśca koṭistaṃbhaiḥ suśobhitam ।। nānācitravicitraiśca sahitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। 41 ।। siṃdūrākāramaṇibhirmadhyadeśe vibhūṣitaiḥ ।। ratnakṛtrimasiṃhaiśca rathacakrordhvasaṃsthitaiḥ ।। 42 ।। caturlakṣaparimitaiścitraghaṃṭāsamanvitaiḥ ।। citraputtaliśobhāḍhyairvicitraiśca virājitam ।। 43 ।। ratimaṃdiralakṣaiśca ratnasāravinirmitaiḥ ।। maṇisārakapāṭaiśca śobhitaiścitravājibhiḥ ।। 44 ।। maṇīṃdrasārakalaśaiḥ śekharojjvalitairyutam ।। bhogadravyasamāyuktaṃ veṣadravyasamanvitam ।। 45 ।। śobhitaṃ ratnaśayyābhī ratnapātraghaṭānvitam ।। harinmaṇīnāṃ vedīnāṃ samūhena samanvitam ।। 46 ।। kuṃkumābhamaṇīnāṃ ca sopānaiḥ koṭibhiryutam ।। syamaṃtakaiḥ kaustubhaiśca rucakaiḥ pravaraistathā ।। 47 ।। padmakṛtrimakoṭīnāṃ śatakaiśca suśobhitam ।। citrakānanavāpībhi rviśiṣṭābhirvirājitam ।। 48 ।। ratneṃdrasāraracitakalaśojjvalaśekharam ।। śatayojanamūrdhvaṃ ca daśayojanavistṛtam ।। 49 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālākoṭivirājitam ।। kuṃdānā karavīrāṇāṃ yūthikānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 50 ।। sucārucaṃpakānāṃ ca nāgeśānāṃ manoharaiḥ ।। mallikānāṃ mālatīnāṃ mādhavīnāṃ sugaṃdhinām ।। 51 ।। kadaṃbānāṃ ca mālānāṃ kadaṃbaiśca virājitam ।। sahasradalapadmānāṃ mālābhiśca virājitam ।। 52 ।। citrapuṣpodyānasaraḥ kānanaiśca vibhūṣitam ।। sarveṣāṃ syaṃdanānāṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ vāyuvahaṃ param ।। 53 ।। tatsūkṣmavastrasārāṇāṃ varairācchāditaṃ param ।। ratnadarpaṇalakṣāṇāṃ śatakaiśca samanvitam ।। 54 ।। śvetacāmarakoṭībhirvajrakoṭibhiranvitam ।। candanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitaiḥ ।। 55 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ koṭitalpavirājitam ।। koṭighaṃṭāsamāyuktaṃ patākākoṭibhiryutam ।। 56 ।। ratnaśayyākoṭibhiśca citravajraparicchadaiḥ ।। caṃdanāktaiścaṃpakānāṃ kuṃkumaiśca vicitritaiḥ ।। 57 ।। puṣpopadhānasaṃyuktaiḥ śṛṃgārārhābhiranvitam ।। adṛśyairaśrutairdravyaiḥ suṃdaraiśca vibhūṣitam ।। 58 ।। evaṃbhūtādrathāttūrṇamavaruhya haripriyā ।। jagāma sahasā devī taṃ ratnamaṃḍapaṃ mune ।। 59 ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśe dvārapālaṃ manoharam ।। lakṣagopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ smerānanasaroruham ।। 60 ।। gopaṃ śrīdāmanāmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapriyakiṃkaram ।। tamuvāca ruṣā devī raktapaṃkajalocanā ।। 61 ।। gaccha dūraṃ gaccha dūraṃ ratilaṃpaṭakiṃkara ।। kīdṛśīṃ matparāṃ kāṃtāṃ drakṣyāmi tvatprabhoraham ।। 62 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā niḥśaṃkaḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ ।। tāmeva na dadau gaṃtuṃ vetrapāṇirmahābalaḥ ।। 63 ।। tūrṇaṃ ca rādhikālyaśca śrīdāmānaṃ sakiṃkaram ।। balena prerayāmāsuḥ kopena sphuritādharāḥ ।। 64 ।। śrutvā kolāhalaṃ śabdaṃ gopikānāṃ hariḥ svayam ।। jñātvā ca kopitāṃ rādhāmaṃtardhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 65 ।। virajā rādhikāśabdādaṃtardhānaṃ harerapi ।। dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ bhayārtā sā jahau prāṇāṃśca yogataḥ ।। 66 ।। sadyastatra saridrūpaṃ taccharīraṃ babhūva ha ।। vyāptaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ tayā golokameva ca ।। 67 ।। koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ prasthe'tinimnameva ca ।। dairghye daśaguṇaṃ cāru nānāratnākaraṃ param ।। 68 ।। ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde virajānadaprastāvavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 2 ।।
<4.3> ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। rādhā ratigṛhaṃ gatvā na dadarśa hariṃ mune ।। virajāṃ ca saridūpāṃ dṛṣṭvā gehaṃ jagāma sā।।1।। śrīkṛṣṇo virajāṃ dṛṣṭvā saridrūpāṃ priyāṃ satīm ।। uccai ruroda virajātīre nīramanohare।।2।। mamāṃtikaṃ samāgaccha preyasīnāṃ pare vare ।। tvayā vinā'haṃ subhage kathaṃ jīvāmi suṃdari ।। 3 ।। nadyadhiṣṭhātri devi tvaṃ bhava mūrtimatī satī ।। mamāśiṣā rūpavatī suṃdarī yoṣitā varā।।4।। pūrvarūpācca saubhāgyādidānīṃ subhagā bhava ।। purātanaṃ śarīraṃ te saridūpamabhūtsati ।।5।। jalādutthāya cāgaccha vidhāya tanumuttamām।। aṣṭau siddhīrmayā dattāḥ surasuṃdari satvaram ।। 6 ।। kṛṣṇājñayā ca virajā vidhāya tanumuttamām ।। ājagāma hareragre sākṣādrādheva suṃdarī ।। 7 ।। pītavastraparīdhānā smerānanasaroruhā ।। paśyaṃtaṃ prāṇanāthaṃ ca paśyaṃtī vakracakṣuṣā ।। 8 ।। nitaṃbaśroṇibhārārtā pīnonnatapayodharā ।। māninī māninīnāṃ ca gajeṃdramaṃdagāminī ।। 9 ।। suṃdarī sudarīṇāṃ ca dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ।। cārucaṃpakavarṇābhā pakvabiṃbādharā varā ।। 10।। pakva dāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktimanoharā ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyā phulleṃdīvaralocanā ।। 11 ।। kastūrībiṃdunā sārdhaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdubhūṣitā ।। cārupatraka śobhāḍhyā sucārukabarīyutā ।। 12 ।। ratnakuṃḍalagaṃḍasthā bhūṣitā ratnamālayā ।। gajamauktikanāsāgrā muktāhāravirājitā ।। 13 ।। ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūracāruśaṃkhakarojjvalā ।। kiṃkiṇījālaśabdāḍhyā ratnamaṃjīraraṃjitā ।। 14 ।। tāṃ ca rūpavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā premodrekā jagatpatiḥ ।। cakārāliṃganaṃ tūrṇaṃ cucuṃba ca muhurmuhuḥ ।।15।। nānāprakāraśṛṃgāraṃ viparītādikaṃ vibhuḥ ।। rahasi preyasīṃ prāpya cakāra ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 16 ।। virajā sā rajoyuktā dhṛtvā vīryamamoghakam ।। sadyo babhūva tatraiva dhanyā garbhavatī satī।। 17 ।। dadhāra garbhamīśasya divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ ca sā ।। tataḥ suṣāva tatraiva putrānsapta manoharān ।। 18 ।। mātā sā saptaputrāṇāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya priyā satī ।। tasthau tatra sukhāsīnā sārddhaṃ putraiśca saptabhiḥ ।। 19 ।। ekadā hariṇā sārddhaṃ vṛṃdāraṇye ca nirjane ।। vijahāra punaḥ sādhvī śṛṃgārāsaktamānasā ।। 20 ।। etasminnaṃtare tatra mātuḥ kroḍaṃ jagāma ha ।। kaniṣṭhaputrastasyāśca bhrātṛbhiḥ pīḍito bhiyā ।। 21 ।। bhītaṃ svatanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatyāja tāṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। kroḍe cakāra bālaṃ sā kṛṣṇo rādhāgṛhaṃ yayau ।। 22 ।। prabodhya bālaṃ sā sādhvī na dadarśāṃtike priyam ।। vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ tatra śṛṃgārātṛptamānasā ।। 23 ।। śaśāpa svasutaṃ kopāllavaṇodo bhaviṣyasi।। kadā'pi te jalaṃ kecinna khādiṣyaṃti jīvinaḥ ।। 24 ।। śaśāpa bālānsarvāṃśca yāṃtu mūḍhā mahītalam ।। gacchadhvaṃ ca mahīṃ mūḍhā jaṃbudvīpaṃ manoharam ।। 25 ।। sthitirnaikatra yuṣmākaṃ bhaviṣyati pṛthakpṛthak ।। dvīpe dvīpe sthitiṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhaṃtu sukhinaḥ sadā ।। 26 ।। dvīpasthābhirnadībhiśca saha krīḍaṃtu nirjane ।। kaniṣṭho mātṛśāpācca lavaṇodo babhūva ha ।। 27 ।। kaniṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa mātṛśāpaṃ ca bālakān ।। ājagmurduḥkhitāḥ sarve mātṛsthāne ca bālakāḥ।।28।। śrutvā vivaraṇaṃ sarve prajagmurdharaṇītalam ।। praṇamya caraṇaṃ māturbhaktinamrātmamūrtayaḥ ।। 29 ।। saptadvīpasamudrāśca sapta tasthurvibhāgaśaḥ ।। kaniṣṭhādvṛddhaparyaṃtaṃ dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ mune ।। 30 ।। lavaṇekṣusurā sarpirdadhidugdhajalārṇavāḥ ।। eteṣāṃ ca jalaṃ pṛthvyāṃ sasyārthaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ।। 31 ।। vyāptāḥ samudrāḥ saptaiva saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām ।। rurudurbālakāḥ sarve mātṛbhrātṛśucā'nvitāḥ ।। 32 ।। ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ sādhvī putravicchedakātarā ।। mūrcchāmavāpa śokena putrāṇāṃ bhartureva ca ।। 33 ।। tāṃ śokasāgare magnāṃ vijñāya rādhikāpatiḥ ।। ājagāma punastasyāḥ smerānanasaroruhaḥ ।। 34 ।। dṛṣṭvā hariṃ sā tatyāja śokaṃ rodanameva ca ।। ānandasāgare magnā dṛṣṭvā kāṃtaṃ babhūva ha ।।35।। cakāra śrīhariṃ kroḍe vijahāra smarāturā ।। tāṃ ca putra parityaktāṃ haristuṣṭo babhūva ha।। 36 ।। varaṃ tasyai dadau prītyā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। kāṃte nityaṃ tava sthānamāgamiṣyāmi niścitam ।। 37 ।। yathā rādhā tatsamā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi priyā mama ।। putrāndrakṣyasi nityaṃ tvaṃ madvarasya prasādataḥ ।। 38 ।। ityuktavaṃtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vasaṃtaṃ virajāṃtike ।। dṛṣṭvā rādhāvayasyāśca kathayāmāsurīśvarīm ।। 39 ।। śrutvā ruroṣa sā devī suṣvāpa krodhamaṃdire ।। etasminnaṃtare kṛṣṇo jagāma rādhikāṃtikam ।। 40 ।। sa tasthau rādhikādvāre śrīdāmnā saha nārada ।। rāseśvarī hariṃ dṛṣṭvā ruṣṭovāca priyaṃ puraḥ ।। 41 ।। matto bahutarāḥ kāṃtā goloke saṃti te hare ।। yāhi tāsāṃ sannidhānaṃ mayā te kiṃ prayojanam ।। 42 ।। virajā preyasī kāṃtā saridrūpā babhūva ha ।। dehaṃ tyaktvā mama bhayāttathā'pi yāhi tāṃ prati ।। 43 ।। tattīre maṃdiraṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ca yāhi tām।। nadī babhūva sā tvaṃ ca nado bhavitumarhasi ।। 44 ।। nadasya nadyā sārddhaṃ ca saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet ।। svajātau paramā prītiḥ śayane bhojane sukhāt ।। 45 ।। devacūḍāmaṇeḥ krīḍā nadyā sārddhamaho bata ।। mahājanaḥ smeramukhaḥ śrutvā sadyo bhaviṣyati ।। 46 ।। ye tvāṃ vadaṃti sarveśaṃ te kiṃ jānaṃti tattvataḥ ।। bhagavānsarvabhūtātmā nadīṃ saṃbhoktumicchati ।। 47 ।। ityuktvā rādhikā devī virarāma ruṣā'nvitā ।। nottasthau bhūmiśayanādgopīlakṣasamanvitā।।48 ।। kāściccāmarahastāśca kāścitsūkṣmāṃśukāṃbarāḥ ।। kāścittāṃbūlahastāśca kāścinmālākarā varāḥ ।। 49 ।। vāsitodakarāḥ kāścitkāścitpadmakarā varāḥ ।। kāścitsiṃdūrahastāśca pānahastāśca kāścana ।। 50 ।। ratnālaṃkārahastāśca kāścitkajjalavāhikāḥ ।। veṇuvīṇākarāḥ kāścitkāścitkaṃkatikākarāḥ ।। 51 ।। kāścidāvīrahastāśca yaṃtrahastāśca kāścana ।। sugaṃdhitailahastāśca kāścana pramadottamāḥ ।। 52 ।। karatālakarāḥ kāścidgeṃduhastāśca kāścana ।। kāścinmṛdaṃgamurajamuralītānakārikāḥ ।। 53 ।। saṃgītanipuṇāḥ kāścitkāścinnartanatatparāḥ ।। krīḍāvastukarāḥ kāścinmadhuhastāśca kāścana ।। 54 ।। sudhāpātrakarāḥ kāścidaṃghripīṭhakarāḥ parāḥ ।। veṣavastukarāḥ kāścitkāściccaraṇasevikāḥ ।। 55 ।। puṭāṃjalikarāḥ kāścitkāścitstutiparā varāḥ ।। evaṃ katividhāḥ saṃti rādhikāpurato mune ।। 56 ।। bahirdeśasthitāḥ kāścitkoṭiśaḥ koṭiśaḥ sadā ।। kāściddvāraniyuktāśca vayasyā vetradhārikāḥ ।। 57 ।। kṛṣṇamabhyaṃtaraṃ gaṃtuṃ na dadurdvārasaṃsthitāḥ ।। puraḥsthitaṃ taṃ prāṇeśaṃ rādhā punaruvāca sā ।। nānurūpamatyakathyayamayogyamatikarkaśam ।। 58 ।। ।। rādhikovāca ।। he kṛṣṇa virajākāṃta gaccha matpurato hare ।। kathaṃ dunoṣi māṃ lola raticaurātilaṃpaṭa ।। 59 ।। śīghraṃ padmāvatīṃ gaccha ratnamālāṃ manoramām ।। athavā vanamālāṃ vā rūpeṇāpratimāṃ vraja ।। 60 ।। he nadīkāṃta deveśa devānāṃ ca gurorguro ।। mayā jñāto'si bhadraṃ te gaccha gaccha mamāśramāt ।। 63 ।। śaśvatte mānuṣāṇāṃ ca vyavahārasya laṃpaṭa ।। labhatāṃ mānuṣīṃ yoniṃ golokādvraja bhāratam ।। 62 ।। he suśīle śaśikale he padmāvati mādhavi ।। nivāryatāṃ ca dhūrto'yaṃ kiṃmasyātra prayojanam ।। 63 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tamūcurgopikā harim ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vinayaṃ sāraṃ yatsamayocitam ।। 64 ।। kāścidūcuriti hare gaccha sthānāṃtaraṃ kṣaṇam ।। rādhākopāpanayane hyāgamiṣyāmahe vayam ।। 69 ।। kāścidūcuriti prītyā kṣaṇaṃ gaccha gṛhāṃtaram ।। tvayaiva vardhitā rādhā tvāṃ vinā kaṃ ca vakṣyati ।। 66 ।। kāścidūcuriti premṇā rādhikāyāṃ hariṃ mune ।। kṣaṇaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ gaccha mānāpanayanāvadhi ।। 67 ।। kāścidityūcurīśaṃ ca parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ ।। mānāpanayanaṃ bhaktyā māninyāḥ kuru kāmuka ।। 68 ।। kāścanocuritīśaṃ taṃ yāhi jāyāṃtaraṃ tava ।। lolupasya kathaṃ nātha kariṣyāmo yathocitam ।। 69 ।। kāścanocuriti hariṃ sasmitaṃ purataḥ sthitam ।। gatvā samīpamutthāya mānāpanayanaṃ kuru ।। 70 ।। kāścanocuriti prāṇanāthaṃ gopyo durakṣaram ।। kaḥ kṣamaḥ sāṃprataṃ draṣṭaṃ rādhikāmukhapaṃkajam ।। 71 ।। kāścanocuriti vibhuṃ vraja sthānāṃtaraṃ hare ।। kopāpanayane kāle punarāgamanaṃ tava ।। 72 ।। kāścanocuritīdaṃ taṃ pragalbhāḥ pramadottamāḥ ।। vayaṃ tvāṃ dārayiṣyāmo na cedyāhi gṛhāṃtaram ।। 73 ।। kāścinnivārayāmāsurmādhavaṃ pramadottamāḥ ।। smitavaktraṃ ca sarveśaṃ svasthamakrodhamīśvaram ।। 74 ।। gopīrbhirvāryamāṇe ca jagatkāraṇakāraṇe ।। sadyaścukopa śrīdāmā harau gehāṃtaraṃ gate ।। 79 ।। kopāduvāca śrīdāmā rādhikāṃ parameśvarīm ।। raktapadmekṣaṇāṃ ruṣṭāṃ raktapaṃkajalocanām ।। 76 ।। ।। śrīdāmovāca ।। ।। kathaṃ vadasi mātastvaṃ kaṭuvākyaṃ madīśvaram ।। vicāraṇāṃ vinā devi karoṣi bhartsanaṃ vṛthā ।। 77 ।। brahmānaṃteśadeveśaṃ jagatkāraṇakāraṇam ।। vāṇīpadmālayāmāyāprakṛtīśaṃ ca nirguṇam ।। 78 ।। svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ karoṣi tvaṃ viḍaṃbanam ।। devīnāṃ pravarā tvaṃ ca nibodha yasya sevayā ।। 79 ।। yasya pādārcanenaiva sarveṣāmīśvarī parā ।। tanna jānāsi kalyāṇi kimahaṃ vaktumīśvaraḥ ।। 80 ।। bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā kṛṣṇaḥ sraṣṭuṃ śaktaśca tvadvidhāḥ ।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo devyastaṃ na jānāsi nirguṇam ।। 81 ।। vaikuṃṭhe śrīharerasya caraṇāṃbujamārjanam ।। karoti keśaiḥ śaśvacchrīḥ sevanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam ।। 82 ।। sarasvatī ca stavanaiḥ karṇapīyūṣasuṃdaraiḥ ।। satataṃ stauti yaṃ bhaktyā na jānāsi tamīśvaram ।। 83 ।। bhītā ca prakṛtirmāyā sarveṣāṃ bījarūpiṇī ।। satataṃ stauti yaṃ bhaktyā taṃ na jānāsi mānini ।। 84 ।। stuvaṃti satataṃ vedā mahimnaḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ।। kadāpi na vijānaṃti taṃ na jānāsi bhāmini ।। 85 ।। vaktraiścaturbhiryaṃ brahmā vedānāṃ janako vibhuḥ ।। stauti sevāṃ ca kurute caraṇāṃbujamīśvari ।। 86 ।। śaṃkaraḥ paṃcabhirvaktraiḥ stauti yaṃ yogināṃ guruḥ ।। sāśrupūrṇaḥ sapulakaḥ sevate caraṇāṃbujam ।। 87 ।। śeṣaḥ sahasravadanaiḥ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। satataṃ stauti yaṃ bhaktyā sevate caraṇāṃbujam ।। 88 ।। dharmaḥpātā ca sarveṣāṃ sākṣī ca jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। bhaktyā ca caraṇāṃbhojaṃ sevate satataṃ mudā।।89।। śvetadvīpanivāsī yaḥ pātā viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ vibhuḥ ।। tasyāṃśaśca tathā yaṃ yaṃ dhāryate'pyakṣaraṃ param ।। 90।। surāsuramunīṃdrāśca manavo mānavā budhāḥ ।। sevaṃte na hi paśyaṃti svapne'pi caraṇāṃbujam।।91।। kṣipraṃ roṣaṃ parityajya bhaja pādāṃbujaṃ hareḥ।। bhrūbhaṃgalīlāmātreṇa sṛṣṭisaṃhartureva ca ।। 92 ।। nimeṣamātrādasyaiva brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet ।। yasyaikadivase'pyaṣṭāviṃśatīṃdrāḥ pataṃtyapi ।। 93 ।। evamaṣṭottaraśatamāyuryasya jagadvidheḥ ।। tvaṃ vā kā'nyāśca vā rādhe madīśvaravaśe'khilam ।।94।। śrīdāmno vacanaṃ śrutvā kevalaṃ kaṭumujjvalam ।। sadyaścukopa sā brahmansadyaḥ prāṇeśvarī hareḥ ।। 95 ।। rāseśvarī bahirgatvā tamuvāca ha niṣṭhuram ।। sphuradoṣṭhī muktakeśī raktāṃbhoruhalocanā ।।96।। ।। rādhikovāca ।। rere jālma mahāmūḍha śṛṇu lpaṭakiṃkara ।। tvaṃ ca jānāsi sarvārthaṃ na jānāmi tvadīśvaram ।। 97 ।। tvadīśvaraśca śrīkṛṣṇo na hyasmākaṃ vrajādhama ।। jānāmi janakaṃ stauṣi sadā niṃdasi mātaram ।। 98 ।। yathā'surāśca tridaśā nityaṃ niṃdaṃti saṃtatam ।। tathā niṃdasi māṃ mūḍha tasmāttvamasuro bhava ।। 99 ।। gopa vrajāsurīṃ yoniṃ golokācca bahirbhava ।। mayā'dya śapto mūḍhastvaṃ kastvāṃ rakṣitumīśvaraḥ ।। 100 ।। rāseśvarī tamityuktvā suṣvāpa virarāma ca ।। vayasyāḥ sevayāmāsuścāmarai ratnamuṣṭibhiḥ ।। 101 ।। śrutvā ca vacanaṃ tasyāḥ kopena sphuritādharaḥ ।। śaśāpa tāṃ ca śrīdāmā vraja yoniṃ ca mānuṣīm ।। śrīdāmovāca ।। ।। mānuṣyā iva kopaste tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣī bhuvi ।। 102 ।। bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho mayā śaptā tvamaṃbike ।। chāyayā kalayā vā'pi paraśaktyā kalaṃkinā ।। 103 ।। mūḍhā rāpāṇapatnī tvāṃ vakṣyati jagatītale ।। rāpāṇaḥ śrīhareraṃśo vaiśyo vṛṃdāvane vane ।। 104 ।। bhaviṣyati mahāyogī rādhāśāpena garbhajaḥ ।। gokule prāpya taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vihariṣyasi kānane ।। 105 ।। bhavitā te varṣaśataṃ vicchedo hariṇā saha ।। punaḥ prāpya tamīśaṃ ca golokamāgamiṣyasi।। 106 ।। tāmityuktvā ca natvā ca sa jagāma hareḥ puraḥ ।। gatvā praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śāpākhyānamuvāca ha ।। 107 ।। ānupūrvyāttu tatsarvaṃ ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ punaḥ ।। uvāca taṃ rudaṃtaṃ ca gacchadhvaṃ dharaṇītalam ।। 108 ।। na jetā te tribhuvane hyasureṃdro bhaviṣyasi ।। kāle śaṃkaraśūlena dehaṃ tyaktvā mamāṃtikam।। 109 ।। āgamiṣyasi paṃcāśadyugāṃte tu mamāśiṣā ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā tamuvāca śucā'nvitaḥ ।। 110 ।। tvadbhaktirahitaṃ māṃ ca kadācinna kariṣyasi ।। ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā jagāma svāśramādbahiḥ ।। 111 ।। paścājjagāma sā devī ruroda ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। kva yāsi vatsetyuccārya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ satī ।।112।। śrīdāmā'pi ca tāṃ natvā ruroda premavihvalaḥ ।। sa eva śaṃkhacūḍaśca babhūva tulasīpatiḥ।। 113 ।। gate śrīdāmni sā devī jagāmeśvarasannidhim ।। sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa hariḥ pratyuttaraṃ dadau ।। 114 ।। śokāturāṃ ca tāṃ kṛṣṇo bodhayāmāsa preyasīm ।। śaṃkhacūḍaśca kālena saṃprāpa punarīśvaram ।। 115 ।। rādhā jagāma dharaṇīṃ vārāhe hariṇā saha ।। vṛṣabhānugṛhe janma lalābha gokule mune ।। 116 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamaṃgalam ।। sarveṣāṃ vāṃchitaṃ sāraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।117।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde saptasamudrajanma rādhāśrīdāmaśāpodbhavo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 3 ।।
<4.4> ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। kena vā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo mahīṃ ca kena hetunā ।। ājagāma jagannātho vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 1 ।। ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। purā vārāhakalpe sā bhārākrāṃtā vasuṃdharā ।। bhṛśaṃ babhūva śokārtā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 2 ।। suraiścāsurasaṃtaptairbhṛśamudvignamānasaiḥ ।। sārddhaṃ taistāṃ durgamāṃ ca jagāma vedhasaḥ sabhām ।। 3 ।। dadarśa tasyāṃ deveśaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā ।। ṛṣīndraiśca munīndraiśca siddheṃdraiḥ sevitaṃ mudā ।। 4 ।। apsarogaṇanṛtyaṃ ca paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। gaṃdharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śrutavaṃtaṃ manoharam ।। 5 ।। japaṃtaṃ paramaṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam ।। bhaktyānaṃdāśrupūrṇaṃ taṃ pulakāṃkitavigraham ।। 6 ।। bhaktyā sā tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ praṇamya caturānanam ।। sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakre daityabhārādikaṃ mune ।। sā'śrupūrṇā sapulakā tuṣṭāva ca ruroda ca ।।7।। tāmuvāca jagaddhātā kathaṃ stauṣi ca rodiṣi ।। kathamāgamanaṃ bhadre vada bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।।8।। susthirā bhava kalyāṇi bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite।। āśvāsya pṛthivīṃ brahmā devānpapraccha sādaram ।। 9 ।। kathamāgamanaṃ devā yuṣmākaṃ mama sannidhim ।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā devā ūcuḥ prajāpatim ।। 10 ।। bhārākrāṃtā ca vasudhā dasyugrastā vayaṃ prabho ।। tvameva jagatāṃ sraṣṭā śīghraṃ no niṣkṛtiṃ kuru ।। 11 ।। gatistvamasyā bho brahmannirvṛtiṃ kartumarhasi ।। pīḍitā yena bhāreṇa pṛthivīyaṃ pitāmaha ।। 12 ।। vayaṃ tenaiva duḥkhārtāstadbhāraharaṇaṃ kuru ।। devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tāṃ papraccha jagadvidhiḥ।।13।। dūrīkṛtya bhayaṃ vatse sukhaṃ tiṣṭha mamāṃtikam ।। keṣāṃ bhāramaśaktā tvaṃ soḍhuṃ paṃkajalocane ।। 14 ।। apaneṣyāmi taṃ bhadre bhadraṃ te bhavitā dhuvam ।। tasya sā vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca svapīḍanam।। pīḍitā yena yenaivaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā ।। 15 ।। ।। kṣitiruvāca ।। ।। śṛṇu tāta pravakṣyāmi svakīyāṃ mānasīṃ vyathām ।। vinā baṃdhuṃ saviśvāsaṃ nānyaṃ kathitumarhati ।। 16 ।। strījātirabalā śaśvadrakṣaṇīyā svabaṃdhubhiḥ ।। janakasvāmiputraiśca garhitā'nyaiśca niścitam ।। 17 ।। tvayā pṛṣṭā jagattāta na lajjā kathituṃ mama ।। yeṣāṃ bhāraiḥ pīḍitā'haṃ śrūyatāṃ kathayāmi te ।। 18 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnā ye ye ca tadbhaktaniṃdakāḥ ।। teṣāṃ mahāpātakināmaśaktā bhāravāhane ।। 19 ।। svadharmācārahīnā ye nityakṛtyavivarjitāḥ ।। śraddhāhīnāśca vedeṣu teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ।। 20 ।। pitṛmātṛgurustrīṇāṃ poṣaṇaṃ putrapoṣyayoḥ ।। ye na kurvaṃti teṣāṃ ca na śaktā bhāravāhane ।। 21 ।। ye mithyāvādinastāta dayāsatya vivarjitāḥ ।। niṃdakā gurudevānāṃ teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ।।22।। mitradrohī kṛtaghnaśca mithyāsākṣyapradāyakaḥ ।। viśvāsaghno nyāsahartā teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ।। 23 ।। kalyāṇasūktasāmāni harernāmaikamaṃgalam ।। kurvaṃti vikrayaṃ ye vai teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ।। 24 ।। jīvaghātī gurudrohī grāmayājī ca lubdhakaḥ ।। śavadāhī śūdrabhojī teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ।। 25 ।। pūjāyajñopavāsādi vratāni vividhāni ca ।। ye ye mūḍhā vihaṃtārasteṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ।।26।। sadā dviṣaṃti ye pāpā goviprasuravaiṣṇavān ।। hariṃ harikathāṃ bhaktiṃ teṣāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitā ।। 27 ।। śaṃkhādīnāṃ ca bhāreṇa pīḍitā'haṃ yathā vidhe ।। tato'dhikānāṃ daityānāṃ bhāreṇa paripīḍitā ।।28।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ madvyathāyā nivedanam ।। tvayā yadi supālyā'haṃ pratīkāraṃ kuru prabho।।29।। ityevamuktvā vasudhā ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। brahmā tadrodanaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 30 ।। bhāraṃ tavāpaneṣyāmi dasyūnāmapyupāyataḥ ।। upāyato'pi kāryāṇi siddhyaṃtyeva vasundhare ।।31।। kālena bhāraharaṇaṃ kariṣyati madīśvaraḥ ।। mantraṃ maṃgalakumbhaṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ ca kuṃkumam ।। 32 ।। madhukāṣṭhaṃ caṃdanaṃ ca kastūrīṃ tīrthamṛttikām ।। khaṅgagaṃḍakakhaṃḍaṃ ca sphāṭikaṃ padmarāgakam ।।33।। iṃdranīlaṃ sūryamaṇiṃ rudrākṣaṃ kuśamūlakam ।। śālagrāmaśilāṃ śaṃkhaṃ tulasīṃ pratimāṃ jalam ।।34।। śaṃkhaṃ pradīpamālāṃ ca śilāmarcyāṃ ca ghaṃṭikām।। nirmālyaṃ caiva naivedyaṃ haridvarṇamaṇiṃ tathā।। graṃthiyuktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ darpaṇaṃ śvetacāmaram ।।35।। gorocanaṃ ca muktāṃ ca śuktiṃ māṇikyameva ca ।। purāṇasaṃhitāṃ vahniṃ karpūraṃ paraśuṃ tathā ।। 36 ।। rajataṃ kāṃcanaṃ caiva pravālaṃ ratnameva ca ।। kuśabījaṃ tīrthatoyaṃ gavyaṃ gomūtragomayam ।। 37 ।। tvayi ye sthāpayiṣyaṃti mūḍhāścaitāni sundari ।। pacyante kālasūtreṇa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ dhruvam ।।38।। brahmā pṛthvīṃ samāśvāsya devatābhistayā saha ।। jagāma jagatāṃ dhātā kailāsaṃ śaṃkarālayam ।। 39 ।। gatvā tamāśramaṃ ramyaṃ dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ vidhiḥ ।। vasaṃtamakṣayavaṭamūle svaḥsaritastaṭe।। 40 ।। vyāghracarmaparīdhānaṃ dakṣakanyāsthibhūṣaṇam ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ trilocanam ।। 41 ।। nānāsiddhaiḥ parivṛtaṃ yogīṃdragaṇasevitam।। parito'psarasāṃ nṛtyaṃ paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। 42 ।। gaṃdharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śrutavaṃtaṃ kutūhalāt ।। paśyaṃtīṃ pārvatīṃ prītyā paśyaṃtaṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। 43 ।। japaṃtaṃ pañcavaktreṇa harernāmaikamaṅgalam ।। maṃdākinīpadmabījamālayā pulakāṃkitam ।। 44।। etasminnaṃtare brahmā tasthāvagre sa dhūrjaṭeḥ ।। pṛthivyā surasaṃghaiśca sārddhaṃ praṇatakaṃdharaiḥ ।। 45 ।। uttasthau śaṃkaraḥ śīghraṃ bhaktyā dṛṣṭvā jagadgurum ।। nanāma mūrdhnā saṃprītyā labdhavānāśiṣaṃ tataḥ ।। 46 ।। praṇemurdevatāḥ sarve śaṃkaraṃ caṃdraśekharam ।। praṇanāma dharā bhaktyā cāśiṣaṃ yuyuje haraḥ ।। 47 ।। vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa pārvatīśaṃ prajāpatiḥ ।। śrutvā natamukhastūrṇaṃ śaṃkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 48 ।। bhaktāpāyaṃ samākarṇya pārvatīparameśvarau ।। babhūvatustau duḥkhārtau bodhayāmāsa tau vidhiḥ ।। 49 ।। tato brahmā maheśaśca surasaṃghānvasuṃdharām ।। gṛhaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa samāśvāsya prayatnataḥ ।।50।। tato deveśvaraistūrṇamāgatya dharmamaṃdiram ।। saha tena samālocya prajagmurbhavanaṃ hareḥ ।। 51 ।। vaikuṃṭhaṃ paramaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param ।। vāyunā dhāryamāṇaṃ ca brahmāṃḍādūrdhvamuttamam ।। koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca brahmalokātsanātanam 52 ।। varṇanīyaṃ na kavibhirvicitraṃ ratnanirmitam ।। padmarāgairiṃdranīlai rājamārgairvibhūṣitam ।। 53 ।। te manoyāyinaḥ sarve saṃprāpustaṃ manoharam ।। hareraṃtaḥpuraṃ gatvā dadṛśuḥ śrīhariṃ surāḥ ।। 54 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpuraśobhitam ।। 95 ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitam ।। pītavastraparīdhānaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 56 ।। śāṃtaṃ sarasvatīkāṃtaṃ lakṣmīdhṛtapadāṃbujam ।। koṭikaṃdarpalīlābhaṃ smitavaktraṃ caturbhujam ।। 57 ।। sunaṃdanaṃdakumudaiḥ pārṣadairupasevitam ।। caṃdanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ suratnamukuṭojjvalam ।। paramānaṃdarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakārakam ।। 58 ।। taṃ praṇemuḥ sureṃdrāśca bhaktyā brahmādayo mune ।। tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ।। paramānaṃdabhārārtāḥ pulakāṃcitavigrahāḥ ।। 99 ।। brahmovāca ।। ।। namāmi kamalākāṃtaṃ śāṃtaṃ sarveṣṭamacyutam ।। vayaṃ yasya kalābhedāḥ kalāṃśakalayā surāḥ ।।60।। manavaśca munīṃdrāśca mānuṣāśca carācarāḥ ।। kalākalāṃśakalayā bhūtāstvatto niraṃjana ।।61।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। tvāmakṣayamakṣaraṃ vā vyaktamavyaktamīśvaram ।। anādimādimānaṃdarūpiṇaṃ sarvarūpiṇam ।।62।। aṇimādikasiddhīnāṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvakāraṇam।। siddhijñaṃ siddhidaṃ siddhirūpaṃ kaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ।।63।। ।। dharma uvāca ।। ।। vede nirūpitaṃ vastu varṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ।। vede nirvacanīyaṃ yattannirvaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। yasya saṃbhāvanīyaṃ yadguṇarūpaṃ niraṃjanam ।। 64 ।। tadatiriktaṃ stavanaṃ kimahaṃ staumi nirguṇam ।। brahmādīnāmidaṃ stotraṃ ṣaṭślokoktaṃ mahāmune ।। 69 ।। paṭhitvā mucyate durgādvāñchitaṃ ca labhennaraḥ ।। devānāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca hariḥ svayam ।। 66 ।। golokaṃ yāta yūyaṃ ca yāmi paścācchriyā saha ।। naranārāyaṇau tau dvau śvetadvīpanivāsinau ।। 67 ।। ete yāsyaṃti goloke tathā devī sarasvatī ।। anaṃtā mama māyā ca kārttikeyo gaṇādhipaḥ ।। sāvitrī vedamātā ca paścādyāsyaṃti niścitam ।। 68 ।। tatrāhaṃ dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo gopībhī rādhayā saha ।। atrāhaṃ kamalāyuktaḥ sunaṃdādibhirāvṛtaḥ ।। 69 ।। nārāyaṇaśca kṛṣṇo'haṃ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt ।। mamaivaitāḥ kalāḥ sarve devā brahmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 70 ।। kalākalāṃśakalayā surāsuranarādayaḥ ।। golokaṃ yāta yūyaṃ ca kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati ।। 71 ।। vayaṃ paścādgamiṣyāmaḥ sarveṣāmiṣṭasiddhaye ।। ityuktvā vai sabhāmadhye virarāma hariḥ svayam ।। 72 ।। praṇamya devatāḥ sarvā jagmurgolokamadbhutam ।। vicitraṃ paramaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param ।। 73 ।। ūrdhvaṃ vaikuṃṭhato gamyaṃ paṃcāśatkoṭiyojanam ।। vāyunā dhāryamāṇaṃ ca nirmitaṃ svecchayā vibhoḥ ।। 74 ।। tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca devāste gamanotsukāḥ ।। te manoyāyinaḥ sarve saṃprāpurvirajātaṭam ।। 75 ।। dṛṣṭvā devāḥ sarittīraṃ
