vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ manoharam ।। 76 ।। muktāmāṇikyaparamamaṇiratnākarānvitam ।। kṛṣṇaśubhraharidraktamaṇirājivirājitam ।। 77 ।। pravālāṃkuramudbhūtaṃ kutracitsumanoharam ।। paramāmūlyasadratnākararājivibhūṣitam ।। 78 ।। vidheradṛśyāmāścarya nidhiśreṣṭhākarānvitam ।। padmarāgeṃdranīlānāmākaraṃ kutracinmune ।। 79 ।। kutracicca marakatākaraśreṇīsamanvitam ।। syamaṃtakākaraṃ kutra kutracidrucakākaram ।। 80 ।। amūlyapītavarṇābhaṃ maṇiśreṇyākarānvitam ।। ratnākaraṃ kutracicca kutracitkaustubhākaram ।। 81 ।। kutra nirvacanīyānāṃ maṇīnāmākaraṃ param ।। kutracitkutracidramyavihārasthalamuttamam ।। 82 ।। dṛṣṭvā tu paramāścaryaṃ jagmustatpāramīśvarāḥ ।। dadṛśuḥ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ śataśṛṃgaṃ manoramam ।। 83 ।। pārijātatarūṇāṃ ca vanarājivirājitam ।। kalpavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ veṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ ।। 84 ।। koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca dairghyaṃ daśaguṇottaram ।। śailaprasthaparimitaṃ paṃcāśatkoṭiyojanam ।।85।। prākārākāramasyaiva śikhare rāsamaṃḍalam ।। daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ vartulākāramuttamam ।। 86 ।। puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena sugaṃdhinā ।। saṃkulena madhughrāṇāṃ samūhena samanvitam ।। 87 ।। surata dravyasaṃyuktai rājitaṃ ratimaṃdiraiḥ ।। ratnamaṃḍapakoṭīnāṃ sahasreṇa samanvitam ।। 88 ।। ratnasopānayuktena sadratnakalaśena ca ।। harinmaṇīnāṃ staṃbhena śobhitena ca śobhitam ।।89।। siṃdūravarṇamaṇibhiḥ paritaḥ khacitena ca ।। indranīlairmadhyagatairmaṃḍitena manoharaiḥ ।। 90 ।। ratnaprākārasaṃyuktamaṇibhedairvirājitam ।। dvāraiḥ kapāṭasaṃyuktaiścaturbhiśca virājitam ।। 91 ।। rajjugraṃthisamāyuktarasālapallavānvitaiḥ । paritaḥ kadalīstaṃbhasamūhaiśca samanvitam ।। 92 ।। śukladhānyaparṇajālaphaladūvāṃrkurānvitam ।। caṃdanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam ।। 93 ।। veṣṭitaṃ gopakanyānāṃ samūhaiḥ koṭiśo mune ।। ratnālaṃkārasaṃyuktai ratnamālāvirājitaiḥ ।। 94 ।। ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūra ratnanūpurabhūṣitaiḥ ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitaiḥ ।। 95 ।। ratnāṃgulīyalalitairhastāṃgulivirājitaiḥ ।। ratnapāśakavṛndaiśca virājitapadāṃgulaiḥ ।। 96 ।। bhūṣitai ratnabhūṣābhiḥ sadratnamukuṭojjvalaiḥ ।। gajeṃdramuktālaṃkārairnāsikāmadhyarājitaiḥ ।। 97 ।। siṃdūrabiṃdunā sārddhamalakādhaḥsthalojjvalaiḥ ।। cārucampakavarṇābhaiścaṃdanadravacarcitaiḥ ।। 98 ।। pītavastraparīdhānairbiṃbādharamanoharaiḥ ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāṇāṃ prabhāṃ muṣṇanmukhojjvalaiḥ ।। 99 ।। śaratpraphullapadmānāṃ śobhāmoṣaṇalocanaiḥ ।। kastūrīpātrikāyuktai rekhāktakajjalojjvalaiḥ ।। 100 ।। praphullamālatīmālājālaiḥkabaraśobhitaiḥ ।। madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ samūhaiścāpi saṃkulaiḥ ।। cāruṇā gamanenaiva gajakhaṃjanagaṃjanaiḥ ।। 101 ।। vakrabhrūbhaṃgasaṃyogaślakṣṇasmitasamanvitaiḥ ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktivirājitaiḥ ।। 102 ।। khageṃdracaṃcuśobhāḍhyanāsikonnatabhūṣitaiḥ ।। gajeṃdragaṃḍayugmābhastanabhāranatairiva ।। 103 ।। nitambakaṭhinaśroṇīpīnabhārabharānataiḥ ।। kaṃdarpaśaraceṣṭābhirjarjarībhūtamānasai ।। 104 ।। darpaṇaiḥ pūrṇacaṃdrāsyasauṃdaryadarśanotsukaiḥ ।। rādhikācaraṇāṃbhojasevāsaktamanorathaiḥ ।।105।। suṃdarīṇāṃ samūhaiśca rakṣitaṃ rādhikājñayā ।। krīḍāsarovarāṇāṃ ca lakṣaiśca pariveṣṭitam ।। 106 ।। śvetaraktairlohitaiśca veṣṭitaiḥ padmarājitaiḥ ।। sukūjadbhirmadhughrāṇāṃ samūhaiḥ saṃkulaiḥ sadā ।। 107 ।। puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena samanvitam ।। koṭikuṃjakuṭīraiśca puṣpaśayyāsamanvitaiḥ ।। 106 ।। bhogadravyasakarpūratāṃbūlavastrasaṃyutaiḥ ।। ratnapradīpaiḥ paritaḥ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ ।। ।। 109 ।। vicitrapuṣpamālābhiḥ śobhitaiḥ śobhitaṃ mune ।। taṃ rāsamaṃḍapaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagmuste parvatādbahiḥ ।। 110 ।। tato vicakṣaṇaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśuḥ suṃdaraṃ vanam ।। vanaṃ vṛdāvanaṃ nāma rādhāmādhavayoḥ priyam ।। 111 ।। krīḍāsthānaṃ tayoreva kalpavṛkṣacayānvitam ।। virajātīranīrāktaiḥ kaṃpitaṃ maṃdavāyubhiḥ ।। 112 ।। kastūrīyuktapatrābjaiḥ puṣpaughaiḥ surabhīkṛtam ।। navapallavasaṃsaktaparapuṣṭarutairyutam।।113।। kutra helikadaṃbānāṃ kadaṃbaiḥ kamanīyakam ।। maṃdārāṇāṃ caṃpakānāṃ candanānāṃ tathaiva ca ।।114।। sugaṃdhikusumānāṃ ca gaṃdhena surabhīkṛtam ।। āmrāṇāṃ nāgaraṃgāṇāṃ panasānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 115 ।। tālānāṃ nārikelānāṃ vṛṃdairvṛṃdārakaṃ vanam ।। jaṃbūnāṃ badarīṇāṃ ca kharjūrāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 116 ।। gurvākāmrātakānāṃ ca jaṃbīrāṇāṃ ca nārada ।। kadalīnāṃ śrīphalānāṃ dāḍimānāṃ manoharaiḥ ।। 117 ।। supakvaphalasaṃyuktaiḥ samūhaiśca virājitam ।। pippalīnāṃ ca śālānāmaśvatthānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 118 ।। niṃbānāṃ śālmalīnāṃ ca tittiḍīnāṃ ca śobhanaiḥ ।। anyeṣāṃ tarubhedānāṃ saṃkulaiḥ saṃkulaṃ sadā ।। 119 ।। paritaḥ kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛndairvṛndairvirājitam ।। mallikāmālatīkuṃdaketakīmādhavī latāḥ ।। 120 ।। etāsāṃ ca samūhaiśca yūthikābhiḥ samanvitam ।। cārukuṃjakuṭīraistaiḥ paṃcāśatkoṭibhirmune ।। 121 ।। ratnapradīpadīpaiśca dhūpena surabhīkṛtaiḥ ।। śṛṃgāradravyayuktaiśca vāsitairgaṃdhavāyubhiḥ ।। 122 ।। caṃdanāktaiḥ puṣpatalpairmālājālasamanvitaiḥ ।। madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ kalaśabdaiśca śabditam ।। 123 ।। ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhayairgopīvṛṃdaiśca veṣṭitam ।। paṃcāśatkoṭigopībhī rakṣitaṃ rādhikājñayā ॥124॥ dvātriṃśatkānanaṃ tatra ramyaṃ ramyaṃ manoharam ॥ vṛṃdāvanābhyaṃtaritaṃ nirjanasthānamuttamam ॥ 129 ॥ supakvamadhurasvāduphalairvṛṃdārakaṃ mune ॥ goṣṭhānāṃ ca gavāṃ caiva samūhaiśca samanvitam ॥126॥ puṣpodyānasahasreṇa puṣpitena sugaṃdhinā ॥ madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ |samūhena samanvitam ॥127॥ paṃcāśatkoṭigopīnāṃ vilāsaiśca virājitam ॥ śrīkṛṣṇatulyarūpāṇāṃ sadratnaguṃṭhitairvaraiḥ ॥128॥ dṛṣṭvā vṛṃdāvanaṃ ramyaṃ yayurgolokamīśvarāḥ ॥ parito vartulākāraṃ koṭiyojanavistṛtam ॥ 129 ।॥ ratnaprākārasaṃyuktaṃ caturddhārānvitaṃ mune।। gopānāṃ ca samūhaiśca dvārapālaiḥ samanvitam ॥ 130 ॥ āśramai ratnakhacitairnānābhogasamanvitaiḥ ॥ gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇabhṛtyānāṃ paṃcāśatkoṭibhiryutam ॥131॥ bhaktānāṃ gopavṛndānāmāśramaiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ ॥ tato'dhikasuvistīrṇaiḥ sadratnagrathitairyutam ॥132॥ āśramaiḥ pārṣadānāṃ ca tato'dhikavilakṣaṇaiḥ ॥ amūlyaratnaracitaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ daśakoṭibhiḥ ॥ 133 । pārṣadapravarāṇāṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇarūpadhāriṇām ॥ āśramaiḥ koṭibhiryuktaṃ sadratnena vinirmitaiḥ ॥ 134॥ rādhikāśuddhabhaktānāṃ gopīnāmāśramairvaraiḥ ॥ sadratnaracitairdravyairdvātriṃśatkoṭibhiryutam।।135।। tāsāṃ ca kikarīṇāṃ ca bhavanaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ।। maṇiratnādiracitaiḥ śobhitaṃ daśakoṭibhiḥ।।136।। śatajanmatapaḥpūtā bhaktā ye bhārate bhuvi ॥ haribhaktiparā ye ca karmanirvāṇakārakāḥ ॥ 137 ॥ svapne jñāne harerdhyāne viviṣṭamānasā mune ॥ rādhākṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti prajapaṃto divāniśam ॥ 138 ॥ teṣāṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ nivāsaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ॥ sadratnamaṇinirmāṇairnānābhogasamanvitaiḥ ॥ 139 ॥ puṣpaśayyāpuṣpamālāśvetacāmaraśobhitaiḥ।। ratnadarpaṇaśobhāḍhyairharinmaṇisaparpitaiḥ।।140।। amūlyaratnakalaśasamūhānvitaśekharaiḥ।। sūkṣmavastrābhyaṃtaritaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ ॥ 14 1 ॥ devāstamadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiyaddūraṃ yayurmudā ॥ tatrākṣayavaṭaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśurjagadīśvarāḥ ॥ |॥142॥ paṃcayojanavistīrṇamūrdhvaṃ taddviguṇaṃ mune ॥ sahasraskaṃdhasaṃyuktaśākhāsaṃsthāsamanvitam ॥ 143॥ raktapakkaphalākīrṇaṃ śobhitaṃ ratnavedibhiḥ ॥ kṛṣṇasvarūpāṃstanmūle dadṛśurvallabhāñchiśūn ॥ 144 ॥ pītavastraparīdhānānkrīḍāsaktamanoharān ॥ candanokṣitasarvāṃgānratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān ।। 145 ।। dadṛśustatra deveśāḥ pārṣadapravarānhareḥ ।। tato'vidūre dadṛśū rājamārgaṃ manoharam ।। 146 ।। siṃdūrākāramaṇibhiḥ parito racitaṃ mune ।। iṃdranīlaiḥ padmarāgairhīrakai rucakaistathā ।। 147 ।। nirmitairvedibhiryuktaṃ parito ratnamaṃḍapam ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam ।। 148 ।। dadhipūrṇalājaphalapuṣpadūrvāṃkurānvitam ।। sūkṣmasūtragraṃthiyuktaśrīkhaṃḍapallavānvitam ।। 149 ।। raṃbhāstaṃbhasamūhaiśca kuṅkumāktairvirājitam ।। sadratnamaṃḍalaghaṭaiḥ phalaśākhāsamanvitaiḥ ।। 150 ।। siṃdūrakuṃkumāktaiśca gaṃdhacaṃdanacarcitaiḥ ।। bhūṣitaiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ pādapaiḥ paribhūṣitam ।। 151 ।। gopikānāṃ samūhaiśca krīḍāsaktaiśca veṣṭitama ।। bahumūlyena ratnena ratnasopānanirmitān ।। 152 ।। vahniśaucāṃśukai ramyaiḥ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ ।। ratnatalpavicitraiśca puṣpamālyairvirājitāna ।। 153 ।। ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyuktāndvārapālaiśca rakṣitān ।। paritaḥ parikhāyuktānratnaprākāraveṣṭitān ।। 154 ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitān।। gṛhānmanoramāndṛṣṭvā te devā gamanotsukāḥ ।। 155 ।। jagmuḥ śīghraṃ kiyaddūraṃ dadṛśuḥ sundaraṃ tataḥ ।। āśramaṃ rādhikāyāśca rāseśvaryāśca nārada ।। 156 ।। devādhidevyā gopīnāṃ varāyāścārunirmitam ।। prāṇādhikāyāḥ kṛṣṇasya ramyadravyamanoharam ।। 157 ।। sarvānirvacanīyaṃ ca paṃḍitairna nirūpitam ।। sucāruvartulākāraṃ ṣaḍgavyūtipramāṇakam ।। 158 ।। śatamaṃdirasaṃyuktaṃ jvalitaṃ ratnatejasā ।। amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ cayaurviracitaṃ varam ।। 159 ।। durlaṃghyābhirgabhīrābhiḥ parikhābhiḥ suśobhitam ।। kalpavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ puṣpodyānaśatāṃtaram ।। 160 ।। sumūlyaratnakhacitaprākāraiḥ pariveṣṭitam ।। sadratnavedikāyuktairyuktaṃ dvāraiśca saptabhiḥ ।। 161 ।। saṃyuktaratnacitraiśca vicitrairvartulaṃ mune ।। pradhānasaptadvārebhyaḥ kramaśaḥ kramaśo mune ।। 162 ।। sarvato'pi tatastatra ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyutam ।। devā ddaṣṭvā ca prākāraṃ sahasradhanurucchritam ।। 163 ।। sadratnakṣudrakalaśasamūhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। pradīptaṃ tejasā ramyaṃ paramaṃ vismayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 164 ।। tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya kiyaddūraṃ yayurmudā ।। purato gacchatāṃ teṣāṃ paścādbhūtastadāśramaḥ ।। 165 ।। gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca dadṛśuścāśramānparān ।। amūlyaratnaracitāñchatakoṭimitānmune ।। 166 ।। darśaṃdarśaṃ ca parito gopānāṃ sarvamāśramam ।। gopikānāṃ cāparaṃ vā ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃnavam ।। 167 ।। golokaṃ nikhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā pulakāṃgaṃ yayuḥ surāḥ ।। tadeva vartulākāraṃ ramyaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ vanam ।। 368 ।। dadṛśuḥ śataśṛṃgaṃ ca tadbahirvirajānadīm ।। virajāṃ tāṃ yayurdevā dadṛśuḥ śūnyameva ca ।। 169 ।। vāyvādhāraṃ ca golokaṃ sadratnamayamadbhutam ।। īśvarecchāvinirmāṇaṃ rādhikājñānubaṃdhanāt ।। 170 ।। yuktaṃ sahasraiḥ sarasāṃ kevalaṃ maṃgalālayam ।। nṛtyaṃ ca dadṛśustatra devāśca sumanoharam ।। 171 ।। sutānaṃ cārusaṃgītaṃ rādhākṛṣṇaguṇānvitam ।। śrutvaiva gītapīyūṣaṃ mūrchāmāpuḥ surā mune ।। 172 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya te devāḥ kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ।। dadṛśuḥ paramāścaryaṃ sthānesthāne manoharam ।। 173 ।। dadṛśurgopikāḥ sarvā nānāveṣavidhāyikāḥ ।। kāścinmṛdaṃgahastāśca kāścidvīṇākarā varāḥ ।। 174 ।। kāściccāmarahastāśca karatālakarāḥ parāḥ ।। kāścidyaṃtravādyahastā ratnanūpuraśobhitāḥ ।। 175 ।। sadratnakiṃkiṇījālaśabdena śabditā varāḥ ।। kāścinmastakakuṃbhāśca nṛtyabhedamanorathāḥ ।। 176 ।। puṃveṣanāyikāḥ kāścitkāścittāsāṃ ca nāyikāḥ ।। kṛṣṇaveṣadharāḥ kāścidrādhāveṣadharāḥ parāḥ ।। 177 ।। kāścitsaṃyogaviratāḥ kāścidāliṃgane ratāḥ ।। krīḍāsaktāśca tā dṛṣṭvā sasmitā jagadīśvarāḥ ।। 178 ।। pragacchaṃtaḥ kiyaddūraṃ dadṛśuścāśramānbahūn ।। rādhāsakhīnāṃ gehāṃśca pradhānānāṃ ca nārada ।।179।। rūpeṇaiva guṇenaiva veṣeṇa yauvanena ca ।। saubhāgyenaiva vayasā sadṛśīnāṃ ca tatra vai ।। 180 ।। trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca rādhikāyāśca gopikāḥ ।। veṣānirvacanīyāśca tāsāṃ nāmāni ca śṛṇu ।। 181 ।। suśīlā ca śaśikalā yamunā mādhavī ratī ।। kadaṃbamālā kuṃtī ca jāhnavī ca svayaṃprabhā ।। 182 ।। caṃdramukhī ca sāvitrī gāyatrī sumukhī sukhā ।। padmālayā pārijātā gaurī ca sarvamaṃgalā ।। 183 ।। kālikā kamalā durgā bhāratī ca sarasvatī ।। gaṃgā 'mbikā madhumatī caṃpā'parṇā ca suṃdarī ।। 184 ।। kṛṣṇapriyā satī caiva naṃdinī naṃdaneti ca ।। etāḥ samānāḥ sadratnaracitā rādhikāpriyāḥ ।। 185 ।। etāsāṃ samarūpāṇāṃ ratnadhātuvicitritān ।। nānāprakāracitreṇa citritānsumanoharān ।। 185 । amūlyaratnakalaśasamūhaiḥ śikharojjvalān ।। sadratnaracitāñchubhrānāśramāndadṛśustathā ।। 187 ।। brahmāṃḍādbahirūrdhvaṃ ca nāsti lokastadūrdhvakaḥ ।। ūrdhvaṃ śūnyamayaṃ sarvaṃ tadaṃtā sṛṣṭireva ca ।। 188 ।। rasātalebhyaḥ saptabhyo nāstyadhaḥ sṛṣṭireva ca ।। tadadhaśca jalaṃ dhvāṃtamagaṃtavyamadṛśyakam ।। brahmāṃḍāṃtaṃ tadbahiśca sarvaṃ matto niśāmaya ।। 189 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde golokavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 4 ।।
<4.5> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। golokaṃ nikhilaṃ dṛṣṭvā devāste hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।। punarājagmū rādhāyāḥ pradhānadvārameva ca ।। 1 ।। sadratnamaṇinirmāṇaṃ vedikāyugmasaṃyutam ।। haridrākāramaṇinā vajrasaṃmiśritena ca ।। 2 ।। amūlyaratnaracitakapāṭena vibhūṣitam ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśurvīrabhānumanuttamam ।। 3 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam ।। pītavastraparīdhānaṃ sadratnamukuṭojjvalam ।। 4 ।। dvāraṃ citravicitreṇa vicitraṃ paramādbhutam ।। sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakrurdevā dauvārikaṃ mudā ।। 5 ।। tānuvāca dvārapālo niḥśaṃkaṃ tridaśeśvarān ।। nāhaṃ vinā''jñayā gaṃtuṃ dātuṃ sāṃpratamīśvaraḥ ।।6।। kiṃkarānpreṣayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇasthānameva ca ।। hareranujñāṃ saṃprāpya dadau gaṃtuṃ surānmune ।। 7 ।। taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevā dvitīyaṃ dvāramuttamam ।। tato'dhikaṃ vicitraṃ ca suṃdaraṃ sumanoharam ।। 5 ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśuścaṃdrabhānuṃ ca nārada ।। kiśoraṃ śyāmalaṃ cāru svarṇavetradharaṃ varam ।। 9 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। gopānāṃ ca samūhena paṃcalakṣeṇa śobhitam ।। 10 ।। taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevāstṛtīyaṃ dvāramuttamam ।। tato'tisundaraṃ citraṃ jvalantaṃ maṇitejasā ।। 11 ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśuḥ sūryabhānuṃ ca nārada ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ।। 12 ।। maṇikuṇḍalayugmena kapolasthalarājitam ।। ratnadaṃḍakaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ preṣyaṃ rādheśayoḥ param ।। 13 ।। navalakṣeṇa gopānāṃ veṣṭitaṃ ca nṛpeṃdravat ।। taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevāścaturthaṃ dvārameva ca ।।14।। tebhyo vilakṣaṇaṃ ramyaṃ sudīptaṃ maṇitejasā ।। atyadbhutavicitreṇa bhūṣitaṃ sumanoharam ।। 15 ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśurvasubhānuṃ vrajeśvaram ।। kiśoraṃ sundaravaraṃ maṇidaṇḍakaraṃ param ।। 16 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhaṃ ca sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। 17 ।। taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevā pañcamaṃ dvārameva ca ।। vajrabhittisthitaiścitravicitrairjvalitaṃ param ।। 18 ।। dvārapālaṃ ca dadṛśurdevabhānuṃ ca tatra vai ।। cāru siṃhāsanasthaṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 19 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca ratnamālāvibhūṣitam ।। kadaṃbapuṣpasaṃsaktasadratnakuṇḍalojjvalam ।। 20 ।। caṃdanāgarukastūrīkuṅkumadravacarcitam ।। nṛpeṃdravaratulyaṃ ca daśalakṣaprajānvitam ।। 21 ।। taṃ vetrapāṇiṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdevā mudā'nvitāḥ ।। vilakṣaṇaṃ dvāraṣaṭkaṃ citrarājivirājitam ।। 22 ।। vajrabhittiyugmayukte puṣpamālyavibhūṣite ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśuḥ śukrabhānuṃ vrajeśvaram ।। 23 ।। nānālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ daśalakṣaprajānvitam ।। śrīkhaṃḍapallavāsaktakapolaṃ kuṇḍalojjvalam ।। 24।। tūrṇaṃ surāstaṃ sabhāṣya yayurdvāraṃ ca saptamam ।। nānāprakāracitraṃ ca ṣaḍbhyaścātivilakṣaṇam ।। 25 ।। dvāre niyuktaṃ dadṛśū ratnabhānuṃ hareḥ priyam ।। caṃdanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam ।। bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇai ramyairmaṇiratnamanoharaiḥ ।। 26 ।। gopairdvādaśalakṣaiśca rājeṃdramiva rājitam ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca smerānanasaroruham ।। 27 ।। taṃ vetrahastaṃ saṃbhāṣya jagmurdeveśvarā mudā ।। vicitramaṣṭamaṃ dvāraṃ saptabhyo'pi vilakṣaṇam ।। 28 ।। dauvārikaṃ te dadṛśuḥ supārśvaṃ sumanoharam ।। sasmitaṃ sundaravaraṃ śrīkhaṇḍatilakojjvalam ।। 29 ।। bandhujīvādharoṣṭhaṃ ca ratnakuṇḍalamaṃḍitam ।। sarvālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyaṃ ratnadaṇḍadharaṃ varam ।। 30 ।। gopairdvādaśalakṣaiśca kiśoraiśca samanvitam ।। tataḥ śīghraṃ yayurdevā navamaṃ dvāramīpsitam ।।31।। vajrasadratnaracitaṃ caturvedisamanvitam ।। apūrvacitraracitamālajālairvirājitam ।। 32 ।। dvārapālaṃ ca dadṛśuḥ subalaṃ lalitākṛtim ।। nānābhūṣaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ bhūṣaṇārhaṃ manoharam ।। 33 ।। vajrairdvādaśalakṣaiśca saṃyuktaṃ sumanoharam ।। taṃ daṇḍahastaṃ sambhāṣya surā dvārātaraṃ yayuḥ ।। 34 ।। viśiṣṭaṃ daśamaṃ dvāraṃ dṛṣṭvā te vismayaṃ yayuḥ ।। sarvānirvacanīyaṃ cāpyadṛṣṭamaśrutaṃ mune ।। 39 ।। dadṛśurdvārapālaṃ ca sudāmānaṃ ca sundaram ।। anivarcanīyarūpaṃ kṛṣṇatulyaṃ manoharam ।। 36 ।। gopaviṃśatilakṣāṇāṃ samūhaiḥ parivāritam ।। taṃ daṇḍahastaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva jagmurdvārāṃtaraṃ surāḥ ।। 37 ।। dvāramekādaśākhyaṃ ca sucitraṃ mahadadbhutam ।। dvārapālaṃ ca tatrasthaṃ śrīdāmānaṃ vrajeśvaram ।। 38 ।। rādhikāputratulyaṃ ca pītavastreṇa bhūṣitam ।। amūlyaratnaracitaratnasiṃhāsanasthitam ।। 39 ।। amūlyaratnabhūṣābhirbhūṣitaṃ sumanoharam ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena virājitam ।। 40 ।। gaṇḍasthalakapolārhasadratnakuṇḍalojjvalam ।। sadratnaśreṣṭharacitavicitramukuṭojjvalam ।। 41 ।। praphullamālatīmālājālaiḥ sarvāṃgabhūṣitam ।। koṭigopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ rājendrādhikamujjvalam ।। 42 ।। taṃ saṃbhāṣya yayurdvāraṃ dvādaśākhyaṃ surā mudā ।। amūlyaratnaracitavedikābhiḥ samanvitam ।। 43 ।। sarveṣāṃ durlabhaṃ citramadṛśyamaśrutaṃ mune ।। vajrabhittisthitaṃ citraṃ sundaraṃ sumanoharam ।। 44 ।। dvāre niyuktā dadṛśurdevā gopāṃganā varāḥ ।। navayauvanasaṃpannā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।। 45 ।। pītavastraparīdhānāḥ kabarībhārabhūṣitāḥ ।। sugaṃdhimālatīmālā jālaiḥ sarvāṃgabhūṣitāḥ ।। 46 ।। ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūraratnanūpurabhūṣitāḥ ।। ratnakuṃḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitāḥ ।। 47 ।। candanāguru kastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitāḥ ।। pīnaśroṇībharānamrā nitaṃbābhārapīḍitāḥ ।। 48 ।। gopīnāṃ śatakoṭīnāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ preṣṭhā harerapi ।। gopīśca koṭiśo dṛṣṭvā surāste vismayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 49 ।। saṃbhāṣya tā mudā yuktā yayurdvārātaraṃ mune ।। tataśca kramaśo vipra triṣu dvāreṣu tatra vai ।। 50 ।। gopāṃganānāṃ śreṣṭhāśca dadṛśuḥ sumanoharāḥ ।। varāṇāṃ ca varā ramyā dhanyā mānyāśca śobhanāḥ ।। 51 ।। sarvāḥ saubhāgyayuktāśca rādhikāyāḥ priyāśca tāḥ ।। bhūṣitā bhūṣaṇai ramyaiḥ prodbhinnanavayauvanāḥ ।। 52 ।। evaṃ dvāratrayaṃ dṛṣṭvā svapnā jñānādbhutāśrutam ।। adṛśyamatiramyaṃ cāpyanirūpyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ।। 53 ।। tāstāḥ saṃbhāṣya devāste vismitā yayurīśvarāḥ ।। rādhikābhyaṃtaraṃ dvāraṃ ṣoḍaśākhyaṃ manoharam ।। 54 ।। sarvāsāṃ ca pradhānaṃ ca gopyaṃ gopāṃganāgaṇaiḥ ।। trayastriṃśadvayasyānāṃ nikarairveṣṭitaṃ mune ।। 55 ।। teṣāmanirvacanīyairnānāguṇasamanvitaiḥ ।। rūpayauvanasaṃpannai ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaiḥ ।। 56 ।। ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūratnanūpurabhūṣitaiḥ ।। sadratnakiṃkiṇījālaimardhyadeśavibhūṣitaiḥ ।। 57 ।। ratnakuṃḍalayugmena gaṃḍasthalavirājitaiḥ ।। praphullamālatīmālājālairvakṣasthalojjvalaiḥ ।। 58 ।। śaratpārvaṇapadmānāṃ prabhāṃ muṣṇanmukheṃdubhiḥ ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālena veṣṭitaiḥ ।। ।। 59 ।। pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhaiśca smerānanasaroruhaiḥ ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhiḥ śobhitairdaṃtapaṃktibhiḥ ।। 60 ।। cārucaṃpakavarṇābhirmadhyasthalakṛśairmune ।। gajamauktikayuktābhirnāsikābhirvirājitaiḥ ।। 61 ।। khageṃdracārucaṃcūnāṃ śobhāmuṣṇābhireva ca ।। gajeṃdragaṃḍakaṭhina stanabhārabharānataiḥ ।। 62 ।। pīnaśroṇibharārtaiśca mukuṃdapadamānasaiḥ ।। nimeṣarahitā devā dvāraṃ ca dadṛśuśca tāḥ ।।63।। lasadramaṇiratnaiśca vedikāyugmaśobhitam ।। harinmaṇīnāṃ staṃbhānāṃ samūhaiḥ saṃyutaṃ sadā ।। 64 ।। siṃdūrākāramaṇibhirmadhyasthalavirājitaiḥ ।। pārijāta prasūnānāṃ mālājālairvibhūṣitam ।। 65 ।। tatsaṃsparśairgaṃdhavāhaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtam ।। dṛṣṭvā tatparamāścaryaṃ rādhikābhyaṃtaraṃ surāḥ ।। 66 ।। śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbhojadarśanaikamanorathāḥ ।। tāḥ saṃbhāṣya yayuḥ śīghraṃ pulakāṃcitavigrahāḥ ।। 67 ।। bhaktyudrekādaśrupūrṇāḥ kiṃcinnamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ।। ārātte dadṛśurdevā rādhikābhyaṃtaraṃ varam ।। 68 ।। maṃdirāṇāṃ ca madhyasthaṃ catuḥśālaṃ manoharam ।। amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ sāreṇa racitaṃ param ।। 69 ।। nānāratnamaṇistaṃbhairvajrayuktaiśca bhūṣitam ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam ।। 70 ।। muktāsamūhairmāṇikyaiḥ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ ।। amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ kalaśairbhūṣitaṃ mune ।। 71 ।। paṭṭasūtragraṃthiyuktaśrīkhaṃḍapallavānvitaiḥ ।। maṇistaṃbhasamūhaiśca ramyaprāṃgaṇabhūṣitam ।। 72 ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutam ।। śukladhānyaśuklapuṣpapravālaphalataṃḍulaiḥ ।। 73 ।। parṇadūrvākṣatairlājairnirmaṃchanavibhūṣitaiḥ ।। phalayuktai ratnakuṃbhaiḥ siṃdūrakuṃkumānvitaiḥ ।। 74 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāyuktairvirājitam ।। prasūnāktairgaṃdhavāhaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtam ।। 75 ।। sarvānirvacanīyaṃ ca yaddravyamanirūpitam ।। brahmāṃḍe durlabhaṃ yadyadvastubhistairvirājitam ।। 76 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiḥ suśobhitam ।। ratnaśayyāsu lalitāḥ sūkṣmavastraparicchadāḥ।।77।। koṭiśo ratnakuṃbhāśca ratnapātrāṇi nārada ।। amūlyāni ca cārūṇi taistaireva vibhūṣitam।।78।। nānāprakāravādyānāṃ kalanādairnināditam।। svarayaṃtraiśca vīṇābhirgopīsaṃgītasuśrutam।। 79 ।। mohitaṃ vādyaśabdaiśca mṛdaṃgānāṃ ca nārada ।। gopānāṃ kṛṣṇatulyānāṃ samūhaiḥ parivāritam।। ।। 80।। rādhāsakhīnāṃ gopīnāṃ vṛṃdairvṛṃdairvirājitam ।। rādhākṛṣṇaguṇodrekapadasaṃgītasuśrutam।।81।। evamabhyaṃtaraṃ dṛṣṭvā babhūvurvismitāḥ surāḥ।। । śuśruvurmadhuraṃ gītaṃ dadṛśurnṛtyamuttamam ।।82।। tatra tasthuḥ surāḥ sarve dhyānaikatānamānasāḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśustridaśeśvarāḥ ।। 83 ।। dhanuḥśatapramāṇaṃ ca parito vartulākṛtim।। sadratnakṣudrakalaśasamūhaiśca samanvitam ।।84 ।। citraputtalikāpuṣpacitrakānanabhūṣitam ।। tatra tejaḥsamūhaṃ ca sūryakoṭisamaprabham ।। 85 ।। prabhayā jvalitaṃ brahmannāścaryaṃ mahadadbhutam ।। saptatālapramāṇaṃ tadvyāptamūrdhvaṃ samantataḥ।।66।। tejomuṣaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mahāśramavivarjitam ।। sarvavyāpi sarvabījaṃ cakṣūrodhakaraṃ param ।।87।। dṛṣṭvā tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca te devā dhyānatatparāḥ ।। praṇemuḥ parayā bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ।। 88 ।। paramānandasaṃyogādaśrupūrṇavilocanāḥ ।। pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgā vāṃchāpūrṇamanorathāḥ ।। 89 ।। natvā tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca tamīśaṃ tridaśeśvarāḥ ।। tatrotthāya dhyānayuktāḥ pratasthustejasaḥ puraḥ ।। 90 ।। dhyātvaivaṃ jagatāṃ dhātā babhūva saṃpuṭāṃjaliḥ ।। dakṣiṇe śaṃkaraṃ kṛtvā vāme dharmaṃ ca nārada ।। 91 ।। bhaktyudrekātpratuṣṭāva dhyānaikatānamānasaḥ ।। parātparaṃ guṇātītaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 92 ।। ।। brahmovāca ।। ।। varaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ varadānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। kāraṇaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 93 ।। maṃgalaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalaṃ maṃgalapradam ।। samastamaṃgalādhāraṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham।। 94 ।। sthitaṃ sarvatra nirliptamātmarūpaṃ parātparam ।। nirīhamavitarkyaṃ ca tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 95 ।। saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 96 ।। tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca vyaktamavyaktamekakam ।। svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 97 ।। guṇatrayavibhāgāya rūpatrayadharaṃ param ।। kalayā te kṛtāḥ sarve kiṃ jānanti śruteḥ param ।। 98 ।। sarvādhāraṃ sarvarūpaṃ sarvabījamabījakam ।। sarvāṃtakamanantaṃ ca tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 99 ।। lakṣyaṃ ṣaṅguṇarūpaṃ ca varṇanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ।। kiṃ varṇayāmi lakṣyaṃ ca tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 100 ।। aśarīraṃ vigrahavadiṃdriyaṃ yadatīṃdriyam ।। yadasākṣi sarvasākṣi tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 101 ।। gamanārhamapādaṃ yadacakṣuḥ sarvadarśanam ।। hastāsyahīnaṃ yadbhoktṛ tejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 102 ।। vede nirūpitaṃ vastu santaḥ śaktāśca varṇitum ।। vede'nirūpitaṃ yattattejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 103 ।। sarveśaṃ yadanīśaṃ yatsarvādi yadanādi yat ।। sarvātmakamanātmaṃ yattejorūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। 104 ।। ahaṃ vidhātā jagato vedānāṃ janakaḥ svayam ।। pātā dharmo haro hartā stotuṃ śaktā na ke'pi yat ।। 105 ।। sevayā tava dharmo'yaṃ pālane ca nirūpitaḥ।। tavājñayā ca saṃhartā tvayā kāle nirūpite ।।106।। niḥśeṣotpattikarttā'haṃ tvatpādāṃbhojasevayā ।। karmiṇāṃ phaladātā ca tvaṃ bhaktānāṃ ca naḥ prabhuḥ ।। 107> brahmāṃḍe biṃbasadṛśe bhūtvā viṣayiṇo vayam ।। evaṃ katividhāḥ saṃti teṣvananteṣu sevakāḥ ।।108।। yathā na saṃkhyā reṇūnāṃ tathā teṣāmaṇīyasām ।। sarveṣāṃ janakaśceśo yastaṃ stotuṃ ca ke kṣamāḥ ।।109।। ekaikalomavivare brahmāṃḍamekamekakam ।। yasyaiva mahato viṣṇoḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśastavaiva saḥ ।। 110।। dhyāyaṃte yoginaḥ sarve tavaitadrūpamīpsitam ।। tvadbhaktadāsyaniratāḥ sevaṃte caraṇāṃbujam ।। 111 ।। kiśoraṃ suṃdarataraṃ yakṣaṃ kamanīyakam ।। maṃtradhyānānurūpaṃ ca darśayāsmākamīśvara ।। 112 ।। navīnajaladaśyāmapītāṃbaradharaṃ varam ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। 113 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatījālamaṃḍitam ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravacarcitam ।। 114 ।। amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ sārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। amūlyaratnaracitakirīṭamukuṭojjvalam ।। 115 ।। śaratpraphullapadmānāṃ prabhāmoṣyāsyacaṃdrakam ।। pakvabiṃbasamānena hyadharoṣṭhena rājitam ।। 116 ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktimanoharam ।। kelīkadaṃbamūle ca sthitaṃ rāsarasonmukham ।। 117 ।। gopīvaktrasmitatanuṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam ।। evaṃ vāṃchitarūpaṃ te dṛṣṭuṃ ko vā na cotsukaḥ ।।118।। ityevamuktvā viśvasṛṭ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ ।। evaṃ stotreṇa tuṣṭāva dharmo'pi śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।।119।। nanāma bhūyobhūyaśca sāśrupūrṇavilocanaḥ ।। tiṣṭhato'pi punaḥ stotraṃ pracakrustridaśeśvarāḥ ।। 120 ।। vyāptāstatrāśrame sarve śrīkṛṣṇatejasā mune ।। stavarājamimaṃ nityaṃ brahmeśadharmabhiḥ kṛtam ।। 121 ।। pūjākāle harerevaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet ।। sudurlabhāṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ niścalāṃ labhate hareḥ ।। 122 ।। surāsuramunīṃdrāṇāṃ durlabhaṃ dāsyameva ca ।। aṇimādikasiddhiṃ ca sālokyādi catuṣṭayam ।।123।। ihaiva viṣṇutulyaśca vikhyātaḥ pūjito dhuvam ।। vāksiddhirmaṃtrasiddhiśca bhavettasya suniścitam ।। 124 ।। sarvasaubhāmyasaṃyuktaṃ yaśasā pūritaṃ jagat ।। putraśca vidyā kavitā niścalā kamalā tathā।।125।। patnī pativratā sādhvī suśīlā susthirāḥ prajāḥ ।। kīrtiśca cirakālīnā tvaṃte kṛṣṇāṃtike gatiḥ ।। 126 ।। iti śrībrahma vaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe golokavarṇane śrīkṛṣṇastotrarājapaṭhanaṃ nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 5 ।।
<4.6> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। dhyātvā stutvā ca tiṣṭhaṃto devāste tejasaḥ puraḥ ।। dadṛśustejaso madhye śarīraṃ kamanīyakam ।। 1 ।। sajalāṃbhodavarṇābhaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। paramāhlādakaṃ rūpaṃ trailokyacittamohanam ।। 2 ।। gaṃḍasthalakapolābhyāṃ jvalanmakara kuṇḍalam ।। sadratnanūpurābhyāṃ ca caraṇāṃbhojarājitam ।। 3 ।। vahniśuddhaharidrābhāmūlyavastravirājitam ।। maṇiratneṃdrasārāṇāṃ svecchā kautukanirmitaiḥ ।। 4 ।। bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇai ramyaistadrūpeṇaiva bhūṣitaiḥ ।। vinodamuralīyuktabiṃbādharamanoharam ।। 5 ।। prasannekṣaṇapaśyaṃtaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। sadratnaguṭikāyuktakavacoraḥsthalojjvalam ।। 6 ।। kaustubhāsaktasadratnapradīptatejasojjvalam ।। tatra tejasi cārvaṃgīṃ dadṛśū rādhikābhidhām ।। 7 ।। paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ kāṃtaṃ paśyaṃtīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। muktāpaṃktiviniṃdyaikadaṃtapaṃktivirājitām ।। ।। 8 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanām ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrābhāviniṃdāsyamanoharām ।। 9 ।। baṃdhujīvaprabhāmuṣṭādharauṣṭharu cirānanām ।। raṇanmaṃjīrayugmena pādāṃbujavirājitām ।। 10 ।। maṇīṃdrāṇāṃ prabhāmoṣanakharājivirājitām ।। kuṅakumābhāsamācchādya padādhorāgabhūṣitām ।। 11 ।। amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ raśanāśroṇibhūṣitām ।। hutāśanaviśuddhāṃśukāmūlyajvalitojjvalām ।। 12 ।। mahāmaṇīṃdrasārāṇāṃ kiṅkiṇīmadhyasaṃyutām ।। sadratnahārakeyūrakarakaṃkaṇabhūṣitām ।। 13 ।। ratneṃdrasāraracitakapolojjvalakuṇḍalām ।। karṇopari maṇīndrāṇāṃ karṇabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 14 ।। khageṃdracaṃcunāsāgra gajeṃdramauktikānvitām ।। mālatīmālayā vakrakabarībhāraśobhi tām ।। 15 ।। mālayā kaustubheṃdrāṇāṃ vakṣaḥsthalasuśobhitām।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālojjvalāṃbarām ।। 16 ।। ratnāṃgulīya nikaraiḥ karāṃgulivibhūṣitām ।। divyaśaṃkhavikāraiśca citrarāgavibhūṣitaiḥ ।।17।। sūkṣmasūtrākṛtai ramyairbhūṣitā śaṃkhabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। sadratnasāraguṭikārājisūtrasuśobhitām ।। 18।। prataptasvarṇavarṇābhāmācchādya cāruvigrahām ।। nitambaśroṇilalitāṃ pīnastananatāṃbarām ।।19।। bhūṣitāṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sauṃdaryeṇa vibhūṣitaiḥ ।। vismitāstridaśāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā tāmīśvarīṃ varām।। tuṣṭuvuste surāḥ sarve pūrṇasarvamanorathāḥ।। 20।। ।। brahmovāca ।। tava caraṇasaroje manmanaścaṃcarīko bhramatu satatamīśa premabhaktyā saroje ।। bhuvanavibhavabhogāttāpaśāṃtyauṣadhāyasudṛḍhasu paripakvādehibhakti cadāsyam ।। 21 ।। ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। ।। bhavajalanidhimagnambittamīno madīyo bhramati satatamasminghorasaṃsāra kūpe ।। viṣayamativiniṃdyaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārarūpamapanaya tava bhaktiṃ dehi pādāraviṃde ।। 22 ।। ।। dharma uvāca ।। tava nijajanasārddhaṃ saṃgamo me madīśa bhavatu viṣayabaṃdhacchedane tīkṣṇakhaṅgaḥ। tava caraṇasaroje sthānadānaikaheturjanuṣi januṣi bhaktiṃ dehi pādāravinde ।।23।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā paripūrṇaikasānasāḥ ।। kāmapūrasya puratastiṣṭhato rādhikāpateḥ ।। 24 ।। surāṇāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā tānu vāca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vacanaṃ smerānanasaroruhaḥ ।। 25 ।। ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ।। tiṣṭhatāgacchata surā madīyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। śivāśrayāṇāṃ kuśalaṃ praṣṭuṃ yuktaṃ na sāṃpratam ।। 26 ।। niściṃtā bhavatātraiva kā ciṃtā vo mayi sthite।। sthito'haṃ sarvajīveṣu pratyakṣo'haṃ stavena vai।।27।। yuṣmākaṃ yamabhiprāyaṃ sarvaṃ jānāmi niścitam ।। śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma kāle khalu bhaviṣyati ।। 28 ।। mahatkṣudraṃ ca yatkarma sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ surāḥ ।। sve sve kāle ca taravaḥ phalitāḥ puṣpiṇaḥ sadā ।। 29 ।। paripakvaphalāḥ kāle kāle pakvaphalānvitāḥ ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vipatsaṃpacchokaciṃtāśubhāśubham ।। 30 ।। svakarmaphalaniṣṭhaṃ ca sarvakāle'pyupasthitam ।। na hi kasya priyaḥ ko vā vipriyo vā jagattraye ।। 31 ।। kāle kāryavaśātsarve bhavaṃtyevāpriyāḥ priyāḥ ।। rājāno manavaḥ pṛthvyāṃ dṛṣṭā yuṣmābhiratra vai ।। 32 ।। svakarmaphalapākena sarve kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ ।। yuṣmākamadhunā caiva goloke yatkṣaṇaṃ gatam ।। 33 ।। pṛthivyāṃ tatkṣaṇenaiva saptamanvataraṃ gatam ।। iṃdrāḥ sapta gatāstatra deveṃdra ścāṣṭamo'dhunā ।। 34 ।। kālacakraṃ bhramatyeva madīyaṃ ca divāniśam ।। indrāśca mānavā bhūpāḥ sarve kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ ।। 35 ।। kīrtiḥ pṛthvyāṃ puṇyamadya kathāmātrāvaśeṣitam ।। adhunā'pi ca rājāno duṣṭāśca hariniṃdakāḥ ।। 36 ।। babhūvurbahavo bhūmau mahābala parākramāḥ ।। sarve yāsyaṃti rājānaḥ kālāṃtaravaśaṃ dhuvam ।। 37 ।। upasthito'pi kālo'yaṃ vāto vāti niraṃtaram ।। vahnirdahati sūryaśca tapatyeva mamājñayā ।। 38 ।। vyādhayaḥ saṃti deheṣu mṛtyuścarati jaṃtuṣu ।। varṣaṃtyete jaladharāḥ sarve devā mamājñayā ।। 39 ।। brāhmaṇyaniṣṭhā viprāśca taponiṣṭhāstapodhanāḥ ।। bra hmarṣayo brahmaniṣṭhā yoganiṣṭhāśca yoginaḥ ।। 40 ।। te sarve madbhayādbhītāḥ svakarmadharmatatparāḥ ।। madbhaktāścaiva niḥśaṃkāḥ karmanirmūlakārakāḥ ।। 41 ।। devāḥ kālasya kālo'haṃ vidhātā dhātureva ca ।। saṃhārakartuḥ saṃhartā pātuḥ pātā parātparaḥ ।। 42 ।। mamājñayā'yaṃ saṃhartā nāmrā tena haraḥ smṛtaḥ ।। tvaṃ viśvasṛṭ sṛṣṭihetoḥ pātā dharmasya rakṣaṇāt ।। 43 ।। brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ sarveṣāmahamīśvaraḥ ।। svakarmaphaladātā'haṃ karmanirmūlakārakaḥ ।। 44 ।। ahaṃ yānsaṃhariṣyāmi kasteṣāmapi rakṣitā ।। yānahaṃ pālayiṣyāmi teṣāṃ haṃtā na ko'pi vā ।। 45 ।। sarveṣāmapi saṃhartā sraṣṭā pātā'hameva ca ।। nāhaṃ śaktaśca bhaktānāṃ saṃhāre nityadehinām ।। 46 ।। bhaktā mamānugā nityaṃ matpādārcanatatparāḥ ।। ahaṃ bhaktāṃtike śaśvatteṣāṃ rakṣaṇahetava ।। 47 ।। sarve naśyaṃti brahmāṇḍe prabhavaṃti punaḥpunaḥ ।। na me bhaktāḥ praṇaśyanti niḥśaṃkāśca nirāpadaḥ ।। 48 ।। ato vipaścitaḥ sarve dāsyaṃ vāṃchaṃti no varam ।। ye māṃ dāsyaṃ prayācaṃte dhanyāste'nye ca vaṃcitāḥ ।। 49 ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhi bhayaṃ ca yamayātanā ।। anyeṣāṃ karmiṇāmasti na bhaktānāṃ ca karhicit ।। 50 ।। bhaktā na liptāḥ pāpeṣu puṇyeṣu sarvaka rmiṇaḥ ।। ahaṃ dhunomi teṣāṃ ca karmabhogānsuniścitam ।। 51 ।। ahaṃ prāṇaśca bhaktānāṃ bhaktāḥ prāṇā mamāpi ca ।। dhyāyaṃte te ca māṃ nityaṃ tānsmarāmi divāniśam ।। 52 ।। cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśāraṃ sutīkṣṇakam ।। yattejaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśo'pi nāsti sarveṣu jīviṣu ।। 93 ।। bhaktāntike tu taccakraṃ dattvā rakṣārthamīpsitam ।। na svāsthyaṃ na ca prītirme yāmi teṣāṃ ca sannidhim ।। 54 ।। na me svāsthyaṃ ca vaikuṃṭhe goloke rādhikāṃtike ।। yatra tiṣṭhaṃti bhaktāste tatra tiṣṭhāmyaharniśam ।। 55 ।। prāṇebhyaḥ preyasī rādhā sthitorasi divāniśam ।। yūyaṃ prāṇādhikā lakṣmīrna me bhaktātparā priyā ।। 56 ।। bhaktadattaṃ ca yaddravyaṃ bhaktyā 'śnāmi sureśvarāḥ ।। abhaktadattaṃ nāśnāmi dhruvaṃ bhuṃkte baliṃ svayam ।। 57 ।। strīputrasvajanāṃstyaktvā dhyāyaṃte māmaharniśam ।। yuṣmānvihāya tānnityaṃ smarāmyahamaharniśam ।। 58 ।। duṣṭā yadā me bhaktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmapi ।। kratūnāṃ devatānāṃ ca hiṃsāṃ kurvaṃti niścitam ।। 59 ।। tathā'ciraṃ te naśyaṃti yathā vahnau tṛṇāni ca ।। na ko'pi rakṣitā teṣāṃ mayi haṃtaryupasthite ।। 60 ।। yāsyāmi pṛthivīṃ devā yāta yūyaṃ svamālayam ।। yūyaṃ caivāṃśarūpeṇa śīghraṃ gacchata bhūtalam ।। 61 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho gopānā hūya gopikāḥ ।। uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ yatsamayocitam ।। 62 ।। gopā gopyaśca śṛṇuta yāta naṃdavrajaṃ param ।। vṛṣabhānugṛhe kṣipraṃ gaccha tvamapi rādhike ।। 63 ।। vṛṣabhānupriyā sādhvī naṃdagopakalāvatī ।। subalasya sutā sā ca kamalāṃśasamudbhavā ।। ।। 64 ।। pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ।। purā durvāsasaḥ śāpājjanma tasyā vraje gṛhe ।। 65 ।। tasyā gṛhe janma labha śīghraṃ naṃdavrajaṃ vraja ।। tvāmahaṃ bālarūpeṇa gṛhṇāmi kamalānane ।। 66 ।। tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā rādhe tava prāṇādhiko'pyaham।। na kiṃcidāvayorbhinnamekāṃgaṃ sarvadaiva hi ।।67।। śrutvaivaṃ rādhikā tatra ruroda premavihvalā ।। papau cakṣuścakorābhyāṃ mukhacaṃdraṃ harermune ।।68।। janurlabhata gopāśca gopyaśca pṛthivītale ।। gopānāmuttamānāṃ ca maṃdire maṃdire śubhe ।।69।। etasminnaṃtare sarve dadṛśū rathamuttamam ।। maṇiratneṃdrasāreṇa hīrakeṇa vibhūṣitam ।। 70।। śvetacāmaralakṣeṇa śobhitaṃ darpaṇāyutaiḥ ।। sūkṣmakāṣāyavastreṇa vahniśuddhena bhūṣitam ।। ।। 71 ।। sadratnakalaśānāṃ ca sahasreṇa suśobhitam ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam ।। 72 ।। pārṣadapravaraiyuktaṃ śāta kuṃbhamayaṃ śubham ।। tejaḥsvarūpamatulaṃ śatasūryasamaprabham ।। 73 ।। tatrasthaṃ puruṣaṃ śyāmaṃ sundaraṃ kamanīyakam ।। śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ varam ।। 74 ।। kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravacarcitam ।। 75 ।। caturbhujaṃ smeravaktraṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। maṇiratneṃdrasārāṇāṃ sārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 76 ।। devīṃ tadvāmato ramyāṃ śuklavarṇāṃ manoharām ।। ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ śobhitāṃ pītavāsasā ।। 77 ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyāṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanām ।। pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca smerayu ktāṃ manoharām ।। 78 ।। veṇuvīṇāgraṃthahastāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ।। vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca jñānarūpāṃ sarasvatīm ।। 79 ।। aparāṃ dakṣiṇe ramyāṃ śatacaṃdrasamaprabhām ।। prataptasvarṇavarṇābhāṃ sasmitāṃ sumanoharām ।। 80 ।। sadratnakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca sukapolavirāji tām ।। amūlyaratnakhacitāmūlyavastreṇa bhūṣitām ।। 81 ।। amūlyaratnakeyūrakarakaṃkaṇaśobhitām ।। sadratnasāramaṃjīrakalaśabdasa manvitām ।। 82 ।। maṇīṃdrakiṃkiṇīyuktamadhyadeśasamanvitām ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāvakṣaḥ sthalojjvalām ।। 83 ।। praphulla mālatīmālāsaṃyuktakabarīyutām ।। śaraccaṃdraprabhāmuṣṇanmukhacāruvibhūṣitām ।। 84 ।। kastūrībiṃdusaṃyuktasinduratilakānvitām ।। sucārukajjalāsaktaśaratpaṃkajalocanām ।। 85 ।। sahasradalasaṃsaktalīlākamalasaṃyutām ।। nārāyaṇaṃ ca paśyaṃtaṃ paśyaṃtī vakraca kṣuṣā ।। 86 ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇa sastrīkaḥ sahapārṣadaḥ ।। jagāma ca sabhāṃ ramyāṃ gopagopīsamanvitām ।। 87 ।। devā gopyaśca gopāśca tasthuḥ prāṃjalayo mudā ।। sāmavedoktastotreṇa kṛtena ca surarṣibhiḥ ।। 88 ।। gatvā nārāyaṇo devo vilīnaḥ kṛṣṇavigrahe ।। dṛṣṭvā ca paramāścaryaṃ te sarve vismayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 89 ।। etasminnantare tatra śātakuṃbhamayādrathāt ।। avaruhya svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ pātā ca jaga tāṃ patiḥ ।। 90 ।। ājagāma caturbāhurvanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ।। pītāṃbaradharaḥ śrīmānsasmitaḥ sumanoharaḥ ।। 91 ।। sarvālaṃkāraśobhā ḍhyaḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ ।। uttasthuste ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭuvuḥ praṇatā mune ।। 92 ।। sa cāpi līnastatraiva rādhikeśasya vigrahe ।। te dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ।। 93 ।। saṃvilīne hareraṃge śvetadvīpanivāsini ।। etasminnaṃtare tūrṇamājagāma tvarānvitaḥ ।। 94 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo nāmnā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ ।। 95 ।। āgataṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ viṣṇuvi graham ।। sa cāgatya nataskadhastuṣṭāva rādhikeśvaram ।। 96 ।। sahasramūrdhā bhaktyā ca praṇanāma ca nārada ।। āvāṃ ca dharmaputrau dvau nara nārāyaṇābhidhau ।। 97 ।। līno'haṃ kṛṣṇapādābje babhūva phālguno'varaḥ।। brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca tasthurekatra tatra vai ।। 98 ।। etasminnaṃtare devā dadṛśū rathamuttamam ।। svarṇasāravikāraṃ ca nānāsanaparicchadam ।। 99 ।। maṇīṃdrasārasaṃyuktaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitam ।। śvetacāmara saṃyuktaṃ bhūṣitaṃ darpaṇānvitaiḥ ।। 100 ।। sadratnasārakalaśasamūhena virājitam ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiḥ suśobhitam।। 101 ।। sahasracakrasaṃyuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam ।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṃḍaprabhāmoṣakaraṃ varam ।। 102 ।। muktāmāṇikyavajrāṇāṃ samūhena samujjvalam ।। citraputtalikāpuṣpasaraḥ kānanacitritam ।। 103 ।। devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca rathānāṃ pravaraṃ mune ।। yatnena śaṃkaraprītyā nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 104 ।। paṃcāśadyojanordhvaṃ ca caturyojanavistṛtam ।। ratitulyavadhūyuktaiḥ śobhitaṃ ratimaṃ diraiḥ ।। 105 ।। tatrasthāṃ dadṛśurdevīṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitām ।। pradagdhasvarṇasārāṇāṃ prabhāmoṣakaradyutim ।। 106 ।। tejaḥsvarūpā matulāṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ।। sahasrabhujasaṃyuktāṃ nānāyudhasamanvitām ।। 107 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām ।। gaṃḍasthalakapolasthasadratnakuṃḍalojjvalām ।। 108 ।। ratnendrasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīraraṃjitām ।। maṇīṃdramekhalāyuktamadhya deśasuśobhitām ।। 109 ।। sadratnasārakeyūrakarakaṃkaṇabhūṣitām ।। maṃdārapuṣpamālābhiruraḥsthalasamujjvalām ।। 110 ।। nitaṃbakaṭhinaśroṇīṃ pīnonnatakucānatām ।। śaratsudhākarābhāsaviniṃdāsyamanoharām ।। 111 ।। kajjalojjalarekhāktaśaratpaṃkajaloca nām ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīcitrapatravibhūṣitām ।। 112 ।। muktāpaṃktiprabhāmuṣṭadaṃtarājivirājitām ।। praphullamālatīmālāsaṃsaktakabarīṃ varām ।।113 ।। pakṣīṃdracaṃcunāsāgragajeṃdramauktikānvitām ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukenātijvalitena samujjvalām ।। 114 ।। siṃhapṛṣṭhasamārūḍhāṃ sutābhyāṃ sahitāṃ mudā ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇanāma ca ।। 115 ।। sutābhyāṃ sahitā devī samuvā sa varānanāḥ ।। gaṇeśaḥ kārttikeyaśca natvā kṛṣṇa parātparam ।। 116 ।। nanāma śaṃkaraṃ dharmamanaṃtaṃ kamalodbhavam ।। uttasthurārātte devā dṛṣṭvā tau tridaśeśvarau ।। 117 ।। āśiṣaṃ ca dadurdevā vāsayāmāsuraṃtike ।। tābhyāṃ saha sadālāpaṃ cakrurdevā mudā'nvitāḥ ।। 118 ।। tasthurdevāḥ sabhāmadhye devasya purato hareḥ ।। gopā gopyaśca bahuśo babhūvurvismayākulāḥ ।। 119 ।। uvāca kamalāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ smerānanasaroruhaḥ ।। tvaṃ gaccha bhīṣmakagṛhaṃ nānāratnasamanvitam ।। 120 ।। vaidarbhyā udare janma labha devi sanā tani ।। tava pāṇiṃ grahīṣyāmi gatvā'haṃ kuṃḍinaṃ sati ।। 121 ।। tā devyaḥ pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya tvarānvitāḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm ।। 122।। vipreṃdra pārvatīlakṣmīvāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevatāḥ ।। tasthurekāsane tatra saṃbhāṣya ca yathoci tam ।। 123 ।। tāśca saṃbhāṣayāmāsuḥ saṃprītyā gopakanyakāḥ ।। ūcurgopālikāḥ kāścinmudā tāsāṃ ca saṃnidhau ।। 124 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pārvatīṃ tatra samuvāca jagatpatiḥ ।। devi tvamaṃśarūpeṇa jana naṃdavraje śubhe ।। 125 ।। udare ca yaśodāyāḥ kalyāṇī naṃdaretasā ।। labha janma mahāmāye sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇi ।। 126 ।। grāme grāme ca pūjāṃ te kārayiṣyāmi bhūtale ।। kṛtsne mahītale bhaktyā nagareṣu vaneṣu ca ।। 127 ।। tatrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ।। dravyairnānāvidhairdivyairbalibhiśca mudā'nvitāḥ ।। 128 ।। tvadbhūmisparśamātreṇa sūtikāmaṃdire śive ।। pitā māṃ tatra saṃsthāpya tvāmādāya gamiṣyati ।। 129 ।। kaṃsadarśana mātreṇa gamiṣyasi śivāṃtikam ।। bhārāvataraṇaṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi svamāśramam ।। 130 ।। ityuktvā śrīharistūrṇamuvāca ca ṣaḍānanam ।। aṃśarūpeṇa vatsa tvaṃ gamiṣyasi mahītalam ।। 131 ।। jāṃbavatyāśca garbhe ca labha janma sureśvara ।। aṃśena devatāḥ sarvā gacchaṃtu dharaṇītalam ।। 132 ।। bhārahāraṃ kariṣyāmi vasudhāyāśca niścitam ।। ityuktvā rādhikānāthastasthau siṃhāsane vare ।। 133 ।। tasthurdevāśca devyaśca gopā gopyaśca nārada ।। etasminnaṃtare brahmā samuttasthau hareḥ puraḥ ।। puṭāṃjalirjagatkāṃtamuvāca vina yānvitaḥ ।। 134 ।। ।। brahmovāca ।। ।। avadhānaṃ kuru vibho kiṃkarasya nivedanam ।। 135 ।। ājñāṃ kuru mahābhāga kasya kutra sthalaṃ bhuvi ।। bhartā pātoddhārakartā sevakānāṃ prabhuḥ sadā ।। 136 ।। sa bhṛtyaḥ sarvadā bhakta īśvarājñāṃ karoti yaḥ ।। ke devāḥ kena rūpeṇa devyaśca kalayā kayā ।। 137 ।। kutra kasyābhideyaṃ ca viṣayaṃ ca mahītale ।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca jagatpatiḥ ।। 138 ।। yatra yasyāvakāśaṃ ca kathayāmi vidhānataḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ।। kāmadevo raukmiṇeyo ratirmāyāvatī satī ।। 139 ।। śaṃbarasya gṛhe yā ca chāyārūpeṇa saṃsthitā ।। tvaṃ tasya putro bhavitā nāmnā'niruddha eva ca ।। 140 ।। bhāratī śoṇitapure bāṇaputrī bhaviṣyati ।। anaṃto devakīgarbhādrauhiṇeyo jagatpatiḥ ।। 141 ।। māyayā garbhasaṃkarṣānnāmnā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। kāliṃdī sūryatanayā gaṃgāṃśena mahītale ।। 142 ।। arddhāṃśenaiva tulasī lakṣmaṇā rāja kanyakā ।। sāvitrī vedamātā ca nāmnā nāgnajitī satī ।। 143 ।। vasuṃdharā satyabhāmā śaibyā devī sarasvatī ।। rohiṇī mitraviṃdā ca bhavitā rājakanyakā ।। 144 ।। sūryapatnī ratnamālā kalayā ca jagatprabhoḥ ।। svāhāṃśena suśīlā ca rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyo nava ।। 145 ।। durgāṃśārddhājjāṃbavatī mahiṣīṇāṃ daśa smṛtāḥ ।। arddhāṃśena śailaputrī yātu jāṃbavato gṛham ।। 146 ।। kailāse śaṃkarājñā ca babhūva pārvatīṃ purā ।। kailāsagāminaṃ viṣṇuṃ śvetadvīpanivāsinam ।। āliṃganaṃ dehi kāṃte nāsti doṣo mamā jñayā ।। 147 ।। ।। brahmovāca ।। kathaṃ śivājñā tāṃ devīṃ babhūva rādhikāpate ।। viṣṇoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇe pūrvaṃ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ ।। 148 ।। ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। ।। purā gaṇeśaṃ draṣṭuṃ ca prajagmuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। śvetadvīpātsvayaṃ viṣṇurjagāma śaṃkarālaye ।। 149 ।। dṛṣṭvā gaṇeśaṃ muditaḥ samuvāsa sukhāsane ।। sukhena dadṛśuḥ sarve trailokyamohanaṃ vapuḥ ।। 150।। kirīṭinaṃ kuṃḍalinaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ varam ।। suṃdaraṃ śyāma rūpaṃ ca navayauvanasaṃyutam ।। 151 ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutam ।। ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhayaṃ smerānanasaroruham ।। 152 ।। ratna siṃhāsanasthaṃ ca pārṣadaiḥ pariveṣṭitam ।। vaṃditaṃ ca suraiḥ sarvaiḥ śivena pūjitaṃ stutam ।।153।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā pārvatī viṣṇuṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā ।। mukhamācchāditaṃ cakre vāsasā vrīḍayā satī ।।154।। atīva sundaraṃ rūpaṃ darśaṃdarśaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ।। dadarśa mukhamācchādya nimeṣarahitā satī ।। 159 ।। paramādbhutaveṣaṃ ca sasmitā vakracakṣuṣā ।। sukhasāgarasammagnā babhūva pulakāṃcitā ।।156।। kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa pañcāsyaṃ śubhravarṇaṃ trilocanam ।। triśūlaparighadharaṃ kandarpakoṭisundaram ।। 157 ।। kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa śyāmaṃ tamekāsyaṃ ca dvilocanam ।। caturbhujaṃ pītavastraṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 158 ।। ekaṃ bahma mūrtibhedamabhedaṃ vā nirūpitam ।। dṛṣṭvā babhūva sā māyā sakāmā viṣṇu māyayā ।। 159 ।। madaṃśāśca trayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। tābhyāmautkarṣapātācca śreṣṭhaḥ sattvaguṇātmakaḥ ।। 160 ।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ pārvatī bhaktyā pulakāṃcitavigrahā।। manasā pūjayāmāsa paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 161 ।। durgāṃtarābhiprāyaṃ ca bubudhe śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।। sarvāṃtarātmā bhagavānaṃtaryāmī jagatpatiḥ ।। 162 ।। durgāṃ nirjanamāhūya tāmuvāca haraḥ svayam ।। bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ hitaṃ tathyamakhaṃḍitam ।। 163 ।। ।। śrīśaṃkara uvāca ।। ।। nivedanaṃ madīyaṃ ca nibodhaṃ śailakanyake ।। śṛṃgāraṃ dehi bhadraṃ te haraye paramātmane ।। 154 ।। ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca brahmaikaṃ ca sanātanam ।। vadaiko vedarahito viṣayānmūrtibhedakaḥ ।। 165 ।। ekā prakṛtiḥ sarveṣāṃ mātā tvaṃ sarvarūpiṇī ।। svayaṃbhūrasi vāṇī tva lakṣmīrnārāyaṇorasi ।। 166 ।। mama vakṣasi durgā tvaṃ nibodhādhyātmakaṃ sati ।। śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca sureśvarī ।। 167 ।। ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। ।। dīnabaṃdho kṛpāsiṃdho tava māmakṛpā katham।। suciraṃ tapasā labdho nāthastvaṃ jagatāṃ mayā ।। 168 ।। mādṛśīṃ kiṃkarī nātha na parityaktumarhasi ।। ayogyamīdṛśaṃ vākyaṃ mā mā vada maheśvara ।। 169 ।। tava vākyaṃ mahādeva kariṣyāmyeva pālanam ।। dehāṃtare janma labdhvā bhajiṣyāmi hariṃ hara ।। 170 ।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā virarāma maheśvaraḥ ।। uccairjahāsābhayadaḥ pārvatyai cābhayaṃ dadau ।। 171 ।। tatpratijñāpālanāya pārvatī jāṃbavadgṛhe ।। labhiṣyati janurdhātarnāmnā jāṃbavatī satī ।। 172 ।। ।। brahmovāca ।। ।। bhūmau katividhe bhūpe saṃsthite pārvatī katham ।। lalābha bhārate janma niṃdite bhālluke gṛhe ।।173।। ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ।। rāmāvatāre tretāyāṃ devāṃśāśca yayurmahīm ।। himālayāṃśo bhallūko jāṃbavānnāma kiṃkaraḥ ।। 174 ।। rāmasya varadānena ciraṃjīvī śriyā yutaḥ ।। koṭisiṃhabalādhānaṃ vidhatte ca mahābalaḥ ।। 175 ।। pituraṃśagṛhe durgā jagāmāṃśena bhūtalam ।। pūrvaṃ pūrvasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kathitaṃ śṛṇu manmukhāt ।। 175 ।। sarveṣāṃ ca surāṇāṃ vai vaṃśā gacchaṃtu bhūtalam ।। nṛpaputrā matsahāyā bhaviṣyaṃti raṇe vidhe ।। 177 ।। kamalākalayā sarvā bhavaṃtu nṛpakanyakāḥ ।। manmahiṣyo bhaviṣyaṃti sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa ।। 178 ।। dharmo'yamaṃśarūpeṇa pāṃḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ।। vāyoraṃśādbhīmasenaḥ sa vajrī hyarjunaḥ svayam ।। 179 ।। nakulaḥ sahadevaśca svarvaidyāṃśasamudbhavau । sṛryāṃśaḥ karṇavīraśca viduraḥ sa yamaḥ svayam ।। 180 ।। duryodhanaḥ kaleraṃśaḥ samudrāṃśaśca śaṃtanuḥ ।। aśvatthāmā śaṃkarāṃśo droṇo vahnyaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ।। 181 ।। hutāśanāṃśo bhagavāndhṛṣṭadyumno mahābalaḥ ।। caṃdrāṃśo'pyabhimanyuśca bhīṣmaścaiva vasūdbhavaḥ ।। 182 ।। vasudevaḥ kaśyapāṃśo'pyadityaṃśā ca devakī ।। vasvaṃśo naṃdagopaśca yaśodā vasukā minī ।। 183 ।। draupadī kamalāṃśā ca yajñakuṃḍasamudbhavā ।। subhadrā śatarūpāṃśā devakīgarbhasaṃbhavā ।।184।। devā gacchaṃtu pṛthivīmaṃśena bhārahārakāḥ ।। kalayā devapatnyaśca gacchaṃtu pṛthivītalam ।। 185 ।। ityevamuktvā bhagavānvirarāma ca nārada ।। sarvaṃ vivaraṇaṃ śrutvā tatrovāsa prajāpatiḥ ।।186।। kṛṣṇasya vāme vāgdevī dakṣiṇe kamalālayā ।। purato devatāḥ sarvāḥ pārvatī cāpi nārada ।। 187 ।। gopyo gopāśca parito rādhā vakṣaḥsthalasthitā ।। etasminnaṃtare sā ca tamuvāca vrajeśvarī ।।188।। ।। rādhikovāca ।। śṛṇu nātha pravakṣyāmi kiṃkarīvacanaṃ prabho ।। prāṇā dahaṃti satatamāṃdolayati me manaḥ ।। 189 ।। cakṣurnimīlanaṃ kartumaśaktā tava darśane ।। tvayā vinā kathaṃ nātha yāsyāmi dharaṇītalam ।। 190 ।। kiyatkālāṃtareṇaiva melanaṃ me tvayā saha ।। prāṇeśvara brūhi satyaṃ bhaviṣyatyeva gokule ।। 191 ।। nimeṣaṃ ca yugaśataṃ bhavitā me tvayā vinā ।। kaṃ drakṣyāmi kva yāsyāmi ko vā māṃ pālayiṣyati ।। 192 ।। mātaraṃ pitaraṃ baṃdhuṃ bhrātaraṃ bhaginīṃ sutam ।। tvayā vinā'haṃ prāṇeśa ciṃtayāmi na kaścana ।। 193 ।। karoṣi māyayā channā māṃ cenmāyeśa bhūtale ।। vismṛtāṃ vibhavaṃ dattvā me satyaṃ śapathaṃ kuru ।। 194 ।। anukṣaṇaṃ mama manomadhupo madhusūdana ।। karotu bhramaṇaṃ nityaṃ samādhvīke padāṃbuje ।। 195 ।। yatrayatra ca yasyāṃ vā yonau janma bhavatvidam ।। tvaṃ svasya smaraṇaṃ dāsyaṃ mahyaṃ dāsyasi vāṃchitam ।। 196 ।। kṛṣṇastvaṃ rādhikā'haṃ ca premasaubhāgyamāvayoḥ ।। na vismarāmi bhūmau ca dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ param ।। 197 ।। yathā tanvā saha prāṇāḥ śarīraṃ chāyayā saha ।। tathā''vayorjanma yātu dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ vibho ।। 198 ।। cakṣurnimeṣavicchedo bhavitā nāvayorbhuvi ।। tatrāgatyāpi kutrāpi dehi mahyaṃ varaṃ prabho ।। 199 ।। mama prāṇaistava tanuḥ kena vā karuṇā hare ।। ātmanā muralīpādau manasā vā vinirmitau ।। 200 ।। striyaḥ katividhāḥ saṃti puruṣā vā puruṣṭuta ।। nāsti kutrāpi kāṃtā vā kāṃtyā śaktyā ca mādṛśī ।। 201 ।। tava dehārdhabhāgena kena vā'haṃ vinirmitā ।। ayamevāvayorbhedo nāstyatastvayi me manaḥ ।। 202 ।। mamātmā mānasaṃ prāṇāstvayi saṃsthāpitā yathā ।। tavātmamānasaprāṇā mayi vā saṃsthitāstathā ।।203।। ato nimeṣavirahādātmanorviklavaṃ manaḥ ।। pradagdhaṃ santataṃ prāṇā dahaṃti virahaśrutau ।। 204 ।। ityevamuktvā sā devī tatraiva surasaṃsadi।। bhūyobhūyo rurodoccairdhṛtvā taccaraṇāṃbujam ।। 205।। kroḍe kṛtvā tu tāṃ kṛṣṇo mukhaṃ saṃmṛjya vāsasā ।। bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ satyaṃ tathyaṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ ।। 206 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ādhyātmikaṃ paraṃ yogaṃ śokacchedanakārakam ।। śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yogīṃdrāṇāṃ ca durlabham ।। 207 ।। ādhārādheyayoḥ sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ paśya sundari ।। ādhāravyatirekeṇa nāstyādheyasya saṃbhavaḥ ।। ।। 208 ।। phalādhāraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca puṣpādhāraṃ ca pallavam ।। skandhaśca pallavādhāraḥ skandhādhārastaruḥ svayam ।। 209 ।। vṛkṣādhāro 'pyaṃkuraśca jīvaśaktisamanvitaḥ ।। aṣṭirekāṃkurādhāraścāṣṭyādhāro vasundharā ।। 210 ।। śeṣo vasundharādhāraḥ śeṣādhāro hi kacchapaḥ।। vāyuśca kacchapādhāro vāyvādhāro'hameva ca ।। 211 ।। mamādhārasvarūpā tvaṃ tvayi tiṣṭhāmi sāṃpratam ।। tvaṃ ca śaktisamūhā ca mūlaprakṛ tirīśvarī ।। 212 ।। tvaṃ śarīrasvarūpā'si triguṇā''dhārarūpiṇī ।। tavātmā'haṃ nirīhaśca ceṣṭāvāṃśca tvayā saha ।।213।। puruṣādvīryamutpannaṃ vīryātsantatireva ca ।। tayorādhārarūpā ca kāminī prakṛteḥ kalā ।। 214 ।। vinā dehena kvātmā ca kva śarīraṃ vinā''tmanā।। prādhānyaṃ ca tayordevi vinā tvā'dya kuto bhavaḥ ।।215।। na kutrāpyāvayorbhedo rādhe saṃsārabījayoḥ ।। yatrātmā tatra dehaṃ ca na bhedo vinayena kim ।। 216 ।। yathā kṣīre ca dhāvalyaṃ dāhikā ca hutāśane ।। bhūmau gandho jale śaityaṃ tathā tvayi mayi sthite ।। 217 ।। dhāvalyadugdhayoraikyaṃ dāhikānalayoryathā ।। bhūgandhajalaśaityānāṃ nāsti bhedastathā''vayoḥ ।। 218 ।। mayā vinā tvaṃ nirjīvā cādṛśyo'haṃ tvayā vinā ।। tvayā vinā bhavaṃ kartuṃ nālaṃ sundari niścitam ।। 219 ।। vinā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ yathā nālaṃ kulālakaḥ ।। vinā svarṇaṃ svarṇakāro'laṃkāraṃ kartumakṣamaḥ ।। 220 ।। svayamātmā yathā nityastathā tvaṃ prakṛtiḥ svayam ।। sarvaśaktisamāyuktā sarvādhārā sanātanī ।। 221 ।। mama prāṇasamā lakṣmīvāṇī ca sarvamaṃgalā ।। brahmeśānantadha rmāśca tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā priyā ।। 222 ।। samīpasthā ime sarve surā devyaśca rādhike ।। ebhyo'pyadhikā no cetkathaṃ vakṣaḥ sthalasthitā ।। 223 ।। tyajāśrumokṣaṇaṃ rādhe bhrāṃtiṃ ca niṣphalāṃ sati ।। vihāya śaṃkāṃ niḥśaṃkaṃ vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ vraja ।। 224 ।। kalāvatyāśca jaṭhare māsānāṃ nava sundari ।। vāyunā pūrayitvā ca garbhaṃ rodhaya māyayā ।। 225।। daśame samanuprāpte tvamāvirbhava bhūtale ।। svātmarūpaṃ parityajya śiśurūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 226 ।। vāyuniḥsāraṇe kāle kalāvatyāḥ samīpataḥ ।। bhūmau vivasanībhūya patitvā rodiṣi dhruvam ।।227।। ayonisaṃbhavā tvaṃ ca bhavitā gokule sati ।। ayonisaṃbhavo'haṃ ca nāvayorgarbhasaṃsthitiḥ ।। 228 ।। bhūmisaṃspṛṣṭamātraṃ māṃ gokule prāpayiṣyati ।। tava hetorgamiṣyāmi kṛtvā kaṃsabhayaṃ chalam ।। 229 ।। yaśodāmaṃdire māṃ ca sānandaṃ nandanaṃdanam ।। nityaṃ drakṣyasi kalyāṇi mamāśleṣaṇapūrvakam ।। 230 ।। smṛtiste bhavitā kāle vareṇa mama rādhike ।। svacchandaṃ vihariṣyāmi nityaṃ vṛndāvane vane ।। 231 ।। triḥsaptaśatakoṭībhirgopībhirgokulaṃ vraja ।। trayastriṃśadvayasyābhiḥ suśīlādibhireva ca ।। 232 ।। saṃsthāpya saṃkhyārahitā gopīrgokula eva ca ।। tā āśvāsya prabodhaiśca mitayā ca sudhāgirā ।।233।। ahaṃ gopāla suhṛdaḥ saṃsthāpyātraiva rādhike ।। vasudevāśramaṃ paścādyāsyāmi mathurāṃ purīm ।। 234 ।। vraje vrajantu krīḍārthaṃ mama saṃge priyātpriyāḥ।। ballavānāṃ gṛhe janma labhantāṃ gopakoṭayaḥ ।। 235 ।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo virarāma ca nārada ।। ūṣurdevāśca devyaśca gopā gopyaśca tatra vai ।। 236 ।। brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ taṃ parātparam ।। śivāpadmāsarasvatyastuṣṭuvuḥ parayā mudā ।। 237 ।। bhaktyā gopāśca gopyaśca virahajvarakātarāḥ ।। tatra saṃstūya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇemuḥ premavihvalāḥ ।। 238> prāṇādhikaṃ priyaṃ kāṃtaṃ rādhāpūrṇamanoratham ।। parituṣṭo'bhavadbhaktyāvirahajvarakātarām ।। 239 ।। sāśrupūrṇātidīnāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ bhayākulām ।। prabodhavacanaṃ śrutyamuvāca tāṃ hariḥ svayam ।। 240 ।। ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। prāṇādhike mahādevi sthirā bhava bhayaṃ tyaja ।। yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca kā ciṃtā te mayi sthite ।। 241 ।। kiṃ tu te kathayiṣyāmi kiṃcidevāstyamaṃgalam ।। varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ pūrṇaṃ tvadvicchedo mayā saha ।। 242 ।। śrīdāmaśāpajanyena karmabhogena sundari ।। bhaviṣyatyeva mama ca mathurāgamanaṃ tataḥ ।। 243 ।। tatra bhārāvataraṇaṃ pitrorbaṃdhanamocanam ।। mālākārataṃtuvāyakubjikānāṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।। 244 ।। ghātayitvā ca yavanaṃ mucukundasya mokṣaṇam ।। dvārakāyāśca nirmāṇaṃ rājasūyasya darśanam ।। 245 ।। udvāhaṃ rājakanyānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa ।। daśādhikaśatasyāpi śatrūṇāṃ damanaṃ tathā ।। 246 ।। mitropakaraṇaṃ caiva vārāṇasyāśca dāhanam ।। harasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ tatra bāṇasya bhujakṛṃtanam ।। 247 ।। pārijātasya haraṇaṃ yadyatkarmāṇi tāni ca ।। gamanaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ munisaṃghapradarśanam ।। 248 ।। saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca baṃdhūnāṃ yajñasaṃpādanaṃ pituḥ ।। śubhakṣaṇe punastatra tvayā sārddhaṃ pradarśanam ।। kariṣyāmi ca tatraiva gopikānāṃ ca darśanam ।। 249 ।। tubhyamādhyātmikaṃ dattvā punaḥ satyaṃ tvayā saha ।। divāniśamavicchedo mayā sārddhamataḥ param ।। 250 ।। bhaviṣyati tvayā sārddhaṃ punarāgamanaṃ vraje ।। kāṃte vicchedasamaye varṣāṇāṃ śatake sati ।। 251 ।। nityaṃ saṃmīlana svapne bhaviṣyati tvayā saha ।। mama nārāyaṇāṃśo yastasya yānaṃ ca dvārakām ।। 292 ।। śatavarṣāṃtare sādhyametadeva suniścitam ।। bhaviṣyati punastatra vane rāsastvayā saha ।। 253 ।। punaḥ pitrośca gopīnāṃ śokasaṃmārjanaṃ param ।। kṛtvā bhārāvataraṇaṃ punarāgamanaṃ mama ।। 254 ।। tvayā sahāpi golokaṃ gopairgopībhireva ca ।। mama nārāyaṇāṃśasya vāṇyā ca padmayā saha ।। 255 ।। vaikuṃṭhagamanaṃ rādhe nityasya paramātmanaḥ ।। śvetadvīpaṃ dharmagehamaṃśānāṃ ca bhaviṣyati ।। 256 ।। devānāṃ caiva devīnāmaṃśā yāsyaṃti svakṣayam ।। punaḥ saṃsthitiratraiva goloke me tvayā saha ।। 257 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca śubhāśubham ।। mayā nirūpitaṃ yattatkāṃte kena nivāryate ।। 258 ।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi ।। tasthau tasthuḥ surāḥ sarve surapatnyaśca vismitāḥ ।। 259 ।। uvāca śrīharirdevāndevīṃ ca samayocitam ।। devā gacchata kāryārthaṃ svālayaṃ viṣayocitam ।। 260 ।। gaccha pārvati kailāsaṃ sutābhyāṃ svāmi nā saha ।। mayā niyojitaṃ karma sarvaṃ kāle bhaviṣyati ।। 261 ।। bhavitā kalayā janma sarveṣāṃ ca vrajeśvari ।। kṣudrāṇāṃ caiva mahatāṃ devaṃ laṃbodaraṃ vinā ।। 262 ।। praṇamya śrīhariṃ devāḥ svālayaṃ prayayurmudā ।। lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ bhaktyā praṇamya puruṣottamam ।। 263 ।। hariṇā yojitaṃ karma kartuṃ vyagrā mahīṃ yayuḥ ।। bhartrā nirūpitaṃ sthānaṃ devānāmapi durlabham ।। 264 ।। uvāca rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇo vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ vraja ।। gopagopīsamūhaiśca saha pūrvanirūpitaiḥ ।। 265 ।। ahaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ vasudevālayaṃ priye ।। paścātkaṃsabhaya vyājādgokulaṃ tava sannidhim ।। 266 ।। rādhā praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ raktapaṃkajalocanā ।। bhṛśaṃ ruroda purataḥ premavicchedakātarā ।। 267 ।। sthāyaṃsthāyaṃ kvacidyāṃtī gatvāgatvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। punaḥ punaḥ samāgatya darśaṃdarśaṃ harermukham ।। 268 ।। papau cakṣuścakorābhyāṃ nimeṣarahitā satī ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhasudhāpūrṇaṃ prabhormukham ।। 269 ।। tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saptadhā parameśvarī ।। praṇamya saptadhā caiva punastasthau hareḥ puraḥ ।। 270 ।। ājagmurgopikānāṃ ca triḥsaptaśatakoṭayaḥ ।। ājagāma ca gopānāṃ samūhaḥ koṭisaṃkhyakaḥ ।। 271 ।। gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca samūhaiḥ saha rādhikā ।। punaḥ praṇamya taṃ rādhā tatra tasthau ca nārada ।। 272 ।। trayastriṃśadvayasyābhirgopībhiḥ saha suṃdarī ।। gopānāṃ ca samūhaiśca praṇamya prayayau mahīm ।। 273 ।। hariṇā yojitaṃ sthānaṃ prajagmurnaṃdagokulam ।। vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ rādhā gopīgopagṛhaṃ yayau ।। 274 ।। mahīṃ gatāyāṃ rādhāyāṃ gopībhiḥ saha gopakaiḥ ।। babhūva śrīhariḥ sadyaḥ pṛthivīṃ gamanotsukaḥ ।। 275 ।। saṃbhāṣya gopāngopīśca niyojya svīyakarmaṇi ।। manoyāyī jagannātho jagāma mathurāṃ hariḥ ।। 276 ।। pūrvaṃ yadyadapatyaṃ ca devakīvasudevayoḥ ।। babhūva sadyastatkaṃsaḥ putraṣaṭkaṃ jaghāna ha ।। 277 ।। śeṣāṃśaṃ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ māyayā''kṛṣya gokule ।। nidhāya rohiṇīgarbhe jagāma cājñayā hareḥ ।।278।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ।। 6 ।।
<4.7> nārada uvāca ।। ।। tasyātirekaṃ kṛṣṇasya mahatpuṇyakaraṃ param ।। vada janma mahābhāga janmamṛtyujarāpaham ।। 1 ।। vasudevaḥ kasya putraḥ kasya kanyā ca devakī ।। ko vasurdevakī kā vā vivāhaṃ cobhayorvada ।। 2 ।। kathaṃ jaghāna kaṃsastatputraṣaṭkaṃ ca dāruṇaḥ ।। kasmindine harerjanma śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।। 3 ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। kaśyapo vasudevaśca devamātā ca devakī ।। pūrvapuṇyaphalenaiva prāpatuḥ śrīhariṃ sutam ।। 4 ।। devamīḍhānmāriṣāyāṃ vasudevo mahānabhūt ।। yasyodbhave devasaṃgho vādayāmāsa duṃdubhim ।। 5 ।। ānakaṃ ca mahāhṛṣṭāḥ śrīharerjanakaṃ ca tam ।। saṃtaḥ purātanāstena vadaṃtyānakaduṃdubhim ।। 6 ।। āhukasya sutaḥ śrīmānyaduvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। devako jñānasiṃdhuśca tasya kanyā ca devakī ।। 7 ।। gargo yadukulācāryaḥ saṃbaṃdhaṃ vasunā saha ।। devakyāḥ kārayāmāsa vidhivacca yathoditam ।। 8 ।। mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro vasudevaḥ śubhe kṣaṇe ।। udvāhe devakīṃ tasmai devakaḥ pradadau kila ।। 9 ।। aśvānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi gajānāṃ ca śatāni ca ।। sālaṃkṛtānāṃ dāsīnāṃ śatāni suṃdarāṇi ca ।। 10 ।। nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ।। maṇiśreṣṭhāni vajrāṇi svarṇapātrāṇi nārada ।। 11 ।। sadratnabhūṣitāṃ kanyāṃ śatacaṃdrasamaprabhām ।। trailokyamohinīṃ dhanyāṃ mānyāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ca yoṣitām ।। 12 ।। rūpādhārāṃ guṇādhārāṃ susmitāṃ vakralocanām ।। navasaṃgamayogyāṃ ca prodbhinnanavayauvanām ।। 13 ।। tāṃ gṛhītvā rathe kṛtvā prasthānasamaye tadā ।। kaṃso hṛṣṭaḥ sahacaro bhaginyudvāhakarmaṇi ।।14।। tasyā rathasamīpasthe kaṃse gacchati tatkṣaṇe ।। kaṃsaṃ saṃbodhya gagane vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।।15।। kathaṃ hṛṣṭo'si rājeṃdra śṛṇu satyaṃ vaco hitam ।। devakyā hyaṣṭamo garbho mṛtyuhetustavaiva hi ।। 16 ।। śrutvaivaṃ devakīṃ kaṃsaḥ khaḍgahasto mahābalaḥ ।। devavākyādbhayātkrodhātpāpiṣṭho haṃtumudyataḥ ।। 17 ।। tāṃ haṃtumudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā vasudevaḥ supaṃḍitaḥ ।। bodhayāmāsa nītijño nītiśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। 1 ।। vasudeva uvāca ।। rājanītiṃ na jānāsi śṛṇu me vacanaṃ hitam ।। yaśaskaraṃ ca doṣaghnaṃ śāstroktaṃ samayocitam ।। 19 ।। asyā evāṣṭamo garbho mṛtyuścettava bhūmipa ।। imāṃ ca hatvā duṣkīrtiṃ karoṣi tvaṃ naraḥ katham ।। 20।। vadhe ca kṣudrajaṃtūnāṃ hiṃsakānāṃ ca paṃḍitaḥ ।। kārṣāpaṇaṃ samutsṛjya mṛtyukāle pramucyate ।। 21 ।। ahiṃsakānāṃ kṣudrāṇāṃ vadhaḥ śataguṇaṃ dhruvam ।। prāyaścittaṃ mṛtyukāle kathitaṃ padmayoninā ।। 22 ।। vadhe viśiṣṭajaṃtūnāṃ paśvādīnāṃ ca kāmataḥ ।। tataḥ śataguṇaṃ pāpaṃ niścitaṃ manurabravīt ।।23 ।। narāṇāṃ mlecchajātīnāṃ vadhe śataguṇaṃ tataḥ ।। mlecchānāṃ ca śatānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ labhate vadhe ।। 24 ।। sacchūdraikasya ca vadhe tatpāpaṃ labhate pumān ।। sacchūdrāṇāṃ śatānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ labhate vadhe ।। 25 ।। tatpāpaṃ labhate nūnaṃ govadhaikena niścitam ।। gavāṃ daśaguṇaṃ pāpaṃ brāhmaṇasya vadhe bhavet ।। 26 ।। viprahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ strīvadhe labhate naraḥ ।। viśeṣato hi bhaginī poṣyā ca śaraṇāgatā ।। 27 ।। strīhatyāśatapāpaṃ ca bhavedasyā vadhe nṛpa ।। tapo japaṃ ca dānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ tīrthadarśanam ।।28।। viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ homaṃ svargārthaṃ kurute budhaḥ ।। jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ svapnatulyasamaṃ bhavam ।।29।। paśyaṃti satataṃ saṃto dharmaṃ kurvaṃti yatnataḥ ।। bhaginīṃ tyaja dharmiṣṭha svavaṃśāparabhāskara ।। 30 ।। budhāḥ katividhāḥ saṃti sabhāyāṃ pṛcchatāṃ nṛpa ।। asyāścaivāṣṭamo garbho yadapatyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 31 ।। baṃdho tubhyaṃ pradāsyāmi tena me kiṃ prayojanam ।। athavā yānyapatyāni bhavaṃti jñānināṃ vara ।।32 ।। tāni sarvāṇi dāsyāmi tvattaḥ ko me varaḥ priyaḥ ।। bhaginīṃ tyaja rājeṃdra kanyātulyāṃ priyāṃ tava ।। 33 ।। miṣṭānnapānadānena vardhitā manujāṃ sadā ।। vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā tatyāja bhaginīṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 34 ।। vasudevaḥ priyāṃ nītvā jagāma nijamaṃdire ।। kramādapatyaṣaṭkaṃ ca yadyadbhūtaṃ ca nārada ।। 35 ।। dadau tasmai vasuḥ satyātsa jaghāna krameṇa tān ।। devakyāḥ saptame garbhe kaṃso rakṣāṃ dadau bhiyā ।। ।। 36 ।। rohiṇījaṭhare māyā tamākṛṣya rarakṣa ca ।। rakṣakāḥ kathayāmāsurgarbhasrāvo babhūva ha ।। 37 ।। tasmādbabhūva bhagavānātmā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। tasyā evāṣṭamo garbho vāyupūrṇo babhūva ha ।। 38 ।। gate ca navame māsi daśame samupasthite ।। dṛṣṭiṃ dadau ca garbhe ca bhagavānsarvadarśanaḥ ।। 39 ।। svayaṃ rūpavatī devī sarvāsāṃ yoṣitāṃ varā ।। babhūva darśanātsadyaḥ suṃdarī sā caturguṇā ।। 40 ।। dadarśa devakīṃ kaṃsaḥ praphullavadanekṣaṇām ।। tejasā prajvalaṃtīṃ ca māyāmiva diśo daśa ।। 41 ।। jyotiṣāṃ saṃhatiṃ caiva yathā mūrtimatīmiva ।। dṛṣṭvā tāmasureṃdraśca vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau ।। 42 ।। asmādgarbhādapatyaṃ ca mṛtyubījaṃ mamaiva ca ।। ityevamuktvā kaṃsaśca dadau rakṣāṃ prayatnataḥ ।। devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca saptadvāraṃ rarakṣa ca ।। 43 ।। pūrṇe ca daśame māse garbhaḥ pūrṇo babhūva ha ।। babhūva sā calaspaṃdā jaḍarūpā ca nārada ।। 44 ।। garbhaṃ ca vāyunā pūrṇe nirlipto bhagavānajit ।। hṛtpadmakośe devakyā adhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 45 ।। sā viśvaṃbharagarbhā ca maṃdirābhyaṃtare satī ।। uvāsa jaḍarūpā ca kleśayuktā babhūva ha ।। 46 ।। uvāsa ca kṣaṇaṃ devī kṣaṇamutthāya tiṣṭhati ।। kṣaṇaṃ vrajati pādaikaṃ kṣaṇaṃ svapiti tatra vai ।। 47 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca devakīṃ śīghraṃ vasudevo mahāmanāḥ ।। prasūtisamayaṃ jñātvā sasmāra harimīśvaram ।। 48 ।। ratnapradīpasaṃyukte maṃdire sumanohare ।। sthāpayāmāsa khaḍgaṃ ca lohaṃ toyaṃ hutāśanam ।। 49 ।। maṃtrajñaṃ ca naraṃ caiva baṃdhupatnīrbhayākulaḥ ।। vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva trasto baṃdhūṃśca sādaram ।। 50 ।। etasminnaṃtare tasyā rātrerdvau praharau gatau।। vyāptaṃ ca gaganaṃ meghaiḥ kṣaṇadyutisamanvitaiḥ ।। 51 ।। vavuśca vāyavaśceṣṭā yayurnidrāṃ ca rakṣakāḥ ।। aceṣṭitāśca śayane mṛtā iva vicetanāḥ ।।52।। etasminnaṃtare tatra cājagmustridaśeśvarāḥ ।। tuṣṭuvurdharmabrahmeśā garbhasthaṃ parameśvaram ।। 53 ।। ।। devā ūcuḥ ।। ।। jagadyonirayonistvamanaṃto 'vyaya eva ca ।। jyotiḥsvarūpo hyanaghaḥ saguṇo nirguṇo mahān ।। 54 ।। bhaktānurodhātsākāro nirākāro niraṃkuśaḥ ।। nirvyūho nikhilādhāro niḥśaṃko nirupadravaḥ ।। 55 ।। nirupādhiśca nirlipto nirīho nidhanāṃtakaḥ ।। svātmārāmaḥ pūrṇakāmo'nimiṣo nitya eva ca ।। 56 ।। svecchāmayaḥ sarvahetuḥ sarvaḥ sarvaguṇāśrayaḥ ।। sukhado duḥkhado durgo durjanāṃtaka eva ca ।। 57 ।। subhago durbhago vāggmī durārādhyo duratyayaḥ ।। vedahetuśca vedāśca vedāṃgo vedavidvibhuḥ ।। 58 ।। ityevamuktvā devāśca praṇemuśca muhurmuhuḥ ।। harṣāśrulocanāḥ sarve vavṛṣuḥ kusumāni ca ।। 59 ।। dvicatvāriṃśannāmāni prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet ।। dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalam ।। 60 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte brahmādikṛtaśrīkṛṣṇastotram ।। ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā devāste svālayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 61 ।। babhūva jalavṛṣṭiśca niśceṣṭā mathurāpurī ।। ghorāṃdhakāranibiḍā babhūva yāminī mune ।। 62 ।। gate saptamuhūrte tu cāṣṭame samupasthite ।। vedātiriktadurjñeye sarvotkṛṣṭe śubhe kṣaṇe ।। 63 ।। śubhe grahe dṛṣṭiyukte'pyadṛṣṭe cāśubhagrahe ।। ardharātre samutpanne rohiṇyāmaṣṭamītithau ।। 64 ।। jayaṃtīyogasaṃyuktaṃ cārdhacaṃdrodaye mune ।। dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ lagnaṃ bhītāḥ sūryādayastadā ।। 65 ।। gagane kramamullaṃghya jagmurmīnaṃ śubhāvahāḥ ।। suprasannā grahāḥ sarve babhūvustatra saṃsthitāḥ ।।66।। ekādaśāste prītyā ca muhūrtaṃ dhāturājñayā ।। vavarṣuśca jaladharā vavurvātāḥ suśītalāḥ ।।67।। suprasannā ca pṛthivī prasannāśca diśo daśa ।। ṛṣayo manavaścaiva yakṣagaṃdharvakinnarāḥ ।। 68 ।। devā devyaśca muditā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।। jagurgaṃdharvapatayo vidyādharyaśca nārada ।।69।। sukhena susruvurnadyo jajvaluścāgnayo mudā ।। nedurduṃdubhayo nāke cānakāśca manoharāḥ ।। 70 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mahāvṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। jagāma sūtikāgehaṃ nārīrūpaṃ vidhāya bhūḥ ।। 71 ।। jayaśabdaḥ śaṃkhaśabdo hariśabdo babhūva ha ।। etasminnaṃtare tatra papāta devakī satī ।। 72 ।। niḥsasāra ca vāyuśca devakījaṭharāttataḥ ।। tatraiva bhagavānkṛṣṇo divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 73 ।। hṛtpadmakośāddevakyā harirāvirbabhūva ha ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śarīraṃ sumanoharam ।। 74 ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sphuranmukuṭakuṇḍalam ।। īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।।79।। maṇiratneṃdrasārāṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitam।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā ।। 76 ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitam ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ biṃbādharamanoharam ।। 77 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca sadrannamukuṭojjvalam ।। tribhaṃgavakramadhyaṃ ca vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 78 ।। śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ cāru kaustubhena virājitam ।। kiśoravayasaṃ śāṃtaṃ kāntaṃ brahmeśayoḥ param ।। 79 ।। dadarśa vasudevaśca devakīpurato mune।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau ।। 80 ।। kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। sāśrupūrṇaḥ sapulako devakyā ca striyā saha ।। 81 ।। ।। vasudeva uvāca ।। ।। tvāmatīṃdriyamavyaktamakṣaraṃ nirguṇaṃ vibhum ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 82 ।। svecchāmayaṃ sarvarūpaṃ svecchārūpadharaṃ param ।। nirliptaṃ paramaṃ brahma bījarūpaṃ sanātanam।। 63 ।। sthūlātsthūlataraṃ vyāptamatisūkṣmamadarśanam ।। sthitaṃ sarvaśarīreṣu sākṣirūpamadṛśyakam ।। 84 ।। śarīravaṃtaṃ saguṇamaśarīraṃ guṇotkaram ।। prakṛtiṃ prakṛtīśaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ prakṛteḥ param।।85 ।। sarveśaṃ sarvarūpaṃ ca sarvāṃtakaramavyayam ।। sarvādhāraṃ nirādhāraṃ nirvyūhaṃ staumi kiṃ vibhum ।। 86 ।। anaṃtaḥ stavane'śakto'śaktā devī sarasvatī ।। yaṃ vā stotumaśaktaśca paṃcavaktraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ ।। 87 ।। caturmukho vedakartā yaṃ stotumakṣamaḥ sadā ।। gaṇeśo na samarthaśca yogīṃdrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 88 ।। ṛṣayo devatāścaiva munīṃdramanumānavāḥ ।। svapne teṣāmadṛśyaṃ ca tvāmeva kiṃ stuvaṃti te ।। 89 ।। śrutayaḥ stavane'śaktāḥ kiṃ stuvaṃti vipaścitaḥ ।। vihāyaiva śarīraṃ ca bālo bhavitumarhasi ।। 90 ।। vasudevakṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। bhaktiṃ dāsyamavāpnoti śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbuje ।। 91 ।। viśiṣṭaputraṃ labhate haridāsaṃ guṇānvitam ।। saṃkaṭaṃ nistarettūrṇaṃ śatrubhītyā pramucyate ।। 92 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte vasudevakṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotram ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā tamuvāca hariḥ svayam ।। prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānbhaktānugrahakātaraḥ ।। 93 ।। ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ।। tapasāṃ ca phalenaiva putro'haṃ tava sāṃpratam ।। varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 94 ।। purā tapasvināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ sutapāstvaṃ prajāpatiḥ ।। patnī te pṛśnināmnī ca tapasā''rādhitastvayā ।। 95 ।। putro matsadṛśastatra dṛṣṭvā māṃ ca vṛto budhaḥ ।। mayā datto varastubhyaṃ matsamo bhavitā sutaḥ ।। 96 ।। dattvā tubhyaṃ varaṃ tāta manasā''locya ciṃtitaḥ ।। matsamo nāsti bhuvane putro'haṃ tena hetunā ।। 97 ।। tapasāṃ ca prabhāveṇa tvameva kaśyapaḥ svayam ।। sutapā devamāteyamaditiśca pativratā ।। 98 ।। adhunā kaśyapāṃśastvaṃ vasudevaḥ pitā mama ।। devakī devamāteyamaditeraṃśasaṃbhavā ।। 99 ।। tvatto'dityāṃ vāmano'haṃ putrasteṃ'śena saṃbhavaḥ ।। adhunā paripūrṇo'haṃ putraste tapasāṃ phalāt ।। 100 ।। māṃ vā tvaṃ putrabhāvena brahmabhāvena vā punaḥ ।। māṃ prāpto'si mahāprājña jīvanmukto bhaviṣyasi ।। 101 ।। yaśodābhavanaṃ śīghraṃ māṃ gṛhītvā vrajaṃ vraja ।। saṃsthāpya tatra māṃ tāta māyāmādāya sthāpaya ।। 102 ।। ityuktvā śrīharistatra bālarūpo babhūva ha ।। nagnaṃ bhūmau śayānaṃ ca dadarśa śyāmalaṃ sutam ।। 103 ।। dṛṣṭvā sa bālakaṃ tatra mohito viṣṇumāyayā ।। kiṃ vā kūṭaṃ ca taṃdrāyāmapūrvaṃ sūtikāgṛham ।। 104 ।। ityuktvā vasudevaśca samālocya striyā saha ।। gṛhītvā bālakaṃ kroḍe jagāma nandagokulam ।। 1 09।। gatvā nandavrajaṃ śīghraṃ viveśa sūtikāgṛham ।। dadarśa śayanāviṣṭāṃ yaśodāṃ nidrayā'nvitām ।। 106 ।। nidrānvitaṃ ca nandaṃ ca sarvaṃ tatra gṛhe sthitam ।। dadarśa bālikāṃ nagnāṃ taptakāṃcanasannibhām ।।1 07।। īṣaddhāsyāṃ prasannāsyāṃ paśyantīṃ gṛhaśekharam ।। tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vasudevaśca vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau ।। 108 ।। saṃsthāpya tatra putraṃ ca kanyāmādāya satvaram ।। jagāma mathurāṃ hṛṣṭaḥ svakāṃtāsūtikāgṛham ।। 109 ।। sthāpayāmāsa tatraiva mahāmāyāṃ ca bālikām ।। rorūyamāṇāṃ tāmeva dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭā ca devakī ।। 110।। rodanenaiva sā bālā bodhayāmāsa rakṣakān ।। utthāya rakṣakāḥ śīghraṃ bālikāṃ jagṛhustadā ।। 111 ।। gṛhītvā bālikāṃ te ca prajagmuḥ kaṃsasannidhim ।। jagāma devakī paścādvasudevaśca śokataḥ ।। 112 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca bālikāṃ kaṃso nātihṛṣṭo mahāmune ।। rorūyamāṇāṃ kalyāṇīṃ taddayā na babhūva ha ।। 113 ।। tāṃ gṛhītvā ca pāṣāṇe hantuṃ yāṃtaṃ sudāruṇam ।। uvāca vasudevaśca devakī paramādaram ।।114।। bhobhoḥ kaṃsa nṛpaśreṣṭha nītiśāstraviśārada ।। nibodha vākyaṃ satyaṃ ca nītiyuktaṃ manoramam ।। 115 ।। hatvā''vayoḥ putraṣaṭkaṃ dayā te nāsti bāṃdhava ।। adhunā cāṣṭame garbhe bālikāmabalāṃ mama ।। 116 ।। hatvā tava kimaiśvaryaṃ bhaviṣyati mahītale ।। strīmeva haṃtumabala kiṃ kṣamā raṇamūrdhani ।। 117 ।। ityevamuktvā taṃ vasurdevakī ca sabhātale ।। ruroda puratastatra kaṃsasya ca durātmanaḥ ।। kaṃsastayorvacaḥ śrutvā tāmuvāca durātmanā ।। 118 ।। ।। kaṃsa uvāca ।। ।। śṛṇu vākyaṃ madīyaṃ ca nibodha bodhayāmi te ।। 119 ।। tṛṇena parvataṃ hantuṃ śakto dhātā ca daivataḥ ।। kīṭena siṃhaśārdūlaṃ maśakena gajaṃ tathā ।। 120 ।। śiśunā ca mahāvīraṃ mahāṃtaṃ kṣudrajantubhiḥ ।। mūṣakena ca mārjāraṃ maṃḍūkena bhujaṃgamam ।। 121 ।। evaṃ janyena janakaṃ bhakṣyeṇaiva ca bhakṣakam ।। vahninā ca jalaṃ naṣṭuṃ vahniṃ śuṣkatṛṇena ca ।। 122 ।। pītāḥ sapta samudrāśca dvijenaikena jantunā ।। dhāturgatirvicitrā tu durjñeyā bhuvanatraye ।। 123 ।। daivena bālikā naṣṭuṃ māṃ samarthā bhaviṣyati ।। bālikāṃ ca vadhiṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।। 124 ।। ityevamuktvā kaṃsaśca gṛhītvā bālikāṃ tadā ।। haṃtumārabdhavānkaṃsastamuvāca vasustadā ।। 125 ।। vṛthā hiṃsitavānrājandehi bālāṃ kṛpānidhe ।। sa tacchrutvā vicārajñaḥ kaṃsastuṣṭo mahāmune ।। 126 ।। saṃbodhayantaṃ tatraiva vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। he kaṃsa haṃsi kāṃ mūḍha na vijñāya harergatim ।। 127 ।। kutracittvannihantā'sti kāle vyakto bhaviṣyati ।। śrutvaiva devavāṇīṃ ca tatyāja bālikāṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 128 ।। vasudevo devakī ca tāmādāya mudā'nvitau ।। jagmatuḥ svagṛhaṃ tau ca kanyāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 129 ।। mṛtāmiva punaḥ prāpya brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam ।। sā parā bhaginī vipra kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 130 ।। ekānaṃśeti vikhyātā pārvatyaṃśasamudbhavā ।। vasustāṃ dvārakāyāṃ tu rukmiṇyudvāhakarmaṇi ।। 131 ।। dadau durvāsase bhaktyā śaṃkarāṃśāya bhaktitaḥ ।। evaṃ nigaditaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇajanmānukīrtanam ।। janmamṛtyujarātighnaṃ sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ mune ।। 132 ।। ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe kṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 7 ।।
<4.8> ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। janmāṣṭamīvrataṃ brūhi vratānāṃ vratamuttamam ।। phalaṃ jayaṃtīyogasya sāmānyenaiva sāṃpratam ।। 1 ।। ko vā doṣo'pyakaraṇe bhojano vā mahāmune ।। upavāsaphalaṃ kiṃ vā jayaṃtyāṃ ca susaṃmatam ।। 2 ।। vrataṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca saṃyamasya ca sāṃpratam ।। upavāsapāraṇayoḥ suvicārya vada prabho ।। 3 ।। ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ saptamyāṃ saṃyataḥ pāraṇe tathā ।। aruṇodayavelāyāṃ samutthāya pare'hani ।। 4 ।। prātaḥkṛtya saṃvidhāya snātvā saṃkalpamācaret ।। vratopavāsayorbrahmañchrīkṛṣṇaprītihetukam ।। 5 ।। manvādidivase prāpte yatphalaṃ snānapūjanaiḥ ।। phalaṃ bhādrapade'ṣṭamyāṃ bhavetkoṭiguṇaṃ dvija ।। 6 ।। tasyāṃ tithau vārimātraṃ pitṝṇāṃ yaḥ prayacchati ।। gayāśrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena śatābdaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 7 ।। snātvā nityakriyāṃ kṛtvā nirmāya sūtikāgṛham ।। lohakhaṃḍavahnijālairyuktaṃ rakṣakasaṃghakaiḥ।। ।। 8 ।। tatra dravyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ nābhicchedanakartanam ।। dhātrīsvarūpāṃ nārīṃ ca yatnataḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ ।। 9 ।। pūjādravyāṇi cārūṇi sopacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।। phalānyaṣṭau ca miṣṭāni dravyāṇyeva hi nārada ।। 10 ।। jātīphalaṃ ca kaṃkolaṃ dāḍimaṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā ।। nārikeraṃ ca jaṃbīraṃ kūṣmāṃḍaṃ ca suvāsasam ।। 11 ।। āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathaiva ca ।। arghyamācanīyaṃ ca snānīyaṃ śayanaṃ tathā ।।12 ।। gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāṃbūlamanulepanam ।। dhūpadīpau bhūṣaṇaṃ vai copacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। 13 ।। pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। ācamya cāsane sthitvā svastivācanapūrvakam ।। 14 ।। ghaṭasyāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya paṃca devatāḥ ।। ghaṭe hyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram ।। 15 ।। vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca yaśodāṃ naṃdameva ca ।। rohiṇīṃ baladevaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhīdevīṃ vasuṃdharām ।। 16 ।। rohiṇīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva aṣṭamīṃ sthānadevatām ।। aśvatthāmnā saha baliṃ hanumaṃtaṃ vibhīṣaṇam ।। 17 ।। kṛpaṃ paraśurāmaṃ ca vedavyāsaṃ mṛkaṃḍakam ।। sarvasyāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ kuryāddharestadā ।। 16 ।। puṣpakaṃ mastake nyasya punardhyāyedvicakṣaṇaḥ ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi nārada ।। 19 ।। brahmaṇā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ kumārāya mahātmane ।। 20 ।। bālaṃ nīlāṃbujābhamatiśayaruciraṃ smeravaktrāṃbujaṃ taṃ brahmeśānaṃtadharmaiḥ katikatidivasaiḥ stūyamānaṃ paraṃ yat ।। dhyānāsādhyamṛṣīndrairmunigaṇamanujaiḥ siddhasaṃghairasādhyaṃ yogīṃdrāṇāmaciṃtyamatiśayamatulaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ bhaje'ham ।। 21 ।। dhyātvā puṣpaṃ ca dattvā ca tatsarvaṃ ca nivedayet ।। evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kuryācchṛṇu maṃtrakramaṃ mune ।। 22 ।। āsanaṃ sarvaśobhāḍhyaṃ sadratnamaṇinirmitam।। vicitraṃ ca vicitreṇa gṛhyatāṃ śobhanaṃ hare ।। 23 ।। vasanaṃ vahniśaucaṃ ca nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। prataptasvarṇakhacitaṃ citritaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 24 ।। pādaprakṣālanārthaṃ ca svarṇapātrasthitaṃ jalam ।। pavitraṃ nirmalaṃ cāru pādyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 25 ।। madhusarpirdadhikṣīraṃ śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ param ।। svarṇapātrasthitaṃ deyaṃ snānārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 26 ।। dūrvākṣataṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ svacchatoyasamanvitam ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīsahitaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 27 ।। susvādu svacchatoyaṃ ca vāsitaṃ gaṃdhavastunā ।। śuddhamācamanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ।। 28 ।। gaṃdhadravyasamāyuktaṃ viṣṇo tailaṃ suvāsitam ।। āmalakyā dravaṃ caiva snānīyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 29 ।। sadratnamaṇisāreṇa racitāṃ sumanoharām ।। chāditāṃ sūkṣmavastreṇa śayyāṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 30 ।। cūrṇaṃ ca vṛkṣabhedānāṃ mūlānāṃ dravasaṃyutam ।। kastūrīdravasaṃyuktaṃ gandhaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 31 ।। puṣpaṃ sugaṃdhiyuktaṃ ca saṃyuktaṃ kuṃkumena ca ।। supriyaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sāṃprataṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 32 ।। gṛhyatāṃ svastikoktaṃ ca miṣṭadravyasamanvitam ।। supakvaphalasaṃyuktaṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 33 ।। laḍḍukaṃ modakaṃ caiva sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ guḍaṃ madhu ।। navoddhṛtaṃ dadhi takraṃ naivedyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। 34 ।। śītalaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ kṣīrasvādusupakvakam ।। tāṃbūlaṃ bhogasāraṃ ca karpūrādisamanvitam ।। 35 ।। bhaktyā niveditamidaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ।। candanāguru kastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutam ।। 36 ।। abīracūrṇaṃ ruciraṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ।। tarubhedarasotkarṣo gaṃdhayukto'gninā saha ।। 37 ।। supriyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ dhūpo'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। ghorāṃdhakāranāśaikahetureva śubhāvahaḥ ।। 38 ।। supradīpo dīptikaro dīpo'yaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। pavitraṃ nirmalaṃ toyaṃ karpūrādisamāyutam ।। 39 ।। jīvanaṃ sarvabījānāṃ pānārthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ hare ।। nānāpuṣpasamāyuktaṃ grathitaṃ sūkṣmataṃtunā ।। 40 ।। śarīrabhūṣaṇavaraṃ mālyaṃ ca pratigṛhyatām ।। dattvā deyāni dravyāṇi pūjopayogitāni ca ।। 41 ।। vratasthānasthitaṃ dravyaṃ haraye deyameva ca ।। phalāni tarubījāni svādūni suṃdarāṇi ca ।। 42 ।। vaṃśavṛddhikarāṇyeva gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ।। āvāhitāṃśca devāṃśca pratyekaṃ pūjayedvratī ।। 43 ।। tānpūjya bhaktibhāvena dadyātpuṣpāṃjalitrayam ।। sunaṃdanaṃdakumudāngopāngopīśca rādhikām ।। 44 ।। gaṇeśaṃ kārttikeyaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ ca śivaṃ śivām ।। lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva dikpālāṃśca grahāṃstathā ।। 45 ।। śeṣaṃ sudarśanaṃ caiva pārṣadapravarāṃstathā।। sampūjya sarvadevāṃśca praṇamya daṃḍavadbhuvi ।। brāhmaṇebhyaśca naivedyaṃ dattvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām ।। 46 ।। kathāṃ ca janmādhyāyoktāṃ śṛṇuyādbhakti bhāvataḥ ।। tadā kuśāsane sthitvā kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī ।। 47 ।। prabhāte cāhnikaṃ kṛtvā saṃpūjya śrīhariṃ mudā ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca kārayeddharikīrtanam ।। 48 ।। ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। vratakālavyavasthāṃ ca vedoktāṃ sarvasaṃmatām ।। vedārthaṃ ca samālocya saṃhitāṃ ca purātanīm ।।49।। upavāse jāgaraṇe vrate kiṃ vā phalaṃ mune ।। kiṃ vā pāpaṃ tatra bhuktvā vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 50 ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। aṣṭamī karkṣasaṃyuktā rātryarthe yadi dṛśyate ।। sa eva mukhyakālaśca tatra jātaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।। 51 ।। jayaṃ puṇyaṃ ca kurute jayaṃtī tena saṃsmṛtā ।। tatropoṣya vrataṃ kṛtvā kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ budhaḥ ।। 52 ।। sarvāpavādaḥ kālo'yaṃ pradhānaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ ।। iti vedavidāṃ vāṇī cetyuktā vedhasā purā ।। 53 ।। tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā yaścopoṣya vrataṃ caret ।। koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 54 ।। varjanīyā prayatnena saptamīsahitāṣṭamī ।। sā sarkṣāpi na kartavyā saptamīsahitāṣṭamī ।। aviddhāyāṃ kaṛkṣāyāṃ jāto devakinaṃdanaḥ ।। 55 ।। vedavedāṃgaguptetiviśiṣṭaṃ maṃgalakṣaṇe ।। vyatīte rohiṇīṛkṣe vratī kuryācca pāraṇām ।। 56 ।। tithyaṃte ca hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā devārcanaṃ vratī। ।। pāraṇaṃ pāvanaṃ puṃsāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।। 57 ।। upavāsāṃgabhūtaṃ ca phaladaṃ siddhikāraṇam ।। sarveṣvevopavāseṣu divā pāraṇamiṣyate ।। 58 ।। anyathā phalahāniḥ syātkṛte dhāraṇapāraṇe।। na rātrau pāraṇaṃ kuryādṛte vai rohiṇīvratāt ।।59।। niśāyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kuryādvarjayitvā mahāniśām ।। pūrvāhṇe pāraṇaṃ śastaṃ kṛtvā viprasurārcanam ।। 60 ।। sarveṣāṃ saṃmataṃ kuryādṛte vai rohiṇī vratam ।। budhasomasamāyuktā jayaṃtī yadi labhyate ।।61।। na kuryādgarbhavāsaṃ ca tatra kṛtvā vrataṃ vratī ।। udaye cāṣṭamī kiṃcinnavamī sakalā yadi ।। 62 ।। bhavedbudheṃdusaṃyuktā prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā ।। apivarṣaśatenāpi labhyate vā na labhyate ।। 63 ।। vrataṃ tatra vratī kuryātpuṃsāṃ koṭiṃ samuddharet ।। nṛṇāṃ vinā vratenāpi bhaktānāṃ hīnasaṃpadām ।। 64 ।। kṛtenaivopavāsena prīto bhavati mādhavaḥ ।। bhaktyā nānopacāreṇa rātrau jāgaraṇena ca ।। 65 ।। phalaṃ dadāti daityārirjayantīvratasaṃbhavam ।। vittaśāṭhyamakurvāṇaḥ samyakphalamavāpnuyāt ।।66।। kurvāṇo vittaśāṭhyaṃ ca labhate sadṛśaṃ phalam ।। aṣṭamyāmatha rohiṇyāṃ na kuryātpāraṇaṃ budhaḥ ।। 67 ।। hanyātpurākṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ copavāsārjitaṃ phalam ।। tithiraṣṭaguṇaṃ haṃti nakṣatraṃ ca caturguṇam ।। 68 ।। tasmātprayatnataḥ kuryāttithibhāṃte ca pāraṇam ।। mahāniśāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tithibhāṃtaṃ yadā bhavet ।। 69 ।। tṛtīye'hni muniśreṣṭha pāraṇaṃ kurute budhaḥ ।। ṣaṇmuhūrte vyatīte tu rātrāveva mahāniśā ।। 70 ।। labhate brahmahatyāṃ ca tatra bhuktvā ca nārada ।। gomāṃsaviṇmūtrasamaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ ca phalaṃ jalam ।। 71 ।। puṃsāmabhakṣyaṃ śuddhānāmodanasya ca kā kathā ।। triyāmāṃ rajanī prāhustyaktvādya ca catuṣṭayam ।। 72 ।। nāḍīnāṃ tadubhe sandhye divasādyaṃtasaṃjñite ।। janmāṣṭamyāṃ ca śuddhāyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ vratam ।। 75 ।। śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। janmāṣṭamyāṃ ca śuddhāyāmupoṣya kevalaṃ naraḥ ।। 74 ।। aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ vinā ।। yadbālye yacca kaumāre yauvane yacca vārdhake ।। 75 ।। saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇajanmadivase yaśca bhuktaṃ narādhamaḥ ।। 76 ।। sa bhavenmātṛgāmī ca brahmahatyāśataṃ labhet ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam ।। 77 ।। anarhaścāśuciḥ śaśvaddaive pitrye ca karmaṇi ।। ante vasetkālasūtre yāvaccaṃdradivākarau ।। 78 ।। kṛmibhiḥ śūlatulyaiśca tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraiśca bhakṣitaḥ ।। pāpī tataḥ samutthāya bhārate janma cellabhet ।। 79 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet ।। gṛdhrakoṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ ।। 80 ।। śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni sṛgālaḥ sapta janma ca ।। saptajanmasu sarpaśca kākaśca saptajanmasu ।। 81 ।। tato bhavennaro mūko galatkuṣṭhī sadāturaḥ ।। tato bhavetpaśughnaśca vyālagrāhī tato bhavet ।। 82 ।। tadaṃte ca bhaveddasyurdharmahīnaśca gṛdhrakaḥ ।। tato bhevatsa rajakastailakārastato bhavet ।। 83 ।। tato bhaveddevalako brāhmaṇaśca sadā'śuciḥ ।। upavāsāsamarthaścedekaṃ vipraṃ ca bhojayet ।। 84 ।। tāvaddhanāni vā dadyādyadbhuktaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet ।। sahasrasaṃmitāṃ devīṃ japedvā prāṇasaṃyamān ।। ।। 85 ।। kuryāddvādaśasaṃkhyākānyathārthaṃ tadvrate naraḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa śrutaṃ yaddharmavaktrataḥ ।। vratopavāsapūjānāṃ vidhānamakṛte ca yat ।। 86 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratapūjopavāsanirūpaṇaṃ nāmā ṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 8 ।।
<4.9> nārada uvāca ।। saṃsthāpya gokule kṛṣṇaṃ yaśodāmaṃdiraṃ vasuḥ ।। jagāma svagṛhaṃ nandaḥ kiṃ cakāra mahāṃ prabhuḥ ।। 1 ।। kiñcakāra haristatra kativarṣasthitiḥ prabhoḥ ।। bālakrīḍanakaṃ tasya varṇaya kramaśo mune ।। 2 ।। purā kṛtā yā pratijñā goloke rādhayā saha ।। tatkṛtaṃ kena vidhinā pratijñāpālanaṃ hareḥ ।। 3 ।। kīdṛgvṛndāvanaṃ nāma maṇḍalaṃ kiṃvidhaṃ vada ।। rāsakrīḍāṃ jalakrīḍāṃ saṃvyasya varṇaya prabho ।। 4 ।। nandastapaḥ kiñcakāra yaśodā cātha rohiṇī ।। hareḥ pūrvaṃ ca halinaḥ kutra janma babhūva ha ।। ।। 5 ।। pīyūṣakhaṃḍamākhyānamapūrvaṃ śrīhareḥ smṛtam ।। viśeṣataḥ kavimukhānnavyaṃ nūnaṃ pade pade ।। 6 ।। svarāsamaṇḍalakrīḍāṃ varṇaya svayameva ca ।। parokṣavarṇanātkāvyaṃ praśastaṃ navyavarṇanam ।।7।। śrīkṛṣṇāṃśo bhavānsākṣādyogīṃdrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। yo yasyāṃśaḥ sa ca janastasyaiva sukhataḥ sukhī ।। 8 ।। tvayaiva varṇitau pādau vilīnau tu yuvāṃ hareḥ ।। sākṣādgolokanāthāṃśastvameva tatsamo mahān ।। 9 ।। ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। brahmeśaśeṣavighneśāḥ kūrmo dharmo'hameva ca ।। naraśca kārttikeyaśca śrīkṛṣṇāṃśā vayaṃ nava ।। 10।। aho golokanāthasya mahimā kena varṇyate ।। yaṃ svayaṃ no vijānīmo na vedāḥ kiṃ vipaścitaḥ ।। 11 ।। sūkaro vāmanaḥ kalkirbauddhaḥ kapilamīnakau ।। ete cāṃśāḥ kalāścānye saṃtyeva katidhā mune ।। 12 ।। kūrmo nṛsiṃho rāmaśca śvetadvīpavirāḍvibhuḥ ।। paripūrṇatamaḥ kṛṣṇo vaikuṇṭhe gokule svayam ।। ।। 13 ।। vaikuṇṭhe kamalākāṃto rūpabhedāccaturbhujaḥ ।। goloke gokule rādhākāṃto'yaṃ dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। 14 ।। asyaiva tejo nityaṃ ca citte kurvaṃti yoginaḥ ।। bhaktāḥ pādāmbujaṃ tejaḥ kutastejasvinaṃ vinā ।। 15 ।। śṛṇu vipra varṇayāmi yaśodānandayostapaḥ ।। rohiṇyāśca yato hetordadṛśuste harermukham ।। 16 ।। vasūnāṃ pravaro nando nāmnā droṇastapodhanaḥ ।। tasya patnī dharā sādhvī yaśodā sā tapasvinī ।।17।। rohiṇī sarpamātā ca kadrūśca sarpakāriṇī ।। eteṣāṃ janmacaritaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te।। 18 ।। ekadā ca dharā droṇau parvate gandhamādane ।। puṇyade bhārate varṣe gautamāśramasannidhau ।। 19 ।। cakratuśca tapastatra varṣāṇāmayutaṃ mune ।। śrīkṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ ca nirjane suprabhātaṭe ।। 20 ।। na dadarśa hariṃ droṇo dharā caiva tapasvinī ।। kṛtvāgnikuṃḍaṃ vairāgyātpraveṣṭuṃ samupasthitau।।21।। tau martukāmau dṛṣṭvā ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। drakṣyathaḥ śrīhariṃ pṛthvyāṃ gokule putrarūpiṇam ।। 22 ।। janmāṃtare vasuśreṣṭha durdarśaṃ yogināṃ vibhum।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca viduṣāṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca vaṃditam ।। 23 ।। śrutvaivaṃ taddharādroṇau jagmatuḥ svālayaṃ sukhāt ।। labdhvā tu bhārate janma dṛṣṭaṃ tābhyāṃ harermukham ।। 24 ।। yaśodānaṃdayorevaṃ kathitaṃ caritaṃ tava ।। sugopyaṃ tridaśānāṃ ca rohiṇīcaritaṃ śṛṇu ।। 25 ।। ekadā devamātā ca puṣpotsavadine satī ।। vijñāpanaṃ caradvārā cakāra kaśyapaṃ mune ।। 26 ।। susnātā suṃdarī devī ratnālaṃkāra bhūṣitā ।। cakāra veṣaṃ vividhaṃ dadarśa darpaṇe mukham ।। 27 ।। kastūrībiṃdunā sārddhaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdusaṃyutam ।। ratnakuṃḍalaśobhāḍhyaṃ patrābharaṇabhūṣitam ।। 28 ।। gajamauktikasaṃyuktaṃ nāsāgraṃ sumanoharam ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanam ।। 29 ।। vakrabhrūbhaṃginā yuktaṃ vicitrakajjalojjvalam ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhadaṃtapaṃktivirājitam ।। 30 ।। pakvabiṃbādharauṣṭhaṃ ca sasmitaṃ suṃdaraṃ sadā ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca munīṃdracittamohanam ।। 31 ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā suṃdarī svagṛhe sthitā ।। paśyaṃtī patimārgaṃ ca kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। 32 ।। śuśrāva vārtāmaditiḥ kaśyapaṃ kadrusaṃyutam ।। ratnasārasamāraṃbhe tasyā vakṣasthale sthitam ।। 33 ।। śrutvā cukopa sādhvī sā hatāśā ratikātarā ।। na śaśāpa patiṃ premṇā śaśāpa sarpamātaram ।। 34 ।। na devālayayogyā sā dharmiṣṭhā dharmanāśinī ।। dūraṃ gacchatu svarlokādātmayoniṃ ca mānavīm ।। 35 ।। śrutvaivaṃ sā caradvārā śaśāpa devamātaram ।। sā caivaṃ mānavīṃ yoniṃ yātu martye jarāyutām ।। 36 ।। kaśyapo bodhayāmāsa kadruṃ ca sarpamātaram ।। kāle yāsyasi martyaṃ ca mayā saha śucismite ।। 37 ।। tyaja bhītiṃ labha sukhaṃ drakṣyasi śrīharermukham।। evamuktvā kaśyapaśca jagāma cāditergṛham ।।38।। vāṃchāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca tasyāśca cakāra bhagavānvibhuḥ ।। ṛtau
