tatra maheṃdraśca babhūva ca surarṣabhaḥ ।।39।। aditirdevakī caiva sarpamātā ca rohiṇī ।। kaśyapo vasudevaśca śrīkṛṣṇajanako mahān ।। 40 ।। rahasyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca sarvaṃ nigaditaṃ mune ।। adhunā baladevasya janmākhyānaṃ mune śṛṇu ।। 41 ।। anaṃtasyāprameyasya sahasraśirasaḥ prabhoḥ ।। rohiṇī vasudevasya bhāryāratnaṃ ca preyasī ।। 42 ।। jagāma gokulaṃ sādhvī vasudevājñayā mune ।। saṃkarṣaṇasya rakṣārthaṃ kaṃsabhītā palāyitā ।। 43 ।। devakyāḥ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ māyā kṛṣṇājñayā tadā ।। rohiṇyā jaṭhare tatra sthāpayāmāsa gokule ।। 44 ।। saṃsthāpya ca tadā garbhaṃ kailāsaṃ sā jagāma ha ।। dināṃtare katipaye rohiṇī naṃdamaṃdire ।। 45 ।। suṣāva putraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ taptaraupyābhamīśvaram ।। īṣaddhāsyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 46 ।। tasyaiva janmamātreṇa devā mumudire tadā ।। svarge duṃdubhayo nedurānakā murajādayaḥ ।। 47 ।। jayaśabdaṃ śaṃkhaśabdaṃ cakrurdevā mudānvitāḥ ।। naṃdo hṛṣṭo brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ dadau ।। 48 ।। ciccheda nāḍīṃ dhātrī ca snāpayāmāsa bālakam ।। jayaśabdaṃ jagurgopyaḥ sarvābha raṇabhūṣitāḥ ।। 49 ।। paraputrotsavaṃ naṃdaścakāra paramādarāt ।। tadā yaśodā gopībhyo brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 50 ।। dhanāni nānāvastūni tailaṃ siṃdūrameva ca ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa yaśodānaṃdayostapaḥ ।। 51 ।। janmākhyānaṃ ca halino rohiṇīcaritaṃ tathā ।। adhunā te vāṃchanīyaṃ naṃdaputrotsavaṃ śṛṇu ।। 52 ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham ।। maṃgalaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jīvanam ।। 53 ।। sarvāśubhavināśaṃ ca bhaktidāsyapradaṃ hareḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vasudevaśca saṃsthāpya naṃdamaṃdire ।। 54 ।। gṛhītvā bālikāṃ hṛṣṭo jagāma nijamaṃdiram ।। kathitaṃ caritaṃ tasyāḥ śrutaṃ saṃmukhato mune ।। 55 ।। adhunā gokule kṛṣṇacaritaṃ śṛṇu maṃgalam ।। vasudeve gṛhaṃ yāte yaśodā naṃda eva ca ।। 56 ।। maṃgale sūtikāgāre jayāgāre jayānvite ।। dadarśa putraṃ bhūmisthaṃ navīnanīradaprabham ।।57।। atīva suṃdaraṃ nagnaṃ paśyaṃtaṃ gṛhaśekharam ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaṃ nīleṃdīvaralocanam ।। 58 ।। rudaṃtaṃ ca hasaṃtaṃ c veṇusaṃsaktavigraham ।। hastadvayaṃ suvinyastaṃ premavaṃtaṃ padāṃbujam ।। 59 ।। dṛṣṭvā naṃdaḥ striyā sārddhaṃ hariṃ hṛṣṭo babhūva ha ।। dhātrī taṃ snāpayāmāsa śītatoyena bālakam ।। 60 ।। ciccheda nāḍīṃ bālasya harṣādgopyo jayaṃ daduḥ ।। ājagmurgopikāḥ sarvā bṛhacchroṇyaścalatkucāḥ ।। 61 ।। bālikāśca vayasyaśca viprapatnyāśca sūtikām ।। āśiṣaṃ yuyujuḥ sarvā dadṛśurbālakaṃ mudā ।। 62 ।। kroḍe cakruḥ praśaṃsaṃtya ūṣustatra ca kāścana ।। naṃdaḥ sacailaḥ snātaśca dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। 63 ।। pāraṃparyavidhiṃ tatra cakāra hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ।। 64 ।। vādyāni vādayāmāsa baṃdibhyaśca dadau dhanam ।। tato naṃdaśca sānaṃdaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam ।। 65 ।। sadratnāni pravālāni hīrakāṇi ca sādaram ।। tilānāṃ parvatānsapta suvarṇaśatakaṃ mune ।। 66 ।। raupyaṃ dhānyācalaṃ vastraṃ gosahasraṃ manoharam ।। dadhi dugdhaṃ śarkarāṃ ca navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu ।। 67 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ sallaḍḍukaughaṃ svādūni modakāni ca ।। bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ vāyuvegāṃsturaṃgamān ।। 68 ।। tāṃbūlāni ca tailāni dattvā hṛṣṭo babhūva ha ।। rakṣituṃ sūtikāgāraṃ yojayāmāsa brāhmaṇān ।। 69 ।। tatra maṃtrajñamanujānsthavirāngopikāgaṇān ।। vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa harernāmaikamaṃgalam ।। 70 ।। bhaktyā ca brāhmaṇadvārā pūjayāmāsa devatāḥ ।। gopālikāśca vṛddhāśca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ ।। 71 ।। sasmitā śīghragāminya ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ।। nānāvidhāśca gaṇakā jyotiḥśāstraviśāradāḥ।। 72 ।। vāksiddhāḥ pustakakarā ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ।। sasmitā viprapatnyaśca vayasyāḥ sthavirā varāḥ ।। 73 ।। bālikā bālakayutā ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ।। tebhyo'pi pradadau ratnaṃ dhanāni vividhāni ca।। 74 ।। varavastrāṇi raupyāṇi gosahasrāṇi sādaram ।। naṃdastebhyo namaskṛtya cakāra vinayaṃ mudā ।। 75 ।। āśiṣaṃ yuyujuḥ sarve dadṛśurbālakaṃ param ।। evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro babhūva vrajapuṃgavaḥ ।।76।। gaṇakaiḥ kārayāmāsa yadbhaviṣyaṃ śubhāśubham ।। evaṃ vavardha bālaśca śuklapakṣe yathā śaśī ।। 77 ।। naṃdālaye halī caiva bhukta mātuḥ payodharam ।। tadā ca rohiṇī hṛṣṭā tatra putrotsave mudā ।।78।। tailasiṃdūratāṃbūlaṃ dhanaṃ tābhyo dadau mune ।। dattvāśiṣaśca śirasi tāśca te svālayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 79 ।। yaśodārohiṇīnaṃdāstasthurgehe mudānvitāḥ ।। 80 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛ ṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde naṃdaputrotsavo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 9 ।।
<4.10> ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। atha kaṃsaḥ sabhāmadhye svarṇasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ ।। śuśrāva vācaṃ gagane sūnṛtāmaśarīriṇīm ।। 1 ।। kiṃ karoṣi mahāmūḍha ciṃtāṃ svaśreyasaḥ kuru ।। jātaḥ kālo dharaṇyāṃ te tiṣṭhopāye narādhipa ।। 2 ।। naṃdāya tanayaṃ dattvā vasudevastavāṃtakam ।। kanyāmādāya tubhyaṃ ca dattvā saṃmāyayā sthitaḥ।।3।। māyāṃśā kanyakeyaṃ ca vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।। tava haṃtā gokule ca varddhate naṃdamaṃdire ।। 4 ।। devakyāḥ saptamo garbho varddhate naṃdamaṃdire ।। devakyāḥ saptamo garbho na susrāvāmṛtaṃ sutam ।। 9 ।। sthāpayāmāsa māyo taṃ rohiṇījaṭhare kila ।। tatra jātaśca śeṣāṃśo baladevo mahābalaḥ ।। 6 ।। gokule tau ca vardhete kālau te naṃdamaṃdire ।। śrutveti vacanaṃ rājā babhūvānamrakaṃdharaḥ ।। 7 ।। ciṃtāmavāpa sahasā tatyājāhāramunmanāḥ ।। pūtanāṃ ca samānīya prāṇebhyaḥ preyasīṃ satīm ।। 8 ।। uvāca bhaginīṃ rājā sabhāmadhye ca nītivit ।। ।।kaṃsa uvāca ।। ।। pūtane gokulaṃ gaccha kāryārthaṃ naṃdamaṃdiram ।। 9 ।। viṣāktaṃ ca stanaṃ kṛtvā śiśave dehi satvaram ।। tvaṃ manoyāyinī vatse māyāśāstraviśāradā ।। 10 ।। māyāmānuṣarūpaṃ ca vidhāya vraja yogini ।। durvāsaso mahāmaṃtraṃ prāpya sarvatragāminī ।। 11 ।। sarvarūpaṃ vidhātuṃ tvaṃ śaktāsi supratiṣṭhite ।। ityuktvā tāṃ mahārājastasthau saṃsadi nārada ।। 12 ।। jagāma pūtanā kaṃsaṃ praṇamya kāmacāriṇī ।। taptakāṃcanavarṇābhā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā ।। 13 ।। bibhratī kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam ।। kastūrībiṃdunā yuktaṃ siṃdūraṃ dadhatī mudā ।। ।। 14 ।। maṃjīraraśanābhyāṃ ca kalaśabdaṃ prakurvatī ।। saṃprāpya goṣṭhaṃ durdarśaṃ naṃdālayamanoharam ।। 15 ।। parikhābhirgabhīrābhirdurlaṃghyābhiśca veṣṭitam ।। racitaṃ prastarairdivyairnirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 16 ।। iṃdranīlairmarakataiḥ padmarāgaiśca bhūṣitam ।। suvarṇakalaśairdivyaiścitritaiḥ śekharojjvalaiḥ ।। 17 ।। prākārairgaganasparśaiścaturdvārasamanvitaiḥ ।। yuktaṃ lohakapāṭaiśca dvārapālasamanvitaiḥ ।। 18 ।। veṣṭitaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ sundarīgaṇaveṣṭitam ।। muktāmāṇikyaparaśaiḥ pūrṇaratnādibhirdhanaiḥ ।। 19 ।। svarṇapātravaṭākīrṇaṃ gavāṃ koṭibhiranvitam।। bharaṇīyaiḥ kiṃkaraiśca gopalakṣaiḥ samanvitam ।। 20 ।। dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraiśca karmavyagraiḥ samanvitam ।। praviveśāśramaṃ sādhvī sasmitā sumanoharā । ।। 21 ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ praviśaṃtīṃ ca gopyo dṛṣṭvānumenire ।। kiṃ vā padmālayā durgā kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgatā ।। 22 ।। praṇemurgopikā gopāḥ papracchuḥ kuśalaṃ ca tām ।। dadau siṃhāsanaṃ pādyaṃ vāsayāmāsa tatra vai ।। 23 ।। papraccha kuśalaṃ sā ca gopānāṃ bālakasya ca ।। uvāsa sasmitā sādhvī pādyaṃ jagrāha sādaram ।। 24 ।। tāmūcurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kā tvamīśvari sāṃpratam ।। vāsaste kutra kiṃ nāma kiṃ vātra karma no vada ।। 25 ।। tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā sāpyuvāca manoharam ।। mathurāvasinī gopī sāṃprataṃ viprakāminī ।। 26 ।। śrutaṃ vācikavaktreṇa tattvaṃ maṃgalasūcakam ।। babhūva sthavire kāle naṃdaputro mahāniti ।। 27 ।। śrutvāgatāhaṃ taṃ draṣṭumāśiṣaṃ kartumīpsitām ।। । putramānaya taṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmi kṛtvā tamāśiṣam ।। 28 ।। brāhmaṇīvacanaṃ śrutvā yaśodā hṛṣṭamānasā ।। praṇamayya sutaṃ kroḍe dadau brāhmaṇayoṣitaḥ ।। 29 ।। kṛtvā kroḍe tu taṃ sādhvī cucuṃba ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। stanaṃ dadau sukhāsīnā hariṃ puṇyavatī satī ।। ।। 30 ।। ahodbhuto'yaṃ bālasta sundaro gopasundari ।। guṇairnārāyaṇasamo bāloyamityuvāca ha ।। 31 ।। kṛṣṇo viṣastanaṃ pītvā jahāsa vakṣasi sthitaḥ ।। tasyāḥ prāṇaiḥ saha papau viṣakṣīraṃ sudhāmiva ।। 32 ।। tatyāja bālakaṃ sādhvī prāṇāṃstyaktvā papāta ha ।। vikṛtākāravadanā cottānavadanā mune ।। 33 ।। sthūladehaṃ parityajya sṛkṣmadehaṃ viveśa sā ।। āruroha rathaṃ śīghraṃ ratnasāravinirmitam ।। 34 ।। pārṣadapravarairdivyairveṣṭitaṃ sumanoharaiḥ ।। śvetacāmaralakṣeṇa śobhitaṃ lakṣadarpaṇaiḥ ।। 35 ।। vahniśaucena vastreṇa sūkṣmeṇa bhūṣitaṃ varam ।। nānācitravicitraiśca sadratnakalaśairyutam ।। 36 ।। suṃdaraṃ śatacakraṃ ca valitaṃ ratnatejasā ।। pārṣadāstāṃ rathe kṛtvā jagmurgolokamuttamam ।। 37 ।। dṛṣṭvā tamadbhutaṃ lokā gopikāścātivismitāḥ ।। kaṃsaḥ śrutvā ca tatsarvaṃ vismitaśca babhūva ha ।। 38 ।। yaśodā bālakaṃ nītvā kroḍe kṛtvā stanaṃ dadau ।। maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa vipradvārā śiśormune ।। 39 ।। dadāha dehaṃ tasyāśca naṃdaḥ sānaṃdarpūvakam ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīsamaṃ saṃprāpya saurabham ।। 40 ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। sā vā kā rākṣasīrūpā kathaṃ puṇyavatī satī ।। kena puṇyena taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāma kṛṣṇamaṃdiram ।। 41 ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। baliyajñe vāmanasya dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ manoharam।। balikanyā ratnamālā putrasnehaṃ cakāra tam ।। 42 ।। manasā mānasaṃ cakre putrasya sadṛśo mama ।। pibedyadi stanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ karomi taṃ ca vakṣasi ।। 43 ।। haristanmānasaṃ jñātvā papau janmāṃtare stanam ।। dadau mātṛgatiṃ tasyai kāmapūraḥ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 44 ।। dattvā viṣastanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūtanā rākṣasī mune ।। bhaktyā mātṛgatiṃ prāpa kaṃ bhajāma vinā harim ।। 45 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra śrīkṛṣṇa guṇakīrtanam ।। padepade sumadhuraṃ pravaraṃ kathayāmi te।।46।। iti śrībra0 ma0 pu0 śrīkṛ0nā0sa0 pūtanāmokṣo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ।।10।।
<4.11> ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā gokule sādhvī yaśodā naṃdagehinī ।। gṛhakarmaṇi saṃsaktā kṛtvā bālaṃ svavakṣasi ।। 1 ।। vātyārūpaṃ tṛṇāvartamāgacchaṃtaṃ ca gokulam ।। śrīharirmanasā jñātvā bhārayukto babhūva ha।। 2 ।। bhārākrāṃtā yaśodā ca tatyāja bālakaṃ tadā ।। śayanaṃ kārayitvā ca jagāma yamunāṃ mune ।। 3 ।। etasminnaṃtare ta vātyārūpadharo'suraḥ ।। ādāya taṃ bhrāmayitvā gatvā ca śatayojanam ।। 4 ।। babhaṃja vṛkṣaśākhāśca hyaṃdhībhūtaṃ ca gokulam ।। cakāra sadyo māyāvī punastatra papāta ha ।। 5 ।। asuro'pi harisparśājjagāma harimaṃdiram ।। suṃdaraṃ rathamāruhya kṛtvā karmakṣayaṃ svakam ।। 6 ।। pāṃḍyadeśodbhavo rājā śāpāddurvāsaso'suraḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇasparśādgolokaṃ sa jagāma ha ।। 7 ।। vātyārūpe gate gopā gopyaśca bhayavihvalāḥ ।। na dṛṣṭvā bālakaṃ tatra śayānaṃ śayane mune।। 8 ।। sarve nijaghnuḥ svaṃ vakṣasthalaṃ śokākulā bhayāt ।। kecinmūrchāmavāpuśca ruruduścāpi kecana ।। 9 ।। anveṣaṇaṃ prakurvaṃto dadṛśurbālakaṃ vraje ।। dhūlidhūsarasarvāṃgaṃ puṣpodyānāṃtarasthitam ।। 10 ।। bāhyaikadeśe sarasastīre nīrasamanvite ।। paśyaṃtaṃ gaganaṃ śaśvadvadaṃtaṃ bhayakātaram ।। 11 ।। gṛhītvā bālakaṃ naṃdaḥ kṛtvā vakṣasi satvaram ।। darśaṃ darśaṃ mukhaṃ tasya ruroda ca śucā'nvitaḥ ।। 12 ।। yaśodā rohiṇī śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ ruroda ca ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi tadvaktraṃ cucuṃba ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 13 ।। maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa snāpayāmāsa bālakam ।। stanaṃ dadau yaśodā ca prasannavadanekṣaṇā ।। 14 ।। ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। kathaṃ śaśāpa durvāsāḥ pāṃḍyadeśodbhavaṃ nṛpam ।। suvicārya vada brahmannitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। 15 ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। pāṃḍyadeśādhipo rājā sahasrākṣaḥ pratāpavān ।। strīsahasraṃ samādāya kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ।। 16 ।। manohare nirjane ca parvate gaṃdhamādane ।। vijahāra nadītīre puṣpodyāne manorame ।। 17 ।। nānāprakāraśṛgāraṃ viparītādikaṃ nṛpaḥ ।। nakhadaṃtakṣatāṃgaṃ ca kāminīnāṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 18 ।। kṛtvā mūrtisahasraṃ ca yogīṃdro nṛpatīśvaraḥ ।। kṛtvā sthalavihāraṃ ca jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha ।। 19 ।। nāryo vivasanāḥ sarvā nagnāśca nṛpayoṣitaḥ ।। vijahruśca puṣpabhadrānadītīre manohare ।। 20 ।। etasminnaṃtare tatra samāyāto mahāmuniḥ ।। śiṣyalakṣaiḥ parivṛto gacchanvai śaṃkaraṃ prati ।। 21 ।। dṛṣṭvā muniṃ mahāmatto nottasthau na nanāma ha ।। vācā hastena rājā ca saṃbhāṣāṃ na cakāra ha ।। 22 ।। dṛṣṭvā cukopa nṛpatiṃ śaśāpa sphuritādharaḥ ।। asuro bhava pāpiṣṭha yogādbhraṣṭo bhuvaṃ vraja ।।23 ।। bhārate lakṣavarṣaṃ ca sthātavyaṃ te narādhama ।। tato haripadasparśādgolokaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam ।। 24 ।। sthānesthāne he mahiṣyo janiṃ labhata bhārate ।। rājeṃdragehe rājeṃdrādbhaviṣyatha manoharāḥ ।। 25 ।। ityuktvā tu munīṃdrastu jagāma śaṃkarālayam ।। hā hā śabdaṃ vicakruśca śiṣyasaṃghāḥ kṛpālavaḥ ।। 26 ।। gate munīṃdre rājeṃdro ruroda ca sarittaṭe ।। rurudū ramaṇīyāśca ramaṇyo virahāturāḥ ।। ।। 27 ।। he nātha ramaṇaśreṣṭhetyuccārya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। tvāṃ vinā vā kva yāsyāmo vayaṃ tvaṃ vā kva yāsyasi।। 28 ।। vayaṃ no vihariṣyāmastvayā sārddhaṃ sunirjane ।। na kariṣyasi rājyaṃ tvaṃ na yāsyāmo gṛhaṃ vayam ।। 29 ।। śaraccaṃdraprabhāmuṣṭaṃ na drakṣyāmo mukhaṃ tava ।। prasāritābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ nānayiṣyāma ityataḥ ।। 30।। ityuktvā ruruduḥ sarvāḥ puraskṛtya narādhipam ।। mūrchāmavāpuścaraṇaṃ dhṛtvā rājñaḥ sarittaṭe ।। 31 ।। rājā'gnikuṇḍamādhāya nārībhiḥ saha nārada ।। smṛtvā haripadāṃbhojaṃ jvaladagniṃ viveśa ha ।।32।। hāhākāraṃ surāḥ sarve vicakrurgagane sthitāḥ।। ityūcurmunayaścaiva daivaṃ ca balavattaram।।33।। sa ca rājā tṛṇāvarto jagāma harimaṃdiram।। mahiṣyo bhārate varṣe lebhire janma vāñchitam ।। 34 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ harermāhātmya muttamam ।। mākṣaṇaṃ nṛpateścaiva munīṃdraśāpahetukam ।। 35 ।। iti śrībra0 ma0 śrīkṛṣṇaja0 nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde tṛṇāvartavadho nāmai kādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 11 ।।
<4.12> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। ekadā maṃdire nandapatnī sā''naṃdapūrvakam ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi goviṃdaṃ kṣudhitaṃ ca stanaṃ dadau ।। 1 ।। etasminnaṃtare gopya ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ।। sthavirāśca vayasyāśca bālikā bālakānvitāḥ ।। 2 ।। atṛptaṃ bālakaṃ śīghraṃ saṃnyasya śayane satī ।। praṇanāma samutthāya karmaṇyautthānike mudā ।। 3 ।। tailasiṃdūratāṃbūlaṃ dadau tābhyo mudā'nvitā।। miṣṭavastūni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca gopikā ।। 4 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇo ruroda kṣudhitastadā ।। prerayitvā sa caraṇaṃ māyeśo māyayā vibhuḥ ।।5।। papāta caraṇaṃ tasya pravīṇe śakaṭe mune ।। viśvaṃbharapadāghātāttacca cūrṇaṃ babhūva ha ।। 6 ।। babhaṃja śakaṭaṃ peturbhagnakāṣṭhāni tatra vai ।। papāta dadhi dugdhaṃ ca navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu ।।7।। dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ gopikāśca dudruvurbālakaṃ bhayāt।। dadṛśurbhagnaśakaṭamiṃdhanābhyaṃtare śiśum।।8।। bhagnabhāṃḍasamūhaṃ ca patitaṃ bahugorasam ।। prerayitvā tu kāṣṭhāni jagrāha bālakaṃ bhiyā ।। 9 ।। māyārakṣitasarvāṃgaṃ ruditaṃ kṣudhitaṃ kṣudhā।। stanaṃ dadau yaśodā taṃ ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ śucā ।। 10 ।। papracchurbālakāngopā babhaṃja śakaṭaṃ katham ।। kiṃciddhetuṃ na paśyāmaḥ sahaseti kimadbhutam ।। 11 ।। ityūcurbālakāḥ sarve gopāḥ śṛṇuta madvacaḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya padāghātādbabhaṃja śakaṭaṃ dhruvam ।।12।। śrutvā tadvacanaṃ gopā gopyaśca jahasurmudā ।। na hi jagmuḥ pratītiṃ ca mithyetyūcurvraje prajāḥ ।। 13 ।। śiśoḥ svastyayanaṃ kāryaṃ cakrurbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ ।। hastaṃ dattvā śiśorgātre papāṭha kavacaṃ dvijaḥ ।। 14 ।। vadāmi tatte viprendra kavacaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam ।। yaddattaṃ māyayā pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṃkaje ।।15।। nidrite jagatīnāthe jale ca jalaśāyini ।। bhītāya stutikartre ca madhukaiṭabhayorbhayāt ।। 16 ।। yoganidrovāca ।। dūrībhūtaṃ kuru bhayaṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ te harau sthite ।। sthitāyāṃ mayi ca brahmansukhī tiṣṭha jagatpate ।।17।। śrīhariḥ pātu te vaktraṃ mastakaṃ madhusūdanaḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇaścakṣuṣī pātu nāsikāṃ rādhikāpatiḥ ।। 18 ।। karṇayugmaṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ ca kapālaṃ pātu mādhavaḥ ।। kapolaṃ pātu govindaḥ keśāṃśca keśavaḥ svayam ।।19।। adharoṣṭhaṃ hṛṣīkeśo daṃtapaṃktiṃ gadāgrajaḥ ।। rāseśvaraśca rasanāṃ tālukaṃ vāmano vibhuḥ ।। 20 ।। vakṣaḥ pātu mukundaśca jaṭharaṃ pātu daityahā ।। janārdanaḥ pātu nābhiṃ pātu viṣṇuśca mehanam ।। 21 ।। nitaṃbayugmaṃ guhyaṃ ca pātu te puruṣottamaḥ ।। jānuyugme jānakīśaḥ pātu te sarvadā vibhuḥ ।। 22 ।। hastayugmaṃ nṛsiṃhaśca pātu sarvatra saṃkaṭe ।। pādayugmaṃ varāhaśca pātu te kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 23 ।। ūrdhvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ pātu hyadhastātkamalāpatiḥ ।। pūrvasyāṃ pātu gopālaḥ pātu vahnau daśāsyahā ।। 24 ।। vanamālī pātu yāmyāṃ vaikuṃṭhaḥ pātu nairṛtau ।। vāruṇyāṃ vāsudevaśca sato rakṣākaraḥ svayam ।। 25 ।। pātu te saṃtatamajo vāyavyāṃ viṣṭaraśravāḥ ।। uttare ca sadā pātu tejasā jalajāsanaḥ ।। 26 ।। aiśānyāmīśvaraḥ pātu pātu sarvatra śatrujit ।। jale sthale cāṃtarikṣe nidrāyāṃ pātu rāghavaḥ ।। 27 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahmankavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। kṛṣṇena kṛpayā dattaṃ smṛtenaiva purā mayā ।। 28 ।। śuṃbhena saha saṃgrāme nirlakṣye ghoradāruṇe ।। gagane sthitayā sadyaḥ prāptimātreṇa so jitaḥ ।। 29 ।। kavacasya prabhāveṇa dharaṇyāṃ patito mṛtaḥ।। pūrvaṃ varṣaśataṃ khe ca kṛtvā yuddhaṃ bhayāvaham ।। 30 ।। mṛte śuṃbhe ca govindaḥ kṛpālurgaganasthitaḥ ।। mālāṃ ca kavacaṃ dattvā golokaṃ sa jagāma ha ।। 31 ।। kalpāṃtarasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kṛpayā kathitaṃ mune ।। abhyaṃtarabhayaṃ nāsti kavacasya prabhāvataḥ ।। 32 ।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo naṣṭā mayā dṛṣṭāśca vedhasaḥ ।। ahaṃ ca hariṇā sārddhaṃ kalpekalpe sthirā sadā ।। 33 ।। ityuktvā kavacaṃ dattvā sā'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। niḥśaṅko nābhikamale tasthau sa kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 34 ।। suvarṇaguṭikāyāṃ ca kṛtvedaṃ kavacaṃ param ।। kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau badhnīyādyaḥ sudhīḥ sadā ।। 35 ।। viṣāgnijalaśatrubhyo bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate ।। jale sthale cāṃtarikṣe nidrāyāṃ rakṣatīśvaraḥ ।। 36 ।। saṃgrāme vajrapāte ca vipattau prāṇasaṃkaṭe ।। kavacasmaraṇādeva sadyo niḥśaṅkatāṃ vrajet ।। 37 ।। baddhvedaṃ kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe śaṃkarastripuraṃ purā ।। jaghāna līlāmātreṇa duraṃtamasureśvaram ।। 38 ।। baddhvedaṃ kavacaṃ kālī raktabījaṃ cakhāda sā ।। sahasraśīrṣā dhṛtvedaṃ viśvaṃ dhatte tilaṃ yathā ।। 39 ।। āvāṃ sanatkumāraśca dharmasākṣī ca karmaṇām ।। kavacasya prabhāveṇa sarvatra jayino vayam ।। 40 ।। tasya nandaśiśoḥ kaṇṭhe cakāra kavacaṃ dvijaḥ ।। ātmanaḥ kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe dadhāra ca svayaṃ hariḥ ।। 41 ।। prabhāvaḥ kathitaḥ sarvaḥ kavacasya harestathā ।। anantasyācyutasyaiva prabhāvamatulaṃ mune ।। 42 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śakaṭabhaṃjanayoganidroktakavacanyāso nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 12 ।।
<4.13> ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। aparaṃ kṛṣṇamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu kiṃcinmahāmune ।। vighnanighnaṃ pāpaharaṃ mahāpuṇyakaraṃ param ।। 1 ।। ekadā nandapatnī ca kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ svavakṣasi ।। svarṇasiṃhāsanasthā ca kṣudhitaṃ taṃ stanaṃ dadau ।। 2 ।। etasminnantare tatra vipreṃdraikaḥ samāgataḥ ।। vṛtaḥ śiṣyasamūhaiśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। 3 ।। prajapanparamaṃ brahma śuddhasphaṭikamālayā ।। daṇḍī chatrī śuklavāsā dantapaṃktivirājitaḥ ।। 4 ।। jyotirgraṃtho mūrtimāṃśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ।। paribibhrajjaṭājālaṃ taptakāṃcanasannibham ।। 5 ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyo gaurāṃgaḥ padmalocanaḥ ।। yogīndro dhūrjaṭeḥ śiṣyaḥ śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ ।। 6 ।। vyākhyāmudrākaraḥ śrīmāñchiṣyānadhyāpayanmudā ।। vedavyākhyāṃ katividhāṃ prakurvanniva līlayā ।। 7 ।। ekībhūya caturvedāstejasā mūrtimāniva।। sākṣātsarasvatīkaṇṭhaḥ siddhāṃtaikaviśāradaḥ ।। 8 ।। dhyānaikaniṣṭhaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapādāṃbhoje divāniśam ।। jīvanmukto hi siddheśaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ ।। 9 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā sā samuttasthau yaśodā praṇanāma ca ।। pādyaṃ gāṃ madhuparkaṃ ca svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau ।। 10 ।। bālakaṃ vaṃdayāmāsa munīndraṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। muniśca manasā cakre praṇāmaśatakaṃ harim ।। 11 ।। āśiṣaṃ pradadau prītyā vedamaṃtropayogikam ।। praṇanāma ca śiṣyāṃśca te tāṃ yuyujurāśiṣam ।।12।। śiṣyānpādyādikaṃ bhaktyā pradadau ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। sāśiṣyāṃghrī ca prakṣālya samuvāsa sukhāsane।।13।। samudyatā sā praṣṭuṃ ca puṭāñjaliyutā satī ।। svakroḍe bālakaṃ kṛtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharā ।। 14 ।। svātmārāmaṃ maṃgalaṃ ca praṣṭuṃ yadyapi na kṣamā ।। tathā'pi bhavato nāma śivaṃ pṛcchāmi sāṃpratam ।। 15 ।। abalā buddhihīnāyā doṣaṃ kṣaṃtuṃ sadā'rhasi ।। mūḍhasya satataṃ doṣaṃ kṣamāṃ kurvaṃti sādhavaḥ ।।16।। aṃgirā vā'tha vā'trirvā marīcirgautamo'tha vā ।। kratuḥ kiṃ vā pracetā vā pulastyaḥ pulaho'thavā ।।17।। durvāsāḥ kardamastvaṃ vā vaśiṣṭho garga eva vā ।। jaigīṣavyo devalo vā kapilo vā svayaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 18 ।। sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanando vā sanātanaḥ ।। voḍhuḥ paṃcaśikho vā tvamāsuriḥ saubhariḥ kimu ।।19।। viśvāmitro'tha vālmāko vāmadevo'tha kaśyapaḥ।। saṃvartaḥ kimutathyo vā kiṃ kaco vā bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 20 ।। bhṛguḥ śukraśca cyavano naranārāyaṇo'thavā ।। sakthinaḥ parāśaro vyāsaḥ śukadevo'tha jaiminiḥ ।। 21 ।। mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanastathā ।। āstīko vā jaratkārurṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṃḍakaḥ ।। 22 ।। paulastyastvamagastyo vā śaradvāngirireva ca ।। śamīko'riṣṭanemiśca māṇḍavyaḥ paila eva ca ।। 23 ।। pāṇinirvā kaṇādo vā śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ।। aṣṭāvakro bhāgurirvā sumanturvatsa eva vā ।। 24 ।। jābālo yājñavalkyaśca vaiśaṃpāyana eva ca ।। yatirhaṃsī pippalādo maitreyaḥ karuṣastathā ।। 25 ।। upamanyurgauramukho'ruṇiraurvo'tha kakṣivān ।। bharadvājo vedaśirā śaṃkukarṇo'tha śaunakaḥ ।। 26 ।। eteṣāṃ puṇyaślokānāṃ ko bhavānvada me prabho ।। pratyuttarārhā nāhaṃ cettathā'pi vaktumarhasi ।। 27 ।। kiṃkaraḥ kiṃkarī vā'pi samarthā prabhumīśvaram ।। yo yasya sevāniyataḥ sa kaṃ pṛcchati taṃ vinā ।। 28 ।। dhanyā'haṃ kṛtakṛtyāhaṃ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ mama ।। tvatpādābjarajaḥsparśājjanmakoṭyaṃhasā kṣayaḥ ।। 29 ।। tvatpādodakasaṃsparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā ।। tavāgamanamātreṇa tīrthībhūto mamāśramaḥ ।। 30 ।। yeye śrutāḥ śrutau brahmañcchrutisārā mahājanāḥ ।। teṣāmeko mayā dṛṣṭaḥ pūrvapuṇyaphalodayāt ।। 31 ।। śiṣyā vedā mūrtimaṃto grīṣma madhyāhnabhāskarāḥ ।। gokulaṃ matkulaṃ sadyaḥ punaṃti pādareṇunā ।। 32 ।। āśiṣaṃ kartumarhaṃti prasannamanasā śiśum ।। pūrṇasvastyayanaṃ sadyo viprāśīrvacanaṃ dhruvam ।। 33 ।। ityevamuktvā naṃdastrī bhaktyā tasthau muneḥ puraḥ ।। naraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa naṃdamānayituṃ satī ।। 34 ।। yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṃgavaḥ ।। jahasuḥ śiṣyasaṃghāśca bhāsayaṃto diśo daśa ।। 35 ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītiyuktaṃ mahatpuṇyakaraṃ param ।। tāmuvāca mudā yuktaḥ śuddhabuddhirmahāmuniḥ ।। 36 ।। śrīgarga uvāca ।। ।। sudhāmayaṃ te vacanaṃ laukikaṃ ca kulocitam ।। yasya yatra kule janma sa eva tādṛśo bhavet ।। 37 ।। sarveṣāṃ gopapadmānāṃ giribhānuśca bhāskaraḥ ।। patnī padmāsamā tasya nāmnā padmāvatī satī ।।38।। tasyāḥ kanyā yaśodā tvaṃ yaśovarddhanakāriṇī ।। ballavānāṃ ca pravaro labdho naṃdaśca vallabhaḥ ।।39।। naṃdo yastvaṃ ca yā bhadre bālo yo yena vā gataḥ।। jānāmi nirjane sarvaṃ vakṣyāmi naṃdasannidhim ।। 40।। gargo'haṃ yaduvaṃśānāṃ cirakālaṃ purohitaḥ ।। prasthāpito'haṃ vasunā nānyasādhye ca karmaṇi ।। 41 ।। etasminnantare naṃdaḥ śrutamātraṃ jagāma ha ।। nanāma daṃḍavadbhūmau mūrdhnā taṃ munipuṃgavam ।। 42 ।। śiṣyānnanāma mūrdhnā ca te taṃ yuyujurāśiṣam।। samutthāyāsanāttūrṇa yaśodānaṃda eva ca ।।43।। gṛhītvā'bhyaṃtaraṃ ramyaṃ jagāma viduṣāṃ varaḥ ।। gargo naṃdo yaśodā ca saputrā sā mudā'nvitā ।। vākyaṃ gargastadovāca nigūḍhaṃ nirjane mune ।। 44 ।। śrīgarga uvāca ।। ayi naṃda pravakṣyāmi vacanaṃ te sukhāvaham ।। prasthāpito'haṃ vasunā yena tacchrūyatāmiti ।।45।। vasunā sūtikāgāre śiśuḥ pratyarpaṇaṃ kṛtaḥ ।। putro'yaṃ vasudevasya jyeṣṭhaśca tasya ca dhruvam ।। 46 ।। kanyā te tena yā nītā mathurāṃ kaṃsabhīruṇā ।। asyānnaprāśanāyāhaṃ nāmānukaraṇāya ca ।। gūḍhena preṣitastena tasyodyogaṃ kuru dvija।।47।। pūrṇabrahmasvarūpo'yaṃ śiśuste māyayā mahīm ।। āgatya bhāraharaṇaṃ kartā dhātrā ca sevitaḥ ।। golokanātho bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāpatiḥ ।। 48 ।। nārāyaṇo yo vaikuṃṭhe kamalākāṃta eva ca ।। śvetadvīpanivāsī yaḥ pitā viṣṇuśca so'pyajaḥ ।। 49 ।। kapilo'nye tadaṃśāśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ rāśirmūrtimānāgataḥ kimu ।। 50 ।। taṃ vasuṃ darśayitvā ca śiśurūpo babhūva ha ।। sāṃprataṃ sūtikāgārādājagāma tavālayam ।। 51 ।। ayonisaṃbhavaścāyamāvirbhūto mahītale ।। vāyupūrṇaṃ mātṛgarbhe kṛtvā ca māyayā hariḥ ।। 52 ।। āvirbhūya vasuṃ mūrtiṃ darśayitvā jagāma ha ।। yugeyuge varṇabhedo nāmabhedo'sya ballava ।।93 ।। śuklaḥ pītastathā rakta idānīṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ ।। śuklavarṇaḥ satyayuge sutīvratejasā vṛtaḥ ।। 54 ।। tretāyāṃ raktavarṇo'yaṃ pīto'yaṃ dvāpare vibhuḥ ।। kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kalau śrīmāṃstejasāṃ rāśireva ca ।।55।। paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma tena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ।। brahmaṇo vācakaḥ ko'yamṛkāro'naṃtavācakaḥ ।। 56 ।। śivasya vācakaḥ ṣaśca nakāro dharmavācakaḥ ।। akāro viṣṇuvacanaḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ ।। 57 ।। naranārāyaṇārthasya visargo vācakaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ rāśiḥ sarvamūrtisvarūpakaḥ ।। 58 ।। sarvādhāraḥ sarvabījastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ।। karmanirmūlavacanaḥ kṛṣirno dāsyavācakaḥ ।। 59 ।। akāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ।। kṛṣirniśceṣṭavacano nakāro bhaktivācakaḥ ।। 60 ।। akāraḥ prāptivacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ।। kṛṣirnirvāṇavacano nakāro mokṣavācakaḥ ।। ।। 61 ।। akāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇa iti smṛtaḥ ।। nāmnāṃ bhagavato naṃda koṭīnāṃ smaraṇena yat ।। 62 ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ kṛṣṇeti smaraṇe naraḥ ।। yadvidhaṃ smaraṇātpuṇyaṃ vacanācchravaṇāttathā ।। 63 ।। koṭijanmāṃhaso nāśo bhavedyatsmaraṇādikāt ।। viṣṇornāmnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam ।। 64 ।। kṛṣṇeti suṃdaraṃ nāma maṃgalaṃ bhaktidāyakam ।। kakāroccāraṇādbhaktaḥ kaivalyaṃ mṛtyujanmaham ।। 69।। ṛkārāddāsyamatulaṃ ṣakārādbhaktimīpsitām ।। nakārātsahavāsaṃ ca tatsamaṃ kālameva ca ।। 66 ।। tatsārūpyaṃ visargācca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। kakāroccāraṇādeva vepaṃte yamakiṃkarāḥ ।।67।। ṛkārokterna tiṣṭhaṃti ṣakārātpātakāni ca ।। nakāroccāraṇādrogā akārānmṛtyureva ca ।। 68 ।। dhruvaṃ sarve palāyaṃte nāmoccāraṇabhīravaḥ ।। smṛtyuktiśravaṇodyogātkṛṣṇanāmno vrajeśvara ।। 69 ।। rathaṃ gṛhītvā dhāvaṃti golokātkṛṣṇakiṃkarāḥ ।। pṛthivyā rajasaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ śaktā vipaścitaḥ ।। 70 ।। nāmnaḥ prabhāvasaṃkhyānaṃ saṃto vaktuṃ na ca kṣamāḥ ।। purā śaṃkaravaktreṇa nāmno'sya mahimā śrutaḥ ।।71 ।। guṇānnāmaprabhāvaṃ ca kiṃcijjānāti madguruḥ ।। brahmā'naṃtaśca dharmaśca surarṣimanumānavāḥ ।। 72 ।। vedāḥ saṃto na jānaṃti mahimnaḥ ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām ।। ityevaṃ kathito naṃda mahimā ca sutasya ca ।।73।। yathāmati yathājñānaṃ guruvaktrādyathā śrutam ।। kṛṣṇaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ kaṃsadhvaṃsī ca viṣṭaraśravāḥ ।। 74 ।। devakīnaṃdanaḥ śrīśo yaśodānaṃdano hariḥ ।। sanātano'cyuto'naṃtaḥ sarveśaḥ sarvarūpadhṛk ।। 75 ।। sarvādhāraḥ sarvagatiḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। rādhābaṃdhū rādhikātmā rādhikājīvanaṃ svayam ।। 76 ।। rādhāprāṇo rādhikeśo rādhikāramaṇaḥ svayam ।। rādhikāsahacārī ca rādhāmānasapūraṇaḥ ।। 77 ।।। rādhādhano rādhikāṃgo rādhikāsaktamānasaḥ ।। rādhikācittacoraśca rādhāprāṇādhikaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 78 ।। paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma goviṃdo garuḍadhvajaḥ ।। nāmānyetāni kṛṣṇasya śrutāni manmukhāddhṛdi ।। 79 ।। janmamṛtyuharāṇyeva rakṣa naṃda śubhekṣaṇa ।। kṛtaṃ nirūpaṇaṃ nāmnāṃ kaniṣṭhasya yathā śrutam ।। 80 ।। jyeṣṭhasya halino nāmnaḥ saṃketaṃ śṛṇu manmukhāt ।। garbhasaṃkarṣaṇādeva nāmnā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 81 ।। nāstyaṃto'syaiva vedeṣu tenānaṃta iti smṛtaḥ ।। baladevo balodrekāddhalī ca haladhāraṇāt।।82 ।। śitivāsā nīlavāsānmusalī musalāyudhāt ।। revatyā saha saṃbhogādrevatīramaṇaḥ svayam ।।83।। rohiṇīgarbhavāsāttu rauhiṇeyo mahāmatiḥ ।। ityevaṃ jyeṣṭhaputrasya śrutaṃ nāma niveditam ।।84।। yāsyāmyahaṃ gṛhaṃ naṃda sukhaṃ tiṣṭha svamaṃdire ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā naṃdaḥ stabdho babhūva ha ।। 85 ।। niśceṣṭā naṃdapatnī ca jahāsa bālakaḥ svayam ।। praṇamyovāca naṃdastaṃ vākyaṃ vinayapūrvakam ।। 86 ।। puṭāṃjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। naṃda uvāca ।। gataścettvaṃ tadā karma kariṣyatyeva ko mahān ।।87।। svayaṃ śubhekṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā kuru nāmnā'nnaprāśanam ।। yannāmaughaśca kathito rādhāprāṇādiko daśa ।। ।। 88 ।। tasyāpi kā vā rādheti kanyakā kasya ca dhruvam।। naṃdasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa munipuṃgavaḥ।। nigūḍhaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ rahasyaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 89 ।। ।। śrīgarga uvāca ।। ।। śṛṇu naṃda pravakṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam ।। 90 ।। purā golokavṛttāṃtaṃ śrutaṃ śaṃkaravaktrataḥ।। śrīdāmno rādhayā sārddhaṃ babhūva kalaho mahān ।। 91 ।। śrīdāmaśāpāddaivena gopī rādhā ca gokule ।। vṛṣabhānusutā sā ca mātā tasyāḥ kalāvatī ।। 92 ।। kṛṣṇasyārddhāṃgasaṃbhūtā nāthasya sadṛśī satī ।। golokavāsinī seyamatra kṛṣṇājñayā'dhunā ।। 93 ।। ayonisaṃbhavā devī mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। māturgarbhaṃ vāyupūrṇaṃ kṛtvā ca māyayā satī ।। 94 ।। vāyuniḥsaraṇe kāle dhṛtvā ca śiśuvigraham ।। āvirbabhūva māyeyaṃ pṛthvyāṃ kṛṣṇopadeśataḥ ।। 95 ।। vardhate sā vraje rādhā śukle caṃdrakalā yathā ।। śrīkṛṣṇatejaso'rddhena sā ca mṛrtimatī satī ।। 96 ।। ekā mūrtirdvidhābhūtā bhedo vede nirūpitaḥ ।। iyaṃ strī sā pumān kiṃvā sā vā kāṃtā pumānayam ।।97।। dve rūpe tejasā tulye rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। parākrameṇa buddhyā vā jñānena saṃpadā'pi ca ।। 98 ।। purato gamanenaiva kiṃtu sāvayasādhikā ।। dhyāyate tāmayaṃ śaśvadimaṃ sā smarati priyam ।। 99 ।। racitā sā'sya prāṇaiśca tatprāṇairmūrtimānayam ।। asya rādhānusāreṇa gokulāgamanaṃ param ।। 100 ।। svīkāraṃ sārthakaṃ kartuṃ gokule yatkṛtaṃ purā ।। kaṃsabhīticchalenaiva gokulāgamanaṃ hareḥ।।101।। pratijñāpālanārthāya bhayeśasya bhayaṃ kutaḥ ।। rādhāśabdasya vyutpattiḥ sāmavede nirūpitā।। 102 ।। nārāyaṇastāmuvāca brahmāṇaṃ nābhipaṃkaje ।। brahmā tāṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaloke ca śaṃkaram ।। 103 ।। purā kailāsaśikhare māmuvāca maheśvaraḥ ।। devānāṃ durlabhāṃ naṃda niśāmaya vadāmi te ।। 104 ।। surāsuramunīṃdrāṇāṃ vāṃchitāṃ muktidāṃ parām ।। repho hi koṭijanmāghaṃ karmabhogaṃ śubhāśubham ।।105।। ākāro garbhavāsaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca rogamutsṛjet ।। dhakāra āyuṣo hānimākāro bhavabaṃdhanam ।। 106 ।। śravaṇasmaraṇoktibhyaḥ praṇaśyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। repho hi niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ dāsyaṃ kṛṣṇapadāṃbuje ।। 107 ।। sarvepsitaṃ sadānaṃdaṃ sarvasiddhaughamīśvaram ।। dhakāraḥ sahavāsaṃ ca tattulyakālameva ca ।। 108 ।। dadāti sārṣṭisārūpyaṃ tattvajñānaṃ hareḥ samam।। ākārastejasāṃ rāśiṃ dānaśaktiṃ harau yathā ।।109।। yogaśaktiṃ yogamatiṃ sarvakālaṃ harismṛtim ।। śrutyuktismaraṇādyogānmohajālaṃ ca kilbiṣam ।। 110 ।। rogaśokamṛtyuyamā vepaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। rādhāmādhavayoḥ kiṃcidvyākhyānaṃ ca yataḥ śrutam ।। 111 ।। taduktaṃ ca yathājñānaṃ sākalyaṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ।। ārād vṛṃdāvane naṃda vivāho bhavitā'nayoḥ ।। 112 ।। purohito jagaddhātā kṛtvā'gniṃ sākṣiṇaṃ mudā ।। kuberaputramokṣaṃ ca gavyasyāhṛtya bhakṣaṇam ।। ।। 113 ।। hiṃsanaṃ dhenukasyaiva kānane tālabhojanam ।। bakakeśipralaṃbānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ cātha līlayā ।। 114 ।। mokṣaṇaṃ dvijapatnīnāṃ miṣṭānnapānabhojanam ।। bhaṃjanaṃ śakrayāgasya śakrādgokularakṣaṇam ।। 115।। gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ vratasaṃpādanaṃ tathā ।। tābhyaḥ punarvastradānaṃ varadānaṃ yathepsitam ।। 116 ।। cetasāṃ haraṇaṃ tāsāmayaṃ vaśyāḥ kariṣyati ।। rāsotsavaṃ mahāramyaṃ sarveṣāṃ harṣavarddhanam ।। 117 ।। pūrṇacandrodaye naktaṃ vasaṃte rāsamaṃḍale ।। gopīnāṃ navasaṃbhogātkṛtvā pūrṇaṃ manoratham ।। 118 ।। tābhiḥ saha jalakrīḍāṃ kariṣyati kutūhalāt ।। vicchedo'sya varṣaśataṃ śrīdāmaśāpahetukam ।। 119 ।। gopālairgopikābhiśca bhavitā rādhayā saha ।। mathurāgamanaṃ tatra gopīnāṃ śokavarddhanam ।। 120।। punaḥ prabodhanaṃ tāsāṃ dānamādhyātmikasya ca ।। syaṃdanākrūrayo rakṣāṃ sadyastābhyāṃ kariṣyati ।।121।। rathamārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā mathurāgamanaṃ punaḥ ।। pitṛbhrātṛvrajaiḥ sārddhaṃ vilaṃghya yamunāṃ vraje ।। 122 ।। akrūrāya jñānadānaṃ darśayitvā svakaṃ jale ।। kautukena ca sāyāhne nagarātsarvadarśanam ।। 123 ।। mālākārataṃtuvāyakubjānāṃ baṃdhamokṣaṇam ।। dhanurbhaṃgaṃ śaṃkarasya yāgasthāna pradarśanam ।। 124 ।। hiṃsanaṃ gajamallānāṃ darśanaṃ nṛpateḥ puraḥ।। kaṃsasya hiṃsanaṃ sadyaḥ pitrornigaḍamokṣaṇam ।। 125 ।। prabodhanaṃ ca yuṣmākamugrasenābhiṣecanam ।। tasyatasya vadhūnāṃ ca jñānācchokāpanodanam ।। 126 ।। bhrātuḥ svasyopanayanaṃ vidyādānaṃ gurormukhāt ।। guruputrapradānaṃ ca punarāgamanaṃ gṛhe ।। 127 ।। chalanaṃ nṛpasainyānāṃ yavanasya durātmanaḥ ।। nirmāṇaṃ dvārakāyāśca mucukuṃdasya mokṣaṇam ।। ।। 128 ।। dvārakāgamanaṃ caiva yādavaiḥ saha kautukāt ।। strīsaṃghānāṃ viharaṇaṃ tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ ca krīḍanam ।। 129 ।। saubhāgyavardhanaṃ tāsāṃ putrapautrādikasya ca ।। maṇisaṃbaṃdhino mithyākalaṃkasya ca mokṣaṇam ।। 130 ।। sāhāyyaṃ pāṃḍavānāṃ ca bhārāvataraṇādikam ।। niṣpannaṃ rājasūyasya dharmaputrasya līlayā ।।131।। pārijātasya haraṇaṃ śakrāhaṃkāramardanam ।। vratapūrṇaṃ ca satyāyā bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam ।। 132 ।। mardanaṃ śivasainyānāṃ harasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ param।। haraṇaṃ bāṇaputryāścaivāniruddhasya mokṣaṇam ।। 133 ।। vārāṇasyāśca dahanaṃ vipradāridryabhaṃjanam ।। vipraputrapradānaṃ ca duṣṭānāṃ damanādikam ।। 134 ।। tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yuṣmābhiḥ saha darśanam ।। kṛtvā ca rādhayā sārdhaṃ vrajamāgamitā punaḥ ।। 135 ।। prasthāpayitvā dvārāṃ ca paraṃ nārāyaṇāṃśakam ।। sarvaṃ niṣpādanaṃ kṛtvā golokaṃ rādhayā saha ।। 136।। gamiṣyatyeva golokaṃ nātho'yaṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ।। nārāyaṇaśca vaikuṃṭhaṃ gamitā sma tvayā saha ।। 137 ।। dharmagehamṛṣī dvau ca viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodameva ca ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ naṃda bhaviṣyaṃ vedanirṇayam ।। 138 ।। śrūyatāṃ sāṃprataṃ karma yadarthaṃ gamanaṃ mama ।। māghaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ kuru karma śubhe kṣaṇe ।। 139 ।। guruvāre ca revatyāṃ viśuddhe caṃdratārake ।। caṃdrasthe mīnalagne ca lagneśapūrṇadarśane ।। 140 ।। vaṇije karaṇotkṛṣṭe śubhayoge manohare ।। sudurlabhe dine tatra sarvotkṛṣṭopayogike ।। 141 ।। ālocya paṃḍitaiḥ sārddhaṃ kuru karma mudā'nvitaḥ ।। ityuktvā bahirāgatya sa uvāca munīśvaraḥ ।। 142 ।। hṛṣṭo naṃdo yaśodā ca karmodyogaṃ cakāra ha ।। etasminnaṃtare draṣṭuṃ gargaṃ gopāśca gopikāḥ ।। 143 ।। bālakā bālikāścaiva ājagmurnaṃdamaṃdiram ।। dadṛśuste muniśreṣṭhaṃ grīṣmamadhyāhnabhāskaram ।। 144 ।। śiṣyasaṃghaiḥ parivṛtaṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā ।। gūḍhayogaṃ pravocaṃtaṃ siddhāya pṛcchate mudā ।। ।। 145 ।। paśyaṃtaṃ sasmitaṃ naṃdabhavanānāṃ paricchadam ।। svarṇasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca yogamudrādharaṃ varam ।। 146 ।। bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca paśyaṃtaṃ jñānacakṣuṣā ।। hṛdīśvaraṃ prapaśyantaṃ siddhaṃ maṃtraprabhāvataḥ ।। 147 ।। bahiryaśodākroḍasthaṃ tādṛśaṃ sasmitaṃ śiśum ।। maheśadattadhyānena yadrūpaṃ ca nirūpitam ।। 148 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītyā pūrṇabhūtamanoratham ।। sāśrunetraṃ pulakitaṃ nimagnaṃ bhaktisāgare ।। 149 ।। hṛdi pūjāṃ praṇāmaṃ ca kurvaṃtaṃ yogacaryayā ।। mūrdhnā praṇemuste taṃ ca sa ca tānāśiṣaṃ dadau ।। 150 ।। āsanastho munistasthau te jagmuḥ svālayaṃ mudā ।। naṃdaḥ svānaṃdayuktaśca baṃdhūnmaṃgalapatrikāḥ ।। 151 ।। prasthāpayāmāsa śīghramārāddūrasthitānmudā ।। dadhikulyāṃ dugdhakulyāṃ ghṛtakulyāṃ prapūritām ।। 152 ।। guḍakulyāṃ tailakulyāṃ madhukulyāṃ ca vistṛtām ।। navanītakulyāṃ pūrṇāṃ ca takrakulyāṃ yadṛcchayā ।। 153 ।। śarkarodakakulyāṃ ca paripūrṇāṃ ca līlayā ।। taṃḍulānāṃ ca śālīnāmuccaiśca śataparvatān ।। 194 ।। pṛthukānāṃ śailaśataṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca sapta ca ।। saptaśailāccharkarāṇāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ ca sapta ca ।। 155 ।। paripakvaphalānāṃ ca tatra ṣoḍaśaparvatān ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ pakvalaḍḍukapiṃḍakān ।। 156 ।। modakānāṃ ca śailaṃ ca svastikānāṃ ca parvatān ।। kapardakānāmatyuccaiḥ śailānsapta ca nārada ।। 197 ।। karpūrādikayuktānāṃ tāṃbūlānāṃ ca maṃdiram ।। vistṛtaṃ dvārahīnaṃ ca vāsitodakasaṃyutam ।। 158 ।। caṃdanāgurukastūrīkaṃkumena samanvitam ।। nānāvidhāni ratnāni svarṇāni vividhāni ca ।। 159 ।। muktāphalāni ramyāṇi pravālāni mudā'nvitaḥ ।। nānāvidhāni cārūṇi vāsāṃsi bhūṣaṇāni ca ।। 160 ।। putrānnaprāśane nandaḥ kārayāmāsa kautukāt ।। saṃskārayuktaṃ ruciraṃ candanadravacarcitam ।। 161 ।। prāṅgaṇaṃ kadalīstambhai rasālanavapallavaiḥ ।। grathitaiḥ sūkṣmavastreṇa veṣṭayāmāsa kautukāt ।। 162 ।। yuktaṃ maṅgalakumbhaiśca phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ ।। candanā'gurukastūrīpuṣpamālāvirājitaiḥ ।। 163 ।। mālyānāṃ varavastrāṇāṃ rāśibhiśca virājitam ।। gavāṃ ca madhuparkāṇāmāsanānāṃ ca nārada ।। 164 ।। phalānāṃ jalakumbhānāṃ samūhaiśca samanvitam ।। nānāprakārairvādyaiśca durlabhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। 165 ।। ḍhakkānāṃ dundubhīnāṃ ca paṭahānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। mṛdaṅgamurajādīnāmānakānāṃ samūhakaiḥ ।। 166 ।। vaṃśīsannahanīkāṃsyaśarayantraiśca śabditam ।। vidyādharīṇāṃ nṛtyena bhṛṅgimābhramaṇena ca ।। 167 ।। gaṃdharvanāyakānāṃ ca saṃgītairmūrcchanāyutaiḥ ।। svarṇasiṃhāsanānāṃ ca rathānāṃ niḥsvanairyutam ।। 168 ।। etasminnantare nandamuvāca vācako mudā ।। ājagmurballavendrāśca bāndhavā ballavāstathā ।। 169 ।। aśvasthāśca gajasthāśca rathasthāśceti satvaram ।। ājagmū rājaputrāśca ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ ।। 170 ।। āgato giribhānuśca sastrīkaśca sakiṅkaraḥ ।। rathānāṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ gajānāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। 171 ।। turaṅgamāṇāṃ koṭiśca śibikānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। ṛṣīndrāṇāṃ munīndrāṇāṃ viprāṇāṃ ca vipaścitām ।। 172 ।। bandināṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca samūhaiśca samīpataḥ ।। gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca saṃkhyā kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। 173 ।। paśyāgatya bahirbhūyetyuvāca prāṅgaṇe sthitaḥ ।। śrutvaivaṃ tānupavrajya samānīya vrajeśvaraḥ ।। 174 ।। prāṅgaṇe vāsayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa satvaram ।। ṛṣyādikasamūhaṃ ca praṇamya śirasā bhuvi ।। pādyādikaṃ ca tebhyaśca pradadau susamāhitaḥ ।। 175 ।। vastubhirbandhubhiḥ pūrṇaṃ babhūva nandagokulam ।। na ko'pi kasya śabdaṃ ca śrotuṃ śaktaśca tatra vai ।।176।। trimuhūrtaṃ kuberaśca śrīkṛṣṇaprītaye mudā ।। cakāra svarṇavṛṣṭyā ca paripūrṇaṃ ca gokulam ।। 177 ।। kautukāpahnavaṃ cakrurbandhuvargāśca krīḍayā ।। ānamrakandharāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā nandasya sampadam।।178।। nandaḥ kṛtāhnikaḥ pūto dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī।। candanāgurukastūrī kuṅkumenaiva bhūṣitaḥ।।179।। uvāsa pādau prakṣālya svarṇapīṭhe manohare ।। gargasya ca munīndrāṇāṃ gṛhītvā''jñāṃ vrajeśvaraḥ ।। 180।। saṃsmṛtya viṣṇumācāṃtaḥ svastivācanapūrvakam ।। kṛtvā karma ca vedoktaṃ bhojayāmāsa bālakam ।। 161 ।। gargavākyānusāreṇa bālakasya mudā'nvitaḥ ।। kṛṣṇeti maṅgalaṃ nāma rarakṣa ca śubhe kṣaṇe ।। 182 ।। saghṛtaṃ bhojayitvā ca kṛtvā nāma jagatpateḥ ।। vādyāni vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam ।। 183 ।। nānāvidhāni svarṇāni dhanāni vividhāni ca ।। bhakṣyadravyāṇi vāsāṃsi brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 184 ।। bandibhyo bhikṣukebhyaśca suvarṇaṃ vipulaṃ dadau ।। bhārākrāntāśca te sarve na śaktā gantumeva ca ।। 185 ।। brāhmaṇānbandhuvargāṃśca bhikṣukāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ।। miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa paripūrṇaṃ manoharam ।। 186 ।। dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ caiva khādyatāṃ khādyatāmiti ।। babhūva śabdo'tyuccaiśca satataṃ nandagokule ।। 187 ।। ratnāni paripūrṇāni vāsāṃsi bhūṣaṇāni ca ।। pravālāni suvarṇāni maṇisārāṇi yāni ca ।। 188 ।। cārūṇi svarṇapātrāṇi kṛtāni viśvakarmaṇā ।। gatvā gargāya vinayaṃ cakāra vrajapuṃgavaḥ ।। 189 ।। śiṣyebhyaḥ svarṇabhārāṇi pradadau vinayānvitaḥ ।। dvijebhyo'pyavaśiṣṭebhyaḥ paripūrṇāni nārada।। 190 ।। ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gṛhītvā śrīhariṃ gargo jagāma nibhṛtaṃ mudā ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā praṇamya ca tamīśvaram ।। 191 ।। sāśrunetraḥ sapulako bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvovāca kṛṣṇapadāṃbuje ।। 192 ।। garga uvāca ।। he kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjana ।। prasanno bhava māmīśa dehi dāsyaṃ padāmbuje ।।193।। tvatpitrā me dhanaṃ dattaṃ tena me kiṃ prayojanam ।। dehi me niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ bhaktānāmabhayaprada ।। 194 ।। aṇimādikasiddhiṣu yogeṣu muktiṣu prabho ।। jñānatattve'maratve vā kiñcinnāsti spṛhā mama ।। 195 ।। indratve vā manutve vā svargalokaphale ciram ।। nāsti me manaso vāñchā tvatpādasevanaṃ vinā ।। 196 ।। sālokyaṃ sārṣṭisārūpye sāmīpyaikatvamīpsitam ।। nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi te brahmaṃstvatpādasevanaṃ vinā ।।197।। goloke vāpi pātāle vāse nāsti manorathaḥ ।। kintu te caraṇāmbhoje santataṃ smṛtirastu me ।।198।। tvanmantraṃ śaṅkarātprāpya katijanmaphalodayāt ।। sarvajño'haṃ sarvadarśī sarvatra gatirastu me ।। 199 ।। kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho dīnabandho padāmbuje ।। rakṣa māmabhayaṃ dattvā mṛtyurme kiṃ kariṣyati ।। ।। 200 ।। sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ sarvastvatpādāmbhojasevayā ।। mṛtyuñjayo'ntakālaśca babhūva yogināṃ guruḥ ।।201।। brahmā vidhātā jagatāṃ tvatpādāmbhojasevayā ।। yasyaikadivase brahmanpatantīndrāścaturdaśa ।।202।। tvatpādasevayā dharmaḥ sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām।। pātā ca phaladātā ca jitvā kālaṃ sudurjayam ।।203।। sahasravadanaḥ śeṣo yatpādāmbujasevayā ।। dhatte siddhārthavadviśvaṃ śivaḥ kaṇṭhe viṣaṃ yathā ।। ।। 204 ।। sarvasaṃpadvidhātrī yā devīnāṃ ca parātparā।। karoti satataṃ lakṣmīḥ keśaistvatpādamārjanam ।।205।। prakṛtirbījarūpā sā sarveṣāṃ śaktirūpiṇī ।। smāraṃsmāraṃ tvatpadābjaṃ babhūva tatparāvarā ।। 206 ।। pārvatī sarvarūpā sā sarveṣāṃ buddhirūpiṇī।। tvatpādasevayā kāntaṃ lalābha śivamīśvaram ।। 207 ।। vidyādhiṣṭhātrī devī yā jñānamātā sarasvatī ।। pūjyā babhūva sarveṣāṃ saṃpūjya tvatpadāmbujam।।208।। sāvitrī vedajananī punāti bhuvanatrayam ।। brahmaṇo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gatistvatpādasevayā ।। 209 ।। kṣamā jagadvibhartuṃ ca ratnagarbhā vasundharā ।। prasūtiḥ sarvasasyānāṃ tvatpādapadmasevayā ।। 210।। rādhā mamāṃśasaṃbhūtā tava tulyā ca tejasā ।। sthitvā vakṣasi te pādaṃ sevate'nyasya kā kathā ।। 211 ।। yathā śarvādayo devā devyaḥ padmādayo yathā ।। sanāthaṃ kuru māmīśa īśvarasya samā kṛpā ।।212।। na yāsyāmi gṛhaṃ nātha na gṛhṇāmi dhanaṃ tava ।। kṛtvā māṃ rakṣa pādābjasevāyāṃ sevakaṃ ratam ।। 213 ।। iti stutvā sāśrunetraḥ papāta caraṇe hareḥ ।। ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ bhaktyā pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ ।। 214 ।। gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। uvāca taṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo mayi te bhaktirastviti ।। 215 ।। idaṃ gargakṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ smṛtiṃ ca labhate dhruvam ।। ।। 216 ।। janmamṛtyujarārogaśokamohādisaṃkaṭāt ।। tīrṇo bhavati śrīkṛṣṇadāsasevanatatparaḥ ।। 217 ।। kṛṣṇasya sahakālaṃ ca kṛṣṇasārddhaṃ ca modate ।। kadācinna bhavettasya vicchedo hariṇā saha ।। 218 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। hariṃ muniḥ stavaṃ kṛtvā dadau nandāya taṃ mudā ।। uvāca taṃ gṛhaṃ yāmi kurvājñāmiti ballava ।।219 ।। aho vicitraṃ saṃsāro mohajālena veṣṭitaḥ ।। saṃmīlanaṃ ca viraho narāṇāṃ sindhuphenavat ।। 220।। gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā ruroda nanda eva ca ।। sadvicchedo hi sādhūnāṃ maraṇādatiricyate।।221।। sarvaśiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ munīndraṃ gantumudyatam ।। sarve nandādayo gopā rudantau gopikāstadā ।। 222 ।। praṇemuḥ paramaprītyā cakrustaṃ vinayaṃ mune ।। dattvā''śiṣaṃ muniśreṣṭho jagāma mathurāṃ mudā ।। 223 ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva bandhuvargāśca ballavāḥ ।। sarve jagmurdhanaiḥ pūrṇāḥ svālayaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।। 224 ।। prajagmurbandinaḥ sarve paripūrṇamanorathāḥ ।। miṣṭadravyāṃśukotkṛṣṭaturagasvarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 225 ।। ākaṇṭhapūrṇā bhuktyā ca bhikṣukā gantumakṣamā।। svarṇavastrabharodrekapariśrāntā mudā'nvitāḥ।।226।। sumandagāminaḥ kecitkecidbhūmau ca śerate।। kecidvartmani tiṣṭhantaścottiṣṭhantaśca kecana ।। 227 ।। kecidūṣuḥ pramuditā hasantastatra kecana ।। kapardakānāṃ vastūnāṃ śeṣāṃścorvaritānbahūn। 228।। kecittānādaduḥ sthitvā darśayantaśca kecana ।। kecinnṛtyaṃ prakurvanto gāyantastatra kecana।।229।। kecidbahuvidhā gāthāḥ kathayantaḥ purātanāḥ ।। maruttaśvetasagaramāṃdhātṝṇāṃ ca bhūbhṛtām ।। 230 ।। uttānapādanahuṣanalādīnāṃ ca yāḥ kathāḥ ।। śrīrāmasyāśvamedhasya rantidevasya karmaṇām ।।231।। yeṣāṃyeṣāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca śrutā vṛddhamukhātkathāḥ।। kathayantaśca tāḥ kecicchrutavantaśca kecana।।232 ।। sthāyaṃsthāyaṃ gatāḥ kecitsvāpaṃsvāpaṃ ca kecana ।। evaṃ sarve pramuditāḥ prajagmuḥ svālayaṃ mudā ।। 233 ।। hṛṣṭo nando yaśodā ca bālaṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi ।। tasthau svamandire ramye kuberabhavanopame।। 234।। evaṃ pravarddhitau bālau śuklacandrakalopamau ।। gavāṃ pucchaṃ ca bhittiṃ ca dhṛtvā cottasthaturmudā।।235।। śabdārddhaṃ vā tadarddhaṃ vā kṣamau vaktuṃ dinedine।। pitrorharṣaṃ ca varddhantau gacchantau prāṅgaṇe mune।।236।। bālo dvipādaṃ pādaṃ vā gantuṃ śakto babhūva ha।। gantuṃ śakto hi jānubhyāṃ prāṅgaṇe vā gṛhe hariḥ ।।237।। varṣādhiko hi vayasā kṛṣṇātsaṃkarṣaṇaḥ svayam ।। tato mudaṃ varddhayantau varddhitau ca dinedine।।238।। vrajantau gokule bālau prahṛṣṭagamane kṣamau ।। uktavantau sphuṭaṃ vākyaṃ māyā bālakavigrahau ।। 239 ।। gargo jagāma mathurāṃ vasudevāśramaṃ mune ।। sa taṃ nanāma papraccha putrayoḥ kuśalaṃ tayoḥ ।। 240 ।। munistaṃ kathayāmāsa kuśalaṃ sumahotsavam ।। ānandāśrunimagnaśca śrutamātrādbabhūva ha ।। 241 ।। devakī paramaprītyā papraccha ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। ānandāśrunimagnā sā ruroda ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 242 ।। gargastāvāśiṣaṃ dattvā jagāma svālayaṃ mudā ।। svagṛhe tasthatustau ca kuberabhavanopame ।। 243 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। yatra kalpe kathā ceyaṃ tatra tvamupabarhaṇaḥ ।। pañcāśatkāminīnāṃ ca patirgandharvapuṅgavaḥ ।। 244 ।। tāsāṃ prāṇādhikastvaṃ ca śṛṅgāranipuṇo yuvā ।। tato'bhūdbrahmaṇaḥ śāpāddāsīputro dvijasya ca ।। 245 ।। tato'dhunā brahmaputro vaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt ।। sarvadarśī ca sarvajñaḥ smārako harisevayā ।। 246 ।। kathitaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ nāmānnaprāśanādikam ।। janmamṛtyujarātighnamaparaṃ kathāyāmi te ।।247।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde kṛṣṇānnaprāśana varṇananāmakaraṇaprastāvo nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 13 ।।
<4.14> ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā nandapatnī ca snānārthaṃ yamunāṃ yayau ।। gavyapūrṇaṃ gṛhaṃ dṛṣṭvā jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ ।। 1 ।। dadhidugdhājyatakraṃ ca navanītaṃ manoramam ।। gṛhasthitaṃ ca yatkiṃciccakhāda madhusūdanaḥ ।। 2 ।। madhu haiyaṅgavīnaṃ yatsvastikaṃ śakaṭasthitam ।। bhuktvā pītvāṃ'śukairvaktrasaṃskāraṃ kartumudyatam ।। 3 ।। dadarśa bālakaṃ gopī snātvā''gatya svamandiram ।। gavyaśūnyaṃ bhagnabhāṇḍaṃ madhvādiriktabhājanam ।। 4 ।। dṛṣṭvā papraccha bālāṃśca aho karmedamadbhutam।। yūyaṃ vadata satyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ kena sudāruṇam ।। 5 ।। yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā sarvamūcuśca bālakāḥ ।। cakhāda satyaṃ bālaste nāsmabhyaṃ dattameva ca ।। 6 ।। bālānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa nandagehinī ।। vetraṃ gṛhītvā dudrāva raktapaṅkajalocanā ।। 7 ।। palāyamānaṃ govindaṃ grahītuṃ na śaśāka ha ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ śivādīnāṃ durāpamapi yoginām ।। 8 ।। yaśodā bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā viśrāntā gharmasaṃyutā ।। tasthau kopaparī tātmā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā ।। 9 ।। viśrāntāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpāluḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। saṃtasthau purato mātuḥ sasmito jagadīśvaraḥ ।। ।। 10।। kare dhṛtvā ca taṃ devī samānīya svamālayam।। baddhvā vastreṇa vṛkṣe ca tatāḍa madhusūdanam ।।11।। baddhvā kṛṣṇaṃ yaśodā sā jagāma svālayaṃ prati ।। haristasthau vṛkṣamūle jagatāṃ patirīśvaraḥ ।। 12 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasparśamātreṇa sahasā tatra nārada ।। papāta vṛkṣaḥ śailābhaḥ śabdaṃ kṛtvā bhayānakam ।।13।। suveṣaḥ puruṣo divyo vṛkṣādāvirbabhūva ha ।। divyasyandanamāruhya jagāma svālayaṃ puraḥ ।। 14।। praṇamya jagatīnāthaṃ śātakaumbhaparicchadam ।। kiśoraḥ sasmito gauro ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ ।। 15 ।। sā vṛkṣapatanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhiyā trastā vrajeśvarī ।। kroḍe cakāra bālaṃ taṃ rudantaṃ śyāmasundaram ।।16।। ājagmurgokulasthāśca gopā gopyaśca tadgṛham ।। yaśodāṃ bhartsayāmāsuḥ śāntiṃ cakruḥ śiśormudā ।। 17 ।। atyantasthavire kāle tanayo'yaṃ babhūva ha ।। dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca ratnaṃ vā tatsarvaṃ putrahetukam ।। 18 ।। sumatirnāsti te satyaṃ jñātaṃ nandavrajeśvari ।। na bhakṣitaṃ yatputreṇa tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhuvi।।19।। putraṃ baddhvā gavyahetorvṛkṣamūle ca niṣṭhure।। gṛhakarmaṇi vyagrāyāṃ daivādvṛkṣaḥ papāta ha ।। 20 ।। vṛkṣasya patanādgopī bhāgyādbālo'pi jīvitaḥ ।। pranaṣṭe bālake mūḍhe vastūnāṃ kiṃ prayojanam ।। 21।। āśiṣaṃ yuyujurviprā bandinaśca śubhāvahām ।। dvijena kārayāmāsurnāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ ।। 22 ।। evaṃ kṛtvā janāḥ sarve prayayurnijamandiram ।। uvāca patnīṃ nandaśca raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ ।।23।। nanda uvāca ।। yāsyāmi tīrthamadyaiva kaṇṭhe kṛtvā tu bālakam ।। athavā tvaṃ gṛhādgaccha tvayā me kiṃ prayojanam ।। 24 ।। śatakūpādhikā vāpī śatavāpīsamaṃ saraḥ ।। saraḥśatādhiko yajñaḥ putro yajñaśatādhikaḥ ।। 25 ।। tapodānodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ janmāntarasukhapradam ।। sukhaprado'pi satputra ihaiva ca paratra ca ।।26।। putrādapi paro bandhurna bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।। evamuktvā svabhāryāṃ ca tasthau nandaḥ svamandire।। yaśodā rohiṇī caiva niyuktā gṛhakarmaṇi।।27।। nārada uvāca ।। suveṣaḥ puruṣaḥ ko vā vṛkṣarūpī ca gokule ।। bhagavanhetunā kena vṛkṣatvaṃ samavāpa ha ।। 28 ।। ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। kuberatanayaḥ śrīmānnāmnā yo nalakūbaraḥ ।। jagāma nandanavanaṃ krīḍārthaṃ saha rambhayā ।। 29 ।। nirjane sarasastīre puṣpodyāne manohare ।। vaṭavṛkṣasamīpe ca saurabhe puṣpavāyunā ।। 30।। vidhāya puṣpaśayane ratnadīpaiśca dīpitam ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravasaṃyutam ।।31।। paritaḥ puṣpamālyaiśca kṣaumavastraiśca veṣṭitam।। tatra rambhāṃ samānīya vijahāra yathecchayā ।।32।। śṛṅgārāṣṭaprakāraṃ ca viparītādikaṃ sukham ।। cumbanaṃ ṣaṭprakāraṃ ca yathāsthāne nirūpitam।।33।। aṅga pratyaṅgasaṃyogatrividhāśleṣaṇaṃ mudā।। nakhadantakarakrīḍāṃ cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ ।। 34 ।। jalātsthale sthalāttoye kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। ratibhogaprakurvantaṃ dadarśa devalo muniḥ।।35।। nagnāṃ rambhāṃ muktakeśīṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām।। nakhadantakṣatāṅgīṃ ca pulakāñcitavigrahām।।36।। paśyantīṃ prāṇanāthaṃ ca paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā।। vakrabhrūbhaṅgasaṃyuktāṃ kāmukīṃ ca dadarśa tām ।। 37।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitām।। vicitraratnamālyaiśca puṣpamālyaiśca bhūṣitām।।38।। kiṅkiṇījālasaṃyuktāṃ sindūra bindusaṃyutām ।। tayā yuktaṃ pulakitaṃ nottiṣṭhantaṃ smarānvitam ।।39।। vṛkṣatvaṃ yāhi pāpiṣṭhetyuvāca munipuṃgavaḥ।। śaśāpa rambhāṃ kāmārtāṃ mānuṣī tvaṃ bhaveti ca ।। 40।। janmejayasya subhagā bhavitā kāminīti ca।। tvameva gokulaṃ gaccha vṛkṣarūpī bhaveti ca।।41।। śrīkṛṣṇa sparśamātreṇa punarāyāsyasi gṛham ।। rambhe tvamindrasaṃyogātpunarāyāsyasi dhruvam ।।42।। ityevamuktvā sa munirjagāma nijamandiram। kuberatanayaḥ śrīmānsa jagāma nijālayam ।।43।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra rambhākhyānaṃ vadāmi te ।। sucandrasya gṛhe rambhā lalābha janma bhārate ।। 44 ।। kanyā lakṣmīsvarūpā ca babhūva sundarī varā ।। tāṃ ca sālaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtvā sucandro nṛpatīśvaraḥ ।।45।। nānākautukasaṃyuktāṃ dadau janmejayāya ca।। janmejayasya subhagā babhūva mahiṣī varā ।। 46 ।। sthānesthāne nirjane ca rājā reme tayā saha ।। ekadā nṛpatiśreṣṭhaścāśvamedhena dīkṣitaḥ।।47।। aśvasaṃgopanaṃ kṛtvā tasthau śakraśca mandire।। yajñāśvaṃ ruciraṃ matvā kautukena ca sundarī ।।48।। draṣṭuṃ jagāma sā sādhvī cāśvamekākinī mudā ।। śakro'śvanikaṭe bhūtvā dharṣayāmāsa tāṃ satīm ।। 49 ।। tayā nivāryamāṇaśca reme tatra tayā saha ।। mūrcchāmavāpa śakraśca bubudhe na divāniśam ।। 50 ।। sā ca saṃbhogamātreṇa dehaṃ tatyāja yogataḥ ।। nṛpasya lajjayā bhītyā śakraḥ svarge jagāma ha ।।51।। rājā śrutvā mṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ।। yajñaṃ samāpya viprebhyo dadau pūrṇāṃ ca dakṣiṇām।। ।।52।। rambhā ca mānavaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā svargaṃ jagāma ha ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vṛkṣārjunavibhañjanam ।।53।। nalakūbaramokṣaśca rambhāyāśca mahāmune ।। puṇyadaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamaparaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 94 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde vṛkṣārjunabhañjanaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।14।।
<4.15> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā kṛṣṇasahito nando vṛndāvanaṃ yayau।। tatropavanabhāṇḍīre cārayāmāsa godhanam।।1।। saraḥ susvādutoyaṃ ca pāyayāmāsa tatpapau ।। uvāsa vṛkṣamūle ca bālaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 2 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇo māyāmānuṣavigrahaḥ ।। cakāra māyayā'kasmānmeghācchannaṃ nabho mune ।। 3 ।। meghāvṛtaṃ nabho dṛṣṭvā śyāmalaṃ kānanāntaram।। jhaṃjhāvātaṃ mahāśabdaṃ vajraśabdaṃ ca dāruṇam।।4।। vṛṣṭidhārāmatisthūlāṃ kampamānāṃśca pādapān।। dṛṣṭvaivaṃ patitaskandhānnando bhayamavāpa ha।।5।। kathaṃ yāsyāmi govatsānvihāya svāśramaṃ bata।। gṛhaṃ yadi na yāsyāmi bhavitā bālakasya kim ।।6।। evaṃ nande pravadati ruroda śrīharistadā।। payobhiyā hariścaiva pituḥ kaṇṭhaṃ dadhāra saḥ।।7।। etasminnantare rādhā''jagāma kṛṣṇa sannidhim ।। gamanaṃ kuvanī rājahaṃsakhañjanagañjanam ।।8।। śaratpārvaṇacandrābhāmuṣṭavaktramanoharā ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ śobhāmocanalocanā ।। 9 ।। paritastārakāpakṣmavicitrakajjalojjvalā ।। khagendracañcucāruśrīśaṃsānāśakanāsikā ।। 10 ।। tanmadhyasthalaśobhārha sthūlamuktāphalojjvalā।। kabarīveṣasaṃyuktā mālatīmālyaveṣṭitā ।।11।। grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhāmuṣṭakakuṇḍalā ।। pakvabimbaphalānāṃ ca śrīmuṣṭādharayugmakā।।12।। muktāpaṅktiprabhātaikadantapaṅktisamujjvalā ।। īṣatpraphullakundānāṃ suprabhānāśakasmitā ।।13।। kastūrībindusaṃyukta sindūrabindubhūṣitā।। kapālaṃ mallikāyuktaṃ bibhratī śrīyutaṃ satī।।14।। sucāruvartulākārakapolapulakānvitā ।। maṇiratnendrasārāṇāṃ hāroraḥsthalabhūṣitā ।। 15 ।। sucāruśrīphalayugakaṭhinastanasaṃgatā ।। patrāvalīśriyā yuktā dīptā sadratnatejasā ।।16।। sucāruvartulākāramudaraṃ sumanoharam ।। vicitratrivalīyuktaṃ nimnanābhiṃ ca bibhratī ।। 17 ।। sadratnasāraracitamekhalājālabhūṣitā ।। kāmāstrasārabhrūbhaṅgayogīndracittamohinī ।। 18 ।। kaṭhinaśroṇiyugalaṃ dharaṇīdharaninditam ।। sthalapadmaprabhāmuṣṭacaraṇaṃ dadhatī mudā ।। ।। 19 ।। ratnabhūṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yāvakadravasaṃyutam ।। maṇīndraśobhāsaṃmuṣṭasālaktakapunarbhavam ।। 20 ।। sadratnasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīra rañjitam ।। ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūracāruśaṅkhavibhūṣitā ।। 21 ।। ratnāṅgulīyanikaravahniśuddhāṃśukojvalā ।। cārucampakapuṣpāṇāṃ prabhā muṣṭakalevarā ।। 22 ।। sahasradalasaṃyuktakrīḍākamalamujjvalam ।। śrīmukhaśrīdarśanārthaṃ bibhratī ratnadarpaṇam ।। 23 ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nirjane nando vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau ।। candrakoṭiprabhāmuṣṭāṃ bhāsayantīṃ diśo daśa ।। 24 ।। nanāma tāṃ sāśrunetro bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। jānāmi tvāṃ gargamukhātpadmādhikapriyāṃ hareḥ ।। 25 ।। jānāmīmaṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ paraṃ nirguṇamacyutam ।। tathāpi mohito'haṃ ca mānavo viṣṇumāyayā ।। 26 ।। gṛhāṇa prāṇanāthaṃ ca gaccha bhadre yathāsukham ।। paścāddāsyasi matputraṃ kṛtvā pūrṇamanoratham ।। 27 ।। ityuktvā pradadau tasyai rudantaṃ bālakaṃ bhiyā ।। jagrāha bālakaṃ rādhā jahāsa madhuraṃ sukhāt ।। 28 ।। uvāca nandaṃ sā yatnānna prakāśyaṃ rahasyakam ।। ahaṃ dṛṣṭā tvayā nanda katijanmaphalodayāt ।। 29 ।। prājñastvaṃ gargavacanātsarvaṃ jānāsi kāraṇam ।। akathyamāvayorgopyaṃ caritaṃ gokule vraja ।। 30 ।। varaṃ vṛṇu vrajeśa tvaṃ yatte manasi vāñchitam ।। dadāmi līlayā tubhyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham ।। 31 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca vrajeśvaraḥ ।। yuvayoścaraṇe bhaktiṃ dehi nānyatra me spṛhā ।। 32 ।। yuvayoḥ sannidhau vāsaṃ dāsyasi tvaṃ sudurlabham ।। āvābhyāṃ dehi jagatāmambike parameśvari ।। 33 ।। śrutvā nandasya vacanamuvāca parameśvarī ।। dāsyāmi dāsyamatulamidānīṃ bhaktirastu te ।। 34 ।। āvayoścaraṇāmbhoje yuvayośca divāniśam ।। praphullahṛdaye śaśvatsmṛtirastu sudurlabhā ।। 39 ।। māyā yuvāṃ ca pracchannau na kariṣyati madvarāt ।। goloke yāsyathānte ca vihāya mānavīṃ tanum ।। 36 ।। evamuktvā tu sānandaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ svavakṣasi ।। dūraṃ nināya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bāhubhyāṃ ca yathepsitam ।। 37 ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ kāmācchleṣaṃśleṣaṃ cucumba ca ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgo sasmāra rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 38 ।। etasminnantare rādhā māyāsadratnamaṇḍapam ।। dadarśa ratnakalaśaśatena ca samanvitam ।। 39 ।। nānāvicitracitrāḍhyaṃ citrakānanaśobhitam ।। sindūrākāramaṇibhiḥ stambhasaṃghairvirājitam ।। 40 ।। candanāgurukastṛrīkuṅkumadravayuktayā ।। saṃyuktaṃ mālatīmālāsamūhapuṣpaśayyayā ।। 41 ।। nānābhogasamāyuktaṃ divyadarpaṇasaṃyutam ।। maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyamālājālairvibhūṣitam ।। 42 ।। maṇīndrasāraracitakapāṭena samanvitam ।। bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣitairvastraiḥ patākānikarairvaraiḥ ।। kuṅkumākāramaṇibhiḥ saptasopānasaṃyutam ।। 43 ।। yuktaṃ ṣaṭpadasaṃyuktaiḥ puṣpodyānaṃ ca puṣpitaiḥ ।। sā devī maṇḍapaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāmābhyantaraṃ mudā ।। 44 ।। dadarśa tatra tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisamanvitam ।। jalaṃ ca ratnakumbhasthaṃ svacchaṃ śītaṃ manoharam ।। 49 ।। sudhāmadhubhyāṃ pūrṇāni ratnakumbhāni nārada ।। puruṣaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca kiśora śyāmasundaram ।।46।। koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ candanena vibhūṣitam ।। śayānaṃ puṣpaśayyāyāṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।।47।। pītavastraparīdhānaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇam ।। maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam ।। 48 ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇakeyūravalayānvitam ।। maṇīndrakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ।। 49 ।। kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrāsyaprabhāmuṣṭamukhojjvalam ।। 50 ।। śaratpraphullakamalaprabhāmocanalocanam ।। mālatīmālyasaṃśliṣṭaśikhipicchasuśobhitam ।। 51 ।। trivaṃkacūḍāṃ bibhrantaṃ paśyantaṃ ratnamandiram ।। kroḍaṃ bālakaśūnyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā taṃ navayauvanam ।। 52 ।। sarvasmṛtisvarūpā sā tathāpi vismayaṃ yayau ।। rūpaṃ rāseśvarī dṛṣṭvā mumoha sumanoharam ।। 53 ।। kāmāccakṣuścakorābhyāṃ mukhacandraṃ papau mudā ।। nimeṣarahitā rādhā navasaṃgamalālasā ।। 54 ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgī sasmitā madanāturā ।। tāmuvāca haristatra smerānanasaroruhām ।। navasaṃgamayogyāṃ ca paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। 55 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। rādhe smarasi golokavṛttāntaṃ surasaṃsadi ।। 56 ।। adya pūrṇaṃ kariṣyāmi svīkṛtaṃ yatpurā priye ।। tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā rādhe preyasī ca varānane ।। 57 ।। yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca bhedo hi nāvayordhruvam ।। yathā kṣīre ca dhāvalyaṃ yathā'gnau dāhikā sati ।। 58 ।। yathā pṛthivyāṃ gandhaśca tathā'haṃ tvayi saṃtatam ।। vinā mṛdā ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ vinā svarṇena kuṇḍalam ।। 59 ।। kulālaḥ svarṇakāraśca nahi śaktaḥ kadācana ।। tathā tvayā vinā sṛṣṭimahaṃ kartuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ ।। 60 ।। sṛṣṭerādhārabhūtā tvaṃ bījarūpo'hamacyutaḥ ।। āgaccha śayane sādhvi kuru vakṣaḥsthale hi mām ।। 61 ।। tvaṃ me śobhā svarūpā'si dehasya bhūṣaṇaṃ yathā ।। kṛṣṇaṃ vadānta māṃ lokāstvayaiva rahitaṃ yadā ।। 62 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca tadā te'pi tvayaiva sahitaṃ param ।। tvaṃ ca śrīstvaṃ ca saṃpattistvamādhārasvarūpiṇī ।। 63 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpāsi sarvarūpo'hamakṣaraḥ ।। yadā tejaḥsvarūpo'haṃ tejorūpā'si tvaṃ tadā ।। 64 ।। na śarīrī yadāhaṃ ca tadā tvamaśarīriṇī ।। sarvabījasvarūpo'haṃ sadā yogena sundari ।। 65 ।। tvaṃ ca śaktisvarūpā ca sarvastrīrūpadhāriṇī ।। mamāṅgāṃśasvarūpā tvaṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 66 ।। śaktyā buddhyā ca jñānena mayā tulyā varānane ।। āvayorbhedabuddhiṃ ca yaḥ karoti narādhamaḥ ।। 67 ।। tasya vāsaḥ kālasūtre yāvaccandradivākarau ।। pūrvānsapta parānsapta puruṣānpātayatyadhaḥ ।। 68 ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam ।। ajñānādāvayornindāṃ ye kurvanti narādhamāḥ ।। 69 ।। pacyante narake ghore yāvaccandradivākarau ।। rāśabdaṃ kurvatastrasto dadāmi bhaktimuttamām ।। 70 ।। dhāśabdaṃ kurvataḥ paścādyāmi śravaṇalobhataḥ ।। ye sevante ca dattvā māmupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। yāvajīvanaparyantaṃ yā prītirjāyate mama ।। 71 ।। sā prītirmama jāyeta rādhāśabdāttato'dhikā ।। priyā na me tathā rādhe rādhāvaktā tato'dhikaḥ ।। 72 ।। brahmānantaḥ śivo dharmo naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। kapilaśca gaṇeśaśca kārttikeyaśca matpriyaḥ ।। 73 ।। lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī prakṛtistathā।। mama priyāśca devāśca tāstathāpi na tatsamāḥ ।।74।। te sarve prāṇatulyā me tvaṃ me prāṇādhikā satī ।। bhinnasthānasthitāste ca tvaṃ ca vakṣaḥsthale sthitā ।। 75 ।। yā me caturbhujā mūrtirbibhartti vakṣasi priyām ।। so'haṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpastvāṃ vivahāmi svayaṃ sadā ।। 76 ।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇastasthau talpe manorame ।। uvāca rādhikā nāthaṃ bhaktinamrātmakandharā ।।77 ।। rādhikovāca ।। smarāmi sarvaṃ jānāmi vismarāmi kathaṃ vibho ।। yattvaṃ vadasi sarvāhaṃ tvatpādābjaprasādataḥ ।। 78 ।। īśvarasyāpriyāḥ kecitpriyāśca kutra kecana ।। ye yathā māṃ na smaranti tathā teṣu tavākṛpā ।। 79 ।। tṛṇaṃ ca parvataṃ kartu samarthaḥ parvataṃ tṛṇam ।। tathāpi yogyāyogye ca saṃpattau ca samā kṛpā ।। 80 ।। tiṣṭhatyahaṃ śayānastvaṃ kathābhiryatkṣaṇaṃ gatam ।। tatkṣaṇaṃ ca yugasamaṃ nāhaṃ prāpayituṃ kṣamā ।।81।। vakṣaḥsthale ca śirasi dehi te caraṇāmbujam ।। dunoti manmanaḥ sadyastvadīyavirahānalāt ।। 82 ।। puraḥ papāta me dṛṣṭistvadīyacaraṇāmbuje ।। nītā mayā nahi kleśāddraṣṭumanyatkalevaram ।।83।। pratyekamaṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva dattā śānte mukhāmbuje।। dṛṣṭvā mukhāravindaṃ ca nānyaṃ gantuṃ ca sā kṣamā ।। 84 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa puruṣottamaḥ ।। tāmuvāca hitaṃ tathyaṃ śrutismṛtinirūpitam ।। 89 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। na khaṇḍanīyaṃ tattatra mayā pūrvaṃ nirūpitam ।। tiṣṭha bhadre kṣaṇaṃ bhadraṃ kariṣyāmi tava priye ।। 86।। tvanmanorathapūrṇasya svayaṃ kālaḥ samāgataḥ ।। yasya yallikhitaṃ pūrvaṃ yatra kāle nirūpitam ।। 87 ।। tadeva khaṇḍituṃ rādhe kṣamo nāhaṃ ca ko vidhiḥ ।। vidhātuśca vidhātā'haṃ yeṣāṃ yallekhanaṃ kṛtam ।। 88 ।। brahmādīnāṃ ca kṣudrāṇāṃ na tatkhaṇḍyaṃ kadācana ।। etasminnantare brahmā''jagāma purato hareḥ ।। 89 ।। mālākamaṇḍalukara īṣatsmeracaturmukhaḥ ।। gatvā nanāma taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pratuṣṭāva yathāgamam।। 90।। sāśrunetrapulakito bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ।। stutvā natvā jagaddhātā jagāma harisannidhim ।।91।। punarnatvā prabhuṃ bhaktyā jagāma rādhikāntikam ।। mūrdhnā nanāma bhaktyā ca mātustaccaraṇāmbuje ।।92।। cakāra saṃbhrameṇaiva jaṭājālena veṣṭitam।। kamaṇḍalujalenaiva śīghraṃ prakṣālitaṃ mudā ।।93।। yathāgamaṃ pratuṣṭāva puṭāñjaliyutaḥ punaḥ ।। ।।brahmovāca ।। ।। he mātastvatpadāmbhojaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ ।।94।। sudurlabhaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bhārate ca viśeṣataḥ ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ purā mayā ।। 95 ।। bhāskare puṣkare tīrthe kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। ājagāma varaṃ dātuṃ varadātā hariḥ svayam ।। 96 ।। varaṃ vṛṇīṣvetyukte ca svābhīṣṭaṃ ca vṛtaṃ mudā ।। rādhikācaraṇāmbhojaṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabham ।। 97 ।। he guṇātīta me śīghramadhunaiva pradarśaya ।। mayetyukto harirayamuvāca māṃ tapasvinam ।। 98 ।। darśayiṣyāmi kāle ca vatsedānīṃ kṣameti ca ।। nahīśvarājñā viphalā tena dṛṣṭaṃ padāmbujam ।। 99 ।। sarveṣāṃ vāñchitaṃ mātargoloke bhārate'dhunā ।। sarvā devyaḥ prakṛtyaṃśā janyāḥ prākṛtikā dhruvam ।। 100 ।। tvaṃ kṛṣṇāṅgārdhasaṃbhūtā tulyā kṛṣṇena sarvataḥ ।। śrīkṛṣṇastvamayaṃ rādhā tvaṃ rādhā vā hariḥ svayam ।। 101 ।। nahi vedeṣu me dṛṣṭa iti kena nirūpitam ।। brahmāṇḍādbahirūrdhvaṃ ca goloko'sti yathāmbike ।। 102 ।। vaikuṇṭhaścāpyajanyaśca tvamajanyā tathāmbike ।। yathā samastabrahmāṇḍe śrīkṛṣṇāṃśāṃśajīvinaḥ।।103।। tathā śaktisvarūpā tvaṃ teṣu sarveṣu saṃsthitā।। puruṣāśca hareraṃśāstvadaṃśā nikhilāḥ striyaḥ ।।104।। ātmanā deharūpā tvamasyādhārastvameva hi।। asyānu prāṇaistvaṃ mātastvatprāṇairayamīśvaraḥ ।।105।। kimaho nirmitaḥ kena hetunā śilpakāriṇā ।। nityo'yaṃ ca tathā kṛṣṇastvaṃ ca nityā tathā'mbike ।। 106 ।। asyāṃśā tvaṃ tvadaṃśo vā'pyayaṃ kena nirūpitaḥ ।। ahaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ devānāṃ janakaḥ svayam ।। 107 ।। taṃ paṭhitvā gurumukhādbhavantyeva budhā janāḥ ।। guṇānāṃ vāstavānāṃ te śatāṃśaṃ vaktumakṣamaḥ ।। 108 ।। vedo vā paṇḍito vā'nyaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ ।। stavānāṃ janakaṃ jñānaṃ buddhirjñānāmbikā sadā ।। 109 ।। tvaṃ buddherjananī mātaḥ ko vā tvāṃ stotumīśvaraḥ ।। yadvastu dṛṣṭaṃ sarveṣāṃ taddhi vaktuṃ budhaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। 110।। yadadṛṣṭāśrute vastu tannirvaktuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। ahaṃ maheśo'naṃtaśca stotuṃ tvāṃ ko'pi na kṣamaḥ।। 111 ।। sarasvatī ca vedāśca kṣamaḥ kaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ ।। yathāgamaṃ yathoktaṃ ca na māṃ ninditumarhasi ।। 112 ।। īśvarāṇāmīśvarasya yogyāyogye samā kṛpā।। janasya pratipālyasya kṣaṇe doṣaḥ kṣaṇe guṇaḥ ।। 113 ।। jananī janako yo vā sarvaṃ kṣamati snehataḥ ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā tasthau ca puratastayoḥ ।।114।। praṇamya caraṇāmbhoje sarveṣāṃ vandyamīpsitam ।। brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।।115।। rādhāmādhavayoḥ pāde bhaktirdāsyaṃ labheddhruvam ।। karmanirmūlanaṃ kṛtvā mṛtyuṃ jitvā sudurjayam ।। vilaṅghya sarvalokāṃśca yāti golokamuttamam।। 116।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca।। brahmaṇaḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca ha rādhikā ।। 117 ।। varaṃ vṛṇu vidhātastvaṃ yatte manasi vartate ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca jagadvidhiḥ ।। 118 ।। varaṃ ca yuvayoḥ pādapadmabhaktiṃ ca dehi me ।। ityukte vidhinā rādhā tūrṇamomityuvāca ha ।। 119 ।। punarnanāma tāṃ bhaktyā vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। tadā brahmā tayormadhye prajvālya ca hutāśanam ।। 120 ।। hariṃ saṃsmṛtya havanaṃ cakāra vidhinā vidhiḥ।। utthāya śayanātkṛṣṇa uvāsa vahnisannidhau ।। 121 ।। brahmaṇoktena vidhinā cakāra havanaṃ svayam ।। praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ janakaḥ svayam ।। 122 ।। kautukaṃ kārayāmāsa saptadhā ca pradakṣiṇām ।। punaḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ rādhāṃ kārayitvā hutāśanam ।। 123 ।। praṇamayya tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vāsayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ ।। tasyā hastaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ grāhayāmāsa taṃ vidhiḥ ।। 124।। vedoktasaptamantrāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa mādhavam ।। saṃsthāpya rādhikāhastaṃ harervakṣasi vedavit ।। 125 ।। śrīkṛṣṇahastaṃ rādhāyāḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe prajāpatiḥ ।। sthāpayāmāsa mantrāṃstrīnpāṭhayāmāsa rādhikām ।।126।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāṃ jānuvilambitām ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya gale brahmā rādhādvārā dadau mudā ।। 127 ।। praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ ca kamalodbhavaḥ ।। rādhāgale haridvārā dadau mālāṃ manoharām।। punaśca vāsayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 128 ।। tadvāmapārśve rādhāṃ ca sasmitāṃ kṛṣṇacetasam ।। puṭāñjaliṃ kārayitvā mādhavaṃ rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ ।। ।।129।। pāṭhayāmāsa vedoktānpañca mantrāṃśca nārada ।। praṇamayya punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarpya rādhikāṃ vidhiḥ ।। 130 ।। kanyakāṃ ca yathā tāto bhaktyā tasthau hareḥ puraḥ ।। etasminnantare devāḥ sānandapulakodgamāḥ ।। 131।। dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsuścānakaṃ murajādikam।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। 132 ।। jagurgandharvapravarā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।। tuṣṭāva śrīhariṃ brahmā tamuvāca ha sasmitaḥ ।।133।। yuvayoścaraṇāmbhoje bhaktiṃ me dehi dakṣiṇām।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca hariḥ svayam ।।134।। madīyacaraṇāmbhoje sudṛḍhā bhaktirastu te ।। svasthānaṃ gaccha bhadraṃ te bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 135 ।। mayā niyojitaṃ karma kuru vatsa mamājñayā ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā vidhātā jagatāṃ mune ।। 136 ।। praṇamya rādhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca jagāma svālayaṃ mudā ।। gate brahmaṇi sā devī sasmitā vakracakṣuṣā ।। ।। 137 ।। sā dadarśa harervaktraṃ cacchāda vrīḍayā mukham ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṃgī kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। 138 ।। praṇamya śrīhariṃ bhaktyā jagāma śayanaṃ hareḥ ।। candanāgurupaṅkaṃ ca kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam।।139।। lalāṭe tilakaṃ kṛtvā dadau kṛṣṇasya vakṣasi ।। sudhāpūrṇaṃ ratnapātraṃ madhupūrṇaṃ manoharam ।। 140 ।। pradadau haraye bhaktyā bubhuje jagatīpatiḥ ।। tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 141 ।। dadau kṛṣṇāya sā rādhā sādaraṃ bubhuje hariḥ ।। cakhāda sasmitā rādhā haridattaṃ sudhārasam ।।142।। tāmbūlaṃ tena dattaṃ ca bubhuje purato hareḥ ।। kṛṣṇaścarvitatāmbūlaṃ rādhikāyai mudā dadau ।।143।। cakhāda parayā bhaktyā papau tanmukhapaṅkajam ।। rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ yayāce madhusūdanaḥ ।।144।। jahāsa na dadau rādhā kṣametyuktaṃ tayā mudā।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravamuttamam ।। rādhikāyāśca sarvāṃge pradadau mādhavaḥ svayam ।। 145 ।। yaḥ kāmo dhyāyate nityaṃ yasyaikacaraṇāmbujam ।। babhūva tasya sa vaśo rādhāsaṃtoṣakāraṇāt ।। 146 ।। yadbhṛtyabhṛtyairmadano jitaḥ sarvakṣaṇaṃ mune ।। svecchāmayo hi bhagavāñjitastena kutūhalāt ।।147।। kare dhṛtvā ca tāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sthāpayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। cakāra śithilaṃ vastraṃ cumbanaṃ ca caturvidham ।।148।। babhūva ratiyuddhena vicchinnā kṣudraghaṇṭikā ।। cumbanenauṣṭharāgaśca hyāśleṣeṇa ca patrakam ।।149।। śṛṃgāreṇaiva kabarī sindūratilakaṃ mune ।। jagāmālaktakāṅkaśca viparītādikena ca ।। 150।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṃṅgī babhūva navasaṃgamāt ।। mūrcchāmavāpa sā rādhā bubudhe na divāniśam ।।151।। pratyaṅgenaiva pratyaṅgamaṅgenāṅgaṃ samāśliṣat ।। śṛṅgārāṣṭavidhaṃ kṛṣṇaścakāra kāmaśāstravit।।152।। punastāṃ ca samāśliṣya sasmitāṃ vakralocanām ।। kṣatavikṣatasarvāṅgīṃ nakhadantaiścakāra ha ।।153।। kaṅkaṇānāṃ kiṅkiṇīnāṃ mañjīrāṇāṃ manoharaḥ ।। babhūva śabdastatraiva śṛṅgārasamarodbhavaḥ ।। 154 ।। punastāṃ ca samākṛṣya śayyāyāṃ ca niveśya ca ।। cakāra rahitāṃ rādhāṃ kabarībandhavāsasā ।। 155 ।। nirjane kautukātkṛṣṇaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। cūḍāveṣāṃśukairhīnaṃ cakāra taṃ ca rādhikā ।।156।। na kasya kasmāddhāniśca tau dvau kāryaviśāradau ।। jagrāha rādhāhastāttu mādhavo ratnadarpaṇam ।।157।। muralīṃ mādhavakarājjagrāha rādhikā balāt ।। cittāpahāraṃ rādhāyāścakāra mādhavo balāt ।।158।। jahāra rādhikā rāsānmādhavasyāpi mānasam ।। nivṛtte kāmayuddhe ca sasmitā vakralocanā।।159।। pradadau muralīṃ prītyā śrīkṛṣṇāya mahātmane।। pradadau darpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ krīḍākamalamujjvalam ।। 160।। cakāra kabarīṃ ramyāṃ sindūratilakaṃ dadau।। vicitrapatrakaṃ veṣaṃ cakāraivaṃvidhaṃ hariḥ।। ।।161।। viśvakarmā na jānāti sakhīnāmapi kā kathā ।। veṣaṃ vidhātuṃ kṛṣṇasya yadā rādhā samudyatā ।। 162 ।। babhūva śiśurūpaṃ ca kaiśoraṃ ca vihāya ca ।। dadarśa bālarūpaṃ taṃ rudantaṃ pīḍitaṃ kṣudhā ।।163।। yādṛśaṃ pradadau nando bhītaṃ tādṛśamacyutam ।। viniśvasya ca sā rādhā hṛdayena vidūyatā ।।164।। itastatastaṃ paśyantī śokārtā virahāturā ।। uvāca kṛṣṇamuddiśya kākūktimiti kātarā ।। 165 ।। māyāṃ karoṣi māyeśa kiṃkarīṃ kathamīdṛśīm ।। ityevamuktvā sā rādhā papāta ca ruroda ca ।। ।।166।। ruroda kṛṣṇastatraiva vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। kathaṃ rodiṣi rādhe tvaṃ smara kṛṣṇapadāmbujam।।167।। ārāsamaṇḍalaṃ yāvannaktamatrāgamiṣyati ।। kariṣyasi ratiṃ nityaṃ hariṇā sārddhamīpsitām ।।168।। chāyāṃ vidhāya svagṛhe svayamāgatya mā ruda ।। kṛtvā kroḍe ca prāṇeśaṃ māyeśaṃ bālarūpiṇam ।। 169 ।। tyaja śokaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha sundarītthaṃ prabodhitā ।। śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ rādhā kṛtvā kroḍe ca bālakam ।। ।। 170 ।। dadarśa puṣpodyānaṃ ca vanaṃ sadratnamaṇḍapam ।। tūrṇaṃ vṛndāvanādrādhā jagāma nandamandiram ।। 171 ।। sā manoyāyinī devī nimiṣārdhena nārada ।। saṃsiktasnigdhamadhurarasanā raktalocanā ।। 172 ।। yaśodāyai śiśuṃ dātumudyatā satyuvāca ha ।। gṛhītvaivaṃ śiśuṃ sthūlaṃ rudantaṃ ca kṣudhāturam ।। 173 ।। goṣṭhe tvatsvāminā dattaṃ prāpnomi yātanāṃ pathi ।। saṃsiktaṃ vasanaṃ vatse meghācchanne'tidurdine ।। 174 ।। picchile kardamodreke yaśodā voḍhumakṣamā ।। gṛhāṇa bālakaṃ bhadre stanaṃ dattvā prabodhaya ।। 175 ।। gṛhaṃ ciraṃ parityaktaṃ yāmi tiṣṭha sukhaṃ sati ।। ityuktvā bālakaṃ dattvā jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati ।। 176 ।। yaśodā bālakaṃ nītvā cucumba ca stanaṃ dadau ।। bahirniviṣṭā sā rādhā svagṛhe gṛhakarmaṇi ।। 177 ।। nityaṃ naktaṃ ratiṃ tatra cakāra hariṇā saha ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ puṇyamaparaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 178 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde rādhākṛṣṇavivāhanavasaṃgamaprastāvo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 15 ।।
<4.16> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। mādhavo bālakaiḥ sārddhamekadā halinā saha ।। bhuktvā pītvā ca krīḍārthaṃ jagāma śrīvanaṃ mune ।।1।। tatra nānāvidhāṃ krīḍāṃ cakāra madhusūdanaḥ ।। kṛtvā tāṃ śiśubhiḥ sārddhaṃ cālayāmāsa godhanam ।। 2 ।। yayau madhuvanaṃ tasmācchrīkṛṣṇo godhanaiḥ saha ।। tatra svādu jalaṃ pītvā vane ca sa mahābalaḥ ।। ।। 3 ।। tatraikadaityo balavāñchvetavarṇo bhayaṃkaraḥ ।। vikṛtākāravadano bakākāraśca śailavat ।। 4 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca gokulaṃ goṣṭhe śiśubhirbalakeśavau ।। yathā hyagastyo vātāpiṃ sarvaṃ jagrāsa līlayā ।। 5 ।। bakagrastaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve devā bhayānvitāḥ ।। cakrurhāheti saṃtrastā dhāvantaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ ।। 6 ।। śakraścikṣepa vajraṃ ca munerasthivinirmitam ।। na mamāra bakastasmātpakṣamekaṃ dadāha ca ।। 7 ।। nīhārāstraṃ śaśadharaḥ śītārtastena dānavaḥ ।। yamadaṇḍaṃ sūyarputrastena kuṇṭho babhūva ha ।। 8 ।। vāyavyāstraṃ ca vāyuśca tena sthānāntaraṃ yayau ।। varuṇaśca śilāvṛṣṭiṃ cakāra tena pīḍitaḥ ।। 9 ।। hutāśanaśca vāhnena pakṣāṃścaiva dadāha saḥ ।। kuberasyārdhacandreṇa chinnapādo babhūva ha ।। 10 ।। īśānasya ca śūlena babhūva mūrcchito'suraḥ ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva kṛṣṇaṃ cakurbhiyā''śiṣam ।। 11 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। dadāha daityasarvāṅgaṃ bāhyābhyantaramīśvaraḥ ।। 12 ।। tatsarvaṃ vamanaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāṃstatyāja dānavaḥ ।। bakaṃ nihatya balavāñchiśubhirgodhanaiḥ saha ।। 13 ।। yayau kelikadambānāṃ kānanaṃ sumanoharam ।। etasminnantare tatra vṛṣarūpadharo'suraḥ ।। 14 ।। nāmnā pralambo balavānmahādhūrtaśca śailavat ।। śṛṅgābhyāṃ ca hariṃ dhṛtvā bhrāmayāmāsa tatra vai ।। 15 ।। dudruvurbālakāḥ sarve ruruduśca bhayāturāḥ ।। balo jahāsa balavāñjñātvā bhrātaramīśvaram ।। 16 ।। bālakānbodhayāmāsa bhayaṃ kimityuvāca ha ।। tadviṣāṇaṃ gṛhītvā ca svayaṃ śrīmadhusūdanaḥ ।।17।। bhrāmayitvā ca gagane pātayāmāsa bhūtale ।। prāṇāṃstatyāja daityendro nipatya ca mahītalam ।। 18 ।। jahasurbālakāḥ sarve nanṛtuśca jagurmudā ।। hatvā pralambaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo balena saha satvaram ।। 19 ।। godhanaṃ cārayāmāsa yayau bhāṇḍīramīśvaraḥ ।। gacchantaṃ mādhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā keśī daityeśvaro balī ।। 20 ।। veṣṭayāmāsa taṃ śīghraṃ khureṇa vilikhanmahīm ।। mūrdhni kṛtvā hariṃ tuṣṭo gaganaṃ śatayojanam ।। 21 ।। utpātya bhrāmayāmāsa papāta ca mahītale ।। jagrāha sa hariṃ pāpī carvayāmāsa kopataḥ ।। 22 ।। sa bhagnadanto daityaśca vajrāṅgacarvaṇādaho ।। śrīkṛṣṇatejasā dagdhaḥ prāṇāṃstatyāja bhūtale ।।23।। svarge dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। etasminnantare tatra pārṣadā divyarūpiṇaḥ ।। 24 ।। tatrājagmuḥ syandanasthā dvibhujāḥ pītavāsasaḥ ।। kirīṭinaḥ kuṇḍalino vanamālāvibhūṣitāḥ ।। ।। 25 ।। vinodamuralīhastāḥ kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitāḥ ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgā gopaveṣadharā varāḥ ।। 26 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā bhaktānugraha kātarāḥ ।। pradīptaṃ rathamāsthāya ratnasāravinirmitam ।। 27 ।। bhāṇḍīravanamājagmuryatra sannihito hariḥ ।। divyavastraparīdhānā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ ।। 28 ।। praṇamayya hariṃ stutvā jagmurgolokamuttamam ।। muktvā dehaṃ parityajya vaiṣṇavāḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ ।। saṃprāpya dānavīṃ yoniṃ babhūbuḥ kṛṣṇapārṣadāḥ ।। 29 ।। nārada uvāca ।। ke te ca divyapuruṣā vaiṣṇavā daityarūpiṇaḥ ।। kathayasva mahābhāga kṛtaṃ kiṃ paramādbhutam ।। 30 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu bahmanpravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। 31 ।। śrutaṃ maheśavadanātsūryaparvaṇi puṣkare।। harerguṇaprasaṅgena kathayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ । 32।। saṃpṛṣṭo munisaṃghaiśca mayā dharmeṇa brahmaṇā ।। brahmaputra mahābhāga kathāṃ bhuvanapāvanīm ।।33।। kathayāmāsa vistārya sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। gandharveśo gandhavāhaḥ parvate gandhamādane ।। 34 ।। mahāṃstapasvipravaro harisevanatatparaḥ ।। putrā babhūvuścatvāro gandharvapravarā mune ।। 35 ।। sasmaruḥ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ svapne jñāne divāniśam।। te ca durvāsasaḥ śiṣyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇārcanatatparāḥ ।। 36 ।। nityaṃ dattvā ca kamalaṃ saṃpūjya taṃ papurjalam ।। vasudevaḥ suhotraśca sudarśanasupārśvakau ।। 37 ।। catvāro vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhāstepuste puṣkare tapaḥ ।। cirakālaṃ tapastaptvā babhūvuḥ siddhamantriṇaḥ ।। 38 ।। jyeṣṭho durvāsaso yogaṃ saṃprāpya yogināṃ varaḥ।। siddhaścākṛtadāraśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। 39 ।। sadyo dehaṃ parityajya babhūva kṛṣṇapārṣadaḥ ।। ekadā bhrātaraste ca jagmuścitrasarovaram।। ।। 40 ।। padmāni kṛṣṇapūjārthamāhartumudaye raveḥ ।। padmānāṃ cayanaṃ kṛtvā gacchato vaiṣṇavānmune ।। 41 ।। dṛṣṭvā nibadhya saṃjagmuḥ sarve śaṃkarakiṃkarāḥ ।। baliṣṭhā durbalāndhṛtvā jagmuḥ śaṃkarasannidhim ।। 42 ।। te sarve śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇemuḥ śirasā bhuvi ।। tānuvāca śivaḥ śīghraṃ prayujyāśiṣamuttamām ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo bhaktānugrahakātaraḥ ।। 43 ।। śiva uvāca ।। ke yūyaṃ padmahartāraḥ pārvatyāśca sarovare ।। 44 ।। lakṣayakṣai rakṣaṇīyaṃ pārvatīvratahetave ।। nityaṃ sahasrakamalaṃ dadāti haraye satī ।। 45 ।। vrate traimāsike bhaktyā patisaubhāgyavarddhane ।। śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamūcurvaiṣṇavā bhiyā ।। puṭāñjaliyutāḥ sarve bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।। 46 ।। gandharvā ūcuḥ ।। ।। vayaṃ gandharvapravarā gandhavāhasutā vibho ।। 47 ।। haraye kamalaṃ dattvā pibāmo jalamīśvara ।। vayaṃ na vidmo he nātha pārvatyā rakṣitaṃ saraḥ ।। 48 ।। gṛhāṇa kamalaṃ sarvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca phalaṃ kuru ।। na dāsyāmo'dya kamalaṃ pāsyāmo'dya jalaṃ hara ।। 49 ।। kiṃ vā kathaṃ na pāsyāmastubhyaṃ dattāni tāni ca ।। nityaṃ dhyātvā yatpadābjaṃ padmena pūjayāmahe ।। 50 ।। sākṣāttasmai pradattvā ca padmaṃ pūtā vayaṃ prabho ।। ekaṃ brahma hyadvitīyaṃ kva dehaḥ kva ca rūpavān ।। 51 ।। bhaktānugrahato deho rūpabhedaśca māyayā ।। kiṃ tu gṛhāṇa padmāni tvameva matprabhuḥ prabho ।। 52 ।। yato no mānasaṃ pūrṇaṃ tadrūpaṃ darśayācyuta ।। dvibhujaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram।। ।। 53 ।। vinodamuralīhastaṃ pītāṃbaradharaṃ param ।। ekavaktraṃ dvinayanaṃ candanāgurucarcitam ।। 54 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।। kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam।। 55 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālārājivibhūṣitam ।। 56 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlādhāmamanoharam ।। gopīsaṃghairdṛśyamānaṃ sasmitairvakralocanaiḥ ।। 97 ।। navayauvanasaṃpannaṃ rādhāvakṣasthalasthitam ।। brahmādibhiḥ stūyamānaṃ vandyaṃ dhyeyamabhīpsitam ।। 58 ।। svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। ityuktvā purataḥ śambhostasthurgandharvapuṅgavāḥ ।। 59।। śrīkṛṣṇarūpaśravaṇātpulakāṅkitavigrahaḥ ।। gandharvāṇāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śivastānityuvāca ha ।। 60 ।। śrīkṛṣṇarūpaśravaṇātsāśrupūrṇavilocanaḥ ।। mayaiva yūyaṃ vijñātā vaiṣṇavapravarā mahīm ।।61।। pūtāṃ kartuṃ ca bhramatha caraṇāmbhojareṇunā ।। ahaṃ vāñchāṃ karomyeva śrīkṛṣṇabhaktadarśane ।। 62 ।। samāgamo hi sādhūnāṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabhaḥ ।। pārvatyāśca surāṇāṃ ca sadā yūyaṃ mama priyāḥ ।। 63 ।। ātmanaścātmabhaktebhyo vaiṣṇavāśca priyāśca naḥ ।। kintu moghaṃ ca na bhavenmayā yatsvīkṛtaṃ purā ।। 64 ।। tacchrūyatāṃ mahābhāgāḥ pārvatīvratakarmaṇi।। sarasaścaiva padmāni yairhṛtāni vratāntare।। 65 ।। te tūrṇamāsurīṃ yoniṃ gamiṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।। na hi śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ।। 66 ।। saṃprāpya mānavīṃ yoniṃ golokaṃ yāsyatha dhruvam ।। yūyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ draṣṭumutsukāḥ ।। 67 ।। dhruvaṃ drakṣyatha bho vatsā vṛndāraṇye ca bhārate ।। dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ tato mṛtyuṃ saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ।। 68 ।। divyaṃ syaṃdanamāruhya gamiṣyatha harergṛham।। adhunā vāñchanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ draṣṭumihotsukāḥ ।। 69 ।। tatsarvaṃ paśyatetyuktvā darśayāmāsa tacchivaḥ ।। rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāśrunetrāḥ praṇamya sarvarūpiṇam ।। 70 ।। ājagmurdānavīṃ yonimiti te dānaveśvarāḥ ।। vasudevaḥ purā muktaḥ suhotraśca bakāsuraḥ ।। 71 ।। sudarśanaḥ pralambo'yaṃ svayaṃ keśī supārśvakaḥ ।। harasya varadānena dṛṣṭvā rūpamanuttamam ।। 72 ।। mṛtyuṃ saṃprāpya śrīkṛṣṇājjagmuste kṛṣṇamandiram ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra hareścaritamadbhutam ।। bakakeśipralambānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ mokṣakārakam ।। 73 ।। nārada uvāca ।। śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga tvatprasādādyadadbhutam ।। 74 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi pārvatyā kiṃ kṛtaṃ vratam ।। ko vā''rādhyo vratasyāsya kiṃ phalaṃ niyamaśca kaḥ ।।72।। kāni dravyāṇi bhagavanvratopayogikani ca ।। katikālaṃ vrataṃ kiṃ vā pratiṣṭhāyāṃ nirūpaṇam ।। 76 ।। suvicārya vada vibho śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। vrataṃ traimāsikaṃ nāma patisaubhāgyavardhanam ।। 77 ।। ārādhyo bhagavānkṛṣṇo rādhikāsahito mune ।। viṣuve ca samāraṃbhaḥ samāptirdakṣiṇāyane ।। 78 ।। saṃyamya pūrvadivase kṛtvā'vaśyaṃ haviṣyakam।। snātvā vaiśākhasaṃkrāntyāṃ saṃkalpya jāhnavītaṭe।।79।। ghaṭe maṇau śālagrāme jale vā pūjayedvratī।। dhyāyedbhaktyā ca rādheśaṃ saṃpūjya pañca devatāḥ ।। 80 ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeya vāsasam ।।81।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyamīṣaddhāsyasamanvitam ।। śaratpraphullapadmākṣaṃ mañjulāñchanaraṃjitam ।।82।। mānasaṃ gopikānāṃ ca mohayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।। rādhayā dṛśyamānaṃ ca rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam।।83।। brahmānanteśadharmādyaiḥ stūyamānamahaṃ bhaje ।। dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhyānena tamāvāhya vratī mudā।।84।। dhyāyettadā rādhikāṃ ca dhyānaṃ madhyaṃdineritam ।। rādhāṃ rāseśvarīṃ ramyāṃ rāsollāsarasotsukām ।। ।।85।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthāṃ rāsādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām ।। rāseśvaroraḥsthalasthāṃ rasikāṃ rasikapriyām।।86 ।। rasikapravarāṃ ramyāṃ ramāṃ ca ramaṇotsukām ।। śaradrājīvarājīnāṃ prabhāmocanalocanām ।। 87 ।। vakrabhrūbhaṅgasaṃyuktāṃ mañjīreṇaiva rañjitām ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāmīṣaddhāsyamanoharām ।। 88 ।। cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ candanena vibhūṣitām ।। kastūrībindunā sārdhaṃ siṃdūrabiṃdunā yutām ।।89।। cārupatrāvalīyuktāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukojjvalām ।। sadratnakuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca sukapolasthalojjvalām ।। 90 ।। ratnendrasārahāreṇa vakṣaḥsthalavirājitām ।। ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūrakiṅkiṇīratnarañjitām ।।91।। sadratnasāraracitakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitām ।। brahmādibhiśca sevyena śrīkṛṣṇenaiva sevitām ।। 92 ।। sarveśena stūyamānāṃ sarvabījāṃ bhajāmyaham ।। iti dhyātvā ca kṛṣṇena sahitāṃ tāṃ ca pūjayet ।। 93 ।। bhaktyā dattvā pratidinamupacārāṃśca ṣoḍaśa ।। pratyekaṃ ca pṛthakkṛtvā sarvaṃ dadyādvratī mudā ।। 94 ।। sahasrakamalaṃ divyaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ mune ।। homaṃ kuryādvratī nityamaṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ ।। 95 ।। dadyādbhaktyā ca kṛṣṇāya svāhetyuccārya yatnataḥ ।। rasālasya kadalyāśca hyāmaṃ vā pakvameva ca ।। 96 ।। nityamaṣṭottaraśataṃ dadyādbhaktyā'kṣataiḥ phalam ।। nityaṃ ca bhojayedbhaktyā brāhmaṇānāṃ śataṃ mune ।। 97 ।। homaṃ kuryādvratī nityamaṣṭottaraśatāhutīḥ ।। dadyādbhaktyā ca kṛṣṇāya rādhikāsahitāya ca ।। 98 ।। tilena havanaṃ kuryādājyamiśreṇa nārada ।। vādyaṃ ca vādayennityaṃ kārayeddharikīrtanam ।। 99 ।। evaṃ māsatrayaṃ kṛtvā pratiṣṭhāṃ tadanantaram ।। pratiṣṭhādivase tatra vidhānaṃ śṛṇu nārada।। ।। 100 ।। kamalānāṃ ca navatisahasrāṇyakṣatāni ca ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava viprendra yatnataḥ ।। 101 ।। bhojayetparamānnāni svādūni miṣṭakāni ca ।। phalaṃ viṃśādhikaṃ saptaśataṃ navasahasrakam ।। 102 ।। dadyānnānāvidhaṃ dravyaṃ naivedyaṃ sumanoharam ।। saṃskṛtāgniṃ ca saṃsthāpya homaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।। 103 ।। navatiṃ ca sahasrāṇi hutvā''jyena tilena ca ।। savastraṃ ca sabhojyaṃ ca yajñasūtraphalānvitam ।। 104 ।। gandhapuṣpārcitānbhaktyā dadyānnavatilaḍḍukān ।। dadyānnavatikumbhāṃśca śītatoyaprapūritān ।। 109 ।। evaṃvidhaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām ।। dakṣiṇāyāḥ parimitaṃ vedeṣu yannirūpitam ।। 106।। vṛṣendrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca svarṇaśṛṅgasamanvitam ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra kṛtaṃ traimāsikavratam ।। 107 ।। viśiṣṭasaṃtatikaraṃ patisaubhāgyavarddhanam ।। vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa saubhāgyaṃ śatajanmani ।। 108 ।। satputrajananī sā ca bhavejjanmaśataṃ dhruvam ।। kadā'pi na bhavettasyā bhedaśca patiputrayoḥ ।। 109 ।। dāsatulyo bhavetputro bhartā ca svavacaskaraḥ ।। anukṣaṇaṃ bhavedrādhākṛṣṇabhaktiyutā satī ।। 110 ।। bhavedvrataprabhāveṇa prāptajñānaharissmṛtiḥ ।। vrataṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvamathāvayoḥ ।। 111 ।। sarveṣāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ śṛṇu vadāmi te ।। svāyaṃbhuvasya ca manoḥ śatarūpābhidhā satī ।। 112 ।। tayā kṛtaṃ prathamataḥ kṛtvā'gastyaṃ purohitam ।। tadā kṛtaṃ devahūtyā cākūtyā ca kṛtaṃ tadā ।। 113 ।। purohitaṃ pulastyaṃ ca kṛtvā śrutyuktyā mune ।। cakāra rohiṇī tattu kratuṃ kṛtvā purohitam ।। 114 ।। ratiścakāra tadbhaktyā gautamastatpurohitaḥ ।। akāri tadvrataṃ bhaktyā tārayā gurukāntayā ।। 115 ।। mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhārā vasiṣṭhastatpurohitaḥ ।। taddṛṣṭvā gurupatnyāśca śakraśacyā kṛtaṃ vratam ।। 116 ।। mahāsambhṛtasambhārastatpurodhā bṛhaspatiḥ ।। vrataṃ cakāra svāhā ca sarvato'pi vilakṣaṇam ।।117।। atisaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro marīcistatpurohitaḥ ।। taddṛṣṭvā pārvatī brahmannuvāca śaṃkaraṃ mudā ।। puṭāñjaliyutā devī bhaktinamrātmakandharā ।।118।। pārvatyuvāca ।। ājñāṃ kuru jagannātha karomi vratamuttamam ।। 119 ।। āvayoriṣṭadevasya vratānāṃ ca paraṃ vratam ।। harerārādhanaṃ nātha sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam ।। 120 ।। iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ śruteḥ pāṭhaṃ tīrthaṃ pṛthvyāḥ pradakṣiṇam ।। harerārādhanasyāpi kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 121 ।। bahirabhyaṃtare yasya harismṛtiranukṣaṇam ।। jīvanmuktasya tasyaiva muktirbhavati darśanāt ।। ।। 122 ।। tasya pādābjarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।। tasya darśanamātreṇa punāti bhuvanatrayam ।। 123 ।। brahmā viṣṇuśca dharmaśca śeṣastvaṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ yatpadābjaṃ tejasā tatsamo mahān ।। 124 ।। yaśca yaṃ santataṃ dhyāyetsa tamāpnoti niścitam ।। guṇena tejasā buddhyā jñānena tatsamo bhavet ।। 125 ।। kṛṣṇasya smaraṇāddhyānāttapasā tasya sevayā ।। mayā prāpto hi bhagavānsvāmī vā putra eva ca ।।126।। pralabdhaṃ līlayā sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ manmānasaṃ tadā ।। svāmī me tvādṛśaḥ putrau kārttikeyagaṇeśvarau ।।127।। pitā himādriḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo mama kiṃ durlabhaṃ prabho ।। pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā suprītaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।। prahasyovāca madhuraṃ pulakāṃkitavigrahaḥ।।128।। ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। ।। mahālakṣmīsvarūpāsi kimasādhyaṃ taveśvari ।। 129 ।।
