sarvasampatsvarūpā tvamanantaśakti rūpiṇī ।। tvaṃ ca yasya gṛhe devi sa caiśvaryasya bhājanam ।। 130।। na lakṣmīryadgṛhe tasya jīvanānmaraṇaṃ varam ।। ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca tvayi bhaktyā śubhaprade ।। 131 ।। saṃhāre sṛṣṭikāle ca tvatprasādādvayaṃ kṣamāḥ ।। ko vā himālayaḥ ko'haṃ kau kārttikagaṇeśvarau ।। ।।132।। tvadvihīnā aśaktāśca tvayā ca vayamīśvarāḥ ।। yuktāḥ pativratāyāśca yāḥ purājñāḥ śrutau śrutāḥ ।।133।। gṛhītvā''jñāmīśvarasya vrataṃ kuru pativrate ।। vratametatkṛtaṃ yābhistābhyaḥ kuru vilakṣaṇam ।। 134 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānvrate te'stu purohitaḥ ।। kamalānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dāyako'pyaham।। 135 ।। kuberaṃ dravyakośe ca rakṣakaṃ kuru sundari ।। vrate ca dānādhyakṣo'haṃ dhanadātrī ca śrīḥ svayam ।। 136 ।। pāṭhako vahnidevaśca varuṇo jaladāyakaḥ ।। vastūnāṃ vāhakā yakṣāstadadhyakṣaḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ ।। 137 ।। sthānasaṃskāra kartā ca vrate'tra pavanaḥ svayam ।। pariveṣṭā svayaṃ śakraścandro'dhiṣṭhāpako vrate ।। 138 ।। sūryaśca dānanirvaktā yogyāyogyaṃ yathocitam ।। vratopayuktaṃ yaddravyaṃ dattvā niyamitaṃ priye ।। 139 ।। tato'dhikaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ haraye dehi sundari ।। vrate niyamitānviprānbhojayitvā tato'dhikām।। 140 ।। asaṃkhyānbrāhmaṇāndevi bhaktyā kuru nimantraṇam ।। samāptidivase svarṇaṃ ratnaṃ muktāṃ pravālakam।।141।। vratoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā sarvaṃ dehi dvijātaye ।। ityuktvā śaṃkarastāṃ ca kārayāmāsa tadvratam ।। 142 ।। vrataṃ cakāra sā durgā sarvābhyaśca vilakṣaṇam ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra pārvatyā yadvrataṃ kṛtam ।। 143 ।। ratnaṃ voḍhumaśaktāśca brāhmaṇāḥ pārvatīvrate ।। itihāsaḥ śrutaḥ sarvaḥ prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu nārada ।। 144 ।। śrīkṛṣṇabālacaritaṃ nūtnaṃ nūtnaṃ pade pade ।। hatvā tāndānavendrāṃśca śiśubhiḥ saha gokule ।।145।। jagāma svagṛhaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kuberabhavanopamam ।। sarvebhyo vanavārtā ca proktā ca śiśubhirmudā ।। 146 ।। śrutvaivaṃ vismitāḥ sarve nando bhayamavāpa ha ।। ānīya vṛddhāngopāṃśca gopikāḥ sthavirāstathā ।। 147 ।। yuktiṃ cakāra taiḥ sārddhamālocya samayocitām ।। kṛtvā yuktiṃ ca gopeśastatsthānaṃ tyaktumudyataḥ।।148।। gantuṃ vṛndāvanaṃ sarvānuvāca tatkṣaṇaṃ mune।। nandājñāṃ ca samākarṇya te sarve gantumudyatāḥ।।149।। gopāśca gopikāścaiva bālakā bālikāstathā ।। kṛṣṇena halinā sārdhaṃ prayayurbālakā mudā ।। 150 ।। saṃgītaṃ ca pragāyanto nānāveṣa samanvitāḥ ।। veṇupravādakāḥ kecitkecicchṛṅgapravādakāḥ ।। 151 ।। karatālakarāḥ kecidvīṇāhastāśca kecana।। śarayantrakarāḥ kecicchṛṅgahastāśca kecana ।। 152 ।। navapallavakarṇāśca kecidgopālabālakāḥ ।। kecinmukulakarṇāśca puṣpakarṇāśca kecana ।। 153 ।। navamālyakarāḥ kecitkecidājānumālinaḥ ।। kecitpallavacūḍāśca puṣpacūḍāśca kecana ।। 154 ।। gopālabālakāḥ sarve viprendra navakoṭayaḥ ।। jagmurgopyo vayasyāśca koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo mudā ।। 155 ।। vṛddhāśca koṭiśastatra bṛhacchroṇyaścalatkucāḥ ।। rādhikāsahacāriṇyo bālā gopālikā mune ।। 196 ।। tāḥ suśīlādayo bhavyā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ ।। divyavastraparīdhānāḥ sasmitāstā yayurmudā ।।157।। kāścidāruhya śibikāṃ rathamāruhya kāścana ।। rādhā syandanamāruhya śātakaumbhaparicchadam ।। 158 ।। tābhiryuktā yayau devī ratnālaṃkāra bhūṣitā ।। yaśodā rohiṇī caiva ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā ।। 159 ।। yayau syandanamāruhya śātakaumbhaparicchadam ।। nandaḥ sunandaḥ śrīdāmā giribhānurvibhākaraḥ ।। 160 ।। vīrabhānuścandrabhānurgajasthāḥ prayayurmudā ।। śrīkṛṣṇabaladevau tau ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitau ।। 161 ।। svarṇa syandanamāsthāya jagmatuḥ parayā mudā ।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo gopā vṛddhāśca yauvanānvitāḥ ।। 162 ।। aśvasthāśca gajasthāśca rathasthāścaiva kecana ।। gopā yayurmudā yuktāścoddhatā nandakiṃkarāḥ ।।163।। vṛṣasthā gardabhasthāśca saṃgītatānatatparāḥ ।। aparā rādhikādāsyastrisaptaśatakoṭayaḥ ।। 164 ।। mudānvitāḥ sasmitāśca svarṇālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ ।। kāścitsindūrahastāśca kāścitkajjalavāhikāḥ ।। ।।165।। kāścitkandukahastāśca kāścitputtalikākarāḥ ।। bhogadravyakarāḥ kāścitkrīḍādravyakarā varāḥ ।। 166 ।। veṣadravyakarāḥ kāścitkāścinmālākarā varāḥ ।। kāścidvādyakahastāśca prayayurgopikā mudā ।।167।। vahniśuddhāṃśukānāṃ ca vāhikāścaiva kāścana ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravavāhikāḥ।।168।। kāścitsaṃgītaniratāḥ kāściccitrakathāratāḥ।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo ramyāḥ prayayuḥ śibikānvitāḥ।। ।।169।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśaścāśvāḥ koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo rathāḥ ।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśaścaiva śakaṭā dravyapūritāḥ ।। 170।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśaścaiva vṛṣendrā dravyavāhakāḥ ।। koṭiśaḥ koṭiśaścaiva daśalakṣāṇi hastinām ।।171।। hastipāṃkuśayuktāni yayurvṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। sarve vṛndāvanaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā śūnyagṛhaṃ mune ।।172।। vṛkṣamūle yathāsthānaṃ tasthuḥ sarve yathocitam ।। uvāca gopāñchrīkṛṣṇo gṛhāṃśceṣṭatamānvrajāḥ ।।173।। adya saṃtiṣṭhatetyevaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇabhāṣitam ।। kutra santi gṛhāḥ kṛṣṇetyevamūcustu gopakāḥ ।। iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇo vākyamabravīt ।। 174 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। atra sthāne gṛhāḥ santi prasannā devanirmitāḥ ।। 175 ।। devaprītiṃ vinā śaktā nahi draṣṭuṃ ca kecana ।। adya tiṣṭhata gopālāḥ saṃpūjya vanadevatāḥ ।। 176 ।। prātaryūyaṃ gṛhānramyāndrakṣyathādya dhruvaṃ mudā ।। dhūpadīpādinaivedyairbalibhiḥ puṣpacandanaiḥ ।।177।। devīṃ ca vaṭamūlasthāṃ pūjāṃ kuruta caṇḍikām ।। kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā gopāḥ saṃpūjya devatām ।। bhuktvā bhogāndine rātrau tatraiva suṣupurmudā ।।178।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde bakapralambakeśivadhapūrvakavṛndāvanagamanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 16 ।।
<4.17> ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। supteṣu vrajanandeṣu naktaṃ vṛndāvane vane ।। sunidrite ca nidreśe mātṛvakṣaḥsthalasthite ।। 1 ।। nidritāsu ca gopīṣu ramyatalpasthitāsu ca ।। yūnāṃ ca sukhasaṃyogānuṣaktamānasāsu ca ।। 2 ।। kāsucicchiśuyuktāsu sakhīyuktāsu kāsucit ।। kāsucicchakaṭasthāsu syaṃdanasthāsu kāsucit ।। 3 ।। pūrṇendukaumudīyukte svargādapi manohare ।। nānāprakārakusumavāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। 4 ।। sarvaprāṇini niśceṣṭe muhūrte pañcame gate ।। tatrājagāma bhagavāñchilpināṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।। 5 ।। bibhraddivyāṃśukaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ratnamālyaṃ manoharam ।। ratnālaṅkāramatulaṃ śrīmanmakarakuṇḍalam ।। 6 ।। jñānena vayasā vṛddho darśanīyaḥ kiśoravat ।। atīva sundaraḥ śrīmānkāmadevasamaprabhaḥ ।। 7 ।। viśiṣṭaśilpanipuṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ śilpitrikoṭibhiḥ ।। maṇiratnairhemaratnairlohāstrayutahastakaiḥ ।। 8 ।। ājagmuryakṣanikarāḥ kuberavanakiṃkarāḥ ।। sphāṭikāratnaveṣāśca dīrghaskandhāśca kecana ।। 9 ।। padmarāgakarā kecidindranīlakarā varāḥ ।। svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau ।। 124 ।। iṣṭālāpaṃ bahutaraṃ cakāra ca parasparam ।। vinayāvanato nandaḥ sambandhoktiṃ cakāra ha ।। 125 ।। nanda uvāca ।। śṛṇu rājendra vakṣyāmi viśeṣavacanaṃ śubham ।। saṃbandhaṃ kuru kanyāyā viśiṣṭena ca sāmpratam ।। 126 ।। surabhānusutaḥ śrīmānvṛṣabhānurvrajādhipaḥ ।। nārāyaṇāṃśo guṇavānsundaraśca supaṇḍitaḥ ।। 127 ।। sthirayauvanayuktaśca yogī jātismaro yuvā ।। kanyā te'yonisaṃbhūtā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā ।। 128 ।। trailokyamohinī śāntā kamalāṃśā kalāvatī ।। sa ca yogyastvadduhitustadyogyā te ca kanyakā ।। 129 ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃbandho guṇavānnṛpa ।। ityevamuktvā nandastu virarāma ca saṃsadi ।। uvāca taṃ nṛpaśreṣṭho vinayāvanato mune ।। ।। 130 ।। bhanandana uvāca ।। saṃbandho hi vidhivaśo na me sādhyo vrajādhipa ।। 131 ।। prajāpatiryogakartā janmadātā'hameva ca ।। kā kasya patnī kanyā vā varaḥ ko vā sasādhanaḥ ।। 132 ।। karmānurūpaphaladaḥ sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ vidhiḥ ।। bhavitavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma tadamoghaṃ śrutau śrutam ।। 133 ।। anyathā niṣphalaṃ sarvamanīśasyodyamo yathā ।। vṛṣabhānupriyā dhātrā likhitā cetsutā mama ।। ।। 134 ।। purā bhūtaiva ko vā'haṃ kenānyena nivāryate ।। ityevamuktvā rājendro vinayānatakaṃdharaḥ ।। 135 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa sādareṇa ca nārada ।। nṛpānujñāmupādāya vrajarājo vrajaṃ gataḥ ।। 136 ।। gatvā sa kathayāmāsa surabhānasya saṃsadi ।। surabhānaśca yatnena nandanena ca sādaram ।। 137 ।। saṃbandhaṃ yojayāmāsa gargadvārā ca satvaram ।। vivāhakāle rājendro vipulaṃ yautakaṃ dadau ।। ।। 138 ।। gajaratnamaśvaratnaṃ ratnāni maṇibhūṣaṇam ।। vṛṣabhānurmudā yuktaḥ prāpya tāṃ ca kalāvatīm ।। 139 ।। reme sunirjane ramye bubudhe na divāniśam ।। cakṣurnimeṣavirahādvyākulāṃ svāminā vinā ।। 140 ।। vyākulo vṛṣabhānuśca kṣaṇena ca tayā vinā ।। jātismarā ca sā kanyā māyāmānuṣarūpiṇī ।। 141 ।। jātismaro hareraṃśo vṛṣabhāno mudā'nvitaḥ ।। vavṛdhe ca tayoḥ prema nityaṃnityaṃ navaṃnavam ।। 142 ।। sadā sakāmā sā prauḍhā sa ca kāmasamo yuvā ।। tayoḥ kanyā ca kālena rādhikā sā babhūva ha ।। daivātsudāma śāpena śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā purā ।। 143 ।। ayonisaṃbhavā sā ca kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā satī ।। yasyā darśanamātreṇa tau vimuktau babhūvatuḥ।। ।। 144 ।। itihāsaśca kathitaḥ prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu sāmpratam ।। pāpendhanānāṃ dāhe ca jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ।।।44।।। vṛṣabhānāśramaṃ gatvā śilpināṃ pravaro mudā ।। sthānāntaraṃ viśvakarmā jagāma svagaṇaiḥ saha ।। 146 ।। krośamātraṃ sthalaṃ cāru manasā''locya tattvavit ।। āśramaṃ kartumārebhe nandasya sumahātmanaḥ ।। 147 ।। kṛtvā'numānaṃ buddhyā ca sarvato'pi vilakṣaṇam ।। parikhābhirgabhīrābhiścaturbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ varam ।। 148 ।। durlaṅghyābhirvairibhiśca khanitābhiśca prastaraiḥ ।। puṣyodyānaiḥ puṣpitābhiḥ pārāvāreṣu puṣpitaiḥ ।। 149।। cāru campakavṛkṣaiśca puṣpitaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। parito vāsitābhiśca sugandhivāyunā mune ।। 150 ।। āmrairguḍālaiḥ panasaiḥ kharjūrairnārikelakaiḥ ।। dāḍimaiḥ śrīphalairbhṛṅgairjambīrairnāgaraṅgakaiḥ ।।151।। tuṅgairāmrātakairjambusamūhaiśca phalānvitaiḥ ।। kadalīnāṃ ketakīnāṃ kadambānāṃ kadambakaiḥ ।। ।। 152 ।। sarvataḥ śobhitābhiśca phalaistaiḥ puṣpitairaho ।। krīḍārhābhirnigūḍhābhirvāñchitābhiśca sarvadā ।। 153 ।। parikhānāṃ rahaḥ sthāne cakāra mārgamuttamam ।। durgamaṃ paravargāṇāṃ svānāṃ ca sugamaṃ sadā ।। 154 ।। saṃketena maṇistambhaiśchāditaiḥ svalpapāthasā ।। stambhasīmākṛtamaho na saṃkīrṇaṃ na vistṛtam ।। 159 ।। parikhoparibhāge ca prākāraṃ sumanoharam ।। dhanuḥśatapramāṇaṃ ca cakārātisamucchritam ।। 156 ।। prastarasya pramāṇaṃ ca pañcaviṃśatihastakam ।। sindūrākāramaṇibhirnirmitaṃ cātisundaram ।। 157 ।। bāhye dvābhyāṃ ca saṃyuktamantare saptabhistathā ।। dvārbhiśca sanniruddhābhirmaṇisārakapāṭakaiḥ ।।158।। harinmaṇīnāṃ kalaśaiścitrayuktairvirājitam ।। maṇisāravikāraiśca kapāṭaiśca suśobhitam ।। 159 ।। svarṇasāravinirmāṇakalaśojjvalaśekharam ।। nandālayaṃ vinirmāya babhrāma nagaraṃ punaḥ ।। 160 ।। rājamārgāśca vividhānsa ca cārūṃścakāra ha ।। raktabhānuvikāraiśca vedībhiśca supattanaiḥ ।। 161 ।। pārāvāre ca parito nibandhāṃśca manoharān ।। vāṇijyārhaiśca vaṇijāṃ parito maṇimaṇḍapaiḥ ।। 162 ।। sarvato dakṣiṇe vāme jvaladbhiśca virājitān ।। tato vṛndāvanaṃ gatvā nirmame rāsamaṇḍalam।।163।। sundaraṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ maṇiprākārasaṃyutam ।। parito yojanāyāmaṃ maṇivedibhiranvitam ।। 164 ।। maṇisāravikāraiśca maṇḍapairnavakoṭibhiḥ ।। śṛṅgārārhaiśca citrāḍhyai ratitalpasamanvitaiḥ ।। 165 ।। nānājātiprasūnānāṃ vāyunā surabhīkṛtaiḥ ।। ratnapradīpasaṃyuktaiḥ suvarṇakalaśojjvalaiḥ ।। 166 ।। puṣpodyānaiḥ puṣpitaiśca sarobhiśca suśobhitam ।। rāsasthalaṃ vinirmāya jagāmānyatsthalaṃ puraḥ ।। 167 ।। dṛṣṭvā vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ parituṣṭo babhūva ha ।। vṛndāvanābhyantare ca sthānesthāne sunirjane ।। 168 ।। kṛtvā parimitaṃ buddhyā manasālocya yatnataḥ ।। vilakṣaṇāni ramyāṇi tatra triṃśadvanāni ca ।। 169 ।। rādhāmādhavayoreva krīḍārthaṃ ca vinirmame ।। tato madhuvanābhyāśe nirjane'timanohare ।। 170।। vaṭamūlasamīpe ca sarasaḥ paścime taṭe ।। campakodyānapūrvāyāṃ ketakīvanamadhyataḥ ।।171।। punastayośca krīḍārthaṃ cakāra ratnamaṇḍapam ।। caturbhirvedikābhiśca parītamatisundaram ।।172।। sadratnasāraracitai rājitaṃ tūlikāśataiḥ ।। amūlyaratnaracitairnānācitreṇa citritaiḥ।।173।। kapāṭairnavabhiryuktaṃ navadvārairmanoharaiḥ ।। ratneṃdracittrakalaśaiḥ kṛtrimaiśca trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 174 ।। paritaḥ parito bhittyāmūrdhvaṃ ca pariśobhitam ।। mahāmaṇīndravikṛtairārohairnavabhirvṛtam ।।175।। sadratnasāraracitakalaśojjvalaśekharam।। patākātoraṇairyuktaṃ śobhitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।।176।। sarvataḥ purato dīptamamūlyaratna darpaṇaiḥ ।। dhanuḥpramāṇaśatakamūrdhvamagniśikhopamam ।।177।। śatahastapramāṇaṃ ca prastāraṃ vartulākṛtim ।। śobhitaṃ ratnakalpaiśca tadabhyantaramuttamam ।।178।। vahniśuddhāṃśukairvastrairmālājālavicitritaiḥ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālyopadhānasaṃyutaiḥ।।179।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiḥ surabhīkṛtam ।। navaśṛṅgārayogyaiśca kāmavarddhanakāribhiḥ ।। 180 ।। mālatīcampakānāṃ ca puṣparājibhiranvitam ।। sakarpūraiśca tāmbūlaiḥ sadratnapātrasaṃsthitaiḥ ।। 181 ।। vajrasāreṇa khacitairmuktājālavilambibhiḥ ।। ratnasāraghaṭākīrṇaṃ ratnapīṭhaiḥ susaṃyutam ।। 182 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanairyuktaṃ ratnacitreṇa citritaiḥ ।। kṣaritaiścandrakāntaiśca susiktaṃ jalabindubhiḥ।।183।। śītavāsitatoyena saṃyuktaṃ bhogavastubhiḥ ।। kṛtvā ratigṛhaṃ ramyaṃ nagaraṃ ca punaryayau ।। 184 ।। yāni yeṣāṃ mandirāṇi tannāmāni lilekha saḥ ।। mudā yukto viśvakarmā śiṣyairyakṣagaṇaiḥ saha ।। 185 ।। nidreśaṃ nidritaṃ natvā prayayau svālayaṃ mune ।। sarvatraivaṃ sukṛtināṃ samastaṃ bhagavatkṛpā ।। 186 ।। nehāścaryaṃ ca nagaraṃ babhūveśecchayā bhuvi ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamaṅgalam ।। sukhadaṃ pātakaharaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 187 ।। ।। nārada uvāca ।। kathaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma kānanasyāsya bhārate ।। vyutpattirasya saṃjñā vā tattvaṃ vada sutattvavit ।। 188 ।। sūta uvāca ।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣirnārāyaṇo mudā ।। prahasyovāca nikhilaṃ tattvameva purātanam ।। 189 ।। ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। purā kedāranṛpatiḥ saptadvīpapatiḥ svayam ।। 190 ।। āsītsatyayuge brahmansatyadharmarataḥ sadā ।। sa reme saha nārībhiḥ putrapautragaṇaiḥ saha ।। 191 ।। putrāniva prajāḥ sarvāḥ pālayāmāsa dhārmikaḥ ।। kṛtvā kratuśataṃ rājā lebhe nendratvamīpsitam ।। 192 ।। kṛtvā nānāvidhaṃ puṇyaṃ phalakāṅkṣī na ca svayam ।। nityaṃ naimittikaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaprītipūrvakam ।। 193 ।। kedāratulyo rājendro na bhūto bhavitā punaḥ ।। putreṣu rājyaṃ saṃnyasya priyāṃ trailokyamohinīm ।। 194 ।। jaigīṣavyopadeśena jagāma tapase vanam ।। hareraikāntiko bhakto dhyāyate saṃtataṃ harim ।।195।। śaśvatsudarśanaṃ cakramasti yatsannidhau mune ।। ciraṃ taptvā muniśreṣṭho golokaṃ ca jagāma saḥ ।।196 ।। kedāraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ ca tannāmnā ca babhūva ha ।। tatrādyāpi mṛtaḥ prāṇī sadyo mukto bhaveddhruvam ।। 197 ।। kamalāṃśā tasya kanyā nāmnā vṛndā tapasvinī ।। na vavre sā varaṃ kaṃcidyogaśāstraviśāradā ।। 198 ।। datto durvāsasā tasyai harermantraḥ sudurlabhaḥ ।। sā viraktā gṛhaṃ tyaktvā jagāma tapase vanam ।। 199 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepe sunirjane ।। āvirbabhūva śrīkṛṣṇastatpuro bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 200 ।। prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānvaraṃ vṛṇvityuvāca saḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā sā rādhikā kāntaṃ śānte sundaravigraham ।। 201 ।। mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa sā sadyaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। sā ca śīghraṃ varaṃ vavre patistvaṃ me bhaveti ca ।। 202 ।। omityuktvā ca rahasi ciraṃ reme tayā saha ।। sā jagāma ca golokaṃ kṛṣṇena saha kautukāt ।। 203 ।। rādhā samā sā saubhāgyādgopīśreṣṭhā babhūva ha ।। vṛndā yatra tapastepe tattu vṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam ।। 204 ।। vṛndayā'tra kṛtā krīḍā tena vā munipuṃgava ।। athā'nyaṃ cetihāsaṃ ca śṛṇuṣva vatsa puṇyadam ।। 205 ।। yena vṛndāvanaṃ nāma nibodha kathayāmi te ।। kuśadhvajasya kanye dve dharmaśāstraviśārade ।। 206 ।। tulasīvedavatyau ca virakte bhavakarmaṇi ।। tapastaptvā vedavatī prāpa nārāyaṇaṃ param ।। 207 ।। sītā janakakanyā sā sarvatra parikīrtitā ।। tulasī ca tapastaptvā vāñchāṃ kṛtvā hariṃ prati ।। 206 ।। daivāddurvāsasaḥ śāpātprāpya śaṅkhāsuraṃ prati ।। paścātsaṃprāpya kamalākāntaṃ kāntaṃ manoharam ।। 209 ।। sā caiva hariśāpena vṛkṣarūpā sureśvarī ।। tasyāḥ śāpena ca hariḥ śālagrāmo babhūva ha ।। 210 ।। tathā tasthau ca satataṃ śilāvakṣasi suṃdarī ।। vistīrṇaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tulasīcaritaṃ ca te ।। tathā'pi ca prasaṃgena kiṃciduktaṃ mune punaḥ ।। 211 ।। tasyāśca tapasaḥ sthānaṃ tadidaṃ ca tapodhana ।। tena vṛndāvanaṃ nāma pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ ।। 212 ।। atha vā te pravakṣyāmi paraṃ hetvantaraṃ śṛṇu ।। yena vṛndāvanaṃ nāma puṇyakṣetrasya bhārate ।। 213 ।। rādhāṣoḍaśanāmnāṃ ca vṛndānāma śrutau śrutam ।। tasyāḥ krīḍāvanaṃ ramyaṃ tena vṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam ।। 214 ।। goloke prītaye tasyāḥ kṛṣṇena nirmitaṃ purā ।। krīḍārthaṃ bhuvi tannāmnā vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam ।। 215 ।। nārada uvāca ।। kāni ṣoḍaśa nāmāni rādhikāyā jagadguro ।। tāni me vada śiṣyāya śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। 216 ।। śrutaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ ca sāmavede nirūpitam ।। tathā'pi śrotumicchāmi tvatto nāmāni ṣoḍaśa ।। 217 ।। abhyaṃtarāṇi teṣāṃ vā tadanyānyeva me vibho ।। aho puṇyasvarūpāṇi bhaktānāṃ vāñchitāni ca ।। 218 ।। nāmāni teṣāṃ vyutpattiṃ sarveṣāṃ durlabhāni ca ।। pāvanāni jaganmāturjagatāmapi kāraṇam ।। 219 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rādhā rāseśvarī rāsavāsinī rasikeśvarī ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā kṛṣṇapriyā kṛṣṇasvarūpiṇī ।। 220 ।। kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasaṃbhūtā paramānandarūpiṇī ।। kṛṣṇā vṛndāvanī vṛndā vṛndāvanavinodinī ।। 221 ।। candrāvatī candrakāntā śatacandranibhānanā ।। nāmānyetāni sārāṇi teṣāmabhyantarāṇi ca ।। 222 ।। rādhetyevaṃ ca saṃsiddhā rākāro dānavācakaḥ ।। svayaṃ nirvāṇadātrī yā sā rādhā parikīrtitā ।। 223 ।। rāseśvarasya patnīyaṃ tena rāseśvarī smṛtā ।। rāse ca vāso yasyāśca tena sā rāsavāsinī ।। 224 ।। sarvāsāṃ rasikānāṃ ca devīnāmīśvarī parā ।। pravadanti purā santastena tāṃ rasikeśvarīm ।। 225 ।। prāṇādhikā preyasī sā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā sā ca kṛṣṇena parikīrtitā ।।226।। kṛṣṇasyātipriyā kāntā kṛṣṇo vā'syāḥ priyaḥ sadā ।। sarvairdevagaṇairuktā tena kṛṣṇapriyā smṛtā ।। 227 ।। kṛṣṇarūpaṃ sannidhātuṃ yā śaktā cāvalīlayā ।। sarvāṃśaiḥ kṛṣṇasadṛśī tena kṛṣṇasvarūpiṇī ।। 228 ।। vāmāṅgārdhena kṛṣṇasya yā saṃbhūtā parā satī ।। kṛṣṇavāmāṅgasaṃbhūtā tena kṛṣṇena kīrtitā ।। 229 ।। paramānandarāśiśca svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī ।। śrutibhiḥ kīrtitā tena paramānandarūpiṇī ।। 230 ।। kṛṣirmokṣārthavacano na evotkṛṣṭavācakaḥ ।। ākāro dātṛvacanastena kṛṣṇā prakīrtitā ।।231।। asti vṛndāvanaṃ yasyāstena vṛndāvanī smṛtā ।। vṛndāvanasyādhidevī tena vā'tha prakīrtitā ।।232।। saṃghaḥ sakhīnāṃ vṛndaḥ syādakāro'pyastivācakaḥ ।। sakhivṛndo'sti yasyāśca sā vṛndā parikīrtitā ।।233।। vṛndāvane vinodaśca so'syā hyasti ca tatra vai ।। vedā vadanti tāṃ tena vṛndāvanavinodinīm।।234।। nakhacandrāvalīvakracandro'sti yatra saṃtatam।। tena candrāvalī sā ca kṛṣṇena parikīrtitā ।।235।। candratulyā kāntirasti sadā yasyā divāniśam ।। sā candrakāntā harṣeṇa hariṇā parikīrtitā ।। 236 ।। śaraccandraprabhā yasyāścānane'sti divāniśam ।। muninā kīrtitā tena śaraccandraprabhānanā ।। 237 ।। idaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmoktamarthavyākhyānasaṃyutam ।। nārāyaṇena yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṅkaje ।।238।। brahmaṇā ca purā dattaṃ dharmāya janakāya me ।। dharmeṇa kṛpayā dattaṃ mahyamādityaparvaṇi ।। 239 ।। puṣkare ca mahātīrthe puṇyāhe devasaṃsadi ।। rādhāprabhāvaprastāve suprasannena cetasā ।। 240 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tubhyaṃ dattaṃ mayā mune ।। nindakāyāvaiṣṇavāya na dātavyaṃ mahāmune ।। 241 ।। yāvajjīvamidaṃ stotraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। rādhāmādhavayoḥ pādapadme bhaktirbhavediha ।। 242 ।। ante labhettayordāsyaṃ śaśvatsahacaro bhavet ।। aṇimādikasiddhiṃ ca saṃprāpya nityavigraham ।। 243 ।। vratadānopavāsaiśca sarvairniyamapūrvakaiḥ ।। caturṇāṃ caiva vedānāṃ pāṭhaiḥ sarvārthasaṃyutaiḥ ।। 244 ।। sarveṣāṃ yajñatīrthānāṃ karaṇairvidhibodhitaiḥ ।। pradakṣiṇena bhūmeśca kṛtsnāyā eva saptadhā ।। 245 ।। śaraṇāgatarakṣāyāmajñānāṃ jñānadānataḥ ।। devānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśanenāpi yatphalam ।। 246 ।। tadeva stotrapāṭhasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। stotrasyāsya prabhāveṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। 247 ।। nārada uvāca ।। saṃprāptaṃ paramāścaryaṃ stotraṃ sarvasudurlabham ।। kavacaṃ cāpi devyāśca saṃsāravijayaṃ prabho ।। ।। 248 ।। kṛtaṃ stotraṃ suyatnena prāptaṃ tadapi durlabham ।। śrutvā kṛṣṇakathāṃ citrāṃ tvatpādābjaprasādataḥ ।। 249 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi yadrahasyaṃ ca tadvada ।। prātaśca nagaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kimūcurballavā mune ।। 250 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gatāyāṃ tatra yāminyāṃ gate ca viśvakarmaṇi ।। aruṇodayavelāyāṃ janāḥ sarve jajāgaruḥ ।। 251 ।। utthāya dṛṣṭvā nagaraṃ sarvebhyo'pi vilakṣaṇam ।। kimāścaryaṃ kimāścaryamityūcurvrajavāsinaḥ ।। 252 ।। kāścidgopānkecidūcuḥ kuta etadabhūdidam ।। na jāne kena rūpeṇa ko bhūmau prabhavediti ।। 253 ।। bubudhe manasā nando gargavākyamanusmaran ।। śrīharericchayā sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram ।। 254 ।। brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ yasya bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā ।। āvirbhūtaṃ tirobhūtaṃ tasyāsādhyaṃ ca kiṃ kutaḥ ।। 255 ।। vivareṣveva yallomnāṃ brahmāṇḍānyakhilāni ca ।। īśasya tanmahāviṣṇoḥ kimasādhyaṃ hareraho ।। 256 ।। brahmānanteśadharmāśca dhyāyante yatpadāmbujam ।। kimasādhyaṃ tadīśasya māyāmānuṣarūpiṇaḥ ।। 257 ।। bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ tannagaraṃ darśaṃdarśaṃ gṛhaṃgṛham ।। pāṭhaṃpāṭhaṃ ca nāmāni sarvebhyo nilayaṃ dadau ।। 258 ।। kṛtvā śubhakṣaṇaṃ nando vṛṣabhānaśca kautukī ।। cakāra sagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ mudā''śramaniveśanam ।। 259 ।। sarve vṛndāvanasthāśca prasannavadanekṣaṇāḥ ।। mudā praveśanaṃ cakruḥ svasvamāśramamuttamam ।। 260 ।। sarve mumudire gopāḥ svesve sthāne manohare ।। bālakā bālikāścaiva cikrīḍuśca praharṣitāḥ ।। 261 ।। śrīkṛṣṇo baladevaśca śiśubhiḥ saha kautukāt ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra tatraiva sthānesthāne manohare ।। 262 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ nirmāṇaṃ nagarasya ca ।। abalānāṃ vane rāsamaṇḍalasya ca nārada ।। 263 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīvṛndāvananagaravarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 17 ।।
<4.18> ।। śaunaka uvāca ।। aho kimadbhutaṃ sūta rahasyaṃ sumanoharam ।। śrutaṃ kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ param ।। 1 ।। sūta uvāca ।। śrutvā nagaranirmāṇaṃ nārado munisattamaḥ ।। papraccha kṛṣṇacaritamaparaṃ sumanoharam ।। 2 ।। nārada uvāca ।। śrīkṛṣṇākhyānacaritaṃ pīyūṣamṛṣisattama ।। jñānasiṃdho nigada māṃ śiṣyaṃ ca śaraṇāgatam ।। 3 ।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā mudā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। uvāca paramīśasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 4 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ balena saha mādhavaḥ ।। jagāma śrīmadhuvanaṃ yamunātīranīrajam ।। 5 ।। vicerurgosahasraiśca cikrīḍurbālakāstadā ।। viśrāntāstṛṭparītāśca kṣudhā ca paripīḍitāḥ ।। 6 ।। tamūcurgopaśiśavaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parayā mudā ।। kṣudasmānbādhate kṛṣṇa kiṃ kurmo brūhi kiṃkarān।।7।। śiśūnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca dayānidhiḥ ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vacanaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।।8।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। bālā gacchata viprāṇāṃ yajñasthānaṃ sukhāvaham ।। annaṃ yācata tāñchīghraṃ brāhmaṇāṃśca kratūnmukhān ।। 9 ।। viprā āṃgirasāḥ sarve svāśrame śrīvanāntike ।। yajñaṃ kurvanti viprāśca śrutismṛtiviśāradāḥ ।। 10।। niḥspṛhā vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve māṃ yajanti mumukṣavaḥ। māyayā māṃ na jānanti māyāmānuṣarūpiṇam ।। 11 ।। na ceddadati yuṣmabhyamannaṃ viprāḥ kratūnmukhāḥ ।। tatkāntā yācata kṣipraṃ dayāyuktāḥ śiśūnprati ।। 12 ।। śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā yayurbālakapuṃgavāḥ ।। purato brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tasthurānamrakaṃdharāḥ ।। 13 ।। ityūcurbālakāḥ śīghramannaṃ datta dvijottamāḥ ।। na śuśruvurdvijāḥ kecitkecicchrutvā sthitāḥ sthitāḥ।।14।। te yayū randhanāgāraṃ brāhmaṇyo yatra pācikāḥ ।। gatvā bālā viprabhāryāḥ praṇemurnatakandharāḥ ।। 19 ।। natvocurbālakāḥ sarve viprabhāryāḥ pativratāḥ ।। annaṃ datta mātaro'smānkṣudhārtānbālakānapi ।। 16 ।। bālānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tāṃśca manoharān ।। papracchuḥ sādaraṃ sādhvyaḥ smerānanasaroruhāḥ ।।17।। viprapatnya ūcuḥ ।। ke yūyaṃ preṣitāḥ kena kāni nāmāni kovidāḥ ।। dāsyāmo'nnaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vyañjanaiḥ sahitaṃ varam ।। 18 ।। brāhmaṇīnāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā tā ūcuste mudā'nvitāḥ ।। snigdhā hasantaḥ sphītāśca sarve gopālabālakāḥ ।। 19 ।। bālā ūcuḥ ।। preṣitā rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ vayaṃ kṣutpīḍitā bhṛśam ।। dattānnaṃ mātaro'smabhyaṃ kṣipraṃ yāmastadantikam ।। 20 ।। ito vidūre bhāṇḍīre vanābhyantarameva ca ।। vaṭamūle madhuvane vasantau rāmakeśavau ।। 21 ।। viśrāntau kṣudhitau tau ca yācete'nnaṃ ca mātaraḥ ।। kimu deyamadeyaṃ vā śīghraṃ vadata no'dhunā ।। 22 ।। gopānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭānandāśrulocanāḥ ।। pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgāstatpādābjamanorathāḥ ।। 23 ।। nānāvyañjanasaṃyuktaṃ śālyannaṃ sumanoharam।। pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ svādu dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu ।। 24 ।। raupye kāṃsye rājate ca pātre kṛtvā mudā'nvitāḥ ।। tāḥ sarvā viprapatnyaśca prayayuḥ kṛṣṇasannidhim ।। 25 ।। nānāmanorathaṃ kṛtvā manasā gamanotsukāḥ ।। pativratāstā dhanyāśca śrīkṛṣṇadarśanotsukāḥ ।। 26 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dadṛśurgatvā rāmaṃ ca saha bālakam ।। vaṭamūle vasantaṃ tamuḍumadhye yathoḍupam ।। 27 ।। śyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam ।। sundaraṃ sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ।।28।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ।। 29 ।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpurabhūṣitam ।। ājānulambitāṃ śubhrāṃ bibhrataṃ ratnamālikām ।। 30 ।। mālatīmālayā kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalavirājitam।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumāñcitavigraham ।।31 ।। sunakhaṃ sukapolaṃ ca pakva bimbādharaṃ varam ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhaṃ bibhrataṃ dantamuttamam ।। 32 ।। śikhipicchasamāyuktaṃ baddhacūḍaṃ parātparam।। kadambapuṣpayugmābhyāṃ karṇamūle virājitam ।। 33 ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ yogināṃ ca bhaktānugrahakātaram।। brahmeśadharmaśeṣendraiḥ stūyamānaṃ munīśvaraiḥ ।। 34 ।। dṛṣṭvaivamīśvaraṃ bhaktyā praṇemurdvijayoṣitaḥ ।। svānāṃ jñānānurūpaṃ ca tuṣṭuvurmadhusūdanam ।। 35 ।। viprapatnya ūcuḥ ।। tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ dhāma nirīho nirahaṃkṛtiḥ ।। nirguṇaśca nirākāraḥ sākāraḥ saguṇaḥ svayam ।।36।। sākṣirūpaśca nirliptaḥ paramātmā nirākṛtiḥ ।। prakṛtiḥ puruṣastvaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ ca tayoḥ param।। 37।। sṛṣṭisthityantaviṣaye ye ca devāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। te tvadaṃśāḥ sarvabījā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। ।। 38 ।। yasya lomnāṃ ca vivare cākhilaṃ viśvamīśvara।। mahāvirāṇmahāviṣṇustvaṃ tasya janako vibho ।। 39 ।। tejastvaṃ cāpi tejasvī jñānaṃ jñānī ca tatparaḥ ।। vede'nirvacanīyastvaṃ kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ ।। 40 ।। mahadādisṛṣṭisūtraṃ pañcatanmātrameva ca ।। bījaṃ tvaṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ sarvaśaktisvarūpakaḥ ।। 41 ।। sarvaśaktīśvaraḥ sarvaḥ sarvaśaktyāśrayaḥ sadā ।। tvamanīhaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ sarvānandaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 42 ।। aho'pyākārahīnastvaṃ sarvavigrahavānapi।। sarveṃdriyāṇāṃ viṣayaṃ jānāsi nendriyī bhavān ।। 43 ।। sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā yatstotre yannirūpaṇe।। jaḍībhūto maheśaśca śeṣo dharmo vidhiḥ svayam।। 44 ।। pārvatī kamalā rādhā sāvitrī vedasūrapi ।। vedaśca jaḍatāṃ yāti ke vā śaktā vipaścitaḥ ।। 49 ।। vayaṃ kiṃ stavanaṃ kurmaḥ striyaḥ prāṇeśvareśvara ।। prasanno bhava no deva dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru।। ।। 46 ।। iti petuśca tā viprapatnyastaccaraṇāmbuje ।। abhayaṃ pradadau tābhyaḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।।47।। viprapatnīkṛtaṃ stotraṃ pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। sa gatiṃ viprapatnīnāṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 48 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। tāḥ padāmbhojapatitā dṛṣṭvā śrīmadhusūdanaḥ ।। varaṃ vṛṇuta kalyāṇaṃ bhavitā cetyuvāca ha ।। 49 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā viprapantyo mudā'nvitāḥ।। tamūcurvacanaṃ bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।। 50।। dvijapatnya ūcuḥ ।। varaṃ kṛṣṇa na gṛhṇīmo naḥ spṛhā tvatpadāmbuje ।। dehi svaṃ dāsyamasmabhyaṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ।। 51 ।। paśyāmo'nukṣaṇaṃ vaktrasarojaṃ tava keśava ।। anugrahaṃ kuru vibho na yāsyāmo gṛhaṃ punaḥ ।। 52 ।। dvijapatnīvacaḥ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ ।। omityuktvā trilokeśastasthau bālakasaṃsadi।। 53 ।। pradattaṃ viprapatnībhirmiṣṭamannaṃ sudhopamam ।। bālakānbhojayitvā tu svayaṃ ca bubhuje vibhuḥ।।54।। etasminnantare tatra śātakumbhaṃ rathaṃ param ।। dadṛśurviprapatnyaśca patantaṃ gaganādaho ।।55।। ratnadarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ ratnasāraparicchadam ।। ratnastambhairnibaddhaṃ ca sadratnakalaśojjvalam ।।56।। śvetacāmarasaṃyuktaṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitam ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam।।57।। śatacakrasamāyuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam।। veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadairdivyairvanamālāvibhūṣitaiḥ।।।98 ।। pītavastraparīdhānai ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaiḥ ।। navayauvanasaṃpannaiḥ śyāmalaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ ।। 59 ।। dvibhujairmuralīhastairgopaveṣadharairvaraiḥ ।। śikhipicchaguñjamālābaddhavakrimacūḍakaiḥ ।। 60 ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ te praṇamya hareḥ padam ।। rathamārohaṇaṃ kartumūcurbrāhmaṇakāminīḥ ।। 61 ।। viprabhāryā hariṃ natvā jagmurgolokamīpsitam ।। babhūvurgopikāḥ sadyastyaktvā mānuṣavigrahān ।। 62।। hariśchāyāṃ vinirmāya tāsāṃ ca viṣṇumāyayā ।। prasthāpayāmāsa gṛhānbrāhmaṇānāṃ svayaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 63 ।। viprāśca bhāryā uddiśya paramodvignamānasāḥ ।। anveṣaṇaṃ prakurvanto dadṛśuḥ pathi kāminīḥ ।। 64 ।। dṛṣṭvocurbrāhmaṇāḥ sarve tāste ca vinayānvitāḥ ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgāḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇāḥ ।। ।। 65 ।। brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ ।। aho'tidhanyā yūyaṃ ca dṛṣṭo yuṣmābhirīśvaraḥ ।। asmākaṃ jīvanaṃ vyarthaṃ vedapāṭho'pyanarthakaḥ ।। 66 ।। vede purāṇe sarvatra vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।। harervibhūtayaḥ sarvāḥ sarveṣāṃ janako hariḥ ।। 67 ।। tapo japo vrataṃ jñānaṃ vedā dhyayanamarcanam ।। tīrthasnānamanaśanaṃ sarveṣāṃ phalado hariḥ ।। 68 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sevito yena kiṃ tasya tapasāṃ phalaiḥ ।। prāptaḥ kalpataruryena kiṃ tasyānyena śākhinā ।। 69 ।। śrīkṛṣṇo hṛdaye yasya tasya kiṃ karmabhiḥ kṛtaiḥ ।। kiṃ vā na sāgarasyaiva pauruṣaṃ kūpalaṅghane।। ।। 70।। ityevamuktvā viprāśca gṛhītvā kāminīvarāḥ ।। ājagmuḥ svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭāstābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca remire ।।71।। tāsāṃ tato'dhikaṃ prema krīḍāsu sarvakarmasu ।। dākṣiṇyaṃ māyayā śaktyā brāhmaṇānāmatarkitam ।।72।। atha nārāyaṇaḥ so'yaṃ balena śiśubhiḥ saha ।। jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ pūrṇabrahma sanātanaḥ ।।73।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ harermāhātmyamuttamam ।। purā śrutaṃ dharmavaktrātkiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। vigraho'syaiva kṛṣṇasya bhaktadhyānārthameva ca ।। 157 ।। jyotiḥsvarūpasya vibhornādyantamadhyamātmanaḥ ।। jalaplute ca brahmāṇḍe jalaśāyī janārdanaḥ ।। 158 ।। yannābhipadmajo brahmā tasyeśasya hrade vipat ।। maśakaścetkṣamo grastuṃ brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ pitaḥ ।। 159 ।। na tathā'pi tadīśaṃ taṃ grastuṃ sarpaḥ kṣamo bhavet ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamādhyātmikamanuttamam ।। 160 ।। nigūḍhaṃ yogināṃ sāraṃ saṃśayacchedakāraṇam ।। baladevavacaḥ śrutvā gargavākyamanusmaran ।। 161 ।। tatyāja śokaṃ nandaśca vrajaśca vrajayoṣitaḥ ।। prabodhaṃ menire sarve na yaśodā na rādhikā ।। 162 ।। bandhuvicchedaviṣaye prabodhe na sthitaṃ manaḥ ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇamutpatantaṃ jalānmune ।। 163 ।। dadṛśustaṃ suprasannā vrajāśca vrajayoṣitaḥ ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। 164 ।। asnigdhavastramasnigdhamaluptacandanāñjanam ।। sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 165 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca vaṃśīvadanamacyutam ।। yaśodā bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā vakṣasi sasmitā ।। 166 ।। cucumba vadanāmbhojaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇā ।। kroḍe cakāra nandaśca balaśca rohiṇī mudā ।। 167 ।। nimeṣarahitāḥ sarve dadṛśuḥ śrīmukhaṃ hareḥ ।। premāndhā bālakāḥ sarve cakrurāliṅganaṃ hareḥ ।। 168 ।। papuścakṣuścakoraiśca mukhacandraṃ ca gopikāḥ ।। etasminnantare tatra sahasā kānanāṃtaram ।। 159 ।। dāvāgnirveṣṭayāmāsa taiḥ sarvaiḥ saha gokulam ।। dṛṣṭvā śailapramāṇāgniṃ paritaḥ kānanāntare ।। 170 ।। praṇāśaṃ menire sarve bhayamāpuśca saṃkaṭe ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve saṃpuṭāñjalayo vrajāḥ ।। bālā gopyaśca saṃtrastā bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।। 171 ।। bālā ūcuḥ ।। yathā saṃrakṣitaṃ brahmansarvāpatsveva naḥ kulam ।। ।। 172 ।। tathā rakṣāṃ kuru punardāvāgnermadhusūdana ।। tvamiṣṭadevatā'smākaṃ tvameva kuladevatā ।। 173 ।। sraṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā jagatāṃ ca jagatpate ।। vahnirvā varuṇo vā'pi candro vā sūrya eva ca ।। 174 ।। yamaḥ kuberaḥ pavana īśānādyāśca devatāḥ ।। brahmeśaśeṣadharmendrā munīndrā manavaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 175 ।। mānavāśca tathā daityā yakṣarākṣasakiṃnarāḥ ।। ye ye carācarāścaiva sarve tava vibhūtayaḥ ।। 176 ।। āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca tathecchayā।। abhayaṃ dehi goviṃda vahnisaṃharaṇaṃ kuru ।। 177 ।। vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ yāmo rakṣa naḥ śaraṇāgatān ।। ityevamuktvā te sarve tasthurdhyātvā padāmbujam ।। 178 ।। dūrībhūtastu dāvāgniḥ śrīkṛṣṇāmṛtadṛṣṭitaḥ ।। dūrībhūte ca dāvāgnau nanṛtuste mudā'nvitāḥ ।। 179 ।। sarvāpadaḥ praṇaśyanti harismaraṇamātrataḥ ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet ।। 180 ।। vahnito na bhavettasya bhayaṃ janmani janmani ।। śatrugraste ca dāvāgnau vipattau prāṇasaṅkaṭe ।। 181 ।। stotrametatpaṭhitvā tu mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। śatrusainyaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti sarvatra vijayī bhavet ।। iha loke harerbhaktimante dāsyaṃ labheddhruvam ।। 182 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dāvāgnimokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā taiḥ sārddhaṃ śṛṇu nārada ।। jagāma śrīharirgehaṃ kuberabhavanopamam ।। 183 ।। brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ nandaḥ paripūrṇaṃ dadau mudā ।। bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa jñātivargāṃśca bāndhavān ।। 184 ।। nānāvidhaṃ maṅgalaṃ ca harernāmānukīrtanam।। vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa vipradvārā mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 185 ।। evaṃ mumudire sarve vṛndāraṇye gṛhegṛhe ।। śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojadhyānaikatānamānasāḥ ।।186।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamaṅgalam ।। kalikilbiṣakāṣṭhānāṃ dahane dahanopamam ।।187।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanma khaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde kālīyadamanadāvāgnimokṣaṇaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 19 ।।
<4.20> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā bālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ balena saha mādhavaḥ।। bhuktvā pītvā'nuliptaśca vṛndāraṇyaṃ jagāma ha ।।1।। krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānkautukena ca taiḥ saha ।। krīḍāni magnacittānāṃ dūraṃ tadgokulaṃ yayau ।। 2 ।। tasya prabhāvaṃ vijñātuṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। cakāra nihnutiṃ gāśca vatsāṃśca bālakānapi ।। 3 ।। vijñāya tadabhiprāyaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvakārakaḥ ।। punaścakāra tatsarvaṃ yogīndro yogamāyayā ।। 4 ।। jagāma śrīharirgehaṃ kālayitvā ca gokulam ।। balena bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ krīḍākautukamānasaḥ ।। 5 ।। evaṃ cakāra bhagavānvarṣamekaṃ ca pratyaham ।। yamunāgamanaṃ gobhirbalena saha bālakaiḥ ।। 6 ।। brahmā prabhāvaṃ vijñāya lajjānamrātmakandharaḥ ।। ājagāma hareḥsthānaṃ bhāṇḍīravaṭamūlake ।। 7 ।। dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ tatraiva gopālagaṇaveṣṭitam ।। yathā pārvaṇacandraṃ ca vibhāntaṃ svagaṇaiḥ saha ।।8।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca hasantaṃ sasmitaṃ mudā।। pītavastraparīdhānaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।।9।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmābhyāṃ svakapolasthalojjvalam ।। 10 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumārcitavigraham ।। 11 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvibhūṣitam ।। navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ prodbhinnanavayauvanam ।।12।। mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaṃ mayūrapicchacūḍakam ।। svāṅgasaundaryadīptyā ca kṛtabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 13 ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrasya prabhāmuṣṭāsyasundaram ।। pakvabimbādharauṣṭhaṃ ca khagendracañcunāsikam ।। 14 ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ prabhāmocanalocanam।। muktāpaṅktivinindyaikadantapaṅktimanoharam ।।15।। kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam।। śāntaṃ ca rādhikākāntaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ param।।16।। evaṃbhūtaṃ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāmātivismitaḥ।। darśaṃdarśamīśvaraṃ taṃ praṇanāma punaḥpunaḥ।।17।। yaddṛṣṭaṃ hṛdayāmbhoje tadrūpaṃ bahireva ca ।। yā mūrtiḥ purato dṛṣṭā sā paścātparitastataḥ ।।18।। tatra vṛndāvane sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasamaṃ mune ।। dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ tatra tasthau jagadguruḥ ।।19।। gāvo vatsāśca bālāśca latāgulmāśca vīrudhaḥ ।। sarvaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ brahmā śyāmarūpaṃ dadarśa ha ।। 20।। dṛṣṭvaivaṃ paramāścaryaṃ punardhyānaṃ cakāra ha ।। dadarśa trijagadbrahmā nānyatkṛṣṇaṃ vinā mune।।21।। kva ca vṛkṣaḥ kva vā śailaḥ kva mahī kva ca sāgarāḥ ।। kva devāḥ kva ca gandharvā munīndrāḥ kva ca mānavāḥ ।।22।। kva cātmā kva jagadbījaṃ kva svargaḥ kvāyameva ca।। sarvaṃ ca svadṛśā brahmā dadarśa māyayā hareḥ ।।23।। kva kṛṣṇo jagatāṃ nāthaḥ kva vā māyāvibhūtayaḥ ।। sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃcinnirvaktumakṣamaḥ ।। 24 ।। kiṃ staumi kiṃ karomīti manasaivaṃ pragṛhya ca ।। tatra sthitvā jagaddhātā japaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 25 ।। sukhaṃ yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā babhūva saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro'tidīnavat ।। 26 ।। iḍāṃ suṣumnāṃ madhyāṃ ca piṅgalāṃ nalinīṃ dhurām ।। nāḍīṣaṭkaṃ ca yogena nibaddhya ca prayatnataḥ ।। 27 ।। mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūraṃ manoharam ।। viśuddhaṃ paramājñākhyaṃ ṣaṭcakraṃ ca nibaddhya ca ।। 28 ।। laṅghanaṃ kārayitvā ca tatṣaṭcakraṃ kramādvidhiḥ।। brahmarandhraṃ samānīya vāyubandhaṃ cakāra ha।।29।। nibadhya vāyuṃ madhyāṃ tāmānīya hṛdayāmbujam।। taṃ vāyuṃ bhrāmayitvā ca yojayāmāsa madhyayā ।। 30 ।। evaṃ kṛtvā tu niṣpando yo datto hariṇā purā ।। jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ tasyaiva ca daśākṣaram ।।31।। muhūrtaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ padāmbujam ।। dadarśa hṛdayāmbhoje sarvatejomayaṃ mune ।।32।। tattejaso'ntare rūpamatīva sumanoharam ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasā ।। 33 ।। śrutimūlasthalanyastajvalanmakarakuṇḍalam ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। 34 ।। yaddṛṣṭaṃ brahmarandhre ca hṛdi tadbahireva ca ।। dṛṣṭvā ca paramāścaryaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।।35।। yatstotraṃ ca purā dattaṃ hariṇaikārṇave mune ।। tamīśaṃ tena vidhinā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। 36 ।। brahmovāca ।। sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।। sarvānirvacanīyaṃ taṃ namāmi śivarūpiṇam ।। 37 ।। navīnajaladākāraṃ śyāmasundaravigraham ।। sthitaṃ jantuṣu sarveṣu nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpiṇam ।। 38 ।। svātmārāmaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ jagadvyāpijagatparam ।। sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveṣāṃ bījarūpaṃ sanātanam ।। 39 ।। sarvādhāraṃ sarvavaraṃ sarvaśaktisamanvitam ।। sarvārādhyaṃ sarvaguruṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam ।। 40 ।। sarvamaṃtrasvarūpaṃ ca sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ varam ।। śaktiyuktamayuktaṃ ca staumi svecchāmayaṃ vibhum ।। 41 ।। śaktīśaṃ śaktibījaṃ ca śaktirūpadharaṃ varam ।। saṃsārasāgare ghore śaktinaukāsamanvitam ।। 42 ।। kṛpāluṃ karṇadhāraṃ ca namāmi bhaktavatsalam ।। ātmasvarūpamekāṃtaṃ liptaṃ nirliptameva ca ।।43।। saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ brahma staumi svecchāsvarūpiṇam।। sarvendriyādidevaṃ tamindriyālayameva ca ।।44।। sarvendriyasvarūpaṃ ca virāḍrūpaṃ namāmyaham ।। vedaṃ ca vedajanakaṃ sarvavedāṅgarūpiṇam।।45।। sarvamantasvarūpaṃ ca namāmi parameśvaram ।। sārātsārataraṃ dravyamapūrvamanirūpiṇam ।। 46 ।। svatantramasvatantraṃ ca yaśodānandanaṃ bhaje ।। santaṃ sarvaśarīreṣu tamadṛṣṭamanūhakam ।।47।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ vidyamānaṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ guruṃ bhaje ।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rāsollāsasamutsukam ।।48।। gopībhiḥ sevyamānaṃ ca taṃ dhareśaṃ namāmyaham ।। satāṃ sadaiva santaṃ tamasantamasatāmapi।।49।। yogīśaṃ yogasādhyaṃ ca namāmi śivasevitam।। mantrabījaṃ mantrarājaṃ mantradaṃ phaladaṃ phalam ।। ।। 50।। mantrasiddhisvarūpaṃ taṃ namāmi ca parātparam ।। sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca sukhadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ puṇyameva ca ।।51।। puṇyapradaṃ ca śubhadaṃ śubhabījaṃ namāmyaham ।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā gāśca sa bālakān ।। 92 ।। nipatya daṇḍavadbhūmau ruroda praṇanāma ca ।। dadarśa cakṣurunmīlya vidhātā jagatāṃ mune ।। 53 ।। brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śrīhareḥ padam ।। 54 ।। labhate dāsyamatulaṃ sthānamīśvarasannidhau ।। labdhvā ca kṛṣṇasānnidhyaṃ pārṣadapravaro bhavet ।। 55 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। gate jagatkāraṇe ca brahmalokaṃ ca brahmaṇi ।। śrīkṛṣṇo bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ jagāma svālayaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 56 ।। gāvo vatsāśca bālāśca jagmurvarṣāntare gṛham ।। śrīkṛṣṇamāyayā sarve menire te dināntaram ।। 57 ।। gopā gopālikā kiṃcittatkartuṃ na kṣamāstadā ।। yoginaḥ kṛtrimaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ nūtnaṃ vā purātanam ।। 58 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakālasukhāvaham ।। 59 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde govatsabālakaharaṇaprastāvo nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 20 ।।
<4.21> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā''nandayuktaśca nando gopavraje mune ।। dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa śakrayāgakṛtodyamaḥ ।। 1 ।। dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ guḍaṃ madhu ।। etānyādāya śakrasya pūjāṃ kurvantviti bruvan ।।2।। yeye santyatra nagare gopā gopyaśca bālakāḥ ।। bālikāśca dvijā bhūyo vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca bhaktitaḥ ।। 3 ।। ityevaṃ śrāvayāmāsa svayameva mudā'nvitaḥ ।। yaṣṭimāropayāmāsa ramyasthāne suvistṛte ।। 4 ।। dadau tatra kṣaumavastraṃ mālājālaṃ manoharam ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravameva ca ।। 5 ।। snātaḥ kṛtāhniko bhaktyā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī।। uvāsa svarṇapīṭhe ca prakṣālitapadāmbujaḥ ।।6।। nānāprakārapātraiśca brāhmaṇaiśca purohitaiḥ ।। gopālairgopikābhiśca bālābhiḥ saha bālakaiḥ ।। 7 ।। etasminnantare tatrājagmurnagaravāsinaḥ ।। mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhārā nānopāyanasaṃyutāḥ ।। 8 ।। ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। śāntāḥ śiṣyagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ ।। 9 ।। gargaśca gālavaścaiva śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ।। gautamaḥ karuṣaḥ kaṇvo vātsyaḥ kātyāyanastathā ।। 10 ।। saubharirvāmadevaśca yājñavalkyaśca pāṇiniḥ ।। ṛṣyaśṛṅgo gauramukho bharadvājaśca vāmanaḥ ।।11।। kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ śṛṅgī sumanturjaiminiḥ kacaḥ ।। parāśaraśca maitreyo vaiśampāyana eva ca ।। 12 ।। brāhmaṇāśca katividhā bhikṣukā bandinastathā ।। bhūpā vaiśyāśca śūdrāśca samājagmurmahotsave ।। 13 ।। dṛṣṭvā munīndrānnandaśca brāhmaṇānbhūmipāṃstathā ।। svarṇapīṭhātsamuttasthau vrajāścottasthureva ca।। 14 ।। praṇamya vāsayāmāsa munīndrānviprabhūmipān ।। teṣāmanumatiṃ prāpya tatrovāsa punarmudā ।। 15 ।। pākaṃ ca yaṣṭinikaṭe kartumājñāṃ cakāra ha ।। pākaprājñaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śatamānīya sādaram ।। 16 ।। tatra ratnapradīpāśca jajvaluḥ paritastathā ।। andhībhūtaṃ ca dhūpena sthānaṃ tatsurabhīkṛtam ।। 17 ।। nānāvidhāni puṣpāṇi mālyāni vividhāni ca ।। naivedyaṃ ca bahuvidhamapūrvaṃ sumanoharam ।। 18 ।। tilalaḍḍukapūrṇaṃ ca maṇḍakānāṃ sahasrakam ।। svastikaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ ca yaṣṭisthānaṃ ca nārada ।। 19 ।। kalaśānāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūrṇaṃ śarkarayā mune ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ laḍḍukairmadhurairvaraiḥ ।। 20।। ghṛtapakvairviprakṛtaiḥ pūrṇāni kalaśāni ca ।। vṛkṣapakvāni ramyāṇi cārurambhāphalāni ca ।।21।। phalāni paripakvāni kāladeśodbhavāni ca।। kṣīrāṇāṃ kumbhalakṣāṇi dadhnāṃ tāvanti nārada ।। 22 ।। madhūnāṃ kumbhaśatakaṃ sarpiṣkumbha sahasrakam ।। kalaśānāṃ trilakṣāṇi takrapūrṇāni niścitam ।। 23 ।। ghaṭānāṃ pañcalakṣāṇi guḍapūrṇāni niścitam ।। tilatailena pūrṇaṃ ca kalaśānāṃ sahasrakam ।। 24 ।। vṛṣendrāśca bahuvidhā bhogārhadravyavāhakāḥ ।। nānāvidhāni pātrāṇi sauvarṇarājatāni ca ।। 29 ।। svarṇapīṭhāni ca brahmannājagmuryaṣṭisannidhim ।। vastrāṇi varaṇārhāṇi cārūṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca ।। 25 ।। nānāvidhāni vādyāni cārūṇi madhurāṇi ca ।। vādakāḥ svarayantrāṇi vādayāmāsurutsave ।। 27 ।। chāgalānāṃ sahasrāṇi mahiṣāṇāṃ śatāni ca ।। meṣakāṇāṃ ca lakṣāṇi hyānayāmāsa tatra vai ।।28।। śatānyeva gaṇḍakānāmājagmuryaṣṭisaṃnidhim ।। prekṣitāni ca sarvāṇi rakṣitāni ca rakṣakaiḥ।।29।। bālakānāṃ bālikānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛkṣayoṣitām ।। yūnāṃ ca yuvatīnāṃ ca saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। 30।। gāyakānāṃ ca saṃgītaṃ nartakānāṃ ca nartanam ।। śrutvā dṛṣṭvā janāḥ sarve mumuhuḥ sumahotsave ।। 31 ।। raṃbhorvaśī menakā ca ghṛtācī mohinī ratiḥ ।। prabhāvatī bhānumatī vipracittistilottamā ।। 32 ।। candraprabhā suprabhā ca ratnamālā madālasā ।। reṇukā ramaṇī brahmannetā ājagmurutsave ।। 33 ।। tāsāṃ nṛtyena gītena stanāsyaśroṇidarśanāt ।। rūpeṇa vakradṛṣṭyā ca mūrcchāṃ prāpuśca mānavāḥ ।। 34 ।। etasminnantare śīghramājagāma hariḥ svayam ।। gopālabālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ balena balaśālinā।।35।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca janāḥ sarve saṃbhrāntā harṣavihvalāḥ ।। uttasthurārādbhītāśca pulakāṅkitavigrahāḥ ।। 36।। krīḍāsthānātsamāyāntaṃ śāntaṃ sundaravigraham।। vinodamuralīveṇuśṛṅgaśabdasamanvitam ।। 37 ।। sadratnasārabhūṣābhirbhūṣitaṃ kaustubhena ca ।। candanāgurupaṅkena carcitaṃ śyāmavigraham ।। 38 ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmāsyaṃ paśyantaṃ ratnadarpaṇe ।। cārucandanacandreṇa kastūrībindunā saha ।। 39 ।। śaśāṅkena yathā''kāśaṃ bhālamadhyavirājitam ।। mālatīmālayā śyāmakaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalojjvalam ।। 40।। bakapaṅktyā yathā''kāśaṃ śāradīyaṃ sunirmalam।। cāruṇā pītavastreṇa śobhitaṃ śyāmavigraham ।।41।। vibhāntaṃ vidyutā śaśvannavaniṃ nīradaṃ yathā ।। kundaprasūnairguñjābhirbaddhavakrimacūḍakam ।। 42 ।। yathendradhanuṣā bhāti vibhātaṃ bhagaṇairnabhaḥ ।। ratnakuṇḍaladīptyā ca smitavaktrasuśobhitam ।। 43 ।। śaratpraphullapadmaṃ ca dyumaṇeḥ kiraṇairyathā ।। viprakṣattriyavaiśyāśca munayo ballavā mune ।। 44 ।। praṇamya vāsayāmāsū ratnasiṃhāsane śubhe ।। uvāsa ratnapīṭhe sa teṣāṃ madhye jagatpatiḥ।। 45 ।। yathā babhau śaraccandro jyotiṣāmantare ca khe ।। śrutvā tamūcuste sarve jagatāmīśvaraṃ param ।। 46 ।। svecchāmayaṃ guṇātītaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। dṛṣṭvā mahotsavaṃ śīghramuvāca pitaraṃ hariḥ ।। sarveṣāṃ durlabhāṃ nītiṃ nītiśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। 47 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। bhobho ballavarājeṃdra kiṃ karoṣīha suvrata ।। 48 ।। ārādhyaḥ kaśca kā pūjā kiṃ phalaṃ pūjane bhavet ।। phalena sādhanaṃ kiṃ vā kaḥ sakhyaḥ sādhanena ca ।। 49 ।। deve ruṣṭe bhavetkiṃ vā pūjāyāḥ pratibandhake ।। tuṣṭo devaḥ kiṃ dadāti phalamatra paratrakam ।। 50 ।। kāciddadātyatra phalaṃ paratreha na kācana ।। kācicca nobhayatrāpi cobhayatrāpi kācana ।। 51 ।। avedavihitā pūjā sarvahānikaraṇḍikā ।। pūjeyamadhunā vā te kimu vā puruṣakramāt ।। 52 ।। dṛṣṭo devastvayā kasminpūjeyaṃ cānusāriṇī ।। sākṣātkhādati devaste sākṣātkiṃ vā na khādati ।। 53 ।। sākṣādbhuṅkte ca yo devaḥ supraśastaṃ tadarcanam ।। sākṣātkhādati naivedyaṃ viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। 54 ।। brāhmaṇe parituṣṭe ca saṃtuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। kiṃ tasya devapūjāyāṃ yo niyukto dvijārcane ।। 55 ।। pūjitā brāhmaṇā yena pūjitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। devāya dattvā naivedyaṃ dvijāya na prayacchati ।। 56 ।। bhasmībhūtaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pūjanaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet।। viprāya devanaivedyadānāddhruvamanantakam ।।57।। tuṣṭo devo varaṃ dattvā prayāti ca svamandiram ।। dattvā devāya naivedyaṃ mūḍho bhuṅkte svayaṃ yadi।।58।। dattāpahārī devasvaṃ bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet ।। devadattaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ naivedyaṃ ca vinā hareḥ ।।99।। praśastaṃ sarvadeveṣu viṣṇunaivedyabhojanam।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam ।। 60 ।। sarveṣāṃ ca kramamidaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। na dattvā vastu devāya dattaṃ viprāya cetsudhīḥ ।। 61 ।। bhuktvā vipramukhe devāstuṣṭāḥ svargaṃ prayānti ca ।। tasmātsarvaprayatnena viprāṇāmarcanaṃ kuru ।।62।। praśastaphaladātṝṇāmiha loke paratra ca।। japastapaśca pūjā vā yajñadānaṃ mahotsavam ।। 63 ।। sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ sāraṃ vipratuṣṭiśca dakṣiṇā ।। dakṣiṇānāṃ śarīreṣu tiṣṭhanti sarvadevatāḥ ।। ।।64।। pādeṣu sarvatīrthāni puṇyāni pādadhūliṣu ।। pādodake ca viprāṇāṃ tīrthatoyāni santi ca ।। 65 ।। tatsparśātsarvatīrtheṣu snānajanyaphalaṃ labhet ।। naśyaṃti bhakṣaṇādrogā bhaktibhāvena ballava ।।66।। saptajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। pāpaṃ pañcavidhaṃ kṛtvā yo vipraṃ praṇamedvraje ।।67।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvapāpātpramucyate ।। brāhmaṇasparśamātreṇa mukto bhavati pātakī ।। 68 ।। darśanānmucyate pāpāditi vede nirūpitam ।। aprājño vā'tha prājño vā brāhmaṇo viṣṇuvigrahaḥ ।। 69 ।। priyāḥ prāṇādhikā viṣṇorye viprā harisevinaḥ ।। dvijānāṃ haribhaktānāṃ prabhāvo durlabhaḥ śrutau ।। 70।। yeṣāṃ pādābjarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā।। teṣāṃ ca pādacihnaṃ yattīrthaṃ tatparikīrtitam ।। 71 ।। teṣāṃ ca sparśamātreṇa tīrthapāpaṃ praṇaśyati ।। āliṅganātsadālāpātteṣāmucchiṣṭabhojanāt ।। ।। 72 ।। darśanātsparśanāccaiva sarvapāpātpramucyate ।। bhramaṇe sarvatīrthānāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ snānato bhavet ।।73।। haridāsasya viprasya tatpuṇyaṃ darśanāllabhet ।। ye viprā haraye dattvā nityamannaṃ ca bhuñjate ।।74।। ucchiṣṭabhojanātteṣāṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhennaraḥ ।। na dattvā haraye bhaktyā bhuñjate cedbhramādapi ।। 75 ।। purīṣasadṛśaṃ vastu jalaṃ mūtrasamaṃ bhavet ।। śūdraśceddharibhaktaśca naivedyabhojanotsukaḥ ।। 76 ।। āmānnaṃ haraye dattvā kṛtvā pākaṃ ca khādati ।। viprakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śālagrāmaśilārcane ।।77।। adhikāro na śūdrāṇāṃ harerapyarcane tathā ।। dravyāṇyetāni gopendra viprebhyaścenna dāsyati ।।78।। bhasmībhūtāni sarvāṇi bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।। annaṃ ca sarvajīvebhyaḥ puṇyārthaṃ dātumarhati ।। 79 ।। dattvā viśiṣṭajīvebhyo viśiṣṭaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ।। ato dattvā mānuṣebhyo labhate'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam ।। 80 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vaiśyebhyo'nnaṃ pradāya ca।। dattvā'nnaṃ kṣatriyebhyo'pi vaiśyānāṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet।। kṣattriyāṇāṃ śataguṇaṃ viprebhyo'nnaṃ pradāya ca ।। 81 ।। viprāṇāṃ ca śataguṇaṃ śāstrajñe brāhmaṇe phalam ।। śāstrajñānāṃ śataguṇaṃ bhakte vipre labheddhruvam ।। 82 ।। sa cānnaṃ haraye dattvā bhuṅkte bhaktyā ca sādaram ।। viṣṇave viprabhaktāya dattvā dātuśca yatphalam ।। 83 ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ bhaktabrāhmaṇabhojane ।। bhakte tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo harau tuṣṭe ca devatāḥ ।। 84 ।। bhavanti siddhāḥ śākhāśca yathā mūlaniṣecanāt ।। dravyāṇyetāni devāya yadyekasmai prayacchati ।। 85 ।। sarve devāśca ruṣṭāśceddevaiḥ kaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ।। athavā'rddhaṃ ca vastūnāṃ dehi govardhanāya ca ।। 86 ।। gā vardhayati nityaṃ yastena govardhanaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। govardhanasamastāta puṇyavānna mahītale ।। 87 ।। nityaṃ dadāti gobhyo yo navīnāni tṛṇāni ca ।। tīrthasthāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ viprabhojane ।। 88 ।। sarvavratopavāseṣu sarveṣveva tapaḥsu ca ।। yatpuṇyaṃ ca mahādāne yatpuṇyaṃ harisevane ।। 89 ।। bhuvaḥ paryaṭane yattu sarvavākyeṣu yadbhavet ।। yatpuṇyaṃ sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣāyāṃ ca labhennaraḥ ।। 90 ।। tatpuṇyaṃ labhate prājño gobhyo dattvā tṛṇāni ca ।। bhuktavantīṃ tṛṇaṃ yaśca gāṃ vārayati kāmataḥ ।। 91 ।। brahmahatyā bhavettasya prāyaścittādviśudhyati।। sarve devā gavā maṅge tīrthāni tatpadeṣu ca ।। 92 ।। tadguhyeṣu svayaṃ lakṣmīstiṣṭhatyeva sadā pitaḥ ।। goṣpadāktamṛdā yo hi tilakaṃ kurute naraḥ।।93।। tīrthasnāto bhavetsadyo jayastasya padepade ।। gāvastiṣṭhaṃti yatraiva tattīrthaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 94 ।। prāṇāṃstyaktā narastatra sadyo mukto bhaveddhruvam ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmaṅgaṃ yo hanti mānavādhamaḥ ।। 95 ।। brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ bhavettasya na saṃśayaḥ ।। nārāyaṇāṃśānviprāṃśca gāśca ye ghnanti mānavāḥ ।। 96 ।। kālasūtraṃ ca te yānti yāvaccandradivākarau ।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo virarāma ca nārada ।।97।। ānandayukto nandaśca tamuvāca smitānanaḥ ।। nanda uvāca ।। paurvāparīyaṃ pūjeti mahendrasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 98 ।। suvṛṣṭisādhanī sādhyaṃ sarvasasyamanoharam ।। sasyāni prāṇināṃ prāṇāḥ sasyājjīvanti jīvinaḥ।।99।। pūjayanti vrajasthāśca mahendraṃ puruṣakramāt।। mahotsavaṃ vatsarānte nirvighnāya śivāya ca ।। 100 ।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā balena saha mādhavaḥ ।। uccairjahāsa sa punaruvāca pitaraṃ mudā ।। 1 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। aho śrutaṃ vicitraṃ te vacanaṃ paramādbhutam ।। upahāsyaṃ lokaśāstraṃ vedeṣveva vigarhitam ।। 2।। nirūpaṇaṃ nāsti kutra śakrādvṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate ।। apūrvaṃ nītivacanaṃ śrutamadya mukhāttava ।। 3 ।। śruṇu nītiṃ śrutimatāṃ he tāta nānayaṃ vadeḥ ।। vacanaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ santo jānanti sarvata।।4।। praśnaṃ kuruṣva mantrāṃśca vividhānapi saṃsadi।। bruvantu paramārthaṃ ca kimindrādvṛṣṭireva ca।।5।। sūryāddhi jāyate toyaṃ toyātsasyāni śākhinaḥ ।। tebhyo'nnāni phalānyeva tebhyo jīvanti jīvinaḥ ।।6।। sūryagrastaṃ ca nīraṃ ca kāle tasmātsamudbhavaḥ।। sūryo meghādayaḥ sarve vidhātrā te nirūpitāḥ ।। 7 ।। yatrābde yo jaladharo gajaśca sāgaro mataḥ ।। sasyādhipo nṛpo mantrī vidhātrā te nirūpitāḥ ।।8।। jalādikānāṃ sasyānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ ca nirūpitam ।। abde'bde'styeva tatsarvaṃ kalpe kalpe yugeyuge ।। 9 ।। hastī samudrādādāya kareṇa jalamīpsitam ।। dadyādghanāya taddadyādvātena prerito ghanaḥ ।। 110 ।। sthānesthāne pṛthivyāṃ ca kālekāle yathocitam।। īśecchayā''virbhūtaṃ ca na bhavetpratibandhakam ।। 11 ।। bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyacca mahatkṣudraṃ ca madhyamam ।। dhātrā nirūpitaṃ karma kena tāta nivāryate ।। 12।। jagaccarācaraṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ teneśvarājñayā ।। ādau vinirmitaṃ bhakṣyaṃ paścājjīva iti smṛtaḥ ।। 13 ।। abhyāsātsa svabhāvo hi svabhāvātkarma eva ca ।। jāyate karmaṇāṃ bhogo jīvināṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।। 14 ।। yātanājanmamaraṇarogaśokabhayāni ca ।। samutpattirvipadvidyā kavitā vā yaśo'yaśaḥ ।। 15 ।। puṇyaṃ ca svargavāsaśca pāpaṃ narakasaṃsthitiḥ ।। bhuktirmuktirharerdāsyaṃ karmaṇā ghaṭate nṛṇām ।। 16 ।। sarveṣāṃ janako hīśaścābhyāsaḥ śīlakarmaṇām ।। dhātuśca phaladātā ca sarvaṃ tasyecchayā bhavet ।।17।। vinirmito virāḍyena tattvāni prakṛtirjagat ।। kūrmaśca śeṣadharaṇī cābrahmastamba eva ca ।।18।। yasyājñayā marutkūrmaṃ dhakte śeṣaṃ bibharti saḥ ।। śeṣo vasundharāṃ mūrdhnā sā ca sarvaṃ carācaram ।। 19 ।। yasyājñayā sadā vāti jagatprāṇo jagattraye ।। tapati bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā bhūgolaṃ suprabhākaraḥ ।। 120 ।। dahatyagniḥ saṃcarate mṛtyuśca sarvajantuṣu ।। utpattiḥ śākhināṃ kāle puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ।। 21 ।। svesve sthāne
