mṛtyormṛtyuḥ kālakālo vidhāturvidhireva saḥ ।। bhaja taṃ śaraṇaṃ tāta sa te rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ।।24।। aho'ṣṭāviṃśadindrāṇāṃ patane yadaharniśam ।। vidhātureva jagatāmaṣṭottaraśatādhikaḥ ।। 25 ।। nimeṣādyasya patanaṃ nirguṇasyātmanaḥ prabhoḥ ।। evaṃbhūte tiṣṭhatīśe śakrapūjā viḍambanam ।।26।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo virarāma ca nārada।। praśaśaṃsuśca munayo bhagavantaṃ sabhāsadaḥ ।। 27 ।। nandaḥ sapulako hṛṣṭaḥ sabhāyāṃ sāśrulocanaḥ ।। ānandayuktā manujā yadi putraiḥ parā jitāḥ ।। 28 ।। śrīkṛṣṇājñāṃ samājñāya cakāra svastivācanam ।। krameṇa varaṇaṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ ca cakāra ha ।। 29 ।। parvatasyamunīṃdrāṇāṃ cakāra pūjanaṃ tadā ।। budhānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gavāṃ vahneśca sādaram ।। 130 ।। tatra pūjāsamāptau ca kratau ca sumahotsave ।। nānāprakāravādyānāṃ babhūva śabda ulbaṇaḥ ।। 31 ।। jayaśabdaḥ śaṅkhaśabdo hariśabdo babhūva ha ।। vedamaṅgalakāṇḍaṃ ca papāṭha munipuṅgavaḥ ।।32।। bandināṃ pravaro ḍiṇḍī kaṃsasya sacivaḥ priyaḥ ।। uccaiḥ papāṭha purato maṅgalaṃ maṅgalāṣṭakam ।।33।। kṛṣṇaḥ śailāntikaṃ gatcā bhinnāṃ mūrtiṃ vidhāya ca ।। vastu khādāmi śailo'smi varaṃ vṛṇvityuvāca ha।।34।। uvāca nandaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paśya śaulaṃ pitaḥ puraḥ।। varaṃ prārthaya bhadraṃ te bhavitā cetyuvāca ha ।।35।। harerdāsyaṃ harerbhaktiṃ varaṃ vavre sa ballavaḥ ।। dravyaṃ bhuktvā varaṃ dattvā so'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha।। ।। 36 ।। munīndrānbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva bhojayitvā ca gopapāḥ ।। bandibhyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca munibhyaśca dhanaṃ dadau ।।37।। munibhyo brāhmaṇebhyo'pi dattvā nando mudā'nvitaḥ ।। rāmakṛṣṇau puraskṛtya sagaṇaḥ svālayaṃ yayau ।।38।। raupyaṃ vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca varamaśvaṃ maṇiṃ tathā ।। bhakṣyaṃ dravyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ baṃdine ḍiṃḍine dadau ।। 39 ।। stutvā natvā rāmakṛṣṇau munayo brāhmaṇā yayuḥ ।। yayurapsarasaḥ sarvā gandharvāḥ kiṃnarāstathā ।। 140 ।। rājāno ballavāḥ sarve cāhūtā ye mahotsave ।। sarve praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ yayuḥ sādarapūrvakam ।। 41 ।। etasminnantare śakraḥ kopaprasphuritādharaḥ ।। makhabhaṃge bahuvidhāṃ niṃdāṃ śrutvā sureśvaraḥ ।। 42 ।। marudbhirvāridaiḥ sārdhaṃ rathamāruhya satvaram।। jagāma naṃdanagaraṃ vṛndāraṇyaṃ manoharam ।। 43 ।। sarve devā yayuḥ paścādyuddhaśāstraviśāradāḥ ।। śastrāstrapāṇayaḥ kopādrathamāruhya nārada ।।44।। vāyuśabdairmeghaśabdaiḥ sainyaśabdairbhayānakaiḥ ।। cakampe nagaraṃ sarvaṃ nando bhayamavāpa ha ।।9। bhāryāṃ saṃbodhya svagaṇamuvāca śokakātaraḥ ।। rahaḥ sthalaṃ samānīya nītiśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। 46 ।। nanda uvāca ।। he yaśode samāgaccha vacanaṃ śṛṇu rohiṇi ।। rāmakṛṣṇau samādāya vraja dūraṃ vrajātpriye ।। bālakā bālikā nāryo yāntu dūraṃ bhayākulāḥ ।। 47 ।। balavantaśca gopālāstiṣṭhaṃtu matsamīpataḥ ।। paścācca nirgamiṣyāmo vayaṃ ca prāṇasaṃkaṭāt ।।48 ।। ityuktvā ballavaśreṣṭhaḥ sasmāra śrīhariṃ bhiyā ।। puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। kāṇvaśākhoktastotreṇa tuṣṭāva ha śacīpatim ।। 49 ।। nanda uvāca ।। indraḥ surapatiḥ śakro ditijaḥ pavanāgrajaḥ ।। 150 ।। sahasrākṣo bhagāṅgaśca kaśyapāṅgaja eva ca ।। biḍaujāśca sunāsīro marutvānpākaśāsanaḥ ।।51।। jayantajanakaḥ śrīmāñchacīśo daityasūdanaḥ ।। vajrahastaḥ kāmasakho gautamīvratanāśanaḥ ।। 52 ।। vṛtrahā vāsavaścaiva dadhīcidehabhikṣukaḥ ।। viṣṇuśca vāmanabhrātā puruhūtaḥ purandaraḥ ।। 53 ।। divaspatiḥ śatamakhaḥ sutrāmā gotrabhidvibhuḥ ।। lekharṣabho balārātirjambhabhedī surāśrayaḥ ।।54।। saṃkrandano duścyavanasturāṣāṇmeghavāhanaḥ ।। ākhaṇḍalo harihayo namuciprāṇanāśanaḥ ।। 55 ।। vṛddhaśravā vṛṣaścaiva daityadarpaniṣūdanaḥ ।। ṣaṭcatvāriṃśannāmāni pāpaghnāni viniścitam ।। 56 ।। stotrametatkauthumoktaṃ nityaṃ yadi paṭhennaraḥ ।। mahāvipattau śakrastaṃ vajrahastaśca rakṣati ।। 57 ।। ativṛṣṭiśilāvṛṣṭivajrapātācca dāruṇāt ।। kadācinna bhayaṃ tasya rakṣitā vāsavaḥ svayam ।। 58 ।। yatra gehe stotramidaṃ yaśca jānāti puṇyavān ।। na tatra vajrapatanaṃ śilāvṛṣṭiśca nārada ।। 59 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। stotraṃ naṃdamukhācchrutvā cukopa madhusūdanaḥ ।। 60।। uvāca pitaraṃ nītiṃ prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। kaṃ stauṣi bhīro ko vendrastyaja bhītiṃ mamāntike ।। 61 ।। kṣaṇārddhe bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamo'hamavalīlayā।। gāśca vatsāṃśca bālāṃśca yoṣito hi bhayāturāḥ ।।62।। govardhanasya kuhare saṃsthāpya tiṣṭha nirbhayam ।। bālasya vacanaṃ śrutvā taccakāra mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 63 ।। harirdadhāra śailaṃ taṃ vāmahastena daṇḍavat ।। etasminnantare tatra dīpto'pi ratnatejasā ।। 64 ।। andhībhūtaśca sahasā babhūva rajasā''vṛtaḥ ।। savāto meghanikaraścacchāda gaganaṃ mune ।। 65 ।। vṛndāvane babhūvātivṛṣṭireva nirantaram।। śilāvṛṣṭirvajravṛṣṭirulkāpātaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।। 66 ।। samastaṃ parvatasparśātpatitaṃ dūratastataḥ ।। viphalastatsamārambho yathā'nīśodyamo mune ।। 67 ।। dṛṣṭvā moghaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ sadyaḥ śakraścukopa ha ।। jagrāhāmoghakuliśaṃ dadhīcyasthivinirmitam ।। ।। 68 ।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ vajrahastaṃ ca jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ ।। sahastaṃ stambhayāmāsa vajramevātidāruṇam ।। 69 ।। sahāmaragaṇaṃ moghaṃ cakārastaṃbhanaṃ vibhuḥ।। sarve tasthurniścalāste bhittau puttalikā yathā ।। 170 ।। hariṇā jṛmbhitaḥ śakraḥ sadyastaṃdrāmavāpa ha ।। dadarśa sarvaṃ tandrāyāṃ tatra kṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat ।। 71 ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।। pītavastraparīdhānaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanasthitam ।।72।। । īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgametatsarvaṃ carācaram ।। 73 ।। dṛṣṭvā'dbhutatamaṃ tatra sadyo mūrcchāmavāpa ha ।। jajāpa mantraṃ tatraiva pradattaṃ guruṇā purā ।। 74 ।। sahasradalapadmasthaṃ dadarśa jyotirulbaṇam ।। tatrāntare divyarūpamatīva sumanoharam ।। ।।75।। navīnajaladotkarṣaṃ śyāmasundaravigraham ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇajvalanmakarakuṇḍalam ।। 76।। jvalanmaṇīndramakarakirīṭojjvala śekharam ।। jvalatā kaustubheṃdreṇa kaṇṭhavakṣaḥsthalojjvalam ।।77।। maṇikeyūravalayamaṇimañjīraraṃjitam ।। antarbahiḥ samaṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। 78 ।। indra uvāca ।। akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। guṇātītaṃ nirākāraṃ svecchāmayamanaṃtakam ।। ।। 79 ।। bhaktadhyānāya sevāyai nānārūpadharaṃ varam ।। śuklaraktapītaśyāmaṃ yugānukramaṇena ca ।। 180 ।। śuklatejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca satye satyasvarūpiṇam।। tretāyāṃ kuṃkumākāraṃ jvalaṃtaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 81 ।। dvāpare pītavarṇaṃ ca śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā ।। kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kalau kṛṣṇaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ prabhum ।। 82 ।। navadhārādharotkṛṣṭaśyāmasundaravigraham ।। nandaikanandanaṃ vande yaśodānandanaṃ prabhum ।।83।। gopikācetanaharaṃ rādhāprāṇādhikaṃ param ।। vinodamuralīśabdaṃ kurvantaṃ kautukena ca ।।84 ।। rūpeṇāpratimenaiva ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। kandarpakoṭisaundaryaṃ bibhrataṃ śāntamīśvaram।।89।। krīḍantaṃ rādhayā sārdhaṃ vṛndāraṇye ca kutracit ।। kutracinnirjane'raṇye rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitam ।।86।। jalakrīḍāṃ prakurvantaṃ rādhayā saha kutracit ।। rādhikākabarībhāraṃ kurvantaṃ kutracidvane ।। 87 ।। kutracidrādhikāpāde dattavantamalaktakam।। sadā carvitatāmbūlaṃ gṛhṇantaṃ kutracinmudā ।।88।। paśyantaṃ kutracidrādhāṃ paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā।। dattavantaṃ ca rādhāyai kṛtvā mālāṃ ca kutracit ।। 89 ।। kutracidrādhayā sārdhaṃ gacchantaṃ rāsamaṃḍalam ।। rādhādattāṃ gale mālāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ ca kutracit ।। 190 ।। sārdhaṃ gopālikābhiśca viharantaṃ ca kutracit ।। rādhāṃ gṛhītvā gacchantaṃ vihāya tāṃ ca kutracit ।। 91 ।। viprapatnīdattamannaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca kutracit।। bhuktavantaṃ tālaphalaṃ bālakaiḥ saha kutracit ।।92।। vastraṃ gopālikānāṃ ca harantaṃ kutracinmudā ।। gavāṃ gaṇaṃ vyāharantaṃ kutracidbālakaiḥ saha ।। 93 ।। kālīyamūrdhni pādābjaṃ dattavantaṃ ca kutracit ।। vinodamuralīśabdaṃ kurvantaṃ kutracinmudā ।। 94 ।। gāyantaṃ ramyasaṅgītaṃ kutracidbālakaiḥ saha।। stutvā śakraḥ stavendreṇa praṇanāma hariṃ bhiyā ।।95।। purā dattena guruṇā raṇe vṛtrāsureṇa ca।। kṛṣṇena dattaṃ kṛpayā brahmaṇe ca tapasyate ।।96।। ekādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kavacaṃ sarvalakṣaṇam ।। dattametatkumārāya puṣkare brahmaṇā purā ।।97।। kumāro'ṅgirase dattaṃ gurave'ṅgirasā mune ।। idamindrakṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। 98 ।। sa hi prāpya dṛḍhāṃ bhaktimante dāsyaṃ labheddhruvam।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokebhyo mucyate naraḥ ।। na hi paśyati svapne'pi yamadūtaṃ yamālayam।।99।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। indrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prasannaḥ śrīniketanaḥ।। 200।। prītyā tasmai varaṃ dattvā sthāpayāmāsa parvatam ।। praṇamya ca hariṃ śakraḥ prayayau svagaṇaiḥ saha ।।1।। gahvarasthā janāḥ sarve prajagmurgahvarādgṛham ।। te sarve menire kṛṣṇaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum ।। 2 ।। puraskṛtya vrajasthāṃśca prayayau svālayaṃ hariḥ ।। tuṣṭāva naṃdaḥ putraṃ taṃ pūrṇabrahma sanātanam ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo bhaktipūrṇāśrulocanaḥ ।। 3 ।। nanda uvāca ।। namo brahmaṇyadevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca ।।4।। jagaddhitāya kṛṣṇāya govindāya namonamaḥ ।। namo brahmaṇyadevāya brahmaṇe paramātmane ।। 5 ।। anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍadhāmadhāmne namo'stu te ।। namo matsyādirūpāṇāṃ jīvarūpāyasākṣiṇe ।।6।। nirliptāya nirguṇāya nirākārāya te namaḥ।। atisūkṣmasvarūpāya sthūlātsthūlatamāya ca ।।7।। sarveśvarāya sarvāya tejorūpa namo'stu te।। atipratyakṣarūpāya dhyānāsādhyāya yoginām ।।8।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ vandyāya nityarūpiṇe ।। dhāmne caturṇṇāṃ varṇānāṃ yugeṣveva caturṣu ca ।।9।। śuklaraktapītaśyāmābhidhānaguṇaśāline ।। yogine yogarūpāya gurave yogināmapi ।। 210।। siddheśvarāya siddhāya siddhānāṃ gurave namaḥ ।। yaṃ stotumakṣamo brahmā viṣṇuryaṃ stotumakṣamaḥ ।।11।। yaṃ stotumakṣamo rudraḥ śeṣo yaṃ stotumakṣamaḥ ।। yaṃ stotumakṣamo dharmo yaṃ stotumakṣamo raviḥ ।।12।। yaṃ stotumakṣamo lambodaraścāpi ṣaḍānanaḥ ।। yaṃ stotumakṣamāḥ sarve munayaḥ sanakādayaḥ ।।13।। kapilo na kṣamaḥ stotuṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ।। na śaktau stavanaṃ kartuṃ naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।।14।। anye jaḍadhiyaḥ ke vā stotuṃ śaktāḥ parātparam।। vedā na śaktā no vāṇī na ca lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।।15।। na rādhā stavane śaktā kiṃ stuvanti vipaścitaḥ ।। kṣamasva nikhilaṃ brahmannaparādhaṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe ।। 16 ।। rakṣa māṃ karuṇā sindho dīnabandho bhavārṇave ।। purā tīrthe tapastaptvā putraḥ prāptaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 17 ।। svakīyacaraṇāmbhoje bhaktiṃ dāsyaṃ ca dehi me ।। brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā sālokyādikameva vā ।।18।। tvatpadāmbhojadāsyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। indratvaṃ vā suratvaṃ vā saṃprāptiṃ siddhisvargayoḥ ।।19।। rājatvaṃ cirajīvitvaṃ sudhiyo gaṇayanti kim ।। etadyatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ brahmatvādikamīśvara ।। 220 ।। bhaktasaṅgakṣaṇārddhasya nopamā te kimarhati ।। tvadbhakto yastvatsadṛśaḥ kastvāṃ tarkitumīśvaraḥ ।।21।। kṣaṇārddhālāpamātreṇa pāraṃ kartuṃ sa ceśvaraḥ ।। bhaktasaṅgādbhavatyeva bhaktiṃ kartumanekadhā ।। 22 ।। tvadbhaktajaladālāpajalasekena varddhate ।। abhaktālāpatāpāttu śuṣkatāṃ yāti tatkṣaṇam ।। ।। 23 ।। tvadguṇasmṛtisekācca varddhate tatkṣaṇe sphuṭam ।। tvadbhaktyaṅkuramudbhūtaṃ sphītaṃ mānasajaṃ param ।। 24 ।। na naśyaṃ varddhanīyaṃ ca nityaṃnityaṃ kṣaṇekṣaṇe ।। tataḥ saṃprāpya brahmatvaṃ bhaktasya jīvanāya ca ।। 25 ।। dadātyeva phalaṃ tasmai haridāsyamanuttamam ।। saṃprāpya durlabhaṃ dāsyaṃ yadi dāso babhūva ha ।। 26 ।। suniścayena tenaiva jitaṃ sarvaṃ bhayādikam ।। ityevamuktvā bhaktyā ca nandastasthau hareḥ puraḥ ।। 27 ।। prasannavadanaḥ kṛṣṇo dadau tasmai tadīpsitam ।। evaṃ nandakṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet ।।28।। sudṛḍhāṃ bhaktimāpnoti sadyo dāsyaṃ labheddhareḥ ।। tapastaptvā yadā droṇastīrthe ca dharayā saha ।।29।। stotraṃ tasmai purā dattaṃ brahmaṇā tatsudurlabham ।। hareḥ ṣaḍakṣaro mantraḥ kavacaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam ।। 230।। iha saubhariṇā dattaṃ tasmai tuṣṭena puṣkare ।। tadeva kavacaṃ stotraṃ sa ca mantraḥ sudurlabhaḥ।। ।। 31 ।। brahmaṇoṃ'śena muninā nandāya ca tapasyate ।। mantraḥ stotraṃ ca kavacamiṣṭadevo gurustathā ।। 32 ।। yā yasya vidyā prācīnā na tāṃ tyajati niścitam ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamadbhutam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ bhavabandhavimocanam ।। 233 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde indrayāgabhañjano nāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।21।।
<4.22> ।।śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā rādhikānātho balena saha bālakaiḥ ।। jagāma tattālavanaṃ paripakvaphalānvitam ।। 1 ।। vṛkṣāṇāṃ rakṣitā daityaḥ khara rūpī ca dhenukaḥ।। koṭisiṃhasamabalo devānāṃ darpanāśanaḥ ।।2।। śarīraṃ parvatasamaṃ kūpatulye ca locane ।। īṣāpaṃktisamā dantāstuṇḍaṃ parvatagahvaram ।। 3 ।। śatahastaparimitā jihvā lolā bhayānakā ।। kāsārasadṛśī nābhiḥ śabdastasya bhayānakaḥ ।। 4 ।। dṛṣṭvā tālavanaṃ bālā harṣamāpuraninditāḥ ।। kautukātkṛṣṇamūcuste smerānanasaroruhāḥ ।। 5 ।। bālā ūcuḥ ।। he kṛṣṇa karuṇāsindho dīna bandho jagatpate ।। mahābala balabhrātaḥ samastabalināṃ vara ।। 6 ।। avadhānaṃ kuru vibho kṣaṇārddhaṃ no nivedane ।। kṣudhitānāṃ śiśūnāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsala ।। 7 ।। svādūni sundarāṇyeva paśya tālaphalāni ca ।। bhaṅktuṃ cālayituṃ vṛkṣānpātituṃ ca phalāni ca ।। 8 ।। nānāvarṇāni puṣpāṇi pakvāni durlabhāni ca ।। ājñāṃ karoṣi cetkṛṣṇa ceṣṭāṃ karttu vayaṃ kṣamāḥ ।।9।। kiṃ tvatra daityo balavānkhararūpī ca dhenukaḥ ।। ajitastridaśaiḥ sarvairmahābalaparākramaḥ ।। 10 ।। durnivāryaśca sarveṣāṃ kaṃsasya sacivo mahān ।। hiṃsakaḥ sarvajantūnāṃ vanānāmasti rakṣitā ।। 11 ।। suvicārya jagatkānta vada no vadatāṃ vara ।। yuktaṃ kāryamayuktaṃ vā kartavyamatha vā na vā ।। 12 ।। bālakānāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ ।। uvāca madhuraṃ bālānvacanaṃ tatsukhāvaham ।। 13 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। kiṃ vo daityādbhayaṃ bālā yūyaṃ matsahacāriṇaḥ ।। vṛkṣānbhaṅktvā cālayitvā phalāni khādatābhayam ।। 14 ।। śrīkṛṣṇājñāṃ samādāya bālakā balaśālinaḥ ।। utpeturvṛkṣaśikharaṃ kṣudhitāśca phalārthinaḥ ।। 15 ।। nānāprakāravarṇāni svādūni sundarāṇi ca ।। phalāni pātayāmāsuḥ paripakvāni nārada ।। 16 ।। kecidbabhañjurvṛkṣāśca cālayāmāsureva ca ।। kecitkolāhalaṃ cakurnanṛtustatra kecana ।। 17 ।। avaruhya tarubhyaśca bālakā balaśālinaḥ ।। phalānyādāya gacchanto dadṛśurdaityapuṅgavam ।। 18 ।। mahābalaṃ mahākāyaṃ ghoraṃ gardabharūpiṇam ।। āgacchantaṃ mahāvegātkurvantaṃ śabdamulbaṇam ।। 19 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruruduḥ sarve phalāni tatyajurbhiyā ।। kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti śabdaṃ ca pracakrurbahudhā bhṛśam ।। 20 ।। asmānrakṣa samāgaccha he kṛṣṇa karuṇānidhe ।। he saṅkarṣaṇa no rakṣa prāṇā no yānti dānavāt।।21।। he kṛṣṇa he kṛṣṇa hare murāre govinda dāmodara dīnabandho।। gopīśagopeśa bhavārṇave'smā nananta nārāyaṇa rakṣa rakṣa ।।22।। bhaye'bhaye vātha śubhe'śubhe vā sukheṣu duḥkheṣu ca dīnanātha ।। tvayā vinā'nyaṃ śaraṇaṃ bhavārṇave na no'sti he mādhava rakṣa rakṣa।।23।। jayajaya guṇasindho kṛṣṇa bhaktaikabandho bahutarabhayayuktānbālakānrakṣa rakṣa ।। jahi danujakulānāmīśamasmāka mantaṃ surakulabaladarpaṃ vardhayemaṃ nihatya ।। 24 ।। bālānāṃ viklavaṃ dṛṣṭvā balena saha mādhavaḥ ।। ājagāma śiśusthānaṃ bhayahā bhakta vatsalaḥ ।। 25 ।। bhayaṃ nāsti bhayaṃ nāstītyuktvā dudrāva satvaram ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo nirbhayaṃ dattavāñchiśūn ।। 26 ।। dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ bālā nanṛturvijahurbhayam ।। harismṛtiścābhayadā sarvamaṅgaladāyikā।।27।। śrīkṛṣṇo dānavaṃ dṛṣṭvā grasantaṃ purataḥ śiśūn।। balaṃ saṃbodhya balinamuvāca madhusūdanaḥ ।। 28 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। dānavo baliputro'yaṃ nāmnā sāhasiko balī ।। gardabho brahmaśāpena śapto durvāsasā purā ।।29।। pāpiṣṭho mama vadhyo'yaṃ mahābalaparākamaḥ ।। ahamenaṃ vadhiṣyāmi tvaṃ rakṣa bālakānbala ।। 30।। ādāya bālakānsarvāndūraṃ gacchetyuvāca ha ।। tāngṛhītvā balaḥ śīghraṃ jagāma tvarayājñayā ।। 31 ।। dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ dānavendro mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। jagrāsa līlayā kopājjvaladagniśikhopamam ।। 32 ।। babhūvātidāhayukto martukāmo'titejasā ।। ujjagrāsa punardaityo vibhuṃ tejasvinaṃ bhiyā ।।33।। ujjhitaṃ santamīśaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā daityo mumoca ha।। atīva sundaraṃ śāntaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।।34।। kṛṣṇadarśanamātreṇa babhūvāsya purā smṛtiḥ ।। ātmānaṃ bubudhe kṛṣṇaṃ jagatāṃ kāraṇaṃ param ।। 35 ।। tejaḥsvarūpamīśaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva dānavaḥ ।। yathāgamaṃ yathājanma guṇātītaṃ śruteḥ param ।। 36 ।। dānava uvāca ।। vāmano'si tvamaṃśena matpituryajñabhikṣukaḥ ।। rājyahartā ca śrīhartā sutalasthaladāyakaḥ ।। 37 ।। balirbhaktivaśo vīraḥ sarveśo bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। śīghraṃ tvaṃ hindhi māṃ pāpaṃ śāpādgardabharūpiṇam ।। 38 ।। munerdurvāsasaḥ śāpādīdṛśaṃ janma kutsitam ।। mṛtyuruktaśca muninā tvatto mama jagatpate ।। 39 ।। ṣoḍaśāreṇa cakreṇa sutīkṣṇenātitejasā ।। jahi māṃ jagatāṃ nātha sadbhaktiṃ kuru mokṣada ।। 40।। tvamaṃśena varāhaśca samuddhartuṃ vasundharām ।। vedānāṃ rakṣitā nātha hiraṇyākṣaniṣūdanaḥ ।। 41 ।। tvaṃ nṛsiṃhaḥ svayaṃ pūrṇo hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe ।। prahrādānugrahārthāya devānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ।। ।। 42 ।। tvaṃ ca vedoddhārakartā mīnāṃśena dayānidhe ।। nṛpasya jñānadānāya rakṣāyai suraviprayoḥ ।। 43 ।। śeṣādhāraśca kūrmastvamaṃśena sṛṣṭihetave ।। viśvādhāraśca viśvastvamaṃśenāpi sahasradhṛk ।।44।। rāmo dāśarathistvaṃ ca jānakyuddhārahetave ।। daśakandharahantā ca sindhau setuvidhāyakaḥ ।।45।। kalayā paraśurāmaśca jamadagnisuto mahān ।। triḥsaptakṛtvo bhūpānāṃ nihantā jagatīpate ।। 46 ।। aṃśena kapilastvaṃ ca siddhānāṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।। mātṛjñānapradātā ca yogaśāstravidhāyakaḥ ।। 47 ।। aṃśena jñānināṃ śreṣṭho naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। tvaṃ ca dharmasuto bhūtvā lokavistārakārakaḥ ।।48।। adhunā kṛṣṇarūpastvaṃ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ।। sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ bījarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 49 ।। yaśodājīvano nityo nandaikānandavardhanaḥ ।। prāṇādhidevo gopīnāṃ rādhāprāṇādhikapriyaḥ ।। 50।। vasudevasutaḥ śānto devakīduḥkhabhañjanaḥ ।। ayonisaṃbhavaḥ śrīmānpṛthivībhārahārakaḥ ।। 51 ।। pūtanāyai mātṛgatiṃ pradātā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। bakakeśipralambānāṃ mamāpi mokṣakārakaḥ ।। 52 ।। svecchāmaya guṇātīta bhaktānāṃ bhayabhañjana ।। prasīda rādhikānātha prasīda kuru mokṣaṇam ।। ।।53।। he nātha gārdabhīyoneḥ samuddhara bhavārṇavāt।। mūrkhastvadbhaktaputro'haṃ māmuddhartuṃ tvamarhasi ।। 54 ।। vedā brahmādayo yaṃ ca munīndrāḥ stotumakṣamāḥ ।। kiṃ staumi taṃ guṇātītaṃ purā daityo'dhunā kharaḥ ।।55।। evaṃ kuru kṛpāsindho yena me na bhavejjanuḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā pādāravindaṃ te kaḥ punarbhavanaṃ vrajet ।।56।। brahmā stotā kharaḥ stotā nopahāsitumarhasi।। sadīśvarasya vijñasya yogyāyogye samā kṛpā ।। 57 ।। ityevamuktvā daityendrastasthau ca purato hareḥ ।। prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānatituṣṭo babhūva ha ।।58।। idaṃ daityakṛtaṃ stotraṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā ca yaḥ paṭhet ।। sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpyaṃ līlayā labhate hareḥ।।59।। iha loke harerbhaktimante dāsyaṃ sudurlabham।। vidyāṃ śriyaṃ sukavitāṃ putrapautrānyaśo labhet ।। 60 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śrutvā'numene daityendrastavanaṃ karuṇānidhiḥ ।। kathaṃ karomi saṃhāramīdṛśaṃ bhaktamityaho ।। ।।61।। anumanya smṛtiṃ tasya saṃjahāra hariḥ svayam ।। na hi yukto vadhaḥ stoturdurvakturvidhirīśvarāt ।।62।। dānavo māyayā viṣṇorvisasmāra punaḥ svakam।। duruktistatkaṇṭhadeśe hyadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra ha।।63।। uvāca śrīhariṃ daityaḥ kopātprasphuritādharaḥ ।। mune sadyo martukāmo daivagrasto vicetanaḥ ।।64।। daitya uvāca।। dhruvaṃ tvaṃ martukāmo'si durbuddhe mānavārbhaka ।। adya prasthāpayiṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ yamamandiram ।। ।।65।। āyāsi jīvanākāṅkṣī mama tālavanaṃ śiśo।। na yāsyasi punargehaṃ bāndhavaṃ na hi drakṣyasi ।।66।। na kaṃso na jarāsandho narako na samo mama ।। devāḥ kampanti me nityaṃ ke cānye matsamā bhuvi ।।67।। nahi saṃhārakartā ca māṃ saṃhartuṃ kṣamaḥ śivaḥ ।। na ca brahmā na viṣṇuśca na mṛtyuḥ kāla eva ca ।।68।। mama tālatarūnbhaṅktvā pātayitvā phalāni ca ।। ahaṃkaroṣi sahasā kimaho kasya tejasā ।। 69 ।। kastvaṃ vada baṭo satyaṃ kamanīyo'tisundaraḥ ।। durlabhaṃ jīvanaṃ dātuṃ mahyaṃ kathamihāgataḥ ।। 70 ।। ityuktvā mastake kṛtvā prerayitvā tu taṃ balī ।। dūrataḥ pātayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ maraṇonmukhaḥ ।। 71 ।। pātayitvā ca taṃ bhūmau viṣāṇābhyāṃ jaghāna saḥ ।। kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa tadviṣāṇe babhañjatuḥ ।।72।। daityo bhagnaviṣāṇaśca tamīśaṃ kopayanmune ।। jagrāsa carvaṇaṃ kartuṃ bhagnadanto babhūva ha ।। 73 ।। tejasā dagdhavaktraśca tamujjagrāha tatkṣaṇe ।। jajvāla vyathitaḥ kopāddadāra khurato mahīm ।। 74 ।। cūrṇayitvā tu lāṃgūlaṃ śabdaṃ kṛtvā bhayānakam ।। sa jagāma śiśusthānaṃ dudruvurbālakā bhiyā ।। 79।। balaṃ ca prerayāmāsa mastakena mahābalī ।। balo muṣṭiṃ dadau tasmai mūrcchāmāpa tato'suraḥ ।।76।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya jagāma harisannidhim ।। balamuṣṭyā ca vyathitaḥ punarmūrcchāmavāpa saḥ ।। 77 ।। punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau vyathākulaḥ ।। utsasarja bṛhalleḍaṃ mūtraṃ ca bhayamāpa ha ।।78।। kṣaṇātsaṃdhikṣaṇaṃ prāpya mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। kṛtvā śirasi govindaṃ cūrṇayāmāsa dānavaḥ ।। 79 ।। pātayāmāsa bhūmau taṃ cūrṇayitvā punaḥpunaḥ ।। utpāṭya tālavṛkṣaṃ taṃ tāḍayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।। 80।। yathā khaḍgaprahāreṇa dānavasya bhavedvyathā ।। tathā babhūva daityasya tālavṛkṣasya tāḍanāt ।।81।। । govardhanaṃ samutpāṭya ghātayāmāsa taṃ vibhuḥ ।। papāta vegācchailendrastasyopari mahāmune ।।82।। parvatasya prahāreṇa mūrcchāmāpa mahābalaḥ।। । babhūva jarjarāṅgaśca rudhiraṃ ca samudvaman ।। 83 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau ruṣā'suraḥ ।। gṛhītvā parvataśreṣṭhaṃ prerayāmāsa mādhavam । ।। 84 ।। dṛṣṭvā śailamutpatantaṃ vegena madhusūdanaḥ ।। jagrāha dakṣiṇakare yathekṣudaṇḍavatprabhuḥ ।। 85 ।। pūrvasthāne parvataṃ taṃ sthāpayāmāsa kautukāt ।। gṛhītvā daityakarṇāgraṃ pātayāmāsa dūrataḥ ।। 86 ।। utpatya ca mahāvegāccakāra veṣṭanaṃ hareḥ ।। pṛthivīṃ gharṣayāmāsa tīkṣṇāgreṇa khureṇa ca ।। 87 ।। pragṛhya śrīhariṃ vegātkṛtvā mūrdhni mahāsuraḥ ।। utpapāta manoyāyī līlayā lakṣayojanam ।। 88 ।। praharaṃ ca tayoryuddhaṃ nirlakṣe ca babhūva ha ।। tato gṛhītvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ papāta dharaṇītale ।। 89 ।। punarmuhūrtaṃ yuddhaṃ ca babhūva bhūtale tayoḥ ।। mudā hariḥ praśaśaṃsa prahasya dānaveśvaram ।। 90 ।। madbhaktasya baleḥ putraṃ dhanyaṃ tajjīvanaṃ param।। svastyastu te dānavendra vatsa nirvāṇatāṃ vraja ।। 91 ।। maddarśanaṃ svastibījaṃ paraṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam ।। sarvādhikaṃ sarvaparaṃ labha sthānaṃ manoharam ।। 92 ।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sasmāra cakramuttamam ।। sūryakoṭisamaṃ dīptyā jagrāha tatsudarśanam ।।93।। cikṣepa bhrāmayitvā ca ṣoḍaśāramanuttamam ।। ciccheda līlayā'vadhyaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ ।। 94 ।। papāta mastakaṃ bhūmau dānavasya mahātmanaḥ ।। tejaḥsamūha uttasthau śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ।। 95 ।। vilokya harilokaṃ saṃśliṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇapadāmbuje ।। saṃprāpya paramaṃ mokṣamaho dānavapuṅgavaḥ ।। 96 ।। gaganasthāḥ surāḥ sarve munayaśca bhṛśaṃ mudā ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ cakruste tatra varṣaṇam ।।97।। nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।। jagurgandharvanikarā stuṣṭuvurmunayo mudā ।। 98 ।। stutvā jagmuḥ surāḥ sarve munayo harṣavihvalāḥ ।। dhenukasya vadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrājagmuśca bālakāḥ ।। 99 ।। balaśca balināṃ śreṣṭhastuṣṭāva puruṣottamam ।। tuṣṭuvurbālakāḥ sarve nanṛtuśca mudā'nvitāḥ ।। 100 ।। dattvā kṛṣṇabalābhyāṃ ca prapakvāni phalāni ca ।। sarvāṇi bhakṣayāmāsurbālāḥ prahaṣṭamānasāḥ ।। 101 ।। bhuktvā pītvā hariḥ śīghraṃ balena bālakaiḥ saha ।। jagāma svālayaṃ brahmannihatya dānaveśvaram।।102।। iti śrībahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyanāradasaṃvāde dhenukavadhonāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 22 ।।
<4.23> nārada uvāca ।। kena pāpena balijo gardabhatvamavāpa ha ।। durvāsāḥ kena doṣeṇa śaśāpa dānaveśvaram ।। 1 ।। kena puṇyena vā nātha balinaḥ śrīhareḥ padam ।। sahasaikatvamuktiṃ ca saṃprāpa dānavādhipaḥ ।। 2 ।। mune sarvaṃ suvistārya vada saṃdehabhañjana ।। aho kavimukhe kāvyaṃ nūtnaṃnūtnaṃ padepade ।। 3 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। purā śrutaṃ dharmavaktrātparvate gandhamādane ।। 4 ।। pādmakalpe ca vṛttāntaṃ vicitraṃ sumanoharam ।। nārāyaṇakathopetaṃ karṇapīyūṣamuttamam ।। 5 ।। yatra kalpe kathā ceyaṃ tatra tvamupabarhaṇaḥ ।। ākalpajīvī saśrīkaḥ sundaraḥ sthirayauvanaḥ ।। 6 ।। paṃcāśatkāminīnāṃ ca patiḥ śṛṅgāratatparaḥ ।। vareṇa brahmaṇastvaṃ ca sukaṇṭho gāyaneśvaraḥ ।। 7 ।। anukṣaṇaṃ papustāste sundaraṃ mukhapaṅkajam ।। nimeṣarahitāḥ sarvāḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ ।। 8 ।। tāsāṃ prāṇaiśca ghaṭito vidhinā tvamiva śrutam ।। divāniśaṃ sahacarā na jīvanti tvayā vinā ।। ।। 9 ।। puṣpodyāne ca rahasi sthānesthāne manorame ।। gahvareṣu ca śailānāṃ kandareṣu nadīṣu ca ।। 10 ।। kānaneṣu ca ramyeṣu śmaśāne jantuvarjite ।। yathāmanorathaṃ tāśca krīḍāṃ cakrustvayā saha ।। 11 ।। tadā daivādvidheḥ śāpādbhūtvā dāsīsuto bhavān ।। adhunā brahmaṇaḥ putro vaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt ।। 12 ।। asaṃkhyakalpajīvī ca vaiṣṇavapravaro mahān ।। jñānadṛṣṭyā sarvadarśī priya śiṣyaśca dhūrjaṭeḥ ।। 13 ।। tasya kalpasya vṛttāntaṃ mune matto niśāmaya ।। vistārya daityavṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmi sudhopamam ।।14।। ekadaiva baleḥ putro nāmnā sāhasiko balī ।। svatejasā surāñjitvā pratasthe gandhamādanam ।। 19 ।। candenokṣitasarvāṅgo ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaśca bahusainyasamanvitaḥ ।। 16 ।। etasminnantare tena pathā yāti tilottamā ।। rūpeṇāpsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā nānāveṣavidhāyinī ।। 17 ।। cārucampakavarṇābhā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। navayauvanasampannā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। 18 ।। īṣaddhāsya prasannāsyā divyavastraṃ subibhratī ।। vakrabhūbhaṅgayuktā sā gajendramandagāminī ।। 19 ।। stanamūruṃ mukhenduṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sāhasiko yuvā ।। vāyunā muktavastrāyāstasyā mūrcchāmavāpa ha ।। 20 ।। sā dadarśa baleḥ putramatīva sumanoharam ।। praphullamālatīmālāṃ bibhrataṃ navayauvanam ।। 21 ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ susmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ vismitā kāmātkaṭākṣaṃ ca cakāra sā ।। 22 ।। krīḍāyai candralokaṃ ca gacchantī candrakāmukī ।। tasthau kena cchalenaiva mattā śṛṅgāralālasā ।। 23 ।। darśaṃdarśaṃ ca tasyāsya prahasya vakracakṣuṣā ।। mukhasyācchādanaṃ cakre vāsasā sā punaḥpunaḥ ।। 24 ।। pulakāṃkitasarvāṅgaṃ dharmakarmasamanvitam ।। babhūva kāmamattāyā yonau kaṇḍūyanaṃ jalam ।। 25 ।। visasmāra śaśadharaṃ baliputramanorathā ।। aho ko veda bhuvane durjñeyaṃ puṃścalīmanaḥ ।। 26 ।। puṃścalyāṃ yo hi viśvasto vidhinā sa viḍambitaḥ ।। bahiṣkṛtaśca yaśasā dharmeṇa svakulena ca।।27।। vāñchitaṃ nūtanaṃ prāpya vinaśyati purātanam ।। tadā svakarmasādhyā sā ko vā tasyāḥ priyo'priyaḥ ।।28।। daive karmaṇi paitrye ca putre bandhau na bhartari ।। dāruṇaṃ puṃścalīcittaṃ sadā śṛṅgārakarmaṇi ।। 29 ।। prāṇādhikaṃ ratijñaṃ sā'mṛtadṛṣṭyā ca puṃścalī ।। ratnapradaṃ ratnavijñaṃ viṣadṛṣṭyā hi paśyati ।। 30 ।। sarveṣāṃ sthalamastyeva puṃścalīnāṃ na kutracit ।। dāruṇā puṃścalī jātirnaraghātibhya eva ca ।।31।। niṣkṛtiḥ sarvabhogānte sarveṣāmasti niścitam।। na puṃścalīnāṃ viprendra yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 32 ।। anyāsāṃ kāminīnāṃ ca kīṭaṃ hantuṃ ca yā dayā ।। sā nāsti puṃścalīnāṃ tu kāntaṃ hanti purātanam ।। 33 ।। kāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā hinastyeva sopāyenāvalīlayā ।। ratijñaṃ nūtanaṃ prāpya viṣatulyaṃ purātanam ।। 34 ।। pṛthivyāṃ yāni pāpāni puṃścalīṣveva bhārate ।। tiṣṭhanti tābhyo na parāḥ pāpiṣṭhāḥ santi kecana ।। 39 ।। puṃścalīparipakvānnaṃ sarvapātakaniścitam ।। daive karmaṇi paitrye ca na deyaṃ ca tathā jalam ।। 36 ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ puṃścalīnāṃ ca niścitam ।। dattvā pitṛbhyo devebhyo bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet ।।37।। śatavarṣaṃ kālasūtre pacatyeva sudāruṇe ।। ghorāndhakāre kṛmayastaṃ daśanti divāniśam।।।। 38 ।। puṃścalyannaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte daivādyadi narādhamaḥ ।। saptajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tasya naśyati niścitam ।। 39 ।। āyuḥ śrīyaśasāṃ hāniriha loke paratra ca ।। tasmādyatnādrakṣaṇīyaṃ pākapātraṃ kalatrakam ।। 40 ।। puṃścalīdarśane puṇyaṃ yātrāsiddhirbhaveddhruvam ।। sparśane ca mahāpāpaṃ tīrthasnānādviśudhyati ।। 41 ।। snānaṃ dānaṃ vrataṃ caiva japaśca devapūjanam ।। niṣphalaṃ puṃścalināṃ ca bhārate jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।।।। 42 ।। kathitaṃ kulaṭākhyānaṃ durjñeyaṃ ca yathāgamam ।। saṃvādaṃ ca tayostatra prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu nārada ।। 43 ।। sa punaścetanāṃ prāpya tāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva baleḥ sutaḥ ।। kāmāturaḥ pramattaśca jagāma kulaṭāntikam ।। 44 ।। uvāca kuṭilāpāṅgī pīnaśroṇipayodharām ।। vrīḍayā vāsasā vaktramācchannaṃ kurvatī mudā ।। 49 ।। sāhasika uvāca ।। kāsi tvaṃ kasya kanyāsi kasya kāntāsi kāmini ।। svayaṃ kva yāsi kaṃ subhrūḥ puṇyavantaṃ manoharam ।। 46 ।। kalpānte tapasā pūtaṃ bhoktuṃ tvāmeva sundari ।। yaṃ taṃ yāsi yāhi sā tvaṃ bhṛtyaṃ māṃ kartumarhasi ।।47।। krīṇīhi ratipuṇyena māṃ bhṛtyaṃ ratilolupam ।। śṛṅgāralolupā tvaṃ ca śṛṅgāraṃ dehi kāmuki ।। 48 ।। tvayā saha mamāśleṣo vidhinā ca vinirmitaḥ ।। nirūpitaṃ yattenaiva vāryate kena tatpriye ।। 49 ।। vākyaṃ pīyūṣasadṛśaṃ sasmitaṃ vada sundari ।। śīghraṃ bhujalatāpāśairbandhanaṃ kuru nirjane ।। 50 ।। āsanaṃ dehi kalyāṇi svoruṃ kanakasannibham।। stanamaṇḍalakumbhaṃ ca pātrayogyaṃ pradarśaya।।51।। tīkṣṇāstreṇa kaṭākṣeṇa jarjaraṃ kuru bhāmini ।। kāmasarpakṣataṃ pādasparśanenārujaṃ kuru ।। 52।। adharoṣṭhāmṛtaṃ svādu dehi me kṣudhitāya ca ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhaṃ dantaṃ darśaya sundarama।53। gambhīranābhiṃ trivalīṃ draṣṭumicchāmi sundari ।। nīvīpramokṣaṇaṃ kartumicchā me vartate sadā ।।54।। śroṇīṃ paśyāmi lalitāṃ munimānasamohinīm ।। śaranmadhyāhnapadmānāṃ prabhāmocanalocanām ।। 55 ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ prasannaṃ ca pradarśaya ।। sā ca tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca smarāturā ।। 56 ।। dṛṣṭvā''rta kāmabāṇena mānasaṃkṣayakāminī ।। tilottamovāca।। patistvatsadṛśo nātha kāminīnāṃ manīṣitaḥ ।। 57 ।। baliputro'si dharmiṣṭho rūpavānguṇavānyuvā ।। śṛṅgāranipuṇaḥ kāntaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ।58।। sadā manojñaḥ strīṇāṃ tvaṃ suveṣaśca svabhāvataḥ।। suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ dāntamarogiṇam।।59।। śṛṅgārajñaṃ guṇajñaṃ tvāṃ yuvānaṃ rasikaṃ śucim ।। strīmanojñaṃ dayāluṃ ca baliṣṭhaṃ santamīśvaram।। dātāramanuraktaṃ ca kāntamicchati kāminī।। 60।। ete sarve guṇāḥ kānta santi kānte tvayi dhruvam।। tvāṃ na vāñchanti yāḥ kāntāstā avijñāśca vañcitāḥ ।।61।। saṃtoṣaṃ te kariṣyāmi samāgamya vidhorgṛhāt।। veṣaṃ kṛtvā tu candrārthaṃ yātrā'dya tasya kāminī ।। anyāśleṣaṇamātreṇa bhavitā dharmalaṅghanā ।। 62 ।। yāśca dharmānna rakṣanti tāsāṃ ca jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।। candrāśleṣaṃ na jānanti yāstā mūḍhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।। tā eva mātṛgarbhasthā na prājñāḥ pauruṣai rasaiḥ ।। 63 ।। svavaidyaumadanaścandro marutvānnalakūbaraḥ ।। ebhirnāliṅgitā yāstā vañcitā ratikarmabhiḥ ।। 64 ।। divāniśaṃ mānasaṃ me teṣāṃ krīḍāṃ ca cintayet ।। viśeṣataḥ kāmadevo nipuṇo ratikarmaṇi ।। 65 ।। candraśṛṅgāramāśleṣamālāpamamṛtādhikam ।। adya tasya ratidinaṃ tena taccintayenmanaḥ ।। 66 ।। tilottamāvacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa balinandanaḥ ।। sakāmaśca sapulakastāmuvāca rahaḥsthale ।। 67 ।। sāhasika uvāca ।। brahmaṇā nirmitā tvaṃ ca kautukena tilottame ।। ato varā cāpsarasāṃ vidagdharasikeśvarī ।। 68 ।। sundopasundayornāśaḥ nimittena prayatnataḥ ।। sarvarūpaguṇādhārā vidhinā ca kṛtā purā ।। 69 ।। sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajñe vijñā suratakarmaṇi ।। harṣeṇa śrotumicchāmi vada vo mānasaṃ vacaḥ ।। 70।। atipriyaśca ko vā ca kaḥ svabhāvo varānane ।। avaśyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca śrotumicchāmi sundari ।। ।।71 ।। gandharvāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca rājñāṃ puṇyavatāmapi।। sarveṣāṃ prāṇatulyā tvameṣu te kaḥ paraḥ priyaḥ ।।72 ।। asurasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya sā tilottamā।। mukhamācchādanaṃ cakre vilokya vakracakṣuṣā ।। 73 ।। satyaṃ sāramantarasthamavyaktamatigopanam ।। uvāca mānasaṃ vākyamajñātaṃ viduṣāmapi ।। 74 ।। ।। tilottamovāca ।। ।। kathanīyaṃ sāhasika puṃścalīnāṃ manovacaḥ ।। strījātīnāṃ ca sarvāsāmupahāsakaraṃ param ।। 75 ।। sarveṣāmapi durjñeyaṃ caritaṃ yoṣitāmapi ।। viśeṣato'pi durjñeyaṃ puṃścalīnāṃ manovacaḥ ।। 76 ।। vedavedāṅgaśāstrāntaṃ sarvaṃ jānāti paṃḍitaḥ ।। kānta nāṃtaṃ vijānāti diśāmākāśayoṣitām।। 77 ।। viṣādapyapriyo vṛddho ratnādapi ca yoṣitām ।। yuvā sarvasvahartā cetprāṇebhyo'pi paraḥ priyaḥ ।।78।। yuvānaṃ sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyārtā bhavati puṃścalī ।। viśeṣataḥ suveṣaṃ ca dṛṣṭvaiva hatacetanā ।। 79 ।। nimeṣarahitā tasya locanābhyāṃ pibenmukham ।। yonau jalaṃ kṣarettasyāḥ sadyaḥ kuṇḍūyanaṃ bhavet ।। 80 ।। mano'tilolamasthairyaṃ sarvāṅgāni cakampire ।। jaḍībhūtaṃ śarīraṃ ca pradagdhaṃ madanānalāt ।। 81 ।। saṃprāpya taṃ cedrahasi sā''lāpaṃ kurute sphuṭam ।। sakaṭākṣaṃ smeravaktraṃ darśayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 82 ।। tathā yadi vaśaṃ kartuṃ na śaśāka jitendriyam ।। svamaṅgaṃ darśayitvā tamantarvākyaṃ sphuṭaṃ vadet ।। 83 ।। duḥsādhye nāyake duḥkhaṃ bhavedājanmajanmani ।। tattulyaṃ tatparaṃ prāpya taṃ vismarati puṃścalī ।। 84 ।। puṃścalīnāmapriyaḥ kaḥ kaḥ priyo vā mahītale ।। yo'tiśṛṅgāranipuṇaḥ sa ca prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ ।। 85 ।। pūrvajāraṃ patiṃ putraṃ bhrātaraṃ pitaraṃ prasūm ।। viśiṣṭaṃ nūtanaṃ prāpya sarvaṃ tyajati līlayā ।। 86 ।। na dānena na mānena satyena stavanena vā ।। nopakāreṇa prītyā vā sā sādhyā suratiṃ vinā ।।87।। śayane bhojane cāpi svapne jñāne divāniśam ।। nityaṃ satpuruṣāśleṣaṃ smaranti kulaṭā striyaḥ ।।।। 88 ।। śṛṅgāranipuṇānāṃ ca dhyānasādhyā ciraṃ param।। dāruṇā puṃścalī jātiḥ prārthayecca navaṃnavam ।।89।। sarvāsāṃ kulaṭānāṃ ca caritraṃ kathitaṃ mayā ।। akathyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca mama hṛdvacanaṃ śṛṇu।। 90।। mama santi priyatarā gandharveṣu sureṣu ca।। yuvāno ratiśūrāśca kāmaśāstraviśāradāḥ ।।91।। viśeṣataḥ śaśadhare sneho me vidyate paraḥ ।। tato'tiriktaḥ sarvasmādapi kāmaḥ priyo mama ।।92।। priyo me kāmasadṛśo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।। smarasya smaraṇāttūrṇaṃ susnigdhaṃ mānasaṃ mama ।। 93 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamātmano yoṣitāmapi ।। ājñāṃ kuru mahārāja yāsyāmi candrasannidhim ।।94 ।। candrasthānāttava sthānaṃ samāgatya suniścitam।। saṃtoṣaṃ tava daityendra kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 99 ।। śrutvaivaṃ baliputraśca jahāsoccaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। sā vakracakṣuṣā''lokya taṃ jahāsa smarāturā।। 96 ।। chalena darśayāmāsa kaṭhinaṃ stanayoryugam ।। cārucampakavarṇābhaṃ vartulaṃ pīnamucchritam ।। 97 ।। śroṇīṃ sukaṭhināṃ ramyāṃ rambhāstambhavinindinīm ।। sakaṭākṣaṃ smeramukha kapolaṃ pulakāñcitam ।। 98 ।। rahaḥsthānaṃ samāsādya kāmena hatacetanā ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgī locanābhyāṃ papau mukham ।। 99 ।। tasya rūpaṃ ca veṣaṃ ca darśaṃdarśaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ।। mukhasyācchādanaṃ bhāvātkurvartī sūkṣmavāsasā ।। 100 ।। atikāmāturāṃ dṛṣṭvā suprājño balinandanaḥ ।। papraccha kāmināṃ kāmī bhāvaṃ vijñātumutsukaḥ ।। 101 ।। sāhasika uvāca ।। kiṃ kariṣyasi māṃ satyaṃ vada paṅkajalocane।। kāryāntaraṃ kariṣyāmi suciraṃ sthātumakṣamaḥ ।।102।। kāminīṣu balātkāro na dharmo dharmiṇāṃ priye।। viśeṣato'tividuṣāṃ nāsmākaṃ svakulocitaḥ ।। 103 ।। śṛṅgāraṃ dehi vā gaccha ratiṃ kartuṃ surāntike ।। kaḥ kṣamo vā vaśīkartuṃ puṃścalīṃ bahugāminīm ।। 104 ।। dānavasya vacaḥ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā ।। ātmānamadhamaṃmanyā bhidyamānā smarāstrataḥ ।। 105 ।। tilottamovāca ।। ।। kathamevaṃ brūhi tvaṃ me kāntaḥ prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ ।। kathaṃ vā kopayukto'si kuru kāryaṃ manīṣitam ।। 106 ।। tvāmevaṃ vimukhaṃ kṛtvā yāmi candrāntikaṃ yadi ।। tavābhiśāpāttatraiva sadyo vighno bhaviṣyati ।। 107 ।। vihāraṃ kuru bhadraṃ te kariṣyati hariḥ svayam ।। padepade śubhaṃ tasya yaḥ strīmānaṃ ca rakṣati ।।1 08।। avamanya striyaṃ mūḍho yo yāti puruṣādhamaḥ ।। padepade tadaśubhaṃ karoti pārvatī satī ।। 109 ।। tilottamāvacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa balinandanaḥ ।। kāmaśāstreṣu niṣṇātastadbhāvaṃ bubudhe sudhīḥ ।। 110 ।। bhāvaṃ vijñāya bhāvajñaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। kare dhṛtvā samāśliṣya cucumba mukhapaṅkajam ।। 111 ।। jagāma ca tayā sārdhaṃ gandhamādanagahraram ।। dadarśa tatra gatvā ca sthānaṃ jantuvivarjitam ।। 112 ।। saṃsthāpya ratnadīpāṃśca dhūpaṃ ca sumanoharam ।। śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā suṣvāpa ca tayā saha ।। 113 ।। nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ cakāra kāmamohitaḥ ।। tilottamā taṃ bubudhe surādapi vicakṣaṇam ।। 114 ।। viparītaratau tuṣṭā babhūva rasikeśvarī ।। divāniśaṃ na bubudhe navasaṃgamamūrcchitā ।। 115 ।। tilottamā kāmabhāvādbaliputramuvāca ha।। kṛtvā vakṣasi prāṇeśaṃ stanayorantare mudā ।। 116 ।। tilottamovāca ।। kadā drakṣyāmyahaṃ kānta mukhacandraṃ manoharam ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ śubhadinaṃ kadā me bhavitā punaḥ ।। 117 ।। ayi kiṃ rūpamāścaryaṃ guṇo vā tava dānava ।। dhruvaṃ śṛṅgāranipuṇastvatparo nāsti kaścana ।।118।। māṃ vismarasi kālena puruṣaḥ ṣaṭpado yathā ।। strīṇāṃ satpuruṣāśleṣa ājīvaṃ manasi sthitaḥ ।। 119 ।। satsaṃgamaḥ śubhadine puṇyātpuṇyavatāṃ bhavet ।। sadvicchedo duḥkhaheturmaraṇādatiricyate ।। 120।। pīyūṣabhojanātsvargavāsādapi ca durlabhaḥ ।। satsaṃgamaḥ sukhamayo'pyasatsaṅgo viṣādhikaḥ ।। 121 ।। kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha mahārāja punarāliṃganaṃ kuru ।। tvayā sārdhaṃ mama prāṇā yāsyanti cetasā saha ।।122।। ityevamuktvā kulaṭā kṛtvā vakṣasi sādaram ।। pumaṃgasaṃgotpulakā mūrcchāmāpa sukhena ca ।। 123 ।। kulaṭāliṃganālāpātso'tikāmī babhūva ha ।। yathā dīptaḥ kṛṣṇavartmā vardhate haviṣā'dhikam ।। 124 ।। punaścakāra śṛṃgāramasuro'ṣṭavidhaṃ mune ।। cuṃbanaṃ ca navavidhaṃ yathāsthāne yathocitam ।। 125 ।। nakhadantakaraiḥ krīḍāṃ cakāra vividhāṃ punaḥ ।। kiṃkiṇīnāṃ kaṃkaṇānāṃ babhūva śabda ulbaṇaḥ ।। munerdurvāsasastena dhyānabhaṅgo babhūva ha ।। 126 ।। adṛṣṭasya tayostatra valmīkācchāditasya ca ।। yogāsanaṃ kurvataśca gandhamādanagahvare ।। 127 ।। dhyāyataścaraṇāṃbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। na papāta tayordṛṣṭiḥ samīpasthe mahāmunau ।। kāmātmanorna hi jñānaṃ kāmena hatacetasoḥ ।। 128 ।। sahasā cetanāṃ prāpya prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। dadarśa puratastau tu munirunmīlya locane ।। 129 ।। divāniśaṃ na jānantau saṃyuktau kāmamohitau ।। dṛṣṭvā cukopa tejasvī rudrāṃśo bhagavānvibhuḥ ।। 130 ।। uvāca tau vihārānte raktapaṅkajalocanaḥ ।। dhyānaprāptapadāmbhojavicchedodvignamānasaḥ ।। 131 ।। durvāsā uvāca ।। uttiṣṭha gardabhākāra nirlajja puruṣādhama ।। bhaktapradhānasya baleḥ putraḥ paśusamaprabhaḥ ।। 132 ।। devo vā mānavo vā'pi daityagandharvarākṣasāḥ ।। lajjāṃ kurvanti satataṃ svajātau ca paśūnvinā ।। 133 ।। jñānalajjāvihīnā ca kharajātirviśeṣataḥ ।। tasmāttvaṃ dānavaśreṣṭha kharayoniṃ vrajādhunā ।। 134 ।। tilottame tvamuttiṣṭha lajjāhīnā ca puṃścalī ।। etādṛśī spṛhā daitye vraja yoniṃ ca dānavīm ।। 135 ।। ityevamuktvā sa munistasthau tatra ruṣā jvalan ।। tau ca tuṣṭuvaturbhītāvutthāya vrīḍitau munima ।। 136 ।। sāhasika uvāca ।। tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ ca viṣṇuśca tvaṃ ca sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ ।। hutāśanastvaṃ sūryaśca sṛṣṭisthityantakārakaḥ ।।137।। kṣamāparādhaṃ bhagavankṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe ।। mūḍhāparādhaṃ satataṃ yaḥ kṣametsa sadīśvaraḥ ।। 138 ।। ityevamuktvā daityendro rurodoccaiḥ puro muneḥ ।। kṛtvā tṛṇāni daśane papāta caraṇāmbuje ।। 139 ।। tilottamovāca ।। he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru ।। vidhisṛṣṭau ca sarveṣāṃ mūḍhā strījātireva ca ।। 140 ।। tato'timattā kulaṭā sadā kāmāturā parā ।। lajjābhītiścetanā ca na santi kāmuke vibho ।। 141 ।। ityuktvā rodanaṃ kṛtvā jagāma śaraṇaṃ muneḥ ।। vinā vipattau keṣāṃcijjñānaṃ bhavati bhūtale ।। tayordṛṣṭvā ca vaikalyaṃ babhūva karuṇā muneḥ ।। 142 ।। durvāsā uvāca ।। atiśāpaḥ prasādo vā bhaveddaivena dānava ।। satkīrtirapakīrtirvā prāktanaprabhavā dhruvam ।। 143 ।। viṣṇubhaktabaleḥ putraḥ sadvaṃśaprabhavo janaḥ ।। janakādviṣṇubhakto'si jānāmi tvāṃ suniścitam ।। 144 ।। janakasya svabhāvo hi janye tiṣṭhati niścitam ।। yathā śrīkṛṣṇapādāṅkaḥ kālīyavaṃśamastake ।। 145 ।। saṃprāpya gārdabhīṃ yoniṃ vatsa nirvāṇatāṃ vraja ।। pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇārcanaphalaṃ na hi luptaṃ satāṃ cirāt ।। 146 ।। vṛndāraṇyaṃ tālavanaṃ vraja śīghraṃ vrajāntikam ।। prāṇāṃstyaktvā hareścakrānmuktiṃ prāpsyasi niścitam ।। 147 ।। tilottame bhārate tvaṃ bāṇaputrī bhaviṣyasi ।। śrīkṛṣṇapautraśleṣeṇa punaḥ pūtā bhaviṣyasi ।। 148 ।। ityevamuktvā sa munirvirarāma mahāmune ।। tau jagmaturyathāsthānaṃ praṇamya munipuṃgavam ।। 149 ।। ityuktaṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ daityasya kharajanmanaḥ ।। tilottamā bāṇaputrī hyuṣā'niruddhakāminī ।। 150 ।। iti śrībahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde tilottamābaliputrayorbrahmaśāpaprastāvo nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 23 ।।
<4.24> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। nigūḍhaṃ śṛṇu vṛttāntaṃ munerdurvāsaso mune ।। aho'sya dārasaṃyogaḥ kathaṃ tadūrdhvaretasaḥ ।। 1 ।। dṛṣṭvā tayośca śṛṅgāraṃ muniḥ kāmī babhūva ha ।। jitendriyo'satsaṃsargāddoṣaḥ sāṃsargiko bhavet ।। 2 ।। sahasā tasya hṛdaye babhūva surate spṛhā ।। tapastaptvā tatra dadhyau kāminīṃ madanāturaḥ ।। 3 ।। etasminnantare tena pathā yāti munīśvaraḥ ।। prārthayantyā patiṃ santamaurvaśca sutayā saha ।। 4 ।। ūrūdbhavo brahmaṇaśca purā kalpe tapasyataḥ ।। ūrdhvaretāśca yogīndra orvastena iti smṛtaḥ ।। 5 ।। tasya jānūdbhavā kanyā kandalī nāma viśrutā ।। durvāsasaṃ prārthayantī nānyaṃ manasi rocate ।। 6 ।। sasuto hi muniśreṣṭho munerdurvāsasaḥ puraḥ ।। tasthau mahāprasannaśca jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ।। ।। 7 ।। munīndro'pi munīndraṃ taṃ puro dṛṣṭvā sasaṃbhramaḥ ।। prajavena samuttasthau nanāma ca mudā'nvitaḥ ।।8।। aurvo durvāsasaṃ tatra samāśliṣya mudā'nvitaḥ ।। uvāca munaye sarvaṃ kanyakāyā manoratham ।। 9 ।। aurva uvāca ।। vikhyātā kandalī nāma mama kanyā manoharā ।। prauḍhā tvāmeva dhyāyantī śrutvā vācikavaktrataḥ ।। 10 ।। ayonisambhavā kanyā trailokyaṃ mohituṃ kṣamā ।। sarvarūpaguṇādhārā doṣeṇaikena saṃyutā ।। 11 ।। atīva kalahāviṣṭā kopena kaṭubhāṣiṇī ।। nānāguṇayutaṃ dravyaṃ na tyajedekadoṣataḥ ।। 12 ।। aurvasya vacanaṃ śrutvā harṣaśokānvito muniḥ ।। dadarśa kanyāṃ purato guṇarūpasamanvitām ।। 13 ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām ।। 14 ।। navayauvanasaṃyuktāṃ paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyāṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitām ।। 15 ।। munirmumoha tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ।। uvāca taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 16 ।। durvāsā uvāca ।। nārīrūpaṃ tribhuvane muktimārganirodhakam ।। vyavadhānaṃ tapasyāyāḥ satataṃ mohakāraṇam ।। 17 ।। kārāgāre ca saṃsāre durvahaṃ nigaḍaṃ param ।। acchedyaṃ jñānakhaḍgaiśca mahadbhiḥ śaṃkarādibhiḥ ।। 18 ।। saṅgicchāyātiriktaṃ ca karmabhogātparātparam ।। indriyādindriyādhārādvidyāyāśca materapi ।। 19।। ādehaṃ saṅginī chāyā bhogāntaṃ bhoga eva ca ।। dehendriyāṇi jīvāntaṃ vidyā caivāvaśīlinam ।। 20 ।। matiścaivāvaśīlāntā sukhī janmanijanmani ।। yāvajjīvī ca sustrīko na tāvajjanmakhaṇḍanam ।।21 ।। yāvacca jīvino janma tāvadbhogaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ।। paraṃ munīndra sarvasmāddharipādābjasevanam।। 22 ।। dhyāyataḥ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ mama vighno babhūva ha ।। na jāne karmadoṣeṇa kena vā pūrvajanmanaḥ ।। 23 ।। puṃścalyā saha śṛṅgāraṃ dṛṣṭvā daityasya manmanaḥ ।। babhūva kāmasaṃyuktaṃ dattaṃ dhātrā ca tatphalam ।।24।। kiṃ tvahaṃ tava kanyāyāḥ kaṭūktiśatakaṃ mune ।। dhruvaṃ kṣamāṃ kariṣyāmi dāsyāmi ca tataḥ phalam ।।25।। sarvato'pi parā nindā strīkaṭūktisahiṣṇutā ।। atīva ninditaḥ satsu strījito bhuvanatraye ।। 25 ।। tavājñāṃ mastake kṛtvā grahīṣyāmi sutāṃ tava ।। upetāṃ kāminīṃ tyaktvā kālasūtraṃ vrajennaraḥ ।।27।। rahasyupasthitāṃ kāmātpuṃścalīṃ cejjitendriyaḥ ।। parityajeddharmabhayādadharmānnarakaṃ vrajet ।। 28 ।। ityevamuktvā durvāsā virarāma muneḥ puraḥ ।। munirvedoktavidhinā dadau tasmai sutāṃ mune ।। 29 ।। svastītyuvāca durvāsā muniśca yautukaṃ dadau ।। kanyāsamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mohāccaiva ruroda ha ।। 30 ।। mūrcchāmavāpa sa muniḥ svakanyāvirahāturaḥ ।। apatyabhedaśokaughaḥ svātmārāmaṃ na muñcati ।। 31 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya bodhayāmāsa kanyakām ।। mūrcchitāṃ tātavicchedādrudantīṃ śokasaṃyutām ।। 32 ।। aurva uvāca ।। śṛṇu vatse pravakṣyāmi nītisāraṃ sudurlabham ।। hitaṃ satyaṃ ca vedoktaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।।33।। svakāntaśca paro bandhuriha loke paratra ca ।। na hi kāntātparaḥ preyān kulastrīṇāṃ paro guruḥ ।।34।। devapūjā vrataṃ dānaṃ tapaścānaśanaṃ japaḥ ।। snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu dīkṣā sarvamakheṣu ca ।।35।। prādakṣiṇyaṃ pṛthivyāśca brāhmaṇātithisevanam ।। sarvāṇi patisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।36।। kimetaiḥ patibhaktāyā abhaktāyāśca bhārate।। yadā duḥkhī sukhārambhe sākāṅkṣaḥ prathamo bhavet ।। patisevā paro dharmaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu paṭhyate।।37।। svaprajñānena satataṃ kāntaṃ nārāyaṇādhikam ।। dṛṣṭvā taccaraṇatmbhojasevāṃ nityaṃ kariṣyati।। ।। 38 ।। parihāsena kopena bhrameṇāvajñayā mune ।। kaṭūktiṃ svāminaḥ sākṣātparokṣānna kariṣyati ।। 39 ।। striyā vāgyoniduṣṭāyāḥ kāmato bhārate bhuvi ।। prāyaścittaṃ śrutau nāsti narakaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śatam ।। 40।। sarvadharmaparītā yā kaṭūktiṃ kurute patim ।। śatajanmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tasyā naśyati niścitam ।। 41 ।। dattvā kanyāṃ bodhayitvā jagāma munipuṃgavaḥ ।। svātmārāmaḥ svāśrame ca tasthau strīsahito mudā ।। 42 ।। sambhogecchāvṛte citte kāmī saṃprāpa kāminīm ।। aho sukṛtināṃ kāmo vāñchāmātreṇa sidhyati ।। 43 ।। śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ kṛtvā muniśreṣṭho mahāmune।। śubhe kṣaṇe gṛhītvā tāṃ suṣvāpa nirjane priyām।।44।। nārīrasānabhijñaḥ syādājanma munipuṃgavaḥ।। tathā'pi suratau vijñaḥ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।।45।। nānāprakāraṃ śṛṅgāraṃ cakāra vidhipūrvakam।। navasaṃgamamātreṇa mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa kandalī ।। 46 ।। mūrcchāṃ prāpa muniśreṣṭho bubudhe na divāniśam ।। evaṃ pratidinaṃ tatra cakāra suratiṃ mune ।।47 ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena babhūva saṃgamaḥ samaḥ ।। saṃbabhūva gṛhāsaktastapastyaktvā munīśvaraḥ ।। 48 ।। karoti kalahe nityaṃ kandalī svāminā saha ।। munīndro bodhayāmāsa nītivākyena kāminīm ।। sā tanna bubudhe kiṃcitkaroti kalahe spṛhām ।। 49 ।। tātapradattajñānena sā na śāntā babhūva ha ।। na hīyate prabodhena svabhāvo duratikramaḥ ।। 50।। nityaṃ kaṭūktiṃ kāntaṃ sā karoti hetunā vinā ।। jagatprakampitaṃ yena tayā kopātsa kampitaḥ।।51।। tayā kṛtāṃ kaṭūktiṃ ca kṣamāsaṃsthāṃ cakāra ha ।। bodhayāmāsa tāṃ nityaṃ sadyo mohāddayānidhiḥ ।। 52 ।। kaṭūktiśatakaṃ pūrṇaṃ tatkālena babhūva ha ।। kṣamāṃ cakāra kṛpayā kaṭūktiṃ ca śatādhikām ।। 53 ।। patnīkaṭūktyā niyataṃ pradagdhaṃ mānasaṃ muneḥ ।। tasyāḥ kaṭūktikāriṇyāḥ karma pūrṇaṃ babhūva ha ।। 54 ।। svātmārāmo dayāluśca kopaṃ tyaktuṃ na sa kṣamaḥ ।। śaśāpa kāminīṃ mohādbhasmarāśirbhaveti ca ।। 55 ।। muneriṅgitamātreṇa bhasmasātsā babhūva ha ।। evamatyucchritānāṃ ca na kalyāṇaṃ jagattraye ।। 56।। śarīre bhasmasādbhūte pratibiṃbaḥ sa cātmanaḥ ।। jīvastatrāntarikṣastho hyuvāca vinayātprabhum ।। 57 ।। jīva uvāca ।। he nātha sarvadarśī tvaṃ satataṃ jñānacakṣuṣā ।। sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajñaḥ kimahaṃ bodhayāmi te।। 58 ।। saduktirvā kaṭūktirvā kopaḥ saṃtāpa eva ca।। lobho mohaśca kāmaśca kṣutpipāsādikaṃ ca yat ।।59।। sthaulyaṃ kārśyaṃ ca nāśaśca dṛśyādṛśyaṃ samudbhavam ।। sarvaṃ śarīradharmaṃ ca na jīvasya na cātmanaḥ ।। 60।। sattvaṃ rajastama iti śarīraṃ triguṇātmakam ।। tacca nānāprakāraṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te ।।61।। kiñcitsattvātiriktaṃ ca kiñcideva rajodhikam ।। tamotiriktaṃ kiñcicca na samaṃ kutracinmune ।।62।। sattvodayācca muktīcchā karmecchā ca rajoguṇāt।। tamoguṇājjīvahiṃsā kopo'haṃkāra eva ca ।। 63 ।। kopātkaṭūktirniyataṃ kaṭūktyā śatrutā bhavet ।। tayā cāpriyatā sadyaḥ śatruḥ kaḥ kasya bhūtale ।। 64 ।। ko vā priyo'priyaḥ kaḥ kiṃ kiṃ mitraṃ ko ripurbhavet ।। iṃdriyāṇi ca bījāni sarvatra śatrumitrayoḥ ।।65।। prāṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ strīṇāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇādhikā priyā ।। babhūva śatrutā sadyo duruktyā ca kṣaṇāddvayoḥ ।। 66 ।। yadgataṃ tadgataṃ sarvaṃ kāmadoṣeṇa vai prabho ।। kṣamāparādhaṃ nikhilaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadādhunā ।। 67 ।। kiṃ karomi kva yāmīti bhavitā kutra janma me ।। tava nānyasya jāyā'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi jagattraye ।। 68 ।। ityevamuktvā jīvaśca maunībhūto babhūva ha ।। mūrcchāmavāpa sa muniḥ śokena hṛtacetanaḥ ।। 69 ।। svātmārāmo mahājñānī jahāra cetanāmaho ।। strīvicchedo vidagdhānāṃ sarvaśokātparātparaḥ ।। 70 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ ।। tatra yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā cakāra vāyudhāraṇam ।।71।। etasminnantare tatra jagāma brāhmaṇo'rbhakaḥ।। daṇḍī chatrī raktavāsā bibhratti lakamuttmam ।। 72 ।। sasmitaḥ śyāmavarṇaśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। vayasā'tiśiśuḥ śānto jñānī vedavidāṃ varaḥ ।। 73 ।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ saṃbhrameṇaiva durvāsāḥ praṇanāma ha ।। vāsayāmāsa tatraiva pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। 74 ।। uvāca brāhmaṇavaṭurdattvā tasmai sadāśiṣam ।। taddarśanādāśiṣā ca sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ gataṃ muneḥ ।। 75 ।। śiśurūpaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā tamuvāca vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। pīyūṣatulyaṃ nītyoghaṃ nītiśāstraṃ viśāradaḥ ।। 76 ।। śiśuruvāca ।। sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña gurormantraprasādataḥ ।। kiṃ tattvaṃ tvāmahaṃ vipra pṛcchāmi śokakātaram ।। 77 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ tapo dharmastapaḥsādhyaṃ jagattrayam ।। svadharmaṃ vai parityajya kimidānīṃ karoṣi bhoḥ ।। 78 ।। kā kasya ekānaṃśā ca bhaginī vasudevasutā hareḥ।। pārvatyaṃśasamudbhūtā suśīlā cirajīvinī ।।81 ।। kalpe kalpe sundarī sā tava patnī bhaviṣyati ।। mano dehi tapasyāyāṃ mudā katipayaṃ dinam।।82।। kandalī kadalījātirbhaviṣyati mahītale ।। śubhadā phaladā kāntā sakṛtsūtā sudurlabhā ।। 83 ।। kalpāntare śāntarūpā tava patnī bhaviṣya ti।। atyucchrisya damanamucitaṃ ca śrutau śrutam।। 84।। ityevamuktvā śīghraṃ ca viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। dattvā jñānaṃ ca viprāya so'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 85 ।। muniḥ sarvabhramaṃ tyaktvā tapasyāyāṃ mano dadhe ।। kandalī kadalījātirbabhūva dharaṇītale ।। 86 ।। daityastālavanaṃ gatvā babhūva gardabhākṛtiḥ ।। tilottamā bāṇaputrī babhūva samaye mune ।। 87।। daityendro viṣṇucakreṇa prāṇāṃstyaktvā suvāñchitam ।। saṃprāpya caraṇāmbhojaṃ munerapi sudurlabham ।। 88 ।। kāle tilottamā bhūtvā jagāma svālayaṃ punaḥ ।। kṛṣṇapautrāliṃganena paripūrṇamanorathā ।। 89 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇākhyānamuttamam ।। padepade sundaraṃ ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 90 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde tālaphalabhakṣaṇaprasaṅge baliputramokṣonāma caturviśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 24 ।।
<4.25> ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। śrutaṃ kimadbhutaṃ brahman hareścaritamaṅgalam ।। viśeṣatastava mukhe hyatīva sumanoharam ।। 1 ।। mṛtāyāṃ munikanyāyāṃ śāpāddurvāsaso muneḥ ।। kiṃ cakāra samāgatya tanme dhyānena bubudhe sarvaṃ kanyāsaṃbandhi saṃkaṭam।।4।। jagāma śokāviṣṭo'pi tūrṇaṃ jāmāturāśramam।। siṣeca pṛthivīreṇūcchaśvannayanabindunā ।।5।। gatvā''layasamīpaṃ ca vipraḥ kātaramānasaḥ ।। he vatse cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa prayatnena mahāmuneḥ ।। 10 ।। saṃprāpya cetanāṃ śīghramuvāca taṃ puraḥ sthitam ।। jāmātaraṃ śokayutaṃ bhītaṃ praṇatakandharam ।। 11 ।। mahāśokādaśrupūrṇaṃ raktapaṅkajalocanam ।। kopātkampitavāñchaśvatsaṃtrastaḥ sphuritādharaḥ ।। 12 ।। aurva uvāca ।। aye brahmannatrivaṃśa pautrastvaṃ jagatīpateḥ ।। svalpadoṣe bahutaraḥ kṛto daṇḍastvayā katham ।।13।। tvajjanma śaṃkarāṃśena śrutau śrutaḥ ।। tvayā krodhādyadi tyaktā pitrā yatnena pālitā ।।18।। madapatyaṃ svalpadoṣe yato bhasmīkṛtaṃ tvayā ।। parābhavastava mahānbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 19 ।। mahatāṃ kṣudrajantūnāṃ sarveṣāṃ jīvināṃ sadā ।। sraṣṭā pātā ca śāstā ca bhagavānkaruṇānidhiḥ ।। 20 ।। ityuktvā ca muniśreṣṭho vilapya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। he'mba vatse hyayītyuktvā jagāma svālayaṃ ruṣā ।।21।। gate munīndre ।। pārṣadapravarendraiśca sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। padmāsevitapādābja sarasvatyā stutaṃ puraḥ ।। 91 ।। sunandanandakumudapracaṇḍādibhirāvṛtam ।। guṇānuvādaṃ gāyantaṃ tantraiḥ paśyantamīpsitam ।। 92 ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā daṇḍavatpraṇanāma ca ।। tuṣṭāva sāmavedoktastotreṇa parameśvaram ।। 93 ।। ।। durvāsā uvāca ।। ।। trāhi māṃ kamalākānta trāhi māṃ karuṇānidhe ।। dīnabandho'tidīneśa karuṇāsāgara prabho ।। 94 ।। vedavedāṅgasaṃsraṣṭurvidhātuśca svayaṃ vidhe ।। mṛtyormṛtyuḥ kālakāla trāhi māṃ saṃkaṭārṇave ।। 95 ।। saṃhārakartuḥ saṃhāraḥ sarveśaḥ sarvakāraṇaḥ ।। mahāviṣṇutarorbījaṃ rakṣa māṃ bhavasāgare ।। 96 ।। śaraṇāgataśokārtabhayatrāṇaparāyaṇa ।। bhagavannava māṃ bhītaṃ nārāyaṇa namo'stu te ।। 97 ।। vedeṣvādyaṃ ca yadvastu vedāḥ stotuṃ na ca kṣamāḥ ।। sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā kiṃ stuvanti vipaścitaḥ ।। ।। 97 ।। śeṣaḥ sahasravaktreṇa yaṃ stotuṃ jaḍatāṃ vrajet ।। pañcavaktro jaḍībhūto jaḍībhūtaścaturmukhaḥ ।। 99 ।। śrutayaḥ smṛtikartāro vāṇī cetstotumakṣamā ।। ko'haṃ vipraśca vedajñaḥ śiṣyaḥ kiṃ staumi mānada ।। 100 ।। manūnāṃ ca mahendrāṇāmaṣṭāviṃśatime gate ।। divāniśaṃ yasya vidheraṣṭottaraśatāyuṣaḥ ।। 101 ।। tasya pāto bhavedyasya cakṣurunmīlanena ca ।। tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca kiṃ staumi pāhi māṃ prabho ।। 102 ।। ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā papāta caraṇāmbuje ।। nayanāmbujanīreṇa siṣeca bhayavihvalaḥ ।।103।। durvāsasā kṛtaṃ stotraṃ hareśca paramātmanaḥ ।। puṇyadaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ jaganmaṅgalanāmakam ।। 104 ।। yaḥ paṭhetsaṃkaṭagrasto bhaktiyuktaśca saṃyataḥ ।। nārāyaṇastaṃ kṛpayā śīghramāgatya rakṣati ।। 105 ।। rājadvāre śmaśāne ca kārāgāre bhayākule ।। śatrugraste dasyubhītau hiṃsrajantusamanvite ।। ।। 106।। veṣṭite rājasainyena magne pote mahārṇave।। stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 107 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte durvāsasā kṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastotraṃ samāptam ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। muneśca stavanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ ।। prahasyovāca madhuraṃ pīyūṣavṛṣṭivanmudā ।। 108 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati vareṇa me ।। kiṃ tu me vacanaṃ nityaṃ śṛṇu satyaṃ sukhāvaham ।। 109 ।। anyeṣāṃ ca bhavejjñānaṃ śrutvā śāstraṃ satāṃ mukhāt ।। svamūrtimanti śāstrāṇi bhavetsantaścaranti hi ।। 110 ।। karma vedaviruddhaṃ ca sarveṣāmatigarhitam ।। karoti vidvāṃścejjñātvā sa ca jīvanmṛtādhikaḥ ।। 111 ।। purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu cetihāseṣu brāhmaṇa ।। vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca mahimā śrutaḥ sarvaiśca sarvataḥ ।।112।। ahaṃ prāṇā vaiṣṇavānāṃ mama prāṇāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। tāneva dveṣṭi yo mūḍho mamāsūnāṃ ca hiṃsakaḥ ।। 113 ।। putrānpautrānkalatrāṃśca rājyaṃ lakṣmīṃ vihāya ca ।। dhyāyante satataṃ ye māṃ ko me tebhyaḥ paraḥ priyaḥ ।। ।। 114 ।। parā bhaktānna me prāṇā na ca lakṣmīrna śaṅkaraḥ ।। na bhāratī na ca brahmā na durgā na gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 115 ।। na brāhmaṇā na vedāśca na vedajananī parā ।। na gopī na ca gopālā na rādhā praṇataḥ priyāḥ ।।116।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ sāraṃ ca vāstavam ।। na praśaṃsāparaṃ teṣāṃ te ca prāṇādhikāḥ priyāḥ ।। 117 ।। māṃ dviṣanti ca ye mūḍhā jñānahīnāśca vañcitāḥ ।। ātmānaṃ ye na jānanti te yānti nirayaṃ ciram ।।118।। ye dviṣanti ca madbhaktānprāṇānāmadhikaṃ priyān।। teṣāṃ śāstā tvahaṃ tūrṇaṃ paratra nirayaṃ ciram ।। 119 ।। prabhāvo'haṃ ca sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ paripālakaḥ।। na ca vyāpī svatantro'haṃ bhaktādhīno divāniśam।। 120।। goloke vā'tha vaikuṇṭhe dvibhujaṃ ca caturbhujam ।। rūpamātramidaṃ śaśvatprāṇā me bhaktasannidhau ।। 121 ।। yaduktaṃ bhaktadattaṃ ca bhakṣaṇīyaṃ ca tanmama ।। abhakṣyaṃ dravyamanyena dattaṃ cedamṛtopamam ।। 122 ।। aṃbarīṣaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ nirīhaṃ tamahiṃsakam ।। kathaṃ haṃsi dayāśīlaṃ sarvaprāṇihite ratam ।। 123 ।। dayāṃ kurvaṃti ye santaḥ satataṃ sarvajantuṣu ।। tāndviṣanti ca ye mūḍhāsteṣāṃ hantā'hameva ca ।।124।। bhaktānāṃ hiṃsakaṃ śatrumahaṃ rakṣitumakṣamaḥ।। ambarīṣālayaṃ gaccha sa tvāṃ rakṣitumīśvaraḥ ।। 125 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। idaṃ vākyaṃ ca tacchrutvā brāhmaṇo bhayavihvalaḥ ।। viṣaṇṇamānasastasthau smarankṛṣṇapadāmbujam ।।126।। etasminnantare brahmā bhavānyā saha śaṃkaraḥ ।। dharmaścendrādayo devā ājagmurmunipuṅgavāḥ।।। ।। 127 ।। praṇamya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve paramātmānamīśvaram ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharāḥ ।। 128 ।। brahmovāca ।। svātmasvarūpa nirlipta bhaktānugrahakātara ।। bhaktāparādhajanakaṃ rakṣa brāhmaṇapuṅgavam ।। 129 ।। mahādeva uvāca ।। dīnabandho jagannātha nāyaṃ vipro jagadbahiḥ ।। kṛtāparādhaṃ dīnaṃ ca pāhīmaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 130 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। bhakta evāṃbarīṣaste na dvijā na surā vayam ।। sarveṣāmīśvarastvaṃ ca rakṣa vipraṃ kṛtāgasam ।। 131 ।। dharma uvāca ।। sarveṣāṃ janakastvaṃ ca pātā daṇḍakṛdīśvaraḥ।। śiśuhetoḥ śiśuṃ hanti pitetyevaṃ kutaḥ prabho ।। 132 ।। iṃdra uvāca ।। kṛpayā samatā śaśvatsarveṣu jīviṣu prabho ।। aparādhaphalaṃ bhūtamadhunā pātumarhasi ।। 133 ।। rudra uvāca ।। śāntiṃ kartuṃ samucitamucitaṃ sāṃprataṃ kuru ।। kṛtakuṇṭhasya mūlasya pālanaṃ kartumarhasi ।। 134 ।। dikpāla uvāca ।। kṛtāparādhaṃ vipraṃ ca chettumarhasi na śrutau ।। aparādhaśamaṃ kṛtvā sadā pāti sadīśvaraḥ ।। 135 ।। grahā ūcuḥ ।। yo dveṣṭi vaiṣṇavaṃ mūḍhastaṃ ruṣṭā sarvadevatāḥ ।। pīḍāṃ kurmo vayaṃ śaśvatpaścāttvaṃ pātumarhasi ।। 136 ।। munaya ūcuḥ ।। nātha vipre parābhūte sarve jīvanmṛtā vayam ।। daṇḍaṃ vidhātumekasya bhavellajjā svajātiṣu ।। 137 ।। atriruvāca ।। tvayaiva dattaḥ putro me krodhī tvatsevakaḥ sadā ।। na kaṃ bibheti trailokye tejasvī tejasā tava ।। 138 ।। lakṣmīruvāca ।। kṣamāparādhaṃ bhagavan brāhmaṇaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। stuvanti deva viprāśca na vipraṃ hantumarhasi ।। 139 ।। sarasvatyuvāca ।। bodhayiṣyāmi devānāṃ janakaṃ kāmadaṃ śrutim ।। bhagavansvāmī sarveṣāṃ sarvāṃśca pātumarhasi ।। 140 ।। pārṣadā ūcuḥ ।। bhavataḥ smṛtimātreṇa sarveṣāṃ sarvamaṅgalam ।। bhavetsarvāpado yānti pāhīmaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 141 ।। nartakā ūcuḥ ।। dāridryabhaṃjana vayaṃ bhikṣukāstava saṃtatam ।। bhikṣāṃ naḥ sāṃprataṃ dehi paritrāṇaṃ dvijasya ca ।। 142 ।। eteṣāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā prabhuḥ śaraṇavatsalaḥ ।। prahasyovāca vacanaṃ sarvasantoṣakāraṇam ।। 143 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। sarve śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ nītiyuktaṃ sukhāvaham।। viprarakṣāṃ kariṣyāmi yuṣmākamājñayā dhruvam ।।144।। kiṃ tvayaṃ yātu vaikuṇṭhādambarīṣālayaṃ punaḥ ।। karotu pāraṇaṃ tatra rājñaḥ suprītaye muniḥ ।। 145 ।। viprastasyātithirbhūtvā nirdoṣaṃ śaptumudyataḥ ।। sudarśanaṃ tu taṃ rakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hantumudyatam ।।146।। pūrṇaṃ varṣamayaṃ bhīto bhramatyeva bhuvaṃ mudā ।। upavāsī sa rājendraḥ sastrīkaśca śucā'nvitaḥ ।।147।। tato'hamupavāsī ca bhaktopavāsakāraṇāt ।। stanāndhaṃ bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhuṅkte jananī yathā ।। 148 ।। mamāśiṣā muniśreṣṭhaḥ sadyo bhavatu vijvaraḥ ।। pathi tatrāsya hiṃsāṃ ca maccakraṃ na kariṣyati ।। 149 ।। ahamevādya niścintaḥ sukhaṃ bhokṣyāmi niścitam ।। bhaktadattaṃ ca yadvastu prītyā kṛtvā sudhopamam ।। 150।। lakṣmīdattaṃ ca yaddravyaṃ na cāhaṃ bhoktumīśvaraḥ ।। vinā bhaktapradānena na tṛptiṃ dātumīśvaraḥ ।। ।। 151 ।। he munīndra mahāprājña gaccha vatsa nṛpālayam ।। sarve devāśca devyaśca gacchantu munayo gṛham ।।152।। ityuktvā śrīharistūrṇaṃ yayau svāntaḥpuraṃ mudā ।। yayuḥ sarve mudā yuktāḥ praṇamya jagadīśvaram ।। 153 ।। brāhmaṇaśca manoyāyī jagāma nṛpamandiram ।। sudarśanaṃ ca taccakraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham ।। 154 ।। upoṣya vatsaraṃ rājā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। siṃhāsanasthaḥ purato dadarśa munipuṅgavam ।। 155 ।। utthāya saṃbhramātsadyaḥ praṇamya sādaraṃ mudā ।। bhojayitvā tu miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bubhuje svayam ।। 156 ।। bhuktvā tuṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭho yuyuje paramāśiṣam ।। jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ praśaśaṃsa punaḥpunaḥ ।। 157 ।। uvāca pathi viprendro manasā vismayākulaḥ।। māhātmyaṃ durlabhamaho vaiṣṇavānāmiti dvijaḥ ।। 158 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde munimo kṣaṇaprastāvo nāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 25 ।।
<4.26> nārada uvāca ।। dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣaḥ śrutastvanmukhato mune ।। parābhavo muneścaiva nṛpatrāṇaṃ hareraho ।। 1 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ ca me ।। ekādaśīvratasyāsya vidhānaṃ vada niścitam ।। 2 ।। aho śrutau śrutaṃ kiṃcinmatabhedānna niścitam ।। śrutīnāṃ kāraṇamukhācchrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। 3 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekādaśīvratamidaṃ devānāmapi durlabham ।। śrīkṛṣṇaprītijanakaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tapasvinām ।।4।। devānāṃ ca yathā kṛṣṇo devīnāṃ prakṛtiryathā ।। āśramāṇāṃ yathā vipro vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śivaḥ ।।5।। yathā gaṇeśaḥ pūjyānāṃ yathā vāṇī vipaścitām ।। śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedāstīrthānāṃ jāhnavī yathā ।।6।। taijasānāṃ yathā svarṇaṃ prāṇināṃ vaiṣṇavo yathā ।। dhanānāṃ ca yathā vidyā saṅgināṃ ca yathā priyā ।।7।। pramathānāṃ yathā rudraḥ śreyasāṃ ca yathā matiḥ।। ātmā yathendriyāṇāṃ ca cañcalānāṃ yathā manaḥ ।।8।। gurustrīṇāṃ yathā mātā bandhūnāṃ ca yathā patiḥ ।। baliṣṭhānāṃ yathā daivaṃ kālaḥ kalayatāṃ yathā ।।9।। suśīlaṃ caiva mitrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ rugyathā mune ।। yathā kīrtiḥ kīrtimatāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca yathā gṛham ।। 10।। yathā khalo hiṃsakānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ caiva puṃścalī ।। tejasvināṃ graheśaśca sahiṣṇūnāṃ yathā kṣitiḥ ।। 11 ।। yathā'mṛtaṃ bhakṣaṇānāṃ dāhakānāṃ yathā'nalaḥ ।। yathā śrīrdhanadātṝṇāṃ satīnāṃ ca yathā satī ।। 12 ।। prajeśānāṃ yathā brahmā saritāṃ sāgaro yathā ।। yathā sāma śrutīnāṃ ca gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā ।।13।। vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca yathā'śvatthaḥ puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā ।। yathā mārgo hi māsānāmṛtūnāṃ ca yathā madhuḥ ।। 14 ।। ādityānāṃ yathā sūryo rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaro yathā।। yathā bhīṣmo vasūnāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā ।। 15 ।। devarṣīṇāṃ yathā tvaṃ ca brahmarṣīṇāṃ yathā bhṛguḥ ।। nṛpāṇāṃ ca yathā rāmaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā ।। 16 ।। yathā sanatkumāraśca yogināṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ śarabho yathā ।। 17 ।। yathā himādriḥ śailānāṃ maṇīnāṃ kaustubho yathā ।। sarasvatī nadīnāṃ ca yathā puṇyasvarūpiṇī ।। 18 ।। gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho yathā śreṣṭhaśca nārada ।। yathā kubero yakṣāṇāṃ sumālī rakṣasāṃ yathā ।। 19 ।। yathā śreṣṭhā ca nārīṇāṃ śatarūpā varā parā ।। manūnāṃ ca yathā śreṣṭhaḥ svayaṃ svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ ।। 20।। sundarīṇāṃ yathā rambhā yathā māyā ca māyinām ।। ekādaśīvratamidaṃ vratānāṃ ca varaṃ tathā ।।21।। kartavyaṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ nityameva ca ।। yatīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 22 ।। satyaṃ sarvāṇi pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ।। santyevaudanamāśritya śrīkṛṣṇavratavāsare ।। 23 ।। bhuktvaitāni ca pāpāni yo bhuṅkte tatra mandadhīḥ ।। ihātipātakī so'pi yātyante narakaṃ dhruvam।।24।। ekādaśīpramāṇāni yugasaṃkhyākṛtāni ca ।। kumbhīpāke mahāghore sthitvā caṇḍālatāṃ vrajet।।29।। galitavyādhiyuktaśca tataḥ saptasu janmasu।। paścānmukto bhavetpāpādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।।29।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahmanyo doṣastatra bhojane ।। dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣo mayoktaśca śrutaḥ purā ।।27।। daśamīlaṅghane doṣaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ।। purā śruto dharmavaktrādvedasāroddhṛto'pi ca ।।28।। daśamīṃ yaḥ kalāmātrāṃ mūḍho'jñānena laṅghayet ।। yāti śrīstadgṛhāttūrṇaṃ śāpaṃ dattvā tu dāruṇam ।।29।। iha tadvaṃśahāniśca yaśohānirbhaveddhruvam ।। ante manvantaraśatamandhakūpe vaseddvija ।। 30।। daśamyekādaśī vāpi dvādaśī yatra vāsare ।। tatra bhuktvā paradine upoṣya vratamācaret ।।31।। dvādaśyāṃ ca vrataṃ kṛtvā trayodaśyāṃ ca pāraṇam ।। dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣo vratināṃ tanna vidyate ।। 32 ।। saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte kiṃcideva sā।। tatropoṣyā dvitīyā ca parā cedyadi vardhate ।।33।। ṣaṣṭidaṇḍātmikā yatra prabhāte ca tithitrayam ।। kurvanti gṛhiṇaḥ pūrvaṃ caiva yatyādayastathā ।।34।। paratrānaśanaṃ kṛtvā nityakṛtyaṃ samācaret ।। vrate jāgaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvatraivācaredbudhaḥ ।।35।। tatpūrvadivase nityaṃ vrate kṛtvā pare'hani ।। ekādaśyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ pāraṇaṃ tu samācaret ।। 36 ।। vaiṣṇavānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca vidhavānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। sarvāḥ samā upoṣyāstā bhikṣūṇāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। 37 ।। śuklāmeva tu kurvanti gṛhiṇo vaiṣṇavetarāḥ ।। na kṛṣṇālaṅghane doṣasteṣāṃ vedeṣu nārada ।। 38 ।। śayanībodhinīmadhye yā kṛṣṇaikādaśī bhavet ।। saivopoṣyā gṛhasthena nānyā kṛṣṇā kadācana ।।39।। ityevaṃ kathito brahmannirṇayo'yaṃ śrutau śrutaḥ ।। vratasyāsya vidhānaṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 40 ।। kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ pūrvāhṇe na ca bhuṅkte punarjalam ।। ekākī kuśaśayyāyāṃ naktaṃ śayanamācaret ।। 41 ।। brāhme muhūrte cotthāya prātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca ।। nityakṛtyaṃ vidhāyātha tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ।। ।। 42 ।। vratopavāsaṃ saṃkalpya śrīkṛṣṇaprītipūrvakam ।। kṛtvā sandhyāṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca vidhāyāhnikamācaret ।। 43 ।। nityapūjāṃ dine kṛtvā vratadravyaṃ samāharet ।। kṛtvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ pradṛṣṭaṃ vidhibodhitam ।। 44 ।। āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ puṣpānulepanam ।। dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam ।। 45 ।। gandhaṃ snānīyatāmbūle madhuparkaṃ punarjalam ।। etānyāhṛtya divase vrataṃ naktaṃ samācaret ।। 46 ।। upaviśyāsane pūto dhṛtvā dhauteyavāsasī ।। ācamya śrīhariṃ natvā svastivācanamācaret।। 47 ।। āropya maṅgalaghaṭaṃ dhānyādhāre śubhe kṣaṇe ।। phalaśākhācaṃdanāktaṃ vedoktaṃ munibhirmudā ।।48।। devaṣaṭkaṃ samāvāhya pṛthagdhānyaiḥ samācaret ।। pūjāṃ pañcopacāraiśca prakṛṣṭaiśca vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। 49 ।। gaṇeśvaraṃ dinakaraṃ vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ।। saṃpūjyaitānpraṇamyātha vrataṃ kuryāddhariṃ smaran ।। 50 ।। nārādhya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca yadi karma samācaret ।। nityaṃ naimittikaṃ cāpi tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ।। 51 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vratāṅgabhūtameva ca ।। kaṇvaśākhoktamiṣṭaṃ ca vrataṃ śṛṇu mahāmune ।।52 ।। sāmavedoktadhyānena dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam ।। puṣpaṃ ca śirasi nyasya punardhyānaṃ samācaret ।।93।। dhyānaṃ śṛṇu nigūḍhaṃ ca sarveṣāmapi vāñchitam ।। na prakāśyamabhaktāya bhaktaprāṇādhikaṃ param ।।54 ।। navīnanīrado yadvacchyāmasundaravigraham ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrābhāvinindyāsyamanuttamam ।। 55 ।। śaratsūryodayābjānāṃ prabhāmocanalocanam।। svāṃgasauṃdaryaśobhābhī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।।56।। gopīlocanakoṇaiśca prasannairatisūcakaiḥ ।। śaśvannirīkṣyamāṇaṃ tatprāṇairiva vinirmitam ।। 57 ।। rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rāsollāsasamutsukam।। rādhāvaktraśaraccandrasudhāpānacakorakam।।58।। kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam ।। 59 ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇaṃ kirīṭojjvalaśekharam ।। vinodamuralīnyastahastaṃ pūjyaṃ surāsuraiḥ ।। 60 ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca vanditam ।। kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ yastamīśvaramahaṃ bhaje ।। 61 ।। dhyātvā'nena tamāvāhya copahārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।। dattvā saṃpūjayedbhaktyā mantrairebhiśca nārada ।। 62 ।। āsanaṃ svarṇanirmāṇaṃ ratnasāraparicchadam ।। nānācitra vicitrāḍhyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara ।। 63 ।। vahniprakṣālitaṃ vastraṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। mūlyānirvacanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ rādhikāpate ।। ।। 64 ।। pādaprakṣālanārhaṃ ca suvarṇapātrasaṃsthitam ।। suvāsitaṃ śītalaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ karuṇānidhe ।। 65 ।। idamarghyaṃ pavitraṃ ca śaṅkhatoyasamanvitam ।। puṣpadūrvācandanāktaṃ gṛhyatāṃ bhaktavatsala ।। 66 ।। suvāsitaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ candanāgurusaṃyutam ।। sadyaste prītijanakaṃ gṛhyatāṃ sarvakāraṇa ।। 67 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumośīramuttamam ।। sarvepsitamidaṃ kṛṣṇa gṛhyatāmanulepanam ।। 68 ।। raso vṛkṣaviśeṣasya nānādravyasamanvitaḥ।। sugandhiyuktaḥ sukhado dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 69 ।। divāniśaṃ supradīpto ratnasāravinirmitaḥ ।। punardhvāntanāśabījaṃ dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 70 ।। nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi svādūni surabhīṇi ca ।। coṣyādīni pavitrāṇi svātmārāma pragṛhyatām ।।71।। sāvitrīgranthisayuktaṃ svarṇatantuvinirmitam ।। gṛhyatāṃ devadeveśa racitaṃ cāru kāruṇā।।72।। amūlyaratnaracitaṃ sarvā vayavabhūṣaṇam।। tviṣā jājvalyamānaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ nandanandana।।73।। pradhāno varṇanīyaśca sarvamaṅgalakarmaṇi ।। pragṛhyatāṃ dīnabandho gandho'yaṃ maṅgalapradaḥ ।।74।। dhātrī śrīphalapatrotthaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ manoharam।। vāñchitaṃ sarvalokānāṃ bhagavanpratigṛhyatām ।।75।। vāñchanīyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam।। mayā niveditaṃ nātha tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām।।76।। sarveṣāṃ prītijanakaṃ sumiṣṭaṃ madhuraṃ madhu।। sadratnasārapātrasthaṃ gopīkānta pragṛhyatām ।। 77 ।। nirmalaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ supavitraṃ suvāsitam ।। punarācamanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ madhusūdana ।। 78 ।। iti ṣoḍaśopacārāndattvā bhakto mudā'nvitaḥ ।। mantreṇānena puṣpāṇi mālyaṃ dattvā prayatnataḥ ।।79।। nānāprakārapuṣpaiśca grathitaṃ śuklatantunā ।। pravaraṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca mālyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ prabho ।। 80 ।। iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyānmūlamantreṇa ca vratī ।। kuryāttatstavanaṃ bhaktyā puṭāñjaliyutaḥ sudhīḥ ।। 81 ।। bhakta uvāca ।। he kṛṣṇa rādhikānātha karuṇāsāgara prabho ।। saṃsārasāgare ghore māmuddhara bhayānake ।। 82 ।। śatajanmakṛtāyāsādudvignasya mama prabho ।। svakarmapāśanigaḍairbaddhasya mokṣaṇaṃ kuru ।। 83 ।। praṇataṃ pādapadme te paśya māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। bhavapāśabhayādbhītaṃ pāhi tvaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 84 ।। bhaktihīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca vedataḥ ।। vastumantravihīnaṃ yattatsaṃpūrṇaṃ kuru prabho ।। 89 ।। vedoktavihitā'jñānātsvāṅgahīne ca karmaṇi ।। tvannāmoccāraṇenaiva sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaveddhare।।86।। iti stutvā taṃ praṇamya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ।। mahotsavaṃ vidhāyātha kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī ।।87।। kṛtvā vratopavāsaṃ ca yadi nidrāṃ niṣevate ।। punareva jalaṃ bhuṅkte vratārdhaphalabhāgbhavet ।। 88 ।। yatnena ca haviṣyānnaṃ sakṛdeva samācaret ।। mantreṇānena viprendra śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇaṃ smaran ।। 89 ।। annaṃ hi prāṇināṃ prāṇā brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā ।। dehi me viṣṇurūpaṃ tvaṃ vratopavāsayoḥ phalam ।। 90 ।। evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā bhārate vratamuttamam ।। pūrvānsapta parānsapta svātmānamuddhareddhruvam ।।91।। mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ caiva śvaśrūṃ ca śvaśuraṃ sutām ।। jāmātaraṃ tathā bhṛtyamuddharenniścitaṃ naraḥ ।। 92 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra śrīkṛṣṇacaritavratam ।। sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāramaparaṃ kathayāmi te ।। ।। 93 ।। iti śrībrahmavavarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde ekādaśīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। ।। 26 ।।
<4.27> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ punaḥ ।। gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ varadānaṃ manīṣitam ।। 1 ।। hemante prathame māsi gopikāḥ kāmamohitāḥ ।। kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ bhaktyā ca yāvanmāsaṃ susaṃyutāḥ ।। 2 ।। snātvā sūryasutātīre pārvatīṃ vālukāmayīm ।। kṛtvā'vāhya ca mantreṇa pūjāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ ।। 3 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiśca manoharaiḥ ।। nānāprakārapuṣpaiśca mālyairbahuvidhairapi ।। 4 ।। dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvastrairnānāphalairmune ।। maṇimuktāpravālaiśca vādyairnānāvidhairapi ।। 5 ।। he devi jagatāṃ mātaḥ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇi ।। nandagopasutaṃ kāntamasmabhyaṃ dehi suvrate ।। 6 ।। mantreṇānena deveśīṃ parihāraṃ vidhāya ca ।। tataḥ kṛtvā tu saṃkalpaṃ pūjayan mūlamantrataḥ ।। 7 ।। mantrastu sāmavedokto'yātayāmaḥ sabījakaḥ ।। oṃ śrīdurgāyai sarvavighnavināśinyai nama iti ।।8 ।। puṣpaṃ mālyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā śubham ।। mantreṇānena tadbhaktyā daduḥ sarvā mudānvitāḥ ।। 9 ।। pravālamālayā bhaktyā cemaṃ mantraṃ sahasradhā ।। japaṃ kṛtvā ca stutvā ca praṇemuḥ śirasā bhuvi ।। 10 ।। sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye sarvakāmaprade śive ।। dehi me vāñchitaṃ devi namaste śaṃkarapriye ।। 11 ।। ityuktvā ca namaskāraṃ kṛtvā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām।। naivedyāni ca sarvāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo yayurgṛham ।। 12 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। stavarājaṃ śṛṇu mune tuṣṭuvuryena pārvatīm ।। bhaktyā gopāṅganāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradām ।। 13 ।। jagatyekārṇave ghore rudrasūryavivarjite ।। añjanākāratoyena saṃplute ca carācare ।। 14 ।। dattaṃ purā brahmaṇe ca hariṇā jalaśāyinā ।। tasmai dattvā sarvamidaṃ nidrāṃ bheje jagatpatiḥ ।। 15 ।। nābhipadme jagatsraṣṭā madhunā kaiṭabhena ca ।। pīḍitaḥ parituṣṭāva mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ।। 16 ।। brahmovāca ।। durge śive'bhaye māye nārāyaṇi sanātani ।। jaye me maṅgalaṃ dehi namaste sarvamaṅgale ।। 17 ।। daityanāśārthavacano dakāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। ukāro vighnanāśārthaṃ vācako vedasaṃmataḥ ।। 18 ।। repho rogaghnavacano gaśca pāpaghnavācakaḥ ।। bhayaśatrughnavacanaścākāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।। 19 ।। smṛtyukti smaraṇādyasyā ete naśyanti niścitam ।। ato durgā hareḥ śaktirhariṇā parikīrtitā ।। 20 ।। vipattivācako durgaścākāro nāśavācakaḥ ।। durgaṃ naśyati yā nityaṃ sā durgā parikīrtitā।।। 21 ।। durgo daityendravacano'pyākāro nāśavācakaḥ ।। taṃ nanāśa purā tena budhairdurgā prakīrtitā ।। 22 ।। śaśca kalyāṇavacana ikārotkṛṣṭavācakaḥ ।। samūhavācakaścaiva vākāro dātṛvācakaḥ ।। 23 ।। śreyaḥsaṅghotkṛṣṭadātrī śivā tena prakīrtitā ।। śivarāśirmūrttimatī śivā tena prakīrtitā ।। 24 ।। śivo hi mokṣavacanaścākāro dātṛvācakaḥ ।। svayaṃ nirvāṇadātrī yā sā śivā parikīrtitā ।। 25 ।। abhayo bhayanāśoktaścākāro dātṛvācakaḥ ।। pradadātyabhayaṃ sadyaḥ sā'bhayā parikīrtitā ।। 26 ।। rājyaśrīvacano māśca yāśca prāpaṇavācakaḥ ।। tāṃ prāpayati yā sadyaḥ sā māyā parikīrtitā ।। 27 ।। māśca mokṣārthavacano yāśca prāpaṇavācakaḥ ।। taṃ prāpayati yā nityaṃ sā māyā parikīrtitā।।28।। nārāyaṇārdhāṅgabhūtā tena tulyā ca tejasā।। sadā tasya śarīrasthā tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā ।।29 ।। nirguṇasya ca nityasya vācakaśca sanātanaḥ ।। sadā nityā nirguṇā yā kīrtitā sā sanātanī ।। 30 ।। jayaḥ kalyāṇavacano yākāro dātṛvācakaḥ ।। jayaṃ dadāti yā nityaṃ sā jayā parikīrtitā ।। 31 ।। sarva maṅgalaśabdaśca saṃpūṇaiśvaryavācakaḥ ।। ākāro dātṛvacanastaddātrī sarvamaṅgalā ।।32।। nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ sāraṃ nāmārthasahasaṃyutam ।। nārāyaṇena yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṅkaje ।। 33 ।। tasmai dattvā nidritaśca babhūva jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। madhukaiṭabhau durgāṃ tau brahmāṇaṃ hantumudyatau ।। 34 ।। stotreṇānena sa brahmā stutiṃ natvā cakāra ha ।। sākṣātstutā tadā durgā brahmaṇe kavacaṃ dadau ।। 35 ।। śrīkṛṣṇakavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvarakṣaṇanāmakam ।। dattvā tasmai mahāmāyā sā'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 36 ।। stotraṃ kurvanti nidrāṃ ca saṃrakṣya kavacena vai ।। nidrānugrahataḥ sadyaḥ stotrasyaiva prabhāvataḥ ।। 37 ।। tatrājagāma bhagavānvṛṣarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। śaktyā ca durgayā sārdhaṃ śaṃkarasya jayāya ca ।। 38 ।। sarathaṃ śaṃkaraṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā ca nirbhayaṃ dadau।। atyūrdhvaṃ prāpayāmāsa jayā tasmai jayaṃ dadau ।। 39 ।। stotrasyaiva prabhāveṇa saṃprāpya kavacaṃ vidhiḥ ।। varaṃ ca kavacaṃ prāpya nirbhayaṃ prāpa niścitam ।। 40 ।। brahmā dadau maheśāya stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ varam।। tripurasya ca saṃgrāme sarathe patite harau ।। 41 ।। brahmāstraṃ ca gṛhītvā sa sanidraṃ śrīhariṃ smaran ।। stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ prāpya jaghāna tripuraṃ haraḥ ।। 42 ।। stotreṇānena tāṃ durgāṃ kṛtvā gopālikā stutim।। lebhire śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ stotrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ।।43।। gopakanyā kṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvamaṅgalanāmakam ।। vāṃchitārthapradaṃ sadyaḥ sarvavighnavināśanam ।। 44 ।। trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca mānavaḥ।। śaivo vā vaiṣṇavo vā'pi śākto durgātpramucyate ।।45।। rājadvāre śmaśāne ca dāvāgnau prāṇasaṃkaṭe ।। hiṃsrajantubhayagrasto magnaḥ pote mahārṇave ।।46।। śatrugraste ca saṃgrāme kārāgāre vipadgate ।। guruśāpe brahmaśāpe bandhubhede ca dustare ।।47।। sthānabhraṣṭe dhanabhraṣṭe jātibhraṣṭe śucā'nvite ।। patibhede putrabhede khalasarpaviṣānvite ।।48।। stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa sadyo mucyeta nirbhayaḥ ।। vāṃchitaṃ labhate sadyaḥ sarvaiśvaryamanuttamam ।। 49 ।। iha loke harerbhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ ca satataṃ smṛtim ।। ante dāsyaṃ ca labhate pārvatyāśca prasādataḥ।। 50।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte gopakanyākṛtaṃ sarvamaṃgalāstotram ।। anena stavarājena tuṣṭuvurnityamīśvarīm ।। praṇemuḥ parayā bhaktyā yāvanmāsaṃ vrajāṅganāḥ ।। 51 ।। evaṃ pūrṇe ca māse ca samāptidivase tathā ।। snātuṃ prajagmurgopyaśca vastrāṇyādhāya tattaṭe ।।52।। nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi ratnamūlyāni nārada ।। pītalohitaśuklāni cārūṇi miśritāni ca ।। 53 ।। tīrāvṛtānyasaṃkhyāni taiśca tīraṃ suśobhanam ।। candanāgurukastūrī vāyunā surabhīkṛtam ।।54।। naivedyaiśca bahuvidhaiḥ kāladeśodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ ।। dhūpaiḥ pradīpaiḥ sindūraiḥ kuṅkumaiśca virājitam ।। 55 ।। jale krīḍonmukhā gopyo babhūvuḥ kautukena ca ।। nagnāḥ
