।। pālayiṣyati yatnena sītā tvaṃ ca bhaviṣyasi ।। 158 ।। gatvā rāmo'pi mithilāṃ tvadvivāhaṃ kariṣyati ।। nārāyaṇasya kāntā tvaṃ kalpe kalpe bhaviṣyasi ।। 159 ।। ityuktvā tāṃ samāliṅgya pārvatī svālayaṃ yayau।। gatvā sā mithilāṃ sādhvī śiśurūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 160।। lāṅgalasya ca rekhāyāṃ sukhāttasthau ca māyayā ।। vilokya janakastāṃ ca nagnāṃ mudritalocanām ।। 161 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇāṃ ca rudantīṃ tejasā'nvitām ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ca gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā vakṣasi nārada ।। 162 ।। gacchantaṃ prati tatraiva vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। ayonisaṃbhavāṃ kanyāṃ kamalāṃ grahaṇaṃ kuru ।। 163 ।। nārāyaṇaste jāmātā bhavitetyeva me vacaḥ ।। śrutvā tadā devavāṇīṃ gṛhītvā kanyakāmṛṣiḥ ।। 164 ।। gatvā dadau svakāntāyai pālanāya mudā'nvitaḥ ।। sā labdhayauvanā prāpa rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ satī ।। 165 ।। vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa kāntaṃ trijagatāṃ patim ।। prakāśitaṃ vaśiṣṭhena pṛthivyāṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ ।। 166 ।। rādhā kṛtvā vratamidaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prāṇavallabham ।। gopāṅganāśca taṃ prāpurvratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ।। 167 ।। ityevaṃ kathitā vipra kathā gaurīvratasya ca ।। bhārate ca vratamidaṃ yā karoti kumārikā ।। svāminaṃ kṛṣṇatulyaṃ ca sā prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ।। 168 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। evaṃ vrataṃ ca cakrustā yāvanmāsaṃ ca gopikāḥ ।। pūrvastotreṇa tāṃ devīṃ tuṣṭuvuśca dinedine ।। 169 ।। samāptidivase gopyo vrataṃ kṛtvā mudā'nvitāḥ ।। kaṇvaśākhoktastotreṇa tuṣṭuvuḥ parameśvarīm ।। 170 ।। yena stotreṇa tāṃ stutvā sītā satyaparāyaṇā ।। sadyaḥ saṃprāpa kāntaṃ ca rāmaṃ rājīvalocanam ।। 171 ।। jānakyuvāca ।। śaktisvarūpe sarveṣāṃ sarvādhāre guṇāśraye ।। sadā śaṃkarayukte ca patiṃ dehi namo'stu te ।।172।। sṛṣṭisthityaṃtarūpeṇa sṛṣṭisthityantarūpiṇī ।। sṛṣṭisthityantabījānāṃ bījarūpe namo'stu te ।।173।। he gauri patimarmajñe pativrataparāyaṇe ।। pativrate patirate patiṃ dehi namostu te ।। 174 ।। sarvamaṃgalamāṅgalye sarvamaṃgalasaṃyute ।। sarvamaṃgalabīje ca namaste sarvamaṃgale ।। 175 ।। sarvapriye sarvabīje sarvāśubhavināśini ।। sarveśe sarvajanake namaste śaṃkarapriye ।। 176 ।। paramātmasvarūpe ca nityarūpe sanātani ।। sākāre ca nirākāre sarvarūpe namo'stu te ।। 177 ।। kṣuttṛṣṇecchā dayā śraddhā nidrā tandrā smṛtiḥ kṣamā ।। etāstava kalāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।। 178 ।। lajjā medhā tuṣṭipuṣṭī śāntisaṃpattivṛddhayaḥ ।। etāstava kalāḥ sarvāḥ sarvarūpe namo'stu te ।। 179 ।। dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasvarūpe ca tayorbījaphalaprade ।। sarvānirvacanīye ca mahāmāye namo'stu te ।। 180 ।। śive śaṃkarasaubhāgyayukte saubhāgyadāyini ।। hariṃ kāntaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ dehi devi namo'stu te ।। 181 ।। stotreṇānena yāḥ stutvā samāptidivase śivām ।। namanti parayā bhaktyā tā labhante hariṃ patim।।182।। iha kāntasukhaṃ bhuktvā patiṃ prāpya parātparam।। divyaṃ syandanamāruhya yātyante kṛṣṇasannidhim ।। 183 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte sītākṛtaṃ pārvatīstotram ।। samāptidivase rādhā gopībhiḥ saha saṃyutā ।। devīṃ praṇamya stutvā ca vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra ha ।। 184 ।। gosahasraṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ suvarṇaśatakaṃ mudā ।। viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā svagṛhaṃ gantumudyatā ।। 189 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca bhojayāmāsa sādaram ।। vādyāni vādayāmāsa bhikṣukāya dhanaṃ dadau ।। 186 ।। etasminnantare tatra durgā durgārtināśinī ।। āvirbabhūva gaganājjvalantī brahmatejasā ।। 187 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasanāsyā yoginīśatasaṃyutā ।। siṃhasthā ca daśabhujā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā ।।188।। śātakumbhamayāddivyādratnasāraparicchadāt ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇamāliṅgyorasi rādhikām ।।189।। dṛṣṭvā gopāṅganā devīṃ praṇemuśca mudā'nvitāḥ ।। āśiṣaṃ yuyuje durgā vāñchāsiddhirbhaviṣyati ।। 190 ।। gopikābhyo varaṃ dattvā tāḥ saṃbhāṣya ca sādaram ।। uvāca rādhikāṃ durgā smerānanasaroruhā ।। 191 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। rādhe sarveśvaraprāṇādadhike jagadambike ।। vrataṃ te lokaśikṣārthaṃ māyāmānuṣarūpiṇi ।। 192 ।। golokanāthaṃ golokaṃ śrīśailaṃ girijātaṭam ।। śrīrāsamaṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ vṛndāvanamanoharam ।। 193 ।। caritaṃ raticorasya strīṇāṃ mānasahārakam ।। viduṣaḥ kāmaśāstrāṇāṃ kiṃsvitsmarasi sundari ।। 194 ।। śrīkṛṣṇārdhāṅgasaṃbhūtā kṛṣṇatulyā ca tejasā ।। tavāṃśakalayā devyaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 195 ।। bhavatī ca hareḥ prāṇā bhavatyāśca hariḥ svayam ।। vede nāsti dvayorbhedaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 196 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi brahmā taptvā tapaḥ purā ।। na te dadarśa pādābjaṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 197 ।। kṛṣṇājñayā ca tvaṃ devi gopīrūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।। āgatā'si mahīṃ śānte kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 198 ।। suyajño hi nṛpaśreṣṭho manuvaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। tvatto jagāma golokaṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 199 ।। triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ cakāra pṛthivīṃ bhṛguḥ ।। tava mantreṇa kavacātkathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 200 ।। śaṃkarātprāpya tvanmantraṃ siddhaṃ kṛtvā ca puṣkare ।। jaghāna kārtavīryaṃ ca kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 201 ।। babhañja darpāddantaṃ ca gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ ।। tvatto nāma bhayaṃ cakre kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 202 ।। mayyuddhatāyāṃ kopena bhasmasātkartumīśvaraḥ ।। rarakṣāgatya matprītyā kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 203 ।। kalpe kalpe tava patiḥ kṛṣṇo janmani janmani ।। vrataṃ lokahitārthāya jaganmātastvayā kṛtam ।। 204 । aho śrīdāmaśāpena bhārāvataraṇena ca ।। bhūmau tavādhiṣṭhānaṃ ca kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 205 ।। ayonisaṃbhavā tvaṃ ca janmamṛtyujarāpahā ।। kalāvatīsutā puṇyā kathaṃ tvaṃ mānuṣī satī ।। 206 ।। triṣu māseṣvatīteṣu madhumāse manohare ।। nirjane nirmale rātrau suyogye rāsamaṇḍale ।। 207 ।। sarvābhirgopikābhiśca sārdhaṃ vṛndāvane vane ।। harṣeṇa hariṇā sārdhaṃ krīḍā te bhavitā sati ।। 208 ।। vidhātrā likhitā krīḍā kalpe kalpe mahītale ।। tava śrīhariṇā sārdhaṃ kena rādhe nivāryate ।। 209 ।। yathā saubhāgyayuktā'haṃ harasya śrīharipriye ।। tathā saubhāgyayuktā tvaṃ bhava kṛṣṇasya sundari ।। 210 ।। yathā kṣīreṣu dhāvalyaṃ yathā vahnau ca dāhikā ।। bhuvi gandho jale śaityaṃ tathā kṛṣṇe sthitistava ।। 211 ।। devī vā mānuṣī vā'pi gāndharvī rākṣasī tathā ।। tvattaḥ parā ca saubhāgyā na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati ।। 212 ।। parātparo guṇātīto brahmādīnāṃ ca vanditaḥ ।। svayaṃ kṛṣṇastavādhīno madvareṇa bhaviṣyati ।। 213 ।। brahmānantaśivārādhyo bhavitā tvadvaśaḥ sati ।। dhyānāsādhyo durārādhyaḥ sarveṣāmapi yoginām ।।214।। tvaṃ ca bhāgyavatī rādhe strījātiṣu na te parā ।। kṛṣṇena sārdhaṃ paścāttvaṃ golokaṃ ca gamiṣyasi ।।215।। ityuktvā pārvatī sadyastatraivāntardadhe mune ।। sārdhaṃ gopālikābhiśca rādhikā gantumudyatā।।216।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇo jagāma rādhikāpuraḥ।। rādhā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram।।217।। pītavastraparīdhānaṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।। ājānumālatīmālāvanamālāvibhūṣitam।। 218 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanam ।।219।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ sadratnamukuṭojjvalam ।। pakvadāḍimabījābhadaśanaṃ sumanoharam ।। 220 ।। vinodamuralīhastanyastalīlāsaroruham ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāmamanoharam ।।221।। guṇātītaṃ stūyamānaṃ brahmānantaśivādibhiḥ।। brahmasvarūpaṃ brahmaṇyaṃ śrutibhiścānirūpitam।।222।। avyaktamakṣarāvyaktaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। māṅgalyaṃ maṅgalādhāraṃ maṅgalaṃ maṅgalapradam ।। 223 ।। dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutaṃ rūpaṃ saṃbhramātpraṇanāma tam ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitā rādhā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। 224 ।। darśaṃdarśaṃ mukhāmbhojaṃ sasmitā vakralocanā ।। mukhasyācchādanaṃ cakre vrīḍayā ca punaḥ punaḥ ।।225।। dṛṣṭvā haristāmuvāca prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। gopālikāsamūhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ purataḥ sthitaḥ ।। 226 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ।। prāṇādhike rādhike tvaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu manīṣitam ।। bho bho gopālikā sarvā varaṃ vṛṇuta vāñchitam।।227।। kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā varaṃ vavre ca rādhikā ।। gopālikāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca sarvasaṃkalpapādapāt ।। 228 ।। rādhikovāca ।। tvatpādābje manmanoliḥ satataṃ bhramatu prabho ।। pātuṃ bhaktirasaṃ padme madhupaśca yathā madhu।।229 ।। madīya prāṇanāthastvaṃ bhava janmani janmani ।। tvadīyacaraṇāmbhoje dehi bhaktiṃ sudurlabhām।। 230 ।। tava smṛtau guṇe cittaṃ svapne jñāne divāniśam ।। bhavennimagnaṃ satatametanmama manīṣitam ।। 231 ।। gopālikā ūcuḥ ।। yathā rādhāṃ tathā naśca prāṇabandho divāniśam ।। bhaviṣyasi prāṇanāthaḥ pāsyasi pratijanmani ।। 232 ।। āsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā tathā'stvevamuvāca ha ।। prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānyaśodānandavardhanaḥ ।। 233 ।। krīḍāpadmaṃ rādhikāyai sahasradalasaṃyutam ।। lalitāṃ mālatīmālāṃ dadau prītyā jagatpatiḥ ।।234।। mālāsamūhaṃ puṣpāṇi gopībhyo gopikāpatiḥ ।। prahasya paramaprītyā pradadāvityuvāca ha ।। 239 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। triṣu māseṣvatīteṣu yūyaṃ krīḍāṃ mayā saha ।। rāsamaṇḍalaramye ca vṛndāraṇye kariṣyatha ।। 236 ।। yathā'haṃ ca tathā yūyaṃ nāhaṃ bhedaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ ।। prāṇo'haṃ caiva yuṣmākaṃ yūyaṃ prāṇā mama prabhoḥ ।। 237 ।। vrataṃ vo lokarakṣārthaṃ na hi svārthamidaṃ priyāḥ ।। sahāgatāśca golokādgamanaṃ ca mayā saha ।। 238 ।। gacchata svālayaṃ śīghraṃ vo'haṃ janmani janmani ।। prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasyo yūyaṃ me nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 239 ।। ityuktvā śrīharistatra tasthau sūryasutātaṭe ।। tasthurgopālikāḥ sarvā vīkṣya kṛṣṇaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ।। 240।। sarvāḥ prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sasmitā vakralocanāḥ ।। prītyā cakṣuścakorābhyāṃ mukhacandraṃ papurhareḥ ।। 241 ।। tāḥ śīghraṃ prayayurgehaṃ jayaṃ dattvā punaḥpunaḥ ।। hariśca śiśubhiḥ sārddhaṃ prasannaḥ svālayaṃ yayau ।। 242 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ hareścaritamaṅgalam ।। gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham ।। 243 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde gopikāvastraharaṇaprastāvo nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 27 ।।
<4.28> nārada uvāca ।। triṣu māseṣvatīteṣu tāsāṃ ca hariṇā saha ।। vada kena prakāreṇa babhūva tanusaṃgamaḥ ।।1।। vṛndāvanaṃ kiṃprakāraṃ kiṃvidhaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। harirekastāśca bahvyaḥ kena krīḍā babhūva ha ।। 2 ।। kutūhalaṃ bhavati me idaṃ śrotuṃ navaṃ navam ।। kathayasva mahābhāga puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana ।। 3 ।। kathā purāṇasārāṇāṃ rāsayātrā hareraho ।। harilīlāḥ pṛthivyāṃ tu sarvāḥ pratimanoharāḥ ।। 4 ।। sūta uvāca ।। nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। prahasya suprasannāsyaḥ pravaktumupacakrame ।। 5 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ekadā śrīharirnaktaṃ vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau ।। śubhe śuklatrayodaśyāṃ pūrṇe candrodaye mune ।। 6 ।। yūthikāmālatīkundamādhavīpuṣpavāyunā ।। vāsitaṃ kalanādena madhubhrāṇāṃ manoharam ।। 7 ।। navapallavasaṃyuktaṃ puṃskokilarutaśrutam ।। navalakṣarāsavāsasaṃyuktaṃ sumanoharam ।। 8 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena suvāsitam ।। karpūrānvitatāmbūlabhogadravyasamanvitam ।।9 ।। prasūnaiścampakānāṃ ca kastūrīcandanānvitaiḥ।। ratiyogyairviracitairnānātalpaiḥ suśobhitam ।। 10 ।। dīptaṃ ratnapradīpaiśca dhūpena surabhīkṛtam ।। nānāpuṣpaiśca racitaṃ mālājālairvirājitam ।। 11 ।। parito vartulākāraṃ tatraiva rāsamaṇḍalam ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumena susaṃskṛtam ।। 12।। puṣpodyānaiḥ puṣpitaiśca yuktakrīḍāsarovaraiḥ।। haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇairjalakukkuṭakūjitaiḥ ।। 13 ।। krīḍanīyaiḥ sundaraiśca surataśramahāribhiḥ ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśatoyapūrṇaiḥ sunirmalaiḥ ।। 14।। dadhipūrṇaśukladhānyajalairnirmañchanīkṛtam ।। rambhāstambhasamūhena sundareṇa suśobhitam ।। 15 ।। āmrapallavayuktena sūtrabandhena cāruṇā ।। bhūṣitaṃ maṃgalaghaṭaiḥ sindūracandanānvitaiḥ।।16।। mālatīmālyasaṃyuktairnārikelaphalānvitaiḥ।। sa rāsamaṇḍalaṃ dṛṣṭvā jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ।।17।। cakāra tatra kutukādvinodamuralīravam ।। gopīnāṃ kāmukīnāṃ ca kāmavardhanakāraṇam ।। 18 ।। tacchrutvā rādhikā sadyo mumoha madanāturā ।। babhūva sthāṇuvaddehā dhyānaikatānamānasā ।। 19 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya punaḥ śuśrāva sā dhvanim ।। uvāsa sā samuttasthau samudvignā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 20 ।। tyaktvā cāvaśyakaṃ karma niḥsasāra drutaṃ gṛhāt ।। yayau tadanusāreṇa prasamīkṣya caturdiśam ।। 21 ।। dhyāyantī caraṇāmbhojaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ।। tejasā ca dyotayantī sadratnasārabhūṣataiḥ ।। 22 ।। bahirbabhūvustāstrastā vareṇa hṛtacetanāḥ ।। kuladharmaṃ parityajya niśaṃkāḥ kāmamohitāḥ ।। 23 ।। trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca tāḥ suśīlādayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। rādhikāyāḥ priyatamā gopīnāṃ pravarā yayuḥ ।।24।। tāsāṃ paścādyayurgopyastāsāṃ saṃkhyā nibodha me।। samā veṣeṇa vayasā rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।।25।। yayuḥ suśīlāsaṃgena sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। yayuścandramukhī paścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। 26 ।। ekādaśasahasrāṇi mādhavyālyaśca niryayuḥ ।। jagmuḥ kadambamālālyaḥ sa sahasrāṇi trayodaśa ।।27।। yayuḥ kuntīvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi daśa smṛtāḥ ।। caturdaśa sahasrāṇi yayustā yamunānugāḥ ।।28।। jāhnavīsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi yayurnava ।। yayurnavasahasrāṇi padmamukhyālya eva ca ।।29।। sāvitryālyaḥ paṃcadaśa sahasrāṇi yayurvrajāt ।। pārijātāvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa ।। 30।। svayaṃprabhānugāḥ sapta sahasrāṇi yayurvrajāt ।। yayuḥ sudhāmukhīgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ।।31।। śubhānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ।। padmānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ।।32।। gaurī padmā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ।। yayuḥ sarvamaṅgalālyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।।33।। kālikālyo yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। niryayuḥ kamalālyaśca sahasrāṇi trayodaśa ।। 34 ।। durgānugā yayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। yayuḥ sarasvatīpaścātsahasrāṇi trayodaśa ।। 35 ।। prajagmurbhāratīpaścātsahasrāṇi daśa vrajāt ।। aparṇāsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ।। 36 ।। ratipaścādvayasyāśca sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa ।। gaṅgāvayasyāḥ prayayuḥ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa ।। 37 ।। prajagmurambikāpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। satīpaścādyayurgopyaḥ sahasrāṇi trayodaśa ।।38।। nandinīsahacāriṇyaḥ sahasrāṇi yayurdaśa ।। prayayuḥ sundarīpaścātsahasrāṇi trayodaśa। ।।39।। yayuḥ kṛṣṇapriyāpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। yayurmadhumatīpaścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa।। 40।। yayuścampānugā gopyaḥ sahasrāṇi trayodaśa ।। candanālyo yayuḥ paścātsahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। 41।। sarvā babhūvurekatra tatra tasthuḥ palaṃ mudā ।। tatrāyayurgopikāśca mālāhastāśca kāścana ।। 42 ।। cārucandanahastāśca kāścittatrāyayurvrajāt ।। śvetacāmarahastāśca kāścittatrāyayurmudā ।। 43 ।। tatrāyayurgopakanyāḥ kāścitkastūrikākarāḥ ।। tatrāyayurgopakanyāḥ kāścitkuṃkumavāhikāḥ ।। 44 ।। kāścittatrāyayugopyastāmbūlapātravāhikāḥ ।। yāvatkāñcanavastrāṇāṃ vāhikā gopakanyakāḥ ।। kāścittatrāyayuḥ śīghraṃ yatra candrāvalī mudā।।49।। sarvāścaikatra saṃbhūya sasmitāśca mudānvitāḥ ।। vidhāya rādhikāveṣaṃ sthānācca prayayurmudā।।46।। cakruḥ punaḥ punastāśca hariśabdajapaṃ pathi ।। prāpurvṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ dadṛśū rāsamaṇḍalam।।47।। svargebhyaḥ sundaraṃ dṛśyaṃ rākāpatikarānvitam ।। sunirjanaṃ kusumitaṃ vāsitaṃ puṣpavāyunā।।48।। nārīṇāṃ kāmajananaṃ munimohanakāraṇam ।। śuśruvustatra tāḥ sarvāḥ puṃskokilakaladhvanim ।। 49 ।। atisūkṣmakalaṃ cātibhramarāṇāṃ manoharam ।। prasūnamadhumattānāṃ bhramarīsaṅgasaṅginām ।। 50 ।। śubhe kṣaṇe praviveśa rādhikā rāsamaṇḍalam ।। sarvābhirālibhiḥ sārdhaṃ dhyātvā kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ।। 51 ।। rādhāmārāttu saṃvīkṣya kṛṣṇastatra mudā'nvitaḥ ।। jagāmānuvrajanprītyā sasmito madanāturaḥ ।। 52 ।। madhyasthāṃ sakhisaṅghānāṃ ratnālaṅkārabhūṣitām ।। divyavastraparīdhānāṃ sasmitāṃ vakralocanām।। 53 ।। gajendragāminīṃ ramyāṃ munimānasamohinīm।। navīnaveṣavayasā rūpeṇātimanoharām ।।54।। talaśroṇinitambānāṃ bhāraśeṣānvitāṃ parām ।। cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ śaraccandranibhānanām ।। bibhratīṃ kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam ।। 55 ।। rādhā dadarśa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram ।। navayauvanasaṃpannaṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitam ।। ।। 56 ।। kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyalīlādhāma manoharam ।। prāṇādhikāṃ tāṃ paśyantīṃ paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। 97 ।। paramādbhutarūpaṃ ca sarvatrānupamaṃ param ।। vicitraveṣaṃ cūḍāṃ ca bibhrataṃ sasmitaṃ mudā ।। 58 ।। vakralocanakoṇena darśaṃdarśaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ।। mukhamācchādayāñcakre vrīḍayā sasmitā satī ।। 59 ।। mūrcchāmavāpa sā sadyaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgī babhūva hatacetanā ।। 60 ।। kaṭākṣakāmabāṇaiśca viddhaḥ krīḍārasonmukhaḥ ।। mūrcchāṃ prāpya na papāta tasthau sthāṇusamo hariḥ ।।61।। papāta muralī tasya krīḍākamalamujjvalam ।। dvitīyaṃ pītavastraṃ ca śikhipicchaṃ śarīrataḥ ।।62।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya yayau rādhāntikaṃ mudā ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi tāṃ prītyā samāśliṣya cucumba saḥ ।। 63 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasparśamātreṇa saṃprāpya cetanāṃ satī ।। prāṇādhikaṃ prāṇanāthaṃ samāśliṣya cucumba ha ।। 64 ।। mano jahāra rādhāyāḥ kṛṣṇastasya ca sā mune ।। jagāma rādhayā sārdhaṃ rasiko ratimandiram ।। 65 ।। ratnapradīpasaṃyuktaṃ ratnadarpaṇasaṃyutam ।। cārucampakaśayyābhiścandanāktābhī rājitam ।। 66 ।। karpūrānvitatāmbūlairbhogadravyaiḥ samanvitam ।। uvāca rādhayā sārdhaṃ kṛṣṇastatra mudānvitaḥ ।। 67 ।। rādhayā dattatāmbūlaṃ cakhāda madhusūdanaḥ ।। rāseśvarī kṛṣṇadattaṃ tāmbūlaṃ bubhuje mudā ।। 68 ।। dattaṃ carvitatāmbūlaṃ rādhāyai prabhuṇā mudā ।। cakhāda bhaktvā sā tūrṇaṃ prahasya madanāturā ।। 69 ।। rādhācarvitatāmbūlaṃ yayāce mādhavo mudā ।। na dadau rādhikā bhītā papāta caraṇāmbuje ।। 70 ।। etasminnantare tatra sakāmaḥ suratonmukhaḥ ।। suṣvāpa rādhayā sārdhaṃ ratitalpe manohare ।। 71 ।। śṛṅgārāṣṭaprakāraṃ ca viparītādikaṃ vibhuḥ ।। nakhadantakarāṇāṃ ca prahāraṃ ca yathocitam ।। 72 ।। kāmaśāstreṣu yadgopyaṃ cumbanāṣṭavidhaṃ param ।। kāminīnāṃ manohāri cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ ।। 73 ।। aṅgairaṅgāni pratyaṅgaiḥ pratyaṅgāni smarāturaḥ ।। cakārāśleṣaṇaṃ tatra kāmukīnāṃ sukhāvaham ।।74।। śṛṅgārakuśalau tau tu kāmaśāstrasupaṇḍitau ।। ratiyuddhavirāmaśca na babhūva dvayorapi ।। 75 ।। evaṃ gṛhe gṛhe ramye nānāmūrtiṃ vidhāya ca।। reme gopāṅganābhiśca suramye rāsamaṇḍale ।। 76 ।। gopīnāṃ nava lakṣāṇi gopānāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। lakṣāṇyaṣṭādaśa mune yuktāni rāsamaṇḍale ।। 77 ।। muktakeśāni nagnāni vicchinnabhūṣaṇāni ca ।। veṣocchinnāni mattāni mūrcchitāni smareṇa ca ।।78।। kaṅkaṇānāṃ kiṃkiṇīnāṃ valayānāṃ ca nārada ।। sadratnanūpurāṇāṃ ca śabdayuktāni saṃtatam ।।79।। evaṃ kṛtvā sthalakrīḍāṃ yayustāni jalaṃ mudā ।। kṛtvā tatra jalakrīḍāṃ pariśrāntāni sāmpratam ।। 80 ।। tūrṇaṃ jalātsamutthāya vāsāṃsi paridhāya ca ।। dadṛśurmukhapadmāni sadratnadarpaṇeṣu ca ।। 81 ।। candanāgurukastūrīdravyāṇi puṣpamālikāḥ ।। mudā paridadhustāni saṃprāpuścetanāni ca ।। ।। 82 ।। sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bhuktvā sarvāṇi kautukāt ।। dadṛśurmukhapadmāni sadratne darpaṇe'male ।। 83 ।। kācitkāmāturā kṛṣṇaṃ balādākṛṣya kautukāt ।। hastādvaṃśī nijagrāha vasanaṃ ca cakarṣa ha ।। 84 ।। kācitkāmapramattā ca nagnaṃ kṛtvā tu mādhavam ।। nijagrāha pītavastraṃ parihasya punardadau ।।85।। yuktiṃ śṛṇvityevamuktvā kācitsaṃgṛhya svāminam ।। cucumba gaṇḍe bimboṣṭhe samāśliṣya punaḥpunaḥ ।।86 ।। sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca mukhacandraṃ stanonnatam ।। kācicchroṇīṃ sulalitāṃ darśayāmāsa kāmataḥ ।। 87 ।। kācitkāntaṃ kare kṛtvā saṃsthāpya śroṇideśataḥ ।। cakāra cūḍānirmāṇaṃ mālatīmālyasaṃyutam ।।88।। kāciccūḍāṃ samākṛṣya mayūrapicchakaṃ dadau ।। guñjāmālyaṃ ca cūḍāyāṃ veṣṭayāmāsa kācana ।। 89 ।। pradadau svāmine kāmātpremavardhanahetave ।। kācitkāñcitsamākṛṣya nagnāṃ kṛtvā tu kāmataḥ ।। 90 ।। preṣayāmāsa kṛṣṇasya kroḍe candanacarcite ।। nanṛtuśca jaguḥ kāścitkāntaṃ kṛtvā tu kāmataḥ ।। 91 ।। nartanaṃ kārayāmāsa taṃ ca kācidbalena ca ।। kṛṣṇaśca vastraṃ kasyāśca vicakarṣa kutūhalāt ।। 92 ।। kāṃcitkṛtvā tu nagnāṃ ca kasyaicidaṃśukaṃ dadau ।। kṛṣṇo rādhāṃ samākṛṣya vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi।।93।। tasyāśca kabarīṃ ramyāṃ sunirmāṇaṃ cakāra ha ।। sindūraṃ ca dadau bhāle kastūrīṃ bindubhiḥ saha ।। 94 ।। atisūkṣmaṃ candanenduṃ kautukāttadadho dadau ।। patrāvalīṃ sulalitāṃ sukapole cakāra ha ।।95।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ cāru paridhāryya prayatnataḥ ।। padoḥ sadratnamaṃjīre gṛhītvā caraṇāmbuje।।96।। nakhanirmārjanaṃ kṛtvā sundaraṃ yāvakaṃ dadau ।। bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṃ kṛtvā saṃpralipyānulepanaiḥ ।। 97 ।। dattvā ca mālatīmālāṃ cucumba ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। cārulocanapadme ca cakārāñjanasaṃyute ।। 98 ।। pradadau nāsikāmadhye durlabhaṃ gajamauktikam।। śroṇideśe ca stanayornakhacchidraṃ cakāra ha ।।99।। cakāra dantadalanaṃ pakvabimbādhare vare ।। sarasaśca taṭe ramye puṣpodyāne sunirjane।। 100 ।। bahiścandrodaye ramye puṣpacandanacarcite ।। agurucandanāktena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। 101 ।। bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokilarutaśrute ।। bahumūrtīḥ saṃvidhāya yogināṃ paramo guruḥ ।। 102 ।। punaścakāra śṛṅgāraṃ gopīnāṃ cittahārakaḥ ।। kiṃkiṇīnāṃ kaṅkaṇānāṃ nūpurāṇāṃ ca nārada ।। 103 ।। śṛṅgārodrekatastatra babhūva sundaro ravaḥ ।। mūrcchāmavāpustāḥ sarvā navasaṃgamamātrataḥ ।। 104 ।। babhūvuracalāspandāḥ pulakāñcitavigrahāḥ ।। śṛṅgāravirate bhūte saṃprāpuścetanāṃ punaḥ ।। 105 ।। nakhadantaprahāraṃ ca pracakāra parasparam ।। kṛṣṇaḥ kararuhāghātaṃ dadau tāsāṃ kucopari ।। 106 ।। śroṇīdeśe sukaṭhine nakhacihnaṃ cakāra ha ।। nīvī visraṃsitā tāsāṃ kabarī kṣudraghaṇṭikā ।। 107 ।। dūrībhūtaṃ suvasanaṃ suveṣaṃ sumanoharam ।। āliṅganaṃ navavidhaṃ cumbanāṣṭavidhaṃ mudā ।। 108 ।। śṛṅgāraṃ ṣoḍaśavidhaṃ cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ ।। aṅgairaṅgāni pratyaṅgaiḥ pratyaṅgāni ca yoṣitām ।। 109 ।। cakārāliṅganaṃ prītyā kāmukīnāṃ ca kāmukaḥ ।। nārīṇāṃ ṣoḍaśa kalāḥ śṛṅgārastatpramāṇakaḥ ।। ।। 110 ।। kalābhedena tadbhedaṃ kāmaśāstravido viduḥ ।। prākṛtaṃ dvādaśavidhaṃ cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ ।। 111 ।। nirūpitaṃ kāmaśāstre cakāreśastato'dhikam ।। krīḍārambhe ca madhye ca viratau karma yoṣitām ।। 112 ।। prītyarthamapi kartavyaṃ cakāreśastato'dhikam ।। gopīkaṅkaṇarekhābhiḥ pādālaktakacihnitaḥ ।। śuśubhe kṛṣṇadehaśca yathā'drirgairikeṇa ca ।। 113 ।। evaṃbhūte pūrṇarāsasaṃbhūte rāsamaṇḍale ।। samājagmuḥ surāḥ sarve sakalatrāśca sānugāḥ ।। 114 ।। suvarṇasyandanasthāśca kautukātsvagaṇāvṛtāḥ ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ ।। 115 ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva siddhāśca pitarastathā ।। vidyādharāśca gandharvā yakṣarākṣasakinnarāḥ ।। sastrīkāśca samājagmurdadṛśuśca mudā'nvitāḥ ।। 116 ।। divyasyandanamāruhya śātakaumbhavinirmitam ।। suśobhitaṃ ca maṇinā ratnasāraparicchadam ।। 117 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukenaiva veṣṭitaṃ sumanoharam ।। śvetacāmarayuktaṃ ca sadratnadarpaṇāmbujam ।। 118 ।। śatacakraṃ citrayuktaṃ manoyāyi manoharam ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇakalaśojjvalaśekharam ।। 119 ।। samājagāma bhagavānpārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ ।। vāmapārśve mahākālo dakṣiṇe nandikeśvaraḥ ।। 120 ।। purataḥ kārtikeyaśca svayaṃ devo gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। piṅgalākṣādayaḥ sarve pārṣadāḥ paritastayoḥ ।। 121 ।। kṣetrapālādayaḥ sarve tathā'ṣṭau bhairaveśvarāḥ ।। vakṣaḥsthalasthitā durgā sasmitā vakralocanā ।। 122 ।। bhāratyā saha brahmā ca śātakaumbharathasthitaḥ।। vāme saptarṣayastasya dakṣiṇe sanakādayaḥ ।।123।। suvarṇasyandanasthaśca dharmaḥ sākṣī ca karmaṇām।। vakṣasthalasthitā tasya mūrtiḥ smerānanā satī ।। 124 ।। paśyantī pūrṇarāsaṃ ca sakāmā vakralocanā ।। paritaḥ pārṣadāḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā ।। 125 ।। śacyā saha mahendraśca rohiṇyā ca kalānidhiḥ ।। svāhā sārddhaṃ svayaṃ vahniḥ sūryaśca saṃjñayā saha ।। 126 ।। samājagāma kāmaśca ratiṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi ।। sarve grahāśca dikpālā ājagmuḥ sakalatrakāḥ ।। 127 ।। ākāśasthāśca dadṛśuḥ sarāsaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। kecicca mumuhustatra mūrcchāmāpuśca kecana ।। 128 ।। muhūrtaṃ ca surāḥ sarve sasmitāśca mudā'nvitāḥ।। candanadravavṛṣṭiṃ ca puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca cikṣipuḥ।।129।। kastūrīyuktamālyānāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ cakrurmunīśvarāḥ।। rāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā devapatnyaḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ।। 130।। sthale ratirasaṃ kṛtvā jagāma yamunājalam ।। rādhayā saha kṛṣṇaśca pūrṇabrahma sanātanaḥ ।। 131 ।। gopībhiḥ saha jagmuśca māyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpikāḥ ।। prapīḍitāḥ kāmabāṇaiḥ krīḍāṃ cakrurjale mudā ।। 132 ।। jalaṃ dadau rādhikāyai sakāmo mādhavaḥ svayam ।। dadau sā ca mādhavāya kāmārtāyāñjalitrayam ।। 133 ।। vastraṃ jagrāha tasyāśca sā ca nagnā babhūva ha ।। mālāṃ ciccheda kabarīṃ cakāra śithilāṃ hariḥ ।। 134 ।। sindūrapakṣakaṃ luptaṃ veṣaṃ ca jalatāḍanaiḥ ।। bhrūvicitramoṣṭharāgaṃ luptaṃ kajjalalocanam ।। 135 ।। tāṃ ca nagnāṃ samāśliṣya nimamajja jale hariḥ ।। prakṛtyā'bhyantare krīḍāṃ sutasthau ca tayā saha ।।136।। tāṃ ca nagnāṃ darśayitvā gopikāṃ krīḍayā natām ।। sasmitāṃ prerayāmāsa dūrato yamunājale ।। 137 ।। sā vegena samutthāya balājjagrāha mādhavam।। gṛhītvā muralīṃ kopātprerayāmāsa dūrataḥ ।। 138 ।। gṛhītvā pītavasanaṃ taṃ cakāra digambaram ।। vanamālāṃ ca ciccheda dadau toyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 139 ।। hariṃ punaḥ samākṛṣya preṣayāmāsa pāthasi ।। gabhīre srotasi mune nimamajja jagatpatiḥ ।। 140 ।। utthāya mādhavaḥ śīghraṃ tāṃ gṛhītvā prahasya ca ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi nagnāṃ ca cucumba ca punaḥpunaḥ।। evaṃ tā mūrtayaḥ sarvā gopībhiḥ saha kautukāt ।। krīḍāṃ vicakruryamunātīranīre manohare ।। 142 ।। tīraṃ gatvā tayā sārdhaṃ harirnagnaśca magnayā ।। sā taṃ yayāce vasanaṃ sa ca tāṃ sasmitāṃ satīm ।।143।। rādhikāyai dadau vastraṃ ramyāṃ mālāṃ ca mādhavaḥ ।। pradadau haraye vastraṃ vaṃśī rāseśvarī tathā ।।144।। candanāgurukastūrīṃ sarvāṅge kuṅkumānvitām।। kṛṣṇasya parayā bhaktyā dadau śroṇisthitasya ca ।। 145 ।। nirmāya cūḍāṃ lalitāṃ kāminīṃ cittamohinīm।। śobhanairmālatīmālyaiścakāra veṣṭanaṃ punaḥ ।। 146 ।। śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāyāśca kabarīṃ sumanoharām ।। kṛtvā kuṇḍalasaṃskāraṃ nirmame patrakāvalīm ।। 147 ।। dadau lalāṭe sindūraṃ kastūrībindubhiḥ saha ।। tadadhaścandanenduṃ ca susūkṣmaṃ sumanoharam ।। 148 ।। nakhāṅgaṃ stanayorūrvorurasyeva ghanaṃ mudā ।। dattvā tāṃ vāsayāmāsa vahniśuddhāṃśukena vai ।। 149 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumānāṃ draveṇa saḥ ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi saṃlipya cucumba ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 150 ।। punarāśleṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dadau mālāṃ gale punaḥ ।। bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṃ kṛtvā mañjīracaraṇe dadau ।। 151 ।। alaktakaṃ caraṇayornakheṣu ca dadau punaḥ ।। evaṃ gopāśca gopīnāṃ vidadhau ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 152 ।। punaḥ prajagmustā mattāḥ sundaraṃ rāsamaṇḍalam।। pūrṇenducandrikāyuktaṃ ratiyogyaṃ sunirjanam ।।153।। mādhavīketakīkundamālatīnāṃ manoharaiḥ ।। campayūthīmallikānāṃ puṣpaiśca surabhīkṛtam ।। 154 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca sphuṭitaṃ puṣpaṃ cayanaṃ kartumīśvarī ।। gopīrniyojayāmāsa kautukena ca rādhikā ।। 155 ।। kāścinniyojayāmāsa mālānirmāṇakarmaṇi ।। kāścittāmbūlasajjeṣu kāściñcandanagharṣaṇe।।।156।। mālā candanatāmbūlaṃ gopīdattaṃ ca sundarī ।। dadau kṛṣṇāya saṃprītyā sasmitā vakralocanā ।।157।। kāścinniyojanaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇasaṅgītakarmaṇi ।। mṛdaṅgamurajādīnāṃ vādaneṣu ca kāścana ।। 158 ।। evaṃ rāse ratiṃ kṛtvā līlayā hariṇā saha ।। vijahāra ca sarvatra nirjaneṣu manoharam ।। 159 ।। puṣpodyāneṣu ramyeṣu sarasāṃ ca taṭeṣu ca ।। kandare kandare ramye nadeṣu ca nadīṣu ca ।। 160 ।। atīva nirjanasthāne śmaśāne girigahvare ।। vāñchiteṣu ca nārīṇāṃ trayastriṃśadvaneṣu ca ।। 161 ।। bhāṇḍīre śrīvane ramye kadambakānane tathā ।। tulasīkānane kundavane campakakānane ।।162।। nimbāraṇye madhuvane jambīrakānane tathā ।। nālikeravane pūgavane ca kadalīvane ।। 163 ।। badarīkānane bilvavane nāriṅgakānane ।। aśvatthakānane vaṃśavane dāḍimakānane ।। 164 ।। mandārakānane tālavane cūtavane tathā ।। ketakīkānane'śokavane kharjūrakānane ।। 165 ।। āmrātakavane jambūgahane śālakānane ।। kaṭake kānane padmavane jātivane mune ।। 166 ।। nyagrodhagahane ghore tathā śrīkhaṇḍakānane ।। prahṛṣṭakesaravane sarvato'pi vilakṣaṇe ।। 167 ।। evaṃ reme kautukena kāmāttriṃśaddivāniśam ।। tathā'pi mānasaṃ pūrṇaṃ na ca kiṃcidbabhūva ha ।। 168 ।। na kāminīnāṃ kāmaśca śṛṅgāreṇa nivartate ।। adhikaṃ vardhate śaśvadyathā'gnirghṛtadhārayā ।। 169 ।। jagmurdevāḥ svagehaṃ ca devyaśca munayastathā ।। te sarve praśaśaṃsuśca vismayaṃ ca yayurmudā ।। 170 ।। gehe gehe nṛpendrāṇāṃ lebhire janma bhārate ।। dagdhāḥ kāmāgnināṃ'śena devyaḥ śṛṅgāralālasāḥ ।। 171 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde rāsakrīḍāprastāvo nāma aṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 28 ।।
<4.29> śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। atha gopāṅganāḥ sarvāḥ kāmamattatayā mune ।। atiprauḍhāśca māninyo neśvaraṃ menire patim ।। 1 ।। kāścidūcuraho kṛṣṇa sasmitā vakralocanāḥ ।। mālatīpuṣpamuttolya dehi me mālikāmiti ।। 2 ।। kāścidūcuraye kṛṣṇa svakroḍe'smāṃśca kurviti ।। gṛhītvāśrīhareḥ skandhamāruroha ca kācana ।। 3 ।। uvāca kāciddarpeṇa pramattā prāṇavallabham ।। svakīyapītavasanaṃ paridhāraya māmiti ।।4।। uvāca kācidīśaṃ taṃ sindūraṃ dehi māmiti ।। uvāca kācitprāṇeśaṃ śīghramāgatya sāmpratam ।। 5 ।। kṛtvā kuntalasaṃskāraṃ kuru me kabarīmiti ।। kāścitsaṃprerayāmāsuḥ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ ballavāya ca ।।6।। svāṃgaveṣavidhāyinyo bhūṣārthaṃ śrutimūlayoḥ ।। uvāca kācitkāmena paraṃ saṃketapūrvakam ।। 7 ।। paśyantī tanmukhāmbhojaṃ sasmitā maithunāya ca ।। kācijjagrāha muralīṃ balādākṛṣya mādhavam ।। 8 ।। jahāra pītavasanaṃ kṛtvā nagnaṃ ca kāminī ।। kāminyaḥ kāścidityūcurmāninyo madhusūdanam ।। 9 ।। alaktakadravaṃ dehi pādayornakhareṣu ca ।। uvāca kācitpremṇā taṃ gaṇḍayoḥ stanayormama ।। 10।। nānācitravicitrāḍhyāṃ karu patrāvalīmiti ।। kṛtvā'numānaṃ manasā dṛṣṭvā tāsāṃ pramattatām ।। 11 ।। mādhavo rādhayā sārddhamantardhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। atīva nirjane sthāne mudā svecchāmayo vibhuḥ ।। 12 ।। kalāmānaprakāraṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ ca cakāra ha ।। parvate parvate ramye dvīpedvīpe sunirjane ।। ।। 13 ।। taṭe taṭe nadīnāṃ ca sarvajantuvivarjite ।। śrīgoṣṭhe ratnaśaile ca velāgaṅgātaṭe'pi ca ।। 14 ।। kālinde ca pulinde ca mandire gandhamādane ।। manohare kundavane kāverītīranīraje ।। 15 ।। puṣpabhadrāpulinaje puṣpodyāne supuṣpite ।। sarvatra ramaṇaṃ kṛtvā rādhāveṣaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 16 ।। jagāma malayadroṇīṃ ramyāṃ candanavāyunā ।। śayyāṃ puṣpamayīṃ kṛtvā tatra reme tayā saha ।। 17 ।। atīva sukhasaṃbhogānmūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya rādhikā ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi govindaṃ pulakāñcitavigrahā ।।18।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mūrcchitāṃ kṛṣṇo ghanaśroṇipayodharām ।। viluptaveṣāṃ kāmārtāṃ nagnāṃ śithilakuntalām ।। 19 ।। cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa kṛtvā vakṣasi tandritām ।। vāsayāmāsa vasanaṃ rādhāyāmekhalāmbaram ।। 20 ।। kabarīṃ racayāmāsa kiṃcidvāmena vakratām ।। mālatīmālyasaṃyuktāṃ kundapuṣpaiśca veṣṭitām।। ।। 21 ।। tasyāḥ kapāle siṃdūratilakaṃ sundaraṃ dadau ।। gaṇḍayoḥ stanayościtrāṃ cakāra patrikāṃ mudā।।22 ।। sālaktakāṃśca nakharāṃścitritānpādapadmayoḥ ।। nakhaiḥ kṛtrimapadmāni nirmame śroṇivakṣasoḥ ।। 23 ।। utthāyātha tayā sārddhaṃ jagāma hi sarovaram ।। nānāprakārapadmānāṃ rājibhiśca virājitam ।। 24 ।। nirmalasphaṭikākārajalapūrṇaṃ manoharam ।। haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇaṃ jalakukkuṭakūjitam ।।25।। madhulubdhamadhughrāṇāṃ padmasthānaṃ supadmajam ।। cāruṇā kalaśabdena śabditaṃ śaśvadeva hi ।। 25 ।। tatra snātvā jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha tayā saha ।। jalaṃ dadau rādhikāyai mudā sā mādhavāya ca ।। 27 ।। sahasradalapadme ca gṛhītvā mādhavaḥ svayam।। ekaṃ dadau rādhikāyai rarakṣa svārthamekakam ।।28 ।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumadravamīpsitam ।। svāṅgaṃ dattvā rādhikāyai lilepa rādhikeśvaraḥ ।। 29।। tato gacchaṃstayā sārddhaṃ dadarśa purato vaṭam ।। atīvottuṅgaśākhāgramativistṛtameva ca ।। 30 ।। mūle yojanaparyantaṃ chāyayā pariveṣṭitam ।। uvāsa tatra govindaḥ ketakīvanasannidhau ।।31।। puṣpāktena suśītena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। citraṃ rahasyaṃ suciraṃ purāṇaṃ ca purātanam ।। ।। 32 ।। praharṣitaśca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kathayāmāsa rādhikām।। etasminnantare tatra dadarśa munipuṃgavam ।।33 ।। āgacchantaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā prasannavadanekṣaṇam ।। na dṛṣṭvā hṛdaye rūpamīśasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 34 ।। dhyānādviratamagre ca paśyantaṃ bahireva tat ।। sarvāvayavavakraṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ sarvadigambaram ।। 35 ।। nāmnā'ṣṭavakraṃ jaṭilaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। mukhato'gnimudgirantaṃ taporāśimivotthitam ।। 36 ।। aho kiṃ vā brahmatejo mūrtimantamiha svayam ।। nakhaśmaśrusudīrghaṃ ca śāṃtaṃ tejasvinaṃ param ।। 37 ।। puṭāñjaliyutaṃ bhaktyā bhītaṃ praṇatakaṃdharam ।। dṛṣṭvā hasantīṃ rādhāṃ tāṃ vārayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।।38।। prabhāvaṃ kathayāmāsa munīndrasya mahātmanaḥ ।। atha praṇamya govindaṃ tuṣṭāva munipuṃgavaḥ ।। yatstotraṃ ca purā dattaṃ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā ।। 39 ।। aṣṭāvakra uvāca ।। guṇātīta guṇādhāra guṇabīja guṇātmaka ।। guṇīśa guṇināṃ bīja guṇāyana namo'stu te ।। 40 ।। siddhisvarūpa siddhyeśa siddhibīja parātpara ।। siddhisiddhiguṇādhīśa siddhānāṃ gurave namaḥ ।। 41 ।। he vedabīja vedajña vedinvedavidāṃ vara ।। vedājñātādyarūpeśa vedājñeśa namo'stu te।। 42 ।। brahmānanteśa śeṣendra dharmādīnāmadhīśvara ।। sarva sarveśa śarveśa bījarūpa namo'stu te ।। 43 ।। prakṛte prākṛta prajña prakṛtīśa parātpara ।। saṃsāravṛkṣa tadbīja phalarūpa namo'stu te ।। 44 ।। sṛṣṭisthityantabījeśa sṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇa ।। mahāvirāṭtarorbīja rādhikeśa namo'stu te ।। 45 ।। aho yasya trayaḥ skandhā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। śākhāpraśākhā vedādyāstapāṃsi kusumāni ca ।। 46 ।। saṃsāraviphalā eva prakṛtyaṃkurameva ca ।। tadādhāra nirādhāra sarvādhāra namo'stu te ।। 47 ।। tejorūpa nirākāra pratyakṣānūhameva ca ।। sarvākārātipratyakṣa svecchāmaya namo'stu te ।। 48 ।। ityuktvā sa muniśreṣṭho nipatya caraṇāmbuje ।। prāṇāṃstatyāja yogena tayoḥ pratyakṣa eva ca ।। 49 ।। papāta tatra taddehaḥ pādapadmasamīpataḥ ।। tattejaśca samuttasthau jvaladagniśikhopamam ।। 50 ।। saptatālapramāṇaṃ tu cotthāya ca papāta ha।। bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ ca parito līnaṃ cābhūtpadāmbuje।।51।। aṣṭāvakrakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet ।। paraṃ nirvāṇa mokṣaṃ ca samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ।। 52 ।। prāṇādhiko mumukṣūṇāṃ stotrarājaśca nārada ।। hariṇā'ho purā datto vaikuṇṭhe śaṃkarāya ca ।। 53 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte ma0 śrīkṛ0 ja0 nārāya0 munimokṣaṇaprastāva ekonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 29 ।।
<4.30> ।। nārada uvāca ।। ।। mahāmune rahasyaṃ ca śrutaṃ brahmankimadbhutam ।। mṛte munau kiṃ cakāra śrīkṛṣṇo bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 1 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ muniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskāraṃ kartumudyataḥ ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi taddehaṃ rurodoccairyathā naraḥ ।।2।। bāhubhyāṃ ca samāśliṣya pipeṣodriktamohataḥ ।। nirgataṃ bhasmanikaraṃ śavādvajrāṃgagharṣaṇāt ।। 3 ।। raktamāṃsāsthihīnaṃ taccharīraṃ ca mahātmanaḥ ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi nirāhāraḥ kṛto mune ।। 4 ।। dagdhaṃ lohitamāṃsāsthi jvalatā jaṭharāgninā ।। bāhyajñānavihīnasya haripādābjacetasaḥ ।। 5 ।। citāṃ candanakāṣṭhena nirmāya madhusūdanaḥ ।। kṛtvā'gnikāryaṃ tatraiva sthāpayāmāsa śokataḥ ।। 6 ।। dadau citāyāmagniṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ dattvā śavopari ।। jvalitāyāṃ citā yāṃ ca mūrcchāmāpa kṣaṇaṃ vibhuḥ ।।7।। taddehe bhasmasādbhūte nedurdundubhayo divi ।। babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca tatkṣaṇādgaganādaho ।। 8 ।। etasminnantare tatra ratnasāravinirmitam ।। syandanaṃ ca manoyāyi vastramālyaparicchadam ।। 9 ।। pārṣadapravarairyuktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasadṛśairvaraiḥ ।। āvirbabhūva golokātsundaraṃ purato hareḥ ।। 10 ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ pārṣadapravarā hareḥ ।। sarve samānarūpāste praṇamya rādhikeśvarau 11 ।। dhṛtavantaṃ sūkṣmadehaṃ praṇamayya munīśvaram ।। rathe kṛtvā tu taṃ dehaṃ jammurgolokamuttamam ।। 12 ।। gate munīndre golokaṃ vṛndāvanavinodinī ।। babhūva vismitā sādhvī papraccha jagadīśvaram ।। 13 ।। śrīrādhikovāca ।। ko'yaṃ nātha muniśreṣṭhaḥ sarvāvayavava krimaḥ ।। atikharvajanākārastejīyānatikutsitaḥ ।। 14 ।। kathaṃ vā nirgataṃ bhasma dehādasya kimadbhutam ।। sākṣādvilīnaṃ yatteja stvatpādābje'nalopamam ।। 15 ।। rathasthaḥ puṇyavānsadyo golakaṃ ca jagāma ha ।। svātmārāmasya yaddheto rodanaṃ te babhūva ha ।। 16 ।। tvayā kṛtaṃ ca satkāramaśrupūrṇena cakṣuṣā ।। sarvaṃ vivaraṇaṃ tūrṇaṃ saṃvyasya kathaya prabho ।। 17 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ kathāṃ kathitumārebhe yugāntaragatāmapi ।। 18 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। rahasyamaṣṭāvakrīyaṃ vikhyātaṃ sarvataḥ priye ।। paścācchroṣyasi kālena prasaṅge viduṣāṃ mukhāt ।।19।। aṣṭāvakro munīndro'pi vikhyāto bhuvanatraye ।। paripūrṇaṃ yadyaśasā janmanā tajjagattrayam।। 20।। kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vimanaskā haripriyā ।। uvāca madhuraṃ yatnācchuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā ।। 21 ।। rādhikovāca ।। yattṛṣālormanaḥ pūrṇa na babhūva sudhāmbudhau ।। sa vitṛpto bhavati kiṃ goṣpadodakapānataḥ ।। 22 ।। vedānāṃ vedavaktṝṇāṃ vidhāturjanakasya ca ।। mahāviṣṇorīśvarastvaṃ ko'nyo vaktā'sti tvatparaḥ ।।23।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇo babhūva ha ।। uvāca gopanīyaṃ ca rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 24 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu kānte pravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। śravaṇātkathanādyasya sarvaṃ pāpaṃ praṇaśyati ।। 25 ।। mahāviṣṇornābhipadmādbabhūva jagatāṃ vidhiḥ ।। mamāṃśasya matkalayā jalākīrṇe jagattraye ।। 26 ।। putrā babhūvuścatvāro brahmaṇo mānasātpurā ।। nārāyaṇaparāḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā ।। 27 ।। śiśavaḥ pañcavarṣīyā nagnā ajñānino yathā ।। bāhyajñānavihīnāśca brahmatattvaviśāradāḥ ।। 28 ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānete catvāra eva ca ।।29।। tānuvāca jagaddhātā sṛṣṭiṃ kuruta putrakāḥ ।। te na tasthuḥ piturvākye prayayustapase mama ।। 30।। vidhātā vimanaskaśca tanayeṣu gateṣu ca ।। piturduḥkhāya prabhavetputraścedavacaskaraḥ ।। 31 ।। jñānena nirmame putrānsvāṅgeṣu ca tapodhanān ।। vedavedāṅgavijñāṃśca jvalato brahmatejasā ।।32।। atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho marīcirbhṛguraṅgirāḥ ।। kraturvasiṣṭho voḍhuśca kapilaścāsuriḥ kaviḥ ।।33।। śaṅkuḥ śaṅkhaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ pracetāste tapodhanāḥ ।। bahukālaṃ tapastaptvā cakruḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tadājñayā ।। 34 ।। kalatravantaste sarve saṃsāraṃ kartumu nmukhāḥ ।। babhūvuḥ putrapautrāśca sarveṣāṃ ca tapasvinām।। 39।। tadastu ca kathā bahvī munivaṃśānukīrtanī ।। cārvī puṇyasvarūpā ca prakṛtaṃ śṛṇu sundari ।। 36 ।। pracetasaḥ sutaḥ śrīmānasito munipuṅgavaḥ ।। sakalatrastapastepe divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam ।। 37 ।। na babhūva sutastasya prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyataḥ ।। taṃ samboddhuṃ babhūvātha satyā vāgaśarīriṇī।।38।। kathaṃ tyajasi prāṇāṃstvaṃ gaccha śaṅkarasannidhim ।। siddhaṃ kuru gṛhītvā ca mantraṃ śaṅkaravaktrataḥ ।। 39 ।। mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ te sadyaḥ sākṣādbhaviṣyati ।। vareṇābhīṣṭadevyāśca putraste bhavitā dhuvam ।। 40 ।। śrutvaitaccaritaṃ vipro jagāma śivasannidhim ।। yogināmapyagamyaṃ ca śivalokaṃ nirāmayam ।। 41 ।। sakalatro yathā yogī tuṣṭāva yogināṃ gurum ।। puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।।42।। asita uvāca ।। jagadguro namastubhyaṃ śivāya śivadāya ca ।। yogīndrāṇāṃ ca yogīndra gurūṇāṃ gurave namaḥ ।। 43 ।। mṛtyomṛrtyusvarūpeṇa mṛtyusaṃsārakhaṇḍana।। mṛtyorīśa mṛtyubīja mṛtyuñjaya namo'stu te ।। 44 ।। kālarūpaṃ kalayatāṃ kālakāleśa kāraṇa ।। kālādatīta kālasya kālakāla namo'stu te ।। 45 ।। guṇātīta guṇādhāra guṇabīja guṇātmaka ।। guṇīśa guṇināṃ bīja guṇināṃ gurave namaḥ ।। 46 ।। brahmasvarūpa brahmajña brahmabhāve ca tatpara ।। brahmabījasvarūpeṇa brahmabīja namostu te ।। 47 ।। iti stutvā śivaṃ natvā purastasthau munīśvaraḥ ।। dīnavatsāśrunetraśca pulakāṃ citavigrahaḥ ।। 48 ।। asitena kṛtaṃ stotraṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet ।। varṣamekaṃ haviṣyāśī śaṅkarasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 49 ।। sa labhedvai ṣṇavaṃ putraṃ jñāninaṃ cirajīvinam ।। bhavedanāḍhyo duḥkhī ca mūko bhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। 50 ।। abhāryo labhate bhāryāṃ suśīlāṃ ca pativra tām ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante śivasannidhim ।। 51 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ purā dattaṃ brahmaṇā ca pracetase ।। pracetasā svaputrāyāsitāya dattamuttamam ।। 52 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। samākarṇya muneḥ stotraṃ bhagavāñchaṃkaraḥ svayam ।। uvāca brahmaṇaḥ putraṃ svabhaktaṃ bhaktava tsalaḥ ।। 513 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। sthiro bhava muniśreṣṭha jānāmi tava vāñchitam ।। putraste bhavitā satyaṃ madaṃśena ca matsamaḥ ।।54।। dāsyāmi mantramatulaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca sudurlabham ।। ityuktvā ca dadau mantraṃ tavaiva ṣoḍaśākṣaram ।। 55 ।। stotraṃ pūjāvidhānaṃ ca kavacaṃ paramādbhutam ।। saṃsāravijayaṃ nāma puraścaraṇapūrvakam ।।56।। varaṃ dātumiṣṭadevī pratyakṣā bhaviteti ca ।। ityuktvā virato rudraḥ sa taṃ natvā jagāma ha ।। 57 ।। jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ so'sitaḥ śatavatsaram ।। sākṣādbhūtvā varastasmai tvayā dattaḥ purā sati ।। 58 ।। putraste bhavitā satyaṃ mahājñānī suteti ca ।। varaṃ dattvā tvamagamo golokaṃ mama sannidhim ।। 59 ।। kālena ca sutastasya śivāṃśena babhūva ha ।। brahmiṣṭho devalo nāmnā kandarpasamasundaraḥ ।। 60 ।। suyajñanṛpateḥ kanyāṃ ratnamālāvatīṃ mudā ।। tāṃ sundarīṃ vivāhena jagṛhe sarvamo hinīm ।। 61 ।। sthāne sthāne ca rahasi śatavarṣaṃ tayā saha ।। sa reme nipuṇaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ strīṇāṃ ramaṇakarmaṇi ।। 62 ।। kālāntare sa virato babhūva munipuṃgavaḥ ।। sukhaṃ sarvaṃ parityajya dharmiṣṭhaḥ śrīhariṃ smaran ।। 63 ।। utthāya rātrau śayanādviraktaśca tapodhanaḥ ।। sa yayau tapase kānte gandhamādanaparvate ।।64।। nidrāṃ tyaktvā ca tatkāntā na dṛṣṭvā svāminaṃ satī ।। vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ śokātpradagdhā virahāgninā।।65।। uttiṣṭhantī nirviśantī rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ ।। taptapātre yathā dhānyaṃ babhūva tanmanastadā ।। 66 ।। āhāraṃ ca parityajya prāṇāṃstatyāja sundarī ।। cakāra tatsutastasyāḥ karma nirharaṇādikam ।।67।। tapaścakāra sa munirgandhamādanagahvare ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca mama bhakto jitendriyaḥ ।।68।। taṃ dadarśa ha daivena rambhā śṛṃgāralokupā।। atīvasundaraṃ śāntaṃ kandarpamiva sundaram ।। 69 ।। sā ca taṃ kathayāmāsa nirjane samupasthitā ।। vidhāya veṣaṃ yatnena trailokyacittamohinī ।। 70 ।। rambhovāca ।। nibodha sādho madvākyaṃ kāminīnāṃ manoharam ।। tyaktvā kaṭhoraṃ rahasi bhaja māṃ sukhadāyikām ।। 71 ।। tvaṃ vareṣu varaḥ pṛthvyāṃ varārohā svayaṃvarā ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhasya durlabho nava saṃgamaḥ ।। 72 ।। yajñaṃ kurvanti bhūpālā bhārate svargahetukam ।। svargabhoganimittaṃ ca bhogasārā vayaṃ mune ।। 73 ।। stanayoryugmamūrvorme sundaraṃ mukhapaṃkajam ।। hāsyabhrūbhaṃgasahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā ko na labhetsukham।। 74 ।। strīrasaḥ sukhasāraśca munīnāmabhivāñchitaḥ ।। rasikāsukhasaṃbhogo nirjane cātidurlabhaḥ ।।75।। devo vā mānavo vā'pi gandharvo vā'tha rākṣasaḥ ।। srīsukheṣvapyavijñeyo rambhāyā rativañcitaḥ।।76।। rahasyupasthitāṃ kāntāṃ na bhajedyo jitendriyaḥ ।। gātralomapramāṇābdaṃ kumbhīpāke vaseddhruvam ।।77।। satyaṃ tasyāśca vadhabhāktacchāpena praṇa śyati ।। vidhātā mohinīśāpādapūjyo bhuvanatraye ।। 78 ।। yena tyaktopasthitā taṃ yathā paśyati puṃścalī ।। svāmiputrasvabandhūnāṃ na tathā ghātakaṃ ruṣā ।। 79 ।। paraṃ priyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jāraṃ jānāti puṃścalī ।। yadi tena parityaktā taṃ hantuṃ sā tu dakṣiṇā।। 80।। puṃścalī hiṃsrajantubhyo navaghātibhya eva ca।। duṣṭā śaśvaddayāhīnā durantā pratijanmani ।। 81 ।। tyaja dhyānaṃ muniśreṣṭha bhuṃkṣvedaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ।। rahasyupasthitāṃ māṃ ca gṛhītvā suciraṃ sukham ।। 82 ।। sa rambhāvacanaṃ śrutvā tāmuvāca bhayākulaḥ ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 83 ।। devala uvāca ।। śṛṇu rambhe pravakṣyāmi vedasāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ ।। kuladharmocitaṃ satyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām ।। 84 ।। dharmo'yaṃ yuktakāle ca svayoṣiti rato dvijaḥ ।। sarvatra pūjitaḥ śaśvadiha loke paratra ca ।। 85 ।। brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo yo rataḥ parayoṣiti ।। yāti tasyāpūjitasya ruṣṭā lakṣmīrgṛhādapi।। 86 ।। ihātinindyaḥ sarvatra nādhikārī svakarmasu ।। paratraivāndhakūpe ca yāvadvarṣaśataṃ vaset ।।।77 ।। grāhyā copasthitā strī ca gṛhiṇā na tapasvinā ।। tyāge doṣaḥ kāminīnāṃ śāpabhākpāpabhāggṛhī ।। 88 ।। brahmā jagadvidhātā'pi na viraktaḥ kalatravān ।। tyāge doṣastatkadācinnāsmākaṃ tyaktayoṣitām ।। 89 ।। svabhāryāṃ ca parityajya yo gṛhṇāti parastriyam ।। yaśodhanāyuṣāṃ hānirbhavejjīvanmṛtasya ca ।। 90 ।। bhuvi nāsti yaśo yasya jīvanaṃ tasya niṣphalam ।। susaṃpadā kiṃ rājyena sukhena ca tapasvinaḥ ।। 91 ।। niṣkāmena ca vṛddhena mayā kiṃ te prayojanam।। suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ mātaryuvānaṃ paśya sundari।।92।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopāpsarasāṃ varā ।। uvāca bhūyo vākyaṃ taṃ trastā prasphuritādharā ।। 93 ।। rambhovāca ।। cārucampakavarṇābhaḥ kandarpasamasundaraḥ ।। tapaḥprabhāvātsaśrīkaḥ suveṣaḥ saṃmataḥ striyāḥ।।94।। tvayā vinā'nyaṃ kaṃ yāmi ko vāsti tvatparaḥ pumān।। puṃścalī tvāṃ parityajya kā jīvati smarā turā ।। 95 ।। śīghraṃ māṃ bhaja viprendra dagdhāṃ kāmāgninā sadā ।। kāmo naśyati māṃ tvatto yathā rambhāṃ mataṃgajaḥ ।। 96 ।। na cecchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। māṃ vā dāruṇaśāpaṃ vā satvaraṃ grahaṇaṃ kuru ।।97।। dagdhāḥ prāṇā manodagdhaṃ svātmā vā iti saṃtatam।। navaśṛṅgārapīyūṣapānanirvāṇatāṃ vrajet ।। 98 ।। svāntarduḥkhena duḥkhārto yo yaṃ śapati niścitam।। taṃ śāpaṃ khaṇḍituṃ śakto na vidhātā jagatpatiḥ ।। 99 ।। dvijo rambhāvacaḥ śrutvā babhūva dhyānatatparaḥ ।। novāca kiṃcinmaunasthaḥ sā taṃ kopācchaśāpa ha ।। 100।। he vakracitta te vipra sarvāvayavavakrimam ।। śarīramañjanākāraṃ rūpayauvanavarjitam ।। 1 ।। atīvavikṛtākāraṃ triṣu lokeṣu garhitam ।। purātanaṃ tapo naṣṭaṃ sadyo bhavatu niścitam ।। 2 ।। ityuktvā puṃścalī kāmātkāmalokaṃ jagāma ha ।। acireṇa munīndraśca na dadarśa hareḥ padam ।।3।। padāravindavirahātsamudvigno babhūva ha।। svāṅgaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vikṛtaṃ pūrvapuṇyavivarjitam।।4 ।। kṛtvā'gnikuṇḍaṃ śokena prāṇāṃstya ktuṃ samudyataḥ ।। mayā dṛṣṭo varo datto divyajñānena bodhitaḥ ।।5।। āśvāsaśca kṛtaḥ prītyā tataḥ śānto babhūva ha ।। aṅgānyaṣṭau ca vakrā ṇi dṛṣṭvā tūrṇaṃ mahāmuneḥ ।। 6 ।। aṣṭāvakreti tannāma kautukena mayā kṛtam ।। madvākyānmalayadroṇīmayamāgamya prapautro brahmaṇo muniḥ ।। 11 ।। niṣkalaḥ puṃścalī śāpādbrahmā'pūjyo yathā purā ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ ।। sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ gūḍhaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 112 ।। iti
