manoyāyi mahāścaryaṃ nānācitreṇa citritam ।।16।। veṣṭitaṃ pārṣadairdivyai ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ।। caturbhujaiḥ śyāmalaiśca jvaladbhiḥ sthirayauvanaiḥ ।। 17 ।। pītavastraparīdhānaiścandanāgurucarcitaiḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā rathasthāndevāṃśca nanāma nṛpatirmudā ।। 18 ।। sahasā tasya śirasi puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।। nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge cānakāśca manoharāḥ ।। 19 ।। ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ prakurvanto mudā''śiṣam ।। praśaśaṃsuḥ surāḥ sarve rājānaṃ harṣanirbharāḥ ।। 20 ।। rājā ca pārṣadāndhyātvā tadrūpaśca babhūva ha ।। pārṣadāstaṃ rathe kṛtvā nītvā jagmurmamālayam ।। 21 ।। madīyaḥ pārṣado bhūtvā sa ca tasthau mamāntike ।। tataḥ svamandiraṃ yāntaṃ dadarśa mohinī vidhim ।।22।। puṣpodyāne ca ramye ca puṣpacandanavāyunā।। sadyo mumoha taṃ dṛṣṭvā pradagdhā madānānalaiḥ।।23।। vilokya vakranayanā jugopa sasmitaṃ mukham।। sindūrabinduṃ dadhatī kastūrībindunā saha।।24।। cārucampakavarṇābhā satataṃ sthirayauvanā।। bṛhannitambayugalā pīnaśroṇipayodharā ।।25।। śaratpārvaṇaśubhrāṃśuprabhāmuṣṭakarānanā ।। sūkṣmavastraparīdhānā ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā ।। 26 ।। trailokyaṃ mohituṃ śaktā kaṭākṣaireva līlayā ।। atīva kāminī śaśvadgajendramandagāminī ।।27।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgī mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa vartmani ।। sannirīkṣya ca tāṃ brahmā jagāma śrīhariṃ smaran ।। 28 ।। sa vikāraṃ na hi prāpa hyātmārāmo jiteṃdriyaḥ ।। brahmalokaṃ ca saṃprāpa brahmā ca jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। 29 ।। sakāmā sā ca kulaṭā babhūva hatacetanā ।। divāniśaṃ cintayantī svapne jñāne caturmukham ।। 30 ।। sarvaṃ jāraṃ visasmāra tatyāja harimīśvarī ।। uttiṣṭhantī nivasatī śayanaṃ kurvatī kṣaṇam ।।31।। taptapātre yathā sasyaṃ bhramatyeva tathā pathi ।। etasminnantare rambhā vidagdhā'psarasāṃ varā ।। ।। 32 ।। gacchantī kāmalokaṃ sā sakāmā tena vartmanā ।। dṛṣṭvā sahacarīṃ tatra śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukām ।। abhiprāyeṇa bubudhe papraccha sasmitā tadā ।। 33 ।। rambhovāca ।। kathamevaṃvidhā tvaṃ hi trailokyacittamohini ।। 34 ।। vada śīghraṃ mahābhāge rambhā'haṃ cetanaṃ kuru ।। kamuddiśya sakāmā tvaṃ gaccha tvaṃ kāntamīpsitam ।।35।। kulaṭā sarvasaubhāgyā na vayaṃ kulapālikāḥ ।। sarve vyagrā indriyāṇāṃ sukhāya bhuvanatraye ।।36।। yānti prāṇā yataḥ kāle kā lajjā tatra jīvinām ।। na cātmanaḥ paraḥ kaścitpriyo'sti bhuvanatraye ।।37।। kānte'patye svabandhau ca sneho yaḥ svātmahetukaḥ ।। sambandhaḥ svātmano yāvattāvatsneho'sti tatra vai ।। 38 ।। yeṣu yanmānasaṃ śaśvatteṣāṃ prāṇāsta eva hi ।। gacchantīṃ kāmalokaṃ ca sakāmāṃ paśya māṃ priye ।। 39 ।। saha sakhyā samālokya manasā gaccha taṃ priyam ।। nibaddhya nīvī keśāṃśca kṛtvā veṣamabhīpsitam ।। 40 ।। munimohanabījaṃ ca taṃ mohaṃ kuru mohini ।। kathayasva mahābhāge vacanaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam ।। 41 ।। rakṣātmānaṃ prabhāvaṃ ca strījātīnāṃ jagattraye ।। svābhiprāyaśca suratau na prakāśyaḥ kadācana ।।42।। svāntaṃ kāntaṃ svānuraktamṛjvīṃ sahacarīṃ vinā ।। tasmādyatnena hṛdvākyaṃ prakāśyaṃ ca priye priye ।। 43 ।। anyathā copahāsāya maraṇāyaiva kalpate ।। tasyāśca vacanaṃ śrutvā sasmitā sā sulajjitā ।। hṛdyaṃ ca kathayāmāsa yaddhetostādṛśī gatiḥ ।। 44 ।। mohinyuvāca ।। yāvaddṛṣṭo mayā rambhe nirjane caturānanaḥ ।। 45 ।। tāvanmano me'tidagdhaṃ śaśvanmanasijānalaiḥ ।। na dattamātmane bhakṣyamantare na hi rocate ।। ।। 46 ।। jānāmi nāhamudayaṃ yāminīśadineśayoḥ ।। adhunā nahi bhedo me satataṃ svapnajñānayoḥ ।। 47 ।। mama prāṇāḥ pratīkṣante tasyāliṅganameva ca ।। kṣaṇaṃ vijñāya na ciraṃ yāsyanti nānyathā priye ।। 48 ।। kāmajvālākalāpaiśca svarṇākāraṃ kalevaram ।। anāhāreṇa cedānīṃ babhūva dagdhaśailavat ।।49।। gantuṃ sthātuṃ na śaktā'haṃ śayanaṃ kartumudyatā।। dhigastu puṃścalījātiṃ māmeva ca viśeṣataḥ ।। 50।। kamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada rambhe'tisāmpratam ।। lajjāṃ vā'pi śarīraṃ vā visṛjāmi ca kiṃ dvayoḥ।।51।। mohinīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyāpsarasāṃ varā ।। tāmuvāca hitaṃ nītamupāyaṃ śubhakāraṇam ।। 52 ।। rambhovāca ।। evametadaho bhadre bhadrasya kāraṇaṃ tava ।। sarvaṃ tvapanayiṣyāmi śṛṇūpāyaṃ bhayaṃ tyaja ।। 53 ।। kṛtvā veṣamapūrvaṃ ca pūrvamārādhya manmatham ।। tena sārddhaṃ svayaṃ gatvā mohaṃ kuru ca bhāmini ।। ।।54।। jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam ।। vinā kāmasahāyena kā śaktā jetumīśvaram ।।55।। bhaja kāmaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā puṣkare vraja mohini ।। sadyaḥ sākṣātsa bhavitā dayāluryoṣitāṃ prabhuḥ ।।56।। ityuktvā tāmapsarasāṃ pravarā kāmamantikam ।। jagāmendriyaśāntyarthaṃ sā jagāma ca puṣkaram ।। 57 ।। puṣkare ca tapaḥ kṛtvā kāmaṃ saṃprāpya mohinī ।। jagāma tena sārddhaṃ ca brahmalokamanāmayam ।। 58 ।। dadarśa nirjanasthaṃ ca mohinī kamalodbhavam ।। tameva mohanaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe puraḥ sthitā ।। 59 ।। kṣaṇaṃ nanarta suciraṃ sugānena kṣaṇaṃ jagau ।। saṃgītaṃ mama saṃbandhi bhaktānāṃ cittamohanam ।। 60 ।। vidhātā jagatāṃ tasyāḥ śrutvā saṃgītamīpsitam ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo mumoha sāśrulocanaḥ ।। 61 ।। dṛṣṭvā mugdhaṃ caturvaktraṃ mohinī hṛṣṭamānasā ।। kalāpramāṇaṃ bhāvaṃ ca cakāra tatra līlayā ।। 62 ।। svāṅgaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsa smerabhrūbhaṅgapūrvakam ।। kā lajjā tasya saṃsāre yaḥ kāmahatacetanaḥ ।। 63 ।। vijñāya brahmā tadbhāvaṃ natavaktro babhūva ha ।। pradāya tasyā dānaṃ ca virataḥ śrīhariṃ smaran ।। 64 ।। vijñāya brahmaṇo bhāvaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā ।। hatodyamā sā tuṣṭāva kāmaṃ kāmapradaṃ varam ।। 65 ।। mohinyuvāca ।। sarvendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ viṣṇoraṃśaṃ ca mānasam ।। tadeva karmaṇāṃ bījaṃ tadudbhava namo'stu te ।। 66 ।। svayamātmā hi bhagavāñjñānarūpo maheśvaraḥ ।। namo brahmañjagatsraṣṭastadudbhava namo'stu te ।। 67 ।। sṛṣṭiḥ sarvaśarīreṣu dṛṣṭiśca yogināmapi ।। jagatsādhya durārādhya durnivāra namo'stu te ।।68।। sarvājita jagajjetarjīva jīvamanohara।। ratibīja ratisvāminratipriya namo'stu te ।। 69 ।। śaśvadyoṣidadhiṣṭhāna yoṣitprāṇādhikapriya ।। yoṣidvāhana yoṣāstra yoṣidbandho namo'stu te ।। 70 ।। patisādhyakarāśeṣarūpādhāra guṇāśraya ।। sugandhivātasaciva madhumitra namo'stu te ।। 71 ।। śaśvadyonikṛtādhāra strīsaṃdarśanavardhana ।। vidagdhānāṃ virahiṇāṃ prāṇāntaka namo'stu te ।। 72 ।। akṛpā yeṣu te'narthāsteṣāṃ jñānavināśanam ।। anūharūpabhakteṣu kṛpāsindho namo'stu te ।। 73 ।। tapasvināṃ ca tapasāṃ vighnabījāvalīlayā ।। manaḥ sakāmaṃ muktānāṃ kartuṃ śakta namo'stu te ।। 74 ।। tapaḥsādhyāścārādhyāśca sadaivaṃ pāñcabhautikāḥ ।। pañcendriyakṛtādhāra pañcabāṇa namo'stu te ।। 75 ।। mohinītyevamuktvā tu manasā sā vidheḥ puraḥ ।। virarāma namravaktrā babhūva dhyānatatparā ।। 76 ।। uktaṃ mādhyaṃdine kānte stotrametanmanoharam ।। purā durvāsasā dattaṃ mohinyai gandhamādane ।। 77 ।। stotrametanmahāpuṇyaṃ kāmī bhaktyā yadā paṭhet ।। abhīṣṭaṃ labhate nūnaṃ niṣkalaṅko bhaved dhruvam ।।78।। ceṣṭāṃ na kurute kāmaḥ kadācidapi taṃ priyam ।। bhavedarogī śrīyuktaḥ kāmadevasamaprabhaḥ ।। vanitāṃ labhate sādhvīṃ patnīṃ trailokyamohinīm ।। 79 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde mohinī stotravarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 31 ।।
<4.32> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। mohinīstavanenaiva kāmastuṣṭo babhūva ha ।। cakāra śarasaṃdhānamantarikṣe sthitaḥ svayam ।। 1 ।। mantrapūtaṃ mahāstraṃ ca cikṣepa pitaraṃ mudā ।। babhūva cañcalo brahmā kāmāstreṇa ca kāmukaḥ ।। 2 ।। kṣaṇaṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ cakre mohinyāsye punaḥpunaḥ ।। jñānaṃ prāpya tadā dhātā virarāma hariṃ smaran ।।3।। bubudhe manasā sarvaṃ caritaṃ manmathasya ca ।। śaśāpa taṃ sutamapi vidhātā krodhavihvalaḥ ।। 4 ।। he kāma yauvanonmatta mūḍhaiśvaryeṇa garvita ।। bhavitā darpabhaṅgaste gurorme helanāditi ।। 5 ।। hatodyamo jagāmāśu manmatho madhunā saha ।। brahmaṇaḥ śāpabhītaśca śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। 6 ।। ityuvāca jagaddhātā mohinīṃ madanāturām ।। caturvaktraṃ ca paśyantīṃ sasmitaṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। 7 ।। brahmovāca ।। mātarmohini gaccha tvaṃ niṣphalaṃ karma cātra te ।। jñātastavābhiprāyaśca nāhaṃ yogyo'sya karmaṇaḥ ।। 8 ।। vede jugupsitaṃ karma tadeva kartumakṣamaḥ ।। vedakartā svayamahaṃ vyavasthākārako bhave ।। 9 ।। akīrtiṃ vedavaktuśca nindyaṃ ca kimataḥ param ।। upasthitā ca yā yoṣidatyājyā rāgiṇāmapi ।। 10।। śrutau śrutamiti tyājyā sarvadaiva tapasvinām ।। aho sarvaiḥ parityājyā puṃścalī ca viśeṣataḥ ।। 11 ।। dhanāyuḥprāṇayaśasāṃ nāśinī duḥkhadāyinī ।। svakāryatatparā śaśvatparakāryavināśinī ।।12।। niṣṭhurā navaghātibhyaḥ sarvāpadbījarūpiṇī ।। vidyuddīptirjale rekhā lobhānmaitrī yathā bhavet ।। 13 ।। paradrohādyathā saṃpatkulaṭāprema tatsamam ।। sarvebhyo hiṃsrajantubhyo vipadbījā sadaiva hi ।।14।। yo viśvasettāṃ saṃmūḍho vipattasya padepade ।। tvaṃ ca rūpavatī dhanyā vañcitā kāmukaiḥ sadā।।15।। yūnāṃ saṃpatsvarūpā ca viṣatulyā tapasvinām।। tvamevāpsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvadā sthirayauvanā ।।16।। tavaiva karma yogyaṃ ca yuvānaṃ paśya sundari ।। tvaṃ vidagdhā ca yoṣitsu vidagdhānveṣaṇaṃ kuru ।। 17 ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet ।। jarāturo'haṃ vṛddhaśca tapasvī vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ ।।18।। asvatantraḥ parādhīnaḥ kā ratiḥ puṃścalīṣu me ।। aye vatse gaccha śīghraṃ vihāya pitaraṃ ca mām ।।19।। nātrā'haṃ ca jagatsraṣṭā tasmāttava pitā sadā।। manmathaṃ caṃdramitraṃ ca jayantaṃ nalakūbaram ।। 20 ।। svarvaidyau caṃdratanayaṃ ditiputrāṃśca suṃdarān ।। kāmaśāstreṣu niṣṇātānratikarmaviśāradān ।। ।। 21 ।। yā māṃ yāsi hi tāṃstyaktvā sā vidagdhā ca kāmukī ।। sadā saṃbhogaviṣaye striyaṃ prārthayate pumān ।।22 ।। strī cetprayāti puruṣaṃ viparītaṃ viḍambanam ।। sarveṣāṃ caiva ratnānāṃ strīratnaṃ durlabhaṃ param ।।23 ।। svayaṃ prārthayate svāmī na tu svāminameva ca।। yoṣijjātiṣu dhik tāśca svayaṃ yāḥ samupasthitāḥ।।24।। bhaveddūraṃ svalpamūlyaṃ ratnaṃ svayamupasthitam ।। nityaṃ pumānstriyaṃ yāti strī vā yāti ca na priyam ।। 25 ।। lokācāreṣu vedeṣu na strī yāti parapriyam ।। svavastu bhuṅkte yaḥ kāle śāstroktavidhipūrvakam ।।26।। sa pūjyo na bhavetpūjyo yadratiḥ paravastuṣu ।। kaḥ kasya śatrurabale niśāmaya jagattraye ।। 27 ।। svendriyāḥ śatravaḥ sarve śatrutā yannimittataḥ ।। vedoktācaraṇe sarvaṃ mitraṃ ca jagatāṃ jagat ।। 28 ।। kṛte vedaviruddhe ca mitraṃ śatrurbhaveddhruvam ।। vedoktaṃ kṛtavantaṃ ca haristuṣṭo divāniśam ।। 29 ।। harau tuṣṭe jagattuṣṭaṃ tasminruṣṭe bhavo ripuḥ ।। kutrāsti kulaṭājātiḥ sādhvījātiśca kutra vā ।। 30 ।। svakīyācaraṇātsarvaṃ bhave bhavati karmaṇaḥ ।। strījātiḥ prakṛteraṃśā nārāyaṇavinirmitā ।। 31 ।। duḥśīlā puṃścalī nindyā suśīlā ca pativratā ।। pativratāstu trividhāḥ puṃścalīṣu ca yoṣitaḥ ।। 32 ।। tāsāmevaṃvidhā nāsti svayaṃ yāti parapriyam ।। strījātīnāṃ ca madhye ca kā'styevaṃ kulakajjalā ।।33।। bhave ratyai svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā veṣaṃ kṛtvā prayāti tam ।। kṣobhitā yadi paśyantī bhakṣyadravyamasādhyakam ।। ।।34।। vaikulyānnahi tatsādhyaṃ sāmānyameva kevalam ।। ityevamuktvā jagatāṃ vidhātā virarāma ca ।। vaktuṃ samudyatā sā ca kopaprasphuritādharā ।। 35 ।। mohinyuvāca ।। jñātaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddhātaścaritaṃ tava sāṃpratam ।। 36 ।। tvayā nibodhitā nītirmano me na sthiraṃ bhavet ।। bhūtaṃ tvayi viśiṣṭaṃ ca yāvaddṛṣṭaḥ kṣaṇe bhavān ।।37।। tvadvaktradṛṣṭimātreṇa sarve jārāśca vismṛtāḥ ।। dehaṃ kāmāgninā dagdhaṃ yadā tyaktuṃ samudyatā ।। 38 ।। niṣiṣedha ca māṃ rambhā pradadau mantramīdṛśam ।। tadā kāmasahāyena tvatsamīpaṃ samāgatā ।।39।। samadhustava śāpena sa jagāma hatodyamaḥ ।। aho gantumaśaktā'haṃ tvayā yadyapi bhartsitā ।। 40 ।। sarvāṅgeṣveva me jāḍyaṃ babhūva sāṃprataṃ vibho ।। kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho na māṃ hantuṃ tvamarhasi ।। 41 ।। tavāśleṣaṇamātreṇa vijvarā'haṃ suniścitam ।। tvameva jagatāṃ dhātā kulaṭā'haṃ ca karmaṇā ।। 42 ।। santo garvaṃ na kurvanti karmasādhyāśca jīvinaḥ ।। kaścitprayāti yānena vahanti taṃ ca kecana ।।43।। karaṃ gṛhṇāti nṛpatiḥ karmaṇā dadati prajāḥ ।। kaścitsiṃhāsanasthaśca nṛpamātraśca kaścana ।। 44 ।। karmaṇā vāhakāḥ kecitkecidvāhanapālakāḥ ।। sūkarījaṭharaṃ kaścinsaṃprayāti svakarmaṇā ।। 45 ।। kaścicchacyāśca jaṭharaṃ tava putrāśca kecana ।। kecitkṛtvā harerbhaktiṃ karmaṇā tasya pārṣadāḥ ।। 46 ।। kecidbhavanti kṛmayo viṣṭhāyāṃ daivadoṣataḥ ।। svargaṃ prayānti rājendrāḥ kecicca svasvakarmaṇā ।। 47 ।। kecitprayānti narakaṃ viṇmūtre tatra pacyate ।। karmaṇā kaścidindrendraḥ surāṇāṃ pravaraḥ svayam।।48।। kecitsurā narāḥ kecitkecicca kṣudrajantavaḥ ।। kecicca karmaṇā viprā varṇaśreṣṭhā mahītale ।। 49 ।। kecidbhūpā vaiśyaśūdrāḥ kecicca mlecchajātayaḥ।। kecitsvakarmaṇā prājñā jñānena sarvadarśinaḥ ।। 50।। kecinmūrkhāḥ kecidandhāḥ svāṅgahīnāśca kecana ।। kecicchāstraṃ bodhayanti śiṣyavargānsvakarmaṇā ।।51।। kecitpaṭhanti sarvārthaṃ jānanti guruvaktrataḥ ।। bhavanti karmaṇā keciddehe sthāvarajaṅgame ।।52।। tapasvī navaghātī ca tvaṃ ca brahmā ca karmaṇā ।। kācitsvakarmaṇā sādhvī pūjyeha ca paratra ca ।।53।। kācidveśyā tadāhāraṃ bhuṅkte kṛtvā'ṅga vikrayam ।। svarveśyā'haṃ surapure surabhogyā supūjitā ।।54।। yeṣāmāliṅganenaiva karmaṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ bhavet ।। manaḥ svabhāvabījaṃ ca svabhāvaḥ karmabījakaḥ ।। 99 ।। tatkarmaphalabījaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ janako hariḥ ।। phalaṃ dadāti niyataṃ karmadvārā vibhuḥ svayam ।। 56 ।। sarvebhyo balavānnityaṃ karmarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। kuto hetorniṃnditā'haṃ tvayaiva bhartsitā katham ।। 57 ।। jagatsraṣṭurīśvarasya pādābjaṃ draṣṭumāgatā ।। svapne yasya padadvandvaṃ na hi paśyanti yoginaḥ ।। 58 ।। tamīśvaraṃ patiṃ kartumicchayā svayamāgatā ।। gatvā hi kasyacitsthānamaspṛśyeha paratra ca ।। 59 ।। kasyacitpādarajasā yaśasā bhānti yoṣitaḥ ।। ityuktvā mohinī śīghraṃ gatvovāsa hareḥ puraḥ ।। 60 ।। svayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ cakampe kulaṭābhayāt ।। sasmitā vakranayanā kāmabhāvaṃ cakāra ha ।। 61 ।। svāṅgaṃ ca darśayāmāsa kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। etasminnantare kāmaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvayogavit ।। 62 ।। āvirbhūya pañca bāṇānnicikṣepa ca brahmaṇi ।। sammohanaṃ samudvegaṃ bījastambhitakāraṇam ।। 63 ।। unmattabījaṃ jvaladaṃ śaśvaccetanahārakam ।। etānprakṣipya madano'pyantarikṣasthitaḥ svayam।।64।। kiṃkarānpreṣayāmāsa saṃmohāya piturmudā ।। vasantaṃ kokilālīśca gandhavātaṃ manoharam ।। 65 ।। niyujyābhyantaraṃ gatvā tadvikāraṃ cakāra ha ।। puṃskokilaḥ kalaṃ rāvamuvāca tatsamīpataḥ।।। ṣaṭpadaḥ sundaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ juguñje purataḥ sthitaḥ।। śaśvadvavau gandhavaho mando'tiśītalaḥ priye ।। 67 ।। satataṃ muditastatra babhrāma ca madhuḥ svayam ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo babhūva jagatāṃ vidhiḥ ।। 68 ।। dadarśa mohinī bhāvaṃ prahasya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। atīva vakranayanā kāmāstrahatacetanā ।। 69।। vidhātā bubudhe sarvaṃ sarvabandhanibandhanam।। niyantuṃ na manaḥ śaktaḥ sasmāra śrīhariṃ bhiyā ।। 70 ।। tuṣṭāva manasā kṛṣṇaṃ śāntaṃ hṛtpaṅkajasthitam ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ hariṃ pītāmbaraṃ param ।। 71 ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca kiśoraṃ sthirayauvanam ।। ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sasmitaṃ śyāmasundaram ।। 72 ।। brahmovāca ।। rakṣa rakṣa hare māṃ ca nimagnaṃ kāmasāgare ।। duṣkīrtijalapūrṇe ca duṣpāre bahusaṃkaṭe ।। 73 ।। bhaktivismṛtibīje ca vipatsopānadustare ।। atīva nirmalajñānacakṣuḥprachannakāraṇe ।। 74 ।। janmormisaṃghasahite yoṣinnakraughasaṃkule ।। ratisrotaḥsamāyukte gaṃbhīre ghora eva ca ।। 75 ।। prathamāmṛtarūpe ca pariṇāmaviṣālaye ।। yamālayapradeśāya muktidvārātivismṛte।।76।। buddhyā taraṇyā vijñānairuddharāsmānataḥ svayam ।। svayaṃ ca tvaṃ karṇadhāraḥ prasīda madhusūdana ।।77।। madvidhāḥ katicinnātha niyojyā bhavakarmaṇi।। santi viśveśa vidhayo he viśveśvara mādhava ।। 78 ।। na karmakṣetramevedaṃ brahmaloko'yamīpsitaḥ ।। tathāpi naḥ spṛhā kāme tvadbhaktivyavadhāyake।।79 ।। he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru ।। tvaṃ maheśa mahājñātā duḥsvapnaṃ māṃ na darśaya ।। 80 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā virarāma sanātanaḥ ।। dhyāyaṃdhyāyaṃ matpadābjaṃ śaśvatsasmāra māmiti ।। 81 ।। brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet ।। sa caivākarṇya viṣaye na nimagno bhaveddhruvam ।। 82 ।। mama māyāṃ vinirjitya saṃjñānaṃ labhate dhruvam ।। iha loke bhaktiyukto madbhaktapravaro bhavet ।। 83 ।। ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde brahmamohinīsaṃvāde dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 32 ।।
<4.33> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। kṛtvā brahmā hareḥ stotraṃ tasthau tasyāḥ samīpataḥ ।। manomattagajendraṃ ca kāmāsaktaṃ nivārayan ।। 1 ।। divyajñānāṃkuśe naiva mayā dattena rādhike ।। uvāca mohinī taṃ ca parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ ।। 2 ।। mohinyuvāca ।। iṅgitenaiva nārīṇāṃ sadyo mattaṃ bhavenmanaḥ ।। karotyākṛṣya saṃbhogaṃ yaḥ sa evottamo vibho ।। 3 ।। jñātvā sphuṭamabhiprāyaṃ nāryā saṃpreṣito hi yaḥ ।। paścātkaroti śṛṅgāraṃ puruṣaḥ sa ca madhyamaḥ ।। 4 ।। punaḥpunaḥ preṣitaśca striyā kāmārtayā ca yaḥ ।। tayā na lipto rahasi sa klībo na pumānaho ।।5।। gṛhī tapasvī kāmī vā tyajetstriyamupasthitām ।। vrajetparatra narakamapūjyaśca bhavediha ।।6।। naṣṭaśrīrbhraṣṭarūpaśca bhraṣṭabuddhirbhaved dhruvam।। sa sadyaḥ klībatāṃ yāti brahmañchāpena yoṣitaḥ।।7।। uttiṣṭha jagatīnātha pāraṃ kuru smarārṇave ।। nimagnāṃ dustare ghore karṇadhāra bhayānake ।।8।। atīva nirjanasthāne sarvajantuvivarjite ।। sugandhivāyunā ramye puṃskokilarutaśrute ।। 9 ।। satataṃ tvanmanaskāṃ māṃ dāsīṃ janmani janmani ।। krīṇīhi ratipaṇyenāmūlyaratnena satvaram ।। 10 ।। ityuktvā mohinī sadyo jagatsraṣṭuśca brahmaṇaḥ ।। vicakarṣa varaṃ vastraṃ sasmitā kāmavihvalā ।। 11 ।। vijñāya samayaṃ dhātā tāmuvāca bhayāturaḥ ।। pīyūṣatulyaṃ vacanaṃ varaṃ vinayapūrvakam ।। 12 ।। brahmovāca ।। śṛṇu mohini madvākyaṃ satyasāraṃ hitaṃ sphuṭam ।। na kuru tvaṃ ca trailokye strījātīnāmapatrapām ।। 13 ।। tyaja māmambike putraṃ vṛddhaṃ niṣkāmameva ca ।। tvatkarmayogyarasikaṃ yuvānaṃ paśya susmite ।। 14 ।। niṣekāllabhate patnī guruṃ bhartuḥ śubhāśubham ।। mantraśilpamapatyaṃ ca sarvametanna yatnataḥ ।। 15 ।। tvayā saha mama rate nibandho nāsti suvrate ।। kṣudraṃ mahadvā yatkarma sarvadaivanibandhakam ।।16।। ityuktavantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ smarantaṃ matpadāmbujam।। vicakarṣa punarveśyā kāmena hatacetanā ।।17।। etasminnantare śīghraṃ sthānaṃ tatsumanoharam।। ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā ।।18।। atriḥ pulastyaḥ pulaho vasiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ।। bhṛgurmarīciḥ kapilo voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho ruciḥ ।। 19 ।। āsuriśca pracetāśca svayaṃ śukro bṛhaspatiḥ ।। utathyaḥ karakaḥ kaṇvaḥ kaśyapo gautamastathā ।। 20 ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca kardamaśca sanātanaḥ ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānyogināṃ paramo guruḥ ।। 21 ।। śātātapaḥ pippalaśca śaṃkuḥ śukraḥ parāśaraḥ ।। mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca mṛkaṇḍuścyavanastathā ।। 22 ।। durvāsāśca jaratkārurāstīkaśca vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।। ṛṣyaśṛṅgo bharadvājo vāmadevaśca kauśikaḥ ।। 23 ।। dṛṣṭvaitāṃśca taponiṣṭhānāgatāṃśca munīśvarān ।। tatyāja mohinī śīghraṃ vrīḍayā kamalodbhavam ।। 24 ।। tatrovāsa jagaddhātā taddhāmapārśvataśca sā ।। praṇemurmunayastaṃ ca bhaktinamrātmakandharāḥ ।। 25 ।। āśiṣaṃ yuyuje brahmā vāsayāmāsa tānvibhuḥ ।। teṣu madhye prajajvāla yathā tārāsu candramāḥ ।। 26 ।। papracchurmunayo devaṃ kathameṣā tavāntike।। svarveśyānāṃ ca pravarā mohinītyevameva ca ।। 27 ।। śrutvā munīnāṃ vacanamuvāca tānprajāpatiḥ ।। strījātīnāṃ ca vacanaṃ lajjācchādanameva ca ।। 28 ।। ।। brahmovāca ।। apūrvaṃ nṛtyagītaṃ ca ciraṃ kṛtvā śubhāvahā ।। uvāseyaṃ pariśrāntā yathā kanyā pituḥ puraḥ ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ dhātā jahāsa muni saṃsadi ।। 29 ।। jahasurmunayaḥ sarve sarvajñāstatra rādhike ।। sarvaṃ rahasyaṃ vijñāya jagatsraṣṭuśca mānasam ।। 30 ।। sadyaścukopa kulaṭā hāsyavyājena saṃsadi ।। sarvāṅgakampamānā sā kulaṭā kuṭilānanā ।। 31 ।। raktapaṅkajanetrā ca kopaprasphuritādharā ।। utthāya ca sabhāmadhye teṣāṃ ca purataḥ sthitā ।। saṃbodhyovāca brahmāṇaṃ mṛtyukanyā yathā ruṣā ।। 32 ।। mohinyuvāca ।। aye brahmañjagannātha vedakartā tvameva ca ।। 33 ।। kiṃ vā vedapraṇihitaṃ karma kiṃ tadviparyayam ।। vicāraṃ manasā svena kuru vedavidāṃ guro ।। 34 ।। svakanyāyāṃ yatspṛhā sa kathaṃ hasasi nartakīm ।। nirmitā'hamīśvareṇa svarveśyā sarvagāminī ।। 35।। satāṃ karma viruddhaṃ yattadatyantaviḍambanam ।। dāsītulyāṃ vinītāṃ ca daivena śaraṇāgatām ।। 36 ।। yato hasasi garveṇa tato'pūjyo bhavāciram ।। acirāddarpabhaṅgaṃ te kariṣyati hariḥ svayam ।। 37 ।। nibodha vacanaṃ brahmanveśyāyāśca tu sāṃpratam ।। tavaiva vacanaṃ stotraṃ gṛhṇāti yo naraḥ sadā ।। 38 ।। bhavitā tasya vighnaśca sa yāsyatyupahāsyatām ।। bhavitā vārṣikī pūjā devatānāṃ yugeyuge ।। 39 ।। tava māghyāṃ ca saṃkrāntyāṃ na bhaviṣyati sā punaḥ ।। kalpāntare'tra kalpe vā dehe dehāṃtare'tra vā ।। 40 ।। punaḥ pūjā na bhavitā yā gatā sā gataiva ca ।। ityuktvā mohinī śīghraṃ jagāma madanālayam ।। 41 ।। tena sārddhaṃ ratiṃ kṛtvā babhūva vijvarā punaḥ ।। paścātsā cetanāṃ prāpya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ punaḥ ।। 42 ।। ayaṃ kathaṃ mayā śapto jagadvidhiratipriyaḥ ।। svarveśyāyāṃ gatāyāṃ ca munayo duḥkhitā bhṛśam ।। 43 ।। svayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ cakampe natakandharaḥ ।। upāyaṃ munayastasmai daduḥ kalyāṇakāriṇaḥ ।। 44 ।। śaraṇaṃ vraja vaikuṇṭhamityuktvā te gṛhānyayuḥ ।। brahmā jagāma śaraṇaṃ mama mūrtyantaraṃ param ।। 45 ।। śāntaṃ taṃ kamalākāntaṃ śyāmaṃ nārāyaṇābhidham।। gatvā viṣaṣṇavadanaḥ praṇamya ca caturbhujam ।। 46 ।। tatrovāsa jagatkartā nātidūre samīpataḥ ।। rahasyaṃ kathayāmāsa śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ ।। 47 ।। dīnabandhuṃ dayāsindhuṃ vipattāraṇakāraṇam ।। śrutvā rahasyaṃ tatsarvaṃ prahasyovāca taṃ vibhuḥ ।। satyaṃ sāraṃ hitaṃ vākyaṃ jagatāṃ ca sukhāvaham ।। 48 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। svayaṃ tvaṃ vedavidasi viduṣāṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।। 49 ।। tvayā kṛtaṃ ca yatkarma iha kena na tatkṛtam ।। strījātiḥ prakṛteraṃśā jagatāṃ bījarūpiṇī ।। 50 ।। strīṇāṃ viḍambanenaiva prakṛteśca viḍambanam ।। na tadbhāratavarṣaṃ ca puṇyakṣetramanuttamam ।। 51 ।। krīḍākṣetre brahmaloke kastavendriyanigrahaḥ ।। yadi tadbhārate daivātkāminī samupasthitā ।। 52 ।। svayaṃ rahasi kāmārtā na sā tyājyā jitendriyaiḥ ।। tyaktvā paratra narakaṃ vrajedativiḍambitaḥ ।। 53 ।। bhavedeva hi duḥkhārtā śāpaṃ dadyācca taṃ dhruvam ।। vihāya svakalatraṃ ca yo gṛhṇāti parastriyam ।। 54 ।। lobhātkāmasukhādvā'pi so'dhamo nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। pātayitvā sa ca pateddaśa pūrvāndaśāparān ।। 55 ।। tyaktvā svasvāminaṃ yā ca paraṃ gacchati kāmataḥ ।। na pumānna ca veśyā ca kulastrī tatra duṣyati ।। ।। 56 ।। upāyena ca yā sādhyaṃ karoti parapūruṣam ।। tiṣṭhatyevāndhakūpe sā yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 57 ।। svarveśyā ca divaṃ yāti satataṃ kuladharmataḥ ।। dhruvaṃ bhavetso'parādhī tasyā apyavamānataḥ ।। 58 ।। tamupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi śapto yatra viśuddhyati ।। kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha jagannātha pāpinaśca bhavārṇave ।। 59 ।। etasminnaṃtare kaścidājagāma hareḥ puraḥ ।। dvārapālaḥ śīghragāmītyuvāca natakandharaḥ ।। 60 ।। dvārapāla uvāca ।। anyabrahmāṇḍādhipatirbrahmā daśamukhaḥ svayam ।। dvāre tiṣṭhanmahābhaktastvāṃ draṣṭuṃ svayamāgataḥ।। 61 ।। dvārapālavacaḥ śrutvā sa caivānumatiṃ dadau ।। dvārapālājñayā brahmā tuṣṭāvāgatya bhaktitaḥ ।। 62।। stotrairativicitraiśca caturvaktrā'śrutairaho ।। stutvovāsājñayā viṣṇoḥ kṛtvā paścāccaturmukham ।। 63 ।। nārāyaṇo dvārapālānityuvāca caturbhujān ।। āgantukaṃ janamapi praveśayata sādaram ।। 64 ।। etasminnantare tatra vṛndāvanavinodini ।। ājagāmātipraṇato brahmā śatamukhaḥ svayam ।। ।। 65 ।। divyaiḥ stotraiśca tuṣṭāva nigūḍhamatisundaraiḥ ।। stutvovāsa varaiḥ stotraiḥ sarveṣāmaśrutairaho ।। 66 ।। tadanantarayoragre bhaktasya śatamukhaḥ svayam ।। jagadvidhau sabhāyāṃ ca tatra tiṣṭhati tatkṣaṇe ।। 67 ।। ājagāmānyabrahmāṇḍādhipo brahmā hareḥ puraḥ ।। sahasravadanaḥ śrīmānbhaktyā namrātmakandharaḥ ।। 68 ।। stutvovāsa varaiḥ stotraiḥ sarveṣāmaśrutairaho ।। taṃ ca papraccha sarveṣāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca brahmaṇām ।। ।। 69 ।। vārtā viṣayiṇāṃ caiva surāṇāṃ ca krameṇa ca।। caturmukhasya tāndṛṣṭvā darpabhaṅgo babhūva ha ।। 70 ।। ātmānaṃ viṣṇusadṛśaṃ manyamānasya darpataḥ ।। anyānna darśayāmāsa brahmāṇḍasthānvidhīnhariḥ ।। 71 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca kṛpayā tatra mṛtatulyaṃ caturmukham।। yāvanti gātralomāni santi nārāyaṇasya me।।72।। tatpramāṇāśca brahmāṇḍā brahmāṇaḥ santi santatam।। nārāyaṇaṃ praṇamyāśu jagmuste svālayaṃ prati।।73।। sa mene vidhirātmānamatyalpaviṣayādhipam ।। papraccha praṇataṃ viṣṇurlajjānamracaturmukham ।। 74 ।। vada tatkimidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ svapnavadbhavatā'dhunā ।। nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā vidhirityuktavāṃstadā ।।75।। bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tava māyāsamudbhavam ।। ityevamuktvā sa vidhistasthau saṃsadi lajjayā ।। sarvāntaryāmī bhagavāṃstasyopāyaṃ vinirmame ।। 76 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde mohinīśāpabrahmadarpabhaṃgo nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 33 ।।
<4.34> ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ।। etasminnantare tatra śaṃkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ ।। sasmito vṛṣabhendrastho vibhūtibhūṣaṇaḥ svayam ।। 1 ।। vyāghracarmāmbaradharo nāgayajñopavītakaḥ ।। svarṇākārajaṭādhāramardhacandraṃ ca sandadhat ।। 2 ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśakaro bibhratkhaṭvāṅgamuttamam ।। sadratnasāraracitasvarayantrakaro mudā ।। 3 ।। vāhanādavaruhyāśu bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। praṇamya kamalākāntaṃ vāme covāsa bhaktitaḥ।।4।। ājagmurmunayaḥ sarve surāḥ śakrādayastathā।। ādityā vasavo rudrā manavaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ।। 5 ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam ।। praṇamya taṃ śivaṃ sarve surāśca namrakandharāḥ।। 6 ।। etasminnantare tatra saṃgītaṃ śaṃkaro jagau ।। kṛtvā'tīva sutālaṃ ca svarayantrasamanvitaḥ ।।7 ।। āvayośca guṇākhyānaṃ rāsasaṃbandhi sundaram ।। samayocitarāgeṇa manomohanakāriṇā ।। 8।। yatra kaṇṭhaikamānena caikatānena cāruṇā।। padabhedavirāmeṇa guruṇā laghunā kramāt।। ।। 9 ।। gamakenātidīrgheṇa madena madhureṇa ca ।। bhave'tidurlabhaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ prītyā svena vinirmitam ।। 10 ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraḥ punaḥpunaḥ ।। tadeva śrutimātreṇa mūrcchāṃ prāpurvicetanāḥ ।। 11 ।। babhūvu rudrarūpāśca munayaḥ purataḥ priye ।। rudrarūpāḥ surāḥ sarve vidhātṛharipārṣadāḥ ।। 12 ।। nārāyaṇaśca lakṣmīśca gāyakaśca śivaḥ svayam ।। jalapūrṇaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā trasto'hamīśvari ।। 13 ।। gatvā mūrtīrvinirmāya sarvāśca tādṛśīriti ।। tatsvarūpāstadastrāśca tatsvavāhanabhūṣaṇāḥ ।। 14 ।। tatsvabhāvāstanmanaskāstattadviṣayamānasāḥ ।। sthānaṃ nirmāya parito vaikuṇṭhasya caturdiśi ।। 15 ।। tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca ājagāma svamālayam ।। śarīrajā surāṇāṃ sā babhūva suranimnagā ।। 16 ।। muktidā ca mumukṣūṇāṃ bhaktānāṃ haribhaktidā ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ vividhaṃ pāpināmaho ।। 17 ।। yasyāśca sparśavāyośca saṃparkeṇa vinaśyati ।। kiṃ vā na jāne prāṇeśi sparśadarśanayoḥ phalam ।। 18 ।। kimuta snānajanyaṃ ca kathayāmi nirūpaṇam ।। sarvatīrthātparaṃ pṛthvyāṃ puṣkaraṃ parikīrtitam ।। 19 ।। vedoktaṃ ca tadevāsyāḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ।। bhagīrathena cānītā tena bhāgīrathī smṛtā ।। 20 ।। gāmāgatā srotasoṃ'śādgaṅgā tena prakīrtitā ।। jānudvārā purā dattā jahnunā''pīya kopataḥ ।। 21 ।। tasya kanyāsvarūpā sā jāhnavī tena kīrtitā ।। bhīṣmaḥ svayaṃ vasurjātastasyāṃśāttena bhīṣmasūḥ ।। 22 ।। dhārābhistisṛbhiḥ svargaṃ pṛthivīmatalaṃ tathā ।। mamājñayā ca gacchantī tena tripathagāminī ।। 23 ।। pradhānadhārayā svarge sā ca mandākinī smṛtā ।। yojanāyutavistīrṇā prasthe ca yojanā smṛtā ।। 24 ।। kṣīratulyajalā śaśvadatyuttuṅgataraṅgiṇī ।। vaikuṇṭhādbrahmalokaṃ ca tataḥ svargaṃ samāgatā ।। 25 ।। svargāddhimādrimārgeṇa pṛthivīmāgatā mudā ।। sā dhārā'lakanaṃdākhyā lavaṇodena miśritā ।। ।। 26 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśā bahuvegavatī satī ।। pāpināṃ pāpaśuṣkendhaṃ dagdhuṃ pāvakarūpiṇī ।। 27 ।। aho sagaravaṃśebhyo nirvāṇamuktidāyinī ।। vaikuṇṭhagāmigī sā ca sopānarūpiṇī varā ।।28 ।। ato'pi mṛtyusamaye satāṃ puṇyasvarūpiṇām ।। ādau pādau ca saṃnyasya mukhe toyaṃ pradīyate ।। 29 ।। gaṅgāsopānamāruhya santo yānti nirāmayam ।। ābrahmalokaṃ saṃlaṃghya rathasthāśca nirāpadaḥ ।। ।। 30 ।। daivātpurā prāktanena magnaṃ cetkṛtapātakaiḥ ।। lomapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca modante harimandire ।। 31 ।। tato bhogo bhavetteṣāṃ niścitaṃ pāpapuṇyayoḥ ।। atisvalpena kālena kālavyūhaṃ ca bibhratām ।। 32 ।। tataḥ puṇyavatāṃ gehe labdhvā janma ca bhārate ।। saṃprāpya niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ bhavanti harirūpiṇaḥ ।। 33 ।। mṛtadvijānāṃ dehāṃśca daivācchūdrā vahanti cet ।। padapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca teṣāṃ ca narake sthitiḥ ।। 34।। tatasteṣāṃ ca sāhāyyaṃ karoti harirūpiṇī।। dadāti muktiṃ tebhyo'pi krameṇa ca kṛpāmayī।।35।। janma puṇyavatāṃ gehe kārayitvā ca bhārate।। sthalaṃ dadāti vaikuṇṭhe niścitaṃ janmabhistribhiḥ ।। 36 ।। yātrāṃ kṛtvā tu yaḥ śuddhau snātuṃ yāti sureśvarīm ।। padapramāṇavarṣaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe modate dhruvam ।। 37 ।। gaṅgāṃ prāpyānuṣaṅgeṇa snāti cetsamalo naraḥ ।। mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ punaryadi na lipyate ।। 38 ।। kalau pañca sahasrābdaṃ sthitistasyāśca bhārate ।। tasyāṃ ca vidyamānāyāṃ kaḥ prabhāvaḥ kaleraho ।। 39 ।। kalau daśasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi pratimā mama।। tiṣṭhanti ca purāṇāni prabhāvastatra kaḥ kaleḥ ।। 40 ।। atalaṃ yāti yā dhārā sā ca bhogavatī smṛtā ।। payaḥphenanibhā śaśvadativegavatī sadā ।। 41 ।। ākarāmūlyaratnānāṃ maṇīndrāṇāṃ ca saṃtatam ।। nāgakanyāśca yattīre krīḍanti sthirayauvanāḥ ।। 42 ।। svayaṃ devī ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ veṣṭayitvā ca saṃtatam ।। sahasrayojanā prasthe dairghye ca lakṣayojanā ।। 43 ।। asyā vināśaḥ pralaye nāstyeva duhiturmama ।। nānāratnākaraṃ divyaṃ tattīraṃ sumanoharam ।। 44 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ jāhnavījanma puṇyadam ।। brahmaṇaśca pratīkāro mohinīśāpatā śṛṇu ।। 45 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde jāhnavījanmaprastāvo nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ।। ।। 34 ।।
<4.35> ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। nārāyaṇaśca brahmāṇamuvāca kṛpayā punaḥ ।। dṛṣṭvā gaṅgāṃ ca sarve tāṃ mama māyāṃ ca menire ।। 1 ।। ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। uttiṣṭha gaccha bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati caturmukha ।। atra snātvā'bhiśaptastvaṃ pūto bhava mamājñayā।।2।। tvaṃ cetsatyaṃ svayaṃ pūtaḥ sparśaṃ vāñchanti tāni te ।। vaiṣṇaveśasya tīrthāni sarvāṇi satataṃ mune।।3।। tathāpi śāpamuktastvamatra prakṛtihelanāt ।। ahaṃkāraśca sarveṣāṃ pāpabījamamaṅgalam ।। 4 ।। śīghraṃ tvaṃ gaccha golokaṃ mamālayaṃ parātparam ।। prakṛtyaṃśāṃ maṅgaladāṃ tatra prāpsyasi bhāratīm ।। 5 ।। prakṛtiṃ bhaja kalyāṇa sṛṣṭibījasvarūpiṇīm ।। aho kalpāntaparyantaṃ tapastaptaṃ tvayā'dhunā।।6।। tava mantraṃ na gṛhṇanti ke'pi veśyā'bhiśāpataḥ ।। yadanyadevapūjāyāṃ tava pūjā bhaviṣyati ।। 7 ।। tvameva jagatāṃ dhātā svātmārāmaśca yoṣitaḥ ।। sarvarūpī ca pūjaḥ ca sarvadeheṣu sarvataḥ ।। 8 ।। tadā mamājñayā brahmā snātvā ca jāhnavījale ।। śīghraṃ jagāma golokaṃ māṃ praṇamya jagadguruḥ ।। 9 ।। te devā munayaḥ sarve prajagmuḥ svālayaṃ mudā ।। sunirmalaṃ mama yaśo gāyantaśca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 10 ।। vidhirāgatya golokaṃ saṃprāpya bhāratīṃ satīm ।। sarvavidyādhidevīṃ tāṃ madvaktrābjavinirmitām ।।11 ।। vāgīśvarīṃ ca saṃprāpya brahmā pramuditaḥ svayam ।। kāmāstrāṇāṃ ca vyāpāramanumene svayaṃ vibhuḥ।।12।। tata āgatya māṃ natvā prāpya trailokyamohinīm ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavānsthānesthāne'tinirjane।।13।। ratiṃ cirataraṃ kṛtvā virarāma svayaṃ vidhiḥ ।। vāgīśvarīmuvācedaṃ tvaṃ vai brahmā ca karmaṇā ।। 14 ।। kācitsvakarmaṇā sādhvī pūjyā ca sthirayauvanā ।। tavaiva karmayogaṃ ca yuvānaṃ paśya sundari ।। 15 ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet ।। jarāturo'haṃ vṛddhaśca tapasvī vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ ।। 16 ।। asvatantraḥ parādhīnaḥ kā ratiḥ puṃścalīṣu me ।। ājagāma brahmalokaṃ punareva nijālayam ।। 17 ।। dadṛśubrarhmalokasthāstāṃ devīṃ kautukānvitāḥ ।। atīva sundarīṃ ramyāṃ śubhravarṇāṃ ca sasmitām ।। 18 ।। śaracchītāṃśuvadanāṃ śaratpaṅkajalocanām ।। pakvabimbaprabhāmuṣṭadīptauṣṭhādharapallavām ।।19।। muktāpaṅktivinindyaikadantapaṅktimanoharām।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnanūpuraśobhitām ।। 20 ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmena karṇamūlavirājitām ।। ratnendrasārahāreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalām ।। 21 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ sūkṣmaṃ bibhratīṃ navayauvanām ।। atīva kamanīyāṃ ca pīnaśroṇipayodharām ।। 22 ।। vīṇāpustakahastāṃ ca vyākhyāmudrākarāṃ varām ।। te ca nirmañchanaṃ kṛtvā cakruḥ paramamaṅgalam ।। 23 ।। purīṃ praveśayāmāsurbrahmāṇaṃ bhāratīṃ mudā ।। brahmā tayā saha krīḍāṃ cakāra sa divāniśam ।। 24 ।। atīva sukhasaṃbhoge nimagnaḥ satataṃ mudā ।। gūḍhe sarvapurāṇeṣu kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 29 ।। ।।śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। prāṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya parameśvarī ।। bhūyo'pi paripapraccha kautukānmānasaṃ purā ।। 26 ।। śrīrādhikovāca ।। brahmā kathaṃ na jagrāha veśyāṃ svayamupasthitām ।। na karmakṣetre rahasi phaladātā ca karmaṇām ।। 27 ।। upasthitāyāstyāge ca mahāndoṣo hi yoṣitaḥ ।। jñātvā devo vidhātā sa kathaṃ tatyāja mohinīm ।। 28 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ ।। pādmakalpasya vṛttāntamuvāca parameśvarīm ।। 29 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca।। śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi purāvṛttāntamīpsitam ।। akathyaṃ gopanīyaṃ ca mahatāmabhininditam ।। 30 ।। ekadā ca prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ vidhātā prerito mayā ।। sasarja manasā putrāñjvalato brahmatejasā।। 31 ।। sanakaṃ ca sanandaṃ ca sanātanamanuttamam ।। sanatkumāraṃ voḍhuṃ ca kaviṃ pañcaśikhaṃ vibhum ।।32 ।। asitaṃ kapilaṃ siddhaṃ siddhānmama kulodbhavān।। tānnagnānpañcavarṣīyānpitā sraṣṭuṃ jagāda ha।। 33 ।। prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ prerakaṃ ca janakaṃ te'vamanya ca ।। prajagmustapase tūrṇaṃ mamārcanaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 34 ।। tadā ruṣṭo jagaddhātā punaḥ putrānvinirmame ।। rudrānekādaśa varānrudato bhīmavigrahān ।। 35 ।। tasminprayujya tarasā punaḥ putrānvinirmame ।। yogī yogena māṃ dhyātvā svātmārāmaḥ svavigrahe ।। 36 ।। vasiṣṭhaṃ pulahaṃ caiva kratumaṅgirasaṃ tathā ।। bhṛgumatriṃ pulastyaṃ ca dakṣaṃ kardamameva ca ।। 37 ।। marīciṃ ca vinirmāya prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ niyujya ca ।। prahṛṣṭamānasaḥ putraṃ kanyaikā ca sasarja ha ।। 38 ।। kṛṣṇasya kāminaḥ putraḥ kāmadevo babhūva ha ।। kanyā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 39 ।। uvāca putraṃ sa vidhiḥ sudīptaṃ purataḥ sthitam ।। durnivāryaṃ matkalāṃśaṃ svātmārāmaṃ manoharam ।। 40 ।। brahmovāca ।। strīpuṃsoḥ krīḍanārthāya mudā tvaṃ ca vinirmitaḥ ।। hṛṣṭiyogena sarveṣāmadhiṣṭhānaṃ kariṣyasi ।। 41 ।। saṃmohanaṃ samudvegaṃ bījastaṃbhitakāraṇam ।। unmattabījaṃ jvaladaṃ śaśvaccetanahārakam ।। 42 ।। pragṛhyaitānmayā dattānsarvānsaṃmohanaṃ kuru ।। durnivāryo mama varādbhava vatsa bhaveṣu ca ।। 43 ।। bāṇāndattvaivamuktvā ca prahṛṣṭaśca jagadvidhiḥ ।। dṛṣṭvovāca duhitaraṃ varaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 44।। etasminnantare kāmo manasā''locya mantraṇām ।। kartuṃ śastraparīkṣāṃ ca bāṇāṃścikṣepa brahmaṇi ।। 45 ।। maṃtrapūtaiśca bāṇaiśca durvāryaiḥ smaraṇena ca ।। atividdho mahāyogī mūrcchito hatacetanaḥ।। 46 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya dadarśāgre ca kanyakām ।। tāṃ saṃbhoktuṃ manaścakre sā dudrāva bhiyā satī ।। 47 ।। dṛṣṭvā paścācca pitaraṃ dhāvantaṃ hatacetanam ।। jagāma śaraṇaṃ śīghraṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ ca tapasvinām ।। 48 ।। te tāṃ samīpe saṃsthāpya tamūcuḥ pitaraṃ krudhā ।। hitaṃ tathyaṃ ca vedoktaṃ nītisāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ ।। 49 ।। ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।। aho kimetajjanaka karma te'tivigarhitam ।। nīcānāṃ caritaṃ yattatkaroṣi tvaṃ jagadvidhe ।। 50 ।। paśyanti satataṃ santaḥ prasūmiva parastriyam ।। ye te sarvatra pūjyāśca paratreha jitendriyāḥ ।।51 ।। tvaṃ svayaṃ vedakartā ca kanyāṃ saṃbhoktumicchasi ।। kanyā ca mātṛvargeṣu praviṣṭā ca śrutau śrutā ।। 52 ।। guroḥ patnī rājapatnī viprapatnī ca yā satī ।। patnī ca bhrātṛsutayormitrapatnī ca tatprasūḥ ।। 53 ।। prasūḥ pitrostathā bhrātuḥ patnī śvaśrūḥ svakanyakāḥ ।। jananī tatsapatnī ca bhaginī surabhī tathā ।। 54 ।। svābhīṣṭasurapatnī ca dhātrikā'nnapradāyikā ।। garbhadhātrī svanāmnā ca bhayāttrātuśca kāminī ।। 55 ।। etā vedapraṇītāśca sarveṣāṃ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ।। etāsvapi ca sarvāsu nyūnatā nāsti kāsu ca ।।56।। kanyādātā'nnadātā ca jñānadātā'bhayapradaḥ ।। janmado mantrado jyeṣṭhabhrātā ca pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।।57 ।। etā vahanti ye mūḍhā ya etāñjanakānapi ।। pacyante narake te ca yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 58 ।। tānandhakūpe saṃsthāpya dūrato yamakiṅkarāḥ।। kurvanti tāḍanaṃ śaśvatpurīṣaṃ pāyayanti ca ।। 59 ।। tvameva viśvakartā ca śāstā vai śamanasya ca ।। vayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ tena gṛhṇāsi kanyakām ।। 60 ।। asmākaṃ purato dūraṃ gaccha kāmārtamānasa।। na kurmo bhasmasātkartuṃ śaktāśca janakaṃ vayam ।।61।। gurordoṣasahasrāṇi kṣantumarhanti paṇḍitāḥ ।। sarvaghnaṃ taṃ vinighnanti nītijñāḥ svaguruṃ vinā ।।62।। gṛhṇanti yadi sarvasvaṃ śapantaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ gurum ।। sādhavastaṃ na nindanti praṇamanti svabhaktitaḥ ।।63।। ye dviṣanti ca nindati gurumiṣṭaṃ surātparam ।। pacyante te'ndhakūpe ca yāvaccandradivākarau।।64।। purīṣaṃ bhuñjate nityaṃ kṣubhitā yamatāḍanaiḥ ।। sarpapramāṇakīṭaiśca daṃśitāśca divāniśam ।। 65।। ityevamuktvā munayaḥ praṇemustatpadāmbujam ।। sarvaṃ bhavati daivena praśāntamanasā dhruvam ।। 66 ।। unmukhā munayaḥ sarve babhūvuśca svakarmaṇi।। brahmā śarīraṃ saṃtyaktuṃ vrīḍayā ca samudyataḥ ।।67।। yogena bhittvā ṣaṭcakraṃ sarvānprāṇānniruddhya ca।। brahmarandhraṃ samānīya tatyāja svena vartmanā ।।68।। manasā śrīhariṃ smṛtvā namaskāraṃ cakāra ha ।। na me manaḥ paradravye bhavitā stokamīśvara ।।69।। prāṇatyāgātparaṃ duḥkhamayaśaśca yaśasvinām ।। babhūva hṛdi kṛtvaikaṃ brahmā līnaśca brahmaṇi।। ।। 70 ।। kanyā tātaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā vilapya ca bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ।। yogena dehaṃ tatyāja sā pralīnā ca brahmaṇi।।71।। mṛtaṃ tātaṃ ca bhaginīṃ dṛṣṭvā ca munipuṃgavāḥ ।। sasmaruḥ śrīhariṃ kopātsvātmārāmaṃ vilapya ca ।।72।। nārāyaṇo madaṃśaśca kṛpayā''gatya satvaram ।। brahmāṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa brahmajñānātsutāṃ ca tām ।।73।। brahmā puro hariṃ dṛṣṭvā varaṃ vavre sma vāñchitam ।। bhaktiṃ tvaccaraṇe śaśvanniścalāmanapāyinīm ।।74।। brahmāṇaṃ virasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tamuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। prabodhavacanaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ manoharam ।। 75 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu brahmanpravakṣye'haṃ mukhamuttolya sāṃpratam ।। tyaja lajjāṃ jagannātha hṛdayajvararūpiṇīm ।। 76 ।। satkīrtirapakīrtirvā supratiṣṭhāpyupadravaḥ ।। kṣudrāṇāṃ caiva mahatāṃ bhavatyeva svakarmaṇā ।।77।। sarveṣāmapi sarvebhyaḥ svakarma balavattaram ।। tasmātsantaḥ prakurvanti nityaṃ satkarma saṃtatam ।। 78 ।। kecitkurvanti nirmūlaṃ sarveṣāmapi karmaṇām ।। kṛtaṃ karma paraṃ bhuktvā haripādābjacetasaḥ ।।79 ।। kukarmaṇaścāpakīrtistato lajjā bhaveddhruvam ।। sukarmaṇaḥ supratiṣṭhā sarvatra nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ ।। 80 ।। kālena rajasā deho balaṃ rūpaṃ śubhāśubham ।। kīrtiryā triguṇā caiva mohaścāpayaśo vidhe ।। 81 ।। ṛṇavraṇāpavādāśca jantūnāṃ yānti kālataḥ ।। mahatāṃ tau ca pūrvoktau netaraśca kadācana ।। 82 ।। sadā'pakīrtirvasati parastrīṣu ca vastuṣu।। tasmātte naiva gṛhṇanti santaḥ svakleśakāraṇe ।। 83 ।। smara māmantare brāhme madīyaṃ viṣayaṃ kuru।। ataste na mano lolaṃ bhavitā paravastuṣu ।। 84 ।। yoṣidrūpā ca me māyā sarveṣāṃ mohakāriṇī ।। līlayā kurute mohaṃ svātmārāmasya saṃtatam ।। 85 ।। nānāmudrāśraye deśe rāgiṇo saṃtataṃ ratiḥ।। stanābhidhe māṃsapiṇḍe'dhare lālālaye'śucau ।।86।। śroṇivaktrastanaṃ tāsāṃ kāmadevālayaṃ sadā ।। tasmātte na hi paśyanti santo hi dharmabhīravaḥ ।।87।। ko dharmaḥ kiṃ yaśasteṣāṃ kā pratiṣṭhā ca kiṃ tapaḥ।। kiṃ buddhirvidyā dānaṃ ca parastrīṣu ca yanmanaḥ ।। 88 ।। ihāpyapayaśo duḥkhaṃ narakeṣu paratra ca ।। vāsaḥ prahārasteṣāṃ ca tāḍanaiḥ kṛmibhakṣaṇaiḥ ।। 89 ।। duḥkhabījaṃ sukhaṃ matvā mūḍhāśca daivadoṣataḥ ।। parastrīsevanaṃ prītyā kurvanti saṃtataṃ mudā ।। 90 ।। uttamā matpadāmbhojaṃ satkarma madhyamāḥ sadā ।। smaranti śaśvadadhamāḥ parastrīsevanaṃ mudā ।। 91 ।। vipattiḥ saṃtataṃ tasya paravastuṣu yanmanaḥ ।। viśeṣataḥ parastrīṣu suvarṇeṣu ca bhūmiṣu ।। 92 ।। daivātparastriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā viramedyo hariṃ smaran ।। dṛṣṭvā parasuvarṇaṃ ca hastaprakṣālanācchuciḥ ।। 93 ।। satataṃ naiva saṃsaktāḥ santaḥ svastrīṣu kāmataḥ ।। yakṣmavyādhijñānahānilokanindābhayena ca ।।94।। tapasvinastapasyāyāṃ śāstracintāsu paṇḍitāḥ।। yogino yogacintāsu vedārtheṣu ca vaidikāḥ ।।95।। sādhyaśca patisevāsu gṛhasthā gṛhakarmasu ।। viṣayeṣu viṣayiṇo madbhaktā mama sevane ।। 96 ।। ete niyuktā eteṣu sabhāsu ca praśaṃsitāḥ।।। vedoktācaraṇenaiva tadviruddhena ninditāḥ ।।97।। sarve nityaṃ praśaṃsanti śaśvatsanmārgagāminam ।। hālikā api nindanti kuvartmagāminaṃ vidhe ।।98।। bhavitā na parastrīṣu paravastuṣu te manaḥ ।। adyaprabhṛti jīvantaṃ niviṣṭaṃ madvareṇa ca ।। 99 ।। madīyaviṣaye bāhye mayā dattaṃ kuru priyam ।। antarā matpadāmbhojacintāṃ vighnavināśinīm ।। 100 ।। kanyā bhavatu me brahmankāmadevasya kāminī ।। ratirnāma parityājyā ratyadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।।101।। ityevamuktvā brahmāṇamāśvāsya kamalāpatiḥ ।। jagāma nityaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vṛndāvanavinodanaḥ ।। 102 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde rādhākṛṣṇasaṃvādo nāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 35 ।।

yathā'bhīṣṭaṃ na jagrāhāsuro varam ।। 26 ।। varṣānte śaṅkaraḥ śaśvattasthau tatpurataḥ svayam ।। varado bhaktipāśena kṣaṇaṃ gantuṃ na sa kṣamaḥ ।। 27 ।। sarvaiśvaryaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ haraḥ
