digambaro jaṭādhārī nāgasaṃghātabhūṣaṇaḥ ।। 72 ।। vṛṣeṇāṭati devendro vihāya varavāhanam ।। na bibharti kathaṃ ratnasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇam ।।73।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ tyaktvā dhatte śārdūlacarmakam ।। dhatte dhattūrakusumaṃ pārijātaṃ vihāya ca ।।74।। nāsti ratnakirīṭecchā jaṭāyāṃ prītiruttamā ।। divyalokaṃ parityajya śmaśāneṣu spṛhā vibhoḥ ।। 75 ।। candanāgurukastūrīsugaṃdhikusumāni ca ।। tyaktvā spṛhā bilvapatre bilvakāṣṭhānulepane।।76।। etadveditumicchāmi vyāsena kathaya prabho ।। śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ nātha varddhate me manaḥspṛhā ।। 77 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi ।। 78 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। yugaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapaḥ kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ ।। virarāma pūrṇatamo dhyātvā māṃ manasā mudā ।।79।। etasminnantare māṃ ca dadarśa purataḥ sthitam ।। atīva kamanīyāṅgaṃ kiśoraṃ śyāmasundaram।। ।। 80।। ahonirvacanīyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā rūpamanuttamam ।। na babhūva vitṛṣṇaśca locanābhyāṃ trilocanaḥ ।। 81 ।। paśyannimeṣarahita iti matvā svamānase ।। bhaktyudrekānmahābhakto ruroda premavihvalaḥ ।। 82 ।। sahasravadano'nanto bhāgyavāṃśca caturmukhaḥ ।। bahubhirlocanairdṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva bahubhirmukhaiḥ ।। 83 ।। paśyāmi kiṃ vā kiṃ staumi saṃprāpya nāthamīdṛśam ।। āsyaikena locanābhyāṃ caturddhā sa punaḥ punaḥ ।। 84 ।। sva mānase kurvatīdaṃ śaṃkare ca tapasvini ।। tadbabhūva caturvaktraṃ pūrveṇa saha pañcamam ।। 85 ।। ekaikavaktraṃ śuśubhe locanaiśca tribhistribhiḥ। babhūva tena tannāma pañcavaktrastrilocanaḥ ।। 86 ।। stavanādadhikaprītiḥ śivasya darśane mama ।। tenādhikāni tasyaivaṃ babhūvurlocanāni ca।। ।। 87 ।। cakṣūṃṣi guṇarūpāṇi tasya brahmasvarūpiṇaḥ ।। sattvaṃ rajastama iti tasya hetuṃ niśāmaya ।। 88 ।। sattvāṃśena dṛśā śaṃbhuḥ paśyanpāti ca sāttvikān ।। rājasena rājasikāṃstāmasena ca tāmasān ।। 89 ।। cakṣuṣastāmasātpaścāllalāṭasthāddharasya ca ।। saṃhārakāle saṃharturagnirāvirbhavetkrudhā ।। 90 ।। koṭitālapramāṇaśca sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ ।। lelihāno dīrghaśikhastrailokyaṃ dagdhumīśvaraḥ ।।91।। vibhūtigātraḥ sa vibhuḥ satīsaṃskārabhasmanā ।। dhatte tasyā asthimālāṃ premabhāvena bhasma ca ।। 92 ।। svātmārāmo yadyapīśastathā'pi pūrṇamabdakam ।। satīśavaṃ gṛhītvā ca bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ ruroda ha ।। 93 ।। pratyaṅgaṃ cāpi tasyāśca papāta yatra yatra ha ।। siddhapīṭhastatra tatra babhūva mantrasiddhikṛt ।। 94 ।। tadā śavāvaśeṣaṃ ca kṛtvā vakṣasi śaṃkaraḥ ।। papāta mūrcchito bhūtvā siddhikṣetre ca rādhike ।।95।। tadā gatvā maheśaṃ taṃ kṛtvā kroḍe prabodhya ca ।। adadāṃ divyatattvaṃ ca tasmai śokaharaṃ param।।96।। tadā śivaśca saṃtuṣṭaḥ svaṃ lokaṃ ca jagāma ha ।। mūrtyantareṇa kālena tāṃ saṃprāpa priyāṃ satīm ।। 97 ।। divyasragdhāriyogena necchā nitye pare vibhoḥ ।। jaṭāṃ tapasyākālīnāṃ dhatte'dyāpi vivekataḥ ।।98।। na cecchā keśasaṃskāre svāṅgaveṣeṇa yoginaḥ ।। samatā candane paṅke loṣṭe ratne maṇīśvare।।99।। garuḍadveṣiṇo nāgāḥ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।। bibharti kṛpayā svāṅge tāneva śaraṇāgatān।। 100।। vāhanaṃ vṛṣarūpo'hamanyastaṃ voḍhumakṣamaḥ ।। tripurasya vadhe pūrvaṃ matkalāṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।।1।। pārijātādikaṃ puṣpasugandhi candanādikam।। mayi saṃnyasya teṣvevaṃ prītirnāsti kadācana।।2।। dhattūre tatsadā prītirbilvapatrānulepane ।। gandhahīne sugandhe ca yogīṣṭe vyāghracarmaṇi ।।3।। divyaloke divyatalpe janatāyāṃ na tanmanaḥ।। śmaśāne'tīvarahasi dhyāyate māmaharniśam।।4।। ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ samaṃ ca manyate śivaḥ।। mamānirvacanīye'tra rūpe tanmagnamānasam।।5।। brahmaṇaḥ patanenāpi śūlapāṇeḥ kṣaṇo bhavet ।। tasyāyuṣaḥ pramāṇaṃ ca nāhaṃ jānāmi kā śrutiḥ।।6।। jñānaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaḥ śūlaṃ dhatte mattejasā samam ।। vinā mayā na kaścittaṃ śaṃkaraṃ jetumīśvaraḥ ।। 7 ।। śaṃkaraḥ paramātmā me prāṇebhyo'pi paraḥ śivaḥ।। tryambake manmanaḥ śaśvanna priyo me bhavātparaḥ ।। 8 ।। brahmāṇḍanikaraṃ channaṃ mayā manmāyayā sadā ।। sa kampati haraṃ śaśvanna ca taṃ mohituṃ kṣamaḥ ।।9।। na saṃvasāmi goloke vaikuṇṭhe tava vakṣasi ।। sadā śivasya hṛdaye nibaddhaḥ premapāśataḥ ।। 110।। svarasiddhaṃ sutānena pañcavaktreṇa śaṃkaraḥ ।। śaśvadgāyati madgāthāṃ tenāhaṃ tatsamīpataḥ ।।11।। sraṣṭuṃ śakto hi naṣṭuṃ ca bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā'pi yaḥ।। brahmāṇḍanikaraṃ yogānna yogī śaṃkarātparaḥ ।।12।। divyajñānena yaḥ sraṣṭuṃ naṣṭuṃ bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā ।। mṛtyuṃ kālādikaṃ bhakto na jñānī śaṃkarātparaḥ ।। 13।। mama bhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca muktiṃ ca sarvasaṃpadaḥ।। sarvasiddhiṃ dātumīśo na dātā śaṃkarātparaḥ ।।14।। pañcavaktreṇa mannāma yo hi gāyatyaharniśam ।। madrūpaṃ dhyāyate śaśvanna bhaktaḥ śaṃkarātparaḥ ।। 15 ।। ahaṃ sudarśanaṃ śaṃbhustejasā ca vayaṃ samāḥ ।। brahmā sraṣṭā ca yogena nāsmābhistejasā samaḥ ।।16।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarve śaṃkarasya yaśo'malam ।। tathā'pyasya darpabhaṅgaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।117।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇakṛtaśaṃkarapraśaṃsā nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।36।।
<4.37> śrīrādhikovāca ।। evaṃbhūtasya ca vibhoḥ sarveśasya mahātmanaḥ ।। na śastaṃ kathamucchiṣṭaṃ brūhi saṃdehabhañjana ।। 1 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। śṛṇu devi pravakṣye'hamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। pāpendhanānāṃ dahane jvaladāgniśikhopamam ।।2।। sanatkumāro vaikuṇṭhamekadā ca jagāma ha ।। dadarśa bhuktavantaṃ ca nāthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dvijaḥ ।।3।। tuṣṭāva gūḍhaiḥ stotraiśca praṇamya bhaktito mudā ।। avaśeṣaṃ dadau tasmai saṃtuṣṭo bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 4 ।। prāptamātreṇa tatraiva bhuktaṃ tenaiva kiṃcana।। kiṃcidrarakṣa baṃdhūnāṃ bhakṣaṇāya ca durlabham ।।5।। siddhāśrame ca yaddattaṃ gurave śūlapāṇine ।। bhaktyudrekācca tatsarvaṃ bhuktaṃ ca prāptimātrataḥ।।6।। bhuktvā sudurlabhaṃ vastu nanarta premavihvalaḥ ।। pulakāṅkitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro mudā'nvitaḥ ।।7।। gāyanmama guṇānbhaktyā sukaṇṭhaḥ paṃcavaktrataḥ ।। rāgabhedaikatānena tālamānena suṃdaram ।। 8 ।। papāta ḍamarurhastācchṛṅgaṃ ca vyāghracarma ca ।। svayaṃ nipatya paścācca rudanmūrcchāmavāpa ha ।। 9 ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ tadrūpaṃ dhyātvaikamānamaḥ ।। sahasradalamadhyasthaṃ māṃ paśyanhṛtsaroruhe ।। 10 ।। etasminnantare devī durgā durgārtināśinī ।। mudā''jagāma śīghraṃ tatprasannavadanekṣaṇā ।। 11 ।। rudantaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nipatantaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ।। prahasya vārtāṃ papraccha kumāraṃ śūlapāṇinaḥ ।। 12 ।। sarvaṃ tāṃ kathayāmāsa kumāraḥ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। śrutvā cukopa sā devī śivaṃ prasphuritādharā ।। ।। 13 ।। tāṃ śaptumudyatāṃ devīmutthāya ca trilocanaḥ ।। bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ tuṣṭāva saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। 14 ।। śrutvā manoharaṃ stotraṃ na śaśāpa śivaṃ śivā ।। duṣṭaṃ cakre taducchiṣṭamabhakṣyaṃ viduṣāmapi ।। 15 ।। na lokānāṃ prabhāvaśca tapaḥsaubhāgyatejasām ।। brahmāṇḍe sarvasaṃhartā cakaṃpe pārvatībhaye ।। 16 ।। uvāca taṃ jaganmātā nītisāraṃ paraṃ vacaḥ ।। gaṇaprasūḥ sakopā ca raktapaṅkajalocanā ।। 17 ।। aho tapaḥprabhāvaśca tejasaśca na jīvinām ।। sa brahmāṇḍasya saṃhartā cakampe śailakanyakā ।। 18 ।। pārvatyuvāca।। tvaṃ poṣṭā jagatāṃ pātā mamaiva ca viśeṣataḥ ।। vaktā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ janakaśca svayaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 19 ।। muktipradātā bhaktānāṃ dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām ।। tvaṃ cetkaroṣi durnītiṃ ko vā dharmaṃ ca pāti vai ।। 20।। sadā te paripālyā'haṃ poṣyā bhaktyā ca kiṃkarī ।। vaṃcitā karmadoṣeṇa haranirmālyabhakṣaṇe ।। 21 ।। kiṃcicchuddhaṃ hiraṇyena kiṃcidvastu ca vāyunā ।। kiṃcitprakṣālanenaiva sarvaṃ viṣṇornivedanāt ।। 22 ।। viṣṇorniveditānnena yaṣṭavyāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। pitaro'tithayaścaivamiti vedeṣu niścitam ।। 23 ।। anivedyamabhakṣyaṃ ca naivedyamudare hareḥ ।। tyaktvā karoti yo bhaktyā pārṣadapravaro bhavet ।। 24 ।। amṛtaṃ sarvavastūnāmiṣṭasāraṃ sudurlabham ।। viṣṇorniveditānnasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 25 ।। hantyakālikamṛtyuṃ tadamṛtaṃ mūḍharaṃjanam ।। naivedyaṃ ca harereva haritulyaṃ karotyaho ।। 26 ।। yadṛcchayā taṃ naivedyaṃ yo bhuṅkte sādhusaṃgataḥ ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ prāpnoti tapasaḥ phalam ।। 27 ।। yo nivedya hariṃ bhuṅkte bhaktyā bhaktaśca nityaśaḥ।। kiṃ vā tapasyāṃ kartā ca sa harestejasā samaḥ ।।28।। śrutaṃ purā tvanmukhataḥ puṣkare munisaṃsadi ।। ahaṃ vedavidhātā na kimahaṃ vaktumīśvarī ।। ।। 29 ।। suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā mayā labdhastvamīśvaraḥ ।। tvayā viṣṇoḥ prasādena vaṃcitā'haṃ kathaṃ prabho ।। 30 ।। yato na dattaṃ naivadyaṃ viṣṇormahyaṃ tvayā'dhunā।। ato matto gṛhāṇaitatphalameva maheśvara ।। 31 ।। adyaprabhṛti ye lokā naivedyaṃ bhuñjate tava ।। te janmaikaṃ sārameyā bhaviṣyantyeva bhārate ।।32।। ityuktvā pārvatī mātā ruroda purato vibhoḥ ।। dṛṣṭiḥ papāta tatkaṇṭhe nīlakaṇṭho babhūva ha ।।33।। tadā śivaḥ śivāṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā vakṣasi sādaram ।। tanmānabhaṅgaṃ stotreṇa vinayena cakāra ha ।। 34 ।। kareṇa cakṣuṣornīraṃ saṃmṛjya ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। bodhayāmāsa vividhairnītivākyairmanoharaiḥ ।। 35 ।। parituṣṭā ca sā devī bhartāraṃ samuvāca ha ।। kalevaraṃ ca tyakṣyāmi naivedyena vinā hareḥ ।। 36 ।। bibharti dehaṃ satataṃ tava saubhāgyavarddhanam ।। kathaṃ vahāmi saubhāgyarahitaṃ ca kalevaram ।। 37 ।। apūrvaṃ tava naivedyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam ।। kṛtaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca yattasmātpaśya dehaṃ tyajāmi ca ।। 38 ।। liṅgopari ca yaddattaṃ tadevāgrāhyamīśvara ।। supavitraṃ bhavettasya viṣṇornaivedyamiśritam ।। 39 ।। ityevamuktvā sā devī dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā ।। trasto harastatpurataḥ stutvā ca svīcakāra ha ।। 40 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। sthirā bhava mahādevi caṇḍike jagadaṃbike ।। mamāparādhamakhilaṃ kṣantumarhasi sundari ।। ।। 41 ।। māṃ bhṛtyaṃ tapasā krītaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ bījabhūte sanātani ।। 42 ।। aho golokanāthastha guṇātītasya nirguṇe ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpe ca sadaiva sahacāriṇi ।। 43 ।। sākāre ca nirākāre nitye svecchāmaye priye ।। kṛpayā tadvibhoreva mama vakṣasi sāṃpratam ।। 44 ।। sarvabījasvarūpe ca mahāmāye manohare ।। sarvasiddhiprade devi muktide kṛṣṇabhaktide ।। 45> icchaiva śrīhareḥ sākṣānnāhaṃ dātumapi kṣamaḥ ।। tadā dehaṃ parityajya nirguṇaṃ vraja nirguṇe ।। 46 ।। ityevamuktvā puratastasthau ca candraśekharaḥ ।। babhūva suprasannā sā praṇanāma haraṃ param ।। 47 ।। ityevaṃ pārvatīstotraṃ śaṅkareṇa kṛtaṃ purā ।। yaḥ paṭhedvipadā grastaḥ sa bhayādeva mucyate।।48।। mitrabhedo bhaved dūraṃ tatsaṃmprītirbhavetpurā ।। pārvatī parituṣṭā ca na tyajettasya mandiram ।। 49 ।। ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। śrutvā pratijñāṃ nāthasya parituṣṭā babhūva sā ।। jagāma svarṇadīṃ tūrṇaṃ snānārthaṃ śaṃkarājñayā ।। 50 ।। snātvā saṃpūjya bhaktyā ca suramiṣṭaṃ ca nirguṇam ।। cakāra prastutaṃ śīghraṃ miṣṭānnaṃ vyañjanāni ca ।। 51 ।। śivaḥ snātvā ca saṃpūjya brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā māmeva hṛdayasthitam ।। 52 ।। gatvā sarvamahaṃ bhuktvā tasmai dattvā'bhivāñchitam ।। naivedyaṃ pārvatī lebhe tava mūlaṃ samāgatā ।। 53 ।। bhuktvā'vaśeṣaṃ sā devī saha bhartrā mudā'nvitā ।। tuṣṭāva śaṅkaraṃ bhaktyā praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ ।। 54 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ sureśvari ।। abhiśaptaṃ śaṅkarasya nirmālyaṃ yena hetunā ।। 55 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde haranirmālyaśāpaprasaṅgo nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।37 ।।
<4.38> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। darpabhaṅgaḥ śruto devi śaṅkarasya jagadguroḥ ।। adhunā śrūyatāṃ matto durgādarpavimocanam ।। 1 ।। tejasā sarvadevānāmāvirbhūya jagatprasūḥ ।। dadhāra kāminīrūpaṃ kamanīyaṃ manoharam ।।2 ।। nihatya dānavendrāṃśca rarakṣa devatākulam ।। lebhe janma tato devī jaṭhare dakṣayoṣitaḥ ।। 3 ।। pinākapāṇiṃ jagrāha sā devī surasādhanam ।। śaśvatparamabhaktyā ca siṣeve svāminaṃ satī ।। 4 ।। dakṣeṇa sārddhaṃ devena babhūva śivaśatrutā ।। nirarthakaṃ daivayogātpurā vai surasaṃsadi ।। 5 ।। dakṣaścakāra yajñaṃ ca tata āgatya kopataḥ ।। sarvānvijñāpayāmāsa tatraiva śaṃkaraṃ vinā ।। 6 ।। sastrīkā devatāḥ sarvā ājagmurdakṣamandiram ।। sagaṇaḥ śaṅkaraḥ kopānnājagāmābhimānataḥ ।। 7 ।। satī patiṃ ca mohena bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ ।। na taṃ cālayituṃ śaktā babhūva cañcalā svayam ।। 8 ।। ājagāma piturgehaṃ darpāttasya vinā''jñayā ।। tasya śāpena tasyāśca darpabhaṅgo babhūva ha ।।9।। na hi saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ cakre vāṅmātreṇa pitā ca tām ।। śrutvā ca nindāṃ bhartuśca dehaṃ tatyāja mānataḥ ।। 10 ।। evaṃ priye nigaditaṃ satīdarpavimocanam ।। tasyā janmāntaraṃ nityaṃ darpabhaṅgaśca śrūyatām ।। 11 ।। lebhe janma satī śīghraṃ jaṭhare śailayoṣitaḥ ।। śivastasyāścitābhasma cāsthi jagrāha bhaktitaḥ ।। 12 ।। cakāra mālāmasthnāṃ ca bhasmanā tanulepanam ।। smāraṃsmāraṃ satīṃ premṇā bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ।। 13 ।। suṣāva menā tāṃ devīmatīva sumanoharām ।। sṛṣṭau vidhātustasyāśca hyupamā nāsti kutra ca ।। 14 ।। guṇaprasūrguṇānsarvānsarvarūpānbibhartti sā ।। sarvāśca devapatnyastatkalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 15 ।। babhūva varddhamānā sā śukle candrakalā yathā ।। atīva yauvanasthā ca śailagehe dinedine ।। 16 ।। babhūvākāśavāṇī ca tāṃ saṃbodhya jagatprasūm ।। śive śivaṃ ca tapasā kaṭhoreṇa labheti ca ।।17।। vineśvaraṃ na tapasā prāptā hi garbhasambhavam ।। prahasya tasthau śrutveti sā ca yauvanagarvitā ।।18।। mama janmāntarīyaṃ ca bhasmāsthi ca bibharti yaḥ ।। sa māṃ prauḍhāṃ kathaṃ dṛṣṭvā na gṛhṇātyatra janmani ।।19।। yo vidagdhaśca brahmāṇḍaṃ babhrāma mama śokataḥ ।। sa kathaṃ māṃ na gṛhṇāti dṛṣṭvā paramasundarīm ।। 20 ।। dakṣayajñaṃ yo babhañja mama hetoḥ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। sa kathaṃ māṃ na gṛhṇāti patnīṃ janmanijanmani ।। 21 ।। yā yasya patnī yo yasyā bhartā prāktanataḥ purā ।। kuto viśve tayorbhedo niṣeko nānyathā bhavet ।। 22 ।। sarvarūpaguṇādhāraṃ matvā svamatimānataḥ ।। na cakāra tapaḥ sādhvī na vijñāya tamīśvaram ।। 23 ।। sundarīṣu ca sarvāsu matto nāstyeva sundarī ।। hṛdīti matvā garveṇa na cakāra tapaḥ śivā ।। 24 ।। rūpayauvanaveṣāṇāṃ pumāngrāhī svayoṣitām ।। śivo macchrutimātreṇa māṃ gṛhṇāti vinā tapaḥ ।। 29 ।। hṛdīti matvā girijā tasthau himagirergṛhe ।। śaśvatsahacarīmadhye krīḍonmattā divāniśam ।। 26 ।। etasminnantare tūrṇaṃ dūtaḥ śailendrasaṃsadi ।। uvācāgatya madhuraṃ tatpuraḥ saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। 27 ।। dūta uvāca ।। uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha śailendra gacchākṣayavaṭāntikam ।। ājagāma mahādevaḥ sagaṇo vṛṣavāhanaḥ ।। 28 ।। madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। pūjanaṃ kuru śailendraṃ devendraṃ tamatīndriyam ।। 29 ।। siddhisvarūpaṃ siddheśaṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum ।। mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālakālaṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ।। 30 ।। paramātmasvarūpaṃ ca saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ vibhum ।। bhaktadhyānārthamamalaṃ dadhānaṃ dehamīśvaram ।। ।।31।। śailo dūtavacaḥ śrutvā samuttasthau mudā'nvitaḥ ।। madhuparkādikaṃ nītvā jagāma śaṅkarāntikam ।। 32 ।। devī dūtavacaḥ śrutvā prasannavadanekṣaṇā ।। hṛdīti mene maddhetorājagāma maheśvaraḥ ।। 33 ।। cakāra veṣamatulaṃ dadhāra vastramuttamam।। ratnendrasārālaṃkārānratnamālāṃ manoharām ।। 34 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāṃ candanasaṃyutām ।। cakāra śaṅkarārthaṃ ca matvā mālāṃ manoharām।।35।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthā sā dadarśa darpaṇe mukham ।। kastūrībindunā sārddhaṃ sindūrabindubhūṣitam ।। 36।। ārakta netrayugalaṃ nirmalāñjanasaṃyutam।। śaranmadhyāhnamamalaṃ yathālipaṃktiveṣṭitam।।37।। sukomalauṣṭhayugulaṃ tāmbūlarāgasaṃyutam।। atīva sundaraṃ ramyapakvabiṃbaphalaṃ yathā।।38।। ratnakuṃḍaladīptyā ca gaṃḍasthalavirājitam ।। sūryodayena jvalitaṃ sumeruśikharaṃ yathā ।।39।। atyanirvacanīyaṃ ca dantapaṃktimanoharam ।। yathā muktāsamūhaṃ ca sajalaṃ jaladāgame।। 40।। gajamuktāsamāyuktaṃ sucārunāsikottamam ।। suśobhitaṃ yathā meruṃ svarṇadījaladhārayā।।41 ।। mālatīmālyasaṃyuktakabarībhārasaṃyutam।। bakapaṃktisuśobhāḍhyaṃ navīnaṃ jaladaṃ yathā ।। 42 ।। taptakāñcana varṇābhaṃ cāruvakṣaḥsthalojjvalam ।। ratnendrasārahārāktaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ।।43।। cārucampakavarṇābhaṃ stanayugmaṃ manoharam ।। badarīphalatulyaṃ ca cārupatrakaśobhitam ।।44।। madhyaṃ manoharaṃ kṣīṇaṃ nimnanābhisthalojjvalam।। atīva sundaraṃ ramyamudaraṃ vartulākṛti ।। 45 ।। rambhāstaṃbhaviniṃdyaikamūruyugmaṃ manoharam ।। kāmālayaṃ sukaṭhinaṃ nigūḍhamaṃśukena ca।। 46 ।। sthalapadmaprabhāmuṣṭapadayugmaṃ manoharam।। ratnapāśakasaṃyuktaṃ siddhālaktakabhūṣitam ।। 47 ।। dadhataṃ ratnamañjīraṃ rājahaṃsānukāri ca।। ratnendrasārābharaṇaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 48 ।। karaṃ sukomalataraṃ sundaraṃ kanakaprabham ।। ratnakaṅkaṇakeyūraśaṃkhabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।।49।। bibhratsadratnamukuraṃ līlākamalamujjvalam।। ratnāṅgulīyamatulaṃ dadhataṃ sumanoharam ।। 50 ।। dṛṣṭvā svarūpamatulaṃ dadhyau śaṅkaramīśvaram ।। viśiṣya manasā śaśvadbhartuścaraṇapaṅkajam ।। 51 ।। pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bandhuṃ sādhvīvargaṃ sahodaram ।। antare sā na sasmāra kiṃcideva śivaṃ vinā ।।52।। atha śaileśvarastatra dadarśa candraśekharam ।। svarṇadīpulinādramyādutpatantaṃ ca sasmitam ।। 53 ।। dadhataṃ saṃskṛtāṃ mālāṃ japantaṃ mama nāmakam ।। taptasvarṇaprabhājuṣṭajaṭārāśi virājitam ।। 54 ।। vṛṣabhasthaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ sarvabhūṣaṇarājitam ।। nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca sarpabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 55 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ vyāghracarmadharaṃ param ।। vibhūtibhūṣitāṅgaṃ tamasthimālaṃ digambaram ।।56।। pañcavaktraṃ trinayanaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham ।। dadarśa rudrānparito jvalato brahmatejasā ।। 57 ।। śivavāme mahākālaṃ dakṣiṇe nandikeśvaram ।। bhūtapretapiśācāṃśca kūṣmāṇḍānbrahmarākṣasān ।।58।। vetālānkṣetrapālāṃśca bhairavānbhīmavikramān ।। sanakaṃ ca sanandaṃ ca kumāraṃ ca sanātanam ।। 59 ।। jaigīṣavyaṃ devalaṃ ca kāṇādaṃ gautamaṃ tathā ।। pippalādaṃ kaṇakhanaṃ voḍhuṃ pañcaśikhaṃ kaṭham ।। 60 ।। jājaliṃ karakhaṃ karṇaṃ lomaśaṃ sūryavarcasam ।। kātyāyanaṃ pāṇiniṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ durvāsasaṃ tataḥ ।। 61 ।। śātātapaṃ pāribhadramaṣṭāvakraṃ marudbhavam ।। etānpurogamānnatvā praṇanāma śivaṃ giriḥ ।। 62 ।। mūrdhnā nipatya bhūmau sa daṇḍavatsaṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। atho analpayā bhaktyā dhṛtvā taccaraṇāmbujam ।। nanāma cāśrunetraḥ sa pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ ।। 63 ।। dharmadattena stotreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। tuṣṭe brāhme dine'tīte puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi ।। 64 ।। himālaya uvāca ।। tvaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭikartā ca tvaṃ viṣṇuḥ paripālakaḥ ।।65।। tvaṃ śivaḥ śivado'nantaḥ sarvasaṃhārakārakaḥ ।। tvamīśvaro guṇātīto jyotīrūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 66 ।। prakṛtaḥ prakṛtīśaśca prākṛtaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। nānārūpavidhātā tvaṃ bhaktānāṃ dhyānahetave ।। yeṣu rūpeṣu yatprītistattadrūpaṃ bibharṣi ca ।।67।। sūryastvaṃ sṛṣṭijanaka ādhāraḥ sarvatejasām ।। somastvaṃ sasyapātā ca satataṃ śītaraśminā।।68।। vāyustvaṃ varuṇastvaṃ ca tvamagniḥ sarvadāhakaḥ ।। indrastvaṃ devarājaśca kālo mṛtyuryamastathā ।। ।।69।। mṛtyuñjayo mṛtyumṛtyuḥ kālakālo yamāntakaḥ ।। 70 ।। vedastvaṃ vedakartā ca vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ।। viduṣāṃ janakastvaṃ ca vidvāṃśca viduṣāṃ guruḥ ।।71।। mantrastvaṃ hi japastvaṃ hi tapastvaṃ tatphalapradaḥ ।। vāk tvaṃ vāgadhidevī tvaṃ tatkartā tadguruḥ svayam ।।72।। aho sarasvatībījaṃ kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ ।। ityevamuktvā śailendrastasthau dhṛtvā padāmbujam ।।73।। tatrovāsa tamābodhya cāvaruhya vṛṣācchivaḥ ।। stotrametanmahāpuṇyaṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। 74 ।। mucyate sarvapāpebhyo bhayebhyaśca bhavārṇave ।। aputro labhate putraṃ māsamekaṃ paṭhedyadi ।।75।। bhāryāhīno labhedbhāryāṃ suśīlāṃ sumanoharām।। cirakālagataṃ vastu labhate sahasā dhruvam ।। 76 ।। rājyabhraṣṭo labhedrājyaṃ śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ ।। kārāgāre śmaśāne ca śatrugraste'tisaṃkaṭe।।77।। gabhīre'tijalākīrṇe bhagnapote viṣādane ।। raṇamadhye mahābhīte hiṃsrajantusamanvite ।। 78 ।। sarvato mucyate stutvā śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ ।। 79 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde 'ṣṭatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 38 ।।
<4.39> ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। iti stutvā himagirirvasataḥ śaṅkarasya ca ।। uvāsa purato dūre labdhājñaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ ।। 1 ।। madhuparkādikaṃ tasmai pradadau bhaktipūrvakam ।। munīnsaṃpūjayāmāsa tataḥ śaṅkarapārṣadān ।। 2 ।। tadā tatra samāgatya menakā strīgaṇaiḥ saha ।। dadarśa vaṭamūlasthaṃ śaṅkaraṃ candraśekharam ।। 3 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ vasantaṃ vyāghracarmaṇi ।। madhye munigaṇānāṃ ca jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।।4।। yathā''kāśe tārakāṇāṃ dvijarājaṃ virājitam ।। paramāhlādakaṃ rūpaṃ kaṃdarpakoṭisannibham ।।5।। vihāya vārddhakāvasthāṃ dadhataṃ navayauvanam ।। atīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ cittacoraṃ ca yoṣitām ।। 6 ।। kāmaṃ kāmāturāṇāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sutaṃ yathā ।। vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ śaivānāṃ ca sadāśivam ।। 7 ।। śaktisvarūpaṃ śāktānāṃ saurāṇāṃ sūryarūpiṇam ।। kālasvarūpaṃ duṣṭānāṃ śiṣṭānāṃ paripālakam।।8।। kālakālasamaṃ mṛtyormṛtyumṛtyu bhayānakam ।। vyāghracarma cāruvastraṃ babhūva bhasma caṃdanam।।9।। sarpāḥ suṃdaramālyāni kastūrī yā viṣaprabhā ।। jaṭāsu lalitā cūḍā caṃdrastvalikacaṃdanam ।। 10 ।। sucārvī mālatīmālā gaṃgādhārā manoharā ।। asthimālā ratnamālā dhattūraṃ cārucaṃpakam ।।11।। ekībhūtaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ netrayugmābjaśobhitam ।। śaratpārvaṇacaṃdrābhaṃ pracchādya dīptamuttamam।। 12 ।। baṃdhujīvaviniṃdyaikamoṣṭhādharamanoharam ।। śvetaścandro vṛṣeṃdraśca bhūtādyā nartakā iva ।।13।। sadyo vyatikramaṃ sarvaṃ maheśasya maheśvari ।। dṛṣṭvaivaṃ śivarūpaṃ ca menā tuṣṭā babhūva ha ।।14।। kāścinnimeṣarahitāḥ kāmena pulakāṃcitāḥ ।। atikāmāturāḥ satyaḥ prāpurmūrcchāṃ ca kāścana ।। ।। 19 ।। kāścidviniṃdya kāṃtāṃśca praśaśaṃsurmaheśvaram ।। manorathena manasā samāśliṣyaṃti kāścana ।। 16 ।। kācinmānasikaṃ kāmātkurvantī cumbanaṃ mudā ।। dhruvaṃ kāmaṃ kariṣyāmo vayaṃ ca kāmasāgare ।। 17 ।। asmākameva bhartā cetparatraiva yaśo bhavet ।। ihaivaṃ kiṃ kariṣyāmo vayaṃ kāṃtairatairalam ।। 18 ।। dṛṣṭvā tamevaṃ suciramiti jalpaṃti kāścana ।। kāściddṛṣṭvā śivaṃ kiṃcinmukhamācchādya vāsasā ।। 19 ।। sasmitā vakranayanāḥ paśyaṃtyeva punaḥpunaḥ ।। vayaṃ gṛhaṃ na yāsyāmo yāsyāmaḥ śivasannidhim ।। 20 ।। śaratsudhāṃśuvadanaṃ drakṣyāmo'harniśaṃ mudā ।। saṃsāraṃ na kariṣyāmaḥ praviśāmo hutāśanam ।।21 ।। bhavitā naḥ śivaḥ svāmītyevaṃ jalpaṃti kāścana ।। aho puṇyavatī durgā ślāghyate janma bhārate ।। 22 ।। yasyā ayaṃ śivaḥ svāmītyevaṃ jalpaṃti kāścana ।। mudā menā śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhaṃ tābhirjagāma ha ।। 23 ।। śivaṃ saṃpūjya śaileṃdraḥ praṇamya svagṛhaṃ yayau ।। kṛtvā'numānaṃ rahasi girīśo menayā saha ।। 24 ।। durgāṃ prasthāpayāmāsa śivāya śivasannidhim ।। pārvatī sakhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ veṣaṃ kṛtvā manoharam ।। 25 ।। bhāvānuraktā harṣeṇa jagāma śivasaṃnidhim ।। dṛṣṭvā śivā śivaṃ śāṃtaṃ prasannavadanekṣaṇam ।। 26 ।। saptapradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā sasmitā praṇanāma sā ।। ananyabhāvaṃ guṇinamaparaṃ jñānināṃ varam ।। 27 ।। suṃdaraṃ labha bhartāraṃ sundarītyāśiṣaṃ dadau ।। bhavitā tava saubhāgyaṃ śubhe svāmini saṃtatam ।। 28।। putraste bhavitā sādhvi nārāyaṇasamo guṇaiḥ ।। bhavitā te parā pūjā trailokye jagadambike ।।29।। brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu sarveṣāṃ ca parā bhava ।। saptapradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā yato bhaktyā tvayā natam ।। 30।। saptajanmani tuṣṭo'haṃ tatphalaṃ labha sundari ।। tīrthe kānte'bhīṣṭadeve gurau mantre tathauṣadhe ।। 31 ।। āsthā ca yādṛśī yāsāṃ siddhistāsāṃ ca tādṛśī ।। ityuktvā śaṅkarastūrṇaṃ brahmajyotiḥ paraṃ ca mām ।। 32 ।। dadhyau yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā yogīśo vyāghracarmaṇi ।। prakṣālya caraṇau devī papau taccaraṇodakam ।। 33 ।। cakāra mārjanaṃ bhaktyā vahniśaucena vāsasā ।। ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ viśvakarmādinirmitam ।।34।। apūrvaṃ kāṃsyapātrasthaṃ naivedyaṃ pradadau kila ।। arghyaṃ maṃdākinītoya saṃyuktaṃ caraṇe dadau ।।35।। sugandhicandanaṃ cāru kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ।। pradadau mālatīmālāṃ gale garalasundare ।।36।। bhaktyā pūjāṃ cakārātha puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca tuṣṭaye ।। pīyūṣaṃ svarṇapātrasthaṃ pradadau madhuraṃ madhu ।। 37 ।। ratnapradīpaśatakaṃ samantāddhūpamuttamam ।। trailokyadurlabhaṃ vastraṃ svarṇayajñopavītakam ।। 38 ।। sugandhiśītatoyaṃ ca pānārthaṃ pārvatī dadau ।। atīva sundaraṃ ramyaṃ ratnasārendrabhūṣaṇam।।39।। durlabhāṃ kāmadhenuṃ ca svarṇaśṛṅgasamanvitām ।। snānīyaṃ tīrthatoyaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ ca manoharam ।। 40 ।। dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ ।। saṃpūjya śūlinaṃ bhaktyā yayau nityaṃ piturgṛham ।।41।। śuśrāvāpsarasāṃ vaktrāddevīmindro maheśvaraḥ ।। śrutvā vārtāṃ śunāsīro nanarta harṣasaṃyutaḥ ।। 42 ।। dūtadvārā kāmadevamānināya tvarānvitaḥ ।। indrājñayā kāmadevaḥ prajagāmāmarāvatīm ।। 43 ।। tūrṇaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa taṃ ca yatra śivaḥ śivā ।। pañcasāyakasaṃyukto jagāma pañcasāyakaḥ ।।44।। prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānyatra śaktiyutaḥ śivaḥ।। gatvā dadarśa madanaḥ śivāyuktaṃ śivaṃ vibhum।।45।। śāntaṃ trailokyakāntaṃ ca prasannavadanekṣaṇam।। kāmaḥ sthito'ntarikṣe ca dhṛtvā ca saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। 46 ।। cikṣepāstraṃ durnivāryamamoghaṃ śaṃkare mudā ।। babhūvāmoghamastraṃ ca moghaṃ tatparamātmani।।47।। ākāśa iva nirlipte nirlipte paramātmani ।। moghībhūte ca śastre ca bhayamāpa ca manmathaḥ ।। 48 ।। cakampe purataḥ sthitvā dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃjayaṃ vibhum ।। sasmāra tridaśānkāmaḥ śakrādīnbhayavihvalaḥ ।।।49।।। āyayurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ śaṃbhukopena vepitāḥ।। cakruḥ stutiṃ ca stotreṇa śaṃkaraṃ tridaśeśvaram ।। 50।। kopāgnimudgirantaṃ taṃ kapālalocanādaho ।। stutiṃ kurvatsu deveṣu sa vahniḥ śaṃbhusaṃbhavaḥ।।51।। jajvālordhvaśikho dīptaḥ pralayāgniśikhopamaḥ ।। utpatya gagane ghūrṇannipatya dharaṇītale ।। bhrāmaṃbhrāmaṃ ca paritaḥ papāta madanopari ।। 52 ।। babhūva bhasmasātkāmaḥ kṣaṇena harakopataḥ।। viṣaṇṇā devatāḥ sarvā natavaktrā ca pārvatī ।।53।। vilalāpa bahutaraṃ harasya purato ratiḥ ।। tuṣṭuvurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ kampitāścandraśekharam ।। 54 ।। ratimūcuḥ surāḥ sarve ruruduśca muhurmuhuḥ ।। kiṃcidbhasma gṛhītvā ca rakṣa mātarbhayaṃ tyaja ।।55।। vayaṃ taṃ jīvayiṣyāmo labhiṣyasi priyaṃ punaḥ ।। harakopāpanayane suprasanne dine tathā ।।56।। dṛṣṭvā ratervilāpaṃ ca mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa pārvatī ।। atīndriyaṃ guṇātītaṃ tuṣṭāva candraśekharam।।57।। rudantīṃ pārvatīṃ tyaktvā svasthānaṃ prayayau śivaḥ।। sadyo babhūva tatraiva pārvatīdarpamokṣaṇam।।58।। rūpayauvanayorgarvaṃ tatyāja śailakanyakā ।। mukhaṃ darśayituṃ lajjā tadbabhūva sakhīgaṇe ।। 59 ।। surāśca ratimāśvāsya sarve jagmuḥ svamandiram ।। praṇamya daṇḍavadrudraṃ śokādudvignamānasāḥ ।। 60।। stutvā ruditvā śokena bhayena kāmakāminī ।। koparaktekṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ rādhike svālayaṃ yayau ।। 61 ।। na jagāma piturgehaṃ pārvatī sā tu lajjayā ।। svālibhirvāryamāṇā'pi jagāma tapase vanam ।। 62 ।। prajagmuḥ sahacāriṇyastatpaścācchokavihvalāḥ ।। mātṛbhirvāryamāṇā sā svarṇadītīrajaṃ vanam ।।63।। suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā sā saṃprāpa trilocanam ।। ratiḥ saṃprāpa madanaṃ śaṃkarasya vareṇa ca ।। 64 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ pārvatīdarpamokṣaṇam ।। nigūḍhacaritaṃ rādhe kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 65 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 39 ।।
<4.40> śrīrādhikovāca ।। aho vicitraṃ caritamapūrvaṃ kiṃ śrutaṃ vibho ।। sundaraṃ śrutipīyūṣaṃ nigūḍhaṃ jñānakāraṇam ।। 1 ।। na viśeṣaṃ samāsaṃ ca śrutaṃ na vyāsamīpsitam ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi vistīrṇaṃ kathaya prabho ।। 2 ।। kiṃ kiṃ tapaḥ kaṭhoraṃ ca cakāra pārvatī svayam ।। kaṃ kaṃ varaṃ vā saṃprāpya kathamāpa maheśvaram ।।3।। ratiḥ kena prakāreṇa jīvayāmāsa manmatham ।। pārvatīśivayoḥ kṛṣṇa vivāhaṃ varṇaya prabho ।। 4 ।। tayo rahasi saṃbhogaṃ pāpināṃ pāpamocanam ।। kathyatāṃ karuṇāsindho duḥkhināṃ duḥkhamocanam।।5।। dampatīvirahoktiśca karṇajvālā ca yoṣitaḥ ।। śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ kṛṣṇa punaḥ saṃmelanaṃ tayoḥ ।। 6 ।। agnijvālā viṣajvālā kṣamā soḍhuṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ।। dampatīvirahajvālā na śrotuṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ kṣamā ।।7 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā vismitaścakitānanaḥ ।। vistīrṇaṃ vaktumārebhe hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 8 ।। dampatīvirahoktiṃ ca yāṃ rādhā śrotumakṣamā ।। vicchede śatavarṣīye kimasyā bhavitā mama ।। 9 ।। ityevaṃ mānase kṛtvā māyeśo māyayā'nvitaḥ ।। kṛpāsindhuśca kṛpayā kathāṃ kathitumudyataḥ ।। 10 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। prāṇādhike rādhike tvaṃ śrūyatāṃ prāṇavallabhe ।। prāṇādhidevi prāṇeśi prāṇādhāre manohare ।।11।। vaṭamūlādgate rudre pārvatī tapase yayau ।। punaḥ punaḥ svamātrā ca pitrā ca vinivāritā।।12।। gatvā sā svarṇadītīraṃ snātvā triṣavaṇaṃ mudā ।। saṃdeśe ca mayā dattaṃ jajāpa taṃ manuṃ mudā।।13।। varṣamekaṃ ca saṃpūrṇamanāhārā svabhaktitaḥ।। taptvā tapaḥ kaṭhoraṃ ca cakāra jagadambikā ।। 14 ।। grīṣme ca parito vahniṃ prajvalantaṃ divāniśam।। ।। kṛtvā pratasthau tanmadhye saṃtataṃ japatī manum।।15।। śaśvatsmaśāne varṣāsu kṛtvā yogāsanaṃ śivā।। śilāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca saṃsiktā babhūva jaladhārayā ।।16।। śīte jalāntare śaśvatpratasthau bhaktipūrvakam ।। anāhārā śaradraudranīhārāsu diśāsu ca।।17।। evaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ varṣamaprāpya śaṃkaraṃ satī।। śucā kṛtvā'gnikuṇḍaṃ ca praveṣṭuṃ sā samudyatā।।18।। tāmagnikuṇḍaṃ viśatīṃ tapasā'tikṛśāṃ satīm।। dṛṣṭvā śivaḥ kṛpāsindhuḥ kṛpayā tāṃ jagāma ha ।।19।। atīva vāmano bālo viprarūpī svatejasā ।। prajvalanmanasā hṛṣṭo daṇḍī chatrī jaṭādharaḥ ।। 20 ।। śuklayajñopavītī ca śuklavāsāśca sasmitaḥ ।। śvetābjabījamālāṃ ca bibhrattilakamujjvalam ।। 21 ।। nirjane bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā snigdhā sāpi jagāda ha ।। tattejasā'tipracchannā tatyāja ca tapaḥ svayam ।।22।। ko bhavāniti papraccha taṃ śiśuṃ purataḥ sthitam ।। manasā'liṅganaṃ kartumicchantī paramādaram।।23।। śrutvā śailasutā praśnaṃ prahasya parameśvaraḥ ।। uvācātīva madhuraṃ karṇapīyūṣamīśvarīm ।। 24 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। icchāgāmī baṭurahaṃ tapasvī viprabālakaḥ ।। kā tvaṃ kāntā'tikāntāre tapaścarasi sundari ।। 25 ।। vada kasya kule jātā kasya kanyā ca kā'bhidhā ।। tapasaḥ phaladātrī tvaṃ kasmāddhetostapastava ।। 26 ।। aho vā tapasāṃ rāśiḥ svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī। ।। tapo vā lokaśikṣārthaṃ karoṣi kamalekṣaṇe ।। 27 ।। svayaṃ tejaḥsvarūpā vā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। vidhāya bhaktadhyānārthaṃ vigrahaṃ bhārate januḥ ।। 28 ।। kiṃ vā triloke lakṣmīstvaṃ saṃpadrūpā sanātanī ।। rakṣāṃ vidhātuṃ jagatāmāgatā dhāturantike ।।29।। kiṃ vāmbikā tvaṃ devānāṃ svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī ।। sāvitrī bhārate janma svecchayā labdhumāgatā ।। 30 ।। rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī vā svayaṃ sākṣātsarasvatī ।। sarvavidyāḥ prakaṭituṃ svecchayā janma bhārate।।31।। etāsu madhye kā vā tvaṃ nāhaṃ tarkitumīśvaraḥ ।। yā sā bhavati kalyāṇi parituṣṭā ca māṃ bhava ।। 32 ।। sati tvayi prasannāyāṃ prasannaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। pativratāyāṃ tuṣṭāyāṃ tuṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 33 ।। tuṣṭe nārāyaṇe deve śaśvattuṣṭaṃ jagattrayam ।। tarumūleṣu sikteṣu śākhāḥ siktā yathā priye ।। 34 ।। śiśostadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya parameśvarī ।। uvāca vacanaṃ cāru karṇapīyūṣamīśvarī ।। 35 ।। pārvatyuvāca ।। nāhaṃ vedaprasūrlakṣmīrvāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। janma me bhārate varṣe sāmprataṃ śailakanyakā ।। 36 ।। pūrvaṃ janma dakṣagehe satī śaṃkarakāminī ।। yogena tyaktadehā'haṃ tātabhartṛvinindayā ।। 37 ।। atra janmani puṇyena samprāpte śaṃkare dvija ।। māṃ tyaktvā bhasmasātkṛtvā manmathaṃ sa jagāma ha ।। 38 ।। prayāte śaṃkare tāpādvrīḍayā'haṃ piturgṛhāt ।। āgamattapase cittaṃ mamedaṃ svarṇadītaṭe ।। 39 ।। tapaḥ kṛtvā kaṭhoraṃ ca suciraṃ prāṇavallabham ।। aprāpyāgniṃ praveṣṭuṃ ca tvāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ sthitā ।। 40 ।। gaccha tvaṃ praviśāmyagnau pralayāgniśikhopame ।। kṛtvā svakāmanāṃ vipra haraprāptimanīṣitam ।। 41 ।। yatra yatra janurlabdhvā labhiṣyāmi śivaṃ param ।। prāṇādhikaṃ priyaṃ kāntaṃ vibhuṃ janmani janmani ।।42।। sarvā hi svapriyaṃ labdhuṃ labhanti janma vāñchitam ।। tajjanma patilābhārthaṃ sarvāsāṃ ca śrutau śrutam ।। 43 ।। prāktanīyo hi yo bhartā sa tāsāṃ pratijanmani ।। yā strī yeṣāṃ suniyatā sā teṣāṃ janmajanmani ।। 44 ।। taddehamiha na prāpya kṛtvā ghorataraṃ tapaḥ ।। kṛtvā'gnikuṇḍe kāmyaṃ ca labhiṣyāmi paratra tam ।।45।। ityuktvā pārvatī tatra tatpuraḥ praviveśa ha ।। niṣidhyamānā purato brāhmaṇena punaḥ punaḥ।।46।। vahnipraveśaṃ kurvantyāḥ pārvatyāḥ parameśvari ।। babhūva tapasā sadyo vahniścandanavaddhruvam।। ।। 47 ।। kṣaṇaṃ tadantare sthitvā cotpatantīṃ śivāṃ śivaḥ ।। punaḥ prapaccha sahasā vṛndāvanavinodini ।।48 ।। śrīmahādeva uvāca ।। aho tapaste kiṃ bhadre na buddhaṃ kiṃcideva hi ।। na dagdho vahninā deho na ca prāpto manīṣitaḥ ।। 49 ।। śivaṃ kalyāṇarūpaṃ ca bhartāraṃ kartumicchasi।। avigrahaṃ patiṃ kṛtvā kiṃ vā te vāñchitaṃ bhavet ।। 50।। saṃhartāraṃ ca bhartāraṃ yadīcchasi śucismite ।। kāntamicchati kā vā strī sarvasaṃhārakāraṇam ।।51।। mokṣaṃ vāñchasi ceddevi kṛtvā kāntaṃ svarūpiṇam ।। sarvamuktipradā tvaṃ ca tapasyā viphalā tava।। ।। 52 ।। śivaśca maṅgale mokṣe saṃhartā na ca dṛśyate ।। śivaśabdasya cānyo'rtho na hi vede nirūpitaḥ ।। 53 ।। taṃ ca saṃhārakartāraṃ yadi vāñchasi sundari ।। labhiṣyase rataṃ rudraṃ sarvalokabhayaṃkaram ।।54।। na bhaviṣyati mokṣaste svābhīṣṭaṃ devasevanam ।। harismṛtiramoghā ca sarvamaṃgaladā sadā ।।55 ।। śīghraṃ piturgṛhaṃ gaccha tatra drakṣyasi śaṃkaram ।। mamāśiṣā svatapasāṃ phalena ca sudurlabham।।56।। ityuktvā pārvatīṃ viprastatraivāntaradhīyata ।। durgā yayau piturgehaṃ mahādeveti vādinī।।57।। pārvatyāgamanaṃ śrutvā menakā ca himālayaḥ ।। divyaṃ yānaṃ puraskṛtya prayayau harṣavihvalaḥ ।। 58 ।। saṃsthāpya maṃgalaghaṭānrājavartmani rādhike ।। candanāgurukastūrīphalaśākhāsamanvitān ।। 59 ।। paṭṭasūtrasannibaddharasālapallavānvitaiḥ ।। paritaḥ parito rambhāstambhavṛndasamanvite ।। 60 ।। patiputravatīyoṣitsamūhairdīpahastakaiḥ ।। pūrṇairlājādhānyadūrvāphalapuṣpasamanvitaiḥ ।।61।। supuṇyairbrāhmaṇaiścāpi munibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ ।। naṭībhirnartakībhiśca gajendraiḥ pariśobhite ।। 62 ।। purohitaiśca saṃyuktaiḥ kurvadbhirmaṅgaladhvanim ।। sucārumālatīmālāhastaiḥ śastaiḥ praśaṃsitaiḥ 63 ।। nānāprakāravādyaiśca śaṃkhadhvanisunāditaiḥ।। sindūrareṇubhiścārucandanadravapaṅkilam ।। 64 ।। praviśya nagaraṃ durgā dadarśa pitarau puraḥ ।। suprasannau pradhāvantau harṣāśrupulakānvitau ।। 65 ।। prasannavadanā devī cālibhiḥ praṇanāma tau ।। saṃyujyāthāśiṣaṃ tau ca cakratustāṃ ca vakṣasi ।। ।। 66 ।। he vatse vatsetyuccārya rudantau premavihvalau।। tadā tāṃ ca rathe kṛtvā jagmaturnijamandiram ।। 67 ।। striyo nirmaṃcchanaṃ cakrurviprā yuyujurāśiṣam।। brāhmaṇebhyaśca bandibhyaḥ parvatendro dhanaṃ dadau।।68।। maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa pāṭhayāmāsa chāndasam ।। evaṃ svakanyayā sārddhaṃ tasthatustau svamandire ।। 69 ।। sukhena vasatau tau hi harṣanirbharamānasau ।। ekadā ca tapaḥ kartuṃ jagāma svarṇadīṃ giriḥ ।। 70 ।। menakākanyayā sārddhamuvāsa prāṅgaṇe mudā ।। etasminnantare bhikṣurnartakaśca sugāyanaḥ ।।71।। sahasaika ājagāma menakāsannidhiṃ mudā ।। śṛṅgavādyaṃ vāmahaste ḍamaruṃ dakṣiṇe tathā ।।72।। kṛtvā vibhūtigātro'tivṛddho'tīva jarāturaḥ ।। pṛṣṭhakantho raktavāsāḥ sukaṇṭho'timanoharaḥ ।। 73 ।। jagau mama guṇākhyānaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyaṃ manoharam ।। vādayāmāsa śṛṅgaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā ।। 74 ।। ājagmurnāgarā bālā bālikā harṣavihvalāḥ ।। vṛddhā yuvāno yuvatīsamūho vṛddhayoṣitaḥ ।। 75 ।। śrutvā tu sundaraṃ gītaṃ sutānasvarasaṃyutam ।। sahasā mumuhuḥ sarve tena mūrcchāmavāpnuvan ।।76।। mūrchāṃ saṃprāpa sā durgā dadarśa hṛdi śaṅkaram ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśakaraṃ vyāghracarmadharaṃ param ।।77।। vibhūtibhūṣaṇaṃ ramyamasthimālāṃ sunirmalām ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ suprasannaṃ trilocanam ।। 78 ।। mālāhastaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ nāgayajñopavītakam।। varaṃ vṛṇvityuktavantaṃ sundaraṃ candraśekharam।।79।। hṛdayasthaṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā manasā taṃ nanāma sā ।। varaṃ vavre mānase sā tvaṃ patirme bhaveti ca ।। 80 ।। evaṃ dattvā śivastasya cāntardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। na dṛṣṭvā hṛdi taṃ durgā saṃprāpya cetanāṃ punaḥ ।। 81 ।। dadarśa cakṣurunmīlya bhikṣukaṃ gāyakaṃ puraḥ ।। nṛtyasaṃgītataḥ sā tu bhikṣukasya ca menakā ।।82।। dātuṃ yayau sā ratnāni svarṇapātrasthitāni ca ।। bhikṣāṃ yayāce bhikṣustāṃ durgāṃ nānyāṃ gṛhītavān ।। 83 ।। punaśca nartanaṃ kartumudyataḥ kautukena ca ।। menā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa vismayaṃ yayau ।। 84 ।। bhikṣukaṃ bhartsayāmāsa bahiḥ kartumuvāca tam ।। patnī trilokanāthasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 85 ।। yāñcāmimāṃ prakurvantaṃ dūraṃ kuru subhāṣiṇam।। etasminnantare taptvā giriḥ svālayamāyayau।।86।। dadarśa purato bhikṣuṃ prāṅgaṇasthaṃ manoharam।। kṛtvā nārāyaṇārcāṃ ca gaṅgātīre manohare ।।87।। tanmūrtidhyānaviśleṣaśokādudvignamānasaḥ ।। śrutvā menāmukhādvārtāṃ jahāsa ca cukopa saḥ ।।88।। ājñāṃ cakāra svacaraṃ bahiḥ kartuṃ ca bhikṣukam ।। ākāśāmiva duḥsparśaṃ prajvalantaṃ svatejasā ।।।89।। na śaśāka bahiḥ kartuṃ samīpaṃ gantumakṣamaḥ।। dadarśa bhikṣukaṃ śailaḥ kṣaṇaṃ cārucaturbhujam।। 90।। kirīṭinaṃ kuṇḍalinaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ param।। suveṣaṃ sundaraśyāmamīṣaddhāsyaṃ manoharam ।। 91 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। yadyatpuṣpaṃ pradattaṃ ca pūjākāle gadābhṛte ।। 92 ।। gātre śirasi tatsarvaṃ bhikṣukasya dadarśa ha ।। dhūpaḥ pradīpo yo datto naivedyaṃ vā manoharam ।। 93 ।। dadarśa śailastatsarvaṃ bhikṣukasya puraḥ sthitam।। kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa dvibhujaṃ vinodamuralīkaram ।। 94 ।। gopaveṣaṃ kiśoraṃ ca sasmitaṃ śyāmasundaram ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।। ।। 95 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa svacchaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ caṃdraśekharam।। 96 ।। triśūlapaṭṭiśakaraṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ param ।। vibhūtigātramamalamasthimālāvibhūṣitam ।। 97 ।। nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca taptasvarṇajaṭādharam ।। ḍamaruśṛṃgahastaṃ ca supraśastaṃ manoharam ।। 98 ।। prajapantaṃ harernāma śvetābjabījamālayā ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakātaram ।। 99 ।। svatejasā prajvalantaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam ।। kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa jagatāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ ca caturmukham ।। 100 ।। japantaṃ śrīharernāma svacchasphaṭikamālayā ।। kṣaṇaṃ sūrya svarūpaṃ ca dadarśa triguṇātmakam ।। 1 ।। dadarśa tamatīvraṃ tu jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। kṣaṇamagnisvarūpaṃ ca jvalantamatitejasā ।। 2 ।। kṣaṇamāhlādajanakaṃ candrarūpaṃ dadarśa ha ।। kṣaṇaṃ tejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirañjanam ।। 3 ।। nirliptaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca paramātmasvarūpiṇam ।। evaṃ svecchāmayaṃ dṛṣṭvā nānārūpadharaṃ param ।। 4 ।। harṣāśrupulakaḥ śailo daṇḍavatpraṇanāma tam ।। bhaktyā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 5 ।। samutpatya harṣayukto dadarśa punareva tam।। vāstavaṃ bhikṣukaṃ dṛṣṭvā śailendro viṣṇumāyayā ।। 6 ।। visasmāra ca tatsarvaṃ nānārūpadharaṃ param ।। bhikṣāṃ yayāce bhikṣustaṃ bhikṣāsthālīsvapārśvakam ।। 7 ।। raktāmbaraḥ śṛṅgavādyavicitraḍamaruḥ kare ।। ādātumutsuko durgāṃ nānyāṃ bhikṣuḥ kadācana ।। 8 ।। na svīcakāra śailendro mohito viṣṇumāyayā ।। bhikṣuḥ kiṃcinna jagrāha tatraivāntaradhīyata ।। 9 ।। tadā babhūva jñānaṃ ca menakāśailayoḥ priye ।। aho dṛṣṭo jagannātha āvābhyāṃ svapnavaddine ।। 110 ।। āvāṃ śivau vañcayitvā svasthānaṃ gatavānvibhuḥ ।। tayorbhaktiṃ śive dṛṣṭvā sarve devāśca cintitāḥ ।। 11 ।। cakruḥ śakrādayo yuktiṃ sumero rakṣaṇe bharāt ।। ekāntabhaktyā śailaścetkanyāṃ tasmai pradāsyati ।। 12 ।। dhruvaṃ nirvāṇatāṃ sadyaḥ saṃprāpnotyeva bhārate ।। anantaratnādhāraścetpṛthvī tyaktvā prayāsyati ।। 13 ।। ratnagarbhābhidhā bhūmermithyaiva bhavitā dhruvam ।। sthāvaratvaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya saḥ ।। 14 ।। kanyāṃ śūlabhṛte dattvā viṣṇulokaṃ gamiṣyati ।। nārāyaṇasya sārūpyaṃ bhaviṣyatyeva līlayā ।। 15 ।। saṃprāpya pārṣadatvaṃ ca haridāso bhaviṣyati ।। daśavāpīsamā kanyā dīyate brāhmaṇāya tām।। 16 ।। vedajñāya pavitrāya cāpratigrahaśāline ।। saṃdhyāyajñavedapāṭhakāriṇe satyavādine ।। 17।। asyai pradattā kanyā ca daśavāpīphalapradā ।। trisaṃdhyākāriṇe satyavādine gṛhaśāline ।। 18 ।। vedajñāya suviprāya dattvā suphaladāyinī ।। paradāragṛhītāya yājakāya dvijātaye ।। 19 ।। śaṭhāya saṃdhyāhīnāya vāpyaikaphaladā sutā ।। sarvasaṃdhyāsvagāyatrīvihīnāya śaṭhāya ca ।। 120 ।। vaiśyodbhavāya dattā yā vāpyarddhaphaladā smṛtā ।। pāpine śūdrajātāya viprakṣatrodbhavāya ca ।।21।। dattvā cāṇḍālatulyāya kanyā sā narakapradā ।। viṣṇubhaktāya viduṣe viprāya satyavādine ।। 22 ।। jitendriyāya dattā yā viṃśadvāpīphalapradā ।। ṣaṣṭi varṣasahasrāṇi divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 23 ।। evaṃbhūtāya dattā cenmodate viṣṇumaṃdire ।। dattvā kanyāṃ suśīlāṃ ca harāya haraye'tha vā ।। 24 ।। nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ ca bhavedeva śrutau śrutam ।। viṣṇubhakto yadā kanyāṃ dadāti viṣṇuprītaye ।। 25 ।। sa labheddharidāsyaṃ ca dhruvaṃ viprodbhavāya ca ।। ityālocya surāḥ sarve kṛtvā ca mantraṇāṃ priye ।। 26 ।। guruṃ prasthāpituṃ jagmurhimālayagṛhaṃ prati ।। gatvā praṇamya ca guruṃ sarve cakrurnivedanam ।। 27 ।। himālayagṛhaṃ gatvā kuru nindāṃ ca śūlinaḥ ।। pinākinaṃ vinā durgā varaṃ nānyaṃ variṣyati ।। 28 ।। anicchayā sutāṃ dattvā phalaṃ tūrṇaṃ labhiṣyati ।। kālena yātu śailendraścedānīṃ bhuvi tiṣṭhatu ।। 29 ।। anantaratnādhāraṃ ca tvameva rakṣa bhārate ।। devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā pradadau karṇayoḥ karau ।। 130।। na svīcakāra svaguruḥ smarannārāyaṇeti ca ।। uvāca devavargāṃśca saṃbhartsya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 31 ।। vedavedāntavijñātā mahābhakto harau hare ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ।। śrūyatāṃ madvacaḥ satyaṃ he devāḥ svārthasādhakāḥ ।। 32 ।। nītisāraṃ ca vedoktaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। harakeśavayorbhaktaṃ ye ca nindanti pāpinaḥ ।। 33 ।। bhūdevānbrāhmaṇāṃścaiva svaguruṃ ca pativratāḥ।। patibhikṣubrahmacārisṛṣṭibījānsurāṃstathā ।। 34।। pacyante kālasūtre te yāvaccandradivākarau ।। śleṣmamūtrapurīṣeṣu śerate te divāniśam ।।35।। bhakṣitāḥ kīṭanikaraiḥ śabdaṃ kurvaṃti kātarāḥ ।। ye nindanti ca brahmāṇaṃ sraṣṭāraṃ jagatāṃ gurum ।।36।। śivaṃ surāṇāṃ pravaraṃ durgāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm ।। gītāṃ ca tulasīṃ gaṅgāṃ vedāṃśca vedamātaram ।। 37 ।। vrataṃ tapasyāṃ pūjāṃ ca mantraṃ maṃtrapradaṃ gurum।। te pacyante'ndhakūpe vai cāyuṣo'rdhaṃ vidheraho।।38।। bhakṣitāḥ sarpasaṃghaiśca śabdaṃ kurvanti saṃtatam ।। ye nindanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ devasāmyaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 39 ।। viṣṇubhaktipradaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ ca śruteḥ param ।। rādhā tadaṅgajā gopī brāhmaṇāṃśca sadārcitān ।। 140 ।। te pacyante'vaṭe devā vidhāturāyuṣā samam ।। adhomukhā ūrdhvajaṅghāḥ sarpasaṃghaiśca veṣṭitāḥ ।। 41 ।। bhakṣitā vikṛtākāraiḥ kīṭaiḥ sarpasamākṛtaiḥ ।। atīva kātarā bhītāḥ śabdaṃ kurvanti saṃtatam ।।42।। śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi dhruvaṃ bhakṣanti kṣobhitāḥ ।। ulkāṃ dadati ruṣṭāśca tanmukhe yamakiṃkarāḥ ।। 43 ।। trisandhyaṃ tarjanaṃ kṛtvā kurvanti daṇḍatāḍanam ।। kurvanti mūtrapānaṃ ca prahāraistṛṣitānbhiyā।।44।। tadā kalpāntare sraṣṭuṃ sṛṣṭiṃ ca prathame punaḥ ।। teṣāṃ bhavetpratīkāra ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 45 ।। kṛtvā hi śivanindāṃ ca yāsyanti narakaṃ surāḥ ।। imamevopakāraṃ ca kartumicchatha putrakāḥ ।। 46 ।। brahmaṇā prerito dakṣo dattvā śūlabhṛte sutām ।। na pāpaṃ paramaiśvaryaṃ saṃprāpa haranindakaḥ ।। 47 ।। anicchayā sutāṃ dattvā turyapuṇyaṃ lalābha saḥ ।। aho vihāya sārūpyaṃ tucchaṃ svargaṃ lalābha saḥ ।। 48 ।। kaścinmadhye ca yuṣmākaṃ gatvā śailagṛhaṃ surāḥ ।। saṃpādayatu svamataṃ śailendrasya prayatnataḥ ।। 49 ।। anicchayā sutāṃ dattvā sukhaṃ tiṣṭhatu bhārate ।। tasmai bhaktyā sutāṃ dattvā mokṣaṃ prāpsyati niścitam ।। 150 ।। paścātsaptarṣayaḥ sarve gṛhītvā tāmarundhatīm ।। dhruvaṃ tasya gṛhaṃ gatvā bodhayiṣyanti parvatam ।। 51 ।। vinā pinākinaṃ durgā varaṃ nānyaṃ variṣyati ।। anicchayā sutāṃ tasmai pradāsyati sutājñayā ।। 52 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ devā gacchantu mandiram ।। ityuktvā vākpatiḥ śīghraṃ tapase svarṇadīṃ gataḥ ।। 153 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 40 ।।
<4.41> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। tadā devāḥ samālocya jagmuste brahmaṇo'ntikam ।। sarve nivedanaṃ cakrurbrahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim ।। 1 ।। devā ūcuḥ ।। ।। tava sṛṣṭau jagatsraṣṭā ratnādhāro himālayaḥ ।। sa cetprāpsyati mokṣaṃ ca ratnagarbhā kuto mahī ।। 2 ।। sutāṃ śūlabhṛte dattvā bhaktyā śaileśvaraḥ svayam ।। nārāyaṇasya sārūpyaṃ saṃprāpsyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 3 ।। tvaṃ tasya nindanaṃ kṛtvā vimatiṃ pratipādaya ।। tvayā vinā kṣamo nānyo gaccha śailagṛhe prabho ।। 4 ।। devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvāca vidhiḥ svayam ।। vacanaṃ nītisāraṃ ca karṇapīyūṣamuttamam ।। 5 ।। ।। ।। brahmovāca ।। nāhaṃ kartuṃ kṣamo vatsāḥ śivanindāṃ suduṣkarām ।। saṃpadvināśarūpāṃ ca vipado bījarūpiṇīm ।। 6 ।। bhūteśaṃ prasthāpayata svātmanindāṃ karoti saḥ ।। paranindā vināśāya svanindā yaśase param ।।7।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā taṃ praṇamya surāḥ priye।। śīghraṃ yayuste kailāsaṃ gatvā ca tuṣṭuvuḥ śivam ।। 8 ।। sarve nivedanaṃ cakruḥ śaṃkaraṃ karuṇālayam ।। sa yayau śailamūlaṃ ca tānāśvāsya prahasya ca ।। 9 ।। devā mumudire sarve śīghraṃ gatvā svamandiram ।। iṣṭasiddhirmude śaśvadasiddhirduḥkhavardhinī ।। 10 ।। atha śailaḥ sabhāmadhye samuvāsa mudā'nvitaḥ ।। bandhuvargaiḥ parivṛtaḥ pārvatīsahitaḥ svayam ।।11।। etasminnantare tatra viprarūpī śivaḥ svayam ।। samājagāma sahasā prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। 12 ।। daṇḍī chatrī dīrghavāsā bibhrattilakamuttamam ।। kare sphaṭikamālāṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ gale dadhat ।। 13 ।। taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā samuttasthau sagaṇaśca himālayaḥ ।। nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktyā'tithimapūrvakam ।।14।। nanāma pārvatī bhaktyā prāṇeśaṃ viprarūpiṇam ।। āśiṣaṃ yuyuje vipraḥ sarveṣāṃ prītipūrvakam ।। 15 ।। śailadattāsane śīghramuvāsa brāhmaṇaḥ svayam ।। madhuparkādikaṃ sarvaṃ jagrāha prītipūrvakam ।। 16 ।। papraccha kuśalaṃ śailo brāhmaṇaṃ ko bhavāniti ।। uvāca sarvaṃ viprendro girīndraṃ sādareṇa ca ।। 17 ।। ।। brāhmaṇa uvāca ।। ghāṭikāṃ vṛttimāśritya bhramāmi dharaṇītale ।। manoyāyī sarvagāmī sarvajño'haṃ gurorvarāt ।। 18 ।। mayā jñātaṃ śaṃkarāya sutāṃ dātuṃ tvamicchasi ।। imāṃ padmāsamāṃ divyāmajñātakulaśīline ।। 19 ।। nirāśrayāyāsaṅgayārūpāya nirguṇāya ca।। śmaśānagāmine sarvabhūtanāthāya yogine ।। 20 ।। digvāsase'higātrāya vibhūtibhūṣaṇāya ca ।। vyālagrāhisvarūpāya kālavyāpādanāya ca।।21।। ajñātamṛtyave'jñāyānāthāyābandhave bhave।। taptasvarṇajaṭābhāradhāriṇe nirdhanāya ca ।। 22 ।। ajñātavayase'tīva vṛddhāya cāvikāriṇe।। sarvāśrayāya bhramiṇe nāgahārāya bhikṣave ।। 23 ।। nibodha jñānināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kulodbhavam ।। sa te pātrānurūpaśca pārvatīdātṛkarmaṇi ।। 24 ।। mahājanaḥ smeramukhaḥ śrutimātrādbhaviṣyati ।। lakṣaśailādhipastvaṃ ca na tasyaiko'sti bāndhavaḥ ।। 25 ।। bāndhavānmenakāṃ praśnaṃ kuru śīghraṃ prayatnataḥ।। sarvānpṛccha ca yatnena he bandho pārvatīṃ vinā ।। 26 ।। rogiṇe nauṣadhaṃ śaśvatkupathyaṃ rocate sadā ।। ityuktvā brāhmaṇaḥ śīghraṃ snātvā pārvatīṃ menā gatvā kopālayaṃ ruṣā ।।31।। tyaktvā''hāraṃ rudantī ca cakāra śayanaṃ bhuvi।। etasminnantare tatra vasiṣṭho bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ।। 32 ।। ājagāma punastaiśca yuktā paścādarundhatī ।। praṇamya saṃbandhayojanāni prasaṅgataḥ ।। 42 ।। ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ।। śailendra śrūyatāṃ vākyamasmākaṃ śubhakārakam ।। 43 ।। śivāya pārvatīṃ dehi saṃhartuḥ śvaśuro bhava ।। ayācitāraṃ deveśaṃ bodhayāśu prayatnataḥ ।। 44 ।। tava śaṅkāvināśāya brahmasaṃbandhakarmaṇi ।। necchako dārasaṃyoge śaṃkaro yogināṃ varaḥ ।। 45 ।। vidheḥ prārthanayā deva tava kanyāṃ grahīṣyati।। duhituste tapasyānte pratijñānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 46 ।। hetudvayena yogīndro vivāhaṃ ca kariṣyati ।। ṛṣīṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya ca himālayaḥ ।। uvāca kiṃcidbhītaśca paraṃ vinayapūrvakam ।। 47 ।। himālaya uvāca ।। śivasya rājasāmagrīṃ na hi paśyāmi kāṃcana ।। kiṃcidāśramamaiśvaryaṃ kiṃ vā svajanabāndhavam ।। 48 ।। na kanyāmatinirliptayogine dātumarhati ।। yūyaṃ vidhātuḥ putrāśca satyaṃ vadata niścitam ।। 49 ।। nānurūpāya putrāya pitā kanyā dadāti cet ।। kālāllobhādbhayānmohācchatābdaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ।। 50 ।। na hi dāsyāmyahaṃ kanyāmicchayā śūlapāṇine ।। yadvidhānaṃ bhavedyogyamṛṣayastadvidhīyatām ।। 51 ।। himālayavacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭho vidhinandanaḥ ।। vedavedāṅgavijñātā vedoktaṃ vaktumudyataḥ ।। 52 ।। vasiṣṭha uvāca ।। vacanaṃ vividhaṃ śaila laukike vaidike tathā ।। sarvaṃ jānāti śāstrajño nirmalajñānacakṣuṣā ।। 93 ।। asatyamahitaṃ paścātsāmprataṃ śrutisundaram ।। subuddhaṃ śatrurvadati na hitaṃ ca kadācana ।। 54 ।। āpātaprītijanakaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। dayālurdharmaśīlaśca bodhayatyeva bāndhavam ।। ।। 55 ।। śrutimātrātsudhātulyaṃ sarvakāle sukhāvaham ।। satyasāraṃ hitakaraṃ vacasāṃ śreṣṭhamīpsitam ।। 56 ।। evaṃ ca trividhaṃ śaila nītiśāstranirūpitam ।। kathyatāṃ triṣu madhye kiṃ vadāmi vākyamīpsitam ।।57।। bāhyasaṃpadvihīnaśca śaṃkarastridaśeśvaraḥ ।। tattvajñānasamudreṣu sannimagnaikamānasaḥ ।।58 ।। āpātabhramasaṃpattirvidyucchrīriva nāśinī ।। sadānandasyeśvarasya svātmārāmasya kā spṛhā ।। 59 ।। gṛhī dadāti svasutāṃ rājyasaṃpattiśāline ।। kanyāṃ vidveṣiṇe dattvā kanyāghātī bhavetpitā ।। 60 ।। ko vadecchaṃkaro duḥkhī kubero yasya kiṃkaraḥ।। bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ naṣṭuṃ kṣamo hi yaḥ।।61।। nirguṇaḥ paramātmā ca ya īśaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। sarveśaḥ sa ca nirlipto liptaśca sarvajantuṣu ।। 62 ।। sa ekaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāre sa sarvaḥ sṛṣṭikarmaṇi ।। nirākāraśca sākāro vibhuḥ svecchāmayaḥ svayam ।। 63 ।। ya īśastrividhāṃ mūrtiṃ vidhatte sṛṣṭikarmaṇi ।। sṛṣṭisthityantajananīṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivābhidhām।।64।। brahmā ca brahmalokastho viṣṇuḥ kṣīrodavāsakṛt ।। śivaḥ kailāsavāsī ca sarvāḥ kṛṣṇavibhūtayaḥ ।। 65 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhābhūto dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ ।। caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam ।।66 ।। tasya devasya teṃ'śāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। keciddevāḥ kalāstasya kalāṃśāścaiva kecana ।। 67 ।। kṛṣṇaḥ sṛṣṭyunmukhaścāpi prakṛtiṃ tatra nirmame ।। nirmāya tāṃ ca tadyonau vīryādhānaṃ cakāra ha ।।68।। tato ḍimbhaḥ samudbhūtastanmadhye ca mahāvirāṭ ।। mahāviṣṇuḥ sa vijñeyo śrīkṛṣṇaṣoḍaśāṃśakaḥ ।। 69 ।। nābhipadmodbhavo brahmā tasyaiva jalaśāyinaḥ ।। bhālodbhavastasya sraṣṭuḥ śaṃkaraścandraśekharaḥ ।। 70 ।। mahāviṣṇurvāmapārśvātsaṃbhūto viṣṇureva ca ।। sarve prākṛtikāḥ śaila brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ।। 71 ।। dhatte caturvidhāṃ mūrtiṃ prakṛtiḥ kṛṣṇasaṃbhavā ।। aṃśena līlayā sṛṣṭyai kalayā bahudhā tayā ।।72।। kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasaṃbhūtā rādhā rāseśvarī svayam ।। mukhodbhavā svayaṃ vāṇī rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। 73 ।। vakṣaḥsthalodbhavā lakṣmīḥ sarvasaṃpatsvarūpiṇī ।। śivā tejaḥsu devānāmāvirbhāvaṃ cakāra sā ।। 74 ।। nihatya dānavānsarvāndevebhyaśca śriyaṃ dadau ।। prāpya kalpāṃtare janma jaṭhare dakṣayoṣitaḥ ।। 79 ।। nāmnā satī śivaṃ prāpa dakṣastasmai dadau ca tām ।। yogena dehaṃ tatyāja śrutvā sā bhartṛniṃdanam।।76।। pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā menakā tava gehinī ।। lalābha tasyā jaṭhare janma sā jagadaṃbikā ।। 77 ।। śivā śivasya patnīyaṃ śaila janmanijanmani ।। kalpe kalpe buddhirūpā jñānināṃ jananī parā ।।78।।। jatismarā ca sarvajñā siddhidā siddhirūpiṇī ।। asyā asthicitābhasma bhaktyā dhatte śivaḥ svayama।।79।। dehi tvaṃ svecchayā kanyāṃ dehi bhadra śivāya ca ।। athavā sā svayaṃ kāṃtasthānaṃ yāsyati drakṣyati ।। 80।। prāktanādyasya yā kāṃtā sā taṃ prāpnoti vallabham ।। prajāpaternibaṃdhaṃ ca na ko'pi khaṃḍituṃ kṣamaḥ ।।81।। vivāhe notsukaḥ śaṃbhuḥ svātmārāmaśca tattvavit ।। tuṣṭuvustaṃ surāḥ sarve tārakākhyena pīḍitāḥ ।। 82 ।। devānāṃ pīḍanaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā prārthito vibhuḥ ।। kṛpayā svīcakārāśu kṛpālurdevasaṃsadi ।। 83 ।। kṛtvā pratijñāṃ yogīṃdro dṛṣṭvā kleśamasaṃkhyakam ।। duhituste tapaḥsthānamājagāma dvijātmakaḥ ।। 84 ।। tāmāśvāsya varaṃ dattvā jagāma nijamaṃdiram ।। tacchrutvaivāyayuḥ sarve surāḥ śakrādayo mudā ।। 85 ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānbrahmā dharmaśca sāṃpratam ।। ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve gaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ ।। 86 ।। tatra sarve mudā yuktaiḥ samālocanakartṛbhiḥ ।। prasthāpitā vayaṃ śīghramanṛṇā sā aruṃdhatī।। 87 ।। tava prabodhane prītirvarddhate mahatī sadā ।। saṃprāptaṃ śubhakāryaṃ ca sarvakālasukhāvaham ।। 88 ।। śivāṃ śivāya śaileṃdra svecchayā cenna dāsyasi ।। । bhavitā vā vivāhaśca bhavitavyabalena ca ।। 89 ।। āgamiṣyati devo yo nārāyaṇasahāyavān ।। ratnasārarathe kṛtvā devānāṃ pravaraṃ varam ।। 90 ।। yogīṃdrāṇāṃ vareṇyaṃ taṃ jñānināṃ ca gurorgurum ।। ādimadhyāṃtarahitamavikāramajaṃ param ।। 91 ।। varaṃ dadau śivāyai sa śivaśca tapasaḥ sthale ।। na hīśvarapratijñātaṃ durlabhaṃ viphalaṃ bhavet ।। 92 ।। brahmādistaṃbaparyataṃ sarvaṃ naśvaramasthiram ।। aho pratijñā durlaṅghyā sādhūnāmavināśinī ।। 93 ।। eko maheṃdraḥ śailānāṃ pakṣāṃściccheda līlayā ।। pavano līlayā meroḥ śṛṃgabhaṃgaṃ cakāra ha ।। ।। 94 ।। ke vā śaileṣu yoddhāraḥ suraiḥ saha himālaya ।। patiṣyaṃti samudreṣu pavanaiḥ preritāḥ kṣaṇāt ।। 95 ।। ekārthe yadi śailendra sarvasaṃpadvinaśyati ।। sarvānrakṣati taddattvā vinā ca śaraṇāgatam ।। 96 ।। śaraṇāgatarakṣārthaṃ prāṇāṃśca dātumarhati ।। putradāradhanaṃ sarvāniti nītivido viduḥ ।। 97 ।। dattvā viprāya svasutāmanaraṇyo nṛpeśvara ।। brahmaśāpādvimuktaśca rarakṣa sarvasaṃpadam ।। 98 ।। tamāśu bodhayāmāsurnītiśāstravido janāḥ ।। brahmaśāpanimagnaṃ ca brahmaṇyamatikātaram ।। 99 ।। tvameva śailarājeṃdra sutāṃ dattvā śivāya ca ।। rakṣa sarvānbaṃdhuvargānvaśe kuru surānapi ।। 100 ।। vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya parvateśvaraḥ ।। papraccha nṛpavṛttāṃtaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 101 ।। himālaya uvāca ।। kasya vaṃśodbhavo brahmannanaraṇyo nṛpeśvaraḥ ।। sutāṃ dattvā sa ca kathamarakṣatsarvasaṃpadam ।। 102 ।। vasiṣṭha uvāca ।। manuvaṃśodbhavo rājā so'naraṇyo nṛpeśvaraḥ ।। ciṃrajīvī dharmaśīlo vaiṣṇavo vijiteṃdriyaḥ ।। 103 ।। svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ brahmaputro'tidhārmikaḥ ।। rājyaṃ cakāra dharmeṇa yugānāmekasaptatim ।। 104 ।। tato jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ sahitaḥ śatarūpayā ।। saṃprāpya dāsyaṃ sānnidhyaṃ harerdāso babhūva ha ।। 105 ।। manurbabhūva tatpaścātsvayaṃ svārociṣo mahān ।। svārociṣe gate śaila babhūva manuruttamaḥ ।। 6 ।। uttame nirgate dharmī tāmaso manureva ca ।। tato manurbabhūvātra raivato jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। 7 ।। cākṣuṣaśca tato jñeyaḥ śrāddhadevaśca saptamaḥ ।। sāvarṇiraṣṭamo jñeyaḥ śrīsūryatanayo mahān ।। 8 ।। caitravaṃśodbhavo rājā purā''sītsuratho bhuvi ।। navamo dakṣasāvarṇirbrahmasāvarṇiko daśa ।। 9 ।। ekādaśo manuśreṣṭho dharmasāvarṇirucyate ।। tataśca rudrasāvarṇirviṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ ।। 110 ।। tatparo devasāvarṇiriṃdrasāvarṇikastataḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitā baṃdho manavaśca caturdaśa ।। 11 ।। eteṣu samatīteṣu babhūva brahmaṇo dinam।। indrasāvarṇivṛttātaṃ sarvaṃ matto niśāmaya ।। 12 ।। manūnāṃ pravaro dharmī śuddhabhakto gadābhṛtaḥ ।। cakāra rājyaṃ dharmeṇa yugānāmekasaptatim ।। 13 ।। rājyaṃ dattvā sureṃdrāya jagāma tapase vanam।। suradreṃsya sutaḥ śrīmāñchrīniketurmahābalaḥ ।।14।। tasya putro mahāyogī purīṣatarureva ca ।। tasya putro'titejasvī gokāmukha iti smṛtaḥ ।। 15 ।। vṛddhaśravāḥ sutastasya tatputro bhānureva ca ।। puṇḍarīkaḥ sutastasya tatputro jihvalastathā ।। ।। 16 ।। jihvalasya sutaḥ śṛṅgī tatputro bhīma eva ca ।। tatputro'pi yaśaścandro yaśasā ca śaśī jitaḥ ।। 17 ।। tatkīrtiṃ nirmalāṃ santo gāyanti saṃtataṃ surāḥ ।। tasya putro vareṇyaśca purāraṇyaśca tatsutaḥ ।।18।। tatputro dhārmikaḥ śrīmāndharāraṇyaśca eva ca ।। tatputro maṃgalāraṇyastapasvī jñānināṃ varaḥ ।। 19 ।। aputrako nṛpaśreṣṭhastapase puṣkaraṃ gataḥ ।। suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā varaṃ labdhvā maheśvarāt ।। ।। 120 ।। saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavaṃ putramanaraṇyaṃ jiteṃdriyam ।। dattvā tasmai ca rājyaṃ ca jagāma tapase vanam ।। 21 ।। anaraṇyo nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ saptadvīpamahīpatiḥ ।। cakāra yajñaśatakaṃ bhṛguṇā ca purodhasā।।22।। tucchaṃ matvāśu śakratvaṃ na lebhe naśvaraṃ sudhīḥ ।। līlayā ca jitaḥ śakro līlayā ca jito baliḥ ।।23।। jitāśca dānaveṃdrā vai jvalatā svena tejasā ।। babhūvuḥ śataputrāśca rājñastasya himālaya ।।24।। kanyaikā suṃdarī ramyā padmā padmālayāsamā।। sā kanyā yauvanasthā ca babhūva pitṛmaṃdire।।25।। cāraṃ prasthāpayamāsa varāya nṛpatīśvaraḥ ।। ekadā pippalādaśca gaṃtuṃ svāśramamutsukaḥ।।26।। tapaḥsthāne nirjane ca gandharvaṃ sa dadarśa ha ।। strīṣu nirmagnacittaṃ ca śṛṅgārarasasāgare ।।27।। kāmādatīva mattaṃ ca na jānantaṃ divāniśam।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ muniśārdūlaḥ sakāmaśca babhūva ha।।28।। tataḥ subhagnacittaḥ sañcintayandārasaṃgraham ।। ekadā puṣpabhadrāyāṃ snātuṃ gacchanmunīśvaraḥ ।।29।। dadarśa padmāṃ yuvatī padmāmiva manoramām ।। keyaṃ kasyeti papraccha samīpasthāñjanānmuniḥ ।। 130 ।। janā nivedanaṃ cakruḥ padmā'naraṇyakanyakā ।। muniḥ snātvā'bhīṣṭadevaṃ saṃpūjya rādhikeśvaram ।। 31 ।। jagāma kāmī bhikṣārthamanaraṇyasabhājire ।। rājā śīghraṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma bhayākulaḥ ।। 32 ।। madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। kāmātsarvaṃ gṛhītvā ca yayāce kanyakāṃ muniḥ ।। 33 ।। maunī babhūva nṛpatiḥ kiṃcinnirvaktumakṣamaḥ ।। muniḥ punaryayāce taṃ kanyā dehīti me nṛpa ।। 34 ।। athavā bhasmasātsarvaṃ kariṣyāmi kṣaṇena ca ।। sarve babhūvurācchannā gaṇāśca tejasā muneḥ ।। 35।। ruroda rājā sagaṇo dṛṣṭvā vṛddhaṃ jarāturam ।। mahiṣyo ruruduḥ sarvā iti karttavyamakṣamāḥ ।।36।। mūrcchāṃ prāpa mahārājñī kanyāmātā śucākulā ।। paṇḍito nītiśāstrajño bodhayāmāsa bhūmipam ।। 37 ।। mahiṣīṃ ca nṛpasutānkanyakānītimuttamām ।। adya vāpi dinānte vā dātavyā kanyakā nṛpa ।। 38 ।। parāya viprādanyasmai kasmai vā dātumarhasi ।। satpātraṃ brāhmaṇādanyaṃ na paśyāmi jagattraye ।। 39 ।। sutāṃ dattvā ca munaye rakṣasva sarvasaṃpadam ।। rājakanyānimittena sarvasaṃpatpraṇaśyati ।। 140 ।। sarvaṃ rakṣati tattyaktvā vinā taṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। rājā prājñavacaḥ śrutvā vilapya ca muhurmuhuḥ ।।41।। kanyāṃ sālaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtvā munīndrāya dadau kila ।। kāntāṃ gṛhītvā sa munirmuditaḥ svālayaṃ yayau ।।42।। rājā sarvānparityajya jagāma tapase śucā ।। bhartuśca duhituḥ śokātprāṇāṃstatyāja sundarī।।43।। putrāḥ pautrāśca bhṛtyāśca mūrcchāṃ prāpurnṛpaṃ vinā ।। anaraṇyastapastaptvā cintayanrādhikeśvaram।।44।। golokanāthaṃ saṃsevya golokaṃ ca jagāma ha ।। babhūva kīrtimānrājā jyeṣṭhaputro nṛpasya ca ।। putravatpālayāmāsa prajāḥ sarvā mahītale ।।145।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde rādhākṛṣṇasaṃvāde ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 41 ।।
<4.42> vasiṣṭha uvāca ।। athānaraṇyasya kanyā siṣeve bhaktito munim ।। karmaṇā manasā vācā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaṃ yathā ।। 1 ।। ekadā svarṇadīṃ snātuṃ gacchaṃtīṃ sasmitāṃ satīm ।। dadarśa pathi dharmaśca māyayā nṛpaliṃgakaḥ ।। 2 ।। cāruratnarathasthaśca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ।। navīnayauvanaśrīmānkāmadevasamaprabhaḥ ।।3।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāmuvāca māyayā vibhuḥ ।। vijñātumantastattvaṃ ca tasyāśca muniyoṣitaḥ ।। 4 ।। dharma uvāca ।। ayi sundari lakṣmīva rājayogye manohare ।। atīva yauvanasthe ca kāmini sthirayauvane।।5।। jarāturasya vṛddhasya samīpe tvaṃ na rājase ।। candanāgurusaṃliptā rājase rājavakṣasi।।6।। vipraṃ tapaḥsu nirataṃ satyajñaṃ maraṇonmukham।। vihāya paśya rājendraṃ ratiśūraṃ smarāturam ।।7।। prāpnoti sundaraṃ puṇyātsaundaryaṃ pūrvajanmataḥ ।। saphalaṃ tadbhavetsarvaṃ rasikāliṃganena ca ।। 8 ।। sahasrasundarīkāntaṃ kāmaśāstra viśāradam ।। kiṃkaraṃ kuru māṃ kānte parityakṣyāmi tā api ।।9।। nirjale nirjane ramye śaileśaile nadenade ।। puṣpodyāne puṣpite ca sugandhipuṣpavāyunā ।। 10।। malaye candanāraṇye cārucandanavāyunā ।। vihariṣyāmi kāmena kāminyā ca tvayā saha।।11।। kāmajvareṇa dagdhāyāḥ śāṃtiṃ kartumahaṃ kṣamaḥ ।। viharasva mayā sārddhaṃ janmedaṃ saphalaṃ kuru ।।12।। ityevamuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ svarathādavaruhya ca ।। grahītumutsukaṃ hastaṃ tamuvāca pativratā ।। 13 ।। padmovāca ।। dūraṃ gaccha gaccha dūraṃ pāpiṣṭha bhūmipādhama ।। māṃ cetpaśyasi kāmena sadyo bhasma bhaviṣyasi ।। 14 ।। pippalādaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ tapasā pūtavigraham।। vihāya tvāṃ bhajiṣyāmi strījitaṃ ratilaṃpaṭam ।।15।। strījitasparśamātreṇa sarvapuṇyaṃ praṇaśyati ।। na bhūmau pātakī pāpātpāpināṃ strījitātparaḥ ।। 16 ।। māṃ mātaraṃ ca strībhāvaṃ kṛtvā yena bravīṣi ca ।। bhaviṣyati kṣayastena kālena mama śāpataḥ ।। 17 ।। śrutvā dharmaḥ satīśāpaṃ nṛpamūrtiṃ vihāya ca ।। dhṛtvā svamūrtiṃ deveśaḥ kaṃpamāna uvāca tām ।। 18 ।। dharma uvāca ।। mātarjānīhi māṃ dharmaṃ dharmajñānāṃ gurorgurum ।। parastrīmātṛbuddhiṃ ca kurvantaṃ saṃtataṃ sati ।। 19 ।। ahaṃ tavāṃtarvijñātumāgatastava sannidhim ।। yuṣmākaṃ ca mano jāne tathāpi daivabodhitaḥ ।। 20 ।। kṛtaṃ me damanaṃ sādhvi na viruddhaṃ yathocitam ।। śāstiḥ samutpathasthānāmīśvareṇa vinirmitā ।। 21 ।। dharmaṃ svadharmaṃ vijñātuṃ kālaṃ kalayituṃ kṣamaḥ ।। vidhātāraṃ saṃvidhātuṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।22।। saṃhartuṃ yaḥ kṣamaḥ kāle saṃhartāraṃ bhavaṃ vibhuḥ ।। sraṣṭāraṃ līlayā sraṣṭuṃ tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।। 23 ।। śatruṃ vidhātuṃ mitraṃ ca suprītiṃ kalahaṃ kṣamaḥ ।। sraṣṭuṃ naṣṭam tadevaṃ ca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।। 24 ।। śāpaṃ pradātuṃ sarvāśca sukhaduḥkhavarānkṣamaḥ ।। saṃpadaṃ vipadaṃ yo hi tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।। 25 ।। prakṛtirnirmitā yena mahāviṣṇuśca nirmitaḥ ।। brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyāstasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।। 26 ।। yena śuklīkṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ kṛtaṃ purā ।। dāhīkṛto hutāśaśca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।। 27 ।। atitejaḥ samutthāya tejorūpāya mūrttaye ।। guṇaśreṣṭhanirguṇāya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।।28।। sarvasmai sarvabījāya sarveṣāmantarātmane।। sarvabaṃdhusvarūpāya tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।। 29 ।। ityuktvā puratastasyāstasthau dharmo jagadguruḥ ।। sā sādhvī taṃ ca vijñāya sahasovāca parvata ।। 30 ।। padmovāca ।। tvameva dharmaḥ sarveṣāṃ sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām ।। sarvāṃtareṣu sarvātmā sarvajñaḥ sarvatattvavit ।। 31 ।। kathaṃ mano me vijñātuṃ viḍaṃbayasi kiṃkarīm ।। yatkṛtaṃ tvatkṛte brahmannaparādho babhūva me ।।32।। tvaṃ ca śapto mayā'jñānātstrīsvabhāvātkrudhā vibho ।। kā vyavasthā bhavettasya cintayāmīti sāṃpratam ।। 33 ।। ākāśo'sau diśaḥ sarvā yadi naśyanti vāyavaḥ ।। tathāpi sādhvīśāpastu na naśyati kadācana ।। 34 ।। tvaṃ ca naṣṭo bhavasi cetsṛṣṭināśo bhavettadā ।। iti kartavyatāmūḍhā tathāpi tvāṃ vadāmyaham ।। 35 ।। satye pūrṇaścatuṣpādaiḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ yathā śaśī ।। virājase devarāja sarvakālaṃ divāniśam ।। 36 ।। pādakṣayaśca tretāyāṃ bhagavanbhavitā tava ।। pādau parau dvāpare ca tṛtīyaśca kalau vibho ।। 37 ।। kaliśeṣe śeṣapādastavācchanno bhaviṣyati ।। punaḥ satye samāyāte paripūrṇo bhaviṣyasi ।। 38 ।। satye sarvavyāpakastvaṃ tadanyeṣu ca kutracit ।। yatra sthānaṃ tavādhāro vadāmi śrūyatāṃ vibho ।।39 ।। vaiṣṇaveṣu ca sarveṣu yatiṣu brahmacāriṣu ।। pativratāsu prājñeṣu vānaprastheṣu bhikṣuṣu ।। 40 ।। nṛpeṣu dharmaśīleṣu satsu sadvaiśyajātiṣu ।। dvijaseviṣu śūdreṣu satsaṃsargasthiteṣu ca ।। 41।। eṣu tvaṃ satataṃ pūrṇo dharmarāja virājase ।। yugeyuge tadādhārā yatra puṇyatamā janāḥ ।। 42 ।। aśvatthavaṭabilveṣu tulasīcaṃdaneṣu ca ।। dīkṣāparīkṣāśapathagoṣṭhagoṣpadabhūmiṣu ।।43।। vivāheṣu ca puṣpeṣu vidyamāno'si śākhiṣu ।। devālayeṣu tīrtheṣu satāṃ śaśvadgṛheṣu ca ।। 44 ।। vedavedāṃgaśravaṇe jaleṣu ca sabhāsu ca । śrīkṛṣṇaguṇanāmokta śrutigītasthaleṣu ca ।। 45 ।। vratapūjātaponyāyayajñasākṣisthaleṣu ca ।। gavāṃ gṛheṣu goṣveva vidyamāno hi paśyasi ।। 46 ।। kṛśatā tena bhavitā dharma teṣu sthaleṣu ca ।। etadanyeṣu kṛśatā yadagamyaṃ ca tacchṛṇu ।। 47 ।। puṃścalīṣu ca sarvāsu gṛheṣu naraghātinām ।। naraghātiṣu nīceṣu mūrkheṣu ca khaleṣu ca ।। 48 ।। devatāguruvipreṣṭapālyānāṃ dhanahāriṣu ।। asannareṣu dhūrteṣu caureṣu ratibhūmiṣu ।।49।। durodarasurāpānakalahānāṃ sthaleṣu ca ।। śālagrāmasādhutīrthapurāṇarahiteṣu ca ।। 50 ।। dasyusneheṣu vādeṣu tālacchāyāsu garviṣu।। asijīvimaṣījīvidevalagrāmayājiṣu ।।51।। vṛṣavāhasvarṇakārajīvahiṃsopajīviṣu ।। bhartṛniṃditanārīṣu strījiteṣu ca puṃsu ca ।। 52 ।। dīkṣāsaṃdhyāviṣṇubhaktivihīneṣu dvijeṣu ca ।। svāṃgakanyāvikrayiṣu svayoṣidvikrayeṣvatha ।। 53 ।। śālagrāmasuragraṃthabhūmivikrayiṣu prabho ।। mitradohikṛtaghneṣu satyaviśvāsaghātiṣu ।। 54 ।। śaraṇāgatadīneṣu cāśritaghneṣu nṛṣvapi ।। śaśvanmithyoktiśīleṣu tathā sīmāpahāriṣu ।। 55 ।। kāmātkrodhāttathā lobhānmithyāsākṣipravādiṣu ।। puṇyakarmavihīneṣu puṇyakarmavirodhiṣu ।। 56 ।। sthātumeteṣu nindyeṣu nādhikārastava prabho ।। mamāpi vacanaṃ satyaṃ babhūva tatkṣaṇaṃ tava ।। 57 ।। yāsyāmi patisevāyai gaccha tāta svamandiram ।। ityevaṃvādinīṃ sādhvīmuvāca vidhinandanaḥ ।। prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānatīva vinayaṃ vacaḥ ।। 58 ।। dharma uvāca ।। dhanyā'si patibhaktā'si svasti te'stu ca saṃtatam ।। 59 ।। varaṃ gṛhāṇa dāsyāmi matparitrāṇakāriṇi ।। yuvā bhavatu bhartā te ratiśūraśca kanyake ।। ।। 60 ।। rūpavānguṇavānsādhvi saṃtataṃ sthirayauvanaḥ ।। paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktā tvaṃ bhava sthirayauvanā ।। 61 ।। cirajīvī bhavatu sa mārkaṇḍeyātparaḥ sute ।। kuberāddhanavāṃścaiva śakrādaiśvaryavānapi ।। 62 ।। viṣṇubhaktaḥ śivasamaḥ siddhastu kapilātparaḥ ।। svāmisaubhāgyasaṃyuktā bhava tvaṃ jīvanāvadhi ।। 63 ।। gṛhā bhavantu te sādhvi kuberabhavanādhikāḥ ।। mātā tvaṃ daśaputrāṇāṃ guṇināṃ cirajīvinām ।। ।। 64 ।। svabharturadhikānāṃ ca bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। ityevamuktvā saṃtasthau dharmarājaśca parvata ।।69।। sā taṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇamya svagṛhaṃ yayau ।। dharmastāmāśiṣaṃ yuktvā jagāma nijamandiram ।। 66 ।। pativratāṃ praśaśaṃsa pratisaṃsadi saṃsadi ।। sā reme svāminā sārddhaṃ yūnā rahasi saṃtatam ।। 67 ।। paścādbabhūva satputrā tadbharturadhikā guṇaiḥ ।। śailendra kathitaṃ sarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।। 68 ।। dattvā'naraṇyaḥ svasutāṃ rarakṣa sarvasaṃpadam ।। tvameva kanyakāṃ dattvā sarveṣāmīśvarāya ca ।।69।। rakṣa sarvabandhuvargānātmanaḥ sarvasaṃpadam ।। saptāhe samatīte ca durlabhe'tiśubhe kṣaṇe ।। 70।। lagnādhipe ca lagnasthe candre svatanayānvite ।। modate rohiṇīyukte viśuddhe candratārake ।। 71 ।। mārgaśīrṣe candravāre sarvadoṣavivarjite ।। sarvasadgrahasaṃdṛṣṭe hyasadgrahavivarjite ।। 72 ।। sadapatyaprade'tīva patisaubhāgyadāyini ।। avaidhavyaprade saukhyaprade janmani janmani ।। 73 ।। atyantapremāvicchedapradāyini parātpare ।। kanyāṃ pradāya devāya tvaṃ kṛtī bhava parvata ।। 74 ।। jagadambāṃ jagatpitre mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ।। tejaḥsvarūpāṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ devapūjitām ।। 79 ।। āvirbhūtā purā kalpe devānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ।। tejorāśiḥ suraughāṇāṃ prajvalanto diśo daśa ।। 76 ।। asyāḥ svatejasā daityāḥ keciddagdhāḥ palāyitāḥ ।। kecidbabhūvuḥ śailendra bhasmībhūtāśca bhūtale ।। 77 ।। bilaṃ praviviśuḥ kecinmūrcchāṃ prāpuśca kecana ।। keciddante tṛṇaṃ kṛtvā jagmuḥ śaraṇamīśvarīm ।। 78 ।। keciccikṣipurastrāṇi stambhitā api kecana ।। kecicciraṃ raṇaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ svargamanāmayam ।। 79 ।। niḥśatravo babhūvuste surā asyāḥ prasādataḥ ।। kṛṣṇājñayā sā kalpānte dakṣakanyā babhūva ha ।। 80 ।। dakṣaśca vidhivaddevīṃ pradadau śūlapāṇaye ।। daivena matpituryajñe sahasā surasaṃsadi ।। 81 ।। babhūva kalahaḥ śaila tena śūlabhṛtā mahān ।। brahmāṇaṃ ca namaskṛtya yayau ruṣṭastrilocanaḥ ।। 82 ।। dakṣaśca sagaṇo ruṣṭaḥ prayayau svālayaṃ tadā ।। kopātsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro dakṣo yajñaṃ cakāra ha ।। 83 ।। na dadau yajñabhāgaṃ ca mātsaryācchūlapāṇaye ।। dṛṣṭvā satī prakupitā janakaṃ raktalocanā ।। 84 ।। nirbhartsya ca bahutaraṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। yajñasthānātsamutthāya jagāma māturantikam ।। 85 ।। bhaviṣyaṃ kathayāmāsa trikālajñā parātparā ।। yajñabhaṅgādikaṃ vā'pi svapituśca parābhavam ।। 86 ।। palāyanaṃ ca devānāṃ yajñasthānādgirīśvaram ।। munīnāmṛtvijāṃ caiva parvatānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 87 ।। jayaṃ śaṃkarasainyānāṃ svātmano mṛtyumeva ca ।। śokātparyaṭanaṃ bharturvirahāturacetasā ।। 88 ।। nirmāṇaṃ netrarasaḥ prabodhaṃ ca janārdanāt ।। mūrtibhedātpunaḥ prāptiṃ vihāraṃ tasya tatsamam ।।89।। aparaṃ bhavitavyaṃ ca sarvamuktvā jagāma sā ।। svamātrā bhaginībhiśca pratiṣiddhā ca duḥkhitā ।। 90 ।। babhūvādarśanā yogātsarvāsāṃ siddhiyoginī ।। gatvā sā jāhnavītīraṃ smṛtvā saṃpūjya śaṃkaram ।। 91 ।। smṛtvā taccaraṇāmbhojaṃ dehaṃ tatyāja sundarī ।। gandhamādanadroṇīsthaṃ śarīraṃ praviveśa ha ।। 92 ।। saṃjahāra purā yena daityānāmakhilaṃ kulam ।। hāhākāraṃ pracakruśca surāḥ sarve'tivismitāḥ ।। 93 ।। jagmuḥ śaṃkarasenāśca deśayajñaṃ vinaśya ca ।। parābhavaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kṛtvā śokāturāḥ parāḥ ।। 94 ।। satvaraṃ sarvavṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsurīśvaram ।। śrutvā pravṛttiṃ saṃhartā sarvarudragaṇairvṛtaḥ ।। jagāma svarṇadītīraṃ yatra devīkalevaram ।। 95 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde satīdehatyāgo nāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 42 ।।
<4.43> nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। atha durgāṃ mahādevassatīmūrtiṃ manoharām ।। amlānapadmavaktrāṃ tāṃ śayānāṃ jāhnavītaṭe ।। 1 ।। dadhatīmakṣamālāṃ ca prataptakāñcanaprabhām ।। tejasā prajvalantīṃ ca dadhānāṃ śuklavāsasam ।। 2 ।। dṛṣṭvā satīśarīraṃ ca pradagdho virahāgninā ।। tattvarāśirmūrtimāṃśca mūrcchāṃ prāpa tathāpi ca ।। 3 ।। kalatraśoko balavānsvātmārāmaṃ parātparam ।। bādhate vedabījaṃ taṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum ।। 4 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya tāmuvāca trilocanaḥ ।। nirīkṣya vadanāmbhojaṃ sthāṇuḥ sthāṇurivāparaḥ ।। 5 ।। sāśrunetro'tidīnaśca dīnānāṃ śaraṇapradaḥ ।। dīnadainyāpahārī ca vilalāpa paraṃ vacaḥ ।। 6 ।। śaṃkara uvāca ।। uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha subhage sati prāṇeśvari priye ।। śaṅkaro'haṃ tava svāmī paśya māṃ nikaṭāgatam ।। 7 ।। śivaṃ śivapradaṃ sarvasaṃpadrūpaṃ ca siddhidam ।। sarvātmānaṃ ca sarveśaṃ śavatulyaṃ tvayā vinā ।। 8 ।। śakto'haṃ ca tvayā sārddhaṃ sarvaśaktisvarūpayā ।। śaktihīnaḥ śavasamo niśceṣṭaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। 9 ।। yaśca śaktiṃ na jānāti jñānahīnaśca nindati ।। taṃ tyaktumucitaṃ vijñe kathaṃ māṃ tyajasi priye ।। 10 ।। svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sādhyabhūtā vayaṃ tava ।। sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca vada kiṃcitsudhopamam ।। 11 ।। madhurābhāsadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ dagdhaṃ secanaṃ kuru ।। māṃ dṛṣṭvā dūrataḥ śīghraṃ snigdhaṃ vadasi sasmitam ।। 12 ।। kathamadyāpi ruṣṭeva vilapantaṃ na bhāṣase ।। prāṇādhike samuttiṣṭha rudaṃtaṃ māṃ na paśyasi ।। 13 ।। parityajya ca naḥ prāṇāngantuṃ nārhasi sundari ।। jagadambe samuttiṣṭha prāṇādhāre parātpare ।। 14 ।। pativrate samuttiṣṭha kathaṃ māṃ nādya sevase ।। kathaṃ karoṣi vijñāya vratabhaṅgaṃ śrutiprasūḥ ।। 15 ।। ityuktvā mṛtadehaṃ ca priyāyā virahāturaḥ ।। nidhāyorasi saṃśliṣya cucumba ca punaḥpunaḥ ।। 16 ।। adhare cādharaṃ dattvā vakṣo vakṣasi śaṅkaraḥ ।। punaḥpunaḥ samāśliṣya punarmūrcchāmavāpa saḥ ।। 17 ।। punaḥ sa cetanāṃ prāpya vegādutthāya śokataḥ ।। dudrāva ca yathonmatto jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।। 18 ।। saptadvīpasaptasindhuṃ lokālokaṃ ca kāñcanam ।। babhrāma bhrāntavajjñānī satīṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 19 ।। śataśṛṅgagireḥ pārśve jambudvīpe ca bhārate।। sunirjane'kṣayavaṭe gaṅgātīre sarittaṭe ।। 20 ।। rurodoccaiḥ svayaṃ kṛtvā sati sādhvītyudīrya ca ।। trinetranetranīreṇa saṃbabhūva sarovaram ।। 21 ।। tannetraṃ ca saro nāma munīnāṃ tapasaḥ sthalam ।। yojanadvayavistīrṇaṃ puṇyatīrthaṃ manoharam ।। 22 ।। yatra snātvā punarjanma narāṇāṃ na bhavedgire ।। śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ snānamātreṇa naśyati ।। 23 ।। tyaktvā tāṃ mānavīṃ mūrtiṃ narā yānti hareḥ padam ।। sa tatra rodanaṃ tyaktvā punarbabhrāma medinīm ।। 24 ।। pūrṇamabdaṃ mahāyogī virahāturamānasaḥ ।। satīgalitapratyaṅgairaṃgaiśca parvateśvara ।। 25 ।। babhūva siddhapīṭhānāṃ samūho vāñchitapradaḥ ।। śeṣāṅgānāṃ mahādevaḥ saṃskāraṃ vai vidhāya ca ।।26।। asthimālāṃ vinirmāya cakāra kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam ।। nityaṃ tadbhasma bhaktyā ca cakāra gātralepanam।।27।। sati prāṇeśvarītyuktvā punarmūrcchāmavāpa saḥ ।। visasmāra brahma paramātmānamātmasaṃbhavaḥ ।।28।। svātmārāmaḥ pūrṇakāmo niśceṣṭo virahajvarāt ।। taṃ śayānaṃ girivarasyābhyāśe vaṭamūlake ।।29।। dṛṣṭvā devāḥ samājagmurvismitāḥ śivasannidhim ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānīśvaraḥ saha pārṣadaiḥ ।। 30।। ratnayānenājagāma padmārcitapadāmbujaḥ।। ratnālaṃkāra śobhāḍhyaḥ pītavāsāścaturbhujaḥ ।। 31 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ।। brahmā śeṣaśca dharmaśca surāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ ।। 32 ।। samūṣurīśasadasi lakṣmīkānta praṇamya te ।। śrīhariḥ śaṅkaramaho kṛtvā vakṣasi mūrcchitam ।। rudantaṃ bodhayāmāsa jñānīśo jñānināṃ gurum ।। 33 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। svātmārāma nibodhedaṃ madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇu ।। 34 ।। hitamadhyātmasāraṃ ca duḥkhaśokanikṛntanam ।। sarvādhyātmavidyamānabījaṃ jñānanidhiṃ vidhim ।। 35 ।। tathāpi bodhayāmi tvāṃ sarvajñaṃ vedhaso vidhim ।। budhaṃ bodhayituṃ śakto'budho'pi prāṇasaṃkaṭe ।। 36 ।। vyavahāro'sti lokeṣu sarvaḥ sarvaparasparam ।। māyāśritā guṇāḥ sarve hetavaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।। 37 ।। viṣṇumāyā balavatī guṇayuktaṃ prabādhate ।। duḥkhaṃ śokaṃ bhayaṃ śaṃbho durdine bhavatīśvara ।। 38 ।। tatrātīte kutastāni sudine ca samāgate ।। harṣa aiśvaryadarpaśca saṃtataṃ tatra varddhate ।। 39 ।। sarvāṇyetāni gaṇyante svapnānīva vipaścitaḥ ।। jñānaṃ labha mahādeva jñānabīja sanātana ।। 40 ।। cetanāṃ kuru bhadraṃ te satīṃ prāpsyasi niścitam ।। tattoyaṃ śītatā nityaṃ nāgniṃ muñcati dāhikā ।। 41 ।। tejaḥ sūryaṃ mahīṃ gandho tathā tvāṃ ca satī śiva ।। śailetyevaṃ samākarṇya hariṃ kiṃciduvāca ha ।। 42 ।। netrāṇyunmīlanaṃ kṛtvā trinetraḥ śrūyatāmiti ।। trinetra uvāca ।। kastvaṃ tejaḥsvarūpo'si ka ime tava sannidhau ।। 43 ।। kinnāma bhavataścaiṣāṃ kāni nāmāni kā satī ।। ko'haṃ ko me bhavānbrūte kiṃkarāḥ kuta āgatāḥ ।। 44 ।। kva yāsyasi kva yāsyāmi kva gacchanta ime vada।। harirityevamākarṇya ruroda sagaṇo gire ।। 45 ।। netranīraistrinetraṃ taṃ rudantaṃ prasiṣeca saḥ ।। haritrinetrayornetranīrapātena tatra vai ।।46।। babhūva sarasāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tīrthaṃ bhuvanapāvanam ।। bhārate'stagireḥ paścāttatrākṣayavaṭāṃtike ।। 47 ।। sthalaṃ babhūva tapasāṃ muktibījaṃ tapasvinām ।। athovāca punaḥ śīghramādhyātmaṃ ca haraṃ hariḥ ।। 48 ।। śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ।। śṛṇu śaṃkara vakṣyāmi jñānānaṃda sanātana ।।49।। jñānaṃ jñānanidhe śokādvismṛto'si parātpara ।। sudinaṃ durdinaṃ śaśvadbhavatyeva bhave bhave ।। 50 ।। sarveṣāṃ prākṛtānāṃ ca te bīje sukhaduḥkhayoḥ।। sukhādbhavati harṣaśca darpaḥ śauryapramattatā ।। 51 ।। rāga aiśvaryakāmaśca vidveṣaśca nirantaram ।। duḥkhācchokātsamudvegādbhayaṃ nityaṃ pravartate ।। 52।। hatānyetāni sarvāṇi hate bīje maheśvara ।। sudinaṃ durdinaṃ caiva sarvakarmodbhavaṃ bhava ।। 53 ।। tatkarma tapasā sādhyaṃ karmaṇā ca śubhāśubham ।। tapaḥ svabhāvasādhyaṃ ca svabhāvo'bhyāsato bhavet।।54।। saṃsargasādhyo 'dhyāsaśca saṃsargaḥ puṇyato bhavet।। puṇyabījaṃ manaścaiva pāpabījaṃ ca caṃcalam ।। 95 ।। manaḥ śaṃbho mamāṃśaśca sarveṃdriyapuraḥsaram।। sarveṣāṃ janako'haṃ ca cittvaṃ brahmā patistvayam ।। 56 ।। brahraikaṃ mūrtibhedastu guṇabhedena saṃtatam ।। tadbrahma vividhaṃ vastu saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ śiva ।। 57 ।। māyāśrito yaḥ saguṇo māyā'tītaśca nirguṇaḥ ।। svecchāmayaśca bhagavānicchayā vikaroti ca।। 58 ।। icchāśaktiśca prakṛtirnityā sarvaprasūḥ sadā ।। kecidekaṃ vadaṃtyeva brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam ।। 59।। kecidvadanti dvividhaṃ brahma prakṛtipūrvakam ।। śṛṇu ye ca vadantyekaṃ māyāpuruṣayoḥ param ।। 60।। tasmādbhavati tau dvau ca tadbrahma sarvakāraṇam ।। atha caikaṃ paraṃ brahma dvividhaṃ bhavatīcchayā ।। ।। 61 ।। icchāśaktiśca prakṛtiḥ sarvaśaktiprasūḥ sadā ।। tatrāśaktaśca saguṇaḥ sarvādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 62 ।। sarveśvaraḥ sarvasākṣī sarvatrāsti phalapradaḥ ।। śarīraṃ dvividhaṃ śaṃbho nityaṃ prākṛtameva ca ।। 63 ।। nityaṃ vināśarahitaṃ naśvaraṃ prākṛtaṃ sadā ।। ahaṃ tvaṃ cāpi bhagavānnāvayornityavigrahaḥ ।। 64 ।। āvayoraṃśabhūtā ye prākṛtā naṣṭavigrahāḥ ।। rudrādayastvadaṃśāśca madaṃśā viṣṇurūpiṇaḥ ।। 65 ।। mamāpyevaṃ dvidhā rūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ ca caturbhujam।। caturbhujo'haṃ vaikuṇṭhe padmayā pārṣadaiḥ saha ।। 66 ।। goloke dvibhujo'haṃ ca gopībhiḥ saha rādhayā ।। dvividhaṃ ye vadantyevaṃ dvau pradhānau tu tanmate।। 67 ।। puruṣaśca sadā nityo nityā prakṛtirīśvarī ।। sadā tau dvau ca saṃśliṣṭau sarveṣāṃ pitarau śiva ।। 68 ।। saśarīrau niḥśarīrau svecchayā sarvarūpiṇau ।। prādhānyaṃ ca yathā puṃsaḥ prakṛteśca sadā tathā ।। 69 ।। satīmicchasi cecchambho prakṛteḥ stavanaṃ kuru ।। yatstotraṃ ca tvayā dattaṃ purā durvāsase mudā ।। 70 ।। taddivyaṃ kaṇvaśākhoktaṃ bhaja tena jagatprasūm ।। śokanāśo bhavatu te śivaṃ śiva mamāśiṣā ।। 71 ।। dūraṃ viplavahetuśca yātu strīvirahajvaraḥ ।। ityevamuktvā lakṣmīśo virarāma girīśvaram ।।72।। stavanaṃ kartumārebhe prakṛteśca maheśvaraḥ ।। snātvā natvā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ।। puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ ।। 73 ।। maheśvara uvāca ।। oṃ namaḥ prakṛtyai mantraḥ ।। brāhmi brahmasvarūpe tvaṃ māṃ prasīda sanātani ।। paramātmasvarūpe ca paramānandarūpiṇi ।। 74 ।। bhadre bhadraprade durge durgaghne durganāśini ।। potasvarūpe jīrṇe tvaṃ māṃ prasīda bhavārṇave ।। ।। 79 ।। sarvasvarūpe sarveśi sarvabījasvarūpiṇi ।। sarvādhāre sarvavidye māṃ prasīda jayaprade ।। 76 ।। sarvamaṅgalarūpe ca sarvamaṅgaladāyini ।। samastamaṅgalādhāre prasīda sarvamaṅgale ।। 77 ।। nidre tandre kṣame śraddhe tuṣṭipuṣṭisvarūpiṇi ।। lajje medhe buddhirūpe prasīda bhaktavatsale ।। 78 ।। vedasvarūpe vedānāṃ kāraṇe vedadāyini ।। sarvavedāṅgarūpe ca vedamātaḥ prasīda me ।। 79 ।। daye jaye mahāmāye prasīda jagadambike ।। kṣānte śānte ca sarvānte kṣutpipāsāsvarūpiṇi ।। 80 ।। lakṣmīrnārāyaṇakroḍe sraṣṭurvakṣasi bhārati ।। mama kroḍe mahāmāye viṣṇumāye prasīda me ।। 81 ।। kalākāṣṭhāsvarūpe ca divārātrisvarūpiṇi ।। pariṇāmaprade devi prasīda dīnavatsale ।। 82 ।। kāraṇe sarvaśaktīnāṃ kṛṣṇasyorasi rādhike ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhike bhadre prasīda kṛṣṇapūjite ।। 83 ।। yaśaḥsvarūpe yaśasāṃ kāraṇe ca yaśaḥprade ।। sarvadevīsvarūpe ca nārīrūpavidhāyini ।। 84 ।। samastakāminīrūpe kalāṃśena prasīda me ।। sarvasaṃpatsvarūpe ca sarvasaṃpatprade śubhe ।। 85 ।। prasīda paramānande kāraṇe sarvasaṃpadām ।। yaśasvināṃ pūjite ca prasīda yaśasāṃ nidhe ।। 86 ।। ādhāre sarvajagatāṃ ratnādhāre vasundhare ।। carācarasvarūpe ca prasīda mama mā ciram । 87 ।। yogasvarūpe yogīśe yogade yogakāraṇe ।। yogādhiṣṭhātri devīśe prasīda siddhayogini ।। 88 ।। sarvasiddhisvarūpe ca sarvasiddhipradāyini ।। kāraṇe sarva siddhīnāṃ siddheśvari prasīda me ।।89 ।। vyākhyānaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ matabhede maheśvari ।। jñāne yaduktaṃ tatsarvaṃ kṣamasva parameśvari ।। 90 ।। kecidvadanti prakṛteḥ prādhānyaṃ puruṣasya ca ।। kecittatra matadvaidhe vyākhyābhedaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ।। 91 ।। mahāviṣṇornābhideśe sthitaṃ taṃ kamalodbhavam ।। madhukaiṭabhau mahādaityau līlayā haṃtumudyatau ।। 92 ।। dṛṣṭvā stutiṃ prakurvantaṃ brahmāṇaṃ rakṣituṃ purā ।। bodhayāmāsa govindaṃ vināśahetave tayoḥ ।। 93 ।। nārāyaṇastvadbhaktyā ca jaghāna tau mahāsurau ।। sarveśvarastvayā sārddhamanīśo'yaṃ tvayā vinā ।। 94 ।। purā tripurasaṃgrāme gaganātpatite mayi ।। tvayā ca viṣṇunā sārddhaṃ rakṣito'haṃ sureśvari ।।95।। adhunā rakṣa māmīśe pradagdhaṃ virahāgninā।। svātmadarśanapuṇyena krīṇīhi parameśvari।।96।। ityuktvā virataḥ śaṃbhurdadarśa gaganasthitām ।। ratnasārarathasthāṃ tāṃ devīṃ śatabhujāṃ mudā ।। 97 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ jagatāṃ mātaraṃ satīm ।। 98 ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ virahāsaktaḥ punastuṣṭāva satvaram ।। duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa prarudanvirahodbhavam ।। 99 ।। darśayāmāsāsthimālāṃ svāṃgasthaṃ bhasmabhūṣaṇam ।। kṛtvā bahu parīhāraṃ toṣayāmāsa suṃdarīm ।। 100 ।। nārāyaṇaśca brahmā ca dharmaḥ śeṣaḥ surarṣayaḥ ।। śivaṃ rakṣeśvarītyuktvā tuṣṭuvuste sanātanīm ।1।। babhūva parituṣṭā sā teṣāṃ stotreṇa tatkṣaṇam ।। uvāca kṛpayā śaṃbhuṃ prāṇeśaṃ prāṇavallabhā ।। 2 ।। prakṛtiruvāca ।। sthiro bhava mahādeva prāṇādhika mama prabho ।। bhavānātmā ca yogīśaḥ svāmī janmani janmani।।3।। ahaṃ śailendrakāminyāṃ labdhvā janma maheśvara ।। tava patnī bhaviṣyāmi muñca tvaṃ virahajvaram ।।4।। ityuktvā śivamāśvāsya cāṃtardhānaṃ cakāra sā ।। surā jagmustamāśvāsya lajjānamrātmakandharam ।। 5 ।। harṣāntarātmā giriśaḥ kailāsaṃ tu jagāma ha ।। nanarta sagaṇastūrṇaṃ saṃtyajya virahajvaram ।। 6।। idaṃ śivakṛtaṃ stotraṃ prakṛtyā yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। na bhavetkāminībhedastasya janmani janmani ।। 7 ।। ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā sa yāti śivamandiram ।। dharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 108 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śaṃkaraśokāpano danaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 43 ।।
<4.44> ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā sagaṇo'pi himālayaḥ ।। vismito bhāryayā sārddhaṃ jahāsa pārvatī svayam ।। 1 ।। arundhatī ca tāṃ menāṃ bodhayāmāsa kātarām ।। nirāhārāṃ rudantīṃ tāṃ jahau śokaṃ mudā ca sā ।। 2 ।। arundhatīṃ bhojayitvā bubhuje bhogamuttamam ।। sarvaṃ prahṛṣṭamanasā maṅgalaṃ ca cakāra ha ।। 3 ।। tataḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro vasiṣṭhasyājñayā priye ।। patraṃ prasthāpayāmāsa nānāsthānaṃ tvarānvitaḥ ।।4।। tataḥ prasthāpayāmāsa śivaṃ maṅgalapatrikām ।। nānāprakāradravyāṇi bāhyāni ca cakāra ha ।।5।। tandulānāṃ ca śailānvai pṛthukānāṃ ca sundari ।। tailānāṃ ca ghṛtānāṃ ca dadhnāṃ vāpīścakāra ha।।6।। guḍānāmāsanānāṃ ca kṣīrāṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। atho haiyaṃgavīnānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ paraṃ mune ।। 7 ।। laḍḍukānāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ svastikānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। yavacūrṇādipiṣṭānāṃ ghṛtapakvāni tāni ca ।। 8 ।। nānāprakāravastrāṇi vahniśaucāni yāni ca ।। mahāratnapravālāni suvarṇarajatāni ca ।।9।। dravyāṇyetāni śailendra kṛtvā tu vidhipūrvakam ।। maṅgalaṃ kartumārebhe tatraiva maṅgale dine ।। 10।। saṃskāraṃ kārayāmāsuḥ pārvatīṃ parvatastriyaḥ ।। snāpayitvā vastrayugmaṃ dhārayāmāsurāśu tāḥ ।। 11 ।। kārayitvā suveṣāṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāma ।। darpaṇaṃ dhārayāmāsurdūrvākṣatasamanvitam ।।12।। daduścālaktakaṃ cāru pādāṃguliṣu pādayoḥ ।। gaṃḍe patrāvalīṃ ramyāṃ netre kajjalamujjvalam ।।13।। kabarīṃ kārayāmāsurmālatīmālyaveṣṭitām ।। paṭṭasūtrapinaddhāṃ tāṃ vāmavaktrāṃ manoharām ।। 14।। etasminnaṃtare rādhe samājagmuḥ sureśvarāḥ ।। nītvā trinetraṃ tatraiva ratnayānasthamīśvaram ।। 15 ।। śailaḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhārānsaṃbhāṣayitumīśvarān ।। śailānprasthāpayāmāsa brāhmaṇānapi pūjitān ।। 16 ।। prāṅgaṇaṃ kārayāmāsa rambhāstambhaiḥ samanvitam ।। paṭṭasūtrasannibaddharasālapallavānvitaiḥ ।। 17।। phalapallavasaṃyuktaiḥ kalaśairjalasaṃyutaiḥ ।। candanāgurukastūrīsucārukusumānvitaiḥ।।18।। mālatīmālyasaṃyuktaiḥ saṃyuktaṃ sumanoharam ।। deveśvarānparo dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma himālayaḥ ।। 19 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ dātuṃ prerayāmāsa kiṅkarān ।। nārāyaṇo hi bhagavānuvāsa pārṣadaiḥ saha ।। 20 ।। vinatānandanāttūrṇamavaruhya caturbhujaḥ ।। caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaiśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ ।। 21 ।। ratnamuṣṭinibaddhaiśca sevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। ṛṣiśreṣṭhaiḥ suraśreṣṭhaiḥ stūyamānaśca saṃsadi ।। 22 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyo bhaktānugrahakātaraḥ ।। uvāsa ca tadabhyāśe brahmā devagaṇaiḥ saha ।।23।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva samūṣurmaṅgale sthale ।। etasminnantare śambhuravaruhya rathādaho ।।24।। ratnāsane samuttiṣṭhandadarśa parvatālayam।। samājagmuḥ śivaṃ draṣṭuṃ śailendranagarastriyaḥ ।। 25 ।। vṛddhā bālā yuvatyaśca vastrābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ।।
