dhruvam ।। 65 ।। śīghraṃ yayuste kailāsaṃ devā mānasaśāyinaḥ ।। muhūrtārddhena muditāḥ saṃprāpuḥ śaṃkarālayam ।। 66 ।। dṛṣṭvā gataṃ devapatnyo munipatnyaśca satvaram ।। āyayurdīpamānīya mudā maṅgalakarmaṇi ।। 67> vāyupatnī kuberasya kāminī śukrakāminī ।। tārā suraguroḥ patnī patnī durvāsasastathā ।। 68 ।। atribhāryānusūyā ca caṃdrapatnyastathaiva ca ।। devakanyā nāgakanyā munikanyāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 69 ।। asaṃkhyakāminīsaṃghaḥ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ ca kaḥ kṣamaḥ ।। tāśca praveśayāmāsurdaṃpatīvāsamaṃdiram ।। 70।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm ।। satīṃ tāṃ darśayāmāsa śivaḥ pūrvālayaṃ mudā ।। 71 ।। sati smarasyato gehādyadgatā tātamaṃdiram ।। adhunā śailakanyā tvaṃ tatra dakṣasutā purā ।। 72 ।। jātismarāṃ smārayāmi nityaṃ smarasi cedvada ।। śaṃkarasya vacaḥ śrutvā sasmitovāca sā satī ।। 73 ।। sarvaṃ smarāmi prāṇeśa maunībhūto bhaveti tam ।। śivaḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro nānāvastumanoharam ।। 74 ।। bhojayāmāsa devāṃśca nārāyaṇapurogamān ।। bhuktvā devāḥ prajagmuste nānāratnavibhūṣitāḥ।।75।। sastrīkā sagaṇāḥ sarve praṇamya candraśekharam ।। nārāyaṇaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ nanāma śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।।76।। tau ca taṃ ca samāśliṣyāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā prajagmatuḥ ।। atha śailaśca menā ca mainākamājuhāva ha ।। 77 ।। śīghramānaya bhadraṃ te pārvatīṃ śaṃkaraṃ suta ।। tayoḥ sa vacanaṃ śrutvā śīghraṃ gatvā śivālayam ।।78।। ājagāma samānīya pārvatīparameśvarau ।। pārvatyāgamanaṃ śrutvā bālāśca bālikāstathā ।।79।। vṛddhā yuvatyo yā yāśca śailāśca dudruvurmudā ।। menā sutābhyāṃ vadhvā ca saha dudrāva sasmitā ।। 80 ।। himālayaśca mudito dudrāvānuvrajansutām ।। avaruhya rathāddevī mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum ।।81।। praṇanāma pramuditā nimagnā''nandasāgare ।। pārvatīṃ ca samāśliṣya menakā harṣavihvalā ।। 82 ।। himālayaśca mudito gatāḥ prāṇā ivāgatāḥ ।। sutāṃ nidhāya gehe sve ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ dadau ।।83।। śūlabhṛte gaṇebhyaśca madhuparkādikaṃ mudā ।। tasthau śvaśuragehe ca sagaṇaścandraśekharaḥ ।।84।। nityaṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjitaḥ saha bhāryayā ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ rādhe śaṃkarodvāhamaṅgalam ।। śokajaṃ harṣajanakaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 85 ।। ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śaṃkaravivāho nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। ।। 45 ।।
<4.46> rādhikovāca ।। suciraṃ ca mṛtaṃ kāmaṃ śaṃkareṇa ca jīvitam ।। ratiḥ punaḥ priyaṃ prāpya kiṃ cakāra mudā'nvitā ।। 1 ।। strīṇāṃ svasvāmivicchedo maraṇādatiduṣkaraḥ ।। punaḥ saṃmelanaṃ bhartuḥ sukhaṃ paramadurlabham ।। 2 ।। śivaḥ satīṃ tāṃ saṃprāpya saṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi।। ciraṃ pranaṣṭavirahaḥ kiṃ cakāra mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 3 ।। kalatravirahaḥ puṃsāṃ sarvaśokātsuduṣkaraḥ ।। punaḥ saṃmīlanaṃ tasyāḥ prāṇadānādhikaṃ sukham ।। 4 ।। ratiḥ puṃso virahiṇī śivaḥ strīvirahī ciram ।। dvayordvayośca saṃprāptau kiṃ babhūva dvayoḥ sukham ।। 5 ।। tadevaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। kṛpayā viduṣāṃ śreṣṭha savyāsaṃ kathaya prabho ।। 6 ।। melanaṃ śaktiśivayo ratimanmathayostataḥ ।। śokāpahaṃ śrutavatāṃ sarvamaṅgalakāraṇam ।। 7 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityuktvā rādhikā devī sasmitā virarāma ha ।। kṛṣṇastadvacanaṃ śrutvā sasmitastāmuvāca ha ।। 8 ।। kṛṣṇa uvāca ।। mṛtaṃ kāmaṃ punaḥ prāpya kāmārtā kāmakāminī ।। svālayaṃ taṃ samānīya harodvāhagṛhādaho ।। 9 ।। bhartuḥ suveṣaṃ vividhaṃ svātmanaḥ svālibhirmudā ।। kārayāmāsa yatnena sā ratī ramaṇotsukā ।। 10 ।। jñātvā kāmastu tadbhāvaṃ kāmaśāstravidhāyakaḥ ।। ratnayānaṃ samāruhya jagāma svālayādvanam ।। 11 ।। śaileśaile'tiramye ca nadyāṃnadyāṃ nadenade ।। dvīpedvīpe sindhutaṭe puṣpodyāne manohare ।। 12 ।। kāñcane bhūminikare vaṭamṛle'tinirjane ।। nadīpulinabhūmyāṃ ca puṣpite puṣpakānane ।। 13 ।। bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokilarutaśrute ।। sugandhivāyunā''kīrṇe dadhatī jalasīkaram ।। 14 ।। citteṣu cetanānāṃ ca haraṇaṃ yoṣitāmaho ।। kalāmānaprakāreṇa śṛṅgāraṃ ca cakāra sā ।।15।। pūrṇamabdaśataṃ divyaṃ sa reme vāmayā saha ।। divāniśaṃ na bubudhe saṃsaktaḥ satataṃ mudā ।। 16 ।। tasthatustau ca tatraiva saṃsaktau satataṃ mudā ।। suratau ca na viratau ratiśāstraviśāradau ।। 17 ।। pativicchedasaṃtāpaṃ vijahau sā ratirmudā ।। prāpya ratnamapahṛtaṃ kaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tyaktumutsahet ।। 18 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ ratisaṃtāpakāraṇam ।। śṛṅgāraṃ śaktiśivayoratulaṃ śṛṇu rādhike ।। 19 ।। śṛṇvatāṃ karṇapīyūṣaṃ paramāścaryamīpsitam ।। sarvasaṃtāpaharaṇaṃ sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham ।। 20 ।। vasañchvaśuragehe sa pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ ।। tadanujñāṃ samādāya krīḍārthaṃ prayayau vanam ।। 21 ।। ratnasyandanamāruhya ratnasāraparicchadam।। ratnasāreṇa khacitaṃ racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 22 ।। śataśṛṅge suvasane malaye gandhamādane ।। nandane puṣpabhadre ca pāribhadre ca bhadrake।।23।। pulinde ca kalinde ca puṃḍre piṃḍārakeṃ'dhake ।। vanevane'tiramye ca sāgarāṇāṃ taṭetaṭe ।। 24 ।। nikaṭe'stagireḥ pārśvavaṭamūle manohare ।। cakāra karuṇāṃ yatra parityajya satī śivam ।। 25 ।। nānāsthāneṣu rahasi paśupakṣivivarjite ।। yathāmanorathaṃgāmī sa reme vāmayā saha ।। 26 ।। yatrayatra śivaṃ nītvā babhrāma dharaṇītalam ।। tatsarvaṃ darśayāmāsa satīṃ śaṃbhurmudā'nvitaḥ ।। 27 ।। kṛtvā vihāraṃ suciraṃ na pūrṇaṃ mānasaṃ tayoḥ ।। mahāśṛṅgāramārebhe sahasrābdaṃ jagatpitā ।। 28 ।। māyātīto'timāyeśo māyāsaktaḥ svamāyayā ।। kālaṃ na bubudhe yogī sukhena kālakārakaḥ ।। 29 ।। śaktiśaktimatostatra na babhūva pariśramaḥ ।। jahatoḥ sarvasaṃtāpamanyonyavirahodbhavam ।। 30 ।। sukhasaṃsaktamanasoḥ pulakāñcitagātrayoḥ ।। kāmabāṇamūrcchitayoḥ puṣpaśayyāśayānayoḥ ।। 31 ।। nagnayoḥ sukhasaṃbhogādratiśāstravidhijñayoḥ ।। nakhadantaprahāraiśca kṣatavikṣatadehayoḥ ।। 32 ।। candanāgurukastūrīsindūrabinduliptayoḥ।। nibaddhakeśakabarīślathayośchinnamālyayoḥ।। 33 ।। vasanānāṃ nūpurāṇāṃ kaṅkaṇānāṃ ca sundari ।। valayānāṃ kuṇḍalānāṃ śabdaiḥ krīḍāṃ prakurvatoḥ ।। 34 ।। puṣpatalpaṃ dalitayorbāṣpotkarṣaṃ ca bibhratoḥ ।। tejasā samayoḥ śaśvatkrīḍayā kautukena ca ।। 39 ।। bhāreṇa viśvaṃbharayorbhārākrāntā vasundharā ।। sā vidīrṇā cakampe ca saśailavanasāgarā।।36।। tayorbharabharākrāntadharāyāśca bhareṇa ca ।। bhārākrānto hi śeṣaśca tadbharārto'pi kacchapaḥ ।। 37 ।। kacchapasya bhareṇaiva sarvādhārā samīraṇāḥ ।। mahāviklavayuktāśca sarvaprāṇāśca stambhitāḥ ।। 38 ।। stambhiteṣu samīreṣu trilokā bhayavihvalāḥ ।। brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।। 39 ।। sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakrurnārāyaṇapadāmbuje ।। nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānuvāca kamalodbhavam ।। 40 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। śṛṅgārabhaṅgasamayo bhavitā nādhunā vidhe ।। kālaprayuktaṃ kāryaṃ ca siddhaṃ tatsamayocitam ।। 41 ।। pūrṇe varṣasahasre ca svecchayā viramiṣyati ।। śaṃbhoḥ saṃyogamiṣṭaṃ ca ko bhedaṃ kartumīśvaraḥ ।।42।। strīpuṃso rativicchedamupāyena karoti yaḥ ।। tasya strīpuṃsayorbhedo bhavejjanmanijanmani ।। 43 ।। yātyante kālasūtre ca varṣalakṣaṃ sa pātakī ।। bhraṣṭajñāno naṣṭakīrtiralakṣmīko bhavediha।।44।। rambhāyuktaṃ śakramimaṃ cakāra virataṃ ratau ।। mahāmunīndro durvāsāstatstrībhedo babhūva ha ।। 45 ।। punaranyāṃ sa saṃprāpya niṣevya śūlapāṇinam ।। divyavarṣasahasraṃ ca vijahau virahajvaram ।। 46 ।। rohiṇīsahitaṃ candraṃ cakāra virataṃ ratau ।। maharṣirgautamastasya strīvicchedo babhūva ha ।। 47 ।। punaḥ śivaṃ samārādhya prāpyāhalyāṃ ca puṣkare ।। divyavarṣasahasraṃ ca vijahau virahajvaram ।। 48 ।। muniḥ svabhāryāsaṃsakte divase nirjane vane ।। brahmāṇḍakasutaṃ nītvā cakāra virataṃ ruṣā ।। 49 ।। babhūva putravicchedastasya kalpāntare punaḥ ।। śivaṃ niṣevya saṃprāpya putraṃ tatyāja viklavam ।। 50 ।। hariścandro hālikaṃ ca vṛṣalyā saha saṃyutam ।। vārayāmāsa niśceṣṭaṃ nirjane tatphalaṃ śṛṇu ।। 51 ।। bhraṣṭaḥ śrīrājyavittebhyastaṃ cakārāvalīlayā ।। viśvāmitro maharṣiśca tāḍayāmāsa taṃ purā ।।।। 52 ।। tataḥ śivaṃ samārādhya dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām ।। sadyo jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ sagaṇo mama mandiram ।। 53 ।। ājāmilaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ vṛṣalyā saha saṃyutam ।। na bhiyā vārayāmāsuḥ surāstaṃ cāpi kecana ।। 54 ।। niṣpanne karmabhoge ca sa madbhakto mumoca ha ।। mannāmasmṛtimātreṇa cājagāma mamālayam ।। 55 ।। sarvaṃ niṣekasādhyaṃ ca niṣeko balavānvidhe ।। niṣekaphaladātā'haṃ niṣekaḥ kena vāryate ।। 56 ।। divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca śaṃbhoḥ saṃbhogakarmakṛt ।। niṣekaphaladātustu niṣekaphalasaṃcayam ।। 57 ।। pūrṇe varṣasahasre ca gatvā tatra maheśvaraḥ ।। yena vīryaṃ patedbhūmau tatkariṣyati niścitam ।।98 ।। tatra vīrye ca bhavitā skandako bhaktatārakaḥ ।। sadā bhadrasvarūpo'haṃ bhayaṃ kiṃ vo mayi sthite ।। 59 ।। adhunā tvaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha bhagavānsvagaṇaiḥ saha ।। karotu śaṃbhuḥ saṃbhogaṃ pārvatyā saha nirjane।।।। 60 ।। ityuktvā kamalākāntaḥ śīghraṃ svāntaḥpuraṃ yayau ।। svālayaṃ prayayurdevāḥ śivaḥ svastho ratau rataḥ ।। 61 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityuktvā rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sakaṭākṣāṃ ca sasmitām ।। jagāma candanavanaṃ nirjane ca tayā saha ।। 62 ।। atīva nirjanaṃ ramyaṃ vāyunā surabhīkṛtam ।। puṣpodyānaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ tatra krīḍāṃ cakāra ha ।। 63 ।। puṣpatalpasamākīrṇe parapuṣṭarutaśrute ।। bhramaravadhvani saṃyukte kāminīnāṃ manohare ।। 64 ।। kṛṣṇasaṃbhogamātreṇa sukhasaṃmūrcchitā ca sā ।। atīva mūrcchitaḥ kṛṣṇo rādhāṅgasparśamātrataḥ ।।।। 65 ।। tasthatustatra saṃyuktau rādhārāseśvarau mune ।। atīvaratiniśceṣṭau kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 66 ।। ityevaṃ maṅgalaṃ karma yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ ।। kadācidbandhuvicchedo na bhavettasya nārada ।।67।। mahāśokārṇave magno bhede putrakalatrayoḥ।। madbhṛtyānāṃ ca bandhūnāṃ māsaṃ śrutvā labheddhruvam ।। 68 ।। sūta uvāca ।। ityuktvā dharmaputraśca virarāma mahāmuniḥ ।। punaḥ saṃpraṣṭumārebhe devarṣiḥ kautukānvitaḥ ।। 69 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṃḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde maṃgalavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 46 ।।
<4.47> nārada uvāca ।। atha krīḍāṃtare rādhā kiṃ papraccha hariṃ vibhum ।। kāṃ kathāṃ kathayāmāsa kathyatāṃ karuṇānidhe ।। 1 ।। ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ।। utthāya sukhasaṃbhogādrādhāṃ kṛtvā puro hariḥ ।। uvāsa malayadroṇīṃ vaṭamūle manohare ।। 2 ।। rādhā taṃ paripapraccha sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। darpabhaṅgaḥ vajrabhṛto nigūḍhaṃ śrutisundaram ।। 3 ।। ।। śrīrādhikovāca ।। śrutaṃ yaśaḥ śūlabhṛto darpabhaṅgaśca daivataḥ ।। pārvatyā darpabhaṅgaśca vivāhaśca tayoraho ।।4।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi darpabhaṅgaṃ harerhare ।। śeṣāṇāṃ ca krameṇaiva vada vyasya jagadguro ।। 5 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। darpabhaṃgaṃ surapatestriṣu lokeṣu viśrutam ।। karṇapīyūṣamatulaṃ sundaraṃ śṛṇu sundari ।। 6 ।। purā śatamakho darpātkṛtvā śatamakhānmudā ।। babhūva sarvadevānāmadhyakṣaḥ saṃpadā yutaḥ ।। 7 ।। dinedine tadaiśvaryaṃ varddhate tapasāṃ phalāt ।। dīkṣāṃ taṃ kārayāmāsa siddhamannaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।।8।। sa jajāpa mahāmantraṃ puṣkare śatavatsaram ।। babhūva mantrasiddhaśca paripūrṇamanorathaḥ ।। 9 ।। brahmasvarūpāṃ prakṛtiṃ saṃpanmūḍho na manyate ।। sā taṃ śaśāpa svaguroḥ śāpaṃ lebhe'tikopataḥ।।।। 10।। ekadā prakṛteḥ śāpāddhatabuddhiḥ svasaṃsadi।। guruṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya na nanāma mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 11 ।। bṛhaspatistataḥ kopānnovāsa gṛhamāyayau ।। na tasthau tārakābhyāśe tapase kānanaṃ yayau ।। 12 ।। uvāca manasā dīno yātu saṃpaddhareriti ।। atha śakro matiṃ prāpya kva gato'to madīśvaraḥ ।।13।। ityuktvā vegataḥ pīṭhājjagāma tārakāntikam।। praṇamya mātaraṃ bhaktyā nataskandhaḥ puṭāñjaliḥ ।।।। 14 ।। sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ kṛtvā rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ ।। putrasya rodanaṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda tārakā bhṛśam ।। 15 ।। vatsa gaccha gṛhaṃ naiva guruṃ drakṣyasi sāmpratam ।। durdinānte guruṃ prāpya punarlakṣmīmavāpsyasi ।। 16।। adhunā karmaṇāṃ bhogaṃ bhuṅkṣva mūḍha durāśaya।। durdine svagurau doṣaḥ sudine paritoṣaṇam ।।17।। sudinaṃ durdinaṃ śakra kāraṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।। ityuktvā tārakā devī virarāma pativratā ।। 18 ।। jagāma śakraḥ snānārthaṃ svarṇadīṃ sumanoharām ।। dadarśa tatra rucirāṃ mārjantīṃ pipīlikām ।। karmaṇā jīvino yāṃti vaikuṃṭhaṃ ca nirāmayam ।। 22 ।। karmaṇā brahmalokaṃ ca śivalokaṃ ca karmaṇā ।। svargaṃ svargasamāsthānaṃ pātālaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।। 23 ।। karmaṇā narakaṃ ghoraṃ svātmaduḥkhaikakāraṇam ।। karmaṇā sūkarīgarbhaṃ karmaṇā kṣudrajīvanam ।। 24 ।। karmaṇā paśupatnīnāṃ karmaṇā pakṣiyoṣitām ।। karmaṇā kīṭayoniṃ ca vṛkṣatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।।25।। svakarmaṇā sukhī duḥkhī sevyaḥ sevaka eva ca ।। karmaṇā brāhmaṇatvaṃ ca daivaṃ cāpi svakarmaṇā ।। 26 ।। svakarmaṇā ca pretatvaṃ brahmatvaṃ ca svakarmaṇā ।। karmaṇā vyādhiyuktaśca karmaṇevātisundaraḥ ।। 27 ।। karmaṇā svāṅgahīnaśca svāṅgavṛddhaśca karmaṇā ।। vidhātā karmasūtreṇa phaladātā ca jīvinām ।। 28 ।। karma svabhāvasādhyaṃ ca svabhāvo'bhyāsajīvakaḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamādhyātmikaparaṃ vacaḥ ।। 29 ।। sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ sāraṃ narakārṇavatārakam ।। saṃsāraḥ svapnavatsarvaṃ devendra sacarācaram।। 130।। mṛtyuśca mastakasthāyī sarveṣāṃ kālayogataḥ ।। jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ jīvināṃ ca śubhāśubham ।। 31 ।। śakra śaśvadbhramatyeva nāviṣṭastatra paṇḍitaḥ ।। ityevamuktvā vipraśca tatra tasthau ca sasmitaḥ ।। 32 ।। vismitāstraidaśādhyakṣo nātmānaṃ bahu manyate ।। etasminnantare śīghramājagāma munīśvaraḥ ।। 33 ।। ativṛddho mahāyogī jñānena vayasā mahān ।। kṛṣṇājinī jaṭādhārī bibhrattilakamujjvalam ।।।। 34 ।। vakṣaḥsthale romacakraṃ bibharti mastake kaṭam ।। sthitaṃ sarvaṃ madhyadeśe kiṃcidutpāṭitaṃ sphuṭam ।। 35 ।। samāgatya dvayormadhye tasthau sthāṇuvadeva saḥ ।। mahendro brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 36 ।। madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। papraccha kuśalaṃ vipraṃ cakāra vinayaṃ punaḥ ।। 37 ।। tuṣṭāvātithibhāvena mudā sādarapūrvakam ।। viprārbhakastena sārddhaṃ saṃbhāṣāṃ ca cakāra saḥ ।। svavāñchitaṃ paraṃ prāha sarvaṃ vinayapūrvakam ।। 38 ।। bālaka uvāca ।। kutastvamāgato vipra kinnāma tava vā vada ।। ko vā'trāgamane heturnivāsaḥ kena hetunā ।। 39 ।। kaṭaṃ kathaṃ mastake te lomacakraṃ ca vakṣasi ।। atyunnataṃ madhyadeśe kiṃcidutpāṭitaṃ mune ।।।। 140 ।। māṃ cetkṛpā'sti te vipra sarvaṃ saṃvyasya kathyatām ।। atyadbhutamidaṃ sarvaṃ śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। 41 ।। sa śiśorvacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca mahāmuniḥ ।। sarvaṃ svakīyavṛttāntaṃ śakrasya purato mudā ।।42।। muniruvāca ।। alpāyuṣā mayā vipra kutrāpi na kṛtā gṛhāḥ ।। na vivāhaścopajīvyaṃ bhikṣopajīvinā'dhunā ।। 43 ।। lomaśeti ca mannāma heturviprasya darśanam ।। varṣaṇātapaśāntyarthaṃ mastakasthaṃ kaṭaṃ mama ।। 44 ।। vakṣasthalasthitaṃ romacakraṃ tatkāraṇaṃ śṛṇu ।। sāṃsārikāṇāṃ bhayadaṃ vivekajananaṃ param ।। 45 ।। āyuḥsaṃkhyāpramāṇaṃ me lomacakraṃ ca vakṣasi ।। śakraikapatanaṃ vipra lomaikotpāṭanaṃ mama ।। 46।। utpāditāni lomāni tena madhye sthitāni ca ।। brahmaṇo dviparārdhe ca mama mṛtyurnirūpitaḥ ।। 47 ।। asaṃkhyavidhayo brahmanmariṣyanti mṛtā api ।। kalatreṇa ca putreṇa gṛheṇa kiṃ prayojanam ।। 48 ।। brahmaṇaḥ patane cakṣurnimeṣaśca harerbhavet ।। tatpādapadmamatulaṃ cintayāmi niraṃtaram ।। 49 ।। durlabhaṃ śrīharerdāsyaṃ bhaktirmuktirgarīyasī ।। svapnavatsarvamaiśvaryaṃ tadbhaktivyavadhāyakam ।। 150 ।। idaṃ madguruṇā dattaṃ śaṃbhunā jñānamuttamam ।। vinā bhaktiṃ na gṛhṇāmi sālokyādicatuṣṭayam ।। 51 ।। ityevamuktvā sa munirjagāma śivasannidhim ।। śiśurūpī haristatraivāntardhānaṃ cakāra ha ।। 52 ।। indrastu svapnavaddṛṣṭvā babhūva tatra vismitaḥ ।। tṛṣṇāmātraṃ ca saṃpattau nāstyeva parameśvare ।। 53 ।। viśvakarmāṇamānīya priyamuktvā śatakratuḥ ।। dattvā ratnāni saṃpūjya taṃ prasthāpitavāngṛham ।। 54 ।। sarvaṃ vinyasya putre ca śaraṇaṃ gantumudyataḥ ।। śacīṃ rājyaśriyaṃ tyaktvā vivekī kṣayakāmukaḥ ।। 55 ।। dṛṣṭvā vivekinaṃ kāntaṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। śacī jagāma śokārtā saṃtrastā śaraṇaṃ guroḥ ।। 55 ।। sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ kṛtvā samānīya bṛhaspatim ।। bodhayāmāsa śakraṃ taṃ nītisāreṇa kāminī।।57।। guroḥ śāstraviśeṣaṃ ca dampatīrasasaṃyutam।। vidhāya ca svayaṃ prītyā pāṭhayāmāsa taṃ mudā ।। 58 ।। muniḥ śāstraviśeṣaṃ ca bodhayāmāsa vākpatiḥ ।। sa cakāra tadā rājyaṃ vṛndāvana vinodini ।। 59 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śakradarpavimocanam ।। sākṣāddṛṣṭo darpabhaṅgo nandayajñe sureśvari ।। 160 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇarādhāsaṃvāde saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 47 ।।
<4.48> śrīrādhikovāca ।। kathito bhavatā mahyaṃ darpabhaṅgaḥ śruto hareḥ ।। darpabhaṅagaṃ raveścāpi śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।। 1 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। ekadaivodayaṃ kṛtvā ravirastaṃ jagāma ha ।। mālī sumālī daityendrau dīptiṃ kartuṃ samudyatau ।। 2 ।। mahāsaṃpanmadonmattau śaṃkarasya vareṇa ca ।। tayośca prabhayā rātrirna bhavediti sundari ।। 3 ।। ruṣṭaḥ sūryaḥ svaśūlena tau jaghānāvalīlayā।। patitau sūryaśūlena mūrcchitau dharaṇītale ।। 4 ।। bhaktāpāyaṃ ca vijñāya śaṃkaro bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। āgatya jīvayāmāsa mahājñānena tau vibhuḥ ।। 5 ।। tau ca natvā śivaṃ bhaktyā jagmaturnijamandiram ।। dudrāva ca mahādevaḥ sūryaṃ hantuṃ ruṣā jvalan ।। 6 ।। dṛṣṭvā saṃhārakartāraṃ jighāṃsantaṃ haraṃ raviḥ ।। bhiyā palāyamānaśca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 7 ।। dudrāva ca mahādevo brahmaṇo nilayaṃ ruṣā ।। śūlamatyarthamudyamya kālakālo vidhervidhiḥ ।। 8 ।। dṛṣṭvā brahmā haraṃ ruṣṭaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। caturvaktreṇa vedoktastotreṇa jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। 9 ।। brahmovāca ।। prasīda dakṣayajñaghna sūryaṃ maccharaṇāgatam ।। tvayaiva sṛṣṭaṃ sṛṣṭeśca samārambhe jagadguro ।। 10 ।। āśutoṣa mahābhāga prasīda bhaktavatsala ।। kṛpayā ca kṛpāsindho rakṣa rakṣa divāniśam ।। 11 ।। brahmasvarūpa bhagavansṛṣṭisthityantakāraṇa ।। svayaṃ raviṃ ca nirmāya svayaṃ saṃhartumicchasi ।। 12 ।। svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ śeṣo dharmaḥ sūryo hutāśanaḥ ।। indracaṃdrādayo devāstvatto bhītāḥ parātpara ।। 13 ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva tvāṃ niṣevya tapodhanāḥ ।। tapasāṃ phaladātā tvaṃ tapastvaṃ tapasāṃ phalam ।। 14 ।। ityevamuktvā brahmā taṃ sūryamānīya bhaktitaḥ ।। prītyā samarpayāmāsa śaṅkare dīnavatsale ।। 15 ।। śaṃbhustamāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā vidhiṃ natvā jagadvidhiḥ ।। prasannavadanaḥ śrīmānālayaṃ prayayau mudā ।। 16 ।। iti dhātṛkṛtaṃ stotraṃ saṃkaṭe yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ।। bhayātpramucyate bhīto baddho mucyeta bandhanāt ।। 17 ।। rājadvāre śmaśāne ca magnapote mahārṇave ।। stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 18 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇarādhāsaṃvāde aṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 48 ।।
<4.49> ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। sūryaḥ praṇamya brahmāṇaṃ mudāyuktastadājñayā ।। cakāra vinayaṃ prītyā tejasvī triguṇātmakaḥ ।। 1 ।। atha vahnerupākhyānaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। gopanīyaṃ purāṇeṣu karṇapīyūṣamuttamam ।।2।। trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartumekadā'gniḥ samudyataḥ।। śatatālapramāṇāntāṃ śikhāṃ kṛtvā bhayānakīm।।3।। kṣubhitaḥ kupitaścaiva bhṛgoḥ śāpasya kāraṇāt ।। svaṃ ca tejasvinaṃ matvā tucchaṃ matvā'nyamātmanaḥ ।।4।। etasminnantare viṣṇurājagāmāvalīlayā।। vahnestāṃ dāhikīṃ śaktiṃ tāṃ jahāra puraḥ sthitaḥ ।। 5 ।। māyayā śiśurūpī ca tamuvāca janārdanaḥ ।। sasmito vinayaṃ kṛtvā bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।। 6 ।। śiśuruvāca ।। kathaṃ ruṣṭo'si bhagavanbhavānmāṃ kāraṇaṃ vada ।। trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartumudyato'si nirarthakam ।।7।। tvameva bhṛguṇā śapto bhṛgośca damanaṃ kuru ।। ekāparādhāttrailokyaṃ bhasmīkartuṃ na cārhasi ।। 8 ।। viśvaṃ ca brahmaṇā sṛṣṭaṃ tasya pātā svayaṃ hariḥ ।। saṃhartā bhagavānrudra evameva kramo bhavet ।। 9 ।। tatkathaṃ bhasmasātkartumīśvare śaṃkare sthite ।। rakṣitāraṃ hariṃ jitvā saṃhāraṃ kuru satvaram ।। 10 ।। ityuktvā brāhmaṇabaṭuḥ śarapatraṃ puraḥ sthitam ।। atiśuṣkaṃ kare dhṛtvā dagdhaṃ kartuṃ dadau mudā ।।11।। dṛṣṭvā śuṣkendhano vahnirlelihāno bhayānakaḥ ।। sa vavre śikhayā vipraṃ meghena śaśinaṃ yathā ।। 12 ।। na ca dagdhaṃ śuṣkapatraṃ lomaikaṃ ca śiśostathā ।। dṛṣṭvā vrīḍāyuto vahnirnistabdho hi śiśoḥ puraḥ ।।13।। kṛtvā vahnerdarpabhaṅgamantardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। vahniḥ svamūrtiṃ saṃhṛtya svasthānaṃ bhītavadyayau ।। 14 ।। ukto vahnerdarpabhaṅgaḥ paraṃ vai śrotumicchasi ।। nityanūtanamākhyānaṃ devānāṃ darpamocanam ।। 15 ।। śrīrādhikovāca ।। śeṣāṇāṃ darpabhaṃgaṃ ca krameṇa kathaya prabho ।। kathāpīyūṣadhārāṃte śrutvā tṛpyeta ko bhuvi ।। 16 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā sasmito bhagavānprabhuḥ ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe śrutvā ramyāṃ purātanīm ।। 17 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde agnidarpamocanaṃ nāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 49 ।। ।।
<4.50> ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। durvāsaso darpabhaṅgaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ।। mahāmuneryogataśca rudrāṃśasyātitejasaḥ ।।1।। ekadā cāmbarīṣaśca kṛtvā ca dvādaśīvratam ।। pāraṇaṃ kartumārebhe bhojayitvā dvijānbahūn ।। 2 ।। etasminnantare tatra cājagāma muniḥ svayam ।। kṣudhārtaśca tṛṣārttaśca viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ।। 3 ।। māṃ bhojaya mahābhāgetyevaṃ sa nṛpamuktavān ।। rājā bhaktyā dadau tasmai paramānnaṃ sudhopamam ।। 4 ।। sakeśaṃ pāyasaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānaṃ śaptumudyataḥ ।। jaṭāṃ nikṛtya śirasaḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhūtale ।। 5 ।। jaṭāmadhyātsamudbhūto jvaladagniśikhopamaḥ ।। saptatālapramāṇaśca puruṣaḥ pralayāṃtakaḥ।। 6 ।। nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ sa rājānaṃ kopena hantumudyataḥ ।। bhayena kampitāḥ sarve śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukāḥ ।।7।। sasmāra ca mahābhīto rājā mama padāmbujam ।। sarvavighrasyopaśamaḥ smṛtimātrādbabhūva ha ।। 8 ।। etasminnantare cakraṃ durnivāryaṃ sudarśanam ।। tejasā mama tulyaṃ ca koṭisūryaprabhopamam ।। 9 ।। āvirbabhūva sahasā sabhāmadhye ca ghūrṇitam ।। nikṛtya kṛtyāpuruṣaṃ dudrāva munipuṅgavam ।। 10 ।। saśaila sāgarāṃ pṛthvīṃ kāñcanīṃ bhūmimuttamām ।। bhrāmayitvā mahīṃ sarvāṃ punardudrāva taṃ munim ।। 11 ।। dhāvantaṃ muktakeśaṃ taṃ bhītaṃ kātaramāturam।। tejasā''cchādya sūryaṃ taṃ dīptiṃ kurvantamuttamām ।।12।। kailāsaṃ saptavargaṃ ca brahmalokamanāmayam ।। viprendro bhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 13।। pādapadme patantaṃ ca dadarśa viprapuṅgavam ।। kṛpayā ca kṛpāsindhurdadau viprāya nirbhayam ।। 14 ।। nārāyaṇavareṇaiva babhūva vijvaro dvijaḥ।। punaryayau hariṃ stutvā nṛpagehaṃ tadājñayā।।15।। rājā munīndraṃ saṃprāpya bhojayāmāsa pāyasam ।। svayaṃ ca pāraṇaṃ cakre sastrīkaḥ sahabāndhavaḥ।।16।। rājānamāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā vipro gṛhaṃ yayau ।। mayā niyojitaṃ cakraṃ bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca ।। 17।। naśyanti sarve pralaye na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati।। sarve devā mama prāṇā bhaktāḥ prāṇādhikā mama।।18।। tvaṃ ca lakṣmīrmahāmāyā sāvitrī vā sarasvatī।। brahmā śaṃbhuranantaśca dharmaśca brāhmaṇāstathā।।19।। gopāṅganāśca gopāśca sarve priyatamā mama।। tebhyaḥ priyāḥ parā bhaktāḥ priyo bhaktānna kaścana ।। 20।। dattvā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca।। tathāpi na pratītirme svayaṃ draṣṭuṃ prayāmi tān।।21।। durvāsaso darpabhaṅgaḥ śruto mattaḥ sureśvari ।। ājñāpaya mahābhāge kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 22 ।। śrīrādhikovāca ।। dhanvantarerdarpabhaṅgaṃ kathayasva jagadguro ।। purāṇe gopanīyaṃ ca śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। 23 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ ।। kathāṃ kathitumārebhe śrutiramyāṃ purātanīm ।। 24 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde durvāsaso darpabhaṅgo nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 50 ।।
<4.51> śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavānsvayaṃ dhanvantarirmahān ।। purā samudramathane samuttasthau mahodadheḥ ।। 1।। sarvavedeṣu niṣṇāto maṃtratantraviśāradaḥ ।। śiṣyo hi vainateyasya śaṅkarasyopaśiṣyakaḥ ।। ।। 2 ।। śiṣyāṇāṃ ca sahasreṇa gataḥ kailāsamīśvari ।। dadarśa takṣakaṃ mārge lelihānaṃ bhayānakam ।। 3 ।। lakṣanāgaiḥ parivṛtaṃ śūlatulyaṃ viṣolbaṇam ।। bhoktuṃ kopātsamāyāṃtamevaṃ dṛṣṭvā jahāsa ca ।। 4 ।। dambhī dhanvantareḥ śiṣyo dhṛtvā takṣakamulbaṇam ।। maṃtreṇa jṛṃbhitaṃ kṛtvā nirviṣaṃ taṃ cakāra ha ।। 5 ।। amūlyaṃ maṇiratnaṃ ca jahāra mastake sthitam ।। kareṇa bhrāmayitvā ca prerayāmāsa dūrataḥ।। ।। 6 ।। niśceṣṭastakṣakastasthau tatra mārge yathā mṛtaḥ ।। gaṇā nivedanaṃ cakurgatvā vāsukisannidhim ।।7।। vāsukistatsamākarṇya prajvalannatikopataḥ ।। sarpānprasthāpayāmāsāsaṃkhyāṃścaiva viṣolbaṇān ।। 8 ।। sarpasenāgraṇīnāṃ ca mukhyānpañca viśāradān ।। droṇakālīyakarkoṭapuṇḍarīkadhanaṃjayān ।। 9 ।। sarve nāgāḥ samājagmuryatra dhanvantariḥ svayam ।। bhayamāpuḥ śiṣyagaṇā dṛṣṭvā nāgānasaṃkhyakān ।। 10 ।। nāganiśvāsavātena sarve śiṣyā mṛtā iva।। niśceṣṭā jñānarahitāḥ śerate dharaṇītale ।। 11 ।। dhanvantariśca bhagavānpīyūṣavarṣaṇena ca ।। jīvayāmāsa śiṣyāṃśca maṃtreṇa ca guruṃ smaran।। 12 ।। cetanāṃ kārayitvā ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca jagadguruḥ ।। cakāra jṛṃbhitaṃ mantraiḥ sarpasaṃghaṃ viṣolbaṇam ।। 13 ।। sarve babhūvurniśceṣṭā jṛṃbhitāste mṛtā iva ।। ko'pi nālaṃ tato devi vārtāṃ dātuṃ gaṇeṣu ca ।। 14 ।। vāsukirbubudhe sarvaṃ sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃkaṭam ।। ājuhāva jagadgaurīṃ bhaginīṃ jñānarūpiṇīm ।। 15 ।। vāsukiruvāca ।। manase tvaṃ samāgaccha nāgānrakṣātisaṅkaṭāt ।। jagattraye mahābhāge pūjā tava bhaviṣyati।। 16 ।। vāsukervacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyovāca kanyakā ।। vākyapīyūṣatulyaṃ ca vinayāvanatasthitā ।। 17 ।। manasovāca ।। nāgendra śṛṇu madvākyaṃ yāsyāmi samaraṃ prati ।। bhadrābhadraṃ daivasādhyaṃ kariṣyāmi yathocitam ।। 18 ।। taṃ śatruṃ saṃhariṣyāmi līlayā samarasthale ।। ahaṃ yaṃ nihaniṣyāmi taṃ ko rakṣitumīśvaraḥ ।। 19 ।। yadi brahmādayo devāḥ samāyānti raṇasthale ।। tathāpi tava śatruṃ ca prajeṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ।। 20।। gururme bhagavāñcheṣaḥ siddhamantraṃ ca dattavān ।। nārāyaṇasya jagatāmīśasya paramādbhutam ।। 21 ।। bibharmi kavacaṃ kaṇṭhe paraṃ trailokyamaṅgalam ।। saṃsāraṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā punaḥ sraṣṭumahaṃ kṣamā ।। 22।। śiṣyā'haṃ maṃtraśāstreṣu śaṃbhorbhagavataḥ purā ।। mahājñānaṃ dattavānsa mahyaṃ ca kṛpayā vibhuḥ ।। 23 ।। śaṃbhośca śiṣyo garuḍo gaṇayāmi na taṃ dhruvam ।। dhanvaṃtaristacchiṣyāṇāmekaḥ kiṃ gaṇayāmi tam ।। 24 ।। ityuktvā sā jagāmaikā tyaktvā nāgagaṇānruṣā ।। praṇamya śrīhariṃ śaṃbhuṃ śeṣaṃ ca hṛṣṭamānasā ।। 25 ।। yatra dhanvantarirdevaḥ prasannavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। tatrājagāma sā devī koparaktekṣaṇā ruṣā ।। 26।। dṛṣṭimātreṇa sarvāśca jīvayāmāsa sundarī ।। viṣadṛṣṭyā śatruśiṣyānniśceṣṭāṃśca cakāra ha ।। 27 ।। dhanvantaristu bhagavānmantraśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। mantreṇa yatnaṃ kṛtavānnotthāpayitumīśvaraḥ ।।28।। dṛṣṭvā dhanvaṃtariṃ devī prahasyovāca satvaram ।। bahūktimarthayuktāṃ ca sāhaṃkārā sureśvari ।। 29 ।। manasovāca ।। mantrārthaṃ mantraśilpaṃ ca mantrabhedaṃ mahauṣadham ।। vada jānāsi kiṃ siddha śiṣyo'si garuḍasya ca ।। 30 ।। ahaṃ ca vainateyaśca śiṣyau śaṃbhośca viśrutau ।। sukalpakālaṃ suciramahaṃ dhanvantare śṛṇu ।। 31 ।। ityuktvā sarasaḥ padmaṃ samānīya jagatprasūḥ ।। mantrasaṃvalitaṃ kṛtvā prerayāmāsa kopataḥ ।। 32 ।। dṛṣṭvā''gataṃ padmapuṣpaṃ jvaladagniśikhopamam ।। (dhanvatariśca niḥśvāsairbhasmasāttaccakāra ha) ।।33 ।। tacca dhanvatarirdṛṣṭvā samaṃtrareṇumuṣṭinā ।। cakāra niṣkalaṃ bhasma tāṃ prahasyāvalīlayā ।। 34 ।। devī jagrāha śaktiṃ ca grīṣmasūryasamaprabhām ।। maṃtrasaṃvalitāṃ kṛtvā prerayāmāsa taṃ ripum ।। 35 ।। dṛṣṭvā jājvalyamānāṃ tāṃ śaktiṃ dhanvatariḥ svayam ।। viṣṇudattena śūlena sa tu ciccheda līlayā ।। 36 ।। tāṃ ca śaktiṃ vṛthā dṛṣṭvā prajajvāleśvarī ruṣā ।। jagrāha nāgapāśaṃ ca ghoramavyarthamulbaṇam ।। 37 ।। nāgalakṣasamāyuktaṃ siddhamantreṇa mantritam ।। prerayāmāsa kopena kālāntakasamaprabham ।।38।। dhanvatarirnāgapāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sasmito mudā ।। sasmāra garuḍaṃ tūrṇamājagāma khageśvaraḥ ।। 39 ।। sarpāstramāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā garuḍo harivāhanaḥ ।। vidhāya cañcunā śīghraṃ bubhuje kṣudhitaściram ।। 40 ।। nāgāstraṃ niṣphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā koparaktekṣaṇā bhṛśam ।। jagrāha bhasmamuṣṭiṃ ca śivadattāṃ purā priye ।। 41 ।। bhasmamuṣṭiṃ mantrapūtāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca preritāṃ yathā ।। pakṣavātena cikṣepa śiṣyaṃ paścānnidhāya ca ।। 42 ।। nirastāṃ bhasmamuṣṭiṃ ca dṛṣṭvā devī cukopa ha ।। jagrāha śūlamavyarthaṃ hantuṃ dhanvantariṃ svayam ।। 43 ।। śivadattaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca śatasūryasamaprabham ।। avyarthaśūlaṃ lokeṣu pralayāgnisamaprabham ।। 44 ।। atha brahmā tathā śaṃbhurājagāma raṇājiram ।। dhanvaṃtareśca rakṣārthaṃ śamanārthaṃ khagasya ca ।।45।। dṛṣṭvā śaṃbhuṃ jagadgaurī vidhiṃ ca jagatāṃ patim ।। bhaktyā nanāma tāveva niḥśaṅkā śūladhāriṇī ।। 46 ।। dhanvantariśca garuḍaḥ praṇanāma sureśvarau ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā tau ca cakraturāśiṣam ।। 47 ।। uvāca brahmā madhuraṃ hitaṃ dhanvatariṃ mudā ।। pūjārthaṃ manasāyāśca lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।। ।। 48 ।। brahmovāca ।। dhanvaṃtare mahābhāga sarvaśāstraviśārada ।। raṇaṃ te manasā sārddhaṃ na hi sāmyaṃ ca me matam ।। 49 ।। śivadattena śūlena durnivāryeṇa sarvataḥ ।। trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣameyaṃ tridaśeśvarī ।। 50 ।। dhyāne kauthumaśākhoktaṃ kṛtvā bhaktyā samāhitaḥ ।। dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ devyāśca kuru pūjanam ।। 51 ।। āstikoktena stotreṇa stavanaṃ kartumarhasi ।। parituṣṭā ca manasā varaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyati ।। 52 ।। brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā cakārānumatiṃ śivaḥ ।। vainateyaśca saṃprītyā bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ ।। 53 ।। eṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtaḥ ।। vidhiṃ purohitaṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 54 ।। dhanvantariruvāca ।। ihāgaccha jagadgauri gṛhāṇa mama pūjanam।। pūjyā tvaṃ triṣu lokeṣu purā kaśyapakanyake ।। 55 ।। tvayā jitaṃ jagatsarvaṃ devi viṣṇusvarūpayā ।। tena te'straprayogaśca na kṛto raṇabhūmiṣu ।। 56 ।। ityuktyā saṃyato bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। gṛhītvā śuklakusumaṃ dhyānaṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 57 ।। cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ sarvāṅgasumanoharām ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śobhitāṃ sūkṣmavāsasā ।।58।। sucārukabarīśobhāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām ।। sarvābhayapradāṃ devīṃ bhaktānugrahakātarām।।59।। sarvavidyāpradāṃ śāntāṃ sarvavidyāviśāradām ।। nāgendravāhinīṃ devīṃ bhaje nāgeśvarīṃ parām ।। 60 ।। dhyātvaivaṃ kusumaṃ dattvā nānādravyasamanvitam ।। dattvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ pūjayāmāsa tāṃ priye ।। 61 ।। stotraṃ cakāra yatnācca pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ ।। puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। 62 ।। dhanvatariruvāca ।। namaḥ siddhisvarūpāyai siddhidāyai namo namaḥ ।। namaḥ kaśyapakanyāyai varadāyai namo namaḥ ।। 63 ।। namaḥ śaṃkarakanyāyai śaṃkarāyai namo namaḥ ।। namaste nāgavāhinyai nāgeśvaryai namo namaḥ ।। 64 ।। nama āstīkajanani jananyai jagatāṃ mama ।। namo jagatkāraṇāyai jaratkārustriyai namaḥ ।। 69 ।। namo nāgabhaginyai ca yoginyai ca namo namaḥ ।। namaściraṃ tapasvinyai sukhadāyai namo namaḥ ।। 66 ।। namastapasyārūpāyai phaladāyai namo namaḥ ।। suśīlāyai ca sādhvyai ca śāntāyai ca namo namaḥ ।। 67 ।। ityevamuktvā bhaktyā ca praṇanāma prayatnataḥ ।। tuṣṭā devī varaṃ dattvā satvaraṃ svālayaṃ yayau ।। 68 ।। brahmarudravainateyāḥ samājagmurnijālayam ।। dhanvaṃtariśca bhagavāñjagāma nijamandiram ।। 69 ।। jagmurnāgāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca phaṇārājivirājitāḥ ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ stavarājaṃ mayā tava ।। 70 ।। vidhinā mātaraṃ bhaktimāstīkaśca cakāra ha ।। tadā tuṣṭā jagadgaurī putraṃ taṃ munipuṃgavam ।। 71 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca yaḥ paṭhet ।। vaṃśajānāṃ nāgabhayaṃ nāsti tasya na saṃśayaḥ ।। 72 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde dhanvantaridarpabhaṃgamanasāvijayo nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 51 ।।
<4.52> ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ।। sarveṣāṃ darpabhaṅgaśca kathitaśca śrutastvayā ।। kṣudrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ caiva kṛta eva na saṃśayaḥ ।।1 ।। adhunā ca samuttiṣṭha gaccha vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। gopikā virahārtāśca śīghraṃ paśyāmi sundari ।।2 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā māninī rasikeśvarī ।। uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ naya māṃ na śaktā gaṃtumīśvara ।। 3 ।। rādhikā vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdanaḥ ।। māmāruhetyevamuktvā so'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha ।।4।। sā manoyāyinī rādhā kṛtvā ca rodanaṃ kṣaṇam।। itastatastamanveṣya vṛndāraṇyaṃ jagāma sā ।।9।। viveśa candanavanaṃ rudantī śokakātarā ।। dadarśa gopikāstatra śokārtā bhayavihvalāḥ।। ।।6।। tāmrāsyā pūrṇanayanā bhramantī sarvakānanam ।। nātha nātheti kurvantīrnirāhārā ruṣā'nvitāḥ ।। 7 ।। tā dṛṣṭvā rādhikā sā ca premavicchedakātarā ।। kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ malayabhramaṇādikam।। 8 ।। tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca sā rādhā ruroda virahāturā ।। hā nāthanāthetyuccārya vilapya ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 9 ।। vinindya kṛṣṇaṃ kopena tarjayāmāsa ca kṣaṇam ।। kṣaṇaṃ śarīramutsraṣṭuṃ kopātsarvāḥ samudyatāḥ ।। ।। 10 ।। etasminnaṃtare kṛṣṇastatra candanakānane ।। svātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa rādhikāṃ gopikāgaṇam ।। 11 ।। rādhā gopāṅganābhiśca dṛṣṭvā prāṇeśvaraṃ mudā ।। sasmitā ca pradudrāva pulakāñcitavigrahā ।।12।। tūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāśliṣya jahāra muralīṃ ruṣā ।। mālāṃ ca pītavasanaṃ bhagnaṃ kṛtvā ca māninī ।। 13 ।। punaḥ saṃdhārayāmāsa vastraṃ mālāṃ manoharām ।। vinodamuralīṃ tuṣṭā vṛndāvanavinodinī ।। 14।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ cakāra tam ।। muhurmuhurmukhaṃ vīkṣya cucumba paramādaram ।।1 5।। kṣaṇaṃ saṃtarjayāmāsa kṣaṇaṃ stotraṃ cakāra ha।। sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tasmai mudā dadau ।। 16 ।। atha gopāṅganāḥ sarvā ruruduḥ premavihvalāḥ ।। sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ cakruḥ svaduḥkhaṃ virahodbhavam ।।17।। dehatyāgaṃ ca snānaṃ ca svāhārasya visarjanam ।। vanevane'harniśaṃ ca śaśvadbhramaṇameva ca।।18।। kṣaṇaṃ taṃ bhartsayāmāsuḥ stotraṃ cakruḥ kṣaṇaṃ mudā।। kṣaṇaṃ dadurbhūṣaṇaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ tasmai ca candanam ।।19।। kāścidūcuḥ prāṇacoraṃ paśya rakṣeti saṃtatam ।। evaṃ punarna karttavya maneneti ca kāścana ।। 20 ।। kāścidūcurimaṃ madhye yūyaṃ kuruta satvaram ।। nibaddhaṃ premapāśena hṛdaye ceti kāścana ।। 21 ।। kāścidūcurayaṃ nāsti pratītirna kadācana।। yatnāccetanacoraṃ ca paśya paśyeti kāścana ।।22।। kāścidūcurniṣṭhuro'yaṃ naraghātīti kopataḥ।। na punarvadate māṃ ca kāścaneti ca nārada ।।23।। nirjanāni ca ramyāṇi yāni yāni vanāni ca ।। bhrameyurgopikāstāni kṛṣṇena saha kautukāt ।। 24 ।। evaṃ taṃ gopikāḥ sarvā madhye kṛtvā sadīśvaram ।। yayurvanāntare yatra suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam।।29।। rāsaṃ gatvā svarṇapīṭhe tasthau sa rasikeśvaraḥ ।। niśi bhāti yathā''kāśe candrastārāgaṇaiḥ saha ।।26।। nānāmūrtīrvidhāyātra saha tābhirjanārdanaḥ ।। cakāra ca punaḥ krīḍāṃ kāmukīnāṃ manoharām ।। 27 ।। svayaṃ rādhāṃ kare dhṛtvā pūrvoktaṃ ratimandiram ।। viśvakarmavinirmāṇamāruroha smarāturaḥ।।28।। candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ suvāsitam ।। tatra campakatalpe sa suṣvāpa ca tayā saha ।। 29 ।। nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। cakāra kāmī krīḍāṃ ca kāminyā saha kautukī ।। 30।। babhūva suratistatra suciraṃ ca tayormune ।। ratiniṣṭhā tayo ramyā viratirnāsti tatkṣaṇam ।। 31 ।। evaṃ tau tasthatustatra rādhākṛṣṇau rasotsukau ।। tasthustā gopikābhiśca suratau kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ।। 32 ।। nārada uvāca ।। ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ vidurbudhāḥ ।। nimittamasya māṃ bhaktaṃ vada bhaktajanapriya ।।33 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। nimittamasya trividhaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। jaganmātā ca prakṛtiḥ puruṣaśca jagatpitā ।। 34 ।। garīyasī trijagatāṃ mātā śataguṇaiḥ pituḥ ।। rādhākṛṣṇeti gaurīśetyevaṃ śabdaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ ।। 35 ।। kṛṣṇarādheśagaurīti loke na ca kadā śrutaḥ ।। prasīda rohiṇīcandra gṛhāṇārghyamidaṃ mama ।। 36 । gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ saṃjñayā saha bhāskara ।। prasīda kamalākānta gṛhāṇa mama pūjanam ।। 37 ।। iti dṛṣṭaṃ sāmavede kauthume munisattama ।। rāśabdoccāraṇādeva sphīto bhavati mādhavaḥ ।। 38 ।। dhāśabdoccārataḥ paścāddhāvatyeva sasaṃbhramaḥ ।। ādau puruṣamuccārya paścātprakṛtimuccaret ।। 39 ।। sa bhavenmātṛghātī ca vedātikramaṇe mune ।। trailokye bhārataṃ dhanyaṃ karmakṣetraṃ ca puṇyadam ।। 40 ।। tato vṛndāvanaṃ puṇyaṃ rādhāpādābjareṇunā ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ ca vedhasā ।। rādhikā caraṇāmbhojapādareṇūpalabdhaye ।। 41 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde rādhāmādhavayo rāsavarṇanaṃ nāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 52 ।।
<4.53> ।। nārada uvāca ।। samatīte pūrṇarāse kiṃ cakāra jagatpatiḥ ।। rahasyaṃ kiṃ babhūvātha tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 1 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। rāsaṃ nivartya rāse ca rāseśvaryā samanvitaḥ ।। svayaṃ rāseśvarastasmādyamunāpulinaṃ yayau ।। 2 ।। tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā nirmalaṃ nirmale jale ।। sārddhaṃ gopāṅganābhiśca jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 3 ।। tato jagāma bhagavānbhāṇḍīraṃ rādhayā saha ।। gopāṅganāśca svagṛhānprayayurvirahāturāḥ ।। 4 ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra rahasi bhāṇḍīre mālatīvane ।। mālatīpuṣpaśayyāyāṃ ramyāyāṃ ramaṇotsukaḥ ।। 5 ।। kṛtvā krīḍāṃ ca tatraiva vāsantīkānanaṃ yayau ।। reme tatraiva rāseśo vasante sumanohare ।। 6 ।। tatraiva ramaṇaṃ kṛtvā yayau candanakānanam ।। candanokṣitasarvāṃgo gṛhītvā candanokṣitam।। 17 ।। ramye candanatalpe ca snigdhe candanapallave ।। pūrṇacandre samudite vijahāra tayā saha ।। 8 ।। kṛtvā vihāraṃ tatraiva yayau campakakānanam ।। ramye campakatalpe ca cakāra ratimīśvarī।। 9 ।। ratiṃ nirvartya tatraiva yayau padmavanaṃ prabhuḥ ।। padmapatrasamākīrṇe talpe'tisumanohare ।। 10।। sārdhaṃ tatra padmamukhyā śītena padmavāyunā।। cakāra sukhasaṃbhogaṃ yayau nidrāṃ tayā saha ।। 11 ।। vihāya nidrāṃ nidreśo dadarśa nidritāṃ priyām ।। śayānāṃ padmatalpe ca sukhasaṃbhogamātrataḥ ।। 12 ।। dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ ca gharmāktaṃ śaraccandraviniṃditam ।। atisaṃluptasindūraṃ luptaṃ kajjalamulbaṇam ।। 13 ।। saṃluptādhararāgaṃ ca saṃluptagaṇḍapatrakam ।। visrastakabarībhāraṃ netrotpalavimudritam ।। 14 ।। ratnakuṇḍalayugmenāmūlyena pariśobhitam ।। rājitaṃ mauktikenaiva gajarājodbhavena ca ।। 15 ।। premṇā svasūkṣmavastreṇa vahniśuddhena mādhavaḥ ।। cakāra mārjanaṃ bhaktyā tadvaktraṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 16 ।। keśasaṃmārjanaṃ kṛtvā nirmāya kabarīṃ hariḥ ।। mādhavīmālatīmālājālena pariśobhitām ।। 17 ।। ratnapaṭṭasūtrabaddhāṃ vāmavaktrāṃ manoharām ।। atīva vartulākārāṃ kundapuṣpasuśobhitām ।। 18 ।। dadau sindūratilakamadhaścandanamujjvalam ।। kastūrībindunā sārddhaṃ paritaḥ pariśobhitām ।। 19 ।। cakāra patrakaṃ gaṇḍayugme citravicitritam ।। pradadau kajjalaṃ bhaktyā netrotpalasamujjvalam ।। ।। 20 ।। cakārādhararāgaṃ ca rādhāyāścānurāgataḥ ।। karṇabhūṣaṇayugmaṃ ca cakārātīva nirmalam ।। 21 ।। amūlyaratnahāraṃ ca stanabhāra yugojjvalam ।। dadau kaṇṭhe ca vaikuṇṭho maṇirājivirājitam ।। 22 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ divyamamūlyaṃ viśvaratnataḥ ।। vāsayāmāsa vasanaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumāktakam ।। 23 ।। pradadau pādayugale ratnamañjīrarañjitam ।। cakārālaktakaṃ bhaktyā pāduṅgulinakheṣu ca ।।24।। cakāra sevāṃ sevyāyāḥ sevyastrijagatāṃ satām ।। aho sevakasaṃbhaktyā śvetena cāmareṇa ca ।। 25 ।। sarvabhāvavidāṃ śreṣṭho bodhajñaḥ kāmaśāstravit ।। kāminīṃ bodhayāmāsa vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 26 ।। premṇā ca pradadau tasyai sadratnadarpaṇaṃ śubham ।। suveṣadarśanārthaṃ ca mukhacandraṃ ca mārjitum ।। 27।। nānāpuṣpairviracitāmamlānāṃ candanokṣitām ।। gaṇḍe saubhāgyayuktāyāḥ saubhāgyena dadau hariḥ ।। 28 ।। kastūrīkuṅkamāktaṃ ca sugandhicandanaṃ tataḥ ।। dadau priyāyāḥ sarvāṅge priyaḥ premabhareṇa ca ।। 29 ।। pārijātasya kusumaṃ dattaṃ rahasi brahmaṇā ।। pradadau tatkabaryāṃ ca lalitāyāṃ ca nārada ।। 30 ।। kamalaṃ nirmalaṃ divyaṃ sahasradalamujjvalam ।। śivena dattaṃ rahasi dadau taddakṣiṇe kare ।। 31 ।। atisāraṃ maṇīndrāṇāṃ maṇiratnaṃ ca kaustubham ।। dattaṃ rahasi dharmeṇa tasyai suprītaye dadau ।। 32।। āsavaṃ ratnapātrasthaṃ dasradattaṃ ca nirjane ।। pānārthaṃ pradadau tasyai kāmonmādakaraṃ param।।33।। mālatīmādhavīkundamandāracampakādikam।। puṣpaṃ sadratnapātrasthaṃ tasyai suprītaye dadau ।। 34 ।। sudurlabhaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisusaṃskṛtam ।। bhakṣaṇaṃ kārayāmāsa samayajñaśca tāṃ priyām ।। 35 ।। sudurlabhaṃ ca viśveṣu vākpateḥ parinirmitam ।। anuttamamamūlyaṃ ca varuṇena rahaḥsthale ।। 36 ।। atisūkṣmamanupamaṃ dattaṃ bhaktyā virājitam ।। vāsayāmāsa vasanaṃ kṛtvā nagnāṃ ca kautukāt ।। 37 ।। devarājena dattaṃ ca gajarājendramauktikam ।। nāsikābhūṣaṇaṃ cāru tasyai suprītaye dadau ।। 38 ।। etasminnantare tatra suśīlādyāśca gopikāḥ ।। ṣaṣṭiḥ satsahacaryaśca rādhāyāḥ supratiṣṭhitāḥ ।। 39 ।। ṣaṣṭisatkoṭigopībhiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ।। āyayuḥ pādacihnena priyasya vahataḥ priyām ।। 40 ।। kāściccaṃdanahastāśca kāściccāmaravāhikāḥ ।। kāścitkastūrihastāśca mālāhastāśca kāścana ।। 41 ।। kāścitsiṃdūrahastāśca kāścitkaṃkatikākarāḥ ।। kāścidalaktakakarā vastrahastāśca kāścana ।। 42 ।। kāściddarpaṇahastāśca puṣpapātradharā varāḥ ।। kāścitkrīḍāpadmahastā mālāhastāśca kāścana ।। 43 ।। kāścidāsavahastāśca kāścidbhūṣaṇavāhikāḥ ।। karatālakarāḥ kāścinmṛdaṃgavāhikāḥ parāḥ ।। 44 ।। svarayaṃtrakarāḥ kāścidvīṇāhastāśca kāścana ।। ṣaṭtriṃśadrāgarāgiṇyo gopikārūpadhārikāḥ ।। 45 ।। golokādāgatāyāśca bhārataṃ rādhayā saha ।। kāścijjaguśca nanṛtustatrāgatya ca kāścana ।। 46 ।। kāściccakruśca sevāṃ ca rādhāyāḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। kāściccakruśca devyāśca pādasaṃvāhanaṃ mudā ।।47।। kāciddadau ca tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣaṇārthe mahāmune ।। evaṃ kautukayuktaśca puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। ।। 48 ।। pratasthau gopikāsārddhaṃ rādhāvakṣaḥsthalasthitaḥ ।। kṣaṇaṃ papau ca mādhvīkaṃ priyayā saha mādhavaḥ ।। 49 ।। kṣaṇaṃ cakhāda tāmbūlaṃ kṣaṇaṃ nidrāṃ yayau mudā ।। kṣaṇaṃ cakāra śṛṅgāraṃ ratnanirmitamandire ।। 50 ।। kṣaṇaṃ jalavihāraṃ ca cakāra yamunājale ।। ityevaṃ kathitā vatsa rāsakrīḍā hareraho ।।51।। svecchāmayasyātmanaśca paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। nirguṇasya svatantrasya parasya prakṛteḥ prabhoḥ ।।52।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvarasya parasya ca ।। kṛṣṇajanmarahasyaṃ ca bālakrīḍanamīpsitam।।53।। uktaṃ kiśoracaritaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 54 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivartte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇarāsakrīḍāvarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 53 ।।
<4.54> nārada uvāca ।। ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ rahasyaṃ babhūva munisattama ।। kathaṃ jagāma bhagavānmathurāṃ nandamandirāt ।। 1 ।। nando dadhāra prāṇāṃśca vicchedena hareḥ katham ।। gopāṅganā yaśodā vā kṛṣṇaikatānamānasāḥ ।।2।। cakṣurnimeṣavicchedādyā rādhā na hi jīvati ।। kathaṃ dadhāra sā devī prāṇānprāṇeśvaraṃ vinā ।। 3 ।। yeye tatsaṅgino gopāḥ śayanāsanabhogataḥ ।। kathaṃ visasmaruste ca tādṛśaṃ bāṃdhavaṃ vraje ।।4 ।। śrīkṛṣṇo mathurāṃ gatvā kiṃ kiṃ karma cakāra saḥ ।। svargārohaṇaparyantaṃ tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 5 ।। śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ।। kaṃsaścakāra yajñaṃ ca samāhūto dhanurmakham ।। jagāma tatra bhagavāṃstena rājñā nimantritaḥ ।। 6 ।। rājā prasthāpayāmāsa cākrūraṃ bhagavatpriyam ।। akrūraḥ prerito rājñā gatvā ca nandamandiram।। 7 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca gṛhītvā sa sagaṇaṃ mathurāṃ gataḥ ।। kṛṣṇaḥ śrīmathurāṃ gatvā jaghāna nṛpatiṃ mune ।। 8 ।। jaghāna rajakaṃ caiva cāṇūraṃ muṣṭikaṃ gajam ।। cakāra pitroruddhāraṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca bāndhavaḥ ।। 9 ।। kubjayā saha śṛṅgāraṃ kṛtvā ca kautukena ca ।। taṃ ca prasthāpayāmāsa golokaṃ gopikāpatiḥ ।। 10 ।। cakāra kṛpayā viṣṇurmālākārasya mokṣaṇam ।। kṛpayā coddhavadvārā bodhayāmāsa gopikāḥ ।। 11 ।। tadopanīto bhagavānavantīnagaraṃ yayau ।। cakāra vidyāgrahaṇaṃ muneḥ sāṃdīpanerguroḥ ।। 12 ।। tato jitvā jarāsandhaṃ nihatya yavaneśvaram ।। ugrasenaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ cakāra vidhipūrvakam ।। 13 ।। gatvā samudranikaṭaṃ nirmāya dvārakāṃ purīm ।। jahāra rukmiṇīṃ devīṃ jitvā nṛpatisaṃghakam ।।14 ।। kāliṃdīṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ śaibyāṃ satyāṃ jāṃbavatīṃ satīm ।। mitraviṃdāṃ nāgnajitīṃ samudvāhaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 15 ।। nihatya narakaṃ bhūpaṃ raṇena dāruṇena ca ।। patnīṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ vihāraṃ ca cakāra saḥ ।। 16 ।। jahāra pārijātaṃ ca jitvā śakraṃ ca līlayā ।। ciccheda bāṇahastāṃśca jitvā ca candraśekharam ।। 17 ।। pautrasya mokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā punarāgatya dvārakām ।। ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa lokāṃśca pratimandiram ।।18 ।। yoge ca vasudevasya tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevīṃ ca dadarśa tatra rādhikām ।। 19 ।। pūrṇe ca śatavarṣe ca sudāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇe ।। punaryayau tayā sārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 20 ।। punaścaturdaśābdaṃ ca tayā sārdhaṃ jagatpatiḥ ।। cakāra rāsaṃ rāse ca puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 21 ।। pūrṇamekādaśābdaṃ ca nivṛtya nandamaṃdire ।। mathurāyāṃ dvārakāyāṃ pūrṇamabdaśataṃ vibhuḥ ।। 22 ।। cakāra bhāraharaṇaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthuvikramaḥ।। paṃcaviṃśativarṣe ca śatavarṣādhikaṃ mune ।। 23 ।। tiṣṭhañjagāma golokaṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca purātanaḥ ।। yaśodāyai ca nandāya vṛṣabhānāya dhīmate ।। 24 ।। rādhāmātre kalāvatyai dadau sāmīpyamokṣaṇam ।। kṛṣṇena sārddhaṃ gopī ca rādhikā ca kutūhalāt ।। 25 ।। nibadhya dharmasetuṃ ca vedoktaṃ ca yuge yuge ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ samāsena mahāmune ।।26।। śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ ramyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam ।। brahmādistambaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva ca ।।27।। bhaja taṃ paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanam ।। svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram।।28।। paramavyayamavyaktaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। satya nityaṃ svataṃtraṃ ca sarveśaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 29 ।। nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca nirākāraṃ nirañjanam ।। 30 ।। iti śrībrahmaivavarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇarādhikāsaṃvādo nāma catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 54 ।। ।। śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ।। ।। pūrvārddhaṃ samāptam ।। ।। ।। śubhaṃ bhavatu ।। idaṃ pustakaṃ mumbayyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇadāsātmajena kṣemarājena svakīye śrīveṅkaṭeśvara(sṭīṃ) mudraṇayantrālaye'ṅkayitvā prakāśitam । oṃ tatsadbrahmaṇe namaḥ। śrīmaddvaipāyanamunīpraṇītaṃ brahmavaivartapurāṇam। atha śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍasyottarārdhaḥ।
<4.55> oṃ tatsadbrahmaṇe namaḥ। śrīmaddvaipāyanamunīpraṇītaṃbrahmavaivartapurāṇam। atha śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍasyottarārdhaḥ। atha pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ। nārāyaṇa uvāca sa eva bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ sarvātmā puruṣaḥ paraḥ । durārādhyo'tisādhyaśca sarvārādhyaḥ sukhapradaḥ ।। 1 ।। nijabhaktātisāghyaścābhaktasyāsādhya eva ca । śaśvaddṛśyaḥ svabhaktasyābhaktasyādṛśya eva ca ।। 2 ।। durjñeyaṃ tasya caritaṃ kāryaṃ hṛdayameva ca । baddhāstanmāyayā sarve mohitāśca durantayā ।। 3 ।। yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ kūrmaṃ dhatte nirāśrayaḥ । kūrmo'nantaṃ vidhatte ca yadbhayena nirantaram ।। 4 ।। bibharti śeṣo viśvaṃ ca yadbhayena ca nārada । sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ śiramaścaikadeśataḥ ।। 5 ।। saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā । śailakānanasaṃyuktā pātālāḥ sapta eva ca ।। 6 ।। saptasvargāśca vividhā brahmalokasamanvitāḥ । evaṃ viśvaṃ tribhuvanaṃ kṛtrimaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 7 ।। yadbhayena vidhātrāca pratisṛṣṭau ca nirmitam । evaṃ viśvānyasaṃravyāni lomakūpairmahānvirāṭ ।। 8 ।। yadbhayena vidhatte ca yadanno dhyāyate hi yam । viṣṇuḥ pāti ca saṃsāraṃ yadbhayena kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 9 ।। kālāgnirudro yadbhītaḥ kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ । mṛtyuṃjayo mahādevo yadbhayāddhyāyate ca yam ।। 10 ।। ṣaḍguṇairanurāgaiśca virāgī virataḥ sadā । yadbhayena dahatyagniḥ sūryastapati yadbhayāt ।। 11 ।। yadbhayādvarṣatīndraśca mṛtyuścarati jantuṣu । yadbhayena yamaḥ śāstā pāpinīṃ dharma eva ca ।। 12 ।। dhatte ca dharaṇī lokānyadbhayena carācarān । sūyate prakṛtiḥ sṛṣṭau yadbhayānmahadādikam ।। 13 ।। durjñeyaṃ tadabhiprāyaṃ ko vā jānāti putraka । yatprabhāvaṃ na jānanti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 14 ।। kathaṃ jānāmi tacceṣṭāmahaṃ vatsa sumandadhīḥ । kathaṃ jagāma mathurāṃ tyaktvā vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 15 ।। kathaṃ tatyāja gopīśca rādhāṃ prāṇādhikāṃ priyām । yaśodāṃ bāndhavādīṃśca nandaṃ va nandanandanaḥ ।। 16 ।। darpahā darpadaḥ so'pi sarveṣāṃ sarvadaḥ sadā । babhañja rādhādarpaṃ ca sudāmnaḥ śāpakāraṇāt ।। 17 ।। anyeṣāṃ bhāvanāhetorbrahmaprāptistathā bhavet । evaṃ kiṃcidvitarkaṃ ca kurute kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 18।। cakāra darpabhaṅgaṃ ca mahāviṣṇuḥ purā vibhuḥ । brahmaṇaścatathā viṣṇoḥ śaṣesya ca śivasya ca ।। 19 ।। dharmasya ca yamasyāpi sāmbasya candrasūryayoḥ । garuḍasya ca vahneśca gurordurvāsasastathā ।। 20 ।। dauvārikasya bhaktasya jayasya vijayasya ca। surāṇamasurāṇāṃ ca bhavataḥ kāmaśakrayoḥ ।। 21 ।। lakṣmaṇasyārjunasyāpi bāṇasya ca bhṛgostathā । sumerośca samudrāṇāṃ vāyośca varuṇasya ca ।। 22 ।। sarasvatyāśca durgāyāḥ padmāyāśca bhuvastathā । sāvitryāścaiva gaṅgāyā manasāyāstathaiva ca ।। 23 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevyaśca priyāyāḥ prāṇato'pi ca । prāṇādhikāyā rādhāyā anyeṣāmapi kā kathā ।। 24 ।। hratvā darpaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ prasādaṃ ca cakāra saḥ । kartā hartā pālayitā sraṣṭā sraṣṭuśca sarvataḥ ।। 25 ।। yaṃ stotumīśo nālaṃ ca pañcavaktraistu śaṃkaraḥ । stotuṃ nālaṃ caturvaktro vidhātā jagatāmapi ।। 26 ।। stotuṃ nālamanantaśca sahasravadanairaho । svayaṃ viṣṇurviśvavyāpī nālaṃ stotuṃ janārdanaḥ ।। 27 ।। mahāvirāṇna śakto'pi yaṃ stotuṃ parameśvaram । kampitā yasya purataḥ prakṛtiḥ paramātmanaḥ ।। 28 ।। sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā yaṃ stotuṃ parameśvaram । mahimānaṃ na jānanti vedā yasya ca nārada ।। 29 ।। ityevaṃ kathito brahmanprabhāvaḥ paramātmanaḥ । nirguṇasya ca kṛṣṇasya kiṃ bhuyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 30 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... uttarārdhe nāradanā... śrīkṛṣṇaprabhāvavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcapañcaśāttamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 55 ।।
<4.56> atha ṣadpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca kimapūrvaṃ śrutaṃ brahmanrahasyaṃ paramādbhutam । anantacaritaṃ dhanyamanantasyācyutasya ca ।। 1 ।। kathaṃ kṛṣṇo mahāviṣṇordarpabhaṅga cakāra saḥ । anyeṣāṃ vā kathamaho tadbhavānvaktumarhati ।। 2 ।। svataḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaritamatīva madhuraṃ śrutau । atīva madhuraṃ ramyaṃ kāvyaṃ kavimukhāttataḥ ।। 3 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca mahāviṣṇorahaṃkāro babhūva sahaseti ca । sarvaṃ mallomakūpeṣu viśvānyevā'hamīśvaraḥ ।। 4 ।। saṃhārabhairavī bhutvā taṃ sa jagrāsa līlayā । syite murdhāvaśeṣe ca prasādaṃ taṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 5 ।। sarvātmanā dhyāyamānaḥ stuto bhītaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ । taccharīraṃ susaṃpannaṃ punareva cakāra saḥ ।। 6 ।। brahmaṇaḥ sahasā brahmanniti darpo babhuva ha । ahaṃ trijagatāṃ dhātā kartā'hamīśvaraḥ svayam ।। 7 ।। matparaḥ pūjito nāsti matparaśca jitendriyaḥ । ityevaṃ manasā kṛtvā bahudarpo babhūva ha ।। 8 ।। taṃ brahāṇāṃ samūhaṃ ca darśayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam । goloke svasamīpe ca vasantaṃ purato vibhoḥ ।। caturvaktraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ṣaḍvaktraṃ ca tato'dhikam ।। 9 ।। śatavaktraṃ ca pratyekaṃ brahmāṇḍaughaṃ ca līlayā । tyaktukāmaṃ svadehaṃ ca vrīḍayā natakaṃdharam ।। 10 ।। punaḥ prasādaṃ kṛpayā taṃ cakāra kṛpānidhiḥ । kālena mohinīdvārā tamapūjyaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 11 ।। svakanyāṃ darśayitvā taṃ sakāmaṃ ca cakāra ha । punastaddarpabhaṅgaṃ ca śivadvārā cakāra saḥ ।। 12 ।। tatyāja lajjayā dehaṃ punardehaṃ dadhāra saḥ । punaścakāra taṃ pūjyaṃ brahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 13 ।। jñānaṃ dadau mahājñānī jñānānandaḥ sanātanaḥ । viṣṇorbabhūva garvaśca jagatpātā'hamīśvaraḥ ।। 14 ।। tamātmavismṛtaṃ kṛṣṇaścakāra rāmajanmani । ahaṃ viśvaṃ bibharmīti śeṣo darpī babhūva ha ।। 15 ।। taddarpaṃ garuḍadvārā cūrṇībhūtaṃ cakāra saḥ । ekadā pūjito nāgairgaruḍaḥ kṛṣṇavāhanaḥ ।। 16 ।। na pūjitaśca śeṣeṇa svadarpeṇa purā mune । garuḍena jitaṃ kodhāttamanantaṃ manasvinam ।। 17 ।। cakāra mokṣaṇaṃ tasya śrīkṛṣṇaśca kṛpānidhiḥ । svayaṃ śivaḥ svadarpācca vivāhaṃ na cakāra saḥ ।। 18 ।। taṃ kṛtvā māyayā mohaṃ kārayāmāsa strīyutam । punarjahāra tatpatnīṃ dakṣakanyāṃ mahāsatīm ।। 19 ।। varṣa śuśoca taddehaṃ kroḍe kṛtvā ca śaṃkaraḥ । nānāsthānaṃ ca babhrāma rudañchokānmuhurmuhuḥ ।। 20 ।। janmāntare punaḥ prāpya tāṃ satīṃ pārvatīṃ mudā । visasmāra ca svajñānaṃ dakṣaśaptaḥ punaḥ śivaḥ ।। 21 ।। punaścā''ṅgīrasadvārā smārayāmāsa satvaram । ekadā sarathaḥ śambhuḥ preritastripure purā ।। 22 ।। hatvā daityaṃ śivadvārā tripurāriṃ cakāra tam । sarvaṃ varaṃ ca sarvasmai dātuṃ śaṃbhuḥ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 23 ।। svayaṃ kalpatarurbhūtvā pratijñāṃ ca cakāra saḥ । vṛkāsuro'nuṣṭhānaṃ ca kṛtvā vavre varaṃ vibhum ।। 24 ।। dāsyāmi hastaṃ yanmūrghni bhasmasādbhavatu kṣaṇāt । jagāda jagatāṃ nātha īpsitaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।। 25 ।। iti labdhvā varaṃ rudrādgacchantaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vibhum । hastaṃ dātuṃ ca taṃ mūrdhni prādhāvatsatvaraṃ purā ।। 26 ।। atīva bhītaḥ śaṃbhuśca jagāma śaraṇaṃ harim । bhagavāṃśca śivasyārthe daityaṃ bhasmīcakāra saḥ ।। 27 ।। śivaṃ yuddhaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bāṇayuddhe purā vibhuḥ । līlayā jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa jaḍībhūtaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 28 ।। samāgataṃ dakṣayajñe śaṃbhuṃ dambhena līlayā । vārayāmāsa bhagavānhastaṃ dattvā ca tadgale ।। 29 ।। kedārakanyakādvārā śapto dharmo'tidaivataḥ । babhūvātikṛśo bhītaḥ kuhvāmeva yathā śaśī ।। 30 ।। tadā tasyāśca śāpānte satye pūrṇo babhuva ha । tripādbabhūva tretāyāṃ dvāparaṃ ca dvipāditi ।। 31 ।। ekapācca kalau so'pi kalerante punaḥ kṣayaḥ । ṣoḍaśāṃśo'tikliṣṭaśca sasmāra canaṇaṃ vibhoḥ ।। 32 ।। tadā satyayugārambhe paripūrṇo'bhavatpunaḥ । punaryugānurodhena krameṇa ca punaḥ kṣayaḥ ।। 33 ।। yamo māṇḍavaśāpena śūdrayonimavāpa ha । tadā punaḥ śatābdānte punaḥ śuddho babhūva ha ।। 34 ।। sāmbo vimātṛśāpena galatkuṣṭhī babhūva saḥ । tadā sūryavrataṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śuddho babhūva saḥ ।। 35 ।। candro darpamadenaiva jahāra ca guroḥ priyām । babhūva darpabhaṅgo'sya yakṣmagrasto babhūva saḥ ।। 36 ।। sūryo darpāttejasaśca hantuṃ śaṃkarakiṃkaram । sumālītyabhidhaṃ daityaṃ jagāmā''śu giriṃ prati ।। 37 ।। aharniśaṃ dīptikaraṃ kurvantaṃ viṣayaṃ raveḥ । sūryeṇa bhīto daityaśca śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 38 ।। sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaraśca jagrāha śūlameva ca । bhīto dudrāva sūryaśca dṛṣṭvā taṃ śūlinaṃ mune ।। 39 ।। jaghāna kāśyāṃ śūlena śūlīkāśīśvaro ravim । mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpya śūlena darpaṃbhaṅgo babhūva ha ।। 40 ।। sāndrāndhakāraḥ sahasā jagrāha pṛthivītalam । āśutoṣo mahādevo jīvayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।। 41 ।। tuṣṭāva śaṃkaraṃ sūryo lajjito'pi bhayena ca । kṛtvā tamāśiṣaṃ tuṣṭo yayau gehaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 42 ।। vibhurgarutmato darpaṃ babhañja līlayā purā । niḥśvāsaiḥ preritasyāpi śivasya vṛṣabhasya ca ।। 43 ।। āgacchantaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā śivaṃ purā । draṣṭuṃ samāgataṃ bhaktyā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param ।। 44 ।। vahnirdapīṃ bhṛgoḥ śāpātsarvabhakṣo babhūva ha । guroḥ svabhāryāhiraṇāddarpaścūrṇo babhūva ha ।। 45 ।। durvāsaso darpabhaṅgo babhūva hyambarīṣataḥ । sudarśanena cakreṇa viṣṇordurviṣaheṇa ca ।। 46 ।। jayasya vijayasyāpi darpabhaṅgaṃ cakāra saḥ । vaikuṇṭhātpatitasyāpi brahmaśāpacchalena ca ।। 47 ।। nṛsiṃheṇa hataḥ so'pi hiraṇyakaśipuryathā । sūkareṇa hiraṇyākṣo līlayā ca rasātale ।। 48 ।। rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca nihatau rāmabāṇataḥ । janmāntare ca laṅkāyāṃ brahmaṇā prārthitasya ca ।। 49 ।। śiśupālo hi nihataḥ kṛṣṇabāṇena līlayā । dantavakraśca sahasā paripūrṇe'tra janmani ।। 50 ।। surāṇāṃ darpabhaṅgaṃ ca daityadvārā cakāra ha । asurāṇāṃ suradvārā virodhena parasparam ।। 51 ।। vidhidvārā darpabhaṅgaṃ bhavataśca cakāra saḥ । bhavānāsīnnāradaśca purā putraḥ prajāpateḥ ।। 52 ।। gandharvaśca pituḥ śāpācchūdrīputrastataḥ kramāt । tataḥ punarnāradaśca prasādādadhunā vibhoḥ ।। 53 ।। mama sādhyaṃ viśvamiti kāmadarpo babhūva ha । taṃ pramataṃ haradvārā bhasmasācca cakāra saḥ ।। 54 ।। punaḥ kṛtvā prasādaṃ taṃ jīvayāmāsa līlayā । aikāntikaṃ ca tadbhaktaṃ sa ca nāstraṃ karoti hi ।। 55 ।। cakāra darpabhaṅgaṃ ca darpiṇo lakṣmaṇasya ca । raṇe śaṃkaraśūlena rāvaṇapreritena ca ।। 56 ।। punastaṃ jīvayāmāsa rāmasya stavanena ca । svayaṃ vismṛtaviṣṇośca brahmaśāpena nārada ।। 57 ।। cakāra darpabhaṅgaṃ ca kārtavīryārjunasya ca । jāmadagnyasya śastreṇāmoghena parśunā purā ।। 58 ।। vipraputrasya maraṇe haraṇe kṛṣṇayoṣitām । karṇena sārdhaṃ samare pārthadarpaṃ babhañja saḥ ।। 59 ।। bāṇasya coṣāharaṇe ciccheda ca bhujānvibhuḥ । bhṛgośca dakṣayajñe ca darpabhaṅgaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 60 ।। parśurāmasya rāmasya vivāho pathi gacchataḥ । babhañja darpaṃ samare rāmadvārā purā vibhuḥ ।। 61 ।। sumeroḥ śṛṅgabhṛṅgaṃ ca vāyudvārā cakāra saḥ । samudrāṇāṃ darpabhaṅgaṃ cakārāgastyabhakṣaṇāt ।। 62 ।। akāle sṛṣṭiharaṇe tatputramaraṇe purā । kopayuktasya vāyośca darpabhaṅgaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 63 ।। uṣāharaṇayātrāyāṃ dvārakāgamane hareḥ । bāṇasya ca gavāṃ hetovaṃruṇaṃ ca śaśāpa saḥ ।। 64 ।। kalahe gaṅgayā vāṇyā nārāyaṇāgrataḥ । sarasvatīṃ ca tatyāja tasyā darpaṃ babhañja saḥ ।। 65 ।। darpayuktāṃ ca durgāṃ ca tyaktvā śaṃbhurhimālaye । kāmaṃ ca bhasmasātkṛtvā tapase ca yayau vibhuḥ ।। 66 ।। lajjāmavāpa sā devī tasyā darpaṃ babhañja saḥ । sā yayau tapase viṣṇoḥ prāptihetoḥ śivasya ca ।। 67 ।। bhārate suciraṃ taptvā devī vīṣṇorvareṇa ca । cakāra svāminaṃ śaṃbhuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 68 ।। mahāsaubhāgyayuktā sā babhūva śaṃkarapriyā । viśveṣu sarvadevīṣu pūjyā vandyā stutā suraiḥ ।। 69 ।। darpayuktā mahālakṣmīrbabhūva sā mahāmune । parābhūtā purā devī jayena vijayena ca ।। 70 ।। praviśantīṃ vibhordvāraṃ dattavā bhaktāya vāñchitam । nivāritā sā dvārācca tena dauvārikeṇa vai ।। 71 ।। yadātmanastiraskāraṃ sābhimānā mahāsatī । smṛtvā hareḥ pādapadmaṃ dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā ।। 72 ।। tadā brahmā maheśaśca viṣṇurdharmaśca bhāskaraḥ । candraśca kāmadevaśca vaiśvānaro dhaneśvaraḥ ।। 73 ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva manavo vighnanāśakāḥ । mahendro varuṇaścaiva jagatprāṇo hutāśanaḥ ।। 74 ।। samāyayūrudantaste padmāyāḥ purataḥ purā । tuṣṭuvuśca mahālakṣmīṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ।। 75 ।।
devā ūcuḥ kṣamasva bhagavatyamba kṣamāśīle parātpare । śuddhasattvasvarupe ca kopādiparivarjite ।। 76 ।। upame sarvasādhvīnāṃ devīnāṃ devapūjite । tvayā vinā jagatsarva mṛtatulyaṃ ca niṣphalam ।। 77 ।। sarvasaṃpatsvarupā tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvarūpiṇī । rāseśvaryadhidevī tvaṃ tvatkalāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। 78 ।। kailāse pārvatī tvaṃ ca kṣīrode sindhukanyakā । svarge ca svargalakṣmīstvaṃ martyalakṣmīśca bhūtale ।। 79 ।। vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrdevadevī sarasvatī । gaṅgā ca tulasī tvaṃ ca vṛndā vṛndāvane vane ।। 80 ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevī tvaṃ goloke rādhikā svayam । rāse rāseśvarī tvaṃ ca vṛndā vṛndāvane vane ।। 81 ।। kṛṣṇapriyā tvaṃ bhāṇḍīre candrā candanakānane । virajā campakavane śataśṛṅge ca sundarī ।। 82 ।। padmāvatī padmavane mālatī mālatīvane । kṛndadantī kundavane suśīlā ketakīvane ।। 83 ।। kadambamālā tvaṃ devī kadambakānane'pi ca । rājalakṣmī rājagehe gṛhalakṣmīrgṛhe gṛhe ।। 84 ।। ityuktavā devatāḥ sarve munayo manavastathā । rurudurnamravadanāḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukāḥ ।। 85 ।। iti lakṣmīstavaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadevaiḥ kṛtaṃ śubham । yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya sa vai sarvaṃ labheddhruvam ।। 86 ।। abhāryolabhate bhāryāṃ vinītāṃ ca sutāṃ satīm । suśīlāṃ sunadarīṃ ramyāmatisupriyavādinīm ।। 87 ।। putrapautravatīṃ śuddhāṃ kulajāṃ komalāṃ varām । aputro labhate putraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cirajīvinam ।। 88 ।। paramaiśvaryayuktaṃ ca vidyāvantaṃ yaśasvinam । bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīrlabhate śriyam ।। 89 ।। hatabandhurlabhedbandhuṃ dhanabhraṣṭo dhanaṃ labhet । kīrtiṃhīno labhetkīrtiṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca labheddhruvam ।। 90 ।। sarvamaṅgaladaṃ stotraṃ śokasaṃtāpanāśanam । harṣānandakaraṃ śaśvaddharmamokṣasuhṛtpradam ।। 91 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavadguṇavarṇane lakṣmīstotrakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyāḥ ।। 56 ।।
<4.57> atha saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca devānāṃ stavanaṃ śrutvā tyaktavā ca rodanaṃ satī । uvāca suprasannā tāṃsteṣāṃ stotreṇa nārada ।। 1 ।। mahālakṣmīruvāca tyajāmi dehaṃ na krodhānna vairāgyoṇa sāṃpratam । idaṃ hṛdi samālocya devāstacchūyatāmiti ।। 2 ।। yasminsadīśe mahati sarvasāmyo ca nirguṇe । sarvātmani sadānande samatā tṛṇaśailayoḥ ।। 3 ।। bhrūbhaṅgalīlayā lakṣmīrlakṣaṃ sraṣṭumalaṃ ca yaḥ । bhṛtye striyāṃ yatsamatā kiṃ kārya tasca sevayā ।। 4 ।। tatpatnīnāṃ pradhānā'haṃ nīrastā dvāriṇā'dhunā । tadbhṛtyabhṛtyabhṛtyena paripūrṇena nepsitā ।। 5 ।। tyakṣyāmi jīvanamahamasaubhāgyā ca svāmini । vahnau ca kāmanāṃ kṛtvā yathā bhadraṃ bhavetpurā ।। 6 ।। yā strī bharturasaubhāgyā sā'saubhāgyā ca sarvataḥ । śayane'bhojane tasyā na sukhaṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।। 7 ।। yasyā nāsti priyaprema tasyā janma nirarthakam । tartki putre dhane rupe saṃpattau yauvane'thavā ।। 8 ।। yadbhaktirnāsti kānte ca sarvapriyatame pare । sā'śucirdharmahīnā ca sarvakarmavivarjitā ।। 9 ।। patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ gurureva ca । sarvakmācca paraḥ svāmī na guruḥ svāminaḥ paraḥ ।। 10 ।। pitāmātā suto bhrātā kliṣṭo dātumidaṃ dhanam । sarvasvadātā svāmī ca mūḍhānaṃ yoṣitāṃ surāḥ ।। 11 ।। kācideva hi jānāti mahāsādhvī ca svāminam । atisadvaṃśajātā ca suśīlā kulapālikā ।। 12 ।। āsadvaṃśaprasūtā yā duḥśīlā dharmavarjitā । mukhaduṣṭā yoniduṣṭā patiṃ nindati kopataḥ ।। 13 ।। yā strī sarvaparaṃ dveṣṭi patiṃ viṣṇusamaṃ gurum । kumbhīpāke pacati sā yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।। 14 ।। vrataṃ cānaśanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ puṣyaṃ tapaściram । patibhaktivihīnāyā bhasmībhūtaṃ nirarthakam ।। 15 ।। ataḥ riṃcinna vakṣyāmi niṣṭhuraṃ patimīśvaram । bhṛtyāparādhairdevasya prāṇāṃstayakṣyāmi niścitam ।। 16 ।। patidoṣe mahāsādhvī patiṃ na niṣṭhuraṃ vadet । yadi soḍhumaśaktā ca prāṇāṃstyajati dharmataḥ ।। 17 ।। patisevā vrataṃ strīṇāṃ patisevā paraṃ tapaḥ । patisevā paro dharmaḥ patisevā surārcanam ।। 18 ।। patisevā paraṃ satyaṃ dānataurthānukīrtanam । sarvadevamayaḥ svāmī sarvadevamayaḥ śuciḥ ।। 19 ।। sarvapuṇyasvarupaśca patirupī janārdanaḥ । yā satībharturucchiṣṭaṃ bhuṅktai pādodakaṃ sadā ।। 20 ।। tasyā darśamupasparśa nityaṃ vāñchanti devatāḥ । tataḥ sarvāṇi tīryāni punanti pāpino hyaghāt ।। 21 ।। ityuktvā ca mahāsādhvī ruroda ca suhurmuhuḥ । uvāca brahmā bhītaśca bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। 22 ।। brahmovāca bhaviṣyati na bhadraṃ ca jayasya vijayasya ca । tvayā na śaptau tau mūḍhau priyāparādhabhautayā ।। 23 ।। sāparādhaṃ ca dharmiṣṭhaḥ kṣamayā na śapedyadī । sarvanāśo bhavettasya niścitaṃ mā ciraṃ sati ।। 24 ।। yadi śaptuṃ na śaktaśca na dṇḍaṃ kartumīśvaraḥ । sāparādhe ca puruṣe dharmo daṇḍaṃ karoti ca ।। 25 ।। sarvaṃ kṣamasva he mārtagaccha priyāntikam । māṃ ca tvatsvāminobhaktaṃ niyojya kṛṣṭikarmaṇi ।। 26 ।। ityuktvā tāṃ puraskṛtvā sārdha devairmunīndrakaiḥ । śīghraṃ jagāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ stotumīśvaraḥ ।। 27 ।। tatra gatvā jagatrāyaṃ tuṣṭāva kamalāsanaḥ । caturvaktraiścaturvaktraścaturvedavidāṃ gurum ।। 28 ।। brahmaṇaḥ ktavanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣaṭvā lakṣmīṃ puraḥ sarām । rudatīṃ namravadanāmuvāca kamalāpatiḥ ।। 29 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca sarvaṃ jānāmi sarvajñaḥ sarvātmā sarvapālakaḥ । sarvaśāstā ca sarvādikāraṇaṃ kamalodbhava ।। 30 ।। bhakte kalatre bandhau ca sarvatra samatā mama । viśeṣato'timadbhaktaḥ kalatrātpara eva ca ।। 31 ।। madbhaktau tava putau ca dvārapālau durantakau । kṣama māmaparāthaṃ ca tayośca bhaktipūrṇayoḥ ।। 32 ।। madbhaktipūrṇo balavāndaityaibhyo na bibheti ca । rakṣito mama cakreṇa bhaktimādhvīkadurmadaḥ ।। 33 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāyo lakṣmīṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi । samānīya dvāraṇakaṃ tamuvācedameva ca ।। 34 ।। mā bhairvatsa sukhaṃ tiṣṭha bhayaṃ ki te mayi sthite । madbhaktānāṃ ca kaḥ śāstā gaccha vatsā''tmanaḥ padam ।। 35 ।। ityuktavā bhagavāṃstatra virarāma mahāmune । yayurdevāśca svasthātaṃ praṇamya jagadīśvaram ।। 36 ।। nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā dvārāpāla uvāca tam । pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। 37 ।। jaya uvāca nāhaṃ bibhemi devaṃśca lakṣmīṃ sunigaṇāṃstathā । tvadīyacaraṇāmbhojadhyānaikatānamānasaḥ ।। 38 ।। iti śrīblahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... nāradanā... utta... lakṣamīvairāgyamocanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 57 ।।
<4.58> athāṣṭapañcāśāttamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca babhūva darpaḥ pṛthvyāśca sarpādhārā'hameva ca । pṛthṛdvārā ca taddarpaṃ jaghāna caiva tatprabhuḥ ।। 1 ।। babhūva darpaḥ sāviñyā vedamātā'hameva ca । kāle cakāra tasyāśca saputrāyā adarśanam ।। 2 ।। babhūva darpaṃ gaṅgayā ahaṃ nivaṇideti ca । jahnudvārā ca taddarpa jahāra jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। 3 ।। jahāra manasādarpa durgādvārā purā mune । virajopagataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhartsayāmāsa kopataḥ ।। 4 ।। praviśantaṃ rāsaguhaṃ gopībhirvinivāritam । dauvārikābhirvetraiśca tāḍitaṃ taṃ ca darpataḥ ।। 5 ।। sudāmnā nijabhaktena rādhā śaptā babhūva ha । devena sahasā dhvastā golokādāgatā dharām ।। 6 ।। vṛṣabhānustriyāṃ jātā kalāvatyāṃ ca nārada । kṛṣṇastadanuraudhena kaṃsabhīticchalena ca ।। 7 ।। samāgato nandagehaṃ tenāhaṃ nandanandanaḥ । sudāmnaḥ śāpavīcchaidapālanārtha jagatpatiḥ ।। 8 ।। punarjagāma mathurāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ । asyāparamabhiprāyaṃ ko vā janāti nārada ।। 9 ।। kathaṃ jātaḥ samāyāte sathurāyāśca gokulam । ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvamaparaṃ śrūyatāmiti ।। 10 ।। yathā jagāma mathurāṃ nandānsa nandanandanaḥ । śokaṃ nando yaśodā ca yathā saṃprapa daivataḥ ।। 11 ।। yathā gopāśca gopyaśca gāvo vṛndāvane vane । vane vane kā vanyāste vanyā jānanti kiṃcana ।। 12 ।। vanaṃ ramyaṃ vanyapadamapi tyaktavā vane vane । śmaśāne vā'śmaśāne vā babhrāma bhāminī mune ।। 13 ।। gramaṃ tyaktvā ca babhrama cetanā'cetanā kṣaṇam । kṣaṇena varjitā sā ca prārthayāntī pratikṣaṇam ।। 14 ।। kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sā śvasiti cintanaṃ kurvatī kṣaṇam । kṣaṇaṃ viśantī talpe ca kṣaṇamtthāya tiṣṭhati ।। 15 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... aṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 58।।
<4.59> athaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarva sarveṣāṃ darpabhañjanam । indrasya darpabhaṅgaṃ ca vistareṇa niśāmaja ।। 1 ।। indo darpātsabhāyāṃ ca ratnasiṃhāsanādvarāt । nottasyau svaguruṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmiṣṭhaṃ ca bṛhaspatim ।। 2 ।। gururjagāmātiruṣṭaḥ svāpamāne samatmaraḥ । tathāpi kṛpayā dharme snehācca na śaśāpa tam ।। 3 ।। vinā śapena taddarvaścūrṇībhūto babhūva ha । anyaścenna śapeddharmātpremṇā vā cātikilviṣam ।। 4 ।। tthā'pi taṃ ca phalati dharmastaṃ hanti nārada । yo yaṃ hiṃsraṃ sāparādhaṃ śapetkopene dhārmikaḥ ।। 5 ।। vināśaḥ sāparādhasya dharmo naṣṭaśca dharmiṇaḥ । tenādharmeṇa śakrasya brahmahatyā babhūva ha ।। 6 ।। bhītastyaktvā svarājyaṃ ca prayayau sarovaram । sarasaḥ badmasūtre ca nivāsaṃ ca cakāra saḥ ।। 7 ।। gantuṃ na śaktā hanyā ca puṇyaṃ viṣṇusarovaram । śreṣṭhaṃ bharatavarṣeca tapaḥsthānaṃ tapasvinām ।। 8 ।। tadeva puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ pravadanti purāvidaḥ । rājyabhraṣṭaṃ harīṃ dṛṣṭvā haribhakto narādhipaḥ ।। 9 ।। balājjahāra tadrājyaṃ nahuṣo nāma dhārmikaḥ । dṛṣṭvā śacīṃ varārohā manapatyāṃ ca sundarīm ।। 10 ।। svargagaṅgaṃ ca gacchantīṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā । navayauvanasaṃpannāṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitām ।। 11 ।। sukomalaṃ tāṃ sudatīṃ vadantīṃ ca mahāsatīm । mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa rājāndraḥ kāmena yauvanena ca ।। uvāca tatpuraḥ sthitvā suvinītaśca dāsavat ।। 12 ।। nahuṣa uvāca thāturgatirvicitrā'hona baudhyā ca satāmapi ।। 13 ।। īdṛśī strī bhagāṅgasya lubdhasya parayoṣiti । īdṛśī sundarī yasya parabhāryāsu tanmanaḥ ।। 14 ।। asyā agre ca kā rambhā korvaśī kā tilottamā। kā vā menā ghṛtācī vā ratnamālā kalāvatī ।। 15 ।। kālikā sundarī bhadrāvatī campāvatī tathā । edāścāpsarasaścānyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 16 ।। imāṃ vihāya mūḍho'nyāṃ kathaṃ gacchati mandadhīḥ । asmākaṃ yobito'syāśca ceṭitulyāśca niścitam ।। 17 ।। māṃ bhajasva varārohe suprīta bhava kiṃkaram । yathā rādhā ca goloke kṛṣṇavakṣasi rājate ।। 18 ।। vaikuṇṭhorasi vaikuṇṭhe yathā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī । brahmaloke ca brahmāṇī yathaiva brahmavakṣasi ।। 19 ।। yathā mūrtirmahāsādhvī dharmavakṣaḥsthalasthitā । pātālatalalakṣmīrvā yathaivā'nantavakṣasi ।। 20 ।। yathā puṣṭirgaṇeṇe ca devasenā ca kārtike ।। varuṇe varuṇānī ca yathā svāhā hatāśane ।। 21 ।। yathāratiḥkāmadeve yathā saṃjñā dineśkre । vāyoḥpatnī yathā vāyau yathā candre ca rohiṇī ।। 22 ।। yathā'ditirdevamātā tava śvaśrūśca kaśyape । yathā himālaye menā pitṛkanyā ca mānasī ।। 23 ।। lopāmudrā yathā'gastye yathā tārā bṛhaspatau । kardame devahūtiśca vasiṣṭhe'rundhatī yathā ।। 24 ।। manau ca śatarupeva damayantī nale yathā । tathā bhava tvaṃ saubhāgyā mama vakṣasi sundari ।। 25 ।। līlayā ca sahasrendrāñchetuṃ śakto'hamīśvaraḥ । nārī vāñchati jāraṃ ca svāmino balavattaram ।। 26 ।। sumerugirikūṭe ca durgameti rahaḥsyale । athavā malaye ramye ramye candanavāyunā ।। 27 ।। viśrambhake surasane kiṃvā nandanakānane । nikaṭe śataśrṛṅgasya puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe ।। 28 ।। godāvarītīranīre samīpe śītavāyunā । campāvatīnadītīre ramye campakakānane ।। 29 ।। śmaśāne'tiśmaśāne ca ramye'tinirjane vane । śaile śaile'tirahasi kaṃdare kaṃdare vane ।। 30 ।। dvīpe dvīpe durgadurgai nadyāṃ nadyāṃ nade nade । samudrapuline ramye sarvajantuvivarjite ।। 31 ।। vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo nirjane sukhaḥ । puṣpacandanaśayyāyāṃ puṣpacandanacarcite ।। 32 ।। māṃ gṛhītvī kuru ratiṃ puṣpacandanacarcitam । brahmaṇaśca varairdevi jarāmṛtyuvivarjitam ।। 33 ।। māṃ kuruṣva patiṃ bhadre nityaṃ susthirayauvanam । suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ dhīraṃ kāmaśāstraviśāradam ।। 34 ।। śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyaṃ candravaṃśasamudbhavam । āgatāmṛrvaśīṃ mahyāṃ tyaktavantaṃ ca yācātīm ।। 35 ।। na mespṛhā parastrīṣu tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā lolupaṃ manaḥ । tyaktā mayā svabhāyaści ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।। 36 ।। athāvā rakṣitāḥsarvā dāsīḥ kṛtvā vahānane । ratnendrasārāṃ mālāṃ te dāsyāmi varuṇasya ca ।। 37 ।। nirjitya varuṇaṃ yuddhe brahmastreṇātitejasā । vahniśuddhaṃvastrayugaṃ jitvā vahniṃ sudurbalam ।। 38 ।। dāsyāmyadyaiva te devi niyojyaṃ māṃ niyojya । maṇīndrasāranirmāṇamakānākānakuṇḍale ।। 39 ।। dāsyāmi devānnirjitya devamātuśca sundari । karabhūṣaṇayugmaṃ cātyamūlyaratnanirmitam ।। 40।। dāsyāmyadyaiva rohiṇyāścandraṃ jitvā'tidurlamam । yakṣmagrastamatikṛśaṃ mamaiva pūrvapūruṣam ।। 41 ।। vinā yuddhena bhīto māṃ kṛpayā vā pradāsyati । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ ktaṇanmañjīrayugmakam ।। 42 ।। dāsyāmyadyaiva pārvatyā bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā maheśvaram । āśutoṣaṃ stutivaśaṃ bhakteśaṃ ce kṛbāmayam ।। 43 ।। sarvasaṃpattidātāraṃ paraṃ kalpataruṃ śubhe । amūlyaratnanirmāṇakeyūrayugulaṃ priye ।। 44 ।। dāsyāmi te'dya gaṅgāyā yuddhaṃ kṛtvā sudurlabham । bahulīyugulaṃ cāru sūryapatnyā manoharam ।। 45 ।। sadratnasāranirmāṇaṃ dāsyāmyadya suśobhane । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ darpaṇāṃ cātinirmalam ।। 46 ।। dāsyāmi te kāmapatnyāḥ kāmaṃ jitvā ca līlayā । krīḍākamalamamlānaṃ kamalāyāśca sundari ।। 47 ।। bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā ca dāsyāmi stutvā ca kamalāpatim । aṅgalīyakaratnāni viśveṣu durlabhāni ca ।। 48 ।। sāvitryāśca pradāsyāmi kṛtvā ca brahmaṇastapaḥ । svayaṃ gītaṃ pragāyantīṃ mūrcchanāśrutisaṃyutām ।। 49 ।। vāṇīvīṇāṃ pradāsyāmi kṛtvā nārāyaṇavratam । ratnapāśakasaṃdhaṃ ca viśvakarmavinirmitam ।। 50।। kuberapatnyā dāsyāmi pādāṅgulivibhūṣaṇama । ityevamuktvā nahuṣaḥ papāta tatpadāmbuje ।। 51 ।। uvāca taṃ śacī trastā rājamārgagataṃ nṛpam । utthāpya taṃ kare dhūtvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā ।। smāraṃ smāraṃ padāmbhojaṃ mahāsādhvī harerguroḥ ।। 52 ।। śacyuvāca śṛṇu vatsa mahārāja he tāta bhayabhañjana ।। 53 ।। bhayatrātā ca rājā ca sarveṣāṃ pālakaḥ pitā । bhraṣṭaśrīśca mahendro'dya tvaṃ ca svarge nṛpo'dhunā ।। 54 ।। yo rājā sa pitā pātā prajānāmeva niścitam । gurupatnī rājapatnī devapatnī tathā vadhūḥ ।। 55 ।। pitroḥ svasā śiṣyapatnī bhṛtyapalī ca mātulī । pitṛpatnī bhrātṛpatnī śvaśrūśca bhaginī sutā ।। 56 ।। garbhadhātrīṣṭadevī ca puṃsaḥ ṣoḍaśa mātaraḥ । tvaṃ naro devabhāryā'haṃ mātā te devasaṃmatā ।। 57 ।। gaccha vatsāditiṃ rantuṃ yadi cecchasi mātaram । sarveṣāṃ niṣkṛtiścāstina vatsa mātṛgāminām ।। 58 ।। kumbhīpāke ne pacanti yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ । tato bhavanti kṛmayaḥ kalpāḥ spata bhavanti te ।। 59 ।। tataśca kuṣṭhino mlecchā bhavanti saptajanmasu । nāstayeva niṣkṛtisteṣāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 60 ।। evaṃ viṭkṣattraśūdrāṇāṃ brahmaṇīgamane nṛpa । vaideṣu niṣkṛtirnāsti cetyāṅgirasabhāṣitam ।। 61 ।। svargasaṃpattibhogaśca sukhaṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ dhruvam । mumukṣūṇāṃ ca mokṣaṇca tapaścaiva tavasvinām ।। 62 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ ca brahmaṇyaṃ munīnāṃ maunameva ca । vedābhyāso vaidikānāṃ kavīnāṃ kāvyavarṇanam ।। 63 ।। viṣṇudāsyaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ viṣṇubhaktirasaṃ param । viṣṇubhaktiṃ vinā naiva muktiṃ vāñchanti vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 64 ।। malāḍhaceṣu ca kledeṣu durgandhinilayeṣu ca । sādhūnāṃ kiṃ sukaṃ sādho strīṇāṃ yoniṣu māṃ vada ।। 65 ।। kulapradība rājendra rājñaṃ maṇḍalavartinām । labdhaṃ ca bhārate janma puṇyena bahujanmanām ।। 66 ।। padmānāṃ candravaṃśyānāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ dīptihetave । tvamāvirāsīstejasvī grūṣmamadhyāhnabhāskaraḥ ।। 67 ।। sarveṣāmaśramāṇāṃ ca svadharmaśca yaśaḥ param । svadharmahīnā narake patanti mūḍhayetasaḥ ।। 68 ।। brāhmaṇasyā svadharmaśca trisaṃdhyamarcanaṃ hareḥ । tatpādodakanaivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ ca sudhādhikam ।। 69 ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtramanivedya harernṛpa । bhavanti sūkarāḥsarve brāhmaṇā yadibhuñjate ।। 70 ।। ājīvaṃ bhuñjate viprā ekādaśyāṃ na bhuñjate । kṛṣṇajanmadine caiva śivarātrau suniścetam ।। 71 ।। tathā rāmanavabhyāṃ ca yatnataḥ puṇyavāsare । brāhmaṇānāṃ svadharmaśca kathito brahmaṇā nṛpa ।। 72 ।। vrataṃ pativratānāṃ ca patisevā paraṃ tapaḥ । yathā putraḥ parapatireṣa dharmaśca yoṣitām ।। 73 ।। pālayanti yathā bhūpāḥ prajāḥ putrānivaurasān । prajāstriyaṃ ca paśyanti rājāno mātaraṃ yathā ।। 74 ।। yajñaṃ kurvanti viṣṇośca sevanaṃ devaviprayoḥ । nivāraṇaṃ ca duṣṭānāṃ śiṣṭānāṃ pratipālanam ।। 75 ।। iti dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ kathito brahmaṇā purā । vāṇijyaṃ caiva vaiśyānāṃ svadharmo dharmasaṃcayaḥ ।। 76 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ viprasevā ca paro dharmeṃ vidhīyate । sarvanyāso harau bhūva dharmaḥ saṃnyāsināṃ dhruvam ।। 77 ।। raktaikavāsā daṇḍī ca bibharti mṛtkamaṇḍalum । sarvatra samadarśo ca smarennānāyaṇaṃ sadā ।। 78 ।। karoti bhramaṇaṃ nityaṃ gehe gehe na tiṣṭhati । vidyāmantraṃ ca kasmaicinna dadāti ca lobhataḥ ।। 79 ।। karoti nā''śramaṃ bhikṣuḥ karoti nānyavāsanām । karoti nānyasaṅgaṃ ca nirmoha saṅgavarjitaḥ ।। 80 ।। na svādubhuṅkte lobhāccā strīmukhaṃ na hi paśyati । na vāñchitaṃ bhakṣyavastu yācate guhiṇāṃ vratī ।। 81 ।। iti saṃnyāsināṃ dharma ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ । iti te kathitaṃ putra gaccha vatsa yathāsukham ।। 82 ।। ityuktvā ca mahendrāṇī virarāma ca vartmani । uvāca nahuṣo rājā śacīṃ vakraprakaṃdharaḥ ।। 83 ।। nahuṣa uvāca tvayā yatkathitaṃ devī sarva tatu viparyayam । yathārthadharmaṃ vedoktaṃ nibodha kathāyāmi te ।। 84 ।। karmaṇāṃ phalabhogaśca sarveṣāṃ surasundari । naiva svarge na pātāle nānyadvīpe śrutau śrutam ।। 85 ।। kṛtvā śubhāśubhaṃ karma puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate । anyatra tatphalaṃ bhuṅkte karmī karmanibandhanāt ।। 86 ।। himālayādāsamudraṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam । śreṣṭhaṃ sarvasthalānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca tapaḥsthalam ।। 87 ।। tatra labdhvā janma jīvī vañcito viṣṇumāyayā । śaśvatkaroti viṣayaṃ vihāya sevanaṃ hareḥ ।। 88 ।। kṛtvā tatra mahatpuṇyaṃ svarga gacchati puṇyavān । gṛhītvā sarvakanyāśca ciraṃ svarge pramodate ।। 89 ।। svargamāgacchati naro vihāya mānavīṃ tanum । svaśarīreṇā''gato'haṃ matpuṇyaṃ paśya sundari ।। 90 ।। anekajanmapuṇyena cā''gataḥ svargamīpsitam । tataḥ kiṃ kena puṇyena darśanaṃ me tvayā saha ।। 91 ।। na hi karmasthalamidaṃ svabhogasthalameva ca । sāraṃ ca sarvabhogānāṃ varastrībhogameva ca ।। 92 ।। bhogasthale bhogavastu na hi tyaktuṃ praśasyate । bhāvānuraktā rasikā bhogyā tvaṃ bhogināmiha ।। 93 ।। dravyamasvāmikaṃ bhogyaṃ sukhaṃ tyajati sandadhīḥ । avirodhasukhatyāgī paśureva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 94 ।। gaccha kānte guhaṃ gatvā kuru talpaṃ manoharam । ramaṇīyaṃ ca rahasi varaṃ ratikaraṃ param ।। 95 ।। tyaja dvaidhaṃ ca manaso niścitaṃ varavarṇiri । varānane mayā sārdhaṃ modasva varamandire ।। 96 ।। amūlyaratnamālāṃ ca maṇirājavirājitām । bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā ca dāsyāmi lakṣmīvakṣasi śobhitām ।। 97 ।। maṇiṃ cānantaśirasaḥ sarveṣāmatidurlabham । duṣprāpyaṃ triṣulokeṣu tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi sundari ।। 98 ।। maṇiratnaṃ kaustubhaṃ ca yo nārāyaṇavakṣasi । bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā tu dāsyāmi kṛtvā nārāyaṇavratam ।। 99 ।। candraśekharamauleśca yadardhaṃ candrabhūṣaṇam । jarāmṛtyuvyādhiharaṃ śaktaṃ krīḍākaraṃ varam ।। 100 ।। atīva viśvaduṣprāpyaṃ viśvavandyaṃ ca sundaram । viśvanāthavrataṃ kṛtvā tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi niścitam ।। 101 ।। dāsyāmi te śrīsūryasya maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ syamantakam । bhaktyā sūryavrataṃ kṛtvā triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।। 102 ।। aṣṭau bhārānsuvarṇaṃ ca yaśca nityaṃ prasūyate । jarāsṛtyuharaṃ cava paraṃ krīḍākaraṃ priye ।। 103 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ pātraratnaṃ manoharam । saṃtataṃ madhṛpūrṇaṃ ca dāsyāmi madanasya ca ।। 104 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ suryatulyaṃ ca tejasā । nānacitravicitrāḍhyaṃ nirmāṇamīśvarecchayā ।। 105 ।। nirmalaṃ maṇḍalākāraṃ saṇirājavirājitam । hastalakṣaparimitaṃ caturasraṃ ca sundari ।। 106 ।। padmāpadmāsanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ preṣṭhaṃ tasyā sudurlabham । dhruvaṃ tumyaṃ pradāsyāmi kṛtvā padmālayāvratam ।। 107 ।। ityevamuktvā nahuṣaḥ kṛtvā vartmaniraudhanam । punaḥ papāta caraṇe mahendrāṇyā muhurmuhuḥ ।। 108 ।। nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukā । tamuvāca mahendrāṇī smāraṃ smāraṃ guruṃ harim ।। 109 ।। śacyuvāca acetanasya mūḍhasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ । śroṣyāmyadya katividhāṃ kathāṃ kāmāturasya ca ।। 110 ।। madhumattaḥ surāsattaḥ kāmamatto dicetanaḥ । mṛtyuṃ na gaṇacetkāmī kāmena hṛtamānasaḥ ।। 111 ।। tyaja māmadha he matta mātṛtulyāṃ rajakvalām । ṛtoḥ prathāmo divaso hyadya he nṛpa me dhruvam ।। 112 ।। prathame divase strī ca cāṇḍālī sā rajasvalā । dvitīye divase mlecchā tṛtīye rajakī tathā ।। 113 ।। śuddhā bhartuścaturye'hni na śuddhā daivapai yayauḥ । asacchūdrāsamā sā ca taddine ca paraṃ prati ।। 114 ।। prathame divase kāntāṃ yo hi gacchedrajasvalām । brahmahatyācaturthāśaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 115 ।। sa pumānna ri karmārhoṃ daive pitrye ca karmaṇi । adhamaḥ sa ca sarveṣāṃ ninditaśca yaśaskaraḥ ।। 116 ।। dvitīye divase nārīṃ yo vrajecca rajasvalām । kāmataḥ paripūrṇāñca gohatyāṃ labhate dhruvam ।। 117 ।। ājīvanaṃ nādhikārī pitṛviprasurārcane । amanuṣyo'yaśasyaḥ syādityāṅgirasabhāṣitam ।। 118 ।। dṛtīye divase jāyāṃ yo hi gacchedrajasvalām । sa mūḍho bhrūṇahatyāṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayāḥ ।। 119 ।। pūrvavatpatitaḥ so'pi na cārhaḥ sarvakarmasu । asacchūdrā caturthe'hni na gacchettāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। yadi māṃ mātaraṃ mūḍha grahīṣyasi balena ca ।। 120 ।। ṛtāvatīte divase gamanaṃ ca kariṣyasi । śacyāśca vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya nahuṣastayā ।। 121 ।। uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ śakrakāntāṃ ca suvratām । devapatnī sadā śuddhā tannyūnaṃ mānavaṃ prati ।। 122 ।। śayane bhojane devī nāśuddhā mānavaṃ prati । rajasvalāyāḥ saṃbhoge karmakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 123 ।। tvayoktaṃ ca bhavetpā paṃ nātra du (sva)rge ca sundari । karmakṣetre'pi tatkarma yadvedoktaṃ śubhāśubham ।। 124 ।। na bhavedvaiṣṇavānāṃ ca jvalatāṃ brahmatejasā । yathā pradīpte vahnau ca śuṣkāṇi ca tṛṇāni ca ।। 125 ।। bhavanti bhasmībhūtāni tathā pāpāni vaiṣṇape । vahnisūryabrāhmaṇebhyastejayānvaiṣṇapaḥ sadā ।। 126 ।। rakṣito viṣṇucakreṇa svatantro mattakuṃjaraḥ । na vicāro na bhogaśca paiṣmavānāṃ svakarmaṇām ।। 127 ।। nikhitaṃ sāmni kauthumyāṃ kuru praśnaṃ bṛhaspatīm । asmāṃśca sarve jānanti candravaṃśyāṃśca vaiṣṇavān ।। 128 ।। devamanyaṃ na sevante candravaṃśyā hariṃ vinā । sadvaṃśaprabhavo yo hi brahmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo'thavā ।। 129 ।। viṣṇumantraṃ na gṛṇhāti vañcito devamāyayā । ko vā mantraśca ke devā na hi śāstā yamo mama ।। 130 ।। sarvāñchāstuṃ samartho'haṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivānvinā । śayyāṃ kṛru guhaṃ gatvā śīghraṃ yāsyāmi te gṛham ।। 131 ।। ṛtupāpaṃ mayi bhavettava kiṃ gaccha śobhane । ityuktvā nahuṣo rājā praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। 132 ।। ratnayānaṃ samāruhya yayau nandanakānanam । na yayau sā śacī gehaṃ prajagāma gurorgṛham ।। 133 ।। gatva kūśāsanasyaṃ ca dadarśa ca bṛhaspatim । tārāsevitapādābjaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 134 ।। japamālākaraṃ śaśvajjapantaṃ kṛṣṇamīpsitam । paramaṃ paramānandaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 135 ।। nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca svatantraṃ prakṛteḥ param । svecchāmayaṃ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 136 ।। tamānandāśrunetraṃ ca nanāma śinakā bhuvi । rudatī sāśrunetrā kā majjantī bhaktisāgare ।। 137 ।। śokārṇave nimajjantī hṛdayena vidūyatā । tuṣṭāva bhītā svaguruṃ brahmiṣṭhaṃ ca kṛpānidhim ।। 138 ।। śacyuvāca rakṣa rakṣa mahābhāga māṃ bhītāṃ śaraṇāgatām । tvamīśvaraḥ svadāsīṃ ca nimagnāṃ śokasāgare ।। 139 ।। anīśvaraśceśvaro vā baravānvā sudurbalaḥ । svaśiṣyabhāryāṃ putrāṃśca śāsituṃ ca sadā kṣamaḥ ।। 140 ।। dūrībhūtaḥ svarājyācca svaśiṣyaśca kṛtastvayā । śāntirbabhūva doṣasya cādhunā'nugrahaṃ kuru ।। 141 ।। anāthāṃ sarvaśūnyāṃ māṃ śunyāṃ tāmamarāvatīm । saṃpacchūnyamāśramaṃ me paśya rakṣa kṛṇānidhe ।। 142 ।। dasyugrastāṃ ca māṃ rakṣa deśaṃ kiṃkaramānaya । dattavā caraṇareṇūṃstaṃ śubhāśīrvacanaṃ kuru ।। 143 ।। sarveṣāṃ ca suruṇāṃ ca janmadātā paro guruḥ । pituḥ śataguṇā mātā pūjyā vandyā garīyasī ।। 144 ।। vidyādātā mantradātā jñānado haribhaktidaḥ । pūjyo vandyaśca sevyaśca mātuḥ śataguṇo guruḥ ।। 145 ।। mantrādyudgiraṇenaiva gururityucyate budhaiḥ । anyo vandyo gururayamanyaścāropito guruḥ ।। 146 ।। ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāñjanaśalākayā । cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ ।। 147 ।। adīkṣitasya mūrkhasya niṣkṛtirnāsti ni ścitam । sarvakarmasvanarhasya narake tatpaśoḥ sthitiḥ ।। 148 ।। janmadātā'nnadātā ca mātā'nye guravāstathā । pāraṃ kartuṃ na śaktāste ghorasaṃsārasāgare ।। 149 ।। vidyāmantrajñānadātā nipuṇaḥ pārakarmaṇi । sa śaktaḥ śiṣyamuddhartumīśvaraśceśvarātparaḥ ।। 150 ।। gururviṣṇurgururbrahmā gururdevo maheśvaraḥ । gururdharmo guruḥ śeṣaḥ sarvātmā nirguṇo guruḥ ।। 151 ।। sarvatīrthāśrayaścaiva karvadevāśrayo guruḥ । sarvavedasvarupaśca gururūpī hariḥ svayam ।। 152 ।। abhīṣṭadeve ruṣṭe ca guruḥśakto hi rakṣitum । gurau ruṣṭe'bhīṣṭadevo na hi śaktaśca rakṣitum ।। 153 ।। sarve grahāśca yaṃ ruṣṭā yaṃ ruṣṭā devabrāhmaṇāḥ । tvameva ruṣṭo bhavasi gurureva hi devatāḥ ।। 154 ।। na gurośca priyaścā''tmā na gurośca priyaḥ sutaḥ । dhanaṃ priyaṃ ca na gurorna ca bhāryā priyā tathā ।। 155 ।। na gurośca priyo dharmo na gurośca priyaṃ tapaḥ । na gurośca priyaṃ satyaṃ na puṇyaṃ ca guroḥ param ।। 156 ।। guroḥ paro na śāstā ca na hi bandhurguroḥ paraḥ । devo rājā ca śāstā ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca sadā guruḥ ।। 157 ।। yāvacchakto dātumannaṃ tāvacchāstā tadannadaḥ । guruḥ śāstā ca śiṣyāṇāṃ pratijanmani janmani ।। 158 ।। mantro vidyā gururdevaḥ pūrvalabdho yathā patiḥ । pratijanmani bandhena sarveṣāmupari sthitaḥ ।। 159 ।। pitā guruśca vandyaśca yatra janmani janmadaḥ । guravo'nye tathā mātā guruśca pratijanmani ।। 160 ।। viprāṇāṃ tvaṃ variṣṭhaśca gariṣṭhaśca tapastinām । brahmiṣṭhau brahmavidbrahmavidbrahman dharmiṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmiṇām ।। 161 ।। tuṣṭo bhava muniśreṣṭha māṃ ca śakraṃ ca saṃpratam । tvayi tuṣṭe sadā tuṣṭā bhavanti grahadevatāḥ ।। 162 ।। ityuktvā kā śacī brahmanpunaruccau ruroda ha । dṛṣṭvā tadrodanaṃ tārā rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ ।। 163 ।। papāta caraṇe tārā ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ । aparādhaṃ kṣametyuktvā gurustuṣṭo'pyuvāca tām ।। 164 ।। gururuvāca uttiṣṭha tāre śacyāśca sarva bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati । sadyaḥ prāpsyati bhartāraṃ mahendraṃ ca madāśiṣā ।। 165 ।। ityuktvā sa gurustatra virarāma ca nārada । papāta caraṇe tārā punareva ruroda ca ।। 166 ।। guhītvā ca śacīṃ tārā saṃsthāpya ca svavakṣaki । bodhayāmāsa vividhamādhyātmikamanuttamam ।। 167 ।। śacīkṛtaṃ gurustotraṃ pūjākāle ca yaḥ paṭhet । guruścābhīṣṭadevaśca saṃtuṣṭaḥ pratijanmani ।। 168 ।। grahadevadvijāstaṃ ca parituṣṭāśca saṃtatam । rājāno bāndhavāścaiva saṃtuṣṭāḥ sarvataḥ sadā ।। 169 ।। gurubhaktiṃ viṣṇubhaktiṃ vāñchitaṃ labhate dhruvam । sadā harṣo bhavettasya na ca śokaḥ kadācana ।। 170 ।। putrārtho labhate putraṃ bhāryārtho labhate priyam । susvarupāṃ guṇavatīṃ satīṃ putravatīṃ dhruvam ।। 171 ।। rogārtoṃ mucyate rogādbaddho mucyota bandhanāt । aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkhobhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। 172 ।। kadācidbandhuvicchedo na bhavettasya niścitam । nityaṃ tadvardhate dharmoṃ vipulaṃ nirmalaṃ yaśaḥ ।। 173 ।। labhate paramaiśvaryaṃ putrapautradhanānvitam । iha sarvasukhaṃ bhuktvā prāpyate śrīhareḥ padam ।। 174 ।। na bhavettatpunarjanma haridāsyaṃ labheddhruvam । viṣṇubhaktinamābdhau ca nimagnaśca bhaveddhruvam ।। 175 ।। śāśvatpibati śāntiśca viṣṇubhaktirasāmṛtam । janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiśokasaṃtāpanāśanam ।। 176 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... mahendradarpabhaṅgaprakaraṇe śacīśokāpanodane śacīkṛtagurustotrakathanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 59 ।।
<4.60> atha ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śācostotraṃ samākarṇya parituṣṭo bṛhaspatiḥ । uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ kāntāmindrasya nārada ।। 1 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca tyaja vatse bhayaṃ sarva bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite । yathā kacasya patnī me tathā tvamapi śobhane ।। 2 ।। yathā putraśtathā śiṣyo na bhedaḥ putraśiṣyayoḥ । tarpaṇe pitṛdāne ca pālane paritoṣaṇo ।। 3 ।। yathā'gnidātā putraśca tathā śiṣyaśca
