niścitam । itīdaṃ kaṇvaśākhāyāmuvāca kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 4 ।। pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiśuścānāthabāndhavāḥ । ete puṃsāṃ nityapoṣyā ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 5 ।। yaścaitāṃśca na puṣṇāti bhasmāntaṃ tasya sūtakam । daive pitrye na karmārhaḥ mo'pītyāha maheśvaraḥ ।। 6 ।। kurute naraburddhi ca mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum । ayaśastasya sarvatra vidhna eva pade pade ।। 7 ।। saṃpanmatto yaḥ karoti svagurośca parābhavam । acinātsarvanāśāśca bhavettasya suniścitam ।। 8 ।। māṃ ca dṛṣṭavā sabhāmadhye nottasathau pākaśāsanaḥ । tatphalaṃ bhujyate sākṣātsadyaḥ paśya ca sāṃpratam ।। 9 ।। ahaṃ karomi mokṣaṃ ca tava rakṣāṃ suniścitam । śāsituṃ rakṣituṃ śaktaḥ sa eva surucyate ।। 10 ।। na paśyati satītvaṃ ca hṛcchuddhāyāśca yoṣitaḥ । yanmānase vikalpaśca tasya dharmaśca naśyati ।। 11 ।। bhaviṣyati prabhāvaste durgāyāśca samaḥ sati । lakṣmīsamā pratiṣṭhā ca yaśastadyaśasā samam ।। 12 ।। saubhāgyaṃ rādhikātulyaṃ tatsamaṃ premabhartari । tattulyaṃ gauravaṃ mānyaṃ prītiḥ prādhānyamīśvare ।। 13 ।। rohiṇyāśca samāpekṣā pūjyā ca bhāratīsamā । śuddhā nirupamā śaśvatsāvitrīsadṛśī sadā ।। 14 ।। etasminnantare tatra āgato nahṛṣāccaraḥ । uvāca vacanaṃ bhīto vākpatergoṃcare tataḥ ।। 15 ।। dūta uvāca uttiṣṭha devi śīghraṃ tvaṃ gacchasva nahuṣaṃ prati । krīḍāṃ kartu ca rahasi ramye nandanakānane ।। 16 ।। dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutavā tamuvāca bṛhaspatiḥ । kampitāvayavaḥ kopādraktapaṅkajalocanaḥ ।। 17 ।। gururuvāca nahuṣaṃ vada gatvā tvaṃ śacīṃ ce dbhoktumicchasi । apūrva yānamāruhya niśāyāmāgamiṣyasi ।। 18 ।। saptarṣīṇāṃ ca skandhe ca datvā svaśivikāṃ śubhām । tāmāruhya suveṣaśca gamanaṃ kartumarhasi ।। 19 ।। vākpatervacanaṃ śrutvā gatvovāca nṛpaṃ tadā । dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasyovāca kiṃkaram ।। 20 ।। gaccha gaccha tvaran gaccha saptarṣīñchīghramānaya । upāyaṃ ca kariṣyāmi taiḥ sārdhaṃ sāprataṃ cara ।। 21 ।। nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā gatvā dūtastadantisam । uvāca sarvāṃstatraiva yathoktaṃ nahuṣeṇa ca ।। 22 ।। dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā yayuḥ saptarṣayo mudā । rājā dṛṣṭvā ca tānsarvānnanāmovāca sādaram ।। 23 ।। nahuṣa uvāca yūyaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ putrā jvalanto brahmatejasā । brahmaṇaḥ madṛśāḥ sarve satataṃ bhaktavatsalāḥ ।। 24 ।। nārāyaṇaparāḥ śaśvacchuddhasattavasvarūpiṇaḥ । mohamātsaryahīnāśca darpāhaṃkāravarjitāḥ ।। 25 ।। nārāyaṇasamāḥ sarve tejasā yaśasā sadā । guṇena kṛpayā premṇā varadānena niścitam ।। 26 ।। ityuktavā praṇato rājā tuṣṭāva ca ruroda ca । dṛṣṭavā te kātaraṃ bhūpamūcuḥ parahitaiṣiṇaḥ ।। 27 ।। ṛṣaya ūcuḥ varaṃ pṛṇīṣva he vatsa yatte manasi vāñchitam । sarvaṃ dātuṃ vayaṃ śaktā nāsārdhya naśca kiṃcana ।। 28 ।। indratvaṃ vā manutvaṃ vā cirāyurvā tataḥ param । saptaddhīpeśvaratvaṃ cāpyatīva suciraṃ sukham ।। 29 ।। athāpi sarvasiddhitvaṃ sarvaiśvarya sudurlabham । muktiṃ vā haribhaktiṃ vā tapasā yā sudurlabhā ।। 30 ।। kimīpsitaṃ te he vatsa brūhi naḥ sāṃprataṃ mudā । sarva tumyaṃ pradāyaiva yāsyāmastapase mudā ।। 31 ।। yugalakṣasamaṃ yacca kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇārcanaṃ vinā । taddinaṃ durdinaṃ yattaddhyānasevanavarjitam ।। 32 ।। vinā tatsevanaṃ yo hi viṣayānyaṃ ca vāñchati । viṣamatti praṇāśāya vihāyāmṛtamīpsitam ।। 33 ।। brahmā śivaśca dharmaśca viṣṇuścāpi mahānvirāṭ । gaṇeśaśca dineśaśca śaṣeśca sanakādayaḥ ।। 34 ।। ete yaccaraṇambhojaṃ dhyāyante'harniśaṃ mudā । janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ tanniratā vayam ।। 35 ।। teṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrṛtvā tānuvāca nṛpeśvaraḥ । sa lajjito namravaktra māyāmohitamānasaḥ ।। 36 ।। nahaṣa uvāca sarva dātuṃ samarthāśca yūyaṃ ca bhaktavatsalāḥ । adhunā dehi (datta) me tūrṇaṃ śacīdānamabhīpsitam ।। 37 ।। saptarṣivāhanaṃ kāntaṃ śacīcchati mahāsatī । etadeva mama varaṃ niṣpannaṃ kurutācinam ।। 38 ।। nahuṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā munayaśca parasparam । matyuccairjahasuḥ sarve kautukena ca nārada ।। 39 ।। rājānaṃ mohitaṃ matvā veṣṭitaṃ viṣṇumāyayā । cakruḥ pratijñāṃ taṃ voḍhuṃ kṛpayā dīnavatsalāḥ ।। 40 ।। cakruḥ skanadhe tacchivikāṃ muktāmāṇikyabhūṣitām । rājā yayau suveṣaśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 41 ।। dṛṣṭvā cātivilambaṃ ca bhartsayāmāsa tānnṛpaḥ । krudhā śāśāpa durvāsāścāgragāmī ca vartmani ।। 42 ।। mahānajaganaro bhūtvā pata vai mūḍhamānasa । darśanāddharmaputrasya tava mokṣo bhaviṣyati ।। 43 ।। ratnayānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ gatvā vaikuṇṭhasevanam । kariṣyasi mahārāja na karma niṣphalaṃ bhavet ।। 44 ।। ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve prahasya munisattamāḥ । rājā papāta tacchāpātsarpoṃ bhūtvā mahāmune ।। 45 ।। śacī cagāma ttacchrṛtvā guruṃ natvā'marāvatīm । yayau bṛhaspatiḥ śīghraṃ yatrendraḥ padmatantuṣu ।। 46 ।। gatvā sanovarāmyāśamājuhāva sureśvaram । atiprasannavadanaḥ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 47 ।। bṛhaspatiruvāca ayivatsatvamāgāccha bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite । tyaja bhītimihāgaccha gurustehaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 48 ।। svagurośca svaraṃ śrutvā mahendro hṛṣṭamānasaḥ । rūpaṃ vihāya sūkṣmaṃ ca svarūpeṇa samāyayau ।। 49 ।। papāta daṇḍavanmūrdhnā bhaktyā caraṇayorguroḥ । taṃ rudantaṃ mahābhītaṃ mudorasi cakāra saḥ ।। 50 ।। kārayitvā somayāgaṃ pragayaścittāthaṃmeva ca । ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa taṃ guruḥ ।। 51 ।। pradadau paramaiśvarya pūrvasmācca caturguṇam । āgatya sarvadevāśca cakuḥ sevāṃ mudā'nvitā ।। 53 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa mahendradarpabhañjanam । śacīsatītvarakṣā ca kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 54 ।। nārada uvāca somayāgavidhānaṃ ca brūhi māṃ munisattama । kathaṃ taṃ kārayāmāsa guruśca kiṃ phalaṃ param ।। 55 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca brahmahatyāpraśamanaṃ somayāgaphalaṃ mune । varṣa somalatāpānaṃ yajamānaḥ karoti ca ।। 56 ।। varṣamekaṃ phalaṃ bhuṅakte varṣamekaṃ jalaṃ mudā । traivārṣikaṃ vratamidaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।। 57 ।। yasya traivāṣikaṃ dhānyaṃ nihitaṃ bhūtavṛddhaye । adhikaṃ vā'pi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati ।। 58 ।। mahārājaśca depo vā yāgaṃ kartumalaṃ mune । na sarvamādhyo yajño'yaṃ bahvanno bahudakṣiṇaḥ ।। 59 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... śakradarpabhaṅgaprakaraṇe śakramokṣakathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 60 ।।
<4.61> athaikaṣaṣṭi,mo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca iti te kathitaṃ kiṃcidindrasya darpabhañjanam । aparaṃ śrūyatāṃ brahmansāvadhānaṃ nigūḍhakam ।। 1 ।। samudramathanaṃ kṛtvā pītvā'mṛtarasaṃ purā । nirjitya daityasaṃghāṃśca bahudarpo babhūva ha ।। 2 ।। tadā kṛṣṇo balidvārā śakradarpa babhañja ha । bhraṣṭaśriyo babhūvuste devā indrapurogamāḥ ।। 3 ।। tadā bṛhaspateḥ stautrādaditeśca vratena te । jātaśca svāṃśakalayā'pyadityāṃ vāmano vibhuḥ ।। 4 ।। yācñāṃ kṛtvā baliṃ rājyaṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ । tasmai dadau mahendrāya devemyaścāpi saṃpadam ।। 5 ।। babhūva śakradarpaśca punaḥ kalpāntane purā । vibhurduvasiso dvārā jahāra tacchriyaṃ mune ।। 6 ।। punardadau ca kṛpayā kṛpālurbhaktavatsalaḥ । punaḥ śrīdurmadaḥ so'pi jahāra gautamapriyām ।। 7 ।। tadā gautamaśāpena bhamāṅgaśca babhūva saḥ । saṃprāpa yātanāmindraḥ svāṅgavedanayā purā ।। 8 ।। uccaistaṃ jahasurdṛṣṭvā ṛṣayo manavastadā । devāśca lajjitāḥ sarve mṛtatulyo bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 9 ।। tadā sahasravarṣa ca tapastaptvā raveḥ purā । ravervareṇa śakraḥ sa sahasrākṣo babhūva ha ।। 10 ।। kalaṅkarūpamindrasya taccakṣurnikaraṃ param । yathā canadre kalaṅkaśca tānakāharaṇādabhūt ।। 11 ।। nārada uvāca brahman kena pragāreṇa jahāra gautamapriyām । mahāsatīsamahalyāṃ ca pūjyāṃ bhuvanapādanīm ।। 12 ।। śuddhāśāyāṃ mahābhāgāṃ nirmalāṃ kamalākalām । etadveditumicchāmi vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 13 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca puṣkare tīrthayātrāyāṃ sūryaparvaṇi nārada । tatrā''gatāmahalyāṃ ca dadarśa pākaśāsanaḥ ।। 14 ।। susmitāṃ sudartī śāntāṃ pīnakṣoṇipayodharām । mrarcchāmavāpa cendraśca dṛṣṭimātreṇa tattkṣaṇāt ।। 15 ।। athāparadine tāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sandākinī taṭe । ekākinīṃ susmisāṃ ca snātīṃ nagnāṃ salajjitām ।। 16 ।। dṛṣṭvā śroṇiṃ stanayugamatīva vipulaṃ hariḥ । mūrcchamavāpa kāmārto jahāra cetanāṃ punaḥ ।। 17 ।। kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpya gatvā kāmī tadantikam । uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā vinayena pativratām ।। 18 ।। mahendra uvāca aho guṇamaho rūpamaho kiṃ vā navaṃ vayaḥ । aho kiṃ vā mukhaśrīste śaraccandraṃ vinindatī ।। 19 ।। ahokaṭākṣaṃ kuṭilaṃ puṃsāṃ cittavikarṣaṇam । kimaho locanaṃ padmaprabhāmocanamīpsitam ।। 20 ।। gamanaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca gacakhañjanabhañjanam । aho vākyaṃ sumadhuraṃ pīyūṣādapi durlabham ।। 21 ।। kimaho vipulaśroṇī kāmādhārā manoharā । kāmadā kāmukāyaiva munimānasamohinī ।। 22 ।। atīva kaṭhinā pīnā rambhāsca mbhaviḍambitā । aho nitambayugulaṃ vartulaṃ candrabimbavat ।। 23 ।। śrīyuktaṃ śrīphalayugatulyaṃ te stanayugmakam । atyunnataṃ sukaṭhinaṃ trailokyacittamohanam ।। 24 ।। aho kiṃ vā tapastepe gautamaśca tapodhanaḥ । saṃprāpa yatphalenaiva sudatīṃ sundarīṃ varām ।। 25 ।। niṣevya prakṛtiṃ durgā viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm । lakṣmīṃ ca lakṣmīsadṛśīmīdṛśīṃ prāpa padminīm ।। 26 ।। sukomalāṃ suvadanāṃ lalanāṃ nalinānanām । śuddhāṃ ca sudatīṃ śyāmāṃ nyagrodhadalamadhyamām ।। 27 ।। tvatpālanaṃ ca jānāmikāmaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ । kāmo vā kāmukaścandra kiṃ tvā jānāti gautamaḥ ।। 28 ।। māṃ praśaṃsanti nityaṃ te kāmaśāstravicakṣaṇāḥ । urvaśyādyaścāpsaraso māṃ praśaṃsanti saṃtatam ।। 29 ।। dāsiṃ kṛtvā ca dāsyāmi śacīṃ tumyaṃ varānane । trailokyalakṣmī vipulāṃ gṛhaṇa tyaja gautamam ।। 30 ।। anabhijñaṃ kāmaśāstre durbalaṃ ca tapasvinam । avyavāhārya niṣkāmaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam ।। 31 ।। avidagdho vidhātā ca yojayāmāma yo'kṣamam । īdṛśīṃ kāmukīṃ ramyāṃ dadāti ca tapasvine ।। 32 ।। ityuktvā kāmukaḥ śakraḥ papāta caraṇe mṛdā । tamuvāca mahāsadhvī vedoktaṃ ca yathaucitam ।। 33 ।। ahalyovāca abhāgyādbrahmaṇaścāpi marīceśca tapasvinaḥ । abhāgyātkaśyapasyāpi tvaṃ putraḥ pāpamānasaḥ ।। 34 ।। kiṃ tajjapena tapasā maunena ca vratena ca । surārcanena tīrthena strībhiryasya manohṛtam ।। 35 ।। strīrūpaṃ nirmitaṃ sṛṣṭau mohāya kāmināṃ manaḥ । anyathā na bhavetsṛṣṭiḥ sraṣṭā tene purā''jñayā ।। 36 ।। sarva māyākaraṇḍaśca dharmamārgārgalaṃ nṛṇām । vyavadhānaṃ ca tapasāṃ doṣāṇāmāśrayaṃ param ।। 37 ।। karmabandhanibaddhānāṃ nigaḍaṃ kaṭhinaṃ smṛtam । pradīparūpaṃ kīṭānāṃ mīnānāṃ baḍiśaṃ yathā ।। 38 ।। viṣakṛmbhaṃ dugdhamukhamārambhe madhunopamam । pariṇāme duḥkhabījaṃ sopānaṃ narakasya ca ।। 39 ।। ṛṣayaḥ sanakādyāśca nodvāhaṃ cakrurīpsitm । parastrīṣu mano yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ sarva ca niṣphalam ।। 40 ।। parastrīsevanaṃ śakra ihaivātyayaśaskanam । paratra narakaṃ ghoraṃ dadāti kāmukāya ca ।। 41 ।। ityuktavā ca mahāsādhvī vihāya taṃ ca kāmukam । prayayau svagṛhaṃ tūrṇa gṛhiṇī gautamasya ca ।। 42 ।। tatsarva kathayāmāsa gautamāya tapasvine । tasthau prahasya sa munirmahandraṃ ca vinindya ca ।। 43 ।। ekadā gautamaḥ śīghraṃ jagāma śaṃkarālayam । śakro gautamarūpeṇa tāṃ saṃbhogaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 44 ।। sarva jñātvā ca sarvajñaḥ mandiradvāramāyayau । nirgacchantaṃ mahendaṃ ca dadarśa munipuṃgavaḥ ।। 45 ।। nagnāmahalyāṃ rahasi pīnaśroṇipayodharām । muniḥ śaśāpa śakaṃ ca bhagāṅgaśca bhaveti ca ।। 46 ।। kopācchaśāpa patnīṃ ca rudatīṃ bhayavihvalām । tvaṃ ca pāṣāṇarūpā ca mahāraṇye bhaveti ca ।। 47 ।। yayau ca svagṛhaṃ śakro lajjaikatānamānasaḥ । uvāca madhuraṃ bhītā svāminaṃ śokakarśitā ।। 48 ।। ahalyovāca māṃ ca dāsīṃ ca nirdoṣāṃ kathaṃ tyajasidhārmika । tvaṃ ca vedavidāṃ śreṣṭho vicāraṃ kuru dharmataḥ ।। 49 ।। gautama uvāca tvāṃ jānāmi manaḥśuddhāṃ suvratāṃ ca pativratām । tyakṣyāmi ca tathā'pi tvāṃ paravīryaṃ ca bibhratīm ।। 50 ।। parabhogyā ca yā kāntā sā'śuddhā sarvakarmasu । tāṃ yogacchenmahāmūḍho narakaṃ tasya kalpakam ।। 51 ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ mūtraṃ parabhogyāśca (yā)niścitam । upaspṛśenna tasyāśca hanti pupyaṃ purākṛtam ।। 52 ।। anicchayā ca śrṛṅgāne strī jāreṇa na duṣyati । duṣṭā strī niścitaṃ sādhvī svecchāśrṛṅgārakarmaṇi ।। 53 ।। tvaṃ śakraṃ svāminaṃ matvā sukhaṃ bhuktvā ratiṃ gṛhe । paścādbabhūva te jñānaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā ca niśāmaya ।। 54 ।। gaccha gaccha mahāraṇyaṃ bhava pāṣāṇarūpiṇī । rāmapādāṅgulisparśātsadyaḥ pūtā bhapiṣyasi ।। 55 ।। māṃ saṃprāpsyasi tatpuṇyātpunarevā''gamiṣyasi । gaccha kānte mahāraṇyamityuktvā tapase yayau ।। 56 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarva mahendradarpabhañjanam । punaḥ saṃprāpa lakṣmīṃ ca vibhośca kṛpayā mune ।। 57 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha ... utta... nāradanā... ekaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 61 ।।
<4.62> atha dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca brahman kena prakāreṇa rāmo dāśarathiḥ svayam । cakāra mokṣaṇaṃ kutra yuge gautamayoṣitaḥ ।। 1 ।। rāmāvatāraṃ sukhadaṃ samāsena manoharam । kathāyasva mahābhāga śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca brahmaṇā prārthito viṣṇurjāto daśarathātsvayam । kausalyāyāṃ ca bhagavāṃstretāyāṃ ca mṛdā'nvitaḥ ।। 3 ।। kaikeyyāṃ bharataścaiva rāmatulyo guṇena ca । lakṣmaṇaścāpi śatrughnaḥ sumitrāyāṃ guṇārṇavaḥ ।। 4 ।। piśvāmitrapreṣitaśca śrīrāmaśca salakṣmaṇaḥ । prayayau mithilāṃ ramyāṃ sītāgrahaṇahetave ।। 5 ।। dṛṣṭvā pāṣāṇārūpā ca rāmo vartmani kāminīm । viśvāmitraṃ ca papraccha kāraṇaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ ।। 6 ।। rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ । uvāca tatra dharmiṣṭho rahasyaṃ sarvameva ca ।। 7 ।। kāraṇaṃ tanmukhācchrṛtvā rāmo bhuvanapāvanaḥ । pasparśa pādāṅgulinā sā babhūva ca padminī ।। 8 ।। sā rāmamāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā prayayau bhartṛ mandiram । śubhāśiṣaṃ dadau tasmai bhāryā saṃprāpya gautamaḥ ।। 9 ।। rāmaśca mithilāṃ gatvā dhanurbhaṅgaṃ śivasyā ca । cakāra pāṇigrahaṇaṃ sītāyāścaiva nārada ।। 10 ।। kṛtvā vivāhaṃ rājendro bhṛgudarpa nihatya ca । ṇayodhyāṃ prayayau ramyāṃ krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ ।। 11 ।। rājā putraṃ nṛpaṃ kartumiṣeya kṛtasādaram । saptatīrthodakaṃ tūrṇamānīya munipuṃgavān ।। 12 ।। kṛtādhivāsaṃ śrīrāmaṃ sarva maṅgalasaṃyutam । dṛṣṭvā bharatamātā ca kaikeyī śokavihvalā ।। 13 ।। varayāmāsa rājānaṃ pūrvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ varam । rāmasya vanavāsaṃ ca rājatvaṃ bharatasya ca ।। 14 ।। varaṃ dātuṃ mahārājo neyeṣa premamohitaḥ । dharmasatyabhayenaivovāca rāmo nṛpaṃ sudhī। ।। 15 ।। śrīrāma uvāca taḍāgaśatadānena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ । tato'dhikaṃ ca labhate vāpīdānena niścitam ।। 16 ।। daśavāpīpradānena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ । tato'dhikaṃ ca labhate puṇyaṃ kanyāpradānataḥ ।। 17 ।। daśakanyāpradānena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ । tato'dhikaṃ ca labhate yajñaikena narādhipa ।। 18 ।। śatayajñena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate puṇyakṛjjanaḥ । tato'dhikaṃ ca labhate putrāsyadarśanena ca ।। 19 ।। darśane śataputrāṇāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ । tatpuṇyaṃ labhate nūnaṃ puṇyavānsatyabālanāt ।। 20 ।। na hi satyātparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param । na hi gahghāsamaṃ tīryaṃ ma devaḥ keśavātparaḥ ।। 21 ।। nāsti dharmātparo bandhurnāsti dharmātparaṃ dhanam । dharmātpriyaḥ paraḥ ko vā spadharmaṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ ।। 22 ।। svadharme rakṣite tāta śaśvatsarvatra maṅgalam । yaśasyaṃ supratiṣṭhā ca pratāpaḥ pūjanaṃ param ।। 23 ।। yaturdaśābdaṃ dharmeṇa tyaktvā gṛhasukhaṃ mraman । vanavāsaṃ kariṣyāmi satyasya pālanāya te ।। 24 ।। kṛtvā satyaṃ ca śapathamicchayā'nicchayā'thavā । na kṛryātpālanaṃ yo hi bhasmāntaṃ tasya sūtakam ।। 25 ।। kumbhīpāke sa pacati yāvaccandradivākarau । tato mūko bhavetkuṣaṭhī mānavaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 26 ।। ityovamuktvā śrīrāmo vidhāya kalkalaṃ jaṭām । prayayau ca mahāraṇye sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca ।। 27 ।। putraśokānmahārājāstatyāja svatanuṃ mune । pālanāya pituḥ satyaṃ rāmo babhrāmakānana ।। 28 ।। kālāntare mahāraṇye bhaginī rāvaṇasya ca । bhramantī kānane ghore bhartrā sārdhaṃ sugautukāt ।। 29 ।। dadarśa rāmaṃ kulaṭā kāmārtā rākṣasī tadā । pulakāñcitasarvāṅgī sūrcchamāpa smareṇa ca ।। 30 ।। śrīrāmanikaṭaṃ gatvā sasmitovāca kāmukī । śasvadhauvanasaṃyuktā'tiprauḍhā kāmadurmadā ।। 31 ।। śūrpaṇakhovāca herāma he dhanaśyāma rūpadhāma suṇānvita । māyānuraktāṃ vanitāṃ māṃ gṛhāṇa sunirjane ।। 32 ।। śrutvā śūrpaṇakhāvākyaṃ dharmaṃ saṃsmṛtya dhārmikaḥ । uvāca sadhureṃ vākyaṃ śāvabhītaśca nārada ।। 33 ।। śrīrāma uvāca ambamātaḥ sabhāryo'hamabhāryaṃ gaccha me'nujam । duḥkhaṃ priyo'nyāṃ prabhajeditaraṃ ca sukhālayam ।। 34 ।। rāmasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prayayau lakṣmaṇaṃ mudā । dadarśa lakṣamaṇaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ ca lakṣaṇānvitam ।। 35 ।। māṃ bhajasva mahābhāgetyuvāca ca punaḥ punaḥ । lakṣmaṇāstadvacaḥ śrutvā tāmuvāca kutūhalāt ।। 36 ।। lakṣmaṇa uvāca vihāya rāmaṃ sarveśaṃ he mūḍhe dāsamicchasi । sītādāsī ca matpatnī sītādāso'hameva ca ।। 37 ।। bhava sītāsapatnī tvaṃ gaccha rāmaṃ madīśvaram । tava putro bhaviṣyāmi sītāyāścayathā sati ।। 38 ।। lakṣmaṇāsya vacaḥ śrutvā kāmena hṛtamānasā । uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ mūḍhā śuṣkakaṇṭheṣṭhatālukā ।। 39 ।। śūrpaṇakhovāca yadī tyajasi māṃ mūḍha kāmātsvayamupasthitām । yuvayośca vipattiśca bhaviṣya ti na saṃśayaḥ ।। 40 ।। brahmā ca mohinīṃ tyaktavā viśve'pūjye babhūva saḥ । rambhāśāpena dakṣaśca chāgamasto babhūva saḥ ।। 41 ।। svarvaidyaścorvaśīśāpādyajñabhāgavivarjitaḥ । rūpahīnaḥ kṛberaśca menāśāpena lakṣmaṇa ।। 42 ।। kāmo ghṛtācīśāpena babhūva bhasmasācchivāt । balirmadālasāśāpādbhraṣṭarājyo babhūva ha ।। 43 ।। śāpena mikṣakeśyāśca hṛtabhāryo bṛhaspatiḥ । mama śāpāttathā rāmo hṛtabhāryo bhaviṣyati ।। 44 ।। kāmāturāṃ yauvanasthāṃ bhāryā svayamupasthitām । na tyajeddharmabhītaśca śrutaṃ mādhyaṃdine purā ।। 45 ।। iha tyaktvā pibadgrastaḥ paratra narakaṃ vrajet । śrutvā śūrpaṇakhāvākyamardhayandreṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 46 ।। ciccheda nāsikāṃ tasyāḥ kṣuradhāreṇa līlayā । tasyā bhrātā ca yuyudhe balavānkharadūṣaṇaḥ ।। 47 ।। sasainyo lakṣmaṇāstreṇa sa jagāma yamālayam । caturdaśasahasraṃ ca rākṣasānkharadūṣaṇam ।। 48 ।। mṛtāndṛṣṭvā śūrpaṇakhā bhartsayāmāsa rāvaṇam । sarvaṃ nivedanaṃ kṛtvā jagāma puṣkaraṃ tadā ।। 49 ।। brahmaṇaśca varaṃ prāpa kṛtvā ca duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ । uvāca tādṛśīṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāhārāṃ tapasvinīm ।। 50 ।। sarvajñastanmano matvā kṛpāsindhuśca nārada ।। 51 ।। brahmovāca aprāpya rāmaṃ dṛṣprāpaṃ karoṣi duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ । jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ।। 52 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraṃ prakṛteḥ param । janmāntare ca bhartāraṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ varānane ।। 53 ।। ityevamuktvā brahma ca jagāma svālayaṃ mudā । dehaṃ tatyāja sā vahno sā ca kubjā babhūva ha ।। 54 ।। atha śūrpaṇakhā vākyātkopātkampitavigrahaḥ । jahāra māyayā sītāṃ māyāvī rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।। 55 ।। sītāṃ na dṛṣṭvā rāmaśca mūrcchāṃ prāpa ciraṃ mune । cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa bhrātā ca''dhyātmikena ca ।। 56 ।। tato babhrāma gahanaṃ śailaṃ ca kaṃdaraṃ nadam । aharniśaṃ ca śokārto munīnāmāśramaṃ mune ।। 57 ।। ciramanveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā na dṛṣṭvā jānakīṃ vibhuḥ । cakāra mitratāṃ rāmaḥ sugrīveṇa svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 58 ।। nihatya vālinaṃ bāṇairdadau rājyaṃ ca līlayā । sugrīvāya ca mitrāya svīkārapālanāya vai ।। 59 ।। dūtānprasthāpayāmāsa sarvatra vānareśvāḥ । tasthau sugrīvabhavane śrīrāmaśca salakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 60 ।। hanūmate varaṃ dattavā ramyaṃ ratnāṅgulīyakam । sītāyai śubhasaṃdeśaṃ prāṇadhāraṇakāraṇam ।। 61 ।। taṃ ca prasthāpayāmāsa dakṣiṇāṃ diśamuttamām । suprītyā''liṅganaṃ dattvā pādareṇūnsudurlabhān ।। 62 ।। hanumānpayayau laṅkāṃ sītānveṣaṇahetave । rāmādadhītasaṃdeśo yayau rudrakalodbhavaḥ ।। 63 ।। aśokakānane sītāṃ dadarśa śokakarśitām । nirāhārāmatikṛśāṃ kuhvāṃ candrakalāmiva ।। 64 ।। satataṃ rāma rāmeti japantīṃ bhaktibūrvakam । bibhratīṃ ca jaṭābhāraṃ taptakāñcanasaṃnibhām ।। 65 ।। dhyāyamānāṃ padābjaṃ ca śrīrāmasya dipāniśam । śuddhāśayāṃ suśīlāṃ ca suvratāṃ ca pativratām ।। 66 ।। mahālakṣmīlakṣmayuktāṃ prajvalantīṃ svatejasā । puṇyadāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhuvanapāvatīm ।। 67 ।। praṇamya mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā rudatīṃ vāyunandanaḥ । ratnāṅgulīyaṃ rāmasya dadau tasyai mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 68 ।। ruroda dharmī tāṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛtvā taccaraṇāmbujam । uvāca rāmasaṃdeśaṃ sītājīvanarakṣaṇam ।। 69 ।। hanumānuvāca pāresamudraṃ śrīrāmaḥ saṃnaddhaśca salakṣmaṇaḥ । babhūva rāmamitraṃ ca sugrīvo balavānkapiḥ ।। 70 ।। rāmaśca vālinaṃ hatvā rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ dadau । sugrīvāya ca mitrāya tadbhāryaṃ vālinā hṛtām ।। 71 ।। sugrīvaśca tavoddhāraṃ svīcakāra ca dharmataḥ । vānarāśca yayuḥ sarve tavānveṣaṇakāraṇāt ।। 72 ।। prāpya maṅgalavārtāṃ ca matto rājīvalocanaḥ । gambhīraṃ sāgaraṃ baddhvā so'cireṇā''gamiṣyati ।। 73 ।। nihatya rāvaṇaṃ pāpaṃ saputraṃ ca sabāndhavam । kariṣyatyacireṇaiva he mātastava mokṣaṇam ।। 74 ।। adya ratnamayīṃ laṅkāṃ niḥśaṅkastvataprasādataḥ । bhasmībhūtāṃ kariṣyāmi mātaḥ paśya ca sasmitam ।। 75 ।। markaṭīḍimbhatulyāṃ ca laṅkāṃ paśyāmi suvrate । mūtratulyaṃ samudraṃ ca śarāvamiva bhūtalam ।। 76 ।। pipīlikāsaṃghamiva sasainyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tathā । saṃhartuṃ ca samarthoṃ'haṃ muhūrtārdhena līlayā ।। 77 ।। rāmapratijñārakṣārthaṃ na haniṣyāmi sāṃpratam । svasthā bhava mahābhāge tyaja bhītiṃ madīśvari ।। 78 ।। pānarasya vacaḥ śrutvā rurodoccairmuhurmuhuḥ । uvāca vacanaṃ bhītā rāmapativratā ।। 79 ।। sītovāca aye jīvati me rāmo macchokārṇavadāruṇāt ।। 80 ।। api me kuśalī nāthaḥ kausalyānandanaḥ prabhu । kīdṛśaśca kṛśāṅgaśca jānakījīvano'dhunā ।। 81 ।। kimāhāraśca kiṃ bhuṅkte mama praṇādhikaḥ priyaḥ । api pāre samudrasya satyaṃ sītāpatiḥ svayam ।। 82 ।। api satyaṃ ka saṃnaddho na śokena hataḥ prabhuḥ । api smarati māṃ pāpāṃ svāmino duḥkharūpiṇīm ।। 83 ।। madarthe kati duḥkhaṃ vā saṃprāpa sa madīśvaraḥ । hāro nā''rorpitaḥ kaṇṭhe purā vyavahito ratau ।। 84 ।। adhunaivā''vayormadhye samudraḥ śatayojanaḥ । api drakṣyāmi taṃ rāmaṃ karuṇāsāgaraṃ prabhum ।। 85 ।। kāntaṃ śāntaṃ nitāntaṃ ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ dharmakarmaṇi । api sevāṃ kariṣyāmi pādapadme punaḥ prabhoḥ ।। 86 ।। patisevāvihīnāyā mūḍhāyā jīvanaṃ dṛthā । api me dharmaputraśca satyaṃ jīvati lakṣmaṇaḥ ।। 87 ।। macchokasāgare magno bhagnadarpo mayā vinā । vīrāṇāṃ pravaro dharmī devakalpaśca devaraḥ ।। 88 ।। api satyaṃ sasaṃnnaddho satprabhoranujaḥ sadā । api drakṣyāmi satyaṃ taṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ।। prāṇānāmadhikaṃ premṇā dhanyaṃ puṇyasvarūpiṇam ।। 89 ।। ityevaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā dattvā pratyuttaraṃ śubham । bhasmībhūtāṃ ca tāṃ laṅkāṃ cakāra līlayā mune ।। 90 ।। punaḥ prabodhaṃ tasyai ca dattavā vāyusutaḥ kapiḥ । prayayau līlayā vegādyatra rājīvalocanaḥ ।। 91 ।। sarvaṃ tatkathāyāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ mātureva ca । sītāmaṅgalavṛttāntaṃ śrutvā rāmo ruroda ca ।। 92 ।। rutodoccairlakṣmaṇaśca sugrīvaścāpi nārada । vānarā ruruduḥ sarve sahabalaparākramāḥ ।। 93 ।। nibadhya setuṃ laṅkāṃ ca prayayau raghunandanaḥ । sasainyaḥ sānujaḥ śīghraṃ saṃnaddhaścāpi nārada ।। 94 ।। nihatya rāvaṇaṃ rāmo raṇaṃ kṛtvā sabāndhavam । cakāra mokṣaṇaṃ brahman sitāyaśca śubhekṣaṇe ।। 95 ।। kṛtvā puṣpakayānena sītāṃ satyaparāyaṇām । ayodhyāṃ prayayau śīghraṃ krīḍākautukamaṅgalaiḥ ।। 96 ।। krīḍāṃ cakāra bhagavān sītāṃ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi । vijahau virahajvālāṃ sītā rāmaśca tatkṣaṇam ।। 97 ।। saptadvīpeśvaro rāmo babhūva pṛthivītale । babhūva nikhilā pṛthvī ādhivyādhivivarjitā ।। 98 ।। babhūvatū rāmaputrau dhārmikau ca kuśīlavau । tayośca putraiḥ pautreśca sūryavaṃśodbhavā nṛpāḥ ।। 99 ।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa śrīrāmacaritaṃ śubham । sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāraṃ pārapotaṃ bhavārṇave ।। 100 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... śrīrāmācaritaṃ nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 62 ।।
<4.63> atha triṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kaṃso vicintyaivaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥsvapnameva ca । samudvigno mahābhīto nirāhāro nirutsukaḥ ।। 1 ।। putraṃ mitraṃ bandhugaṇaṃ bāndhavaṃ ca purohitam । samānīya sabhāmadhye tānuvāca suduḥkhitaḥ ।। 2 ।। kaṃsa uvāca mayā dṛṣṭo niśīthe yo duḥsvapno hi bhayapradaḥ । nibodhata budhāḥ sarve bāndhavāśca purohitāḥ ।। 3 ।। bibhratī raktapuṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ sā raktacandanam । raktāmbanaṃ khaḍgatīkṣṇaṃ kharparaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram ।। 4 ।। prakṛtyāṭṭāṭṭahāsaṃ ca lolajihvā bhayaṃkarī । atīva vṛddhā kṛṣṇāṅgī nagare mama nṛtyati ।। 5 ।। muktakeśī chinnanāsā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāmbārapriyā । vidhavā sā mahāśūdrī māmāliṅgitumicchati ।। 6 ।। malinaṃ cailakhaṇḍaṃ ca bibhratī rūkṣamūrdhajān । dadhatī cūrṇatilakaṃ kapolai mama vakṣasi ।। 7 ।। kṛṣṇavarṇāni pakvāni cchinnabhinnāni satyaka । patanti kṛtvā śabdāṃśca śaśvattālaphalāni ca ।। 8 ।। kucailo vikṛtākāro mleccho hi rūkṣamūrdhajaḥ । dadāti mahyaṃ bhūṣāyāṃ chinnabhinnakapardakān ।। 9 ।। mahāruṣṭā ca divyā strī patiputravatī satī । babhañja pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca sā'bhiśapya punaḥ punaḥ ।। 10 ।। amlānāmoṃḍūmālāṃ ca raktacandanacarcitām । dadāti maṅyaṃ vipraśca mahāruṣṭo'tiśapya ca ।। 11 ।। kṣaṇamaṅgāravṛṣṭiśca bhasmavṛṣṭiḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam । kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ raktavṛṣṭirbhavecca nagare mama ।। 12 ।। vānaraṃ vāyasaṃ śvānaṃ bhallūkaṃ sūkaraṃ kharam । paśyāmi vikaṭākāraṃ śabdaṃ kurvantamulbaṇam ।। 13 ।। paśyāmi śuṣkakāṣṭhānāṃ rāśimamlānakajjalam । aruṇodayavelāyāṃ kapīṃścinnanakhāni ca ।। 14 ।। pītavastraparidhānā śuklacandanacarcitā । bibhratī mālatīmālāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 15 ।। krīḍākamalahastā sā sindūrabinduśobhitā । kṛtvā'bhiśāpaṃ māṃ ruṣaṭā yāti manmandirātsatī ।। 16 ।। pāśahastāṃśca puruṣānmuktakeśānbhayaṃkarān । atirūkṣāṃśca paśyāmi viśāto nagaraṃ mama ।। 17 ।। nagnanārī suktakeśī nṛtyantī ca gṛhe gṛhe । atīva vikṛtākārāṃ paśyāmi sasmitāṃ sadā ।। 18 ।। chinnanāsā ca vidhavā mahāśūdrī digambarā । sā tailābhyaṅgitaṃ māṃ ca karotyatibhayaṃkarī ।। 19 ।। nirvāṇāṅgārayuktāśca bhasmabūrṇā digambarā । atiprabhātasamaye citrāḥ paśyāmi sasmitāḥ ।। 20 ।। paśyāmi ca vivāhaṃ ca nṛtyagītamanoharam । raktavastraparīdhānānpuriṣānraktamīrdhajān ।। 21 ।। raktaṃ vamantaṃ puruṣaṃ nṛtyantaṃ nagnamulbaṇam । dhāvantaṃ ca śayānaṃ ca paśyāmi sasmitaṃ sadā ।। 22 ।। rāhugrastaṃ ca gagane maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryayauḥ । ekakāleca paśyāmi sarvagrāsaṃ ca bāndhavāḥ ।। 23 ।। ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ bhūkampaṃ rāṣṭraviplavam । jhañjhāvātaṃ mahotpātaṃ paśyāmi ca purohita ।। 24 ।। vāyunā ghūrṇamānāṃśca cchinnaskandhānmahīruhān । patitānparvatāścaiva paśyāmi pṛthivītale ।। 25 ।। puruṣaṃ chinnaśirasaṃ rṛtyantaṃ nagnamucchritam । muṇḍamālākaraṃ ghoraṃ paśyāmi ca gṛhe gṛhe ।। 26 ।। dagthaṃ sarvāśramaṃ bhakmapūrṇamaṅgārasaṃkulam । hāhākāraṃ ca kurvantaṃ sarvaṃ paśyāmi sarvataḥ ।। 27 ।। ityevamuktvā rājā sa virarāma sabhātale । dṛṣadvā (śrṛtvā) svaptaṃ bāndhavāśca na tamuktvāniśaśvasuḥ ।। 28 ।। jahāra cetanāṃ sadyaḥ satyakaśca purohitaḥ । matvā vināśaṃ kaṃsasya yajamānasya nārada ।। 29 ।। ruroda nārīvargaśca pitā mātā ca śokataḥ । mene vināśakālaṃ ca sadyaḥ svayamupasthitam ।। 30 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... kaṃsaduḥkhapnakathanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 63 ।।
<4.64> atha catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca sarva kṛtvā parāmarśaṃ satyakaśca purohitaḥ । buddhimāñchukraśiṣyaśca tamuvāca hitaṃ mune ।। 1 ।। satyaka uvāca bhayaṃ tyaja mahābhāga bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite । kuru yāgaṃ maheśasya marvāriṣṭavināśanam ।। 2 ।। yāgo dhanurmakho nāma bahvanno bahudakṣiṇaḥ । duḥśapnānāṃ nāśakaraḥ śatrubhītivināśakaḥ ।। 3 ।। ādhyātmikamādhidaivamādhibhautikamutkaṭam । eṣāṃ trividhotpātānāṃ khaṇḍano bhūtivardhaṃnaḥ ।। 4 ।। yāge samāpte śaṃbhuśca jarāmṛtyuharaṃ varam । dadāti sākṣādbhavati dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām ।। 5 ।। cakāremaṃ ca yāgaṃ ca purā bāṇo mahābalaḥ । nandī paraśurāmaśca bhallaśca balināṃ varaḥ ।। 6 ।। purā dadau dhanuridaṃ śivo nandīśvarāya ca । yāgena bhūtvā siddhaḥ sa dadau bāṇāya dhārmikaḥ ।। 7 ।। kṛtvā yāgaṃ mahāsiddho dadau rāmāya puṣkare । tubhyaṃ dadau paraśurāmaḥ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 8 ।। sahasrahastaparimitaṃ dairdhye'tikaṭhinaṃ nṛpa । daśahastapraśastaṃ ca śaṃkarecchāvinirmitam ।। 9 ।। paśupateḥ paśupataṃ yuktayānena durvaham । sarve bhaṅktuṃ na śaktāśca devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vinā ।। 10 ।। yāge ca dhanuṣaḥ pūjāṃ śaṃkarasya tu śaṃkare । kuru śīghraṃ śubhārthaṃ ca sarvānkuru nimantraṇam ।। 11 ।। asminyāge dhanurbhaṅgo bhavedyadi narādhipa । vināśo yajamānasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 12 ।। bhagne dhanuṣi yāgaśca bhagno bhavati niścitam । phalaṃ dadāti ko vā'tra cāniṣpanne ca karmaṇi ।। 13 ।। brahmā ca dhanuṣo mūle madhye nārāyaṇaḥ svayam । agre cograpratāpaśca mahādevo mahāmate ।। 14 ।। dhanurhi trivikāraṃ ca sadratnakhacitaṃ varam । grīṣmamadhyāṅnamārtaṃṇḍaprabhāpracchannakāraṇ ।। 15 ।। aśaktaśca namayitumanantaśca mahābalaḥ । suryaśca kārtikeyaśca kā kathā'nyasya bhūmipa ।। 16 ।। tripurāriḥ purā'nena jaghāna tripuraṃ mudā । nirbhayaṃ kuru svacchandaṃ maṅgalārha mahotsavam ।। 17 ।। matyakasya vacaḥ śrutvā candravaṃśavivardhanaḥ । uvāca kaṃsaḥ sarvārthe satataṃ ca hitaiṣiṇam ।। 18 ।। kaṃsa uvāca vasudevagṛhe jajñe madvadhī kuranāśanaḥ । svacchandaṃ nandagehe ca vardhate nandanandanaḥ ।। 19 ।। madvandhuvargāñchūrāṃśca mantriṇaḥ suviśāradān । bhaginīṃ pūtanāṃ pūtāṃ jaghāna bālako balī ।। 20।। govardhanaṃ dadhārrakakareṇa balavardhanaḥ । mahendrasya ca śūrasya cakāra ca parābhavam ।। 21 ।। brahmāṇaṃ darśayāmāsa brahmarūpaṃ carācaram । nivahaṃ bāravatsānāṃ cakāra kṛtrimaṃ mudā ।। 22 ।। tameva balinaṃ hantuṃ mantraṇāṃ kuru satyaka । mama śatrurvinā tena nāstiha dharaṇītale ।। 23 ।। nahi svarge na pātāle triṣu lokeṣu niścitam । santi santaśca rājānaḥ sarvatra mama bāndhavāḥ ।। 24 ।। mahātapasvī brahmā ca tapasvīṃ śaṃkaraḥ svayām । viṣṇuḥ sarvatra sarvātmā samadarśo sanātanaḥ ।। 25 ।। nandaputraṃ nihatyāhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu pūjitaḥ । mārvabhaumo bhaviṣyāmi saptadvīpeśvaro mahān ।। 26 ।। svarge nihatya śakraṃ ca durbalaṃ daityanirjitam । bhaviṣyāmi mahendraśca tatra nirjitya bhāskaram ।। 27 ।। yakṣmagrastaṃ ca candraṃ ca mamaiva pūrvapūruṣam । vāyuṃ kuberaṃ varuṇaṃ yamaṃ jeṣyāmi niścitam ।। 28 ।। gaccha nandavrajaṃ śīghraṃ nandaṃ ca nandanandanam । tadbhrātaraṃ ca balinaṃ balamānaya saṃpratam ।। 29 ।। kaṃsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca sa satyakaḥ । hitaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ paraṃ sāmayikaṃ tathā ।। 30 ।। satyaka uvāca akrūramuddhavaṃ vā'pi vasudevamathāpi vā । prasthāpaya mahābhāga nandavrajamabhīpsitam ।। 31 ।। satyakasya vacaḥ śrutvā vasantaṃ tatra saṃsadi । svarṇasiṃhāsanasthaṃ ca vasudevamuvāca saḥ ।। 32 ।। kaṃma uvāca tattavajño nītiśāstrāṇāṃ tvamupāyaviśāradaḥ । vraja nandavrajaṃ bandho vasudeva mutālayam ।। 33 ।। vṛṣabhānaṃ ca nandaṃ ca balaṃ ca nandanandanam । śīghramānaya yajñe'tra sarvaṃ gokulavāsinam ।। 34 ।। gṛhītvā patrikāṃ dūtā gacchantu ca caturdiśm । nṛpānmunigaṇānsarvānkartuṃ vijñāpanaṃ mudā ।। 35 ।। nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ । uvāca vacanaṃ brahman hṛdayena vidūṣatā ।। 36 ।। vasudeva uvāca niyuktamatra rājendra gamanaṃ mama sāṃpratam । vijñāpituṃ nandavrajaṃ nandaṃ vā nandanandanam ।। 37 ।। yadyāyāto nandaputro yāgo te ca mahotsave । avaśyaṃ tadvirodhaśca bhaviṣyati tvayā saha ।। 38 ।। tamahaṃ ca samānīya kārayiṣyāmi saṃyutam । iti me na hi bhadraṃ ca vidhnastasya tavāpi ca ।। 39 ।। pitrā''noto mṛtaḥ kṛṣṇa iti sarvo vadiṣyati । vasudevaḥ sutadvārā jaghāna nṛpameva ca ।। 40 ।। dvayorekatarasyāpi sadyo mṛtyurbhaviṣyati । patiṣyanti ca śūrāśca nāsti yuddhaṃ nirāmiṣam ।। 41 ।। vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā raktapaṅkacalocanaḥ । khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvā taṃ hantuṃ prayayau nṛpatīśvaraḥ ।। 42 ।। hāheti kṛtvā putraṃ ca vārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam । ugraseno mahārājamatīva balavānmune ।। 43 ।। svapīṭhādvasudevaśca kopāviṣṭo gṛhaṃ yayau । akrūraṃ prerayāmāsa gantuṃ nandavrajaṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 44 ।। dūtānprasthāpayāmāsa śīghraṃ pratidiśaṃ tathā । āyayurmunayaḥ sarve nṛpaśca saparicchadā ।। 45 ।। dikpālāśca surāḥ sarve brāhmaṇāśca tapasvinaḥ । sanakaśca sanandaśca voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ।। 46 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānprajvalanbrahmatejasā । kapilaścāsuriḥ pailaḥ sumantuśca sanātanaḥ ।। 47 ।। pulahaśca pulastyaśca bhṛsuśca kraturaṅgirāḥ । marīciḥ kaśyapaścaiva dakṣo'triścyavanastathā ।। 48 ।। bharadvājaśca vyāsaśca gautamaśca parāśaraḥ । pracetāśca vasiṣṭhaśca saṃvartaśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 49 ।। kātyāyano yājñavalkyo'pyuttaṅkaḥ saubharistathā । parvato devalaścaiva jaigīṣavyaśca jaiminiḥ ।। 50 ।। viśvāmitraśca sutapāḥ pippalaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ । jābālirjāṅgaliścaiva piśaliśca śilālikaḥ ।। 51 ।। āstaukaśca jagatkārustathā kalyāṇamitrakaḥ । durvāsā vāmadevaśca ṛṣyaśrṛṅgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।। 52 ।। pathiḥ kaviḥ kaṇādaśca gauśikaḥ pāṇinistathā । kautso'dyamarṣaṇaścaiva vālmīkirlomaharṣaṇaḥ ।। 53 ।। mārkaṇaḍeyo mṛkaṇḍuśca parśurāmaśca sāṃkṛtiḥ । agastyaśca tathā vāntastathā'nye munayo mune ।। 54 ।। saśiṣyāśca saputrāśca brāhmaṇāśca tapasvinaḥ । jarāsaṃdho dantavakro dāmbhiko draviḍādhipaḥ ।। 55 ।। śiśupālo bhīṣmakaśca bhagadattaśca mudgalaḥ । dhārtarāṣṭro dhūmakeśo dhūmraketuśca śambaraḥ ।। 56 ।। śalyaḥ satrājitaḥ śaṅkurnṛpāścānye mahābalāḥ । bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpācāryo hyaśvatthāmā mahābalāḥ ।। 57 ।। bhūriśravāśca śālvaśca kaikeyaḥ kauśalastathā । sarvānsaṃbhāṣayāmāsa mahārājo yathocitam satyako yajñadivase cakāra ca śubhakṣaṇam ।। 58 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... kaṃsayajñakathānaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ ।। 64 ।।
<4.65> atha pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyama uvāca kaṃsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā so'krūro dharmiṇāṃ varaḥ । uvāca cauddhavaṃ śāntaṃ śāntaḥ prahṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। 1 ।। akrūra uvāca suprabhātā'dya rajanī babhūva me śubhaṃ dinam । tuṣṭāśca guravo vibrā devā māmiti niścitam ।। 2 ।। koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ mama svayamupasthitam । babhūva me samutpannaṃ yadyatkarma śubhāśubham ।। 3 ।। ciccheda bandhanigaḍaṃ mama baddhasya karmaṇā । kārāgārāśca saṃsārānmukto yāmi hareḥpadam ।। 4 ।। suhṛdartho kṛto'haṃ ca kaṃsena viduṣā ruṣā । vareṇa tulyo devasya krodho mama babhūva ha ।। 5 ।। vrajarāja samāhartuṃ vrajaṃ yāsyāmi sāṃpratam । drakṣyāmi paramaṃ pūjyaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinam ।। 6 ।। navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ nīlendīvaranocanam । pītavastrasamāyuktakaṭideśavirājitam ।। 7 ।। dhūlidhūsaritāṅgaṃ ca kiṃvā candanacarcitam । athāva navanītāktamaṅgaṃ drakṣyāmi sasmitam ।। 8 ।। kiṃvā vinodamuralīṃ vādayantaṃ manoharam । kiṃvā gavāṃ samūhaṃ ca cārajantamitastataḥ ।। 9 ।। kiṃvā vasantaṃ gacchantaṃ śayānaṃ vā suniścitam । nidreśaṃ kīdṛśaṃ cādya sudṛṣṭvā ca śubhe kṣaṇo ।। 10 ।। yatpādapadmaṃ dhyāyante brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ । na hi jānāti yasyāntamananto'nantavigrahaḥ ।। 11 ।। yatprabhāvaṃ na jānanti devāḥ santaśca saṃtatam । sya stotre jaḍībhūtā bhītā devī sarasvatī ।। 12 ।। dāsīniyuktā yaddāsyo mahālakṣamīśca lakṣītā । gaṅmā yasya padāmbhojānniḥsṛtā sattava rūmiṇī ।। 13 ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharā tribhuvanātparā । darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ pātakanāśinī ।। 14 ।। dhyāyate yatpadāmbhojaṃ durgā durgavināśinī । trelokyajananī devī mulaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 15 ।। lomnāṃ kūpeṣu viśvāni mahāviṣṇośca yasya ca । asaṃkhyāni vicitrāṇi sthūlātsthūlatarasya ca ।। 16 ।। sa ca yatṣoḍaśāṃśaśca yasya sarveśvarasya ca । taṃ draṣṭuṃ yāmi he bandho māyāmānuṣarūpiṇam ।। 17 ।। sarva sarvāntarātmānaṃ sarvajñaṃ prakṛteḥ param । brahmajyotiḥsvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 18 ।। nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca nirānandaṃ nirāśrayam । paramaṃ paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanam ।। 19 ।। svecchāmayaṃ sarvaparaṃ sarvabījaṃ sanātanam । vadanti yoginaḥ śaśvaddhyāyante'harniśaṃ śiśum ।। 20 ।। manvantarasahasraṃ ca nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ । padme pādmastapastepe purā pādmaṃ tu yatkṛte ।। 21 ।। punaḥ kuru tapasyāṃ ca tadā drakṣyasi māmiti । sakṛcchabdaṃ ca śuśrāva na dadarśa tathā'pi tam ।। 22 ।। tāvatkālaṃ punastaptvā varaṃ prāpa dadarśa tam । īdṛśaṃ parameśaṃ ca drakṣyāmyadya tamuddhava ।। 23 ।। purā śaṃbhustapastepe yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ । jyotirmaṇḍalamadhye ca goloke taṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। 24 ।। sarvatattavaṃ sarvasiddhaṃ mamatatvaṃ paraṃ varam । saṃprāpa tatpadāmbhoje bhaktiṃ ca nirmalāṃ parām ।। 25 ।। cakārā'tmasamaṃ taṃ ca yo bhakto(ktaṃ)bhaktavatsalaḥ । īdṛśaṃ parameśaṃ ca drakṣyāmyadya tamuddhava ।। 26 ।। sahasraśakrapātāntaṃ nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ । yasyānantastapastepe bhaktyā ca paramātmanaḥ ।। 27 ।। tadā cā''tmasamaṃ jñānaṃdadau tasmai ya īśvāḥ । īdṛśaṃ parameśaṃ ca drakṣyā... ।। 28 ।। sahasraśakrapātāntaṃ dharmastepe ca yattapaḥ । tadā babhūva sākṣī sa dharmiṇāṃ sarvakarmiṇām ।। 29 ।। śāstā ca phaladātā ca yatprasādānnṛṇāmiha । sarveśamīdṛśamaho drakṣyā... ।। 30 ।। aṣṭāviṃśatirindrāṇāṃ patane yaddivāniśam । evaṃ krameṇa māsābdaiḥ śatābdaṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।। 31 ।। aho yasya nimeṣeṇa brahmaṇaḥ patanaṃ bhavet । īdṛśaṃ paramātmānaṃ drakṣyā... ।। 32 ।। nāsti bhūrajasā saṃkhyā yathaiva brahmaṇāṃ tathā । tathaiva bandho viśvānāṃ tadādhāro mahāvirāṭ ।। 33 ।। viśave viśve ca pratyekaṃ brahma viṣṇuśivādayaḥ । munayo manavaḥ middhā mānavādyāścarācarāḥ ।। 34 ।। yatṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ sa virāṭ sṛṣṭo naṣṭaśca līlayā । īdṛśaṃ sarvaśāstāraṃ drakṣyā... ।। 35 ।। ityovamuktvā'krūraśca pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ । mūrcchāṃ prāpa sāśrunetrodadhyo taccaraṇāmbujam ।। 36 ।। babhūva bhaktipūrṇaśca smāraṃ smāraṃ padāmbujam । kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ vā'pi kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 37 ।। uddhavaśca tamāśliṣya praśaśaṃka punaḥ punaḥ । sa ca śīghraṃ yayau gehamakūro'pi svamandiram ।। 38 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... akrūraharṣotkarṣakathanaṃ nāma pañcaṣaṣṭi,mo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 65 ।।
<4.66> atha ṣaṭuṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha rāseśvarīyukto rāse rāseśvaraḥ svayam । sa ca reme tayā sārdhaṃmatīva ramaṇotsukaḥ ।। 1 ।। sukhasaṃbhogamātreṇa yayau nidrāṃ ca rādhikā । dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ samutvāya dīnovāca priyaṃ dine ।। 2 ।। rādhikovāca aho svāminnihā''gaccha tvāṃ karomi svavakṣasi । pariṇāme vidhātā me na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati ।। 3 ।। ityuktvā kā mahābhāgā priyaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi । duḥsvapnaṃ kathāyāmāsa hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 4 ।। rādhikovāca ratnasiṃhāsane'haṃ ca ratnacchatraṃ ca bibhratī । tadātapatraṃ jagrāha ruṣaṭo vipraśca me prabho ।। 5 ।। sāgare kajjalākāre mahāghore ca dustare । gabhīre prerayāmāsa māmeva durbalāṃ sa ca ।। 6 ।। tatra srotasi śokārtā bhramāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ । mahormīṇāṃ ca vegena vyākulā nakrasaṃkule ।। 7 ।। trāhi trāhīti he nātha tvāṃ vadāmi punaḥ punaḥ । tvāṃ na dṛṣṭvā mahābhītā karomi prārthanāṃ suram ।। 8 ।। kṛṣṇa tatra nimajjantī paśyāmi candramaṇḍalam । nipatantaṃ ca gaganācchatakhaṇḍaṃ ca bhūtale ।। 9 ।। kṣaṇāntare ca paśyāmi gaganātsūryaṃmaṇḍalam । babhūva ca catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ nipatya dharaṇītale ।। 10 ।। ekakāle ca gagane maṇḍalaṃ candrasūryayoḥ । atīva kajjalākāraṃ sarvaṃ grastaṃ ca rāhuṇā ।। 11 ।। kṣaṇāntare ca paśyāmi brahmaṇo dīptimāniti । satkroḍasthaṃ sudhākumbhaṃ babhañja ca ruṣeti ca ।। 12 ।। kṣaṇāntare ca paśyāmi mahāruṣṭaṃ ca brāhmaṇam । gṛhītvā ca vrajantaṃ ca cakṣuṣoḥ puruṣaṃ mama ।। 13 ।। krīḍākamaladaṇḍaṃ ca hastāddhvastaṃ mama prabho । sahasā khaṇḍaśaṇḍaṃ ca babhūva saha hetunā ।। 14 ।। hastādṣvastaśca sahasā sadratnasāradarpaṇaḥ । nirmalaḥ kajjalākāraḥ khaṇḍakaṇḍo babhūva ha ।। 15 ।। hāro me ratnamārāṇāṃ chinno bhūtvā ca vakṣasaḥ । atīva marinaṃ padmaṃ papāta dharaṇītale ।। 16 ।। saudhaputtalikāḥ sarvā nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca । āsphoṭayanti gāyanti rudanti ya kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam ।। 17 ।। kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bṛhaccakraṃ khe bhramantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ । nipatantaṃ cotpatantaṃ paśyāmi ca bhayaṃkaram ।। 18 ।। prāṇādhidevaḥ puruṣo niḥsṛtyāmyantarānmama । rādhe vidāyaṃ dehīti tato yāmītyuvāca ha ।। 19 ।। kṛṣṇavarṇā ca pratimā māmāśliṣyati cumbati । kṛṣṇavastraparīdhānā ceti paśyāmi sāṃpratam ।। 20 ।। itīdaṃ viparītaṃ ca dṛṣṭāvā ca prāṇāvallabha । nṛtyanti takṣiṇāṅgāni prāṇā āndolayanti me ।। 21 ।। rudanti śokātkarṣanti samudvignaṃ ca mānasam । kimidaṃ kimidaṃ nātha vada vedavidāṃ vara ।। 22 ।। ityuktvā rādhikā devī śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukā । papāta tatpadāmbhoje bhītā sa śokaviṅvalā ।। 23 ।। śrutvā svapnaṃ jagannātho devīṃ kṛtvā svavakṣami । ādhyātmikena yogena vodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।। 24 ।। ttayāca śokaṃ sa devī jñānaṃ saṃprāpya nirmalam । śāntaṃ ca bhagavaṃtaṃ ca kṛtvā kāntaṃ svavakṣasi ।। 25 ।। iti... śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajānmakha... utta... nāradanā... rādhāśokāpanodane ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 66 ।।
<4.67> athā saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca virahavyākulāṃ dṛṣṭvā māminīṃ kāmamohanaḥ । kṛtvā vakṣasi tāṃ kṛṣṇo yayau krīḍāsarovaram ।। 1 ।। rājarājeśvarī rādhā kṛṣṇavakṣasi rājate । saudāminīva jalade nadīne gagane mune ।। 2 ।। reme sa ramayā sārdhaṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ । dvayordvayoryathā svarṇaṃmaṇyormārakato maṇiḥ ।। 3 ।। ratnanirmāṇaparyaṅke ratnendrasāranirmite । natnapradīpe jvalati ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 4 ।। ratnabhūṣābhūṣitayā rāsaratnaśca kautukāt । rasaratnākare ramye nimagno rasikeśvaraḥ ।। 5 ।। rāse rāseśvarī rādhā rāmeśvaramuvāca sā । suratau viratau satyāṃ virate na manorathe ।। 6 ।। rādhikovāca praphullā'haṃ tvayā nātha mṛtā mlānā ca tvāṃ vinā । yathā mahauṣadhigaṇaḥ prabhāte bhāti bhāskare ।। 7 ।। naktaṃ dīpaśikhevāhaṃ tvayā sārdhaṃ tvayā vinā । dine dine yathā kṣīṇā kṛṣṇapakṣe vidhoḥ kalā ।। 8 ।। tava vakṣasi me dīptiḥ pūrṇaṃcandraprabhāsamā । sadyo mṛtā tvayā tyaktā kuhvāṃ candrakalā yathā ।। 9 ।। jvaladagniśikhevāhaṃ ghṛtāhutyā tvayā saha । tvayā vinā'haṃ nirvāṇā śiśire padminī yathā ।। 10 ।। cintājvarajarāgrastā mattastvayi gate'pyaham । astaṃgate ravau candre dhvāndagrastā dharā yathā ।। 11 ।। bhraṣṭo veṣastvāṃ vinā me rupayauvanacetanam । tārāvalī paribhraṣṭā sūryasūtodaye yathā ।। 12 ।। tvamevā''tmā ca sarveṣāṃ mama nātho viśeṣataḥ । tanuryathā''tmanā tyaktā tathā'haṃ ca tvayā vinā ।। 13 ।। pañcaprāṇātmakastvaṃ me mṛtā'haṃ ca tvayā vinā । dṛṣṭeśca golakau jadvaddṛṣṭiḥ puttalikāṃ vinā ।। 14 ।। sthalaṃ yathā citrayuktaṃ tvayā sārdhamahaṃ tathā । asaṃskṛtā tvayā hīnā tṛṇācchannā yathā mahī ।। 15 ।। tvayā sārdhamahaṃ kṛṣṇa citrayukteva mṛnmayī । tvāṃ vinā jaladhautā'haṃ virūpā mṛnmayīva ca ।। 16 ।। gopāṅganānāṃ śobhā ca tvayā rāseśvareṇa ca । hāre svarṇavikāre ca śvetena maṇinā saha ।। 17 ।। vrajarāja tvayā sārdha rājante rājarājayaḥ । yathā candreṇa nabhasi tārārājirvirājate ।। 18 ।। tvayā śobhā yaśodāyā nandasya nandanandana । yathā śākhāphalaskandhaistarurājirvirājate ।। 19 ।। tvayā kārdha gokuleśa sobhā gokulavāsinām । yathā sarvā lokarājī rājendreṇa virājate ।। 20 ।। rāmasyāpi ca rāseśa tvayā śobhā manoharā । rājate devarājena yathā svarge'marāvatī ।। 21 ।। vṛndāvanasya vṛkṣāṇāṃ tvaṃ ca śobhā patirgatiḥ । anyoṣāṃ ca vanānāṃ ca balavānkesarī yathā ।। 22 ।। tvayā vinā yaśodā ya nimagnā śokasāgare । aprāpya vatsaṃ murabhiḥ krośantī vyākulā yathā ।। 23 ।। āndolayanti nandasya prāṇā dagdhaṃ ca mānasam । tvayā vinā taptapātre yathā dhānyasamūhakaḥ ।। 24 ।। ityuktvā paramapremṇā sā patantī hareḥ pade । punarādhyātmikenaiva bodhayāmāsa tāṃ vibhuḥ ।। 25 ।। ādhyātmiko mahāyogī mohasaṃchedakāraṇam । yathā parśuśca vṛkṣāṇāṃ tīkṣṇadhāraśca nārada ।। 26 ।। nārada uvāca ādhyātmikaṃ mahāyogaṃ vada vedavidāṃ vara । śokacchedaṃ ca lokānāṃ śrotuṃ kautuhalaṃ mama ।। 27 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca ādhyātmiko mahāyogo na jñāto yogināmavi । sa ca nānāprakāraśca sarvaṃ vetti hariḥ svayam ।। 28 ।। kiṃcidādhyātmikaṃ caiva gonoke rādhikeśvaraḥ । suprītaḥ kathāyāmāsa tripurāriṃ yathā mune ।। 29 ।। sahasrendranipātāntaṃ tapaḥ kurvantamīśvaram । śreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ ca tapasvinām ।। 30 ।। puṣkare duṣkaraṃ taptvā pādme pādmaṃ ca padmajaḥ । dṛṣṭvā taṃ sādaraṃ kṛṣṇa uvāca kiṃcidevatam ।। 31 ।। śatendrapātaparyantaṃ kaṭhoreṇa kṛśodaram । niśceṣṭamasthisāraṃ ca kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 32 ।। siṃhakṣetre purā dharmaṃ mattātaṃ dharmiṇāṃ varam । caturdaśendrāvacchinnaṃ tapastaptvā kṛśodaram ।। 33 ।। papāṭhā''yātmikaṃ kiṃcitkṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ । kicicchatendrāvacchinnaṃ māṃ tapantamuvāca saḥ ।। 34 ।। kiṃcitsanatkumāraṃ ca tapantaṃ suciraṃ param । sutapantamanantaṃ ca kiṃciccovāca nārada ।। 35 ।। ciraṃ tapantaṃ kapilaṃ himaśaile tapasvinam । puṣkare bhāskare kiṃcittapantaṃ duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।। 36 ।। uvāca kiṃcitprahlādaṃ kiṃciddurvāsasaṃ bhṛgum । evaṃ nigūḍhaṃ bhaktaṃ ca kṛpyā bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 37 ।। krīḍākanovare ramye yaduvāca kṛpānidhiḥ । śokārtāṃ rādhikāṃ tacca kathāyāmi niśāmaya ।। 38 ।। virasaṃ rasikāṃ dṛṣṭvā vāsayitvā ca vakṣasi । uvācā''dhyātmikaṃ kiṃcidyoginīṃ yogināṃ guruḥ ।। 39 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca jātismare smarā''tmānaṃ kathaṃ vismarasi priye । sarvaṃ golokavṛttāntaṃ sudāmnaḥ śāpameva ca ।। 40 ।। śāpātkiṃciddinaṃ dīne tvadvicchedo mayā saha । bhaviṣyati mahābhāge melanaṃ punarāvayoḥ ।। 41 ।। punareva gamiṣyāmi golokaṃ taṃ nijālayam । gatvā gopāṅganābhiśca gopairgolokavāsibhiḥ ।। 42 ।। adhunā''dhyātmikaṃ kiṃcittavāṃ vadāmi niśāmaya । śokadhnaṃ harṣadaṃ sāraṃ sukhadaṃ mānasasya ca ।। 43 ।। ahaṃ sarvāntarātmā ca nirliptaḥ sarvakarmasu । vidyamānaśca sarveṣu sarvatrādṛṣṭa eva ca ।। 44 ।। vāyuścarati sarvatra yathaiva sarvavastuṣu । na ca liptastathaivāhaṃ sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām ।। 45 ।। jīvo matpratibimbaśca sarvatra sarvajīviṣu । bhoktā śubhāśubhānāṃ ca kartā ca karmaṇāṃ sadā ।। 46 ।। yathā calaghaṭeṣveva maṇḍalaṃ candramuryayoḥ । bhagneṣu teṣu saṃśliṣṭastayoreva tathā mayi ।। 47 ।। jīvaḥ śliṣṭastathā kāle mṛteṣu jīviṣu priye । āvāṃ ca vidyamānau ca satataṃ sarvajantuṣu ।। 48 ।। ādhāraścāhamādheyaṃ kārya ca kāraṇaṃ vinā । aye sarvāṇi dravyāṇi naśvarāṇi ca sundari ।। 49 ।। āvirbhāvādhikāḥ kutra kutracinnyūnameva ca । mamāṃśāḥ ke'pi devāśca keciddevāḥkalāstathā ।। 50 ।। kecitkalāḥ kalāṃśāṃśāstadaṃśāṃśāśca kecana । madaṃśā prakṛtiḥ sūkṣmā sāca mūrtyāca pañcadhā ।। 51 ।। sarasvatī ca kamalā durgā tvaṃ cāpi vedasūḥ । sarve devāḥ prākṛtikā yāvanto mūrtidhāriṇaḥ ।। 52 ।। ahamātmā nityadehī bhaktadhyānānurodhataḥ । ye ye prakṛtikā rādhe te naṣṭāḥ prākṛte laye ।। 53 ।। ahamevā''samevāgre paścādapyahameva ca । yathā'haṃ ca tathā tvaṃ ca yathā dhāvalyadugdhayoḥ ।। 54 ।। bhedaḥ kadā'pi na bhavenniścitaṃ ca tathā''vayoḥ । ahaṃ mahānvirāṭ suṣaṭau viśvāni yasya lomasu ।। 55 ।। aṃśastvaṃ tatra mahatī svāṃśena tasya kāminī । āhaṃ kṣudravirāṭ sṛṣṭau viśvaṃ yannābhipadmataḥ ।। 56 ।। ayaṃ viṣṇorlomakūpe vāso me cāṃśataḥ sati । tasya strī tvaṃ ca bṛhatī svāśane subhagā tathā ।। 57 ।। tasya viśve ca pratyekaṃ brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ । brahmaviṣṇuśivā aṃśāścānye cāpi ca matkalāḥ ।। 58 ।। matkalāṃśāṃśakalayā sarve devi carācarāḥ । vaikuṇṭhe tvaṃ mahālakṣmīrahaṃ tatra caturbhujaḥ ।। 59 ।। sa ca viśvādbahiścordhvaṃ yathā goloka eva ca । sarasvatī tvaṃ satye ca sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyāḥ ।। 60 ।। śivaloke śivā tvraṃ ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī । vināśya durgaṃ durgā ca sarvadurgatināśinī ।। 61 ।। sa eva dakṣakanyā ca sā eva śailakanyakā । kailāse pārvatī tena saubhāgyā śivavakṣasi ।। 62 ।। svāṃśena tvaṃ sindhukanyā kṣīrode viṣṇuvakṣasi । ahaṃ svāśena sṛṣṭau ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 63 ।। tvaṃ ca lakṣmī śivā dhātrī sāvitrī ca pṛthakpṛthak । goloke ca svayaṃ rādhā rāse rāseśvarī sadā ।। 64 ।। vṛndā dṛndāvane ramye virajā virajātaṭe । sā tvaṃ sudāmaśāpena bhārataṃ puṇyamāgatā ।। 65 ।। pūtaṃ kartuṃ bhārataṃ ca vṛndāraṇyaṃ ca sundari । tvatkalāṃśāṃśakalayā viśveṣu sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। 66 ।। yāyoṣitsā ca bhavatī yaḥ pumānso'hameva ca । ahaṃ ca kalayā vahnistvaṃ svāhā dāhikā priyā ।। 67 ।। tvayā saha samartho'haṃ nālaṃ dagdhuṃ ca tvāṃ vinā । ahaṃ dīptimatāṃ sūryaḥ kalayā tvaṃ prabhākarī ।। 68 ।। saṃjñā tvaṃ ca tvayā bhāmi tvāṃ vinā'haṃ na dīptimān । ahaṃ ca kalayā candrastvaṃ ca śobhā ca rohiṇī ।। 69 ।। manoharastvayā sārdhaṃ tvāṃ na ca sundaraḥ । ahamindraśca kalayā svargalakṣmīśca tvaṃ śacī ।। 70 ।। tvayā sārdhaṃ devarājo hataśrīśca tvayā vinā । ahaṃdharmaśca kalayā tvaṃ ca mūrtiśca dharmiṇī ।। 71 ।। nāhaṃ śakto dharmakṛtyo tvāṃ ca dharmakriyāṃ vinā । ahaṃ yajñaśca kalayā tvaṃ ca svāṃśena dakṣiṇā ।। 72 ।। tvayā sārdhaṃ ca phalado'pyakamarthastvayā vinā । kalayā pidṛloko'haṃ svāṃśena tvaṃ svadhā satī ।। 73 ।। tvayā'laṃ kavyadāne ca sadā nālaṃ tvayā vinā । ahaṃ pumāṃstvaṃ prakṛtirna sraṣṭā'haṃ tvayā vinā ।। 74 ।। tvaṃ ca saṃvatsvarūpā'hamīśvaraśca tvayā saha । lakṣmīyuktastvayā lakṣmayā niḥ śrīkaśca tvayā dinā ।। 75 ।। yathā nālaṃ kulālaśca ghaṭaṃ kartuṃ mṛdā vinā । ahaṃ śeṣaśca kalayā svāṃśena tvaṃ vasuṃdharā ।। 76 ।। tvāṃ sasyaratnādhārāṃ ca bibharmi mūrdhni sundari । tvaṃ ca kāntiśca śāntiśca bhūtirmūrtimatī satī ।। 77 ।। tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ kṣamā lajjā kṣudhā tṛṣṇā parā dayā । nidrā śraddhā ca tandrā ca mūrcchā ca saṃnatiḥ kriyā ।। 78 ।। mūrtirūpā bhaktirūpā dehināṃ deharūpiṇī । mamā''dhārā sadā tvaṃ ca tavā'tmā'haṃ parasparam ।। 79 ।। yathā tvaṃ ca tathā'haṃ ca samau prakṛtipūruṣau । na hi sṛṣṭirbhaveddevi dvayorekataraṃ vinā ।। 80 ।। ityuktvā paramātmā ca rādhāṃ prāṇādhikāṃ priyām । kṛtvā vakṣasi suprīto bodhayāmāsa nārada ।। 81 ।। sa ca kīḍāniyuktaśca babhūva ratnamandire । tathā ca rādhāyā sārdhaṃ kāmukyā saha kāmukaḥ ।। 82 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... ādhyatmikayogakathanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 67 ।।
<4.68> athāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca kṛtvā krīḍāṃ samutthāya puṣpatalpātpurātanaḥ । nidritāṃ prāṇasadṛśīṃ bodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।। 1 ।। vastrāñcalena saṃskṛtya kṛtvā tannirmalaṃ mukham । uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaṃ śāntāṃ ca madhusūdanaḥ ।। 2 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ayi tiṣṭhakṣaṇaṃ rādhe rāseśvari śucismite । vraja bṛndāvanaṃ vā'pi vrajaṃ vraja vrajeśvari ।। 3 ।। rāsādhiṣṭhātṛtevi tvaṃ rāsaṃ rāse kuru kṣaṇam । grāme grāme yathā santi sarvatra grāmadevatāḥ ।। 4 ।। priyāralinivahaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ candanakānanam । kṣaṇaṃ vā campakavanaṃ ghaccha vā tiṣṭha sundari ।। 5 ।। kṣaṇaṃ gṛhaṃ ca yāsyāmi viśiṣṭaṃ kāryamasti me । vidāyaṃ dehi me prītyā kṣaṇaṃ māṃ prāṇavallabhe ।। 6 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ prāṇāśca tvayi santi me । prāṇī vihāya praṇāṃśca kutra sthātuṃ kṣamaḥ priye ।। 7 ।। tvayi me mānasaṃ śaśvattavaṃ me saṃsāravāsanā । tvatto mama priyā nāsti tvameva śaṃkarātpriyā ।। 8 ।। prāṇā me śaṃkaraḥ satyaṃ tvaṃ ca prāṇādhikā sati । ityuktvā tāṃ samāśliṣya bhagavān gantusudyataḥ ।। 9 ।। akrūrāgamanaṃ jñātvā sarvajñaḥ sarvasādhanaḥ । ātmā pātā ca sarveṣāṃ sarvopakārakārakaḥ ।। 10 ।। dṛṣṭvā tameva gacchantamutsukaṃ bhinnamānasam । uvāca rādhikā devī hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 11 ।। rādhikovāca he nātha ramaṇapreṣṭha śreṣṭhaśca preyasāṃ mama । he kṛṣṇa he ramānātha vrajeśa mā draja vrajam ।। 12 ।। adhunā tvāṃ prāṇanātha paśyāmi bhinnamānasam । gate tvayi mama prema gataṃ saubhāgyameva ca ।। 13 ।। kva yāsi māṃ vinikṣipya gambhīre śokasāgare । virahavyākulāṃ dīnāṃ tvayyeva śaraṇāgatām ।। 14 ।। na yāsyāmi punargehaṃ yāsyāmi kānanāntaram । kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti gāyaṃ gāyaṃ divāniśam ।। 15 ।। na yāsyāmyathavā'raṇyaṃ yāsyāmi kāmasāgare । tatra tvatkāmanāṃ kṛtvā tyakṣyāmi ca kalevaram ।। 16 ।। yathā''kāśo yathā''tmā ca yathā candro thā raviḥ । tathā tvaṃ yāsi matpārśve nibaddho vasanāñcale ।। 17 ।। adhunā yāsi nairāśyaṃ kṛtvā me dīnavatsala । na yuktaṃ hi parityaktuṃ dīnāṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatām ।। 18 ।। yatpādapadmaṃ dhayāyante brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ । tvāṃ māyayā gopaveṣaṃ kathaṃ jānāmi matsarī ।। 19 ।। kṛtaṃ yaddeva durnītamaparādhasahasrakam । yaduktaṃ patibhāvena cābhimānena tatkṣama ।। 20 ।। cūrṇobhūtaśca madgarvo dūrībhūto manorathaḥ । vijñātumātmasaubhāgyaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi te ।। 21 ।। jñātvā gargamukhacchrutvā mohitā tava māyayā । tvāṃ ca vaktuṃ na śaknomi premṇā vā bhaktipāśataḥ ।। 22 ।। yāsi cenmāṃ parityajya sakalaṅko bhaviṣyasi । tvatputrapautrā naśyanti brahmamopānalena ca ।। 23 ।। kṣaṇaṃ yugaśataṃ manye tvāṃ vinā prāṇavallabham । kathaṃ śatābdaṃ tvāṃ tyaktvā bibharmi jīvanaṃ prabhī ।। 24 ।। ityuktvā rādhikā mopātpapāta dharaṇītale । mūrcchaṃ saṃprāpa sahasā jahāra cetanāṃ mune ।। 25 ।। kuṣṇastāṃ mūrcchitāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ । cetanāṃ kārayitvā ca vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 26 ।। bodhayāmāsa vividhaṃ yogaiḥśokavikhaṇḍanaiḥ । tathā'pi śokaṃ tyaktuṃ ca na śaśāka śucismitā ।। 27 ।। sāmānyavastuviśleṣīnṛṇāṃ śokāya kevalam। dehātmanośca vicchedaḥ kva sukhāya prakalpate ।। 28 ।। na yayau tatra divase vrajarājo vrajaṃ pati । krīḍāsarovarābhyāśaṃ prayayau rādhāyā saha ।। 29 ।। tatra gatvā punaḥ krīḍāṃ cakāra ca tayā saha । vijahau krihajvālāṃ rāse rāseśvarī mudā ।। 30 ।। rādhā sā svāminā sārdhaṃ puṣpacandanacarcitā । puṣpacandanatalpe ca tasthau rahasi nārada ।। 31 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmākha... utta... nāradanā... rādhāśokavimocanaṃ nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 68 ।।
<4.69> athaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ rahasyaṃ rādhākeśavayorvada । nigūḍhatatvāmaspaṣṭaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramādbhutam । gopanīyaṃ ca vedeṣu purāṇeṣu purāvidām ।। 2 ।। punaḥ sakāmo bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ svecchāmayo vibhuḥ । reme sa ramayā sārdhaṃ vidagdhaśca vidagdhayā ।। 3 ।। catuḥṣaṣṭikalāśaktyā yathā kāntā kalāvatī । kāmaśāstreṣu nipuṇā vidagdhā rasikeśvarī ।। 4 ।। śṛṅgāralīlānipuṇā śaśvatkāmā ca kāmukī । sundarī sundarīṣveva śaśvatsusthirayauvanā ।। 5 ।। pitaṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā ca māninī । śaṃbhoḥ śiṣyā jñānayutā śatakalpāntajīvinī ।। 6 ।। vedavedāṅganipuṇā yoganītiviśāradā । nānārūpadharā sādhvī prasiddhā siddhayoginī ।। 7 ।। tatkanyā rādhikā devī mātṛtulyā ca kāmukī । cakāra nānābhāvaṃ sā suśīlā svāminaṃ prati ।। 8 ।। catuḥṣaṣṭikalāmānaṃ śrṛṅgāraṃ ca cakāra saḥ । tyā viśiṣṭayā sākaṃ rāse rāmarasotsukaḥ ।। 9 ।। tāṃ nakhāgrakṣataśroṇīṃ nakhakṣatapayodharām । luptacandanasiṃdūrāṃ kabarīśithilāṃ satīm ।। 10 ।। sukhasaṃbhogamagnāṃ ca nagnāṃ ca śokamūrcchitām । pulakāñcitasarpāṅgīṃ nidrādevī samāyayau ।। 11 ।। dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nidritāṃ kṛṣṇaḥkṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ । ruroda māyayā māyī mayeśo lokaśikṣayā ।। 12 ।। kṛtvā vakṣasi rādhāṃ ca cucumba ca punaḥ punaḥ । snātāṃ ca netrasalilaiḥ prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām ।। 13 ।। prāṇādhikāṃ priyatamāṃ dhārayāmāsa vāsasī । vahniśuddhe'tisūkṣme cāmūlye viśvamudurlabhe ।। 14 ।। kabarīṃ ca dadau kuṅkumacandanam । tadgātre ca gale hāramamūlyaṃ ratnanirmitam ।। 15 ।। sindūraṃ ca dadau tasyāḥ sīmantādhaḥsthale'male । dāḍimīkusumākāraṃ yuktaṃ candanabindubhi ।। 16 ।। cakāra padmakaṃ gaṇḍe nānācitravicitrakam । dadau tatpādapadme ca ratnamañjīrarañjitam ।। 17 ।। pādāṅgulinakhāge ca sundarālaktakaṃ dadau । nānāsuveṣojjvalitāṃ tāṃ nidrākulitāṃ vibhuḥ ।। 18 ।। punaścakāra mohena gāḍhāliṅganamīpsitam । punaśca cumbanaṃ kṛtvā niveśya ca svavakṣasi ।। 19 ।। suṣvāpa jagatāṃ svāmī kāntāvirahakātaraḥ । etasminnantare kāne brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।। 20 ।। śivaśeṣādibhirdevairmunīndraiḥ sārdhamāyayau । āgatya natvā sirasā tuṣṭāva saṃpuṭāñjaliḥ ।। 21 ।। sāmavedoktastotreṇa paripūrṇatamaṃ vibhum ।। 22 ।। brahmovāca jaya jaya jagadīśa vanditacaraṇa nirguṇa nirākāra svecchāmaya bhaktānugraha nityavigraha ।। 23 ।। gopaveṣa māyayā māyeśa suveṣa suśīla śānta sarvakānta dānta nitāntajñānānanda parātparatara prakṛteḥ para sarvāntarātmarūpa nirlipta sākṣisvarūpa vyaktāvyakta nirañjana bhārāvatāraṇa karuṇārṇava śokasetāpagrasana jarāmṛtyubhayādiharaṇa śaraṇapañjara bhaktānugrahakāraka bhaktavatsala bhaktasaṃcitadhana oṃ namo'stu te ।। 24 ।। sarpādhiṣṭhātṛdevāyetyuktvā vai prīṇanāya ca । punaḥpunaḥruvācedaṃ mūrcchitaśca babhūva ha ।। 25 ।। iti brahmakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ । tatsarpābhīṣṭasiddhiśca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 26 ।। aputro labhate putraṃ priyāhīno labhetpriyām । nirdhano labhate satyaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ dhanam ।। 27 ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cānte dāsyaṃ labheddhareḥ । acalāṃ bhaktimāpnoti mukterapi sudurlabhām ।। 28 ।। stutvā ca jagatāṃ dhātā praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ । śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samutthāya bhaktyā punaruvāca ha ।। 29 ।। brahmovāca uttiṣṭha devadeveśa paramānandakāraṇa । nandanandana sānanda nityānanda namo'stu te ।। 30 ।। vraja nandālayaṃ nātha tyaja vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । smara sṛdāmaśāpaṃ ca śatavarṣanibandhanam ।। 31 ।। bhaktaśāpānṛrodhena śatavarṣa priyāṃ tyaja । punarenāṃ ca saṃprāpya golokaṃ ca gamiṣyasi ।। 32 ।। gatvā pitṛgṛhaṃ deva paśyākūraṃ samāgatam । pitṛvyamatithiṃ mānyaṃ dhanyaṃ vaiṣṇavamīśvara ।। 33 ।। tena sārdhaṃ madhupurīṃ bhagavān gaccha saṃpratam । kuru śaṃbhordhanurbhaṅgaṃ bhagnaṃ vairigaṇaṃ hare ।। 34 ।। hana kaṃsaṃ durātmānaṃ tātaṃ bodhaya mātaram । nirmāṇaṃ dvārakāyāśca bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhuvaḥ ।। 35 ।। daha vārāṇasīṃ śaṃbhoḥ śakrasya sadanaṃ vibho । śivasya jṛmbhaṇaṃ yuddhe bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam ।। 36 ।। rukmiṇīharaṇaṃ nātha ghātanaṃ narakasya ca । ṣoḍaśānāṃ sahasraṃ ca strīṇāṃ pāṇigrahaṃ kuru ।। 37 ।। tyaja priyāṃ prāṇasamāṃ vrajeśvara vrajaṃ vraja । uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te yāvadrādhā na jāgrati ।। 38 ।। tyevamuktvā brahmā ca sendrairdevagaṇaiḥ saha । jagāma brahmalokaṃ ca śeṣaśca śaṃkarastathā ।। 39 ।। puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiṃ ca kuṣṇasyopari devatāḥ । cakruḥ prītyā ca bhaktyā ca vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। 40 ।। badha kaṃsaṃ vathārha ca svapitrormokṣaṇaṃ kuru । kṣayaṃ kurubhuvo bhāraṃ nāradetyevameva ca ।। 41 ।। ityevaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ । rādhā bhagavatīṃ tyaktvā samuttasthau śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।। 42 ।। yayau hariḥ kiyaddūraṃ nirīkṣya ca punaḥ punaḥ । kṣaṇaṃ tasthau candanānāṃ vane vāsasamīpataḥ ।। 43 ।। vihāya rādhā nindrāṃ sā samuttasthau svatalpataḥ । na nirīkṣya harīṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ ca prāṇavallabham ।। 44 ।। hā nātha ramaṇa preṣṭha prāṇeśa prāṇavallabha । prāṇacora priyatama kva gato'sītyuvāca ha ।। 45 ।। kṣaṇamanveṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā babhrāma mālatīvanam । uvāsa kṣaṇamuttasthau kṣaṇaṃ suṣvāpa bhūtale ।। 46 ।। ruroda kṣaṇamatyuccairvilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ । āgacchā''gaccha he nāthetyevasuktvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 47 ।। mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa saṃtāpātsaṃptatā virahānalaiḥ । bhūtale ca tṛṇācchanne papāta ca yathā mṛtā ।। 48 ।। āyayustatra gopyaśca brahmañchatasahasraśaḥ । kāściccāmarahastāśca gṛhītvā candanadravam ।। 49 ।। tāsāṃ madhye priyā līlā kṛtvā rādhāṃ svavakṣasi । mṛtāmiva priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda premavihvalā ।। 50 ।। sajalaṃ paṅkajadalaṃ paṅkopari nidhāya ca । sthāpayāmāsa tāṃ rādhāṃ niśceṣṭāṃ ca mṛtāmiva ।। 51 ।। gopībhiḥ sevitāṃ tatra ruciraiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ । candanadravayuktāṃ ca snigdhavastrānvitāṃ satīm ।। 52 ।। dadarśa kṛṣṇastatraitya tāmeva prāṇavallabhām । nivāritaśca gopībhirbaliṣṭhābhiśca nārada ।। 53 ।। yathā nītaḥ sāparādho daṇḍatho rājabhaṭādibhiḥ । cakāra rādhāṃ kroḍe ca samāgatya kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 54 ।। cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa bodhayāmāsa bodhanaiḥ । saṃprāpya cetanāṃ devī dadarśa prāṇavallābhām ।। 55 ।। babhūva susthirā devī tatyāja virahajvaram । cakāra kāntaṃ sā kāntā gātrāliṅganamīpsitam ।। 56 ।। nānāprakāraśṛṅgāraṃ cakāra madhusūdanaḥ । uvāsa ratnatalpe ca rādhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 57 ।। rādhāsakhī ratnamālā vidagdhā sarvapūjitā । uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ madhuraṃ nītisāramanuttamam ।। 58 ।। ratnamārovāca śṛṇu kṛṣṇa pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham । hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ daṃpatyoḥ prītikāraṇam ।। 59 ।। saṃmataṃ kāmaśāstreṣu nītau vedapurāṇayoḥ । laukikavyavarāreṣu praśasyaṃ suyaśaskaram ।। 60 ।। nārīṇāṃ ca priyā mātā priyo bhrātā ca vandhuṣu । tataḥ priyaśca putraśca putrādeva priyaḥ patiḥ ।। 61 ।। śataputrātpriyaḥ svāmī sādhvīnāṃ sādhusaṃmataḥ । rasikānāṃ vidagdhānāṃ na hi bhartuḥ paraḥ priyaḥ ।। 62 ।। yadi bhartā vidagdhaśca vidagdhānāṃ sukhāvahaḥ । anyathā viṣatulyaśca viṣamaścetkhalaḥ khalu ।। 63 ।। saṃsāre cānṛte vatsa daṃpatyoḥ prītireva ca । parasparaṃ ca samatā priyasaubhāgyamīpsitam ।। 64 ।। daṃpatyoḥ samatā nāsti yatrayatra hi mantire । alakṣmīstatra tatraiva viphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tayoḥ ।। 65 ।। susvāmināṃ vibhedaśca paraṃ duḥkhaṃ ca yoṣitām । śokasaṃtāpabījaṃ ca jīvitaṃ maraṇādhikam ।। 66 ।। svapne jāgaraṇe cāpi patiḥ prāṇāśca yoṣitaḥ । patireva guruḥ strīṇāmiha loke paratra ca ।। 67 ।। asmāttavayi gate nāthe mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa rādhikā । papāta sahasā bhūmau tṛṇācchanne ca bhūtale ।। 68 ।। mayā dattaṃ mukhe'syāśca śītalaṃ jalamuttamam । tadā śvāso babhūvāsyāścetanaṃ bālyameva ca ।। 69 ।। kṣaṇaṃ vadati he nātha he kṛṣṇeti kṣaṇaṃ sakhī । kṣaṇaṃ roditi saṃtaptā mūrcchāṃ prāpnoti tatkṣaṇam ।। 70 ।। rādhikāyāḥ śarīraṃ ca saṃtaptaṃ virahānalaiḥ । dagdhalohayaṣṭisamamaspṛśyamanalopamam ।। 71 ।। svapne jāganaṇe rātrau divase ca gṛhe vane । jale sthale cāntarikṣe'bhyudaye candrasūryayoḥ ।। 72 ।। nāsti bhedaśca rādhāyā mṛtatulyā jaḍākṛtiḥ । śaśvatpaśyati sthānasthā sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagat ।। 73 ।। snigdhapaṅke paṅkajānāṃ sajalāni dalāni ca । nipatya tatkṛte talpe suṣvāpa virahāturā ।। 74 ।। sevitā sā priyālībhiḥ saṃtataṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ । candanadravasaṃsiktā snigdhavastrasamanvitā ।। 75 ।। rādhāṅgasparśamātreṇa paṅkaḥ saṃprāpa śuṣkatām । snigdhāni padmapatrāṇi babhūvurbhasmasātkṣaṇam ।। 76 ।। candanaṃ śuṣkatāṃ prāpa varṇaścampakasaṃnibhaḥ । babhuva kajjalākāraḥ keśasya varṇato hare ।। 77 ।। sindūrabindū ruciraḥ śyāmatāṃ prāpa tatkṣaṇam । veṣo vilāso līlā ca krīḍā tyaktā babhūva ha ।। 78 ।। ratnamālā tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā gatvā kṛṣṇāntikaṃ tadā । uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ rādhāhitakaraṃ param ।। 79 ।। ratnamālovāca he kṛṣṇa kamalākānta tvadviyogena matsakhī । prāṇāṃstyakṣyati śīghraṃ sā yadi nā''yāsyasi dhruvam ।। 80 ।। vicārya manasā kṛṣṇa yattatsamṛcitaṃ kuru । na bhavetkāminīhatyā yena nītiviśārada ।। 81 ।। ratnamālāvācaḥ śrutvā prahasyovāca mādhavaḥ । hitaṃ satyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇamasukhāvaham ।। 82 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca īśo yadyapi śakto'haṃ niṣekaṃ khaṇḍituṃ priye । tathā'pi na kṣamo ratne niyaternaṃ karomyaham ।। 83 ।। brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu maryādā sthāpitā mayā । tayā karma prakurvanti munayaśca surā narāḥ ।। 84 ।। sudāmaśāpādvicchedaḥ śatavarṣamanīpsitaḥ । bhaviṣyatyeva daṃpatyorāvayoreva sundari ।। 85 ।। bhedo jāgaraṇe'syāśca mayā saha sumadhyame । saṃśleṣaḥ saṃtataṃ svapne madvareṇa bhaviṣyati ।। 86 ।। ādhyātmikī mayā dattā śokacchedo bhaviṣyati । rādhāṃ bodhaya bhadraṃ te yāsyāmi nandamandiram ।। 87 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho yayau nandālayaṃ prati । rādhikāṃ bodhayāmāsurālisaṃghāśca nārada ।। 88 ।। gatvā gṛhaṃ ca pitaraṃ nanāma mātaraṃ tathā । cakāra mātā kroḍe ca navanītaṃ ca nūtanam ।। 89 ।। mātṛdattaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ cakhāda śītalaṃ jalam । uvāsa tatra jagatāṃ nātho mātṛsamīpataḥ ।। 90 ।। sarvairgopasamūhaiśca sevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ । mālyacandanatāmbūlaṃ te ca tasmai dadurmudā ।। 91 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇacanmakha... utta... nāradanā... śrīkṛṣṇāgamanaṃ nāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 69 ।।
<4.70> atha saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca athākrūraḥ svaśaraṇaṃ gatvā kaṃsena preṣitaḥ । cakāra śayanaṃ talpe bhuktvā mīṣṭānnamuttamam ।। 1 ।। sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ cakhāda vāsitaṃ jalam । jagāma nidrāṃ sukhataḥ sukhasaṃbhogamātrataḥ ।। 2 ।। tato dadarśa susvapnaṃ purāṇaśrutisaṃmatam । niśāvaśeṣasamaye bādhādiparivarjitaḥ ।। 3 ।। arogī baddhakeśaśca vastrayugmasamanvitaḥ । sutalpaśāyī susnigdhaścintāśokavivarjitaḥ ।। 4 ।। kiśoravayasaṃ śyāmaṃ dvibhujaṃ muralīdharam । pītavastraparīdhānaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 5 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ mālatīmālyaśobhitam । bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇārhaṃ ca sadratnamaṇibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 6 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca sasmitaṃ padmalocanam । evaṃbhūtaṃ dvicaśiśuṃ dadarśa prathamaṃ mune ।। 7 ।। tato dadarśa rucirāṃ patiputravatīṃ satīm । pītavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 8 ।। jvalatpradīpahastāṃ ca śukladhānyakarāṃ varām । śaraccandranibhāsyāṃ ca sasmitāṃ varadāṃ śubhāma ।। 9 ।। tato dadarśa vipraṃ ca prakurvantaṃ śubhāśiṣam । śvetapadmagataṃ haṃsaṃ turagaṃ ca sarovaram ।। 10 ।। dadarśa citritaṃ cāru phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ śubham । āmranimbanārikelagurvarkakadalītarum ।। 11 ।। daśantaṃ śvetasarpaṃ ca svātmānaṃ parvatasthitam । vṛkṣasthaṃ ca gajasthaṃ ca taristhaṃ turagasthitam ।। 12 ।। vīṇāṃ vāditavantaṃ ca bhuktavantaṃ ca pāyasam । dadhikṣīrayutānnaṃ ca padmapatrasthamīpsitam ।। 13 ।। kṛmiviṭsahitāṅgaṃ ca rudantaṃ mohitaṃ tadā । śukladhānyapuṣpakaraṃ kṣaṇaṃ candanacarcitam ।। 14 ।। prāsādasthaṃ samudrasthamātmānaṃ ca salohitam । chinnabhinnaṃ kṣatāṅgaṃ ca medapūyasamanvitam ।। 15 ।। tato dadarśa rajataṃ maṇiṃ śubhraṃ ca kāñcanam । suktāmāṇikyaratnaṃ ca pūrṇakumbhajalaṃ śubham ।। 16 ।। surabhiṃ ca savatsāṃ ca vṛṣabhendraṃ mayūrakam । śukaṃ ca sārasaṃ haṃsaṃ cillaṃ khañjanameva ca ।। 17 ।। tāmbūlaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ ca jvaladagniṃ surārcanam । pārvatīpratimāṃ kṛṣṇapratimāṃ śivaliṅgakam ।। 18 ।। viprabālāṃ ca bālaṃ ca supakvaphalitāṃ kṛṣim । devasthalīṃ ca rājendraṃ siṃhaṃ vyāghraṃ guruṃ suram ।। 19 ।। dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ samuttasthau cakārā''hnikamīpsitam । uddhavaṃ kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ vṛttāntameva ca ।। 20 ।। uddhavājñāṃ samādāya kṛtvā gurusurārcanam । yātrāṃ cakāra śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhyātvā manasi nārada ।। 21 ।। dadarśa vartmanyevaṃ ca maṅgalārhaṃ śubhapradam । vāñchāphalapradaṃ ramyaṃ puro maṅgalasūcakam ।। 22 ।। vāme śaivaṃ śivāṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ nakulacāṣakam । patiputravatīṃ sādhvīṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām ।। 23 ।। śuklapuṣpaṃ ca mālyaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca khañjanaṃ śubham । dakṣiṇe jvaladagriṃ ca vipraṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ gajam ।। 24 ।। vatsaprayuktāṃ dheruṃ ca śvetāśvaṃ rājahaṃsakam । veśyāṃ ca puṣpamālāṃ ca patākāṃ dadhi pāyasam ।। 25 ।। maṇiṃ suvarṇa racataṃ muktāmāṇikyamīpsitam । madyaṃ māṃkaṃ candanaṃ ca mādhvīkaṃ ghṛtamuttamam ।। 26 ।। kṛṣṇaśāraṃ phalaṃ lājāḥ siddhānnaṃ darpaṇaṃ tathā । vicitritaṃ vimānaṃ ca sudīptāṃ pratimāṃ tathā ।। 27 ।। śuklotpalaṃ padmavanaṃ śaṅkhacillaṃ ca kīrakam । mārjāraṃ parvataṃ meghaṃ mayūraṃ śukasārasam ।। 28 ।। śaṅkhakokilavādyānāṃ dhvaniṃ śuśrāva maṅgalam । vicitrakṛṣṇasaṃgītaṃ hariśabdaṃ jayadhvanim ।। 29 ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭavā śrutvā prahṛṣṭamānasaḥ । praviveśa hariṃ smṛtvā puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 30 ।। dadarśa purato ramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalamīpsitam । candanāgurukastūrīpuṣpacandanavāyunā ।। 31 ।। vāsitaṃ maṅgalaghaṭai rambhāstamabhairvirājitam । āmrapallavasaṃghaiśca paṭṭasūtravicitritaiḥ ।। 32 ।। śobhitaiḥ paritaḥ śaśvatpadmarāgavinirmitam । śobhitaṃ śobhanārhaṃ ca trikoṭiratnamandiraiḥ ।। 33 ।। ramyaiḥ kuñjakuṭīraiśca rājitaṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ । rāsaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiyaddūraṃ yayau ca saḥ ।। 34 ।। dadarśa purato ramyaṃ nandavrajamanuttamam । paraṃ vekuṇṭhasaṃkāśaṃ vaikuṇṭha nilayaṃ śubham ।। 35 ।। ratnasopānasaṃyuktaṃ ratnastambhairvirājitam । nānācitravicitrāḍhyaṃ sadratnavalayānvitam ।। 36 ।। khacitaṃ maṇisāreṇa racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā । dvāri dṛṣṭena mārgeṇa rājadvāraṃ viveśa saḥ ।। 37 ।। patākāratnajālāḍhyaṃ suktāmāṇikyabhūṣitam । ratnadarpaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ ratnacitravicitritam ।। 38 ।। ratnavithīviracitaṃ maṅgalaṃ maṅgarairghaṭaiḥ । akrūrāgamanaṃ śrutvā sāṅlādo nanda eva ca ।। 39 ।। sahito rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ jagāmānuvrajāya vai । vṛṣabhānvādibhiryuktaḥ kṛtvā veśyāṃ puraḥsaram ।। 40 ।। pūrṇakumbhaṃ gajendraṃ ca kṛtvā'gre śukladhānyakam । kṛṣṇāṃ gāṃ madhuparkaṃ ca pādyaṃ ratnāsanādikam ।। 41 ।। gṛhītvā sādaraḥ śāntaḥ sasmito vinatasthā । ānandayukto nandaśca sagaṇaḥ sahabālakaḥ ।। 42 ।। dṛṣṭvā'krūraṃ mahābhāgaṃ tūrṇamāliṅganaṃ dadau । praṇemuḥ śiramā sarvai gopā jagṛhurāśiṣam ।। 43 ।। parasparaṃ ca saṃyogo babhūva guṇatrānmune । kroḍe cakārākrūraśca kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ krameṇa ca ।। 44 ।। cucumba gaṇḍayugule pulakāñyitavigrahaḥ । sāśrunetro'tisāhlādaḥ kṛtārthaḥ siddhavāñchitaḥ ।। 45 ।। dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ dvibhujaṃ kṣaṇaṃ śyāmalasundaram । pītavastraparīdhānaṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।। 46 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ paraṃ vaṃśīdharaṃ varam । stutaṃ brahmeśaśeṣādyairmunīndraiḥ sanakādibhiḥ ।। 47 ।। vīkṣitaṃ gopakanyābhiḥ paribūrṇatamaṃ vibhum । kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa kroḍasthaṃ sasmitaṃ ca caturbhujam ।। 48 ।। lakṣmīṃsarasvatīyuktaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam । sunandanandakumudaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parisevitam ।। 49 ।। sevitaṃ siddhasaṃghaiśca bhaktinamraiḥ parātparam । kṣaṇaṃ dadarśa devaṃ taṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam ।। 50 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ nāgarājairvirājitam । digambaraṃ paraṃ brahma bhasmāṅgaṃ ca jaṭāyutam ।। 51 ।। japamālākaraṃ dhyānaniṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ca yoginam । kṣaṇaṃ caturmukhaṃ dhyānaniṣṭhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ manīṣiṇām ।। 52 ।। kṣaṇaṃ dharmasvarūpaṃ ca śeṣarupaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇam । kṣaṇaṃ bhāskararūpaṃ ca jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। 53 ।। kṣaṇaṃ paramaśobhāḍhyaṃ koṭikandarpaninditam । kāminīkamanīyaṃ ca kāmukaṃ kāmasaṃyutam ।। 54 ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ śiśuṃ dṛṣṭvā sthāpayāmāsa vakṣasi । ratnamiṃhāsane ramye nandadatte ca nārada ।। 55 ।। kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ bhaktyā pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ । praṇamya śirasā bhūmau tuṣṭāva puruṣottamam ।। 56 ।। akrūra uvāca namaḥ kāraṇarūpāya paramātmasvarūpiṇe sarveṣāmapi viśvānāmīśvarāya namo namaḥ । parāya prakṛterīśa parātparatarāya ca ।। 57 ।। nirguṇāya nirīhāya nīrūpāya svarūpiṇe । sarvadevasvarūpāya sarvadeveśvarāya ca ।। 58 ।। sarvadevādhidevāya viśvādibhūtarūpiṇe । asaṃśyeṣu ca viśveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivātmaka ।। 59 ।। svarūpāyā''dibījāya tadīśaviśvarūpiṇe । namo gopāṅganeśāya gaṇeśeśvararūpiṇe ।। 60 ।। namaḥ suragaṇeśāya rādheśāya namo namaḥ । rādhāramaṇarūpāya rādhārūpadharāya ca ।। 61 ।। rādhārādhyāya rādhāyāḥ prāṇādhikatarāya ca । rādhāsādhyāya rādhādhidevapriyatamāya ca ।। 62 ।। rādhāprāṇādhidevāya viśvarūpāya te namaḥ । vedastutātmavedajñarūpiṇe sarvavedine ।। 63 ।। vaidādhiṣṭhātṛdevāya vedabījāya te namaḥ । yasya lomasu viśvāni cāsaṃkhyāni ca nityaśaḥ ।। 64 ।। mahadviṣṇorīśvarāya viśveśāya namo namaḥ । svayaṃ prakṛtirūpāya prākṛtāya namo... ।। 65 ।। prakṛtīśvararūpāya pradhānapurūṣāya ca । ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā mūrcchāmāpa sabhātale ।। 66 ।। papāta sahasā bhūmau punarīśaṃ dadarśa saḥ । bahiḥsthaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 67 ।। paritaḥ śyāmarūpaṃ ca viśvasthaṃ viśvameva ca । akrūraṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nandaḥ sādarapūrvakam ।। 68 ।। ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa nārada । papraccha sarvavṛttāntaṃ kiṃsviddṛṣṭamiti tvayā ।। 69 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāya kuśalaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ । akrūreḥ kathayāmasa kaṃsavṛttāntamīpsitam ।। 70 ।। svapitrormokṣaṇārthaṃ ca gamanaṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ । ityakrūrakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhetsusamāhitaḥ ।। 71 ।। aputro labhate putramabhāryoṃ labhate priyam । adhano dhanamāpnoti nirbhūmirurvarāṃ mahīm ।। 72 ।। hataprajaḥ prajālābhaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ cāpratiṣṭhitaḥ । yaśaḥ prāpnoti vipulamayaśasvī ca līlayā ।। 73 ।। atha suṣvāpa samaye paraṃ saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ । ramye campakatalpe ca kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 74 ।। prātaruthāya sahasā kṛtvā''ṅnikamanuttamam । svarathe sthāpayāmāsa rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jagatpatim ।। 75 ।। gavyaṃ pañcaprakāraṃ ca nānādravyaṃ sudulrabham । vṛṣabhānaṃ ca nandaṃ ca sunandaṃ candabhānakam ।। 76 ।। nānāprakāraṃ vādyaṃ ca mṛdaṅgamurajādikam । paṭahaṃ paṇavaṃ caiva ḍhakkāṃ duṃdubhimānakam ।। 77 ।। sajjāṃ saṃnahanīṃ kāsyapaṭṭamardalamaṇḍavīm । vādayāmāsa sānandaṃ nandagopo vrajeśvaraḥ ।। 78 ।। śrutvā vādyaṃ ca gopyaśca gamanaṃ rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ । dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ rathasthaṃ tamāyayuḥ kopapīḍitāḥ ।। 79 ।। kṛṣṇena vāritāḥ sarvāḥ preritā rādhāyā dvijaḥ । babhañjurīśvararathaṃ pādāghātena līlayā ।। 80 ।। tatra sarveṣu gopeśa hāhākāraṃ kṛteṣu ca । prayayurbalavatyaśca kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 81 ।। kācitkrūraṃ tamakrūraṃ bhartsayāmāsa kopataḥ । kāścidvaddhvā ca vastreṇa cākūraṃ prayayustataḥ ।। 82 ।। kācittaṃ tāḍayāmāsa kaṅkaṇena kareṇa ca । tadvastraṃ hārayāmāsa kṛtvā vivasanaṃ mune ।। 83 ।। kṣatavikṣatasarvāṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā'krūraṃ ca mādhavaḥ । jagāma rādhānikaṭaṃ bodhayāmāsa tāṃ punaḥ ।। 84 ।। ādhyātmikena yogena vinayena ca sādaram । akrūraṃ bodhayāmāsa vodhayāmāsa tāṃ punaḥ ।। 85 ।। ākāśātpatitaṃ divyaṃ santraprasthāpitaṃ ratham । vicitravastrasaṃyuktaṃ dadarśa purato hariḥ ।। 86 ।। khacitaṃ maṇirājena racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā । taṃ dṛṣṭvā mātṛbhavanamājagāma jagatpatiḥ ।। 87 ।। bhuktvā pītvā sukhaṃ suptvā bhagavānsahabāndhavaḥ । tasthau munīndradevendrabrahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ ।। 88 ।। muṣupurgoṃpikāḥ sarvāḥ paraṃ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ । puṣpatalpe ca ramye ca rādhayā saha nārada ।। 89 ।। sarve cā''nandayuktāśca janā gokulavāsinaḥ । kecidgopāśca nanṛtuḥ kecitsaṃgītatatparāḥ ।। 90 ।। iti śībrahma... śrikṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... gopīviṣayo nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 70 ।।
<4.71> athaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca rādhikāyāṃ ca suptāyāṃ suptāsu gopikāsu । puṣpacandanatalpe ca vāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। 1 ।। tṛtīyaprahare'tīte niśāyāṃ ca śubhe kṣaṇe । śubhacandrarkṣayoge cāmṛtayogasamanvite ।। 2 ।। saumyasvāmiyute lagne saumyagrahavilokite । pāpagrahasamāsaktaduṣṭadoṣādivarjite ।। 3 ।। yaśodāṃ bodhayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam । vandhūnāśvāsayāmāsa samutthāya hariḥ svayam ।। 4 ।। vādyaṃ niṣedhayāmāsa rādhikābhayabhītavat । svatantro viśvakartā ca pātā bhartā svatantravat ।। 5 ।। prakṣālya pādayugalaṃ dhṛtavā dhaute ca vāsasī । uvāsa saṃskṛte sthāne vilipte candanādinā ।। 6 ।। phalapallavasaṃyuktaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ candanādibhiḥ । vāme kṛtvā pūrṇakumbhaṃ vahniṃ vipraṃ svadakṣiṇe ।। 7 ।। patiputravatīṃ dīpaṃ darpaṇaṃ puratastathā । dūrvākāṇḍaṃ ca susnigdhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhānyaṃ sitaṃ śubham ।। 8 ।। gurudattaṃ guhītvā ca pradadhau mastakopari । dhṛtaṃ dadarśa mādhvīkaṃ rajataṃ kāñcanaṃ dadhi ।। 9 ।। candanaṃ lepanaṃ kṛtvā puṣpamālāṃ gale dadau । guruvargaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca vandayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। 10 ।। śaṅkhadhvaniṃ vedapāṭhaṃ saṃgītaṃ maṅgalāṣṭakam । vipraśīrvacanaṃ ramyaṃ śuśrāva paramādaram ।। 11 ।। dhyātvā maṅgalarūpaṃ ca sarvatra maṅgalapradam । cikṣepa dakṣiṇāṃ pādaṃ sundaraṃ svātmavigraham ।। 12 ।। vidhṛtya nāsikāvāmabhāgaṃ madhyamayā vibhuḥ । visṛjya vāyuṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ nāsādakṣiṇarandhrataḥ ।। 13 ।। tato yayau nandanando nandasya prāṅgaṇaṃ varam । sānandaḥ paramānando nityānandaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 14 ।। nityo'nityo nityabīcasvarūpo nityavigrahaḥ । nityāṅgabhūto nityeśo nityakṛtyaviśāradaḥ ।। 15 ।। nityanūtanarūpaśca nityanūtanayauvanaḥ । nityanūtanaveṣaśca vayasā nityanūtanaḥ ।। 16 ।। nityanūtanasaṃbhāṣo yatprema nityanūtanam । nityanūtanasaṃprāptiḥ saubhāgyaṃ nityanūtanam ।। 17 ।। sudhārasaparaṃ miṣṭaṃ yatvākyaṃ nityanūtanam । nityanūtanabhaktaṃ ca yatpadaṃ nityanūtanam ।। 18 ।। sthāyaṃ sthāyaṃ prāṅgaṇe'sminamāyeśo māyayā yutaḥ । atīva ramye susnigdho babhūva gamanonmukhaḥ ।। 19 ।। rambhāstambhasamūhaiśca rasālapallavānvitaiḥ । paṭṭasūtranibaddhaiśca sundaraiśca susaṃskṛtaiḥ ।। 20 ।। padmarāgeṇa khacite racite viśvakarmaṇā । kastūrīkuṅkumāktaiśca candanaiśca susaṃskṛte ।। 21 ।। tatra tasthau svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sahākrūraḥ sabāndhavaḥ । yaśodayā samāśliṣṭo vāmapārśvena māyayā ।। 22 ।। nandenā''nandayuktenā''śliṣṭo dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ । saṃbhāṣito bāndhavaiśca pitrā mātrā ca cumbitaḥ ।। 23 ।। iti śībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... yātrāmaṅgalaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 71 ।।
<4.72> atha dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kṛṣṇo guruṃ natvā nirgamya śibirānmune । āruhya svargayānaṃ ca śubhāṃ madhupurīṃ yayau ।। 1 ।। viveśa mathurāṃ ramyāṃ sahākrūragaṇaiḥ samam । nirjitya śakranagarī śobhāyuktāṃ manoharām ।। 2 ।। ratnaśreṣṭhena khacitāṃ racitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā । amūlyaratnakalaśo rājitaiśca virājanām ।। 3 ।। rājamargaśatairiṣṭairvaiṣṭitāṃ rucirairvaraiḥ । candrākāraiścandrasārairmaṇimiḥ parisaṃskṛtaiḥ ।। 4 ।। vicitrairmaṇisāraiśca vīthīśatavinirmitaiḥ । śobhitairvaṇijaiḥ śreṣṭhaiḥ puṇyavastusamanvitaiḥ ।। 5 ।। sarovarasahasraiśca paritaḥ pariśobhitam । śudhdhasphaṭisaṃkāśaiḥ padmarāgavirājitaiḥ ।। 6 ।। ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyaiḥ śobhitāṃ padminīgaṇaiḥ । syirayauvanasaṃyuktairnimeṣarahitaiḥ paraiḥ ।। 7।। śākṣarairūrdhvavadanaiḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasaiḥ । bhrūbhaṅgalīlālolaiśca śaśvaccañcalalocanaiḥ ।। 8 ।। śaśvatkāmasamāyuktaiḥ pīnaśroṇipayodhareḥ । komalāṅgairmadhyakūpai ratirāsaviśāradaiḥ ।। 9 ।। ratnanirmāṇayānānāṃ koṭibhiḥ pariśobhitām । bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitābhiśca citretābhiśca citrakaiḥ ।। 10 ।। nānāprakāraśrīyuktāṃ puṣpodyānatrikoṭibhiḥ । nānāpuṣpaiḥ puṣpitābhiryuktābhirmadhusūdanaiḥ ।। 11 ।। mādhuryamadhusaṃyuktairmadhulubdhairmudā'nvitaiḥ । mādhvīkamadhumattaiśca yuktairmaṃdhukarīcayaiḥ ।। 12 ।। nānāprakāradurgeśca durgamyāṃ vairiṇāṃ gaṇaiḥ । raṇitāṃ raṇakaiḥ śāścadrakṣāśāstraviśāradaiḥ ।। 13 ।। trikoṭṭyāṭṭālikābhiśca saṃyuktāṃ sumanoharām । racitāṃ kila sadratnairvicitrairviśvakarmaṇā ।। 14 ।। evaṃbhūtāṃ ca mathurāṃ dṛṣṭvā kamalalocanaḥ । dadarśa pathi kubjāṃ tāṃ vṛddhāmatiyarādurām ।। 15 ।। yāntoṃ daṇḍasahāyena cātinamrāṃ namadvalīm । rūkṣitāṃ vikṛtākārāṃ bibhratīṃ candanadravam ।। 16 ।। kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca sparśamātreṇa nārada । sugandhimakarandena gandhāḍhyaṃ sumanoharam ।। 17 ।। sādṛṣṭvā sasmitā vṛddhā śrīkāntaṃ śāntamīśvaram । śrīyuktaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ taṃ śrībījaṃ śrīniketanam ।। 18 ।। praṇamya sahasā mūdharnā bhaktinamrā puṭāñjaliḥ । pradadau candanaṃ tasya gātreśyāmalasundare ।। 19 ।। gātreṣu tadgaṇānāṃ ca svarṇapātrakarā varā । kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ ।। 20 ।। śrīkṛṣṇadṛṣṭimātreṇa śrīyuktā sā babhūva ha । sahasā śrīsamā ramyā rūpeṇa yauvanena ca ।। 21 ।। vahiśuddhāṃśuvasanā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā । yathā dvādaśavarṣoyā kanyā dhanyā manoharā ।। 22 ।। bimboṣṭhī sasmitā śyāmā taptakāñcanasaṃnibhā । suśroṇī sudatī bilvaphalatulyapayodharā ।। 23 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇahārasāravirājitā । gajendrarājagamanā ratnamañjīrarañjitā ।। 24 ।। bibhratī kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmālyaveṣṭitam । rakṣitaṃ vāmabhāgena ruciraṃ vartulākṛtim ।। 25 ।। sindūrabinduṃ dadhatoṃ dāḍimīkusumākṛtim । kastūrī bindumupari sārdha candanabindubhiḥ ।। 26 ।। rannadarpaṇāhastā ca praśastā ratikarmasu । śrīkṛṣṇaṃ varayāmāsa lolalocanakoṇataḥ ।। 27 ।। śrīvāsastāṃ samāśvasya yayau sthānāntaraṃ param । kṛtārtharūpā sā prītyā yayau padmayathā''layam ।। 28 ।। sa dadarśa svabhavanaṃ yayā padyālayālayam । ratnaśayyāviracitaṃ sadratnasāranirmitam ।। 29 ।। ratnapradīparājībhī rājitābhiśca rājitam । ratnadarpaṇarājaiśca rājitaṃ paritastataḥ ।। 30 ।। sindūravastratāmbūlaṃ ścetacāmaramālyakam । bibhratībhiśca dāsībhirveṣṭitaṃ dāsasaṃghakaiḥ ।। 31 ।। tatra gatvā ca bhuktvā ca miṣṭānnaṃ paramaṃ mudā । suṣvāpa ratnaparyaṅke sā dāsībhiśca sevitā ।। 32 ।। sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam । candanaṃ sthāpayāmāsa svatalpe haraye satī ।। 33 ।। mālatīmālyayugalaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam । śītalaṃ salilaṃ svādu miṣṭānnaṃ svasamīpataḥ ।। 34 ।। karmaṇā manasā vācā cintayantī hareḥ padam । harerāgamanaṃ cāpi mukhacandraṃ manoharam ।। 35 ।। jagatkṛṣṇamayaṃ śaśvatpaśyantī kāmukī mune । koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ kāmasaktaṃ ca kāmukam ।। 36 ।। tato tadarśa śrīkṛṣṇo mālākāraṃ manoharam । mālāsamūhaṃ bibhrantaṃ gacchantaṃ rājamandiram ।। 37 ।। so'pi dṛṣṭvā ca śrīkāntaṃ praṇamya śiraśā bhuvi । dadau mālyasamūhaṃ ca kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।। 38 ।। kṛṣṇastasmai varaṃ dattavā svadāsyamatidurlabham । mālyaṃ gṛhītvā prayayau rājamārge varaṃ varaḥ ।। 39 ।। tato dadarśa rajakaṃ bibhrataṃ vastrapuñjakam । ahaṃkṛtibaliṣṭhaṃ ca satataṃ yovanodvatam ।। 40 ।। vastraṃ yayāce taṃ kṛṣṇo vinayena mahāmune । sa tasmai na dadau vastraṃ tamuvāca ca niṣṭhuram ।। 41 ।। gorakṣakāṇāṃ tvadyogyaṃ vastrametatsudurlabham । rājayogyaṃ ca he mūḍha he gopajanavallabha ।। 42 ।। gṛhītvā gopakanyāśca kanyālolupa lampaṭa । yadvihāraḥ kṛtastatra vṛndāraṇye'pyarājake ।। 43 ।। na cātra tādṛśaṃ karma rājñaḥ kaṃsasya vartmaṃni । vidyamāno'tra rājendraḥ śāstā duṣṭasya tatkṣaṇam ।। 44 ।। rajakasya vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa madhusūdanaḥ । jahāsa baladevaśca sākrūro gopavargakaḥ ।। 45 ।। taṃ nihatya capeṭena jagrāha vastrapuñjakam । vastraṃ saṃdhārayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sagaṇastathā ।। 46 ।। ratnayānena gonokaṃ pārṣaderveṣṭitena ca । yayau rajakarājaśca dhṛtvā divyakalevaram ।। 47 ।। śaśvadyauvanayuktaṃ ca jarāmṛtyuharaṃ varam । pītavastrasamāyuktaṃ sasmitaṃ śyāmasundaram ।। 48 ।। babhūva so'pi goloke pārṣadeṣu ca pārṣadaḥ । kṛṣṇasyā''gamanaṃ tatra sasmāra satataṃ vaśī ।। 49 ।। astaṃ gato dinakaro'pyakrūraḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau । kṛṣṇasyānumatiṃ prāpya kṛṣṇo'pi kasyacidgṛham ।। 50 ।। vaiṣṇavasya kuvindasya tasminnastadhanasya ca । sānando nandasahito baladevādibhiryutaḥ ।। 51 ।। sa bhaktaḥ pūjayāmāsa praṇamya śrīniketanam । tasmai dadau svadāsyaṃ ca varaṃ brahmādidurlabham ।। 52 ।। paryaṅke suṣupuḥ sarve bhuktvā miṣṭānnasuttamam । nidrāṃ ca lebhe sā kubjā nidreśo'piyayau mudā ।। 53 ।। gatvā dadarśa kubjāṃ tāṃ ratnatalpe ca nidritām । dāsīgaṇaiḥ parivṛtāṃ sundarīṃ kamalāmiva ।। 54 ।। bodhayāmāsa tāṃ kṛṣṇo na dāsīsvapi nidritāḥ । tāmuvāca jagannātho jagannāthapriyāṃ satīm ।। 55 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca tyaja nidrāṃ mahābhāge śṛṅgāraṃ dehi sundari । purā śūrpaṇakhā tvaṃ ca bhaginīṃ rāvaṇasya ca ।। 56 ।। rāmajanmani maddhetostvayā kānte tapaḥ kṛtam । tapaḥprabhāvānmāṃ kāntaṃ bhaja śrīkṛṣṇajanmani ।। 57 ।। adhunā sukhasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā gaccha mamā''layam । sudurlabhaṃ ca golokaṃ jarāsṛtyuharaṃ param ।। 58 ।। ityukatvā śrīnivāsaśca kṛtvātāmeva vakṣasi । nagnāṃ cakāra śṛṅgāraṃ cumbanaṃ cāpi kāmukīm ।। 59 ।। sa sasmitā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ navasaṃgamalajjitā । cucumba gaṇḍe kroḍe taṃ cakāra kamalā yathā ।। 60 ।। suraterviratirnāsti daṃpatī ratipaṇḍitau । nānāprakārasurataṃ babhūva tatra nārada ।। 61 ।। stanaśroṇiyugaṃ tasyā vikṣataṃ ca cakāra ha । bhagavānnakharaistīkṣṇairdaśanairadharaṃ varam ।। 62 ।। niśāvasānasamaye vīryādhānaṃ cakāra saḥ । sukhasaṃbhogabhogena mūrcchāmāpa ca sundarī ।। 63 ।। tatrā''jagāmatāṃ tandrā kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthalasthitām । bubudhe na divārātraṃ svarga martya jalaṃ sthalam ।। 64 ।। suprabhātā ca rajanī babhūva rajanīpatiḥ । patyurvyatikrameṇaiva lajjayeva malīmasaḥ ।। 65 ।। athājagāma golokādratho ratnavinirmitaḥ । jagāma tena taṃ lokaṃ dhṛtvā divyakalevaram ।। 66 ।। vahniśuddhāṃ śukādhānaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam । prataptakāñcanābhāsaṃ nityaṃ janmādivarjitam ।। 67 ।। sā babhūva ca tatraiva gopī candramukhī mune । gopyaḥ katividhāstasyā babhūvuḥ paricārikāḥ ।। 68 ।। bhagavānapi tatraiva kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā svamandiram । jagāma yatra nandaśca sānando nandanandanaḥ ।। 69 ।। atha kaṃso niśāyāṃ ca nidrāyāṃ bhayavihvalaḥ । dadarśa duḥkhaduḥsvapnamātmano mṛtyusūcakam ।। 70 ।। dadarśa sūryaṃ bhūmisthaṃ catuḥkhaṇḍaṃ nabhaścyutam । daśakhaṇḍe candrabimbaṃ bhūmisthaṃ khāccyutaṃ mune ।। 71 ।। puruṣānvikṛtākārānrajjuhastāndigambarān । vidhavāṃ śūdrapatnīṃ ca nagnāṃ ca cchinnanāsikām ।। 72 ।। hasantīṃ cūrṇatilakāṃ śvetakṛṣṇoccamūrdhajām । khaḍgakharparahastāṃ ca lolajihvāṃ ca bibhratīm ।। 73 ।। ruṇḍamālāsamāyuktāṃ gardabhaṃ mahiṣaṃ vṛṣam । bhallūkaṃ sūkaraṃ kākaṃ gṛdhraṃ kahkaṃ ca vānaram ।। 74 ।। virajaṃ kukkuraṃ nakraṃ śṛgālaṃ bhasmapuñjakam । asthirāśiṃ tālaphalaṃ keśaṃ kārpāsamulbaṇam ।। 75 ।। nirvāṇāṅgāramilkāṃ ca śavaṃ sartyaṃ citāśritam । kulālatailakārāṇāṃ cakraṃ vakraṃ kapardakam ।। 76 ।। śmaśānaṃ dagdhakāṣṭhaṃ ca śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ kuṇaṃ tṛṇām । gacchantaṃ ca kabandhaṃ ca nadantaṃ mṛtamastakam ।। 77 ।। dagdhasthānaṃ bhasmayutaṃ taḍāgaṃ jalavarjitam । dagdhamatsyaṃ ca lohaṃ ca nirvāṇadagdhakānanam ।। 78 ।। galatkuṣṭhaṃ ca vṛṣalaṃ nagnaṃ ca suktasūrdhacam । atīva rūpaṭaṃ vipraṃ ca śapantaṃ gurumīdṛśām ।। 79 ।। atīvaruṣṭaṃ bhikṣuṃ ca yoginaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ naram । evaṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya kathayāmāsa mātaram ।। 80 ।। pitaraṃ bhrātaraṃ patnīṃ rudatīṃ premavihvalam ।। mañcakānkārayāmasa sthāpayāmāsa hastinam ।। 81 ।। mallasainyaṃ ca yoddhāraṃ kārayāmāsa maṅgalam । sabhāṃ ca kārayāmāsa puṇyaṃ svastyayanaṃ śivam ।। 82 ।। yatnena yojayāmāsa yoge yuktaṃ purohitam । uvāsa mañcake ramye dhṛtvā khaḍgaṃ vilakṣaṇam ।। 83 ।। raṇe niyojayāmāsa yoddhāraṃ yuddhakovidam । vāsayāmāsa rājendrānbrāhmaṇāṃśca munīśvarān ।। 84 ।। brāhmaṇāśca suhṛdvargāndharmiṣṭhānraṇakovidān । athā''jagama govindo rāmeṇa saha nārada ।। 85 ।। maheśasya dhanurmadhyaṃ babhañja tatra līlayā । śabdena tasya mathurā badhirā ca babhūva ha ।। 86 ।। viṣādaṃ prāpa kaṃsaśca mudaṃ ca devakīsutaḥ । upasthitaḥ sabhāmaddhe gajaṃ mallaṃ nihatya ca ।। yogī dadarśa taṃ devaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 87 ।। yathā hṛtpadmamadhyasthaṃ tādṛśaṃ bahireva ca । rājendrarūpaṃ rājānaḥ śāstāraṃ daṇḍadhāriṇā m ।। 88 ।। pitā mātā dugdhamukhaṃ stanāndhaṃ bālakaṃ yathā । kāminyaḥ koṭikandarpalīlālāvapyadhāriṇam ।। 89 ।। kaṃsaśca kālapuruṣaṃ vairiṇaṃ tasya bāndhavāḥ । mallā mṛtyupradaṃ caiva prāṇatulyaṃ ca yādavāḥ ।। 90 ।। namaskṛtya munīnviprānpitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum । jagāma mañcakāmyāśaṃ haste kṛtvā sudarśanam ।। 91 ।। dṛṣṭāvā bhaktaṃ bhaktabandhuḥ kṛpayā ca
