kṛpānidhiḥ । ākṛṣya mañcakātkaṃkaṃ jaghāna līlayā mune ।। 92 ।। rājā dadarśa viśvaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ param । purato ratnayānaṃ ca hīrakāhārabhūṣitam ।। 93 ।। yayau viṣṇupadaṃ sphīto dibyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca । tejo viveśa paramaṃ kṛṣṇapādāmbuje mune ।। 94 ।। nivṛtya tasya satkāraṃ brāhmaṇemyo dharaṃ dadau । dadau rājyaṃ rājachatramugrasenāya dhīmate ।। 95 ।। sa babhūva nṛpendraśca candravaṃśasamudbhavaḥ । vilalāpa kaṃsamātā patnīvargaśca tatpitā ।। 96 ।। bāndhavā mātṛvargaśca bhaginī bhrātṛkāminī । darśanaṃ dehi rājendra samuttiṣṭha nṛpāsane ।। 97 ।। rājyaṃ rakṣa dhanaṃ rakṣa bāndhavaṃ balameva ca । kva yāsi bāndhavānhitvā tvamanāthānmahābala ।। 98 ।। brahmādistambaparyantamasaṃkhyaṃ viśvameva ca । sarvaṃ carācarādhāraṃ yaḥ sṛjatyeva līlayā ।। 99 ।। brahmeśaśeṣadharmāśca dineśaśca gaṇeśvaraḥ । munīndravargo devendro dhyāyate yamaharniśam ।। 100 ।। vedāḥ stupanti yaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ stauti bhītā sarasvatī । stauti yaṃ prakṛtirhṛṣṭā prākṛtaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 101 ।। svecchāmayaṃ nirīhaṃ ca nirguṇaṃ ca nirañjanam । parātparataraṃ brahma paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 102 ।। nityaṃ jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham । nityānandaṃ ca nityaṃ ca nityamakṣaravigraham ।। 103 ।। so'vatīrṇoṃ hi bhagavānbhārāvataraṇāya ca । gopālabālaveṣaśca māyeśo māyayā prabhuḥ ।। 104 ।। sa yaṃ hanti ca sarveśo rakṣitā tasya kaḥ pumān । sa yaṃ rakṣati sarvātmā tasya hantā na ko'pi ca ।। 105 ।। ityevamuktvā sarvaśca virarāma mahāmune । brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa tebhyaḥ sarvaṃ dhanaṃ dadau ।। 106 ।। bhagavānapi sarvātmā jagāma piturantikam । chittavā ca lohanigaḍaṃ tayormokṣaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 107 ।। nanāma daṇḍavadbhamau mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tathā । tuṣṭāva bhakttayā deveśo bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। 108 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vidyāmantradaṃ gurumeva ca । yo na puṣṇāti puruṣo yāvajjīvaṃ ca so'śuciḥ ।। 109 ।। sarveṣāmapi pūjyānāṃ pitā vandyo mahān guruḥ । pituḥ śataguṇairmātā garbhadhāraṇapoṣaṇāt ।। 110 ।। mātā ca pṛthivīrūpā sarvebhyaśca hiraiṣiṇī । nāsti mātuḥ paro bandhuḥ sarveṣāṃ jagatītale ।। 111 ।। vidyāmantrapradaḥ katyaṃ mātuḥ paratano guruḥ । na hi tasmātparaḥ kau'pi vandyaḥ pūjyaśca vedataḥ ।। 112 ।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇo balabhadro nanāma ca । mātā cakāratau kroḍe pitā ca sādaraṃ mune ।। 113 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ paramaṃ tau ca bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇān । vasurvasusamūhaṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 114 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... kaṃsavadhavasudevadevakīmokṣaṇaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamodhyāyaḥ ।। 72 ।।
<4.73> atha trisaptatitamodhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kṛṣṇaśca sānandaṃ nandaṃ taṃ pitaraṃ balaḥ । bodhayāmāsa śokārtaṃ divyairādhyātmikādibhiḥ ।। 1 ।। uccai rudantaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ putraviccedakātaram । dattvā tasmai maṇiśreṣṭhamityuvāca jagatpatiḥ ।। 2 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca nibodha nanda sānandaṃ tyaja śokaṃ mudaṃ labha । jñānaṃ gṛhāṇa maddattaṃ yaddataṃ brahmaṇe purā ।। 3 ।। yadyaddattaṃ ca śoṣāya gaṇeśāyeśvarāya ca । dineśāya munīśāya yogīśāya ca puṣkare ।। 4 ।। kaḥkasya putraḥ kastātaḥ kā mātā kasyacitkutaḥ। āyānti yānti saṃsāraṃ paraṃ svakṛtakarmaṇā ।। 5 ।। karmānusārājjantuśca jāyate sthānabhedataḥ । karmaṇā ko'pi jantuśca yogīndrāṇāṃ nṛpastriyām ।। 6 ।। dvijāpatnyāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyāyāṃ śūdrayoniṣu । tiryagyoniṣu kaścicca kaścitpaśvādiyoniṣu ।। 7 ।। mamaiva māyayā sarve sānandā viṣayeṣu ca । dehatyāme viṣaṇṇāśca vicchede bāndhavasya ca ।। 8 ।। prajābhūmidhanādīnāṃ vicchedo maraṇādhikaḥ । nityaṃ bhavati mūḍhaśca na ca vidvāñchucā yutaḥ ।। 9 ।। madbhakto bhaktiyuktaśca madyājī vijitendriyaḥ । manmantropāsakaścaiva matsevānirataḥ śuciḥ ।। 10 ।। madbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ ravirbhāti ca nityaśaḥ । bhāti candro mahendraśca kālabhede ca varṣati ।। 11 ।। vahnirvahati mṛtyuśca caratyeva hi jantuṣu । bibharti vṛkṣaḥ kālena puṣpāpi ca phalāni ca ।। 12 ।। nirādhāraśca vāyuśca vāyvādhāraśca kaccipaḥ । śeṣaśca kacchapādhāraḥ śeṣādhāraśca parvataḥ ।। 13 ।। tadādhārāśca pātālāḥ sapta eva hi paṅktitaḥ । niścalaṃ ca jalaṃ tasmājjalasthā ca vasuṃdharā ।। 14 ।। saptasvarga dharādhāraṃ jyotiścakaṃ grahāśrayam । nirādhāraśca vaikuṇṭho brahmāṇḍemyaḥ paro varaḥ ।। 15 ।। tatparaścāpi golokaḥ pañcāśatko ṭiyojanāt । ūrdhva nirāśrayaścāpi ratnasāravinirmitaḥ ।। 16 ।। saptadvāraḥ saptasāraḥ parikhāsaptasaṃyutaḥ । lakṣaprākārayuktaśca nadyā virajayā yutaḥ ।। 17 ।। veṣṭito ratnaśailena śataśṛṅgeṇa cāruṇā । yojanāyutamānaṃ ca yasyaikaṃ śṛṅgamujjvalam ।। 18 ।। śatakoṭiyojanaśca śaila ucchrita eva ca । dairdhyaṃ tasya śataguṇaṃ prasthaṃ ca lakṣayojanam ।। 19 ।। yojanāyutavistīrṇastatraiva rāsamaṇḍalaḥ । amūlyaratnanirmāṇo vartulaścandrabimbavatu ।। 20 ।। pārijātavanenaiva puṣpitena ca vevṭitaḥ । kalpavṛkṣasahasreṇa puṣpodyānaśatena ca ।। 21 ।। nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpavṛkṣaiḥ puṣpitena ca cāruṇā । trikoṭiratnabhavano gopīlakṣaiśca rakṣitaḥ ।। 22 ।। ratnapradīpayuktaśca ratnatalpasamanvitaḥ । nānābhogasamāyukto sadhuvāpīśatairvṛtaḥ ।। 23 ।। pīyūṣavāpīyuktaśca kāmabhogasamanvitaḥ । golokagṛhasaṃkhyānavarṇane vā viśāradaḥ ।। 24 ।। na ko'pi veda vidvānvā vedavidvānvrajeśvaraḥ । amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhavanānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 25 ।। śobhitaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ rādhāśiviramuttamam । amūlyaratnakalaśairujjvalaṃ ratnadarpaṇaiḥ ।। 26 ।। asūlyaratnastamabhānāṃ rājibhiśca virājitam । nānācitravicitraiśca citritaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 27 ।। māṇikyamuktāsaṃsaktaṃ hīrāvārasamanvitam । ratnapradīpasaṃsaktaṃ ratnasopānasundaram ।। 28 ।। amūlyaratnapatraiśca talparājivirājitam । amūlyaratnacitraiśca tribhiścitravicitritaiḥ ।। 29 ।। tisṛbhiḥ parikhābhiśca tribhirdvāraiśca durgamaiḥ । yuktaṃ ṣoḍaśakakṣābhiḥ pratidvāreṣu vā'ntaram ।। 30 ।। gopīṣoḍaśalakṣaiśca saṃniyuktairitastataḥ । vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānai ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ ।। 31 ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhaiḥ śatacandrasamanvitaiḥ । rādhikāriṃkarīvargairyuktamabhyantaraṃ varam ।। 32 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇapraṅgaṇaṃ sumanoharam । amūlyaratnastambhānāṃ samūraiśca suśobhitam ।। 33 ।। ratnamaṅgalakumbhaiśca phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ । saṃyutaṃ ratnavedībhirmuktā yuktābhirīpsitam ।। 34 ।। amūlyaratnamukuraiḥ śobhitaṃ sundarairaho । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ bhavanānāṃ varaṃ gṛham ।। 35 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthā ca gopīlakṣaiśca sevitā । koṭipūrṇenduśobhāḍhyā śvetacampakasaṃnibhā ।। 36 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitā । amūlyaratnavasanā bibhratī ratnadarpaṇam ।। 37 ।। ratnapadmaṃ ca ruciraṃ savyadakṣiṇahastataḥ । dāḍimbakusumākāraṃ sindūraṃ sumanoharam ।। 38 ।। suśobhitaṃ sṛgamadairiṣṭaiścandanabindubhiḥ । dadhatī kabarībhāraṃ mālatīmalyamaṇḍitam ।। 39 ।। racitaṃ vāmabhagena munīndrāṇāṃ manoharam । evaṃbhūtaṃ (tā) tatra rādhā gopībhiḥ parisevitā ।। 40 ।। śvetacāmarahastābhistattulyābhiśca sarvataḥ । amūlyaratnanirmāṇairbhūṣitābhiśca bhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 41 ।। matprāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevī devīnāṃ pravarā varā । sudāmnaḥ sā ca śāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā ।। 42 ।। śatābdiko hi vicchedo bhaviṣyati mayā saha । tena bhārāvataraṇaṃ kariṣyasi bhuvaḥ pitaḥ ।। 43 ।। tadā yāsyāmi golokaṃ tayā sārdhaṃ suniścatam । tvayā yaśodayā cā'pi gobairgopībhireva ca ।। 44 ।। vṛṣabhānena tatpatnyā kalāvatyā ca bāndhavaiḥ । evaṃ ca nandaṃ sānandaṃ yaśodāṃ kathayiṣyasi ।। 45 ।। tyaja śokraṃ mahābhāga vrajaiḥ sārdhaṃ vrajaṃ vraja । ahamātmā ca sākṣī ca nirliptaḥ sarvajīviṣu ।। 46 ।। jīvo matpratibimbaśca ityevaṃ sarvasaṃmatam । prakṛtirmadvikārā ca sā'pyahaṃ prakṛtiḥ svayam ।। 47 ।। yathā dugdhe ca dhāvalyaṃ na taryorbhaida eva ca । yathā jale tathā śaityaṃ yathā vahnau ca dāhikā ।। 48 ।। yathā''kāśe tathā śabdo bhūmau gandho yathā nṛpa । yathā śobhā ca candre ca yathā dinakare prabhā ।। 49 ।। yathā dīvastathā''tmāhaṃ tathaiva rādhayā saha । tyaja tvaṃ gopikābuddhiṃ rādhāyāṃ mayi putratām ।। 50 ।। ahaṃ sarvasya prabhāvaḥ sā ca prakṛtinīśvarī । śrūyatāṃ nanda sānandaṃ madvibhūtiṃ sukhāvahām ।। 51 ।। purā yā kathitā tāta brahmaṇe vyaktajanmane । kṛṣṇo'haṃ devatānāṃ ca goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। 52 ।। caturbhujo'haṃ vaikuṇṭhe śivaloke śivaḥ svayam । brahmaloke ca brahmā'haṃ sūyastejasvināmaham ।। 53 ।। pavitrāṇāmahaṃ vahnirjalameva draveṣu ca । indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi samīraḥ śīghragāminām ।। 54 ।। yamo'haṃ daṇḍakarta ṇāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham । akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi sāmnāṃ ca sāma eva ca ।। 55 ।। indraścaturdaśendreṣu kubero dhanināmaham । īśāno'haṃ dimīśānāṃ vyāpakānāṃ nabhastathā ।। 56 ।। sarvāntarātmā jīveṣu brāhmaṇaścā''śrameṣu ca । dhanānāṃ ca ratnamahamamūlyaṃ sarvadurlabham ।। 57 ।। taijasānāṃ suvarṇo'haṃ maṇīnāṃ kaustubhaḥ svayam । vaiṣṇavānāṃ kumāro'haṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 58 ।। puṣpāṇāṃ pārijāto'haṃ tīrthānāṃ puṣkaraḥ svayam । śālagrāmastathā'rcyānāṃ patrāṇāṃ tulasīti ca ।। 59 ।। senāpatīnāṃ skando'haṃ lakṣmaṇo'haṃ dhanuṣmatām । rājendrāṇāṃ ca rāmo'haṃ nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī ।। 60 ।। māsānāṃ margaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāmasmi mādhavaḥ । vāreṣvādityavāro'haṃ tithiṣvekādaśīti ca ।। 61 ।। sahiṣṇūnāṃ ca pṛthivī mātā'haṃ bāndhaveṣu ca । amṛtaṃ bhakṣyavastūnāṃ gavyeṣvājyamahaṃ tathā ।। 62 ।। kalpavṛkṣaśca vṛkṣāṇāṃ surabhiḥ kāmadhenuṣu । gaṅgā'haṃ saritāṃ madhye kṛtapāpavināśinī ।। 63 ।। vāṇīti paṇḍitānāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ praṇavastathā । vidyāsu bījarūpo'haṃ sasyānāṃ dhānyameva ca ।। 64 ।। aśvatthaḥ phalināmeva gurūṇāṃ mantradaḥ svayam । kaśyapaśca prajeśānāṃ garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।। 65 ।। ananto'haṃ ca nāgānāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipaḥ । brahmarṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ ।। 66 ।। rājarṣīṇāṃ ca janako maharṣīṇāṃ śukastathā । gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo munīḥ ।। 67 ।। bṛhaspatirbuddhimatāṃ kavīnāṃ śukra eva ca । grahāṇāṃ ca śanirahaṃ viśvakarmā ca śilpinām ।। 68 ।। mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendo'haṃ vṛṣāṇāṃ śivavāhanam । airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham ।। 69 ।। vedāśca sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham । urvaśyapsarasāmeva samudrāṇāṃ jalārṇavaḥ ।। 70 ।। sumeruḥ parvatānāṃ ca ratnavatsu himālayaḥ । durgā ca prakṛtīnāṃ ca devīnāṃ kamalālayā ।। 71 ।। śatarūpā ca nārīṇāṃ matpriyāṇāṃ ca rādhikā । sādhvīnāmapi sāvitrī vedamātā ca niścitam ।। 72 ।। prahlādaścāpi daityānāṃ baliṣṭhānāṃ baliḥ svayām । nārāyaṇarṣirbhagavāñjñānināṃ madhya eva ca ।। 73 ।। hanūmānvānarāṇāṃ ca pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ । manasā nāgakanyānāṃ vasūnāṃ droṇa eva ca ।। 74 ।। droṇo jaladharāṇāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ tathā । kāmināṃ kāmadevo'haṃ rambhā ca kāmukīṣu ca ।। 75 ।। golokaścāsmi lokānāsuttamaḥ sarvataḥ paraḥ । mātṛkāsu śāntirahaṃ ratiśca sundarīṣu ca ।। 76 ।। dharmo'haṃ sākṣiṇāṃ madhye saṃdhyā ca vāsareṣu ca । deveṣvahaṃ ca māhendo rākṣaseṣu vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 77 ।। kālāgnirudro rudrāṇāṃ saṃhāro bhairaveṣu ca । śaṅkheṣu pāñcajanyo'hamaṅgeṣvapi ca mastakaḥ ।। 78 ।। paraṃ purāṇasūtreṣu cāhaṃ bhāgavataṃ varam । bhārataṃ cetihāseṣu pañcarātreṣu kāpilam ।। 79 ।। svāyaṃbhuvo manūnāṃ ca munīnāṃ vyāsadevakaḥ । svadhā'haṃ pitṛpatnīṣu svāhā vaṅnipriyāsu ca ।। 80 ।। yajñānāṃ nājasūyo'haṃ yajñapatnīṣu dakṣiṇā । śastrāstrajñeṣu rāmo'haṃ jamadagnisuto mahān ।। 81 ।। paurāṇikeṣu sūto'haṃ nītimatsvaṅgirā muniḥ । viṣṇuvrataṃ vratānāṃ ca balānāṃ daivameva ca ।। 82 ।। oṣadhīnāmahaṃ dūrvā tṛṇānāṃ kuśameva ca । dharmakarmasu satyaṃ ca snehapātreṣu putrakaḥ ।। 83 ।। ahaṃ vyādhiśca śatrūṇāṃ jvaro vyādhiṣvahaṃ tathā । madbhaktiṣvapi maddāsyaṃ vareṣu ca varaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 84 ।। āśramāṇāṃ gṛhastho'haṃ saṃnyāsī ca vivekinām । sudarśanaṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ kuśalaṃ ca śubhāśiṣām ।। 85 ।। eśvaryāṇāṃ mahājñānaṃ vairāgyaṃ ca sukheṣvaham । mi (i) ṣṭavākyaṃ prītideṣu dāneṣu cā''tmadānakam ।। 86 ।। saṃcayeṣu dharmakarma karmaṇāṃ ca madarcanam । kaṭhoreṣu tapaścāhaṃ phaleṣu mokṣa eva ca ।। 87 ।। aṣṭasiddhiṣu prākāmyamahaṃ kāśīpurīṣu ca । nagareṣu tathā kāñcī sa deśo yatra vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 88 ।। sarvādhāreṣu sthūleṣu ahameva mahānvirāṭ । paramāṇurahaṃ viśve mahāsūkṣmeṣu nityaśaḥ ।। 89 ।। vaidyānāmaśvinīputrau jauṣadhīṣu rasāyanam । dhanvantarīrmantravidāṃ viṣādaḥ kṣayakāriṇām ।। 90 ।। rāgāṇāṃ meghamallāraḥ kāmodastatpriyāsu ca । matpārṣadeṣu śrīdāmā madvanvuṣvahamuddhavaḥ ।। 91 ।। paśujantuṣu gauścahaṃ candanaṃ kānaneṣu ca । tīrthapūtaśca pūteṣu niḥśaṅkeṣu ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 92 ।। na vaiṣṇavātparaḥ prāṇī manmantropāsakaśca yaḥ । vṛkṣeṣvaṅkurarūpo'hamākāraḥ sarvavastuṣu ।। 93 ।। ahaṃ ca sarvabhūteṣu mayi sarve ca saṃtatam । yathā vṛkṣe phalānyeva phaleṣu cāṅkurastaroḥ ।। 94 ।। sarvakāraṇarūpo'haṃ na ca matkāraṇaṃ param । sarveśī'haṃ na me'pīśo hyahaṃ kāraṇakāraṇam ।। 95 ।। sarveṣāṃ sarvabījānāṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ । manmāyāmohitajanā māṃ na jānanti pāpinaḥ ।। 96 ।। pāpagrastena durbuddhyā vidhinā vañcitena ca । svātmā'haṃ sarvajantūnāṃ svāmyahaṃ nādṛtaḥ svayam ।। 97 ।। yatrāhaṃ śaktayastatra kṣutpipāsādayastathā । gate mayi tathā yānti naradehe (ve) yathā'nugāḥ ।। 98 ।। he vrajeśa nanda tāta jñānaṃ jñātvā vrajaṃ vraja । kathayasva ca tāṃ rādhāṃ yaśodāṃ jñānameva ca ।। 99 ।। jñātvā jñānaṃ vrajeśaśca jagāma svānugaiḥ saha । gatvā ca kathayāmāsa te dve ca yoṣitāṃ vare ।। 100 ।। te ca sarve jahaḥ śokaṃ mahājñānena nārada । kṛṣṇo yadyapi nirlipto māyeśo māyayā rataḥ ।। 101 ।। yaśodayā preritaśca punarāgatya mādhavam । tuṣṭāva paramānandaṃ nandaśca nandanandanam ।। 102 ।। sāmavedoktastotreṇa kṛtena brahmaṇā purā । putrasya purataḥ sthitvā ruroda ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 103 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... nandādiṇokapramocanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 73 ।।
<4.74> atha catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramānandaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ । paramātmā ca paramo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ।। 1 ।। bhuvo bhārāvataraṇo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ । parātpanastu bhagavānbrahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ ।। 2 ।। tuṣṭo nandastavaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ । āgacchantaṃ gokulācca virahajvarakātaram ।। 3 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca gaccha nandavrajaṃ nanda tyaja śokaṃ bhramaṃ bhuvi । śṛṇu satyaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ śokagranthinikṛntanam ।। 4 ।। vāyuśca bhūmirākāśo jalaṃ tejaśca pañcamam । uktaḥ śrutigaṇairetaiḥ pañcabhūtaiśca nityaśaḥ ।। 5 ।। sarvaiṣāṃ dehināṃ tāta dehaśca pāñcabhautikaḥ । mithyābhramaḥ kṛtrimaśca svapnavanmāyayā'nvitaḥ ।। 6 ।। dehaṃ gṛhṇanti sarvaiṣāṃ pañcabhūtāni nityaśaḥ । māyāsaṃketarūpaṃ tadabhijñānaṃ bhramātmakam ।। 7 ।। ko vā kasya sunastāta kā strī kasya patistu vā । karmaṇā bhramaṇaṃ śaśvatsarveṣāṃ bhūrijanmani ।। 8 ।। karmaṇā jāyante jantuḥ karmaṇaiva pralīyate । sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ karmaṇā ca prapadyate ।। 9 ।। keṣāṃ vā janma svargeṣu keṣāṃ vā brahmaṇo gṛhe । keṣāṃ vipreṣu kṣatreṣu keṣāṃ vā baiśyaśūdrayoḥ ।। 10 ।। atinīceṣu keṣāṃ vā keṣāṃ kṛmiṣu viṭsu ca । paśupakṣiṣu keṣāṃ vā keṣāṃ vā kṣudrajantuṣu ।। 11 ।। punaḥ punarbhramantyeva sarve tāta svakarmaṇā । karoti karma nirmūlaṃ madbhakto matpiyaḥ sadā ।। 12 ।। satyaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliśceti caturyugam । pañcaviṃśatsahasrāṇāṃ yugānte nidhanaṃ manoḥ ।। 13 ।। manoḥ samaṃ mahendrasya paramāyurvinirmitam । caturdaśendravicchittau brahmaṇo dinamucyate ।। 14 ।। evaṃ parimitā rātriḥ kālavidbharvinirmitā । evaṃ parimitā māsā varṣaṃ ca pariniścitam ।। 15 ।। brahmaṇaśca varṣaśataṃ paramāyurvinirmitam । nimeṣamātraṃ kālo'yaṃ brahmaṇo nidhane mama ।। 16 ।। brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ viśve vinirmitam । satyo'haṃ paramātmā ca bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 17 ।। manmantropāsakaḥ satyo dehaṃ tyaktvā dharāsu ca । yāsyatyeva hi golokaṃ chitvā karma purātanam ।। 18 ।। asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte na bhavettasya pātanam । gṛhṇati nityaṃ svaṃ dehaṃ janmamṛtyujarāpaham ।। 19 ।। na nanda mama bhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit । nityaṃ sudarśanaṃ taṃ ca parirakṣati marvataḥ ।। 20 ।। matto hi balavānbhaktaścintito'haṃ na cintitaḥ । ahaṃ svāmī ca tasyaiva na me svāmī pitā prasūḥ ।। 21 ।। putrabuddhiṃ parityajya bhaja māṃ brahmarūpiṇam । chittavā ca brahmanigaḍaṃ golokaṃ tadvraja svayam ।। 22 ।। kathayasva yaśodāṃ ca gopīṃ gopagaṇāṃ vraja । taiśca sarvairjanaiḥ śokaṃ tyaja svamandiraṃ vraja ।। 23 ।। ityevamuktvā bhagavānvirarāma ca saṃsadi । papraccha punarevaṃ taṃ nandaścā''nandasaṃplutaḥ ।। 24 ।। nanda uvāca vada sāṃsārikaṃ jñānaṃ yena yāsyāmi tvatpadam । mūḍho'haṃ paramānanda śrutīnāṃ janako bhavān ।। 25 ।। nandasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sarvajño bhagavānsvayam । āhnikaṃ kathayāyāsa śrutibhirna śrutaṃ hi yat ।। 26 ।। iti... śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... bhagavannandasaṃvāde catuḥ saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 74 ।।
<4.75> atha pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣyāmi jñānaṃ ca paramādbhutam । sugopanīyaṃ vedeṣu purāṇeṣu ca durlabham ।। 1 ।। na viśvāso hi nārīṣu saṃtataṃ kulaṭāsu ca । mokṣamārgārgalāsveva bhramamāyāsvamūṣu ca ।। 2 ।। haribhakterasādhvīnāṃ viruddhāsu yutāsu ca । bījarūpāsu nāśānāṃ pramadāsu vrajeśvara ।। 3 ।। nityaṃ ca prātarutthāya rātrivāso vihāya ca । abhīṣṭadevaṃ hṛtpadme brahmarandhre gṛruṃ param ।। 4 ।। vicintya manasā prātaḥkṛtyaṃ kṛtvā suniścitam । snānaṃ karoti suprājño nirmaleṣu jaleṣu ca ।। 5 ।। na saṃkalpaṃ ca kurute bhaktaḥ karmanikṛntanaḥ । snātvā hariṃ smaretsaṃdhyāṃ kṛtvā yāti gṛhaṃ prati ।। 6 ।। prakṣālya pādau praviśennidhāya dhautavāsasī । pūjayotparamātmānaṃ māmeva muktikāraṇam ।। 7 ।। śālagrāme maṇau yantre pratimāyāṃ jale'pi ca । tathā ca vipre gavi ca guruṣvevaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 8 ।। ghaṭi'ṣṭadalapadme ca pātre candananirmite । āvāhanaṃ ca sarvatra śālagrāme jalena ca ।। 9 ।। mantrānurūpadhyānena dhyātvā māṃ pūjayedvratī । ṣoḍaśopacāradravyāṇi dadyānmūlena bhaktitaḥ ।। 10 ।। śrīdāmānaṃ mudāmānaṃ vasudāmānameva ca । vīrabhānuṃ śūrabhānuṃ gopānpañca prapūjayet ।। 11 ।। sunandanandakumudaṃ pārṣadaṃ me sudarśanam । lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ durgāṃ rādhāṃ gaṅgāṃ vasuṃdharām ।। 12 ।। guruṃ ca tulasīṃ śaṃbhuṃ kārtikeyaṃ vināyakam । navagrahāṃśca dikpālānparitaḥ pūjayetsudhīḥ ।। 13 ।। devaṣaṭkaṃ ca saṃpūjya sarvādau vighnavighnataḥ । gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivam ।। 14 ।। śrutau vinirmitāndevānmokṣadānkarmakṛntanān । gaṇeśaṃ vighnanāśāya sūryaṃ vyādhivināśine ।। 15 ।। vahniṃ prāptinimittena śāntau śuddhau bhaveddhruvam । viṣṇuṃ mokṣanimittena jñānadānāya śaṃkaram ।। 16 ।। buddhimuktinimittena pārvatīṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ । puṣpāñjalitrayaṃ dattvā svastotraṃ kavacaṃ paṭhet ।। 17 ।। guruṃ praṇamya saṃpūjya tatpaścātpraṇametsuram । kṛtvā''hrikaṃ ca saṃpūjya yathāsukhamudīritam ।। 18 ।। samācaretsvakarmaitadvedoktaṃ svātmaśuddhaye । viṣṭhāṃ na paśyetprājñaśca vyādhibījasvarūpiṇīm ।। 19 ।। mūtraṃ ca vyādhibījaṃ ca paraṃ narakakāraṇam । liṅgaṃyoniṃ pāpaduḥkhavyādhidāridryadāyinīm ।। 20 ।। uruṃ mukhaṃ stanaṃ strīṇāṃ kaṭākṣaṃ hāsyameva ca । vināśabījaṃ rūpaṃ ca vipadāṃ kāraṇaṃ sadā ।। 21 ।। divābhogaṃ ca svastrīṇāṃ svālāpaṃ parivarjayet । rogāṇo kāraṇaṃ caiva cakṣuṣoḥ karṇayostathā ।। 22 ।। ekatāraṃ ca gaganaṃ na paśyettu rujāṃ bhayāt । daivāddṛṣṭvā hariṃ smṛtvā saptadhā nāradaṃ japet ।। 23 ।। astakāle raviṃ candraṃ na paśyed vyādhikāraṇam । khaṇḍaṃ masuditaṃ candraṃ na paśyed vyādhikāraṇam ।। 24 ।। jalasthaṃ ca raviṃ candraṃ dṛṣṭvā śokaṃ labhennaraḥ । bandhuvicchedahetuṃ ca na paśyetparamaithunam ।। 25 ।। ekatra śayanaṃ sthānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca gatiṃ tathā । na kuryātpāpinā sārdhaṃ sarvaṃ nāśasya lakṣaṇam ।। 26 ।। ālāpādgātrasaṃsparśācchayanāśrayabhojanāt । saṃcaranti dhruvaṃ pāpāstailavindurivāmbhasā ।। 27 ।। hiṃsrajantusamīpaṃ ca na gacchedduḥkhakāraṇam । khalena sārdha milanaṃ na kuryācchokakāraṇam ।। 28 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ । na kuryāddhiṃsanaṃ hāniṃ sarvanāśasya kāraṇam ।। 29 ।। devadevalaviprāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tathaiva ca । vittaṃ dhanaṃ ca naharetsarvanāśasya kāraṇam ।। 30 ।। svadattaṃ paradattaṃ vā brahmavittaṃ harettu yaḥ । ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ।। 31 ।। gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ । śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni gaṇḍakaḥ saptajanmani ।। 32 ।। ghoṭakaḥ saptajanmāni kumbhīraḥ pañcajanmasu । puṃścalīnāṃ yonikīṭaṃ śatajanmasu niścitam ।। 33 ।। vraṇakīṭaṃ ca teṣāṃ śatajanmasu nārada । godhikā saptajanmāni gardabhaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 34 ।। saptajanmāni mārjāro nakulaśtreṣu janmasu । uccaiḥśravā janmaśataṃ kharaścāpi tathaiva ca ।। 35 ।। krūrasarpaśca śārdūlo mahiṣaḥ saptajanmasu । bhekaśca śatajanmāni cchāgalaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 36 ।। bhallūkaḥ śatajanmāni śṛgālo lakṣajanmasu । tato jalaukā bhavati brahmasvaharaṇāddhruvam ।। 37 ।। kumbhīpāke ca pacyante pāpino brahmaṇaḥ śatam । dakṣiṇāṃ vipramuddiśya tatkālaṃ cainna dīyate ।। 38 ।। ekarātre vyatīte tu taddānaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet । māse śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ dvimāse tu sahasrakam ।। 39 ।। saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sa dātā narakaṃ vrajet । dātrā na dīyate mūrkho grahītā ca na yācate ।। 40 ।। ubhau tau narakaṃ yāto dātā vyādhiyuto bhavet । viprāṇāṃ hisanaṃ kṛtvā vaṃśahāniṃ labheddhruvam ।। 41 ।। dhanaṃ lakṣmīṃ parityajya bhikṣukaśca bhavedvrajan । devaṃ ca brahmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā na namedyo labhecchucam ।। 42 ।। na kuryādgurubhaktiṃ yo labhate rauravaṃ śucam । ya strī mūḍhā durācārā svapatiṃ harirūpiṇam ।। 43 ।। na paśyettarjanaṃ kṛtvā kumbhīpāke vrajeddhruvam । vāktarjanādbhavetkāko hiṃsanātsūkaro bhavet ।। 44 ।। sarpo bhavati kopaina darpeṇa gardabho bhavet । kukkurī ca kuvākyenāpyandhaśca viṣadarśanāt ।। 45 ।। pativratā ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ patyā saha vrajeddhruvam । śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇapatiṃ sūrya vipraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।। 46 ।। viṣṇuṃ nindati yo mūḍhaḥ sa mahārauravaṃ vrajet । pitaraṃ mātaraṃ putraṃ satīṃ bhāryāṃ guruṃ tathā ।। 47 ।। anāthāṃ bhaginīṃ kanyāṃ vinindya narakaṃ vrajet । viprabhaktivihīnāśca kṣatraviṭśūdrayonijā ।। 48 ।। haribhaktivihīnāśca pacyante narame dhruvam । patibhaktivihīnāśca yuvatyaśca narādhamāḥ ।। 49 ।। śālagrāmajalaṃ viṣṇuprasādaṃ ye ca bhuñjate । tīrya punanti te viprāḥ śataṃ puṃsāṃ vasuṃdharām ।। 50 ।। pitṛndevānsamamyarcya khādanmāsaṃ dvijaḥ śuciḥ । yo bhakṣati vṛthā māṃsaṃ sa mahārauravaṃ vrajet ।। 51 ।। matsyāṃśca kāmato jagdhvā copavāsaṃ vaseddvijaḥ । prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuryādvrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ।। 52 ।। kāmato brāhmaṇo matsyaṃ bhuṅkte yo jñānadurbalaḥ । so'śuciḥ satataṃ nanda hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam ।। 53 ।। viṣṇorucciṣṭabhojī yo matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ na khādati । pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam ।। 54 ।। ekādaśīṃ ye kurvanti kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvratam । śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 55 ।। yadbālaye yacca kaumāre vārdhake yacca yauvane । bhasmībhūtāni kurvanti pātakāni kṛtāni ca ।। 56 ।। ekādaśīdine bhuṅkte kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvrate । trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ so'pi bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ ।। 57 ।। āture niyamo na syādapi vṛddhe ca bālake । bhaktasya dviguṇaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya śucirbhavet ।। 58 ।। yo bhuṅkte śivarātrau ca śrīrāmanavamīdine । upavāse samarthaśca sa mahārauravaṃ vrajet ।। 59 ।। kuhūpūrṇendusaṃkrānticaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca । naraścāṇḍālayoniḥ syātstrītailamāṃsasevanāt ।। 60 ।। matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūraṃ ca kāṃsyapātre ca bhojanam । ārdrakaṃ raktaśākaṃ ca ravau ca parivarjayet ।। 61 ।। anyathā narakaṃ yāti kumbhīpākaṃ na saṃśayaḥ । rajasvarānnaṃ veśyānnaṃ madirānnaṃ vrajeśvara ।। 62 ।। yo bhuṅkte brāṅmaṇo daivādviḍbhojī sa bhaveddhruvam । yadahnā kurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet ।। 63 ।। sa bhavedaśucirnityaṃ bhasmāntaṃ tasya sūtakam । nārī veśyā pratijñeyā catuṣpuruṣagāminī ।। 64 ।। pāke ca pitṛdevānāmadhikāro na tadbhavet । yadgrāmayājināmannaṃ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojanam ।। 65 ।। bhuktvā ca narakaṃ yāti yāvaccandradivākarau । śūdrāṇāṃ śrāddhadivase tadannaṃ bhuñjate ddhijāḥ ।। 66 ।। kumbhīpāke ca pacyante yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam । yaḥ śūdreṇābhyanujñāto bhuṅkte śrāddhadine'nyataḥ ।। 67 ।। surāpīti sa vijñeyaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ । asijīvī maṣījīvī devalo vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।। 68 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca yo hi śūdrāpatiddhijaḥ । sa śūdravadvahiṣkāryastadannaṃ viṭsamaṃ satām ।। 69 ।। nopatiṣṭhati yaḥ pūrvāṃ nopāste yastu paścimām । sa śūdravadbahiṣkāryaḥ savaṃsmāddvijakarmaṇaḥ ।। 70> saṃdhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu । yadahnākurute karma na tasya phalabhāgbhavet ।। 71 ।। vāmamantropāsakaśca brāhmāṇo narakaṃ vrajet । nadīgarbhe ca garte ca dṛkṣamūle jalāntike ।। 72 ।। devāntike sasyabhūmau purīṣaṃ notsṛjedbudhaḥ । valmīkamūṣakotkhātāṃ mṛdamantarjalāṃ tathā ।। 73 ।। śaucāvaśiṣṭāṃ gehācca nā''dadyāllepasaṃbhavām । antaḥprāṇipipīlyāṃ ca halotkhātāṃ vrajeśvara ।। 74 ।। ālavālotthitāṃ caiva sasyakṣetrotthitāṃ tathā । vṛkṣamūlotthitāṃ nanda nadīgarbhotthitāṃ tathā ।। 75 ।। parityajenmṛdastvetāḥ sakalāḥ śaucasādhane । kūṣmāṇḍaghātikā yā strī dīvanirvāṇakaḥ pumān ।। 76 ।। saptajanma bhavedrogī daridro janmajanmani । pradīpaṃ śivaliṅgaṃca śālagrāmaṃ maṇiṃtathā ।। 77 ।। pratimāṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca suvarṇa śaṅkhameva ca । hīrakaṃ ca tathā muktāṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ ghṛtam ।। 78 ।। śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ bhūmau tyaktvā vrajedadhaḥ । daridraḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kuṣṭhī vaṃśahīno'pyabhāryakaḥ ।। 79 ।। bhūmihīnaḥ prajāhīno bandhuhīnaśca kutsitaḥ । andhaḥ paṅgurvā kharvaśca khañjaścaivāṅgahīnakaḥ ।। 80 ।। bhavetkameṇa pāpī sa hyetānbhūmau tyajetu yaḥ । divase saṃdhyayornidrāṃ strīsaṃbhogaṃ karoti yaḥ ।। 81 ।। saptajanma bhavedrogī daridraḥ saptajanmasu । udite jagatīnāthe yaḥ kuryāddantadhāvanam ।। 82 ।। sa pāpiṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ brūte pūjayāmi janārdanam । mṛdbhasmagosakṛtviṇḍaistathā bālukayā'pi vā ।। 83 ।। kṛtvā liṅkaṃ sakṛtpūjaya vasetkalpaśataṃ divi । sahasrapūjanātso'pi labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam ।। 84 ।। lakṣaṃ ca pūjayedyastu śivatvaṃ labhate dhruvam । jīvanmukto bhavedvipro liṅgamabhyarcayetu yaḥ ।। 85 ।। śivapūjāvihīnaśca brāhmaṇo narakaṃ vrajet । matpūjitaṃ priyatamaṃ śivaṃ nindanti ye narāḥ ।। 86 ।। pacyante niraye tāvadyāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam । pūjite śivaliṅge ca yadi syātkeśavālukā ।। 87 ।। sa mahāndho vālukayā keśena yavano bhavet । kṣudro daridraḥ kṛpaṇo vyādhiḥ syātkutsite yathā ।। 88 ।। sarvebhyo mānahāniḥ syājjāyate nīcayoniṣu । sarveṣu priyapātreṣu brahmaṇaśca mama priyaḥ ।। 89 ।। brahmaṇācca priyā lakṣmīḥ satataṃ vakṣasi sthitā । tato'dhikā priyā rādhā priyā bhaktāstato'dhikāḥ ।। 90 ।। tato'dhikaḥ śaṃkaro me nāsti me śaṃkarātpriyaḥ । mahādeva mahādeva mahādeveti vādiraḥ ।। 91 ।। paścādyāmi ca saṃtṛpto nāmaśravaṇalobhataḥ । mano me bhaktamūle ca prāṇā rādhātmakā dhruvam ।। 92 ।। ātmā me śaṃkarasthānaṃ śivaḥ prāṇādhikaśca yaḥ । ādyā nārāyaṇī śaktiḥ sṛṣṭisthityantakāniṇī ।। 93 ।। kanomi ca yathā sṛṣṭiṃ yayā brahmādidevatāḥ । yayā jayati viśvaṃ ca yayā sṛṣṭiḥprajāyate ।। 94 ।। yayā vinā jagannāśti mayā dattā śivāya sā । dayā nidrā ca kṣuttṛptistṛṣṇa śraddhā kṣamā dhṛtiḥ ।। 95 ।। tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭistathā śāntirlajjādhidevatā hi sā । vaisuṇṭhe sā mahālakṣmīrgoloke rādhikā satī ।। 96 ।। martye lakṣmīśca kṣīrode dakṣakanyā satī ya sā । sā durgā menakākanyā daityadurgatināśinī ।। 97 ।। svargalakṣmīśca durgā sā śakrādīnāṃ gṛhe gṛhe । sā vāṇī sā ca sāvitrī vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। 98 ।। vahnau sa dāhikāśaktiḥ prabhāśaktiśca bhāskare । śobhāśaktiḥ pūrṇacandre jale śaktiśca śītatā ।। 99 ।। sasyaprasūtā śaktiśca dhāraṇā ca dharāsu sā । brāhmaṇyaśaktirvipreṣu devaśaktiḥsureṣu sā ।। 100 ।। tapasvināṃ tapasyā kā gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhadevatā । muktiśaktiśca muktānāmāśā sāṃsārikasya sā ।। 101 ।। madbhaktānāṃ bhaktiśaktirmayi bhaktipradā sadā । nṛpāṇāṃ rājyalakṣmīśca vaṇijāṃ labhyarūpiṇī ।। 102 ।। pari saṃsārasindhūnāṃ trayītattvā tu tāriṇī । satsu sadbuddhirūpā sā medhāśaktisvarūpiṇī ।। 103 ।। vyākhyāśaktiḥ śrutau śāstre dātṛśaktiśca dātṛṣu । kṣattrādīnāṃ viprabhaktiḥ patibhaktiḥ satīsu ca ।। 104 ।। evaṃ rūpā ca yā śaktirmayā dattā śivāya sā । evaṃ te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। praśnaṃ karoṣi yadyanmāṃ tatsarvaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 105 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhasavannandasaṃ... pañcasaptatitamodhyāyaḥ ।। 75 ।।
<4.76> atha ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca yeṣāṃ ca darśane puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ yasya ca darśane । tatsarva vada sarveśa śrotuṃ kautūharaṃ mama ।। 1 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca subrāhmaṇānāṃ tīrthānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca darśane । devatāpratimādarśī tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ ।। 2 ।। sūryasya darśane bhaktyā matīnāṃ darśane tathāḥ । saṃnyāsināṃ yatīnāṃ ca tathaiva brahmacāriṇām ।। 3 ।। bhaktyā gavāṃ ca vahnīnāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ । gajendrāṇāṃ ca siṃhānāṃ śvetāśvānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 4 ।। śukānāṃ ca pikānāṃ ca khañjanānāṃ tathaiva ca । haṃsānāṃ ca mayūrāṇāṃ cāṣāṇāṃ śaṅkhapakṣiṇām ।। 5 ।। vatsaprayuktadhenūnāsaśvatthānāṃ tathaiva ca । patiputravatīnāṃ ca narāṇāṃ tīnthayāyinām ।। 6 ।। pradīpānāṃ suvarṇānāṃ maṇīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ । ṇuktānāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ ca māṇikyānāṃ mahāśaya ।। 7 ।। tulasīśuklapuṣpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ pāpanāśam । phalāni śukladhānyāni ghṛtaṃ dadhi madhūni ca ।। 8 ।। pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca lājāṃśca rājendraṃ darpaṇaṃ jalam । mālāṃ ca śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 9 ।। gorocanaṃ ca karpūraṃ rajataṃ ca sarovaram । puṣpodyānaṃ puṣpitāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā puṣyaṃ... ।। 10 ।। śuklapakṣasya candraṃ ca pīyūṣaṃ candanaṃ tathā । kastūrīṃ kuṅkumaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanda puṇyaṃ ।। 11 ।। patākāmakṣayavaṭaṃ taruṃ devotthitaṃ śubham । devālayaṃ devakhātaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ... ।। 12 ।। devākṣitāṃ devadyaṭaṃ sugandhipavanaṃ tathā । śaṅkhaṃ ca duṃdubhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ puṇyaṃ... ।। 13 ।। śukiṃta pravālaṃ rajataṃ sphaṭikaṃ kuśamūlakam । gaṅgāmṛdaṃ kuśaṃ tāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ... ।। 14 ।। purāṇapustakaṃ śuddhaṃ sabījaṃ viṣṇuyantrakam । snigdhadūrvākṣate ratnaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ... ।। 15 ।। tapasvināṃ siddhamantraṃ masudraṃ kṛṣṇasārakam । yajñaṃ mahotsavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa puṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। 16 ।। gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ dugdhaṃ godhūliṃ goṣṭhagoṣpadam । pakvasasyānvitaṃ kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labheddhruvam ।। 17 ।। rucirāṃ padminīṃ śyāmāṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalām । suveṣakāṃ suvasanāṃ divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 18 ।। veśyāṃ kṣemakarīṃ gandhaṃ sudūrvākṣatataṇḍulam । siddhānnaṃ paramānnaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 19 ।। kāntikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca rādhikāpratimāṃ śubhām । saṃpūjya dṛṣṭvā natvā ca karoti janmakhaṇḍanam ।। 20 ।। hiṅgulāyāṃ tathā'ṣṭamyāmiṣe māsi site śubhe । śrīdurgāpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janma... ।। 21 ।। śivarātrau ca kāśyāṃ ca viśvanāthasya darśanam । kṛtvopavāsaṃ pūjāṃ ca karoti janma... ।। 22 ।। janmāṣṭamīdine bhakto dṛṣṭvā māṃ bindumādhavam । praṇamya pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca karoti janma... ।। 23 ।। pauṣe māsi śuklarātrau yatra yatra sthale naraḥ । padmāyāḥ pratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janma... ।। 24 ।। saptajanma bhavettasya putraḥ pautro dhaneśvaraḥ । upoṣyaikādaśīṃ snātvā prabhāte dvādaśīdine ।। 25 ।। dṛṣṭvā kāśyāmannapūrṇāṃ karoti janmakhaṇḍanam । caitrai māsi caturdaśyāṃ kāmarūpeṣu puṇyade ।। 26 ।। dṛṣṭvā natvā bhadrakālīṃ karoti janma... । ayodhyāyāṃ ca rāmaṃ ca śrīrāmanavamīdine ।। 27 ।। saṃpūjya natvā dṛṣṭvā ca karoti janma... । upoṣya puṣkare snātvā kiṃvā badarikāśrame ।। 28 ।। maṃpūjya dṛṣṭvā māmekaṃ karoti janma... । dattavā tiṣṇupade piṇḍaṃ viṣṇuṃ yaśca prapūjyet ।। 29 ।। pitaṇāṃ svātmanaścaiva karoti janma... । prayāge muṇḍanaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ ca kurute yadi ।। 30 ।। upoṣya naimiṣāraṇye karoti janma... । siddhiṃ kṛtvā ca vadarīṃbhuṅkte badarikāśrame ।। 31 ।। dṛṣṭavā matpratimāṃ nanda karoti janma... । delāyamānaṃ govindaṃ puṇye vṛndāvane ca mām ।। 32 ।। dṛṣṭavā saṃpūjya natvā ca karoti janma... । bhādre dṛṣṭvā ca mañcasthaṃ māmeva madhusūdanam ।। 33 ।। saṃpūjya natvā bhaktaśca karoti janma... । rathasthaṃ ca jagannāthaṃ yo drakṣyati kalau naraḥ ।। saṃpūjya natvā bhaktyā ca karoti janma... ।। 34 ।। uttarāyaṇasaṃkrāntyāṃ prayāge snānamācaret । saṃpūjya natvā māmeva karoti janma... ।। 35 ।। kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā matpratimāṃ śubhām । upoṣya pūjaraṃ kṛtvā karoti janma... ।। 36 ।। candrabhāgāsamīpe ca mādhyāṃ ca māṃ nametsudhīḥ । rādhayā saha māṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janmanaḥ kṣayam ।। 37 ।। rāmeśvaraṃ setubandha aṣāṇīpūrṇimādine । upeṣya dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya karoti janma... ।। 38 ।। svarge vidyādharā rātrau nṛtyanti ca suhurmuhuḥ। praṇāmaṃ kartumīśaṃ taṃ samāyāti vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 39 ।। gāyanti kiṃnarā rātrau gandharvāśca manoharam । praṇāmaṃ kartumīśaṃ ta samāyāti ya mādhavaḥ ।। 40 ।। dṛṣṭvā sākṣādvasantaṃ ca sarveśaṃ candraśekharam । jīvanmukto bhavedante prayāti harimandiram ।। 41 ।। dīnanāthaṃ dinakaraṃ koṇārke cottarāyaṇe । upoṣya dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjya karoti janma... ।। 42 ।। kṛṣikoṣṭhe suvasane kalarvike vasuṃdhare । vispandake rājakoṣṭhe nandake puṣpabhadrake ।। 43 ।। pārvatīpratimāṃ dṛṣṭvā kārtikeyaṃ gaṇeśvaram । nandinaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā karoti janmanaḥ kṣayam ।। 44 ।। upoṣya prātaḥ saṃpūjya dṛṣṭvā stutvā stutau nataḥ । pāraṇaṃ ca dadhi prāśya karoti janma... ।। 45 ।। trikūṭe maṇibhadre ca paścimodadhisaṃnidhau । samupoṣya dadhi praśya māṃ dṛṣṭvā muktimāpnuyāt ।। 46 ।। pratimāsu madīyāsu pārvatīpratimāsu ca । jīvaṃ saṃnyasya saṃpūjya karoti janma... ।। 47 ।। śivadurgālayaṃ kṛtvā madīyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ । śivasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā karoti janma... ।। 48 ।। puṣpodyānaṃ ca śaṃkuṃ ca setuṃ khātaṃ sarovaram । viprasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā karoti janma... ।। 49 ।। na ca vedāḥ purāṇāni brahmasaṃsthāpanaṃ phalam । jānanti santo munayaḥ surā viprādayaḥ pitaḥ ।। 50 ।। gaṇyante pāṃsavo bhūmergaṇyante vṛṣṭibindavaḥ । na gaṇyate vidhātrā'pi viprasaṃsthāpane phalam ।। 51 ।। kṛtvopajīṃyaṃ viprasya jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ । acalāṃ śrīyamāpnoti pare sukticatuṣṭayam ।। 52 ।। maddāsyabhaktiṃ sa labhedvaikuṇṭhe modake ciram । na hi pāto bhavettasya yathā me paramātmanaḥ ।। 53 ।। kumārīmaṣṭavarṣoyāṃ suvipraya dadāti yaḥ । saṃpūjya sarvābharaṇāṃ durgādānaphalaṃ labhet ।। 54 ।। sarva svargya samālokya brahmalokeṣu pūjitaḥ । labhate mama dāsyaṃ ca vaisuṇṭhe modate ciram ।। 55 ।। vivāhadarśane koṭisvarṇadānaphalaṃ labhet । ante svarge prayātyevamihaiva niścalāṃ śriyam ।। 56 ।। yaḥ suvipramanāthaṃ ca daridraṃ ca supaṇḍitam । dṛṣṭvā kuryāttadvivāhaṃ sa mokṣaṃ labhate dhruvam ।। 57 ।। yacchatrapādukādānaṃ śālagrāmasya yoṣitaḥ । karoti bhaktyā puṇyāhe pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ labhet ।। 58 ।। gajacadāne ca tallomamānavarṣa śrutau śrutam । caturguṇaṃ gajendraṃ ca modate mama mandire ।। 59 ।। gajardha śvetaturage tadardha cetane pitaḥ । gajatulyaṃ kṛṣṇagavāṃ dāne ca tatphalaṃ labhet ।। 60 ।। tattulyaṃ dhenudāne ca hyardhaṃ sāmānyagostathā । labhedvatsaprasūtānāṃ dāne dāne phalaṃ bhuvaḥ ।। 61 ।। bhūmidāne reṇumānavarṣa sthānaṃ ca matpade । jñānadāne mahatpuṇyaṃ vaikuṇṭhe modate ciram ।। 62 ।। śriyaṃ labhetsvarṇadāne rājatvaṃ rajatena ca । annadāne phalaṃ gahaṃ kathaṃ jānāmi pai śutam ।। 63 ।। labhate sarvadānasya phalaṃ brahmaṇabhojane । annadānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।। 64 ।। nātra pātraparīkṣā'sti na kālaniyamaḥ kvacit । annadāne śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ dātuḥ pātraṃ tvapātakī ।। 65 ।। annadānaṃ ca dhanyaṃ syādbhūmau vaikuṇṭhahetukam । vastraṃ dadāti vipraya daridrāya kuṭumbine ।। 66 ।। vastraṃsūtramānavarṣa vaikuṇṭhe modate ciram । suramye candraloke ca vāruṇe ca tathaiva ca ।। 67 ।। kṛtvā lohapradīpaṃ ca svarṇavartisamanvitam । dattavā ghṛtapradīpaṃ ca haraye paramātmane ।। 68 ।। andhakāraṃ ca na gṛhaṃ yamadūtaṃ yamaṃ tathā । na hi paśyati dātā ca prayāti mama mandiram ।। 69 ।। brahmaṇāya ca dattavaiva na yāti yamayātanām । divyavarṣasahaśraṃ ca modate śakramandire ।। 70 ।। āsanaṃ labhate svarge vastumātrānurūpataḥ । uttame lakṣavarṣe ca tadardha cetare vrajet ।। 71 ।। tāmpūlena labhedbhogaṃ svarge varṣaśataṃ vrajet । mālyadāne priyaṃ svarga vastumātrānurūpataḥ ।। 72 ।। phaladānaphalaṃ svarga labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ । sāmānyaśayyādānena svarga varṣaśataṃ vrajet ।। 73 ।। caturguṇaṃ prakṛṣṭāyāṃ guṇalakṣaṃ dilakṣaṇe । anāthāya suviprāya yadi gehaṃ pradīyate ।। 74 ।। atraiva mānavarṣa ca śakraloke mahīyate । dṛṣṭvā bubhukṣitaṃ vipramannaṃ tasmai pradīyate ।। 75 ।। ayalāṃ śriyamāpnoti putrapautravivardhinīm । vrajanātha vrajaṃ gatvā vrajabhūmau vrajādhunā ।। 76 ।। vraja bhojaya vipāṃśca vraja sarva vraje vraje । gokule gokule vatsa vatsa vatsa nirākule ।। 77 ।। vyākulānāṃ gokulānāṃ saṃkule ca vraje vraje । etatte kathitaṃ nanda sānandaṃ puṇyavardhanam ।। susvapnadarśanaṃ puṇyaṃ yadi nīcaṃ na vakti ca ।। 78 ।। kāśyapaṃ durbhagaṃ nīcaṃ śatrumajñāninaṃ streyam । tyaktvā rātriṃ ca divase vakti vipraṃ mupaṇḍitam ।। 79 ।। devālaye ca devaṃ vā'pyaśvatthatulaśīvaṭam । uktvā taddviguṇaṃ puṇyamaprakāśya caturguṇam ।। 80 ।। susvapnadarśane prājño gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet । arthaṃ vittaṃ ca bhāryā ca bhūmiṃ putraṃ labhetprajām ।। 81 ।। mokṣaṃ ca paramaiśvaryaṃ labhate sarvavāñchitam । ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 82 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 76 ।।
<4.77> atha saptaspatatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca kena spapnena kiṃ puṇyaṃ kena mokṣo bhavetsukham । ko'pi ko'pi ca susvapnastatsarvaṃ kathaya prabho ।। 1 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca vedeṣu sāmavedaśca praśastaḥ sarvakarmasu । tathaiva kaṇvaśākhāyāṃ puṇyakāṇḍe manohare ।। 2 ।। sa vyavato yaśca duḥsvapnaḥ śaśvatapuṇyaphalapradaḥ । tatsarva nikhilaṃ tāta kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 3 ।। svapnādhyāyaṃ pravakṣyāmi bahupuṇyaphalapradam । svapnādhyāyaṃ naraḥ śrutvā gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ।। 4 ।। svapnaktu prathame yāme saṃvatsaraphalapradaḥ । dvitīye cāṣṭabhirmāsaistribhirmāsaistṛtīyare ।। 5 ।। caturthe cārdhamāsena svapnaḥ svātmaphalapradaḥ । daśāhe phaladaḥ svapno'pyaruṇodayadarṇane ।। 6 ।। prātaḥsvapnaśca phaladastatkṣaṇaṃ yadi bodhitaḥ । dine manasi yaddṛṣṭaṃ tatsarva ca labheddhruvam ।। 7 ।। cintāvyādhisamāyukto naraḥ svapnaṃ ca paśyati । tatsarva niṣphalaṃ tāta prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 8 ।। jacaḍo mūtrapurīṣeṇa pīḍitaśca bhayākulaḥ । digambaro muktakeśo na labhetsvapnajaṃ phalam ।। 9 ।। dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ ca nidrāluryadi nidrāṃ prayati ca । vimūḍho vakti cedrātrau na labhetsvapnajaṃ phalam ।। 10 ।। uktavā kāśyapagotre ca vipartti labhate dhruvam । durgate durgatiṃ yāti nīce vyādhiṃprayāti ca ।। 11 ।। śatrau bhayaṃ ca labhate mūrkhe ca kalahaṃ labhet । kāminyāṃ dhanahāniḥ syādrātrau jorabhayaṃ bhavet ।। 12 ।। nidrāyāṃ labhate śokaṃ paṇḍite vāñchitaṃ phalam । na prakāśyaśca susvapnaḥ paṇḍitaiḥ kāśyape vraja ।। 13 ।। gavāṃ ca kuñjarāṇāṃ ca hayānāṃ ca vrajeśvara । prāsādānāṃ ca śailānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। 14 ।। ārohaṇaṃ ca dhanadaṃ bhojanaṃ rodanaṃ tathā । pratigṛhyatathā vīṇāṃ sasyāḍhyāṃ bhūmimālabhet ।। 15 ।। śastrāstreṇa yadā viddho vraṇena kṛmiṇā tathā । viṣṭhayā rudhireṇaiva saṃyukto'pyarthavānbhavet ।। 16 ।। svapne'pyagamyāgamato bhāryālābhaṃ karoti yaḥ । mūtrasiktaḥ pibecchukaṃ narakaṃ ca viśatyapi ।। 17 ।। nagaraṃ praviśedraktaṃ samudraṃ vā sudhāṃ pibet । śubhavārtāmavāpnoti vipulaṃ cārthamālabhet ।। 18 ।। gajaṃ nṛpaṃ suvarṇa ca vṛṣabhaṃ ghenumeva ca । dīpamannaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ kanyāṃ chatraṃ rathaṃ dhvajam ।। 19 ।। kuṭumbaṃ labhate dṛṣṭvā kīrtiṃ ca vipulāṃ śriyam । pūrṇakumbhaṃdvijaṃ vahniṃ puṣpatāmbūlamandiram ।। 20 ।। śukladhānyaṃ nadaṃ veśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt । gokṣīraṃ ca ghṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā cārtha puṇyadhanaṃ labhet ।। 21 ।। pāyasaṃ padmapatre ca dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu । miṣṭānnaṃ svastikaṃ bhuktvā dhruvaṃ rājā bhaviṣyati ।। 22 ।। pakṣiṇāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca bhuṅkte māṃsaṃ naro yadi । bahvarthaṃ śubhavārtāṃ ca labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam ।। 23 ।। chatraṃ vā pādukāṃ vā'pi labdhvā dhānyaṃ ca gacchati । asiṃ ca nirmaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tattathaiva bhaviṣyati ।। 24 ।। helayā saṃtaredyo hi sa pradhāno bhaviṣyati । dṛṣṭvā ca phalitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ dhanamāpnoti niścitam ।। 25 ।। sarpeṇa bhakṣito yo hi ṇarthalātraśca tadbhavet । svapne sūrya vidhuṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate vyādhibandhanāt ।। 26 ।। vaḍavāṃ kukkuṭīṃ dṛṣṭvā kauñcīṃ bhāryaṃ labheddhruvam । svapneyo nigaḍairbaddhaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ putramālabhet ।। 27 ।। dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ bhuṅkate padmapatre nadītaṭe । viśīrṇapadmapatre ca so'pi rājā maviṣyati ।। 28 ।। jalaukasaṃ vṛścikaṃ ca sarpa ca yadi paśyati । dhanaṃ putraṃ ca vijayaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vā labhediti ।। 29 ।। śṛṅgibhirdaṃṣṭribhiḥ kolairvānaraiḥ pīḍito yadi । niścitaṃ ca bhavedrājā dhanaṃ ca vipulaṃ labhet ।। 30 ।। matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ mauktikaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ candanahīrakam । yastu paśyati svapnānte vipulaṃ dhanamālabhet ।। 31 ।। surāṃ ca rudhiraṃ svarṇa bhuktvā viṣṭhāṃdhanaṃ labhet। pratimāṃ śivaliṅgaṃca labheddṛṣṭvā jayaṃ dhanam ।। 32 ।। phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ bilvamāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā labheddhanam । dṛṣṭvā ca jvaladagniṃ ca dhanaṃ buddhiṃ śriyaṃ labhet ।। 33 ।। āmalakaṃ dhātrauphalamutpalaṃ ca dhanāgamam । devatāśca dvijā gāvaḥ pitaro liṅginastathā ।। 34 ।। yaddadāti mithaḥsvapne tattathaiva bhaviṣyati । śuklāmbaradharā nāryaḥ śuklamālyānulepanā । samāśliṣyanti yaṃ svapne tasya śrīḥ sarvataḥ sukham ।। 35 ।। pītāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ pītamālyānulepanām । avagūhati yaḥ svapne kalyāṇaṃ tasya jāyate ।। 36 ।। sarvāṇi śuklāni praśaṃsitāni bhasmāsthikārpāsavivarjitāni । sarvāṇi kṛṣṇanyatininditāni gohastivājidvijadevavarjyam ।। 37 ।। divya strī sasmitā viprā natnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā । yasya mandiramāyāti sa priyaṃ labhate dhruvam ।। 38 ।। svapne ca brahmaṇo devo brāhmaṇī devakanyakā । brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇī vā'pi saṃtuṣṭā sasmitā satī ।। 39 ।। phalaṃ dadāti yasmai ca tasya putro bhaviṣyati । yaṃ svapne brāhmaṇā nanda kurvanti ca śubhāśiṣam ।। 40 ।। yadvadanti bhavettasya tasyaiśvarya bhaveddhruvam । parituṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭhaśṭā''yāti yasya mandiram ।। 41 ।। nārāyaṇaḥ śivo brahmā praviśettu tadāśramam । saṃpattisvasya bhavati yaśaśca vipulaṃ śubham ।। 42 ।। pade pade sukhaṃ tasya samānaṃ gauravaṃ labhet । akasmādapi svapne tu labhate surabhiṃ yadi ।। 43 ।। bhūmilābho bhavettasya bhāryā cāpi pativratā । kareṇa kṛtvā hastī yaṃ mastake sthāpayedyadi ।। 44 ।। rājyalābhobhavettasya niścitaṃ ca śrutau matam । svapne tu brāhmaṇastuṣṭaḥ samāśliṣyatiyaṃ vraja ।। 45 ।। tīrthasnāyī bhavetso'pi niścitaṃ ca śriyā'nvitaḥ । svapne dadāti puṣpaṃ ca yasmai puṇyavate dvijaḥ ।। 46 ।। jayayukto bhavetso'pi yaśasvī ca dharī sukhī । svapne dṛṣṭavā ca tīrthāni saudharatnagṛhāṇi ca ।। 47 ।। jayayuktaśca dhanavāṃstīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ । svapne tu pūṇaṃkalaśaṃ kaścitkasmai dadāti ca ।। 48 ।। putralābho bhavettasya maṃpattiṃ vā samālabhet । haste kṛtvā tu kuḍavamāḍhakaṃ vārasundarī ।। 49 ।। yasya mandiramāyāti sa lakṣmīṃ labhate dhruvam । divyā strī yadgṛhaṃ gatvā purīṣaṃ visṛjeddvija ।। 50 ।। arthalābho bhavettasya dāridryaṃ ca prayāti ca । yasya gehaṃ samāyāti brāhmaṇo bhāryayā saha ।। 51 ।। pārvatyā saha śaṃbhurvā lakṣmyā nārāyaṇo'thavā । brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇī vā'pi svapne tasmai pradīyate ।। 52 ।। dhānyaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ vā'pi tasya śrīḥ sardatomukhī । muktāhāraṃ puṣpamālyaṃ candanaṃ ca labhedvraja ।। 53 ।। svāpne dadāti vipraśca tasya śrīḥ sarva... । gorocanaṃ patākāṃ vā haridrāmikṣudaṇḍakam ।। 54 ।। siddhānnaṃ ca labhetsvapne tasya śrīḥ sarva... । brāhmaṇo brahmāṇī vā'pi dadāti yasya mastake ।। 55 ।। chatraṃ vā śuklavānyaṃ va sa carājā bhaviṣyati । svapne lathasthaḥ puruṣaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ ।। 56 ।। tatrasthodadhi bhuṅkte ca pāyasaṃ vā lṛpo bhavet । svapne dadāti vipraśca brāhmaṇī ca sudhāṃdadhi ।। 57 ।। praśastapātraṃ yasmai vā so'pi rājā bhaveddhruvam । kumārī cāṣṭavarṣīyā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 58 ।। yasya tuṣṭā bhavetsvapne sa bhavetkavipaṇḍitaḥ । dadāti pustakaṃ svapne yasmai puṇyavate ca sā ।। 59 ।। sa bhavedviśvavikhyātaḥ kavīndraḥ paṇḍiteśvaraḥ । yaṃ pāṭhayati svapne vā māteva ca sutaṃ yathā ।। 60 ।। sarasvatīsutaḥ so'pi tatparo nāsti paṇḍitaḥ । brāhmaṇaḥ pāṭhayedyaṃ ca piteva yatnapūrvakam ।। 61 ।। dadāti pustakaṃ prītyā sa ca satsadṛśo bhavet । prāpnoti pustakaṃ svapne pathi vā yatra tatra vā ।। 62 ।। sa paṇḍito yaśasvī ca vikhyātaśca mahītale । svapne yasmai mahāmantraṃ vipro vipre dadāti cet ।। 63 ।। sa bhavetpuruṣaḥ prājño dhanavānguṇavānsudhīḥ । svapne dadāti mantraṃ vā pratimāṃ vā śilāmayīm ।। 64 ।। yasmai dadāti vipraśca mant siddhiśca tadbhavet । vipraṃ viprasamūhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā natvā''śiṣaṃ labhet ।। 65 ।। rājendraḥ sa bhavedvā'pi kiṃvā ca kavipaṇḍitaḥ । śukladhānyayutāṃ bhūmīṃ yasmai vipra samutsṛjet ।। 66 ।। svapne'pi parituṣṭaśca sa bhavetpṛthivīpatiḥ । svapna vipro rathe kṛtvā nānāsvargaṃ pradarśayet ।। 67 ।। ciraṃjīvī bhavedāyurdhanavṛddhirbhaveddhruvam । viprāya vipraḥ saṃtuṣṭo yasmai kanyāṃ dadāti ca ।। 68 ।। svapne ca sa bhavennityaṃ dhanāḍhyo bhūvatiḥ svayam । svapne sarovaraṃ dṛṣṭavā samudraṃ vā nadīṃ nadam ।। 69 ।। śuklāhiṃ śuklaśailaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt । yaṃ paśyanti mṛtaṃ svapne sa bhaveccirajīvanaḥ ।। 70 ।। arogī rogiṇaṃ du khī suśinaṃ ca sukhaṃ bhavet । divyā strī yaṃ pravadati mama svāmī bhavāniti ।। 71 ।। svapne dṛṣṭvā ca cāgatiṃ sa ca rājā bhaveddṛḍham । svapne vā kālikāṃ dṛṣṭvā labdhavā sphaṭikamālikām ।। 72 ।। indracāpaṃ śakravajraṃ sa pratiṣṭhāṃ labheddhruvam । svapne vadati yaṃ vipro mama dāso bhaveti ca ।। 73 ।। haridāsyaṃ ca madbhaktiṃ sa labdhvā vaiṣṇavo bhavet । svapne vipro harīḥ śaṃbhurbrāhmaṇī kamalā śivā ।। 74 ।। śaklā strī devamātā vā jāhnavī vā sarasvatī । gopālikāveṣadharī bālikā rādhikā mama ।। 75 ।। bālaśca bālagopālaḥ svapnavidbhiḥ prakāśitaḥ । eṣa te kathito nanda susvapnaḥ puṇyahetukaḥ ।। śrotumicchasi kiṃ vā tvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te ।। 76 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... susvapnakathānaṃ nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 77 ।।
<4.78> athāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca śrīkṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha susvapnaśca śruto mayā । vedasāro nītisāro laukiko vaidikastathā ।। 1 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi pāpaṃ yeṣāṃ ca darśane । yasminkarmaṇi vā vatsa tanmāṃ kathitumarhasi ।। 2 ।। vacanaṃ vedaśāśroktaṃ tathā vedānuyāyinaḥ । śrotumicchanti saṃtaptā lokāstvanmukhatastathā ।। 3 ।। vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca vaidikānāṃ satāmapi । prahmādīnāṃ surāṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ jagatāmapi ।। 4 ।। śrutaṃ yattvanmukhāmbhojātpramāṇaṃ vacanāmṛtam । tena deho'bhiṣikto me vatsavicchedadāhanaḥ ।। 5 ।। svapne yaccharaṇāmbhojaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam । brahmādayo na paśyanti tadadya dṛṣṭigocaram ।। 6 ।। ataḥ paraṃ tvatpadābjaṃ kva paśyāmi ca pātakī । viṇmūtradhārī deho me nibaddhaśca svakarmaṇā ।। 7 ।। īdṛśaṃ ca dinaṃ vatsa kadā mama bhaviṣyati । tvayā brahmādināthena saṃvādo mama pāpinaḥ ।। 8 ।। kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha mama doṣaṃ kṣamasva ca । vatsabuddhyā ca durnītaṃ yatkṛtaṃ ca maheśvara ।। 9 ।। brahmeśaśeṣamunayo dhyāyante tvatpadāmbujam । sarasvatī śrutiryasya stavane jaḍatāṃ vrajet ।। 10 ।। ityevamuktvā nandaśca nirānandaḥ śucā''kulaḥ । mūrcchāmāpa ruditvā ca putravicchedavihvalaḥ ।। 11 ।। saṃtrasto bhagavānkṛṣṇo bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ । paramādhyātmikaṃ jñānaṃ dadau tasmai jagatpatiḥ ।। 12 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca he nanda janakaśreṣṭha sarvaśreṣṭha vrajeśvara । cetanaṃ kuru kalyāma jñānaṃ ca paramaṃ śrṛṇu ।। 13 ।। paramādhyātmikaṃ jñānaṃ jñānināṃ ca sudulrabham । vedaśāstre gopanīyaṃ tubhyameva dadāmyaham ।। 14 ।। nibodha śrūyatāṃ nanda sānandaḥ susamāhitaḥ । janmamṛtyucarāvyādhiryadabhyāsānna jāyate ।। 15 ।। sthiro bhava mahārāja vrajanātha vrajaṃ vraja । jñānaṃ labdhvā sadānandaḥ śokamohavivarjitaḥ ।। 16 ।। jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ sacarācaram । prabhāte svapnavanmithyā mohakāraṇameva ca ।। 17 ।। mithyākṛtrimanirmāṇahetuśca pāñcabhautikaḥ । māyayā satyabuddhyā ca pratītiṃ jāyate naraḥ ।। 18 ।। kāmakrodharobhamohairveṣṭitaḥ sarvakarmasu । māyayā mohitaḥ śaśvajjñānahīnaśca durbalaḥ ।। 19 ।। nidrātandrākṣutpipāsākṣamāśraddhādayādibhiḥ । lajjā śāntirdhṛtiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiścā''bhiśca veṣṭitaḥ ।। 20 ।। manobuddhicetanābhiḥ prāṇajñānātmabhiḥ saha । saṃsaktaḥ sarvadevaiśca yathā vṛkṣaśca vāyasaiḥ ।। 21 ।। ahamātmā ca sarveśaḥ sarvajñānātmakaḥ smṛtaḥ । mano brahmā ca prakṛtirbuddhirupā sanātanī ।। 22 ।। prāṇā viṣṇuścetanā sā padmā tu cādhidevatā । mayi sthite sthitāḥ sarve gatāste'pigate mayi ।। 23 ।। asmābhiśca vinā dehaḥ sadyaḥ patati niścitam । pāñcabhūto vilīnaśca pañcabhūteṣu tatkṣaṇam ।। 24 ।। nāmasaṃketarūpaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ mohakāraṇam । śokaścājñānināṃ tāta jñānitāṃ nāsti kiṃcana ।। 25 ।। nidrādayaḥ śaktayaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛte kalāḥ । lobhādayo hyadharmāśāstathā'haṃkārapañcamaḥ ।। 26 ।। te brahmaviṣṇurudrāśā guṇāḥ sattvādayastrayaḥ । jñānātmakaḥ śivo jyotirahamātmā ca nirguṇaḥ ।। 27 ।। yadā viśāmi prakṛtau tadā'haṃ saguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । saguṇā viṣayā viṣṇuprahmarudrādayastathā ।। 28 ।। dharmo madaṃśo viṣayī śoṣaḥ sūryaḥ kalānidhiḥ । evaṃ sarve satkalāṃśā munimanvādayaḥsurāḥ ।। 29 ।। sarvadehe praviṣṭo'haṃ na liptaḥ sarvakarmasu । jīvanmuktaśca madbhakto janmamṛtyujarāharaḥ ।। 30 ।। sarvasiddheśvaraḥ śrīmānkīrtimānpaṇḍitaḥ kaviḥ । caturstriśadvidhaḥ siddhaḥ sarvakarmopahārakaḥ ।। 31 ।। tamupaimi svayaṃ siddhaṃ bhaktastvanyanna vāñchati । dvāviṃśatividhaṃ siddhaṃ siddhisādhanakāraṇam ।। 32 ।। manmukhācchūyatāṃ nanda siddhamantraṃ gṛhāṇa ca । aṇimā laghimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā ।। 33 ।। īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca tathā kāmāvasāyitā । dūraśravaṇameveti parakāyapraveśanam ।। 34 ।। manoyāyitvameveti sarvajñatvamabhīpsitam । vahnistambhaṃ jalastambhaṃ ciraṃjīvitvameva ca ।। 35 ।। vāyustambhaṃ kṣutpipāsānidrāstambhanameva ca । kāyavyūhaṃ ca vāksiddhiṃ mṛtānayanamaupsitam ।। 36 ।। sṛṣṭīnāṃ karaṇaṃ caiva prāṇākarṣaṇameva ca । oṃ sarveśvareśvarāya sarvadighnavināśine madhusūdanāya svāheti ।। 37 ।। ayaṃ santro mahāgūḍhaḥ sarveṣāṃ kalpapādapaḥ । sāmavede ca kathitaḥ middhānāṃ sarvamiddhidaḥ ।। 38 ।। anena yoginaḥ siddhā munīndrāśca surāstathā । śatalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavetsatām ।। 39 ।। yadi nārāyaṇakṣetre haviṣyānnarato japet । gatvā kuru japaṃ tātakāśikāṃ maṇikarṇikām ।। 40 ।। śrṛśu nārāyaṇakṣetrai jalādhastaccatuṣṭayam । atra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nānyaḥ svāmī kadācana ।। 41 ।। jñānaṃ cātra mṛte loke mūrtirbhavati tasya vai । vrataṃ vinā'pi mantreṇa jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ ।। 42 ।। vrajaṃ kuru pavitraṃ ca vrajanātha vrajaṃ vraja । pāpaṃ yaddarśane tāta kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 43 ।। duḥsvapnaṃ pāpabaujaṃ ca kevalaṃ vighnakāraṇam । goghnaṃ ca brāhmaṇaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ kṛṭilaṃ tathā ।। 44 ।। devaghnaṃ pitṛmātṛghnaṃ pāpaṃ viśvavāsaghātinam । mithyāsākṣipradātāraṃ yaṃ cā''tithyavivañcanam ।। 45 ।। grāmayājinameveti devaviprasvahāriṇam । aśvatthaghātinaṃ duṣṭaṃ śivaviṣṇuvinindakam ।। 46 ।। adīkṣitamanācāraṃ saṃdhyāhīnaṃ dvijaṃ tathā । devalaṃ vṛṣavāhaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārakam ।। 47 ।। śavadāhaṃ ca śūdrāṇāṃ śūdraśrāddhānnabhojinam । avīrāṃ chinnanāsāṃ ca devabrāhmaṇanindakām ।। 48 ।। padibhaktiviṅīnāṃ ca viṣṇubhaktivihīnakām । śūdrāṇāṃ vidhavāṃ caiva cāṇḍālīṃ vyabhicāriṇīm ।। 49 ।। śaśvatkopayutaṃ duṣṭamṛṇagrastaṃ ca jārajam । cauraṃ mithyāvādinaṃ ca śaraṇāgatayāyinam ।। 50 ।। māṃsāpahāriṇaṃ caiva brahmaṇaṃ vṛṣalīpatim । brāhmaṇīgāmiraṃ śūdra dvijaṃ vādhurṣikaṃ tathā ।। 51 ।। agamyāmāminaṃ duṣṭaṃ caturvaṇaṃ narādhamam । mātā sapatnīmātā ca śvaśrūśca bhaginī sutā ।। 52 ।। gurupatnī putrapatnī sodarasya priyā satī । mātṛṣvasā pitṛṣvasā bhāmineyapriyā tathā ।। 53 ।। mātulānī navoḍhā ya pitṛvyastrī rajasvalā । pitṛmātṛprasūścaiva cāgamyāṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। 54 ।। kīrtitāḥ sāmavede ca paripālyāḥ satāṃ vraja । etā dṛṣṭvā ca spṛṣṭvā ca brahmahatyāṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 55 ।। tasmāddaivena tā dṛṣṭvā sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ smaret । kāmato yadi paśyanti vinindyāste bhavanti vai ।। 56 ।। tasmātsanto na paśyanti śāpabhītā vrajeśvara । rāhugrastaṃ raviṃ sobhaṃ na paśyanti vipaścitaḥ ।। 57 ।। janmāṣṭasaptariḥ phāṅkadaśamasthe divākare । janmarkṣe nidhane cāpi caturthe'pi kalānidhau ।। 58 ।। sarvairaṃśairna paśyanti kampitaṃ candrabhāskaram । neṣṭacandro na dṛśyaśya bhādre māsi sitāsite ।। 59 ।। caturthyāmuditaścandraḥ parityakto manīṣimiḥ । candrastārāpaharaṇaṃ kalaṅgamatiduṣkaram ।। 60 ।। tasmai dadāti he nanda kāmato di paśyati । akāmato naro dṛṣṭvā mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet ।। 61 ।। tadā śuddho bhavetsadyo niṣkalaṅkī mahītale । siṃhaḥ prasenamavadhītsiṃho jāmbavatā hataḥ ।। 62 ।। sukumāraka mā rodīstava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ । iti mantreṇa pūtaṃ ca jalaṃ sādhuḥ pibeddhruvam ।। iti te kathitaṃ sarvamaparaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 63 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... aṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 78 ।।
<4.79> athaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca rāhugrastaḥ kathaṃ sūryaścandro vā'pi jagatprabho । neṣṭaścandraḥ kathaṃ bhādre caturthyāṃ cāsite site ।। 1 ।। vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca kaṃ pṛcchāmitvayā vinā । vede purāṇe gopyaṃ yanna jānanti vipaśyitaḥ ।। iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā cedaṃ vacanamabravīt ।। 2 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca atathyaṃ vacanaṃ cedaṃ niṣiddhaṃ vaidikairapi । kṣamasva nanda bhadraṃ te praśnamanyaṃ kuruṣva mām ।। 3 ।। biśvastaṃ vacanaṃ tāta na prakāśyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ । vighnaḥ prakāśe bhavati satāṃ chidraṃ ca daivataḥ ।। 4 ।। nanda uvāca kathayasva jagannātha na bhakte vñcanaṃ kuru । adṛśyau cāpi deveśau rāhugrastau ca puṣyadau ।। 5 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣayāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm । yāṃ śrutvā niṣkalaṅkaśca tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ ।। 6 ।। sarvapātakinaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatpāpaṃ labhate naraḥ । ākhyānaśravaṇonaiva bhasmībhūtaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 7 ।। ekadā jamadagniśca mahākautūhalānvitaḥ । reṇukāsahitastuṣṭo jagāma narmadātaṭam ।। 8 ।। nirjane narmadātīre vijahāra tayā saha । navoḍhayā ca sundaryā navayauvanayuktayā ।। 9 ।। suveṣayā susmitayā ratnabhūṣaṇayuktayā । natayā stanabhāreṇa śroṇībhāreṇa mandayā ।। 10 ।। sundarīṇāmatulayā śvetacampakavarṇayā । supūrṇacandrānanayā kaṭākṣayutayā tathā ।। 11 ।। atīvasūkṣmāmbarayā kāmabāṇārtayā vraja । pulakāñcitasarvāṅgasaṃbhogenāpi mūrcchayā ।। 12 ।। puṃskokilayute ramye śabdite sumadhuvrate । sugandhivāyusaṃyukte puṣpatalpānvite śubhe ।। 13 ।। candanokṣitasarpāṅgaṃ vastramālyadharaṃ munim । mahārāsarasāḍhyaṃ tamuvāca bhāskaraḥ svayam ।। 14 ।। vedakartuḥ prapautrastavaṃ brahmaṇaśca jagatvateḥ । caturvedavidheyeṣu suniṣṇātaḥ sadā śuciḥ ।। 15 ।। vedāṅgakartā dharmajñaḥ śreṣṭho vedavidāṃ varaḥ । mahātapasvī tejasvī brahmacārī ca suvratī ।। 16 ।। yuṣmadvidhoktaṃ śāstraṃ ca paṭhitvā'nyaśca paṇḍitaḥ । vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ ।। 17 ।। dharma tyajati dharmajño hyadharmeṇa rataḥ katham । divāmaithunadoṣaṃ ca vakti vedo viśeṣataḥ ।। 18 ।। ahaṃ ca dharmiṇāṃ sākṣī tena tvāṃ kathayāmi te । sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tatyāja maithunaṃ dvijaḥ ।। 19 ।। dṛṣṭvā puro viprarūpaṃ sūrya tejasvinaṃ suram । uvāca sūrya raktāsyaḥ kopalajjāsamanvitaḥ ।। reṇukā lajjitā tatra vidhārya vāsasī satī ।। 20 ।। jamadagniruvāca ko bhavānpaṇḍitaṃmanyo na tvadanyo'sti paṇḍitaḥ । ahaṃ bhṛgorbhagavataḥ śiṣyastvaṃ kaśyapasya ca ।। 21 ।। caturvedāṃśca jānāmi dharmādharmanirūpaṇo । vedapraṇihito dharme hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ ।। 22 ।। ajñānī puruṣaḥ śaśvajjaḍitaśca svakarmaṇā । tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vaṅneḥ sarvabhujo yathā ।। 23 ।। anye bhavāṃśca dharmaśca sākṣī sarve ca karmaṇām । phaladātā ca śāstrajño yatastvattanayaḥ sadā ।। 24 ।। na vaiṣṇavānāṃ śāstāro yūyamasmākameva ca । na vāsudevabhaktānāmaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ।। 25 ।।
hareḥ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ śaśvadrakṣati vaiṣṇavān । nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānsvayaṃ brahmā ca śaṃkaraḥ ।। 26 ।। śāstā yamaśca nāsmākaṃ tvaṃ vai nāpi divākara। rājaputro yathā sthāne vayaṃ svacchandagāminaḥ ।। 27 ।। śakto'haṃ bhasmasātkartuṃ yamaṃ sarvasurāṃstathā । mahendraprabhṛtīnsūrya kṣaṇenaivāvalīlayā ।। 28 ।। kastvaṃ dharmapravaktā me yāhi svasthānameva ca । mama śāstā tu bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 29 ।। adya me nirjane sthāne rasabhaṅgastvayā kṛtaḥ । mama śāṇatpāpa dṛśyo rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi ।। 30 ।। draṣṭuṃ tvāṃ ye ghanāḥ sarve dūrībhūtā bhavanti te । tvāmācchannaṃ kariṣyanti vāyunā preritāstathā ।। 31 ।। svatejasā bhavāngarvāddhatatejā bhaviṣyasi । meghācchannaḥ svalpatejā rāhugrasto bhavānbhava ।। 32 ।। brāhmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānbhāskaraḥ svayam । tataḥ puṭāñjalirbhūtvā tuṣṭāva munipuṃgavam ।। 33 ।। bhāskara uvāca avadhyāḥ sarve dharmajña dhanyā mānyāḥ puraskṛtāḥ । nārāyaṇaśca bhagavāñchaṃbhurbrahmā svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 34 ।। gaṇeśāścāpi śeṣaśca dharmaścāpi sanātanaḥ । stuvānti brahmaṇaṃ sarve viprarūpī janārdanaḥ ।। 35 ।। vipradattaśca yo brahmanvayamasmanmukho dvijaḥ । hutāśanaśca dvimukhāḥ surāḥ sarve dvijo varaḥ ।। 36 ।। kṣamasva vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhaḥ svadharma sa samācara । vaiṣṇavānāṃ kṛtaḥ kopo hṛdi yeṣāṃ janārdanaḥ ।। 37 ।। asmābhiḥ pūjitā viprā yuṣamābhiḥ pūjitāḥ surāḥ । parasparaṃ snehapātraṃ cedamācaraṇaṃ dvija ।। 38 ।। ahamevaṃ tvayā śapto mayā śapto bhavānbhava । anyathā māṃ vadantyevaṃ sūrya nistejasaṃ janāḥ ।। 39 ।। parābhūtaḥ kṣatriyeṇa bhaviṣyasi dvijeśvara । maraṇaṃ kṣatriyāstreṇa bhavataśca bhaviṣyati ।। 40 ।। sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ । taṃ śaśāpātiraktāsyaḥ śaṃbhunā nirjito bhavān ।। 41 ।। ubhayoḥ kalahaṃ jñātvā kaśyapena saha vraja । ājagāma svayaṃ brahmā vidhātā jagatāmapi ।। 42 ।। āgatya brahmā saṃtrastaṃ bodhayāmāsa bhāskaram । muniśreṣṭhaṃ ca dharmajñaṃ dharmajñānāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 43 ।। brahmovāca kṣamasva bhāskara tvaṃ ca sākṣānnārāyaṇo bhavān । yuṣmākaṃ paripālyaścāpyavadhyo brāhmaṇāḥ sadā ।। 44 ।। ahaṃ karomi bhavato vipraśāpāntamulbaṇam । atrāhamāgatastrasto bhṛguṇā preritastataḥ ।। 45 ।। sphuṭo'haṃ preritaścāpi kaśyapena marīcinā । śānto bhava surakṣeṣṭha sākṣītvaṃ sarvakarmaṇām ।। 46 ।। kutraciddivase brahmaṃstvaṃ tatra kutracitkṣaṇam । bhaviṣyasi ghanācchannaḥ sadyo mukto bhaviṣyasi ।। 47 ।। nyūnātirakte varṣe ca rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi । tatrādṛśyaśca keṣāṃcitpuṇyadṛśyo hi kasyacit ।। 48 ।। anyathā sarvakālena puṇyadṛśyo bhavānbhuvi । tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca namaskṛtya sarve niṣpāpino janāḥ ।। 49 ।। janmasaptāṣṭariḥ phāṅkacaturthe daśame tathā । janmarkṣe nidhanai naṇāmadṛśyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।। 50 ।। astakāle ghanācchanne madhyāhanasthe jale'pi vā । ardhodite ca kāne ca pāpadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi ।। 51 ।। bhāryāduḥkhanimittena bhāryayā hetubhūtayā । śvaśureṇa śālakena hatatejā bhaviṣyasi ।। 52 ।। anyathā tava tejaśca saṃjñā sahitumakṣamā । mālīsumāliyuddhe ca śaṃbhunā tvaṃ parācitaḥ ।। 53 ।। ityevamuktvā sūrya ca bodhayāmāsa brāhmaṇam । namraṃ śāpaparābhūtaṃ lajjitaṃ kopitaṃ vraja ।। 54 ।। he vipra śvagṛhaṃ gaccha gaccha vatsa yathāsukham । tvattejasā kṣaṇenaiva bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavejjagat ।। 55 ।। sūryastvatparipālyaśca bhavānsūryasya nityaśaḥ । parasparaṃ ca pūjyaśca saṃbandhaḥ poṣyapoṣkaḥ ।। 56 ।। haryaśena kṣatriyeṇa kārtavīryārjunena ca । bhaviṣyasi na saṃdehaḥ parābhūto dvijo mṛtaḥ ।। 57 ।। purā te prāktanaṃ sarva kadācinna hi khaṇḍitam । nārāyaṇāśca svāṃśona tava putro bhaviṣyati ।। 58 ।। triḥ saptakṛtvo jagatīṃ niḥkṣatrāṃ ca kariṣyati । mṛtyuste yaśaso bījaṃ bhadiṣyati mahītale ।। 59 ।। ityevamukttā brahmā ca yayau gehaṃ vrajeśvara । prayayau jamadagniśca bhāskaraśca svamandiram ।। 60 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tāta ākhyānaṃ puṇyakārakam । rāhugrasto bhāskaraścāpyadṛśyo yena hetunā ।। 61 ।। caturthyāmuditaścandro bhādre māsi sitāsite । adṛśyo naṣṭarūpaśca śrūyatāṃ yena heturā ।। 62 ।। rāhugrastaḥ kalaṅkī vā purāśapto mayā pitaḥ । sarva tvāṃ kathayiṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm ।। 63 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... ekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 79 ।।
<4.80> athāśotitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca purā tārā guroḥ patnī navayauvanasaṃyutā । ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyā varasūkṣmāmbarā satī ।। 1 ।। suśroṇī sasmitā ramya sundarī sumanoharā । atīva kabarīramyā mālatīmālyabhūṣitā ।। 2 ।। mindūrabindunā sākaṃ cārucaṃdanabindubhi। । kastūrībindunā'dhaśca bhālamadhyasthalojjvalā ।। 3 ।। ratnendrasāranirmāṇakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitā । suvakralocanā śyāmā sucārukajjalojjvalā ।। 4 ।। sucārusāramuktābhadantapaṅktimanoharā । ratnakuṇḍalayugmena cārugaṇḍasthalojjvalā ।। 5 ।। kāminīṣvatulā bālā gajendramandagāminī । sukomalā candramukhī kāmādhārā ca kāmukī ।। 6 ।। svargamandākinītīre snātā snigdhāmbarā varā । dhyāyantī gurupādaṃ sā svagṛhaṃ gamanonmukhī ।। 7 ।। dṛṣṭvā tasyāśca sarvāṅgamanaṅgabāṇapīḍitaḥ । bhādre caturthyāṃ candraśca jahāra cetanāṃ vraja ।। 8 ।। jñānaṃ kṣaṇena saṃprāpya rathastho ramiko balī । rathamārohayāmāsa kare dhṛtvā ca tārakam ।। 9 ।। kāmonmattaḥ kāminīṃ tāṃ samāśliṣya cucumba ca । śṛṅgāraṃ kartumudyuktaṃ tamuvāca gurupriyā ।। 10 ।। tārakovāca tyaja māṃ tyaja māṃ candra sureṣu kulapāṃsana । gurupatnīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ ca pātivratyaparāyaṇām ।। 11 ।। gurupatnīsaṃgamane brahmahatyāśataṃ bhavet । gurupatnī viprapatnī yadi sā ca pativratā ।। 12 ।। brahmahatyāsahasraṃ ca tasyāḥ saṃgamane labhet । putrastvaṃ tava mātā'haṃ dhairya kuru sureśvāra ।। 13 ।। dhiktvāṃ śrutvā suragururbhasmībhūtaṃ kariṣyati । putrādhikaśca śiṣyaśca priyo matsvāmino bhavān ।। 14 ।। svadharma rakṣa pāpiṣṭha māmevaṃ mātaraṃ tyaja । dāsyāmi strīvadhaṃ tumyaṃ yadimāṃ saṃgrahīṣyasi ।। 15 ।। vilaṅdhya tārāvacanaṃ tāṃ ca saṃbhoktumudyatam । śaśāpa tārā kopena niṣkāmā sā pativratā ।। 16 ।। rāhugrasto ghanagrastaḥ pāpadṛśyo bhavānbhava । kalaṅkī yakṣmaṇā grasto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 17 ।। candraṃ śaptvā tadā tūrṇa kāmadevaṃ śaśāpa sā । tejasvinā kenacittvaṃ bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi ।। 18 ।। candrastārāṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā'pi ramaṇaṃ vraja । kroḍenidhāya prayayau rudatīṃ tā śucā'nvitām ।। 19 ।। nirjane nirjane ramye śaile śaile manohare । saronadanadīnāṃ ca tīre tīre manohare ।। 20 ।। madhuvratapikokte ca puṣpodyāne supuṣpite । ramyāyāṃ puṣpaśathyāyāṃ sa reme rāmayā saha ।। 21 ।। cadanokṣitasarvāṅgo madhupānarataḥ suraḥ । sukhasaṃbhogasaṃsakto bubudhe na divāniśam ।। 22 ।। malaye malayāraṇye malayānilasaṃyute । syandane candanavane paścimodadhisaṃnidhau ।। 23 ।। trikūṭe vaṭamūle ca tatra candrasarovare । sucāruśatapatrāṇāṃ patre candanacarcite ।। 24 ।। sucārucampakodyāne campakānilapūjite । kṣīrodakāñcanībhūmau krauñcakāñcanaparvate ।। 25 ।। ratnaśaile maṇimaye maṇimandirasundare । māṇikyamuktāsāreṇa hīrahāreṇa śobhite ।। 26 ।। sucāruvastracitrāḍhye śvetacāmāradarpaṇaiḥ । bhūṣite ratnadīpaiśca devakrīḍe priyasthale ।। 27 ।। vāruṇīṃ madirāṃ pītvā varuṇānīsamanvitaḥ । baruṇo ramate yatra tatra reme tayā saha ।। 28 ।। pāvane pavanodyāne parijātānilena ca । sugandhimohite ratnamālātīre ca nirmale ।। 29 ।। ṛkṣaśaile kalpavṛkṣavane vahnipriyāśrame । papau ca kāmadhenūnāṃ kṣīraṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe ।। 30 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukayugaṃ vahnistasmai dadau mudā । varuṇo ratnamālāṃ ca natnacchatraṃ samīraṇaḥ ।। 31 ।। tatra dṛṣṭvā'suraguraṃ baligehātsamāgatam । praṇamya sarvamuktvā ca candrastaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 32 ।। śukrastaṃ bodhayāmāsa vacanaṃ nītiyuktitaḥ । nirapekṣo suniśreṣṭho vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ ।। 33 ।। śukra uvāca śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi gurave dehi tārakām । śaṃbhośca suruputrāya pautrāya brahmaṇaśca vai ।। 34 ।। pūjitāya surārṇā ca deyā tasmai niśāpate । priyāya tatpriryāṃ dattavā śīghraṃ tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 35 ।। gurupatnīṃ mātṛtulyāṃ tyaja sadvacanādvidho । kuru pāpakṣayaṃ pāpanivṛttistu mahāphalā ।। 36 ।। satīnāṃ gurupatnīrnāṃ grahaṇe ca balena ca । brahmahatyāsahasrārṇāṃ pātakaṃ labhate janaḥ ।। 37 ।। kumbhīpāke ca pacyante yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam । sāmyaṃ nārāyaṇasthāne tṛṇaparvatayoḥ sura ।। 38 ।। kastvaṃ vatsa hareḥ sthāne karmabhogo'sti brahmaṇaḥ । nārāyaṇāśrītāḥ sarve jīvinastrividhā bhave ।। 39 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... tārāharaṇe'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 80 ।।
<4.81> athaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa uvāya etasminnantare śukraḥ surakṣeṇīṃ dadarśa saḥ । ākāśamārgādāyāntīṃ raṇaśastrāstradhāriṇīm ।। 1 ।। patākārnāṃ trikoṭiśca śatakoṭirmahārathāḥ । śatakoṭirgajendrārṇāṃ rathārnāṃ taccaturguṇam ।। 2 ।। aśvārnāṃ tatchataguṇaṃ samūhaṃ ca sudāruṇam । padātīrnāṃ samūhaṃ ca turaṅgebhyaśca ṣaḍguṇam ।। 3 ।। duṃdūbhīvādyabhāṇḍānāṃ pañcalakṣaṃ tathaiva ca । paṭahānāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca ḍiṇḍimānāṃ dvilakṣakam ।। 4 ।। airāvate mahendraṃ ca śvetāśve dharmameva ca । kuberaṃ varuṇaṃ vahniṃ rathasthaṃ pavanaṃ tathā ।। 5 ।। mahiṣasthaṃ yamaṃ caiva syandanasthaṃ divākaram । īśānaṃ ca vṛṣendrasthamanantaṃ nāgavāham ।। 6 ।। ādityāṃśca vasūnrudrānsiddhagandharvākinnarān । jīvanmuktamunīnāṃ ca samīhaṃ sūryavarcasam ।। 7 ।। tāndṛṣṭvā nirbhayaḥ śukraḥ samāśvāsya niśākaram । surāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ sainyamājuhāva vrajeśvara ।। 8 ।। ratnamālānadītīre hutāśanapriyāśrame । tatra tasthau daityasainyaṃ puṇyakṣīrodadhestaṭe ।। 9 ।। etasminnantare śukaḥ samīpe sarasastaṭe । puṇyāśrame'kṣayavaṭe surasainyātsamāgatam ।। 10 ।। dadarśa vṛṣabhasthaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ sarvaṃśaṃkaram । triśalapaṭṭīśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam ।। 11 ।। tejaḥsvarūpaṃ paramaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham । sardasaṃpatpradātāraṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvakāraṇam ।। 12 ।। sarveśvaraṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarvahūpaṃ sanātanam । śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃparitrāṇaparāyaṇam ।। 13 ।। sasmitaṃ paramātmānaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā । saṃtrastaḥ sahasotthāya praṇanāma padāmbuje ।। 14 ।। dadau śubhāśiṣaṃ tasmai suprasannaḥ parātparaḥ । ratnasiṃhāsane taṃ ca vāsayāmāsa sādaram ।। 15 ।। atha tatrāntare vipraṃ puratastaṃ dadarśa saḥ । śāntaṃ svayaṃ vidhātāraṃ ratnasyandanamundaram ।। 16 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ ratnamālāvibhūṣitam । prasannaṃ susmitaṃ śuddhaṃ jagatāmīśvaraṃ param ।। 17 ।। karmaṇāṃ phaladātāraṃ taporūpaṃ tapaśvinām । vedānāṃ janakaṃ vedaprasūṃ kāntaṃ manoharam ।। 18 ।। puṭāñjalistadā trastaḥ praṇanāma sureśvaram । ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। 19 ।। pūjāṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca tayoścaraṇapaṅkaje । nocitaṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ tayoḥ kalyāṇameva ca ।। 20 ।। vidhātā jagatāṃ nanda śakācāryaṃ purasthitam । sunītiṃ kathayāmāsa yatnataḥ śaṃmusaṃmataḥ ।। 21 ।। śrṛṇu śukra pravakṣyāmi turnītiṃ śaśinaḥ suta । lajjākāraṃ trijagatāṃ karma vedavahiṣkṛtam ।। 22 ।। snātvā gṛhonmukhīṃ tārrāṃ gurupatnīṃ pativratām । gṛhītvā śaraṇāpannastvayi pāpaśca saṃpratam ।। 23 ।। prastutaṃ devasainyaṃ ca paśya vatsa raṇodyatam । ahaṃ śaṃbhustvatsamīpaṃ tadarthaṃ ca samāgatau ।। 24 ।। śaṃbhuruvāca candramānaya he vipra yadyātmaśivamicchasi । saṃhariṣye sirastasya triśūrena ca pāpinaḥ ।। 25 ।। anyathā saṃhariṣyāmi sarvadaityānkṣaṇena ca । mayi ruṣṭe rakṣitā ko daityārnāṃ ca bhaveddvija ।। 26 ।। sadyaḥ pāśupatenaiva vāyvastreṇa ca rsāṃpratam । surārṇāṃ ripuvargaṃ ca hariṣyāmi ca līlayā ।। 27 ।। durvāsaso madaṃśasya gurustasyāṅgirā suniḥ । parasparācca saṃbandhādguruputro gururmama ।। 28 ।। bṛhaspatiśca tejasvī taṃ bhasmīkartumīśvaraḥ । na cakāra kṛpāluścetpriyaśiṣyeṇa hetunā ।। 29 ।। utathyapatnīṃ dṛṣṭvā sa purā reme svakāmataḥ । tatpateḥ śāpato'syaiva paragrastā priyā satī ।। 30 ।। patnīṃ madguruputrasya dehi tārrāṃ manoharām । madvairiṇaṃ ca candraṃ ca bhrādṛbhāryāpahāriṇam ।। 31 ।। śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ na hi rakṣedyadīśvaraḥ । pacyate niraye tāvadyāvadindāścatudarśa ।। 32 ।। atra nāsti vicāro me pāpiṣṭhe śaraṇāgate । pāpī yaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāti sa pāpī ca na saṃśayaḥ ।। 33 ।। dehi taṃ vipraśārdūla pāpinaṃ mātṛgāminam । bahiṣkṛtya svāśramācca tārāsādhvīsamanvitam ।। 34 ।। śukra uvāca surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ jagatāmapi । tvameva śāstā bhagavānko vā śāsti sure'sure ।। 35 ।। kṛtvā surāṇāṃ sāhāyyaṃ kathaṃ daityānhaniṣyasi । saṃhartuḥ sarvajagatāṃ daityaudhe kiṃ ca pauruṣam ।। 36 ।। tvaṃ jayotiḥ paramaṃ brahma saguṇo nirguṇaḥ svayam । guṇabhedānmūrtibhedo brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ ।। 37 ।। balidvāre gadāpāṇiḥ svayameva bhavānprabho । svayaṃ pradattā śakrāya tasmai śrīrapi līlayā ।। 38 ।। kṣamasva bhagañchaṃbho hara krodhaṃ ca saṃhara । kiṃ pauruṣaṃ ca bhavato brahmaṇasyāpi hiṃsayā ।। 39 ।। ahaṃ jīvañcharīreṇa na dāsyāmi niśākaram । śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ lajjirvaṃ pāpasaṃyutam ।। 40 ।। ahaṃ ca tvatpadāmbhoje śaraṇaṃ yāmi śaṃkara । yathocitaṃ kuru vibho jagatsarvaṃ tathaiva ca ।। 41 ।। śukrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prasanno bhagavāñchivaḥ । ityuvāca niśānāthaṃ samānaya śubhaṃ bhavet ।। 42 ।। etasminnantare brahmā bodhayitvā kaviṃ vibhuḥ । samānīya niśānāthaṃ tārakāsahitaṃ vraja ।। 43 ।। śaṃbhośca caraṇāmbhoje cakāra ca samarpaṇam । śaṃbhustaṃ prītiyuktaśca vāsayāmāsa vakṣasi ।। 44 ।। dattavā tasmai pādareṇuṃ niṣpāpaṃ ca cakāra saḥ । dattavā tanmastake hastaṃ kṛpālurabhayaṃ dadau ।। 45 ।। kṣīrode snāpayitvā ca prāyaścittena śaṃkaraḥ । cakāra candraṃ niṣpāpaṃ brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śucim ।। 46 ।। yogena candraṃ yogīndro dvikhaṇḍaṃ taṃ cakāra saḥ । rarakṣārdhaṃ lalāṭe ca so'pyardhaṃ brahmaṇaḥ puraḥ ।। 47 ।। ata eva mahādevo babhūva candraśekharaḥ । mṛgāṅko lajjitastatra kalaṅkīṃ devasaṃsadi ।। 48 ।। lajjayā ca svayogena dehatyāgaṃ cakāra saḥ । taccharīraṃ ca kṣīrode brahmaṇā ca samarpitam ।। 49 ।। rurodātriśca kṛbayā śucā kṣīrodadhestaṭe । atreścakṣurjalaṃ tasya papāta ca jale vraja ।। 50 ।। tasmādbabhūva candraśca niṣpāpo devasaṃsadi । brahmā ca bhagavāñchaṃbhurabhiṣekaṃ cakāra tam ।। uvāca taṃ mahādevo nirbhayaṃ devasaṃsadi ।। 51 ।। mahādeva uvāca svasthānaṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ kuruṣva viṣayaṃ mudā । paścāttasyāśca śāpenayakṣmagrastobhaviṣyasi ।। 52 ।। vyarthaṃ pativratāśāpaṃ kartumīśaścako bhuvi । madāśiṣā yakṣmaṇaśca pratīkāro bhaviṣyati ।। 53 ।। yasmādbhādracaturthyāṃ tu gurupatnīkṣatiḥ kṛtā । tasmāttasmindine vatsa pāpadṛśyo yuge yuge ।। 54 ।। nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi । avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ।। 55 ।। dehatyāgena he vatsa karmabhogo na naśyati । prāyaścittānna saṃdeho ṅyastameva bhaviṣyati ।। 56 ।। tārābaharaṇāvatsa kalaṅkaścandramaṇḍale । mṛgākṛtirvilagnaśca bhaviṣyati yuge yuge ।। 57 ।। śṛṇu vākyamihā''gaccha tārake ca pativrate । satyaṃ brūhi kasya garbhaṃtyaktvā śuddhābhava priye ।। 58 ।। akāmato balātsādhvī na strī jāreṇa duṣyati । kāmato narakaṃ yāti yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 59 ।। uvāca tārā brahmāṇaṃ garbhaṃ candrasya sasmitam । jahasurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ śaṃbhuśca munisaṃghakāḥ ।। 60 ।। dadau tārāṃ ca gurave lajjitāya vrajeśvara । bṛhaspatiryayau gehaṃ gṛhītvā ca pativratām ।। 61 ।। tayā prasūtaṃ putraṃ ca sundaraṃ kanakaprabham । gṛhītvāprayayau candaunamaskṛtya vidhiṃ śivām ।। 62 ।। yayurdevāśca munayaḥ śaṃbhuśca kamalodbhavaḥ । prayayau svagṛhaṃ śukrau daityayuktau mudā'nvitaḥ ।। 63 ।। etatte kathitaṃ nanda hyākhyānaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham । etacchru tvā tu niṣpāpo niṣkalaṅkī naro bhavet ।। 64 ।। dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ param । śokāpanodanaṃ harṣakaraṃ marvatra maṅgalam ।। 65 ।। tyaja śokaṃ sadā nanda gṛhaṃ vraja vrajeśvara । brūhi sarvaṃ yaśodāṃ ca matprasūṃ gopikāgaṇam ।। 66 ।। bodhayiṣyasi sarvāṃ tāṃ strījātiṃ śokasaṃyutām । sadīyajñānadattena harṣayuktaḥ sadā bhava ।। 67 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... tārāharaṇaṃ nāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 81 ।।
<4.82> atha dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mahābhāga duḥsvapnaṃ kathaya prabho । uvāca taṃ vai bhagavāñchrūyatāmiti tadvacaḥ ।। 1 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca svapne hasati yo harṣādvivāhaṃ yadi paśyati । nartanaṃ gītamiṣṭaṃ ca vipattistasya niścitam ।। 2 ।। dantā yasya vibīḍyante vicarantaṃ ca paśyati । dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā cāpi śarīrajā ।। 3 ।। amyaṅgitastu tailena yo gaccheddakṣiṇāṃ diśam । kharoṣṭramahiṣārūḍho mṛtyustasya na saṃśayaḥ ।। 4 ।। svapane karṇe japāpuṣpamaśokaṃ karavīrakam । vipattistasya tailaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ yadi paśyati ।। 5 ।। nagnāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ chinnanāsāṃ śūdrasya vidhavāṃ tathā । kapardakaṃ tālaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokamavāpnuyāt ।। 6 ।। svapne ruṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca brāhmaṇīṃ kopasaṃyutām । vipattiśca bhavettasya lakṣmīryāti gṛhāddhruvam ।। 7 ।। vanapuṣpaṃ raktapuṣpaṃ palāśaṃ ca supuṣpitam । kārpāsaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।। 8 ।। gāyantīṃ ca hasantīṃ ca kṛṣṇāmbaradharāṃ striyam । dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃ ca vidhavāṃ naro mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।। 9 ।। devatā yatra nṛtyanti gāyanti ca hasanti ca । āsphoṭayanti dhāvanti tasya deho mariṣyati ।। 10 ।। vāntaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca vaidyaṃ raupyaṃ suvarṇakam । pratyakṣamathavā svapne jīvitaṃ daśamāvadhi ।। 11 ।। kṛṣṇāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ kṛṣṇamālyānulepanām । upagūhati yaḥ svapne tasya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ।। 12 ।। mṛtavatsaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ ca mṛgasya ca narasya ca । yaḥ prāptotyasthimālāṃ ca vipattistasya niścitam ।। 13 ।। rathaṃ kharoṣṭrasaṃyuktamekākī yo'dhirohayet । tatrastho'pi ca jāgarti mṛtyureva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 14 ।। amyaṅgistu haviṣā kṣīreṇa madhunā'pi ca । takreṇāpi guḍenaiva pīḍā tasya viniścitam ।। 15 ।। raktāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ raktamālyānuleparām । upagūhati yaḥ svapne tasya vyādhirviniścitam ।। 16 ।। patitānnakhareśāṃśca nirvāṇāṅgārameva ca । bhasmabūrṇāṃ citāṃ dṛṣṭvā labhate mṛtyumeva ca ।। 17 ।। śmaśānaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca tṛṇāni lohameva ca । śamīṃ ca kiṃ citkṛṣṇāśvaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ labheddhruvam ।। 18 ।। pādukāṃ phalakaṃ raktaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ bhayānakam । māṣaṃ masūraṃ mudgaṃ vā dṛṣṭvā sadyo vraṇaṃ labhet ।। 19 ।। kaṭakaṃ saraṭhaṃ kākaṃ bhallūkaṃ vānaraṃ gavam । pūyaṃ gātramalaṃ svapne kevalaṃ vyādhikāraṇam ।। 20 ।। bhagnabhāṇḍaṃ kṣataṃ śūdraṃ galatkuṣṭhaṃ ca rogiṇam । raktāmbaraṃ ca jaṭilaṃ sūkaraṃ mahiṣaṃ kharam ।। 21 ।। andhakāraṃ mahāghoraṃ mṛtajīvaṃ bhayaṃkaram । dṛṣṭvā svapne yoniliṅga vipattiṃ labhatedhruvam ।। 22 ।। kuveṣarupaṃ malecchaṃ ca yamadūtaṃ bhayaṃkaram । pāśahastaṃ pāśaśastraṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 23 ।। brahmaṇo brāhmaṇī bālā bālako vā sutaḥ sutā । vilāpaṃ kurute kopāddṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।। 24 ।। kṛṣṇaṃ puṣpaṃ ca tanmālyaṃ sasyaṃ śastrāstradhāriṇam । mlecchāṃ ca vikṛtākāraṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃlabheddhruvam ।। 25 ।। tyaktaprāṇaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ ca labhate dhruvam । matsyādi dhārayedyo hi tadbhrāturmaraṇaṃ dhruvam ।। 26 ।। vādyaṃ ca nartanaṃ gītaṃ gāyanaṃ raktavāsasam । mṛdaṅgavādyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ labheddhruvam ।। 27 ।। chinnaṃ vā'pi kabandhaṃ vā vikṛtaṃ muktakeśinam । kṣipaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca kurvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ ।। 28 ।। mṛto vā'pi mṛtā vā'pi kṛṣṇā mlecchā bhayānakā । upagūhati yaṃ svapne tasya mṛtyurviniścitam ।। 29 ।। yeṣāṃ dantāśca bhagnāśca keśāścāpi patanti hi । dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā vā taccharīrajā ।। 30 ।। upadravanti yaṃ svapne śrṛṅgiṇo daṃṣṭriṇo'pi vā । bālakā mānavāścaiva tasya rājakulādbhayam ।। 31 ।। chinnavṛṅaṃ patantaṃ ca śilāvṛṣṭiṃ tuṣaṃkṣuram । raktāṅgāraṃ bhasmavṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamāvāpnuyāt ।। 32 ।। gṛhaṃ patantaṃ śailaṃ vā dhūmaketuṃ bhayānakam । bhagnaskandhaṃ tarorvā'pi dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।। 33 ।। rathagehaśailavṛkṣagohastituragāmbarāt । bhūmau patati yaḥ svapne vipattistasya niścitam ।। 34 ।। uccaiḥ patanti garteṣu bhasmāṅgārayuteṣu ca । kṣārakuṇḍeṣu cūrṇeṣu mṛtyusteṣāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।। 35 ।। balādgṛhṇāti duṣṭaścacchatraṃ ca yasya mastakāt । piturnāśo bhavettasya gurorvā'pi nṛpasya vā ।। 36 ।। surabhiryasya gehācca yāti trastā savatmikā । prayāti pāpinastasya lakṣmīrapi vasuṃdharā ।। 37 ।। pāśena kṛtvā badvaṃ ca yaṃ gṛhītvā prayānti ca । yamadūtāśca ye mlecchāstasya mṛtyurviniścitam ।। 38 ।। gaṇako brāhmaṇo vā'pi brāhmaṇī vā gurustathā । pariruṣṭaḥ śapati yaṃ vipattistasya niścitam ।। 39 ।। virodhinaśya kākāśca kukkuṭā bhallukāstathā । patantyāgatya yadgātre tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ ।। 40 ।। mahiṣā bhallukā uṣṭrā sūkarā gardabhāstathā । ruṣṭā dhāvanti yaṃ svapne sa rogī niścitaṃ bhavet ।। 41 ।। raktacandanakāṣṭhāni ghṛtāktāni juhoti yaḥ । gāyatryāśca mahasreṇa tena śāntirvidhīyate ।। 42 ।। sahasradhā capedyo hi bhaktyainaṃ madhusūdanam । niṣpāṇo hi bhavetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ susvapno bhavet ।। 43 ।। acyutaṃ keśavaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ satyaṃ janārdanam । haṃsaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ caiva hyetannāmāṣṭakaṃ śubham ।। 44 ।। śuciḥ pūrvamukhaḥ prājño daśakṛtvaśca yo japet । niṣpāpo'pi bhavetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ śubhavānbhavet ।। 45 ।। viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mādhavaṃ madhumūdanam । hariṃ narahariṃ rāmaṃ govindaṃ dadhivāmanam ।। 46 ।। bhaktyā cemāni nāmāni daśa bhadrāṇiyo japet । śatakṛtyo bhaktiyukto japtvā nīrogatāṃ vrajet ।। 47 ।। lakṣadhā hi japedyo hi bandhanānmucyate dhruvam । japtvā ca daśalakṣaṃ ca mahāvandhyā prasūyate ।। 48 ।। haviṣyāśī yataḥ śuddho daridro dhanavānbhavet । śatalakṣaṃ ca japtvā ca jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। 49 ।। oṃ namaḥ śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇapatiṃ kārtikeyaṃ dineśvanam । dharmaṃ gaṅgāṃ ca tulasīṃ rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm ।। 50 ।। nāmānyetāni bhadrāṇi jale snātvā ca yo japet । vāñchitaṃ ca labhetso'pi duḥsvapnaḥ śubhavānbhavet ।। 51 ।। oṃ hrīṃ klīṃ pūrvadūrgatināśinyai mahāmāyāyai svāhā । kalpavṛkṣo hi lokānāṃ santraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ ।। 52 ।। śuciśca daśadhā japtvā duḥsvapnaḥ sukhavānbhavet । śatalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।। 53 ।। siddhamantrastu labhate sarvasiddhiṃ ca vāñchitam । oṃ namo mṛtyuṃjayāyeti svāhāntaṃ lakṣadhā japet ।। 54 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca maraṇaṃ svapne śatāyuśca bhavennaraḥ । pūrvottaramukho bhūtvā svapnaṃ prājñe prakāśayet ।। 55 ।। kāśyape durgate nīce devabrāhmaṇanindake । mūrkhe caivānabhijñe ca na ca svapnaṃ prakāśayet ।। 56 ।। aśvatthe gaṇake vipre pitṛdevāsaneṣu ca । ārye ca vaiṣṇave mitre divā svapnaṃ prakāśayet ।। 57 ।। iti te puṇyamākhyātaṃ kathitaṃ pāpanāśanam । dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 58 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 82 ।।
<4.83> atha tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca vedānāṃ kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ ca putraka । sarvaṃ kathaya bhadraṃ te kaṃ pṛcchāmi tvayā vinā ।। 1 ।। viprāṇāṃ yo hi dharmaśca kṣatravidśūdrakarmaṇām । saṃnyāsināṃ ca yo dharmo yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। 2 ।। viprāṇāṃ vidhavāstrīṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāmapi । pativratānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca tatsarva vaktumarhasi ।। 3 ।। gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhiṇīnāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ । putrāṇāṃ cāpi kanyānāṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ prati ।। 4 ।। strījātiśca katividhā bhaktaḥ katividhaḥ prabho । brahmāṇḍaṃ ca katividhaṃ vadanaṃ ca kimātmakam ।। kiṃ nityaṃ kṛtrimaṃ kiṃ ca brūhi sarvaṃ krameṇa ca ।। 5 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca saṃdhyāpūtaḥ sadā vipraḥ kurute mama sevanam । nityaṃ bhuṅkate matprasādamanivedya kadā ca na ।। 6 ।। annaṃ viṣṭhā jalaṃ yadviṣṇoraniveditam । viṣṇuprasādabhojī ca jīvanmuktaśca brāhmaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।। nityaṃ tapasyānirataḥ śuciḥ śāntaśca śāstravit । vratatīrthāśrito dharmī nānādhyāpanasaṃyutaḥ ।। 8 ।। viṣṇumantraṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā ca gurusevanam । guhītvā tadanujñāṃ ca paścādbhavati sa gṛhī ।। 9 ।। dakṣiṇāṃ nityabūjānāṃ gurave ca nivedayet । gurūṇāṃ poṣaṇaṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 10 ।। sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ pitā caiva mahān guruḥ । pituḥ śataguṇairmātā mātuḥ śataguṇaiḥ suraḥ ।। 11 ।। mantradastantradaścaiva sṛrāṇāṃ ca caturguṇaḥ । nārāyaṇāśca bhagavānguruḥ pratyakṣa īśvaraḥ ।। 12 ।। uddeśe dīyate tasmai surāyeti śrutau śrutam । pratyakṣabhoktā svaguruḥ svayaṃ dehī janārdanaḥ ।। 13 ।। gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgurureva svayaṃ śivaḥ । gurau ca sarvadevāśca tiṣṭhanti satataṃ mudā ।। 14 ।। gurau tuṣṭe haristuṣṭo yasmiṃstuṣṭe ca devatā । guruḥ putrasamaṃ snehaṃ śiṣyeṣu na kariṣyati ।। 15 ।। labhate brahmahatyāṃ ca bhuṅkte kṛtvā ca nā''śiṣam । svadharmanirato vipro brāhmaṇaśca sadā śuciḥ ।। 16 ।। viṣṇusevī sadā viprastadanyo'pyaśuciḥ sadā । brāhmaṇo vṛṣavāhaśca śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārakaḥ ।। 17 ।। brāhmaṇo devalaścaiva saṃdhyāhīnaśca durbalaḥ । brāhmaṇaśca divāśāyī śūdraśrāddhānnabhojanaḥ ।। 18 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhī ca te ca śūdrasamā dvijāḥ । śālagrāmamahāmantraṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ vidhānataḥ ।। 19 ।। bhuṅkte naṃvedyaśeṣaṃ ca tatpādodakameva ca । hareḥ pādodakaṃ pītvā tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ ।। 20 ।। mucyate sarvapāpemyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati । sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।। 21 ।। śālagrāmaśilātoyairyo'bhiṣekaṃ samācaret । gaṅgājalāddaśaguṇaṃ śālagrāmajalaṃ vraja ।। 22 ।। nityaṃ bhuṅkte ca yo vipro jīvanmuktaḥ suraiḥ samaḥ । viprāṇāṃ nityakṛtyaṃ ca viṣṇornaivedyabhojanam ।। 23 ।। yatnena pūjanaṃ tasya tatpājodakamevanam । nityaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ kurute bhaktyā ca mama pūjanam ।। 24 ।। ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṅkte ca mama vai janmavāsare । śivarātrau ca he tāta śrīrāmanavamīdine ।। 25 ।। na ca bhuṅkte vratī yo hi jīvanmukto hi sa dvijaḥ । pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tasya pāde ca tāni ca ।। 26 ।। viprapādodakaṃ pītvā tīrthasnāyī bhavennaraḥ । viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī ।। 27 ।। tāvatpuṣkarapātreṣu pivanti pitaro jalam । viṣṇuprasādabhojī ca pavitrāṃ kurute mahīm ।। 28 ।। tīrthāni ca narāṃścaiva jīvanmukto hi sa dvijaḥ । sarvatīrtheṣu sa snāto vratānāṃ ca phalaṃ labhet ।। 29 ।। pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate niścitaṃ phalam । vahnivāyusamaḥ pūtastejasā bhāskaropamaḥ ।। 30 ।। yamadūtaṃ yamaṃ caiva sa ca svapne na paśyati । vaikuṇṭhe modate so'pi pārṣado hariṇā saha ।। 31 ।। na bhavettasya pāto hi viprasya harisevinaḥ । viṣṇumantropāsakaśya sa eva vaiṣṇavo dvijaḥ ।। 32 ।। brāhmaṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ prājño na hi tasmātparaḥ pumāt । vedokto vā purāṇokstantrokto vā ।। manuḥ śuciḥ ।। 33 ।। vicārato gṛhītvā taṃ śaivaḥ śāktaśca vaiṣṇavaḥ । guruvaktrādviṣṇumantroyasya karṇe viśatyayam ।। 34 ।। taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ mahāpūtaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ । mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। 35 ।। bhīttavā brahmaṇḍamakhilaṃ yāsyatyeva hareḥ padam । pūrvānsapta parānsapta sapta mātāmahādikān ।। 36 ।। sodarānṛddharedbhaktastatprasūṃ tatprasūṃ tathā । japennārāyaṇakṣetre puraścaraṇapūrvakam ।। 37 ।। puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca līlayā'।tmānamudvaret । mantragrahaṇamātreṇa phalametadvrajeśvara ।। 38 ।। puraścaraṇasaṃparkātpuruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam । aikāntiko vaiṣṇavaścapuṃsāṃ lakṣaṃ samuddharet ।। 39 ।। kriyā viṣṇupade yasya saṃkalpāśca bahiḥkṛtā । dvijāḥ surā mama prāṇā bhaktaḥ prāṇatparaḥ priyaḥ ।। 40 ।। viśveṣu priyapātreṣu na me bhaktātparaḥ priyaḥ । tejīyāṃsaṃ guruṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvatra rakṣituṃ kṣamam ।। 41 ।। kanoti mantragrahaṇaṃ tasmādbhūyādvicakṣaṇaḥ । vayohīnājjñānahīnādvidyāhīnāttathaiva ca ।। jātihīnādgurormantraṃ gṛhṇīyānna kadācana ।। 42 ।। aśāstrārtha kṣataṃ mantraṃ na guhṇīyātkadācana । mūrkhādāśramahīnācca pituḥ saṃnyāsinastathā ।। 43 ।। rogiṇo vaṃśahīnācca bhāryāhīnāttathaiva ca । mantrakṣiptāttathā mantraṃ na gṛhṇīyātkadācana ।। 44 ।। viṣṇumantraṃ na gṛhṇīyādviṣṇubhakti vihīnataḥ । na ca śaivānna śāktācca gṛhṇīyādvaiṣṇavāddvijāt ।। 45 ।। vayohīnāttathā'lpāyurjñānahīnādapaṇḍitaḥ । vidyāhīnādbhavenmūḍho jātihīnātkṣayo bhavet ।। 46 ।। mūrkhānmūrkho bhavetsadyo duḥkhī svāśramahīnataḥ । yaśohāniḥ pituścaiva mṛtyuḥ saṃnyāsinastathā ।। 47 ।। rogiṇo vyādhiyuktaśca nirvaṃśo vaṃśahīnataḥ । bhāryāhīno'pi strīhīnānmantrakṣiptādguro samaḥ ।। 48 ।। viṣṇubhaktivihīnācca bhaktihīno bhavennaraḥ । śaivācchāktādgṛhītvā ca harau bhaktirna vardhate ।। 49 ।। brāhmaṇo vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhaḥ pakvānnaṃ dātumīśvaraḥ । pakvānnaṃ haraye dātumakṣamaścetaro janaḥ ।। 50 ।। oṃkāroccāraṇāddhomācchālagrāmaśilārcanāt । mahyaṃ pakvānnadānācca viprādanyo vrajedadhaḥ ।। 51 ।। udāsīnāddūrācārānna gṛṅṇīyānmanuṃ sudhīḥ । daivādyadi ca gṛhṇīyāddhanahīno bhaveddhruvam ।। 52 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca nirāmiṣam । āmiṣasya parityāgātsūryaṃvattejasā bhavet ।। 53 ।। nityaṃ nūtanabhāṇḍena kartavyaḥ pāka eva ca । athavā pakṣaparyantaṃ tatastyājyaṃ manīthibhi। ।। 54 ।। sthānaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ kṛtvā pākaṃ nirvṛ tya pūjakaḥ । sthāne pariṣkṛte vipro dattvā mahyaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ।। 55 ।। tadā nivedya bhuṅkte ca dattvā viprāya sādaram । anivedya ca bhukttvā ca surāpītirbhaveddvijaḥ ।। 56 ।। candrasūryeparāge vai cā''śauce mṛtajātayoḥ । spṛṣṭenāśucinā sadyāḥ pākabhāṇḍaṃ parityajet ।। 57 ।। bhṛṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ tathā'nnaṃ ca dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī । pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā bhuṅkate sthāno pariṣkṛte ।। 58 ।। dvirbhojanaṃ na
