kartavyaṃ sthite sūrye dvijātibhiḥ । niṣphalaṃ tadbhavetkarma bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet ।। 59 ।। yātrāṃ yudvaṃ nadītīraṃ punarbhojanamaithune । varjaṃyecchrāddhadivase haviṣyāśī ca saṃyamī ।। 60 ।। dvijāya viṣṇubhaktāya pātraṃ dadyādvudhāya ca । vṛṣalīpataye caiva na dadyāychūdrayājine ।। 61 ।। saṃdhyāhīnāya duṣṭāya vṛṣavāhāya yatnataḥ । śukravikrayiṇe caiva devalāya kadācana ।। 62 ।। pradattaṃ pātrametebhyo brāhmaṇaṃ narakaṃ nayet । pātre bhuktavā taddivase maithunānnarakaṃ vrajetu ।। 63 ।। sarvebhyaḥ pātakī tāta kanyāvikrayakārakaḥ । mūnyaṃ gṛhītvā yo dadyātsa mahārauravaṃ vrajet ।। 64 ।। kanyālomapramāṇāntaṃ varṣaṃ ca pitṛbhiḥ saha । kumbhīpāke pacyate ca putraścāpi purohitaḥ ।। 65 ।। tasmātkanyāṃ supātrāya dānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ । śūdravadbrāhmaṇebhyaśca naiva tadvaṃśacāya ca ।। 66 ।। vipravaiṣṇavayordharmaḥ kathitaśca vrajeśvaraḥ । yaduktaṃ ca purāṇaiśca caturbhiḥ śrutibhistathā ।। 67 ।। dvijārcanaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā nārāyaṇārcanam । rājyānāṃ pālanaṃ caiva raṇe nirbhayatā tathā ।। 68 ।। nityaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam । putratulyaṃ prajānāṃ ca duḥkhināṃ paripālanam ।। 69 ।। śastrāstrāṇāṃ ca naipuṇyaṃ raṇe śauṇḍīryameva ca । tapaśca dharmakṛtyaṃ ca yatnataḥ kurute mudā ।। 70 ।। paṇḍitaṃ nītijñāstrajñaṃ nityaṃ ca paripālayet । niyojayetsabhāmadhye nityaṃ sadbhiśca saṃyute ।। 71 ।। hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ senāṅgaṃ ca catuṣṭayam । pālayedyatnato nityaṃ yaśasvī ca pratāpavān ।। 72 ।। raṇe nimantritaścaiva dāne na vimukho bhavet । raṇe vā yastyajetprāṇāṃstasya svargo yaśaskaraḥ ।। 73 ।। vaiśyānāmapi vāṇijyamīśvaraḥ kṛṣipālane । vipradevārcanaṃ dānaṃ tapasyā vratasevanam ।। 74 ।। viprāṇāmarcanaṃ nityaṃ śūdradharmo vidhīyate । tatkṛṣī taddhanagrāhī śūdraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet ।। 75 ।। gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ । śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni śūdo vipradhanāpahaḥ ।। 76 ।। yaḥ śūdro brāhmaṇīgāmī mātṛgāmī sa pātakī । kṛmbhīpāke pacyate sa yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śātam ।। 77 ।। kumbhīpāke taprataile bhuktaḥ sarpairaharniśam । śabdaṃ ca vikṛtākāraṃ kurute yamatāḍanāt ।। 78 ।। tataścāṇḍālayoniḥ syātsaptajanmasu pātakī । saptajanmasu sarpaśca jalaukāḥ saptajanmasu ।। 79 ।। janmakoṭisahatraṃ ca viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ । puṃścalīnāṃ yonikṛmiḥ sa bhavetsaptajanmasu ।। 80 ।। garvā vraṇakṛmiḥ syācca pātakī saptajanmasu । yonau yonau bhramatyevaṃ na punarjāyate naraḥ ।। 81 ।। saṃnyāsināṃ ca yo dharmo manmukhācca niśāmaya। daṇḍagrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet ।। 82 ।। pūrvakarmāṇi dagdhvā ca parakarmanikṛntanam । kurute cintayenmāṃ ca hyāyāti mama mandiram ।। 83 ।। saṃnyāsināṃ padasparśātsadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā । sadyaḥ punanti tīrthāni vaiṣṇavasya yathā vraja ।। 84 ।। saṃnyāsinaśca sparśena niṣpāpo jāyate naraḥ । saṃnyāsinaṃ bhojayitvā cāśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 85 ।। natvā ca kāmato dṛṣṭvā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet । phalaṃ saṃnyāsināṃ tunyaṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। 86 ।। saṃnyācī yāti sāyāhne kṣudhito gṛhiṇāṃ gṛham । sadannaṃ vā kadannaṃ vā taddattaṃ naiva varjayet ।। 87 ।। na yācate ca miṣṭānnaṃ na kuryātkopameva ca । na dhanagrahaṇaṃ kuryādekavāsā nirīhataḥ ।। 88 ।। śītagrīṣmasamānaśca lobhamohavivarjitaḥ । tatra sthitvaikarātraṃ ca prātaranyatsthalaṃ vrajet ।। 89 ।। yānamānohaṇaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā gṛhiṇo dhanam । gṛhaṃ kṛtvā gṛhī ramyātsvadharmātpatito bhavet ।। 90 ।। kṛtvā cakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ kuvṛttiṃ kurute ca yaḥ । sa saṃnyāsī hṛtācāraḥ svadharmātvatito bhavet ।। 91 ।। aśubhaṃ ca śubhaṃ vā'pi svakarma kurute yadi । bahiṣkṛtaḥ svadharmo vā'pyupahāsyaśca vai bhavet ।। 92 ।। brāhmaṇī patihīnā yā bhavenniṣkāminī sadā । ekabhuktā dinānte sā haviṣyānnaratā sadā ।। 93 ।। na dhatte divyavastraṃ ca gandhadravyaṃ sutailakam । srajaṃ ca candanaṃ caiva śaṅkhasindūrabhūṣaṇam ।। 94 ।। tyaktvā malinavastrā syānnityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smaret । nārāyaṇasya sevāṃ ca kurute nityameva ca ।। 95 ।। tannāmoccāraṇaṃ śaśvatkurute nānyabhaktitaḥ । putratulyaṃ ca puruṣaṃ sadā paśyati dharmataḥ ।। 96 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ na ca bhuṅkte sā na kuryādvibhavaṃ vraja । ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīdine ।। 97 ।। śrīrāmasya navamyāṃ tu śivarātrau pavitrayā । aghorāyāṃ ca pretāyāṃ candrasūryoparāgayoḥ ।। 98 ।। bhṛṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ parityajya bhujyate parameva ca । tāmbūlaṃ vidhavāstrīṇāṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāniṇām ।। 99 ।। saṃnyāsināṃ ca saumāṃsasurātulyaṃ śrutau śrutam । raktaśākaṃ masūraṃ ca jambīraṃ parṇameva ca ।। 100 ।। alāburvartulākārā varjanīyā ca tairavi । paryaṅkaśāyinī nārī vidhavā pātayetpatim ।। 101 ।। yānamārohaṇaṃ kṛtvā vidhavā narakaṃ vrajet । na kuryātkeśasaṃskāraṃ gātrasaṃskārameva ca ।। 102 ।। keśaveṇī jaṭārūpe tatkṣauraṃ tīrthakaṃ vinā । tailābhyaṅgaṃna kurvīta nahi paśyati darpaṇam ।। 103 ।। mukhaṃ ca parapuṃsāṃ ca yātrāṃ nṛtyaṃ mahotsavam । nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ caiva suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ śubham ।। 104 ।। śṛṇuyācca satāṃ dharma sāmavedanirūpitam । paramārtha paraṃ caiva nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 105 ।। adhyāpanamadhyānaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ paripālanam । guruṇāṃ sevanaṃ nityaṃ dvicadevārcanaṃ tathā ।। 106 ।। siddhāntaśāstranaipuṇyaṃ bhāvanaṃ svātmatoṣaṇam । vyākhyānaṃ pariśuddhaṃ ca granthābhyastaṃ ca saṃtatam ।। 107 ।। pyavasthāpariśuddhyartha vicāro vedasaṃmataḥ । śāstrārthācaraṇaṃ caiva katadhyaṃ svayameva ca ।। 108 ।। devāhnikeṣu naipuṇyaṃ vedācaraṇamīpsitam । vedoktabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva pavitrācaraṇaṃ sadā ।। 109 ।। pativratānāṃ yaṃ dharma taṃ nibodha vrajeśvara । nityaṃtu bhartaryautsukyāttatpādodakamīpsitam ।। 110 ।। bhaktibhāvena satataṃ bhoktavyaṃ tadanujñayā । vrataṃ tapasyāṃ devārcāṃ parityajya prayatnataḥ ।। 111 ।। kuryāccaraṇasevāṃ ca stavanaṃ paritoṣaṇam । tadājñārahitaṃ karma na kuyadviraitaḥ satī ।। 112 ।। nārāyaṇātparaṃ kāntaṃ dhyāyate satataṃ satī । parapuṃsāṃ mukhaṃ caiva suveṣapuruṣaṃ param ।। 113 ।। yātrāmahotsavaṃ nṛtyaṃ nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ vraja । parakrīḍāṃ ca satataṃ na hi paśyati suvratā ।। 114 ।। yadbhakṣyaṃ svāmino nityaṃ tadevamapi yoṣitām । nahi tyajettu tatsaṅgaṃ kṣaṇameva ca suvratā ।। 115 ।। uttare nottaraṃ dadyātsvāminaśya pativratā । na kopaṃ kurute śudvā tāḍitā cāpi kopataḥ ।। 116 ।। kṣudhitaṃ bhojayetkāntaṃ dadyātpānaṃ ca bhojanam । na bodhayettaṃ nidrāluṃ prareyennaiva karmasu ।। 117 । putrāṇāṃ ca śataguṇaṃ snehaṃ kuryātpatīṃ satī । patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ kulayoṣitaḥ ।। 118 ।। śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sudhātulyaṃ kāntaṃ paśyati sundarī । sasmitaṃ vadanaṃ kṛtvā bhaktibhāvena yatnataḥ ।। 119 ।। puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca satī strī ca samuddharet । patiḥ pativratānāṃ ca mucyate sarvapātakāt ।। 120 ।। nāsti teṣāṃ karmabhogaḥ satīnāṃ vratatejasā । tayā sārdhaṃ ca niṣkarmī modate harimandire ।। 121 ।। pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni satīpādeṣu tānyapi । tejaśca sarvadevānāṃ munīnāṃ ca satīṣu ca ।। 122 ।। tapasvināṃ tapaḥ sarvaṃ vratināṃ yatphalaṃ vraja । dāne phalaṃ yaddātaṇāṃ tatsarva tāsu saṃtatam ।। 123 ।। svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhurvidhātā jagatāmapi । surāḥ sarve ca munayo bhītāstābhyāṃ ca saṃtatam ।। 124 ।। satīnāṃ pādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā । pativratāṃ namaskṛtvā mucyate pātakānnaraḥ ।। 125 ।। trailokyaṃ bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣaṇenaiva pativratā । svatejasā samarthā sā mahāpuṇyavatī sadā ।। 126 ।। satīnāṃ ca patiḥ sādhuḥ putro niḥśaṃka eva ca । na hi tasya bhayaṃ kiṃciddevebhyaśca yamādapi ।। 127 ।। śatajanmapuṇyavatāṃ gehe jātā pativratā । pativratāprasūḥ pūtā jīvanmuktaḥ pitā tathā ।। 128 ।। satī strī prātarutthāya tyaktvā ca rātrivāsasam । bhartāraṃ ca namaskṛtya karoti stavanaṃ mudā ।। 129 ।। gṛhakāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snātvā dhaute ca vāsasī । gṛhītvā śuklapuṣpaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ pūjayetpatim ।। 130 ।। snāpayitvā supūtena jalena nirmalena ca । tasmai dattvā dhautavastraṃ tatpādau kṣālayenmudā ।। 131 ।। āsane vāsayitvā ca dattvā bhāle ca candanam । sarvāṅgalepanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā mālyaṃ gale'pi ca ।। 132 ।। sāmavedoktamantreṇa bhogadravyaiḥ sudhopamaiḥ । saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ kāntaṃ stutvā ca praṇamenmudā ।। 133 ।। oṃ namaḥ kāntāya śāntāya sarvadevāśrayāya svāhā । ityanenaiva mantreṇa dattvā puṣpaṃ ca candanam ।। 134 ।। pādyārdhyaṃ dhūpadīpau ca vastraṃ naivedyamuttamam । jalaṃ suvāsitaṃ śuddhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam ।। 135 ।। dattvā stotraṃ paṭhedyadyatkṛtaṃ vai pāṭhyameva ca । oṃ namaḥ kāntāya bhartre ca śiraścandrasvarūpiṇe ।। 136 ।। namaḥ śāntāya dāntāya sarvadevāśrayāya ca । namo brahmasvarūpāya satīprāṇaparāya ca ।। 137 ।। namasyāya ca pūjyāya hṛdādhārāya te namaḥ । pañcaprāṇādhidevāya cakṣuṣastārakāya ca ।। 138 ।। jñānādhārāya patnīnāṃ paramānandarūpiṇe । patirbrahmā patirviṣṇuḥ patireva maheśvaraḥ ।। 139 ।। patiśca nirguṇādhāro brahmarūpa namo'stu te । kṣamasva bhagavan doṣaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ ca yat ।। 140 ।। patnībandho dayāsindho dāsīdoṣaṃ kṣamasva me । idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sṛṣṭyādau padmayā kṛtam ।। 141 ।। sarasvatyā ca dharayā gaṅgayā ca purā vraja । sāvitryā ca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe cāpi nityaśaḥ ।। 142 ।। pārvatyā ca kṛtaṃ bhaktyā kailāse śaṃkarāya ca । munīnāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca patnībhiśca kṛtaṃ purā ।। 143 ।। pativratānāṃ sarvāsāṃ stotrametacchubhāvaham । idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yā śrṛṇoti pativratā ।। 144 ।। naro'nyo vā'pi nārī vā labhate sarvavāñchitam । aputro labhate putraṃ nirdhano labhate dhanam ।। 145 ।। raugī ca mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt । pativratā ca stutvā ca tīrthasnānaphalaṃ labhet ।। 146 ।। phalaṃ ca sarvaṃ tapasāṃ vratānāṃ ca vrajeśvara । idaṃ stutvā namaskṛtvā bhuṅkte sā tadanujñayā ।। uktaḥ pativratādharmo gṛhiṇāṃ śruyatāṃ vraja ।। 147 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... uttaṃ... nāradānā... bhagavannandasaṃ... tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 83 ।।
<4.84> atha caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrībhagavānuvāca dvijadevārcanaṃ caiva karoti satataṃ gṛhī । svadharmācaraṇaṃ caiva cāturvarṇyaṃ ca nityaṇaḥ ।। 1 ।। kurvanti gṛhiṇāmāśāṃ sarve devādayastathā । akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhasthaśca sadā'śuciḥ ।। 2 ।। pitaraḥ karmakāle cātithikāle ca devatāḥ । sarve gṛhasthamāyānti nipānamiva dhenavaḥ ।। 3 ।। samāyāti prayatnena sayāhne kṣudhito'tithiḥ । pūjāṃ labdhvā''śiṣaṃ kṛtvā prayāti gṛhiṇo gṛhāt ।। 4 ।। akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhī bhavati pātakī । trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 5 ।। atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinirvate । pitarastasya devāśca vahnayaśca tathaiva ca ।। 6 ।। nirāśāḥ pratigacchanti gṛhiṇo'tithayo gṛhāt । strīdhnairgoghnaiḥ kṛtaghnaiśca brāhmaṇairgurutalpagaiḥ ।। 7 ।। tulyadoṣo bhavatyeva yenātithiranarcitaḥ । svātmanaḥ pātakaṃ dattvā puṇyamādāya gacchati ।। 8 ।। tasmātkṛtvā sarvasevāṃ devādīṃśca śubhāśayaḥ । poṣyāṇāṃ bharaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścādbhuṅkte sa dharmavit ।। 9 ।। yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti bhāryā ca puṃścalī tathā । araṇyaṃ tena gantavyamaraṇyādduḥkhadaṃ gṛham ।। 10 ।। patīṃ dveṣṭi sadā duṣṭā viṣatunyaṃ ca paśyati । dadāti tasmai nā''hāraṃ bhartsanaṃ kurute sadā ।। 11 ।। pūjitaṃ munitulyaṃ ca sā ca pāpīyasī param । saṃtataṃ tṛṇavanmatvā nyakkāraṃ kurute sadā ।। 12 ।। durvākyāvahninā dagdho mṛtatulyaśca jīvati । yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ saṃprāpya duṣṭavaṃśajām ।। 13 ।। gṛhiṇīnāṃ sadācāraṃ śrūyatāṃ tacchru tau śrutam । gṛhiṇī patibhaktā ca devabrāhmaṇabūjitā ।। 14 ।। sā śuddhā prātarutthāya namaskṛtya patiṃ suram । prāṅgaṇe maṅgalaṃ dadyādgomayena jalena ca ।। 15 ।। gṛhakṛtyaṃ ca kṛtvā ca snātvā''gatya gṛhaṃ satī । suraṃ vipraṃ patiṃ natvā pūjayedgṛhadevatām ।। 16 ।। gṛhakṛtyaṃ sunirvṛtya bhojayitvā patiṃ satī । atithiṃ pūjayitvā ca svayaṃ bhuṅkate sukhaṃsatī ।। 17 ।। putraiśca pūjitastātaḥ śiṣyaiśca pūjito guruḥ । ājñayā kurute karma putraḥ śiṣyaśca bhṛtyavat ।। 18 ।। na prerayedguruṃ tātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyaśca karmasu । pitre ca gurave nityaṃ sarvasvaṃ ca samarpayet ।। 19 ।। na kuryānnarabuddhiṃ ca gurau pitari saṃtatam । kṛtvā ca narabuddhiṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labheddhruvam ।। 20 ।। mātaraṃ pūjayedbhaktyā pituścāpyadhikāṃ tathā । mātuḥ paraṃ guruṃ caiva pūjayedbhaktiyogataḥ ।। 21 ।। pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiṣyaḥ putraḥ sadā'kṣamaḥ । anāthā bhaginī kanyā nityaṃ poṣyā gurupriyā ।। 22 ।। evaṃ ca kathitaṃ tāta sarveṣāṃ dharmamuttamam । śtrījātirvāstapīśuddhā tāśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ ।। 23 ।। sarvā jātirekavidhā cā''dau sṛṣṭā ca brahmaṇā । tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pavitrāḥ paṇḍitādhikāḥ ।। 24 ।। kedārakanyāśāpena sa hi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ । tadā kopena dhātrā ca kṛtyā strī ca vinirmitā ।। 25 ।। kṛtyā strī trividhā jātirbrahmaṇā nirmitā purā । uttamā prathamā sā ca madhyamā cādhamā vraja ।। 26 ।। uttamā patibhaktā sā kiṃciddharmasamanvitā । prāṇānte'pi na kurute taṃ jāramayaśakaram ।। 27 ।। pūjayetsā yathā kāntaṃ tathā devadvijātithīn । vratāni copavāsāṃśca kurute sarvapūjanam ।। 28 ।। guruṇā rakṣitā yatnājjāraṃ ca na bhajedbhayāt । sa kṛtrimā madhyamā ca yathākiṃcitpatiṃ bhajet ।। 29 ।। sthānaṃ nāstikṣaṇaṃ nāsti nāsti prārthayitā naraḥ । tena he nanda tāsāṃ ca satītvamupajāyate ।। 30 ।। adhamā paramā duṣṭā'tyantāsadvaṃśajā tathā । adharmaśīlā duḥśīlā durmukhā kalahānvitā ।। 31 ।। patiṃ bhartsayate nityaṃ jāraṃ ca sevate sadā । duḥśaṃ dadāti kāntāya viṣatulyaṃ ca paśyati ।। 32 ।। jāradvāramupāyena hanti kāntaṃ manoharam । dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca mahītale ।। 33 ।। kāmadevasamaṃ cāpi jāraṃ paśyati kāmataḥ । śubhadṛṣṭyā kaṭākṣeṇa śaravatpāpīyasī mudā ।। 34 ।। suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ draṣṭvā yuvānaṃ ratiśūkaram । yoniḥ klidyati nārīṇāṃ kāminīnāṃ nirantaram ।। 35 ।। dadāti bhartre nā''hāraṃ viṣoktiṃ vakti saṃtatam । adharmaṃ cintayecchaśvajjāraṃ ca paramaṃ mudā ।। 36 ।। gurubhirbhartsitā sā ca rakṣitā ca śatena ca । tathā'pi jāraṃ kurute nāpi sādhyā nṛperapi ।। 37 ।। nāsti tasyāḥ priyaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ kāryavaśena ca । gāvastṛṇamivāraṇye prārthayantī navaṃ navam ।। 38 ।। vidyudābhā jale rekhā tasyā prītistathaiva ca । adharmayuktā satataṃ kapaṭaṃ vakti niścitam ।। 39 ।। vrate tapasi dharme ca na mano gṛhakarmaṇi । na gurau na ca deveṣu jāre snigdhaṃ ca cañcalam ।। 40 ।। strījātitrividhānāṃ ca kathā ca kathitā mayā । bhaktānāṃ trividhānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ śrūyatāmiti ।। 41 ।। tṛṇaśayyārato bhakto mannāmaguṇakīrtiṣu । mano niveśayettyaktvā saṃsārasukhakāraṇam ।। 42 ।। vyāyate matpadābjaṃ ca pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ । ahaitukīṃ tasya devāḥ saṃkalparahitasya ca ।। 43 ।। sarvasiddhiṃna vāñchanti te'ṇimādikamīpsitam । brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā suratvaṃ sukhakāraṇam ।। 44 ।। dāsyaṃ vinā nahīcchanti sālokyādicatuṣṭayam । naiva nirvāṇamuktiṃ ca sudhāpānamabhīpsitam ।। 45 ।। vāñchanti niścilāṃ bhaktiṃ madīyāmatulāmapi । strīpuṃvibhedo nāstyeva sarvajīveṣu bhinnatā ।। 46 ।। teṣāṃ siddheśvarāṇāṃ ca pravarāṇāṃ vrajeśvara । kṣutpipāsādikaṃ nidrālobhamohādikaṃ ripum ।। 47 ।। tpaktvā divāniśaṃ māṃ ca dhyāyante ca digambarāḥ । samadbhaktottamo nanda śrūyatāṃ madhyamādikam ।। 48 ।। nā''saktaḥ karmasu gṛhī pūrvaprāktanataḥ śuciḥ । karoti satataṃ caiva pūrvakarmanikṛntanam ।। 49 ।। na karotyaparaṃ vatnātsaṃkalparahitaḥ sa ca । sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya yatkiṃcinnāhaṃ kartā ca karmaṇaḥ ।। 50 ।। karmaṇā manasā vācā satataṃ cintayediti । nyūnabhaktaśca tannyūnaḥ sa ca prākṛtikaḥ śrutau ।। 51 ।। yamaṃ vā yamadūtaṃ vā svapne'pi na ca paśyati । puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūrvabhaktaḥ suddharet ।। 52 ।। puṃsāṃ śataṃ madhyamaśca taccaturthaṃ ca prākṛtaḥ । bhaktaśca trividhastāta kathitaśca tavā''jñayā ।। 53 ।। brahmāṇḍaracanākhyānaṃ śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ । brahmāṇḍaracanārthaṃ ca bhaktā jānanti yatnataḥ ।। 54 ।। munayaśca surāḥ santaḥ kiṃcijjānanti duḥkhataḥ । jānāmi viśvaṃ sarvārtha brahmā''nanto ।। maheśvaraḥ ।। 55 ।। dharmaḥ sanatkumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī । kapilaśca gaṇeśaśca durgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।। 56 ।। vedāśca vedamātā ca sarvajñā rādhikā svayam । ete jānanti viśvārtha nānyo jānāti kaścana ।। 57 ।। vaiṣamyārtha ca sudhiyaḥ sarve vijñātumakṣamāḥ । nityākāśo yathā''tmā ca tathā nityā diśo daśa ।। 58 ।। yathā nityā ca prakṛtistathaiva viśvagolakaḥ । golokaśca yathā nityastathā vaikuṇṭha eva ca ।। 59 ।। ekadā mayi goloke rāse nityaṃ prakurvati । āvirbhūtā ca vāmāṅgādbālā ṣoḍhaśavārṣikī ।। 60 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhā śaraccandrasamaprabhā । atīva sundarī rāmā ramaṇīnāṃ parāvarā ।। 61 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā kaumalāṅgī manoharā । vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। 62 ।। yathā jaladapaṅktiśca balākābhirtibhūṣitā । sindūrabindūnā cārucandracandanabindubhiḥ ।। 63 ।। kastūrībindubhiḥ sārdhaṃ sīmantāndhaḥsyalojjvalā । amūlyaratnanirmāṇasusnigdhakiraṇojjvalā ।। 64 ।। vicitraiśca sucitraiśca sukapolasthalojjvalā । khamendracañcuvijitanāsāmauktikaśobhitā ।। 66 ।। gajendragaṇḍanirmuktamuktābhūṣaṇabhūṣitā । śuktyā vimuktamuktābhadantapaṅktimanoharā ।। 67 ।। valitākalitā'tīva pakvabimbādharā varā । śaśvatpūrṇendunindāsyā padmaninditalocanā ।। 68 ।। kṛṣṇasāranibhodbhinnasucārukajjalojjvalā । amūlyaratnanirmāṇakeyūrakaṅkaṇojjvalā ।। 69 ।। maṇīndrarājarājībhiḥ śaṅkhayugmakarojjavalā । ratnāṅgulīyakairebhiramṛtāṅgulibhūṣitā ।। 70 ।। ratnendrarājarājena kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitā । ratnapāśakarājībhiḥ pādāṅgulivirājitā ।। 71 ।। sundarālaktarāgeṇa caraṇādhaḥsthalojjvalā । gajendragāminī rāmā kāminī vāmalocanā ।। 72 ।। māṃ dadarśa kaṭākṣeṇa ramaṇī ramaṇotsukā । rāse saṃbhūya rāmā sā dadhāra purato mama ।। 73 ।। tena rādhā samākhyātā burāvidbhiḥ prapūjitā । prahṛṣṭā prakṛtiścāsyāstena prakṛtirīśvarī ।। 74 ।। śaktā syātsarvakāryeṣu tena śaktiḥ prakīrtitā । sarvādhārā sarvarūpā maṅgalārhā ca sarvataḥ ।। 75 ।। sarvamaṅgaladakṣā sā tena syātsarvamaṅgalā । vaikuṇṭhe sā mahālakṣmīrmūrtibhede sarasvatī ।। 76 ।। prasūya vedānviditā vedamātā ca sā sadā । sāvitrī sa ca gāyatrī dhātrī trijagatāmapi ।। 77 ।। purā saṃhṛtya durgaṃ ca sā durgā ca prakīrtitā । tejasaḥ sarvadevānāmāvirbhūtā purā satī ।। 78 ।। tenā''dyā prakṛtirjñeyā sarvāsuravimarditī । sarvānandā ca sānandā duḥkhadāridrayanāśinī ।। 79 ।। śatruṇāṃ bhayadātrau ca bhaktānāṃ bhayahāriṇau । dakṣakanyā satī kā ca śailajāteti pārvatī ।। 80 ।। sarvādhārasvarūpā sā kalayā sā vasuṃdharā । kalayā tulasī gaṅgā kalayā sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। 81 ।। sṛṣṭiṃ karomi ca yayā tāta śaktyā punaḥ punaḥ । dṛṣṭvā tāṃ rāsamadhyasthāṃ mama krīḍā ।। tayā saha ।। 82 ।। babhūva suciraṃ tāta yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam । atyadbhutaṃ kautukaṃ ca mahāśrṛṅgāramīpsitam ।। 83 ।। tayordvayordharmarāśiḥ susrāva rāsamaṇḍale । tasmānmanoharaṃ jajñe nāmanākārasarovaram ।। 84 ।। papāta dharmadhārā'dho vegena viśvagolake । babhūva jalabūrṇaṃ ca brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca golakam ।। 85 ।। jalapūrṇa purā sarva śṛṣṭiśūnyaṃ vrajeśvara । śruṅgārānte ca tasyāṃ ca vīryādhānaṃ mayā kṛtam ।। 86 ।। dadhāra garbha sā rādhā yāvadvai brahmaṇāḥ śatam । susrāva sā tadante ca ḍimbhaṃ ca paramādbhutam ।। 87 ।। cukopa devī taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda viṣasāda sā । pādena prerayāmāsa tamadho viśvagolake ।। 88 ।। sa papāta jale tāta sarvādhāro mahānvirāṭ । dṛṣṭvā'patyaṃ jalasthaṃ ca mayā śaptā ca sā purā ।। 89 ।। anapatyā ca sā rāthā macchāpena purā vibho । tena prasūtāḥ kramato durgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī ।। 90 ।। catasraḥ paribūrṇāstāḥ prasūtāśca suniścitam । devyo'nyāścāpi kāminyastāḥ prasūtā vrajeśvara ।। 91 ।। kalayā prabhavo yāsāṃ kalāṃśāṃśena vā vraja । jajñe mahānvirāḍyena ḍimbhena kalayā''śrayaḥ ।। 92 ।। amṛtāṅguṣṭhapīyūṣaṃ mayā dattaṃ papau ca saḥ । jale sthāvararūpaśca śete ca nijakarmaṇaḥ ।। 93 ।। upadhānaṃ jalaṃ talpaṃ tasya yogabalena ca । tasya lomnāṃ ca kūpāni jalapūrṇāni saṃtatam ।। 94 ।। pratyekaṃ kramatasteṣu śete kṣudravirāṭ punaḥ । sahasrapatraṃ kamalaṃ jajñe kṣudrasya nābhitaḥ ।। 95 ।। tatra jajñe varo brahmā tenāyaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ । tatrā''virbhūya sa vidhiścintāgrasto babhūva saḥ ।। 96 ।। kasmāddehaḥkvā mātā me pitā vā kva ca bāndhavaḥ । divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣañca babhrāma kamalāntare ।। 97 ।। tato divyaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ sasmāra tapasā ca mām । tadā mayā dattamantraṃ jajāpa kamalāntare ।। 98 ।। divyavarṣasaptalakṣaṃ niyataṃ saṃyataḥ śuciḥ । tadā matto varaṃ labdhvā sraṣṭā sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 99 ।। māyayā prati brahmāṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ । dikpālā dvādaśādityā rudrāścaikādaśāpi ca ।। 100 ।। navagrahāṣṭau vasavo devāḥ koṭitrayaṃ tathā । brāhmaṇākṣatraviṭśūdrā yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ ।। 101 ।। bhūtādayo rāṅasāścāpyevaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram । viśve viśve vinirmāṇāḥ svargāḥ sapta krameṇa ca ।। 102 ।। saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā । kāñcanībhūmisaṃyuktā tamoyuktaṃ sthalaṃ tathā ।। 103 ।। pātālāśca tathā sapta brahmāṇḍamebhireva ca । viśve viśve candrasūyo puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam ।। 104 ।। tīrthānyetāni sarvatra gaṅgādīti vrajeśvara । yāvanti lomakūpāni mahāviṣṇoḥ krameṇa ca ।। 105 ।। viśvānyeva hī tāvanti hyamaṃkhyātāni ca dhruvam । viśveṣāsūrdhvābhāme ca vaikuṇṭhaśca nirāśrayaḥ ।। 106 ।। madicchayā vinirmāṇā vedāḥ kathitumakṣamāḥ । kuyogināma dṛṣṭaścāmabhaktānāṃ viniścitam ।। 107 ।। tasmādupari golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanaḥ । vāyunā dhāryamāṇaśca vicitraḥ paramāśramaḥ ।। 108 ।। atīva ramyanirmāṇo nityarūpo madicchayā । śataśrṛṅgeṇa śailena puṇyavṛndāvanena ca ।। 109 ।। surāsamaṇḍalenāpi nadyā virajayā yutaḥ । koṭiyojanavistīrṇā prasthena virajā vraja ।। 110 ।। dairdhyaṃ tasyāḥ śataguṇaṃ paritaḥ paramā śubhā । amūlyaratnanikarairhīramāṇikyayostathā ।। 111 ।। maṇīnāṃ kaustubhādīnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ manoharā । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ tatrāvi pratimandiram ।। 112 ।। manoharaṃ ca prākāramadṛṣṭaṃ viśvakarmaṇā । gopībhirgopanikarairvaiṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ ।। 113 ।। kalpavṛkṣaiḥ pārijātairasaṃkhyaiśca sarovaraiḥ । puṣpodyānaiḥkoṭibhiśca saṃvṛtaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 114 ।। veṣṭitaṃ veṣṭitairgopairmandiraiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ । ratnapradīpayuktaiśca puṣpatalpasamanvitaiḥ ।। 115 ।। sugandhicandanāmodaiḥ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitaiḥ । krīḍopayuktairbhogeśca tāmbūlairvāsitairjalaiḥ ।। 116 ।। dhūpaiḥ surabhiramyaiśca mālyaiśca ratnadarpaṇaiḥ । rakṣakai rakṣitaṃ śaśvadrādhādāsītrikoṭibhiḥ ।। 117 ।। amūlyaratnābharaṇairvahniśuddhāṃśukairapi । lakṣaṇattagajendrāṇāṃ veṣṭitaṃ ca balaiḥ kramāt ।। 118 ।। navayauvanasaṃpannai rūpairnirupamairapi । ramyaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ candrabimbaṃ yathā vraja ।। 119 ।। amūlyaratnaracitaṃ daśayojanavistṛtam । kastūrīkuṅkumai rabhyaiḥ sugandhicandanārcitam ।। 120 ।। āvṛtaṃ maṅgalaghaṭaiḥ phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ । dadhilājaiśca parṇaiśca snigdhadūrvāṅkuraiḥ phalaiḥ ।। 121 ।। śrīrāmakadalīstambhairasaṃkhyaiśca manoharaiḥ । paṭṭasūtranibaddhaiśca snigdhaiścandanapallavaiḥ ।। 122 ।। candanāsaktamālyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitam । amūlyaratnaracitaṃ śataśṛṅgamanoharam ।। 123 ।। koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca dairdhyaṃ śataguṇottaram । śailaprasthaparimitaṃ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam ।। 124 ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ya vedānirvacanīyakam । prākāramiva tasyāpi golalokasya manoharam ।। 125 ।। parito veṣṭitaṃ ramyaṃ hīrahārasamanvitam । tatra vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ yuktaṃ candanapādapaiḥ ।। 126 ।। kalpavṛkṣaiśca namyaiśca mandāraiḥ kāmadhenubhiḥ । śobhitaṃ śobhanāḍhyaiśca puṣpodyānairmanoharaiḥ ।। 127 ।। krīḍāsarovarai ramyaiḥ suramyai ratimandiraiḥ । atīva ramyaṃ rahasi rāsayogyasthalānvitam ।। 128 ।। rakṣitaṃ rakṣakai ramyairasaṃkhyairgopikāgaṇaiḥ । parito vartulākāraṃ trilakṣayojanaṃ vanam ।। 129 ।। ṣaṭpadadhvanisaṃyuktaṃ puṃskokilarutānvitam । tatrākṣayo vaṭo ramyo rahasye bahṛvistṛtaḥ ।। 130 ।। sahasrayojanordhvaśca paritaśca caturguṇaḥ । gopīnāṃ kalpavṛkṣaśca sarvavāñchāphalapradaḥ ।। 131 ।। krīḍānvitairāvṛtaśca rādhādāsītrilakṣakaiḥ । virajātīranirāṇāṃ vāyunā śītalena ca ।। 132 ।। puṣpānvitena mandena pavitraśca sugandhinā । dāsīgaṇairasaṃkhyaiśca vṛndāvanavinodinī ।। 133 ।। tatra krīḍati rādhā sā mama prāṇādhidevatā । seyaṃ śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā ।। 134 ।। brahmādidevaiḥ siddhendrairmunīndraiḥ pūjitā vraja । siddhairguṇairbalairbuddhyā jñānayogaiśca vidyayā ।। 135 ।। tāta sarvaprakāreṇa vandyā satsadṛśī priyā । ityevaṃ kathitaṃ nanda brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca varṇanam ।। yathocitaṃ parimitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 136 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā...bhagavannandasaṃ... caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 84 ।।
<4.85> atha pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca sāṃpratam । vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi ।। 1 ।। kathayasva mahābhāga kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam । tvatto'nyaṃ kaṃ ca pṛcchāmi nitāntaṃ santamīśvaram ।। 2 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ caturṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ ca yathocitam । vedoktaṃ śrūyatā tāta sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। 3 ।। ayaḥpātre payaḥpānaṃ gavyaṃ siddhānnameva ca । bhṛṣṭādikaṃ padhu guḍaṃ nālikerodakaṃ tathā ।। 4 ।। phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca yatkiṃcidabhakṣayaṃ manurabravīt । dagdhānnaṃ taptasauvīramabhakṣyaṃ vrahmanirmitam ।। 5 ।। nālikerodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmrapātre sthitaṃ madhu । gavyaṃ ca tāmrapātrasthaṃ sarvaṃ madyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vinā ।। 6 ।। tāmrapātre payaḥpānamucchiṣṭe ghṛtabhojanam । dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ caiva sadyo gomāṃsabhakṣaṇam ।। 7 ।। abhakṣyaṃ madhumikṣaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ guḍaṃ tathā । ārdrakaṃ guḍasaṃyuktamabhakṣyaṃ śrutisaṃmatam ।। 8 ।। pītaśeṣajalaṃ caiva māghe ca mūlakaṃ tathā । japādikaṃ ca śayane sadā prājñaḥ parityajet ।। 9 ।। dvirbhojanaṃ ca divase saṃdhyayohbhojanaṃ tathā । bhakṣyaṃ ca rātriśeṣe ca dhruvaṃ prājñaḥ parityajet ।। 10 ।। pānīyaṃ pāyasaṃ cūrṇaṃ ghutaṃ lavaṇameva ca । svastikaṃ guḍakaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ takraṃ tathā madhu ।। 11 ।। hastāddhastagṛhītaṃ ca sadyo gomāṃsameva ca । karpūraṃ raupyapātrasthamabhakṣyaṃ śrutisaṃmatam ।। 12 ।। pariveṣaṇakārī cedbhoktāraṃ spṛśate yadi । mabhakṣyaṃ ca tadannaṃ ca sarveṣāmeva saṃmatam ।। 13 ।। nakulānāṃ gaṇḍakānāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇām । sarpāṇāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 14 ।। marjārāṇāṃ sṛgālānāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ vrajeśvara । vyāghrāṇāmapi siṃhānāṃ tyājyaṃ māṃsaṃ nṛṇāṃ sadā ।। 15 ।। jalaukasāṃ ca nakrāṇāṃ gedhikānāṃ tathaiva ca । maṇḍūkānāṃ karkaṭānāṃ cuñcukānāṃ ca niścitam ।। 16 ।। gavāṃ ca camarīṇāṃ ca na kalau māṃsabhakṣaṇam । hastināṃ ghoṭakānāṃ ca nṛṇāmeva ca rakṣasām ।। 17 ।। daṃśaśca maśakaścaiva makṣikā ca pipīnikā । anyedhāṃ ca niṣiddhānāṃ loke vede vrajeśvara ।। 18 ।। vānarāṇāṃ bhallukānāṃ śarabhāṇāṃ tathaiva ca । niṣiddhaṃ mṛganābhīnāṃ gardabhānāṃ ca māṃsakam ।। 19 ।। abhakṣyaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ ca dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā । svastikaṃ ca tathā tatra viprāṇāṃ navanītakam ।। 20 ।। māṃsamucchaiḥśravasakaṃ tasya dugdhādikaṃ tathā । varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ cāpyabhakṣyaṃ ca śrutau śrutam ।। 21 ।। abhakṣyamārdrakaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ ca raverdine । paryuṣitaṃ calaṃ cānnaṃ viprāṇāṃ dugdhameva ca ।। 22 ।। varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ cāpyavīrānnasya bhakṣaṇam । tadannaṃ ca surātulyaṃ gomāṃsādhikameva ca ।। 23 ।। avīrānnaṃ ca yobhuṅkte brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ । pitṛdevārcanaṃ tasya niṣphalaṃ manurabravīt ।। 24 ।। brahmāṇānāṃ va2ṣṇavānāmabhakṣyaṃ matsyameva ca । itareṣāmabhakṣyaṃ ca pañcaparvasu niścitam ।। 25 ।। pitṛdevāvaśeṣe ca bhakṣyaṃ māṃsaṃ na dūthitam । pañcaparvasu tyājyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ manurabravīt ।। 26 ।। asaṃskṛtaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ tailaṃ cābhakṣyameva ca । bhakṣyaṃ pavitraṃ sarveṣāṃ vyañjanaṃ vahnisaṃskṛtam ।। 27 ।। ekahaste ghṛtaṃ toyamabhakṣyaṃ sarvamaṃmatam । āvilaṃ kṛmiyuktaṃ ca pariśuddhaṃ ca nirmalam ।। 28 ।। abhakṣyaṃ brahmāṇānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ । anivedyaṃ harereva yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। 29 ।। pipīlikāmiśritaṃ ca madhu gavyaṃ guḍaṃ tathā । yatkiṃcidvastu vā tāta na bhakṣyaṃ ca śrutau śrutam ।। 30 ।। pakṣibhakṣyaṃ kīṭabhakṣyaṃ śṛddhaṃ pakvaphalaṃ tathā । kākabhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dravyameva ca ।। 31 ।। ghṛtapakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ śūdrasaṃskṛtam । abhakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śūdrabhakṣyaṃ ca pīṭhakam ।। 32 ।। sarveṣāmaśucīnāṃ ca jalamannaṃ parityajet । āśaucāntātparadine śuddhameva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 33 ।। vipākaṃ karmaṇāmeva duṣkaraṃ śrutisaṃmatam । bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca kathitaṃ yathājñānaṃ vraceśvara ।। 34 ।। kramāccaturṣu vedeṣu cauktaṃ matacatuṣṭayam । sarveṣāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca kathayāmi pitaḥ śṛṇu ।। 35 ।। nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi । avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ।। 36 ।। tīrthānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca sahāyena nṛṇāmapi । kiṃcidbhavati sāhāyyaṃ kāyavyūhena sarvataḥ ।। 37 ।। prāyaścitāni cīrṇāni niścitamamatparāṅamukham । na niṣpunanti he tāta surākumbhamivā''pagāḥ ।। 38 ।। prāyaścittena puṇyena na hi śudhyanti mānavā । sarvārambheṇa vaiśyendra dānena yogato'pi vā ।। 39 ।। śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma vinā bhogānna ca kṣayaḥ । bhogena śuddhimāpnoti tato muktirbhavennṛṇām ।। 40 ।। na naṣṭaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ karma sukṛtena ca karmaṇā । na naṣṭaṃ sukṛtaṃ karma kṛtena duṣkṛtena ca ।। 41 ।। yajñena tapasā vā'pi vratenānaśanena ca । tīrthasnānena dānena japena niyamena ca ।। 42 ।। bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇenaiva purāṇaśravaṇena ca । upadeṇena puṇyena pūjayā gurudevayoḥ ।। 43 ।। svadharmācaraṇenaivātithīnāṃ pūjanena ca । brahmaṇāṃ pūjanenaiva bhojanena viśeṣataḥ ।। 44 ।। yaddhattamapi viprāya tatprāptaṃ pūrṇarūpataḥ । bījarūpaṃ ca taddānaṃ kṣetrarūpaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ 45> ekena karmaṇā tāta svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ । karmaṇā na hi mokṣaṃ ca tadeva mama sevayā ।। 46 ।। svargaṃ ca sukṛtenaiva narakaṃ duṣkṛtena ca । vyādhirjanma ca yonau ca kutsite ca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 47 ।। goghno yo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmataścopapātakī । dandaśūkatvamāpnoti golomasamavarṣakam ।। 48 ।। sarpeṇa bhakṣitastena cvālayā garalasya ca । tṛṣito vyathitaścaiva nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ ।। 49 ।। tataḥ kuṇḍātsamutthāya gaurbhavellomavarṣakam । tataḥ kuṣṭhī ca cāṇḍālo varṣalakṣaṃtato naraḥ ।। 50 ।। tadā bhavedbrāhmaṇaśca kuṣṭhayukto hi karmaṇā । bhojayitvā vipralakṣaṃ nirvyādhiśca bhavecchuciḥ ।। 51 ।। akāmatastadardhaṃ ca kṣatriyasyāpi kāmataḥ । akāmatastadardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca viśastathā ।। 52 ।। tadardha śūdragoghnaśca bhuṅkte pāpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ । prāyaścittena śuddhaśca bhuṅkte śeṣaṃ ca karmaṇaḥ ।। 53 ।। anukalpe caturthaṃ ca pāpaṃ bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ । caturguṇaṃ ca goghnānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pātakam ।। 54 ।। bhuṅkte pāpaṃ ca brahmanno brāhmaṇāścetaro'pi vā । krameṇānena bodhyaṃ ca kāmato'kāmato'pi vā ।। 55 ।। prāyaścittaṃ janma karma vyādhireva pa saṃśayaḥ । goghno bhavati gauścāpi yāvadvarṣa ca niścitam ।। 56 ।। caturguṇaṃ ca teṣāṃ ca brahmaghno viṭkṛmirbhavet । tato bhavati mlecchaśca tāvadvarṣacaturguṇam ।। 57 ।। tataścāndho bhavedvipraḥ pūrveṣāṃ ca caturguṇam । brahmaṇānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ bhojayitvā śucirbhavet ।। 58 ।। cakṣuṣmāṃśca yaśasvī ca bhavetso'pyatipātakāt । strīghnacaturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ vede so'pyatipātakī ।। 59 ।। kālasūtraṃ ca prāpnoti strīlomasamavarṣakam । bhakṣitaḥ kṛmiṇā tatra nirāhāro vyathāyutaḥ ।। 60 ।। tato bhavati loke ca tāvadvarṣa ca pātakī । tataḥ pāpī bhavetso'pi yakṣmagrastaśca karmaṇā ।। 61 ।। varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva vipralakṣaṃ ca bhojayet । tataḥ śuddho brāhmaṇaśca vidvāṃstapasi saṃyataḥ ।। 62 ।। kiṃcidbhuṅakte pāpaśeṣaṃ svarṇadānācchucirbhavet । garbhaghnaśca mahāpāpī saṃprāpnoti śunīmukham ।। 63 ।। varṣāṇāṃ satakaṃ caiva ghoṭakaśca bhaveddhruvam । varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva sūkṣmaśastreṇa pīḍītaḥ ।। 64 ।। tataḥ pāpī bhavedvaiśyo dravyayukto hi kamaṃṇā । pañcāśadvarṣaparyantaṃ svarṇadānādbhavecchuciḥ ।। 65 ।। tataḥ svakulajāto'pi nirvyādhirbrāhmaṇaḥśuciḥ । brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaghnaśca kṣatriyo vā vinā raṇāt ।। 66 ।। taptaśūlaṃ ca prāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam । kvathitaṃ taptalohena cā''rtanādaṃ karoti ca ।। 67 ।। tato bhavenmattagajo varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā । tato raktavikārī ca śūdro varṣaśataṃ tathā ।। 68 ।। gajadānena muktaśca vyādhitaśca tato dvijaḥ । vaiśyaghnaścāpi vaiśyaśca śūdraghno vaiśya eva ca ।। 69 ।। vaiśyaghnaścāpi śūdraśca samaṃ pāpaṃ labheddhruvam । kṛmikuṇḍaṃ ca prāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā ।। 70 ।। kṛmibhirbhakṣito duḥśī kirātaśca bhavettataḥ । varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva kṛmivyādhisamanvitaḥ ।। 71 ।। tato mandāgniyuktaśca brāhmaṇo dainyavānvraja । pañcāśadvarṣaparyantaṃ durbalaśca kṛśodaraḥ ।। 72 ।। muktirbhavati yuktena tīrthecāśvapradānataḥ । śūdraghno brahmaṇaścaiva kāmato'kāmato'pi vā ।। 73 ।। sāvitrī lakṣayāpyena tadardhena śucirbhavet । caturvarṇaḥ kukkuraghno hyabhiśaptaśca śaṃbhunā ।। 74 ।। varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva prāpnoti rauravaṃ naraḥ । tato bhavetkukkulaśca varṣāṇāmapi ṣoḍaśa ।। 75 ।। tataḥ śuddho bhavedvipro bhakṣitaḥ kukkureṇai ca । gaṅgāsnānena dānena svarṇasyāpi bhavecchuciḥ ।। 76 ।। mārjāraghnaścaturvarṇo gaṅgāsnānādbhavecchuciḥ । viprāya lavaṇaṃ dattvā ṣaṭpalaṃ ca pramucyate ।। 77 ।। hatvā sarpāṃścaturvarṇo mama pādena cihnitān । brahmahatyācaturthaṃ ca pātakaṃ ca labheddhruvam ।। 78 ।। asipatraṃ ca narakaṃ varṣāṃṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā । prāpnoti yātanāyukto vicchinnastīkṣṇadhārayā ।। 79 ।। tato bhavati sarpaśca ḍuṇḍubho varṣapañcakam । nareṇa tāḍito duḥkhī mṛtyorbhavati pīḍitaḥ ।। 80 ।। tato bhavennaraḥ pāpī jvarayukto hi durbalaḥ । varṣāṇāṃ pañcakenaiva mṛto bhavati karmaṇā ।। 81 ।। aśvaghnaśca gajaghnaśca caturvarṇaśca pātakī । varṣāṇāṃ pañcakenaiva mṛto bhavati karmaṇā ।। 82 ।। tato bhavati hastī ca ghoṭako vā vrajeśvara । yāvadviṃśativarṣāṇi tataḥ śūdro bhaveddhruvam ।। 83 ।। ahaṃkṛtī vyādhiyukto raupyadānena mucyate । brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śatakaṃ bhojayitvā śucirbhavet ।। 84 ।। kṣudrajantuvadhenaiva kṣudrajanturbhavennaraḥ । varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva kṣudravyādhiṃ tarettataḥ ।। 85 ।। kṛpā kāryā satā śaśvatahiṃsreṣu ca jantuṣu । hiṃsāyāṃ na hi doṣaśca hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca vrajeśvara ।। 86 ।। aśvatthaghnaścatuvaṃrṇo brahmahatyācaturthakam । pāpaṃ ca labhate tāta cāsipatraṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 87 ।। sa tīkṣṇenāpi śastreṇa vicchinnaśca divāniśam । varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva bhuṅkte paramayātanām ।। 88 ।। tato bhavati vṛkṣaśca śālamalirahvarṣalakṣakam । tato bhavati śūdraśca cchinnāṅgo vyādhisaṃyutaḥ ।। 89 ।। yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ tato vipro bhaveddhruvam । vraṇavyādhisamāyukto mucyate svarṇadānataḥ ।। 90 ।। mithyāsākṣyapradātā ca kṛtaghno'tikṛtaghnakaḥ । viśvāsaghātī mitraghno viprāṇāṃ dhanahārakaḥ ।। 91 ।। śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakaḥ । śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca vṛṣavāhakapātakī ।। 92 ।। dhāvako devalaścāpi caite'tipāpinastathā । kumbhīpākaṃ prayāntayeva varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। 93 ।। tatraiva taptatailena saṃtaptaśca divāniśam । ṇakṣito vyathitaścaiva sarvākāreṇa jantunā ।। 94 ।। gṛdhraḥ koṭisamasrāṇi śatajanmāni śūkaraḥ । śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni śūdro rogī bhavettataḥ ।। 95 ।। mandāgnijvarasaṃyuktaḥ pañcāśadvarṣakaṃ tathā । suvarṇānāṃ śatapalaṃ dattavā śuddho bhaveddhruvam ।। 96 ।। caturvarṇo vastrahārī gavyahārī ca mānavaḥ । raupyamuktāpahārī ca śūdradravyāpahārakaḥ ।। 97 ।। varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca bakajātirbhaveddhruvam । mutrakuṇḍaṃ ca vai bhuktvā varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā ।। 98 ।। tato bhavecchūdrajātirvarṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ vraja । kuṣṭhavyādhisamāyukto galitaścaiva pātakī ।। 99 ।। tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaśca kuṣṭhāvaśeṣasaṃyutaḥ । svarṇaṣaṭpaladānena vyādhito mucyate śuciḥ ।। 100 ।। śākāpahārakaścaiva phalāpahārakastathā । yakṣaḥ pṛthivyāṃ saṃbhūto līlādravyāpahārakaḥ ।। 101 ।। varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva cāṣapakṣī bhaveddhruvam । tato bhavetkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ śūdraśca bhārate bhuvi ।। 102 ।। tato bhavedbrāhmaṇaścāpyadhikāṅgo'pi janmani । punarjanmadvijo bhūtvā sucyate viprabhojanāt ।। 103 ।। pakvadravyāpahārī ca paśuyonirbhavedradhruvam । yasyāṇḍakośo gandhāktaḥ kastūrī yasya nāma ca ।। 104 ।। saptajanmamṛgo bhūtvā tato bhavati gandhakaḥ । janmaikaṃ ca tataḥ śūdro galatkuṣṭhī ca janmani ।। 105 ।। tato rogāvaśeṣeṇa saṃyuto brahmaṇaḥ kṛśaḥ । svarṇaṣaṭpaladānena mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 106 ।। dhānyāpahārī duḥkhī ca kṛpaṇaḥ saptajanmasu । viṣṭhākuṇḍaṃ varṣaśataṃ saṃprāpya mucyate bhiyā ।। 107 ।। svarṇāpahārī kuṣṭhī ca mānava patito bhavet । svarṇadānapratigrāhī viṭkuṇḍaṃ ca prayāti ya ।। 108 ।। tato varṣaśataṃ bhuktvā purīṣaṃ ca divāniśam । tato vyāgho bhavecchūdro raktadoṣeṇa saṃyutaḥ ।। 109 ।। tajjanmapātakaṃ bhuktvā brāhmaṇaśca punarbhavet । vyādhiroṣāvayuktaśca mucyate svarṇadānataḥ ।। 110 ।। agamyānāṃ ca gāmī ca pūrvoktaṃ rauravaṃ vrajet । kumbhīpākaṃ mahāghoraṃ varṣāṇāṃ cāpyasaṃkhyakam ।। 111 ।। tato bhavetpuṃścalīnāṃ yonīnāṃ ca kṛmistathā । varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca viṭkṛmirvarṣalakṣakam ।। 112 ।। paśuyonirbhavettasmāttasmācca kṣudrajantavaḥ । tato bhavenmlecchajātistataḥ śūdrādhamastadā ।। 113 ।। tato bhavati vipraśca vyādhiyukto napuṃsakaḥ । punaśca brāhmaṇo bhūtvā tīrthaparyaṭanena ca ।। 114 ।। krameṇa śuddho bhavati vaṃśahīnaśca pātakāt । bhojayitvā vipralakṣaṃ putraṃ ca labhate śuciḥ ।। 115 ।। mānavaḥ krodhayuktaśca gardabhaḥ saptajanmasu । mānavaḥ kalahāviṣṭaḥ saptajanmasu vāyasaḥ ।। 116 ।। śālagrāmapratigrāhī kālasūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam । varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva śañjarīṭo bhavettataḥ ।। 117 ।। lohacoraśca nirvaśo maṣīcoraśca kokilaḥ । śuko'pyañjanaconaśca miṣṭacoraḥ kṛmirbhavet ।। 118 ।। vipradveṣī gurudveṣī śirasāṃ ca kṛmirbhavet । puṃścalīṃ kāminīṃ tāta bhuktvā ca rauravaṃ vrajet ।। 119> tato vṛthā kṛmiścaiva varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā । tato'pi vidhavā caiva vandhyā ca saptajanmasu ।। 120 ।। aspṛśyā jātihīnā ca ccinnanāsā bhavetkramāt । raktadravyāpahānī ca raktadoṣānvito bhavet ।। 121 ।। ācārahīno yavanaḥ khañjo bhavati hiṃsakaḥ । adīkṣito vaṅkharaśca duṣṭadarśo ca kāṇakaḥ ।। 122 ।। ahaṃkārī karṇahīno badhiro vedanindakaḥ । vākyahartā ca mūkaśca hiṃsakaḥ keśahīnakaḥ ।। 123 ।। mithyāvādī śmaśruhīno durvākyo dantahīnakaḥ । cihvāhīnaḥ satyahārī duṣṭo'pyaṅgulihīnakaḥ ।। 124 ।। granthāpahārī mūrkhaśca vyādhiyukto bhaveddhruvam । aśvagrāhī ca taccauro lālāmūtraṃ vrajediti ।। 125 ।। varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃ schitvā ghoṭakaśca bhaveddhruvam । gajacoro gacagrāhī viṭkuṇḍe ca sahasrakam ।। 126 ।। sthitvā varṣa bhaveddhastī tatpaścādvṛṣalo bhavet । ayajñe chāgahantā ca cchāgacorapratigrahī ।। 127 ।। pūyakuṇḍe varṣaśataṃ sthitavā cāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet । chāgaśca varṣaparyantaṃ tadā bhavati mānavaḥ ।। 128 ।। śatruśastreṇā cchinnaśca tadā mukto bhaveddvijaḥ । dattāpahārī vāgdānaṃ kṛtvā'paharate punaḥ ।। 129 ।। sa bhavenmalecchayonau ca bhuktvā ca narakaṃ vrajet । ekākī miṣṭamaśnāti kālamūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 130 ।। tatra varṣaśataṃ sthitvā predo varṣasahasrakam । tadā bhavati janmaikaṃ makṣikā ca pipīlikā ।। 131 ।। janmaikaṃ bhramaraśyaiva janmaikaṃ madhumakṣikā । janmaikaṃ varalaścaiva janmaikaṃ daṃśa eva ca ।। 132 ।। janmaikaṃ maśakaścaiva janmaikaṃ pūtikaṃ smṛtam । janmaikaṃ talpakīṭaśca tadā śūdro bhaveddhruvam ।। 133 ।। asadbuddhirvyādhiyuktastadā mukto bhaveddvijaḥ । tailacorastailakāro mūrdhina kīṭastrijanmakam ।। 134 ।। tadā bhavetsvarṇakāro janmaikaṃ duṣṭamānasaḥ । viśvaikanipikartā ca bhakṣmadādurdhanaṃ haret ।। 135 ।। tamaḥkuṇḍe varṣaśataṃ sthitvā svarṇavaṇigbhavet । janmaikaṃ ca darācāro janmaikaṃ karaṇo bhavet ।। 136 ।। kāyasthenodarasthena māturmāsaṃ na khāditam । tatra nāsti kṛpā tasya dantābhāvena kevalam ।। 137 ।। svarṇakāraḥ svarṇavaṇik kāyasthaśca vrajeśvara । nareṣu madhye te dhūrtāḥ kṛpāhīnā mahītale ।। 138 ।। hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ teṣāṃ nāsti ca sādaram । śateṣu sajjanaḥ ko'pi kāyastho netarau ca tau ।। 139 ।। subuddhiḥ śivayuktaśca śāstrajño dharmamānasaḥ । na viśvasetteṣu tāta svātmakalyāṇahetave ।। 140 ।। sīmāpahārī duṣṭaśca bhūmicoraśca hiṃsakaḥ । bhūmidānāpahārī ca kālasūtraṃ vrajeddhruvam ।। 141 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāmi kṣaṭatvivāsārditaḥ sthitaḥ tato'pitāni nāmāni viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ।। 142 ।। tato bhavedasacchūdro janmaikaṃ ca tataḥ śuciḥ । tasmājjñānaiḥ sāvadhānaṃ bhavetprājñaśca yatnataḥ ।। 143 ।। raktavastrāpahārī ca janmaikaṃ raktakīṭa kaḥ । tataḥ śūdraśca janmaikaṃ tato vipro bhavecchuci ।। 144 ।। trisaṃdhyahīno vibraśca prātaḥśāyī ca yo naraḥ । saṃdhyāśāyī divāśāyī yajñasūtrāpahārakaḥ ।। 145 ।। aśuddhaḥ saṃdhyākārī ca vedavedāṅganindakaḥ । tadviruddhaḥ svargamārgastrijanmapatito dvijaḥ ।। 146 ।। yaḥ śūdro brāhmaṇīgāmī kumbhīpāke vrajeddhruvam । varṣāṇāṃ ca trilakṣaṃ ca pacyate tatra pīḍitaḥ ।। 147 ।। divāniśaṃ pradagdhaśca taptataile ca dāruṇe । tatau bhavedyonikīṭaḥ puṃścalīnāṃ ca pātakī ।। 148 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi cā''hāraṃ tasya tanmalam । tato bhavati cāṇḍālo janmalakṣaṃ krameṇa ca ।। 149 ।। tataḥ śūdro galatkuṣṭhī janmaikaṃ ca tataḥ śuciḥ । so'pi vipro vyādhiśeṣastīrthaparyaṭanācchuciḥ ।। 150 ।। asacchūdraśca bhavati so'sthāne'sūrapūjite । dattavā devāya naivedyamapavitraṃ ca mānavaḥ ।। 151 ।। sakeśaṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃpūjya yavano bhavet । durbalena bhavedandhaḥ kutsitena ca kutsatiḥ ।। 152 ।। aṅgahīno daridraśca vyādhiyuktaśca mānavaḥ । aśraddhayā ca nirmāṇe nirmāṇasadṛśaṃ phalam ।। 153 ।। mṛdbhasmagośakṛtviṇḍaistathā vālukayā'pi vā । kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sakṛtpūjya vasetkalpāyuṣaṃ divi ।। 154 ।। tato bhavati vipraśca mahābrajñaśca bhūmimān । rājā bhavedbhārate ca liṅgānāṃ śatapūjanāt ।। 155 ।। sahasrapūjanātso'pi labhate niścitaṃ phalam । sthitvā ca suciraṃ svarge rājendro bhārate bhavet ।। 156 ।। ayute ca tadīśaśca lakṣe ca pṛthivīśvaraḥ । pūjane cātibhaktyā cāpyatiristaṃ phalaṃ labhet ।। 157 ।। tīrthasnānena dānena viprāṇāṃ bhojanena ca । nārāyaṇārcayā caiva viprajātiśca karmaṇā ।। 158 ।। atiriktena tapasā paṇḍito brāhmaṇo bhavet । paṇḍito brāhmaṇaścaiva vaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ ।। 159 ।। anekajanmapuṇyena jāyate bhārate bhuvi । tasyāṅdhrisparśanenaiva sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā ।। 160 ।। tīrthāḥ kurvanti tīrthāni jīvanamuktāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ । svapuṃsāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca punantīti śrutau śrutam ।। 161 ।। pāpena vaidyajanmaiva duścikitso'pi brāhmaṇaḥ । duścikitsastathā vaidyo vyālagrāhī trijanmasu ।। 162।। atikrūro durācāro dveṣṭā ca suraviprayoḥ । sa bhavetkuṭilavyālo varṣāṇāṃ ca mahasrakam ।। 163 ।। puṃścalīlampaṭānāṃ ca dūtī yā kāminī vraja । kālamūtre varṣaśataṃ sthitvā ca godhikā bhavet ।। 164 ।। janmaikaṃ godhikā bhūtvā hariṇaśca trijanmasu । janmaikaṃ mahiṣacaiva janmaikaṃ bhalluko bhavet ।। 165 ।। janmaikaṃ gaṇḍakaścaiva sṛgālaśca trijanmasu । parakīyataḍāgaṃ ca luptvā sasyaṃ dadāti ca ।। 166 ।। sa bhavennakrajātiśca kacchapaśca trijanmasu । vṛthā māṃsaṃ ca yo bhuṅkte matsyalubdhaśca brāhmaṇaḥ ।। 167 ।। bhuṅkte māṃsamadattaṃ ca sa mīnaśca mṛgo bhavet । varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca tāta bhuktvā ca kilbiṣam ।। 168 ।। karmabhogācchucirbhūtvā sa punarbrāhmaṇo bhavet । ekādaśīvihīnaśca brāhmaṇaḥ patitobhavet ।। 169 ।। bhakṣyasya dviguṇaṃ dattvā tena pāpena mucyate । mama janmadine caiva yo bhuṅkte mānavo'dhamaḥ ।। 170 ।। trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ so'pi bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ । bhuktvā ca narakaṃ sarvaṃ paścāccaṇḍālatāṃ vrajet ।। 171 ।। evaṃ ca śivarātau ca śrīrāmanavamīdine । upavāsāsamarthaśca haviṣyānnaṃ samācaret ।। 172 ।। tato'śakto durbalaśca bhojayedbrāhmaṇānapi । kṛtvā mahotsavaṃ puṇyaṃ madīyaṃ pātakācchuciḥ ।। 173 ।। tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ mama । gṛdhraḥ koṭisahasrāṇi śatajanmāni sūkaraḥ ।। 174 ।। śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni kuhvāṃ ca niśi bhojanāt । adīkṣito dvijaścaiva śaṅkhaścillaḥ ।। śuko bhavet ।। 175 ।। anudvāhī dvijaścaiva rājahaṃso bhavaddhruvam । citravastrāpahārī ca mayūraśca trijanmasu ।। 176 ।। tejaḥpatrāpahārī ca bhavetkāraṇḍavaściram । surāṇāṃ pratimācoro'pyandhaśca saptacanmasu ।। 177 ।। daridro vyādhiyuktaśca badhiraścāpi kubjakaḥ । strītailamadhumāṃsāni ravau vā pañcaparvasu ।। 178 ।। sevate yo mahāmūḍho vajradaṃṣṭraṃ vrajeddhruvam । pātakī duḥkhitastatra varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। 179 ।। tato bhavati mlecchaśca cāṇḍālaḥ saptajanmasu । vyāviyuktastataḥ śūdro brāhmaṇaśca tataḥ śuciḥ ।। 180 ।। tasmādyatnānna bhoktavyaṃ bhārate dharmabhīruṇā । brāhmaṇaṃ ca suraṃ dṛṣṭvā na namedyo narādhamaḥ ।। 181 ।। yāvajjīvanaparyantamaśuciryavano bhavet । abhyutthānaṃ na kurute dṛṣṭvā cā''gatabrāhmaṇam ।। 182 ।। sa bhavedbrahmaghātī ca saptajanmasu niścitam । śivadveṣī kukkuṭaśca devalaḥ saptajanmamu ।। 183 ।। pitṛdevāncanaṃ hanti vedoktaṃ jñānadurbalaḥ । sa yāti naramaṃ pāpī varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। 184 ।। tataśca rauravaṃ bhuktvā tīrthakākastricanmasu । trijanmasu śṛgālaśca tīrthe bhuṅkte śavaṃ vraja ।। 185 ।। trijanmasu bhavetso'pi tīrtheṣu śavarakṣakaḥ । śavānāṃ karamādatte karmaṇā kṛtapātakī ।। 186 ।। nityaṃ surārcanaṃ kṛtvā dāmbhiko jñānadurbalaḥ । guruṃ ca nārcayedbhaktyā tasmai nānnaṃ dadāti yaḥ ।। 187 ।। sa bhaveddelo duḥkhī devaśāpena pātakī । nityaṃ surārcanaṃ kṛtvā dāmbhiko jñānadurbalaḥ ।। 188 ।। pūcāphalaṃ na labhate devadrohī sa dārupāḥ । dīpanirvāṇakartā ca khadyola saptacanmasu ।। 189 ।। atīva matsyalabdhaścāpyanaivedyaṃ ca khādati । sa bhavenmatsyaraṅgaśca mārjariḥ saptajanmasu ।। 190 ।। goṇīhartā kapotaśca mālāhartā vihaṃgamaḥ । caṭako dhānyacoraśca māṃsacoraśca kuṃjaraḥ ।। 191 ।। kaviḥ prahartā viduṣāṃ māṇḍrakaḥ saptajanmasu । asatkavirgrāmavipro nakulaḥ saptajanmasu ।। 192 ।। kuṣṭhī bhavecca janmaikaṃ kṛkalāsastrijanmasu । janmaikaṃ varalaścaiva tato vṛkṣapipīlikā ।। 193 ।। tataḥ śūdraśca vaiśyaśca kṣatriyo brāhmaṇastathā । kanyāvikrayakārī ca caturvarṇo hi mānavaḥ ।। 194 ।। sadyaḥ prayāti tāmisraṃ yāvaccandradivākarau । tatau bhavati vyādhaśca māṃsavikrayakārakaḥ ।। 195 ।। tato vyādhi(dho)rbhavetpaścādyo yathā pūrvacanmani । mannāmavikrayī viprona hi mukto ।। bhaveddhruvam ।। 196 ।। mṛtyuloke ca mannāmasmṛtimātraṃ na vidyateḥ । paścādbhavetsa goyonau janmaikaṃ jñānadurbalaḥ ।। 197 ।। tataścāgastato meṣo mahiṣaḥ sptacanmasu । mahācakrī ca kuṭilo dharmahīnastu mānavaḥ ।। 198 ।। janmaikaṃ tailakāraśca kumbhakālastathaiva ca । mithyākalaṅkavaktā ca devabrāhmaṇa nindakaḥ ।। 199 ।। sa bhavetsvarṇakāraśca rajakaḥ saptajanmasu । brāhmaṇakṣatraviṭśūdrāḥ kutsitāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ ।। 200 ।। janma teṣāṃ malecchayonau varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tathā । atīva kāminīlubdhaḥ kāmukaḥ strīrataḥ sadā ।। 201 ।। yakṣmagrasto bhavetsadyaḥ paratrāpi napuṃsakaḥ । kāmato yoṣitāṃ śroṇīstanāsye yaśca paśyati ।। 202 ।। sa bhaveddṛṣṭihīnaśca paratrāpi napuṃsakaḥ । vipro'bhicārakartā ca hiṃsako jñānadurbalaḥ ।। 203 ।। yātyevamandhatāmisraṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tathā । tadā bhavati daivajño'pyagradānī ca durmatiḥ ।। 204 ।। tataḥ śūdro bhavedvipro bhogena karmaṇastathā । śāstrajñātā ca daivajño mithyā vadati lobhataḥ ।। 205 ।। sa bhavecca dhruvaṃ jyeṣṭhī vānaraḥ saptajanmasu । anekajanmatapasā bhārate brāhmaṇo bhavet ।। 206 ।। subuddhiratidharmiṣṭho dharmahīnaśca pātakī । svadharmanirato vipraḥ paramācca hutāśanāt ।। 207 ।। pavitraścātitejasvī tasmadbhītāḥ surāḥ sadā । nadīṣu ca yathā gaṅgā tīrtheṣu puṣkaraṃ yathā ।। 208 ।। purīṣu ca yathā kāśī yathā jñāniṣu śaṃkaraḥ । śāstreṣu ca yathā vedā yathā'śvatthaśca pādape ।। 209 ।। mama pūjā tapasyāsu vrateṣvanaśanaṃ yathā । tathā jātiṣu sarvāsu brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭha eva ca ।। 210 ।। vipraṇadeṣu tīrthāni puṇyāni ca vratāni ca । viprapādarajaḥ śuddhaṃ pāpavyādhivimardanam ।। 211 ।। śubhāśīrvacanaṃ teṣāṃ sarvakalyāṇakāraṇam । etatte kathitaṃ tāta vipākaḥ karmaṇāmaho ।। 212 ।। yathāśrutaṃ yathājñātaṃ tadaśeṣaṃ niṇāmaya। śutvā dharmavipākaṃ ca vācakāya suvarṇakam ।। 213 ।। dadyāttasmai ca raupyaṃ ca vastraṃ tāmbūlameva ca । suvarṇaśatakaṃ dadyātsadyo dehī ca gokulam ।। raupyaṃ vastraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ matprītyā brāhmaṇāya ca ।। 214 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ...pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 85 ।।
<4.86> atha ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca kedārakanyāprastāvātkathitaṃ karmakīrtanam । kṛtyāstrīṇāṃ prasaṅgena tadvyāsena vada prabho ।। 1 ।। kedārakanyā sā kā vā ko vā kedārabhūpatiḥ । kasya vaṃśecatajjanma tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 2 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca purātu brahmaṇāḥ putro manuḥ svāṃyabhuvastathā । tasya strī śatarūpā ca dhanyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ।। 3 ।। priyavratottānapādau tayoḥ putrau babhūvatuḥ । uttānapādaputraśca dhruva eva mahāyaśāḥ ।। 4 ।। tatputro nandasāvarṇiḥ kedāraśca tadātmajaḥ । saptadvīpapatiḥ śrīmānkedāro vaiṣṇavaḥ svayam ।। 5 ।। tasya rakṣānimittena satsabhāyāṃ sudarśanam । gavāṃ lakṣaṃ śuddhaṃ svarṇaśṛṅgaṃ ca bhūṣitam ।। 6 ।। vahniśuddhāni vastrāṇi dattāni varuṇena ca । suvarṇānāṃ tathā lakṣaṃ sarvasasyāṃ vasuṃdharām ।। 7 ।। maṇiratnaṃ ca muktāśca hīrakaṃ paramaṃ tathā । māṇikyāmaśvaratnānāṃ lakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ cahastinām ।। 8 ।। raupyaṃ pravālaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ śatadhānyācalaṃ varam । nityaṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇemyo dadau ca ratnabhūṣaṇām ।। 9 ।। śatalakṣaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ । jalabhojanapātrāṇi suvarṇānāṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।। 10 ।। suvarṇānāṃ yajñasūtramaṅgulīyakamuttamam । āsanaṃ svarṇaratnānāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 11 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ ca lakṣaṃ ca sūpakāraṃ nṛpasya ca । brāhmaṇānāṃ dvilakṣaṃ ca pariveṣaṇakārakam ।। 12 ।। ghṛtakulyā madhukulyā dadhikulyā manoharāḥ । guḍakulyā dugdhakulyā nityaṃ prārthanamīpsitam ।। 13 ।। prātarārabhya saṃdhyāntaṃ viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā । duḥśināṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ ca dhanadānaṃ yathocitam ।। 14 ।। phalamūlāśano rājā vaiṣṇavaśca jitendriyaḥ । sarva madarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā'japanmāṃ ca divāniśam ।। 15 ।। ekadā sūpakāraśca tamuvāca nṛpeśvaram । viprāṇāṃ bhojanāyaiva daśalakṣamupasthitam ।। 16 ।। bhuñjate brāhmaṇāścādya rūkṣamannaṃ vada prabho । kurvantu bhakṣaṇaṃ te vai viprāḥ sūpādinā nṛpa ।। 17 ।। caturyojanaparyantamadhikāro nṛpasya ca । yo rājā tacchatasuṇaḥ sa eva maṇḍaleśvaraḥ ।। 18 ।। tattaddaśaguṇo rājā rājendraḥ parikīrtitaḥ । rājendrāṇāṃ pañcalakṣaṃ nityaṃ kedārasaṃsadi ।। 19 ।। amūlyaratnamāṇikyaṃ muktāhīraṃ maṇīśvaram । gajaratnamaśvaratnaṃ kedārāya karaṃ dadau ।। 20 ।। kamalākalayā jātā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavāḥ । vahriśuddhāṃsukādhānā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 21 ।। kāmukī kāminīśreṣṭhā kanyā kamalalocanā । kanyā'smi te mahārājetyuvāca nṛpatiṃ ca sā ।। 22 ।। rājā saṃpūjya tāṃ bhaktyā tasthau patnīṃsarpya ca । sā vijñāya prasūṃ tātaṃ kṛtvā ca vinayaṃ sudā ।। 23 ।। yayau puṇyavanaṃ ramyaṃ tapase yamṛnāntikam । tattapasyāvanaṃ yasmāttasmāddṛndāvanaṃ smṛtam ।। 24 ।। tapasā varayāmāsa māṃ varaṃ ca varaṃ varam । brahmā dadau varaṃ tasyai paśyātkṛṣṇaṃ labheṣyasi ।। 25 ।। sa caikadā nadītīne vasante sasmitā satī । śayānā puṣpaśayyāyāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। 26 ।। brahmā parīkṣituṃ yātaḥsādhvīṃ ca sumanoharām । dadarśa kanyā rahasi yuvānaṃ puruṣaṃ param ।। 27 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam । sasmītaṃ kāmukaṃ ramyaṃ ramaṇīnāṃ ca vāñchitam ।। 28 ।। yathā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyaṃ kumāraṃ kanakaprabham । koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ vītāmbaradharaṃ varam ।। 29 ।। śaratpārvaṇācandrāsyaṃ śaratpadmasulocanam । dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca samutthāya vāsayāmāsa saṃnidhau ।। 30 ।। pūjāṃ cakāra bhaktyā ca phalaṃ mūlaṃ dadau mudā। suvā sitaṃ jalaṃ dattvā praṇanāma mudā'nvitā ।। 31 ।। pūjāṃ gṛhītvā muditaḥ sādaraṃ tāmuvāca ha । viprarūpī ca bhagavānprajvalanbrahmātejasā ।। kāmukīnāṃ ca kāmyaṃ ca satīnāṃ duṣkaraṃ vraja ।। 32 ।। dharma uvāca bhavatī kasya kanyā vā kiṃ te nāma manohare । kiṃ karoṣi rahasyeva tanme kathitumarhasi ।। 33 ।। kasya hetostapasyā te kiṃ vā vāñchasi sundari । varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam ।। 34 ।। vṛndovāca vipra kedārakanyā'haṃ vṛndā vṛndāvane sthitā । tapaḥ karomi rahasi cintayāmi hariṃ patim ।। 35 ।। yadi dātuṃ samartho'si dehi me vāñchitaṃ varam । asamartho'si cedgaccha kiṃ te praśnena brāhmaṇa ।। 36 ।। dharma uvāca nirīhamaditarkyaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram । nirguṇaṃ ca nirākāraṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 37 ।। kā kṣamā taṃ patiṃ kartuṃ vinā lakṣamīṃ sarasvatīm ।। caturbhujasya dve bhārye harervaikuṇṭhaśāthinaḥ ।। 38 ।। goloke dvibhujasyāpi śrīvaṃśīvadanasya ca । kiśoragopaveṣasya paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। 39 ।। tasya bhāryā svayaṃ rādhā mahālakṣmīḥ parātparā । brahmasvarūpā paramā paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 40 ।। bhajate satataṃ śāntaṃ suramyaṃ śyāmasundaram । koṭikandarpasaundaryaninditaṃ sukalevaram ।। 41 ।। amūlyaratnābharaṇaṃ satyaṃ ca nityavigraham । pītāmbaradharaṃ ramyaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām ।। 42 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaśca dvidhārūpo dvibhujaśca caturbhujaḥ । caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe goloke dvibhujaḥ svayam ।। 43 ।। yannimeṣo bhavedvṛnde brahmaṇaḥ patatena ca । pañcaviṃśatsahasreṇā yugenendrasya pātanam ।। 44 ।। caturdaśendrāvacchinnakālena brahmaṇo dinam । tāvatīti niśā tasya vidhāturjagatāmapi ।। 45 ।। evaṃ triṃśaddinairmāsaṃ dviṣaṭke māsi varṣakam । evaṃ śatāyustasyaiva nibodha bodhatatparam ।। 46 ।। yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ sevante sanakādayaḥ । kalpānāṃ koṭikoṭiṃ ca tanna sādhyāścayo vibhuḥ ।। 47 ।। sahasravaktraḥ śeṣaśca sevate ca japansadā । divāniśaṃ ca yaṃ bhaktyā kalpakoṭiśataṃ śatam ।। 48 ।। tanna sādhyo hitakaro durārādhyaḥ parātparaḥ । brahmā brahmāsvarūpaṃ taṃ bhajejjanmani janmani ।। 49 ।। vaktraiścaturbhiḥ satataṃ stauti nityaṃ sanātanam । vede'nirvacanīyaśca vedānāṃ janako vidhiḥ ।। 50 ।। vidhātā phaladātā ca dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām । tanna sādhyo hi bhagavānkālakālāntakaḥ ।। 51 ।। saṃhārakartā jagatāṃ kalayā rudrarūpataḥ । sa stauti pañcavaktreṇa ko'nyo'nyasyāpi kā kathā ।। 52 ।। tatparaśca priyo nāsti vṛnde bhagavātaḥ śṛṇu । sarvaśaktisvarūpā sā durgā durgatināśinī ।। 53 ।। brahmasvarūpā paramā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī । nārāyaṇī viṣṇumāyā vaiṣṇavī sā sanātanī ।। 54 ।। yanmāyayā jagadbhrāntamanitye bhramate sadā । sā stauti bhaktyāyaṃ devaṃ vṛnde'yaṅge divāniśam ।। 55 ।। stauti bhaktyā svaśaktyā ca gajavaktraḥ ṣaḍānanaḥ । dhyāyate yaṃ gaṇeśaśca sarvādau yasya pūjanam ।। 56 ।। bhagavānsarvadeveśo jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ । sidvendreṣu ca devendre yomīndre jñānināṃ gurau ।। 57 ।। na gaṇeśātparo vidvāngaṇeśaśca surādhipaḥ । sarasvatī ca yaṃ stotumaśaktā parameśvarī ।। 58 ।। divāniśaṃ pādapadmaṃ bhaktyā padmā niṣevate । yatkaṭākṣājjagatsarva paripūrṇatamaṃ śivam ।। 59 ।। yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryastapati yadbhayāt । varṣatīndro dahatyagnirmṛtyuścarati jantuṣu ।। 60 ।। pṛthivī sevayā yasya sarvādhārā vasaṃdharā । samṛdrā niścalāḥ śailā yasya bhītāśca sundari ।। 61 ।। tīrthasārā ca sā gaṅgā pavitrā muktidāyinī । jagatāṃ pāvanī devī yasya pādābjasevayā ।। 62 ।। pavitrā tulasī devī smaraṇādyasya sevanāt । navagrahāśca dikpālā bhītā yasya pratāpataḥ ।। 63 ।। brahmaṇḍeṣu ca sarveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ । anye ye ye sureśāśca śeṣādyā munayastathā ।। 64 ।। kecitkalāsvarūpāścāpyaṃśarūpāśca kecana । kecitkalāṃśāḥ kṛṣṇasya kecicca paramātmanaḥ ।। 65 ।। patimicchasi kalyāṇi prakṛteḥ paramīśvaram । goloke rādhikā sādhyo nānyeṣāṃ ca kadācana ।। 66 ।। māṃ bhajasva mahābhāge nṛpāṇāmīśvaraṃ patim । balavantaṃ ca devebhyo daityebhyaśca varānane ।। 67 ।। sukhāni yāni kalyāṇi triṣu lokeṣu santi vai । bhuṅkṣva tānyeva sarvāṇi matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ ।। 68 ।। saptasāgalapāre ca kāñcanī rucirā vare । devānāṃ krīḍanārthāya vidhātrā nirmitā purī ।। 69 ।। tatraiva gacchabhadraṃ te rama rāme mayā saha । mahendrasya priyavanaṃ puṣpodyānasamanvitam ।। 70 ।। gaccha svarṇamayīṃ laṅkāṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām । tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te rama... ।। 71 ।। vispandakaṃ suvasanaṃ nandakaṃ puṣpabhadrakam । tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te rama... ।। 72 ।। sumerugahvaraṃ vā'pi kṣīrorda vā manoharam । tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te rama... ।। 73 ।। satyalokaṃ brahmalokaṃ ramyaṃ sadma rahaḥsthalam । tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te rama... ।। 74 ।। malaye nilayaṃ ramyaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam । sugandhiyuktaṃ satataṃ śuddhaṃ candanavāyunā ।। 75 ।। mālatī yūthikā ramyā ketakī mādhavī tathā । cārucampakapuṣpāṇāṃ gandhena sumanoharam ।। 76 ।। pikānāṃ bhramarāṇāṃ ca madhuradhvanisaṃyutam । tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te rama... ।। 77 ।। indrasya varuṇāsyaiva vāyorapi yamasya ca । dhaneśvarasya bahreśca dharmasya śaśinastathā ।। 78 ।। suramyaṃ lokameteṣāṃ madhye tevi yathecchasi । tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te rama... ।। 79 ।। ratnadvīpaṃ maṇidvīpaṃ ramyaṃ candrasarovaram । tatraiva gaccha bhadraṃ te rama... ।। 80 ।। ityevamuktvā saṃbhoktuṃ gacchantaṃ taṃ chalena ca । na vāstavaparīkṣārthaṃ satītvaṃ bodhituṃ vraja ।। 81 ।। uvāca sā nṛpasutā kopavaktrāsyalocanā । hitaṃ satyaṃ yogayuktaṃ dharmārthaṃ ca yaśaskaram ।। 82 ।। vṛndovāca dhairya kuru mahābhāga śreṣṭho jātiṣu brahmaṇaḥ । brahmaṇānāṃ tapo mūlaṃ satyaṃ vedavrataṃ dhṛtiḥ ।। 83 ।। parastrīsahasaṃbhogaḥ svabhāvaścāpyadharmiṇām । adharmeṇaiva he vipra duṣṭo'bhadrāṇi paśyati ।। 84 ।। tataḥ sapatne jayati samūlastho vinaśyati । pativratānāṃ gamane balātkāreṇa niścitam ।। 85 ।। mātṛgāmī bhavetsadyo brahmahatyāśataṃ bhavet । kumbhīpāke pacyate ca yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 86 ।। pradagdhastailatapteṣu na mṛtaḥ sūkṣmadehataḥ । tāḍito yamadūtaiśca lohadaṇḍena mūrdhani ।। 87 ।। kṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ ciraṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvanāśasya kāraṇam । agamyāgamanaṃ duḥkhaṃ dharmiṣṭho naiva vāñchati ।। 88 ।। kṣamasvagaccha bhadraṃ te brāhmaṇa jñānadurbala । yathā dīpaśikhāṃ dṛṣṭvā kīṭaḥ patati niścitam ।। 89 ।। miṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā baḍīśāgre lubdhamīno mṛgo yathā । yathā viṣāktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ ca bhuṅkte bhoktā bubhukṣitaḥ ।। 90 ।। gṛhṇāti duṣṭo duṣṭaṃ ca viṣakumbhaṃ payomukham । tathā dṛṣṭvā parastrīṇāṃ mukhapadmaṃ manoharam ।। 91 ।। vināśabījaṃ mohena bhrānto bhavati lampaṭaḥ । mukhaṃ ca ruciraṃ strīṇāṃ śroṇiyugmaṃ manoharam ।। 92 ।। kāmādhāraṃ nāśabījamadharmasthalameva ca । bhagaṃ narakakuṇḍaṃ ca lālāmūtrasamanvitam ।। 93 ।। durgandhiyuktaṃ pāpaṃ ca yamadaṇḍasya kāraṇam । yathā liṅgaṃ viśatyeva pāpayonau ca yoṣitām ।। 94 ।। tathā pumānviśatyeva raurave ca yuge yuge । rahasyaṃ cā''padaṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ tavaṃ dharṣitumicchasi ।। 95 ।। atraiva sarvadevāśca lokapālāśca brāhmaṇā । jājvalyamāno dharmaśca sākṣī śāstā ca karmaṇām ।। 96 ।। yamaśca daṇḍakartā ca sthāpito hariṇā svayam । svayaṃ kuṣṇaśca dharmātmā jñānarupo maheśvaraḥ ।। 97 ।। durgā buddhirmano brahma cendriyāṇi surāstathā । sarvaprāṇiṣu tiṣṭhanti sākṣiṇāḥ karmaṇāṃ dvija ।। 98 ।। kva guptaṃ kva rahasyaṃ vā brahmaṇa jñānadurbala । kṣamasva gaccha bhadraṃ te avadhyāśca dvijātayaḥ ।। 99 ।। śaktā'haṃ bhamasātkartuṃ gaccha vatsa yathāsukham । tapasyāsu mama gatamaṣṭottaraśataṃ yugam ।। 100 ।। nāsti gortra matpituśca na mātā na pitā mama । sarvāntarātmā bhagavānkṛṣṇo rakṣati māṃ dvija ।। 101 ।। kṛṣṇena sthāpito dharmo māṃ ca rakṣati nityaśaḥ । ādityaśca tathā candraḥ pavanaśca hutāśanaḥ ।। 102 ।। brahmā śaṃbhurbhagavatī durgā rakṣati māṃ sadā । yena śuklīkṛtā haṃsāḥ śukāśca haritāḥ kṛtāḥ ।। 103 ।। mayūrāścitritā yena sa me rakṣāṃ kariṣyati । anāthabālavṛddhānāṃ rakṣakāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।। 104 ।। nārībudvyā na māṃ dharmastyaktvā gaccheddhi sarvadā । māṃ mātaraṃ parityajya gaccha vatsa yathāsukham ।। 105 ।। ityevamuktvā devī sā tasthau tatra dharā yathā । āgacchantaṃ ca saṃbhoktuṃ mā yāntaṃ bodhanena ca ।। 106 ।। śaśāpeti ca sā kopādbrahmapandho kṣayo bhava । kṣayo bhava durācāra he pāpiṣṭha kṣayo bhava ।। 107 ।। punaḥ śaptaṃ svayaṃ sūryo vārayāmāsa yatnataḥ । etasimannantare tāta tatrava jagadīśvarāḥ ।। 108 ।। ājagmuratisaṃtrastā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ । dharma dṛṣṭvā kalārūpaṃ rurudustridaśeśvarāḥ ।। 109 ।। kṛtvā kroḍe'tīva kṛśaṃ kuhvā bhītaṃ yathā vidhum । niśceṣṭaṃ malinaṃ dagdhaṃ satīkopāgninā vraja ।। 110 ।। śrībhavānuvāca kṣamasva vṛnde madbhakte janmamṛtyujarāhare । dharma jīvaya madbhaktaṃ rakṣa dharma pativrate ।। 111 ।। brahmovāca dhvāntapūrṇa jagatsardaṃ vinā dharma babhūva ha । kampitau candrasūryau ca śeṣaścāpi vasuṃdharā ।। 112 ।। mahadeva uvāca pranaṣṭaṃ ca jagatsarvaṃ vinā dharmeṇa sundari । dharmaṃ jīvaya bhadraṃ te svasti te'stu varānane ।। 113 ।। sūrya uvāca varaṃ vṛṣṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam । dharmaṃ jīvaya bhadraṃ te rakṣa sṛṣṭiṃ pativrate ।। 114 ।। ananta uvāca dharmaṃ karoṣi tapasā kathaṃ dharmaṃ vihasi ca । dharmaṃ jīvaya bhadraṃ te sarvadharmo bhavettava ।। 115 ।। candra uvāca dvijarūpadharo dharmastvāṃ parīkṣitumāgataḥ । brahmaṇā preritaścaiva nirdoṣaśca vihiṃsitaḥ ।। 116 ।। mahendra uvāca tapasopānjito dharmo dharmeṇa ca phalaṃ nṛpām । kathaṃ phalaṃ ca tapasāṃ yadi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ ।। 117 ।। varuṇa uvāca dharmaṃ jīvaya dharmiṣṭhe dharmaṃ rakṣa sanātanam । niṣphalaṃ karmiṇāṃ karma vinā dharmeṇā dhārmike ।। 118 ।। pavana uvāca jagatpūtaṃ kuru śubhe dharmaṃ jauvaya sāṃpratam । dharme pranaṣṭe tapasāṃ tavāpūrvaṃ vinaṅkṣyati ।। 119 ।। vahniruvāca svadharmopārjanaṃ kartumāgatā'si ca bhāratam । vihaṃsi dharmamajñātvā punarjīvaya sundari ।। 120 ।। yama uvāca vedoktakarmakartaṇāsahaṃ viśve varānane । dharmānusārātphalado dharma jīvaya satvaram ।। 121 ।। devānāṃ vacanaṃ kṣutvā samutthāya pativratā । namaskṛtya sureśāṃścatānuvāca tapasvinī ।। 122 ।। vṛndovāca ahaṃ devā na jānāmi dharmaṃ brāhmaṇarūpiṇam । kṛtaḥ kṣayo mayā kopānmāṃ parīṅitumāgataḥ ।। 123 ।। jīvayāmi dhruvaṃ dharmaṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca prasādataḥ । ityevamuktvā sā vṛndā cetyuvāca vpajeśvara ।। 124 ।। tapaḥ satyaṃ yadi mama satyaṃ ca viṣṇupūjanam । tena puṇyena sadyo'tra dvijo bhavatu vijvaraḥ ।। 125 ।। yadi me ca bhavetsatyaṃ vrataṃ satyaṃ tapaḥśuci । tena puṇyena satyena dvijo bha... ।। 126 ।। yadi nārāyaṇaḥ satyaḥ sarvātmā nityavigrahaḥ । jñānātmakaḥ śivaḥ satyo dvijo bha... ।। 127 ।। brahma satyaṃ ca te devāḥ prakṛtiḥ paramā yadi । yajñaḥ satyastapaḥ satyaṃ dvijo bha... ।। 128 ।। ityevamuktvā sā vṛndā dharma kroḍe cakāra ca । taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca kalārūpaṃ ruroda kṛpayāsatī ।। 129 ।। etasminnantare mūrtirdharmabhāryā śucā''kulā । nipatya viṣṇupāde ya śirasā cetyuvāca sā ।। 130 ।। mūrtiruvāca he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru । tūrṇaṃ jīvaya kāntaṃ me jagannātha kṛpāmaya ।। 131 ।। patihīnā ca yā nārī pāpinī sā bhavārṇave । yathā''syaṃ cakṣurvirataṃ prāṇahīnā yathā tanūḥ ।। 132 ।। mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ bhrādā mitaṃ sutaḥ । mitaṃ bandhurmitaṃ mātā sarvadātā patiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 133 ।। ityevamuktvā sā devī tatra tasthau ruroda ca । uvāca vṛndāṃ ṇagavānsarvātmā prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 134 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca tvayā''yustapasā labdhaṃ yāvadāyuśca brahmaṇaḥ । tadeva dehi dharmāya golokaṃ gaccha sundari ।। 135 ।। tanvā'nayā ca tapasā paścānmāṃ ca labhiṣyasi । paścādgolokamāgatya vārāhe ca varānane ।। 136 ।। vṛṣabhānasutā tvaṃ ca rādhācchāyā bhaviṣyasi । matkalāṃśaśca rāyāṇastvāṃ vivāha grahīṣyati ।। 137 ।। māṃ labhiṣyasi rāse ca gopībhī rādhayā saha । rādhā śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā yadā ।। 138 ।। sā caiva vāstavī rādhā tvaṃ ca cchāyāsvarupiṇī । vivāhakāle rāyāṇastvāṃ ca cchāyāṃ grahīṣyati ।। 139 ।। tvāṃ dattvā vāstavī rādhā sā'ntardhānā bhaviṣyati । rādhaiveti vimūḍhāśca vijñāsyanti ।। ca gokule ।। 140 ।। svapne rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ na ri paśyanti ballavāḥ । svayaṃ rādhā mama kroḍe chāyā rāyāṇakāminī ।। 141 ।। viṣṇośca vacanaṃ śrutvā dadāvāyuśca sundarī । uttasthau pūrṇa dharmaśca taptakāñcanasaṃnibhaḥ ।। pūrvasmātsundaraḥ śrīmānpraṇanāma parātparam ।। 142 ।। vṛndovāca devāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ durlaṅghyaṃ sāvadhānataḥ । na hi mithyā bhavedvākyaṃ madīyaṃ ca niśāmaya ।। 143 ।। kṣayo bhaveti vākyaṃ ca mayoktaṃ kopabhītayā । vāratrayaṃ punarvaktuṃ vārayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ ।। 144 ।। satye ca paripūrṇo'yaṃ yathāpūrvo yathā'dhunā । tripādaścāpi tretāyāṃ dvāpado dvipare tathā ।। 145 ।। ekapādaśca darmo'yaṃ kaleśca prathame hare । śeṣe kalāṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ punaḥ satye yathā purā ।। 146 ।। trirnirgataṃ mama mukhātkṣayastena tataḥ kramāt । punarukte ca manasi vārayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ ।। 147 ।। tenaiva retunā'yaṃ ca kariśeṣe kalāmayaḥ । tathā śaptaḥ sthito durge kaliśeṣe tathā dhruvam ।। 148 ।। etasminnantare nanda dadṛśurdevatā ratham । golokādāgataṃ vegādatīva sundaraṃ śubham ।। 149 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ hīrahārapariṣkṛtam । maṇimāṇikyamuktābhirvastraiśca śvetacāmarai। ।। 150 ।। vibhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇauśca rucirai stanadarpaṇaiḥ । natvā hariṃ haraṃ vṛndā brahmāṇaṃ sarvadevatāḥ ।। 151 ।। samāruṅya rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā golokaṃ ca jagāma sā । devā jagmuśca svasthānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 152 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 86 ।।
<4.87> atha saptāśītitamodhyāyaḥ nanda uvāca tvāṃ jñātuṃ nahi śaktāśca vedā vedaprabhuṃ svayam । surā brahmeśaseṣādyā munisiddhādayastathā ।। 1 ।। ko bhavāniti vijñātuṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama । tatsarva svātmayāthārthyaṃ nirjane kathaya prabho ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare tatra kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ munīśvarāḥ । ājagmuḥ sahasā vatsa jvalanto brahmatejasā ।। 3 ।। pulahaśca pulastyaśca kratuśca bhṛguraṅgirāḥ । pracetāśca vasiṣṭhaśca durvāsāḥ kaṇva eva ca ।। 4 ।। kātyāyanaḥ pāṇiniśca kaṇādo gautamastathā । sanakaśca sanandaśca dṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ ।। 5 ।। kapilaścā''suriścaiva vāyuḥ pañcaśikhastathā । viśvāmitro vālmīkiśca kaśyapaśca parāśaraḥ ।। 6 ।। vibhāṇḍako marīciśca śukrau'triśca bṛhaspatiḥ । gārgyaśyāpi tathā vātsyo vyāsaśca jaiministathā ।। 7 ।। mitavāgṛṣyaśṛṅgaśca yājñavalkyaḥ śukastathā । saubhariḥ śuddhajaṭilo bharadvājaḥ subhadrakaḥ ।। 8 ।। mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca āsuriśca viṭaṅkaṇaḥ । aṣṭāvakra śatānando vāmadeśca bhāsuriḥ ।। 9 ।। saṃvartaścāpyutathyaśca naro'haṃ cāpi nārada । jābāliḥ parśurāmaścāpyagastyaḥ paila eva ca ।। 10 ।। yudhāmanyurgau ramukho'pyupamanyuḥ śrṛtaśravāḥ । maitreyaścyavanaścaiva vararucyarṣireva ca ।। 11 ।। tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya namaskṛtya puṭāñjaliḥ । siṃhāsaneṣu ramyeṣu vāsayāmāsa sādaram ।। 12 ।। pūjayāmāsa vidhivatkuśalapraśnapūrvakam । parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya madhye kṛṣṇa uvāsa saḥ ।। 13 ।। etasminnantare kṛṣṇastejorāśiṃ dadarśa saḥ । daduśuste ca munayo'pyākāśe ca samujjvalam ।। 14 ।। tejaso'bhyantare vatsa kumāraṃ kanakaprabhām । yathaiva pañcavarṣīyaṃ nagnaṃ bālakamīpsitam ।। 15 ।। āvirbabhūva sahasā samāmadhye ca nārada । uttiṣṭamānaṃ sahasā taṃ dṛṣṭvā munapuṃgavāḥ ।। 16 ।। praṇemurmunayaḥ sarve śauriśca praṇanāma tam । sasmitaṃ snigdhanetraṃ cakṛtvā yuktiṃ ca sādaram ।। 17 ।। sa sarvānāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā samuvāsa ca saṃsadi । uvāca tāṃśca śauriṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 18 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca bhadraṃ vo munayaḥ śaśvattapasāṃ phalamīpsitam । kṛṣṇasya kuśalapraśnaṃ sivabījasya niṣphalam ।। 19 ।। sāṃprataṃ kuśulaṃ vaśca darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ । bhaktānurodhāddehasya parasya prakṛterapi ।। 20 ।। nirguṇāsya nirīhasya sarvabījasya teyasā । bhārāvataraṇāyaiva cā''virbhūtasya sāṃpratam ।। 21 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śarīradhāriṇaścāpi kuśalapraśnamīpsitam । tatkathaṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ mayi vipra na vidyate ।। 22 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca śarīre prākṛte nātha saṃtataṃ ca śubhāśubham । nityadehe kṣemabīje śivapraśnamanarthakam ।। 23 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca yo yo vigrahadhārī ca sa ca prākṛtikaḥ smṛtāḥ । deho na vidyate vipra tāṃ nityāṃ prākṛtiṃ vinā ।। 24 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca raktabindūdbhavā dehāste ca prākṛtikā smṛtāḥ । kathaṃ prakṛtināthasya bījasya prākṛtaṃ vapuḥ ।। 25 ।। sarvabījasya sarvādirbhavāṃśca bhagavānsvayam । sarveṣāmavatāraṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam ।। 26 ।। kṛtvā vadanti vedāśca nityaṃ satyaṃ sanātanam । jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam ।। 27 ।। māyayā saguṇaṃ caiva māyeśaṃ nirguṇaṃ param । pravadanti ca vedāṅgāstathā vedavidaḥ prabho ।। 28 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca saṃprataṃ vāsudevo'haṃ raktapīryāśritaṃ vapuḥ । kathaṃ na prakṛto vipra śivapraśnamabhīpsitam ।। 29 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvāni yasya lomasu । tasya devaḥ paraṃ brahma vāsudeva itīritaḥ ।। 30 ।। vāsudeveti tannāma vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca । purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu yātrādiṣu ca dṛśyate ।। 31 ।। raktavīryāśrito dehaḥ kva te vede nirūpitaḥ । sākṣiṇo munayaścaiva dharmaḥ sarvatra eva ca ।। 32 ।। sākṣiṇo mama vedāśca ravicandau ca saṃpratam ।। 33 ।। bhṛguruvāca satyaṃ vadasi tvameva vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ । svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ śaśvatkiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ ।। 34 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca śrūyatāṃ munayaḥ sarve śrūyatāṃ kṛṣṇa sāṃpratam । aho yena nimittena cātiśīghramihā''gataḥ ।। 35 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca bhagavanmarvadharmajña kiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ । sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña tvameva viduṣāṃ varaḥ ।। 36 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca dhanyo'si bhagavañchaśvanmānyo'si jagatāmapi । sarveśvareśvaro'si tvaṃ tatparo nāsti viśvataḥ ।। 37 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca yajñānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasyānāṃ dvijeśvara। satataṃ phaladātā'haṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ya ।। 38 ।। iti śrutvā kumāraśca javena prayayau vane । matvā''ścarya ca vacanaṃ vārayāmāsa te'pitam ।। 39 ।। ṛṣaya ūcuḥ he siddhendra mahābhāga kumāra karuṇāmaya । kā śaṅkitakathā proktā bhagavatkṛṣṇasaṃnidhau ।। 40 ।। kiṃ putra dṛṣṭamāścarya śrutaṃ kimapi kutracit । atīva kṛtvā vistīrṇamasmākaṃ vaktumarhasi ।। 41 ।। eta sminnnatare brahmā pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ । anantaścāpi dharmaśca śrīsūryaśca niśākaraḥ ।। 42 ।। ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālādyāśca devatāḥ । śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sahasotthāya saṃbhādhya capṛthakpṛthaku ।। 43 ।। madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ । praṇesurṛṣayaḥ sarve śeṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ vidhiṃ śivām ।। 44 ।। parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣā babhūva dvijadevayoḥ । samuvāsā''sane madhye kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ ।। kayāṃ kathitumārebhe saṃsadi dvijadevayoḥ ।। 45 ।। mayā gataśca goloko na dṛṣṭo rādhikāpatiḥ । tato gataṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra nāsti caturbhujaḥ ।। 46 ।। tato gataśca kṣīrodastatra nāsti hariḥ svayam । pariśrānto viṣaṇṇaśca snātaṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe ।। 47 ।। vistīrṇavālukāmadhye kacchapaḥ śatayojanaḥ । bhītaśca kampitastatra dṛṣṭo duḥkhī ca śuṣkitaḥ ।। 48 ।। niḥsārito rāghaveṇa mīnena ca mahātmanā । dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca nāhaṃ dhanya uvāca saḥ ।। 49 ।। kṣīrodaḥ sāgaro dhanyo jantavo yatra madvidhāḥ । matto mahattarāścāpi hyasaṃkhyāśca mahāmune ।। 50 ।। bhavāndhanyo'sti kṣīroda tenokto nāhameva ca । dhanyā vasuṃdharā devī yatraiva saptasāgarāḥ ।। 51 ।। dhanyā'si vasudhetyuktā nāhamevetyuvāca sā । dhanyo'nanto mamā''dhāraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo nāgarāḍvibhuḥ ।। 52 ।। mahasramūrdhnā madhye'haṃ mūrdhni śūrpe ca sarṣapaḥ । dhanyo'si śeṣetyukto'yaṃ dhanyo nāhamuvāca vai ।। 53 ।। dhanyaḥ kūrmo mamā''dhāro gaccha tatraiva vai mune । dhanyo'si kūrmetyukto'yaṃ nāraṃ dhanyo'smi vai mune ।। 54 ।। vāyunā dhāryamāṇo'haṃ matto dhanyatamaśca saḥ । dhanyo'sītyuktaḥ pavano dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ ।। 55 ।। dhanyaśca bhagavānbrahmā vidhātā jagatāmapi । dhanyo'si tatra dhātā ca dhanyo nāhamuvācasaḥ ।। 56 ।। dhanyo maheśvaro devo yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ । sarvārādhyaḥ sarvapūjyo dharmarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 57 ।। kālakālaśca saṃhartā svayaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaḥ prabhuḥ । dhanyo'si tatra śaṃbhuśca dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ ।। 58 ।। sarvādau pūjanaṃ yasya jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ । dhanyo gaṇeśvaro devo devānāṃ pravaraḥ paraḥ ।। 59 ।। siddhendreṣu munīndreṣu devendreṣu śrutau śrutam । yogīndreṣu ca prājñeṣu na gaṇeśātparaḥ pumān ।। 60 ।। nimnagāsu yathā gaṅagā tīrtheṣu puṣkaraṃ yathā । vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ ।। 61 ।। vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvayaṃ pūjyā vyavasthayā । tasmācchāstrāṇi sarvāṇi purāṇāni ca santi vai ।। 62 ।। yasmānnirūpito dharmaścetihāsaśca saṃhitā । tasmāddhanyāśca te vedā vadantyatra manīṣiṇāḥ ।। 63 ।। yūyaṃ dhanyāśca mānyāścetyuktā vedā mayā tataḥ । ūyuste na vayaṃ dhanyā yajñasaṃghaśya sāṃpratam ।। 64 ।। vayaṃ vyavasthākartāro yajñaughaḥ phaladaḥ svayam । tasmāddhanyaḥ sa evāpi gaccha gaccha mahāmune ।। 65 ।। dhanyo'si yajñasaṃgho'sītyuktastatra mayā vibho । ūcuste na vayaṃ dhanyā dhanyaṃ karma śubhaṃ mune ।। 66 ।। śubhakarmāsi dhanyaṃ tvaṃ nāhaṃ dhanyamuvāca tat । karmaṇāṃ phaladātā yaḥ karmahetuśca sāṃpratam ।। 67 ।। dhāturvidhātā bhagavānsarvādiḥ sarvakārakaḥ । śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā ca dhanyo mānyaścaniścitam ।। 68 ।। dharmālayaṃ tato gatvā na duṣṭvā jagadīśvaram । mathurāmāgato draṣṭuṃ paripūrṇatam prabhum ।। 69 ।। yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva vratānāṃ śubhakarmaṇām । īśvaraṃ phaladātāraṃ paramātmānameva ca ।। 70 ।। kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ puraḥsaram । dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ca ।। 71 ।। ityuktena bhagavatā kathitaṃ sarvakāraṇam । dakṣiṇābhiśca phalado hatayajño ṅyadakṣiṇāḥ ।। 72 ।। dakṣiṇā vipramuddiśya tatkāle tu na dīyate । ekarātre vyatīte tu taddānaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet ।। 73 ।। māse śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ dvimāse tu sahasrakam । saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sa dātā narakaṃ vrajet ।। 74 ।। varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca mūtrakuṇḍe nipatya ca । tataścāṇḍālatāṃ yāti vyādhiyuktaśca pātakī ।। 75 ।। dātrā na dīyate dānaṃ grahītrā cenna gṛhyate । ubhau tau narakaṃ prāptau varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam ।। 76 ।। yajamānaśca cāṇḍālo brahmaṇastatpurohitaḥ । vyādhiyuktāvubhau tau ca pāpinau karmaṇaḥ phalāt ।। 77 ।। sarve devāśca munayo jahasurvismayaṃ yayuḥ । vismayaṃ ca yayau nandastatyāja putrabhāvakam ।। 78 ।। ruroda ca sabhāmadhye lajjāhīnaḥ śucā''kulaḥ । tyaja mauhamitītyuktvā bodhayāmāsa pārvatī ।। 79 ।। nanda uvāca amūlyaratnaṃ māṇikyaṃ yathā kujanmano gṛhe । sthitaṃ tena ca deveśa tathā'haṃ vañcitaḥ prabho ।। 80 ।। mamāparādhaṃ bhagavān kṣamasva prakṛteḥ para । yāsyāmi na punargehaṃ gokulaṃ yamunātaṭam ।। 81 ।। vṛndāvanaṃ tathā''vāsaṃ krīḍāvāsaṃ gadāgraja । tatsarvaṃ ca yaśodāyā gopikāntikameva ca ।। 82 ।। kiṃ bravīmi yaśodāṃ ya preyasīṃ rādhikāmapi । premapātraṃ ca bālaughaṃ vada bhoḥ kathayāmi kim ।। 83 ।। ityuktvā ca sabhāmadhye marcchāṃ saṃprāpa nārada । kroḍe kṛtvā jagannātho bodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।। 84 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 87 ।।
<4.88> athāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇā uvāca cetanaṃ kuru he tāta he tāta cetanaṃ kuru । jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ sacarācaram ।। 1 ।। tyāja mohaṃ mahābhāga māyāṃ stauhi paratparāmā । brahmasvarūpāṃ paramāṃ sarvamohanikṛntanīm ।। 2 ।। muktipradāṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm । tripurasya vadhe ghore mahāyuddhe bhayākule ।। 3 ।। yena stotreṇa saṃbhuśca tayā daityaṃ jaghāna saḥ । stotrarājaṃ pradāsyāmi sarvamohanikṛntanam ।। sarvavāñchāpradaṃ nanda śrūyatāmatra saṃsadi ।। 4 ।। nanda uvāca sarvavighnavināśāya duḥkhapraśamanāya ca । vibhūtaye ca yaśase nṛṇāṃ vāñchitasiddhaye ।। 5 ।। stotramekaṃ mahādevyā jaganmāturjagatprabho । paraṃ durgatināśinyā gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham ।। 6 ।। dehi marhya vinītāya bhaktāya bhaktavatsala । vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca nirguṇāśca parātparaḥ ।। 7 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca śruṇu vakṣyāmi daiśyendra stotraṃ yatparamādbhutam । sarvavighnavināśārthaṃ mohapāśanikṛntanam ।। 8 ।। raṇatrastena vibhunā śaṃkareṇa purā kṛtam । nārāyaṇopadeśena preritena ca brahmaṇā ।। 9 ।। śatrugrastaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa brahmāṇamuvāca ha । uvāca śaṃkaraṃ brahmā rathasthaṃ patitaṃ raṇe ।। 10 ।। surasaṃkaṭaśāntyarthaṃ durgā durgatināśinīm । mūlaprakṛtimādyāṃ tāṃ stau(stu) hi brahmasvarūpiṇīm ।। 11 ।। hariṇā prerito'haṃ ca tvāṃ vadāmi sureśvara । vinā śaktisahāyena ko vā kaṃ jetumīśvaraḥ ।। 12 ।। brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā durgāṃ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ । puṭāñjaliparo bhūtvā bhaktinamratmakaṃdharaḥ ।। 13 ।। snātaḥpādau ca prakṣālya dhṛtvā dhaute vāsasī । ācāntaḥ kuśahastaśca śucirviṣṇuṃ ca saṃsmaran ।। 14 ।। mahādeva uvāca rakṣa rakṣa mahādevi durge durgatināśini । māṃ bhaktamanuraktaṃ ca śatrugraste kṛpāmayi ।। 15 ।। viṣṇumāye mahābhāge nārāyaṇi sanātani । brahmasvarūpe parame nityānandasvarūpiṇi ।। 16 ।। tvaṃ ca brahmādidevānāmambike jagadambike । tvaṃ saṃhāre ca guṇato nirākāre ca nirguṇāt ।। 17 ।। māyayā puruṣastvaṃ ca māyayā prakṛtiḥ svayam । tayoḥ paraṃ brahma paraṃ tvaṃ bibharṣi sanātani ।। 18 ।। vedānāṃ jananī tvaṃ ca sāvitrī ca parātparā । vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīḥ sarvamaṃpatsvarūpiṇī ।। 19 ।। martyalakṣmīśca kṣīrode kāminī śeṣaśāyinaḥ । svargeṣu svargalakṣmīstvaṃ rājalakṣmīśca bhūtale ।। 20 ।। nāgādilakṣmīḥ pātāle gṛheṣu gṛhadevatā । sarvasasyasvarūpā tvaṃ sarvaiśvaryavidhāyinī ।। 21 ।। rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ brahmaṇaśca sarasvatī । prāṇānāmadhidepī tvaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 22 ।। goloke ca svayaṃ rādhā śrīkṛṣṇasyaiva vakṣasi । golokādhiṣṭhitā devī dṛndā dṛndāvane vane ।। 23 ।। śrīrāsamaṇḍale ramyā vṛndāvanavinodinī । śataśṛṅgādhidevī tvaṃ nāmnā citrāvalīti ca ।। 24 ।। dakṣakanyā kutrakalpe kutrakalpe ca śailajā । devamātā'ditistvaṃ ca sarvādhārā vasuṃdharā ।। 25 ।। tvameva gaṅgā tulasī tvaṃ ca svāhā satī । tvadaṃśāṃśāṃśakalayā sarvadevādiyoṣitaḥ ।। 26 ।। strīrūpaṃ cātipuṃrūpaṃ devi tvaṃ ca napuṃsakam । vṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛṅarūpā tvaṃ sṛṣṭā cāṅkurarūpiṇī ।। 27 ।। vahnau ca dāhikā śaktirjale śaityasvarūpiṇī । sūrye tejaḥ svarūpā ca prabhārūpā ca saṃtatam ।। 28 ।। gandharūpā ca bhūmau ca ākāśe śabdarūpiṇī । śobhāsvarūpā candre ca padmasaṃghe ca niścitam ।। 29 ।। sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭisvarūpā ca pālane paripālikā । mahāmārī ca saṃhāre jale ca jalarūpiṇī ।। 30 ।। kṣuttavaṃ dayā tvaṃ nidrā tvaṃ tṛṣṇā tvaṃ buddhirūpiṇī । tuṣṭistvaṃ cāpi puṣṭistvaṃ śraddhāstvaṃ ca kṣamā svayam ।। 31 ।। śāntistvaṃ ca svayaṃ bhrāntiḥ kāntistavaṃ kīrtireva ca । lajjā tvaṃ ca tathā māyā bhuktisuktisvarūpiṇī ।। 32 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā tvaṃ sarvasaṃbatpradāyinī । vede'nirvacanīyā tvaṃ tvāṃ na jānāti kaścana ।। 33 ।। sahasra vaktrastvāṃ stotuṃ na ca śaktaḥ sureśvari । vedā na śaktāḥ ko vidvānna ca śaktā sarasvatī ।। 34 ।। svayaṃ vidhātā śakto na na ca viṣṇuḥ manātanaḥ । kiṃ staumi pañcavaktraistu raṇatrasto maheśvari ।। 35 ।। kṛpāṃ kuru mahāmāye mama śatrukṣayaṃ kuru । ityuktvā ca sakaruṇaṃ rathasthe patite raṇe ।। 36 ।। āvirbabhūva sā durgā sūryakoṭisamaprabhā । nārāyaṇena kṛpayā preritā paramātmanā ।। 37 ।। śivasya purataḥ śīghraṃ śivāya ca jayāya ca । ityuvāca mahādevī māyāśaktyā'suraṃ jahi ।। 38 ।। durgovāca varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam । bhavānvaraḥ surāṇāṃ ca jayaṃ tubhyaṃ dadāmyaham ।। 39 ।। mahādeva uvāca kṣayo bhavatu daityasya iti me varamīśvarī । dehīti vāñchitaṃ durge paramādye malātani ।। 40 ।। bhagavatyuvāca hariṃ smara mahābhāgā jaya daityaṃ jagadguruḥ । svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavāṃstvameva jyotirīśvaraḥ ।। 41 ।। etasminnantare viṣṇurvṛṣarūpo babhūva ha । dadhāra kalayā mūrdhnā śūlapāṇe rathaṃ vibhuḥ ।। 42 ।। ūrdhvacakramathograṃ ca prakṛtiṃ ca cakāra saḥ । śastraṃ dadau mantrapūtamuddadhāra tato ratham ।। 43 ।। śivaḥ śastraṃ gṛhītvā ca dhyātvā viṣṇuṃ maheśvarīm । jaghāna tripuraṃ śīghraṃ sa papāta mahītale ।। 44 ।। tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ devāścakuśca puṣpavarṣaṇam । durgā tasmai dadau śūraṃ pinākaṃ viṣṇureva ca ।। 45 ।। brahmā śubhāśiṣaṃ caiva munayaścāpi harṣitāḥ । nanṛturdevatāḥ sarvā jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ ।। 46 ।। etasminnantare tāta stavarājamanuttamam । vighnavighnakaraṃ śīghraṃ śatrusaṃhārakāraṇam ।। 47 ।। paramaiśvaryajanakaṃ sukhadaṃ paramaṃ śubham । nirvāṇamokṣadaṃ caiva haribhaktipradaṃ dhruvam ।। 48 ।। golokavāsadaṃ caiva sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam । stotrarājaprapaṭhanātprasannā pārvatī sadā ।। 49 ।। lobhamohakāmakrodhakarmamūlanikṛntanam । balabuddhikaraṃ caiva janmamṛtyuvināśanam ।। 50 ।। dhanaputrapriyābhūmisarvasaṃpatpradaṃ nṛṇām । śokaduḥkhaharaṃ caiva sarvāmiddhipradaṃ varam ।। 51 ।। stotrarājaprapaṭhanānmahāvandhyā prasūyate । vandhanānmucyate duḥkhī bhayānmucyeta niścitam ।। 52 ।। rogādvimucyate rogī daridraśca dhanī bhaven । dāvāgnimadhye na mṛto magnaḥ poto mahārṇave ।। 53 ।। dasyugrasto nipugrasto hiṃsrajantusamanvitaḥ । stotreṇānena vaiśyendra kalyāṇaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। 54 ।। taijasānāṃ yathā ratnamāśramāṇāṃ dvijo yathā । nadīnāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā mantrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā ।। 55 ।। tulasī sarvapatrāṇāṃ dharāṇāṃ ca vasuṃdharā । puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaṃ ca kāṣṭhānāṃ candanaṃ yathā ।। 56 ।। viṣṇupūjā ca tapasāṃ vrateṣvekādaśī yathā । jñānināṃ ca yathā śaṃbhuḥ siddhānāṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 57 ।। devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvedāḥ śāstreṣu tantrataḥ । devīnāṃ ca yathā durgā śāntānāṃ kamalā yathā ।। 58 ।। sarasvatī ca viduṣāṃ rādhikā sundarīṣu ca । tathā stotreṣvidaṃ stotraṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ vraja ।। 59 ।। purā dattaṃ brahmaṇe ca puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi । daityagrastāya bhītāya sarvadurgaharaṃ param ।। 60 ।। śivāya śatrugrastāya dadau brahmā madājñayā । śivaśca sanakādibhyaḥ purā durvāsase dadau ।। 61 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānkṛpayā gautamāya ca । pulahāya pulastyāya dadau cāṅgirase mudā ।। 62 ।। tathā yandrāya sūryāya sūryaścāpi yamāya ca । yamāśca citraguptāya kṛpayā ca purā dadau ।। 63 ।। nityaṃ paṭhiṣyasi stotraṃ golokagamanāya vai । sākṣātpaśyasi bho tāta tāmeva pārvatīmiha ।। 64 ।। yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ pāpine gopanaṃ kuru । nārāyaṇasya bhaktāya śāntāya viduṣe tathā ।। 65 ।। sarvajñāya ca viprāya dātavyaṃ ca prayatnataḥ । viprāya vṛṣavāhāya vṛṣalīvataye tathā ।। 66 ।। śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārāya śūdrakṣāddhānnabhojine । kanyāvikraciṇe caiva brāhmaṇāya viśeṣataḥ ।। 67 ।। sarvasiddhiṃ ca labhate siddhastotre bhavedyadi । daśāyutajapenaiva siddhastotro bhavennaraḥ ।। 68 ।। agnistamabhaṃ jalastambhaṃ mṛtstambhaṃ manasastathā । aśvamedhasahasrācca pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇāt ।। 69 ।। snānācca sarvatīrthānāṃ stotrametacca puṇyadam । dattaṃ tubhyaṃ mayā tāta mama prāṇasamaṃ vraja ।। 70 ।। stavanaṃ kuru pārvatyāścedānīṃ mama saṃsadi । śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā nandastuṣṭāva pārvatīm ।। 71 ।। stotreṇānena viprendra sarvasaṃpatpradāyinīm । varaṃ tasmai dadau durgā golokavāsamīpsitam ।। 72 ।। durlabhaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ vede yanna śrutaṃ mune । rājendratvaṃ gokule ca kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ।। 73 ।। taddāsvaṃ cāvi parato mahattvaṃ siddhameva ca । varaṃ dattvā yayau durgā saṃbhāṣya śaṃbhunā saha ।। 74 ।। jagmurdevāśca munayaḥ stutvā ca nandanandanam । uvāca nandaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vraja nanda vrajānvitaḥ ।। prahaṣṭastyaktamohaśca bodhena durlabhena ca ।। 75 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣmajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 88 ।।
<4.89> atha navāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca gaccha gaccha gṛhaṃ gaccha vrajarāja vrajaṃ vraja । sarvaṃ tattvaṃ tvayā jñātaṃ dṛṣṭāśca munayaḥ surāḥ ।। 1 ।। śrutaṃ me dhanyamākhyānaṃ nānākhyānaṃ sudurlabham । durgāyāḥ stotrarājaṃ ca janmapāśanikṛntanam ।। 2 ।। sthitaṃ tate nigaditaṃ harṣeṇa ca sukhena ca । matkṛtaṃ bālabhāvena cāparāddhaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam ।। 3 ।। yatsukhaṃ na kṛtaṃ tāta pitrośca nṛpamandire । kṛtaṃ sukhaṃ tatparaṃ ca svargādapi sudurlabham ।। 4 ।। madīyaṃ priyavākyaṃ ca prahvatvaṃ vinayaṃ nayam । parihāsaṃ bahataraṃ yaśodāṃ gopikāgaṇam ।। 5 ।। bālakānāṃ samūhaṃ ca rādhāṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ । ekatra ca sthitaṃ teṣu bandhuvargeṣu karmaṇā ।। 6 ।। ihaivāpi sukhaṃ bhuktvā gaccha golokamuttamam । sārdha yaśodayā tāta rohiṇyā gopikāgaṇaiḥ ।। 7 ।। gopānāṃ bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛṣabhānena gopakaiḥ । rādhāmātrā kalāvatyā rādhayā saha yāsyasi ।। 8 ।। rathānāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca golokādāgataṃ pitaḥ । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ hīrahārapariṣkṛtam ।। 9 ।। maṇimāṇikyamuktānāṃ mālājālavibhūṣitam । vahniśuddhāṃśukai ramyairācchannaṃ pītavarṇakaiḥ ।। 10 ।। pārṣadapravarai ramyairveṣṭitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ । sadratnadarpaṇai ramyairgopikābhiśca gopakaiḥ ।। 11 ।। veṣṭitaṃ ca tadāruhya kautukādyāsyasi dhruvam । tyaktvā ca pārthivaṃ dehaṃ divyadehaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 12 ।। ayonisaṃbhavā rādhā rādhāmātā kalāvatī । yāsyatyeva hi tenaiva nityadehena niścitam ।। 13 ।। pitṛṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā kalāvatī । dhanyā ca sītāmātā ca durgāmātā ca menakā ।। 14 ।। ayonisaṃbhavā durgā tārā sītā ca sundarī । ayonisaṃbhavāstāśca dhanyā menā kalāvatī ।। 15 ।। ityeva kathitaṃ tāta gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham । varo'yaṃ tattastubhyaṃ ca mayā ca durgayā tathā ।। 16 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vrajeśvaraḥ । punareva jagannāthaṃ ta dbhakto bhaktavātsalam ।। 17 ।। nanda uvāca yugānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca yaṃ yaṃ dharma sanātanam । krameṇa kṛṣṇa vistīrṇaṃ kṛtvā māṃ kathaya prabho ।। 18 ।। kaliśeṣe bhavedyadyadguṇadoṣaṃ kalestathā । kā gatirvā pṛthivyāśca dharmasya praṇināṃ tathā ।। 19 ।। nandasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ kamalalocanaḥ । kathāṃ kathitumārebhe vicitrāṃ madhurānvitām ।। 20 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇa janmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 89 ।।
<4.90> atha navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣyami sānandaṃ mānasaṃ yathā । kathāṃ ramyāṃ sumadhurāṃ purāṇeṣu pariṣkṛtām ।। 1 ।। paripūrṇatamo dharmo dhārmikāśca kṛte yuge ।
