paripūrṇatamaṃ satyaṃ paripūrṇatamā dayā ।। 2 ।। atīva prajvaladrūpā vedāścatvāra eva ca । vedāṅgāścāpi pipidhāsāścetihāsāca saṃhitāḥ ।। 3 ।। purāṇāni suramyāṇi pañcarātrāṇi pañca ca । rucirāṇi subhadrāṇi dharmaśāstrāṇi yāni ca ।। 4 ।। viprā vedavidaḥ sarve puṇyavantastapasvinaḥ । nārāyaṇaṃ te dhyāyanti tanmantraṃ ca japanti ca ।। 5 ।। brāhmaṇāḥkṣatriyā vaiśyāśyaturvarṇāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ । śūdrā brāhmaṇabhṛtyāśca satyadharmaparāyaṇācha ।। 6 ।। rājāno dhārmikāścaiva prajāpālanatatparāḥ । gṛhṇāntyeva prajānāṃ ca ṣoḍaśāṃśakarāṣṛpāḥ ।। 7 ।। karaśūnyāśca viprāśca pūjyāḥ svacchandagāminaḥ । tataṃ sarvasasyāḍhyā ratnādhārā vasuṃdharā ।। 8 ।। gurubhaktāśca śiṣyāśca pitṛbhaktāḥ sutāstathā । yoṣitaḥ patibhaktāśca pativrataparāyaṇāḥ ।। 9 ।। ṛtau saṃbhoginaḥ sarve na strīlubdhā na lammapaṭāḥ । na bhayaṃ dasyucauryāṇāṃ na tatra pāradārikāḥ ।। 10 ।। taravaḥ pūrṇaphalinaḥ pūrṇakṣīrāśca dhenavaḥ । balavanto janāḥ sarve dīrghāḥ saundaryasaṃyutāḥ ।। 11 ।। lakṣavarṣāyuṣaḥ kecitpuṇyavanto kṣyarogiṇaḥ । yathā viprā viṣṇubhaktā strivarṇāṃ viṣṇusevinaḥ ।। 12 ।। jalapūrṇā nadā nadyaḥ saṃtataṃ kaṃdarāstathā । tīrthapūtāścaturvarṇāstapaḥ pūtā dvijātayaḥ ।। 13 ।। manaḥpūtāśca nikhilāḥ khalahīnaṃ jagattrayam । satkīrtiparibūrṇaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ maṅgalānvitam ।। 14 ।। pitaraḥ sarvakāleṣu tithikāleṣu devatāḥ । sarvakāleṣvatithayaḥ pūjitāśca gṛhe gṛhe ।। 15 ।। trivarṇā viprabhaktāśca viprabhojatatparāḥ । brāhmaṇasya mukhaṃ kṣetramanūṣaramakaṇṭakam ।। 16 ।। nārāyaṇotkīrtanena harṣayuktāstadutsave । na śatravo janānāṃ ca sarve sarvaṃhitaiṣiṇaḥ ।। 17 ।। nā''tmapraśaṃsakāḥ kecitsarve paraguṇotsukāḥ । na devānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca viduṣāṃ tatra nindakāḥ ।। 18 ।। puruṣā yoṣitaścāpi na hi sūrkhāśca paṇḍitāḥ । na duḥkhino janāḥsatye sarveṣāṃ ratnamandiram ।। 19 ।। maṇimāṇikyaratnaugharatnasvarṇasamanvitam । na bhikṣukā na rogārtāḥ śokahīnāścaharṣitāḥ ।। 20 ।। na hi bhūṣaṇahīrāśca narā nāryaśca kecana । na pāpino na dhūrtāśca na kṣudhārtā na kutsitāḥ ।। 21 ।। jarāhīnāḥ prāṇinaśca śaśvadyauvanasaṃsthitāḥ । ādhivyādhivihīnāśca nirvikārāśca dehinaḥ ।। 22 ।। yadukto vai satyayuge dharmaḥ satyaṃ dayādikam । pādahīnaśca tretāyāṃ satyārdha dvāpare'pi ca ।। 23 ।। dharmai kapācca prathame kaleścātikṛśo'balaḥ । duṣṭānāṃ dasyucauryāṇāmaṅkuraḥ prabhavedvraja ।। 24 ।। adharmaniratāḥ kecidbhītāḥ saṃgopinastathā । bhītā guptāśca puṃścalyau bhītāśca pāradārikāḥ ।। 25 ।। dharmiṣṭhānāṃ bhayaṃ śaśvadadharmiṣṭhāśca kampitāḥ । svalpadharmaratā bhūpāḥ svalpavedaratā dvijāḥ ।। 26 ।। vratadharmaratāḥ kecitsarve svacchandagāminaḥ । yāvattiṣṭhanti tīrthāni yāvattiṣṭhanti sādhavaḥ ।। 27 ।। yāvattiṣṭhanti grāmāṇāṃ devāḥ śāstrāṇi pūjanam । tāvatkiṃcittapaḥ satyaṃ svargadharmāśa eva ca ।। 28 ।। kalerdoṣanidhestāta guṇa eko mahānapi। mānasaṃ saṃbhavetpuṇyaṃ sukṛtaṃ na hi dṛṣkṛtam ।। 29 ।। tīrthādike gate tāta naṣṭo dharmāśa eva ca । kalārūpaśca dharmaśca yathā kuhvāṃ niśākaraḥ ।। 30 ।। nanda uvāca tīrthānyetāni sarvāṇi tiṣṭhantyeva kiyaddinam । sādhavo grāmyadevāśca śāstrāṇyetāni vatsaka ।। 31 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca kalau daśasahasrāṇi haristiṣṭhati medinīm । devānāṃ pratimā būjyā śāstrāṇi ca purāṇakam ।। 32 ।। tadardhamapi tīrthāni gaṅgādīni suniścitam । tadardha grāmadevāśca vedāśca viduṣāmapi ।। 33 ।। adharmaḥ paribūrṇaśca tadante ca kalau pitaḥ । ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti varṇāścatvāra eva ca ।। 34 ।। na mantrapūtodvāhaśca na hi satyaṃ na ya kṣamā । strīsvīkārarato nityaṃ grāmyadharmapradhānataḥ ।। 35 ।। na yajñasūtraṃ tilakaṃ brāhmaṇanāṃ ca nityaśaḥ । saṃdhyāśāstravihīnāśca vipravaṃśāḥśrutā api ।। 36 ।। sarvaiḥ sārdha ca sarveṣāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ niyamacyutam । abhakṣyabhakṣā lokāśca caturvarṇāśca lampaṭāḥ ।। 37 ।। nārīṣu na satī kācitpuṃścalī ca gṛhe gṛhe । karoti tarjanaṃ kāntaṃ bhṛtyatulyaṃ ca kampitam ।। 38 ।। jārāya dattvā miṣṭānnaṃ tāmbūlaṃ vastracandanam । na dadātyeva cā''hāraṃ svāmine duḥkhine pitaḥ ।। 39 ।। putreṇa bhartsitastātaḥ śiṣyeṇa bhartsito guruḥ । prajābhistāḍito bhūpo bhūpena pīḍitāḥ prajāḥ ।। 40 ।। dasyucoreśca duṣṭaiśca śiṣṭāśca paripīḍitāḥ । sasyahīnā ca vasudhā kṣīrahīnāśca dhanevaḥ ।। 41 ।। svalpakṣīre ghṛtaṃ nāsti navanītaṃ ca nityaśaḥ । satyahīnā janāḥ sarve nityaṃ mithyā vadanti ca ।। 42 ।। śaucasaṃdhyāśāstrahīnā brāhmaṇā vṛṣavāhakāḥ । sūpakārāśca śūdrāṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakāḥ ।। 43 ।। śūdrastrīniratāḥ śaśvacchūdrā vipravadhūratāḥ । khādanti yasya viprasya bhakṣyaṃ ca paripācakāḥ ।। 44 ।। mātuḥ parāṃ tasya patnīṃ śūdrā gṛhṇanti lampaṭāḥ । bhṛtyaśca hatvā rājānaṃ svayaṃ rājā bhaviṣyati ।। 45 ।। nārī hatvā patiṃ kāmādbhajejjāraṃ ca kautukāt । putraśca pitaraṃ hatvā svayaṃ bhūpo bhaviṣyati ।। 46 ।। sarve svacchandaniratāḥ śiśnodaraparāyaṇāḥ । vaṅkharā vyādhiyuktāśca kutsitāśca kucailakāḥ ।। 47 ।। vikṣuṇṇamantraliptāśca mithyāmantrapracārakāḥ । jātihīnāśca guravo vayohīnāśca nindakāḥ ।। 48 ।। rājānaścāpi malecchāśca yavanā dharmanindakāḥ । satkīrtimapi sādhūnāṃ kurvantyunmūlanaṃ mudā ।। 49 ।। pitṛdevadvijātīnāmatithīnāṃ ca nityaśaḥ । pūjā nāsti gurūṇāṃ ca pitrośca pūjanaṃ striyāḥ ।। 50 ।। strībandhūnāṃ gauravaṃ ca strīṇāṃ ca satataṃ pitaḥ । coraḥ satkulajātiśca brahmadevasvahārakaḥ ।। 51 ।। mānaṃ vahanti lobhena yugadharmeṇa kautukāt । devāyatanahīnaṃ ca jagatsarva bhayākulam ।। 52 ।। arājakaṃ ca durnītaṃ saṃtataṃ kalidoṣataḥ । bubhṛkṣitāḥ kucailāśca daridrā vyādhino narāḥ ।। 53 ।। kapardakaghaṭādhyakṣo rājendro hi ghaṭeśvaraḥ । vṛddhāṅguṣṭasamā lokā vṛkṣāḥśākasamāstathā ।। 54 ।। tālānāṃ nārikelāṇāṃ panasānāṃ tathaiva ca । phalāni sarṣapāṇyeva tatkṣudraṃ ca tataḥ param ।। 55 ।। jalabhājanapātreṇa sasyena vāsasā tathā । vihīnaṃ mandiraṃ sarvaṃ gṛhāṇāmapariṣkṛtam ।। 56 ।। gandhakena parivṛtaṃ dīpahīnaṃ tameyutam । hiṃsrajantubhayādbhītā janāḥ sarve ca pāpinaḥ ।। 57 ।। sarve ca kalahāviṣṭā puṃścalyaḥ kalahapriyāḥ । rūpavatyo na kāminyo narāścāpi na rūpiṇaḥ ।। 58 ।। nadyo nadāḥ kaṃdarāśca taḍāgāśca sarovarāḥ । jalapadmavihīnāśca jalahīnā dhanāstathā ।। 59 ।। apatyahīnā nāryaśca kāmukyo jārasaṃyutāḥ । aśvatthacchedinaḥ sarve vṛkṣahīnā vasuṃdharā ।। 60 ।। phalahīnāśca taravaḥ śākhāḥ skandhavihīnakāḥ । phalāni svāduhīnāni cānnāni ca jalāni ca ।। 61 ।। mānavāḥ kaṭuvaktāro nirdayā dharmavarjitāḥ । tadante dvādāśādityāḥ saṃhariṣyanti mānavān ।। 62 ।। sarvāñjantuṃśca tāpena bahuvṛṣṭyā vrajeśvara । avaśiṣṭā ca pṛthivī kathāmātrāvaśeṣitā ।। 63 ।। kalau gate ca pṛthivī kṣetraṃ varṣāgate tathā । punaḥ satyapravṛttiśca bhaviṣyati krameṇa vai ।। 64 ।। ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ gaccha tāta vrajaṃ sukham । ahaṃ dugdhamukho bālaḥputraste kathayāmi kim ।। 65 ।। navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi takraṃ pariṣkṛtam । svastikaṃ śubhakarmārhaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam ।। 66 ।। miṣṭadravyaṃ ca yatkiṃcitpitṛdevanimittakam । bhuktaṃ balācca tatsarva bālānāṃ rodanaṃ balam ।। 67 ।। tatkṣamasvāparādhaṃ me bāladoṣaḥ pade pade । tvaṃ pitā tava putro'haṃ yaśodā jananī mama ।। 68 ।। madīyaṃ parihāsaṃ ca yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ vada । kumārāsyācchrutaṃ sarva so'hamityevamīpsitam ।। 69 ।। kīrtayiṣyasi tatsarva sarva gokulavāsinam । kālaḥ karoti sasairga bandhūnāṃ bandhubhiḥ saha ।। 70 ।। kālaḥ karoti vicchedaṃ virodhaṃ prītimeva ca । kālaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ ca kurute kālaśca paripālanam ।। 71 ।। kālaḥ karoti sānandaṃ kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ । sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ ca janma ca ।। 72 ।। sarvaṃ karmānurodhena kāla eva karoti ca । sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ tāta vismayaṃ na vrajaṃ vraja ।। 73 ।। kutastvaṃ gokule vaiśyo nando vaiśyādhipo nṛpaḥ । vasudevasuto'cahaṃ ca mathurāyāmaho kutaḥ ।। 74 ।। pitā me kaṃsabhītena tvadgṛhe ca samapritaḥ । pitu paraḥ pitā tvaṃ ca mātā mātuḥ parā'pivā ।। 75 ।। mayā dattena jñānena pārvatyā ca vrajeśvara । tyaja mohaṃ mahābhāga gaccha tāta sukhaṃ gṛham ।। 76 ।। nanda uvāca smara vṛndāvanaṃ tāta ramyaṃ puṇyaṃ mahotsavam । gokulaṃ gokulaṃ ramyaṃ sundaraṃ yamunātaṭam ।। 77 ।। ramaṇīnāṃ suramyaṃ ca tvatpriyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam । gopālikā gopabālānyaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ priyām ।। 78 ।। prāṇādhikāṃ rādhikāṃ na kathaṃ smarasi putraka । vāramekaṃ svalpadinaṃ gokulaṃ gaccha vatsaka ।। 79 ।। ityevamuktavā nandaśca kroḍe kṛṣṇaṃ cakāra saḥ । netrāśruṇā ca pūrṇena taṃ siṣeca śucā'nvitaḥ ।। 80 ।। cucumba tadgaṇḍayugaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi mohataḥ । sānandaḥ paramānado bhagavāṃstamuvāca saḥ ।। 81 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavannandasaṃ... navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 90 ।।
<4.91> athaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ śrībhagavānuvāca niṣekena pariṣvaṅgo vibhedastena vā bhavet । kṣaṇena darśanaṃ tena niṣekaḥ kena vāryate ।। 1 ।। gamanāgamanārtha cāpyuddhavaḥ kathayiṣyati । prasthāpayāmi taṃ śīghraṃ vijñāsyasi tataḥ pitaḥ ।। 2 ।। yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ caiva gopikāṃ gopabālakān । prāṇādhikāṃ rādhikāṃ tāṃ gatvā saṃbodhayiṣyati ।। 3 ।। etasminnantare tatra vasudevaśca devakī । baladevaścoddhavaśca tathā'krūraśca satvaram ।। 4 ।। vasudeva uvāca nanda tvaṃ balavāñjñānī sadbandhuśca sakhā mama । tyaja mohaṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha vatsaste'yaṃ yathā mama ।। 5 ।। dūrībhūtā gokulācca mathurā nāsti bāndhava । mahotsave sadānande nanda drakṣyasi putrakam ।। 6 ।। devakyuvāca yathā'yamāvayoḥ putrastathaiva bhavato dhruvam । sālasaḥ kena he nanda śucā deho hi lakṣyate ।। 7 ।। ekādaśābdaṃ sabalaḥ sthitvā te mandire sukham । kathaṃ svalpadinenaiva śokagrasto bhaviṣyasi ।। 8 ।। tiṣṭha putreṇa sārdhaṃ ca mathurāyāṃ kiyaddinam । pūrṇacandrānanaṃ paśya janma tvaṃ saphalaṃ kuru ।। 9 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca ghacchoddhava sukhaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati tava priyam । praharṣa gokulaṃ gatvā yaśodāṃ rohiṇīṃ prasūm ।। 10 ।। gopavālasamūhaṃ ca rādhikāṃ gopikāgaṇam । prabodhayā''dhyātmikena maddattena śucaśchidā ।। 11 ।। nandastiṣṭhatu sānandaṃ manmāturājñayā śucā । nandasthitiṃ sadvinayaṃ yaśodāṃ kathayiṣyasi ।। 12 ।। ityevamuktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pitrā mātrā balena ca । akrūreṇa samaṃ tūrṇa yayāvabhyantaraṃ gṛham ।। 13 ।। uddhavo rajanīṃ sthitvā mathurāyāṃ ca nārada । prabhāte prayayau śīghraṃ ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 14 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradānā... ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 91 ।।
<4.92> atha dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇaprerito hṛṣṭaḥ praṇamya ca gaṇeśvaram । smarannārāyaṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ durgā lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm ।। 1 ।। gaṅgāṃ ca manasi dhyātvā dimīśaṃ taṃ maheśvaram । prajagāmoddhavaścaiva dṛṣṭvā maṅgalamūcakam ।। 2 ।। śuśrāva duṃdubhiṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ śaṅkhadhvaniṃ tathā । hariśabdaṃ ca saṃgītaṃ śuśrāva maṅgaladhvanim ।। 3 ।। patiputravatīṃ sādhvīṃ pradīpaṃ mālyadarpaṇam । paribūrṇatamaṃ kumbhaṃ dadhilājaphalāni ca ।। 4 ।। dūrvāṅkuraṃ śukladhānyaṃ rajataṃ kāñcanaṃ madhu । brāhmaṇānāṃ samūhaṃ ca kṛṣṇasāraṃ vṛṣaṃ ghṛtam ।। 5 ।। sadyomāṃsaṃ gajendraṃ ca nṛpendraṃ śvetaghoṭakam । patākāṃ nakulaṃ cāṣaṃ śuklaṃ puṣpaṃ ca candanam ।। 6 ।। dṛṣṭvaivaṃ pathi kalyāṇaṃ prāpa vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । dadarśa purato vṛkṣaṃ bhāṇḍīre vaṭamakṣayam ।। 7 ।। snigdhaparṇa raktavarṇa puṇyadaṃ tīrthamīpsitam । suveṣānbālakāṃścaiva ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitān ।। 8 ।। vadato balakṛṣṇeti rudataśca śucā'nvitān । tānāśvāsya yayau dūraṃ praviśya nagaraṃ mudā ।। 9 ।। dadarśa nandaśibiraṃ racitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā । maṇiratnavinirmāṇaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ ।। 10 ।। paricchannaṃ manoramyaṃ sadratnakalaśānvitam । dvāraṃ citraṃ vicitrāḍhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca praviveśa saḥ ।। 11 ।। avaruhya rathāttūrṇa tasthau tatprāṅgaṇe mudā । yaśodā rohiṇī śīghraṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ param ।। 12 ।। āsanaṃ ca jalaṃ gāṃ ca madhuparkaṃ dadau mudā । kva nandaḥ kva balaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ satyaṃ tatkathayoddhava ।। 13 ।। uddhavaḥ kathayāmāsa sarva bhadraṃ krameṇa ca । sārdhaṃ ca balakṛṣṇābhyāṃ nandaḥ sānandapūrvakam ।। 14 ।। āyāsyati vilambena kṛṣṇopanayanāvadhi । yuṣmākaṃ kuśalaṃ tatvaṃ vijñāya vidhipūrvakam ।। 15 ।। ahaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ yaśode śṛṇu sāṃpratam । śrṛtvā maṅgalavārtā ca yaśodā rohiṇī mudā ।। 16 ।। brāhmaṇāya dadau ratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vastramīpsitam । uddhavaṃ bhojayāmāsa miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam ।। 17 ।। maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ ca ratnaṃ ca dadau tasmai ca hīrakam । vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa bhadraṃ nānāvidhaṃ tathā ।। 18 ।। brahmaṇānbhojayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam । vedāśca pāṭhayāmāsa paramānandapūrvakam ।। 19 ।। śaṃkaraṃ pūjayāmāsa vipradvārā paraṃ vibhūm । nānopahārairnaivedyaiḥ puṣpadhūpapradīpakaiḥ ।। 20 ।। candanairvastratāmbūlairmadhugavyaghṛtādibhiḥ । bhavānīṃ pūjayāmāsa śrīvṛndāraṇyadevatām ।। 21 ।। ṣoḍaśopacārairdravyairbalibhirvividhairmune । mahiṣāṇāṃ śate śuddhaṃ chāgālānāṃ sahasrakam ।। 22 ।। meṣāṇāmayutaṃ śuddhaṃ yuktamādāya pañcakam । brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svarṇaśataṃ dhenunāṃ ca śataṃ tathā ।। 23 ।। pradadau dakṣiṇāṃ tūrṇa kṛṣṇakalyāṇahetave । uddhavaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaraṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 24 ।। samāśvāsya yaśodāṃ ca rohiṇīṃ gopabālakān । vṛddhāngopālikāḥ sarvāḥ prayayū rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 25 ।। dadarśa rāsaṃ ruciraṃ candramaṇḍalavartulam । śrīrāmakadalīstambhaśatakairupaśobhitam ।। 26 ।। yuktaiśca snigdhavasanaiścandanānāṃ ca pallavaiḥ । paṭṭasūtranibaddhaiśca śrīyuktamālyajālakaiḥ ।। 27 ।। dadhilājaphalaiḥ paṭṭaiḥ puṣpairdūrvāṅkurairapi । candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiḥ parisaṃskṛtam ।। 28 ।। veṣṭitaṃ sakṣitaṃ yatnādgopikānāṃ trikoṭibhiḥ । trilakṣaiḥ sundarai ramyaiḥ saṃsaktaṃ ratimandiraiḥ ।। 29 ।। lakṣagopaiḥ parivṛtaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanaśaṅkitaiḥ । yamunāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā prayayau mālatīvanam ।। 30 ।। candanānāṃ campakānāṃ yūthikānāṃ tathaiva ca । ketakīmādhavīnāṃ ca vanaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ।। 31 ।। bakulānāṃ vañjulānāmaśokānāṃ ca kānanam । mallikānāṃ palāśānāṃ śirīṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 32 ।। dhātrīṇāṃ kāñcanānāṃ ca karṇikānāṃ vanaṃ tathā । nāgeśvarāṇāṃ vipinaṃ lavaṅgānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 33 ।। vanaṃ ca śālatālānāṃ hintālānāṃ vanaṃ tathā । panasānāṃ rasālānāṃ lāṅgalīnāṃ manoharam ।। 34 ।। mandārakānanaṃ ramyaṃ vāmaṃ kṛtvā ca satvaram । dṛṣṭvā kundavanaṃ ramyaṃ saṃprāpya madhukānanam ।। 35 ।। puṃskokilānāṃ śabdena madhureṇa samanvitam । madhuvratasamūhānāṃ madhuradhvanibūritam ।। 36 ।। vanyavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtaṃ mādhvīkādhāramīpsitam । vātena vanyabuṣpāṇāṃ varitaḥ surabhīkṛtam ।। 37 ।। taddṛṣṭvā rājamārgeṇa yaśodoktena sāṃpratam । yayau śīghraṃ nirudvigniṃ rahasyaṃ badarīvanam ।। 38 ।। śrīphalānāṃ ca nimbārnāṃ nāriṅgāṇāṃ vanaṃ tathā । padmānāṃ karavīrāṇāṃ tulasīnāṃ ca kānanam ।। 39 ।। dṛṣṭavā raktimavarṇaṃ ca supakvaphalamīpsitam । tadeva vāmataḥ kṛtvā viveśa kadalīvanam ।। 40 ।। atīva nirjane ramye dadarśa rādhikāśramam । maṇīndrāṇāṃ ca prākāraṃ parikhādurgaveṣṭitam ।। 41 ।। atyagamyaṃ ripūṇāṃ ca mitrāṇāṃ sugamaṃ sukham । gopyaṃ saṃketamārgaṃ ca rakṣakaiḥ parirakṣitam ।। 42 ।। nānācitravicitrāḍhyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā । maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārojjvalaṃ param ।। 43 ।। ratnendrasāraracitaṃ ratnastambhaiḥ suśobhitam । ratnasopānasaṃsaktamandireṇa manoharam ।। 44 ।। amūlyaratnakhacitaṃ kalaśaiḥ pariśobhitam । vāhniśuddhāṃśukābhiśca patākābhiḥ pariṣkṛtam ।। 45 ।। sadratnadarpaṇotkṛṣṭaṃ carcitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ । dadarśa siṃhadvāraṃ ca yuktaṃ ratnakapāṭakaiḥ ।। 46 ।। dvāropari vicitraṃ ca ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । kadambakānanaṃ ramyaṃ tadvāstraharaṇādikam ।। 47 ।। viśvakarmaviracitaṃ suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam । nānāratnakuṭīraṃ ca gopagopīsamanvitam ।। 48 ।। rakṣitaṃ gopikālakṣairvetrahastairmanoharaiḥ । svacchandācaraṇaiḥ śaśvadamitairbalibhirmudā ।। 49 ।। taddvāraṃ purato dṛṣṭvā vilaṅkya ca jagām saḥ । dvitīyaṃ dvāramullaṅghya tasmāduttamamīpsitam ।। 50 ।। dvāraṃ caturthaṃ saṃprāpya sarvasmācca vilakṣaṇam । tatpaścātpañcamaṃ dvāraṃ dadarśa citramuttamam ।। 51 ।। dvāraṣaṭkaṃ ca prayayau sarvatra ruciraṃ param । rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ bhitticitraṃ manoharam ।। 52 ।। daśāvatāraṃ viṣṇośca kṛtrimaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam । yamunājalakeliṃ ca racitāṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 53 ।। gopikānāṃ sahasreṇā ṣaṣṭhaṃ dvāraṃ ca rakṣitam । ratnendrasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitena ca ।। 54 ।। sadratnadaṇḍahastena hīrakairbhūṣitena ca । maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārānvitena ca ।। 55 ।। mādhavī tatpradhānā sā papraccha sāṃprataṃ śivam । dadau pratyuttaraṃ sarvaṃ krameṇa ca sa uddhavaḥ ।। 56 ।। gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa rādhāpriyasakhīgaṇam । sā mādhavī mahāhṛṣṭā tatra saṃsthāpya taṃ mudā ।। 57 ।। śrutvā maṅgalavārtāṃ ca rādhāpriyasakhīgaṇaiḥ । kṛtvā śaṅkhadhvaniṃ ghaṇṭāmṛdaṅgapaṭahasvanam ।। 58 ।। kṛtvā nirmañchanaṃ śīghramuddhavaṃ priyamāgatam । hṛṣṭā praveśayāmāsa rādhābhyantaramuttamam ।। 59 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ gatvā mandiramuttamam । dadarśa purato rādhāṃ kuhvā candrakalopamām ।। 60 ।। supakvapadmanetrāṃ ca śayānāṃ śokamūrcchitām । rudatīṃ raktavadanāṃ vilṣṭāṃ ca tyaktabhūṣaṇām ।। 61 ।। niśceṣṭāṃ ca nirāhārāṃ suvarṇavarṇakuṇḍalām । śuṣkitādharakaṇṭhāṃ ca kiṃcinniḥ śvāsasaṃyutām ।। 62 ।। praṇanāma ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ । pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo bhaktyā bhaktaḥ sa uddhavaḥ ।। 63 ।। uddhava uvāca vande rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ brahmādisuravindatam । yatkīrtiḥ kīrtanenaiva punāti bhuvanatrayam ।। 64 ।। namo gokulavāsinyai rādhikāyai namo namaḥ । śataśṛṅganivāsinyai candrāvatyai na... ।। 65 ।। tulasīvanavāsinya vṛndāraṇyai na... । rāsamaṇḍalavāsinyai rāseśvaryai na... ।। 66 ।। virajātīravāsinyai vṛndāyai ca na... । vṛndāvanavilāsinyai kṛṣṇāyai ca na... ।। 67 ।। namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca śāntāyai ca na... । kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthitāyai ca tatpiyāyai na... ।। 68 ।। namo vaikuṇṭhavāsinyai mahālakṣmyai na... । vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevyai ca sarasvatyai na... ।। 69 ।।sarvaiśvaryādhidevyai ca kamalāyai na... । padmanābhapriyāyai ca padmāyai ca na... ।। 70 ।। mahāviṣṇośca mātre ca parādyāyai na... । namaḥ sindhusutāyai ca martyalakṣmayai na... ।। 71 ।। nārāyaṇapriyāyai ca nārāyaṇyai na... । namo'stu viṣṇumāyāyai vaiṣṇavyai ca na... ।। 72 ।। mahāmāyāsvarūpāyai saṃpadāyai na... । namaḥ kalyāṇarūpiṇyai śubhāyai ca na... ।। 73 ।। mātre caturṇā vedānāṃ sāvitryai ca na... । namo'stu buddhirūpāyai jñānadāyai na... ।। 74 ।। namo durgavināśinyai durgādevyai na... । tejaḥsu sarvadevānāṃ purā kṛtayuge mudā ।। 75 ।। adhiṣṭānakṛtāyai ca prakṛtyai ca na... । namastripurahāriṇyai tripurāyai na... ।। 76 ।। sundarīṣu ca ramyāyai nirguṇāyai na... । mamo nidrāsvarūpāyai nirguṇāyai na... ।। 77 ।। namo dakṣasutāyai ca namaḥ satyai na... । namaḥ śailasutāyai ca pārvatyai ca na... ।। 78 ।। namo namastapasvinyai hyu māyai ca na... । nirāhārasvarūpāyai hyaparṇāyai na... ।। 79 ।। gaurīlaukavilāsinyai namo gauryai na... । namaḥ kailāsavāsinyai māheśvaryaiḥ na... ।। 80 ।। nidrāyai ca dayāyai ca śraddhāyai ca na... । namo dhṛtyai kṣamāryai ca lajjāyai ca na... ।। 81 ।। tṛṣṇāyai kṣutsvarūpāyai sthitikartryai na... । namaḥ saṃhārarūpiṇyai mahāmāryai na... ।। 82 ।। bhayāyaiṃ cābhayāyaiṃ ca muktidāyai na... । namaḥ svadhāyaiṃ svāhāyai śāntayai kāntyai na... ।। 83 ।। namastuṣṭyaiṃ ca puṣṭyai ca dayāyai ca na... । namo nidrāsvarūpāyai śraddhāyai ca na... ।। 84 ।। kṣutpipāsāsvarūpāyai lajjāyaiṃ ca na... । namo dhṛtyaiṃ kṣamāyaiṃ ca cetanāyaiṃ na... ।। 85 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇyai sarvamātre na... । agnau dāhasvarūpāyai bhadrāyai ca na... ।। 86 ।। śobhāyai pūrṇacandre ca śaratpadma na... । nāsti bhedo yathā devi dugdhadhāvalyayoḥsadā ।। 87 ।। yathaiva gandhabhūmyośca yathaiva jalaśaityayauḥ । yathaiva śabdanbhasorjyotiḥ sūryakayoryathā ।। 88 ।। loke vede purāṇe ca rādhāmādhavayostathā । cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi dehi māmuttaraṃ sati ।। 89 ।। ityuktvā coddhavastatra praṇanāma punaḥ punaḥ । ityudvavakṛtaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktipūrvakam ।। 90 ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante harimandiram ।na bhavedbandhuvicchedo rogaḥ śokaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।। 91 ।। proṣitā strī labhetkāntaṃ bhāryābhedī labhetpriyām । aputro labhate putrānnirdhano labhate dhanam ।। 92 ।। nirbhūmirlabhate bhūmiṃ prajāhīno labhetprajām । rogādvimucyate rogī baddhī mucyate bandhanāt ।। 93 ।। bhayānmucyeta bhītastu mucyetā''pannaāpadaḥ । aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। 94 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rādhāstotraṃ nāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 92 ।।
<4.93> atha trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca uddhavastavanaṃ śrutvā cetanāṃ prāpya rādhikā । vilokya kṛṣṇākāraṃ ca tamuvāca śucā'nvitā ।। 1 ।। rādhikovāca kinnāma bhavato vatsa kena vā prerito bhavān । āgato vā kuta iti brūha māṃ kena hetunā ।। 2 ।। kṛṣṇākṛtistvaṃ sarvāṅgairmanye tvāṃ kṛṣṇapārṣadam । kṛṣṇasya suśalaṃ brūhi baradevasya sāṃpratam ।। 3 ।। nandastiṣṭhati tatraiva hetunā kena tadvada । samāyāsyati sovindo ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 4 ।। punardrakṣyāmi tasyaiva pūrṇacandramukhaṃ śubham । punaḥ krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi tenāhaṃ rāsamaṇḍale ।। 5 ।। jale ca vihariṣyāmi punarvā sakhibhiḥ saha । śrīnandanandanāṅge ca punardāsyāmi candanam ।। 6 ।। uddhava uvāca uddavetyabhidhānaṃ me kṣatriyo'haṃ varānane । preṣitaḥ śubhavārtārthaṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। 7 ।। tavāntikaṃ samāyātaḥ pārṣado'haṃ harerapi । kṛṣṇasya baladevasya śivaṃ nandasya sāṃpratam ।। 8 ।। rādhikovāca asti tadyamunākūlaṃ sugandhipavano'sti saḥ । tasya kelikadambānāṃ mūlamastayeva sāṃpratam ।। 9 ।। puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ tadvidyamānamīpsitam । puṃskokilānāṃ virutaṃ talpaṃ candanacarcitam ।। 10 ।। caturvidhaṃ ca bhojyaṃ ca madhupānaṃ ca sundaram । duranto duḥkhado'pyasti pāpiṣṭho manmathastathā ।। 11 ।। te ca ratnapradīpāśca jvalanti rāsamaṇḍale । maṇīndrasāranirmāṇamastyeva ratimandiram ।। 12 ।। gopāṅganāgaṇo'styeva pūrṇacandro'sti śobhitaḥ । sugandhipuṣparacitaṃ talpaṃ candanacarcitam ।। 13 ।। tāmbūlaṃ ratibhogārhaṃ karpūrādisusaṃskṛtam ।sugandhimālatīmālyaṃ śvetacāmaradarpaṇam ।। 14 ।। muktāmāṇikyasaṃsaktahīrahāramanoharam । kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca pātrapūrṇaṃ ca candanam ।। 15 ।। nānopakānanaṃ ramyaṃ ramyakrīḍāsarovaram । sugandhipuṣpodyānaṃ ca padmaśreṇīmanoharam ।। 16 ।। astyevaṃ sarvavibhavaḥ prāṇanāthaḥ kuto mama । hā kṛṣṇa hā rāmānātha kvāsi me prāṇavallabha ।। 17 ।। kva vā'parādho dāsyāśca dāsīdoṣaḥ pade pade । ityevamuktvā sā devī punarmūrcchāmavāpa sā ।। 18 ।। cetanāṃ kārayāmāsa punareva sa uddhavaḥ । tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāścarya mene kṣatriyapuṃgavaḥ ।। 19 ।। sakhībhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ । gopīnāṃ ca trilakṣaiśca supriyaiḥ priyasevitām ।। 20 ।। divāniśaṃ veṣṭitāṃ ca gopīnāṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ । kācitkajjalahastā ca kācinmālyavarā'parā ।। 21 ।। kācitsindūrahastā ca kācidgorocanākarā । kāciccandanapātraṃ ca haste kṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati ।। 22 ।। kāciddarpaṇahastā ca kācitkuṅkumāvahikā । kastūrīpātramiṣṭaṃ ca kācidvahati tatra vai ।। 23 ।। kāciccampakapātraṃ ca kare dhṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati । madhubhirmadhuraiḥ pūrṇaṃ pātraṃ dhṛtvā śucā'nvitā ।। 24 ।। kācitsugandhitailaṃ ca gṛhītvā paritiṣṭhati । kācidvahati tāmbūlaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 25 ।। kācidvāsitamacchaṃ ca jalaṃ dhṛtvā ca tiṣṭhati । krīḍāputtalikāṃ kāciccitrāḍhyāṃ parirakṣati ।। 26 ।। kācidvahati kandūkaṃ kācicca ratnabhūṣaṇam । vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ kācidamūlyaṃ parirakṣati ।। 27 ।। kācidbhakṣayopahāraṃ ca gṛhītvā parivartate । kācicca keśaveśārthakaroti mālyamīpsitam ।। 28 ।। kācitkaṅkatikāṃ dhṛtvā purataḥ paritiṣṭhati । kācidyāvakahastā ca kāciddhātrīrasaṃ mudā ।। 29 ।। dūrato'pi vahatyevaṃ bhītā ca paritiṣṭhati । kācidbhītā bhiyā stautikācidroditi śokataḥ ।। 30 ।। kācittāṃ baudhayetyerva vidagdhā virahāturām । kāciduttāpataptā ca snigdhatalpe manohare ।। 31 ।। sthāpayeddāhadūrārthaṃ snigdhapadmadale śubhe । evaṃbhūtāṃ catāṃ dṛṣṭavā covāca punaruddhavaḥ ।। supriyaṃ karṇapīyūṣaṃ vinayena ca bhītivat ।। 32 ।। uddhava uvāca jāne tvāṃ devadevīśāṃ susnigdhāṃ siddhayoginīm । sarvaśaktisvarūpāṃ ca sūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ।। 33 ।। śrīdāmaśāpāddharaṇīṃ prāptāṃ golokakāminīm । kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikāṃ devīṃ tadvakṣaḥsthalavāsinīm ।। 34 ।। śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi śubhavārtāmabhīpsitām । susthiraṃ sakhibhiḥ sārdhaṃ hṛdayasnagdhikāriṇīm ।। 35 ।। duḥkhadāvāgnidagdhāyāḥ sudhāvarṣaṇarūpiṇīm । virahavyādhiyuktāyā rasāyanasamāṃ śubhām ।। 36 ।। tatra tiṣṭhati nando'yaṃ sānando suditaḥ sadā । nimantritaśca vasunā kṛṣṇopanayanāvadhi ।। 37 ।। gṛhītvā sabalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi । sa nandaḥ paramānando sudā''yāsyati gokulam ।। 38 ।। āgatya kṛṣṇo muditaḥ praṇamya mātaraṃ punaḥ । naktamāyāsyati mudā puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 39 ।। acirāddrakṣyasi sati śrīkṛṣṇamukhapaṅkajam । sarvaṃ virahaduḥkhaṃ ca saṃtyakṣyasi ca sāṃpratam ।। 40 ।। susthirā bhava mātastvaṃ tyaja śokaṃ sudāruṇam । vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ramyaṃ paridhāya praharṣitā ।। 41 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ kuru । gṛhāṇacandanaṃ snigdhaṃ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitam ।। 42 ।। kuruṣva keśasaṃskāraṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam । suveṣaṃ kuru kalyāṇi gaṇḍe ca citrapatrakam ।। 43 ।। sindūrabinduṃ sīmante kastūrīcandanānvitam । alaktakāktaṃ caraṇaṃ yuktaṃ yāvakabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 44 ।। kuruṣva tiṣṭhacotiṣṭha ratnasiṃhāsane vare । sapaṅkapaṅkajaṃ talpaṃ tyaja sārdhaṃ śucā sati ।। 45 ।। bhuṅkṣva kṛṣṇena manasā viśuddhaṃ madhuraṃ madhu । saṃskṛtaṃ bhāsitaṃ toyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam ।। 46 ।। ratnendrasāranirmāṇaparyaṅke mumanohare । vahnisaddhāṃśukākte ca mālatīmālyabhūṣite ।। 47 ।। sugandhiyukte kastūrījātīcampakacandanaiḥ । parito mālatīmālyahīrahāravibhūṣite ।। 48 ।। maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyasundaraiśca pariṣkṛte । puṣpamālyopadhāne ca maṅgalārhe mudā'nvitā ।। 49 ।। śayanaṃ kuru deveśi gopībhiḥ sevitā sadā । karotu sevanaṃ śaśvatpriyāliḥ śvetayāmaraiḥ ।। 50 ।। padāravindasevāṃ ca gopībhaktā manohare । sadratnasāranirmāṇaparyaṅke sumanohare ।। 51 ।। tyevamuktvā sa mune punastūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha । praṇamya pādapadmaṃ ca brahmādisuravanditam ।। 52 ।। uddhavasya vacaḥśrutvā sasmitā rādhikā satī । yautukaṃ ca dadau tasmai ratnasārāṅgulīyakam ।। 53 ।। amūlyaṃ sundaraṃ ramyaṃ viśvakarmavinirmitam । mukhadṛśyaṃ pītavarṇa sudīptaṃ supradīpavat ।। 54 ।। kṛṣṇaya vahninā dattamapūrvaṃ rāsamaṇḍale । maṇikuṇḍalayugmaṃ cāmūlyaratnavinirmitam ।। 55 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ sarvabhūṣaṇamīpsitam । vahniśuddhāṃśukayugaṃ ratnanirmāṇanāyakam ।। 56 ।। hīrahāravinirmāṇaṃ hāraṃ ca sumanoharam । purā dattaṃ ca suprityā kṛṣṇāya varuṇena ca ।। 57 ।। śrīsūryeṇa ca yaddattaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya syamantakam । pradattaṃ kau(yau) tukaṃ tasmai yaddattaṃ hariṇā purā ।। 58 ।। yaddattaṃ ca mahendreṇa ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ varam । tatpradattaṃ mudā debyā tasmai prītyā ca rādhāyā ।। 59 ।। maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ chatraratnaṃ manoharam । muktāmāṇikyasāreṇa hīrahārasamanvitam ।। 60 ।। vicitraratnapadmena vicitraṃ vāruṇaṃ sadā । śobhitaṃ paritaścānyai ratnanirmāṇadarpaṇaiḥ ।। 61 ।। yaddattaṃ brahmaṇa prītyā haraye rāsamaṇḍale । suprītyā rādhayā tatra pradattamuddhavāya ca ।। 62 ।। maṇikāravinirmāṇaṃ maṇirājavirājitam । japāmālyaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ca yaddattaṃ śaṃbhunā purā ।। 63 ।। tadeva dattaṃ tasmai cāpyamūlyaṃ puṇyadaṃ śubham । janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ cātimanoharam ।। 64 ।। candrakāntamaṇiṃ ramyaṃ candradattaṃ pariṣkṛtam । candrāvalīṃ dadau tasmai sudīptaṃ pūrṇacandravat ।। 65 ।। viśuddhaṃ madhupūrṇaṃ ca madhupātraṃ yadakṣayam । dharmeṇa yatpradattaṃ ca taddattaṃ priyayā hareḥ ।। 66 ।। jalabhojanapātraṃ ca śṛdraṃ svarṇavinirmitam । miṣṭānnaṃ paramānnaṃ cadadau susvādumiṣṭakam ।। 67 ।। bhojataṃ kārayitvā ca karpūrādisuvāsitam । tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau śīghraṃ mālyaṃ susnigdhacandanam ।। 68 ।। śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau vāñchitaṃ pravaraṃ varam । jñānaṃ kṛṣṇena yaddattaṃ goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 69 ।। puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ yāvanniścalāṃ kamalāṃ dadau । vidyāṃ yaśaskarīṃ śuddhāṃ yaśaḥ kīrtiṃ sunirmalām ।। 70 ।। sarvasiddhiṃ harerdāsyaṃ haribhaktiṃ ca niścalām । pārṣadapravaratvaṃ ca pārṣadaṃ ca hareriti ।। 71 ।। varaṃ prasādaṃ dattvā ca samutthāya mudā'nvitam । vahniśuddhāṃśuke dhṛtvā cāmūlyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam ।। 72 ।। hīrahāraṃ ratnamālāṃ parighāya manoharām । sindūraṃ kajjalaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ sustigdhacandanam ।। 73 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthaṃ taṃ pūjitā pūjitaṃ mudā । veṣṭitā harṣanirataṃ gaupīnāṃ śātakoṭi bhiḥ ।। taptakāñcanavarṇābhā śatacandrasamaprabhā ।। 74 ।। rādhikovāca satyamāyāsyati hariḥ satyaṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ vada । vada tathyaṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā satyaṃ brūhi susaṃsadi ।। 75 ।। varaṃ kūpaśatādvāpī varaṃ vāpīśatātkratuḥ । varaṃ kratuśatātputraḥ satyaṃ putraśatātkila ।। 76 ।। na hi satyātparo dharmo nānṛtātpātakaṃ param ।। 77 ।। uddhava uvāca satyamāyāsyati hariḥ satyaṃ drakṣyasi sundari । dhruvaṃ tyakṣyasi saṃtāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā candramukhaṃ hareḥ ।। 78 ।। maddarśanānmahābhāge gataste virahajvaraḥ । nānābhogasukhaṃ bhuktvā tyaja cintāṃ duratyayām ।। 79 ।। ahaṃ prasthāpayāsyāmi gatvā madhupurīṃ harim । vidhāya tatprabodhaṃ ca kāryamanyatkariṣyati ।। 80 ।। vidāyaṃ kuru me mātaryāsyāmi harisaṃnidhim । sarvaṃ taṃ kathayiṣyāmi tvadvṛttāntaṃ yathocitam ।। 81 ।। rādhikovāca gamiṣyasi yadā vatsa mathurāṃ sumanoharām । śrṛṇu duḥkhakathāṃ kāṃcittiṣṭha vatsa sthirobhava ।। 82 ।। māṃ vismṛto na bhavasi virahajvarakātarām । kathayiṣya si matkāntaṃ dhruvaṃ prasthāpayiṣyasi ।। 83 ।। nārīṇāṃ manaso vārtāṃ ko vā jānāti paṇḍitaḥ । kiṃcicchāstrānusāreṇa prakaroti nirūpaṇam ।। 84 ।। vedā vaktuṃ na śaktāśca śāstrāṇi kiṃ vadanti ca । katha yiṣyāmi tvāṃ sarvaṃ putra kṛṣṇaṃ ca vakṣyasi ।। 85 ।। gehe vane na bhedo me paśvādiṣu tathā nṛṣu । kiṃ vā jalaṃ kimu svapnamajñānaṃ ca divāniśam ।। 86 ।। ātmānaṃ ca na jānāmi caudayaṃ candrasūryayoḥ । kṣaṇaṃ prāpya harervārtāṃ cetanaṃ me babhūva ha ।। 87 ।। kṛṣṇākṛtiṃ ca paśyāmi śrṛṇomi muralīdhvanim । kulaṃ lajjāṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā cintayāmihareḥ padam ।। 88 ।। saṃprāpya sarvajagatāmīśvaraṃ prakṛteḥ param । na jñānaṃ māyayā tasya jñātvā gopapatermaṃma ।। 89 ।। dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ vedā brahmādayaḥ surāḥ । sa bhartsito mayā kīpāddhdi śatyamidaṃ mama ।। 90 ।। tatpadāmbhojasevābhirguṇaprastāvato'pi vā । tadbhaktyā yatkṣaṇo nīto dhyāto dhyānena pūjayā ।। 91 ।। tatrāpi maṅgalaṃ sarvaṃ harṣamāyurvyaṃvasthitam । vighnaṃ ca hṛdi saṃtāpastadvicchede sadoddhava ।। 92 ।। krīḍāprītirnaṃ bhavitā tāduśīṣṭā punarmama । tādṛśaṃ premasaubhāgyaṃ nirjane na ca saṃgamaḥ ।। 93 ।। vṛndāvanaṃ na yāsyāmi tatsaṅge punaruddhava । candanaṃ vā na dāsyāmi nandanandanavakṣasi ।। 94 ।। mālāṃ tasmai na dāsyāmi na drakṣyāmi mukhāmbujam । mālatīnāṃ ketakīnāṃ campakānāṃ ca kānanam ।। 95 ।। punareva na yāsyāmi sundaraṃ rāsamaṇḍalam । harisaṅge na yāsyāmi ramyaṃ candranakānanam ।। 96 ।। punareva na yāsyāmi malayaṃ ratnamandiram । mādhavīnāṃ vanaṃ ramyaṃ rahasyaṃ madhukānanam ।। 97 ।। śrīkhaṇḍakānanaṃ ramyaṃ svacchaṃ candrasarovaram । vispandakaṃ suravanaṃ nandanaṃ puṣpabhadrakam ।। 98 ।। bhadrakaṃ hariṇāṃ sārdhaṃ na yāsyāmi punaḥ punaḥ । kva sā ramyā vikasitā mādhave mādhavīlatā ।। 99 ।। kva gatā mādhavī rātriḥ kva madhuḥ kvāpi mādhavaḥ । isyevamuktvā sā rādhā dhyātvā kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ।। punarmurcchāṃ ca saṃprapya rūdatī pulakānvitā ।। 100 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... nāradanā... śrīkṛṣmajanmakha... uttara... rādhoddhavasaṃ... trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 93 ।।
<4.94> atha caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca uddhavo vismayaṃ prāpya bhayaṃ ca vipulaṃ mune । cetanaṃ kārayāmāsa tāmuvāca mṛtāmiva ।। 1 ।। tadbhaktiṃ samabhijñāya svātmānaṃ bhaktasaṃkhyakam । tucchaṃ mene jagatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāgyavatīṃ satīm ।। 2 ।। uddhava uvāca cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi jaganmātarnamo'stu te । tvameda prāktanaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ drakṣyasi sāṃpratam ।। 3 ।। tvatto viśvaṃ pavitraṃ ca tvatpādarajasā mahī । supavitraṃ tvadvadanaṃ puṇyavatyaśca gopikāḥ ।। 4 ।। lokāstvāmeva gāyanti saṃgītairmaṅgalastavaiḥ । tvatsukīrtiṃ ca devāśca sanakādyāśca saṃtatam ।। 5 ।। kṛtapāpaharāṃ puṇyāṃ tīrthapūjāṃ ca nirmalām । haribhaktipradāṃ bhadrāṃ sarvavighnadināśinīm ।। 6 ।। tvameva rādhā tvaṃ kṛṣṇastvaṃ pumānprakṛtiḥ parā । rādhāmādhavayorbhedo na purāṇe śrutau tathā ।। 7 ।। rādhikāṃ mūrcchitāṃ dṛṣṭvā paścātkṛtvā tamudvavam । uvāca mādhavī gopī rādhāyāḥ purataḥ sthitā ।। 8 ।। mādhavyuvāca kiṃ vā corasya kṛṣṇasya rūpaṃ vā veṣamuttamam । kiṃ sukhaṃ vibhavaṃ kiṃ vā gauravaṃ cāpyanuttamam ।। 9 ।। kiṃ vā tadvīryamaiśvaryaṃ śaurya vā duratikramam । kiṃ vā siddhaṃ prasiddhaṃ vā kiṃ vā tulyaṃ guṇottamam ।। 10 ।। ito vā kuta āyātaḥ punareva kuto gataḥ । bālako gopaveṣaśca nahi rājātmajaḥ pumān ।। 11 ।। tvaṃ kiṃ smarasi kalyāṇi gopālaṃ nandanandanam । ātmānaṃ rakṣayatnena kaḥ priyaḥ svātmanaḥ paraḥ ।। 12 ।। dhiktvāṃ rādhe'tinirlajjāṃ tavaiva jīvanaṃ vṛthā । jagato yuvatīnāṃ ca karoṣi suyaśaḥkṣayam ।। 13 ।। nārīṇāṃ gopanaṃ kārya suvyakte svayaśaḥkṣayam । yatnena cakṣuṣo vā'rhaṃ sakhi saṃcaraṇaṃ kṛru ।। 14 ।। antare patibhāvaṃ ca saṃgopya bhāvanaṃ kuru । na vai jātiśca śatrūṇāṃ mitrāṇāṃ ca sureśvari ।। 15 ।। śatruḥ kāryavaśenaiva mitraṃ ca karmaṇā bhavet । svakāryamuddharetprājñaḥ kāryadhvaṃsena mūrkhatā ।। 16 ।। kaḥ kasya vallabho rādhe kaḥ kasyāpriya eva ca । kāryaṃ ca samayaṃ jñātvā santaḥ kurvanti saṃtatam ।। 17 ।। śatrurdhanāpahārī ca prāṇahartā tataḥ paraḥ । kaṭuvaktā duḥkhadātā śatrūṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śrṛṇu ।। 18 ।। svakulāttvāṃ bahiṣkṛtya visṛjya śokasāgare । gṛhītvā cetanaṃ prāṇānniṣṭhuro dāruṇo gataḥ ।। 19 ।। kiṃ kiṃ smarasimūḍhe hi tyaja śokaṃ sudāruṇam । ātmānaṃ rakṣa yatnena kaḥ priyaḥ svātmanaḥ paraḥ ।। 20 ।। padmāvatyuvāca bhavatā kathitaṃ pūrṇaṃ yamunājalasaṃnidhau । arasasya ratirdūraṃ nārīṇāṃ na sukhaṃ priye ।। 21 ।। vidyujjvārā jale rekhā khalānāṃ prītireva ca । na nītirtītiśāstreṣu suviśvāsaḥ khaleṣu ca ।। 22 ।। yadā tvaṃ yamunākūle mukhaṃ vīkṣya hareraho । sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca punaḥ kṛtvā'sya gopanam ।। 23 ।। punaḥ punastvaṃ saṃvīkṣya tvayā tyaktaṃ ca cetanam । gṛhaṃ tyaktvā gurubhayaṃ sakhīnāṃ vacanaṃ śubham ।। 24 ।। saṃtataṃ dhyāyase kṛṣṇaṃ nā''hāraṃ jīvanaṃ tathā। kva kṛṣṇo mathurāyāṃ ca kvāpi tvaṃ kadalīvane ।। 25 ।। tvaṃ yadi tyajasi prāṇānnā''virbhavati so'dhunā । kāle drakṣyasi svātmānaṃ yadi rakṣasi sundari ।। 26 ।। candramukhyuvāca prāktanena śubhaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaṃ ca vibhavaściram ।duḥkhaṃ śoko prāktanena vipatsaṃpacca sāṃpratam ।। 27 ।। bhārate puṇyabhūmau ca sarveṣāmīpsite vare । labhetpatiṃ hariṃ kāntaṃ tapasā prakṛteḥ param ।। 28 ।। tathā'pi pradahedgātraṃ kāmabāṇena sāṃpratam । asyāḥ śatruḥ kathaṃ candro madhurvā madhumādhavau ।। 29 ।। śaṃkareṇa pradagdho'bhūtpunareva sa manmathaḥ । candraṃ bhakṣatu rāhuśca punaścodvamanaṃ tathā ।। 30 ।। madhuśca mitraśokena prāṇāṃstyaktvā yayauyamam । sudhāsindhuśca cenduryo viṣasindhuśca māṃ prati ।। 31 ।। suveṣaḥ syājjvaladvahniścandanaṃ tad ghṛtāhutiḥ । saṃtataṃ pradahedgātraṃ sugandhiśca samīraṇaḥ ।। 32 ।। tyaktāhārā mama sakhī paśya śvasiti jīvati । praśaṃsāṃkuru kṛṣṇasya mukhena kurunandana ।। 33 ।। tannāmasmṛtimātreṇa tadguṇaśravaṇena ca । tadvārtayā ca śubhayā sahasā cetanaṃ bhavet ।। 34 ।। śaśikalovāca tvaṃ kiṃ mādhavi jānāsi kṛṣṇamātmānamīśvaram । yaṃ taṃ brahmādayo devā vedāścatvāra eva ca ।। 35 ।। dhyāyanti saṃtasaṃ santaḥ pādapadmaṃ surepsitam । padmā sarasvatī durgā so'nanto'pi maheśvaraḥ ।। 36 ।। yaṃ na jānanti siddhendra munīndrāṃ manavastathā । sarvātmanaḥ kuto rūpaṃ nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ ।। 37 ।।satyamuktaṃ ca satyasya yattadeva yathocitam । dhatte bhārāvataraṇe pṛthivyāśca manoharam ।। 38 ।। sukhamāhlādakaṃ ramyaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham । kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ janamanoharam ।। 39 ।। koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ līlādhāma śubhākṣayam । yatpādapadmamadhuraṃ madhu mandākinījalam ।। 40 ।। dadhre śirasi bhaktyā ca sarveśaḥ śaṃkaraḥ paraḥ । śaśvatkaroti vairāgī tīrthakīrteśca kīrtanam ।। 41 ।। kṣaṇaṃ nṛtyati bhaktyā ca pañcavaktreṇa gāyati । āhāraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ vastraṃ parityajya digambaraḥ ।। 42 ।। brahma jyotiḥ svarūpaṃ ca dhyātvā śubhraṃ sunirmalam । brahmā ca tapasā janma nayatyeva hi sevayā ।। śeṣaḥ sanatkumāraśca siddhasaṃghaśya yogavit ।। 43 ।। suśīlovāca nirmañchanārhaṃ na bhavettasya kāmaśataṃ śatam । candro'śivanīkumāro vā rupeṣu kena gaṇyate ।। 44 ।। asaṃkhyeṣu ca viśveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ । munayo manavaḥ siddhā bhaktāḥ santaśca saṃtatam ।। 45 ।। dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ nirguṇasyā''tmanaśca vai । vedāḥ stotuṃ na śaktāśca yamīśaṃ ca sarasvatī ।। 46 ।। jaḍībhūtā ca bhītā ca stavanena kṣamāṇyetu । sahasravaktraḥ stavane kampitaśca nirantaram ।। 47 ।। vedānāṃ janako brahmā stotreṇa tasya hīśvaraḥ । taṃ satyaṃ nityamīśaṃ ca mādhavī parinindati ।। 48 ।। apavitrā sabhā bhūtā gopīnāṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā । tāsu puṇyavatī śokaḥ praṇaśyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 50 ।। ratnamālovaca dadhāra vāmahastena śailaṃ govardhanaṃ hariḥ) । tataḥ kiṃ taddaśaḥ śaurya jagatāṃ janakasya ca ।। 51 ।। śailānāṃ ca sahasraṃ yo bhetuṃ śaktaśca daityarāṭ । līlāmātreṇa teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṃ hantu kṣamo hariḥ ।। 52 ।। yadaṃśakalayā jātaḥ sūkaro viṣṇurīśvaraḥ । vasudhāṃ daśanāgreṇa coddadhāra ca līlayā ।। 53 ।। śailānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi yatra santi mahītale । daityāśca vā'pyasaṃkhyāśca vīrāḥ śūrāstathaiva ca ।। 54 ।। tenaiva karmaṇā tasya na śauryaṃ na ca pauruṣam । na yaśāśca praśaṃsā vā sakhi sarvātmanā''tmanā ।। 55 ।। pārijātovāca saptadvīpā ca vasudhā saśailavanasāgarā । kāñcanībhūmisahitā sarvādhārā manoharā ।। 56 ।। sapta svargāśca vividhā brahmalokāvadhi priye । vicitrāḥ sundarāścaiva pātālānāṃ ca sapta ca ।। 57 ।। etaiḥ parimitaṃ viśvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam । mahadviṣṇorlomakūpe tadevaṃ cāṇuvatsthitam ।। 58 ।। tasya yāvanti lomāni tāni viśvāni santi ca । sa eva ṣoḍaśāṃśaśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 59 ।। tasyaiva kiṃ yaśaḥ śaurcaṃ mahimānamanūpamam ।ghasmarī gopakanyā ca kiṃ vā jānāti mādhavī ।। 60 ।। mādhavyuvāca mayā yaduktaṃ na jñātvā mūḍhā jalpanti gopikāḥ । uddhava śuṇu me vākyaṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ śubham ।। 61 ।। svecchayā saguṇo viṣṇuḥ svecchayā nirguṇobhavet । bhuvo bhārāvataraṇe gopaveṣaḥ śiśurvibhuḥ ।। 62 ।। yadi vedāḥ purāṇāni siddhāḥ santaśca saṃtatam । brahmeśaśeṣabhaktāśca na jānanti yamīśvaram ।। 63 ।। taṃ kiṃ jānāmi mūḍhā'haṃ ghasmarī gopakanyakā । tathā'pi madvacaḥ satyaṃ śrūyatāṃ vatsa tatkṣaṇam ।। 64 ।। kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ śauryaṃ yaśo balam । vīryaṃ veṣaṃ ca siddhiṃ cāpyanyo vā yo guṇo hareḥ ।। 65 ।। svecchāmayasya tasyaiva saguṇasya ca sāṃpratam । kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca vartate tadviśeṣaṇam ।। 66 ।। nirguṇasya ca viṣṇośca vehahīnasya svātmanaḥ । vartate ca kimākhyeyaṃ tasya rūpādikaṃ ca kim ।। 67 ।। māṃ nindati mahāmūḍhā na buddhā vacanaṃ mama । eṣā jānāti kiṃ mūḍhā taṃ satyaṃ prakṛteḥ param ।। 68 ।। jyotiḥ svarūpaṃ paramaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram । tamanirvacanīyaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 69 ।। yatpādapadbhaṃ padmā sā trailokyajananī parā । sevate kampitā bhītā dāsīvatsatataṃ bhiyā ।। 70 ।। viṣṇumāyā ca prakṛtirmūlarūpā sanātanī । brahmasvarūpā paramā bhītā dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ ।। 71 ।। sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā bhītā ca parameśvarī । stotuṃ na śaktā vedāḥ kiṃ stuvanti parameśvaram ।। 72 ।। tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā coddhavo bhaktivihvalaḥ । pulakāñcitasarvāṅgo ruroda ca papāta ca ।। 73 ।। mūrcchaṃ saṃprāpya bhakttyā ca dhyātvā taṃ parameśvaram । tucchaṃ mene sa cā''tmānaṃ gopīṃ bhaktyā'pyuvāca saḥ ।। 74 ।। uddhava uvāca dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ dvīpānāṃ jambudvīpaṃ manauharam । yatra bhāratavarṣaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ śubhadaṃ tathā ।। 75 ।। vaṇijāṃ ca puśyakṛtaṃ vāṇijyasthalamīpsitam । atra kṛtvā supuṇyaṃ ca bhuṅkte'nyatra śubhaṃ phalam ।। 76 ।। dhanyaṃ bhāratavarṣaṃ tu puṇyadaṃ śubhadaṃ varam । gopīpādābjarajasā pūtaṃ paramanirmalam ।। 77 ।। tato'pi gopikā dhanyā sānyā yoṣitsu bhārate । nityaṃ paśyanti rādhāyāḥ pādapadmaṃ supuṇyadam ।। 78 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ ca brahmaṇā । rādhikāpādapadmasya reṇūnāmupalabdhaye ।। 79 ।। golokavāsinī rādhā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā parā । tatra śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā ।। 80 ।। ye ye bhaktāśca kṛṣṇasya devā brahmādayastathā । rādhāyāścāpi gopīnāṃkarāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 81 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ vijānāti yogīndraśca maheśvaraḥ । rādhā gopyaśca gopāśca golokavāsinaśca ye ।। 82 ।। kiṃcitsanatkumāraśca brahmā cedviṣayī tathā । kiṃcideva vijānanti siddhā bhaktāśca niścitam ।। 83 ।। dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'hamāgato gokulaṃ yataḥ । gopikābhayo gurubhyaśca haribhaktiṃ labhe'calām ।। 84 ।। mathurāṃ ca na yāsyāmi tīrthakīrteśca kīrtanam । śroṣyāmi kiṃkaro bhūtvā gopīnāṃ janmajanmani ।। 85 ।। na gopībhyaḥ paro bhakto hareśca paramātmanaḥ । yādṛśīṃ lebhiregopyo bhaktiṃ nānye ca tādṛśīm ।। 86 ।। kalāvatyuvāca pitaṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā menā kalāvatī । vayaṃ tisro bhaginyaśca bhramāmaḥ pṛthivītale ।। 87 ।। dhanyā janakapatnī naḥ sītāmātā pativratā । ayonisaṃbhavā rādhā ahaṃ cāyonisaṃbhavā ।। 88 ।। rādhā śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā bhuvi । sanatkumāraśāpena vayameva mahītale ।। 89 ।। kṣīrodasāgaraṃ ramyaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ manoharam । tisro bhaginyo bhaktyā ca viṣṇuṃdraṣṭuṃ gatā vayam ।। 90 ।। amyutthānādi na kṛtaṃ kopādasmāñchaśāpa ha । sanatkumāro bhagavānyogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 91 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca mūḍhāstiṣṭhata bhūmau ca punaḥ svargaṃ na yāsyatha । martyaprāṇipriyā bhūtvā cāhaṃkāraiṇa haitunā ।। 92 ।। punarvaraṃ ca pratyekaṃ dadau tuṣṭo dviceśvaraḥ । viṣṇorvaśasya śailasya himādhārasya kāminī ।। 93 ।। jyeṣṭhā bhavatu tvatkanyā bhaviṣyatyeva pārvatī । dhanyā priyā tu bhavatu yogino janakasya ca ।। 94 ।। tasya kanyā mahālakṣmīḥ sītādevī bhaviṣyati । vṛṣabhānasya vaiśyasya yogināṃ pravarasya ca ।। 95 ।। durvāsasaśca śiṣyasya kaniṣṭhā ca kalāvatī । bhaviṣyati priyā sādhvīdvāparānte ca gokule ।। 96 ।। kalāvatīsutā rādhā devī golokavāsinī । śrīdāmagopaśāpena bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 97 ।। īśo brahmeśaśeṣāṇāṃ bhārāvataraṇena ca । āgamiṣyati pṛthavīṃ ca puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam ।। 98 ।। kalāvatī vṛṣbhānaḥ kautukāt kanyayā saha । jīvanmuktaśca golokaṃ gamiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 99 ।। dhanyā ca sītyā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gamiṣyati । menakā yoginī siddhā pārvatyāśca vareṇa ca ।। 100 ।। kalpānte viṣṇuloke ca lakṣmīvanmodate ciram । vinā vipattyā mahimā keṣāṃ kutra bhaviṣyati ।। 101 ।। karmaṇā ca gate duḥkhe prabhaveddurlabhaṃ sukham । purā pitaṇāṃ kanyāśca svarmabhogavilāsikāḥ ।। 102 ।। lakṣmīsamā vareṇāpi viprasya viṣṇudarśanāt । karmakṣayaṃ cāpyasmākaṃ babhūva viṣṇudarśanāt ।। 103 ।। puṇye tena tīvreṇa kumārasyāpi darśanam । śrutaṃ tatra kumārāsyājjñānaṃ paramadurlabham ।। 104 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ siddhānāṃ jagatāmapi । īśvaraḥ paramātmā ca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ nirguṇaśca nirīhaśca paraḥ svecchāmayo varaḥ ।। 105 ।। tulasyuvāca sarvaprāṇiṣu devāśca tiṣṭhantyeva pṛthakpṛthak । prāṇo viṣṇuśca viṣayī mano brahmā ca cetanā ।। 106 ।। prakṛtirbuddhirūpā ca sarvaśaktyadhidevatā । jñānasvarūpaḥ śaṃbhuśca svayaṃ dharmaśca pūruṣaḥ ।। 107 ।। nirguṇaḥ paramātmā ca tadbrahma prakṛteḥ param । sa eva kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣī ca karmaṇāṃ jīvināmapi ।। 108 ।। bhoktā ca sukhaduḥkhānāṃ jīvastatpratibimbakaḥ । cakṣuṣoścandrasūryau ca jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatī ।। 109 ।। vasuṃdharā tvaci sadā bāhvoste lokapālakāḥ । ātmanaścāpi te sarpe paricārakarūpiṇaḥ ।। 110 ।। ātmanyeva priyāste ca sarve gacchanti jīvinaḥ । yathā saṃsadi saṃsāre naradeha(va) mivānugāḥ ।। 111 ।। tasmātsarvātmanā''tmānaṃ bhajanti saṃtataṃ sadā । santaśca parayā bhaktyā dhyāyante yogino mudā ।। 112 ।। karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣī kutaḥ karma ca gopanam । antaryāmī ca kṛṣṇaśca pracāraṃ kurute mudā ।। 113 ।। kālikovāca narā bālāśca vṛddhāśca yuvānastrividhāstathā । devādayaśca ce siddhāḥ sarve jānanti taṃ param ।। 114 ।। uddhava uvāca sāṃprataṃ mūrcchitāṃ rādhāṃ yukto bodhayituṃ budhaḥ । atra yuktiḥ pradhānā tvaṃ tāṃ prabodhaya coddhava ।। 115 ।। cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi jaganmātarnibodha mām । udbhavaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktasya kiṃkarasyāpi kiṃkaram ।। 116 ।। prasādaṃ kuru mātarmāṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ punaḥ । na svatantraḥ parādhīno yoṣā dārumayī yathā ।। 117 ।। yathā vṛṣo vaśībhūto vṛṣavāhasya saṃtatam । tathā mātarjagatsarvaṃ jagannāthasya niścitam ।। 118 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣmajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rādhoddhavasaṃ... caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 94 ।।
<4.95> atha pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca uddhavasya vacaḥ śrutvā cetanaṃ prāpya rādhikā । sā covāca samutthāya ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। 1 ।। uvāca madhuraṃ devī hṛdayena vidūyatā । gopībhiḥ saptabhirbhakatyā sevitā śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 2 ।। rādhikovāca mathurāṃ gacchavatsa tvaṃ māṃca (na) vismara saṃvadā । ato'pyadharmo nāstyeva bhavato bhavasāgare ।। 3 ।। madīyaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaṃ gatvā kathaya sāṃpratam । śrīkṛṣṇaṃ paramānandaṃ śīghramānaya matprabhum ।। 4 ।। yoṣijjanmani yoṣitsu saṃprāpya tādṛśaṃ patim । bhedo babhūva kasyā vā madanyā kā'pi duḥkhinī ।। 5 ।। kiṃ dadāsi prabodhaṃ me nāsti me bodhanocitam । niṣphalo dehināṃ deho vinā''tmānaṃ sahoddhava ।। 6 ।। saṃprītyā saha saubhāgyaṃ gauravaṃ nityanūtanam । atīva durlabhaṃ prema rahasyaṃ navasaṃgamam ।। 7 ।। smarāmi manasā śaśvannānyo manasi vartate । rātrau nidrāṃ parityajya smaraṇaṃ śokavardhanam ।। 8 ।। māmuddhara dhruvaṃ vatsa nimagnāṃ śokasāgare । jīvābhavapradānena tīrthe snānaphalaṃ nṛṇām ।। 9 ।। prabodhituṃ na śaknomi durnivāraṃ ca mānasam । cintaye caraṇāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 10 ।। tadguṇaṃ mahimānaṃ ca prītiṃ ca premasāgaram । smāraṃ smāraṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ mano me na sthiraṃ calam ।। 11 ।। jagatāṃ yuvatīnāṃ ca kāsāṃ vā duḥkhamīdṛśam । śrīkṛṣṇabhedaduḥkha ca kā vā jānāti māṃ vinā ।। 12 ।। kiṃ cijjānāti sītā sā'pyahaṃ ca vidhibodhitam । matparā duḥkhinī nāsti kāminīṣu jagattraye ।। 13 ।। kāvāyāti pratītiṃ me śrutvā ca mānasīṃ vyathām । kāsāṃ vā matsamaṃ duḥkhaṃ yuvatīnāṃ sutoddhava ।। 14 ।। rādhikāsadṛśī strīṣu na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati । duḥkhinī virahātaptā sukhasaubhāgyavarcitā ।। 15 ।। saṃprāpya kalpavṛkṣaṃ ca patiṃ ca jagatāṃ patim । vañcitā'haṃ vidhātrā ca nirdayena ca pāpinā ।। 16 ।। jīvanaṃ saphala janma susnigdhaṃ cakṣuṣī manaḥ । tatpādapadmavaktrendurūpaveṣapradarśanāt ।। 17 ।। yannāmaśrutimātreṇa pañca prāṇāḥ praharṣitāḥ । smṛtimātrātpraphullyanta ātmā susnigdha eva ca ।। 18 ।। yaśca pasparśa suratau yaśastribhuvanaṣvapi । kathā vā saṃpadā vatsa vismarāmi tamīśvaram ।। 19 ।। trailokyavijayaṃ rūpaṃ guṇameva bibharti yaḥ । na nirmito yo vidhinā tenaiva nirmito vidhiḥ ।। 20 ।। taṃ vidheśca vidhātāraṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām । kalpavṛkṣātparaṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam ।। 21 ।। sarveśaṃ sarvabījaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram । kayā vā saṃpadā tāta vismarāmi cataṃ patim ।। 22 ।। yasya nirmañchanārhaśca na candro na ca manmathaḥ । naivāśvinīkumāraśca guṇasābhyaṃ na diśvataḥ ।। 23 ।।dhyāyante yatpadāmbhojaṃ brahmeśaśeṣasaṃjñakāḥ । kayā vā saṃpadā tāta vismarāmi ca taṃ prabhum ।। 24 ।। svapne paśyanti ye rūpamatulaṃ ca manoharam । te'pi sarvaṃ parityajya dhyāyānte tamarniśam ।। 25 ।। guṇena śailaḥ salilaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ dravediti । mṛtavṛkṣo mukulitaḥ stambhitaśca samīraṇaḥ ।। 26 ।। sūryaśca jaladhiścaiva sthagito bhaktibhāvataḥ । kayā vā saṃpadā putra vismarāmi cataṃ priyam ।। 27 ।। yadbhayādvāti vāto'yaṃ sūryastapati yadbhayāt । varṣatīndro dahatyagnirmṛtyuścarati jantuṣu ।। 28 ।। yadbhayātphalino vṛkṣāḥ puṣpitāḥ samaye'pi ca । samudrāḥ svātmaviṣaye grahāśca munayaḥ surāḥ ।। 29 ।। kālasya kālaḥ saṃhartuḥ saṃhartā sraṣṭurīśvaraḥ । svādhīnaśca svatantraśca svayamevā''tmasaṃjñakaḥ ।। 30 ।। kayā vā saṃpadā bhakta vismarāmi ca taṃ prabhum । prabodho nāsti tadbhede yena māṃ bodhayedbudhaḥ ।। 31 ।। māṃ ca bodhayituṃ śaktā na sāvitrī sarasvatī । na vedā na ca vedāṅgāḥ ke vā santaśca ke surāḥ ।। 32 ।। sahasravaktro'nantaśca vedānāṃ janako vidhiḥ । na śaṃbhunaṃ gaṇeśāśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 33 ।। sthitergatiścintanīyā mārgaśūnye kuto gatiḥ । kālasādhyaṃ ca sarva ca sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ śubhāśubham ।। 34 ।। durnivāraḥ sa kālaśca kālasādhyaṃ jagatsu ca । uttiṣṭha mathurāṃ gaccha sukhaṃ vatsa manoharam ।। 35 ।। vrajavākaṃ parityajya bhavāṃśca gamanotsukaḥ । suciraṃ kṛṣṇavicchedo duḥkhāya na sukhāya ca ।। 36 ।। paśya candramukhaṃ tasya janmamṛtyujarāpaham । rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā ruroda bhṛśamuddhavaḥ rudatīṃ rādhikāṃ dṛṣṭvā bandhuvicchedakātarām ।। 37 ।। iti... śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rādhoddhavasaṃ... pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 95 ।।
<4.96> atha ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇaṃ kṛtvā gamanonmukhamuddhavam । nataṃ rādhāpadāmbhoje śirasā pulakāñcitam ।। 1 ।। uvāca mādhavī gopī rudatī premavihvalā । bhaktaṃ rudantamucchaiśca rādhāvicchedakātaram ।। 2 ।। mādhavyuvāca uddhava śṛṇu vakṣyāmi kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha yathocitam । nigūḍhaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ yatte manasi vāñchitam ।। 3 ।। sudurlabhaṃ purāṇeṣu vedeṣu gopanīyakam । praśnaṃ kuru mahābhāga rādhikāṃ trijagatprasūm ।। 4 ।। ityuktvā sā ca gopīśā samuvāsa musaṃsadi । uvāca madhuraṃ śāntāmuddhavaścāpi rādhikām ।। 5 ।। uddhavauvāca ekākī bhavamāyāti yātyekākī punaḥ punaḥ । prāṇī karmānurodhena svakarmaphalabhukpumān ।। 6 ।। karmaṇā jāyate jantuḥ karmaṇauva pralīyate । sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ karmaṇaivābhipadyate ।। 7 ।। janturbhogāvaśeṣeṇa bhogaṃ bhuṅkte bhaveṣu ca । punaśca karmaṇo bhogātsamāyāti ca yāti ca ।। 8 ।। ratnādikaṃ ca yatkicinmahyaṃ dattaṃ tvayā sati । mayā sārdha na yātyeva tena me kiṃ prayojanam ।। 9 ।। bhavābthitāraṇe devi bhavatī taraṇirvarā । karṇadhāraḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarveṣāṃ pārakārakaḥ ।। 10 ।। kiṃcidyānaṃ dehi mahyaṃ bhavābdhipārakāraṇam । prāpya prasātaṃ yāsyāmi mathurāṃ kṛṣmamūlakam ।। 11 ।। yāṃ yāṃ kālagatiṃ mātaḥ surāṇāṃ ca nṛṇāmapi । pitṝṇāṃ brahmalokasya tadūrdhvasya ca tāṃ vada ।। 12 ।। tāmeva dustarāṃ ghorāṃ tīrtvā yāmi hareḥ padam । evaṃbhūtamupāyaṃ ca dehi me kamalālaye ।। 13 ।। dūrato yatpadāmbhojaṃ dhyāyante ca divāniśam । devā brahmeśaśeṣādyāstvaṃ tadvakṣaḥ sthalasthitā ।। 14 ।। uddhavasya vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa kamalālayā । vāsasā netranīraṃ ca saṃbhārjya tamuvāca sā ।। 15 ।। rādhovāca mādhavīvacanenaiva karoṣi praśnamuddhava । strījātirabalā loke kiṃ vā jñānaṃ dadāmi te ।। 16 ।। śuddhāṃ kālagatiṃ vatsa jānāti bhagavānhariḥ । brahma maheśaḥ śeṣaśca vedāścatvāra eva ca ।। 17 ।। kiṃcidvedānusāreṇa santo jānanti putraka । śrūyatāṃ kuṣṇavaktreṇa goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 18 ।। goloke cāpi vaikuṇṭhe brahmaloke ca sāṃpratam । yā ca dṛṣṭā kālagatistāmeva kathayāmi te ।। 19 ।। nṛṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ brahmalokādikasya ca । bahilrokasya brahmāṇḍātpātālānāṃ ca niścitam ।। 20 ।। duratyayāṃ kālagatiṃ yenopāyena paṇḍitāḥ । nistaranti budhaśreṣṭha kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 21 ।। bhajanti jagatāṃ nāthaṃ kālakālaṃ jagadgurum । nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 22 ।। sadyaḥ patati deho'yaṃ vinā yena sadātmanā । taṃ niṣevya kālagatiṃ talatyeva hi kevalam ।। 23 ।। āyurharati sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ ravireva ca । śrīhareḥ śuddhabhaktānāṃ satāṃ puṇyavatāṃ vinā ।। 24 ।। vidhermānasikānputrāṃścaturaḥ paśya putraka । sanakādīnbhāgavatānyeṣāṃ ca susthiraṃ vamaḥ ।। 25 ।। rudrādyānvayasā nityāñjñātināṃ ca gurorgurūn । bālānanupanītāṃśca pañcavarṣaśiśūnyathā ।। 26 ।। amyantare mahāsphītānsasmitāṃśca digambarān । śrīkṛṣṇadhyānapūtāśca tīrthapūtāṃśca vaiṣṇavān ।। 27 ।। vedavedāṅgaśāstrāṇāṃ cintāhīnānpraphullitān । bhaktyā divāniśaṃ śaśvaddharibhāvena tatparān ।। 28 ।। bāhyapūjāvihīnāṃśca pūtānmānasikāṃstathā । mṛtyuñjayānmahābhāgānkālavyālajitastathā ।। 29 ।। sanakaṃ ca sanandaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca sanātanam । paraṃ sanatkumāraṃ ca ye smaranti ca sarvaśaḥ ।। 30 ।। tīrthasnānaphalaṃ labdhvā mucyate kṛtapātakāt । haribhaktirbhavetteṣāṃ haridāsyaṃ labhanti ca ।। 31 ।। mṛkaṇḍubālakaṃ paśya karmaṇā ca dvijottamam । daśavarṣāyuṣaṃ tīvraṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā ।। 32 ।। harisevanataḥ paścātsaptakalpāntajīvinam । voḍhuṃ pañcaśikhaṃ paśya lomaśaṃ cā''suriṃ tathā ।। 33 ।। sarvakarmavihīnaṃ ca harisevanatatparam । śatakalpāyuṣaṃ caiva dhyāyamānaṃ hareḥ padam ।। 34 ।। jamadagneḥ sutaṃ paśya rāmaṃ taṃ cirajīvinam । hanumantaṃ baliṃ vyāsamaśvatthāmānameva ca ।। 35 ।। vibhīṣaṇaṃ kṛpaṃ vipraṃ jāmbavantaṃ ca bhallukam । haribhāvanayā caite śuddhāḥ sucirajīvinaḥ ।। 36 ।। siddhendreṣu munīndreṣu nareṣvanyeṣu coddhava । haribhāvanaśuddhāśca sarve te cirajīvinaḥ ।। 37 ।। prahlādaṃ paśya daityeṣu hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutam । haridviṣo durantasya haribhāvanatatparam ।। 38 ।। cirāyuṣaṃ kālajitaṃ paśyānyaṃ cāpyasaṃkhyakam । anekajanmatapasā labdhvā janma ca bhārate ।। 39 ।। ye hariṃ taṃ na sevante te mūḍhāḥ kṛtapāpinaḥ । vāsudevaṃ parityajya viṣaye nirato janaḥ ।। 40 ।। tyaktvā'mṛtaṃ mahāmūḍho viṣaṃ bhuṅkte nijecchayā । kasya strī kasya vā putraḥ kasya vā bāndhavāstathā ।। 41 ।। kaḥ kasya bandhurvipadi śrīkṛṣṇena vinā bhuvi । tasmātsantaḥ sadā kṛṣṇaṃ bhajantyeva divāniśam ।। 42 ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ sarvaharaṃ param । kālasya taraṇopāyaṃ bhajanaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।। 43 ।। ānandanandanasyaiva paripūrṇatamasya ca । śṛṇu kālagatiṃ vatsa madīyajñānagocarām ।। 44 ।। narāṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ cāpi brahmaṇaḥ । nāgānāṃ rākṣasādīnāṃ tatpareṣāṃ ca putraka ।। 45 ।। kathayāmi nigūḍhārthaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya । sarvasmācca paraṃ sthānaṃ sarvādhāro mahānvirāṭ ।। 46 ।। yasya lomasu viśvāni cāsaṃkhyāni ca tāni ca । sarvasmācca paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ paramāṇuṃ niśāmaya ।। 47 ।। kālārambhātmakaṃ sarvamanūraṃ paramīpsitam । caramaḥ sadviśeṣāṇāmaneko'saṃyutaḥ sadā ।। 48 ।। paramāṇuḥ sa vijñeyo nṛpāmaikyabhramo yataḥ । paramāṇudvayenāṇustrasareṇustu te trayaḥ ।। 49 ।। trasareṇutrikeṇāpi truṭiruktā manīṣibhiḥ । vedhastruṭiśatenaiva trivedhena lavastathā ।। 50 ।। trilavena nimeṣaśca tri nimeṣeṇa ca kṣaṇaḥ । kāṣṭhā pañcakṣaṇenaiva laghuśca daśakāṣṭhayā ।। 51 ।। laghupañcadaśaṃ daṇḍastatpramāṇaṃ niśāmaya । dvādaśārdhapalonmānaṃ caturbhiścaturaṅgulaiḥ ।। 52 ।। svarṇamāṣaiḥ kṛtacchidraṃ yāvatprasthajalaplutam । daṇḍadvaye muhūrtaḥ syātvaṣṭidaṇḍātmikā tithiḥ ।। 53 ।। tadaṣṭabhāgaḥ praharaḥ pramāṇaṃ ca nirūpaṇam । caturbhiḥ praharai rātriścaturbhirdinamucyate ।। 54 ।। tithipañcadaśenaiva pakṣamānaṃ prakīrtitam । pakṣadvayena māsaḥ syācchuklakṛṣṇābhidhena ca ।। 55 ।। ṛturmāsadvayenaiva tatṣaṭkenaiva vatsaraḥ । vasantagrīṣmavarṣāśca śaraddhemantaśītakāḥ ।। 56 ।। varṣāḥ pañcavidhā jñeyāḥ kālavidbhirnirūpitāḥ । saṃvatsaraḥ pravatsara ilāvatsara eva ca ।। 57 ।। anuvatsaro vatsaro'yamiti kālavido viduḥ । abdo dviṣaṭkamāsaiśca tannāma śuṇu coddhava ।। 58 ।। vaiśākho jyeṣṭha āṣāḍhaḥ śrāvaṇo bhādra eva ca । āśvinaḥ kārtiko mārgaḥ pauṣo māghastu phālgunaḥ ।। 59 ।। saitrastu caramo jñeyo varṣaśeṣī nirūpitaḥ । vasantaścaitravaiśākhamāsayugmena kīrtitaḥ ।। 60 ।। jyeṣṭhāvāḍhadvayenaiva grīṣmastu parikīrtitaḥ । varṣā śrāvaṇabhadre ca hyāśvine kārtike śarat ।। 61 ।। mārge pauṣe ca hemantaḥ śiśiro māghaphālgune । abdastu cāyanai dve vai cottare dakṣiṇāyane ।। 62 ।। māghādiṣaḍvinirmitamuttarāyaṇamīpsitam । śrāvaṇādimāsaṣaṭkaṃ dakṣiṇāyanameva ca ।। 63 ।। māghādāṣāḍhaparyantaṃ dinaṃ vṛddhaṃ krameṇa vai । naktaṃ vṛddhaṃ śrāvaṇaśca pauṣaparyantameva ca ।। 64 ।। pratipatpūrṇimāntaśca śuklapakṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ । pūrṇimāyāḥ pratipadaścāmāvāsyānta eva ca ।। 65 ।। kṛṣṇapakṣastu vijñeyo vedavidbhirnirūpitaḥ । dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca caturthī pañcamī tathā ।। 66 ।। ṣaṣṭhī ca saptamī caiva hyaṣṭamī navamī tathā । daśamyekādaśī cāpi dvādaśī ca trayodaśī ।। 67 ।। caturdaśī kuhūryāvaddinaṃ tu gaṇanaṃ smṛtam । asvinī bharaṇī cāpi kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā ।। 68 ।। mṛgaśirastthā''rdrā ca nakṣatre dve punarvasū । puṣyāśleṣe maghā caiva pūrvā cottaraphālgunī ।। 69 ।। hastacitre tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā । jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ tathā jñeyā pūrvāṣāḍhottarā tathā ।। 70 ।। śravaṇābhijitī caiva dhaniṣṭhā ca prakīrtitā । tataḥ śatabhiṣā jñeya pūrvābhādrapadā tathā ।। 71 ।। tathottarā tu vijñeyā revatī caramā smṛtā । aṣṭāviṃśati nakṣatraṃ kalatraṃ śaśinastathā ।। 72 ।। krameṇa tābhiḥ sārdha ca candrastiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ । saptaviṃśati nakṣatraṃ kalatraṃ ca śrutau śrutam ।। 73 ।। abhijicchūvaṇacchāyā tenāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ smṛtā । ekadā ca madhau candro rohiṇyā vāmayā saha ।। 74 ।। reme divāniśaṃ nityaṃ śravaṇā ca cukopa sā । chāyāṃ ca dattvā candrāya yayau tātāntikaṃ bhiyā ।। 75 ।। tataḥ pitaramādāya sā cakre ca vibhāgakam । babhūva tena nakṣatramabhijinnāmakaṃ purā ।। 76 ।। etacchrutvā kṛṣṇamukhācchataśrṛṅge ca parvate । nakṣatraṃ kathitaṃ vatsa tithyā bhramati nityaśaḥ ।। 77 ।। yogaṃ ca karaṇaṃ caiva madvaktreṇa niśāmaya । viṣkambhaḥ prītirāyuṣmānsaubhāgyaḥ śobhanastathā ।। 78 ।। atigaṇḍaḥ sukarmā ca ghṛtiḥ śūlastathaiva ca । gaṇḍo vṛddhirdhruvaścaiva vyāghāto harṣaṇāstathā ।। 79 ।। vajraṃ siddhirvyatīpāto varīyānparighaḥ śivaḥ । siddhiḥ sādhyaḥ śubhaḥ śuklo brahmendro vaidhṛtistathā ।। 80 ।। kīrtitaste yogagaṇaḥ karaṇaṃ śrūyatāmiti । bavaśca bālavaścaiva kaulavastaitilastathā ।। 81 ।। garaśca vaṇijaścāpi viṣṭiśca śakunistathā । catuṣpāccāpi nāgaśca kiṃstughna iti kīrtitam ।। 82 ।। narāṇāṃ cāpi māsena pitṝṇāṃ ca divāniśam । śukle cāpi dinaṃ teṣāṃ kṛṣṇe naktaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 83 ।। vatsareṇa nārāṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca divāniśam । dinaṃ teṣāmuttare ca naktaṃ ca dakṣiṇāyane ।। 84 ।। manvantaraṃ tu divyānāṃ yugānāmekasaptatiḥ । manorāyuḥ parimitaṃ śakrasyā''yuḥ prakīrtitam ।। 85 ।। pañcaviṃśatsahasraṃ ca tathā pañcaśataṃ param । tatra sūryagatirnāsti śakrapātānusārataḥ ।। 86 ।। divāniśaṃ ca jānanti brahmalokanivāsinaḥ । daṇḍadvayaṃ narapalaṃ śakrapātena tatpalam ।। 87 ।। evaṃ triśaddinenaiva dhāturmāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ । abdo dvādaśabhirmāsairevaṃ tasya śatāyuṣaḥ ।। 88 ।। brahmaṇaḥ patanenaiva nimeṣācchrīharerapi । dhātuḥ pātānusāreṇa vaikuṇṭhe na divāniśam ।। 89 ।। tatra sūryagatirnāsti caivaṃ golokataḥ smṛtam । vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ sarve na vai jānantyaharniśam ।। 90 ।। candrasyāpi grahāṇāṃ ca gatirnāsti ca tatra vai । cakraṃ naiva bhramatyeva rāśīnāmicchayā hareḥ ।। 91 ।। dinaṃ ca tejasā dīptaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ । naktaṃ tejovihīnaṃ ca harau ca mandiraṃ gate ।। 92 ।। evaṃ kālagatistatra viṣṇuloke'sti saṃtatam । kālasvarūpo bhagavānparamātmā nirākṛtiḥ ।। 93 ।। candrasūryagatirnāsci pātāleṣu ca saptaṣu । ,dvāsinaśca jānanti śaṅkante na divāniśam ।। 94 ।। dine ca mūrdhnināgānāṃ maṇirjvalati nityaśaḥ । saṃdhyāyāṃ dīptamagniśca rātriśca tamasā''vṛtā ।। 95 ।। kālaṃ tāmrīpramāṇena jānanti tannivāsinaḥ । yathā bhuvi tathā tatra parimāṇaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 96 ।। kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam । divyairdvādaśasāhasrairvatsaraiścāpi tanmitam ।। 97 ।। aṣṭau śatānyapyadhikaṃ sahasrāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam । divyairvarṣaiḥ kṛtayugaṃ kālavidbhirnirūpitam ।। 98 ।। aṣṭāviṃśatsahasrāṇyapyadhikaṃ parimāṇakam । lakṣāṇāṃ ca saptadaśaṃ nṛmānaṃ parikīntitam ।। 99 ।। adhikaṃ ṣaṭśatānyeva sahasrāṇāṃ trayaṃ tathā । divyairvarṣaiśca treteti vatsa kālavido viduḥ ।। 100 ।। ṣaṇṇavatisahasrāṇi lakṣairdvādaśabhiḥ saha । nṛṇāṃ varṣaiśca treteti kālavidbhiḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 101 ।। catuṣṭayaṃ śatānāṃ cāpyadhikaṃ dvisahasrakam । varṣa divyaṃ dvāparaṃ ca kālajñaiḥ parikīrtitam ।। 102 ।। catuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi lakṣairaṣṭabhireva ca । nṛṇāṃ varṣairdvāparaṃ ca kālajñaiḥ parikīrtitam ।। 103 ।। adhikaṃ dviśataṃ caiva divyaṃ varṣasahasrakam । evaṃmitaṃ kaliyugaṃ vatsa prājñairnirūpitam ।। 104 ।। dvātriṃśacca sahasraṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ nṛmānakam । varṣa ceti kaliyuge cakāra kālakovidaḥ ।। 105 ।। lakṣairdvicatvāriṃśadbhiḥ saha viṃśatsahasrakaiḥ । nṛmānavarṣaiḥ kālajñairvyaktameva caturyugam ।। 106 ।। iti te kathitaṃ vatsa kālasaṃkhyānirūpaṇam । yathāśrutaṃ yathājñānaṃ gaccha vatsa hareḥ puram ।। 107 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rādhodvavasaṃ... kālanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṇṇvatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 96 ।।
<4.97> atha saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca gacchantamuddhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃtrastā śrīhareḥ priyā । samutthāyā''sanācchīghraṃ hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 1 ।। gopībhiḥ sahitā śīghraṃ samudvignā sahāsatī । dadau śubhāśiṣaṃ tasmai tasya mūrdhni karaṃ tathā ।। 2 ।। stigdhadūrvākṣataṃ śukladhānyaṃ puṣpaṃ ca maṅgalam । prerayāmāsa lājāṃśca phalaṃ parṇaṃ tathā dadhi ।। 3 ।। darmaṇaṃ darśayāmāsa pūrṇakumbha sapallavam । saphalaṃ gandhasindhūrakastūrīcandanānvitam ।। 4 ।। puṣpamālyaṃ pradīpaṃ ca ratnaṃ gandhaṃ dvijottama । patiputravatī sādhvī kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ tathā ।। 5 ।। tamuvāca mahāsādhvī hitaṃ satyaṃ ca maṅgalam । saṃgopyaṃ sāśrunetraṃ ca patitaṃ duḥkhitā hṛdi ।। 6 ।। rādhikovāca śubhaṃ bhavatu mārgaste kalyāṇamastu saṃtatam । jñānaṃ labha hareḥ sthānātkṛṣṇasya supriyo bhava ।। 7 ।। kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ daleṣu ca varaṃ varam । śreṣṭhā pañcavidhā mukterharibhaktirgarīyasī ।। 8 ।। brahmatvādapi devatvādindratvādamarādapi । amṛtātsiddhilābhācca haridāsyaṃ sudurlabham ।। 9 ।। anekananmatapasā saṃbhūya bhārate dvijaḥ । haribhaktiṃ yadi labhettasya janma sudurlabham ।। 10 ।। saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tasya kurvataḥ karmaṇaḥ kṣayam । pitṝṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi svasya mātuśca niścitam ।। 11 ।। mātāmahānāṃ puṃsāṃ ca śatānāṃ sodarasya ca । bāndhavasyāpi patnyāśca gurūṇāṃ śiṣyabhṛtyayoḥ ।। 12 ।। tatkarma śobharaṃ vatsa yacca kṛṣṇo samarpaṇam । tatkarma śobhanaṃ śuddhaṃ kuṣṇasaṃtoṣaṇaṃ yataḥ ।। 13 ।। saṃkalpasādhanaṃ karma saṃprītividhipūrvakam । tadeva maṅgalaṃ dhanyaṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 14 ।। tadvrataṃ tattapaḥ satyaṃ tadbhaktiḥ pūjanaṃ tathā । taduddeśyamanaśanaṃ kevalaṃ dāsyakālaṇam ।। 15 ।। samastapṛthivīdānaṃ pradakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvastathā । samastatīrthasnānaṃ ca samastaṃ ca vrataṃ tapaḥ ।। 16 ।। samastayajñakaraṇaṃ sarvadānaphalaṃ tathā । samastavedavedāṅgapaṭhanaṃ pāṭhanaṃ tathā ।। 17 ।। bhītasthaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva jñānadānaṃ sudurlabham । atithīnāṃ pūjanaṃ ca śaraṇāgatarakṣaṇam ।। 18 ।। sarvadevārcanaṃ caiva vandanaṃ japanaṃ manoḥ । bhojanaṃ vipradevānāṃ puraścaraṇapūrvakam ।। 19 ।। guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ caiva pitrorbhaktiśca poṣaṇam । sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadāsyasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 20 ।। tasmāduddhava yatnena bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam । nirguṇaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 21 ।। nityaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma prakṛteḥ paramīśvaram । paribūrṇatamaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 22 ।। karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣyapradaṃ nirliptameva ca । jyotiḥ svarūpaṃ paramaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। 23 ।। sarvasvarūpaṃ sarveśaṃ sarvasaṃpatpradaṃ śubham । bhaktidaṃ dāsyadaṃ svasya nijasaṃpatpadapradam ।। 24 ।। visṛjya jñātibuddhiṃ ca mātsaryamaśubhapradam । bhaja taṃ paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ nandanandanam ।। 25 ।। vede kauthumiśākhāyāṃ tasya nāmnāṃ sahasrakam । nandanandananāmoktaṃ kṛtau vighnaṃ sudurlabham ।। 26 ।। uddhavaḥ sarvamākarṇya paramaṃ vismayaṃ yayau । jñānaṃ saṃprāpya saṃpūrṇa paribūrṇe bhabhūva ha ।। 27 ।। svavastraṃ ca gale baddhvā daṇḍavatpraṇanām tām । murdhnaḥ keśaiśca tatpādaṃ nibadhya ca punāḥ punaḥ ।। 28 ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetraśca bhaktitaḥ । tadvicchedaśucā premṇa rurodoccaiśca nārada ।। 29 ।। ruroda rādhā tatpremṇā ruroda ballavīgaṇaḥ । uddhavasya galaṃ dhṛtvā sathāpayāmāsa lobhataḥ ।। 30 ।। udvavaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā jṛmbhitaṃ tyaktacetanam । śīghrasutthāpayāmāsa rādhikā kṛṣṇamānasam ।। 31 ।। cetanaṃ kārayāmāsa jalaṃ dattvā mukhāmbuje । śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau vatsa jīveti nārada ।। 32 ।। uddhavaścetanāṃ prāpya tamuvāca susaṃsadi । rudatīnāṃ ca gopīnāṃ purataḥ paramārthadam ।। 33 ।। uddhava uvāca dhanyo yaśasyo dvīpānāṃ jambudvīpaḥ sudurlabhaḥ । yatra bhāratavarṣa tu sarvaiṣāmīpsitaṃ varam ।। 34 ।। aho bhāratavarṣe tu puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । rādhāpādābjasaṃsparśarajaḥ pūtaṃ surepsitam ।। 35 ।। dhanyā mānyā ca pṛthivī treṣu lokeṣu pūjitā । rādhāyāstīrthapūtāyāḥ pādābjarajasā varā ।। 36 ।। ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni puṣkare purā । brahmaṇā ca tapastaptaṃ vedoktaṃ bhaktipūrvakam ।। 37 ।। goloke rādhikākṛṣṇadarśanārthaṃ manorathāt । goloke rādhikākṛṣṇo na dṛṣṭaḥ svapnatastadā ।। 38 ।। śrutā tenā''kāśavāṇī satyarūpā ca līlayā । vārāhe bhārate varṣe puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। 39 ।। rāsotsave mahārāmye tatraiva rāsamaṇḍale । drakṣyasīti ca devānāṃ madhye sustho na saṃśayaḥ ।। 40 ।। śrutvā ca virato brahmā tapasaḥ svagṛhaṃ gataḥ ।kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭaśca hṛṣṭaśca paripūrṇamanorathaḥ ।। 41 ।। gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca saphalaṃ janma jīvanam । nityaṃ paśyanti te pādapadmaṃ brahmādidurlabham ।। 42 ।। māninīṃ rādhikāṃ santaḥ sadā sevanti nityaśaḥ । yogīndrāśca munīndrāśca siddhendrā vaiṣṇavāstathā ।। 43 ।। satīṃ puṇyāṃ tīrthapūtāṃ svataḥ śuddhāṃ sudurlabhām । sulabhaṃ yatvadāmbhojaṃ brahmādīnāṃ sudurlabham ।। 44 ।। yatpādapadmanakharaṃ kṛtaṃ yāvakacihnitam । sarveśvareśvareṇaiva kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। 45 ।। cakāra yasyāḥ pūjāṃ ca stotrarājaṃ sudurlabham । śataśṛṅge svayaṃ kṛṣṇo goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 46 ।। pārijātaprasūnānāmañjaliṃ gandhayandanam । dadau dūrvākṣataṃ snigdhaṃ yasyāḥ pādāravindayoḥ ।। 47 ।। triṃśatsahasrakoṭīnāṃ gopīnāmīśvarī ca yā । tatṣaṭtriṃśatsakhīnāṃ ca īśvarī rādhikābhidhā ।। 48 ।। ye vā dviṣanti nindanti pāpinaśca hasanti ca । kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikādevadevīṃ ca rādhikāṃ varām ।। 49 ।। brahmahatyāśataṃ te ca labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ । tatpāpena ca pacyante kumbhīpāke ca raurave ।। 50 ।। taptataile mahāghore dhvānte kīṭe ca yantrake । caturdaśendrāvacchinnaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saptabhiḥ saha ।। 51 ।। tataḥ paraṃ ca jāyante janmaikaṃ lokajanmataḥ । divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca viṣṭhākīṭāśca pāpataḥ ।। 52 ।। puṃścalīnāṃ yonikīṭāstadraktamalabhakṣakāḥ । malakīṭāśca tanmānavarṣaṃ ca pūyabhakṣakāḥ ।। 53 ।। vede ca kāṇvaśākhāyāmityāha kamalodbhavaḥ । ityuktavantaṃ taṃ yāntamuvāca rādhikā punaḥ rudantaṃ ca rudantī sā kṛṣṇavicchedakātarā ।। 54 ।। rādhikovāca gaccha vatsa madhupurīṃ sarvaṃ bodhaya mādhavam । yathā paśyāmi govindaṃ prayatnena tathā kuru ।। 55 ।। niṣphalaṃ ca gataṃ janma gaccha mithyādurāśayā । āśā hi paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ nairāśyaṃ paramaṃ sukham ।। 56 ।। paścādvicintya govindaṃ jīvanmuktā babhūva sā । ityuktvā rādhikā tatra ruroda ca bhṛśaṃ punaḥ ।। 57 ।। praṇamya tāṃ rudantīṃ ca yaśodābhavanaṃ yayau । athoddhave gate rādhā mūrcchāṃ maṃprāpa nārada ।। 58 ।। tatyāja cetanāṃ śaśvadbabhūva dhyānatatparā । paṅkasthe paṅkajadake sajale śayane mune ।। 59 ।। gopyastāṃ sthāpayāmāsuḥ sāśrunetrotpalā varāḥ । tatsparśamātrācchayanaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ babhūva ha ।। 60 ।। punaḥ snigdhasthale sthigdhanicole candanāṅkite । punastāṃ sthāpayāmāsurvirahajvarakātarām ।। 61 ।। sahasā śuṣkatāṃ prāpa sugandhi candanodakam । nimeṣeṇa śatayugaṃ tadbabhūvoddhavaṃ vinā ।। 62 ।। hā hoddhavoddhava hariṃ śīghraṃ gatvā vadeti ca । samānaya hariṃ śīghraṃ matprāṇeśvaramityapi ।। 63 ।। ityuktavacanāṃ dīnāṃ saṃtāpahṛtacetanām । rurudurgopikāḥ sarvā rādhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi cetanāṃ kārayāmāsurbodhayāmāsuraupsitam ।। 64 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rādhoddhavasaṃ... saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 97 ।।
<4.98> athāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca athoddhavo yaśodāṃ ca praṇamya tvarayā mudā । kharjūrakānanaṃ vāme kṛtvā ca yamunāṃ yayau ।। 1 ।। snātvā bhuktvā ca tatraiva jagām mathurāṃ punaḥ ।dadarśa vaṭamūle ca govindaṃ rahasi sthitam ।। 2 ।। praphullo'pyuddhavaṃ dṛṣṭavā sasmitaṃ tamuvāca saḥ । rudantaṃ śokadagdhaṃ ca sāśrunetraṃ ca kātaram ।। 3 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca āgacchoddhava kalyāṇaṃ rādhā jīvati jīvati । kalyāṇayuktā gopyaśca jīvanti virahajvarāt ।। 4 ।। śubhaṃ gopaśiśūnāṃ ca vatsānāṃ ca gavāmapi । mātā me putravirahādyaśodā kīdṛśī ca sā ।। 5 ।। vada bandho yathārthaṃ tattvāṃ dṛṣṭvā kimuvāca sā । tvayoktā jananī kiṃ vā punaḥ sā kimuvāca mām ।। 6 ।। dṛṣṭaṃ tadyamunākūlaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । nirjanopavanoghaiśca suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 7 ।। ramyaṃ kuñjakuṭīraudhai ramyaṃ krīḍāsarovaram । puṣpodyānaṃ vikasitaṃ saṃkulaṃ ca madhuvrataiḥ ।। 8 ।। bhāṇḍīre ca vaṭo dṛṣṭaḥ susnigdho bālakānvitaḥ । dṛṣṭo goṣṭho gavāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ gokulaṃ gokulavrajam ।। 9 ।। yadi jīvati rādhā sā dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ kimuvāca mām । tatsarvaṃ vada he bandhī cā''ndolayati me manaḥ ।। 10 ।। kimūcurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kimucurgopabālakāḥ । gopāśca vṛddhāḥ kiṃvocurvayasyā janakasya me ।। 11 ।। balavevasya jananī kimūce rohiṇī satī । kimucūraparāstāta bandhuvallabhavallavāḥ ।। 12 ।। kiṃ bhuktaṃ kimapūrvaṃ vā dattaṃ mātrā ca rādhayā । kīdṛgvākyaṃ sumadhuraṃ saṃbhāṣā kīdṛśīti ca ।। 13 ।। gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca śiśūnāṃ mātureva ca । rādhāyāścāpi kīdṛgvā mayi premoddhavādhikam ।। 14 ।। māṃ ca smarati mātā me māṃ ca smarati rohiṇī। māṃ ca smarati sā rādhā matpremavirahākulā ।। 15 ।। māṃ ca smaranti gopyaśca gopāśca gopabālakāḥ । bhāṇḍīre vaṭamūle ca bālāḥ krīḍanti māṃ vinā ।। 16 ।। dattamannaṃ brāhmaṇībhiryatra bhuktaṃ sudhopamam । pramadābālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ taddṛṣṭaṃ padamīpsitam ।। 17 ।। indrayāgasthalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭo govardhano varaḥ । brahmaṇā ca hṛtā gāvo yatra taddṛṣṭamuttamam ।। 18 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā śokoktaṃ madhurānvitam । uddhavaḥ samuvācedaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 19 ।। uddhava uvāca yadyadukataṃ tvayā nātha sarvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathepsitam । saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ janma kṛtamatraiva bhārate ।। 20 ।। dṛṣṭaṃ bhāratasāraṃ ca puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । tatsāraṃ vrajabhūmau ca suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 21 ।। tatsārabhūtā golokavāsinyo gopikāḥ varāḥ । dṛṣṭā tatmārabhūtā ca rādhā rāseśvarī parā ।। 22 ।। kadalīvanamadhye ca nirjane suhṛdasthale । paṅkasthe paṅkajadale sajale candanārcite ।। 23 ।। śayane'tiviṣaṇṇā sā ratnabhūṣaṇavarjitā । atīva malinā kṣīṇā''cchāditā śuklavāsasā ।। 24 ।। sevitā sakhibhistatra satataṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ । kṛśodarī nirāhārā kṣaṇaṃ śvasiti ca kṣaṇam ।। 25 ।। kṣaṇaṃ jīvati kiṃ vā sā virahajvarapīḍitā । kiṃ vā jalaṃ sthalaṃ kiṃ dā naktaṃ kiṃ vā dinaṃ hare ।। 26।।naraṃ paśuṃ na jānāti kiṃ paraṃ kimu bāndhavam । bāhyajñānavirahitā dhyāyamānā padaṃ tava ।। 27 ।। trelokye yaśasā bhāti tanmṛtyuryaśasaṃbhavaḥ । strīhatyāṃ naiva vāñchanti jñānahīnāśca dasyavaḥ ।। 28 ।। gaccha śīghraṃ jagannātha kadalīvanamīpsitam । bahirbhūtā na jagatāṃ sā rādhā tvatparāyaṇā ।। 29 ।। atīva bhaktā na tyājyā prabhuṇā rakṣitā sadā । na hi rādhāparā bhaktā na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati ।। 30 ।। manmathaḥ śaṃkarādbhīto bhavāṃśca tatpuraḥsuraḥ । bhavadvidhaṃ patiṃ prāpya kāmadagdhā ca rādhikā ।। 31 ।। tasmātsarvaparaṃ karma tanna kenāpi vāryate । madhurdahati candraśca satataṃ kiraṇena ca ।। 32 ।। śaśvatsugandhivāyuścāpyanāthā sarvabīḍitā । taptakāñcanavarṇabhā sā'dhunā kajjalopamā ।। 33 ।। suvarṇavarṇakeśī ca vāsoveṣavivarcitā । svayaṃ vidhātā tvadbhaktaḥ surāṇāṃ pravaro vibhuḥ ।। 34 ।। tvadbhaktaḥ śaṃkaro devo yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ । sanatkumārastva dbhakto gaṇeśo jñānitāṃ varaḥ ।। 35 ।। munīndrāśca katividhāstvadbhaktā dharaṇītale । tvadbhaktā yādṛśī rādhā na bhaktādṛśo'paraḥ ।। 36 ।। dhyāyate yādṛśī rādhā svayaṃ lakṣmīrna tādṛśī । harirāyāti cetyevaṃ rādhāgre svīkṛtaṃ mayā ।। 37 ।।śīghraṃ gaccha mahābhāga tadeva sārthakaṃ kuru । addhavasya vacaḥśrutvā jahāsovāca mādhavaḥ vedoktaṃ kathayāmāsa sahitaṃ satyasuvratam ।। 38 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca strīṣu dharmavivāheṣu vṛttyarthe prāṇasaṃkaṭe । gavāmarthe brāhmaṇārthe nānṛtaṃ syājjugupsitam ।। 39 ।। tatsvīkāravihīnena kutastvaṃ narakaḥ kutaḥ । golokaṃ yāti madbhakto narakaṃ na hi paśyati ।। 40 ।। tvadaṅgīkārasāphalyaṃ kariṣyāmi tathā'pi ca । yāsyāmi svapne ca gokulaṃ virahākulam ।। 41 ।। ityākaṇarya yayau gehamuddhavaśca mahāyaśāḥ । harirjagāma svapne ca gokulaṃ virhākulam ।। 42 ।। svapne rādhāṃ samāśvāsya dattvā jñānaṃ sudurlabham । saṃtoṣya krīḍayā tāṃ ca gopikāśca yathocitam ।। 43 ।। bodhayitvā yaśodāṃ ca stanaṃ pītvā ca nidritām । gopāngopaśiśūṃścaiva bodhayitvā yayau punaḥ ।। 44 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... aṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 98 ।।
<4.99> atha navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare gargo vasudevāśramaṃ yayau । daṇḍī chatrī ca jaṭilo dīptaśca brahmatejasā ।। 1 ।। śuklayajñopavītī ca tapasvī saṃyataḥ sadā । śukladantaḥ śuklavāsā yadoḥ kulapurohitaḥ ।। 2 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya devakī praṇanāma ca । vasudevaśca bhaktyā ca ratnasihāsanaṃ dadau ।। 3 ।। madhuparkaṃ kāmadhenuṃ vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ tathā । dattvā gandhaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। 4 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ paramānnaṃ ca piṇṭakaṃ madhuraṃ madhu । bhojayāmāsa yatnena tāmbūlaṃ vāsitaṃ dadau ।। 5 ।। praṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ manasā sabalaṃ taṃ vilokya ca । uvāca vasudevaṃ ca devakīṃ ca pativratām ।। 6 ।। garga uvāca vasudeva nibodhenaṃ savalaṃ paśya putrakam । uvanītocitaṃ śuddhaṃ vayamā sāṃprataṃ varam ।। 7 ।। vasudeva uvāca śubhakṣaṇaṃ kuru gṛro yadūnāṃ pūjyadaivata । upanītocitaṃ śuddhaṃ praśaṃsyaṃ ca satāmapi ।। 8 ।। garga uvāca sarvemyo bāndhavemyo'pi dehyāmantraṇapatrikām । saṃbhāraṃ kuru yatnena vasudeva vasupama ।। 9 ।। paraśvaḥ subhamevāsti copenatumihārhasi । dinaṃ satāmapi mataṃ viśuddhaṃ candratārayoḥ ।। 10 ।। gargasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vasudevo vasūpamaḥ । prasthāpayāmāsa sarvānbandhūnmaṅgalapatrikām ।। 11 ।। ghṛtakulyāṃ dugdhakulyāṃ dadhikulyāṃ manoharām । madhukulyāṃ guḍakulyāṃ pracakāra samanvitaḥ ।। 12 ।। rāśiṃ nānopahārāṇāṃ maṇiratnaṃ suvarṇakam । nānālaṃkāravastraṃ ca muktāmāṇikyahīrakam ।। 13 ।। śrīkṛṣṇo devavargāśca munīndrasiddhapuṃgavān । sasmāra manasā bhaktyā bhaktāśca bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 14 ।। śubhe dine ca saṃprāpte te ca sarve samāyayuḥ । munīndrā bāndhavā devā rājāno bahuśastathā ।। 15 ।। devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāśca sarvaśaḥ । vidyādharyaśca gandharvāścā''yayurvādyabhāṇḍakāḥ ।। 16 ।। brāhmaṇā bhikṣukā bhaṭṭā yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ । saṃnyāsinaścāvadhūtā yoginaśca samāyayuḥ ।। 17 ।। strībāndhavāḥ svabandhūnāṃ vargā mātāmahasya ca । bandhūnāṃ bāndhavāḥ sarve svāyayuḥ śubhakarmaṇi ।। 18 ।। bhīṣmo droṇaśca karṇaścāpyaśvatthāmā kṛpo dvijaḥ । suputro dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sabhāryaśca samāyayau ।। 19 ।। kuntī saputrā vidhavā harṣaśokasamāplutā । nānādeśodbhavā yogyā rājāno rājaputrakāḥ ।। 20 ।। atrirvasiṣṭhaścyavano bharadvājo mahātapāḥ । yājñavalkyaśca bhīmaśca gārgyo gargo mahātapāḥ ।। 21 ।। vatsaḥ saputraśca dharmo jaigīṣavyaḥ parāśaraḥ । pulahaśca pulastyaścāpyagastyaśvāpi saubhariḥ ।। 22 ।। sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca manātanaḥ । sanatkumāro bhagavānvoḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ।। 23 ।। turvāsāścāṅgirā vyāso vyāsaputraḥ śukastathā । kuśikaḥ kauśiko rāma ṛṣyaśṛṅgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।। 24 ।। śṛṅgī ca vāmadevaśca gautamaśca guṇārṇavaḥ । kraturyatiścā''ruṇiśca śukrācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 25 ।। aṣṭāvakro vāmanaśca vālmīkiḥ pāribhadrakaḥ । pailo vaiśaṃpāyanaśca pracetāḥ purujittathā ।। 26 ।। bhṛgurmarīcirmadhujitkaśyapaśca prajāpatiḥ । aditirdevamātā ca ditirdaityaprasūstathā ।। 27 ।। sumantuśca subhānuśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanastathā । mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca kapilaśca parāśaraḥ ।। 28 ।। pāṇiniḥ pāriyātraśca pāribhadraśca puṃgavaḥ । saṃvartaścāpyutathyaśca naro'haṃ cāpi nārada ।। 29 ।। viśvāmitraḥ śatānando jābālistaitilastathā । sāṃdīpaniśca brahmāṃśo yogināṃ jñānināṃ guruḥ ।। 30 ।। upamanyurgauramukho maitreyaśca śrutaśravāḥ । kaṭhaḥ kacaśca karakho bharadvājaśca dharmavit ।। 31 ।। saśiṣyā munayaḥ sarve vasudevāśramaṃ yayuḥ । vasudevaśca tāndṛṣṭvā vavande daṇḍavadbhuvi ।। 32 ।। athāsminnantare brahmā sasmito haṃsavāhanaḥ । ratnanirmāṇayānena pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ ।। 33 ।। nandī svayaṃ mahākālo vīrabhadraḥ subhadrakaḥ । maṇibhadraḥ pāribhadraḥ kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 34 ।। gajendreṇa mahendraśca dharmaścandro ravistathā । kubero varuṇaścaiva pavano vahnireva ca ।। 35 ।। yamaḥ saṃyaminīnātho jayanto nalakūbaraḥ । sarve grahāśca vasavo rudrāśca sagaṇastathā ।। 36 ।। ādityāśca tathā śeṇo nānādevāḥ samāyayuḥ । vasudevaśca bhaktyā ca vavande śirasā bhuvi ।। 37 ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā devendrāṃśca tathā surān । bhaktina mrātmamūrdhā ca pulakāñcitavigrahaḥ ।। 38 ।। vasudeva uvāca paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma parameśaḥ parātparaḥ । svayaṃ vidhātā madgehe jagatāṃ paripālakaḥ ।। 39 ।। vedānāṃ janakaḥ sraṣṭā sṛṣṭihetuḥ sanātanaḥ । surāṇāṃ ca munīndrāṇāṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ ।। 40 ।। svapne yatpādapadmaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ sudurlabham । śivasmaraṇamotreṇa sarvāniṣṭāḥ palāyitāḥ ।। 41 ।। sarvasaṃkaṭamuttīrya kalyāṇaṃ labhate naraḥ । sarvāgre pūjanaṃ yasya devānāmagraṇīḥ paraḥ ।। 42 ।। ghaṭeṣu maṅgalaṃ mantrairbhaktyā cā''vāhanena ca । svayaṃ gaṇeśo bhagavān sākṣādvighnavināśakaḥ ।। 43 ।। kārtikeyaśca bhagavāndevādīnāṃ ca pūjitaḥ । devānāṃ pravarā pūjyā mahālakṣmīḥ parātparā ।। 44 ।। madgehe pārvatī mātā jagatāmādirūpiṇī । sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 45 ।। parāparāṇāṃ paramā parabrahmasvarūpiṇī । yasyāḥ pādau samārādhya vāñchitaṃ labhate naraḥ ।। 46 ।। śaratkāre ca bhaktyā ca sā sākṣānmama mandire । sarvadevaiśca sahitā sagaṇā bhaktavātsalā ।। 47 ।। kṛpāmayī ca kṛpayā cā''virbhūtā ca bhārate । dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama ।। 48 ।। āgatā'si yato durge paramādyā ca madgṛhe । evaṃ sarvāṃśca tuṣṭāva krameṇa ca parasparam ।। 49 ।। sarvānmunīndrānviprāṃśca gale baddhvāṃ'śukaṃ mudā । pratyekaṃ vāsayāmāsa ratnasihāsane vare ।। 50 ।। pūjayāmāsa vidhivatkrameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak । pratyekaṃ varayāmāsa brahmādīṃśca surānapi ।। 51 ।। munivargānbrāhmaṇāṃśca bhaktyā gargaṃ purohitam । ratnaiḥ pravālairmaṇibhirmuvatāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ ।। 52 ।। bhūṣaṇairvasanaiścaiva mālyaiśca gandhacandanaiḥ । latnasihāsane ramye sarveṣāṃ madhyadeśataḥ ।। 53 ।। gaṇeśaṃ vāsayāmāsa pūjārthaṃ śubhakarmaṇi । saptatīrthodakenaiva suvarṇakalaśena ca ।। 54 ।। puṣpajandranayuktena śītena vāsitena ca । svargagaṅgājalenaiva puṣkarodakuṇyataḥ ।। 55 ।। pañcāmṛtena śuddhena pañcagavyena bhaktitaḥ । herambaṃ snāpayāmāsa samudrodena mantrataḥ ।। 56 ।। varayāmāsa mālyena pārijātasya nārada । ratnendrabhūṣaṇenaiva vahniśuddhena vāsasā ।। 57 ।। gandhayandanapuṣpaiśca ratnamālyāṅgulīyakam । tuṣṭāva pārvatīputraṃ sarvadevādhipaṃ śubham vighnanighnakaraṃ śāntaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 58 ।। iti śrībrahma... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavadupanayane gaṇeśābhiṣeko nāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 99 ।।
<4.100> atha śātatame'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca athāditirditiścaiva devakī rohiṇī ratiḥ । sarasvatī ca sāvitrī yaśodā ca pativratā ।। 1 ।। lobāmudrā'rundhatī ca ahalyā tārakā tathā । yayustāḥ pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭavā vegena mandirādapi ।। 2 ।। parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya samāśliṣya punaḥ punaḥ । praṇamya veśayāmāsurmandiraṃ ratnanirmitam ।। 3 ।। ratnasihāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm । varayāmāsurmālyena vāsasā ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 4 ।। pārijātasya puṣpaṃ ca śakrānītaṃ manoharam । dadau tatpādapadme ca devakī bhaktipūrvakam ।। 5 ।। sindūrabinduṃ sīmante bhāle candanabindukam । kastūrīkuṅkumādīṃśca pradadau paritastayoḥ ।। 6 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa śītatoyaṃ suvāsitaṃ । tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 7 ।। alaktakaṃ ca pradadau nakheṣu pādapadmayoḥ । kuṅkumasyāpi rāgaṃ ca siṣeve śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 8 ।। maṃpujya pārvatīṃ devīṃ munipatnīḥ krameṇa ca । pūjayāmāsa vidhivatpatiputravatīḥ satīḥ ।। 9 ।। rājakanyā devakanyā nāgakanyā manoharāḥ । munikanyā bandhukanyāḥ pūjayāmāsa suvratā ।। 10 ।। vādya nānāvidhaṃ ramyaṃ vādayāmāsa kautukāt । maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa brahmaṇān ।। 11 ।। bhairavīṃ pūjayāmāsa mathurāgrāmadevatām । upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ maṅgalacaṇḍikām ।। 12 ।। puṇyaṃ svastyayanaṃ śuddhaṃ vārayāmāsa maṅgalam । vedāṃśca pāṭhayāmāsa vasudevāsya vallabhā ।। 13 ।। svargaṅgāsujalenaiva suvarmakalaśena ca । snāpayāmāsa sabalaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ putravatsalā ।। 14 ।। vastracandanamālyaiśca tayorveṣaṃ cakāra sā । ratnendrasāranirmāṇabhūṣaṇaiśca manoharaiḥ ।। 15 ।। mātṛbhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaḥ sabalaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca । āyayau ca sabhāṃ devamunīndrāṇāṃ ca nārada ।। 16 ।। dṛṣṭvā taṃ jagatāṃ rāthamuttasthau prajavena ca । svayaṃ vidhātā śaṃbhuśca śeṣo dharmaśca bhāskaraḥ ।। 17 ।। devāśca munayaścaiva kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ । pṛthakpṛthak krameṇaiva tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। 18 ।। brahmovāca nāthānirvacanoyo'si bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ । vedānirvacanīyaṃ ca kastvāṃ stotumiheśvaraḥ ।। 19 ।। mahādeva uvāca deheṣu dehināṃ śaśvatsthitaṃ nirliptameva ca । karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ śuddhaṃ sākṣiṇāṃ sākṣataṃ vibhum ।। kiṃ staumi rūpaśūnyaṃ ca guṇaśūnyaṃ ca nirguṇam ।। 20 ।। ananta uvāca kiṃvā jānāmyahaṃ nātha tvāmajño'nantamīśvaram । anantakoṭibrahmāṇḍakāraṇaṃ duḥkhatāraṇam ।। 21 ।। mahāviṣṇośca lomnāṃ ca vivareṣu jaleṣu ca । santi viśvānyasaṃkhyāni citrāṇi kṛtrimāṇi ca ।। 22 ।। santi santaśca devāśca brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ । tvadaṃśāḥ pratibimbeṣu tīrthāni bhārataṃ tathā ।। 23 ।। brahmāṇḍaikasthito'haṃ ca sūkṣmanāgasvarūpakaḥ । sthāpitaśca tvayā kūrme gajendre maśako yathā ।। 24 ।। paramāṇuparaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśveṣu nāsti kutracit । mahāviṣṇoḥ paraṃ sthūlaṃ samo nāsti ca kutracit ।। 25 ।। mahāviṣṇoḥ parastvaṃ ca tvatparo nāsti kaścana । sthūlātsthūlataro devaḥ mūkṣmātsūkṣmatamo mahān ।। 26 ।। ādhāraśca mahāviṣṇo jalarūpo bhavānsvayam । jalādhāro hi golokastvaṃ ca sthāvararūpadhṛk ।। 27 ।। marvādhāro mahānvāyuḥ śvāsaniḥ śvāsarūpakaḥ । bhaktānugrahadehasya nityasya bhavato dibho ।। 28 ।। vaktrairbahutarairvāṃ'tha tvayā dattaiḥ puraiva ca । stotumicchāmi tvadyogaṃ na dattaṃ jñānamaiśvaram ।। 29 ।। devā ūcuḥ tvāmanantaṃ yadi stotuṃ devo'nanto na hīśvaraḥ । na hi svayaṃ vidhātā ca na hi jñānātmakaḥ śivaḥ ।। sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā kiṃ kurmaḥ stavanaṃ vayam ।। 30 ।। munīndrā ūcuḥ vedā na śaktāḥ stotuṃ cettvāṃ caiva jñātumīśvaram । vayaṃ vedavidaḥ santaḥ kiṃ kurmaḥ stavanaṃ tava ।। 31 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ devaiśca munimiḥ kṛtam । yaḥ paṭhetsaṃyataḥ śuddhaḥ pūjākāle ca bhaktitaḥ ।। 32 ।। iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā labdhvā jñānaṃ nirañjanam । ratnāyānaṃ samāruhya golokaṃ sa ca gacchati ।। 33 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bhagavadupanayane śātatamo'yāyaḥ ।। 100 ।।
<4.101> athaikādhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca saṃstūya devā munayo viremurnahi mānase । dadṛśuḥ prāṅgaṇe kṛṣṇaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā ।। 1 ।। yathā saudāminīyuktaṃ navīnajaladaṃ mune । bakapaṅ ktiyutaṃ caiva mālatīmālayā tathā ।। 2 ।। kapāle maṇḍalākārakastūrīyuktacandanam । sakalaṅkaṃ mṛgāṅkaṃ ca śobhitaṃ jalade tathā ।। 3 ।। dvibhujaṃ śyāmalaṃkāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam । īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 4 ।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam । rudantaṃ piturutsaṅge balena sahitaṃ param ।। 5 ।। atha maṅgalakāle ca śubhalagne manorame । saṃpīkṣite grahaiḥ saumyairjāṃgrallagnādhipe sthite ।। 6 ।। asadgrahairadṛṣṭe ca sadgrahekṣita eva ca । śubhakarmasamārambhaṃ svastivācanapūrvakam ।। 7 ।। cakāra vasudevaścāpyājñayā suraviprayoḥ । dattvā suvarṇaśatakaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca sādaram ।। 8 ।। devendrāṃśca munīndrāśca namaskṛtya purohitam । gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ śivām ।। 9 ।। saṃpūjya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca sākṣatairdevasaṃsadi । upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ saṃyato bhaktipūrvakam ।। 10 ।। putrādhivāsanaṃ cakrai vedamantreṇa saṃsadi । saṃpūjya nānādevāṃśca dikpālāṃśca navagrahān ।। 11 ।। dattvā pañcopacārāṃśca bhaktyā ṣoḍaśamātṛkāḥ । dattvā ca vasudhārāṃ ca saptavārānghṛtena ca ।। 12 ।। cedirājaṃ vasuṃ natvā saṃpūjya prayayau punaḥ । vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ sunirvāpya yatkiṃciddaivikaṃ tathā ।। 13 ।। yajñaṃ kṛtvā tu vedoktaṃ yajñasūtraṃ dadau mudā । valadevāgracāyaiva kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।। 14 ।। gāyatrī ca dadau tābhyāṃ muniḥ sāṃdīpanistathā । bhikṣāṃ dadau ca prathamaṃ pārvatī paramādarāt ।। 15 ।। amūlyaratnapātrasthaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakam । hīrasāravinirmāṇaṃ pitrā dattaṃ ca hārakam ।। 16 ।। śubhāśiṣaṃ ca pradadau śuklapuṣpeṇā dūrvayā । tato'ditirditiścaiva munipatnyaśca devakī ।। 17 ।। yaśodā rohiṇī hṛṣṭā sāvitrī ca sarasvatī । pratyekaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitām ।। 18 ।। devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāḥ pativratāḥ । kāminyo bāndhavānāṃ ca sasmitāḥ snigdhalocanāḥ ।। 19 ।। indrāṇī varuṇānī ca pavanānī ca rohiṇī । kuberapatnīṃ svāhā ca ratiḥ kāmasya kāminī ।। 20 ।। pratyekaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām । bhikṣāṃ gṛhītvā bhagavānsabalo bhaktipūrvakam ।। 21 ।। kiṃciddadau ca gargāya
