kicitsvagurave tathā । vaidikaṃ karma nirvāpya gargāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।। 22 ।। devāṃśca bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇāṃścāpi sādaram । ye ye samāyayuryajñe teca dattvā śubhāśiṣam ।। 23 ।। kṛṇṇāya baladevāya prahṛṣṭāḥ prayayṛrguham । nandaḥ sabhāryo nirvāpya śubhakarma sutasya vai ।। 24 ।। kroḍe kṛtvā balaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cucumba vadanaṃ tayoḥ । ucacai ruroda nandaśca yaśodā ca pativratā śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ samāśvāsya bodhayāmāsa yatnataḥ ।। 25 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca sānandaṃ gaccha he mātaryaśode tātamatvaram । tvameva mātā poṣṭrī tvaṃ pitā ca paramārthataḥ ।। 26 ।। avantinagaraṃ tāta yāsyāmi sabalo'dhunā । muneḥ sāṃdīpaneḥ sthānaṃ vedapāṭhārthamīpsitam ।। 27 ।। tata āgatya suciraṃ kāle bhavati darśanam । kāmaḥ karoti kalanaṃ sa ca bhedaṃ karoti ca ।। 28 ।। sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ mātarbhedaṃ saṃmīlanaṃ nṛṇām । sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca harṣaṃ ca śokaṃ ca maṅgalālayam ।। 29 ।। mayā dattaṃ ca tattvaṃ ca yogināmapi durlabham । sarvaṃ nandaśca sānandaṃ tvāmeva kathayiṣyati ।। 30 ।। ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho vasudevasabhāṃ yayau । tadājñayā kṣaṇaṃ prāpya yayau saṃdīpanergūham ।। 31 ।। vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca saṃbhāṣya vinayena ca । nandaḥ sabhāryaḥ prayayau hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 32 ।। muktāmaṇiṃ suvarṇa ca māṇikyaṃ hīrakaṃ tathā । vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ratnaṃ nandāya devakī dadau ।। 33 ।। śvetāśvaṃ ca gajendraṃ ca suvarṇarathamuttamam । nandāya kṛṣṇaḥ pradadau vasudevaśca sādaram ।। 34 ।। tayoranuvrajanviprā devakīpramukhāḥ striyaḥ । vasudevastathā'krūro'pyuddhavaśca yayau mudā ।। 35 ।। kālindīnikaṭaṃ gatvā te sarve ruruduḥ śucā । parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya te sarve svālayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 36 ।। kuntī saputrā vidhavā vasudevājñayā mune । nānāratnamaṇiṃ prāpya prayayau svaralayaṃ mudā ।। 37 ।। vasutevo devakī ca putrakalyāṇahetave । nānāratnamaṇiṃ vastraṃ muvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā ।। 38 ।। muktāmāṇikyacahāraṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam । bhaṭṭemyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca pradadau sādaraṃ mudā ।। 39 ।। mahotsavaṃ vedapāṭhaṃ harernāmaikamaṅgalam । viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ caiva kārayāmāsa yatnataḥ ।। 40 ।। jñātīnāṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca puraskāraṃ yathocitam । cakāra maṇimāṇikyamuktāvastrairmanoharaiḥ ।। 41 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... nārādanā... utta... bhagavadupanayanaṃ nāmaikādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 101 ।।
<4.102> dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca kṛṇṇaḥ sāṃdīpanergehaṃ gatvā ca sabalo mudā । namaścakāra svaguruṃ gurupatnīṃ pativratām ।। 1 ।। śubhāśiṣaṃ gṛhītvā ca dattvā ratnamaṇiṃ hariḥ । gurave tasya bhāryāyai tamuvāca yathocitam ।। 2 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca tvatto vidyāṃ labhiṣyāmi vāñchitāṃ vāñchitaṃ mama । kṛtvā śubhakṣaṇaṃ vipra māṃ pāṭhaya yathocitam ।। 3 ।। omityuktvā muniśreṣṭhaḥ pūjayāmāsa taṃ mudā । madhuparkaprāśanena gavā vastreṇa candanaiḥ ।। 4 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayāmāsa tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitaṃ । supriyaṃ kathayāmāsa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। 5 ।। sāṃdīpaniruvāca paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paramīśa parātpara । svecchāmayaṃ svayaṃjyotirniliptaiko niraṅkuśaḥ ।। 6 ।। bhaktaikanātha bhakteṣṭa bhaktānugrahavigraha । bhaktavāñchākalpataro bhaktānāṃ prāṇavallabha ।। 7 ।। māyayā bālarūpo'si brahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ । māyayā bhuvi bhūpāla bhuvo bhārakṣayāya ca ।। 8 ।। yogino yaṃ vidantyevaṃ brahmajyotiḥ sanātanam । dhyāyante bhaktanivahā jyotirabhyantare mudā ।। 9 ।। dvibhujaṃ muralīhastaṃ sundaraṃ śyāmahupakam । candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ sasmitaṃ bhaktavatsalam ।। 10 ।। pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ vanamālavibhūṣitam । līlāpāṅgataraṅgaiśca ninditānaṅgamūrcchitam ।। 11 ।। alaktabhavanaṃ tadvatpādapadmaṃ suśobhanam । kaustubhodbhāsitāṅgaṃ ca divyamūrtiṃ manoharam ।। 12 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannaṃ ca suveṣaṃ prastutaṃ suraiḥ । devadevaṃ jagannāthaṃ trelokyamohanaṃ param ।। 13 ।। koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ kamanīyamanīśvaram । amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇaughena bhūṣitam ।। 14 ।। varaṃ varaṇyaṃ varadaṃ varadānāmabhīpsitam । caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। 15 ।। pāṭhārtha matpriyasthānamāgato'si ca māyayā । pāṭhaṃ te lokaśikṣārthaṃ ramaṇaṃ gamanaṃ raṇam ।। svātmārāmasya ca vibhoḥ paripūrṇatamasya ca ।। 16 ।। gurupatnyuvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ mama । pātivratyaṃ ca saphalaṃ saphalaṃ ca tapovanam ।। 17 ।। maddakṣahastaḥ saphalo dattaṃ yenānnamīpsitam । tadāśramaṃ tīrthaparaṃ tīrthapādapadāṅkitam ।। 18 ।। tvatpādarajasā pūtā gṛhāḥ prāṅgaṇamuttamam । tvatpādapadmaṃ dṛṣṭvā caivā''vayorjanmakhaṇḍanam ।। 19 ।। tāvadduḥkhaṃ ca śokaśca tāvadbhogaśca rogakaḥ । tāvajjanmāni karmāṇi kṣutpipāsādikāni ca ।। 20 ।। yāvattvatpādapadmasya bhajanaṃ nāsti darśanam । he kālakāla bhagavansraṣṭuḥ saṃharturīśvara ।। 21 ।। kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha māyāmohanikṛntana । ityuktvā sāśrunetrā sā kroḍe kṛtvā hariṃ punaḥ svastanaṃ pāyayāmāsa premṇā ca devakī yathā ।। 22 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca mātastvaṃ māṃ kathaṃ stauṣi bālaṃ dugdhamukhaṃ sutam । gaccha golokamiṣṭaṃ ca svāminā sahasāpratam ।। 23 ।। tyaktvā prākṛtikaṃ mithyā naśvaraṃ ca kalevaram । vidhāya nirmalaṃ dehaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam ।। 24 ।। ityuktavā caturo vedānpaṭhitvā munipuṃgavāt । māsena parayā bhaktyā dattvā putraṃ mṛtaṃ purā ।। 25 ।। ratnānāṃ ca trilakṣaṃ ca maṇīnāṃ pañcalakṣaṇam । hīrakāṇāṃ caturlakṣaṃ muktānāṃ pañcalakṣakam ।। 26 ।। māṇikyānāṃ dvilakṣaṃ ca vastraṃ trailokyadurlabham । hāraṃ ca durgayā dataṃ hastaratnāṅgulīyakam ।। 27 ।। daśakoṭiṃ suvarṇānāṃ gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadau । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ nārīsarvāṅgabhūṣaṇamā ।। 28 ।। gurupriyāyai pradadau vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ varam । munirdattvā ca putrāya taḥsarvaṃ priyayā saha ।। 29 ।। sadratnarathamāruhya yayau golokamuttamam । tamadbhūtaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau svālayaṃ mudā ।। 30 ।। evaṃ brahmaṇyadevasya caritraṃ śṛṇu nārada । idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ yaḥ paṭhedbhaktipūrvakam ।। 31 ।। śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ । aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। 32 ।। iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya yātyante śrīhareḥ padam । tatra nityaṃ harerdāsyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 33 ।। iti... śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... munipatnīstotraṃ nāma dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 102 ।।
<4.103> atha tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca athā''gatya madhupurīṃ praṇamya pitaraṃ vibhuḥ । sabalo vaṭamūle ca sasmāra garuḍaṃ hariḥ ।। 1 ।। sādaraṃ lavaṇodaṃ ca viśvakarmaṇamīpsitam । tatyāja gopaveṣaṃ ca nṛpaveṣaṃ dadhāra saḥ ।। 2 ।। etasminnantare cakramājagām hariṃ svayam । paraṃ sudarśanaṃ nāma sūryakoṭisamaprabham ।। 3 ।। tejasā hariṇā tulyaṃ paraṃ vairivimardanam । avyarthamastramastrāṇāṃ pravaraṃ paramaṃ param ।। 4 ।। ratnayānaṃ puraḥ kṛtvā garuḍo harisaṃnidhim ।viśvakarmā saśiṣyaśca jaladhiḥ kampitastathā ।। 5 ।। hariṃ praṇemuste sarve murdhnā ca bhaktipūrvakam । sasmitaḥ sādaraṃ yatnāttānuvāca kramādvibhuḥ ।। 6 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca he samudra mahābhāga sthalaṃ ca śātayojanam । dehi me nagarārtha ca paścāddāsyāmi niścitam ।। 7 ।। nagaraṃ kuru he kāro triṣu lokeṣu durlabham । ramaṇīyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kamanīyaṃ ca yoṣitām ।। 8 ।। vāñcitaṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ vaikuṇṭhasadṛśaṃ param । sarveṣāmapi svargāṇāṃ paraṃ pāramabhīpsitam ।। 9 ।। divāniśaṃ khagaśreṣṭha saṃnidhau viśvakarmaṇaḥ । sthitiṃ kuru mahābhāga yāvannirmāti dvārakām ।। 10 ।। divāniśaṃ ca matpārśve cakraśreṣṭha sthitiṃ kuru । omityukatvā tu prayayuḥ sarve cakaṃ vinā mune ।। 11 ।। kaṃsasya pitaraṃ bhadramugrasenaṃ mahābalam । nṛpaṃ cakāra nagare kṣatriyāṇāṃ satāmapi ।। 12 ।। vijitya ca jarāsaṃdhaṃ nihatya yavanaṃ tathā । upāyena mahābhāga nirmāṇakramamīśvaraḥ ।। 13 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca śatayojanaparyantaṃ nagaraṃ sumanoharam । padmarāgairmarakatairindranīlairanuttamaiḥ ।। 14 ।। rucakaiḥ pāribhadraiśca palaṅkaiśca syamantakaiḥ । gandhakairgālimaiścaiva candrakāntādibhistathā ।। 15 ।। sūryakāntādibhiścaiva putraiśca sphaṭikākṛtaiḥ । haridvarṇaiśca maṇibhiḥ śyāmairgoramukhaiścaṣaiḥ ।। 16 ।। gorocanābhiḥ pītaiśca dāḍimībījarūpakaiḥ । padmabījanibhaiścaiva nīlaiḥ kamalavarṇakaiḥ ।। 17 ।। maṇibhiḥ kajjalākārairujjvalaiśca pariṣkṛtaiḥ । śvetacampakavarṇābhaistaptakāñcanasaṃnibhaiḥ ।। 18 ।। svarṇamūlyaśataguṇairīṣadraktaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ । gariṣṭhaiśca variṣṭhaiścama ṇiśreṣṭhaiśca pūjitaiḥ ।। 19 ।। yathāvidhānaṃ yadyogaṃ yatra yanmuktamīpsitam । maṇīnāṃ haraṇaṃ caiva yakṣasaṃghā himālayāt ।। 20 ।। divāniśaṃ kariṣyanti yāvannirmāṇapūrvakam । yakṣaiśca saptabhirlakṣaiḥ kuberapreritairapi ।। 21 ।। vetālalakṣaiḥ kūṣmāṇḍalakṣaiḥ śaṃkarayojitaiḥ । dānavairbrahmarakṣobhiḥ śailakanyāniyojitaiḥ ।। 22 ।। kuru divyaṃ ca patnīnāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa । anyapatnījanasyāpi cāṣṭādhikaśatasya ca ।। 23 ।। śibiraṃ parikhayuktamuccai prākāraveṣṭitam । yuktadvādaśaśālaṃ ca siṃhadvārapariṣkṛtam ।। 24 ।। yuktaṃ citrairvicitraiśca kṛtrimaiśca kapāṭakaiḥ । niṣiddhavṛkṣarahitaṃ prasiddhaiśca pariṣkṛtam ।। 25 ।। sulakṣaṇaṃ candravedhaṃ prāṅgaṇaṃ ca tathaiva ca । yadūnāmāśramaṃ divyaṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 26 ।। sarvatra siddhaṃ nilayamugrasenasya bhūbhṛtaḥ । āśramaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ vasudevasya matpituḥ ।। 27 ।। viśvakarmovāca ke te vṛkṣāḥ praśastāśca niṣiddhāścāpi kecana । bhadrābhadrapradāścāpi tānvadasva jagadguro ।। 28 ।। keṣāmasthiniyuktaṃ ca śibiraṃ ca śubhāśubham । diśi kutra jalaṃ bhadramabhadraṃ ca vada prabho ।। 29 ।। bhadrapradaśca ko vṛkṣo diśi kṛtra pravartate । kiṃ pramāṇaṃ gṛhāṇāṃ ca prāṅgaṇānāṃ sureśvara ।। 30 ।। maṅgalaṃ kusumodyānaṃ diśi kutra tarostathā । prākārāṇāṃ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ parikhāṇāṃ sureśvara ।। 31 ।। dvārāṇāṃ ca gṛhāṇāṃ ca prākārāṇāṃ pramāṇakam । kasya kasya taroḥ kāṣṭhaṃ praśastaṃ śibire prabho ।। 32 ।। amaṅgalaṃ vā keṣāṃ ca sarva māṃ vaktumarhasi ।। 33 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca āśrame lārikelaśca gṛhiṇāṃ ca dhanapradaḥ । śibirasya yadīśāne pūrve putrapradastaruḥ ।। 34 ।। sarvatra maṅgalārhaśca tarurājo manoharaḥ । rasālavṛkṣaḥ pūrvasminnṛṇāṃ saṃpatpradastathā ।। 35 ।। śubhapradaśca sarvatra surakāro niśāmaya । bilvaśca panasaścaivajambīro badarī tathā ।। 36 ।। prajāpradaśca pūrvasmindakṣiṇe dhanadastathā । saṃpatpradaśca sarvatra yato hi bardhate gṛhī ।। 37 ।। jambūvṛkṣaśca dāḍimbaḥ kadalyāmrātakastathā । bandhupradaśca pūrvasmindakṣiṇe mitradastathā ।। 38 ।। sarvatra śubhadaścaiva dhanaputraśubhapradaḥ । harṣaprado guvākaśca dakṣiṇe paścime tathā ।। 39 ।। īśāne sukhadaścaiva sarvatraiva niśāmaya । sarvatra campakaḥ śuddho bhuvi bhadrapradastathā ।। 40 ।। alābuścāpi kūṣmāṇḍamāyāmbuśca sakiṃśukaḥ । kharjūrī karkaṭī cāpi śibire maṅgalapradā ।। 41 ।। vāstūkakārabilvaśca vārtākaśca śubhapradaḥ । latāphalaṃ ca śubhadaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatra niścitam ।। 42 ।। praśastaṃ kathitaṃ kāro niṣiddhaṃ ca niśāmaya । vanyavṛkṣo niṣiddhaśca śibire nagare'pi ca ।। 43 ।। vaṭo niṣiddhaḥ śibire nityaṃ corabhayaṃ yataḥ । nagareṣu prasiddhaśca darśanātpuṇyadastathā ।। 44 ।। niṣiddhaḥ śālmariścaiva śibire nagare pure । duḥkhapradaśca satataṃ bhūmipānāṃ sadā'pi ca ।। 45 ।। na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca । vidyāmatiniṣiddhastu satataṃ duḥkhadastadā ।। 46 ।। he kāro tintiḍīvṛkṣo yatnāttaṃ parivarjayet । śatena dhanahāniḥ syātprajāhānirbhaveddhruvam ।। 47 ।। śibire'tiniṣiddhaśca nagare kiṃcideva ca । na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca ।। 48 ।। vidyāmatiniṣiddhaśca prājñastaṃ parivarjayet । kharjūraśca gahaścaiva niṣiddhaḥ śibire tathā ।। 49 ।। na niṣiddhaḥ prasiddhaśca grāmeṣu nagaleṣu ca । vṛkṣaśca caṇakādīnāṃ dhānyaṃ ca maṅgalapradam ।। 50 ।। grāmeṣu nagare cāpi śibire ca tathaiva ca । ikṣuvṛkṣaśca śubhadaḥ saṃtataṃ śubhadastathā ।। 51 ।। aśokaśca śirīṣaśca kadambaśca śubhapradaḥ । kacciddharidrā śubhadā śubhadaścā''rdrakastathā ।। 52 ।। harītakī ca śubhadā grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca । na vādyā bhadradā nityaṃ cā''malakī ghruvam ।। 53 ।। gajānāmasthi śubhadamaśvānāṃ ca tathaiva ca । kalyāṇamuccaiḥśravasāṃ vāstau sthāpanakāriṇām ।। 54 ।। na śubhapradamanyeṣāmucchinnakāraṇaṃ param । vānarāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ gavāmapi ।। 55 ।। kukkurāṇāṃ śṛgālānāṃ mārjārāṇāmabhadrakam । bheṭakānāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ karveṣāṃ ca śubhapadam ।। 56 ।। īśāne cāpi pūrvasminpaścime ca tathottare । śibirasya jalaṃ bhadramanyatrāśubhameva ca ।। 57 ।। dīrghe prasthe samānaṃ ca na kuryānmandire budhaḥ । caturasre gṛhe kāro gṛhiṇāṃ dhananāśanam ।। 58 ।। dīrghaprasthaḥ parimito netrāṅkenāpi saṃhṛtam । śūnyena rahitaṃ bhadraṃ śūnyaṃ śūnyapradaṃ nṛṇām ।। 59 ।। prasthe hastadvayātpūrvaṃ dīrghe hastatrayaṃ tathā । gṛhāṇāṃ śubhadaṃ dvāraṃ prākārasya gṛhasya ca ।। 60 ।। na madhyadeśe kartavyaṃ kiṃcinnyūnādhike śubham । caturasraṃ candravedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṅgalapradam ।। 61 ।। abhadradaṃ sūryavedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṅgalapradam । abhadradaṃ sūryavedhaṃ prāṅgaṇaṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। 62 ।। śibirāmyantare bhadrā sthāpitā tulasī nṛṇām । dhanaputrapradātrī ca puṇyadā haribhaktidā ।। 63 ।। prabhāte tulasīṃ dṛṣṭvā svarṇadānaphalaṃ labhet । mālatī yūthikā kundaṃ mādhavī ketakī tathā ।। 64 ।। nāgeśvaraṃ mallikāṃ ca kāñcanaṃ bakulaṃ śubham । aparājitā ca śubhadā teṣāmudyānamīpsitam ।। 65 ।। pūrve ca dakṣiṇe caiva śubhadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ । ūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśahastebhyo naiva kuryādgṛhaṃ gṛhī ।। 66 ।। urdhvaṃ viṃśatihastebhyaḥ prākāraṃ na śubhapradam । sūtradhāraṃ tailakāraṃ svarṇakāraṃ ca hīrakam ।। 67 ।। vāṭīmūle grāmamadhye na kuryātsthāpanaṃ budha । brāhmaṇaṃ kṣabhiyaṃ vaiśyaṃ sacchūdraṃ gaṇakaṃ śubham ।। 68 ।। bhaṭṭaṃ vaidyaṃ puṣpakāraṃ sthāpayecchibirāntike । prasthe ca parikhāmānaṃ śatahastaṃ praśastakam ।। 69 ।। pārataḥ śibirāṇāṃ ca gambhīraṃ daśahastakam । seketapūrvakaṃ caiva parikhādvāramīpsitam ।। 70 ।। śatroragamyaṃ mitrasya gamyameva sukhena ca । śālmalīnāṃ tintiḍīnāṃ hintālānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 71 ।। nimbāṇāṃ sindhuvārāṇāṃ badarīṇāmabhadrakam । dhattūrāṇāṃ vaṭānāṃ cāpyeraṇḍānāmavāñchitam ।। 72 ।। eteṣāmatiriktānāṃ śibire kāṣṭhamīpsitam । vṛkṣaṃ ca vajrahastaṃ ca bhūdharo varjayedadhaḥ ।। 73 ।। putradāradhanaṃ hanyādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ । kathitaṃ lokaśikṣārthaṃ kurukāṣṭhaṃ vinā purīm ।। 74 ।। śubhakṣaṇaṃ cāpyadhunā gaccha vatsa yathāsukham । viśvakarmā hariṃ natvā jagām pakṣiṇā saha ।। 75 ।। samudrasya samīpaṃ ca vaṭamūlaṃ manoharam । suṣvāpa tatra naktaṃ ca kāruśca pakṣiṇā saha ।। 76 ।। svapne dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ dadarśa garuḍastathā । yatkiṃcitkathitaṃ kāruṃ kṛṣṇena paramātmanā ।। 77 ।। tadeva lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ dadarśa nagare mune । kāruṃ hamanti svapne ca sarve te śilpakāriṇaḥ ।। 78 ।। garuḍaṃ garuḍāścānye baravantaśca pakṣiṇaḥ । buddho dadarśa garuḍo viśvakarmā ca lajjitaḥ ।। 79 ।। atīva dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ śatayojanavistṛtām । brahmādīnāṃ ca nagaraṃ vijitya ca virājitām ।। tejasā''cchāditāṃ sūryaṃ ratnānāṃ ca pariṣkṛtām ।। 80 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... dvārakānirmāṇārambhe tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 103 ।।
<4.104> atha caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare brahmā bhavānyā ca bhavaḥ svayam । anantaścāpi dharmaśca bhāskaraśca hutāśanaḥ ।। 1 ।। kubero varuṇaścaiva pavanaśca yamastathā । mahendraścapi candraśca rudrāścaikādaśaiva te ।। 2 ।। anye devāśca munayo vasavaḥ sapta eva ca । ādityāścāpi daityāśca gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā ।। 3 ।। āyayurdvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca balaṃ tathā । āgacchantaṃ ca sahasā vaṭamūlaṃ manoharam ।। 4 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca devatāḥ sarvāstuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam । ākāśācca vimānaiśca saṃprāpya vaṭamūlakam ।। 5 ।। dadṛśurdvārakāṃ ramyāmatīva sumanoharam । muktāmāṇikyahīreṇā ratnarājivirājitām ।। 6 ।। paritaścaturasrāṃ ca śatayojanasaṃmitām । saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca gambhīrābhiśca veṣṭitām ।। 7 ।। prākārairnavabhiryuktāṃ lakṣaiḥ krīḍāsarovaraiḥ । manoharaiḥ sapadmaiśca sahitaiśca madhuvrataiḥ ।। 8 ।। śobhitāṃ sarvatobhadraiḥ puṣpodyānatrilakṣakaiḥ । praphullapuṣpaiḥ pavanaiḥ sarvatra surabhīkṛtām ।। 9 ।। āmoditāṃ ca śītena mandacandanavāyunā । tarubhirnārikelāṇāṃ śobhitāṃ śatakoṭibhiḥ ।। 10 ।। guvākānāṃ ca vṛkṣaiśca bhūṣitāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ । caturguṇairguvākānāṃ yuktāmāmramahīruhaiḥ ।। 11 ।। parītāṃ panasānāṃ ca vṛkṣairāmrasamairmune । suśobhitāṃ ca tālānāṃ drumairāmrasamairmune ।। 12 ।। aśvatthairbadarībhiśca bilvairāmrātakairvaṭaiḥ । śālmalībhiśca jambūbhiḥ kadambaiścāpi śobhitām ।। 13 ।। vaṃśaiśca tintiḍībhiśca campakairbakulaistathā । nāgeśvarairnāgaraṅgairjambīrairdāḍimairyutām ।। 14 ।। kharjurairarjunaiḥ piṣṭairikṣubhiḥ kāñcanairapi । harītakībhirdhātrībhirindubhiḥ paritaḥ plutām ।। 15 ।। śālaiḥ priyālairhintālaiḥ śirīṣaiḥ saptaparṇakaiḥ । anyairnānādrumairiṣṭairiṣṭāṃ yuktāṃ pariplutām ।। 16 ।। asaṃkhyairmandirai ramyairatyuccairapi saṃskṛtām । ratnendrasāranirmāṇairmuktāmāṇikyabhūṣitaiḥ ।। 17 ।। māṇikyahīrakaiścitraiḥ sadratnakalaśānvitaiḥ । maṇibhirnirmitairiṣṭaiḥ sopānanikarairvaraiḥ ।। 18 ।। kapāṭaiḥ kaṭhinairdavyairargalākīlakairyutām । harinmaṇīnāṃ stambhānāṃ kadambairapi saṃyutaiḥ ।। 19 ।। nānācitrairvicitraiśca sucitraiśca pariṣkṛtaiḥ । darpaṇaiḥ sūkṣmavastraiśca śobhitaiḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 20 ।। prāṅgaṇaiḥ padmarāgādyarindranīlapariṣkṛtām । vīthībhī ratnakhacitairājamārgaiḥ samanvitām ।। 21 ।। grīṣmadhyāhnasūryābhāṃ jvalitāṃ ratnatejasā । gavākṣalakṣaiḥ saṃyuktāṃ vājiśālāpariṣkṛtām ।। 22 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ te devā vismayaṃ yayuḥ । prasannavadano devo lāṅgalī bhagavānajaḥ ।। 23 ।। sasmāra yaduvaṃśānāṃ samūhamugrasenakam । vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca pāṇḍavāṃśca samātṛkān ।। 24 ।। nandaṃ yaśodāṃ gopālānrājendramunipuṃgavām । gandharvānkinnarāṃścaiva sahito yadupuṃgavaiḥ ।। 25 ।। nando yaśodā gopāśca jananyā saha pāṇḍavāḥ । gandharvāḥ kinnarāścaiva vidyādharyaśca nārada ।। 26 ।। kinnaryaścāpi nartakyo gāyakā vādyabhāṇḍakāḥ । bhikṣukā bhāṇḍakāścaiva bhaṭṭāścagaṇakāstathā ।। 27 ।। nānādeśo dbhavā bhūpā vaidyāścānye ca mānavāḥ । saṃnyāsinaśca yatayo'vadhūtā brahmacāriṇaḥ ।। 28 ।। āyayurmunayaḥ sarve saśiṣyāḥ siddhapuṃgavāḥ । sanakaśca sanandaśca ttīyaśca sanātanaḥ ।। 29 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavāñjñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ । śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdha pañcavarṣā digambaraḥ ।। 30 ।। śiṣyaistrilakṣaiḥ sahito durvāsā bhagavānajaḥ । lakṣaśiṣyaiḥ kaśyapaśca vālmīkiśca trilakṣakaiḥ ।। 31 ।। lakṣaśiṣyairgau tamaśca kauṭibhiśca bṛhaspatiḥ । śukrastrikoṭibhiḥ sārdha bharadvājaśca lakṣakaiḥ ।। 32 ।। śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdhamaṅgirā bhagavānajaḥ । vasiṣṭhaḥ koṭibhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ pracetāḥ koṭibhistathā ।। 33 ।। trilakṣaiśca pulastyaścāpyagastyaḥ koṭibhiḥ saha । pulaho lakṣaśiṣyaiśca kraturlakṣaisthaiva ca ।। 34 ।। atristrikoṭibhiḥ śiṣyairbhṛguśca pañcakoṭibhiḥ । trikoṭibhirmarīciśca śatānandaḥ sahasrakaiḥ ।। 35 ।। sārdha trikoṭibhiḥ śiṣyairṛṣyaśṛṅgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ । pāpiniḥ koṭibhiḥ śiṣyairlakṣaiḥ kātyāyanastathā ।। 36 ।। yājñavalkyaḥ sahasraiśca vyāsaḥ śiṣyatrikoṭibhiḥ । śiṣyairlakṣaiśca sahito gargaḥ kulapulohitaḥ ।। 37 ।। gālavaśca sahasraiśca sahasaiḥ saubharistathā । trikoṭibhirlomaśaśca mārkaṇḍeyastrikoṭibhiḥ ।। 38 ।। koṭibhirvāmadevaśca jaigīṣavyastrikoṭibhiḥ । sāṃdīpanirdevalaśca sacchiṣyaiśca trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 39 ।। voḍhuḥ śiṣyaiḥ koṭibhiśca lakṣaiḥ pañcaśikhastathā । ahaṃ nārāyaṇaścaiva naro mama sahodaraḥ ।। 40 ।। śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdhaṃ viśvāmitraśca koṭibhiḥ । trikoṭibhirjaratkārurāstīkaśca trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 41 ।। trikoṭibhiḥ parśurāmo vatso lakṣaiśca śiṣyakaiḥ । dakṣastrilakṣaiḥ śiṣyaiśca kapilaḥ pañcakoṭibhiḥ ।। 42 ।। saṃvartaśca trilakṣaiścāpyutathyaśca tathaiva ca । sahasrairjaiminiścaiva pailo lakṣaistathaiva ca ।। 43 ।। suvaṇaṃśca sahasraiśca vaiśampāyana eva ca । śiṣyairlakṣaiḥ sametaśca vyāsaśiṣyaḥ purogamaḥ ।। 44 ।। lakṣaiḥ śiṣyaistathā śṛṅgī copamanyustathaiva ca । sahasraiśca gauramukhaḥ kaco lakṣairguroḥ sutaḥ ।। 45 ।। aśvatthāmā tathā droṇaḥ kṛpācāryaḥ saśiṣyakaḥ । bhīṣmaḥ karṇaśca śakunī rājā duryodhanastathā ।। nṛpasya bhrātaraḥ sarve cānye bhūpā jagadgurum ।। 46 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca śubhakarmaṇi niṣpanne yāsyanti ye samāgatāḥ । śivabrahmādayo devā munayaśca tathā'pare ।। 47 ।। bhavāśca yādavaiḥ sārdhaṃ praviśa dvārakāṃ purīm । matpitrā mātṛbhiḥ sārdha māhendre ca kṣaṇe nṛpa ।। 48 ।। apare yadavo'nye ca yāsyanti mathurāṃ purīm । śrutveti viraso rājā tamuvāca bhayākulaḥ ।। 49 ।। ugrasena uvāca vāsudeva na yāsyāmi bhūmiṃ tāṃ paitṛkīṃ punaḥ । sarvatīrthaparāṃ śuddhāṃ daive karmaṇi paitṛke ।। 50 ।। pāvake bhūmideśe ca pitṝṇāṃ nirvapettu yaḥ । tadbhūmiḥ svāmipitṛbhiḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi hanyate ।। 51 ।। pitṝṇāṃ niṣphalaṃ śrāddhaṃ devānāmapi pūjanam । kiṃcitphalapradaṃ caiva saṃpūrṇe paitṛke sthale ।। 52 ।। putrapautrakalatrebhyaḥ prāṇebhyaḥ preyasī sadā । durlabhā paidṛkī bhūmiḥ piturmāturgarīṃyasī ।। 53 ।। tatsatyaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca daive karmaṇi paitṛke । krīḍāṃ ca datte dānaṃ ca paradattamaśuddhakam ।। 54 ।। mriyate paitṛkībhūmyaṃ tīrthatulyaphalaṃ labhet । gaṅgājalasamaṃ pūtaṃ patṛkhātodakaṃ hare ।। 55 ।। tatra snātvā jale pūte gaṅgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet । pitaṇāṃ tarpaṇāṃ tatra pavitraṃ devapūjanam ।। 56 ।। paitṛkī janmabhūmiśceddviguṇaṃ tatphalaṃ labhet । paitṛkībhūmitulyāca dānabhūmiḥ satāmapi ।। 57 ।। vāsudeva uvāca bhogāste vacanaṃ kiṃ vā niṣekaḥ kena vāryaṃte । paitṛkī tīrthatulyā sā kiṃ tīrthaṃ dvārakāparam ।। 58 ।। sarvatīrthaparā śreṣṭhā dvārakā bahapuṇyadā । yasyāḥ praveśamātreṇa narāṇāṃ janmakhaṇḍanam ।। 59 ।। dānaṃ ca dvārakāyāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca devapūjanam । caturguṇaṃ ca tīrthānāṃ gaṅgādīnāṃ ca bhūmipa ।। 60 ।। gaccha brahmadibhiḥ sārdha munibhiryādavaiḥ saha । rājendrabhavanaṃ tatra gṛhāṇāṃ sādaraṃ punaḥ ।। 61 ।। karoti śaśvannyakkāraṃ mahendrasyāmarāvatīm । nivasa tvaṃ sudharmāyāṃ māhendre ca kṣaṇe nṛpa ।। 62 ।। jambudvīpasthitā bhūpā rājendramaṇḍaleśvarāḥ । karaṃ dāsyanti tubhayaṃ ca mahendrāya surā yathā ।। 63 ।। bhūyājjitaḥ kuberaśca dhanena dhanasaṃpadā । tejasā bhāskaraścāpi mahendraḥ saṃpadaḥ tathā ।। 64 ।। devā jitā raṇenaiva puṇyena munayo jitāḥ । tapasvinaśya tapasā vratīnaśca vratena ca ।। 65 ।। ugrasenasamo rājā na bhūto na bhaviṣyati । sabhāyāṃ yasya bhagavānbaladevo mahābalaḥ ।। 66 ।। viśvaṃ ca yasya śirasāṃ sahasrāṇaṃ nareśvara । ekasmiñśirasi nyastaṃ śūrpe ca sarṣapo yathā ।। 67 ।। na hyanantasamo devo balena balavattaraḥ । yadguṇānāṃ ca nāstyantastenānantaṃ jagurbudhāḥ ।। 68 ।। vasavo'ṣṭau mahābhāgā rudrāśca śaṃkaraṃ vinā । balino dvādaśādityā mahendraśca suraiḥ samaḥ ।। 69 ।। na samarthā dhruvaṃ jetumugrasenaṃ nṛpeśvaram । kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prasannavadano nṛpaḥ ।। 70 ।। prayayau yādavaiḥ sārdha mahendrabhavanātparam । svālayaṃ dvārakāmadhye jvalantaṃ maṇitejasā ।। 71 ।। sahasraidvaripālaiśca śūlibhirdaṇḍahastakaiḥ । niyuktai rakṣitaṃ dvāraṃ dadarśa mānaveśvaraḥ ।। 72 ।। abhyantare ca śibiraṃ dvārebhyaḥ ṣaḍbhya eva ca । mandirāṇāṃ ca śatakai ratnānāṃ paribhūṣaṇam ।। 73 ।। koṭiṃ mattagajendrāṇāṃ dadarśa gajamandire । caturyugaṃ gajaughaṃ gajānāṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ tathā ।। 74 ।। mahābalāṃśca turagānsūryāśvaṃ ca hasanti ye । gajendrarājaṃ sarveṣāṃ vāhanānāmapīśvaram ।। 75 ।। hasatyairāvataṃ śaśvanmahendrasya ca nārada । atyuccairuccaiḥśravamāṃ dadarśa koṭimīpsitam ।। 76 ।। kharāṇāṃ daśakoṭiṃ ca pādātaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ tathā । nirmāṇaṃ ratnasārāṇāṃ tathānāṃ pañcalakṣakam ।। 77 ।। pañcalakṣaṃ sārathīnāṃ tatrāśvaṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ tathā । aśvavāṭaṃ tatsamaṃ ca sudharmāṃ ca sabhāmapi ।। 78 ।। dadarśāmyantare ramye devaughamunisaṃyutām । vahniśuddhāśukai ramyairbhūṣitāṃ raktakambalaiḥ ।। 79 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanai ramyairbhūṣitāṃ raktapiṅgalaiḥ । amūlyaratnanirmāṇavīthīnāṃ tejasojjvalām ।। 80 ।। veṣṭitāṃ ca mahābhītaiḥ kiṃkaraiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ । praviveśa sabhāṃ ramyāṃ śrutvā śaṅkhadhvaniṃ śubham ।। 81 ।। vādyaṃ ca duṃdubhīnāṃ ca munīnāṃ vedamantrakam । dṛṣṭvā nṛpaṃ samuttasthau vegena sabalo hariḥ ।। 82 ।। brahmā maheśvaraścaiva śeṣaśca devapuṃgavāḥ । samuttasthuḥ surāḥ sarve munayaśca mahāvratāḥ ।। 83 ।। rājendrāścāpi siddhendrā vasudevapurogamāḥ । ratnasiṃhāsane ramye cograseno mahābalaḥ ।। 84 ।। samuvāsa mahendrasya munīnāmājñayā hareḥ । devānāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca gargasyāpi tathaiva ca ।। 85 ।। saptatīrthodakenaiva pūrṇakumbhena nārada । jakāra vedamantraiśca nṛpasyāpyabhiṣecanam ।। 86 ।। tasmai vastrayugaṃ dattaṃ vahniśuddhaṃ manoharam । varuṇena purā dattaṃ kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।। 87 ।। mālyaṃ ca pārijātānāṃ candanaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam । ratnacchatraṃ dadau tasmai baladevo mahābalaḥ ।। 88 ।। brahmā kamaṇḍaluṃ caiva śūlaṃ cāpi maheśvaraḥ । pārvatī ratnamālyaṃ ca hāraṃ ca mālatī satī ।। 89 ।। anye devāśca munayo rājendrāḥ siddhapuṃgavāḥ । yautakaṃ ca dadau tasmai krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 90 ।। vasudevo dadau tasmai śubhadaṃ śvetacāmaram । pavanena purā dattaṃ kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।। 91 ।। nando dadau ca surabhiṃ kāmadhenuṃ ca pūjitām । yaśodā devakī tasmai ratnaśreṣṭhaṃ dadau mudā ।। 92 ।। saptabhiḥ kiṃkaraiścāpi saivitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ । dadhāra cchatramakrūro bhaktyā caivā''jñayā hareḥ ।। 93 ।। ratnasihāsane ramye dadarśa ratnadarpaṇam । atīva puṇyāvāpyaṃ ca hariṇāṃ ca puraskṛtaḥ ।। 94 ।। cakruḥ stutiṃ ca bhaṭṭāśca bhiṅukā brāhmaṇāstathā । daduḥ śubhāśiṣaṃ tasmai devāśca munayastathā ।। 95 ।। brahmaṇemyo dadau rājā ratnakoṭiṃ ca bhaktataḥ । bhaṭṭabhyo ratnaśatakaṃ bhikṣukemyastathaiva ca ।। 96 ।। abhiṣicya nṛpendraṃ ca devāṃśca munipuṃgavān । saṃpūjya brāhmaṇāṃścāpi bhaṭṭānbhikṣuṃ dvijaṃ gurum ।। 97 ।। svālayaṃ ca yayuḥ sarve yādavāśca mudā'nvitāḥ । ye ye hareḥ pārṣadāśca te sarve svālayaṃ yayuḥ ।। 98 ।। prabhāte cā''yayuḥ sarve sudharmā ca sabhāṃ hareḥ । namaskṛtya nṛpendraṃ ca coṣuḥ sarve ca saṃsadi ।। 99 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... dvārakāpraveśa ugrasenābhiṣeko nāma caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 104 ।।
<4.105> atha pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha vaidarbharājendro mahābalaparākram । vidarbhadeśe puṇyāśca satyaśīlaśca bhīṣmakaḥ ।। 1 ।। rājā nārāyaṇāṃśaśca dātā ca sarvasaṃpadām । dharmiṣṭhasca garīyāṃśca variṣṭhaśṭāpi pūjitaḥ ।। 2 ।। tasya kanyā mahālakṣmī rukmiṇī yoṣitāṃ varā । atīva sundarī ramyā ramā rāmāsu pūjitā ।। 3 ।। navayauvanasaṃpannā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā । taptakāñcanavarṇābhā tejasojjvalitā satī ।। 4 ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpā sā satyaśīlā pativratā । śāntā dāntā nitāntā cāpyanantaguṇaśālinī ।। 5 ।। indrāṇī varuṇānī ca candranārī ca rohiṇī । kuberapatnī sūryastrī svāhā śāntā kalāvatī ।। 6 ।। anyāsu ramaṇīyāsu śreṣṭhā ca sumanoharā । rukmiṇyā bhīṣmakanyāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ।। 7 ।। tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājarājendro vālakrīḍāratāṃ parām । bālāṃ suśobhāṃ kurvantīṃ yathā'bhreṣu vidhoḥ kalām ।। 8 ।। śaratpūrṇenduśobhāḍhyāṃ śaratkamalalocanām । vivāhayogyāṃ yuvatīṃ lajjānamrānanāṃ śubham ।। 9 ।। sahasā cintito dharmo dharmaśīlaśca suvrataḥ । sutāṃ papraccha putrāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃśca purohitān ।। 10 ।। kaṃ vṛṇomi sutārdha ca varāhaṃ pravaraṃ varam । muniputraṃ devaputraṃ rājendrasutamīpsitam ।। 11 ।। vivāhayogyā kanyā me vardhamānā manoharā । śīghraṃ paśya varaṃ yāgyaṃ navayauvanasaṃsthitam ।। 12 ।। dharmaśīlaṃ satyasaṃdhaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam । mahākulaprasūtaṃ ca sarvatraiva pratiṣṭhitam ।। 14 ।। karoṣi rājaputraṃ cedraṇaśāstraviśāradam । mahārathaṃ pratāpārhaṃ raṇamūrdhni ca susthiram ।। 15 ।। karoṣi devaputraṃ ceddevaṃ guṇayutaṃ tathā । karoṣi muniputraṃ ceccaturvedaviśāradam ।। 16 ।। vāvadūkaṃ vicārajñaṃ siddhānteṣu nitāntakam । nṛpendravacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca muneḥ sutaḥ ।। 17 ।। gotamasya śatānando vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ । āptaḥ pravaktā vijñaśca dharmī kulapurohitaḥ ।। pṛthivyāṃ sarvatattvajño niṣṇātaḥ sarvakarmasu ।। 18 ।। śatānanda uvāca rājendra tvaṃ ca dharmajño dharmaśāstraviśāradaḥ । pṛrvākhyānaṃ ca vedoktaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 19 ।। bhuvo bhārāvataraṇe svayaṃ nārāyaṇo bhuvi । vasudevasutaḥ śrīmānparibūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 20 ।। vidhātuśca vidhātā ca brahmeśaśeṣavanditaḥ । jyotiḥsvarūpaḥ paramo bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 21 ।। paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ prakṛteḥ paraḥ । nirliptaśca nirīhaptaśca sākṣī ca sarvakarmaṇām ।। 22 ।। rājendra tasmai kanyāṃ ca paripūrṇatamāya ca । dattvā yāsyasi golokaṃ pitṝṇāṃ śatakaiḥ saha ।। 23 ।। labha sārūpyamuktiṃ ca kanyā dattvāṃ paratra ca । ihaiva sarvapūjyaśca bhava viśvagurorguruḥ ।। 24 ।। sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā mahālakṣmīṃ ca rukmiṇīm । samarpaṇaṃ kuruvibho kuruṣva janmakhaṇḍanam ।। 25 ।। vidhātā nikhito rājansaṃbandhaḥ sarvasaṃmataḥ । dvārakānagare kṛṣṇaṃ śīghraṃ prasthāpaya dvijam ।। 26 ।। kṛtvā śubhakṣaṇaṃ tūrṇa sarveṣāmapi saṃmatam । ānīya paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 27 ।। dhyānānurodhahetuṃ ca nityadehamanuttamam । dṛṣṭimātrātkuru nṛpa svajanmakarmakhaṇḍanam ।। 28 ।। yaṃ na jānanti catvāro vedāḥ saṃtaśca devatāḥ । siddhendrāśca munīndrāśca devā brahmādayastathā ।। 29 ।। dhyāyante dhyānapūtāśca yogino na vidanti yam । sarasvatī jaḍībhūtā vedāḥ śāstrāṇiyāni ca ।। 30 ।। sahasravaktraḥ śeṣaśca pañcavaktraḥ sadāśivaḥ । caturmukho jagaddhātā kumāraḥ kārtikastathā ।। 31 ।। ṛṣayo munayaścaiva bhaktāḥ paramavaiṣṇavāḥ । akṣamāḥ stavane yasya dhyānāsādhyaśca yoginām ।। 32 ।। bālako'haṃ mahārāja tadguṇaṃ kathayāmi kim । śatānandavacaḥ śrutvā praphullavadano nṛpaḥ ।। 33 ।। āniṅganaṃ dadau tasmai samutthāya javena ca । nānāratnaṃ muvarṇa ca vastraṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇam ।। 34 ।। dadau tasmai pradānaṃ ca prasādasumukho nṛpaḥ । gajendra turagaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rathaṃ ca maṇinirmitam ।। 35 ।। ratnasihāsanaṃ ramyaṃ dhanaṃ ca vipulaṃ tathā । bhūmiṃ ca sarvasasyāḍhyāṃ śaśvadvṛṣṭikarīṃ śubhām ।। 36 ।। akṛṣṭasādhyāṃ pūjyāṃ ca grāmaṃ sarvapraśaṃsitam । etasminnantare rukmiścukopa nṛpanandanaḥ ।। 37 ।। kampito'dharmayuktaśca raktāsyo raktalocanaḥ । uvāca pitaraṃ vripraṃ sabhāyāmasthirastadā ।। 38 ।। utyāya tiṣṭhanpurataḥ sarveṣāṃ ca sabhāsadām ।। 39 ।। rukmiruvāca śrṛṇu rājendra vacanaṃ hitaṃ tathayaṃ praśaṃsitam । tyaja vākyaṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ lobhināṃ krodhināmaho ।। 40 ।। nartakānāṃ ca vaiśyānāṃ bhaṭṭānāmarthināmapi । kāyasthānāṃ ca bhikṣūṇāmasatyaṃ vacanaṃ sadā ।। 41 ।। ghaṭakānāṃ nāṭakānāṃ strīlubdhānā ca kāminām । daridrāṇāṃ ca mūrkhāṇāṃ stutipūrva vacaḥ sadā ।। 42 ।। nihatya kālayavanaṃ rājendraṃ dūrato bhiyā । uvāyena mahābāho labdhaṃ kṛṣṇena taddhanam ।। 43 ।। dvārakāyā dhanī kṛṣṇo yavanasya dhanena ca । jarāsaṃdhabhayenaiva samudrābhyantare gṛhī ।। 44 ।। jarāsaṃdhaśataṃ caiva kṣaṇenaiva ca līlayā । kṣamo'haṃ hantumekākī rājñaścānyasya kā kathā ।। 45 ।। durvāsasaśca śiṣyo'haṃ raṇaśāstraviśāradaḥ । dhruvaṃ bhīṣmaka tenaiva viśvaṃ saṃhartumīśvaraḥ ।। 46 ।। matsamaḥ parśurāmaśca śiśupālaśca matsamaḥ । sakhā ca balavāñchūraḥ svargaṃ jetuṃ sa ca kṣamaḥ ।। 47 ।। mahendraṃ sagaṇaṃ jetumahamīśaḥ kṣaṇena ca । jitvā yuddhe jarāsaṃdhaṃ durbalaṃ yoginaṃ nṛpa ।। 48 ।। ahaṃkārayutaḥ kṛṣṇo pīraṃ svaṃ manyate dhiyā । yadyāyāsyati madgrāmaṃ vivāhaṃ kartumīpsitam ।। 49 ।। dhruvaṃ prasthāpayiṣyāmi kṣaṇena yamamandiram । aho nandasya vaiśyasya tasmai gorakṣakāya ca ।। 50 ।। sākṣājjārāya gopīnāṃ gopālocchiṣṭabhojine । karoṣi kanyāsvīkāraṃ devayogyāṃ ca rukmiṇīm ।। 51 ।। dātumicchasi vākyena bhiṅukasya dvijasya ca । rājendra buddhihīno'si vacanādvadga(durba) lasya ca ।। 52 ।। mā rājaputro māśūro ma kulīnaśca mā śuciḥ । mā dātā mā dhanāḍhyaśca mā yogyo mā jitendriyaḥ ।। 53 ।। kanyāṃ dehi suputrāya śiśupālāya bhūmipa । balena rudratuṣṭāya rājendratanayāya ca ।। 56 ।। nimantraṇaṃ kuru nṛpa nānādeśabhavānnṛpān । bāndhavāṃśca munīndrāṃśca patradvārā tvarānvitaḥ 55 ।। aṅgaṃ kaliṅgaṃ magadhaṃ saurāṣṭraṃ valkalaṃ varam । rāṭaṃ varendraṃ vaṅgaṃ ca gurjaraṭiṃ ca paṭheram ।। 56 ।। mahārāṣṭraṃ virāṭaṃ ca mudgalaṃ ca muraṅgakam । bhallakaṃ gallakaṃ kharva durgaṃ prasthāpaya dvijam ।। 57 ।। ghṛtakulyāsahasraṃ ca madhukulyāsahasrakam । dadhikulyāsahasraṃ ca dugdhakulyāsahasrakam ।। 58 ।। tailakulyāpañcaśataṃ guḍakulyādvilakṣakam । śarkarāṇāṃ rāśiśataṃ miṣṭānnānāṃ caturguṇam ।। 59 ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ piṣṭarāśiśataṃ śatam । pṛthukānāṃ rāśilakṣamannānāṃ ca caturguṇam ।। 60 ।। gavāṃ lakṣaṃ chedanaṃ ca hariṇānāṃ dvilakṣakam । caturlakṣaṃ śaśānāṃ ca kūrmāṇāṃ ca tathā kuru ।। 61 ।। daśalakṣaṃ chāgalānāṃ bheṭānāṃ taccaturguṇam । parvaṇi grāmadevyai ca baliṃ dehi ca bhaktitaḥ ।। 62 ।। eteṣāṃ pakvamāṃsaṃ ca bhojanārtha ca kāraya । paripūrṇa vyañjanānāṃ sāmagrīṃ kuru bhūmipa ।। 63 ।। atha śrutvā ca tadvākyaṃ rājendraḥ sapurohitaḥ । cakāra mantraṇāṃ tūrṇa nirjane mantriṇā saha ।। 64 ।। dvijaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa dvārakāṃ yogyamīpsitam । kṛtvā ca śubhalagnaṃ ca sarveṣāmabhivāñchitam ।। 65 ।। rājā saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro babhūva satvaraṃ mṛdā । nimantraṇaṃ ca sarvatra cakāra ca sutājñayā ।। 66 ।। vipraḥ sudharmāṃ saṃprāpya nṛpairdevaiśca veṣṭitām । pradadī patrikāṃ bhadrāmugrasenāya bhūbhṛte ।। 67 ।। praphullavadano rājā śrutvā patraṃ sumaṅgalam । suvarṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।। 68 ।। duṃdubhiṃ vādayāmāsa dvārakāyāṃ ca sarvataḥ । devānmunīnnṛpāṃścaiva jñātivargāśca bāndhavān ।। 69 ।। bhaṭṭāṃśca bhikṣukāṃścaiva bhojayāmāsa sādaram । śrīkṛṣṇasya sṛveṣaṃ ca kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।। 70 ।। atīva ramyamatulaṃ treṣu lokeṣu dulrabham । yātrāṃ ca kārayāmāsa jagatāṃ pravaraṃ varam ।। 71 ।। vedamantreṇa ramyeṇa māhendre sumanohare । ādau brahmā rathasthaśca sāvitryā sahito yayau ।। 72 ।। rathasyaśca mahāhṛṣṭo bhavānyā ca bhavaḥ svayam । śeṣaścāpi dineśaśca gaṇeśaścāpi kārtikaḥ ।। 73 ।। mahendraścatathā candro varuṇaḥ pavanastathā । kuberaśca yamo vahnirīśāno'pi yayau mudā ।। 74 ।। devānāṃ ca trikoṭyaśca munīnāṃ ṣaṣṭikoṭayaḥ । rājendrāṇāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca śvetacchatraṃ trilakṣakam ।। 75 ।। ugraseno babhau rājā nakṣatreṣu yathā śaśī । yayau prasannavadanaḥ kuṇḍinābhimukho balī ।। 76 ।। ratnanirmāṇayānena baladevo mahābalaḥ । vasudevaścoddhavaśca nando'krūraśca sātyakiḥ ।। 77 ।। gopālā yādavendrāśca candravaṃśyāśca te yayuḥ । dhṛtarāṣṭrasutāḥ sarve duryodhanapulogamāḥ ।। 78 ।। yudhiṣṭhirastathā bhīmaḥ phālguno nakulastathā । sahadevaśca yānaiśca prayayuḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ ।। 79 ।। bhīṣmo droṇaśca karṇaścāpyaśvatthāmā mahābalaḥ । kṛpācāryaśca śakuniḥ śalyaścaprayayau mudā ।। 80 ।। bhaṭānāṃ ca trikoṭyaśca viprāṇāṃ śatakoṭayaḥ । saṃnyāsināṃ sahasraṃ ca yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।। 81 ।। dvisahasraṃ jitakrodhāścāvadhūtāstathaiva ca । utpalānāṃ sahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ puṣpakāriṇām ।। 82 ।। nānāśirpakarāścaiva vicitraṃ citrameva ca । lakṣaṃ ca vādyabhāṇḍānāṃ nartakānāṃ ca lakṣakam ।। 83 ।। gandharvāṇāṃ gāyakānāṃ lakṣameva tu nārada । tatra kalpe bhaktyeva gandharvaścopabarhaṇaḥ ।। 84 ।। pañcāśatkāminībhiśca tvameva teṣu madhyagaḥ । vidyādharīṇāṃ lakṣaṃ ca lakṣamapsarasāṃ tathā ।। 85 ।। kinnarāṇāṃ trilakṣaṃ cagandharvāṇāṃ trilakṣakam ।। 86 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rukmiṇyudvāhe pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 105 ।।
<4.106> atha paḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥnārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare nājā kakudmī ca mahābalaḥ । varārthaṃ kanyakāyāśca brahmalokātsamāgataḥ ।। 1 ।। pradadau revatīṃ kanyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām । amūlyaratnabhūṣāḍhyā triṣu lokeṣu durlabhām ।। 2 ।। balāya baladevāya saṃpradānena kautukāt । vayo yasyā gataṃ satye yugānāṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ ।। 3 ।। dattvā kanyāṃ vidhānena munidevendrasaṃsadi । gajendrāṇāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca jāmātre yautukaṃ dadau ।। 4 ।। daśalakṣaṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ rathānāṃ lakṣameva ca । ratnālaṃkārayuktānāṃ dāsīnāṃ cāpi lakṣakam ।। 5 ।। maṇilakṣaṃ ratnalakṣaṃ svarṇakoṭiṃ ca sādaram । vahniśuddhāṃśukaṃ ramyaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakam ।। 6 ।। dattavā kanyāṃ ca rājendo balāya balaśāline । ratnendrasārayānena taiḥ sārdha kuṇḍinaṃ yayau ।। 7 ।। athāntare ca nirbandhe sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi । revatīṃ veśayāmāsa yoṣitāṃ kamalākalām ।। 8 ।। devakī rohiṇī caiva yaśodā nandagehinī । aditiśca ditiḥ śāntirjayaṃ kṛtvā ca mandiram ।। 9 ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa dadau tebhyo dhanaṃ mudā । maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa vasudevasya vallabhā ।। 10 ।। atha devāśca munayo rājendraḥ kaṭakaiḥ saha । saṃprāpurlīlāmātreṇa kuṇḍinaṃ nagaraṃ mudā ।। 11 ।। dadṛśurnagaraṃ sarve hyatīva sumanoharam । saptabhiḥpariśābhiśca gabhīrābhiśca veṣṭitam ।। 12 ।। prākāraiḥ saptabhiryuktaṃ dvārāṇāṃ śatakaistathā । nānāratnaiśca maṇibhirnirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ।। 13 ।। nagarasya bahirdvāraṃ dadṛśurvarayātriṇaḥ । rakṣitaṃ rakṣakaiḥ sārdha caturbhiśca mahārathaiḥ ।। 14 ।। rukmiśca śiśupālaśca dantavaktro mahābalī । śālvo māyāvināṃ śreṣṭho yuddhaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। 15 ।। nānāśāsratraistathā'śtraiśca rathasthaśca raṇonmukhaḥ । vilokya kṛṣṇasainyaṃ ca cukopa nṛpanandanaḥ ।। 16 ।। uvāca niṣṭhuraṃ vākyaṃ śrutitīkṣmaṃ suduṣkaram । upahāsya munīndrāṃśca devāṃśca munipuṃgavān ।। 17 ।। rukmiruvāca aho kālakṛtaṃ karma daivaṃ ca kena vāryate । kiṃvā'haṃ kathayiṣyāmi devendrāṇāṃ ca saṃsadi ।। 18 ।। grahītuṃ rukmiṇīṃ kanyāṃ devayogyāṃ manoharām । āyāti devairmunibhirnandasya paśurakṣakaḥ ।। 19 ।। sākṣājjāraśca gopīnāṃ gopocchiṣṭānnabhojanaḥ । jāteśca nirmayo nāsti bhakṣyamaithunayostathā ।। 20 ।। kiṃ nu rājendraputraśca kiṃ nu vā muniputrakaḥ । vasudevaḥ kṣatriyaśca bhakṣaṇaṃ vaiśyamandire ।। 21 ।। śiśukāle ca strīhatyā kṛtā'nena durātmanā । kubjā mṛtā ca saṃbhogādvāsasā rajako mṛtaḥ ।। 22 ।। rājendrasya vadhe duṣṭo brahmahatyāṃ labheddhruvam । mathurāyāṃ ca dharmiṣṭhaḥ sadyaḥ kaṃso nipātitaḥ ।। 23 ।। śālva uvāca yaduktaṃ rukmiṇā devāḥ kimasatyaṃ ca tatra vai । ko vā'yaṃ rukmiṇībhartā nandasya paśurakṣakaḥ ।। 24 ।। śiśupāla uvāca aho bhuvi kimāścarya devā brahmādayastathā । munīndrā brahmaṇaḥ putrāścā''yayurmānavājñayā ।। 25 ।। dantavaktra uvāca saṃtataṃ brāhmaṇā lubdhā devāśca bhaktavatsalāḥ । āyayurbrahmaputrāśca nandaputrājñayā katham ।। 26 ।। teṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa devasaṃdhakaḥ । munirājendrasaṃghaśca lāṅgalītyādayastathā ।। 27 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rukmiṇyudvāhe ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 106 ।।
<4.107> atha saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kopapītaśca baladevo mahābalaḥ । halena rukmiyānaṃ ca babhañja munipuṃgava ।। 1 ।। ghoṭakānsārathiṃ caiva nihatya jagatīpatiḥ । bhumiṣṭhaṃ cāpi pāpiṣṭhaṃ rukmiṃ hantuṃ jagāma saḥ ।। 2 ।। rukmī ca śarajālena vārayāmāsa līlayā । nāgāstraṃ yojayāmāsa baddhuṃ halinamīśvaram ।। 3 ।। nāgāstraṃ gāruḍenaiva saṃjahāra halī svayam । jagrāha kopādrukmī ca paraṃ pāśupataṃ mune ।। 4 ।। avyarthaṃ vairimarda ca śatasūryasamaprabham । abhito halinā rukmī jṛmbhaṇāstreṇa jṛmbhitaḥ ।। 5 ।। bhūmiṣṭhaḥ sthāṇumadrukmī nidrāstreṇaiva nidritaḥ । śālvastaṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā śatabāṇānmumoca tam ।। 6 ।। śailavṛṣṭiṃ śilāvṛṣṭiṃ jalavṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ । jvaladaṅgāravṛṣṭiṃ ca śaravṛṣṭiṃ cakāra ha ।। 7 ।। balāccāstreṇa sarvāṇi vārayāmāsa lāṅgalī । halena tadrathaṃ cūrṇa cakāra raṇamadhyataḥ ।। 8 ।। ghoṭakānsārathiṃ caiva jaghāna caiva līlayā । kopādbalena taṃ hantuṃ vāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī ।। 9 ।। tyaja śālvaṃ kṛṣṇavadhyaṃ tava kiṃ pauruṣaṃ raṇe । yasya mūrdhni ca brahmāṇḍaṃ śūrpe ca sarṣape yathā ।। 10 ।। tacchrutvā baladevaśca halena tasya mastakam । cakāra cūrṇa vyathitaḥ papāta raṇamūrdhani ।। 11 ।। śālvasya patanaṃ dṛṣṭvā śiśupālo mahābalī । cakāra śaravṛṣṭiṃ ca jalavṛṣṭiṃ yathā bhuvi ।। 12 ।। halī tasya rathaṃ cūrṇa cakāra lāṅgalena ca । ardhacandreṇa tadvāṇānvārayāmāsa līlayā ।। 13 ।। taṃ hantuṃ śaṃkaraḥ sākṣānniṣedhaṃ ca cakāra tam । kṛṣṇavadhyaṃ tyaja bala pārṣadapravaraṃ haraḥ ।। 14 ।। dantavaktrasya dantaṃ ca babhañja sa halena ca । supravṛttasya yuddhena te sarve jahasuśca tam ।। 15 ।। balasya vikramaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vīrāḥ palāyitāḥ । cakruḥ praveśanaṃ sarve kuṇḍinaṃ varayātrikāḥ ।। 16 ।। etasminnantare tatra śatānando mahāmuniḥ । koṭibhirmunibhiḥ sārdhamājagāma hareḥ puraḥ ।। 17 ।। puraṃ praveśayāmāsa śatadvāraṃ ca durgamam । agamyaṃ cāpi śatrūṇāṃ mitrāṇā ca sukhapradam ।। 18 ।। devakanyā nāgakanyā rājakanyāstathaiva ca । munikanyā varaṃ draṣṭuṃ sasmitāśca samāyayuḥ ।। 19 ।। dadṛśuryoṣitaḥ sarvā nimeṣarahitena ca । prasannaṃ kārayāmāsa sasmitaścandraśekharaḥ ।। 20 ।। ratnendrasāranirmāṇarathasthaṃ parameśvaram । sarveṣāṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 21 ।। navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā । yandanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ।। 22 ।। ratnakeyūravalayaratnamālākulojjvalam । ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirācitam ।। 23 ।। ratnendrasāranirmāṇakvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam । sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ paśyantaṃ ratnadarpaṇam ।। 24 ।। saptabhiḥ pārṣadairgopaiḥ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ । navayauvanasaṃpannaṃ śaratkamalalocanam ।। 25 ।। śaratpūrṇendutulyāsyaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam । koṭikandarpasaundaryaṃ satyaṃ nityaṃ sanātanam ।। 26 ।। tīrthapūtaṃ kīrtipūtaṃ brahmeśaśeṣavanditam । paramhnādakaṃ rūpaṃ kauṭicandrasamaprabham ।। 27 ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ paramaṃ prakṛteḥ param । dūrvayā paṭṭasūtraṃ ca ratnendrasāradarpaṇam ।। 28 ।। dadhānaṃ kartṛkāsārdha kadalyāḥ sphuṭamañjarīm । cūḍāṃ trivikramākārāṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।। 29 ।। puṣpaṃ nārīpradattaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ mastakojajvavalam । dṛṣṭvā varaṃ yuvatyaśca mūrcchā saṃprāpurīśvaram ।। 30 ।। rukmiṇījīvanaṃ dhanyaṃ ślādhyamityūcurīpsitam । jāmātaraṃ sā dadarśa rājñī bhīṣmakakāminī ।। 31 ।। nimeṣarahitā tuṣṭā prasannavadanekṣaṇā । rājā prasannavadanaḥ sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ ।। 32 ।। samāgatya surānviprānbhūpāṃśca praṇanāma saḥ । dadau yogyāśramaṃ tebhyo bhakṣyapūrṇa sudhopamam ।। 33 ।। divāniśaṃ cāpyuvāca dīyatāṃ dīyatāmiti । sukhaṃ nināya rajanīṃ devaiśca bāndhavaiḥ saha ।। 34 ।। vasudevaḥ prabhāte ca prātaḥkṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ । snātvā saṃdhyādikaṃ kṛtvā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। 35 ।। cakāra vedamantreṇa śubhādhivāsanaṃ hareḥ । saṃpūjya mātṛkāḥ sarvāḥ sākṣācca sarvadevatāḥ ।। 36 ।। pradāya vasudhārāṃ ca vṛddhiśrāddhādikaṃ tathā । prāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa devāṃśca bāndhavāṃstathā ।। 37 ।। vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam । suveṣaṃ kārayāmāsa varasyāpi praśaṃsitam ।। 38 ।। sajjaṃ ca kārayāmāsa narayānaṃ suśobhanam । evaṃ rājā bhīṣmakaśca vivāhārhaṃ ca maṅgalam ।। 39 ।। purohitairvedamantraiḥ sarva karma cakāra saḥ । maṇiratnaṃ dhanaṃ cāpi muktāmāṇikyahīrakam ।। 40 ।। bhakṣyadravyaṃ ca vastraṃ cāpyupahāramanuttamam । bhaṭṭemyo brāhmaṇebhyo'pi bhikṣukebhyo dadau mudā ।। 41 ।। vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam । suveṣaṃ kārayāmāsa rukmiṇyāśca manoharam ।। 42 ।। rājñībhirmunipatnībhirvidhānaṃ ca yathocitam । tataḥ śubhe kṣaṇe prāpte māhendre paramodaye ।। 43 ।। vivāhocitalagne ca lagnādhipatisaṃyute । sadgrahekṣaṇaśuddhe cāpyasatāṃ dṛṣṭivarjite ।। 44 ।। śubhakṣaṇe subharkṣe ca viśuddhe candratārayoḥ । vedhadoṣādirahite śalākādivivarjite ।। 45 ।। daṃpatyoḥ śarmayogye ca pariṇāmasukhaprade । evaṃbhūte ca samaye bhīṣmakaprāṅgaṇaṃ hariḥ ।। 46 ।। ājagāma suraiḥ sārdha suniviprapurohitaiḥ । jñātibhirbāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ pitrā mātrānṛpaistathā ।। 47 ।। gopālakaiḥ pārṣadaiśca vayasyaiśca manoharaiḥ । bhaṭṭaiśca gaṇakairjyotiḥ śāstrajñānaviśāradaiḥ ।। 48 ।। vādyairnānāvidhaiścaiva nartakairgāyanaistathā । nānāśilpakaraiścaiva mālākāraistathā'paraiḥ ।। 49 ।। vidyādharyapsarobhiśca kinnarībhiśca satvaram । sthalaṃ ca daduśurdevā munayaśca nṛpeśvarāḥ ।। 50 ।। sarve samāgatā ye ca vivāhadarśanotsukāḥ । rambhāstambhasahasraiśca paṭṭasūtrapariṣkṛtaiḥ ।। 51 ।। cambakānāṃ candanānāṃ rasālānāṃ ca pallavaiḥ । mālyairnānāvidhaiścaiva pītaraktasitānvitaiḥ ।। 52 ।। parito maṅgalaghaṭaiḥ phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ । kastūrīcandanāktaiśca kuṅkumena virājitaiḥ ।। 53 ।। parṇairlājaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpairdūrvābhirupaśobhitaiḥ । munibhirbrāhmaṇaiścaiva rājendrairapi veṣṭitam ।। 54 ।। ratnendrasāranirmāṇavedīyuktaṃ manoharam । carcitaṃ candanasnigdhaiḥ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitaiḥ ।। 55 ।। sugandhiśītamandaiśca pavanaiḥ surabhīkṛtam । ratnānāṃ ca sahasraiśca jvalitaṃ jvaladīptakaiḥ ।। 56 ।। nānāprakāradhūpaiśca gandhadravyaiḥ suvāsatam । citrairvicitrairvividhaiḥ śilpināṃpuṇyakāriṇām ।। 57 ।। paritaḥ paritaścaiva śobhanārhaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ । gandharvāṇāṃ ca saṃgītaimadhuraṃrmadhurīkṛtam ।। 58 ।। vidyādharīṇāṃnṛtyaiśca nartakīnāṃ ca śilpinām । tatra niśceṣṭacitraiśca janarājivirājitam ।। 59 ।। guptadvārairgavākṣaiśca yuvatībhiśca vīkṣitam । maṅgalena ghaṭenaiva vidhuṣā ca purodhasā ।। 60 ।। kuśahastena bhūpena dānena dānavastunā । dṛṣṭvā ca prāṅgaṇaṃ rājño devā brahmādayastathā ।। 61 ।। avaruhya rathāttūṇaṃ tiṣṭanti prāṅgaṇe mudā । rājendrā dānavendrāśca sunayaḥ sanakādayaḥ ।। 62 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaścāpi bhagavānpārṣadapravaraiḥ saha । tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya javena bhīṣmakastathā ।। 63 ।। mūrghnā vavande devāśca munondrāṃśca nṛpāṃstathā । ratnasihāsaneṣveva suramyeṣu pṛthavapṛthak ।। 64 ।। kramato vāsayāmāsa saṃpūjya sādareṇa ca । rājā tuṣṭāva bhaktyā ca tānsarvānbhaktipūrvakam vasudevaṃ vāsudevaṃ sāśrunetraḥ puṭāñjaliḥ ।। 65 ।। bhīṣmaka uvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam । babhūva janmakoṭīnāṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam ।। 66 ।। svayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ pradātā sarvasaṃpadām । svapre yatpādapadmaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ naiva kṣamaḥ prabho ।। 67 ।। tapasāṃ pharadātā ca saṃsraṣṭā prāṅgaṇe mama । svātmārāmeṣu pūrṇeṣu śubhapraśnamanīpsitam ।। 68 ।। yogīndrairapi siddhendraiḥ surendraiśca munīndrakaiḥ । dhyānādṛṣṭaśca yo devaḥ sa śivaḥ prāṅgaṇe mama ।। 69 ।। kālasya kālo bhagavānmṛtyormṛtyuśca yaḥ prabhuḥ । mṛtyuṃjayaśca sarveśonarāṇāṃ dṛṣṭigocaraḥ ।। 70 ।। yasyamūrdhnāṃ sahasreṣu mūrdhni viśvaṃ carācaram । nāstyantaḥ sarvavedeṣu so'yaṃ ca mama prāṅgaṇe ।। 71 ।। sarvakāmapraṇeyo hi sarvāgre yasya pūjanam । śreṣṭho devagaṇānāṃ ca sa gaṇeśo mamāṅgaṇe ।। 72 ।।munīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca pravano jñānināṃ guruḥ । sanatkumāro bhagavānpratyakṣaḥ prāṅgaṇe mama ।। 73 ।। brahmaputrāśca pautrāśca prapautrāścāpi vaṃśajāḥ । te sarve madagṛhe'dyaiva jvalanto brahmatejasā ।। 74 ।। aho kalpāntaparyantaṃ tīrthībhūto mamā''śramaḥ । yeṣāṃ pādodakaistīrtha viśuddhaṃ tadgṛhe mama ।। 75 ।। pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni tīrthāni sāgare । sāgare yāni tīrthāni viprapādeṣu tāni ca ।। 76 ।। viprapādodakaklinnā yāvattiṣṭhati medinī । tāvatpuṣkarapatreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam ।। 77 ।। viprapādodakaṃ bhuktvā dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām । srānānāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ phalamāpnoti niścitam ।। 78 ।। nikṛntanaṃ ca vipadāṃ vyādhinirmulakāraṇam । sukhadaṃ śubhadaṃ sāraṃ viprapādodakaṃ nṛṇām ।। 79 ।। na gaṅgāsadṛśaṃ tīrtha na devo mādhavātparaḥ । sanatkumārā dbhakto na na hi kalpatarostaruḥ ।। 80 ।। na puṣpaṃ pārijātācca na vrataṃ harivāsarāt । pūjane na hi pūjyaṃ ca na patraṃ tulasīparam ।। 81 ।। na devī prakṛteścāpi nā''dhāraḥ pavanātparaḥ । na hi sthūlo mahāviṣṇorna sūkṣmaṃ paramāṇutaḥ ।। 82 ।। na brāhmaṇātparaḥ pūto nā''śramaśca na tīryakam । na devo na paraḥ ko'pi cetyāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 83 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ prakṛteśca paraḥ prabhuḥ । dhyānāsādhyo durārādhyo yogināmapi niścitam ।। 84 ।। nirguṇaśca nirākāro bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ । sa eva cakṣuṣo nṝṇāṃ sākṣāddevaśca madgṛhe ।। 85 ।। devairbrahmeśaśeṣaiśca dhyātaṃ yatpādapaṅkajam । dhaneśena gaṇeśena dineśenāpi durlabham ।। 86 ।। ityuktvā bhīṣmakaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samānīya svayaṃ puraḥ । tuṣṭāva sāmavedoktastotreṇa parameśvaram ।। 87 ।। bhīṣmaka uvāca sarvāntarātmā sarveṣāṃ sākṣī nirlipta eva ca । karmiṇāṃ karmaṇāmeva kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। 88 ।। kecidvadanti tvāmekaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam । kecicca paramātmānaṃ jīvo yatpratibimbakaḥ ।। 89 ।। kecitprākṛtikaṃ jīvaṃ sagṛṇaṃ bhrāntabuddhayaḥ । kecinnityaśarīraṃ ca buddhā (dhā) śca sūkṣmabuddhayaḥ ।। 90 ।। jyotirabhyantare nityaṃ deharūpaṃ sanātanam । kasmāttejaḥ prabhavati sākāramīśvaraṃ vinā ।। 91 ।। evaṃ stutvā sa cā''cāntaḥ smaranviṣṇuṃ ca nārada । pādyaṃ padmārcite pādapadme cāyaṃ dadau mudā ।। 92 ।। ardhyaṃ ca pradadau tatra dūrvāpuṣpajalānvitam । madhuparkaṃ ca surabhiṃ sarvāṅge gandhayandanam ।। 93 ।। yatpradattaṃ mahendreṇa śubhakarmaṇi yautukam । pārijātasya mālyaṃ ca jāmātuśca gale dadau ।। 94 ।। kubereṇa ca yadattamamūlyaratnabhūṣaṇam । cakāra varaṇaṃ tasya sa rājā bhaktipūrvakam ।। 95 ।। kahniśuddhāṃśukayugaṃ yaddattaṃ vāhninā purā । dadau tadeva kṛṣṇāya paripūrṇatamāya ca ।। 96 ।। jvalitaṃ ratnamukuṭaṃ yaddattaṃ viśvakarmaṇā । dadau tanmastake rājā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 97 ।। dhūpaṃ ratnapradīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sumanoharam । nānāprakārapuṣpaṃ ca ratnasihāsanaṃ dadau ।। 98 ।। saptatīrthodakaṃ caiva punarācamanīyakam । tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 99 ।। śayyāṃ ratikarī ramyāṃ pānārthaṃ vāsitaṃ jalam । kṛtvā ca varaṇaṃ rājā parihāraṃ cakāratam ।। 100 ।। kṛtāñjalipuṭo rājā tasmai puṣpāñjalīṃ dadau ।। 101 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rukmiṇyudvāhe saptādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 107 ।।
<4.108> athāṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyāṇa uvāca etasminnantare devī mahālakṣmīśca rukmiṇī । ājagāma sabhāmadhye munidevādibhiryute ।। 1 ।। ratnasiṃhāsanasthā ca ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā । vahniśuddhāśukādhānā kabarībhārabhūṣitā ।। 2 ।। paśyantī sasmitā sādhvīhyamūlyaratnadarpaṇam । kastūrībindubhiryuktā snigdhacandanacarcitā ।। 3 ।। sidhūrabidunā śaśvadbhālamadhyasthalojjvalā । taptakāñcanavarṇabhā śatacandrasamaprabhā ।। 4 ।। candanokṣitamarvāṅgā mālatīmālyaśobhitā । saptabhirnṛpaputraiścasamānītā ca bālakaiḥ ।। 5 ।। devendrāśca munīndrāśca siddhendrā nṛpapuṃgavāḥ । dadṛśū rukmiṇīṃ devīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ pativratām ।। 6 ।। saptapradakṣiṇāḥkṛtvā praṇamya svapatiṃsatī । siṣeca śītatoyena snigdhacandanapallavaiḥ ।। 7 ।। tāṃ siṣeca jagatkāntaḥ kāntā śāntāṃ ca sasmitām । dadarśa kāntaḥ kāntāṃ ca kāntaṃ kāntā śubhe kṣaṇe ।। 8 ।। atha devī pituḥ kroḍe samuvāsa śubhānanā । lajjayā namravadanā jvalantī ca svatejasā ।। 9 ।। rājā deveśvarīṃ tasmai paribūrṇatamāya ca । pradadau saṃpradānena vedamantreṇa nārada ।। 10 ।। vasudevājñayā kṛṣṇaḥ svastītyuktvā sthito mudā । jagrāha devīṃ devaśca bhavānīṃ ca bhavo yathā ।। 11 ।। suvarṇānāṃ pañcalakṣaṃ kṛṣṇāya paramātmane । dakṣiṇāṃ tāṃ dadau rājā paripūrṇatamāya ca ।। 12 ।। śubhakarmaṇi niṣpanne kṛtvā kanyāṃ ca vakṣasi । ruroda rājā mohena munidevendrasaṃsadi ।। 13 ।। parihāreṇa vacasā kutvā tasmai samarpaṇam । siṣeca kanyāṃ dhanyāṃ ca netrayugmajalena ca ।। 14 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rukmiṇyudvāhe'ṣṭādhikaśātatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 108 ।।
<4.109> atha navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca etasminnantare rājñī rukmiṇījananī śabhā । patiputravatībhiśca sādhvībhiḥ sahitā mudā ।। 1 ।। āgatya maṅgalaṃ kṛtvā tatra nirmañchanādikam । daṃpatī veśayāmāsa ratnanirmāṇamandiram ।। 2 ।। nānācitravicitrāḍhyaṃ hīrahāreṇa bhūṣitam । muktāmāṇikyaratnena mudīptaṃ darpaṇena ca ।। 3 ।। dadarśa kṛṣṇastatraiva durgāṃ durgatināśinīm । sarasvatīṃ ca sāvitrīṃ ratiṃ ca rohiṇīṃ satīm ।। 4 ।। devapatnīṃ rājapatnīṃ munipatnīṃ pativratām । ratnamihānasthāṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 5 ।। uttasthurārāddṛṣṭvā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ jagatīpatim । ratnasihāsane ramye vārayāmāsa tāṃ mudā ।। 6 ।। stutiṃ cakruśca devāśca munipatnyaśca mādhavam । puṭāñjaliyutāstatra trameṇa ca pṛdhakpṛthak ।। 7 ।। bhojayāmāsa rājñī ca vareṇa saha kanyakām । sakarpūraṃ satāmbūlaṃ pradadau vāsitaṃ jalam ।। 8 ।। durgā kṛṣṇāya pradadau tatra maṅgalapatrikām । sarvāsāmājñayā devī paṭheti tamuvāca sā ।। 9 ।। papāṭha patrikāṃ kṛṣṇo devīsaṃsadi sasmitaḥ । lakṣmī sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikā satī ।। 10 ।। tulasī pṛthivī gaṅgā'rundhati yamunā'ditiḥ । śatarūpā ca sītā ca devahūtiśca menakā ।। 11 ।। daivyaścaitāśca daṃpatyoḥ kurvantu param । papāṭha ceti kṛṣṇaśca śuśruvurjahasuśca tāḥ ।। 12 ।। pārvatyuvācarukmiṇīṃ rukmiṇīkānta tvāṃ paśyantīṃ ca sasmitām । paśya prauḍhāṃ rupavatīṃ sundarīṃ navayauvanām ।। 13 ।। śacyuvāca tava yogyā ca yuvatī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā । tvāṃ prārthayantī suciramavamanyānyamīśvaram ।। 14 ।। sāvitryuvāca yathā varastathā kanyā vidhinā yojitā purā । vidagdhāyā vidagdhena sarvatra saṃgamaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 15 ।। ratyuvāca īśvareṇa parīhāsaṃ kā vā kartuṃ kṣamā bhuvi । dhyānāsādhyo durārādhyaścāvamanyānyamīśvaram ।। 16 ।। gāyatryuvāca yathā varastathā kanyā ca kṣubdhe bhaiṣmake gṛhe ।। 17 ।। rohiṇyuvāca satyaṃ brūhi jagannātha kāminīnāṃ ca saṃsadi । kīdṛśī rādhikā ramyā rukmiṇī cāpi kīdṛśī ।। 18 ।। sarasvatyuvāca rādhāyāṃ yādṛśī prītī rukmiṇyāṃ naiva tādṛśī । sā saṅginī pūrvakāle sarvakrīḍāsu vardhinī ।। 19 ।। prāṇādhiṣṭhātudevī sā pañcaprāṇādhikā satī । rukmiṇī kamalā sākṣātsaṃpadāmadhidevatā ।। 20 ।। sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ । buddherapyadhidevī ca durgā nārāyaṇī parā ।। 21 ।। devādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ sāvitrī vedamātṛkā । vidyādhidevatā'haṃ ca tato'nyāśca kalākalāḥ ।। 22 ।। na brahmaṇi śive śeṣe gaṇeśe ca dineśvare । na bhakteṣu ca padmāyāṃ na śivāyāṃ ca mayyapi ।। 23 ।। prasādo yādṛśastasyāmanyeṣu ca na tādṛśaḥ । trailokye pṛthivī dhanyā supuṇyaṃ bhārataṃ yataḥ ।। 24 ।। tatra vṛndāvanaṃ dhanyaṃ rādhāpādābjacihnitam । sarvāsāmapi devīnāṃ rādhā puṇyavatī satī ।। 25 ।। rādhāpādābjanakhare dadau snigdhamalaktakam । ayamevamiti śrutvā jahasuḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। 26 ।। dhyāyante dūrtaḥ sarvā rādhā vakṣaḥsthalasthitā । tasmādrādhāṃ namaskṛtya tulanāṃ manyate kila ।। 27 ।। sarasvatīvacaḥ śrutvā sāvitrī pārvatī satī । anyāśca yoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ sādhvityūcuśca saṃsadi ।। 28 ।। lopāmudrā'nasūyā cāpyahalyā'rundhatī tathā । sarvāstā munipatnyaśca rabhasaṃ cakrurīśvaram ।। 29 ।। atha devāṃśca bhūpāṃśca munīdrāṃścāpi bhīṣmakaḥ । pūjayāmāsa vidhinā bhojayāmāsa sādaram ।। 30 ।। khādyatāṃ lokā dīyatāṃ dīyatāmiti । śabdo babhūva nagare vādyasaṃgītamaṅgalaiḥ ।। 31 ।। atha prabhāte brahmeśaseṣāstridaśāstathā । yānamārohaṇaṃ bhūpāścakrire ca tvarānvitāḥ ।। 32 ।। rājā mahograsenaśca vasudevastvarānvitaḥ । kārayāmāsa yātrāṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rukmiṇīṃ satīm ।। 33 ।। subhadrā rukmiṇīmātā kanyāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi । rurodoccaistatsakhībhirbāndhavairityuvāca sā ।। 34 ।। subhadrovāca kva yāsi māṃ parityajya vatse mātaramīśvarīm । kathaṃ jīvāmi tvāṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ tvaṃ vā'pi jīvasi ।। 35 ।। mahālakṣmīrmama gṛhātkanyārūpā ca māyayā । vasudevālayaṃ yāsi vāsudevapriyā satīḥ ।। 36 ।। ityuktvā kanyakāṃ śokātsiṣeva netrajairjalaiḥ । bhīṣmakaḥ sāśrunetraśca kanyāṃ kṛṣṇe samarpya ca ।। 37 ।। taṃ ca kṛtvā parīhāraṃ rurodoccairatīva saḥ । ruroda rukmiṇī devī śrīkṛṣṇaścāpi māyayā ।। 38 ।। rathamāropayāmāsa vasudevaḥ sutaṃ vadhūm । etasminnantare rājā jāmātre yautukaṃ dadau ।। 39 ।। gacendrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca ṣaṅguṇaṃ ca turaṃgamam । dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca kiṃkarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam ।। 40 ।। ratnānāṃ ca sahasraṃ caivāmulyaratnabhūṣaṇam । svarṇānāṃ pariśuddhānāṃ pañcalakṣaṃ ca sādarama ।। 41 ।। toyabhojanapātrāṇi kutāni viśvakarmaṇā । sauvarṇāni ca ramyāṇi surabhīḥ pradadau mudā ।। 42 ।। dugdhavatīnāṃ dhenunāṃ savatsānāṃ sahasrakam । amūlyāni ca ramyāṇi vahniśuddhāṃśukāni ca ।। 43 ।। vasudevaścograseno devaiśca munībhiḥ saha । prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śīghraṃ dvārakābhisukhaṃ yayau ।। 44 ।। praviśya svapurīṃ ramyā kārayāmāsa maṅgalam । vādyaṃ ca vādayāmāsa sundaraṃ sumanoharam ।। 45 ।। devakī rohiṇī ramyā yaśodā nandagehinī । aditiśca ditiścaiva tathā ca varakāminī ।। 46 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rukmiṇīṃ ramyāṃ vilokya ca punaḥ punaḥ । gṛhaṃ praveśayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam ।। 47 ।। caturvidhaṃ bhojayitvā devāṃśca munipuṃgavān । nṛpāṃśca bāndhavāṃścaiva parīhāraṃ cakāra ca ।। 48 ।। bhaṭṭebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo'pi dadau ratnādikaṃ mudā । tāṃścapi bhojayāmāsa parituṣṭāṃśca sasmitān ।। 49 ।। evaṃ bhuktvā dhanaṃ labdhvā yayuḥ sarve gṛhaṃ mudā । maṅgalaṃ kārayāmāsa vasudevasya vallabhā ।। 50 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... rukmiṇyudvāho nāma navādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 109 ।।
<4.110> atha daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca āgateṣu gateṣvevaṃ sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi । nando yaśodayā sārdha putrābhyāśaṃ samāyayau ।। 1 ।। yaśodovāca jñānaṃ ca bhavatā dattaṃ pitre nandāya mādhava । māṃ cāpi mātaraṃ vatsa kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe ।। 2 ।। māmuddhara mahābhāga dharoddhāraṇakāraṇa । bhavābdhitaraṇe bhīmau bhītāṃ ca patitāmapi ।। 3 ।। māyāmayī sā prakṛtirbhavābdhitaraṇe tariḥ । tvameva karṇadhāraśca bhaktottīrṇe kṛpāmaya ।। 4 ।। yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa puruṣottamaḥ । uvāca mātaraṃ bhaktyā jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।। 5 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca jñānaṃ yogātmakaṃ mātarjñānaṃ ca viṣayātmakam । jñānaṃ bhaktyātmakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ maddāsyakāraṇaṃ śubham ।। 6 ।। jñānaṃ pañcavidhaṃ proktaṃ sarvavedeṣu saṃmatam । bhaktyātmakaṃ sarvaparaṃ teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu ।। 7 ।। kṣutpipāsādikānāṃ ca khaṇḍanaṃ svāntaśodhanam । nāḍīnāṃ śodhanaṃ caiva cakrāṇāmapi bhedanam ।। 8 ।। śaktikuṇḍalinīyuktamīśvaraṃ cintayettataḥ । indriyāṇāṃ ca damanaṃ laubhādīnāṃ ca varjanam ।। 9 ।। mūlādhāraṃ svadhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūramanāhatam । viśuddhaṃ ca tathā jñākhyaṃ cakraṣaṭkaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 10 ।। nārīṇāmapi durbodhaṃ murkhāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ । jñānaṃ yogātmakaṃ sādhvi siddhānāṃ sādhyamīpsitam ।। 11 ।। jantūnāmapi sarveṣāṃ jñānaṃ svaviṣaye tathā । santaḥ sarve vijānanti svecchayā ca madīyayā ।। 12 ।। siddhyātmakaṃ ca siddhānāṃ niyuktaṃ sarvakarmasu । catustriṃśatsu siddhānāṃ sādhanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathā ।। 13 ।। jñānaṃ maukṣātmakaṃ siddhaṃ paraṃ nirvāṇakāraṇam । nivṛttimārgamārūḍhaṃ bhaktastatraiva vāñchati ।। 14 ।। bhaktyātmakaṃ ca yajjñānaṃ tubhyaṃ rādhā pradāsyati । tasyāṃ ca mānavaṃ bhāvaṃ tyaktvā jñānaṃ kariṣyati ।। 15 ।। nandāya dattaṃ yajjñānaṃ tacca tubhyaṃ pradāsyati । gaccha nandavrajaṃ mātarnandena saha sādaram ।। 16 ।। ityuktvā vinayaṃ kṛtvā jagāmābhyantaraṃ hariḥ । nando yaśodayā sārdhaṃ prayayau kadalīvanam ।। 17 ।। dadarśa rādhāṃ tatraiva nidritāṃ tyaktabhūṣaṇam । dadhānāṃ śuklavastraṃ ca nirāhārāṃ kṛśodarīm ।। 18 ।। paṅkasthe paṅkajadale sajale candanārcite । śayānāṃ śuṣkitauṣṭhīṃ ca sāśrunetrāṃ ca mūrcchitām ।। 19 ।। dhyāyamānāṃ padāmbhojaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ । bāhyajñānaparityaktāṃ tanni viṣṭaikamānasām ।। 20 ।। paśyantīṃ sasmitaṃ kāntaṃ paśyantīṃ tanmukhāmbujam । hasantīṃ ca rudantīṃ ca svapne kāntasamīpataḥ ।। 21 ।। sakhībhiḥ paritaḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ ścetacāmaraiḥ । divāniśaṃ rakṣitāṃ ca gopībhiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ ।। 22 ।। sāvadhānaparābhiśca vetrahastābhirīśvarīm । saptadvāreṣu yuktābhiḥ paritaḥ prāṅgaṇeṣu ca ।। 23 ।। tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ prāpya sabhāryo nanda eva ca । nanāma parayā bhaktyā daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca ।। 24 ।। nidrāṃ tyāktvā ca sahasā bubudhe seśvarecchayā । kṣaṇena cetanāṃ prāpa viṣayajñānavarcitām ।। 25 ।। purato daṃpatī dṛṣṭvā papraccha sādaraṃ satī । uvāca madhuraṃ caivaṃ tatraiva sakhisaṃsadi ।। 26 ।। rādhikovāca kastvaṃ cātra samāyāto brūhi vā kiṃ prayojanam । na ca me viṣayajñānaṃ na jānāmi naraṃ paśum ।। 27 ।। kiṃ jalaṃ vā sthalaṃ kiṃvā naktaṃ tinaṃ śruṇu । striyaṃ pumāṃsaṃ klībaṃ vā nāhaṃ jānāmi bhedākam ।। 28 ।। rādhikāvacanaṃ śrutvā nandaśca vismayaṃ yayau । bhītā yaśodā nikaṭaṃ gopīsaṃbhāṣitā yayau ।। 29 ।। uvāsa nikaṭe tasyāḥ samuvāca priyaṃ vacaḥ । uvāsa tatra nandaśca gopīdattāsanena ca ।। 30 ।। yaśodovāca cetanaṃ kuru rādhe tvamātmānaṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ । drakṣyasi prāṇanāthaṃ ca saṃprāpte maṅgale dine ।। 31 ।। tvatto viśvaṃ pavitraṃ ca svakulaṃ ca sureśvari । gopyaśca puṇyavatyaśca tvatpādāmbujasevayā ।। 32 ।। lokā gāsyanti tvatkīrtitīrthapūtāṃ sumaṅgalām । santo vedāśca catvāraḥ purāṇāni purātanīm ।। 33 ।। ahaṃ yaśodā nando'yaṃ buddhirūpe nibodha mām । vṛṣabhānasutā tvaṃ ca māṃ niśāmaya suvrate ।। 34 ।। dvārakānagarādbhadre śrīkṛṣṇasaṃnidhānataḥ । tavāntikamāgatā'haṃ preritā hariṇā sati ।। 35 ।। śṛṇu maṅgalavārtāṃ ca maṅgalaṃ ca gadābhṛtaḥ । ārāddrakṣyasi kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ he devi cetanaṃ kuru ।। 36 ।। bhaktyā tmakaṃ parijñānaṃ dehi mahyaṃ ca sāṃpratam । tvadbharturupadeśena tvatsamīpaṃ samāgatau ।। 37 ।। paścadāyāsyati haristvāṃ muhūrtaṃ varānane । bhaviṣyatyacireṇaiva śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamocanam ।। 38 ।। yaśodāvacanaṃ śrutvā vārtāṃ prāpya gadābhṛtaḥ । śrīkṛṣṇanāmasmaraṇāddūribhūtamamaṅgalam ।। 39 ।। saṃprāpa cetanaṃ rādhā saṃbhāvya kṛṣṇamātaram । uvāca madhuraṃ śāntā laukikīṃ bhaktimuttamām ।। 40 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... rādhāyaśodāsaṃ... daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 110 ।।
<4.111> athaikādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ rādhikovāca jñānātmakaśca paramo brahmeśaśeṣapūjitaḥ । jñānaṃ ca na dadau tubhyaṃ manmulaṃ preṣitā sati ।। 1 ।। tenaiva cchadmanā tubhyaṃ bhāvārthaṃ bodhayāmi kim । vedāḥ santaśca bhāvārthaṃ naiva jānanti tasya ca ।। 2 ।। strījātirabalā mūḍhā vaktuto'jñānatatparā । tatastadviraheṇaiva saṃtataṃ hatacetanā ।। 3।। kiṃ vā'haṃ kathayiṣyāmi jñānaṃ pañcavidheṣu ca । bhaktyātmakaṃ sarvaparaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 4 ।। śrīkṛṣṇasya vareṇāpi na sādho nirbhayo bhava । goloke cāpi patanaṃ saṃbhavecca kuyoginaḥ ।। 5 ।। tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya bhajasva parameśvaram । putrabuddhiṃ parityajya brahmarūpaṃ niśāmaya ।। 6 ।। yaśode bhavatī sarve parityajya ca naśvaram । gatvā vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam ।। 7 ।। kṛtvā trikālasnānaṃ ca nirmale yamunājale । kṛtvā'ṣṭadalapadmaṃ ca snigdhena candanena ca ।। 8 ।। dhyānena gargadattena śuddhena manasā sati । saṃpūjya paramānandaṃ sānandaṃ vraja tatpadam ।। 9 ।। kṛtvā nikṛntanaṃ karma pidṛbhiḥ śatakaiḥ saha । vaiṣṇavena sahā''lāpaṃ kuruṣva satataṃ sati ।। 10 ।। varaṃ hutavahajvālāṃ bhakto vāñchati pañjaram । varaṃ ca kaṇṭake vāsaṃ varaṃ ca viṣbhakṣaṇam ।। 11 ।। haribhaktivihīnānāṃ na saṅgaṃ nāśakāraṇam । svayaṃ naṣṭo bhaktihīno bṛddhiṇedaṃ karoti ca ।। 12 ।। aṅkuro bhaktivṛkṣasya bhaktasaṅgena vardhate । paraṃ harikathālāpapīyūṣāsecanena ca ।। 13 ।। abhaktālāpadīpāgnijvālāyāḥ kalayāpi ca । aṅkuraḥ śuṣkatāṃ yāti punaḥ sekena vardhate ।। 14 ।। tasmādabhaktasaṅgaṃ ca sāvadhānaḥ parityaja । yathā dṛṣṭvā kālasarpaṃ naro bhītvā palāyate ।। 15 ।। yaśode ca prayatnena svātmanaḥ putramīśvaram । rāma nārāyaṇananta mukunda madhusūdana ।। 16 ।। kṛṣṇa keśava kaṃsāre hare vaikuṇṭha vāmana । ityekādaśa nāmāni paṭhedvā pāṭhayediti ।। 17 ।। janmakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ pātakādeva mucyate । rāśabdo viśvavacano maścāpīśvaravācakaḥ ।। 18 ।। viśvānāmīśvaro yo hi tena rāmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ । ramate ramayā sārvaṃ tena rāmaṃ vidurbudhā ।। 19 ।। ramāyā ramaṇasthānaṃ rāmaṃ rāmavido viduḥ । rāśceti lakṣmīvacano maścāpīśvaravācakaḥ ।। 20 ।। lakṣmīpatiṃ gatiṃ rāmaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ । nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāṃ smaraṇe yatphalaṃ labhet ।। 21 ।। tatphalaṃ labhate nūnaṃ rāmoccāraṇamātrataḥ । sārūpyamuktivacano sāreti ca vidurbudhāḥ ।। 22 ।। yo devo'pyayanaṃ tasya sa ca nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । nārāśca kṛtapāpāścāpyayanaṃ gamanaṃ smṛtam ।। 23 ।। yato hi gamanaṃ teṣāṃ so'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ । sakṛnnārāyaṇetyuktvā pumānkalmaśatatrayam ।। 24 ।। gaṅgādisarvatīrtheṣu snāto bhavati niścitam । nāraṃ ca mokṣaṇaṃ puṇyamayanaṃ jñānamīpsitam ।। 25 ।। tayorjñānaṃ bhavedyasmātso'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । nāstyanto yasya vedeṣu purāṇeṣu caturṣu ca ।। 26 ।। śāstreṣvanyeṣu yogeṣu tenānantaṃ vidurbudhāḥ । mukumadhyayamānaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ mokṣavācakam ।। 27 ।। taddadāti ca yo devo mṛkuṃdastena kīrtitaḥ । mukuṃ bhaktirasapremavacanaṃ vedasaṃmatam ।। 28 ।। yastaṃ dadāti bhaktebhyo mukaṃdastena kīrtitaḥ । sūdanaṃ madhudaityasya yasmātsa madhusūdanaḥ ।। 29 ।। iti santo vadantīśaṃ vede bhinnārthamīpsitam । madhu klībaṃ ca mādhvīke kṛtakarmaśubhāśubhe ।। 30 ।। bhaktānāṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva sūdanaṃ madhusūdanaḥ । pariṇāmāśubhaṃ karmaṃ bhrāntānāṃ madhuraṃ madhu ।। 31 ।। karoti sūdanaṃ yo hi sa eva madhusūdanaḥ । kṛṣirutkṛṣṭavacano ṇaśca sadbhaktivācakaḥ ।। 32 ।। aścāpi dātṛvacanaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tena vidurbudhāḥ । kṛṣiśca paramānande ṇaśca taddāsyakarmaṇi ।। 33 ।। tayordātā ca yo devastena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ । koṭijanmārjite pāpe kṛṣiḥkleśe ca vartate ।। 34 ।। bhaktānāṃ ṇaśca nirvāṇe tena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ । nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāṃ trirāvṛttyā cayatphalam ।। 35 ।। ekāvṛttyā tu kṛṣṇasya tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ । kṛṣṇanāmnaḥ paraṃ nāma na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।। 36 ।। sarvebhyaśca paraṃ nāma kṛṣṇeti vaidikā viduḥ । kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇoti he gopi yastaṃ smarati nityaśaḥ ।। 37 ।। jalaṃ bhittvā yathā padmaṃ narakāduddharecca saḥ । kṛṣṇeti maṅgalaṃ nāma yasya vāci pravartate ।। 38 ।। bhasmībhavanti sadyastu mahāpātakakoṭayaḥ । aśvamedhasahasrebhyaḥ phalaṃ kṛṣṇajapasya ca ।। 39 ।। varaṃ tebhyaḥ punarjanma nāto bhaktapunarbhavaḥ । sarveṣāmapi yajñānāṃ lakṣāṇi ca vratāni ca ।। 40 ।। tīrthasnānāni sarvāṇi tapāṃsyanaśanāni ca । vedapāṭhasahasrāṇi prādakṣiṇyaṃ bhuvaḥ śatam ।। 41 ।। kṛṣṇanāmajapasyāsya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm । teṣāṃ lobhā dbhavetsvargaphalaṃ ca suciraṃ nṛṇām ।। 42 ।। svarkādavaśyaṃ puṃsaśca japakarturhareḥ padam । ke jale sarvadehe'pi śayanaṃ yasya cā''tmanaḥ ।। 43 ।। vadanti vaidikāḥ sarve taṃ devaṃ keśavaṃ param । kaṃsaśca pātake vighne roge śoke ca dānave ।। 44 ।। teṣāmarirnihantā ca sa kaṃsāriḥ prakīrtitaḥ । rudrarūpeṇa saṃhartā viśvānāmapi nityaśaḥ ।। 45 ।। bhaktānāṃ pātakānāṃ ca haristena prakīrtitaḥ । mā ca brahmasvarūpā yā mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 46 ।। nārāyaṇīti vikhyātā viṣṇumāyā sanātanī । mahālakṣmīsvarūpā ca vedamātā sarasvatī rādhā vasuṃdharā gaṅgā tāsāṃ svāmī ca mādhavaḥ ।। 47 ।। brahmeśaśeṣādibhavaiśca vandyaṃ dhyānairna kiṃcitsanakādibhiśca । vedaiḥ purāṇairna nirūpitaṃ ca bhajasva bhaktyā navanītacoram ।। 48 ।। kva cāpi dugdhaṃ kva daghi ghṛtaṃ vā navoddhṛtaṃ vā kva ca takramīpsitam । teṣāṃ kva corobhavatiṃ kva cāpi kva bandhanaṃ te bhavamūlamadhye ।। 49 ।। na yogibhiḥ siddhagaṇairmunīndrairna bhaktasaṃghairbhavapadmaśeṣaiḥ । yogairna baddho na hi rakṣituṃ kṣamaiḥ kathaṃ sa vaddhastava mūlamadhyataḥ ।। 50 ।। pramṇānu bhaktyā stavanena pūjayā bhajasva putraṃ tarasā ca bhārate । hṛtpadmamadhye sthitamīśvaraṃ paraṃ dhyānena yatnena ca saṃtataṃ sati ।। 51 ।। varaṃ vṛṇuṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam । sarvaṃ dāsyāmi jagati devānāmapi durlabham ।। 52 ।। yaśodovāca harau ca niścalā bhaktistaddāsyaṃ vāñchitaṃ mama । tava nāmnaśca vyutpattiḥ kā vā tadvaktumarhasi ।। 53 ।। rādhikovāca bhavedbhaktirniścalā te harerdāsyaṃ ca durlabham । labhasva madvareṇāpi kathayāmi sunirṇayam ।। 54 ।। purā nandena dṛṣṭā'haṃ bhāṇḍīre vaṭamūlake । mayā ca kathito nando niṣiddhaśca prajeśvaraḥ ।। 55 ।। ahameva svayaṃ rādhā chāyā rāyaṇakāminī । rāyaṇaḥ śrīhareraṃśaḥ pārṣadapravaro mahān ।। 56 ।। rāśabdaśca mahāviṣṇurviśvāni yasya lomasu । viśvaprāṇiṣu viśveṣu dhā dhātrī mātṛvācakaḥ ।। 57 ।। dhātrī mātā'hameteṣāṃ mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī । tena rādhā samākhyātā hariṇā ca purā budhaiḥ ।। 58 ।। ahaṃ sudāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā । śatavarṣaṃ ca vicchedo hariṇā saha sāṃpratam ।। 59 ।। vṛṣabhānaśca kṛṣṇasya pārṣadapravaro mahān । pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyā mama mātā kalāvatī ।। 60 ।। ayonisaṃbhavā'haṃ ca mama mātā ca bhārate । punaḥ sārthaṃ ca yuṣmābhiryāsyāmi śrīhareḥ padam ।। 61 ।। iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vrajaṃ vraja vrajeśvari । vrajeśvareṇa sahitā svāminā jñāninā sati ।। 62 ।। mamādhunā ca bhavatī dhyānasya vyavadhānikā । dhyānabhaṅge mahādoṣo narāṇāmapi sundari ।। 63 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... rādhāyaśodāsaṃ... ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 111 ।।
<4.112> atha dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca vāsudevo dvārakāyāṃ vasudevājñayā mune । prayayau ratnaruciraṃ rukmiṇīmandiraṃ varam ।। 1 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśamamūlyaratnanirmitam । purataḥ parito ramyaṃ nānācitreṇa citritam ।। 2 ।। amūlyaratnakalaśaṃ śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ । vahaniśuddhāśukaiḥ śuddhaiḥ paritaḥ pariśobhitam ।। 3 ।। dadarśa rukmiṇīṃ devīmatīva navayauvanām । ratnaparyaṅkamāruhya śayānāṃ sasmitāṃ mudā ।। 4 ।। aprauḍhāṃ ca navoḍhāṃ tāṃ navasaṃgamalajjitām । amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇena vibhūṣitām ।। 5 ।। sucārukabarībhārāṃ mālatīmalyabhūṣitām । dṛṣṭavā kṛṣṇāṃ bhīṣmakanyā sahasā praṇanāma sā ।। 6 ।। tāṃ saṃprāpya jagannātho ratnatalpe uvāsa saḥ । śubhakṣaṇe ca śubhayā sa reme rāmayā saha ।। 7 ।। sukhasaṃbhogamātreṇa mūrcchāmāpa mudā satī । tasyāṃ jajñe kāmadevo bhasmībhūtadaśca śaṃbhunā ।। 8 ।। sa śambaraṃ nihatyaiva tatra prāpa ratiṃ satīm । ratirmāyāvatīnāmnā saṃketena surasya ca ।। chāyāṃ dattvā ca śayane gṛhiṇī śambarālaye ।। 9 ।। narada uvāca jahāra śambaraṃ kāmo daityaṃ kena prakārataḥ । kathayasva māhābhāga vistareṇa śubhāṃ kathām ।। 10 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca samatīte ca saptāhe rukmiṇīsūtikāgṛhāt । gṛhītvā bālakaṃ daityo jagām svālayaṃ javāt ।। 11 ।। aputrakaśca daityeśaḥ putraṃ prāpya praharṣitaḥ । māyāvatyai dadau hṛṣṭo hṛṣṭā māyāvatī satī ।। 12 ।। atīva pālanenaiva vardhayāmāsa bārakam । sarasvatī tāṃ rahasi kathayāmāsa nirjane ।। 13 ।। sarasvatyuvāca śivakopānale pūrva bhasmībhūtaḥ patistava । sa cāyaṃ rukmiṇīputro daityenaiva samāhṛtaḥ ।। 14 ।। māyayā'pi ca māyeśo rukmiṇīsūtikāgṛhāt । samānīya dadau tubhyaṃ patiste'yaṃ na cā''tmajaḥ ।। 15 ।। kāmaṃ ca kathayāmāsa jaganmātā ca sā satī । tava patnī ratiśceyaṃ ramasva rāmayā saha ।। 16 ।। tvameva rukmiṇīputro nānyadaityasya manmathaḥ । kurarīva satī nityaṃ roditi sma tvayā vinā ।। 17 ।। ityuktvā ca yayau vāṇī brahmāṇī brahmaṇaḥ padam ।sa reme nirjane nityaṃ rāmayā saha sundaraḥ ।। 18 ।। ekadā manmathaṃ daityau dadarśa rahasi śthitam । śṛṅgāraṃ rāmayā sārdhaṃ kurvantaṃ kautukena ca ।। 19 ।। sasmitaṃ sasmitāyāśca madhyavakṣaḥsthalasthitam । ratiṃ dadarśa kāmena mūrcchitāṃ suratotsukām ।। 20 ।। dṛṣṭvā cukopa daityaśca jagrāha khaḍgamuttamam । uvāca khaḍgahastaśca kāmadevaṃ ratiṃ satīm ।। 21 ।। śamvara uvāca dhiktvāṃ mahākāmukaṃ ca mūrkhaṃ paṇḍitamāninam । mahāpātakināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pramattaṃ mātṛgāminam ।। 22 ।। dhiktvāṃ ca puṃścalīṃ mattāṃ kāmukīṃ hatacetanām । putraṃ gṛhītvā rahasi kaloṣi suratiṃ sati ।। 23 ।। ityevamuktvā khaḍgaṃ ca tāmeva hantumṛdyataḥ । jighāṃsantaṃ ratiṃ detyaṃ prerayāmāsa manmathaḥ ।। 24 ।। papāta dūrato brahmanmūrcchitaḥ svāṅgapīḍitaḥ । punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya kopena prajvalanniva ।। 25 ।। śivadattaṃ ca śūlaṃ ca jagrāha nirbhareṇa ca । śatasūryaprabhaṃ śūlaṃ pralayāgnisamaṃ mune ।। 26 ।। dṛṣṭvā''jagmuśca devāśca brahmeśaśeṣasaṃjñakāḥ । pavanaḥ kathayāmāsa karṇe kāmasya yatnataḥ ।। 27 ।। smara smara mahāmāyāṃ durgāṃ turgatināśinīm । pavanasya vacaḥ śrutvā durgāṃ sasmāra manmathaḥ ।। 28 ।। śūlaṃ babhūva tasyāṅge ramyaṃ mālyaṃ manoharam । brahmāstreṇa ca taṃ daityaṃ jaghāna manmatho mudā ।। 29 ।। ratiṃ gṛhītvā yānena jagāma dvārakāṃ purīm । prayayurdevatāḥ sarvā stutvā ca pārvatīṃ svayam ।। 30 ।। rukmiṇī maṅgalaṃ kṛtvā prajagrāha ratiṃ sutam । utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa paraṃ svastyayanaṃ hariḥ ।। 31 ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa pārvatīmra । atha kṛṣṇaḥ krameṇaiva vedokte maṅgale dine ।। 32 ।। saptānāṃ ramaṇīnāṃ ca pāṇigrāhaṃ cakāra ha । kālindīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca satyā rāgnijitīṃ satīm ।। 33 ।। jāmbavatīṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ ca samudvāhaṃ cakāra saḥ । tābhiḥ sārdha krameṇaiva putratpattiṃ cakāra ha ।। 34 ।। ekasyāṃ daśaputrāśca kanyakaikā krameṇa ca । nihatya narakaṃ daityaṃ saputraṃ ca nṛpeśvaram ।। 35 ।। balavantaṃ muraṃ daityaṃ jaghāna raṇamūrdhani । dadarśa kanyāstatrasthāḥ sahasrāṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśa ।। 36 ।। śatādhikā vayasyāśca śaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ । praphullavadanāḥ sarvā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।। 37 ।। śubhakṣaṇe ca tāsāṃ ca pāṇiṃ jagrāha mādhavaḥ । tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ sa reme ca krameṇa ca śubhakṣaṇe ।। 38 ।। ekasyāṃ daśaputrāśca kanyakaikā krameṇā ca । hareretānyapatyāni babhūvuśca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 39 ।। ekadā dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ durvāsā munipuṃgavaḥ । śiṣyaistrikoṭibhiḥ sārdhamājagāmāvalīlayā ।। 40 ।। rājā mahograsenaśca saputraḥ sapurohitaḥ । vasudevo vāsudevo'pyakrūraścoddhavastathā ।। 41 ।। nītvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ praṇemurmunipuṃgavam । śubhārśiṣaṃ ca pradadau tebhyo brahmanpṛthakpṛthak ।। 42 ।। ekānaṃśāṃ ca kanyāṃ tāṃ dadau tasmai śubhakṣaṇe । muktāmāṇikyaṅīrāṃśca ratnaṃ ca yautakaṃ dadau ।। 43 ।। sa reme rāmayā sārdha māhendre ratnamandire । ratnendrasāranirmāṇaṃ dadau tasmai śubhāśramam ।। 44 ।। ekadā sa muniśreṣṭhaḥ samālocya svacetasā । śayānaṃ kṛtracidramyaparyaṅke ratnanirmite ।। 45 ।। śrutavantaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śraddhayā kutraciddhibhum । mahotsave niyuktaṃ ca kutracitprāṅgaṇe śubhe ।। 46 ।। tāmabūlaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca bhaktyā dattaṃ ca satyayā । kutracitsevitaṃ talpe rukmiṇyā ścetacāmaraiḥ ।। 47 ।। kālindīsepitapadaṃ śayānaṃ kutracinmudā । sarvatra samasaṃbhāṣāṃ cakāra bhagavānmunim ।। 48 ।। vismayaṃ prayayau viprau dṛṣṭvā tatparamādbhutam । tuṣṭāva jagatīnāthaṃ rukmiṇīmandire punaḥ vasantaṃ ca sudharmāyāṃ satāṃ saṃsadi sundaram ।। 49 ।। durvāsā uvāca jaya jaya jagatāṃ nātha jitasarva janārdana sarvātmaka sarveśa sarvabīja purātana nirguṇa nirīha ।। 50 ।। nirlipta nirañjana nirākāra bhaktānugrahavigraha satyamvarūpasanātana niḥsvarūpa nityanūtana ।। 51 ।। brahmeśaśeṣadhaneśavandita padmayā sevitapādapadma brahmajyotiranirvacanīya vedāviditaguṇarūpa mahākāśasaṃmānanīya paramātmannamo'stu te ।। 52 ।। ityevamuktvā manasā hareranumatena ca । praṇamya tasthau viprendrastatraiva purato hareḥ ।। 53 ।। tamuvāca jagannātho hitaṃ satyaṃ purātanam । jñānaṃ ca vedavihitaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca satāṃ matam ।। 54 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca mā bhervipra śivāṃśastvaṃ kiṃ na jānāsi jñānataḥ । ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate ।। 55 ।। ahamātmā ca sarveṣāṃ śāvāḥ sarve mayā vinā । prāṇidehānmayi gate yāntyeva sarvaśaktayaḥ ।। 56 ।। jātāvapyeka evāhaṃ vyaktāveva pṛthakpṛthak । yo bhuṅkte tasya tṛptiḥ syānnānyeṣāṃ ca kadācana ।। 57 ।। pṛthagjīvādisarveṣāṃ pratimānaṃ ca prāṇinām । paripūrṇatamo'haṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 58 ।। śrīdāmaśāpādrādhā sā māṃ draṣṭumakṣamā'dhunā । sarve caivāṃśarūpeṇā kalayā ca tadaṃśataḥ ।। 59 ।। rukmiṇīmandire cāṃśo'pyanyāsāṃ mandire kalāḥ । mamāpi kutraciccāṃśaṃ kutra cicca kalākalāḥ ।। 60 ।। kalākalāṃśāḥ kutrāpi pratimāsu ca dehiṣu । ityuktvā jagatāṃ nātho gṛhasyābhyantaraṃ yayau durvāsāśca priyāṃ tyaktvā śrīharestapase gataḥ ।। 61 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... munikṛṣṇasaṃ... dvādaśādhikāśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 112 ।।
<4.113> atha trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca saśiṣyaścāpi durvāsāstyaktvā ca dvārakāṃ purīm । kailāsaṃ prayayau bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ draṣṭumīśvaram ।। 1 ।। gatvā muniśca kailāsaṃ praṇanāma śivaṃ śivām । tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā saśiṣyaḥ praṇataḥ śuciḥ ।। 2 ।। tatsarvaṃ kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ śrīharerapi । ātmanastapasastattvaṃ svavairāgyaṃ ca cetamaḥ ।। 3 ।। muneśca vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya pārvatī satī। tamuvāca hitaṃ satyaṃ sākṣācchaṃkaramaṃnidhau ।। 4 ।। pārvatyuvāca dharmatattvaṃ na jānāsi dharmiṣṭhaṃ manyase svayam । anapatyāṃ parityajya vava yāsi tapase mune ।। 5 ।। anapatyāṃ ca yuvatīṃ kulajāṃ ca pativratām । tyaktvā bhaveyuḥ saṃnyāsī brahmacārī yatīti vā ।। 6 ।। vāṇijye vā pravāse vā ciraṃ dūraṃ prayāti yaḥ । tīrthe vā tapase vā'pi mokṣārthaṃ janma khaṇḍitum ।। 7 ।। na mokṣastasya bhavati dharmasya skhalanaṃ dhruvam । abhiśāpena bhāryāyā narakaṃ ca paratra ya ।। 8 ।। ihaiva ca yaśonāśa ityāha kamalodbhavaḥ । dvārakāṃ gaccha he vipra svadharma rakṣa sāṃpratam ।। 9 ।। ekānaṃśāṃ madaṃśāṃ ca dharmataḥ paripālaya । pādapadmārjitaṃ pādapadmaṃ sarvasudurlabham ।। 10 ।। saṃtataṃ śaṃbhunā gītaṃ munīndraiḥ sanakādibhiḥ । parityaja surataroḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 11 ।। kva yāsi tapase vatsa sudhāṃ tyaktvā manoharām । śrīkṛṣṇapādapadmaṃ ca svapne japati yo mune ।। 12 ।। śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ । yadbālye yacca kaumāre vārdhake yacca yauvane ।। 13 ।। kāmato'kāmato vā'pi bhasmībhūtaṃ ca pātakam । sākṣādyo bhārate varṣe śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbujam ।। 14 ।। dṛṣṭvā sadyo bhavetpūjyo jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvam । koṭijanmārjitātsadyaḥ kṛtapāpādvimucyate ।। 15 ।। sarvāṇyeva hi tīrthāni yataḥpūtāni nityaśaḥ । tadvrataṃ tattapaḥ satyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ tacca pūjanam ।। 16 ।। saphalaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃbandhi svajanmakhaṇḍanaṃ yataḥ । kṛṣṇabhaktivihīnaśca brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ ।। 17 ।। tatsaṅgācca tadālāpā dbhaktabhaktiḥ praṇaśyati । kṛṣṇasyocchiṣṭabhojī yaḥ kuṣṇabhaktaśca brāhmaṇaḥ ।। 18 ।। āvahnipavanātpūtaḥ pūtaṃ kartuṃ jagatkṣamaḥ । śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca parityajya kvayāsi tapase dvija ।। 19 ।। tapasāṃ phalamāpnoti śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇena ca । yato bhaktirna ca bhavecchrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ।। 20 ।। sa guruḥ paramo vairī karoti janma niṣphalam । pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā śaṃkaraḥ premavihvalaḥ ।। 21 ।। pulakāñcitasarvāṅgastuṣṭāva parameśvarīm । durvāsāḥ praṇatiṃ kṛtvā śivadurgāpadāmbuje ।। 22 ।। smāraṃ smāraṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ punaṣca dvārakāṃ yayau । tatra gatvā hariṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। 23 ।। ekānaṃśālayaṃ gatvā sa ca reme tayā saha । kṛṣṇo yudhiṣṭhiradhyānātprayayau hastināpuram ।। 24 ।। kuntīṃ sabhāṣya bhūpaṃ ca bhrātṝṃ ścapramudā'nvitaḥ । upāyena jarāsaṃdhaṃ nihatya śālvameva ca ।। 25 ।। kālayāmāsa yajñaṃ ca vidhibodhitadakṣiṇam । munīndraiśca nṛpendraiśca rājasūyamabhīpsitam ।। 26 ।। śiśupālaṃ dantavaktraṃ tatra yajñe jaghāna saḥ । atīva nindāṃ kurvantaṃ sabhāyāṃ surabhūpayoḥ ।। 27 ।। papāta taccharīraṃ ca jīvo gatvā hareḥ padm । na dṛṣṭvā tatra marveśaṃ tuṣṭāvā''gātya mādhavam ।। 28 ।। śiśupāla uvāca vedānāṃ janako'si tvaṃ vedāṅgānāṃ ca mādhava । surāṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca prākṛtānāṃ ca dehinām ।। 29 ।। sūkṣmāṃ vidhāya sṛṣṭiṃ ca kalpabhedaṃ karopi ca । māyayā ca svayaṃ brahmā śaṃkaraḥ śaṣe eva ca ।। 30 ।। manavo munayaścaiva devāśca mṛṣṭipālakāḥ । kalāṃśenāpi kalayā dikpālāśca grahādayaḥ ।। 31 ।। svayaṃ pumānsvayaṃ strī ca svayameva napuṃsakaḥ । kāraṇaṃ ca svayaṃ kāryaṃ janyaśca jarakaḥ svayam ।। 32 ।। yantrasya ca guṇo deṣo yantriṇaśca śrutauśrutam । sarve yantrā bhavānyantrī tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।। 33 ।। mama kṣamasvāparādhaṃ mūḍhasya dvāriṇastava । brahmaśāpātkubuddheśca rakṣa rakṣa jagadguro ।। 34 ।। ityevamuktvā kramato jayo vijaya eva ca । mudā tau yayatuḥ śīghraṃ vaikuṇṭhadvāramīpsitam ।। 35 ।। śiśupālasya stotreṇa sarve te vismayaṃ yayuḥ । paribūrṇatamaṃ kṛtvā menire kṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। 36 ।। kārayitvā rājasūyaṃ bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇān । kurupāṇḍavayuddhaṃ ca kārayāmāsa bhedataḥ ।। 37 ।। bhuvo bhārāvataraṇaṃ cakāra sa kṛpānidhiḥ । punaryayau dvārakāṃ ca ciraṃ sthitvā nṛpājñayā ।। 38 ।। viprāyā mṛtavatsāyā jīvayāmāsa putrakān । mṛtasthānātsamānīya tanmātre pradadau sutān ।। 39 ।। taddṛṣṭvā devakī tuṣṭā yayāce mṛtaputrakān । mṛtasthānātsamānīya dadau mātre sahodarān ।। 40 ।। sadyo jahāra dāridryaṃ sudāmno brāhmaṇasya ca । samāgatasya svagṛhāddvārakāṃ śaraṇārthinaḥ ।। 41 ।। tasmai dadau rājalakṣmīṃ niścalāṃ sāptapauruṣīm । pṛthukānāṃ kaṇaṃ bhuktvā bhaktasya phaktavatsalaḥ ।। 42 ।। babhūva tasya rājyaṃ ca yathondrasyāmarāvatī । yathā dhaneśvaro devo dhanāḍhyaḥ sa babhuva ha ।। 43 ।। niścalāṃ haribhaktiṃ ca dadau dāsyaṃ sṛdurlabham । avināśini goloke yatheṣṭaṃ vadamuttamam ।। 44 ।। jahāra pārijātaṃ ca śakrāhaṃkārameva ca । satyāṃ ca kārayāmāsa puṇyakaṃ vratamīpsitam ।। 45 ।। vardhayāmāsa sarvatra nityaṃ naimittikaṃ mune । tatra vrate kumārāya svātmānaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।। 46 ।। brahmāṇānbhojayāmāsa tebhyo ratnaṃ dadau mudā । satyabhāmātimānaṃ ca vardhayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।। 47 ।। rukmiṇyā atisaubhāgyamanyāsāṃ ca navaṃ navam । vaiṣṇavānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca vipraṇāmapi pūjanam ।। 48 ।। vardhayāmāsa sarvatra nityaṃ naimittikaṃ mune । paramādhyātmikaṃ jñānamuddhavāya dadau prabhuḥ ।। 49 ।। arjunaṃ kathayāmāsa gītāṃ ca raṇamūrdhani । kṛtvā niṣkaṇṭakaṃ caiva kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 50 ।। yudhiṣṭhirāya pṛthivīrājyalakṣmīṃ dadau prabhuḥ । durgāṃ ca pūjayāmāsa vaiṣmavīṃ grāmadevatām ।। 51 ।। yajñaṃ ca kārayāmāsa koṭihomānvitaṃ śupham । nānāprakāranaivedyairdyūpadīpairmanoharaiḥ ।। 52 ।। brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa pārvatīprītaye tathā । raivate parvate ramye cāmūlyaratnamandire ।। 53 ।। gaṇeśaṃ pūjayāmāsa devānāmīśvaraṃ param । laḍḍukānāṃ tilānāṃ ca susvadusumanoharam ।। 54 ।। paripūṣṭaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ naivedyaṃ ca dadau mudā । laḍḍukaṃ svastikānāṃ ca saptalakṣaṃ sudhopamam ।। 55 ।। gaṇeśvarāya pradadau śarkarāśatarāśikam । pakvarambhāphalānāṃ ca daśalakṣamapūpakam ।। 56 ।। miṣṭānnaṃ pāyasaṃ ramyaṃ svādu svastikapiṣṭakam । ghṛtaṃ ca navanītaṃ ca dadhi dugdhaṃ sudhopamam ।। 57 ।। dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ pārijātapuṣpamālyamabhīpsitam । sugandhi candanaṃ gandhaṃ vahniśuddhāśuke dadau ।। 58 ।। yajñaṃ ca kārayāmāsa koṭihomānvitaṃ śubham । brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa tuṣṭāva sa gaṇeśvaram ।। 59 ।। vādyaṃ daśavidhaṃ caiva vādayāmāsa tatra vai । sūryaṃ ca pūjayāmāsa sāmbaḥ kuṣṭhakṣayāya ca ।। 60 ।। haviṣyaṃ kārayāmāsa taṃ ca sāmbaṃsamātaram । paribūrṇa vatsaraṃ cāpyupahārairanuttmaiḥ varaṃ dadau ca sāmbāya stotraṃ ca bhāskaraḥ svayam ।। 61 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... uttaṃ nāradanā... gaṇeśapūjā nāma trayodaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 113 ।।
<4.114> atha caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca kṛṣṇaputraśca pradyumno mahābalaparākramaḥ । tatputro'pyaniruddhaśca vidhāturaṃśa eva ca ।। 1 ।। ekadā'sāvaniruddho navayauvanasaṃyutaḥ । supto rahasi paryaṅke puṣpacandanacarcite ।। 2 ।। svapne dadarśa yuvatīṃ puṣṇodyāne supuṣpite । sugandhipuṣpatalpe ca snigdhacandanacarcite ।। 3 ।। śayānāṃ susmitāṃ ramyāṃ navayauvanasaṃyutām । amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇena vibhūṣitām ।। 4 ।। cārukeyūravalayaśaṅkhakaṅkaṇaśobhitām । maṇikuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitām ।। 5 ।। atīva sūkṣmavasanāṃ kvaṇanmañajīrarañjitām । pakvabimbādharoṣṭhīṃ ca śaratkamalalocanām ।। 6 ।। śaratpadmaprabhāmuṣṭakoṭīnduninditānanām । muktāpaṅktisamāsādyadantapaṅktimanoharām ।। 7 ।। trivakrakabarībhārāṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitām । kastūrīkuṅkumālaktasnigdhacandanakajjalaiḥ ।। 8 ।। patrāvalīviracitasukapolasthalojjvalām । dāḍimīkusumākārasindūrabindubhūṣitām ।। 9 ।। śrīrāmakadalīstambhaninditorusthalojjvalām । atyuccairvartulākārastanayugmavibhūṣitām ।। 10 ।। nitambabhārana mrāṃ ca kāmabāṇaprapīḍitām । kāmukīṃ kamanīyāṃ ca paśyantīṃ vakracakṣuṣā ।। 11 ।। kuṅkumālaktaraktāktapādapadmavirājitām । vāyupreraṇavastreṇa vyaktaguvtasthalojjvalām ।। 12 ।। tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmaputraśca kāmonmathitamānasaḥ । uvāca madhuraṃ ramyaṃ kāmamattāṃ sukomalām ।। 13 ।। cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ kāmena pulakānvitām । atiprauḍhāṃ navoḍhāṃ ca śṛṅgānecchāsucañcalām ।। 14 ।। aniruddha uvāca kiṃ devī kiṃ ca gāndharvokā tvaṃ kāminikānane । kasya satrī kasya kanyā vā kaṃ vā vāñchasi sundari ।। 15 ।। trailokyātulasaundaryā munimānasamohinī । na bibheṣi kathaṃ brūhi svayamekākinī ca mām ।। 16 ।। ahaṃ trailokyanāthasya pautraḥ kāmātmajo'dhunā । kānte'hamaniruddhaśca navīnayauvanāhataḥ ।। 17 ।। kamanīyaśca kāmī ca kāmaśāstraviśāradaḥ । kāmukīkāmanāṃ pūrṇāṃ kartumeveśvaraḥ svayam ।। 18 ।। māṃ bhajasva suśīre tvaṃ suveṣaṃ ca suśīlakam । ratiśūraṃ ratirasaprājñaṃ ratirasapriyam ।। 19 ।। ratiputraṃ ratirasaṃ pramattaṃ rasikaṃ priye । yuvānaṃ vyādhihīnaṃ ca kāmukaṃ kāmukīcchati ।। 20 ।। vidagdhāmu vidagdhaṃ ca kāntamāyāti kāmataḥ । vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhavet ।। 21 ।। pracchādya lojanāsyaṃ ca navasaṃgamalajjitā । vilokayantī vakrākṣikoṇena tamuvāca sā ।। 22 ।। kāminyuvāca kāmukaḥ kāmaputro'si kāmena vyākulo'dhunā । bhavāṃścetkāmukīyogyo na kāmaścintitaḥ katham ।। 23 ।। pautrastrailokyanāthasya svataḥ saṃbhāvitasya ca । svayaṃ yogyo yogyaputro vivāhaṃ na kathaṃ (vyadhāḥ) cana ।। 24 ।। vivāhītā yajñapatnī sā ca puṇyavratā satī । niścalā satataṃ sādhyā vardhinī saṅginī sadā ।। 25 ।। bhayaprītidānasādhyā guptapatnī tvaniścalā । naimittikā na nītyā sā sā ca vedavivarjitā ।। 26 ।। paraṃ narakasopānā paratrehāyaśaskarā । sādhustatra na hi rato vaṃśajo vaiṣṇavo yadi ।। 27 ।। yadi pūrva bhavedbhrānto nivṛttaḥ sādhusaṅgataḥ । pravṛttireṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttistu mahāphalā ।। 28 ।। prāyaścittī punarlipto nivṛttaḥ pātakī yadi । uvahāsyo bhuvi bhavetsarvaṃ
