kuñjaraśaucavat ।। 29 ।। suśīlā sundarī śāntā dharmapatnī praśaṃsitā । pativratā susādhyā sā śaśvatsupriyavādinī ।। 30 ।। komalāṅgī vidagdhā ca śyāmā ratisukhapradā । evaṃbhūtāṃ parityajya vaiṣṇavastapase vrajet ।। 31 ।। sā jetpariṇatā sādhvī śāntā putravatī yadā । anyathā ca vṛthā sarvaṃ tapasaḥ skhalanaṃ bhavet ।। 32 ।। asādhuśca kuvaṃśaścetparanārīṃ prayāti cet । sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ pituśiḥ saptabhiḥsaha ।। 33 ।। ahamūṣā bāṇakanyā bāṇaḥ śaṃkarakiṃkaraḥ । bāṇastrailokyavijayī śaṃkaro jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। 34 ।। na svatantrā parādhīnā triṣu kāleṣu kāminī । puṃścalī yā svatantrā sā'pyasadvaṃśaprasūtikā ।। 35 ।। pitā dadāti kanyāṃ tāṃ suyogyāya varāya ca । kanyā varaṃ na yāceta dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ।। 36 ।। tvaṃ ca yogyo'si yogyā'haṃ māmicchasi yadi prabho । bāṇaṃ prārthaya śaṃbhuṃ vā''pyathavā pārvatīṃ satīm ।। 37 ।। ityuktvā sundarī sādhvī sāntardhānā babhūva ha । nidrāṃ tatyāja sahasā kāmī kāmātmajo mune ।। 38 ।। buddhavā svapnaṃ sa vijñāya kāmena vyathitāntaraḥ । babhūva vyākulo'śānto na dṛṣṭvā prāṇavallabhām ।। 39 ।। tyaktvā''hāramanidraśca pramattaśca kṛśodaraḥ । kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhati śete ca kṣaṇaṃ rahasi roditi ।। 40 ।। putraṃ dṛṣṭvā tu krandantaṃ devakī rukmiṇī ratiḥ । anyāśca yoṣitaḥ sarvāḥ kathayāmāsurīśvaram ।। 41 ।। tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya mavusūdanaḥ । uvāca sarvatattvajñaḥ kṛṣṇaśca pūrṇamānasaḥ ।। 42 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca kāmāturā bāṇakanyā ratiṃ dṛṣṭvā śiveśayoḥ । varaṃ saṃprāpa durgāyā vyākulā madanāstrataḥ ।। 43 ।। svapnaṃ ca darśayāmāsa sā'niruddhaṃ ca pārvatī । mama pautraṃ pramattaṃ ca cakāra kautukena ca ।। 44 ।। tatputrīṃ ca pramatāṃ tā karomi svapnatā'dhunā । svacchandaṃ tiṣṭha na ciraṃ nāsti cintā manovyathā ।। 45 ।। iti kṛṣṇaḥ samāśvāsyasarvātamāsarvasiddhivit । svapnaṃ ca darśayāmāsa bāṇaputrīṃ ca kāmukīm ।। 46 ।। suptā sutalpe bālā sā puṣpacandanacarcite । navayauvanasaṃyuktā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।। 47 ।। śayānā ratnaparyaṅke dadarśa svapnamīpsitam । atīva nirjane deśe ratnanirmāṇamandire ।। 48 ।। navīnanīradaśyāmamatīva navayauvanam । koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ sasmitaṃ sumanoharam ।। 49 ।। ratnakeyuravalayaratnamañjīrarañjitam । ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam ।। 50 ।। candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ bhūṣitaṃ pītavāsasā । sucārumālatīmālyavakṣaḥ sthalasamujjvalam ।। 51 ।। śayānaṃ ratnaparyaṅke puṣpacandanacarcite । taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā sādhvī tanmūlaṃ prayayau mudā ।। 52 ।। uvāca madhuraṃ sādhvī hṛdayena vidūyatā । kāmātmajapriyā kāntā kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। 53 ।। ūṣovāca kastvaṃ kāmuka bhadraṃ te māṃ bhajasva smarāturām । atiprauḍhāṃ navoḍhāṃ ca navasaṃgamalālasām ।। 54 ।। tavānuraktāṃ bhaktāṃ ca gāndharveṇa samudvaha । vivāhāṣṭaprakāreṣu gāndharvaḥ sulabho nṛṇām ।। 55 ।। anuraktāṃ priyāṃ prāpya tyajedyaḥ kapaṭī pumān । tasmādyāti mahālakṣmīḥ śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam ।। 56 ।। pumānuvāca ahaṃ kṛṣṇasya pautraśca kāmadevātmajaḥ svayam । kathaṃ gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ kānte tayoranumatiṃ vinā ।। 57 ।। ityevamuktvā sa pumānantardhānaṃ cakāra saḥ । kāmena vyākulā kāntā na dṛṣṭvā kāntamīpsitam ।। 58 ।। nidrāṃ tyaktvā samutthāya talpādeva manoharāt । viṣasāda sakhīmadhye pramattā rudatī bhṛśam ।। 59 ।। papraccha tāṃ varā''līnāṃ kiṃ kimityeva niścitam । uvāca baudhayāmāsa citralekhā suyoginī ।। 60 ।। cetanaṃ kuru kalyāṇi kasmāte bhītirulbaṇā ।svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ śivā sākṣāddurlaṅdhye nagare sati ।। 61 ।। śivasmaraṇamātreṇa sarvāriṣṭaṃ palāyate । śivaṃ bhavati sarvatra śiva eva śivālayaḥ ।। 62 ।। dhyānāddurgatināśinyāḥ sarvaṃ durgaṃ vinaśyati । dadāti maṅgalaṃ tasmai sarvamaṅgalamahgalā ।। 63 ।। citralekhāvacaḥ śrutvā kiṃcinnovāca sundarī । tyaktvā''hāraṃ ca nidrāṃ ca puruṣaṃ cintayetsadā ।। 64 ।। citralekhā sakhī gatvā bāṇamāha ca tatpriyām । durgāṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ skandaṃ gaṇeśaṃ yogināṃ gurum ।। 65 ।। citralekhāvacaḥ śrutvā rurodoccairbhṛśaṃ satī । bāṇaśya śaṃkarābhyāśe viṣasāda pramūrcchitaḥ jahāsa śaṃkaro durgā kārtikeyo gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 66 ।। gaṇeśvara uvāca yo dadāti dhruvaṃ duḥkhamanyasmai damabhamohitaḥ । sakṣmadharmavicāreṇa sa vindati caturguṇam ।। 67 ।। śiveśayośca krīḍāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yā kāmamohitā । varaṃ tasyai dadau durgā varameva sudurlabham ।। 68 ।। svapne gatvā svayaṃ devī mattaṃ kṛtvā samarātmajam । adhunā vāmapārśce ca śaṃbhostiṣṭhati mūkvat ।। 69 ।। sarvaṃ jñātvā ca sarvajño bhagavānharirīśvaraḥ । svapne suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ darśayāmāsa kanyākām ।। 70 ।। suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuvānaṃ yuvātī satī । paramecchā bhavettasyā dharmabhītyā nivartate ।। 71 ।। suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṃścalī pāpavaṃśajā । tyejennidrāṃ ca svāhāraṃ patiṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ gṛham ।। 72 ।। cetanaṃ gṛhakārya ca kulalajjāṃ kuladvayam । yuvānaṃ ratiśūraṃ cāpyatinīca na hi tyajet ।। 73 ।। tyajejjātiṃ ca dharmaṃ ca prāṇāṃśca pariṇāmataḥ । tasmātprājñaḥ prayatnena prāṇebhyo yuvatīṃ sadā ।। 74 ।। parirakṣecca satataṃ māyāyuktāṃ na viśvaset । hṛdayaṃ kṣuradhārābhaṃ nārīṇāṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ ।। 75 ।। tāsāṃ mano na jānanti santo vedāśca vaidikā । prayātu dvārakāṃ sadyāścitralekhā suyoginīṃ ।। 76 ।। aniruddhaṃ samāhartuṃ pramāttamavalīlayā । iti śrutvā mahādevo gaṇeśaṃ tamuvāca ha ।। 77 ।। na śruṇoti yathā bāṇaḥ śubhakāryaṃ tathā kuru । citralekhā yayau turṇaṃ dvārakābhavanaṃ hareḥ ।। 78 ।। sarveṣāmapi durlaṅdhyaṃ līlayā praviveśa sā । nidritaṃ cāniruddhaṃ ca samāhṛtya ca yogataḥ ।। 79 ।। rathamārohayāmāsa nidvitaṃ bālakaṃ mudā । sā manoyāyinī bhadrā gṛhītvā bālakaṃ mune ।। 80 ।। muhūrtācchoṇitapuraṃ kṛtvā śaṅkhadhvaniṃ yayau । athā''śramābhyantare ca ruruduḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।। 81 ।। aho bāṇaharo vatsaḥ kvagataḥ prāṇavallabhaḥ । kṛṣṇastāśca samāśvāsya sarvajñaḥ sarvatattvavit ।। 82 ।। sāmbakāmabalaiḥ sārdha kṛṣṇāḥ sātyakinā tathā । gṛhītvā gānuḍaṃ vīraṃ rathamāruhya satvaraḥ ।। 83 ।। sudarśanaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ padmaṃ kaumodakīṃ gadām । paścādyāsyatideveśo nagaraṃ śoṇitaṃ tathā ।। 84 ।। sagaṇaiḥśaṃkeraṇaiva pārvatyā parirakṣitam । atha sā yoginī dhanyā puṇyā mānyā ca yoṣitām ।। 85 ।। śiṣyā durvāsasaḥ śāntā siddhayogena siddhidā । bārakaṃ bodhayāmāsa rudantaṃ mātaraṃ smaran ।। 86 ।। snāpayitvā dadau tasmai mālyacandanabhūṣaṇam । kṛtvā suveṣaṃ bālasya kanyāntaḥ puramīpsitam ।। 87 ।। cakre praveśaṃ yogena rakṣakaiścāpi rakṣitam । tāmūṣāṃ nidritāṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāhārāṃ kṛśodarīm ।। 88 ।। śīghraṃ ca bodhayāmāsa sakhībhiḥ parirakṣitām । ūṣāṃ kṛtvā ca susnātāṃ vastrabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 89 ।। vastrairmālyaiścandanaiśca sindūrapatrakaiḥ śubhaiḥ । dvayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tatra māhendre ca śubhakṣaṇe ।। 90 ।। kārayāmāsa guptyā ca sakhīnāṃ saṃmatena ca । pativratā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā sā reme vigatajvarā ।। 91 ।। gāndharveṇa vivāhena tāmuvāha smarātmajaḥ । ratirbabhūva suciramubhayoḥ sukhakāraṇam ।। 92 ।। divāniśaṃ na bubudhe smaraputraḥ smarāturaḥ । ūṣā kāmāturā prauḍhā navoḍhā navasaṃgamāt ।। 93 ।। mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa puṃsaśca sparśamātreṇa kāmukī । evaṃ nityaṃ ca rahasi saṃgamaḥ sumanoharaḥ babhūva suciraṃ vipra rājā śuśrāva rakṣakāt ।। 94 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradānā... ūṣāniruddhayoḥ saṃgame caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 114 ।।
<4.115> atha pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha bhītā rakṣakāste samūturbāṇamīśvaram । skandaṃ gaṇeśaṃ durgāṃ ca daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca ।। 1 ।। rakṣakā ūcuḥ aho duṣṭaśca kālo'yamatīva duratikramaḥ । svatantrā bālikā prauḍhā patimicchati sāṃpratam ।। 2 ।। asaṅgasaṃgamaṃ nātha sādhūnāṃ duḥkhakāraṇam । saṃsargajā guṇā doṣā bhavanti satataṃ nṛṇām ।। 3 ।।citralekhā svayaṃ dūtī samānīya paraṃ varam । raṇaśūraṃ mahāvīraṃ nṛpendraṃ ca mahāratham ।। 4 ।। yuvānaṃ vyādhihīnaṃ ca kandarpādapi sundaram । saṃbhogaṃ kārayāmāsa bubudhe na divāniśam ।। 5 ।। sāṃprataṃ tava kanyā sā'pyūṣāgarbhavatī satī । kulajā kulayoścaiva taptāṅgārasvarūpiṇī ।। 6 ।। dauhitro vā'pi dauhitrī babhuva sāṃprataṃ tava। kanyāṃ paśya mahāprauḍhāṃ nagarīṃ nāgarānvitām ।। 7 ।। nakhavikṣatasarvāṅgīṃ varādhīnāṃ ca cañcalām । puṃsaśca saṅgirīṃ śaśvadrahasye ratisaṅginīm ।। 8 ।। sasmitāṃ sakaṭākṣāṃ ca cñcalekṣaṇavīkṣatām । evaṃ śrutvā lajjitaśca bāṇastatra cukopa ha ।। 9 ।। yuddhāya ca matiṃ cakre vāritaḥ śabhunā bhṛśam । vāritaśca gaṇeśena skandena śivayā tathā ।। 10 ।। bhairavyā bhadrakālyā ca yoginībhiśca saṃtatam । aṣṭabhirbhairavaiścaiva rudrairekādaśātmakaiḥ ।। 11 ।। bhūtaiḥ pretaiśca kūṣmāṇḍairvetālairbrahmarākṣasaiḥ । yosīndrairapi siddhendrai rudraiścaṇḍādibhistathā ।। 12 ।। koṭaryā prāmadevyā ca yathā mātrā hitāya ca । uvāca śaṃkaro bāṇaṃ mūḍhaṃ paṇḍitamāninam hitaṃ satyaṃ nītiśāstraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 13 ।। mahādeva uvāca śṛṇu bāṇa pravakṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm । bhuvo bhārāvataraṇe bhārate svayamīśvaraḥ ।। 14 ।। nihatya sarvānrājendrāndvārakāyāṃ virājate । yasya lomasu viśvāni tasya vāsaḥ sadīśvaraḥ ।। 15 ।। vāsudeva iti khyātaḥ kathyate tena kovidaiḥ । dhāturvidhātā bhagavāṃścakrapāṇiḥ svayaṃ bhuvi ।। 16 ।। brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ । nirguṇaśca nirīhaśca bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 17 ।। paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paramātmā ca dehinaḥ । yasmingate śavo jīvo saṃgrāmastena saṃbhavet ।। 18 ।। śastraviddho mahākāśo yathā mūḍha diśastathā । tathā''tmā ca nirākāro dehī ca dhyānahetunā ।। 19 ।। tasya putro'niruddhaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ । trailokyamapi saṃhartuṃ kṣaṇena ca kṣamaḥ svayam ।। 20 ।। sarve vevāśca daityāśca balavanto mahārathāḥ । te sarve cāniruddhasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 21 ।। yayoreva samaṃ vittaṃ yayoreva samaṃ balam । tayorvivāho maitrī ca na tu puṣṭavipuṣṭayoḥ ।। 22 ।। baliḥ pitā te daityānāṃ sārabhūto mahārathaḥ । kṣaṇena yena nītaśca sutalaṃ sa hareḥ kalā ।। 23 ।। sarve cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥ paripūrṇatamasya ca । vṛndāvaneśvarasyāpi kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 24 ।। pārvatyuvāca dhyāyate dhyānaniṣṭhaśca hṛtpadme ca divāniśm । brahmā maheśaḥ meṣaśca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 25 ।। dineśaśca gaṇeśaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ । dhyāyate paramātmānaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 26 ।। sanatkumāraḥ kapilo naro nārāyaṇastathā । dhyāyate hṛdayāmbhoje bhagavantaṃ sa... ।। 27 ।। manavaśca munīndrāśca siddhendrā yogināṃ varāḥ । dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca dhyāyante bhagavantaṃ sa... ।। 28 ।। sarvādiṃ sarvabījaṃ ca sarveśaṃ ca parātparam । dhyāyante jñāninaḥ sarve bhagavantaṃ sa... ।। 29 ।। gaṇeśa uvāca abhāgyaṃ ca baleścāpi vaiṣṇavasya mahātmanaḥ । mūḍho'yamīdṛśaḥ putraḥ prahlādasya ca dhīmataḥ ।। 30 ।। skanda uvāca aye bhrātarna śrutā ca hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kathā । hiraṇyākṣasya ca madhoḥ kaiṭabhasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 31 ।। pūrvajāste'pi te daityā mahābalaparākramāḥ । krameṇa viṣṇunā nītā līlayā yamasādanam ।। 32 ।। bhagavānyasya saṃhartā svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ । tasya ko rakṣitā bhrātarnivartasva śubhāyaca ।। 33 ।। teṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvācāsureśvaraḥ । koparaktāsyanayano dhanuṣpāṇiryathā'ntakaḥ ।। 34 ।। bāṇa uvāca śṛṇu mātaḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tāta maheśvara । śṛṇu bhrātargaṇapate śṛṇu bhrātaśca kārtika ।। 35 ।। śubhaśubhaṃ prāktanena prāṇināṃ karmiṇāṃ tathā । kṛtakarmātiriktaṃ ca kārya keṣāṃ ca vartate ।। 36 ।। nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi । tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati ।। 37 ।। yasmācca yasya nirvāṇaṃ vidhātrā likhitaṃ purā । tadeva nityaṃ satyaṃ ca niṣekaḥ kena vāryate ।। 38 ।। saṃgrāme kātaro yo hi niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvanam । jayī yaśasca labhate mṛtaḥ svargaṃ ca gacchati ।। 39 ।। praviśya kanyāṃ gṛhṇāti nagaraṃ śivarakṣitam । pārvatyā ca gaṇeśena yuddhena balinā tathā ।। 40 ।। ko vā gṛhṇāti kanyāṃ ca kasya vā jīvitasya ca । sagarbhā tava kanyeti sabhāyāṃ rakṣako vadet ।। 41 ।। iti me vajratulyaṃ ca śrutikauṭaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ । ato'nirudvaṃ hatvā ca ghātayiṣyāmi kanyakām anyathā jvaladagnau ca tyakṣyāmi ca kalevaram ।। 42 ।। koṭaryuvāca śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi mātā'haṃ te'pi dharmataḥ । turantenāpi pṛtreṇa pitrorduḥrkha pade pade ।। 43 ।। kanyā paragṛhītā sā'pyanyasmai dātumakṣamā । śrīkṛṣṇasyāpi pautrāya pradyumnasya sutāya ca ।। 44 ।। aniruddhāya mahate svecchayā dehi kanyakām । pūto'si bhārate varṣe saptabhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha ।। 45 ।। yautukaṃ dehi sarvasvaṃ yaśase mahase bhuvi । anyathā raṇamadhye ca tvāṃ haniṣyati mādhavaḥ ।। 46 ।। sudaśaṃnena cakeṇa ko vā tvāṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ । koṭarīvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa daityapuṃgavaḥ ।। 47 ।। prayayau rathamāruhya yatra pautro harermune । skandaḥ senāpatirbhūtvā prayayau śaṃkarājñayā ।। 48 ।। bāṇaḥ svastyayanaṃ cakre gaṇeśaśca śivaḥ svayam । bāṇaṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ cakre pārvatī koṭarī tathā ।। 49 ।। aṣṭau ca bhairavāścaiva rudrāścaikādaśaiva te । sarve yuddhāya hantāro babhūvuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ ।। 50 ।। etasminnantare dūto'pyaniruddhamuvāca ha । pārvatyā preritaścaiva bāṇapatnyā ca satvaram ।। 51 ।। dūta uvāca aniruddhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ pārvatīvacanaṃ śṛṇu । bhava sāṃnāhiko vatsa kuru yuddhaṃ bahirbhava ।। 52 ।। bhītoṣā rudatī trastā sasmāra pārvatīṃ satīm । rakṣa rakṣa mahāmāye matpraṇeśvaramīpsitam ।। 53 ।। abheye'pyabhayaṃ dehi saṃgrāme ghoradāruṇe । tvameva jagatāṃ mātā snehaste sarvataḥ samaḥ ।। 54 ।। athāniruddhaḥ saṃnāhī śastrapāṇirbabhūva ha । ūṣādattaṃ rathaṃ prāpya cakārā''rohaṇaṃ mudā ।। 55 ।। bahiḥ saṃbhūya śibirāddadarśa bāṇamīśvaraḥ । sāṃnāhikaṃ śastrapāṇiṃ raktāsyalocanaṃ param ।। 56 ।। dṛṣṭvā'niruddhaṃ bāṇaśca tamuvāca ruṣā'nvitaḥ । ghorasaṃgrāmamadhye ca viṣoktiṃ prajvalanniva ।। 57 ।। bāṇa uvāca aye vīra mahāduṣṭa nītiśāstravivarjita । candra vaṃśakulāṅgāra puṇyakṣetre'yaśaskara ।। 58 ।। pitā te śambaraṃ hatvā jagrāha tasya kāminīm । tato jāto bhavaneva nirodhaṃ svakulakṣamam ।। 59 ।। pitāmaho vāsudevo mathurāyāṃ ca kṣatriyaḥ । gokule vaiśyaputraśca nāmnā ca nandanandanaḥ ।। 60 ।। vṛndāvane ca gopasya nandasya paśurakṣakaḥ । sākṣājjāraśca gopīnāṃ duṣṭaḥ paramalampaṭaḥ ।। 61 ।। jaghāna pūtanāṃ sadyo nārīghātī hyadhārmikaḥ । āgatya mathurāṃ kubjāṃ jaghāna maithunena ca ।। 62 ।। durbalaṃ narakaṃ hatvā strīsamūhaṃ manoharam । jagrāha yonilubdhaśca svaputramatiniṣṭhuraḥ ।। 63 ।। bhīṣmakaṃ mānavaṃ jitvā tatputraṃ cāpi durbalam । jagrāha kanyakāṃ tasya devayogyāṃ ca rukmiṇīm ।। 64 ।। satrājitaḥ sūryabhṛtyo devātprāpa maṇīśvaram । ghātayitvā hyupāyena jagrāha maṇikanyakām ।। 65 ।। kurupāṇḍavayuddhaṃ ca kārayitvā ca dāruṇam । yudhiṣṭhirasya yajñe ca śiśupālaṃ jaghāna saḥ ।। 66 ।। dantavaktraṃ ca śālbaṃ ca jarāsaṃdhaṃ ca dāruṇaḥ । saṃjahāra bhuvo bhūpasamūhamatidāruṇam ।। 67 ।। upāyānnarakaṃ hatvā sarvasvaṃ tajjahāra saḥ । durbalo rājabhītaścasamudraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।। 68 ।। jitvā ca bhrātaraṃ śakraṃ bhāryāyā vacanena ca । jagrāha pārijātaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca svargadurlabham ।। 69 ।। kaṃsaṃ nihatyādharmiṣṭho bhrātaraṃ mātureva ca । jagrāha tasya sarvasvaṃ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi te ।। 70 ।। jatvā ca bhallukaṃ yuddhe jagrāha tasya kanyakām । tatpiturbhaginī kuntī caturṇāṃ kāminī bhuvi ।। 71 ।। draupadī bhrātṛpatnī ca pñcānāṃ kāminī tathā । goṣṭhīno yonilubdhaśca śaśvatparamalampaṭaḥ ।। 72 ।। tajjyeṣṭho baradevaśca śaśvatpibati vāruṇīm । yamunāṃ bhrātṛpatnīṃ ca karotyāhvānamīpsitam ।। 73 ।। jahāra bhaginīṃ tasya kauḥteyaḥ śakranandanaḥ । subhadrāṃ mātulasutāṃ saṃnibodha kulakramam ।। 74 ।। bāṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa kāmanandanaḥ । uvāca paramārthaṃ ca yogyaṃ pratyuttaraṃ mune ।। 75 ।। aniruddha uvāca pitā me kāmadevaśca brahmaputraḥ purā śuciḥ । yasyāstreṇa vaśībhūtaṃ trailokyaṃ satataṃ śṛṇu ।। 76 ।। śivakopānalenaiva bhasmībhūtaḥ svakarmataḥ । kṛṣṇasya putro'pyadhunā sarveṣāṃ paramātmanaḥ ।। 77 ।। pativratā ratirmātā patiśokena sāṃpratam । śambarasya gṛhe tasthau hṛtā tena balena ca ।। 78 ।। chāyāṃ māyāvatīṃ dattvā māyayā śayanena ca । ratiṃ svadharma saṃrakṣya dharmasākṣī ca tadgṛhe ।। 79 ।। nihatya śambaraṃ śatruṃ gṛhītvā svapriyāṃ satīm । ājagāma dvārakāṃ ca candrasuryau ca sākṣiṇau ।। 80 ।। pitāmahaṃ vāsudevaṃ tvaṃ kiṃ jānāmi mūḍhavat । yaṃ ca santona jānanti vedāścatvāra eva ca ।। 81 ।। vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvāni yasya lomasu । tasya devaḥ paraṃ brahma vāsudeva iti smṛtaḥ ।। 82 ।। śaṃkaraṃ pṛccha sākṣācca yasya bhṛtyo'dhunā bhavān । kṛṣṇabhṛtyasya ca baleḥ putro'si kiṃkarātmajaḥ ।। 83 ।। gokule vaiśyaputratvaṃ brūhi tvaṃ jñānadurbala । bhojanaṃ vedavihitaṃ śaśvatkṣattriyavaiśyayoḥ ।। 84 ।। droṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ śreṣṭhā dharā tasya priyā satī । putraṃ ca tapasā lebhe paramātmānamīśvaram ।। 85 ।। droṇo nando vaiśyarājo yaśodā sā dharā satī । vṛṣabhānasutā rādhā sudāmnaḥ śāpakāraṇāt ।। 86 ।। triṃśatkoṭiṃ ca gopīnāṃ gṛhītvā bharturājñayā । puṇyaṃ ca bhārataṃ kṣetraṃ golokādājagāmasā ।। 87 ।। tābhiḥ sārdha sa reme ca svapatnībhirmudā'nvitaḥ । pāṇiṃ jagrāha rādhāyāḥ svayaṃ brahmā purohitaḥ ।। 88 ।। gopakoṭiśca golokādājagām mṛdā'nvitā । tejasā haritulyāste pārṣadapravarā hareḥ ।। 89 ।। gorakṣaṇaṃ harereva gopaveṣasya cā''tmanaḥ । gopānāṃ śiśurakṣārthaṃ māyeśasyāpi māyayā ।। 90 ।। pūtanā balikanyā ca bhaginī ca tavāsura । dṛṣṭvā ca vāmanaṃ vindhyā cakāra putramānasam ।। 91 ।। evaṃbhūto yadi mama putro bhavati sāṃpratam । stanaṃ dadāmi tanayaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi sundaram ।। 92 ।। tasyāḥpūrṇaṃ mānasaṃ ca cakāra bhagavānprabhuḥ । stanaṃ dattvā ca golokaṃ yayau sā ratnayānataḥ ।। 93 ।। kubjā sā bhaginī pūrvaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ । śrīrāmaṃ cakame kāmānnāmnā śūrpaṇakhā satī ।। 94 ।। nāsāṃ ciccheda tasyāśca lakṣmaṇo dhārmikeśvaraḥ । tapasā ca varaṃ lebhe brahmaṇaḥ priyamīśvaram ।। 95 ।। tena puṇyena taṃlabdhvā golokaṃ sā jagāma ha । gopī babhūva goloke kṛṣṇasyā''liṅganena ca ।। 96 ।। narako harivadhyaśca svapūrvaprāktanena ca । pāṇiṃ jagrāha kanyānāṃ sākṣiṇau śaśibhāskarau ।। 97 ।। bhīṣmakanyā mahālakṣmīḥ śīkṛṣṇasya priyā satī । vaikuṇṭhādāgatā sādhvī brahmaṇo'nṛmatena ca ।। 98 ।। satrājitasya kanyā sā satyabhāmā vasuṃdhara । dadau kṛṣṇāya rājā sa taṃ maṇiṃ yautukena ca ।। 99 ।। bhuvo bhārāvataraṇahetunā gamanaṃ hareḥ । saṃjahāra bhuvo bhāraṃ kurupāṇḍavayuddhataḥ ।। 100 ।। śiśupālo dantavaktro jayo vijaya eva ca । dvāriṇau dvāraṣaṭke ca vaikuṇṭhe śrīharerapi ।। 101 ।। kumāraśāpātpatitau prāpya janmatrayaṃ dhruvam । hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva tavaiva pūrvapūruṣaḥ ।। 102 ।। tasya bhrātā hiraṇyākṣastenaiva varuṇo jitaḥ । harirnṛsiṃharūpeṇa taṃ jaghānāvalīlayā ।। 103 ।। sūkareṇa hato'nyaśca pūrvajanmakathāṃ śṛṇu । dvitīye janmani purā rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇakaḥ ।। 104 ।। śrīrāmeṇa hatau tau dvau śeṣajanma kalau tayoḥ । śrīkṛṣṇena hatau tau dvau dharmaputrāvubhau tathā ।। 105 ।। jarāsaṃdhaśca śālvaśca durātmā kaṃsa eva ca । prāktanāttasya vadhyāste bhuvo bhārajihīrṣayā ।। 106 ।। māṃdhātuḥ sutamadhye ca yavanaścāpi prāktanāt । lakṣmīśvarasya kṛṣṇasya dhanena kiṃ prayojanamā ।। 107 ।। pratijñayā ca satyāyāḥ puṇyakavratakāraṇāt । pārijātaṃ samanīya cakāra svātmano vratam ।। 108 ।। svayaṃ jāmbavatī devī durgāṃśā bhallukātmajā । pāṇiṃ jagrāha tasyāśca tapasā bhārate hariḥ ।। 109 ।। kuntyāśca kṣetrajāḥ putrāḥ kevalaṃ bharturājñayā । kalau niṣiddhaṃ triyuge prasiddhaṃ palapaitṛkam ।। 110 ।। yudhiṣṭhiro dharmaputro bhīmaśca pavanātmajaḥ । mahendraputro dharmiṣṭhaḥ phālguno vijayī bhuvi ।। 111 ।। yasmai pāśupataṃ śaṃbhuḥ pradadau ca svayaṃ purā । aśvamedhaṃ gavālambhaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ parapaitṛkam ।। 112 ।। devareṇa sutotpatiṃ kalau pañca nityaśaḥ । draupadyāḥ pañca bhartāraḥ śaṃkarasya vareṇa ca ।। 113 ।। baladevaḥ puṣpamadhu pūtaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ । cakāra yamunāhvānaṃ snānārthaṃ dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ।। 114 ।। subhadrāṃ ca dadau kṛṣṇaḥ phālgunāya mahātmane । kanyakāṃ mātulānāṃ ca dākṣiṇātyaḥ parigrahaḥ ।। 115 ।। deśeṣvanyeṣu doṣo'yamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 116 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... vāṇāniruddhasaṃ... pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 115 ।।
<4.116> atha ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ bāṇa uvāca aniruddha budho'si tvaṃ tvayoktaṃ satyameva ca । śaṃbhunā caivamuktaṃ ca sarvaṃ buddhaṃ svacetasā ।। 1 ।। tvayoktaṃ śaṃkaravarātpañcānāṃ svāmināṃ priyā । draupadī ca mahābhāgā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 2 ।। śambareṇa hṛtā pūrva tava mātā kathaṃ ratiḥ । devairapi kathaṃ dattā devāstena jitā katham ।। 3 ।। aniruddha uvāca ekadā raghunāthaśca sītayā lakṣmaṇo ca । snātaḥ sarasi tatrastho ramye pañcavaṭītaṭe ।। 4 ।। uvāca sītā hemante jalaṃ susvādu nirmalam । tathā'nnaṃ vyañjanaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaṃ vastu suśītalam ।। 5 ।। phalāvabacayanaṃ cakre sītāyai pradadau mudā । tato dadau lakṣmaṇāya paścādbhaṅkte svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।। 6 ।। lakṣmaṇastadgṛhītvā ca naiva bhuṅkte phalaṃ jalam । meghanādavadhārthaṃ ca sītoddhāraṇakāraṇāt ।। 7 ।। nidrāṃ na yāti no bhuṅkte varṣāṇāṃ ca caturdaśa । ya evaṃ puruṣo yogī tadvadhyo rāvaṇatmajaḥ ।। 8 ।। etasminnantare rāmaṃ draṣṭuṃ kamalalocanam । vahanistatra samāyāto dvijarūpī kṛpānidhiḥ bhaviṣyatkathayāmāma śrutikauṭaparaṃ vacaḥ ।। 9 ।। vahniruvāca śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga sītāsaṃgopanaṃ kuru । saptāhābhyantare caiva rāvaṇo duṣṭarākṣasaḥ ।। 10 ।। durnivāryaḥ prāktanena jānakīṃ ca hariṣyati । vidhātrā likhitaṃ karma prāktaṃnaṃ kena vāryate ।। 11 ।। vedaiścaturbhiḥ kathitaṃ na ca daivātparaṃ varam ।। 12 ।। rāma uvāca sītāṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ gaccha cchāyā'traiva tu tiṣṭhatu । kalatravarjanaṃ karma sarveṣāṃ ca jugupsitam ।। 13 ।। sītāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau rudatīṃ ca hutāśanaḥ । sītayā sadṛśī chāyā tasthau śrīrāmasaṃnidhau ।। 14 ।। sā ca cchāyā hṛtā pūrva rāvaṇenāvalīlayā । samuddadhāra tāṃ rāmo nihatya taṃ sabāndhavam ।। 15 ।। vahnau parīkṣākāle ca cchāyā vahnau viveśa sā । agniśchāyāṃ ca saṃrakṣya dadau rāmāya jānakīm ।। 16 ।। rāmastāṃ ca gṛhītvā ca prayayau svāśramaṃ mudā । chāyā tasthau vahnipārśve hṛdayena vidūyatā ।। 17 ।। sā ca cchāyā tapaścakre nārāyaṇasarovare । tapaścakāra divyaṃ ca śātavarṣaṃ ca śūlinaḥ ।। 18 ।। varaṃ vṛṇuṣva bhadre tvamuvāca śaṃkaraśca tām । uvāca śivaṃ vyagrā bharturduḥkhena duḥkhitā ।। 19 ।। patiṃ dehi pañcadhā sā varaṃ vavre trilocanam । sarvasaṃpatpradastuṣṭastasyai śarvo varaṃ dadau ।। 20 ।। mahādeva uvāca sādhvi tvaṃ pañcadhā brūhi patiṃ dehīti vyākulā । pañcendrāśca hareraṃśā bhaviṣyanti priyāstava ।। 21 ।। te ca sarve ca pañcendrāścādhunā pañca pāṇḍavāḥ । sā ca cchāyā draupadī ca yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā ।। 22 ।। kṛtayuge vedavatī tretāyāṃ janakātmajā । dvāpare draupadī chāyā tena kṛṣṇā trihāyaṇī ।। 23 ।। vaiṣṇapī kṛṣṇabhaktā ca tena kṛṣṇā prakīrtitā । svargalakṣmīrmahendrāṇāṃ sā ca paścādbhaviṣyati ।। 24 ।। rājā dadau phālgunāya kanyāyāśca svayaṃvare । papraccha mātaraṃ vīro vastu prāptaṃ mayā'dhunā ।। 25 ।। tamuvāca svayaṃ mātā gṛhāṇa bhrātṛbhiḥ saha । śaṃbhorvareṇa pūrva ca paratra māturājñayā ।। 26 ।। draupadyāḥ svāminastena hetunā pañca pāṇḍavāḥ । caturdaśānāmindrāṇāṃ pañcendrāḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ ।। 27 ।। śaṃkareṇābhisaṃśaptā sā mātrā bhartsitena ca । bhartāte bhasmasādbhūto harakopānalena ca ।। 28 ।। he rati tvaṃ mayā śaptā daityagrastā bhavādhunā । vijityadevānsendrāśca śambarastvā hariṣyati ।। 29 ।। punaruvataṃ varaṃ prādātsatītvāṃ te na yāsyati । chāyāṃ dattvā tiṣṭha gehe yāvajjīvati te patiḥ ।। 30 ।। iti te kathitaṃ sarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam । devānāṃ guptacaritaṃ śrṛṇu daityendra sāṃpratam ।। 31 ।। etasminnantare tatra subhadraśca mahābalaḥ । kumbhāṇḍabhrātā balavānbāṇasenāpatīśvaraḥ ।। 32 ।। nirbhatsarya bāṇaṃ samare śastrapāṇirmahārathaḥ । śrīkṛṣṇapautraṃ śūlaṃ ca cikṣepa pralayāgnivat ।। 33 ।। ardhayandreṇa tacchūlaṃ ciccheda kāmaputrakaḥ । śaktiṃ cikṣepa bhadraśca śatasūryasamaprabhām ।। 34 ।। vaiṣṇavāstreṇa ciccheda tāṃ śaktiṃ kāmaputrakaḥ । nārāyaṇāstraṃ cikṣepa subhadro raṇamūrdhani ।। 35 ।। praṇamya śete nirbhīto madanasya suto balī । ūrdhvamastraṃ ca babhrāma śatasūryasamaprabham ।। 36 ।। pralīnamastramākāśe viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam । astre gate so'niruddho gṛhītvā ca mahānasim ।। 37 ।। prababhañjabhadrarathaṃ jaghānāśvāṃśca sārathim । jaghāna taṃ subhadraṃ ca līlayā raṇamūrdhani ।। 38 ।। hate subhadre bāṇaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ । vāṇānāṃ śatakaṃ cāpi cakṣepa raṇamūrdhani ।। 39 ।। kāmātmajo'gnibāṇena bāṇodhaṃ pradadāha saḥ । bāṇaścikṣepa brahmāstraṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇam ।। 40 ।। dṛṣṭvā kāmātmajaḥ śīghraṃ sabījaṃ mantrapūrvakam । brahmastreṇaiva sahasā saṃjahārāvalīlayā ।। 41 ।। bāṇaḥ pāśupataṃ kṣeptuṃ samārebhe ca kopataḥ । niṣiddhaśca gaṇeśena skandena śaṃbhunā tathā ।। 42 ।। taddṛṣṭvā so'niruddhastaṃ dhanurbāṇaugha saṃyutam । mumoca jṛmbhaṇe yuddhe śīghraṃ taṃ ca mahāratham ।। 43 ।। jaḍo babhūva bāṇaśca niśceṣṭo raṇamūrdhani । punaścikṣepa nidrāsyaṃ nidritaṃ taṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 44 ।। bāṇaṃ taṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhītvā khaḍgamuttamam । bāṇaṃ hantuṃ samudyantaṃ vārayāmāsa kārtikaḥ ।। 45 ।। skandaśca śatabāṇauśca vārayāmāsa līlayā । aniruddhaṃ mahābhāgaṃ balavāntaṃ dhanurdharam ।। 46 ।। aniruddhaśca sahasā tathā śaktyā duratyayā । babhañja kārtikarathaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam ।। 47 ।। gadayā kārtikaḥ kruddho'pyaniruddharayaṃ mudā । babhañja līlayā tatra kṣaṇena raṇamūrdhani ।। 48 ।। aniruddho'rdhacandreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa līlayā । ciccheda kārtikadhanurbhallāstreṇa niyojitam ।। 49 ।। jadhāna kārtikastaṃ ca gadayā ca durantayā । gadāṃ jagrāha taddhastājjavena madanātmajaḥ ।। 50 ।। śūlaṃ gṛhītvā skandaṃ ca tameva hantumu dyatam । aniruddhaśca kopena prerayāmāsa dūrataḥ ।। 51 ।। kārtikaḥ punarāgatya gṛhītvā kāmaputrakam । gṛhītvā ca kareṇaiva pātayāmāsa bhūtale ।। 52 ।। aniruddho gṛhītvā'siṃ prabhustasthau mahābalaḥ । tayorvirodhaṃ dūraṃ ca pracakāra gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 53 ।। kārtikaḥ prayayau gehamūṣāgehaṃ smarātmajaḥ । sarva nivedituṃ śaṃbhuṃ prayayau sa gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 54 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... bāṇayu... ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 116 ।।
<4.117> atha saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśastu śivasthānaṃ gatvā natvā maheśvaram । sarva vijñāpayāmāsa krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 1 ।। bāṇāniruddhayoryuddhaṃ subhadranidhanaṃ tathā । skandāniruddhayoryuddhamaniruddhasya vikramam ।। 2 ।। gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya bhagavānbhavaḥ । uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā suguptaṃ vedasaṃmatam ।। 3 ।। mahādeva uvāca gaṇeśvara mahābhāga śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama । hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।। 4 ।। asaṃkhyaviśvasaṃghaṃ ca sarva kṛṣṇātmajaṃ sutam । kṛṣṇaṃ jānīhi yatkāryaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। 5 ।। brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ jagatmarva gaṇeśvara । nibodha satyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 6 ।। goloke dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam । śiśurūpaṃ gopaveṣaṃ gopaveṣaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ prabhum ।। 7 ।। gopībhirgopanikaraiḥ sahitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ । puṇye vṛndāvane ramye sundare rāsamaṇḍale ।। 8 ।। carantaṃ muralīhastaṃ brahmeśaśeṣavanditam । śataśṛṅgai ca śaileśe vaṭamūle nirākule ।। 9 ।। goṣṭhe bhāṇḍīranikaṭe nirmale virajātaṭe । navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā ।। 10 ।। yathā navaṃ ghanaughaṃ ca saudāminthā virājitam । āvirbhāvaśca teṣāṃ vai goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 11 ।। tāvanto gokule ramye puṇye vṛndāvane vane । sarve cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥkṛṣṇastu bhagavānsvayam ।। 12 ।। paripūrṇatamaḥ kāmo brahmaśāpātsvavismṛtaḥ । tasya putro'niruddhaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। 13 ।। mayā prasthāpitaḥ skando mahāyuddhe sudāruṇe । mṛto bāṇaśca saṃgrāme tena skandena rakṣitaḥ ।। 14 ।। skandāniruddhayoryuddhe samatvaṃ tu gaṇeśvara । aṣṭau ca bhairavāḥ sarve rudrāścaikādaśaiva te ।। 15 ।। aṣṭau ca vasavaścaite devāḥ śakrādayastathā । tathaiva dvādaśādityāḥ sarve daityeśvarāstathā ।। 16 ।। devānāmagraṇīḥ skando bāṇaśca sagaṇastathā । sarve te cāniruddhaṃ ca saṃgrāme jetumakṣamāḥ ।। 17 ।। aniruddhaḥ svayaṃ brahmā pradyumnaḥ kāma eva ca । baladevaḥ svayaṃ śeṣaḥ kṛṣṇaśca prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 18 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bāṇaṃ rakṣa gaṇeśvara । bhavāñśubhasvarūpaśca vighnakhaṇḍanakārakaḥ ।। 19 ।। ārādāyāsyati harirgṛhītvā ca sudarśanam । avyarthamastrapravaraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham ।। 20 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bāṇayuddhe śivalambodarasaṃ... saptadaśādhikaśātatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 117 ।।
<4.118> athāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśaṃ bodhayitvā tu śaṃbhuramyantaraṃ yayau । tatra siṃhāsane ramye durgā durgatināśinī ।। 1 ।। bhairavī bhadrakālī ca ugracaṇḍā ca koṭarī । tāḥ samutthāya sahasā praṇemurjagadīśvam ।। 2 ।। tatrā''yayau gaṇeśaśca kārtikeyaśca vīryavān । bāṇaśca vīrabhadraśca svayaṃ nandī sunandakaḥ ।। 3 ।। mahākālo mahāmantrī hyathāṣṭauṃ bhairavāstathā । siddhendrāścāpi yogīndrā rudrāścaikādaśaiva te ।। 4 ।। etasminnantare tatra maṇibhadraḥ samāyayau । sihadvāre svayaṃ dvārī tabhīśvaramuvāca saḥ ।। 5 ।। maṇibhadra uvāca asaṃkhyāni ca sainyāni yādavānāṃ maheśvara । baladevaśca pradyumnaḥ sāmbaśca sātyakistathā ।। 6 ।। rājā mahograsenaśca bhīmaśca svayamarjunaḥ । akrūnaścodyavaścaiva jayantaḥ śakranandanaḥ ।। 7 ।। ratnenadrasāranirmāṇarathendre sumanohare । vidhervidhātā bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। 8 ।। saptabhiḥ pārṣadaigoṃpaiḥ sevitaḥ śvetayāmaraiḥ । kandarpakoṭilīlābho vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ।। 9 ।। dadhāra cakramatulaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham । gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ śūlamavyarthaṃ saṃnidhāya ca ।। 10 ।। rathamadhye mahāśaṅkhaṃ viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam । mahārathānāṃ lakṣaiśca rathānāṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ ।। 11 ।। trikoṭibhirgajendrāṇāṃ mallānāṃ ca trikoṭimiḥ । śatakoṭibhiraśvānāṃ carmiṇāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ ।। 12 ।। khaḍgināṃ tatsaptaguṇairdviguṇaistaddhanuṣmatām । ebhiḥ sārdha ca tvaritamāyayau śoṇitaṃ puram ।। 13 ।। parito veṣṭayāmāsa laṅkāṃ dāśarathiryathā । sahasratālamānāṃ ca jvaladagniśikhojjvalām ।। 14 ।। ūrdhve ca parikhāyuktāṃ durlaṅdhyāmasuraiḥ suraiḥ । svargagaṅgāmburāśīnāṃ samūhairvṛṣṭibhistathā ।। 15 ।। pakṣīndro garuḍaḥ sākṣānnirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ । maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ prākārābhraṃlihaṃ puram ।। 16 ।। babhañja lakṣaṃ mallānāṃ baladevaśca lāṅgalaiḥ । udyānānāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca cakārotpāṭanaṃ prabho ।। 17 ।। praviveśa mahādvāraṃ dvārapālānnipatya ca । evaṃ śrutvā mahādevaścovāca surasaṃsadi ।। 18 ।। pārvatī bhadrakālī ca skandaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tathā । aṣṭau ca bhairavāṃścaiva rudrāśca vīrabhadrakam mahākālaṃ nandinaṃ ca sarvānsenāpatīnnava ।। 19 ।। mahādeva uvāca golokanātho bhagavāṃścakrapāṇiḥ samāgataḥ । viśvaughaṃ bhaṅktumīśo yaḥ kṣaṇena nagaraṃ ca kim ।। 20 ।। sarvopāyaiśca sarve te bāṇaṃ rakṣantu yatnataḥ । bāṇo gacchatu saṃgrāmaṃ smṛtvā lambodaraṃ param ।। 21 ।। bāṇasya dakṣiṇo skandaḥ purataśca gaṇeśvaraḥ । vāme ca bhairavā rudrāḥ svayaṃ nandī sahārathaḥ ।। 22 ।। mahākālo vīrabhadro ye cānyo sainikāstathā । ūrdhve durgā bhadrakālī hyagraṇḍā ca koṭarī ।। 23 ।। bāṇaṃ rakṣa mahābhāge durge durgatināśini । kṛṣṇasya bhavatī śaktistena nārāyaṇī smṛtā ।। 24 ।। viṣṇumāye jaganmātaḥ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgale । avyarthāccakrasāracca rakṣa bāṇaṃ sudarśanāt ।। 25 ।। bāṇaḥ priyo me sarvemyo gaṇeśātkārtikādapi । bāṇamūrdhni karaṃ dhehi pādābjarajasā saha ।। 26 ।। śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā durgā durgatināśinī । prahasyovāca madhuraṃ yāthārthyaṃ samayocitam ।। 27 ।। pārvatyuvāca maṇiratnādikaṃ yadyanmuktāmāṇikyahīrakam । sarvasvaṃ kanyakāmūṣāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 28 ।। ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyamaniruddhaṃ paraṃ varam । puraskṛtya dehi bāṇa kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।। 29 ।। rājyaṃ kuruṣva nirvighnaṃ kiṃ yuddhamātmanā saha । yasmingate gatāḥ prāṇāḥ ka jīvaścaindriyaiḥ saha । śaktiścāhaṃ mano brahmā svayaṃ jñānātmakaṃ śivaḥ ।। 30 ।। sadyaḥ patati dehaśca śivaṃ tyaktvā śavo bhavet । ko vā tiṣṭhati saṃgrāme cakrasya tejasā śiva ।। 31 ।। nā''tmā''kāśo bāṇaviddho yuddhaṃ kiṃ svātmanā saha । paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 32 ।। nityaḥ satyo hi kṛṣṇaśca paribūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ । gaṇeśaḥ kārtikeyaśca bhavānapi tayoḥ paraḥ ।। 33 ।। kiṃkareṣu priyo bāṇo na hi kṛṣṇātparaḥ priyaḥ । vaikuṇṭhe'haṃ mahālakṣmīrgoloke rādhikā svayam ।। 34 ।। śivā'haṃ śivaloke'pi brahmaloke sarasvatī । ahaṃ nihatya daityāṃśca dakṣakanyā satī purā ।। 35 ।। tvannindayā tyaktadehā sā cāhaṃ śailakanyakā । raktabījasya yuddhe ca kānī ca mūrtibhedataḥ ।। 36 ।। sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ sītā janakakanyakā । rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ ca bhārate bhīṣmakanyakā ।। 37 ।। sudāmnaḥ śāpato daivādvṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā । dharmapatnī ca kṛṣṇasya puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। 38 ।। bhagavantaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ tvāṃ śivaṃ ca sanātam । kiṃ vā'haṃ kathayāmīti kartavyaṃ samayocitam ।। 39 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bāṇayuddhe'ṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 118 ।।
<4.119> athaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā gameśaśca śivaḥ svayam । kārtikeyaśca kālī ca tāṃ praśaṃsāṃ cakāra ha ।। 1 ।। uvāca bhagavāñśaṃbhurjagatāṃ mātaraṃ parām । jyotiḥ svarūpāṃ paramāṃ mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm ।। 2 ।। mahādeva uvāca tvayā yadhaktaṃ deveśi sarva vedoktamīpsitam । ayuktamupahāsyaṃ va samaraṃ paramātmanā ।। 3 ।। bāṇo dadātu kanyāṃ dāṃ svarṇabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām । sāmañjasyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca śubhadaṃ sarvakarmasu ।। 4 ।। na dadāti yadā bāṇo hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prajā । yuddhe parāṅmukho bhīto bhagavatyayaśaskaraḥ ।। 5 ।। bāṇo gacchatu saṃnāhī raṇaśāsraviśāradaḥ । paścāccā ''gamanaṃ kurmo vayaṃ sāṃnāhikāḥ śive ।। 6 ।। uvāca bāṇaṃ tāṃ dātuṃ sa ca na svīcakāra ha । durgā taṃ bodhayāmāsa na bubodha ca sadvacaḥ ।। 7 ।। etasminnantare tāṃ ca sabhāmeva mahoramām । ājagāma mahādharmo baliśca vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ।। 8 ।। rathaṃ latnendranirmāṇaṃ samāruhya mahābalaḥ । prataptaiḥ saptabhirdaityaiḥ sevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 9 ।। daityendrāṇāṃ saptalakṣairāvṛtaḥ paramāstravit । avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca śivāṃ śivām ।। 10 ।। praṇamya kārtikeyaṃ ca sa uvāsa ca saṃsadi । uttasthurārāttaṃ dṛṣṭvā te sarve śaṃkaraṃ vinā ।। 11 ।। tamuvāca mahādevaḥ saṃbhāṣya priyabhāṣaṇam ।। 11 ।। mahādeva uvāca bhagavaṃścaturastvaṃ ca pradātā sarvasaṃpadām । ayaṃ hi paramo lābho vaiṣṇavānāṃ samāgamaḥ ।। 12 ।। tīrthānyapi ca pūtāni vaiṣṇavasparśamātrataḥ । sarveṣāmāśramāṇāṃ ca pūjito brāhmaṇaḥ śuciḥ ।। 13 ।।tato'dhikaḥ pūjito'pi brāhmaṇo yadi vaiṣṇavaḥ । na hi pūtaṃ ca paśyami vaiṣṇavabrāhmaṇātparam ।। 14 ।। sa pūtaḥ pavanādeva sa pūtaśca hutāśānāt । tīrthemyo'pi ca sarvebhyo bibheti ca tataḥ suraḥ ।। 15 ।। na hi pāpāni taddehe vahnau śuṣkatṛṇādivat ।। 16 ।। baliruvāca kathaṃ stauṣi jagannātha bhṛtyamastavyamīśvaraḥ । pradattaṃ parameśvarya tvayā nātha sudulrabham ।। 17 ।। adhunā sthāpito daivātsarvādhaḥ sutale'pi ca । indrāya dattamaiśvarya matto bhaktātsureśvara ।। 18 ।। tvayā vāmanarūpeṇa sarvarūpo'si sarvataḥ । bāṇaṃ bodhaya bhadraṃ ca mama prāṇātmajaṃ param ।। 19 ।। ātmanā saha yuddhaṃ ca deveṣvapi vigarhitam । ityuktvā ca śivaṃ natvā śirasā praṇanāma tam ।। 20 ।। sāmavedoktastotreṇa tuṣṭāva parameśvaram । pulakāñcitasarvāṅgaḥ sāśrunetro'tivihvalaḥ ।। 21 ।। dhyāyamānaśca nityaṃ yo hṛtpadme sumanohare । śukreṇa dattaṃ mantraṃ ca japtvā caikādaśākṣaram ।। 22 ।। baliruvāca adityāḥ prārthanenaiva māturdevyā vratena ca । purā vāmanarūpeṇa tvayā'haṃ vañcitaḥ prabho ।। 23 ।। saṃpadrūpā mahālakṣmīrdattā bhaktāya bhaktitaḥ । śakrāya matto bhaktāya bhrātre puṇyavate dhruvam ।। 24 ।। adhunā mama putro'yaṃ bāṇaḥ śaṃkarakiṃkaraḥ । ārācca rakṣitaḥ so'pi tenaiva bhaktabandhunā ।। 25 ।। paripuṣṭaśca pārvatyā yathā mātrā sutastathā । gṛhītavāṃśca tatkanyāṃ balena yuvatīṃ satīm ।। 26 ।। samudyataśca taṃ hantuṃ kārtikenāpi vāritaḥ । āgato'si punarhantuṃ pautrasya damane kṣamaḥ ।। 27 ।। sarvātmanaśca sarvatra samabhāvaḥ śrutau śrutaḥ । karoṣi jagatāṃ nātha kathamevaṃ vyatikramaḥ ।। 28 ।। tvayā ca nihato yo hi tasya ko rakṣitā bhuvi । sudarśanasya tejo hi sūryakoṭinibhaṃ param ।। 29 ।। keṣāṃ surāṇāmastreṇa tadeva ca nivāritam । yathā sudarśanaṃ caivamastrāṇāṃ pravaraṃ varam ।। 30 ।। tathā bhavāṃśca devānāṃ sarveṣāmīśvaraḥ paraḥ । yathā bhavāṃstathā kṛṣṇo vidhātā vedhasāmapi ।। 31 ।। viṣṇuḥ sattvaguṇādhāraḥ śivaḥ sattvāśrayastathā । svayaṃ vidhātā rajasaḥ sṛṣṭikartā pitāmahaḥ ।। 32 ।। kālāgnirudro bhagavānviśvacasaṃhārakārakaḥ । tamasaścā''śrayaḥ so'pi rudrāṇāṃ pravaro mahān ।। 33 ।। sa eva śaṃkarāṃśaścāpyanye rudrāśca tatkalāḥ । bhavāṃśca nirguṇasteṣāṃ prakṛteśca parastathā ।। 34 ।। sarveṣāṃ paramātmā vai praṇā viṣṇusvarūpiṇaḥ । mānasaṃ ca svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ jñānātmakaḥ śivaḥ ।। 35 ।। pravarā sarvaśaktīnāṃ buddhiḥ prakṛtirīśvarī । svātmanaḥ pratibibhbaste jīvaḥ sarveṣu dehiṣu ।। 36 ।। jīvaḥ svakarmaṇāṃ bhogī svayaṃ sākṣī bhavāṃstathā । sarve yānti tvayi gate naradeve yathā'nugāḥ ।। 37 ।। sadyaḥ patati dehaśca śavo'spṛśyastvayā vinā । buddhāḥ santo na jānanti vañcitāstava māyayā ।। 38 ।। tvāṃ bhajantyeva ye santo māyāmetāṃ taranti te । triguṇā prakṛtirdurgā vaiṣṇavī ca sanātanī ।। 39 ।। parā nārāyaṇīśānī tava māyā duratyayā । tvadaṃśāḥ prativiśveṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ ।। 40 ।। sarveṣāmapi viśveṣāmāśrayo yo mahānvirāṭ । sa sete ca jale yogādviśveśo gokule yathā ।। 41 ।। sa eva vāsurbhagavāṃstasya devo bhavānparaḥ । vāsudeva iti khyātaḥ purāvidbhiḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 42 ।। tvameva kalayā sūryastvameva kalayā śaśī । kalayā ca hutāśaśca kalayā pavanaḥ svayam ।। 43 ।। kalayā varuṇaścaiva kuberaśca yamastathā । kalayā tvaṃ mahendraśca kalayā dharma eva ca ।। 44 ।। tvameva kalayā śeṣa īśāno naiṛṃtistathā । munayo manavaścaiva grahāśca phaladāyakaḥ ।। 45 ।। kalākalāyāścāṃśena sarve jīvāścarācarāḥ । tvaṃ brahma paramaṃ jyotirdhyāyante yoginaḥ sadā ।। 46 ।। taṃ tcā''driyante bhaktāste dhyāyante ya tadantare । navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam ।। 47 ।। īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhakteśaṃ bhaktavatsalam । candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ dvibhujaṃ muralīdharam ।। 48 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyabhūṣitam । amūlyaratnanirmāṇakeyūravalayāvintam ।। 49 ।। maṇikuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalavirājitam । ratnasārāṅgalīyaṃ ca kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitam ।। 50 ।। koṭikandarpalīlābhaṃ śaratkamalalocanam । śaratpūrṇaindunindāsyaṃ candrakoṭisamaprabham ।। 51 ।। vīkṣitaṃ sasmitābhiśca gopīnāṃ koṭikoṭibhiḥ । vayasyaiḥ pārṣadairgopaiḥ sevitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 52 ।। gopabālakaveṣaṃ ca rādhāvakṣaḥ sthalasthitam । dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ brahmeśaśeṣavanditam ।। 53 ।। sinddhendraiśca munīndraiśca yogīndraiḥ praṇataṃ stutam । vedānirvacanīyaṃ ca paraṃ svecchāmayaṃ vibhum ।। 54 ।। sthūlasthūlatamaṃ rūpaṃ sūkṣmātsūkṣmatamaṃ param । satyaṃ nityaṃ praśastaṃ ca prakṛteḥ paramīśvaram ।। 55 ।। nirliptaṃ ca nirīhaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam । evaṃ dhyātvā ca te pūtāḥ snigdhadūrvākṣatā jalam ।। 56 ।। padmāpadmārcite pādapadme ca dātumutsukāḥ । vedāḥstotumaśaktāstvāmaśaktā sā sarasvatī ।। 57 ।। śeṣaḥ stotumaśaktaśca svayaṃbhūḥ śaṃbhurīśvaraḥ । gaṇeśaśca dineśaśca mahendraścandra eva ca ।। 58 ।। stotuṃ nālaṃ dhaneśaśca kimanye jaḍbuddhayaḥ । guṇātītamanīhaṃ ca kiṃ staumi nirguṇaṃ param ।। 59 ।। apaṇḍito'yamasuro na suraḥ kṣantumarhasi । balestadvacanaṃ śrutvā tamuvāca jagatpatiḥ ।। paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānbhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 60 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca mā bhairvatsa gṛhaṃ gaccha sutalaṃ rakṣitaṃ mayā । madvareṇa prasādena tvatputro'pyajarāmaraḥ ।। 61 ।। darpahāniṃ kariṣyāmi tasya mūrkhasya darpiṇaḥ । prahlādāya varo datto bhaktāya ca tapasvine ।। 62 ।। mamāvadhyaśca tvadvaṃśaśceti prītena cetasā । tava putrāya dāsyāmi jñānaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaṃ param ।। 63 ।। tvayā kṛtimidaṃ stotraṃ sāmavedoktamīpsitam । purā sanatkumārārāya pradattaṃ brahmaṇā tathā ।। 64 ।। siddhāśrame puṇyatame praśaste sūryaparvaṇi । gautamāya pradattaṃ ca gauryā mandākinītaṭe ।। 65 ।। śaṃkareṇa ca śiṣyāya bhaktāya ca dayālunā । brahmaṇe ca mayā dattaṃ śivāya virajātaṭe ।। 66 ।। bhṛgave ca purā dattaṃ kumāreṇa ca dhīmatā । tvaṃ ca dāsyasi bāṇāya bāṇaḥ stoṣyatyanena mām ।। 67 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyamubadiśya gurormukhāt । vṛtasya pūjitasyāpi vastrabhūṣaṇacandanaiḥ ।। 68 ।। susnāto yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ pūjākāle ca bhaktitaḥ । koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 69 ।। vipadāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ stotraṃ kāraṇaṃ sarvasaṃpadām । vāraṇaṃ duḥkhaśokānāṃ bhavābdhidhoratāraṇam ।। 70 ।। khaṇḍanaṃ garbhavāsānāṃ jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param ।bandhanānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ bhaktamaṇḍanam ।। 71 ।। sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ । vratī vrateṣu sarveṣu tapasvī ca tapaḥsu ca ।। 72 ।। sa stayaṃ sarvadānānāṃ phalaṃ ca labhate dhruvam । lakṣadhā stotrapāṭhena stotrasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।। 73 ।। sarvasiddhiṃ ca labhate siddhistotro bhavedyadi । ihaloke devatulyo'pyante yāti hareḥ padam ।। 74 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bāṇayuddhe balikṛtaśrīkṛṣṇamtotraṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 119 ।।
<4.120> viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kṛṣṇaśca bhagavānuddhaveta balena ca । dūtaṃ praśthāpayāmāsa vidhāya mantraṇaṃ śubham ।। 1 ।। śivo gaṇapatiryatra durgāṃ durgatināśinī । kārtikeyo bhadrakālī cogracaṇḍā ca koṭarī ।। 2 ।। āgatya natvā dūtaśca gaṇeśaṃ ca śivaṃ śivām । mānavāṃścāpi pūcyāṃśca samuvāca yathocitam ।। 3 ।। dūta uvāca bāṇamāhvayate kṛṣṇaḥ saṃgrāmārtha maheśvara । kiṃ vā'niruddhamūṣāṃ ca gṛhītvā śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 4 ।। raṇe nimantrito yo hi na yāti bhayakātaraḥ । paratra narakaṃ yāti saptabhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha ।। 5 ।। dūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sabhāmadhye yathocitam । uvāca pārvatī devī svayaṃ śaṃkarasaṃnidhau ।। 6 ।। pārvatyuvāca gaccha bāṇa mahābhāga gṛhītvā tava kanyakām । sarvasvaṃ yautakaṃ dattvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 7 ।। sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ bījaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadam । varaṃ varepyaṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛpāluṃ bhaktavatsalam ।। 8 ।। pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā tamūcuste sureśvarāḥ । praśasaṃsuḥsabhāmadhye dhanyadhanyeti sarvadā ।। 9 ।। kopāviṣṭaśca bāṇo'yamuttasthau sahasā'suraḥ । sāṃnāhiko dhanuṣpāṇiḥ praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ yayau ।। 10 ।। sarvairniṣidhyamānaśca kampito raktalocanaḥ । sāṃnāhikaśca daityānāṃ trikoṭyā ca mahābalaḥ ।। 11 ।। kumbhāṇḍaḥ kūpakarṇaśca nikumbhaḥ kumbha eva ca । senāpatīśvaraścaite yayuḥ sāṃnāhikāstathā ।। 12 ।। unmattabhairavaścaiva saṃhārabhairavastathā । asitāṅgo bhairavaśca rurubhairava eva ca ।। 13 ।। mahābhairavasaṃjñaśca kālabhairava eva ca । pracaṇḍabhairavaścaiva krodhabhairava eva ca ।। 14 ।। prayayuḥ śaktibhiḥ sārdha sarve sāṃnāhikāśca te । kālāggirudro bhagavānrudraiḥ sāṃnāhiko yayau ।। 15 ।। ugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍikā caṇḍināyikā । caṇḍeśvarī ca cāmuṇḍā caṇḍī caṇḍakapālikā ।। 16 ।। aṣṭau ca nāyikāḥ sarvāḥ prayayuḥ kharparāvintāḥ । koṭarī ratnayānasthā śoṇitagrāmadevatā ।। 17 ।। prayayau sā praphullāsyā khaḍgakharparadhāriṇī । indrāṇī vaiṣṇavī śāntā brahmāṇī brahmavādinī ।। 18 ।। kaumārī nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī vikaṭākṛtiḥ । māheśvarī mahāmāyā bhairavī bhīmarūpiṇī ।। 19 ।। aṣṭau ca śaktayaḥ sarvā rathasthāḥ prayayurmudā । ratnendrasārayānasthā prayayau bhadrakālikā ।। 20 ।। raktavarṇā trinayanā jihvālalanabhīṣaṇā । śūlaśaktigadāhastā khaḍgakharparadhāriṇī ।। 21 ।। prayayau śūlahastaśca vṛṣabhastho maheśvaraḥ । skandaśca śikhiyānasthaḥ śastrapāṇirdhanurdharaḥ ।। 22 ।। evaṃ ca prayayuḥ sarve gaṇeśaṃ pārvatīṃ vinā । ebhiryuktaṃ mahādevaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bhadrakālikām ।। 23 ।। pracakre cakrapāṇiśca saṃbhāṣāṃ ca yathocitām । bāṇaḥ śaṅkadhvaniṃ kṛtvā praṇamya pārvatīśvaram ।। 24 ।। dhanurdathāra saguṇaṃ divyāstreṇa niyojitam । bāṇaṃ samudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā sātyakiḥ paravīrahā ।। 25 ।। niṣidhyamānastaiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃnāhī prayayau mudā । bāṇaścikṣepa divyāstramañjanaṃ nāma nārada ।। 26 ।। avyarthaṃ grīṣmamadhyāhanamārtaṇḍābhaṃ sutīkṣṇakam । dṛṣṭāvā'straṃ sātyakiḥ sākṣātkiṃcinnamro babhūva saḥ ।। 27 ।। kiṃ vā na dagdhaḥ prayayau nabhomadhyaṃ sudāruṇam । vahniṃ cikṣepa bāṇaśca sātyakirvāruṇena ca ।। 28 ।। prajvalantaṃ tālamānaṃ nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ । ciccheda vāruṇaṃ ghoraṃ prajaṇḍaṃ bhīmamulbaṇam ।। 29 ।। ciccheda sātyakiścaiva pārjanyenāvalīlayā । cikṣepa pavanaṃ bāṇaḥ pracaṇḍaṃ bhīmamulbaṇam ।। 30 ।। ciccheda sātyakiścaiva parvatāśtreṇa līlayā । nārāyaṇastraṃ cikṣepa bāṇaśca raṇamūrdhani ।। 31 ।। sātyakirdaṇḍavadbhūmau papātārjunaśikṣayā । māheśvaraṃ pracikṣepa bāṇaḥ śastravidāṃ varaḥ ।। 32 ।। sātyakirvaiṣṇavāstreṇa pravicchedāvalīlayā । brahmāstraṃ cāpi cikṣepa bāṇaśca raṇamūrdhani ।। 33 ।। kṣaṇaṃ cakāra nirvāṇaṃ brahmāstreṇa ca sātyakiḥ । nāgāstraṃ cāpi cikṣepa bāṇo raṇaviśāradaḥ ।। 34 ।। sātyakirgāruḍenaiva saṃjahāra kṣaṇena ca । jagrāha śūlamavyarthaṃ śaṃkarasya sudāruṇam ।। 35 ।। tuṣṭāva sātyakirdurgā gale mālyaṃ babhūva ha । jagrāha dhanuṣā bāṇo bāṇaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā ।। 36 ।। bāṇaṃ sabāṇaṃ jṛmbhaṃ ca sātyakiśca cakāra ha । bāṇaṃ taṃ jṛmbhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ ।। 37 ।। ardhacandraṃ ca cikṣepa kāmaściccheda līlayā । gadāṃ cakṣepa ca skandaḥ prātaḥ sūryasamaprabhām ।। 38 ।। vaiṣṇavāstreṇa kāmaśca nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ । nārāyaṇastraṃ skandaśca prākṣipacca tvarānvitaḥ ।। 39 ।। papāta daṇḍavadbhūmau pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇaśikṣayā । skandaḥ śaktiṃ ca cikṣepa pralayagnisamaprabhām ।। 40 ।। kāmo nārāyaṇāstreṇa nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra tām । brahmāstraṃ ca pracikṣepa kārtiko raṇamūrdhani ।। 41 ।। brahmāstreṇāpi kāmaśca nirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ । jagrāha kārtikaṃ kopāddivyaṃ pāśupataṃ tadā ।। 42 ।। nidrāstreṇāpi madano nidritaṃ ca cakāra tam । kārtikaṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇaṃ ca jṛmbhitaṃ tathā ।। 43 ।। kopātkāmaṃ ca sarathaṃ jagrāha bhadrakālikā । kroḍe kṛtvā ca bāṇaṃ ca skandaṃ ca jagatāṃ prasūḥ ।। 44 ।। raṇasthalācca prayayau yatraiva pārvatī satī । kārtikaṃ bodhayāmāsa bāṇaṃ susthaṃ cakāra sā ।। 45 ।। sahasāsarathaḥ kāmo nāsārandhreṇa vartmanā । bahirbabhūva saṃtrastaḥ prayayau ca raṇasthalam ।। 46 ।। dṛṣṭkā kāmaṃ ca sarathaṃ jahasuryādavāstadā । sarve śaivāśca tatrasthāḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhā bhayakulāḥ ।। 47 ।। atha bāṇaḥ punaḥ kruddho rathamāruhya kopataḥ । kārtikeyaśca bhagavānyuddhāya punarāgataḥ ।। 48 ।। bāṇaḥ pañca śarāṃścaiva cikṣepa raṇamūrdhani । ardhacandreṇa ciccheda baladevo mahābalaḥ ।। 49 ।। rathaṃ babhañja bāṇasya lāṅgalena ca lāṅgalī । jaghana sūtamaśvāṃśca musalenāvalīlayā ।। 50 ।। kurvantamudyamaṃ chettuṃ halinaṃ ca mahābalaḥ । kālāgnirudro bhagavānvārayāmāsa līlayā ।। 51 ।। rathaṃ kālāgnirudrasya babhañja lāṅgalī ruṣā । halena sūtamaśvāśca jadhāna raṇamūrdhani ।। 52 ।। kālāgnirudraḥ kopena cikṣepa javaramulvaṇam । babhūvuryādavāḥ sarve jvarākrāntā hariṃ vinā ।। 53 ।। taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ sasarja vaiṣṇavaṃ jvaram । taṃ cikṣepa jvaraṃ hantuṃ māheśaṃ raṇamūrdhani ।। 54 ।। babhūva jvarayoryuddhaṃ muhūrtamatidāruṇam । vaiṣṇavajvaraniṣkānto raṇamīrdhni papāta saḥ ।। paraṃ babhūva niśceṣṭastuṣṭāva mādhavaṃ punaḥ ।। 55 ।। jvara uvāca praṇānrakṣa jagannātha bhaktānugrahavigraha । tvamātmā puruṣaḥ purṇaḥ sarvatra samatā tava ।। 56 ।। jvarasya vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃjahāra svakaṃ jvaram । māheśvaro jvaro bhīto raṇādeva hi niryayau ।। 57 ।। bāṇaśca punarāgatya bāṇānāṃ ca sahasrakam । cikṣepa mantrapūtaṃ ca pralayāgniśikhopamam ।। 58 ।। phālgunaḥ śarajālena vārayāmāsa līlayā । cikṣepa śaktiṃ bāṇaśca grīṣmasūryasamaprabhām ।। 59 ।। ciccheda līlayā tāṃ ca savyasācī mahābalaḥ । sa jagrāha pāśupataṃ śatasūryasamaprabham ।। 60 ।। atyarthamatighoraṃ ca viśvasaṃhārakārakam ।taddṛṣṭā cakrapāṇiśca cakraṃ cikṣepa dāruṇam ।। 61 ।। hastānāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca sapāśupatamulbaṇam । ciccheda raṇamadhye ca papātācalasiṃhavat ।। 62 ।। śastraṃ pāśupataṃ caiva yayau paśupateḥ karam । avyartha dāruṇaṃ loke pralayāgniśikhopamam ।। 63 ।। bāṇaraktasamūhena babhūva ca mahānadaḥ । bāṇaḥ papāta niśceṣṭī vyathito hatacetanaḥ ।। 64 ।। tatrā''jagāma bhagavānmahadevo jagadguruḥ । rurodā''gatya mohena bāṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 65 ।। śivāśrupatanenaiva saṃbabhūva sarovaram । cetanaṃ kārayāmāsa karumāsāgaraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 66 ।। bāṇāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau yatra devo janārdanaḥ । cakre padmārcite pādapadme bāṇasamarpaṇam ।। 67 ।। tuṣṭāva jagatāṃ nāthaṃ bhakteśaṃ candraśekhalaḥ । balinā ca stataṃ yena vedoktena ca tena ca ।। 68 ।। harirmṛtyuṃjayaṃ jñānaṃ dadau bāṇāya dhīmate । karapadmaṃ dadau gātre taṃ cakārājarāmaram ।। 69 ।। bāṇaḥ stotreṇa tuṣṭāva bhaktyā balikṛtena ca । varāṃ kanyāṃ samānīya ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 70 ।। bradadau haraye bhaktyā tatraiva devasaṃsadi । gajendrāṇāṃ pañcalakṣmaśvānāṃ taccaturguṇam ।। 71 ।। dāsīnāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam । sahasraṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ vatsayuktaṃ ca sarvadam ।। 72 ।। māṇikyānāṃ ca muktānāṃ ratnānāṃ śatalakṣakam । maṇīndrāṇāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ manoharam ।। 73 ।। jalabhājanapātrāṇi suvarṇanirmitāni ca । mahasrāṇi dadau tasmai bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharaḥ ।। 74 ।। varāṇi sūkṣmavastrāṇi vahniśuddhāṃśukāni ca । dadau bāṇaśca marvāṇi svabhaktyā śaṃkarājñayā ।। 75 ।। tāmbūlānāṃ madhanāṃ ca pūrṇapātrāṇi nārada । sahasrāṇi dadau bhaktyā varāṇi vividhāni ca ।। 76 ।। kanyāṃ samarpayāmāsa pādapadme harerapi । rurodoccaiḥ svabhaktyā ca parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 77 ।। kṛṣṇastasmai varaṃ dattvā vedoktaṃ ca śubhāśiṣm । śaṃkarānumatenaiva prayayau dvārakāṃ purīm ।। 78 ।। gatvā kanyāṃ navoḍhāṃ tāṃ bāṇasyāpi mahātmanaḥ । rukmiṇyai pradadau śīghraṃ devakyai ca hariḥ svayam ।। 79 ।। mahotsavaṃ maṅgalaṃ ca kārayāmāsa yatnataḥ । brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ dadau ।। 80 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... bāṇayuddhaṃ nāma viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 120 ।।
<4.121> athaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca atha kṛṣṇaḥ sudharmāyāṃ nivasansagaṇastathā । tatrā''jagām vipraśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā ।। 1 ।। āgatya dṛṣṭāva tuṣṭāva bhaktyā ca puruṣottamam । uvāca madhuraṃ śānto bhīto vinayapūrvakam ।। 2 ।। brāhmaṇa uvāca śrṛgālo vāsudevaśca rājeśo maṇḍaleśvaraḥ । tvāmuvāca sa yadvākyaṃ sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya ।। 3 ।। śrṛgāla uvāca vaikuṇṭhe vāsudevo'haṃ deveśaśca caturbhujaḥ । lakṣmīpatiśca jagatāṃ dhātā dhātuśca pālakaḥ ।। 4 ।। brahmaṇā prārthito'haṃ ca bhārāvataraṇāya ca । bhuvo bhāratavarṣa ca tadartha gamanaṃ mama ।। 5 ।। vasudevasuto vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyaścāpyahaṃkṛtaḥ । ātmānaṃ bhaktaviṣṇuśca māyāvī ca pratārakaḥ ।। 6 ।। janaṃ janena nirjitya durbalaṃ balinā saha । jodhayitvā mahādhūrto ghātayāmāsa bhūpatīn ।। 7 ।। duryodhanaṃ jarāsaṃdhaṃ bhūpamanyaṃ ca durbalam । bhīmena ghātayāmāsa balinā'lpena bhūtale ।। 8 ।। droṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ ca karṇa ca yaṃ yamanyaṃ ca bhūtale । balīyasā'rjunenaiva ghātayāmāsa māyayā ।। 9 ।। yaṃ yamanyaṃ durbalaṃ ca prasiddhamaprasiddhakam । prasiddhena balavatā ghātayāmāsa māyayā ।। 10 ।। śiśupālaṃ dantavaktraṃ kaṃsaṃ ca cirarogiṇam । matputraṃ narakaṃ caiva durbalaṃ keśinaṃ muram ।। 11 ।। svayaṃ jaghāna saṃketācchalena sahasā bata । na dharmayuddhe kapaṭī sa ca bālo hyadhārmikaḥ ।। 12 ।। jaghāna pūtanāṃ kubjāṃ strīghātī vastrahetunā । jaghāna rajakaṃ śiṣṭamaśiṣṭaśca pratārakaḥ ।। 13 ।। hiraṇyakaśipuṃ daityaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam । madhuṃ ca kaiṭabhaṃ caiva hatvā'haṃ suṣṭirakṣakaḥ ।। 14 ।। ahameva svayaṃ brahmā hyahameva svayaṃ śivaḥ । ahaṃ viṣṇuśca jagatāṃ pātā duṣṭāpahārakaḥ ।। 15 ।। aṃśena kalayā sarve manavo munayastathā । svayaṃ nārāyaṇo'haṃ ca mirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ ।। 16 ।। lajjayā kṛpayā caiva mitrabuddhyā ṅamā kṛtā । yadgataṃ tadgataṃ bhadra yuddhaṃ kuru mayā saha ।। 17 ।। śrṛṇomi dūtadvāreṇa hyatīvoccairahaṃkṛtam । ucitaṃ damanaṃ tasyāpyunnatānāṃ nipātanam ।। 18 ।। rājñaśca paramo dharmo'pyahaṃ śāstā bhuvo'dhunā । śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ gṛhītvā'haṃ caturbhujaḥ ।। 19 ।। dvārakāṃ tā gamiṣyāmi yuddhāya sagaṇaḥ svayaṃ । yuddhaṃ kuru yadīcchā'sti mā māṃ ca śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 20 ।। yadi mā yāsyati mama śaraṇaṃ śaraṇāgataḥ । bhasmībhūtāṃ kariṣyāmi dvārakāṃ ca kṣaṇena ca ।। 21 ।। sabalaṃ ca saputraṃ tvāṃ sagaṇaṃ ca sabāndhavam । kṣaṇena dagdhuṃ śakto'hamasahāyena līlayā ।। 22 ।। tapasvinaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ ca jitvā yuddhe ca śaṃkaram । śakraṃ bhagāṅgaṃ jitvā ca rogiṇaṃ brahmaśāpataḥ ।। 23 ।। matto'si vīramātmānaṃ manyamānastvameva ca । strījito hi vṛthārtha ca pārijātasya hetunā ।। 24 ।। lamapaṭo yonilubdhaśca rādhādīnaśca gokule । adhunā kiṃkarasamaḥ satyādīnāṃ ca yoṣitām ।। 25 ।। ityevamuktvā vipraśca tūṣṇīṃbhūya sthito mune । śīkuṣṇaḥ sagaṇaḥ śrutvā bhṛśasucchairjahāsa saḥ ।। 26 ।। bhojayitvā ca saṃpūjya brāhmaṇaṃ ca caturvidham । nināya rajanīṃ duḥkhādvākśalyamāna jvarāt ।। 27 ।। prabhāte rathamāruhya sagaṇaḥ satvaraṃ mudā । līlāmātreṇa prayayau śrṛgālo nṛpatiryataḥ ।। 28 ।। śrutvā śrṛgālo vārtāṃ tāṃ kṛtrimaśca caturbhujaḥ । ājagāma hareḥ sthānaṃ yuddhāya sagaṇaḥ svayam ।। 29 ।। kṛṣṇaścakre ca saṃbhāṣāṃ mitrabuddhyā ca laukikīm । āśleṣaṃ madhurālāpaṃ snigdhanetraśca sasmitaḥ ।। 30 ।। rājā nimantraṇaṃ cakre kṛṣṇo na svīcakāra tat । uvāca kṛṣṇabhītaścatyaktvā dambhaṃ ca darśanāt ।। 31 ।। śrṛgāla uvāca cakreṇa macchiraśchittvā suśīghraṃ dvārakāṃ vraja । pāpaḥ patatu deho'yamanityo naśvarastathā ।। 32 ।। ahaṃ subhadraste dvāri jayaśca vijayo yathā । sarva jānāsi sarvajña mā vilambaṃ kuru prabho ।। 33 ।। lakṣmīśāpena bhraṣṭo'haṃ kālaḥ pūrṇo babhūva me । śatavarṣeṇa śāpānte yāsyami bhavanaṃ tava ।। 34 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca pūrva māṃ mitra prahara paścādyuddhaṃ karobhyaham । sarva jānāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ gaccha vatsa yathāsukham ।। 35 ।। śrṛgālo daśabāṇāṃśca cikṣepa mādhavaṃ prati । te praṇabhya yayuḥ śīghramākāśaṃ kālarūpimaḥ ।। 36 ।। gadāṃ cikṣepa rājā sa pralayāgniśikhopamām । kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa babhañja ca kṣaṇena ca ।। 37 ।। śūlaṃ cikṣepa musalaṃ ca paraśuṃ tathā । kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa babhañja ca kṣaṇena ca ।। 38 ।। dhanuścikṣepa khaṅgaṃ ca kālarūpaṃ sudārupām । kṛṣṇāṅgasparśamātreṇa babhañja ca kṣaṇena ca ।। 39 ।। dṛpṭvā nirastraṃ rājanamityuvāca kṛpānidhiḥ । gṛhaṃ gatvā sutīkṣṇaṃ ca mitrāstramānayeti ca ।। 40 ।। śrṛgāla uvāca nā''tmā''kāśo'straviddhaśca kiṃ yuddhamātmanā saha । māmuddhara bhavābdheśca dharoddhāraṇakāraṇa ।। 41 ।। bhavārbdhi viṣamaṃ nātha viṣayaṃ ca viṣādhikam । chindhi me nigaḍaṃ māyāṃ mohajālaṃ svakarmaṇaḥ ।। 42 ।। karmaṇāmīśvarastvaṃ ca vidhātā ghātureva ca । dātā śubhaphalānāṃ ca pradātā sarvasaṃpadām ।। 43 ।। kāraṇaṃ prāktanānāṃ ca teṣāṃ ca khaṇḍane kṣamaḥ । yāmi gehaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tavaiva dvārasaptamam ।। 44 ।। tyaktvā ca naśavaraṃ dehaṃ prākṛtaṃ pāñcabhautikam । mitrasya stavanaṃ śrutvā vacanaṃ ca sudhopamam ।। 45 ।। ruroda samare tatra kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ । babhūva tatra sahasā kṛṣṇanetrāśrubindunā ।। 46 ।। divyaṃ bindusaro nām tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ param । tattoyasparśamātreṇa jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ ।। saptajanmarjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 47 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca kathametādṛśī buddhirmitra te nirmalaṃ manaḥ । dūtadvārā kathaṃ cauktaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ ।। 48 ।। śṛgāla uvāca evamukto mayā tvaṃ ca tena krodhādihā''gataḥ । anyathā durlabhaṃ nātha svapne'pi tava darśanam ।। 49 ।। etasminnantare yogāddehaṃ tyaktvā ca prākṛtam । dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ ca yānena vaikuṣṭhaṃ prayayau mudā ।। 50 ।। saptatālapramāṇaṃ ca jyotistatra maholbaṇam । padmaiḥ padmārcitaṃ pādapadmaṃ natvā jagāma ha ।। 51 ।। gatvā ca dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇo natvā ca pitaraṃ prasūm । śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sagaṇaḥ śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā ca paramādbhutam ।। 52 ।। praphullavadanaḥ śrīmāndvārakābhimukhaṃ yayau । jagāma rukmaṇīgehaṃ puṣpajandanavāsitam ।। 53 ।। puṣpacandanatalpe ca naktaṃ reme tayā saha । mūrcchaṃ saṃprāpa sa bhaiṣmī kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 54 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... śṛgālavāsudevamokṣaṇaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 121 ।।
<4.122> atha dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca sarvāsāṃ ramaṇīnāṃ ca kṛṣṇena paramātmanā । samudvāhaśca kathitastvayā bhagavatā mudā ।। 1 ।। syamantakasya ca maṇerupākhyānamabhīpsitam । tanna śrutaṃ mahābhāga tanmāṃ vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca bhādraśuklacaturthyāṃ ca tārakāṃ hṛtvāñchaśī । tāṃ tatyāja sa kṛṣṇāyāṃ gurustāṃ ca gṛhītavān ।। 3 ।। guruṇā bhartsitā tārā magarbhā lajjitā satī । śaśāpa lajjayā kopāccandraṃ kāmāturaṃ purā ।। 4 ।। tārovāca bhava śāpakalaṃkī tvaṃ yastvāṃ paśyati dehabhṛt । pāpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa pāpī ca kalaṃkī ca bhaviṣyati ।। 5 ।। iti śrutvā sa candraśca nārāyaṇasarovare । nārāyaṇatapastaptvā mumoca kṛtapātakāt ।। 6 ।। tapaḥkliṣṭaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ । tamuvāca mahābhītaṃ kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 7 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca mukto bhava kalaṃkī tvaṃ sarvakālaṃ kalānidhe । śāpasthānaṃ tārakāyā bhādre māsi sitāsite ।। 8 ।। caturthyāmuditaṃ candraṃ yastu paśyati kāmataḥ । taṃ yāti tatkalaṅkaśca sa kalaṃkī bhaviṣyati ।। 9 ।। hariṇā dīyate tāle bhādre māsi sitāsite । caturthyāmuditaścandro nekṣitavyaḥ kadācana ।। 10 ।। svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā svavākyaṃ ca pālanaṃ kartumarhati । bhādre candraṃ caturthyāṃ tu sa kalaṃkī babhūva ha ।। 11 ।। kalaṃkī yena rūpeṇa tadvakṣyāmi niśāmaya । sa mumoca kalaṃkācca lokaśikṣārthamīśvaraḥ ।। 12 ।। satrājitaḥ sūryabhaktastapastabtvā ca puṣkare । syamantakaṃ maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ saṃprāpa bhāskarādapi ।। 13 ।। aṣṭau bhārānsuvarṇānāṃ prasūte nityameva ca । viṣgormaṇāvadhiṣṭhānaṃ mahāpūte ca puṇyade ।। 14 ।। satrājitaḥ satyabhāmāṃ dattvā kṛṣṇāya bhaktitaḥ । yautukārthe maṇiṃ dātumudyato mahate mahān ।। 15 ।। taṃ niṣidhya prasenaśca durmatiḥ kālapīḍitaḥ । maṇiṃ gṛhītvā prayayau puṇyāṃ vārāṇasīṃ purīm ।। 16 ।। nihatya taṃ pathi balātsiṃhaḥ sabala eva ca । maṇiṃ jagrāha ruciraṃ sūtrabaddhaṃ gale dadhau ।। 17 ।। kaliṅgarājaputraśca brahmaśāpātsudāruṇāt । vipreṇāmyuditastena paśuyoniṃ jagām saḥ ।। 18 ।। nihatya siṃhaṃ gahane bhallūko jāmbavānbalī । maṇiṃ gṛhītvā prayayau svapuraṃ ratnanirmitam ।। 19 ।। ūcuḥ sarve dvārakāyāṃ maṇiṃ jagāha mādhavaḥ । tasya buddhiṃ na jānīmaḥ kenopāyena veti ca ।। 20 ।। iti śrutvā tu bhagavānkalaṃkakṛntanāya ca । prayayau kānanaṃ ghoraṃ cauracihnena vartmanā ।। 21 ।। mṛtaṃ prasenaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca duḥkhī sihaṃ dadarśa saḥ । maṇiśūnyaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣasāda ca mādhavaḥ ।। 22 ।। sarvaṃjñātvā ca sarvajño bhallūkabhavanaṃ yayau । rudantaṃ bālakaṃ tatra dhātrīkroḍe dadarśa saḥ ।। 23 ।। bālakaṃ bodhayāmāsa sā dhātrī karuṇānvitā । maṇiṃ gṛhāṇa bāleti tava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ ।। 24 ।। siṃhaḥ prasenamavadhītsiṃho jāmbavatā hataḥ । sukumāraka mā rodīstava hyeṣa syamantakaḥ ।। 25 ।। iti dhātryuktasuślokaṃ yaśca smṛtvā jalaṃ pibet । daivadṛṣṭanaṣṭacandradroṣādeva pramṛcyate ।। 26 ।। kāmato yadi paśyanti dāmbhikā vedanindakāḥ । kalaṅkino bhavantyevamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ।। 27 ।। kṛṣṇo dhātrīvacaḥ śrutvā maṇiṃ jagrāha bālakāt । dhātrī gatvā ca bhallūkaṃ kathayāmāsa kopataḥ ।। 28 ।। jāmbavāṃśca samāgatya tuṣṭāva praṇipatya saḥ । kanyāṃ jāmbavatīṃ tasmai yautukārthaṃ maṇiṃ dadau ।। 29 ।। dvārakāṃ maṇimānīya darśayāmāsa yādavān । prabhuśca sarvataḥ śuddho niṣkalaṅko babhūva saḥ ।। 30 ।। etatte kathitaṃ vatsa maṇerākhyānamuttamam । adhyāyaśravaṇādeva niṣkalaṃko bhavennaraḥ ।। 31 ।। yacchru taṃ dharmavaktreṇa taduktaṃ ca yathāgamam । sudurlabhamupākhyānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 32 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradānā... syamantakamaṇiḥ haraṇaṃ nāma dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 122 ।।
<4.123> atha trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca gaṇeśapūjanākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu ca durlabham । śrutaṃ tadbrahmaṇo vaktrātsāmānyaṃ ca samāsataḥ ।। 1 ।। mahimānaṃ gaṇapateḥ sarvabūjyeśvarasya ca । vyāsena śrotumicchāmi yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguroḥ ।। 2 ।। siddhāśrame mahāpūja trailokyasthaiḥ kṛtā purā । rādhāmādhavayostatra punaḥ saṃmīlaraṃ purā ।। 3 ।। atīte varṣaśatake śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇe । ādau cakāra pūjāṃ ca sā ca rādhā kathaṃ mune ।। 4 ।। sthiteṣu ca surendreṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivādiṣu । nāgendre ca sthite śeṣe nāgeṣu ca mahatsu ca ।। 5 ।। rājendreṣu ca bhūmau ca baliṣṭheṣvasureṣu ca । gandharveṣu ca rakṣaḥsu cānyeṣu balavatsu ca ।। 6 ।। vistareṇa mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 7 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca trelokye pṛthivī dhanyā mānyā puṇyavatī satī । tatra bhāratavarṣaṃ ca karmaṇāṃ phaladaṃ śubham ।। 8 ।। dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ pūjyaṃ ca puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate । siddhāśramaṃ mahāpuṇyakṣetraṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ।। 9 ।। sanatkumāro bhagavāṃstatra siddho babhūva ha । svayaṃ vidhātā tatraiva taptvā siddho babhūva ha ।। 10 ।। yogīndrāśca munīndrāśca siddhendrāḥ kapilādayaḥ । śatakrantūnmahendraśca tatra kṛtvā babhūva ha ।। 11 ।। tena siddhāśramaṃ nāma sarveṣāmapi durlabham । adhiṣṭhānaṃ gaṇeśasya tatreva satataṃ mune ।। 12 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇagaṇeśapratimāṃ śubhām । vaiśākhyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca pūjāṃ kurvanti devatāḥ ।। 13 ।। nāgāśca mānavāścaiva daityā gandharvarākṣasāḥ । siddhendrāśca munīndrāśca yogīndrāḥ sanakādayāḥ ।। 14 ।। tatrā''jagāma śaṃbhuśca pārvatvā saha śaṃkaraḥ । sagaṇaḥ kārtikeyaśca svayaṃ brahmā prajāpatiḥ ।। 15 ।। tatrā''jagāma śeṣaśca nāgendraiḥ saha satvaram । tajñā''jagmuḥ surāḥ sarve manavo mṛnayastathā ।। 16 ।। ājagmuste nṛpāḥ sarve pūjārthaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ । āyayau bhagavānkṛṣṇo dvārakāvāsibhiḥ saha ।। 17 ।। ājagāma tathā nandaḥ sārdhaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ । gopītriśatakoṭībhirgolokavāsibhiḥ saha ।। 18 ।। gacendrakoṭitulyābhirbaliṣṭhābhiḥ sahā''libhiḥ । āyayau sundarī rādhā kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevatā ।। 19 ।। rāseśvarī surasikā śatavarṣe gate sati । susnātā mudatī śuddhā dhṛtvā dhaute ca vāsasī ।। 20 ।। saṃyatā sā nirāhārā gatvā ca maṇimaṇḍapam । suprakṣālitapādābjā kāntā bhuvanapāvanī ।। 21 ।। śrīkṛṣṇaprītikāmā'tha susaṃkalpaṃ vidhāya ca । gaṅgodakena herambaṃ snāpayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।। 22 ।। dhyārna ca sāmavedoktaṃ cakāra śuklapuṣpataḥ । mātā caturṇāṃ vedānāṃ vasośca jagatāmapi ।। 23 ।। buddhirūpā bhagavatī jñānināṃ jananī parā । dhyānātmakaṃ svapusraṃ taṃ paraṃ dhyānaṃ cakāra sā ।। 24 ।। śarvaṃ lambodaraṃ sthūlaṃ jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā । gajavaktraṃ vahnivarṇamekadantamanantakam ।। 25 ।। siddhānāṃ yogināmeva jñānināṃ ca gurorgurum । dhyātaṃ munīndrairdevendrairbrahmeśaśeṣasaṃjñakaiḥ ।। 26 ।। siddhendrairmunibhiḥ sadbhirbhagavantaṃ sanātanam । brahmasvarūpaṃ paramaṃ maṅgalaṃ maṅgalālayam ।। 27 ।। sarvavighnaharaṃ śāntaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām । bhavābdhimāyāpotena karṇadhāraṃ ca karmiṇām ।। 28 ।। śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇam । dhyāyeddhyānātmakaṃ sādhyaṃ bhakteśaṃ bhaktavatsalam ।। 29 ।। iti dhyātvā svaśirasi dattvā puṣpaṃ punaḥ satī । sarvāṅgaśodhanaṃ nyāsaṃ vedoktaṃ ca cakāra sā ।। 30 ।। punaśca dhyātvā dhyānena tenaiva śubhadāyinā । dadau puṣpaṃ pādapadme rādhā lambodarasya ca ।। 31 ।। saptatīrthodakenaiva śītena vāsitena ca । dadau pādyaṃ pādapadme taiḥ padmādibhirarcite ।। 32 ।। dūrvākṣataiḥ śuklapuṣpaiḥ sugandhicandanodakaiḥ । arghyaṃ dadau tacchirasi svayaṃ golokavāsinī ।। 33 ।। sacandanaṃ sgdhimālyaṃ pārijātasya sundaram । dadau gale gaṇeśasya svayaṃ rāsaṃśvarī mudā ।। 34 ।। kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca sugandhi snigdhacandanam । sarvāṅge pradadau tasya vṛndāvanavinodinī ।। 35 ।। sugandhi śuklaṃ puṣpaṃ ca sugandha candanārcitam । dadau tasya padāmbhoje mahāpadmalayā satī ।। 36 ।। sugandhiyuktaṃ dhūpaṃ ca pūtairvastubhiranvitam । dadau kṛṣṇapriyā tasmai jagatāmīśvarāya ca ।। 37 ।। dīpaṃ ghṛtapradīptaṃ ca dhvāntavidhvaṃsakāraṇam । dadau tasmai sureśāya paramādyā sanātanī ।। 38 ।। naivedya vividhaṃ ramyaṃ susvādu sumanoharam । coṣyaṃ carvyaṃ lehyapeye sudhātulyaṃ caturvidham ।। 39 ।। phalāni ca supakvāni trailokye durlabhāni ca । madhurāṇi ca mūlāni grāmyāraṇyāni nārada ।। 40 ।। tāni tvanyānyasaṃkhyāni tilānāṃ laḍḍukāni ca । laḍḍukāni supakvāni svādūni surasāni ca ।। 41 ।। yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ pakvāni piṣṭakāni ca । ghṛtāktāni ca ramyāṇi śarkarāsahitāni ca ।। 42 ।। svāstikānāṃ laḍḍukāni sthūlāni sundarāṇi ca । bhṛṣṭadravyaṃ ca vividhamakṣataṃ śarkarānvitam ।। 43 ।। ghṛtakulyāṃ dugdhakulayāṃ madhukulyaṃ manoharām । guḍasya dadhnaḥ kulyāṃ ca pāyasānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 44 ।। piṣṭakānāṃ svastikānāṃ rambhāṇāṃ rāśireva ca । miṣṭavyañjanayuktāni śālyannāni śubhāni ca ।। 45 ।। dadau tasmai sureśāya kṛṣṇaprāṇādhidevatā । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ ramyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ varam ।। 46 ।। dadau vighnapināśāya virājataṭavāsinī । sūkṣmavastrayugaṃ ramyamamūlyaṃ vahniśuddhakam ।। 47 ।। dadau śailātmajāyaiva śataśṛṅganivāsinī । viśuddhasarpiṣā yuktaṃ nirmalaṃ madhuraṃ madhu ।। 48 ।। madhuparkaṃ dadau tasmai vṛndāvananivāsinī । tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 49 ।। sarvasaṃpatpradātre ca vṛṣabhānasutā dadau । saptatīrthodakaṃ śuddhaṃ susitaṃ suvāsitam ।। 50 ।। pānārtha ca jalaṃ tasmai dadau gaupośvarī mudā । amūlyaṃ durlabhaṃ caiva viśuddhaṃ śvetacāmaram ।। 51 ।। dadau tasmai pareśāya mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ muktāmāṇikyahīrakaiḥ ।। 52 ।। pariṣkṛtaṃ sutalpaṃ ca puṣpacandanacarcitam । sitasūkṣmāśukenaiva paritaśca pariṣkṛtam ।। 53 ।। dadau śivātmajāyaiva kṛṣṇavakṣaḥsthalasthitā । dattvā ca kāmadhenuṃ ca savatsāṃ vāñchitapradām ।। 54 ।। kṛtvā'tīva parīhāraṃ vṛndā puṣpāñjaliṃ dadau । divyena mūlmanunā sabījenojjvalena ca ।। 55 ।। dadau ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ kālindīkulavāsinī । oṃ gaṃ gauṃ gaṇapataye vighnavināśine svāhā ।। 56 ।। ityevameva mantraṃ ca gāṇeśaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram । sā jajāpa sahasraṃ ca paraṃ salpataruṃ varam ।। 57 ।। tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharā । sāśrunetrā pulakitā stotreṇa kauthumena ca ।। 58 ।। rādhikovāca paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahma pareśaṃ parameśvaram । vighnanighnakaraṃ śāntaṃ puṣṭaṃ kāntamanantakam ।। 59 ।। surāsurendraiḥ siddhendraiḥ stutaṃ staumi parātparam । surapadmadineśaṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ maṅgalāyanam ।। 60 ।। idaṃ stotraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vighnaśokaharaṃ param । yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya sarvavighnātpramucyate ।। 61 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyoyaḥ ।। 123 ।।
<4.124> atha caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyoyaḥ nālāyaṇa uvāca rādhā saṃpūjya vidhinā stutvā lambodaraṃ satī । amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ sarvāṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ dadau ।। 1 ।। rādhāyāḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā pūjāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca vastu ca । uvāca madhuraṃ śāntaḥ śāntāṃ trailokyamātaram ।। 2 ।। gaṇeśa uvāca tava pūjā jaganmātarlokaśikṣākarī śubhe । brahmasvarūpā bhavatī kṛṣṇavakṣaḥ sthalasthitā ।। 3 ।। yatpādapadmatulaṃ dhyāyante te sudurlabham । surā brahmeśaśeṣādyā munīndrāḥ sanakādayaḥ ।। 4 ।। jīvanmuktāśca bhaktāśca siddhendrāḥ kapilādayaḥ । tasya prāṇādhidevī tvaṃ priyā prāṇādhikā parā ।। 5 ।। vāmāṅganirmitā rādhā dakṣiṇāṅgaśca mādhavaḥ । mahālakṣmīrjaganmātā tava vāmāṅganirmitā ।। 6 ।। vasoḥ sarvanivāsasya prasūstvaṃ parameśvarī । vedānāṃ jagatāmeva mūlprakṛtirīśvarī ।। 7 ।। sarvāḥ prākṛtikā mātaḥ sṛṣṭyāṃ ca tvadvibhūtayaḥ । viśvāni kāryarūpāṇi tvaṃ ca kāraṇarūpiṇī ।। 8 ।। pralaye brahmaṇaḥ pāte tannimeṣo harerapi । ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ parātparam ।। 9 ।। sa eva paṇḍito yogī golokaṃ yāti līlayā । ādau rādhāṃ samuccārya paścātkṛṣṇaṃ parātparam ।। 10 ।। jagatāṃ bhavatī mātā paramātmā pitā hariḥ । pitureva gururmātā pūjyā vandyā parātparā ।। 11 ।। bhajate devamanyaṃ vā kṛṣṇaṃ vā sarvakāraṇam । puṇyakṣetre mahāmūḍho yadi nindati rādhikām ।। 12 ।। vaṃśahānirbhavettasya duḥkhaśokamihaiva ca । pacyate niraye ghore yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 13 ।। guruścajñānodgiraṇājjñānaṃ syānmantratantrayoḥ । sa ca mantraśca tattantraṃ bhaktiḥ syāddhruvayoryataḥ ।। 14 ।। niṣevya mantraṃ devānāṃ jīvā janmani janmani । bhaktā bhavanti durgāyāḥ pādapadme sudurlabhe ।। 15 ।। niṣevya mantre śaṃbhośca jagatāṃ kāraṇasya ca । tadā prāpnoti yuvayoḥ pādapadmaṃ sudurlabham ।। 16 ।। yukyoḥ pādapadmaṃ ca durlabhaṃ prāpya puṇyavān । kṣaṇārdhaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ ca nahi muñcati daivataḥ ।। 17 ।। bhaktyā ca yuvacormantraṃ gṛhītvā vaiṣmapādapi । stavaṃ vā kavacaṃ vā'pi karmamūlanikṛntanam ।। 18 ।। yojayetparayā bhaktyā puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate । puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca tvātmanā sārdhamuddharet ।। 19 ।। gurumabhyarcya vidhivadvastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ । kavacaṃ dhārayedyo hi viṣṇutulyo bhaveddhruvam ।। 20 ।। yaddattaṃ vastu me mātastatsarvaṃ sārthakaṃ kuru । dehi viprāya matprītyā tadā bhokṣyāmi sāṃpratam ।। 21 ।। deve deyāni dānāni deve deyā ca dakṣiṇā । tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyāttadānantyāya kalpate ।। 22 ।। brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhaṃ rādhe devānāṃ mukhamukhyakam । viprabhuktaṃ ca yaddravyaṃ prāpnuvantyeva devatāḥ ।। 23 ।। viprāṃśca bhojayāmāsa tatsarva rādhikā satī । babhūva tatkṣaṇādeva prīto lambodaro mune ।। 24 ।। etasminnantare devā brahmeśaśeṣasaṃjñakāḥ । āyayurvaṭamūlaṃ ca devapūjārthameva ca ।। 25 ।। tatra gatvā śivacaro devāndevīruvāca saḥ । śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhaśca bhayabhītaśca rakṣakaḥ ।। 26 ।। rakṣaka uvāca gaṇeśaṃ pūjayāmāsa sarvādau ca śubhakṣaṇe । vṛṣabhānasutā rādhā prakṛtya svastivācanam ।। 27 ।। sahitā sā balavatī gopītriśatakoṭibhiḥ । vārito'haṃ valiṣṭhābhiryuṣmāṃśca kathayāmi tat ।। 28 ।। marvādau pūjayedyo hi so'nantaṃ phalamālabhet । madhye madhyavidhaṃ puṇyaṃ śeṣe svalpamiti smṛtam ।। 29 ।। devendreṣu munīndreṣu devastrīṣu sthitāsu ca । gopībhiśca saha tayā rādhayā pūjitaḥ paraḥ ।। 30 ।। dūtavākyaṃ samākarṇya jahasuḥ sarvadevatāḥ । munayo manavaścaiva rājāno devayoṣitaḥ ।। 31 ।। rukmiṇyādyā ramaṇyaśca yā devyo vismayaṃ yayuḥ । sarasvatī ca sāvitrī pārvatī parameśvarī ।। 32 ।। rohiṇī ca satī saṃjñā svāhādyā devayoṣitaḥ । muditāḥ prayayuḥ sarvā munipatnyaḥ pativratāḥ ।। 33 ।। munayo manavaḥ sarve devāścāpi narāstathā । śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sa gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ ye cānye prayayurmudā ।। 34 ।। te sarve vividhairdravyaiḥ pūjāṃ cakruḥ śubhakṣaṇe । baliṣṭhā durbalāścaiva krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 35 ।। laḍḍukānāṃ ca rāśīnāṃ śatakoṭirbabhūva ha । śarkarāṇāṃ tadardhaṃ ca svastikānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 36 ।। annānāṃ bhavyavastūnāṃ śatakoṭirbabhūva ha । asaṃkhyāni phalānyeva svādūni madhurāṇi ca ।। 37 ।। madhukulyā dugdhakulyā dadhikulyā ghṛtasya ca । babhūvuḥ śatasaṃkhyāśca trailokyānāṃ ca pūjane ।। 38 ।। pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu te sarve samūṣuśca sukhāsane । pārvatī paramaprītyā rādhāsthānaṃ samāyayau ।। 39 ।। sā rādhā pārvatīṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya javena ca । yathāyogyāṃ ca saṃbhāṣāṃ cakāra sādaraṃ mudā ।। 40 ।। āśleṣaṇaṃ cumbanaṃ ca babhūva ca parasparam । uvāca madhuraṃ durgā rādhāṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi ।। 41 ।। pārvatyuvāca kiṃvā praśnaṃ kariṣyāmi tvāṃ rādhā maṅgalālayām । gatā te virahajvālā śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇe ।। 42 ।। satataṃ manmanaḥ prāṇāstvayyeva mayi te tathā । na hyevamāvayorbhedaḥ śaktipūruṣayostathā ।। 43 ।। yetvāṃ nindanti madbhaktāstvadbhaktāścāpi māmapi । kumbhīpāke ca pajyante yāvaccandra divākarau ।। 44 ।। rādhāmādhavayorbhedaṃ ye kurvanti narādhamāḥ । vaṃśahānirbhavetteṣāṃ pacyante narake ciram ।। 45 ।। yānti sūkarayoniṃ ca pitṛbhiḥ śatakaiḥ saha । ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmayastathā ।। 46 ।। tvayaiva pūjitaḥ putro na mayā ca gaṇeśvaraḥ । sarvādau sarvapūjyo'yaṃ yathā tava tathā mama ।। 47 ।। yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ na vicchedo bhaviṣyati । rādhāmādhavayordevi dugdhadhāvalyayoryathā ।। 48 ।। siddhāśrame mahātīrthe puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate । nirvaghnaṃ labhagovindaṃ saṃpūjya vighnakhaṇḍanam ।। 49 ।। rāseśvarī tvaṃ rasikā śrīkṛṣṇo rasikeśvaraḥ । vidagdhāyā vidagdhena saṃgamo guṇavānbhadet ।। 50 ।। śrīdāmnaḥ śāpanirmuktā śatavarṣāntare sati । kuruṣva madreṇādya kṛṣṇena saha saṃgamam ।। 51 ।। mamā''jñayā durlabhayā suveṣaṃ kuru sundari । sudurlabhaḥ kāminīnāṃ satpuṃsā saha saṃgamaḥ ।। 52 ।। cakruḥ suveṣaṃ rādhāyāḥ priyālyaśca śivājñayā । ratnasiṃhāsane ramye vāsayāmāsurīśvarīm ।। 53 ।। purato ratnamālā sā ratnamālāṃ gale dadau । rādhāyā dakṣiṇe haste krīḍāpadmaṃ manoharam ।। 54 ।। dadau padmamukhī pādapadmayugme'pyalaktakam । pradadau sundarī gopī sindūraṃ sundaraṃ varam ।। 55 ।। candanena samayutaṃ sīmantādhaḥ sthalojjvalam । sucārukabarīṃ ramyāṃ cakāra mālatī satī ।। 56 ।। manoharāṃ munīnāṃ ca mālatīmālyabhūṣitām । kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca cārucandanapatrakam ।। 57 ।। stanayugme sukaṭhine cakāra candanā satī । cārucampakapuppāṇāṃ mālāṃ gandhamanoharām ।। 58 ।। mālāvatī dadau tasyau praphullāṃ navamallikām । ratīṣu rasikā gopī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām ।। 59 ।। tāṃ cakārātirasikāṃ varāṃ ratirasotsukām । śaratpadmadalābhaṃ ca lojanaṃ kajjalojjvalam ।। 60 ।। kṛtvā dadau sulalitaṃ vastraṃ ca lalitā satī । mahendreṇa pradattaṃ ca pārijātaprasūnakam ।। 61 ।। sugandhiyuktaṃ tasyāśca pārijātaṃ kare dadau । suśīlaṃ madhuroktaṃ ca bhartuḥ pārśve yathocitam ।। 62 ।। śikṣāṃ cakāra nītiṃ ca suśīlā gopikā satī । strīṇāṃ ca ṣoḍaśakalāṃ vipattau vismṛtāṃtayoḥ ।। 63 ।। smaraṇaṃ kārayāmāsa rādhāmātā kalāvatī । śrṛṅgāraviṣayoktaṃ ca vacanaṃ ca sudhopamam ।। 64 ।। smaraṇaṃ kārayāmāsa bhaginī ca sudhāmukhī । kamalānāṃ campakānāṃ dale candanacarcite ।। 65 ।। cakāra ratitalpaṃ ca kamalā cā''śu komalam । cārucampakapuṣpaṃ ca kṛṣṇārthaṃ puṭakasthitam ।। 66 ।। cakāra candanāktaṃ ca svayaṃ ca pārvatī satī । puṣpaṃ kelikadambānāṃ stabakaṃ ca manoharam ।। 67 ।। kadambamālāṃ kṛṣṇārtha vidyamānāṃ cakāra sā । tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ samyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ।। 68 ।। kṛṣṇapriyā ca kṛṣṇārthaṃ cakāra vāsitaṃ jalam । etasminnantare sarvamāśramaṃ sajalasthalam ।। 69 ।। sākṣādgorocanābhaṃ ca dadṛśurmunayaḥ surāḥ । te sarve vismayaṃ gatvā papracchuḥ kṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। 70 ।। uvāca bhagavāṃstāśca sarvajñaḥ sarvakārāṇā ।। 71 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca abhiśaptā ca śrīdāmnā bhraṣṭaśobhā rādhikā । sarvaṃ jñānaṃ visasmāra madvicchedajvarāturā ।। 72 ।। vimukte varṣaśatake jñānaṃ sasmāra sā satī । siddhāśramaṃ ca pītābhaṃ rāseśvaryāśca tejasā ।। 73 ।। paramāhlādakaṃ tejaścandrakoṭisamaprabham । sukhadṛśyaṃ ca sukhadaṃ cakṣudhāṃ prāṇināmapi ।। 74 ।। tacchrutvā paramāścaryaṃ munayo manavastathā । devyaśca sarvadevāste brahmeśānādayastathā ।। 75 ।। javena gatvā tatsthānaṃ bhaktinamrātmakaṃdharā । sarve janāste dadṛśustrailokyasthāśca rādhikām ।। 76 ।। śvetacampakavarṇābhāmatulāṃ sumanoharām । mohinīṃ mānasānāṃ ca munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ।। 77 ।। sukeśīṃ sundarīṃ śyāmāṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalām । nitambakaṭhinaśroṇīṃ stanayugmonnatānanām ।। 78 ।। koṭīnduninditāsyāṃ tāṃ sasmitāṃ sudatīṃ satīm । kajjalojjvalarūpāṃ ca śaratkamalalojanām ।। 79 ।। mahālakṣmīṃ bījarūpāṃ parāmādyāṃ sanātīm । paramātmasvarūpasya prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatām ।। 80 ।। stutāṃ ca pūjitāṃ caiva parāṃ ca paramātmane । brahmasvarūpāṃ nirliptāṃ nityarūpāṃ ca nirguṇām ।। 81 ।। viśvānurodhātprakṛtiṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahām । matyasvarūpāṃ śuddhāṃ ca pūtāṃ patitapāvanīm ।। 82 ।।sutīrthapūtāṃ satkīrtiṃ vidhātrīṃ vedasāmapi । mahatpriyāṃ ca mahatīṃ mahāviṣṇośca mātaram ।। 83 ।। rāseśvareśvarīṃ ramyāṃ rasikāṃ rasikeśvarīm । vahniśuddhāṃśukādhāmāṃ svecchārūpāṃ śubhālayām ।। 84 ।। gopībhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaśvatsevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ । catasṛbhiḥ priyālībhiḥ pādapadmopasevitām ।। 85 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇabhūṣaṇoccairvibhūṣitām । cārukuṇḍalayugmena śrutigaṇḍasthalojjvalām ।। 86 ।। sunāsāṃ gajamuktārhāṃ khagendracañcuninditām । kuṅkumālaktakastūrīsnigdhacandanacarcitām ।। 87 ।। dadhānāṃ sukapolaṃ ca komalāṅgīṃ sukāmukīm । gacendragāminīṃ rāmāṃ kāmanīyāṃ sukāminīm ।। 88 ।। kāmāstrajayarūpāṃ ca kāmakāmyālayāṃ varām । krīḍākamalamamlānaṃ pārijātaprasūnakam ।। 89 ।। amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ dadhānāṃ darpaṇojjvalam । nānāratnavicitrāḍhyaratanasiṃhāsanasthitām ।। 90 ।। padmaiḥ padmārcitaṃ pādapadmaṃ ca maṅgalālayam । hṛtpadme dhyāyamānaṃ ca kṛṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 91 ।। karmaṇā manasā vācā svapne jāgaraṇe'pi ca । tatprītiṃ prema saubhāgyaṃ smarantīṃ nityanūtanam ।। 92 ।। bhāvānuraktasaṃsaktāṃ śuddhabhaktāṃ pativratām । dhanyāṃ mānyāṃ gauravarṇāṃ śaśvadvakṣaḥ sthalasthitām ।। 93 ।। priyāsu priyabhakteṣu supriyāṃ priyavādinīm । kṛṣṇavāmāṅgasaṃbhūtāmabhedāṃ guṇarūpayoḥ ।। 94 ।। golokavāsinīṃ devadevīṃ sarvoparisthitam । vṛṣabhānasutākhyāṃ tāṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 95 ।। gopīśvarīṃ guptarūpāṃ siddhidāṃ siddhirūpiṇīm । dhyānāsādhyāṃ durārādhyāṃ vande sadbhaktavanditām ।। 96 ।। dhyāne dhyānena rādhāyā vyāyante dhyānatatparāḥ । ihaiva jīvanmuktāste paratra kṛṣṇapārṣadāḥ ।। 97 ।। dṛṣṭvā brahmā ca sarvādau tuṣṭāva parameśvarīm । svayaṃ vidhātā jagatāṃ mātaraṃ vedhasāmapi ।। 98 ।। brāhmovāca ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasraṇi divyāni parameśvari । puṣkare ca tapastaptaṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 99 ।। tvatpādapadmadhuramadhulubdhena cetasā । madhuvratena lolena preritena mayā sati ।। 100 ।। tathā'pi na mayā labdhaṃ tvatpādapadmamīpsitam । na dṛṣṭamapi svapne'yi jātā vāgaśarīriṇī ।। 101 ।। vārāhe bhārate varṣe puṇye vṛndāvane vane । siddhāśrame gaṇeśasya pādapadmaṃ ca drakṣyasi ।। 102 ।। rādhāmādhavayordāsyaṃ kuto viṣayiṇastava । nivartasva mahābhāga parametatmudurlabham ।। 103 ।। iti śrutvā nivṛtto'haṃ tapase bhagnamānasaḥ । paripurṇa tadadhunā vāñchitaṃ tapasaḥ phalam ।। 104 ।। mahādeva uvāca padmaiḥ padmārcitaṃ pādapadamaṃ yasya sudurlabham । dhyāyante dhyānaniṣṭhāśca śāśvadrabrahmādayaḥ surāḥ ।। 105 ।। munayo manavaścaiva siddhāḥ santaśca yoginaḥ । draṣṭuṃ naiva kṣamāḥ svapne bhavatī tasya vakṣasi ।। 106 ।। ananta uvāca vedāśca vedamātā ca purāṇāni ca suvrate । ahaṃ sarasvatī santa stotuṃ nālaṃ ca saṃtatam ।। 107 ।। asmākaṃ stavane yasya bhrūbhaṅgaṃ ca sudurlabham । tavaiva bhatsene bhītāścāvayorantaraṃ hareḥ ।। 108 ।। evaṃ devāśca devyaścāpyanye ye ca samāgatāḥ । praṇatāstuṣṭuvuḥ sarve munimanvādayastathā ।। 109 ।। lajjayā namravaktrāśca rukmiṇyadyāśca yoṣitaḥ । malīmasaṃ ca cakrustāḥ śvāsena ratnadarpaṇam ।। 110 ।। mṛtatulyā satyabhāmā nirāhārā kṛśodarī । manaso'pyabhimānaṃ ca sarva tatyāca nārada ।। 111 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... siddhāśramatīrthayātrāprasaṅgegaṇeśapūjanaṃ brahmeśaśeṣādikṛtarādhikāstotraṃ nāma caturviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 124 ।।
<4.125> atha pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca gaṇeśapūjanādeva rādhāstotrātparaṃ vibho । babhūva kiṃ rahasyaṃ vā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 1 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca gaśeśapūjane tīrthe ye devāśca samāyayuḥ । munayaścāpi yogīndrā vasanto vaṭamūlake ।। 2 ।। vasudevo devakī ca paramādarabūrvakam । papraccha śaṃbhuṃ brāhmaṇamanantaṃ munipuṃgavān ।। 3 ।। bhavedbhavābdhitaraṇamāvayoruttamā gatiḥ । śīghraṃ brūta mahābhāgā dīnayordīnabāndhavāḥ ।। 4 ।। bhavābdhitaraṇe taryāṃ tatra yūyaṃ ca nāvikāḥ । na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ ।। 5 ।। yajñarūpāṇi puṇyāni vratānyanaśanāni ca । tapāṃsi nānādānāni vipradevārcanāni ca ।। 6 ।। ciraṃ punanti sarvāṇi darśanādeva vaiṣṇavāḥ । satāṃ ca viṣṇubhaktānāṃ rajasāṃ sparśamātrataḥ ।। 7 ।। pūtānāṃ pādapadmānāṃ sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā । tīrthāni ca pavitrāṇi samudrāḥ parvatāstathā ।। 8 ।। surā darśanamicchanti pātakendhanapāpakam । so'jñāni naiva bubudhe jñānaṃ ca jñāninā saha ।। 9 ।। paramaṃ svādurūpaṃ ca dadhidugdharasaṃ yathā । yathā kṛṇasya tāto'haṃ saṅgī sucirameva ca ।। 10 ।। tathaiva devakī mātā jñānināṃ ca gurorguroḥ । vasudevavacaḥ śrutvā prahasya śaṃkaraḥ svayam caturṇāmapi vedānāmuvāca janako guruḥ ।। 11 ।। mahādeva uvāca saṃnikarṣo jñānināṃ cāpyanādaraṇakāraṇam । yānti gaṅgāmbhasā pūtāstīrthānyanyāni siddhaye ।। 12 ।। vāsudevāsya tāto'yaṃ vasudevaśca paṇḍitaḥ । jñāninaḥ kaśyapasyāśo vasostātasya cā''tmanaḥ ।। 13 ।। pṛcchati jñānamasmāṃśca kṛṣṇājñānputrabuddhitaḥ । aho durgā mahāmāyā jñānināmapi mohinī ।। 14 ।। viṣṇumāyā durārādhyā na sādhyā jāgatāmapi । vayaṃ ca mohitāḥ śaśvadvedānāṃ janakastathā ।। 15 ।। brahmā kṛṣṇaṃ parīkṣeta mohitastasya māyayā । dhyāyate yatpadāmbhojaṃ tapasā jīvanāvadhi ।। 16 ।। indreṣu daśalakṣeṣvapyadhikāṣṭaśateṣu ca । pāteṣu brahmaṇaḥ pāte nimeṣo mādhavasya ca ।। 17 ।। saha tenendrayuddhaṃ ca pārijātasya hetunā । pārijātataruṃ dattvā mayā śakraśca rakṣitaḥ ।। 18 ।। yajjñānaṃ na girāmeva tatvaṃ vā viṣayātmakam । nahi kiṃ cittadajñānāṃ tasmāddhyānaṃ sadaiva hi ।। 19 ।। prāṇināmātmano jñānamasmākaṃ jñānamasti ca । tadūdharvaṃ tatsamaṃ naiva kṛṣṇaṃ pṛccha śubhāśumam ।। 20 ।। brahmaṇaśca caturyāmaṃ kalpaṃ kalpavido viduḥ । saptakalpāntajīvī ca mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ।। 21 ।। aṣṭānavatiśakreṣu pāteṣu patanaṃ muneḥ । tataḥ prāptaṃ harerdāsyaṃ muninā tapasaḥ phalāt ।। 22 ।। pralaye brahmaṇaḥ pāte patanaṃ lomaśasya ca । dikpālānāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca tadāyuścirajīvinām ।। 23 ।। anyeṣāmapi devānāṃ munīnāmūrdhvaretasām । tadevā''yuśca rudrāṇāṃ māṃ ca mṛtyuṃjayaṃ vinā ।। 24 ।। pralaye ca vidheḥ pāte śivaloke'pyahaṃ śivaḥ । brahmabhālodbhavaḥ śaṃbhūḥ sarvādiḥ sargabhāṣaṇaḥ ।। 25 ।। kṛṣṇavāmāṅgasaṃbhūtā yathā rādhā tathaiva ca । tathaiva durgā lakṣmīśca sāvitrī ca sarasvatī ।। 26 ।। ādityo''yaditeḥ putraḥ kāyavyūhena dvādaśa । tathaiva ca mahendraśca kāyavyūhāccartudaśa ।। 27 ।। tathaiva vasavaścāṣṭau rudrāścaikāvaśaiva te । manupāte cendrapāto viṣayātpatanaṃ bhavet ।। 28 ।। samāyayau ca sarveṣāṃ nidhanaṃ pralaye'pi ca । pralayo darśayāmāsa brahmāṇḍaṃ ca jalaplutam ।। 29 ।। brahmāṇaṃ ca svalokaṃ ca svātmānaṃ śaktibhiśca mām । sarveṣāṃ mūlarūpaśca sarveśaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca ।। 30 ।। bhaja putraṃ rājasūye yajñeśaṃ yajñakāraṇam । vidhivaddakṣiṇāṃ dattvāṃ bhavābdhiṃ tara yādava ।। 31 ।। muktiste nāsti nirvāṇā viṣayī kaśyapo bhavāna । na te dāsyaṃ ktadhanamaditirdevakī tathā ।। 32 ।। vraja svargaṃ bhogabījaṃ svasthānamamarālayam । śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā saṃyata ścaśubhakṣaṇe ।। 33 ।। tatra saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro rājasūyaṃ cakāra saḥ । vasudevasya havyaṃ ca sākṣācca jagṛhaḥ surāḥ ।। 34 ।। yatra sākṣācca yajñeśo yajño'yaṃ dakṣiṇā saha । būrṇāhutiṃ dattavantaṃ vasudevamuvāca saḥ ।। sanatkumāro bhagavānvāsudevājñayā mune ।। 35 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dehi turṇaṃ lakṣmīpateḥ pitaḥ । sārthakaṃ kuru karmedaṃ vedoktaṃ vacanaṃ śruṇu ।। 36 ।। dakṣiṇāṃ vipramuddiśya tatkālaṃ cenna dīyate । muhūrte tu vyatīte sā dakṣiṇā dviguṇā bhavet ।। 37 ।। vāsare ca bahirbhūte bhavetsā'pi caturguṇā । trirātre samatīte ṣaḍguṇā dakṣiṇā bhavet ।। 38 ।। pakṣānte tu śataguṇā māsānte tu caturguṇā । ṣaṇmāse'pyadhike nyūne ca sāhastraguṇā tathā ।। 39 ।। varṣānte sā lakṣaguṇā brahmaṇoktaṃ ca yāṭava । ubhau ca narakaṃ yāṃtaḥ karmakartṛpurohitau ।। 40 ।। vāsudaivaśca tacchutvā sarvasvamutsasarjaṃ saḥ । adhikārāṃśca sāh lādo vāsudevājñayā tathā ।। 41 ।। amūlyānāṃ ca ratnānāṃ daśakoṭimanuttamamā । dadau gargāya sarvādau svayaṃ lakṣmaupateḥ pitā ।। 42 ।। śatakoṭiṃ maṇīndrāṇāṃ svarṇānāṃ taccartuguṇam । māṇikyānāṃ ca muktānāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 43 ।। raupyaṃ pravālaṃ paramaṃ svarṇapātrāṇi yāni ca । svastrīṇāṃ svavadhūnāṃ cāpyamūlyaratnabhūṣaṇam ।। 44 ।। śvetacāmaralakṣaṃ ca lakṣaṃ ca ratnadarpaṇam । kāmadhenugaṇaṃ sarvaṃ śatakoṭiṃ gajānapi ।। 45 ।। śatakauṭiṃ gajendrāṇāmaśvānāṃ taccaturguṇam । yaddhanaṃ yādavānāṃ ca rājño rājanumodanāt ।। 46 ।। grāmāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca sasasyaṃ phalitaṃ tarum । dhānyācalānāṃ lakṣaṃ ca śālyannānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 47 ।। pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva miṣṭānnaṃ ca sudhopamam । svastikānāṃ tilānāṃ ca ramyaṇi lḍḍukāni ca ।। 48 ।। dadhnāṃ madhūnāṃ dugdhānāṃ guḍānāṃ haviṣāmapi । kulyānāṃ śatakaṃ dattvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 49 ।। sakarpūraṃ ca tāmdūlaṃ suśītaṃ vāsitaṃ jalam । sugandhi candanaṃ caiva pārijātasya mālikām ।। 50 ।। āsanāni ca ramyāṇivahniśuddhāśukāni ca । ratnanirmāṇatalpāni puṣṇāṇi ca phalāni ca ।। 51 ।। pradadau brāhmaṇebhyaśca praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ । devāṃśca bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhaiḥ subhaiḥ ।। 52 ।। devāśca munayo rātrau svarāmābhiścaremire । prabhāte prayayuḥ sarve śrīkṛṣṇānumatena ca ।। 53 ।। vādavāḥ prayayuḥ sarvedvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām । amūlyarātnabūrṇāṃ ca rukmiṇīdarśanena ca ।। 54 ।। iti śrī brahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo''dhyāyaḥ ।। 125 ।।
<4.126> atha ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kṛtvā mādhavo yādavaiḥ saha । devairmunibhiranyaiśca devībhiḥ saha nārada ।। 1 ।। aṃśena devo devībhī rukmiṇyādyābhireva ca । prayayau dvārakāṃ ramyāṃ tasthau siddhāśrame svayam ।। 2 ।। kṛtvā suprītisaṃbhāṣāṃ sārdhagolokavāsibhiḥ । gopaiḥ suhṛdbhirnandena mātrā gopyā yaśodayā ।। 3 ।। uvāca mātaraṃ tātaṃ sunītaṃ ca cathocitam
