। gopāṃśca gokulasthāṃśca bandhuvargāśca sāṃpratam ।। 4 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca gaccha nandavrajaṃ nanda he tāta prāṇavallbha । mātaryaśode tvamapi paramārthe yaśasvini ।। 5 ।। bhuktvā kālāvaśeṣaṃ ca gaccha golokamuttamam । sālokyamuktiṃ dāsyāmi sārtha gokulavāsibhiḥ ।। 6 ।। ityuktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ pitroranumatena ca । jagāma rādhikāsthānaṃ nandaśca gokulaṃ tathā ।। 7 ।। dadarśa rādhā rucirāṃ muktāhārāṃ ca sasmitām । yathā dvādaśavarṣīyāṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ।। 8 ।। ratnoccairāsanasthā ca gopītriśatakoṭibhiḥ । āvṛtā vetrahastābhiḥ sasmitābhiśca sāṃpratam ।। 9 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca dūrato rādhā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prāṇavallabham । śiśuveṣaṃ suveṣaṃ ca sundareśaṃ ca sasmitam ।। 10 ।। navīṃnajaladaśyāmaṃ pīṃtakauśeyavāsasam । candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 11 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyaśobhitam । īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ bhaktānuprahavigraham ।। 12 ।। krīḍākamalamamlānaṃ dhṛtavantaṃ manoharam । muralīhastavinyastaṃ supraśastaṃ ca darpaṇam ।। 13 ।। javena ca samutthāya gopībhiḥ saha sādaram । praṇamya parayā bhaktyā tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। 14 ।। rādhikovāca adya me saphalaṃ janmajīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam । yaddṛṣṭvā mukhacandraṃ te susnigdhaṃ locanaṃ manaḥ ।। 15 ।। pañca prāṇāśca snigdhāśca paramātmā ca supriyaḥ । ubhayorharṣabījaṃ ca durlabhaṃ bandhudarśanam ।। 16 ।। śokārṇave nimagnā'haṃ pradagdhā virahānalaiḥ । tvaddṛṣṭyā'mṛtavṛṣṭyā ca susiktā'dya suśītalā ।। 17 ।। śivā śivapradā'haṃ ca śivabījā tvayā saha । śi (śa) va svarūpā niśceṣṭā'pyadṛśyā ca tvayā vinā ।। 18 ।। tvayi tiṣṭhati dehe ca dehī śrīmāñchuciḥ svayam । sarvaśaktisvarūpā ca śivarūpā gate tvayi ।। 19 ।। strīpuṃso viṃraho nāthasāmānyaśca sudāruṇaḥ । yāntyeva śaktibhiḥ prāṇā vicchedātparamātmanaḥ ।। 20 ।। ityuktvā rādhikā vevī paramātmānamīśvaram । svāsane vāsayāsāsa kṛtvā pādārcanaṃ mudā ।। 21 ।। ratnasiṃhāsane śrīmānuvāsa rādhayā saha । gopībhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaśvatsevitaḥ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 22 ।। candanā sā dadau gātre sugandhi candanaṃ hareḥ । sasmitā ratnamālā sā ratnamālāṃ gale dadau ।। 23 ।। padmaiḥ padmārcite pādapadme padmāvatī satī । ardhyā dadau sā sajalaṃ dūrvā puṣpaṃ ca candanam ।। 24 ।। mālato mālatīmālyaṃ cūḍāyāṃ ca harerdadau । campāpuṣpasya puṭakaṃ dadau campāvatī satī ।। 25 ।। pārijātā ca haraye pārijātaṃ dadau mudā । sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ vāsitaṃ śītalaṃ jalam ।। 26 ।। dadau kadambamālā sā kadambamālikāṃ śubhām । krīḍākamalamamlānamamūlyaṃ rtanadarpaṇam ।। 27 ।। dadau haste harereva kamalā sā sukomalā । varuṇena purā dattaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca sundaram ।। 28 ।। sākṣādgorocanābhaṃ ca sundarī haraye dadau । madhupātraṃ madhustasmai madhuraṃ madhupūrṇakam ।। 29 ।। sudhāpūrgaṃ sudhāpātraṃ dadau bhaktyā sudhāmukhī । cakāra puṣpaśayyāṃ ca gopī candanacarcitām ।। 30 ।। amlānamālatīpuṣpamālājālavibhūṣitām । ratnendrasāranirmāṇamandire sumanohare ।। 31 ।। maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahāravibhūṣite । kastūrīkuṅkumāktena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ।। 32 ।। ratnapradīpaśatakairjvaladbhiśca sudīpite । dhūpite satataṃ dhūpairnānāvastusamanvitaiḥ ।। 33 ।। kṛtvā śayyāṃ ratikarīṃ yayurgopyaśca sasmitāḥ । dṛṣṭvā rahasi talpaṃ ca suramyaṃ sumanoharam ।। 34 ।। mādhavo rāghayā sārdha viveśa ratimandiram । nānāprakārahāsyaṃ ca parihāsaṃ smarocitam ।। 35 ।। dvayorbabhūva talpe ca madanāturayostathā । mālyaṃ dadau ca kṛṣṇāya tāmbūlaṃ ca suvāsitam ।। 36 ।। kastūrīkuṅkumāktaṃ ca candanaṃ śyāmavakṣasi । cārucampakapuṣpaṃ ca cūḍāyāṃ pradadau satī ।। 37 ।। sahasradalasasaṃktakrīḍāpadmaṃ kare dadau । prakṣipya muralīṃ hastātpradadau ratnadarpaṇam ।। 38 ।। pārijātasya kusumamamlānaṃ purato dadau । uvāca madhuraṃ rādhā rahasye madhuraṃ vacaḥ sasmitā sasmitaṃ śāntaṃ kāntaṃ kāntā manoharam ।। 39 ।। rādhikovāca niṣphalaṃ maṅgalapraśtaṃ maṅgale maṅgalālaye । sarvamaṅgalabīje ca māṅgalye maṅgalaprade ।। 40 ।। tathā'pi kuśalapraśne sāṃprataṃ samayocitam । laukiko vyavahāro'pi vedebhyo balavāṃstathā ।। 41 ।। kuśalaṃ rukmiṇīkānta satyabhāmeśa sāṃpratam । mahandreṇa samaṃ yuddhaṃ līlayā ca yadājñayā ।। 42 ।। pārijātataruṃ svargādutpāṭya cāmarāvatīm । gatvā vijitya devāṃśca tasyai dasamiti śrutam ।। 43 ।। puṇyakaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena pārijātena suvratam । tvāmeva sādhyaṃ kāntaṃ ca saṃpūrṇe dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।। 44 ।। brahmeśaśeṣāsādhyastvaṃ tayā sādhyaḥ kṛtaḥ katham । sarvabhyaḥ kāminībhyaśca satyabhāmāṃ bibheṣi ca ।। 45 ।। rukmiṇyāṃ premasaubhāgyamatiriktaṃ ca gauravam । bhayaṃ mālyaṃ ca dhanyāyāṃ satyāyāṃ satataṃ śrutam ।। 46 ।। satyaṃ jāmbavatīkānta vada māṃ ca suniścitam । tāsu sarvāsu kāntāsu kasyāste prema cādhikam ।। 47 ।। śṛṅgāre sarvabhāve vā tāsu kā rasikā parā । tvayi snigdhā vidagdhā kā tāmu dhanyā'tisuvratā ।। 48 ।। sā strī bhāvānuraktā yā bhāryāṃ pāti patiśca saḥ । premātiriktaṃ strīpuṃsostrailokyeṣu sudurlabham ।। 49 ।। rasikā strī vijānāti satī guṇavatī patim । guṇajñaṃ rasikaṃ śūraṃ suśīlaṃ suratau sadā ।। 50 ।। dūrāddhāvati padmārtha madhulobhānmadhruvrataḥ । bhekastanna hi jānāti tanmūrdhni pādamutsṛjet ।। 51 ।। yantrī jānāti saṃgītarasaṃ yantraṃ ca naiva ca । dugdhāsvādaṃ vidagdhaśca na darvī naiva bhājanam ।। 52 ।। paripakvaphalāsvādaṃ jānanti bhoginaḥ sukham । ekatrāvasthitāḥ śaśvannakiṃcitphalino yathā ।। 53 ।। suśīlajalāsvādaṃ vijānanti tṛṣālvaḥ । na ca vāpī na ghaṭaścaikatrāvasthito yathā ।। 54 ।। bhokino hi vijānanti śālisvādurasaṃ param । ekatrāvasthitaṃ cetu na kṣetraṃ bhājanaṃ yathā ।। 55 ।। bubudhe candanāghraṇaṃ candanārthī ca bhogavit । na gardabho bhāravāhī na tasya pātrikā yathā ।। 56 ।। yaṃ na yānanti vedāśca brahmeśānādayastathā । yogino munayaḥ siddhāstaṃ kiṃ jānanti yoṣitaḥ ।। 57 ।। saubhāgyaṃ gauravaṃ prema durlabhaṃ nityanūtam । yauṣitāṃ ca paraṃ naiva cūrṇībhūtaṃ kṣaṇena ca ।। 58 ।। atyucchrito nipatanaṃ prāpnotyeva dhruvaṃ prabho । ārādvipattibījaṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ vihiṃsanam ।। 59 ।। śrīdāmā ca mayā śaptastvadbhakto bhaktavatsalaḥ । etādṛśī vipattirme putraśrīdāmaśāpataḥ ।। 60 ।। īśvaraḥ kasya vā bandhuḥ priyo vā vipriyastathā । satataṃ bhaktisādhyaśca yo bhaktaśca tadīśvaraḥ ।। 61 ।। vedāśca vaidikāḥ santaḥ purāṇāni vadanti ca । rādhāyā mādhavaḥ sādhyo bhagavāniti niṣphalam ।। 62 ।। jitvā ca sagaṇaṃ śaṃbhuṃ bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam । kṛtvā ca rukmiṇīpautraḥ samānītaḥ sabhāryakaḥ ।। 63 ।। aho tvayi samāyāte rukmiṇī kimuvāca ha । prema sthitaṃ samānaṃ te kiṃ vivṛddhaṃ ca gauravam ।। 64 ।। kurupāṇḍavayuddhena kuravo nihatāstvayā । pāṇḍavārthe tathā bhūpāḥ kva sāmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।। 65 ।। sākṣānmahendrajātasya kaunteyasyārjunasya ca । rājamaṇḍalamdhyastho bhavāneva hi sārathiḥ ।। 66 ।। tena bhaktena śuddhena bhīṣmeṇa ca mahātmanā । lajjitena kimuktaṃ te mahatīṣu mabhāsu ca ।। 67 ।। devairapi kathaṃ dṛṣṭo brahmeśaśesaṃṣajñakaiḥ । bhaktasihairbhṛttaiḥ sarvairna coktaṃ kiṃcideva saḥ ।। 68 ।। yaścānirvacanīyaśca vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca । purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu prakṛteḥ para īśvaraḥ ।। 69 ।। nirguṇaca nīrīhaśca nirliptaḥ sarvakarmaṇām । karmaṇāṃ sākṣirūpaśca bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 70 ।। paraṃ brahma paraṃ jyotiḥ parameśaḥ parātparaḥ । paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ sūto nararathasthitaḥ ।। 71 ।। tvayā kubjā ca saṃbhuktā vṛddhā kṣatriyakāminī । aputriṇī cādhikāṅgī yūnā'spṛśyā ca ।। praktanāt ।। 72 ।। tvayā ca nihataḥ kaṃso mātulaḥ kena hetunā । āyāsyatīti kṛtvā ca gattaṃ na punarāgatam ।। 73 ।। nihatya yādavānsarvānvibhajya dvārakāṃ purīm । tvāṃ nibadhya samānetumīśvarī vāritā janaiḥ ।। 74 ।। ityuktvā rādhikā devī bhṛśamuccai ruroda sā । mūrcchāṃ saṃprāpa sahasā niniḥśvāsā babhūva ha ।। 75 ।। gopyo gavākṣajālasthāḥ śuśruvurdadṛśustathā । dṛṣṭvā tamāyayuḥ sarvā ūcū rādhā mṛteti ca ।। 76 ।। uccaistā ruruduḥ sarvāḥ kroḍe kṛtvā ca rādhikām । ūcustā rakṣarakṣeti hare narahare prabho ।। 77 ।। gopya ūcuḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ kiṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇa tvayā rādhā mṛtā ca naḥ । rādhāṃ jīvaya bhadraṃ te yāsyāmaḥ kānanaṃ vayam ।। 78 ।। anyathā strīvadhaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmaḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ । gopīnāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā rādhikāyāśca mādhavaḥ ।। 79 ।। uvāca jīvayāmāsa mudhādṛṣṭyā ca nārada । uttasthau rādhikā devī rudatī māninī satī ।। 80 ।। gopyastāṃ bodhayāmāsuḥkroḍe kṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 81 ।। śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrṛṇu rādhe pravakṣyāmi jñānamādhyātmikaṃ param । yacchrutvā hāliko mūrkhaḥ sadyo bhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। 82 ।। jātyā'haṃ cagatāṃ svāmī kiṃ rukmiṇyādiyoṣitām । kāryakāraṇarūpo'haṃ vyakto rādhe pṛthak pṛthak ।। 83 ।। ekātmā'haṃ ca viśveṣāṃ jātyā jyotirmayaḥ svayam । sarvaprāṇiṣu vyaktyā cāpyābrahmāditṛṇādiṣu ।। 84 ।। ekasmiṃśca bhuktavati na tuṣṭo'nyo janastathā । mayyātmani gate'pyeko mṛto'pyanyaḥ sujīvati ।। 85 ।। jātyā'haṃ kṛṣṇarūpaśca paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam । goloke gokule puṇye kṣetre vṛndāvane vane ।। 86 ।। dvibhujo gopaveṣaśca svayaṃ rādhāpatiḥ śiśuḥ । gopālairgopikābhiśca sahitaḥ kāmadhenubhiḥ ।। 87 ।। caturbhujo'haṃ vaikuṇṭhe dvidhārūpaḥ sanātanaḥ । lakṣmīsarasvatīkāntaḥ satataṃ śāntavigrahaḥ ।। 88 ।। yanmānasī sindhukanyā martyalakṣmīpatirbhuvi । śvetadvīpe ca śrīrīde tatrāpi ca caturbhujaḥ ।। 89 ।। ahaṃ nārāyaṇarṣiśca naro dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ । dharmavaktā ca dharmiṣṭho dharmavartmapravartakaḥ ।। 90 ।। śāntirlakṣmīsvarūpā ca dharmiṣṭhā ca pativratā । atra tasyāḥ patirahaṃ puṇyakṣetre ca bhārate ।। 91 ।। siddheśaḥ siddhidaḥ sākṣātkapilo'haṃ satīpatiḥ । nānārūpadharo'haṃ ca vyaktibhedena sundari ।। 92 ।। ahaṃ caturbhujaḥ śaśvaddvārvatyāṃ rukmiṇīvatiḥ । ahaṃ kṣīrodaśāyī ca satyabhāmāgṛhe śubhe ।। 93 ।। anyāsāṃ mandire'haṃ ca kāyavyūhātpṛthakpṛthak । ahaṃ nārāyaṇarṣiśca phālgunasyāsya sārathiḥ ।। 94 ।। sa nararṣirdharmaputro madaṃśo balavānbhuvi । tapasā''rādhitastena sārathye'haṃ ca puṣkare ।। 95 ।। yathā tvaṃ rādhikā devī goleke gokule tathā । vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīrbhavatī ca sarasvatī ।। 96 ।। bhavatī martyalakṣmīśca kṣīrodaśāyinaḥ priyā । dharmaputravadhūstvaṃ ca śāntirlakṣmīsvarūpiṇī ।। 97 ।। kapilasya priyā kāntābhārate bhavatī satī । tvaṃ sītā mithilāyāṃ ca tvacchāyā draupadī satī ।। 98 ।। dvāravatyāṃ mahālkṣmīrbhavatī rukmiṇī satī । pañcānāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca bhavatī kalayā priyā ।। 99 ।। rāvaṇena hṛtā tvaṃ ca svaṃ ca rāmasya kāminī । nānārūpā yathā tvaṃ ca cchāyayā kalayā satī ।। 100 ।। nānārūpastathā'haṃ ca śvāṃśena kalayā tathā । paripūrṇatamo'haṃ ca paramātmā parātparaḥ ।। 101 ।। iti te kathitaṃ sarvamādhyātmikamidaṃ sati । rādhe karvāparādhaṃ me kṣamasva parameśvarī ।। 102 ।। śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā parituṣṭā ca rādhikā । parituṣṭāśca gopyaśca praṇemuḥ parameśvaram ।। 103 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ ।। 126 ।।
<4.127> atha saptaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā prahṛṣṭā gopikā mudā । mandiraṃ prayayuḥ sarvāḥ praṇamya rādhikāṃ prabhum ।। 1 ।। rādhāśṛṅgārabhāvaṃ ca kalāṣoḍaśapūrvakam । cakāra sasmitā sādhvī vakracañcalalocanā ।। 2 ।। dattvā ca candanaṃ mālyaṃ svāmine punareva ca । rahasyaṃ ca parīhāsyaṃ punareva cakāra saḥ ।। 3 ।। ākṛṣya rādhikāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ samānīya svavakṣasi । oṣṭhādharaṃ kapolaṃ ca gaṇḍayugmaṃ cucumba ca ।। 4 ।। rādhā cucumba kṛṣṇasya mukhacandraṃ manoharam । cakāra kṛṣṇaṃ prāṇeśaṃ bāhubhyāṃ ca svavakṣasi ।। 5 ।। śṛṅgāraṃ ṣoḍaśavirdhaṃ kāmaśāstroktamīpsitam । strīpuṃsostoṣajanakaṃ cakāra bhagavānprabhuḥ ।। 6 ।। nakhavikṣatasarvāṅgā daśanenādharakṣatā । pulakāñcitadehā sa tandritā vāmanastanī ।। 7 ।। mīrcchitā sukhasaṃbhogādvilagnā hatacetanā । śvāsamātrāvaśeṣā ca nidrāmudritalocanā ।। 8 ।। ratiśūrā komalāṅgī kāntāvakṣaḥ syalasthitā । śīte sukhoṣṇasarvāṅgī grīṣme sā sukhaśītalā ।। 9 ।। śṛṅgārakāle sukhadā sāndraśroṇipayodharā । nitambabhārānamrā ca prasaṅge sukhadāyikā ।। 10 ।। vidagdhā rasikā śreṣṭhā kāmukī ca varāṅganā । sahasā cetanaṃ prāpya śuśrāva kokiladhvanim ।। 11 ।। śrutvā paramabhītā sā dīnā dīnaviśaṅkayā । uvāca paramā sā ca parameśaṃ parātparam bāhuśroṇiyugāmyāṃ ca nibadhya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 12 ।। rādhikovāca rāsaṃ gaccha mahābhāga puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । tatra krīḍāṃ kariṣyāmi jalena ca sthalena ca ।। 13 ।। punaryāsyāmi malayaṃ sundaraṃ maṇimandiram । aparaṃ yadrahasyaṃ vā janmalā na śrutaṃ mayā ।। 14 ।। tatra yāmi tvayā sārdhamiti me lālasā parā । parasparaikālāpena prayayau rajanī śubhā ।। 15 ।। aruṇodayakāle'pi na tyajenmādhavaṃ satī । mādhavaḥ prītivacasā bodhayāmāsa sāghanāt ।। 16 ।। prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā svāruroha rathaṃ hariḥ । gopībhī rādhayā sārdhaṃ śaratkamalalocanaḥ ।। 17 ।। yojanāyatavistīrṇa gṛhestriśatakoṭibhiḥ । maṇīndrasāranirmāṇairjvaladbhirupaśobhitam ।। 18 ।। golokādāgataṃ tatra manoyāyi manoharam । sahasracakrasaṃyuktaṃ mahasrāśvaiḥ pracālitam ।। 19 ।। maṇistambhaiśtrikoṭībhī ratnarājivirājitam । muktāmāṇikyaparamairhīrahāraiḥ suśobhitam ।। 20 ।। nānācitrairvicitraiśca śvetacāmaradarpaṇaiḥ । vahniśuddhāṃśukairdīptairmālājālairvibhūṣitam ।। 21 ।। ratnirmāṇatalpaiśca puṣpacandanacarcitam । samānarūpaveṣaiśca gopīlakṣaiḥ samāvṛtam ।। 22 ।। rathena tena bhagavānpunarvṛndāvanaṃ yayau । tatra gatvā niśākāle vijahāra jale sthale ।। 23 ।। śṛṅgāraṃ suciraṃ kṛtvā vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca । rādhikāṃ darśayāmāsa yathāsarva ca nūtanam ।। 24 ।। vispandake surasane māhendre nandane vane । sumeruśikhare ramye parvate gandhamādane ।। 25 ।। śaile śaile sundare ca kandare kandare vane । puṣpodyāne surahasi nadyāṃ nadyāṃ nade nade ।। 26 ।। samudrapuline ramye pārijātavane vane । subhadre puṣpabhadre ca nārāyaṇasarovare ।। 27 ।। pavanasyaiva nilaye malaye ca surālaye । trikūṭe bhadrakūṭe ca pañcakūṭe sukūṭake ।। 28 ।। devānāṃ kamanīyāyāṃ kāñcanyāṃ ca tathaiva ca । samudre ca samudre ca dvīpe dvīpe manohare ।। 29 ।। kharvaṭe pravare ramye puṇyacandrasarovare । supārśve munipārśve ca sa reme rādhayā saha ।। 30 ।। śīghraṃ ca punarāgatya jambūdvīpaṃ ca puṇyadam । dvārakāṃ darśayāmāsa parvataṃ raivataṃ tathā ।। 31 ।। gokulaṃ punarāgatya gopagokulasaṃkulam । tatra dṛṣṭvā ca bhāṇḍīraṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau ।। 32 ।। śrīkṛṇṇāgamanaṃ śrutvā yaśodā nanda eva ca । gopā gopyaśca vṛddhāścāpyaśrunetrā nirākulāḥ ।। 33 ।। vāraṇendraṃ puraskṛtya veśyāṃ ca naṭanartakāḥ । patiputravatīṃ sādhvīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā ।। 34 ।। yathā devāśca vahniṃ ca dṛṣṭvā nandaṃ ca mātaram । āyayurbālakṛṣṇaśca rādhayā saha mādhavaḥ ।। 35 ।। mātuḥ kroḍamāruroha prahasya madhusūdanaḥ । nando yaśodayā sārdha cucumba mukhapaṅkajam ।। 36 ।। āśliśya bhṛśamuccaiśca siṣeca netrajairjalaiḥ । svayaṃ ca bhagavānkṛṣṇo yaśodāyāḥ stanaṃ papau ।। 37 ।। tādṛśaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve yādṛśo mathurāṃ yayau । muralīhastavinyastaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 38 ।। yathaikādaśavarṣīyaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā । mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam ।। 39 ।। mandiraṃ veśayāmāsa rādhayā saha mādhavam । yaśodā maṅgalaṃ kṛtvā bhojayāmāsa brāhmaṇān ।। 40 ।। pūjāṃ cakāra gopīnāṃ munīnāṃ ca yathā janaḥ । maṇiratnaṃ pravālaṃ ca suvarṇa paramaṃ tathā ।। 41 ।। bhuktāmāṇikyahīraṃ ca brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā । gajaratnaṃ gavāṃ ratnamaśvaratnaṃ manoharam ।। 42 ।। āsanāni ca pātrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni tathaiva ca । dhānyānyapi ca sasyāni vastrāṇi ca tathā dadau ।। 43 ।। apūrva darśayāmāsa rādhayā saha mādhavam । gopīgaṇaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ sādareṇāpi nārada ।। 44 ।। dundubhīnvādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṅgalam । devāṃśca bhojayāmāsa sānandaṃ ca manoharam ।। 45 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... saptaviśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 127 ।।
<4.128> athāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇaśca samāhvānaṃ gopāṃścāpi cakāra saḥ । bhāṇḍīre vaṭamūle ca tatra svayamuvāsa ha ।। 1 ।। purā'nnaṃ ca dadau tasmai yatraiva brāhmaṇīgaṇaḥ । uvāsa rādhikā devī vāmapārśve harerapi ।। 2 ।। dakṣiṇe nandagopaśca yaśodāsahitastathā । taddakṣiṇo vṛṣabhānastadvāme sā kalāvatī ।। 3 ।। anye gopāśca gopyaśca bāndhavāḥ suhṛdastathā । tānuvāca sa govindo yathārthyaṃ samayocitam ।। 4 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu nanda pravakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ samayocitam । satyaṃ ca paramārthaṃ ca paralokasukhāvaham ।। 5 ।। ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ bhramaṃ sarvaṃ niśāmaya । vidyuddīptirjale reṣā yathā toyasya budbudam ।। 6 ।। mathurāyāṃ sarvamuktaṃ nāvaśeṣaṃ ca kiṃcana । yaśodāṃ bodhayāmāsa rādhikā kadalīvane ।। 7 ।। tadeva satyaṃ paramaṃ bhramadhvāntapradīpakam । vihāya mithyāmāyāṃ ca smara tatparamaṃ padam ।। 8 ।। janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ harṣakaraṃ param । śokasaṃtāpaharaṇaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam ।। 9 ।। māmeva paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam । dhyāyaṃ dhyāyaṃ putrabuddhiṃ tyaktvā labha paraṃ padam ।। 10 ।। golokaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ sārdhaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ । ārātkalerāgamanaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam ।। 11 ।। strīpuṃsorniyamo nāsti jātīnāṃ ca tathaiva ca । vipre saṃdhyādikaṃ nāsti cihnaṃ yajñopavītakam ।। 12 ।। yajñasūtraṃ ca tilakaṃ śeṣaṃ luptaṃ suniścitam । divāvyavāyanirataṃ virataṃ dharmakarmaṇi ।। 13 ।। yajñānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasāṃ luptameva ca । kedārakanyāśāpena dharmo nāstyeva kevalam ।। 14 ।। svacchandagāminīstrīrṇā patiśca satataṃ vaśe । tāḍayetsatataṃ taṃ ca bhartsayeccha divāniśam ।। 15 ।। prādhānyaṃ strīkuṭumbānāṃ strīṇāṃ ca satataṃ vraja । svāmī ca bhaktastāsāṃ ca parābhūto nirantaram ।। 16 ।। kalau ca yoṣitaḥ sarvā jārasevāsu tatparāḥ । śataputrasamaḥ snehastāsāṃ jāre bhaviṣyati ।। 17 ।। dadāti tasmai bhakṣyaṃ ca yathā bhṛtyāya kopataḥ । sasmitā sakaṭākṣā sā'mṛtadṛṣṭyā nirantaram ।। 18 ।। jāraṃ paśyati kāmena viṣadṛṣṭyā patiṃ sadā । satataṃ gauravaṃ tāsāṃ snehaṃ ca jārabāndhave ।। 19 ।। patyau karaprahāraṃ ca nityaṃ nityaṃ karoti ca । miṣṭānnaṃ śraddhayā bhaktyā jārāya pradadāti ca ।। 20 ।। veṣayuktā ca satataṃ jārasevanatatparā । prāṇā bandhurgatiścā''tmā kalau jāraśca yauṣitām ।। 21 ।। luptā cātithisevā ca praluptaṃ viṣṇusevanam । pitṛṇāmarcanaṃ caiva devānāṃ ca tathaiva ca ।। 22 ।। viṣṇuvaiṣṇavayordveṣī satataṃ ca naro bhavet । vāmamantropāsakāśca caturvarṇāśca tatparāḥ ।। 23 ।। śālagrāmaṃ ca tulasīṃ kuśaṃ gaṅgodakaṃ tathā । na spṛśenmānavo dhūrto mlecchācārarataḥ sadā ।। 24 ।। kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sarvabījakam । sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ śaśvaddātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām ।। 25 ।। tyaktvā māṃ parayā bhaktyā kṣudrasaṃpatpradāyinam । vedanighnaṃ vāmamantraṃ japedvipraśca māyayā ।। 26 ।। sanātanī viṣṇumāyā vañcitaṃ taṃ kariṣyati । mamā''jñayā bhagavatī jagatāṃ ca duratyayā ।। 27 ।। kalerdaśasahasrāṇi madarcā bhuvi tiṣṭhati । tadardhāni ca varṣāṇi gaṅgā bhuvanapāvanī ।। 28 ।। tulasī viṣṇubhaktāśca yāvadgaṅgā ca kīrtanam । purāṇāni ca svalpāni tāvadeva mahītale ।। 29 ।। mama cotkīrtanaṃ nāsti etadante kalau vraja । ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti kirātā balinaḥ śaṭhāḥ ।। 30 ।।pitroḥ sevā guroḥ sevā sevā ca devaviprayoḥ । vivarjitā narāḥ sarve cātithīnāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 31 ।। sasyahīnā bhavetpṛthvī sā'nāvṛṣṭyā nirantaram । phalahīno'pi vṛkṣaśca jalahīnā sarittathā ।। 32 ।। vedahīno brāhmaṇaśca balahīnaśca bhūpatiḥ । jātihīnā janāḥ sarve mleccho bhūpo bhaviṣyati ।। 33 ।। bhṛtyavattāḍayettātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyastathā gurum । kāntaṃ ca tāḍayetkāntā lubdhakukkuṭavadgṛhī ।। 34 ।। naśyanti sakalā lokāḥ kalau śeṣe ca pāpinaḥ । sūryāṇāmātapātkecijjalaughenāpi kecana ।। 35 ।। he vaiśyendra pratikalau na naśyati vasuṃdharā । punaḥ sṛṣṭau bhavetsatyaṃ satyabījaṃ nirantaram ।। 36 ।। etasminnantare vipra rathameva manoharam । caturyojanavistīrṇamūrdhve ca pañcayojanam ।। 37 ।। śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam । amlānapārijātānāṃ mālājālavirājitam ।। 38 ।। maṇīnāṃ kaustubhānāṃ ca bhūṣaṇena vibhūṣitam । amūlyaratnakalaśaṃ hīrahāravilambitam ।। 39 ।। manoharaiḥ pariṣvaktaṃ sahasrakoṭimandiraiḥ । sahasradvayacakraṃ ca sahasradvayaghoṭakam ।। 40 ।। sūkṣmavastrācchāditaṃ ca gopīkoṭībhirāvṛtam । golokādāgataṃ tūrṇaṃ dadṛśuḥ sahasā vraje ।। 41 ।। kṛṣṇājñayā tamāruhya yayurgolokamuttamam । rādhā kalāvatī devī dhanyā cāyonisaṃbhavā ।। 42 ।। golokāda gatā gopyaścāyonisaṃbhavāśca tāḥ । śrutipatnyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ svaśarīreṇa nārada ।। 43 ।। sarve tyaktvā śarīrāṇi naśvarāṇi suniścitam । golokaṃ ca yayau rādhā sārghaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ ।। 44 ।। dadarśa virajātīrra nānāratnavibhūṣitam । taduttīrya yayau vipra śataśṛṅgaṃ ca parvatam ।। 45 ।। nānāmaṇigaṇākīrṇaṃ rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam । tato yayau kiyaddūraṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 46 ।। sā dadarśākṣayavaṭamūrdhve triśatayojanam । śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ śākhākoṭisamāvṛtam ।। 47 ।। raktavarṇaiḥ phalaughaiśca sthūlairapi vibhūṣitam । gopīkoṭisahasraiśca sārdhaṃ vṛndā manoharā ।। 48 ।। anuvrajaṃ sādaraṃ ca sasmitā sā samāyayau । avaruṅya rathāttūrṇaṃ rādhāṃ sā praṇanāma ca ।। 49 ।। rāseśvarīṃ tāṃ saṃbhāṣya praviveśa svamālayam । ratnasiṃhāsane ramye hīrahārasamanvite ।। 50 ।। vṛndā tāṃ vāsayāmāsa pādasevanatatparā । saptabhiśca sakhībhiśca sevitāṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ ।। 51 ।। āyayurgopikāḥ sarvā draṣṭuṃ tāṃ parameśvarīm । nandādikaṃ prakalpyaitadrādhā vāsaṃ pṛthakapṛthak ।। 52 ।। paramānandarūpā sā paramānandapūrvakam । svaveśmani mahāramye pratasthe gopikā saha ।। 53 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... aṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 128 ।।
<4.129> athaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārāyaṇa uvāca śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavāṃstatra paripūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ । dṛṣṭvā sārokyamokṣaṃ ca sadyo gokulavāsinām ।। 1 ।। uvāsa pañcabhirgopairbhāṇḍīre vaṭamūlake । dadarśa gokulaṃ sarva gokulaṃ vyākulaṃ tathā ।। 2 ।। arakṣakaṃ ca vyastaṃ ca śūnyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । yogenāmṛtavṛṣṭyā ca kṛpayā ca kṛpānidhiḥ ।। 3 ।। gopībhiśca tathā gopaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ cakāra saḥ । tathā vṛndāvanaṃ caiva suramyaṃ ca manoharam ।। 4 ।। gokulasthāśca gopāśca samāśvāsaṃ cakāra saḥ । uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ hitaṃ nītaṃ ca durlabham ।। 5 ।। śrī bhagavānuvāca he gopagaṇa he bandho sukhaṃ tiṣṭha sthiro bhava । ramaṇaṃ priyayā sārdhaṃ suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 6 ।। tāvatprabhṛti kṛṣṇasya puṇye vṛndāvane vane । adhiṣṭhānaṃ ca satataṃ yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 7 ।। tathā jagāma bhāṇḍīraṃ vidhātā jagatāmapi । svayaṃ śeṣaśca dharmaśca bhavānyā ca bhavaḥsvayam ।। 8 ।। sūryaścāpi mahendraśca candraścāpi hunāśanaḥ । kubero varuṇaścaiva pavanaśca yamastathā ।। 9 ।। īśānaścāpi devāśca vasavo'ṣṭau tathaiva ca । sarve grahāśca rudrāśca munayo manavastathā ।। 10 ।। tvaritāścā''yayuḥ sarve yatrā''ste bhagavānprabhuḥ । praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūbhau tamuvāca vidhiḥ svayam ।। 11 ।। brahmavāca paribūrṇatam brahmasvarūpa nityavigraha । jyotiḥsvarūpa parama namo'stu prakṛteḥ para ।। 12 ।। sunirlipta nirākāra sākāra dhyānahetunā । svecchāmaya paraṃ dhāma paramātmannamo'stu te ।। 13 ।। sarvakāryasvarūpeśa kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇa । brahmeśaśeṣadeveśa sarveśa te na... ।। 14 ।। sarasvatīśa padmeśa pārvatīśa parātpara । he sāvitrīśa rādheśa rāseśvara na... ।। 15 ।। sarveṣāmādibhūtarstvaṃ sarvaḥ sarveśvarastathā । sarvapātā ca saṃhartā sṛṣṭirūpa na... ।। 16 ।। tvatpādapadmarajasā dhanyā pūtā vasuṃdharā । śūnyarūpā tvayi gate he nātha paramaṃ padam ।। 17 ।। yatpañcaviṃśatyadhikaṃ varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ gatam । tyaktvemāṃ svapadaṃ yāsi rudatīṃ virahāturām ।। 18 ।। mahādeva uvāca brahmaṇā prārthitastvaṃ ca samāgatya vasuṃdharām । bhūbhāraharaṇaṃ kṛtvā prayāsi svapadaṃ vibho ।। 19 ।। trailokye pṛthivī dhanyā sadyaḥ pūtā padāṅkitā । vayaṃ ca munayo dhanyāḥ sākṣāddṛṣṭvā padāmbujam ।। 20 ।। dhyānāsādhyo durārādhyo munīnāmūrdhvaretasām । asmākamapi yaśceśaḥ so'dhunā cākṣuṣo bhuvi ।। 21 ।। vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvani yasya lomasu । devastasya mahāviṣṇurvāsudevo mahītale ।। 22 । suciraṃ tapasā labdhaṃ siddhendrāṇāṃ sudurlabham । yatpādapadmamatulaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ sarvajīvinām ।। 23 ।। ananta uvāca tvamananto hi bhagavannāhameva kalāṃśakaḥ । viśvaikasthe kṣudrakūrme maśako'haṃ gaje yathā ।। 24 ।। asaṃkhyaśeṣāḥ kūrmāśca brahmaviṣaṇuśivātmakāḥ । asaṃkhyāni ca viśvāni teṣāmīśaḥ svayaṃ bhavān ।। 25 ।। asmākamīdṛśaṃ nātha sudinaṃ kva bhaviṣyati । svapnādṛṣṭaścayaśceśaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ sarvajīvinām ।। 26 ।। nātha prayāsi golokaṃ pūtāṃ kṛtvā vasuṃdharām । tāmanāthāṃ rudantīṃ ca nimagnāṃ śokasāgare ।। 27 ।। devā ūcuḥ vedāḥstotuṃ na śaktā yaṃ brahmeśānādayastathā । tameva stavanaṃ kiṃ vā vayaṃ kurmo namo'stu te ।। 28 ।। ityevamuktvā devāste prayayurdvārakāṃ purīm । tatrasthaṃ bhagavantaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ śīghraṃ mudā'nvitāḥ ।। 29 ।। atha teṣāṃ ca gopālā yayurgolokamuttamam । pṛthivī kampitā bhītā calantaḥ saptasāgarāḥ ।। 30 ।। hataśriyaṃ dvārakāṃ ca tyaktvā ca brahmaśāpataḥ । mūrtiṃ kadambamūlasthāṃ viveśa rādhikeśvaraḥ ।। 31 ।। te sarve cairakāyuddhe nipeturyādavāstathā । citāmāruhya devyaśca prayayuḥ svāmibhiḥ saha ।। 32 ।। arjunaḥ svapuraṃ gatvā samuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram । sa rājā bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ yayau svargaṃ ca bhāryayā ।। 33 ।। dṛṣṭvā kadambamūlasthaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram । devā brahmādayaste ca praṇemurbhaktipūrvakam ।। 34 ।। tuṣṭuvuḥ paramātmānaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum । śyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ bhūṣitaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 35 ।। vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānaṃ śobhitaṃ vanamālayā । atīva sundaraṃ śāntaṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ manoharam ।। 36 ।। vyādhāstrasaṃyutaṃ pādapadmaṃ padmādivanditam । dṛṣṭvā brahmādidevāṃstānabhayaṃ sasmitaṃ dadau ।। 37 ।। pṛthivīṃ tāṃ samāśvāsya rudatīṃ premavihvalām । vyādhaṃ prasthāpayāmāsa paraṃ svapadamuttamam ।। 38 ।। balasya tejaḥ śeṣe ca viveśa paramādbhutam । pradyumnasya ca kāme vai vā'niruddhasya brahmaṇi ।। 39 ।। ayonisaṃbhavā devī mahālakṣmīśca rukmiṇī । vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau sākṣātsvaśarīreṇa nārada ।। 40 ।। satyabhāmā pṛthivyāṃ ca viveśa kamalālayā । svayaṃ jāmbavatī devī pārvatyāṃ viśvamātari ।। 41 ।। yā yā devyaśca yāsāṃ cāpyaṃśarupāśca bhūtale । tasyāṃ tasyāṃ praviviśustā eva ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 42 ।। sāmbasya tejaḥ skande ca viveśa paramādbhutam । kaśyape vasudevaścāpyadivyāṃ devakī tathā ।। 43 ।। rukmiṇīmandiraṃ tyakatvā samastāṃ dvārakāṃ purīm । sa jagrāha samudraśca praphullavadanekṣaṇaḥ ।। 44 ।। lapaṇodaḥ samāgatya tuṣṭāva puruṣottamam । ruroda tadviyogena sāśrunetraśca vihvalaḥ ।। 45 ।। gaṅgā sarasvatī padmāvatī ca yamunā tathā । godāvarī svarṇarekhā kāverī narmadā mune ।। 46 ।। śarāvatī bāhṛdā ca kṛtamālā ca puṇyadā । samāyayuśca tāḥ sarvāḥ praṇemuḥ parameśvaram ।। 47 ।। uvāca jāhnavī devī rudatī parameśvaram । sāśrunetrā'tidīnā sā virahajvarakātarā ।। 48 ।। bhāgīrathayuvāca he nātha ramaṇaśreṣṭha yāsi golokamuttamam । asmākaṃ kā gatiścātra bhaviṣyati kalau yuge ।। 49 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca kaleḥ pañcasahasrāṇi varṣāṇi tiṣṭha bhūtale । pāpāni pāpino yāni tubhyaṃ dāsyanti snānata ।। 50 ।। manmantropāsakasparśādbhasmībhūtāni tatkṣaṇāt । bhaviṣyanti darśanācca snānādeva hi jāhnavi ।। 51 ।। harernāmāni yatraiva purāṇāni bhavanti hi । tatra gatvā sāvadhānamābhiḥ sārdhaṃ ca śroṣyasi ।। 52 ।। purāṇaśravaṇāccaiva harernāmānukīrtanāt । bhasmībhūtāni pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ।। 53 ।। bhasmībhūtāni tānyeva vaiṣṇavāliṅganena ca । tṛṇāni śuṣkakāṣṭhāni dahanti pāvakā yathā ।। 54 ।। tathā'pi vaiṣṇavā loke pāpāni pāpināmapi । pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyapi ca jāhnavi ।। 55 ।। madbhaktānāṃ śarīreṣu santi pūteṣu saṃtatam । madbhaktapādarajasā sadyaḥ pūtā vasuṃdharā ।। 56 ।। sadyaḥ pūtāni tīrthāni sadyāḥ pūtaṃ jagattathā । manmantropāsakā viprā ye maducchiṣṭabhojinaḥ ।। 57 ।। māmeva nityaṃ dhyāyante te matprāṇādhikāḥ priyāḥ । tadupasparśamātreṇa pūto vāyuśca pāvakaḥ ।। 58 ।। kalerdaśasahasrāṇi madbhaktāḥ santi bhūtale । ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti madbhakteṣu gateṣu ca ।। 59 ।। madbhaktaśūnyā pṛthivī kaligrastā bhaviṣyati । etasminnantare tatra kṛṣṇadehādvinirgataḥ ।। 60 ।। caturbhujaśca puruṣaḥ śatacandrasamaprabhaḥ । śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīvatsalāñchanaḥ ।। 61 ।। sundaraṃ rathamāruhya śrīrodaṃ sa jagāma ha । sindhukanyā ca prayayau svayaṃ mūrtimatī satī ।। 62 ।। śrīkṛṣṇamanasā jātā martyalakṣmīrmanoharā । śvetadvīpaṃ gate viṣṇau jagatpālanakartari ।। 63 ।। śuddhasattvasvarūpe ca dvidhārūpo babhūva saḥ । dakṣiṇāṃśaśca dvibhujo gopabārakarūpakaḥ ।। 64 ।। napīnajaladaśyāmaḥ śobhitaḥ pītavāsasā । śrīvaṃśavadanaḥ śrīmānsasmitaḥ padmalocanaḥ ।। 65 ।। śatakoṭīndusaundaryaṃ śatakoṭismaraprabhām । dadhānaḥ paramānandaḥ paribūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 66 ।। paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahmasvarūpo nirguṇaḥ svayam । paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।। 67 ।। nityadehaśca bhagavānīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ । yogino yaṃ vadantyevaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam ।। 68 ।। jyotiramyantare nityarūpaṃ bhaktā vidanti yam । vedā vadanti satyaṃ yaṃ nityamādyaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ ।। 69 ।। yaṃ vadanti surāḥ sarve paraṃ svecchāmayaṃ prabhūm । siddhendrā munayaḥ sarve sarvarūpaṃ vadanti yam ।। 70 ।। yamanirvacanīyaṃ ca yogīndraḥ śaṃkaro vadet । svayaṃ vidhātā pravadetkāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। 71 ।। śeṣo vadedanantaṃ yaṃ navadhārūpamīśvaram । tarkāṇāmeva ṣaṇṇāṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ rūpamīpsitam ।। 72 ।। vaiṣṇavānāmekarūpaṃ vedānāmekameva ca । purāṇānāmekarūpaṃ tasmānnavavidhaṃ smṛtam ।। 73 ।। nyāyo'nirvacanīyaṃ ca yaṃ mataṃ śaṃkaro vadet । nityaṃ vaiśeṣikāścā''dyaṃ taṃ vadanti vicakṣaṇāḥ ।। 74 ।। sāṃkhya vadanti taṃ devaṃ jyotīrūpaṃ sanātanam । mīmāṃsā sarvarūpaṃ ca vedāntaḥ sarvakāraṇam ।। 75 ।। pātañjalo'pyanantaṃ ca vedāḥ satyasvarūpakam । svecchāmayaṃ purāṇaṃ ca bhaktāśca nityavigraham ।। 76 ।। so'yaṃ golokanāthaśca rādheśo nandanandanaḥ । gokule gopaveṣaśca puṇye vṛndāvane vane ।। 77 ।। caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe mahālakṣmīpatiḥ svayam । nārāyaṇaśca bhagavānyannāma muktikāraṇam ।। 78 ।। sakṛnnārāyaṇetyuktvā pumānkalpaśatatrayam । gaṅgādisarvatīrtheṣu snāto bhavati nārada ।। 79 ।। sunandanandakumudaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parivāritaḥ । śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ śrīvatsalāñchanaḥ ।। 80 ।। kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa bhūṣito vanamālayā । devaiḥ stutaśca yānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ svapadaṃ yayau ।। 81 ।। gate vaikuṇṭhanāthe ca rādheśaśca svayaṃ prabhuḥ । cakāra vaṃśīśabdaṃ ca trailokyamohanaṃ param ।। 82 ।। mūrcchāṃprāpurdevagaṇā munayaścāpi nārada । acetanā babhūvuśca māyayā pārvatīṃ vinā ।। 83 ।। uvāca pārvatī devī bhagavantaṃ sanātanam । viṣṇumāyā bhagavatī sarvarūpā sanātanī ।। 84 ।। parabrahmasvarūpā yā paramātmasvarūpiṇī । saguṇā nirguṇā sā ca parā svecchāmayī satī ।। 85 ।। pārvatyuvāca ekā'haṃ rādhikārūpā goloke rāsamaṇḍale । rāsaśūnyaṃ ca golokaṃ paripūrṇa kuru prabho ।। 86 ।। gaccha tvaṃ rathamāruhya muktāmāṇikyabhūṣitam । paribūrṇatamā'haṃ ca tava vaṅaḥ sthalasthitā ।। 87 ।। tavā''jñayā mahālakṣmīrahaṃ vaikuṇṭhagāminī । sarasvatī ca tatraiva vāme pārśve harerapi ।। 88 ।। tavāhaṃ manasā jātā sindhukanyā tavā''jñayā । sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ kalayā vidhisaṃnidhau ।। 89 ।। taijaḥsu sarvadevānāṃ purā satye tavā''jñayā । adhiṣṭhānaṃ kṛta tatra dhṛtaṃ devyā śarīrakam ।। 90 ।। śumbhādayaśca daityāśca nihatāścāvalīlayā । durga nihatya turgā'haṃ tripurā tripure vadhe ।। 91 ।। nihatya raktabījaṃ ca raktabījavināśinī । tavā''jñayā dakṣakanyā satī satyasvarūpiṇī ।। 92 ।। yogena tyaktvā dehaṃ ca śailajā'haṃ tavā''jñayā । tvayā dattavā (ttāḥ śaṃkarāya goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 93 ।। viṣṇubhaktirahaṃ tena viṣṇumāyā ca vaiṣṇavī । nārāyaṇasya māyā'haṃ tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā ।। 94 ।। kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā'haṃ ca prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā । mahāviṣṇośca vāsośca jananī rādhikā svayam ।। 95 ।। tavā''jñayā pañcadhā'haṃ pañcaprakṛtirūpiṇī । kalākalāṃśayā'haṃ ca devapatnayo gṛhe gṛhe ।। 96 ।। śīghraṃ gaccha mahābhāga tatrā'haṃ virahāturā । govībhiḥ sahitā rāsaṃ bhramantī paritaḥ sadā ।। 97 ।। pārvatīvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya rasikeśvaraḥ । ratnayānaṃ samāruhya yayau golokamuttamam ।। 98 ।। pārvatī bodhayāmāsa svayaṃ devagaṇaṃ tathā । māyāvaṃśīravācchannaṃ viṣṇumāyā sanātanī ।। 99 ।। kṛtvā te hariśabdaṃ ca svagṛhaṃ vismayaṃ yayuḥ । śivena sārdhaṃ durgā sā prahṛṣṭā svapuraṃ yayau ।। 100 ।। atha kṛṣṇaṃ samāyāntaṃ rādhā gopīgaṇaiḥ saha । anuvrajaṃ yayau hṛṣṭā sarvajñā prāṇavallabham ।। 101 ।। dṛṣṭvā samīpamāyāntamavaruhya rathātsatī । praṇanāma jagannāthaṃ sirasā sakhibhiḥ saha ।। 102 ।। gopā gopyaśca muditāḥ praphullavadanekṣaṇāḥ । duṃdubhiṃ vādayāmāsurīśvarāgamanotsukāḥ ।। 103 ।। virajāṃ ca samuttīrya dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ jagatpatiḥ । avaruhya rathāttūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā rādhikākaram ।। 104 ।। śataśṛṅgaṃ ca babhrāma suramyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam । dṛṣṭvā'kṣayavaṭaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau ।। 105 ।। tulasīkānanaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayayau mālatīvanam । vāme kṛtvā kundavanaṃ mādhavīkānanaṃ tathā ।। 106 ।। cakāra dakṣiṇe kṛṣṇaścampakāraṇyamīpsinam । cakāra paścāttūrṇaṃ ca cārucandanakānanam ।। 107 ।। dadarśa purato ramyaṃ rādhikābhavanaṃ param । uvāsa rādhayā sārdhaṃ ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।। 108 ।। sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ bubhuje vāsitaṃ jalam । suṣvāpa puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite ।। 109 ।। sa reme rāmayā sārdhaṃ nimagno rasasāgare । ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dharmavaktrācca yacchrutam ।। 110 ।। golokārohaṇaṃ ramyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 111 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... golokārohaṇaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 129 ।।
<4.130> atha triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ nārada uvāca sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mahābhāga nāraśeṣamabhīpsitam । kimapūrva purāṇaṃ ca brahmavaivartamiṣṭadam ।। 1 ।। adhunā kiṃ kariṣyāmi tanmāṃ brūhi jagadguro । ājñāṃ kuru tapasyāṃ ca kartu yāmi himālayam ।। 2 ।। nārāyaṇa uvāca uvabarhaṇagandhardaḥ pañcaśatkāminīpatiḥ । janmāntare bhavānāsīdadhunā brahmaputrakaḥ ।। 3 ।। tāsvekā ca satī ramyā tapasā śaṃkaraṃ param । ārādhya ca varaṃ lebhe vāñchitaṃ nāradaṃ patim ।। 4 ।। sā ca sṛñjayakanyā ca svarṇaṣṭhīvīsahodarā । tāṃ vivāhaṃ kuruṣveti śaṃkarājñā kathaṃ vṛthā ।। 5 ।। sundarī sundarīṣvevaṃ komalāṃ kamalākalām । pativratāṃ mahābhagāṃ ramyāṃ supriyavādinīm ।। 6 ।। kāmukīṃ kamanīyāṃ ca śaśvatsusthirayauvanām । vidhātrā likhitaṃ karma prāktanaṃ kena vāryate ।। 7 ।।nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi । avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ śubhāśubham ।। 8 ।। sūta uvāca nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā hṛdayena vidūyatā । praṇamya prayayau śīghraṃ nāradaḥ sṛñjayālayam ।। 9 ।। śaunaka uvāca aho sūta mahābhāga śrutaṃ kiṃ paramādbhutam । kimapūrvaṃ rahasyaṃ ca sarasaṃ ca purātanam ।। 10 ।। adhunā śrotumicchāmi vivāhaṃ nāradasya ca । atīndriyasya ca munerbrahmaputrasya sāṃpratam ।। 11 ।। sūta uvāca nārado mū(gu)ḍharupaśca dṛṣṭāvā sṛñjayakanyakām । tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇām ।। 12 ।। yayau brahmasabhāṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevaiḥ samāvṛtām । praṇamya pitaraṃ śāntaḥ sarvaṃ tattvamuvāca tam ।। 13 ।। brahmā prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrutvā vārtāṃ śubhāvahām । tapasvinaṃ ca putraṃ ca saṃprāpya jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। 14 ।। ratnanirmāṇayānena sārdhaṃ devaiḥ śubhe kṣaṇe । putraṃ kṛtvā ca purato yayau sṛñjayamandiram ।। 15 ।। tacchrutvā sṛñjayo rājā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām । gṛhītvā kanyakāṃ ramyāṃ nāradāya dadau mudā ।। 16 ।। sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā maṇimuktādikaṃ tathā । puṭāñjaliyuto bhūtvā parihāre cakāra saḥ ।। 17 ।। kanyāṃ samarpya brahmāṇaṃ rājā ca yogināṃ varaḥ । ruroda bhṛśamuccaiśca vatse vatsa itīritam ।। 18 ।। kva yāsi tyaktvā madgehaṃ śūnyaṃ ka malalocane । ahaṃ yāmi vanaṃ ghoraṃ tvāṃ tyaktvā jīvito mṛtaḥ ।। 19 ।। praṇamya pitaraṃ kanyā rudantaṃ mātaraṃ tathā । rudatīṃ tāṃ rudantī sā'pyāruroha rathaṃ vidheḥ ।। 20 ।। gṛhītvā ca sabhāryaṃ ca putraṃ dhātā mudā'nvitaḥ । prayayau brahmalokaṃ ca devandrairmunibhiḥ saha ।। 21 ।। brāhmaṇānbojayāmāsa sāṅge maṅgalakarmaṇi । devānapi ca siddhāṃśca vādayāmāsa duṃdubhim ।। 22 ।। nāradastu muniśreṣṭho bādhitaḥ pūrvakarmaṇā । yasya yatprāktanaṃ vipra durlaṅdhya kena vāryate ।। 23 ।। suramye puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite । sa reme rāmayā sārdha bubudhe na divāniśam ।। 24 ।। evaṃ kṛtvā vivāhaṃ ca virato munisattamaḥ । uvāsa brahmalokeṣu vaṭamūle manohare ।। 25 ।। tatrā''jagāma nagnaśca prajvalanbrahmatejasā । sanatkumāro bhagavānsākṣācca bālako yathā ।। 26 ।। sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaśca vayasā yathaiva pañcahāyanaḥ । ayūḍo'nupanītaśca vedasaṃdhyāvihīnakaḥ ।। 27 ।। kṛṣṇeti mantraṃ japati yasya nārāyaṇo guruḥ । anantakālakalpaṃ ca bhrātṛbhiśca tribhiḥ saha ।। 28 ।। vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśo jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ । ārāddṛṣṭvā nārādastaṃ bhrātaraṃ ca satāṃ varam ।। 29 ।। sahasā śirasā bhūmau daṇḍavatpraṇanāma tam । uvāca nāradaṃ bālaḥ prahasya paramārthakam ।। 30 ।। sanatkumāra uvāca aye bhrātaḥ kiṃ karoṣi kuśalaṃ yuvatīpateḥ । strīpuṃsorvardhate prema nityaṃ tannityanūtanam ।। 31 ।। argalaṃ jñānamārgasya bhaktidvārakapāṭakam । mokṣamārgavyavahitaṃ ciraṃ bandhanakāraṇam ।। 32 ।। garbhavāsasya bījaṃ ca paraṃ narakakāraṇam । pīyūṣabuddhyā garalaṃ bhuṅkte pāpī narādhamaḥ ।। 33 ।। paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā yasyā''ste viṣaye manaḥ । sa vañcito māyayā cāmṛtaṃ tyaktvā viṣaṃ bhajet ।। 34 ।। sarveṣāṃ karmabhoge'sti karmiṇāmīśvaraṃ vinā । vayaṃ vidhātuḥ putrāśca sā buddhiriti dehinām ।। 35 ।। yadi te nāsti bhogaśca kathaṃ gandharvajanma ca ।kathaṃ dāsīsutastvaṃ ca muktaśca bhaktasaṅgataḥ ।। 36 ।। nirgaccha tapase bhrātastyaja mayāmayīṃ priyām । supuṇye bhārate varṣe tapasā bhaja mādhavam ।। 37 ।। sthite nārāyaṇe sveśe pare svapadadātari । viṣayī viṣayāndhaśca vañcito māyayā dhruvam ।। 38 ।। gṛhāṇa mama mantraṃ ca kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam । sarveṣāmeva santrāṇāṃ sārātsāraṃ parātparam ।। 39 ।। sarveṣu ca purāṇeṣu vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca । dharmaśāstraiṣu tantraiṣu nāstyevāsmātparo manuḥ ।। 40 ।। nārāyaṇena datto me puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi । asaṃkhyakalpa japtvā'haṃ bhramāmi sarvapūjitaḥ ।। 41 ।। ityuktvā snāpayitvā taṃ dadau dasmai paraṃ manum । divāniśaṃ sa japati pūtayā maṇimālayā ।। 42 ।। tasmai śubhāśiṣaṃ dattvā mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ । golokaṃ prayayau draṣṭuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 43 ।। nāradastu manu prāpya sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam । śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ pūrvakarmanikṛntanīm ।। 44 ।। tyaktvā māyāmayīṃ bhāryāṃ bhārataṃ tapase yayau । kṛtamālānadītīre dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ param ।। 45 ।। dṛṣṭvā ca sahasā mūrdhnā praṇanāma śivaṃ muniḥ । tamuvāca jagannātho bhaktaṃ ca bhaktavatsalaḥ ।। 46 ।। mahādeva uvāca aho nārada dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ prasanno'haṃ svatejasā । bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ yatra sudinaṃ taccharīriṇām ।। 47 ।। ayaṃ hi paramo lābho dehināṃ baktasaṃgamaḥ । sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yo dadarśa ca vaiṣṇavām ।। 48 ।। api prāpto mahāmantraḥ sarvatantrasudurlabhaḥ । mayā datto gaṇeśāya skandāya svātmajāya ca ।। 49 ।। mahyaṃ dattaśca kṛṣṇena goloke rāsamaṇḍale । brahmaṇe cāpi dharmāya dharmo nārāyaṇāya ca ।। 50 ।। brahmā sanatkumārāya tumyaṃ dattaśca tena vai । mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jano nārāyaṇo bhavet ।। 51 ।। vicāraṇaṃ ca nāstyatra kālākālaṃ śubhāśubham । pañcalakṣajapenaiva puraścaraṇamasya ca ।। 52 ।। dhyānaṃ ca sāmavedoktaṃ tena dhyāyecca vaiṣṇavaḥ । dhyānaṃ ca pāpadahanaṃ karmamūlanikṛntanam ।। 53 ।। kṛṣṇaṃ navaghanaśyāmaṃ kiśoraṃ pītavāsasam । śatakoṭīndusaundaryaṃ dadhānamatulaṃ param ।। 54 ।। bhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇaughaistairamūlyaratnanirmitaiḥ । candanokṣitasarvāṅgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam ।। 55 ।। mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca mālatīmālyamaṇḍitam । īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ nityopāsyaṃ śivādibhiḥ ।। 56 ।। dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ nirguṇaṃ prakṛteḥ param । sarveṣāṃ paramātmānaṃ bhaktānugrahavigraham ।। 57 ।। vedānirvacanīyaṃ ta varaṃ sarveśvaraṃ bhaje । dhyānenānena taṃ dhyātvā bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 58 ।। bhaja taṃ paramānandaṃ satyaṃ nityaṃ parātparam । ityuktvā svapadaṃ śaṃbhūrjagām parameśvaraḥ ।। 59 ।। taṃ praṇamya jagannāthaṃ nāradastapase yayau । nāradaḥ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā yogāttyaktvā kalevaram nilīnaḥ pādapadme ca pāda (padmā) padmārcite hareḥ ।। 60 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... nāradavivāhādiprakaraṇaṃ nāma triṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 130 ।।
<4.131> adhai katriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ śaunaka uvāca atyapūrvamupākhyānaṃ śrutaṃ paramamādbhutam । sugopyaṃ ca sugopyaṃ ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam ।। 1 ।। kimanirvacanīyaṃ ca kamanīyaṃ manoharam । sudurlabhā kathā proktā purāṇeṣu purātanī ।। 2 ।। evaṃbhūtaṃ ca sudinaṃ kadā'smākaṃ phaviṣyati । tajjanma saphalaṃ dhanyaṃ yatra vaiṣṇavasaṃgamaḥ ।। 3 ।। garbhavāsocchedanaṃ ca karmamūlanikṛntanam । haridāsyapradaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaktānāṃ bhaktivardhanam ।। 4 ।। asādhusaṅgadurbuddhipāponmūlanakāraṇam । gaṇeśajanmopakhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sudurlabham ।। 5 ।। tulasīrādhikākhyānaṃ kimapūrva śrutaṃ param । anyadyadyadgopanīyaṃ vyaktamavyaktamīpsitam ।। 6 ।। sarvaṃ śrutaṃ mahābhāga paribūrṇaṃ manoharam । adhunā śrotumicchāmi vahnerutpattimīpsitām svarṇasya ca mahābhāga tanme vyākhyātumarhasi ।। 7 ।। sūta uvāca sāmagrīkaraṇaṃ sṛṣṭerjalameva hutāśanaḥ । tathaiva prakṛtirnityā mahāneva tathaiva ca ।। 8 ।। yathā diśo mahākāśo yayaiva sṛṣṭigolakam । prakṛtermahataśca syādya thā'haṃkāra eva ca ।। 9 ।। yathaiva śabdastanmātraṃ tathaiva ca hutāśanaḥ । tathā'pi tatsamutpattiṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya ।। 10 ।। ekadā sṛṣṭikāle ca brahmānantamaheśvarāḥ । śvetadvīpaṃ yayuḥ sarve draṣṭuṃ viṣṇuṃ jagatpatim ।। 11 ।। parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣāṃ kṛtvā siṃhāsaneṣu ca । ūcuḥ sarve sabhāmadhye suramye purato vibhoḥ ।। 12 ।। viṣṇugātrodbhavāstatra kāminyaḥ kamalākalāḥ । tatra nṛtyanti gāyanti viṣṇugāthāśca ।। susvaram ।। 13 ।। tāsāṃ ca kaṭhināṃ śroṇiṃ kaṭhinaṃ stanamaṇḍalam । sasmitaṃ mukhapadmaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā brahmā sukāmukaḥ ।। 14 ।। manonivāraṇaṃ kartuṃ na śaśāka pitāmahaḥ । vīryaṃ papāta cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā vibhuḥ ।। 15 ।। tadvīryaṃ vastrasahitaṃ prataptaṃ kāmatāpataḥ । kṣīrode prerayāmāsa saṃgīte virate dvija ।। 16 ।। jalādutthāya puruṣaḥ prajvalanbrahmatejasā । uvāsa brahmaṇaḥ kroḍe lajjitasya ca saṃsadi ।। 17 ।। etasminnantare ruṣṭo jalādutthāya satvaraḥ । praṇamya varuṇo devānbālaṃ netuṃ samudyataḥ ।। 18 ।। bālo dadhāra brahmāṇaṃ bāhumyāṃ ca bhayādrudan । kiṃ cinnovāca jagatāṃ vidhātā lajjayā dvija ।। 19 ।। bālakasya kare dhṛtvā cakāra''karṣaṇaṃ ruṣā । varuṇaśca sabhāmadhye taṃ cikṣepa prajāpatiḥ ।। 20 ।। papāta dūrato devo varuṇo durbalastataḥ । mūrchāṃ saṃprāpa mṛtavatkopadṛṣṭyā vidheraho ।। 21 ।। cetanaṃ kārayāmāsāmṛtadṛṣṭyā ca śaṃkaraḥ । saṃprāpya cetanaṃ tatra tamuvāca jaleśvaraḥ ।। 22 ।। varuṇa uvāca bālo jale samudbhūto mama putro'yamīpsitaḥ । ahaṃ gṛhītvā yāsyāmi brahmā māṃ tāḍayetkatham ।। 23 ।। brahmovāca vālakaḥ śaraṇāpanno mayi viṣṇo maheśvara । kathaṃ dāsyāmi bhītaṃ ca rudantaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 24 ।। śaraṇāgatadīnārtaṃ yo na rakṣedapaṇḍitaḥ । pacyate niraye tāvadyāvaccandradivākarau ।। 25 ।। ubhayorvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya madhusūdhanaḥ । uvāca tatra sarvajñaḥ sarveśaśca yathocitam ।। 26 ।। śrībhagavānuvāca dṛṣṭvā tu kāminīśroṇiṃ vīryaṃ dhātuḥ papāta tat । lajjayā prerayāmāsa kṣīrode nirmale jale ।। 27 ।। tatau babhūva bālaśca dharmato vidhiputrakaḥ । kṣetrajñaśca sutaḥ śāstre varuṇasyāpi gauṇataḥ ।। 28 ।। mahādeva uvāca yo vidyāyonisaṃbandho vedeṣu ca nirūpitaḥ । śiṣye putre ca samatā ceti vedavido viduḥ ।। 29 ।। mantraṃ dadātu varuṇo vidyāṃca bārakāya ca । putro vidhāturvaṅniśca śiṣyaśya varuṇasya ca ।। 30 ।। viṣṇurdadātu bālāya dāhikāṃ saktimujjvalām । sarvadagdho hutāśaśca nirvāṇo varuṇena ca ।। 31 ।। viṣṇuśca dāhikāṃ śaktiṃ dadau tasmai śivājñayā । mantraṃ vidyāṃ ca varuṇo ratnamālāṃ manoharām ।। 32 ।। kroḍe kṛtvā ca taṃ bālaṃ cucumba māyayā suraḥ । brahmaṇe ca dadau sākṣādviṣṇuśaṃkarayorapi ।। 33 ।। praṇamya viṣṇuṃ brahmā ca yayau śaṃbhuḥ svamandiram । agnyutpattiśca kathitā svarṇotpattiṃ niśāmaya ।। 34 ।। vilokya rambhāṃ suśroṇiṃ sakāmo vahnireva ca । papāta vīryaṃ cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā tathā ।। 35 ।। vilokya rambhāṃ suśroṇiṃ sakāmo vahnireva ca । papāta vīrya cacchāda lajjayā vāsasā tathā ।। 36 ।। uttasthau svarṇapuñjaśca vastraṃ kṣiptvā jvalatprabhaḥ । kṣaṇena vardhayāmāsa sa sumerurbabhūva ha ।। 37 ।। hiraṇyaretasaṃ vahniṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ । iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।। 38 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nārādanā... vahnisuvarṇotpattirnāmaikatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 131 ।।
<4.132> atha dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ śaunaka uvāca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ nāvaśeṣaṃ dharmeśa vrahmaṇaṃ ca mām । kathayasva mahābhāga purāṇaṃ punareva hi ।। 1 ।। evaṃvidhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca janmanaiva na hi śrutam । nadhṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ tāta tā (tvā) dṛśaṃ vājakaṃ tathā ।। 2 ।। sūta uvāca śrūyatāṃ bho mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ ca saṃyatam । adhyāyaśravaṇenaiva purāṇaphalamālabhet ।। 3 ।। brahmakhaṇḍaṃ ca kathitaṃ paraṃ brahmanirūpaṇam । tadanirvacanīyaṃ ca yeṣāmapi yathāgamam ।। 4 ।। sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ pṛthak । yeṣāmapi yathā śaktistathaiva dhyānameva ca ।। 5 ।। golokādervarṇanaṃ ca krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak । tatropayuktopākhyānaṃ yadyatprāsaṅgikaṃ dvija ।। 6 ।। jātīnāṃ nīrṇayaścaiva saṃkarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca । yadyadviśiṣṭopākhyānaṃ tattatpraśanānurodhataḥ ।। 7 ।। rādhāmādhavayoḥ krīḍā mahāviṣṇoḥ samudbhavaḥ । nirūpaṇaṃ ca viśveṣāṃ samāsena dvijottama ।। 8 ।। brahmanāradayoścaiva saṃvādaḥ paramārthataḥ । vipeko nāradasyaiva munīndrasya tathaiva ca ।। 9 ।। ājñayā brahmaṇaścaiva naranārāyaṇāśramam । gamanaṃ nāradasyaiva tena sārthaṃ ca darśanam ।। 10 ।। tayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ caiva nāradādya(ya) nivedanam । tatra deva brahmakhaṇḍaṃ krameṇoktaṃ dvijottama ।। 11 ।। śrūyatāṃ prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ sudhākhaṇḍasamaṃ mune । prakṛterlakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca varṇanam ।। 12 ।। upāśyānaṃ ca tāsāṃ ca varṇanaṃ būjanādikam । lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī durgā sāvitrī rādhikā tathā ।। 13 ।। etāsāṃ caritaṃ caivamanyāsāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak । upākhyānaṃ mahālakṣmyāḥ sarasvatyāstathaiva ca ।। 14 ।। apūrvaṃ rādhikākhyānaṃ sāvitryāśca tathaiva ca । saṃvādo yamasāvitryoḥ satyavajjīvadānakam ।। 15 ।। kṛṇḍānāṃ varṇanaṃ proktaṃ teṣāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ tathā । jīvitarmavipākaśca bhoganirṇaya eva ca ।। 16 ।। apūrva rādhikākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sugopyakam । suyajñasca nṛpendrasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 17 ।। proktaṃ tulasyupākhyānaṃ purāṇeṣu sugopyakam । mahāyuddhaṃ ca saṃvāde maheśaśaṅkhacūḍayoḥ ।। 18 ।। tulasīkṛṣṇasaṃvādastayoḥ saṃbhoga eva ca । nidhanaṃ śaṅkhacūḍasya śrīdāmnaḥ śāpamokṣaṇam ।। 19 ।। padaprāptiḥ surāṇāṃ ca vipadāṃ khaṇḍanaṃ tathā । jīvināṃ mokṣabījaṃ ca gaṅgopākhyānamīpsitam ।। 20 ।। tathaiva manasākhyānaṃ paraṃ harṣavivardhanam । svāhāsvadhākhyānamevamanyāsāṃ ca nirūpaṇam ।। 21 ।। yadyataprāsaṅgikākhyānaṃ vaktuḥ praśnānurodhataḥ । proktaṃ tatprakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ khaṇḍaṃ gaṇapateḥ śrṛṇu ।। 22 ।। atīva madhuraṃ ramyaṃ svādu svādu pade pade । sugopyaṃ tatpurāṇeṣu ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam ।। 23 ।। sudurlabhamupākhyānaṃ śrotṛprītikaraṃ param । proktā krīḍā ca paramā pārvatīparameśayoḥ ।। 24 ।। skandotpattiḥ prathamataḥ krīḍābhaṅgastayostathā । pārvatītoṣaṇaṃ caivamabhimānavimokṣaṇam ।। 25 ।। puṇyakaṃ ca vrataṃ viṣṇordevyāścaritamuttamam । varadānaṃ harereva suvratāṃ pārvatīṃ prati ।। 26।। hareśca darśanaṃ caiva brāhmaṇātithirūpiṇaḥ । āvirbhāvo gaṇeśasya kṛpayā śivamandire ।। 27 ।। darśanaṃ putravaktrasya pārvatīparameśayoḥ । paramānandarūpaṃ ca śivagehe mahotsavam ।। 28 ।। devādyā dadṛśuḥ sarve bālaṃ nityamajaṃ vibhum । satyasvarūpaṃ paramaṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇam ।। 29 ।। sarvavighnaharaṃ śāntaṃ dātāraṃ sarvasaṃpadām । tapasāṃ japayajñānāṃ vratānāṃ phaladaṃ vibhum ।। 30 ।। atīva kamanīyaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca yoṣitām । prāṇādhikaṃ priyatam pārvatīparameśayoḥ ।। 31 ।। paramātmasvarūpaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam । sarveśaṃ sarvabījaṃ ca sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam ।। 32 ।। yaddarśanācca stavanātpraṇāmātpūjanāttathā । dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ janmakoṭyaghanāśanam ।। 33 ।। kārtikoddharaṇaṃ proktaṃ tasyābhiṣeka eva ca । gaṇeśapūjanaṃ caiva sarvavighnavināśanam ।। 34 ।। jamadagneśca yuddhaṃ ca kārtavīryārjunena ca । surabhīharaṇaṃ caiva nidhanaṃ ca munestathā ।। 35 ।। pativratāreśukāyāścitārohaṇameva ca । pratijñātaṃ bhṛgoścaiva dāruṇaṃ ca sudāruṇam ।। 36 ।। niḥkṣatrīkaraṇaṃ caivamekaviṃśatikaṃ dvija । saṃvādo jñānalābhaśca gaṇeśaparśurāmayoḥ ।। 37 ।। tayoryuddhaṃ dārumaṃ ca herambadantabhañjanam । durgāyāśca vilāpaścābhiśāpo bhārgavaṃ prati ।। 38 ।। smaraṇe parśurāmasyāpyāvirbhāvo harerapi । pārvatīṃ bodhayāmāsa svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 39 ।। varṇanaṃ śivalokasya paramāścaryamīpsitam । pradattaṃ parśurāmāya mahāstraṃ śaṃkareṇa ca ।। 40 ।। mantraṃ ca kavacaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ । varadānaṃ cābhayaṃ ca pradānaṃ sarvasaṃpadām ।। 41 ।। triḥsaptakṛtvo bhūpānāṃ nidhanaṃ ca cakāra saḥ । babhūva bhṛguṇā vipra bhuvaśca bhāramīkṣaṇam ।। 42 ।। praśnānurodhakramataḥ pūrvāpākhyānameva ca । proktaṃ gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ samāsena dvijottama ।। 43 ।। śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ । janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiharaṃ mokṣakaraṃ param ।। 44 ।। haridāsyapradaṃ śuddhaṃ suśrāvyaṃ ca sudhopamam । atyabūrvamuṇākhyānaṃ ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam ।। 45 ।। na śrutaṃ canmanā yadyatsvadu svādu pade pade । pradīpaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ bhavābdhitāraṇaṃ param ।। 46 ।। karmepabhogarogāṇāṃ mardanaṃ ca rasāyanam । śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojaprāptisopānakāraṇam ।। 47 ।। śrīdāmarādhākalahavarṇanaṃ dāruṇaṃ dvija । tayoḥ śāpaprakathanaṃ tatasteṣāṃ visarjanam ।। 48 ।। brahmaṇa prārthitasyaiva harerjanam mahītale । proktaṃ ca janmakhaṇḍe ca paramādbhutameva ca ।। 49 ।। āvirbhāvo harereva vasudevasya mandire । kaṃsāsurabhayenaiva gokule gamanaṃ hareḥ ।। 50 ।। vṛṣabhānasutā rādhā śrīdāmnaḥ śāpahetunā । bālakrīḍāvarṇanaṃ ca gokule paramātmanaḥ ।। 51 ।। daityādinidhanaṃ caiva kīrtitaṃ hariṇā tathā । gargasyā''gamanaṃ proktaṃ śubhānnaprāśanaṃ hareḥ ।। 52 ।। nidhanaṃ pūtanāyāśca sadyaḥ śakaṭabhañjanam । śrīkṛṣṇabandhamokṣaṃ ca yamalārjunabhañjanam ।। 53 ।। trailokyadarśanaṃ vaktre govatsāharaṇaṃ tathā । kṛtvā govatsanirmāṇaṃ brahmaṇaḥ stavanaṃ hareḥ ।। 54 ।। sahasā gokulaṃ tyavatvā puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam । bhayājjagāma nandaśca sārdhaṃ ca nandanena ca ।। 55 ।। vṛndāvanasya nirmāṇaṃ proktaṃ ca paramādbhutam । sārdhaṃ ca bālakaiḥ sārdha tatra saṃkrīḍanaṃ hare ।। 56 ।। sadannaṃ brāhmaṇīnāṃ ca bhojanaṃ kathitaṃ hareḥ । varadānaṃ ca tāsāṃ vai prāktanena nirūpaṇam ।। 57 ।। kratūnāṃ varṇanaṃ caiva vastrāpaharaṇaṃ tathā । varadānaṃ ca gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇenaiva kaṛtaṃ dvija ।। 58 ।। kātyāyanīvrataṃ proktaṃ śrīdurgāpūjanaṃ tathā । pārvatyā ca varo datto gopībhyo yamunātaṭe ।। 59 ।। tālānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ śakrayāmāvimardanam । rādhayā saha kṛṣṇasya viraho melanaṃ tathā ।। 60 ।। gopīkrīḍā ca saṃproktā kṛṣṇakroḍe ca rādhikā । chāyā rāyaṇagehe ca saṃproktā māyayā hareḥ ।। 61 ।। śṛṅgāraṃ ṣoḍasavidhaṃ kṛtvā tu rāsamaṇḍale । antardhānaṃ harereva rādhayā saha kānane ।। 62 ।। malayāgamanaṃ caiva tayā sārdhaṃ dvijottama । rādhāmādhavayoścaiva saṃvādastatra nirjane ।। 63 ।। kaivalyamapi gopīnāṃ proktaṃ nānāvidhaṃ mune । punarāgamanaṃ caiva puṇyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vanam ।। 64 ।। śrīkṛṣṇadarśanaṃ caiva gopīnāṃ harṣavarthanam । nānāprakārakrīḍā ca proktā tasya jale sthale ।। 65 ।। gopīnāmapi saubhāgyaṃ rādhāyāśca viśeṣataḥ । proktaṃ vyāsena saundarya ramyaṃ ramyaṃ navaṃ navam ।। 66 ।। nabhaḥsthitānāṃ devānāṃ darśanaṃ proktameva ca । manasaḥ skhalanaṃ caiva devīnāṃ rāsamaṇḍale ।। 67 ।। aṃśena lebhire janma devyaścoktamidaṃ dvija । akrūrāgamanaṃ caiva gopīnāṃ ca vilāpanam ।। 68 ।। proktaṃ sarvaṃ kramegaiva cākrūrabhartsanaṃ tathā । mathurāgamanaṃ viṣṇoḥ śokaṃ gokulavāsinām ।। 69 ।। rādhikāvirahajvālājālaṃ proktaṃ yathocitam । svamūltidarśanaṃ caivamakrūraṃ yamunātaṭe ।। 70 ।। mathurāveśanaṃ proktaṃ nidhanaṃ rajakasya ca । kubjayā saha saṃbhogastasyā mokṣaṇameva ca ।। 71 ।। prasādanaṃ kuvindasya mālākārasya mokṣaṇam । dhanudho bhañjanaṃ śaṃbhorhastino nidhanaṃ tathā ।। 72 ।। sabhāpraveśanaṃ proktaṃ nānārūpapradarśanam । kaṃsasya nidhanaṃ proktaṃ tadbandhūnāṃ vilāpanam ।। 73 ।। saṃskāraṃ tasya vidhivadrājatvaṃ tatpitustathā । vilāpanaṃ ca nandasya stavanaṃ paramādbhutam ।। 74 ।। proktastayośca saṃvādo nirjane tātaputrayoḥ । paramādhyātmikaṃ jñānaṃ nandāya ca dadau vibhuḥ ।। 75 ।। munīnāṃ gamanaṃ caiva dhanyopākhyānameva ca । kathitaṃ ca kumāreṇa proktameva sudurlabham ।। 76 ।। uddhavāgamanaṃ proktaṃ rādhāsthānaṃ ca nirjanam । jñānaṃ tayośca saṃvāde proktameva śubhāvaham ।। 77 ।। yajñopavītaṃ kṛṣṇasya vidyādānaṃ gṛrorgṛhe । mṛtaputrapradānaṃ ca proktaṃ tadgurave purā ।। 78 ।। jarāsaṃdhasya damanaṃ nidhanaṃ yavanasya ca । dvārakāyāśca nirmāṇaṃ viśvakārodyamaṃ tathā ।। 79 ।। dvārakāveśanaṃ proktamugrasenavilāpanam । rukmiṇīharaṇaṃ caiva nṛpāṇāṃ damanaṃ tathā ।। 80 ।। sarvāsaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca proktamudvāhanaṃ tathā । māyāvatīmokṣaṇaṃ ca nidhanaṃ śambarasya ca ।। 81 ।। dharmaputrarājasūye śiśupālasya mokṣaṇam । dantavaktrasya ca muneḥ śālvasya nidhanaṃ tathā ।। 82 ।। maṇeśca haraṇaṃ caiva pārijātasya svargataḥ । kurupāṇḍavayuddhe ca bhuvaśca bhāramokṣaṇam ।। 83 ।। ūṣāyā haraṇaṃ proktaṃ bāṇasya bhujakṛntanam । baleśca stavanaṃ proktamaniruddhasya vikramaḥ ।। 84 ।। rādhāyaśodāsaṃvādaḥ proktaḥ paramadurlabhaḥ । mokṣaṇaṃ ca śṛgālasya proktaṃ ca paramādbhutam ।। 85 ।। tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena gaṇeśapūjanaṃ tathā । darśanaṃ rādhikāsārdhaṃ kuṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।। 86 ।। rādhāyā darśanaṃ devyā rādhātejaḥprakāśanam । rādhāya ramaṇaṃ tīrthe bhramaṇaṃ rahasi smṛtam ।। 87 ।। nidhanaṃ yaduvaṃśānāṃ brahmaśāpena śaunaka । mokṣaṇaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca svapade gamanaṃ hareḥ ।। 88 ।। vivāho nāradasyaivotpattirvahnisuvarṇayoḥ । proktaṃ sarva mahābhāga punareva samāsataḥ ।। 89 ।। catuḥkhaṇḍaiḥ purāṇaṃ ca brahmavaivartameva ca । ataḥ paraṃ muniśreṣṭha kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrātumicchasi ।। 90 ।। iti śrībrahma... mahā... śrīkṛṣṇajanmakha... utta... nāradanā... anukramaṇikaṃ nāma dvātriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 132।।
<4.133> atha trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ śaunaka uvāca adhya me saphalaṃ janma cīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam । yatphalaṃ brahmavaivarte nirvighnaṃ mokṣakāraṇam ।। 1 ।। abhayaṃ dehi he vatsa he tāta mahyameva ca । tadā nivedanaṃ kiṃcidastīti ca karomyaham ।। 2 ।। sūta uvāca tyaja bhītiṃ mahābhāga praśnaṃ kuru yadicchasi । sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi yadyadgopyaṃ manoharam ।। 3 ।। śaunaka uvāca adhunā śrotumicchāmi purāṇānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam । saṃkhyānamapi teṣāṃ ca phalamasyaiva putraka ।। 4 ।। sūta uvāca vistarāṇi purāṇāni cetihāsaśca śaunaka । saṃhitāṃ pañcarātrāṇi kathayāmi yathāgatam ।। 5 ।। sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca । vaṃśānucaritaṃ vipra purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam ।। 6 ।। etadupapurāṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ । mahatāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kathayāmi te ।। 7 ।। sṛṣṭiścāpi visṛṣṭiśca sthitisteṣāṃ ca pālanam । karmaṇāṃ vāsanā vārtāmanūnāṃ cākrameṇa ca ।। 8 ।। varṇanaṃ pralayānāṃ ca maukṣasya ca nirūpaṇam । utkīrtanaṃ harereva vedānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 9 ।। daśādhikaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca mahatāṃ parikīrtitam । saṃkhyānaṃ ca purāṇānāṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ।। 10 ।। paraṃ brahmapurāṇaṃ ca sahasrāṇāṃ daśaiva tu । pañconaṣaṣṭisāhasraṃ pādmameva prakīrtitam ।। 11 ।। trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vidurbudhāḥ । caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ śaivaṃ caiva nirūpitam ।। 12 ।। grantho'ṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ viduḥ । pañcaviṃśatisāhasraṃ nāradīyaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 13 ।। mārkaṇḍaṃ navasāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ paṇḍitā viduḥ । catuḥśatādhikaṃ pañcadaśasāhasrameva ca ।। 14 ।। paramagnipurāṇaṃ ca ruciraṃ parisīrtitam । caturdaśasahasrāṇi paraṃ pañcaśatādhikam ।। 15 ।। purāṇapravaraṃ caiva bhaviṣyaṃ parikīrtitam । aṣṭādaśasahasraṃ ca brahmavaivartamīpsitam ।। 16 ।। sarveṣāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ sārameva vidurbudhāḥ । ekādaśasahasraṃ tu paraṃ liṅgapurāṇakam ।। 17 ।। caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ vārāhaṃ parikīrtitam । ekāśītisahasraṃ ca parameva śatādhikam ।। 18 ।। varaṃ skandapurāṇaṃ ca sadbhirevaṃ nirūpitam । vāmanaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kaurma saptadaśaiva tu ।। 19 ।। mātsyaṃ caturdaśa proktaṃ purāṇaṃ paṇḍitaistathā । ūnaviśatisāhasraṃ gāruḍaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 20 ।। paraṃ dvādaśasāhasraṃ brahmāḍhaṃ parikīrtitam । evaṃ purāṇasaṃkhyānaṃ caturlakṣamudāhṛtam ।। 21 ।। aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāmevameva vidurbudhāḥ । evaṃ copapurāṇānāmaṣṭādaśa prakīrtitā ।। 22 ।। itihāso bhārataṃ ca vānmīkaṃ kāvyameva ca । pañcakaṃ pañcarātrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇamāhātmyapūrvakam ।। 23 ।। vasiṣṭhaṃ nāradīyaṃ ca kāpilaṃ gautamīyakam । paraṃ sanatkumārīyaṃ pañcarātraṃ ca pañcakam ।। 24 ।। pañcakaṃ sahitānāṃ ca kṛṣṇabhaktisamanvitam । brahmaṇāśca śivasyāpi prahlādasya tathaiva ca ।। 25 ।। gautamasya kumārasya saṃhitāḥ parikīrtitāḥ । iti te kathitaṃ sarva krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak ।। 26 ।। astyevaṃ vipulaṃ śāstraṃ mamāpi ca yathāgamam । uvācedaṃ purāṇaṃ ca goloke rāsamaṇḍale ।। 27 ।। śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsākṣādbrahmāṇaṃ ca svabhaktakam । brahmā dharma ca dharmiṣṭhaṃ dharmo nārāyaṇaṃ munim ।। 28 ।। nārāyaṇo nāradaṃ ca nārado māṃ ca bhaktakam । ahaṃ tvāṃ ca muniśreṣṭha variṣṭhaṃ kathayāmi tat ।। 29 ।। sudarlabhaṃ purāṇaṃ ca brahmavaivartamīpsitam । yadvṛṇotyeva viśvaughaṃ jīvināṃ paramātmakam ।। 30 ।। tadbrahma sākṣirūpaṃ ca karmaṇāmeva karmiṇām । tadbrahma vivṛtaṃ yatra tadvibhūtimanuttamām ।। 31 ।। tenedaṃ brahmavaivartamityevaṃ ca bidurbudhāḥ । puṇyapradaṃ purāṇaṃ ca maṅgalaṃ maṅgalapradam ।। 32 ।। sugopyaṃ ca rahasyaṃ ca yatra ramyaṃ navaṃ navam । haribhaktipradaṃ caiva durlabhaṃ haridāsyadam ।। 33 ।। sukhadaṃ brahmadaṃ sāraṃ śokasaṃtāpanāśanam । saritāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā sadyo muktipradā śubhā ।। 34 ।। tirthātāṃ puṣkaraṃ śuddhaṃ yathā kāśī purīṣu ca । sarveṣu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ sadyo muktipradaṃ śubham ।। 35 ।। yathā sumeruḥ śaileṣu pārijātaṃ ca puṣpataḥ । patreṣu tulasīpatraṃ vrateṣvekādaśīvratam ।। 36 ।। vṛkṣeṣu kalpavṛkṣaśca śrīkṛṣṇaśca sureṣu ca । jñānīndreṣu mahādevo yogīndreṣu gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 37 ।। siddhendreṣveva kapilaḥ sūryastejasvināṃ yathā । sanatkumāro bhagavānvaiṣṇaveṣu yathā'graṇīḥ ।। 38 ।। bhūpeṣu ca yathā rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca dhanuṣmatām । devīṣu ca yathā durgā mahāpuṇyavatī satī ।। 39 ।। prāṇādhikā yathā rādhā kṛṣṇasya preyasīṣu ca । īśvarīṣu yathā lakṣmīḥ paṇḍiteṣu sarasvatī ।। 40 ।। tathā sarvapurāṇeṣu brahmavaivartameva ca । nāto diśiṣṭaṃ sukhadaṃ madhuraṃ ca supuṇyadam ।। 41 ।। saṃdehabhañjanaṃ caiva purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam । iha loke ca sukhadaṃ supradaṃ sarvasaṃpadām ।। 42 ।। śubhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ caiva vighnanighnakaraṃ param । haridāsyapradaṃ caiva paraloke praharṣadam ।। 43 ।। yajñānāmapi tīrthānāṃ vratānāṃ tapasāṃ tathā । bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇasyāpi phalaṃ nāsya samānakam ।। 44 ।। caturṇāmapi vedānāṃ pāṭhādapi varaṃ phalam । śrṛṇotīdaṃ purāṇaṃ ca saṃyataśceha putraka ।। 45 ।। guṇavantaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ putramālabhet । śrṛṇoti durbhagā cettu saubhāgyaṃ svāmino labhet ।। 46 ।। mṛtavatsā kākavandhyā mahāvandhyā ca pāpinī । purāṇaśravaṇāllebhe putraṃ ca ciracīvinam ।। 47 ।। aputro labhate putramabhāryo labhate priyām । aspaṣṭakīrtiḥ suyaśā mūrkho bhavati paṇḍitaḥ ।। 48 ।। rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt । bhayānmucyeta bhītastu mucyetāpanna āpadaḥ ।। 49 ।। araṇye brāntare bhīto dāvāgno mucyate dhruvam । aghaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca dāridryaṃ rogaṃ śokaṃ ca dāruṇam ।। 50 ।। puṇyavānśravaṇādeva naiva jānātyapuṇyavān । ślokārdha ślokapādaṃ vā yaḥ śṛṇoti susaṃyataḥ ।। 51 ।। golakṣadānapuṇyaṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ । yutuḥkhaḍaṃ purāṇaṃ ca śuddhakāle jitendriyaḥ ।। 52 ।। saṃkalpato yaḥ śṛṇoti bhaktyā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām । yadbālye yaccakaumāre vārdhake yacca yauvane ।। 53 ।। koṭijanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ । ratnanirmāṇayānena dhṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇarūpakam ।। 54 ।। nityaṃ gatvā ca golokaṃ kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ labhedbhūvam । asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ pāte na bhavettasya pātanam ।। 55 ।। samīpe pārṣado bhūtvā sevāṃ ca kurute ciram । śrutvā ca brahmakhaṇḍaṃ ca susnātaḥ saṃyataḥ śuciḥ ।। 56 ।। pāyasaṃ piṣṭakaṃ caiva phalaṃ tāmbūlameva ca । bhojayitvā vācakaṃ ca tasmai dadyātsuvarṇakam ।। 57 ।। candanaṃ śuklamālyaṃ ca sūkṣmavastraṃ manoharam । nivedya vāsudevaṃ ca vācakāya pradīyate ।। 58 ।। śrutvā ca prakṛteḥ khaṇḍaṃ suśrāvyaṃ ca sudhopamam । bhojayitvā ca dadhyannaṃ tasmai dadyācca ।। kāñcanam ।। 59 ।। savatsāṃ surabhiṃ ramyāṃ dadyādvai bhaktipūrvakam । śrutvā gaṇapateḥ khaṇḍaṃ vighnanāśāya saṃyataḥ ।। 60 ।। svarṇayajñopavītaṃ ca śvetāśvacchatramālyakam । pradīyate vāyakāya svastikaṃ tilalaḍḍukam ।। 61 ।। paripakvaphalānyeva kāladeśodbhavāni ca । śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ ca śrutvā bhaktaśca bhaktitaḥ ।। 62 ।। vācakāya pradadyācca paraṃ ratnāṅgulīyakam । sūkṣmavastraṃ ca mālyaṃ ca svarṇakuṇḍalamuttamam ।। 63 ।। mālyaṃ ca varadolāṃ ca supakvaṃ kṣīrameva ca । sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātstavanaṃ kurute dhruvam ।। 64 ।। śatakaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayetparamādarāt । brahmaṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraniṣṇātaṃ paṇḍitaṃ varam ।। 65 ।। kurute vācakaṃ śuddhamanyathā niṣphalaṃ bhavet । śrīkṛṣṇa vimukhādduṣṭānnopadiṣṭācca brāhmaṇāt ।। 66 ।। śrīkṛṣṇabhaktiyuktaṃ ca purāṇaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti ca । bhaktiṃ puṇyaṃ na labhate hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtam ।। 67 ।। śrīkṛṣṇabhaktiyuktācca purāṇaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti ca । bhaktiṃ puṇyaṃ ca labhate yātyante śrohareḥ padam ।। 68 ।। etatte kathitaṃ sarva yacchru taṃ guruvaktrataḥ । bidāyaṃ dehi viprendra yāmi nārāyaṇāśramam ।। 69 ।। dṛṣṭvā viprasamūhaṃ ca namaskartuṃ samāgataḥ । kathitaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ bhavatāmājñayā param ।। 70 ।। namo'stu brāhmaṇebhyaśca kṛṣṇāya paramātmane । śivāya brahmaṇe nityaṃ gaṇeśāya namo namaḥ ।। 71 ।। kāyena manasā vācā paraṃ bhaktyā divāniśam । bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma rādheśaṃ triguṇātparam ।। 72 ।। namo devyai sarasvatyai purāṇagurave namaḥ । sarvavighnavināśinyai durgādevyai namo namaḥ ।। 73 ।। yuṣmākaṃ pādadmāni dṛṣṭvā puṇyāni śaunaka । adya siddhāśramaṃ yāmi yatra devo gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 74 ।। iti śrībrahmavaivarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa uttarārdhe nāradanārayaṇasaṃvāde sūtaśaunakasaṃvāde trayastriṃdaśadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 133 ।। samāpto'yaṃ śrīmadbrahmavaivartapurāṇasthaśrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍasyottarārdhaḥ । samāptamidaṃ śrīmadbrahmavaipartapurāṇasya caturthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍaṃ śrīmadvyāsamunipraṇītaṃ brahmavaivartapurāṇaṃ ca
